These are delicious, low calorie, you can read all the ingredients, they're cheap compared to similar products and they show up on time. What more can be said?

I discovered these on a whim at a discount store and they were surprisingly delicious. They have an awesome crunch and great potato flavor. The best part was the nutrition stats: only 110 calories, 1.5 fat, and 2 fiber per ounce (which is a much larger portion than expected and very satisfying). The original flavor is very good, but could use a touch more salt. The jalapeno is also really tasty: a little sweet, a little smoky, and just a little spicy.

column9: These are great but the mix of flavors is not the best
column10: I love Smart fries so they get 5 stars. However this pack is not the best mix of the flavors. It good if you don't know what you like and want to try 1-2 bags of each different flavor. However, if you know you like certain flavors and are looking for a bunch of them you should just buy the seperate flavor packs.The flavor of the smart fries themselves are amazing. I have been using these as a subsitute for eating other salty or sweet snacks. The whoel bag is only a little over 100 calories and if you swap them out for the right cravings they are going to save you a junk load of calories.The price here is alot better then local stores that I have seen. At my work cafe they have these for about 2 dollars a bag. So anything under 1.50 would have been great but under a dollar a bag that's just awesome. I am planning on stocking up on some of the 1 flavor packs for a long road trip since these are an excellent "snacking food" when your not starving but want to munch :).

Had my first package of these today - the Cheddar.  I was surprised at how many are in the bag.  I was expecting maybe a dozen and it was easily 3-4x that. If you're looking for an alternative to potato chips and greasy stuff that's bad for you, these will do the trick. I'm trying to cut all saturated fat from my diet so having something like this to snack on or to throw a bag in my lunch is going to be great. Great flavor and texture.  Sure they aren't as filling as regular chips but that's kind of the point, right? A full bag should do the trick - it certainly did for me.

After you've had these, I guarantee, you will NOT want or crave real french fries--honestly!! I just finished off my first bag (from a case) of the "jalapeno trio." They were absolutely Deeeeee-licious and sooooo satisfying as far as crunchy-nous, salty-nous, and were very flavorful. Loved them! And, so low in calories. A full-bag with only 2 grams of fat and only 110 calories!
these are just great for dieters, they are only 100 calories per pack, great to throw in lucnch sack, and are nice and crunchy too, very flavorable too!

I bought this snack at a local supermarket and my whole family finshed the bags in 2 minutes. So I ordered a box of the 6 flavor mix and ever since then everyone has been hooked. They take a bag with them to school everyday. It is such a great, healthy snack.  They are not fried and only have 110 calories for a huge serving. These are way better then pop chips! We are all huge smart frie fans!!!!

I purchased the 24 - 1 ounce 6 flavor variety pack.  These are so light and tasty, well all are tasty except for the vintage cheese.  I found that flavor to have one awful after-taste to it (and I absolutely LOVE cheese) so the next time I order these I'll choose the 3 flavor pack instead of the 6.  It's too bad that Amazon doesn't give an option to customers to mix and match varieties.

These are nothing like french fries. When you open the bag, a bunch of little tube-shaped flavorless "potato sticks" are staring back at you. They are literally the consistency of styrofoam. Ever had cheese curls? They're the texture of that, but the exterior is smooth. It is extremely odd. Due to the smooth exterior, the "sea salt" (which I find to be remarkably similar to table salt) doesn't stick. So the entire bag is covered in salt, but very little ends up being on the actual "fry"I'm sitting here eating a bag as I type this, and honestly, it's really hard for me to finish. They don't even taste like potato. They taste like paper. Salty paper. I mean if you're into bland and tasteless food, this will be right up your ally. But there are many other healthy alternatives that taste SO much better.

column9: Sweet and spicy, tangy BBQ taste
column10: These came in the variety pack Gourmet Basics Smart Fries 6-Flavor Variety Pak, 1-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24), and were among my favorite.  I must say that all the varieties are enjoyable.  However, the BBQ, honey mustard, and plain potato chips or fries stood out in front of the assortment.  This brand's packages are much fuller than others.  The chips or fries have a sweet and spicy, tangy BBQ flavor.  I say they have more of a Memphis than Carolina style BBQ taste.  I would say they will pair with almost any kind of hearty sandwich or make a filling snack.  Yummy!
These fries are delicious.  A little sweet, a little salty...satifies my need for something crunchy. And they're guilt-free!

I was leary to order since I've been disappointed with similar types like these in the past, but to my surprise, these were GREAT!!! Just the right amount of flavor, not too little and not too overpowering...JUST RIGHT! Service was excellent. I had a slight problem with some of the bags that came in damaged, but I received another complete order free of charge with their appologies...very professional and pleasant to deal with
these are very good, and easy to take on the go.  They are light and not too salty.
These were better than I could have ever hoped.  As far as the Weight Watcher plus points goes they are 3 pp.  There are a lot in a package and they are so worth the calories and/or the points.

This is my second order of the 24 pack and I'll definitely order more when I'm done with these!  All of the flavors are great, but my favorites are Honey Mustard & Onion and Jalapeno Trio. Thanks for such a wonderful snack; I'm a fan for life!!!

column9: So glad I took the plunge and ordered!
column10: I ordered the Variety pack of 24. The only flavor I didn't care for is the Salt and Vinegar but that's only because I don't like that flavor in anything. I gave them to my grandkids and they LOVED them!!I was VERY surprised when I opened a bag and saw how many were in a 1 oz serving! WOW!!! Not like your typical lo-cal/lo-fat snack chip where you get about 10 chips and you're done. I love the texture and everything about these fries. I'm already trying to decide what flavor/flavors to reorder. This is definitely on the top of my snack list.My only suggestion is if a little bit more salt could be added to the Classic Sea Salt flavor. They didn't have quite the flavor punch I was expecting but they were still very good. I think a bit more salt would make them PERFECT!!I'm so glad I came across these fries and I'll definitely spread the word to friends and family.
I'm always looking for good tasting, low calorie snacks.  This definately fits the bill.  Thanks!!

The Japanese Juniper Bonsai Tree, grown by Eve's Garden was found to be as advertised and arrived in a timely manner.The plant was found to be sturdy and in very good health. This was a positive purchase.
Came 3 days ahead of time, couldn't be more satisfied.The plant itself was very alive and looked ready to grow.

column9: As advertised and fast shipping from Thailand
column10: I enjoyed these dry fish that shipped ahead of schedule from Thailand. Took about 2 weeks to get from Thailand to NC, I am impressed. If you have not tried dried fish before, then you may be surprised that the taste is pretty good, and it is healthier than potato chips!

The box was full of fun surprises !!! More than I expected, both my husband and I loved it and so did everyone else. The item was received very fast and in excellent condition. Would definately recommend ordering this for the hard to buy for 50 year old....Unique and different gift!

This 50th Birthday Gift Box was a big hit at the party, while it was being opened we had music from the 70's playing.  The contents of the box were exactly as expected and the retro design with the peace signs on the outside made the box stand out. No need to wrap it.  Great gift.
This candy pack is loads of fun with candy that makes you nostalgic for the "old days." The candy is delicious and it's an excellent variety.

I purchased this as a birthday gift for my friend, and what a HOOT (and a hit) it was..not only for her, but for me (Naturally, I had to check it out first) and her mother and other friends as well. This is one of those gifts that you don't want to write in because you'll want to pass it on.  GREAT idea!

What fun to open up the box of retro candy and relive our childhood.  There are some senses your taste buds never forget. It was the perfect gift for a friend celebrating her 50th birthday, nothing but fun!

This oatmeal is unlike anything I've tasted before -- and I've eaten a lot of grains in my life.  The flavor is creamy and delicious -- absolutely amazing.  It is clear that the folks at Simpli really care about their product, and their customers.  This is truly a gourmet food, and a gourmet experience.  Any lover of premium, exceptional food MUST try this!  Treat yourself -- you'll be delighted.

This particular Chili is only 70 grams of sodium per serving (2 servings per can) as compared with Healthy Valley's "low sodium" varieties which are about 490 grams per serving.A big difference for those of us who have high blood pressure.

I regularly purchase this chili.  You can heat and eat or add to soup or stews if you like.  Great addition to your already healthy diet of low sodium and organic ingredients.  I suggest you try it.  L. Smith, NC

column9: I guess you either love it or hate it--I LOVE IT!!!
column10: I love this chili.  It is really good. I don't really like salty food (I am not on a restricted diet).  This chili is great and very convenient (and ORGANIC!).  I have been eating this for years and am delighted that I can get this delivered every few months.  It is not easy to find.  Even Whole Foods has it only sporadically.

My 86 year old Dad is on a low sodium diet, so I am always looking foods that are easy to prepare and tasty.  I give this chili two thumbs down.  Although this is very low in sodium, it is overpoweringly sweet and yet flavorless.  No amount of doctoring with spices helped. Don't waste your money on this one.
I love that the salt is really low and it had a decent flavor, but its just to sweet for me.  I won't be buying again.
This chili gives vegetarian a bad name and its not because it has no salt added.  This stuff just taste bad.

Who puts 22 grams of sugar into a can of chili?  Have you ever had sugary-sweet chili?  Barf.  I guess from now on I have to check every can of chili to see how much sugar is in it.What's next?  Salty cookies?  If you love chili and you are looking for a vegetarian option, steer clear of this culinary monstrosity.

This "chili" is absolutely gross.  It has a sickly sweet flavor that reminds me of vomit, and makes your breath smell like dog food, even after brushing your teeth.  Trust me.  The only thing that can make eating it bearable is to add salt, which is fine for me but not for some.  I also add cayenne and crushed red and black pepper.  I will not reorder.  Can anyone produce healthy food that actually tastes good?

I was skeptical about box mixes. Wow, was I surprised. I added extra eggs only because I raise organic brown eggs. and a little more chocolate and the cake became outrageously great.  Guess were amazed. i baked in a cheese cake pan. looked like it came from a gourmet bakery. the taste superb. i will by over and over again. Rose

The reviewers who said the cake is flavorless or doesn't Taste good are right. Unfortunately I had already bought this sat the store and hadn't checked out the reviews and was loathed to return them.I like it because it is organic but if you are looking to impress guests this needs some modification to have the rich chocolate indulgent flavor.This is what I did and turned out tasting decadent and rich.Add an extra egg.Substitute vege oil with melted butter.Add 2-3 heapful tablespoon of unsweetened cocoa powder. (the more you add the richer it gets)I also baked at 25 degrees lower but for at least 25 mins longer in my shiny Kaiser 9" round. Cake was very moist.

I made one of these cakes this afternoon.I saw another review that said that the cooking time was too long, so I was careful to check on the cake early, to be sure that I didn't overcook it.  For my cake, the recommended time seemed to be just right.I also made the Dr Oetker Organics Organic Chocolate Icing Mix (12x11.3 OZ) to frost the cake with.To be honest, I was pretty unimpressed with the cake.  Even though I'm sure it was not overcooked, this cake is very dry.  To me it tastes a lot like a store-bought pre-made cake.  Even though I just made it a few hours ago, because it is dry it tastes a little stale, like a cake that is a few days old.  Or a store-bought cake.  The Dr. Oetker icing makes it somewhat better, but you have to be sure to get icing with every bite.It also has kind of an interesting chocolate flavor.  I think maybe the chocolate used is not from a very high quality cacao; I attended a chocolate-tasting class once, and we learned that lower-quality cacao beans are deliberately burned in processing to mask the poor quality of the chocolate.  I kind of smell and taste the burnt-cacao flavor in this cake; most people just identify that smell and taste as regular chocolate because Hersheys and other cheap chocolates all have that flavor.  Of course, just because we're purchasing an organic product does not mean that the manufacturer selects high quality cacao beans, and surely organic cacao comes in all different grades just like conventional cacao beans.  So, that is what it is.  It isn't the end of the world.  The flavor is not very rich or complex, though.I will say something about the mix that did impress me: it is not totally homogeneous.  Usually if you purchase a cake mix that's just a conventional one, the powder is very finely ground, and it all looks really uniform.  With this cake mix, when you pour it out of the bag, you can see the little sugar crystals, and I did like that, because it made it seem more like "real food".Honestly, if you can just mix up a homemade cake, you'll be happier with the result of that than you will with this.  If you desperately want the convenience of a cake mix, this product is okay, but not amazing.

This is a great blend for Italian Sausage. It makes a mild sausage with a little kick. It does 50 lbs of sausage and I make it in 10 lb batches. I measured the level of the blend(5") and with a permanent marker made lines every inch on the container for my 10 lbs of meat. I ground up my shoulders, mixed in the spices, then reground a second time. Some of the best sausage I have ever had. Tastes like NY style sausage with the fennel in it. I would recommend to anyone who is looking to save money on sausage. I estimated I have about 1.75 a pound into it where store bought is over 3.50 a pound. It is also very healthy. I will be purchasing other blends in the future to also try.

so i tried the garlic one and i made a mistake.... and didn't wear a gas mask when i used it ... i LOVE garlic but wow this is over powering in powder form when i first got it i opened it up to give it a smell and almost fell over it was like i got mased eyes tearing up nose burning regardless i bought it im trying it and i mix up some sausage and if you add water like it says it gets toned down so you can work with it after stuffing it and letting it sit for 24hrs for the casing to firm up i grilled them and im not impressed its not bad like someone just dumped a bunch of garlic powder in my sausage and no other spices i feel like it needs more flavor then JUST garlic powder i mean even salt and pepper would be nice

We followed the directions closely for a 10 lb. mix of 1/2 venison and 1/2 pork. (We did mix the seasoning directly into the meat, then added a bit of water.) We then let it sit overnight in the refrigerator.  We fried some patties up the next morning to taste test.The pepper seasoning came through, not excessively so, but it did linger a bit.  I have been known to like things hot (although my tastes have mellowed with age) and I would rate this between mild and medium.  I have tasted commercially prepared breakfast sausage that tasted hotter.  It definitely makes this a great sausage for using in spaghetti and other italian dishes.  By itself, the sausage is very flavorable.  We plan to pack 1/2 into casings and bulk store the rest for cooking Italian dishes.I do agree with one reviewer, it is a bit salty tasting and could be toned down a bit.  But, it is within the limits for a spicy sausage and will be fine used in other Italian recipes, IMHO.I would buy this again, but back off of the amount to mix into the meat (due to the salt) and add other Italian seasonings.
This some good sausage seasoning, has a great garlic taste, I use half the recommended seasoning on a 10lb mix and its just right for me. Great product
I know others like salt more than I do but I am not on a salt free diet or anything like that.  I love sausage but this was way too salty for my taste.

column9: On a 1-5 scale this is definitely a 10!
column10: This is one Awesome Flavor! Very rare! And hard to find yet the Saskatoon berry is really an old Canadian and North American Favorite. Loaded with nutrition!  Sort like a blueberry but with deep rich taste of its own. You got to try this, it's really worth buying! It has very nice consistence smooth texture and pours just right! On a 1-5 scale this is definitely a 10!  This is one very hard to find product of this type, It just maybe one of the best berries syrups I have ever tried. Topps!
Great, didn't like the strange spit like consistency, but it was still great. I imagine it would be great with yogurt.
this syrup is delicious! perfect texture, pours easily, pretty color. the flavor is very rich, very saskatoony. kind of expensive, but where else can you find saskatoon syrup?
I usually buy organic tahini, but there is none at the moment at a reasonable price. This Tahini is good quality, and i would buy it again.

The Roland Tahini is an excellent sesame paste and is delicious.I use it for all of my middle eastern favorites.The price was also right, if the product had arrived in one piece it would have been a real bargain, but one jar burst in transit.They call it a can, but they are plastic. Still a good product.

column9: The best Tahini that you can find in the US
column10: This is the best Tahini that I have used (and I tried more than 15 different brands).I used it for both making a great Hummus and Tahini

This product made great hummus and was easy to mix (I just shook the bottle before opening). This was little to no bitterness, unlike many other brands of tahini on the market. I even use it to make a very mild flavored hummus from peanuts with no problems.

I have found this tahini to be excellent for the price and we are currently using up our second order of the product.I use it primarily in hummus but it is also great in Asian noodle dishes as well. Roland tends to be a decent brand for all kinds of things but they are sometimes hard to find.

I made that silly mistake of buying a brand that I had not tasted and chose it because it was a good price.  Hummus is something I make once or twice a week, so good tahini is essential.  The batches I have made with the Roland brand have not been very good. (Not inedible, just not very tasty.)  It has a more bland taste, less nutty tasting and the texture of the hummus made with it isn't blending creamy or smooth like it should be.  I have yet to open the second jar, but I cancelled the auto-ship so I won't receive any more "less than satisfactory" tahini.

column4: FOREVER student of Life:D "Always learning co...
column9: Have it 2 or 3 X's a day Yum
column10: I have this like Almond Butter, Since I have to wait to get>SunButter Organic Sunflower Seed Spread, 16-Ounce Plastic Jars (Pack of 3)> It DOES NOT have Added Salt or Sugar! Have it with my Lunch & Dinner along with...eg Tinkyada Brown Rice Penne Pasta with Rice Bran, 16-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12) or other styles + eg RiceSelect Organic Texmati Brown Rice, 36-Ounce Jars (Pack of 4) I LOVE Quinoa egBob's Red Mill Organic Grain Quinoa, 26-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4)I Also Have with YummyReese Artichoke Bottoms, 14-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) I rinse so I don't have Too much Salt! Bon Appétit!! Explore Mix Favors ENJOY:D

column9: Best tahini I have had so far.
column10: This is thinner than some of the other tahinis I have had but the taste is so much better.  There is no bitterness at all.  I always thought it got bitter when it started going rancid but I then was finding a lot of the stuff I was buying new was bitter right off the bat so assumed that that info was wrong but now .. this is not bitter at all.  I will buy again.

I was looking forward to trying this Tahini.  It arrived without damage, however I found the taste to have an underlying bitterness. Going back to my health food store for their less economical, but better tasting, Tahini.
This Tahini is absolutely awesome.  It doesn't have a bitter taste and has a wonderful texture.  I will buy this product again.

I prefer raw tahini, but I make a raw cashew hummus and it tastes much better with roasted sesame seeds.  This is a great tasting product and I have ordered it numerous times.  My four star rating is because I prefer the flavor of raw sesame but for toasted, it is very good.
The Hoop Cheese made it all the way to Afghanistan and it was perfect. Aside from the packages being a little oily from the travel, they were wonderful!!!

column9: Taste wise it is a 6 star item
column10: The mouth says, "How do I love thee, let me count the ways..."If you like apple products a must have item.  The only draw back, shipping cost.  These are very heavy.
Arrived slightly thawed. My parents wouldn't accept it. However, the company was very helpful and issued a full refund.

The crust on these tarts are perfect.  My husband loves these, but I'm not so crazy about them.  They are just too sour/tart for my taste.  I'll eat the crust and hubby takes my filling.  My kids think they're great, so maybe it's just me.
These are absolutely scrumptuous!  My husband and I both love them, however, as another customer put it, they are expensive to ship!  The cost of shipping is more than the tartlets themselves are!
What a nice alternative to an apple pie. Love the fact there was no slicing and dicing. Easy to prepare. I also loved the fact that you can make them fresh whenever needed.

I like Creme Brulee. I loved that these were so easy. Just sprinkle on the sugar that came with and broil. They look amazing and taste great. My guess thought I really went out of the way for them when really it took all of 5 minutes. I will be ordering more!
not what I was expecting in terms of the company's reputation for excellent home delivery products

a lot of the things you give up with a gluten free diet is the TEXTURE of foods you used to love.  The spongy, slightly chewy moistness of a decadent chocolate cake is missing out of most box versions.  This one does not disappoint!I am buying a case.  It's that good.
Love the packaging and the flavor is great.  I used to get the William Sonoma brand but they stopped making them.  This is definitely a good alternative
brought my first bag back from Melbourne 7 years ago and have been ordering it ever since. The best finishing salt for fresh vegetables - steamed or raw!
longer lasting flavor and nicer softer chew than other xyltol gumsseems to be out of stock frequently.

These pretzels are evil. When my snacking comes to an end, I see flashes of myself laying on the unkempt wooden floor of an abandoned house. Scant beams of light burn between the cracks in the boards on the lone window frame, illuminating my tattered and orange-stained clothes. The sound of my body writhing over a pool of empty yellow aluminum bags, a half foot high up the empty broken walls, is quieted only by the echo of my cries of longing and despair.

column9: These are awesome, fatty, and flavorful.
column10: These little pretzel pieces are totally addictive, which is probably not a good thing because they're a lot worse for you than you'd think pretzels should be. They have around 60 fat calories and 3 grams of saturated fat in ONE ounce, which equals out to be 15% of your daily sat fat intake per serving (one ounce).The reason they're so good AND so fatty is that the mustard/onion seasoning is in an oil that permeates through the shell of the pretzel, making them extra flavorful and not dry at all. They're a little sweet, have good mustard flavor, and the onion flavor even comes through a little (they taste like they're supposed to). I try to just grab a handful at snack time and quit while I'm ahead, but I usually end up going back for more later.If you're willing to put up with a little extra fat for a lot of extra flavor, these are a perfect snack.

column9: It's like eating real hot wings!!!
column10: If you like pretzels and you like hot wings. Do yourself a favor and try these. You will not believe how much like a true hotwing they made these pretzels taste.Oh and to the 3 star reviewer who didn't like that they are hot. Umm they don't call them cool wings. They are not hot, but do have a spice to them. If you are someone that eats hotwings you will love them.

I love buffalo wings; not just the heat, but the flavor! This product, while not offering tongue-burning, sinus-clearing heat, has good bite to it. The flavor--how can I describe it? It's very addictive! I can down a whole 10 ounce package in no time. I'm not sure if I'm imagining it, but there seems to be a hint of a bleu cheese taste in there as well, which adds to the whole "hot wing" experience of the snack, in my opinion.My kids like these as well. I have to hide the bag from them sometimes just to ensure that I get my fair share.
These are delicious. Taste exactly like a buffalo wing should taste. They are not very healthy but I don't care. I love them.

I'm a girl from buffalo NY and these have true Buffalo hot wing /hot sauce flavor. I can easily eat a whole bag - although it probably would not be wise. Do yourself a favor and buy this snack! I just bought a case to give as treats to friends that enjoy a good hot wing

I've tried the Buffalo flavor and loved them.They taste great all by themselves or tossed in a salad.Then I saw they had jalapeno.Anything with jalapeno and I start drooling all over myself.I saw.I bought.I ate.I cried...they were all gone.I bought more.(Brian doing happy jalapeno dance).Delicious.Unhealthy.Who cares.......recommended.

Snyder's Honey Mustard & Onion Prezel Pieces might very well hold the title for most delicious non-candy snack item.  A large bag rarely lasts a day in my house, which isn't a good thing when they're pretty caloric.  They're so delicious you just want to stuff a whole handful in your mouth and slowly suck the flavor out of them, crunching on the remains as you look like a mad squirrel.I would go as far as to say that you could eat these every day and not get tired of them.  I would replace every meal of the day with these things if I wasn't afriad of them giving me heart disease.Try them once and you'll be hooked.  I have tried the other flavors since some stores run discounts, none of the other flavors were anywhere near as good as the Honey Mustard & Onion.  Buttermillk Ranch is ok, but you can't top Cool Ranch Doritos.  Cheddar Cheese wasn't good at all, and Buffalo Wing was hard to eat (flavor makes your hands all nasty).

There are many types of honey mustard pretzel but the Snyder Honey Mustard pieces are the best most flavorful and satisfying to me others just don't compare and are lightly flavored in comparison.  I LOVE them.

This is a kind of pretzel that will make your taste buds tingle, if you honestly don't like pretzels much at all, you will love them after you try these pretzels.  They are the most excellent tasting pretzels around.  I would strongly inform people to try these amazing pretzels.

Bought a trial bag at a local market.  Taste is very addicting.  The whole family loved it, even the little ones.  Bought bulk at Amazon and spread the wealth to other family members, co-workers, and friends.  All seem to enjoy this flavor and texture quite nicely.  Good price at Amazon and 12 pack is gone in no time.
Love them! Gotta have them! They really are good especially if you like HOT treats!

If you like Buffalo Wings, You'll love these. I can't believe how they can make a pretzel taste so much like a buffalo wing. These are GREAT!If you haven't tried them yet, do yourself a favor and try them today.
Everyone in the family (and my daughter's friends) like these.  Even though you get 12 bags they don't last long.  Need to refill every few months.

Snyder's of Hanover Hot Buffalo Wing Pretzel Pieces, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12) If you like pretzels, buffalo wings, heat and salt you will love these.  They are a product that actually delivers on their promises.  They are hot and spicy, but not in the bland heat just to say they are spicy of so many other products.  These have the heat and the vinegar tang of actual buffalo chicken wings.  I love them.  Unfortunately they don't last long at our house.  Once a bag is opened they are gone as the burst of heat you get from them is addictive. The only downside aside from the speed at which they get eaten is the orange fingers you get from them.  But that is a small price to pay for entrance into flavor heaven.

I found the Butermilk Ranch Pretzel Pieces while on a trip to Texas a couple years ago.  My family and I feel in love with the flavor as well as the crunch.  But, to our dismay, that particular flavor was almost impossible to find in our state of Connecticut.  I found the web site and Voila!!!! Twelve scrumptious bags of the tasty treat.

I am huge pretzel lover.These in my opinion, are the best tasting pretzels out there.They are TRULY finger licking good.  Everybody I know who has tasted them raves about the flavor.  I don't think you could have found a better combination of flavors to add to a pretzel.  I've tried Hanover's other flavors but they don't come near this all time favorite.  I did have to stop buying and eating them because of health reasons, but when I did eat them, I would not be without any in  my house.

Honey mustard and onion was so good I wanted to try more flavors...buttermilk ranch tasted more like a pickle than ranch.  I hate to throw food away but I just couldn't eat them.  Like I said though honey mustard and onion are great, just don't kiss anyone after eating them.

These are pretty good and these are not low calorie..they are about the same as potato chips....so they are not like regular pretzels....get em on sale in Amazon Warehouse and then go make some friends.

I just love these pretzels.  There was only one bag on the shelf at the store today and I nearly had a heart attack!  Totally panicked thinking "Oh no what if they have discontinued them"  I sure hope they never will!

column9: The best pretzel snack you can buy.
column10: These are absolutely mouth-watering.  About 10 nibblers will cost you:-130 calories-3 grams of fat(1.5 sat. fat.) - no trans fat95 mg sodium (just 4% dv)3g protein (amazingly you get protein out of this)Less than 1g sugars23g carbs (8% DVAlso has 10% DV or less of: Iron, Riboflavin, Folate, Niacin, Thiamin.With the taste this good and nutrional value so great, this might make you ditch the fatty chips and start buying these.  I don't even feel guilty about over-eating these from time-to-time.  I solute Snyder's for making these!

A few words that come to mind.....amazing, wonderful, astonishing, delicious, fantastic, and delightful.  Thank you Snyder's of Hanover for these pretzle pieces bravo!These are the next best thing to an actual Buffalo chicken wing!

These taste great and they are my snacking weakness! however, they get on my nerves because the non-uniformaly shaped pieces exhibit the brazil nut effect where granular particles of similar/equal density tend to be on top aka the larger pretzel pieces tend to be in the first handful but as you eat more the smaller ones are always on the bottom of the bag no matter what you do. frustrating but unavoidable. just be aware.snyder should get a better pretzel chipper machine or whatever they use and keep the size consistent! if it works for potato chips why can't it work for pretzel???

I don't like pretzels and was hesitant about trying these but omg they are gooood!! I couldn't taste the actually pretzel, just the hot wing. I love this and definitely adding to my favorite snacks. The honey mustard isn't bad either but hot wings are #1!
These are not sold in stores where I live, so I had to order them online.  They are the best pretzels ever, we eat them all the time.

Snyder's of Hanover Cheddar Cheese Pretzel Pieces, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12) package claims these pretzels are bursting with flavor. I agree with this claim, my family agrees with this claim, my son's family agrees with this claim; as a matter of fact, everyone I've shared these pretzels with agrees with this claim.These are hard, sourdough pretzel pieces.  I'd guess the average size is 1/2" x 3/4" - 1"  of all different shapes because they are randomly broken. I ordered these using Amazon's subscribe & save program which brings the price down to less than I'd pay in the supermarket. Twelve packages are a lot. I share them with my family & friends.Nutrition Facts:1 oz. or approx 1/3 cup serving = 130 caloriesTotal fat 6g~Saturated fat 3.5g~Trans fat & Cholesterol 0Sodium 260 mg (11% of your daily value)Total Carbs 18g~Fiber less than 1g~Sugars less than 1gProtein 2gVitamin A, C, & Calcium 0Iron & Niacin each 6%Riboflavin 8%Thiamin 10%Folate 20%I can't really describe the flavor so I thought I'd list some of the ingredients which make up the 'burst of flavor.' Included in the ingredients: Cheddar cheese, buttermilk powder, onion powder, tomato powder, spice, nonfat dry milk, garlic powder, turmeric extract, annatto extract, & paprika extract.Allergy info: These are produced in a facility that handles peanut butter.Warning...very addicting!!!

column9: Jalapeno: Awsome Tase, can only eat 5 at a time...
column10: There is 3,800 MG of sodium in this entire 10oz bag, that's alot of salt. It's very salty, its unnessary for the flavor, but hey, its awsome when you eat like 5 pieces, than another 5 an hour later. I reccomend these

These taste great and arrived well packaged.  However, be prepared to eat these in a hurry - the expiration date was only 2 weeks away when they arrived. Eat quickly or throw away.  Amazon really needs to improve this problem.
Excellent product, received promptly and fresh when opened. However, I found it was priced about the same as in Walmart. I expected more of a price bargain when ordering in bulk.

Love this snack!  Snyder's of Hanover Cheddar Cheese Pretzel Pieces, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)Cannot find it locally any more so Amazon is my go-to store.  Ordering is easy & convenient, price is comparable to stores, delivery is quick.
excellent product, however high in salt, but I love them...recommend to allpeople who like spicy stuff..
these pretzels are so great! i purchased them for my husband because we can no longer find them in the grocery store. i highly recommend them to anyone who likes spicy foods.
I bought a bag for our road trip and everyone just dived into it till it was all gone. Nobody could stop, even those who don't usually like pretzels. It's savory with a hint of sweetness. Yum.
Although these are really excellent by themselves, I use them as croutons on my daily salad.  Totally wonderful.  It just wouldn't be a great salad without them.

As a rule, Snyder's just makes the best pretzels, hands down.  They've been making them for 100 years now and well, there's a reason they're still in business!  These are great - they disappear rather quickly.  My only complaint is that they're small and very hard so they scrape the roof of your mouth.  Other than that, they're the best tasting things out there.  Highly recommend!

column9: You can't eat just a handful!
column10: These are the best pretzel snack out there.  The broken pieces really soak up the flavor which a whole pretzel would not.And what everybody else said!

column9: WILL EAT WHOLE BAG AT ONE SITTING !
column10: Goodness, these are soooo good. the most tastiest snack on the planet. It lights up your eyes. and you go YUMMMMM. and you cant stop. they are addicting !  There must be a cult fan club over this particular snack if there isnt one already. Get someone to try it who never had it before. They will be addicted as well.
These are awesome tasting, like authentic Ranch dressing, but dont eat too many in one sitting as the flavour can overpower!
These are spicy and salty, and highly addictive if you don't worry about the salt content. I am sure after the case of 12 I will die of kidney damage one day. But they are that good.

My son discovered these somehow so we purchased some from the grocery store. Yummy. Very salty (but not as much as the buffalo wing flavor), and yes, not as "good" for you as the regular pretzel, but hey, they taste 10 times better. Bag gone in 10 minutes. Thanks to the other reviews I now have no fear getting the box of 12...

Snyder's are the best quality pretzels, in my opinion.  The fact that they have been around for 100 years speaks for itself.Also as a retail convenience store I get my supply from Amazon because the price is right.  On Subscribe and Save I make over 40% at retail price as oppose to the 25% I use to with a local middle man distributor.
Oh Glorious day when I found the best snack treat on Amazon.  Just like hot wings, except in pretzel form.  No longer have to wait for the store to get in stock, I can order online now.
These pretzels are wonderful.  The heat is present but not overpowering.  My 4, 7, and 13 year old kids love them.  Try using them in your "famous name cereal" party mix.  It makes a big difference!
I tried these as I had already ordered the regular Snyder's pretzels.  They are very good and very hot.!  If you don't like "hot stuff" they are probably not for you.

column9: A little broken up but the taste is GREAT!
column10: I really loved  Snyder's of Hanover Cheddar Cheese Pretzel Pieces, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12).  The taste is fabulous and texture is crunchy.  Mine arrived a little broken up but that doesn't change the great taste.  Just smaller bits to nibble on!  Wish I could put this order on automatic!

If you are in the mood for good eats (ok maybe Alton Brown can charge me for that) try these jalapeno pretzels. They are very good, not too hard and great flava flav. And it's really true you get 12 packages.
It can be hard to find this flavor in the grocery stores; I made sure to stock up.

Who knew they could put buffalo wings in a bag?  These pretzel pieces are absolutely wonderful . . . and  . . . a-hem . . . less fattening than actual chicken wings.  All the glory, less fat!  Yummy!  Yummy!  Yummy!
I am hopelessly addicted to these jalapeño pieces. Someone help me. I need some kind of medication to wean me off of them.
I tried it in a party and found it very tasty.  It is kind of oily, though.
Taste is good.  Received the product on Oct. 22nd, 2009, but ALL 12 bags expires on Nov. 29th, 2009.  Only 38 days to eat them all or give away.  I will NOT order again.

column9: Great, but 11 of the 12 bags came.
column10: These pretzels are very tasty when you crave a salty, mild cheddar cheese flavor. They are crunchy and hard, which I love. But, the box was one bag short (11 out of 12).

Very flavorful, jalapeno is a fantastic concept for Pretzels. Random bags yield random results, the first pretzel in your mouth is an awesome experience, for the most part.But, for crying out loud, why do they have to add an YEAR'S WORTH OF SALT in one friggin bag?!! It's not consistent, sometimes you get lucky with the top portion of the bag when it's not all that salty, but by the end of one bag, you do get the feeling that you have consumed an ocean's salt content. Why this idiocy? When all one craves for is the taste of spicy jalapeno? The sucker that I am, I eat the first couple of pretzel pieces and then throw the whole bag away, it's serious sodium poisoning if you do consume the whole bag.

column9: Not the best Snyder's of Hanover Pretzels
column10: Snyder's of Hanover makes good pretzels (Honey Mustard & Onion is my favorite), but these are just not appetizing at all.  "Hot Buffalo Wing" gets its kick from dried cayenne pepper sauce.  So if you are a fan of peppers you might like this pretzel.  They are nowhere near as good as Honey Mustard in my opinion, though they aren't as bad as just cheddar cheese.  Hot Buffalo seems to be enhanced by eating them with other food, in my case, chocolate M&M's.  If you like a spicy zing, try these pretzels, they are not horrible.  If you like sweetness just stick to Honey Mustard & Onion.  Nutrition-wise, are not the best as they contain MSG and caramel color.  Also, if you consumed an entire 10 oz. bag in one sitting, you would be consuming 1400 calories.  I guess their good if you are trying to gain weight like I am trying to do.  Otherwise stick to the healthier counterpart of the unflavored ones.
the "hot wing" pretzels were hot. if you like hot things you will like these.

column9: Knock off brand made from Concetrate
column10: Not made in USA as stated. This is NOT made by "Florida's Natural", Amazon has the wrong information listed.  It is a knock off brand by a company called "Florida's Natural GROWERS PRIDE".  Bottom of can states:"Product of ARGENTINA, made from concentrate".

these are very good but they are not my favorite. these are good for a change. they add a little bit of variety to the menu. my favorites are the "amish kitchen noodles wide & extra wide". those are really delicious. they are unbelievable delicious with mashed potatoes. i will eat these noodles up though. they will not go to waste.

Since Rib-It went out of business, we had a tough time finding another sauce we loved until we found Bone Suckin sauce.  We prefer the flavor of the 'hot' variations even though the flavor isn't really hot...it's kinda sweet with a tang (but not overly sweet like a brown sugar or honey bbq sauce).The thicker style is nice to get a good bbq sear on the grill.  The normal sauce is very thin and is basically great as a dip, marinade or mix-in.  But this thicker style can definitely stand on it's own!

I tried a different brand of lemon juice and lemon oil from Italy, and liked it. This one is cheaper, but there is a reason for that. I suspect my other brand has a higher dose of the oil, or comes from tastier lemons. My batch expires in December, but can it be that DeLallo uses the European way of writing a date, where JULY 12th, 2012 would read 12/7/2012? Maybe I was sent a batch that is expired.

This product is perhaps a half-cut below that of the similar Sicilia Brand product, but way ahead of any other such product (Goya, Realemon, etc.  The taste is close to that of freshly squeezed lemon juice, but just a tad off - there is a slight hint of a taste which I can best describe as that of a very good lemon gumdrop mixed in with the natural lemon flavor.You need to be careful about reading labels on such products. The Sicilia brand uses sulpher dioxide as a preservative. Sulpher dioxide, in small quantities, is harmless to most people, but can trigger a serious allergic reaction in a small percentage of people. I cannot tell from the information here whether that preservative is used. It's never bothered me at all, but people should be careful about such things.What I can vouch for is that this product has a very pleasant taste and is very easy to use.
Expected stronger lemon flavor so have to use a lot to really taste the lemon.  Not terrible but pretty mediocre...

column4: C. Lane "Be the change you want to see in the...
column10: Has the most wonderful fragrance!  You'll think you just sliced open a lemon.  I'm hooked on this product.
Not as good as a fresh lemon, but close.  The best part of it is the convenience of it.  You can just open the cap and squeeze.  Also, it's a perfect size they come in.

column9: I love this K-cup holder so much I bought a second one!!
column10: I don't like to have a lot of kitchen counter clutter so I was so happy to find this product.  I read a bunch of the reviews ahead of time so I went ahead and secured it with the screws so it wouldn't go anywhere.  I love this thing so much that I bought a second one so both my husband and I can have our own coffees in our own holders. The design is sleek and I love being able to have a bunch of different flavored coffees right by my Keurig without having a pile of different boxes on the counter.The one tip I would like to pass on is to open and close the holder by using the front bar only.  Otherwise it can go up cockeyed and not close up flat.

Bought the smaller one for the wife.  Mounting is a breeze.  I went ahead and used the screws to insure it wasn't going anywhere.  Perfect way to store your K cups without taking up a drawer or more counter space.  It tucks them away nicely out of site under the cabinet.  Highly recommend this unit.

Very nice item. The BUT is about the self (non)sticky tape provided. Had it installed about my wine glasses. In the middle of the night it fell down. It comes with screws USE THEM!!!Will look for another though.
These are great.  I purchased 3 of them.  One for coffees, one for teas, and one for specialty drinks.  I like that these are not sitting on my cupboard taking up space.  Well made

This was easy to install. After reading other reviews I decided to use the included screws. The bottom of my cabinet has a rough texture so I doubt the adhesive would have held very long. I did use it to keep the rack in place while I screwed it in. I love that it keeps my countertop clutter free. This is by far the best storage for k cups!

column9: BEST Storage option for kcups, IMHO.
column10: I love this storage option for kcups.  The rack mounts EASILY under a cabinet with included 3M adhesive and/or included screws.  The rack efficiently uses what is normally wasted space under the cabinet and frees up valuable counter space.  Once installed and filled only the very bottom of the kcups are visible.  It pulls down and pushes up smoothly, and there are tiny, strong magnets that hold it closed.  If you have limited space, you won't regret this purchase.

Dear coffeekeepers:Thank you for your generous donation to our United Way Silent Auction.  It is due to company's like coffeekeepers that the United Way can continue to strive and help those in need.Sincerely,Carolyn LawFederal-Mogul Corporationhttp://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B005F0JM7W/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_title

Ordered this product based on reviews and am not disappointed.  It clears the clutter from my counter but the K-cup selection is at our fingertips.  I'd order a second one except this one took nine days to process and be delivered.  The product origin point was two hours from my home and took six days to be delivered.  That type service doesn't deserve to be rewarded with a follow up order.Follow-up:  Our family of four liked this so well that my daughter ordered the second one using her membership upgrade.  It came from a different location and shipping was better.  This installs quickly, used the screws provided and they both work great.  We keep flavored coffees, etc., in one and plain coffee in the other. It's easy to keep a supply and variety readily available yet out of sight!

column9: Easy to Install and hides out of the way
column10: Great Product for clearing the counter of boxes while leaving plenty of K-cups near our Keurig. Easily Mounts under cabinet with 4 wood screws.

This product was very easy to install and works great!  I followed a recommendation from another reviewer and used the screws to install it.  This does a great job of keeping you k-cups organized and out of the way.  If you're short on counter space, this is a perfect addition to your kitchen.
IF YOU OWN/BUY A KEURIG, IT IS A MUST-HAVE!  BUY IT IMMEDIATELY! I have one and am buying another - it's totally hidden,operates smoothly - it's a fantastic product!

I don't like messy counters or appliances take up all my counter space.  The Kuerig does a good job of consuming space, and most of the storage for K cups appear to do the same.  I was originally going to make wall mountable shelf to store some, but the Coffee Keeper seems to better fit my need.It has double sided tape preapplied for a quick and easy installation (also some alcholol swabs to prepare the surface before applying).  Directions were simple and clear.  It also included optional screws (I thought about using them, but the tape is more than sufficient when given time to bond).It's a clever, useful, and evidently unique solution to K cup storage.There are two small cons I'd like to point out, which hopefully they correct in future versions.The one I received was a bit tight to pull down, obviously they should not be loose enough to drop on their own, but to pull down with a single finger would be nice.In fact a little pull tab in the front to grab on to would be very beneficial, rather than having to find and pull down on the edge/lip (which is hidden by your cabinet). I thought about deducting a star for this, but I've been told they will be adding it in the future and frankly it's still pretty darn convenient.

Opted for the smaller rack that fit well under the cabinet. Rack works well, free's up counter space and always draws positive comments from guests. Would like to install a second one but is unavailable.
I bought two of these. Easy to install and works great. The only problem is now my wife is buying more K-cups.

I love this Under Cabinet K-cup holder.  It fits snuggly under the counter.  I can't stand lots of "stuff" on my countertops, so this clears up my countertops. So far it seems well made and haven't had any problems.  Would definity buy this again.  It may be a bit pricey but it is exactly what I wnated

This product works just as described.  It is not too flimsy and appears to be sturdy enough for everyday household use.  One word of caution--if you use the adhesive strips they are VERY sticky and you cannot easily remove it.  Make sure it is exactly where you want to mount it when using the adhesive strips.  We also used the included screws as an added measure.

I received the under cabinet K-Cup holder promptly.  The packaging was a simple plastic bag, but it included everything need from instructions to alcohol cleaning pads and screws.Install was simple.  Clean the underside of the cabinet with the alcohol wipes and allow to dry.  Peal back the double sided tape already attached to the holder.  Press it up and into the underside of the cabinet.  Hold for 60 seconds.  Screw in the supplied screws.My only complaint was that my item was slightly bent/malformed.  I fixed this with some light taps of a hammer and I squared everything up.Overall, I am very happy with this product and it saves counter space.

I absolutely love this under cabinet K-cup dispenser. It gives me more counter room and is almost hidden. What a great idea! I found it on Amazon.com and am amazed each time I use it. My husband installed it for me quickly and easily. It came with screws and it's wonderful. It iss easy to pull down to choose the K-cup I or my guests want, and just as easily, is pushed up again under my cabinet. I highly recommend this dispenser for anyone who wants more counter space or even just wants to have the most innovative design available.

Ordered two of these to rid clutter off my counter.  Fairly easy installation; just remember to check direction of the pulldown and closeness to any contact walls, husband forgot to do this twice and had to change afterwards.  Not easy to do but he managed.  Received lots of compliments from visiting family and friends plus wanting to know where to purchase one too. Enjoy not having clutter on counter and this does the job. Only gave 4 stars as the directions were a little too simplistic.

This is the best Kcup holder I have seen . We mounted it and have had very good complements from everyone about how well it keeps the Kcups out of the way. I recomend this to anyone with a Kcup storage problem.
perfect......size, quality and appearance.....works easy but must use the screws to install, not anything of lesser degree.......gives a nice clean line.

This little device has been a lifesaver in my house. I have told so many of my friends about it, who are sad because it doesn't ship to Canada. Luckily, my boyfriend was in NC for work and I had it sent to him there. When you come to Canada - be warned - this will take off! :)

I love this k-cup holder. I don't have a lot of counter space, and I couldn't get one of the ones that sits under the Keurig because my shelves are a bit low. So this was perfect for us. I've had it a few months and it works like a charm. I mounted using the screws because the adhesive didn't hold well enough. I didn't not want the worry of the whole unit coming down everytime I gave it a pull. The screws are under the shelf, so it's not like anyone will ever see under there. I highly recommend this product. The only downfall is you can totally see the bottoms of the cups, but that's to be expected. That's something the maker and the customers can't really get around.
This is the ideal rack for k-cups. it is especially good if you have limited counter space. Installation is a breeze.

First- let me tell you these are the ONLY way to store K-Cups!!!Easy to install, well designed and made to last.The company who makes them offers fantastic customer service, too.These were sold out when I originally tried to purchase them. I inquired directly aboutavailability and was told they'd email me as soon as they were in stock. A couple weeks later I got the email,went directly to Amazon- where they were still sold out. Tried again in a half hour and bought two.I'm about to purchase a few more as gifts, don't wait for Christmas when demand will skyrocket!

You gotta love this gadget. Keeps my k-cups in order - - not in my cabinet, not on the counter, not in the pantry . . . r i g h t above and to the left of my keurig coffee maker.  The ONLY reason I did not give it 5 stars was because I wanted it all to be hidden . .  however the space under the upper cabinet is slightly shallow so you can see 1/2 of the k-cups in their slots.  No fault of the gadget, just be aware it will only hide the cups if the depth of the aforementioned cabinet is deeper than the standard.  New kitchen cabinets are in my future . . . and I know that this space needs to be about 1/2" more than standard if it continues to bother me.

LOVE this k cup holder, worth every penny I spent on it! It fits under my cabinet perfectly and have had no issues with the tape. It does come with screws, I just haven't got around to putting them in yet.

This K-cup holder is an EXCELLENT alternative to the carousel holders to get all your extra k-cups out of the way. Easy to install and you don't even see the k-cups under the cabinet! I followed the advice of other reviewers and installed it with the screws. This holder also holds my eKoBrew cups. Highly recommend.
This is a great product. Easy to install and such a space-saver. It fit easily under my counter and holds more cups than other solutions I've found.
This works perfect if space is limited.  I actually bought two because if you're like me, 30 kcups close by just isn't enough.  Anyway, love it but just a little expensive for such a simple solution.

The most ingenious design of any k-cup holder!! So convenient-especially for those of us with limited counter space. Sturdy construction and easy to install. Best purchase I've made this year. Even my hard to please husband was impressed!!
Great storage fits in a small spot, easy to install with a screw driver.  Can't be seen from face of cabinet.
I bought 3 of these and love them.  They keep my counters cleared and now I can keep an assortment available.

Keeps the cups off the counter!! It is a very well made sturdy product. It is a little stiff to pull down but but I'd rather that than falling down by it's self.  We used the included screws to make sure it stays up. We are very pleased.

I have to say i bought this item with some apprehension but when it arrived I was happy. The item doesn't come in any packaging except a plastic bag, hmmm, bit odd, but its not made of plastic itself its actually metal, very sturdy. Now my main concern was that I ordered it and my wife said how does it fix to the units, I replied by sticky pads. Very, very pleased. Highly recommend this for your K-cups.

column9: Under Cabinet K-cup® Holder. Designed for Keurig's® K-cups®- Elite
column10: So PERFECT!!!I don't drink coffee my husband does and I use basically all of my counter top and I just hated to wast so much space for his kcups...and then I found this....it was sold out the first time I saw it, and when I saw it stocked again I bought it..got it yesterday, and im so glad i did! I love it. I think I might buy a 2nd one for extra storage to go right next to the one I have! GREAT PRODUCT!!!!!

I searched and searched for a k-cup holder to keep them off my limited counter space, and this is it! Now this is genius!
Space saver is the best part of this design. The price and quality are exceptional. Everyone with K-cups would like this.

This product is simply ingenious. It's important to me that my kitchen is uncluttered - and with limited space to start, I have to get creative. column9: The Best Solution for K-cup Storage
column10: This is a fantastic idea and the ONLY solution for storage of K-cups without taking up valuable counter or drawer space. An excellent good quality product that works as advertised - thank you for creating it!! P.S. I used the 4 screws for added security and they installed without the use of a drill!

Their customer service exceeded my expectations and the holder is great.  Can't wait to show everyone.
A+ no problems and arrived in timely manner, would deal again.That iis all I have to say about this item.

The storage tray is a bit hard to move and will easily stay at any angle you pull it down to (even crooked). Each arm moves independently.  It's a great product just use common sense when you choose where to mount it.

column9: The BEST way to keep kcups available!
column10: I'm very pleased with item, and highly recommend it. It's the perfect way to store your K cups without taking up countertop space. Mounting was easy, altho USE THE SCREWS. Do you remember that old commercial from the 1970's that was later spoofed in the movie "Airplane?" A couple has just finished dinner when their host offers the visiting husband a second cup of coffee. When he happily accepts, his wife gets a concerned look on her face and thinks, "Jim never has a second cup at home," suggesting that the coffee she makes in her own kitchen must taste like swamp water.Well, Jim and I had that in common. I NEVER had a second cup of coffee. Don't get me wrong - I LOVE coffee, but unless I was cramming for a mid-term at 3:00am in college, I'd never found a cup that was good enough to warrant more. But that all changed when I discovered Douwe Egberts.I'm probably the only person here who isn't Dutch and hasn't had this coffee in the Netherlands. In fact, my first experience with Douwe Egberts was in Las Vegas - I just didn't know what it was called.I LOVE Las Vegas and make the trek 3-4 times a year. For the past few years I've stayed at the Paris Hotel and had breakfast/lunch in their buffet (Lunch is served at 11, so if you get there at 10:30, you can have their amazing breakfast AND lunch for the price of breakfast!) The coffee was the best I'd ever had - no kidding. I'd have cup after cup and couldn't get enough! I'd be more hyped-up and jittery than a washer on spin-cyle, but I didn't care - the coffee was THAT good! After several trips and regardless of the hotel, it got to be that I'd HAVE to make it over to the Paris - JUST FOR THEIR COFFEE. But every time I'd ask the server what kind it was, they'd never tell me. Then one trip I found a server who was from my home town. After schmoozing her for a while, I finally got her to give it up. She went in the back and returned with the name scrawled out on a meal ticket. Yes, it was this nectar from the gods, Douwe Egberts! Perfectly blended and roasted, I promise you won't find a better cup of coffee - even in Seattle. It is a bit pricey (I get this same package at a local Dutch store for $6.20), but if you think about what you pay for a "gourmet" cup of coffee at the corner Starbucks, this is a bargain.Take my word for it. Splurge a little and see if you don't agree with me. Or if you want to just try a single cup before you blow the whole $8 on a half pound, you can always fly to Vegas and get some from the Paris buffet which I also highly recommend, but we'll save that for another review.

It let you see that there is more to Holland than Cheeses, wooden shoes, tullips and windmills. Yes, there is also coffee. Try dunkin'a bisquit in it preferably a 'speculaasje'

Our three cats are enthusiastic about Pounce cat treats, so we expected them to be equally enthusiastic about Greenies.  They were not.They each tried three treats and then left.  Our long-haired orange male left to throw up his treats, but being a long-hair, he throws up from grooming his fur so much.  I do not necessarily attribute the vomiting to Greenies.I did search for menadione sodium bisulfite (MSB) as another reviewer suggested, but I did not find in my search that menadione sodium bisulfite (MSB) is a poison.  Menadione is an irritant in its pure form and irritates skin and mucous membranes, but the study I read indicated no adverse effects from menadione sodium bisulfite (MSB)in animal studies.We won't be buying Greenies again because of the lukewarm reception it received, but, if your cat likes it, I wouldn't worry about the menadione sodium bisulfite (MSB) it contains.  It might be a problem if that was all your cat ate, but treats are treats, not standard diets, and should be given in only small amounts.

We received a free sample of Feline Greenies in the mail today from PETCO. Our 13 indoor cats gobbled the entire 1-oz. package in less than 10 minutes. Even our finicky eaters loved them. We are very careful pet owners, double-checking every ingredient in anything that they eat (in the same way that we watch our own food). Unfortunately, I fed first and checked later (something that I have NEVER done before and will never do again)!Imagine my dismay when I found menadione sodium bisulfite in this product. This toxic, unapproved ingredient has no business in our pet food. Its use is prohibited in many European countries, and our own FDA won't approve it.We have requested that PETCO discontinue the sale of this product immediately, until the manufacturer removes this poison.If you love your cats, you will not feed this product to them. Just do a web search for "menadione sodium bisulfite (MSB)". You'll be a better cat owner, that's for sure . . .

LOL.  "Imagine my dismay" ... OK.First of all, this product is intended as a treat, not a meal.  A little candy now and then isn't going to kill anyone.I agree, the ingredients could be better.  I am not a fan of the corn or gluten -- especially as I make a point to feed my cat nothing but grain-free raw food.  Greenies could choose better ingredients - such as potatoes, perhaps instead of corn & gluten - to hold their product together.  It doesn't contain by-products, though, and the first ingredient is chicken meal, so it's not *terrible*.  I wouldn't feed this product if it were a meal.  But it's a treat.  A little won't hurt.  Unless your cat is allergic to corn or gluten (as many are) -- then stay away from this product!The serving size is outrageous.  I don't feed my cat more than 5 a day.  That's plenty.I have yet to see if it actually does anything for my cat's teeth.  Remove tartar?  Doubtful.  These little kibble-bits break together with a little force from my fingers - they won't likely scrape off years of tartar build-up.I've heard great things, though, and they come highly recommended from my vet.  The whole reason I got them was because of the dental benefits -- these came listed as the #1 choice among all other "dental treats".It took awhile to get my cat to crunch down on these, but eventually he did.  It's funny, after feeding your cat raw, they tend to forget that kibble is food - which it barely is.  That's why it's a treat.

The label now reads "Perfect Pinch Cajun, natural, no MSG" and ingredients are now: "Salt, spices (including black pepper, thyme, and red pepper), paprika, garlic, onion, and celery seed."  While I'm happy the ingredients are still all natural, the celery seed and black pepper really throw both the taste and smell off.The Amazon listing does include a legal disclaimer stating: "Actual product packaging and materials may contain more and different information than what is shown on our website", but I really wish the description matched the product sold.So before anyone else buys six jars of this stuff, beware, you are not going to get the product as described.

Very tasty, though not very salty.  I was pleasantly surprised that it adds so much flavor without going crazy with the sodium, since I have high blood pressure.  I bought it for a fried turkey but now use it in many foods.

This isn't as hot as some of the hot sauces I have tried. However, this one has the best taste for the scovel units. So this is the best bang for the heat and flavor combined. You will not find anything hotter with this kind of flavor. Great stuff.

I ordered this item specifically because it is the new packaging.  I received the old packaging, which also does not taste like the one that is pictured.  I sent a message to Amazon and have not heard a response.  I am curious as if I should just dispute the charge being as I do not have the option of returning it?
not much to say except that this taste's the same as the Campbell's Tomato that I remember as a kid...mixed with skim milk it comes out thick and tasty...a GREAT treat on a cold winter's day..!!

ONLY bombilla that works -- all my S. American friends agree.  And in the last year, 9 impressed N. American house guests have asked me to get them one.-- suction is always good because there are no cracks to leak-- seldom a tea leaf in your mouth-- cleans quickly, easily and thoroughly-- the stainless steel eliminates the metallic taste or tarnish that others havePLEASE KEEP MAKING THIS BOMBILLA AVAILABLE TO US!  I won't waste more money on any other kind.  EcoTeas Stainless Steel SPRING BOMBILLA.

column9: Only Received One and It's Mediocre
column10: Amazon only sent me one of them.  They did work with me to make up for their mistake, though.This bombilla is made of relatively light-weight but strong stainless steel and is easy to clean.  That's about all there is good about it.  It might work okay with large-cut leaf-only yerba (like Eco-Teas) or yerba/teas with very little powder and only larger stems, if any.  In my experience it does not work well with yerba with a lot of powder and/or finely-cut leaves & stems.  Perhaps my pull through the straw is too aggressive, but I would end up with a fair amount of fine leaves/stems in my mouth, at least until the yerba settled into the mate after a few cycles.I guess you get what you pay for, except I thought I was buying two and received only one.  Buyer beware of possible disappointment on two levels.

The chips arrived in great condition... hardly any breakage (much better than in the grocery store).  My husband just LOVES these chips with wine.  The price is very reasonable.  We purchased the chips because we couldn't find them in the Minnesota... and we got hooked on them in Arizona.  We may just purchase them from here again even when we're in Arizona where they're available in grocery stores.Thanks!

I was surprised at how delicious these toasted chips are. They ship well with little damage. I have ordered them several times. Also they are very fresh. Not one bit was left in the bag when I got through.

I've tried a few varieties of Bagel chips, and by far, this is my favorite.  Most bagel chips use mini-bagels, cut horizontally.  You can tell because of the hole in the center.  Bagels are typically seasoned on the outside, sliced, then baked as chips.  If you get a chip that is close to the exterior of the bagel chances are good that you will get the seasoning (usually too much).  If you get an interior chip you will likely get too little seasoning (if any).  Some brands season the chips after they are cooked as well, which almost guarantees that you'll get far too much seasoning.Stacy's starts with regular, whole bagels; the same high-quality bagels that you will find on a supermarket or baker's sehlf.  Because these are sliced vertically, you get round chips that are all seasoned correctly on the outside ring.  Each chip is round and perfect for dipping or spreading.  I love regular bagels toasted with cream cheese, which is also good with Stacy's bagel chips.  However, these are good enough to warrant more creativity.  Try them with hummus, salsa, melted cheese--use your imagination.Yes, this is the same Stacy's that makes Stacy's Pita Chips.  All of Stacy's products are very high quality.  If you are a fan of everything bagels, you will love these.  The Simply Naked Bagel Chips are similar to the Simply Naked Pita Chips--simple, and delicious with dip. The Everything Bagel Chips are standard everything bagels, covered on the outside with seeds, onion, and garlic.  These are my favorite out of all the Stacy's bagel offerings.  If you like a bit of seasoning and don't like all of the extras, try the Toasted Garlic Bagel Chips (I like these, but I miss the extras of the everything chips).
This one is not the recent style. But still good. Will not recommend this one since the new one is better. Thanks!

We were having trouble finding the bagel chips in the grocery store when we wanted them...so I decided to take a change and order them in bulk...GOOD DECISION...they arrived in great condition and are all within a reasonable "fresh date".  Would I do it again?  Yes...
Get them on sale if you can...these chips are wonderful....however be careful..you might eat the bag in one sitting as they are not low fat or low calorie...and they sure are good.
These bagel chips are really good chips, as long as you like garlic...a lot.  Otherwise, you might want to try another flavor.
It's really hard to find any bagel chips in stores around here. They arrived in good shape. Had a 3+ month best used by date. So much better then chips or crackers! I'm a happy camper.
This is a wonderful product, at a wonderful price.  I am so hooked on the stacy's pita chips, and this is a great buy.
Very good product.  Nice and crunchy.  Nicely seasoned.  Very happy with all the Stacy's products I have eaten.

These are better than homemade bagel chips and my new favorite snack. So glad these are on Amazon because they are sometimes hard to find in my area and when found rather pricey. The price on Amazon is competitive, with Subscribe & Save it can't be beat. Warning: it takes a lot of willpower not to eat a bag each day, they are that good.

column9: Cookies for those Who Will Swallow Anything
column10: Cookies as health food? Who could have imagined it? These sweet wonders contain as much fiber as a bowl of oatmeal, as much Vitamin A as a glass of tomato juice, and as much Vitamin D and calcium as an 8 ounce glass of milk. And that's only the beginning, for the Whonu cookies also are sources of B12, and Vitamins C and E. With three grams of fiber and "a total of 20 essential vitamins and minerals"  three cookies would seem to be a great start to the day, and six cookies should be even better, offering twice as much fiber and nutrition.Munch on these cookies with a sprinkling of caveat emptor. In addition to all the good stuff, three cookies also provide 170 calories and six grams of fat. Eat six cookies, like I am apt to do and you've consumed 340 calories, 24 grams of sugar,  and 12 grams of fat.The Whonu bakers invite us to compare their cookies with the other leading cookies. Yes, the Whonu cookies have the edge in added vitamins, but it's pretty much a wash otherwise. Three Oreo golden cookies hold 160 calories and seven grams of fat - less calories but one gram more fat than the Whonu enriched cookies.Conclusion - I found the Whonu cookies quite tasty, so tasty that I had a difficult time limiting myself to only three cookies per snackfest. Despite the vitamin fortification, and the low sodium content, don't confuse these sweet confections with an apple or a bowl of oatmeal.

They are perfect as a little treat to jump start your day or a nice suprise for lunch. Overall, AWESOME

column10: Love the cookie taste.  Most of them arrived broken, but that just lets the calories out, right?  However the price is over $6 per box.  I've since found them in local supermarket for less than $3 per box.  Something's not quite right about that.

column9: The Best of the WhoNu Cookies
column10: Of course that is subjective, but, for myself and my family, we all agree that the vanilla sandwich WhoNu cookies are the best of all their varieties.  We've tried them all and this is the only one that we get on a regular basis.  They taste the most like a normal cookie, with a pleasant sweet vanilla taste, but not sickeningly sweet like most store-bought cookies.  Plus they have the benefit of some added nutrients.  They are still a cookie, so you can't really eat a bunch of them anyway.  But I feel better eating these than say, an Oreo.  The other WhoNu cookies tend to taste like "health cookies"...not all that great.  This one is the closest to a "regular cookie".

I was hoping to find plain old mustard with no salt in it but this is as close as I can come to finding it. It taste fine. I have come to not miss the taste of salt in my food. For medical reason I can't have much salt in my diet so I look for foods without it. The mustard is good. I would buy it again

They were the right sweet balance-Not too sweet and Not too sour :)I shared these with my friends and they loved them. They came well packaged, none broken.I also love their orange slice shape...It is like you were eating a real orange slice, except this is Hard Candy.Since I am a Big CHOCOLATE Fan, I would buy these Hard candies again and surely buy them for friends, family too...They are really good..they were so good that Even if I am a Chocolate Fan, I loved them!

column9: hard italian citrus flavored candy, Perugina.
column10: I bought this candy for a friend and we both liked it very much. We like to keep some fruit flavoredhard candy in our handbags. The flavors are excellent.

column9: Organic Darjeeling best with Organic Sucanat
column10: "Sitting on the porch of a bungalow on a tea plantation in Darjeeling, you can see the peaks of Everest and Kanchenjunga as you sip a cup of this exquisite brew. Life is good." ~tea packetIf you want a subtle tea with a smooth, soothing flavor, then Darjeeling is an excellent choice. The slightly floral flavor is much milder than an Earl Grey. I especially love this blend when eating a Caramel Apple Cobbler Clif Bar. For some reason, the flavors mingle nicely. I think it is the slightly nutty flavor of the Darjeeling.While many of the Tazo teas are blends of a variety of teas, this tea is purely a blend of Organic Black Darjeeling teas. The tea is grown near India's border with Bhutan. There are only "true Darjeeling" tea leaves in this tea.This tea is just perfect when blended with an Organic Sucanat: Natural Sugar Cane. You might also want to try using "milk powder" instead of cold milk with your tea. I find it helps to keep the tea strength and adds a creamy element to the smoothness of this tea.Darjeeling is a very satisfying blend for morning tea. You might also enjoy AWAKE and Earl Grey if you enjoy this tea.I just love the packaging of the Tazo Teas. The individual wrappings have a nice crinkly sound and the colors are all so soothing and quite beautiful. These teas are definitely for the aesthetically aware. Drinking Tazo teas literally becomes a magical experience. There is something mysterious going on here. The teas even seem to have a magical glint or luster to them. When you drink Tazo teas the world looks more beautiful and you feel much more aware of life itself. I find that my creativity soars after drinking Tazo teas.For more information on the mysteries of Tazo Tea, read the review for the Tazo Assorted Teas.For a calming experience try the Tazo Calm Herbal Infusion which is perfect for quiet evenings, after completing a yoga workout or just to sip on while you write inyour journal.~The Rebecca Review

There are a lot of dog foods available, but at what cost to our pets. This family run business creates wholesome, balanced foods for dogs & cats in their own plants with high standards of quality assurance and employee satisfaction. They offer a no-questions asked return policy if you are unhappy with their product.Dogs & cats love it and their condition reflects the holistic properties of the food. Also produces less gas & stool.

I was persuaded into upgrading the quality of our dogs' food by friends that own Golden Retrievers.  Our golden was always itching/chewing at his skin, typical for the breed, but friends said they switched there dog over to gluten free no filler dog food and saw a big difference in their dogs' itchiness.  I found this food at a local independent dog store. I am not a "holistic" person, I do believe in eating well-balanced meals and exercising regularly, but not a lot of the fluff that the "holistic" crowds go for.  I have to say though after a month and a half my golden is not itching any more.  I am so happy with this line of dog food, I won't ever go back to purina.  Also because there are no fillers in this food you actually feed them less, so although it cost more it lasts a little longer, which helps cushion the difference in price.
