They have ENERGY, they are healthy and it is like a total miracle!  I can't say enough about the quality of this dog food, but it has literally changed the way my dogs act, feel and look.  I HIGHLY recommend this dog food to anyone who may have similar circumstances. I was literally resigned to believe that all Frenchies just threw up and I would have to deal with it.  NOT TRUE.  This has totally changed our lives and the lives of our dogs.A++++ Keep up the good work Blue Buffalo!
This is great dog food. My golden loves it, her coat is shiny and soft, she has lots of energy and is happy happy happy!

My wheaten terrier has been on Wellness Core for a couple of years now. I buy the BB to mix in with the Wellness about 50/50 to give him some variety. He is much more likely to eat when the food goes into his bowl when there's more BB in than WC. This last time I wasn't as diligent in mixing the two in the food container and there's more BB on top and he's been scarfing down his food immediately. I can't say I've noticed any other changes other than his enthuiasm for it, but that's enough for me...

column9: This is our new dog food, and I think she has more energy.
column10: I have no problems with our last dog food (and it would still be my alternate choice in a pinch), but a perusal of comparisons and ratings showed that my old food was  3 or 4 stars (depending on which rater you looked at).  I decided to see what 5/6 star foods would be available locally and in the same price range.  This one fit the bill, so I gave it a try.  She likes it, and I do think that it's higher protein gives her a little more energy.If you are switching dog foods, do so gradually, and beware of loose stools if you transition to quickly.  Try [...] to compare foods.Grain free foods have been a huge benefit to my dog!  The improved nutrition has really reduced the number of ear infections that my Golden Retriever has gotten.

column9: Great for Dogs with digestive allergies.
column10: When I first got my Golden Retriever I knew I wanted to feed him right. I started with Solid Gold puppy food which didn't work well. His feces were more like 'liquid gold' and his gas was constant and terrible. I also tried Nutro's Natural Choice and Blue Buffalo for large breed puppies. The stool and gas were better but still not solid. When he turned one year old I decided to give Wilderness a try, I came to the conclusion that he is allergic to rice and rice flower found in almost all dog foods. It has been nothing but good times since the switch. Sure it is a bit pricey but well worth it. You can also get a $5.00 coupon from the manufactures web site to use at B&M stores. I wish I could have started him on this food sooner but it is NOT for puppies. You should wait at least 1 year before the switch. He is also allergic to most kind of dog treats including rawhide. Blue Buffalo makes Wilderness treats as well, but I have yet to try them.

column9: Great ingredients but something is wrong
column10: I did a lot of research on dog food after hearing Eukanuba and other dog food were found top have pentobarbital in them. I loved the ingredients of Blue Buffalo and they seemed to have an amazing reputation. We slowly, over ~ 10 days, weaned our dogs off Eukanuba and onto Blue Buffalo Wilderness Salmon. Bad things began happening soon after we started. All 3 dogs stopped having solid feces, and someone vomited everyday. We got through the bag and figured that lot, or set of ingredients, didn't agree with their digestive systems so we went over to the Duck. Things got worse.After 2 months of this we changed over to Nutro and they have been great since. I contacted Blue Buffalo to let them know our experiences and they replied with an email pretty much saying "Thanks for being a valuable customer"

column9: Chinese Hairless Cresteds LOVE this food!
column10: I just got this today and changed from "U.D." ( urinary diet) that my hairless dogs have been tolerating ( barely) for 2+ years! My little guys WOLFED down a whole bowl each! I've never seen them like a food this much!! I could kiss the creators! First ,1 dog has has 2 surgeries for urine stones! In 2 years! On a " UD" $$$$ food! I shop amazon daily and researched all reviews and saw I was killing my own dogs with that garbage ! ( Grain is bad news but one review told me many dogs are allergic to chicken! ) my older " true hairless" is VERY allergic and despite 1000's spent on allergy testing, shots shampoos, etc he keeps an awful skin lesions that require shirts to cover!! It never completely goes away so I was FED up!! I ordered the salmon bc of the fish oil for skin ,( also got urine strips to test my little guys urine- less $$ to vet!!, got Urine crystal breakdown cranberry stuff (just do search on" urine crystals dogs" ) and followed other reviewers recommendations- my breed is prone to skin conditions ( including blackheads!!) and losing teeth,They've only started this food today , but the " itch monster" is sleeping peacefully as well as my baby pup  - satiated and snoring !Thank you Blue Buffalo!! I'm telling everyone abt this amazing food! ( & thanks to reviewers ) I also recommend you look up pat McKay - a holistic vet site with great vitamins and natural recipes! They'll direct you to a work up and 3 mos of "care" for only 250! ( I'm not affiliated at all ! )

I have been using Blue Buffalo Wilderness for a little over a year. I have 3 dogs, 2 labs and 1 golden. In my quest to find the "perfect" food for my golden's skin issues, I came across Blue Buffalo. After proper food transition, things seemed to be going smoothly. My golden still itches (which I think is yeast now, not food) and the one lab has a little gas, no biggie. About a month ago, I got a batch of food that made my 2 labs sick. The vet and I came to this determination when I put the dogs on plain rice, they were ok, then back on the food, sick again. I called Blue, they said perhaps the food was "too rich" for the labs. I'm not sure how, for they had been ok on the food for over a year. So, I tossed the food, bought a new batch, all is ok. The same thing happened this week, the labs are sick, and the golden ok. The labs eat rice for 2 days and they are good. Back on the food, now sick again. I called Blue. They could only say the food was too rich. To me, it doesn't make sense. Perhaps something along the process got into the food which sickens my labs, but not my golden. I like that the ingredients seemed to be sourced from whole foods, but I can't help but think the quality control of their processing is in check. Also, Blue did not rise up in the area of customer services. I was bummed about that.

column9: My lab/pit-bull mix loves it, has a beautiful coat, healthy body
column10: Our young lab/pit-bull mix has been on the Blue Buffalo Wilderness dry foods for months now, and she loves it. She's about a year and a half old, with a ridiculously muscular body, a shiny coat, and less poops than when on a grain-based diet. She loves the taste of the Blue Buffalo Wilderness foods (you can obviously smell that it's fishy), and the Salmon has seemed to be her favorite, though we've bought the Duck and the Chicken as well. She never appears to overeat, so I don't worry about her having a lack of valuable nutrients. A young dog, she doesn't need the food to be softened with water.It's expensive, but surely it's worth it. My dog appears and acts very healthy. I've seen dogs fed on cheap, grain-based diets who are very overweight, despite exercising daily. Dogs are the descendants of wild beasts! And none of them ate corn. (Neither did our own ancestors.) A meat and vegetable diet is by far the healthiest. Sometimes I wonder if she's eating better than I am....

I have 3 dogs. 2 boxers and one terrier. One of my boxers was having stool issues and vomiting often (sensitive stomach). We could not keep weight on her AT ALL! We fed her a large amount of different brand dog food and she still looked starved. We went to a pet store one day and asked for recommendations. They recommended this product (we get the salmon flavor to help her skin as well). We couldn't be happier! No more throwing up. No more bad poo's, and now it looks like we feed her! She (like many boxers) is still on the skinny side but not just ribs and hip bones sticking out. Since this product is expensive we feed our other 2 dogs purina pro plan (which works for them). Some reviews mention the dogs having stinky gas... BOTH my boxers stink us out of the house and the terrier doesn't fart at all (maybe a breed thing?). But, they are on 2 different dog foods (so not necessarily just the dog food causing the stink). Worth the money!!

column9: Smells good enough for Humans to eat!
column10: I have 3 dogs and always concerned about their health as they are like children. About 2 weeks ago I went on a search for better food, after I read horrible reviews and details about the ingredients on previous food I was feeding them.Based on my dogs breed (Brussels Griffon, Yorkie & their baby) I was looking for a 5-star dog food brand that would fit all three best, including the convenience of being able to get the food by "location"!Luckily, PetSmart sells 2 5-star dog foods and this was one of them.I must say the food smells great! They all love it! I mix it with half a can of the same type in wet version.  The only problem I seem to be having is that the baby had a minor diarrhea due to the food change and one of them has really bad gas! Besides that they are all doing very well!

The price of this product wasn't any less than what I pay at the store, but it was less trouble having the 30 pound bag delivered to my door.  Packaging was excellent with no holes or tears.  Would have rated excellent had the price been better.

My dogs love this dog food!!! I did research and compared dog foods. Not only is it recommended by dog food critics, it has natural ingredients. I elected to go with this dog food because of recommendations, ingredients, price. There are other higher rated products, but cost was also a factor. Great all around dog food.

I have a chocolate lab that has various skin issues, all of which directly come from what food he eats.  I had him on purina pro plan and after he would eat his muzzle and gums were red and rash-y just from the stuff touching his skin.  The vet also said he was a little too heavy at 105 lbs.  I put him on this and he went back to the vet 2 weeks later for a follow up- he was down to 95lbs!!  His skin was also completely cleared up and his fur started to grow back where he had been chewing at himself.  He has much more energy now and doesn't have that doggie breath anymore.  I absolutley LOVE this food for him.  We feed twice a day, 2 cups in the morning and 2 cups at night and he never leaves a kibble, with the other food he would often leave half uneaten.  His poop is also much easier to deal with because there isn't as much waste in this food, so instead of going 5 times a day- he goes once.  I do wish it wasn't so expensive, but when you have a dog with allergies, its cheaper to buy this than go back and forth to the vet every month.  6 months later and he has a shiny glossy coat, sheds less and his eyes don't water anymore.  Salmon is his favorite flavor, but he likes the others as well.  Their catfood is awesome too!

This was so much easier than getting it from one of the local pet stores.  Delivered right to the door, free shipping, and I checked the date and it was good until December of 2011!  If you're thinking about putting your dog on a better dog food, this is the one.  It's grain free, so most of my dog's allergies and itching got under control with this food. (Most)  I could tell it was good dog food when the running under her eyes stopped. And this is HIGH allergy season, so I was able to determine that the runny eyes were mostly being caused by the food.

I've been feeding my dog Buddy (65 lb border collie/chow chow mix) Blue Wilderness for a few months, but it is expensive at my local petsmart. I figured out that it's cheaper per bag here at amazon, plus I don't have to pay sales tax, and it arrives at my door, no more lugging into a cart and then into the car then into my house. When I told my vet what I was feeding Buddy he was very pleased, because salmon is a great source of omega-3's. Plus, Buddy LOVES the salmon flavor. His coat is so much more shiny since I switched to the Wilderness line, must be because there's no grain in it. It also helped with his scratching, I think he's probably a little allergic to grains. Overall, a great shopping experience and a great product.

i love just getting stuff from here and not having to drive to the store. Not really saving much by getting it from here but even the fact that i don't have to deal with people and checkout lanes is worth it to me.Also my dog loves this food so works out for both of us

column9: Too much fish/chicken meals for the price
column10: I sure wish I had researched the ingredients first. There is a large amount of fish meal and chicken meal in this supposedly high quality food. I expect to see non-meal meat by products when paying this price.
Ordered as a gift for parents, it was really enjoyed.  But my dad likes chocolate covered cherries and this box had none.

Good, strong flavor. Grinds easily in my (plastic *blush*) grinder. The only thing I wish Frontier would work on is their packaging. Sure, they come in "resealable" bags, but you can't reseal it if the zipper pulls off the bag every time you try to open it for the first time. Grr.

I'd never tried these before purchasing so I didn't know what to expect. They were a pleasant surprise. They're not as oily and salty as normal mixed nuts but are still quite flavorful. Most of the peanuts are lacking "skins" also so they're much less messy to eat. I eat a fair amount of nuts for health purposes and I feel good about these. I intend to purchase them again.
These are perfect ladyfingers for making your own tiramisu.  Not too soft or hard so it stands up well to the coffee.  Plus they are a nice treat as they are not too sweet.

My best friend turned me on to Cavender's back in the 70's.  I use it in so many recipes, I'd be lost without it.  It goes in salad, on pasta, on veggies and meats, in soups.  Ok, I never used it in a dessert recipe!  I backpacked up the east coast of Australia once for two months.  My Cavender's was the only thing I made sure was in my pack...the jumbo size.  I've introduced more people to this seasoning; it is the "secret ingredient" to some of my most popular recipes.Lately, I've been making "simple salad" - torn bibb lettuce leaves, olive oil, Cavender's, a little grated parmesan, a little balsamic vinegar.  Nothing else.  I can't get enough.

There are very few things that are even remotely as versatile as Cavender's.  Fantastic on chicken, beef and pork.  I have never tried it on fish, but I'm sure it would be great there too...  I try to keep at least two or three cans on hand at all times so I never run out, and when I'm feeling generous I even give them away to friends.

column9: Still the best after nearly forty years!
column10: I first started using Cavenders when I was in my teens, living in the Midwest. When I first started cooking for myself, I experimented making fried rice; my parents had bought a container of Cavenders, so I tossed some into my rice and fell in love. I've been using it ever since, now going on forty years. My wife and I use it in a wide variety of dishes, from simple casseroles to more complex fish & meat dishes--and I still love it in my fried rice.If you haven't tried it, do so--you'll be glad you did!

column9: Cavender's Greek Seasoning is the best.
column10: I was introduced to Cavender's Greek Seasoning several years ago at a Greek Festival. It is so versatile. I use it to blacken steaks, grill Pork chops, season Gravy's, season Hamburgers,on potatoes. I give as gifts to friends I love it so much.

column9: Not Really Smokey, But Still Very Good
column10: I would call the flavor accent of this Smoked Salt a 'Sweet Woody'.  When I opened the bottle I was immediately disappointed with the lack of a smokey scent -but upon tasting some of the light, flaky crystals I was pleasantly surprised with its 'sweet' taste.  If you're looking for smokey salt I would say look elsewhere.  This salt has been my favorite sea salt on Salads thus far.  I won't be afraid to buy the regular Arabian Fleur De Sel now.

I guess you could call me a salt addict, I also guess it is a good thing that I have no blood pressure or heart issues as I am able to indulge myself with all different kinds of salts. This particular one is very nice and has a lovely mellow smoke flavor. The size of the crystals at first had me thinking I would have to use this salt in a grinder but I found that the large crystals are delicate and crush very easily in the fingers. I'll order more Spice Lab products based on how nice this salt is.

These snacks were the best I've ever found. We have a Granddaughter that is sensitive to dyes, these were 100% natural no dyes at all, just fruit juice. They tasted great and were good for them, I'm very disappointed they are no longer available.

The labeling debate continues ... Natural... Doesn't mean it's natural to consume!  How can a product geared towards children that boasts 'made with real fruit and vegetable juice' also contain an ingredient that among other things, prohibits the normal absorption of vitamins and is used to clean industrial products? Please search 'mineral oil' before purchasing Motts products. There are healthy gummy alternatives out there or you can offer actual fruit and vegetables at snack time.  I am referring specifically to Mott's Medleys assorted fruit fruit flavored snacks. Let's keep our kids healthy!!!

column9: Product was good, shipping was rough, had a few leak
column10: The product was fine.  Good price through Amazon - less than the grocery store on sale.  However, the shipping was rough and one box had several pouches that leaked.  2 of the 4 boxes were fine.  1 box was wet (pouches okay) but the leaking box beside it got it wet and ruined the box.  4th box had several pouches leak and ruined the cardboard box.  Amazon gave a partial discount for my trouble.  Would order again with reservations.
I love it!  It is perfect and great taste of Loriva Extra Virgin Sesame Oil.  It is perfect and great for stir-fry.  I have tried to taste some different kinds of Sesame Oil that they tasted awful.

I bought this because I heard that sesame oil was great for making mayo.  I haven't tried other sesame oils, but this is FANTASTIC.Some recipes call for extra virgin olive oil, but that makes a very strong flavored (disgusting!) mayo--I used that the first time I made mayo, and I just threw it away.  This sesame oil makes all the difference, though.This is the recipe that I used:---1 farm fresh egg1 cup extra virgin cold pressed sesame oil1 Tbsp lemon juicesalt and pepper to taste1. In a large bowl whisk the egg.2. In a thin, very slow stream, add the oil with one hand while continuing to whisk with the other hand.  A food processor can be used as an easier alternative to doing it by hand.3. Whisk in all remaining ingredients.4. Store refrigerated.---I used my food processor.  And, today I made a second batch with half sesame oil, half coconut oil; it was still good.  I think the sesame oil really adds the perfect smell and taste to mayo.We've been using the mayo on toasted sourdough sandwiches with grilled meat and cheese, lettuce, tomato, and green peppers.  SO tasty!  It would make a perfect substitute for any store mayo, though.  (And it's way healthier, since it doesn't have hydrogenated oils and chemicals, etc.)I do think this would make a great addition to salad dressings or stir fry.  It has a lighter flavor than toasted sesame oil.Highly recommended.  This oil is SO good!
I bought this to go with a cheese sampler for a party. It was inedible.

column9: Get these if need a POWERFUL LAXATIVE
column10: I purchased these at a local store, and had half a bag for lunch.  They tasted OK, but were definitely not worth the after effects.  Within about 7 hours after eating these my stomach started feeling awkward.  Shortly after I started having cramps and severe watery diarrhea several times throughout the evening and late night.  Looking at the ingredients, the thing that stands out is carboxymethylcellulose AKA cellulose gum.  The package I purchased said cellulose gum on the ingredients list, but on the web sites it is listed as carboxymethylcellulose.  You will find they are synonyms if you Google them.  All I had for breakfast that day was a bowl of dry corn flakes, and didn't have time to eat dinner before my stomach started cramping.  If you look up this ingredient, or look it up along with "side effects" you will find it is undigestible and can cause side effects such as bloating and diarrhea.  Never again.  All I can say is please post a review if this happened to you to others are forewarned!
