column9: Wonderful taste and will protect your teeth
column10: I love licorice, and just the smell of these licorice mints when I opened the box from Amazon was heavenly... So was the taste! They didn't melt instantly in my mouth as another poster said, although they're small and won't last for long (mainly because other common ingredients to slow down disintegration are thankfully missing, so it's just xylitol and natural flavors). But the licorice flavor lingers for quite a while. Gosh, I can just sniff the container periodically for a quick fix.... :) You just can't go wrong with something that is just xylitol plus natural licorice extract, natural anise, and natural fennel oil - all my favorites!I didn't buy them as candy (although I can see they will be quite suitable as a licorice fix when the craving hits) or as a "breath mint" but rather to use for preventive dental care, to help preserve and repair my teeth. The recommendation (see the zellies site with the link down at the bottom of the home page to the Ask Dr. Ellie blog for more information) is 3 to 6 grams of xylitol per day, preferably in small amounts after each meal, snack, or non-water beverage. These will do just fine for reaching my goal of 6 grams xylitol per day, since they have 0.4 grams (400 milligrams) of xylitol in each tiny tablet. One or two of them per dose will work well.They also do not have any sorbitol in them (a common ingredient in many products marketed as containing xylitol), which is a big asset because sorbitol can cause digestive problems and also can promote growth of the mouth bacteria (they can easily metabolize it) we're trying to reduce with xylitol (which can be eaten in much larger amounts with no problem by humans but the bacteria don't seem to be able to manage it). Xylitol also helps alkalinize your saliva after acidic foods or drinks, a good thing because that helps remineralize your teeth.The Amazon price is good, also, especially with Subscribe&Save.
really like the licorice-mint combo, but they dissolve too fast, so i like to take several at once, or one after another. seemed like a good value, but they are not.

These are probably my favorite xylitol candies.  The licorice flavor is very natural-tasting (which makes sense considering the ingredients are all natural) and they make a nice digestive after a meal.  Not to mention they protect against cavities.

column9: Tasty and healthy for your teeth!
column10: Thanks to Amazon, I recently discovered these and I am a new but huge fan!If you enjoy the taste of black licorice and want to protect your teeth with Xylitol, look no further. I like these licorice mints but they dissolve almost instantly and are gone so you have to take a handful at once as they are very tiny.I'm giving 3 stars for taste and healthiness.Would not buy again,not good value.
They taste fine-a little sweet. They melt and break down instantly. I was hoping for more of  hard candy or mint.

No sugar-coating, just compressed tablets of flavor bliss!  In case you don't know, xylitol is the one sweetner that's good for teeth.  With these, I'm not only getting that benefit, but the herbal benefits of licorice, anise and fennel.  Love it!!
This product is very flavorful, but not too strong. It is a great breath mint.
This is an excellent tasting coffee. I really like having a fresh cup of coffee every time and this one is the best!

This is a non-acid gentle cup of coffee, it smells wonderful! If you are looking for a strong blend or heavy flavoring this is not the coffee for you. However if you enjoy mild, smooth flavors give it a try.

column9: My Favorite Flavored Gloria Jean Coffee!
column10: The butter toffee flavor coffee is delicious without the artificial flavor taste so many coffees like this have.  It is a mild roast, so it's not for someone looking for a robust cup of coffee.  This is my go-to afternoon cup of coffee flavor.

This is my favorite K-cup coffee so far.  The price was about the same as what I am able to get on sale in the stores, without having to wait for the sale.  The stores usually only offer 18ct boxes, these were 24ct.  I am enjoying it daily.

column9: My favorite K-cup of all time!

I use my travel mug so I actually use the medium cup selection - open the top and re-use the same k-cup with a small cup to fill up my mug and it still has lots of flavor.  I've shared these with a few friends and got them hooked too - great value.
I love this and have ordered more. It has a very satifying and rich flavor. I use the largest cup size on my B60 and it is still strong enough for me. It does smell and taste like buttered toffee.
I've tried a bunch of different coffees in my Keurig and this is my favorite.  It smells so good when brewing and tastes great as well.  Smooth and tasty!

I got got my Keurig Coffee Maker as a gift and I was delighted to find that you could get the k-cups through Amazon.  I checked it against the store prices and the prices from Keurig and with the automatic delivery this price is better.
This is our second favorite coffee at the office - the cappucchino being the first - Great coffee - Great price....

Nothing to complain about. The K Cups are the greatest idea and the flavor selection is perfect. Anyone can find a flavor they will like, and the beauty of getting a cup of exactly what you want quicker than the microwave is priceless. No wasted half pots anymore. Love it !!

I enjoy the nutty flavored coffees and figured with all the positive reviews, I would enjoy this. The aroma is very appealing but the taste is both weak and stale. Not sure if I got a bad batch but I struggle to give it 1. If I could drink the smell, it would be a 5.

I ordered this coffee with the auto-send feature because it is so good.  I usually mix it with sugar free hot chocolate and skim milk and make a mocha of sorts with it.  All of the Gloria Jean coffee that I have purchased have been delicious.

I have tried several different Gloria Jean's, Timothy's and Green Mountain coffee flavors for the Keurig and this is probably the best one I've had.  Whenever I make it for myself at work, at least 2 or 3 people comment on how good it smells and want to know what it is.

As the non-coffee drinker in the house, I can just tell you that my husband has struggled to get through these.  He has a couple of different flavors that he drinks each day and he keeps telling me how happy he will be when this one is out of the mix.  So, my conclusion is that since he is still drinking it, it is not horrible, but not all that good either.By the way, his favorite is the Timothy's Cinnamon Pastry K-Cups if you are looking for something fabulous!
I'm afraid it doesn't live up to its name.  The flavor is a bit bitter.
My favorite of flavored coffees! All types of Gloria Jeans coffee are wonderful and definitely recommended. :)
All of our friends love it that we have this coffee. I like stronger coffee but this is a wonderful tasting cup of coffee.

This is the BEST Keurig coffee I have EVER had!!!  By far my favorite....Try with Toffee Nut (Coffemate) or Southern Butter Pecan (International Delight) creamer and it is defn. a treat for the taste buds....

I had this after lunch today and it was like having dessert.  Rich and buttery.  Wonderful aroma.  This is my favorite flavored coffee so far.  More reviews noted on the k-cup exchange on yahoo groups.  Check them out.

column9: Gloria Jeans Butter Toffee IS the Best Flavored Coffee
column10: If you love flavored coffees this one is the best I've tried so far. Rich flavor and aroma, very smooth. Exceptional with a vanilla caramel creamer.

After reading so many glowing reviews, I was expecting a really special taste experience. It just goes to show how different people's tastes are, b/c I found it to be weak and hardly tasty at all! I brewed it on the "small cup" setting to get the strongest brew (b/c I know Gloria Jean's flavors tend to be on the weaker side) and still found it to be nearly tasteless. It doesn't have a BAD taste, just not enough taste. This is not the coffee for me. I'm just glad I got it in a sample pack and did not get stuck w/2 whole boxes!

This is really terrible tasting coffee.  I love Van Houttes vanilla, and Green Mountain Caramel Vanilla, so I thought I'd try this.  It's terrible.  Now I have a bunch that I'm going to have to get rid of somehow.  Yuck.

column9: Smells INCREDIBLE while brewing... tastes good too
column10: I would honestly just make cup after cup of this stuff, so it would make my apartment smell like heaven.  I didn't purchase mine from Amazon (they were cheaper on other sites), but I thought I'd share-- if you like the smell of butterscotch, or the taste of butter pecan ice cream, just stand around your Keurig and sniff while brewing this flavored coffee gem.  It's terrific.  I like my coffee sweet, so I add caramel syrup (just generic stuff purchased at Target) and a little warm milk to mine.  Faaaaaantastic!

I'm not entirely sure why I bought these.  I'm more of a medium coffee drinker who takes it black and I've never been a big fan of flavored coffee but I was surfing for K-Cup refills and ran across this with its superior reviews and was sold.It's a pretty typical flavored coffee for me, with a seriously bitter finish.  The big cup setting produces a nearly tea-colored coffee, but the small setting is just about right...I just need to brew two of them.  It smells good though, and doesn't taste terrible, it's just not for me.  Luckily, a shot of Irish cream (some shots stiffer than others) will cure most bad coffee ills, otherwise I wouldn't be able to finish off my now huge supply of this stuff.

I was so disappointed bc this seems to get great reviews.  It has an extremely weak taste and is bitter.  Also, I find that Gloria Jean's coffees (hazelnut, french vanilla, butter toffee) are weak and taste like you're drinking perfume.  I love a stronger, smoother coffee... this is just not good.

I usually like Gloria Jean's coffee syrups so I decided to try this coffee for my Keeurig brewer.  BIG Mistake.  I have to really be in the mood for a sweet coffee - well, to me it doesn't even taste like coffee.  I only wish I could send you one cup to try before you buy a gazillion of them like I did.Don't know what I'll do with 47 more of these......
The flavoring just does not taste right to me, but seems like a cheap fake of "butter toffee".  I had hoped to like this flavor, but have decided to go back to unflavored k-cups.

I have bought a few of the Gloria Jean's coffees and really enjoy this one.  The flavor is there, but not overbearing and the taste is smooth.  I would recommend this to anyone that likes flavored coffees.

I enjoy trying new K-Cups and finding out which are my favorites and which I'll never try again.  This K-Cup is by far the best I have tried so far.  It smells delicious when it's brewing, and although the actual flavor when you drink it is more mild, it's simply perfect.  It's got notes of caramel, nuts and vanilla, yet is not so overwhelming that you can't drink it as your every day coffee.  It's flavor profile is very similar to Green Mountain Southern Pecan, but I find Gloria Jean's butter toffee to be more rich and flavorful.  If I could only have two K-Cups for all time, I would choose this coffee and Coffee People Donut Shop.Buy this- you'll love it!

This coffee is really good. I can cut a lot of calories but using flavored coffee and low fat milk, instead of flavored creamers. This particular flavor is my favorite. It also smells good enough to have my office mates asking for a sample and everyone who has tried it loves it too.

I wanted to try this coffee because the description sounded so yummy and I like to keep several flavors on hand for guests. Well, when it arrived- of course I had to try it and now- this is the only flavor I want. I find myself choosing it every morning. I will soon have to order more. It tastes like a heath bar but without the chocolate. Truly delicious!
Unlike other Gloria Jean's flavored K-cups, I thought this one falls short of the target. The butter toffee flavor just doesn't come through. There is also a slight bitter finish to it.

I like this just for the variety.  I have really liked a number of the flavored coffees, but this one is borderline.  It is a little bitter, but I still like to drink it black, but my wife adds a little sugar which we've never done for other kcups so far.  Unlike some other flavors, I don't feel like the flavor is spot on.  There is a butter flavor taste, but seems more like an added flavor and imperfect coffee rather than perfect harmony.  I keep a large selection of flavors, so I still like this enough to have in the rotation for variety.  But one box is enough and I will probably buy it again when I run out, but I'm in no hurry.  I wouldn't give this to guests as their first k-cup experience, but fine for me when I feel like it.So if you're more into flavors and don't care about having to be superb coffee, it is something you can mix into your variety.  I rate it right in the middle, not bad.  But I can see why some might not like it since there are better kcups out there.  I feel like I'm being too harsh since I'll probably have more.  I have just been so thrilled with other kcups that this is quite a contrast with some that seem so perfect.
wonderful taste of heaven. I'm a heavey coffee drinker and this is a true touch of heaven>

This Butter Toffee fills the house with a wonderful smell and the taste is marvelous! Buy it! I know your palate will love the taste the smoothness and just a great way to enjoy the morning. Start your day with Butter Toffee from Gloria Jean's Coffees.

We have tried several Keurig cups in our dental office and our patients agree this is the best taste overall - I just reordered more on subscription.  The aroma it has permeates our office and makes us crave it too.  If you enjoy flavored coffee, this is the one to get.  The butter toffee I did not think would appeal to many but it is really good.
This is my absolute favorite flavor. I drink my coffee black with nothing added so I am appreciating the true taste. Enjoy!
This one tasted more like butter flavored coffee to me and rather weak even though I used the smallest setting.  Glad I ordered the samples.
This is not one of my favorite products.  I loved the aroma but the flavor lest something to be desired.

column9: Absolutely my favorite flavor thus far.....
column10: I am basically new to K-cups and the single maker, but when I got my variety pack, this was the first one I tried.  I didn't care for it all that much at first.  However, it was in the running.  I was a heavy English Toffee cappuccino drinker before a diagnosis of type-2 diabetes in late February, and I sure have missed having it every day (several times a day).  So, I was looking for a replacement.  My daughter ended up buying me a box locally, and I cringed, because I had found another variety of toffee elsewhere, bought it, and thought it was the one.  I liked it so much at first that I bought 2 more boxes (and the title is English Toffee).  However, now I find that it doesn't come close to tasting as good as Gloria Jeans Butter Toffee (too strong and bitter, and the flavor just doesn't compare at all....and I have a lot to muddle through....ugh).  The minute I close the lid with Gloria Jeans, the aroma pours out and makes my heart race.  It's not a strong coffee, so that's perfect for me.  Once I add creamer and sweetener, it's divine.  This flavor/brand is by far my ultimate favorite and the best I've tried out of many thus far.  I'm sipping on a cup now and have only 1 of that flavor left.  I find myself panicking, too.  Time to get a lot more *lol*  I just ordered a box of her Mudslide K-cups to try, so I'm hoping hers are good.  (I tried another brand and didn't like it at all...tasted like coconut when there's no such thing in a mudslide at all *ha ha*)  Anyway, I highly endorse this product a million times :-)
THis is a great flavored coffee. Enjoy this flavor after a meal or mid afternoon. Smooth flavor and wonderful aroma. Anyone who comes into kitchen when it is brewing wants to try a cup.
K-cups arrived 3 days before due and well packaged.  This is one of my wife's two favorite flavored coffees.  She is very pleased.
This coffe tastes wonderful!  Mellow with a hint of sweet butter.  I will buy this again as will my coworkers.  I helps to start my day off!

I love flavored coffees and I really enjoy smooth flavors. This coffee fits both of those. It's slightly sweet and has an excellent toffee flvor. The smell of the coffee once it brews is fantastic as well. This has becaome one of the only k-cups I drink now.
I have tried lots of different brands of his flavor and my wife and I both feel this is best of the brands - That said K-Cup coffee by its design is a little expensive but cheaper than going out

I bought some of this stuff near expiration date for cheap. I was surprised to LOVE it!!! It is now my favorite coffee by far. Rich strong, flavorful, but not bitter at all. No creamer needed with this one!
Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee K-Cup is my favorite flavor.  The taste is very yummy, and the room smells so good after brewing the Butter Toffee.  Will not be disappointed !!
I love this coffee flavor.  It is very hard to find in stores in my area.  Now, I can just order it from Amazon and it comes right to my front door.
These Butter Toffee flavored K Cups have become my favorite. I don't like a really strong cup of coffee and these are just right. They have a lot of flavor without any bitterness. Yummy!
This Gloria Jean's Butterr Toffee is incredible!  It's not overpowering, but just perfectly flavored.  I'd say it's a comforting drink!!!  Love it!
Butter Toffee is our favorite flavor from Gloria Jean's.  The aroma is wonderful!  Great way to wake up.

I am a "Doctor it up" coffee drinker, so I do add plain creamer and sugar to my coffee. That said, this coffee has a nice flavor. Not too rich or bold, but not weak either. I tend to like the caramel and chocolate type coffees, but I have added this one to my list!

column9: Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee Coffee for Keurig
column10: The taste of Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee Coffee for Keurig is what brings me back to it everytime. There really is a hint of butter toffee. It adds some snazz to my mornings, and it is a great buy through Amazon's Subscribe and Save program. I just wish it was made in decaf.

Well, I had hoped to enjoy this coffee, but darn...the flavor seems odd, slightly burned and bitter, not smooth in the slightest. Of the eight different flavored coffees that I've tried since buying my Breville Keurig coffeemaker, this one is the least successful for me. Adding cream and sugar doesn't seem to help either, as it emphasizes the unpleasant aftertaste.I'm getting smarter and buying samples of various coffees before I saddle myself with a large quantity of a product that doesn't work for me. I just wish I'd done it sooner.
If you like flavored coffee this stuff is great.  I like the flavor and would recommend it to anyone.

column9: Truly excellent coffee!  One of the better K-cup brands/flavors!
column10: Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee is one of the better tasting K-cup offerings. The coffee tastes very smooth, with just the right amount of flavoring. More importantly, the butter toffee flavoring is not overpowering, and does taste as it should (accurate notes). This is a quality, well balanced coffee.

Smells delicious and tastes delicious.  I love this particular flavor but, for me, it is definitely a flavor that I want only one cup of--no second helpings of this one as it is a bit sweet and rich.  It is definitely a treat.

I tend to be a flavored coffee drinker and I have tried many different flavors, but this is among one of my favorites. It has a great flavor and it's incredibly smooth. It's definitely deserves five stars!

column9: Best coffee for Keurig, great flavor and smell.
column10: I purchased this originally in a small quantity for my continuing search as to what is available for the Keurig.  I had read a review that was very supportive of this flavor--had to try it myself.. It is very good, in fact I drink a couple of cups each day and buy it in the convenient Amazon 50 packs--much cheaper way to buy.  I brew it next to my basement office and the whole floor smells good, a free air freshener. Try it!

I most always order this flavor of Gloria Jean's coffee, which is Butter Toffee. I have ordered other flavors and I always come back to this one.I think if you will notice other reviews, they are also very good. I don't know what I would do without my keurig coffee maker and Gloria Jean's. I always look forward to a cup every morning. I have always ordered my flavored coffee from Amazon.com. I think their price is very good.The delivery is also prompt.

Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee has just a hint of toffee flavor and not too much bite (like the bold k-cups).  It is not as flavorful as other flavored k-cups like German Chocolate Cake, but it seems to have more flavor than Hazelnut or French Vanilla.
We adore the flavor of the Butter Toffee. It is a treat just drinking it black.

We love several of the k-cups amazon.com has for sale.  One of our favorites for a calorie free dessert replacement is the sinfully delicious Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee.  It helps to satisfy the ferocious sweet tooth we have and is delicious both for coffee flavor and butter toffee flavor.  We highly recommend.
Perhaps the best K-cup coffee! I have tried a wide variety of cups. I keep coming back to this. I highly suggest you try it!
I'm not a coffee guru, but I do love the smell of this coffee in the morning and love the taste too!  If you want something a little different and on the sweeter side try this!

This is one of my top,favorite flavors. So good~~ as a matter of fact I have to limit myself or I drink way too much. This coffee is fairly strong but has a wonderful taste. I read one review that stated they felt it was bitter....it is not bitter at all & I bet that person enjoys a milder coffee. I would say this is worth a try if you enjoy flavors verses a plain coffee.

I love this coffee. I drink it frequently. I always use cream/creamer and sugar. The taste reminds me of Butter Rum Lifesavers candy. It is so good.  I really like Gloria Jeans coffee I have tried a lot of her coffee and haven't found one I didn't like.  Sky

I got this flavor in a sampler pack of 4 flavors. It is one of the tastiest new flavors I've found in quite a while. It, along with the Swiss Chocolate Almond flavor from Gloria Jean's, go to the top of my flavored coffee list. The chocolate flavor doesn't overpower the coffee, and vice versa. I have all my coffee with Coffeemate Liquid French Vanilla - Sugar Free only. Thanks Gloria Jean's for adding to my coffee variety!

column9: coffee flavor too weak for my taste, but I fixed that!
column10: The flavor of this coffee is nice, but it's not quite strong enough for my taste.  I have a mini Keurig machine, the kind that makes one cup at a time.  If I get a little too much water in the tank, the coffee is weak. If I get the water even with the fill line, it's still not quite "coffee" enough for me.  The butter toffee flavor is delicious, though. If you like coffee on the light side, you'll like this coffee.  If you like a medium to bold coffee flavor, skip this one.  I'll finish my box, but I won't be buying again.EDIT:  I'm coming back to edit this review 6 months later, because I've had to eat my words.  I HAVE bought more of this coffee, and I can't in good conscience leave this review as is.After my first box, I tried other K Cups, & what I found was--they were all either too weak or too blech tasting.  So what I've done is go back to the toffee flavor, & in every cup I add one of those instant coffee sticks you can buy at the grocery store in the coffee aisle (20 per box for around $3.50). It adds just the right amount of extra coffee boldness that I like. I add the Hazelnut instant coffee to this flavor, and it's wonderful.I love that Amazon has now added a 50 cup box, frustration free packaging, for $22.  What a deal.
I really like this coffee.  It tastes like what you would order in the shop, especially when you add some whip cream and caramel sauce on top.  Very enjoyable.
i love this coffee and will be ordering more as you cannot find it in a store.

I have had my Keurig for many years and we have tried almost every K-cup made.  This seems to be the biggest hit in the house and I recently went on vacation to Florida and bought some there for my family and we could not keep it in stock at the house!  From my 21 year old niece, to my 84 year old grandparents, they all loved it as well. They were all Hazelnut people, as I am as well, but this has turned in to our new fave! Just yummy, I wish it was made in decaf so I could drink more of it per day without shaking :)
Love this K-cup!!!!! I also bring a cup to a co-worker twice a week and she loves it also!
I have tried many flavored coffees and this remains my favorite K-cup.  Timothy's World "German Chocolate Cake" is a close 2nd.

column9: My Fiancée LOVES Her Butter Toffee!!!
column10: I got the Keurig B60 coffee maker for my girlfriend (now my fiancée) for Christmas last year. She was so excited when she realized that she would have the ease of making a cup of coffee whenever she wanted. I don't drink coffee but I like to vicariously live through her...or at least smell the freshly brewed cup.I first got her the Coffee People, Donut Shop K-Cups for her to try. She liked the flavor and definitely enjoyed the Donut Shop coffee but I felt she might be getting a little tired of the Donut Shop coffee because I'd gotten her the amazon.com 50 pk. I started looking around on amazon.com again to find "the perfect" K-Cup for her. I stumbled onto Gloria Jean's Coffees, Butter Toffee K-Cup. I read the reviews and thought I'd take a chance, so I ordered it. I knew I had done something right when she took a sip from her first cup of the Butter Toffee! Her eyes got big and and exclaimed loudly..."YUMMY!!!".It's been about 2 1/2 months now and the Butter Toffee is still the only K-Cup that sits next to our Keurig! She goes through the 48 pk in about 3 weeks! She's stated that the Butter Toffee doesn't even need creamer because the flavor is already so good. If you're looking to impress someone with a special K-Cup, then this is the one for you! You won't be sorry! Just be ready for a loud "YUMMY" within the first 5 minutes of receiving this item :D
If you like flavored coffee, I highly recommend this coffee.  It has an excellent taste, and flavor.

column9: A little more bold or bitter than I thought, but good!
column10: Hazelnut is a lot better and more balanced.  Butter toffee is not as good as it sounds, but is good.  What else can I say?  It's coffee:  gimme some!

column9: GLoria Jean's Butter Toffee coffee cups
column10: Gloria Jean's coffee K-cups are wonderful in the mornings.  The Butter Toffee even smells great!

This Butter Toffee Coffee has a rich full flavor and it has become one of my favorites!  It doesn't taste "watery" as some flavored coffees can.  It was a great price and you can't beat the convenience of having it delivered to your door within 48 hours ... especially during a Chicago snow storm!  It is umm umm good and I hope that you enjoy it as much as I do!
This is my favorite flavored coffee.  A lot of the K-cups are too strong for me and this one is a mild to moderate roast with a great flavor.

column9: Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee K-Cups for Keurig Brewers
column10: Really enjoyed this coffee. The smell is great! Tastes good, what more can you ask! I will buy this product again. Would recommend this product.
A great tasting cup of coffee. If you like good flavored coffee this is for you.

column9: Best Coffeet At A Great Price
column10: Fantastic flavor combined with the ease of a Keurig AND a great program such as Amazon's Subscribe and Save makes this purchase a no brainer.  Just received another box in the mail today......cannot wait to finish that one then on to another.  Thanks Amazon for a great deal.

I haven't had my Keurig coffee maker too long, but I like the Butter Toffee coffee better than any others I've tried.  Hazlenut is OK, but is not nearly as good as my 8 o'clock Hazlenut brewed in my regular coffee maker. The price at Amazon is great too. If you get on the auto shipping it is even less, but I will wait and do that.  I'm sure I'd suddenly get backed up with too many boxes if I didn't time the shipments just right.

This is one of my favorite flavors of coffee. Gloria Jeans coffee always have a lot of flavor to them. Some other brands you have to really think about it to discern the flavor, not so with Gloria Jean's. This price is good also, you won't find it in any store, in this size, for this price.
This is the most popular flavor in our office.  I can't keep enough of it in stock.
I just tried the Butter Toffee and it is wonderfully delicious!I would recommend it highly!!!
This is my favorite flavor of the KCups I have tried so far.  It's really good iced.

I love the the taste of this k-cup it just might be my favoriteit is a wonderful taste for a morning cup of coffee i look forward do drinking itit makes me feel good and special to drink this k-cup well done cheersto another great k-cup!

This flavor is excellent.  It's not too weak or strong, and the flavor is exactly what you would expect- like butter toffee candy- smooth, rich and not too indulgent.  I'm not even a fan of butter toffee candy, but the smell certainly warms up the morning and makes the day easier somehow.  Great for an afternoon treat as well.  Certainly my new favorite coffee.
This is the perfect flavored coffee, the right amount of flavor and boldness.  I love it!

This product has met my expectations for flavor and convenience, while exceeding my expectations for quality and value. The butter toffee happens to be my favorite flavor and being able to purchase these k cups online has been great. They are less expensive when bought in bulk, and they are delivered right to my door. No going to the nearest specialty store to wrestle through throngs of crazed pre-Christmas shoppers : )
I ordered this coffee based on previous reviews and must say it is awesome.  I have a B60 and the largest size is a little too watered down tasting, but the 12 oz. size is just perfect.

I ordered two boxes of Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee. I am glad I did. It was gone within one month. This has a great flavor that is not overpowering and does not have a bitter after-taste. I only wish I ordered more. Amazon provided fast, free delivery and the ordering process is a snap. I will definately shop Amazon more often and I will buy more of Gloria Jean's.

The price is certainly right on this coffee through Amazon, esp. if you sign up for auto delivery. I have to say that the few flavors I have tried in this brand of coffee, I'm not as impressed as I have been with Timothy's & Green Mountain. I was so anxious to try butter toffee just to be somewhat disappointed that the coffee tastes burnt. There is definitely a great smell to it, but the actual taste of it is different than the smell. I have had my co-worker tell me the same of this brand of coffee.
This is the stuff; not bitter at all; perfect for setting 3 on Keurig one Cup Brewer

K-Cup coffes have put us back on track to making coffee at home. We believe they are as good as the best restaurant coffees. We both really enjoy Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee after dinner as a dessert coffee, but of course it is good at any time of day. We are waiting for the decaf version most especially when we have a late dinner.

column9: Very close, but not quite like the real deal
column10: These are quite tasty. They don't taste too peachy at first, but then you have this nice lingering peach flavor after swallowing. The consistency isn't as gummy as their gummy bears, and I miss that. I do also miss the ring shape, though that is only a minor issue. I will say, as a vegetarian, it kills the craving for animal product gummies.

So disappointed with this product. Bought it online because I thought it would taste high end homemade. It is going out to the troops in Afghanistan and I wanted them to have a taste of home for the holidays . Unfortunately, I found I could've saved money and just bought Crunch N' Munch. This product has a bunch of un-popped kernels per bag; not randomly (which would also be bad) but at least 3 to 4 kernels per bag. I thought they would put their product through more rigorous standards of quality, but i see that is not a concern with this vendor.

This gift made a HUGE impression on my recipient. She liked the giant cookie and remarked how original I was to send her such a unique gift. Delivery was on time and Lady Fortunes customer service was very responsive to my delivery questions. I recommend this for anyone who wants to make a BIG impression!
My doggie love her birthday bones. She has a sensitive stomach and the bones didn't make her sick. Thank you!

They look really nice and were very cute.  My dog just turned 15 so I gave these out to friends with dogs for her birthday.  My dog ate hers, but I don't think she loved the taste.  However, I bought them more for the fun of it than for a tasty treat and they served that purpose well.
I have not been able to find this in the stores in about a year-- thank you for the fast service!!

column9: This Product is not available where I live
column10: I have been using this product for years to make Pot Roast.  None of the stores in my area carry it any longer.  Without Amazon I would have to drive 50 miles to purchase it.
Good stuff.  Not available in the Albany NY area where we live.  Had to go to Pittsfield MA to find it.  Worth the trip if you like sauerbraten and don't want to make it from scratch.

We picked up some of this hot sauce on our last trip to the Caribbean and it is by far the best we have every had!  It has the perfect balance of heat with flavor which is due to the garlic in it.  I put this on anything I want to make spicy!

column9: This is how coffee is supposed to taste!
column10: I drank this coffee in Italy 2 years ago when we rented a house there - the locals recommended it - and I am so excited to find out it is available on Amazon.  It has a very nice body without the strong aftertaste - the best way to describe the taste is - full bodied and smooth.  Love, love, love it!  Definitely an improvement over any north American roasted coffee, which tends to have too much bitterness - sign of over-roasting.

Delicious, smooth coffee.  No bitterness with a delightful coffee taste.  I use it in an espresso pot and my drip coffee maker; however, be aware that if you have a fast running drip coffee maker such as "Bunn", this product will not work because it is too finely ground.
Item "name" should include that this is espresso grind -- not for use in drip coffee makers!  Says so on the can, but not in the product title.
Item comes in clear glass, not the white as shown. I would not have purchased the product if I had known.
In my neighborhood these cost more. With the offered free shipping and the price and the speedy delivery. This is a true bargain. I've recommended it to my friends.
What a wonderful cake. An absolute delight. So delicious I just ordered more......And can't wait to get them in the mail.

column9: Excellent Price for fresh Candy Corn!
column10: When ordering candy, there is always the worry of getting old & stale stuff. Well, I ordered mine from Candy Crate, and I got some excellently fresh candy corn! Well packaged, nice and fresh!The candy corn was inside a nice bag that will keep the freshness (which was tied on the top) and then inside of a shopping bag style bag with handles that were also tied. Then inside a box with packing paper to prevent accidental tears on the trip. Bulk packaging, but well worth it!This is the traditional candy corn I was looking for! Orange center, white pointy end, and yellow on the wide end. Brightly colored and tastes great! If you are looking for candy corn, this is a sweet deal!

I ordered these because they were described online as Brachs brand and I was specifically looking for Brachs.  These are definitely not Brachs candy corn.  They look and more importantly, taste totally different.  They do not look like this display picture, and they have a sweeter, waxy, artificial taste.  I contacted the seller and said that I wanted to exchange them for Brachs and he told me that these were Brachs.  I have to absolutely disagree with him.  It sounds silly, but I know my candy corn and these are definitely not Brachs brand.

column9: great find for my father's love of "candy corn".
column10: I could not always find this candy locally, so I went on line and found exactly what I wanted for a great X-MAS present.  The order was shipped out on time and the candy was fresh.  My father and I are very pleased.

This product is not Brach's but took a chance because it was cheaper. It's dry and many pieces are brittle and broken. Will not order it again but I'm not as addicted to this product as much as I was to Brach's Candy Corn. Their's is absolutely yummy!!

column9: Turned out to be not Brach's
column10: My SO loves Brach's candy corn and when I purchased this it was advertised as that. It turned out that it wasn't.  It was good candy corn just not Brach's. So beware.
I purchased this for a friend overseas.  He loved it.  The shipment took long however according to my friend it was worth the wait.  Thanks Amazon.  Candy Corn 5lb Bag
These were listed as Brach's, which I dearly love. They taste like them, so I have no problems with that. They were just in a big bag with no labeling.

This candy corn is so good I'm ordering another. I was nervous when I opened the box it came in because all that in the box was a clear plastic bag filled with the candy. Like the first time, I was disappointed, not because of the cookie itself, which is normally delicious--as a French person, I am very familiar with PIM'S cookies and know what they should taste and look like--, but because of the improper manner in which the packages are stored and handled along the way (I cannot figure out at which end). Obviously, the packages go from cold to hot temperatures (or vice versa), possibly multiple times, which is the worst thing that can happen to cookies incorporating chocolate and filling: this alters their appearance and consistency--chocolate surface becomes discolored and collapses due to melting before regaining some firmness, and the cookie part and filling become too soft. The taste is not affected too badly, but you cannot serve them to guests, because of the cookies' miserable appearence.  In order to save them anyway for my own consumption, I wrap the individual packs in a bath towel and store them in the vegetable compartment of my refrigerator. That helps regain some firmness in the cookies, but of course the chocolate surface remains discolored. So my advice is:  buy individual packs at your grocery store if they carry PIM'S, because the cookies are normally delicious, but do not buy them from Amazon.  It's too bad that Amazon has done nothing so far to correct this storage problem. I buy a lot of stuff from Amazon, to my satisfaction 99 p.100 of the time, including LU "Petit Beurre" cookies (these are rarely available in US grocery stores). Since they include no chocolate or filling, the shipments are usually in perfect condition.  I give PIM,S Orange three stars because the product is excellent under normal conditions, and the problem is not caused by the manufacturer.

column9: Not an EXTRACT - it's artificial vanilla FLAVORING
column10: Do not buy this product if you want vanilla extract, which is legally defined by the FDA as being derived from a tincture containing at least 13.35 ounces of relatively-dry vanilla beans per gallon of 70-proof alcohol.  Vanilla may be the only food flavoring that the FDA has developed standards for - which is understandable given that this orchid-derived spice may be the most popular flavor worldwide.  The popularity and use of vanilla extract in cooking and other products undoubtedly resulted in the need to standardize its formulation.Not sure why Amazon continues to advertise this flavoring as an EXTRACT given that the bottle's label fails to identify it as such.  Unfortunately I couldn't read the label shown on the low resolution image of this item on Amazon's website, but after I received shipment of this item I noticed the top of the bottle's front label actually reads "Watkins Original Vanilla Double Strength - Artificially Flavored" - and thus it clearly does not identify this product as being an EXTRACT (merely mentioning in the fine print at bottom of front label that it contains vanilla extract).Furthermore, the bottle's back label lists its ingredients - and their order of preponderance shows this flavoring contains more water, sugar and "propylene glycol" (a component of anti-freeze!) than vanilla extract!!!Sure would be great if Amazon would correct this item's product description by removing the word "Extract" from both its banner and "product features" section.  Even better, it should note that the product is "artificially flavored" and also list its ingredients in the order of their predominance (i.e., Water, glucose, propylene glycol, vanilla extract (alcohol, water, extractive of vanilla beans), alcohol (8.25%), artificial flavors, caramel color. Contains Sulfites.).Hopefully, no one else will fall prey to this item's false advertisement.
