I will never buy another Watkins  product!

column9: The description didn't say " Artificially Flavored"
column10: I am very picky on what I feed my family and I spend the extra to stay pure rather then "Artificially  Flavored"  so I was very disappointed when I opened my package and saw "Artificially  Flavored" on the package I will not order again because of this. The flavor is good and I will use it up. I am so sad that it is "Artificially  Flavored"

The flavor is terrific, but I'm a little disappointed that it's not more of natural product.  I'm on the fence on whether I'd use it again.  On one hand it really is a terrific, yummy product, but I don't like that it's not more natural.Bottom line - If you don't care about the ingredients, this product is very,very good.
I bought this for my wife who loves to bake and this made such a difference in any of her recipes that called for vanilla,what a difference.

column9: THE BEST VANILLA AND I FOUND IT ON AMAZON.COM
column10: I first found Watkins Vanilla Double Strength at a farmer's market street fair many years ago.  I haven't used anything else since.  Watkins has a depth of flavor that enhances everything you cook.  If you love the taste of vanilla, try this product, you won't be disappointed.

I do not use any other extract or flavoring except Watkins. It makes the difference in my baking. As a  child, my mother used only Watkins as did my grandmother. It is the best and worth the cost which by the way was a good deal.
No doubt that this is the best true vanilla that you can buy today...but the bargain price I found here on Amazon was astounding!  So much cheaper than directly from a dealer!

I love Watkins Vanilla and was delighted to be able to receive so quickly with little effort on my part.  I did purchase through Amazon and was amazed at the quick delivery.  I thought Amazon was only for books, but have used several times for other things.  I check Amazon first when I need/want something.

column9: A fantastic sweetener for my overly sweet coffee fix.
column10: I was already familiar with this product prior to purchase since I like coffee with my sugar (or sugar substitute.) It is a delicious sweetener since it tastes exactly like sugar without the strange aftertaste typical of other sugar substitutes.  I will be a life long consumer of this product.

I switched to this product thinking I would get more of a value than buying the bagged form but I was wrong..It takes some time for this sugar to dissolve into what you are adding it to which was not a problem with the bagged xylitol..Not happy that I purchased so many packets but once they are all gone I won't be purchasing it again..Get the bagged loose xylitol, its much better...
This has lasted me more than a year. This xylitol tastes great, and this enables me to carry some in my day bag. So im not stuck using sugar in my teas. Great value and product!

This is a very good product for any price. People knock it a bit because of the corn but I've spoken to Eagle Pack and have found they are very open about their product. Carbohydrates are carbohydrates are carbohydrates. No cat needs them. Ever! Apparently the grains used in this product are local to Indiana and surrounding areas (Michigan, Illinois, Ohio)? That's never a bad thing as far as I'm concerned. I've also read the company is non-GMO but I haven't confirmed that information through e-mail. The point is that unless your pet is allergic to corn or rice you're wasting your time going grain free. Potatoes and peas are just as useless as corn or rice and cats would never eat any of these in the wild. So if you want a food that is locally sourced (for the most part) and don't want to pay twice as much for Orijen simply because they use peas and potatoes this is a great option.

column9: The flavors are great; but don't expect a dark roast!!
column10: I loved the flavor options when I bought this pack, but it took a while to get the blend of my coffee correct.  I made a 6-cup pot of coffee and used an entire pack of Boyer's and still added 1 scoop of my store-bought dark roast coffee to get a robust coffee taste.  The first pot I made was weak as tea, but the added flavors (Vanilla Nut, French Vanilla, etc) were excellent.  If they would darken the roast I would recommend this product.
This stuff tastes like sweet n' low, really nasty!It doesn't mix very well, leaves a bad taste in your mouth all day, I wont buy it again.

column9: Tastes like what I imagine food in hell would taste like!
column10: I work out every day and I've choked down the newest protein powders that tastes like chalk.I eat tomatoes chopped up on food even though I hate them.So after the first bite and that sudden WTF realization that this tasted nothing like apples or cinnamon I figured I would just trod through it.My gag reflex had other plans! (I just burped and almost threw up again!)I'd like to find what ever taste tester at Cytosport OK'd this flavor and punch him or her in the crotch!I tried to give it to my dogs (they are the left over cleaner uppers) and they looked at me like I was holding a club in my hand!They lick their own butts (one of the dogs used to eat from the cats' litter box) and they wouldn't come near it!They must be smarter than me because I figured that I'd try a second container with whole milk instead of water.So much for bigger brain=smarter.I am going to try to feed the last four containers (uncooked) to the squirrels outside and see if they will eat it.Have you heard the saying "anticipation of death is worse than death itself"?Well I have six containers of their maple/brown sugar as well.And I am not too manly to admit that I am scared, yes SCARED, to try one!(Burped again, choking back bile!)I just ate a piece of bread slathered in mustard to block the taste.So in summary, AVOID THIS STUFF LIKE RAT POISON!I may yet call the poison control hotline.If you don't see a review of the maple/brown sugar flavor in the next week, call 911 for me!

I love Muscle milk and the idea of it with Oatmeal sounded right on track.  The stuff does not mix and is too sweet.  Real oatmeal with Muscle milk over it would be great, this stuff is awful, and it's 300 calories.If I wasn't so lazy, I'd return them.  I'll mix it with a shake to gag them down.

column9: Use milk instead of water -  tastes better
column10: I have low blood sugar, so I am always excited about trying a new product that is high in protein to keep my blood sugar levels stable.  I have been using Muscle Milk shakes for several years and have enjoyed good results, so I was very excited about trying Muscle Milk oatmeal.  I was soooooo disappointed by the awful taste.  Didn't want to waste the 6-pack, so I gave some to my Mother.  She said she loved the taste, but she used hot milk instead of hot water to mix.  Then I tried heating milk for 60 seconds in the microwave and then pouring it into the cup.  Wow!  What a difference.  The taste is so much better that I plan to add this product to my list of food staples.  Before I purchased, I read a few reviews that gave poor ratings due to the taste.  Try it with hot milk, and you might like it. Since I have low blood sugar, I need to eat a lot of protein which can increase cholesterol; this product only has 5mg of cholesterol per serving, so it is a great way to increase protein.  Also, I found the one cup serving to be a little too much.  So, I just eat 1/2 at breakfast and put the container in a gladware container and reheat the next day.

I am a fan of the Muscle Milk Milk and Oats oatmeals by Cytosport.  The product comes in several flavors of which Banana Walnut is one.  The banana flavor was detectable but the walnut was understated.My preferred flavor is blueberries and cream.Milk and Oats is in my opinion a healthy product which delivers a good amount of protein and vitamins.  It provides a healthy start to any day.One caution with this product.  It took me several times making the oatmeal to make it turn out right.  It takes a little more effort than add water, stir and nuke.
This is the worst tasting protein I have ever eaten. It is the Indiana Jones and the crystal skull of the protein world.

I eat steelcut oatmeal, prepare it with water and love it that way. My husband decided to try this thing and honestly is the most disgusting thing we've ever eaten. It is so unnecesary to put that sweetener on it. My stepsons tried it too and hated it. It is so bad I don't even want to give it away (bought 4 trays, since we love oatmeal). It is going straight to the trash.

I love this stuff.  Normally I would eat egg whites and oatmeal, like my personal trainer wants me too, but I have a young kid (7) that I have to get ready for school each day, and I never seem to have time for cooking in the mornings.  My personal trainer actually put me on to Muscle Milk N' Oats when I decided to to a 2 week road trip and I knew I would have very limited chances to cook.  Since then I have been using them every time I need a good breakfast in a hurry (when I don't have time to make egg whites and oatmeal).  This stuff tastes great, and you can make it in about 2 minutes or less.  I would recommend these to anyone.  I love the Maple and Brown sugar flavor.  I tried the Vanilla flavor and I didn't like it.  I haven't tried the other flavors.  I have been eating the Maple and Brown sugar flavor almost every day for about 5 months and I haven't got tired of it.

column9: By far, one of the worst breakfast foods ever...
column10: I've tried Maple Brown Sugar and Banana flavored Muscle Milk and Oats and they are absolutely terrible.  I am a big fan of Muscle Milk, but this is an awful way to consume it.  It's simply a scoop or so of the Muscle Milk powder with some wimpy, fine oatmeal flakes.  Add a little bit of hot water and you've got a super pasty extra strong, hot, pungent soup of protein powder and oatmeal.  I couldn't eat the six-pack obviously, so I gave to some friends to try... every verdict from everyone was that it was terrible.  I'd give it 0 stars if I could.

I bought these b/c I needed a little more in my cart to get free shipping, and should not have wasted my money.  They are terrible, I think it's the combo of oj and mango -- not good at all.  The Crispy brand freeze dried fruit is much better and I'll be sticking with that from now on.
More orangey than mangoey, but very very tasty! A great portable, crisp, light snack. Nutritious too! And it has a monkey on the package!!! Who doesn't love monkeys on their food?!!!
My kids are pretty open to dried friut or the like, but they say these are not good at all.  I think I will return them.
I like the Funky Monkey and would gladly buy more. I just cannot justify the cost ($38/pound).

The OJ is barely noticeable, but who cares? The kids love it. The mango tastes as if (color me surprised) it was actually ripe when processed. Bag size is good for 1 serving for an older child, a bit much for a young child. At roughly $1/bag, these won't make an everyday appearance in the lunchboxes, but will be a nice option when fresh things aren't available.

First of all, when I saw this product on display showing all 3 items I thought that for $8.00 it was for all 3 products. But when I only received the raisins I thought, WOW I could of got the SunMaide Chocolate Raisins in a Big Container for just alittle more money, for a lot more raisins.. They should show this product individually, instead of the group of 3, because I thought I was getting all 3 items.. So for $8.00 it wasnt worth it, just to have 1 item for that expensive cost, that I could eat all in one sitting.Even tho it was Ghirdelli's name on the product, it tasted no different than the normal chocolate on a raisinette!!

Ok, so these are expensive, but to date these are the BEST chocolate covered raisins I have tried.  And as a chocoholic, "foodie", chocolate covered raisin lover person; I have tried many, many other brands of chocolate raisins.  I make it my business to know who makes the best "chockies" because I see no reason to consume inferior chocolate.

column9: Makes using garlic a pleasure, no work and plenty of flavor.
column10: We love garlic bread with our pasta. First, we alwaysmake garlic butter - with garlic juice all you needto do is mix some juice into the butter and get a creamygarlic butter which spreads on toasted french breadand there you have it. Delicious. Fast.

This product met the standards prescribed by my doctor. It is potent! I have to use twenty words to say that it is the right product for what I am trying to do and in the future I will probably not fill out this sort of information when I have to be wordy just to say, "I like it. It works well. I will buy it again."

column9: the gum for people with dentures
column10: I wish the taste would last longer. It goes flat a little too quickly. But I know of no other gum for dentures
I buy this gum for my dental work.  Winterfresh is my favorite flavor.  I buy it on-line as I cant get it in stores in Columbus Ohio.
I love this gum and could no longer get it any where here in Wyoming. So I tried the internet and here it was. Thanks so much.

Is this really Freedent? I don't know, it sticks to my dental work, leaves a blue syrup-y liquid behind that gathers and dries at the corners of my mouth and creates cracks, like it dried it out or something.When I used to buy this in the grocery store it never did any of that to me! What's up, Wrigley? Plus, I only ordered one, not two of these.

I bought this because my partner and I were starting a diet and wanted something to curb my appetite. I didn't realize I would be saving money as opposed to buying out of the vending machine even considering that I probably go through about 3x the ammount of gum.

column4: E. Allen "butter my toast and sugar my tea, h...
column10: I first saw this in the grocery store about a year ago and although its price was a bit more steep than traditional lasagna noodles, I decided to give it a try. Am SO I glad I did! These noodles are paper-thin and although they do not give the impression of covering the pan, do NOT be fooled. They DO expand to perfection while baking! For one who texture is a big deal, this old-world lasagna is a culinary delight because it allows you to actually enjoy the flavor of the marinara and cheese with just a hint of pasta, similar perhaps to a cross between angel-hair pasta and thin-crust pizza. The top layer becomes slightly-so crunchy when baking so it makes the cheese on top super scrumptious.There is a fabulous recipe ON the box but it uses their brand-label pasta sauce. I personally used Bertolli's Red Wine marinara blends because I think it is a much richer and flavorful taste with the ricotta and meshes beautifully with the noodles. I punched it up with some baby spinach and baby bellas in the layers and only used half a lb of ground turkey meat (for those who prefer more veggies) I made one pan for our family and the other pan for a new mother from my church. Her small family of 3 LOVED it and gobbled it up in a day!! I won't go back to traditional noodles after tasting this. VERY IMPRESSED!!!!So here's the rundown:5 Stars: skipping the burdensome task of boiling noodles beforehand5 Stars: excellent taste, texture and quality5 Stars: recipe on the box was obviously tested beforehand (a rare commodity these days!!) and works wonderfully with their product

Not great tasting if you fix your lasagna using these noodles and plan to eat it within a 60 minute baking time.  However, if you fix your lasagna in the morning it is fabulous after baking that evening for dinner.  Or even better, refrigerate and bake it off the next day.  These noodles save tons of time and taste just as good as the ones you have to pre-boil.  But they only taste just as good if you do not eat them right away.  Then they taste a bit like cardboard.  They do need to absorb some of the sauce and cheese, etc.  You will not be sorry you bought these.  They sure save time.  And, I love being able to buy them at Amazon.com.

I have an amazing recipe for Chicken Alfredo Lasagna that originally called for these noodles.  Being a skeptic, I always used the traditional ones.  This lasagna has always turned out flawless. Well, today, Christmas Eve, I was very short on time and decided to give these a try.  What an idiot mistake on my part (first, to do on a holiday, and second, to think that there is ever a valid short-cut to give you the same results as the long route).I baked according to directions and was utterly disgusted to see the results.  The noodles were thin, gummy, and almost non-existent in the dish.  Sure, they "stretched" to the edges of the pan as they claimed, but who cares?  It's garbage!  I'm pretty confident in my abilities in the kitchen, and I don't think the mistake was on me.  Now that I think about it, I believe I tried these several years ago and had horrible results...which is why I didn't use them in this recipe in the first place.  Too bad I didn't think of that earlier when I was only concentrating on saving time.So, now we'll be having spaghetti and meat sauce (thank goodness I've always got a back-up).  But, alas, I wasted about $40 in ingredients and 3 hours that I'll never get back.  Thanks for nothing, Barilla.  I'm done with your products.
the candy is great. I really enjoy the great flavors. i am reminded of when i was just a young kid and used to go to the store and get some of this penny candy. I see more orders in the future.

I'm on a total liquid diet and the shakes I drink for nutrition are so bland!  I add this peanut butter syrup (Just a tablespoon) to my chocolate shake for a yummy reese's flavor.  I add the english toffee brand with peanut butter to my vanilla shake and I'm in heaven...well as much heaven as can be accessed without any solid food!  :o)
I get sugar-free soynut butter and mix it as follows: 1 oz. sugar-free peanut butter syrup, 4 oz. soynut butter, 3 packets of artificial sweetener.  It's great!

column9: One of the better soup bases
column10: This Pho soup base is good if you don't have time to make soup from scratch. Very few restaurants actually make Pho soup from scratch. Most don't want you to know that they actually use one of the Korean or Japanese made beef dashida or Hondashi powder soup stocks and add a few ingredients such as star anise, clove, peppercorns and lemongrass. Pho is a good profit making dish. (Consider the fact that a pound of rice stick noodles cost less than a dollar.)The key to good Pho is having very fresh Thai Basil, Cilantro and Mung Bean Sprouts. If your going to add some sriracha, hoisin, chili sauce and lime to your Pho, you'll never know that this product wasn't made from scratch. Extra meatballs please.This Asian Food Grocer/Wholesaler thinks that Por Kwan brand soup bases are some of the better products on the shelf.

I love this Pho base, No its not going to be like getting a bowl of freshly made Pho from your local vietnamese restaurant, but it is a tasty tasty soup base on its own. I use it also to flavor stir fry, I combine it with frozen dumplings for a soup. Its super salty, just the way I like it, and it lasts forever. If you like lemongrass, ginger, star anise, cinnamon, garlic and sweet basil youll love the flavors this soup base brings.

column9: Can't be beat for the price
column10: Tried this on a whim and after messing around with preparation, can't see myself using anything else. I moved to Maryland form NW Washington (pho everywhere to pho nowhere). I needed something to keep my cravings in check. I was expecting to just put up with this stuff, but it surprised me.I add to cloves of Star Anise, a dash of Ginger, and a few cloves of Basil to simmer while I get everything else ready, and for homemade, you are doing great. On top of that it is quick and cleanup is nothing. Plus, reading the instructions is fun. Recommended highly for those away from authentic pho.

Pho is one of my favorite meals, unfortunately there aren't many good pho restaurants in my area.  I bought this product at an Asian market without any expectations, however I was pleasantly surprised at how good the resulting soup came out.  Definitely not the same as ones I've had at better pho reastaurants, but for a quick, delicious homemade meal, it's much better than I thought was possible. Just add beef, onions, and sprouts... highly recommended!

This is definitely the worst, most horrific imitation of pho I've ever had. If you have eaten and enjoyed a delicious bowl of pho in a restaurant, beware. This tastes nothing like what you're used to, or looking forward to. It stinks, and tastes overly salty and rancid, though I know it wasn't, because I bought another jar of it from a shop and it was just the same. If what you're looking for is a way to make pho at home, my suggestion is to either take the time to make the broth from scratch, or abandon the idea and go to a restaurant. This is absolutely not worth your time or money.

Nice, rich taste, with hints of the complex spices you expect in a bowl of pho.  The broth is a bit thicker than restaurant pho, but  tastes the same, in my opinion -- much better than I expected!  Highly recommended.

This takes the work out of making PHO. We do use about twice as much of the paste than the directions call for and let it steep a little longer. It is not quite as clear as some but the flavor is great. I really recommend this. This is one of my favorite products.

I just finished my first bowl of Umpqua Oats and had to grab my computer to write a review about it. I'm not the healthiest of eaters, though I really try to be. It's very hard for me to finish any bowl of oatmeal, either because my stomach starts to hurt or because the consistency of the oatmeal grosses me out.The cashier at the coffee shop I frequent recommended Umpqua "R U Nuts" Oats and, man, I licked the bowl clean! It was filled with a hint of brown sugar and chopped up nuts and I think I saw some sunflowers in there. I added a few cut strawberries in there and enjoyed every.single.bite!I plan on buying this six pack of oats because an individual container cost me $3.50 at the cafe. I'm sure my husband will want to try these too.Mmmmm. Mmmmm. Yummy!

column9: LITTLE FINGERS LOVE TO SHOVE THIS YUM STUFF IN THEIR MOUTHS!
column10: GERBER FINGER FOODSMy little ten month old grand-daughter, Paige, LOVES these little food puffs.  We bought her the banana flavor, but there are many flavors available.The good thing about these little stars is that they taste good and are easy for little ones to pick up.  They also are good practice for finger dexterity.  These little MAGIC STARS -- as we call them -- melt right away in baby's mouth.  Great food for those babies just starting to eat table food.They are a good little food for snack time or any time.  Easy, convenient packaging makes traveling easy too.Your baby will love these.  And I know you will sneak a few for yourself!Enjoy!Thank you!Pam

These are great, tasty snacks for babies who are starting to eat finger foods.  They are a bit crunchy, but quickly melt so they don't pose a choking risk.  I buy them all of the time for my grandson, but I love them myself.  Eighty of these poofs have 25 calories, you can't beat that when you want to munch!  They are fat free and contain a fair amount of vitamins.  Nothing not to like, try them even if you don't have any little ones!
I love this product! I bought it to replace my constant purchase of vanilla beans.  It's a perfect substitute.

I usually order vanilla beans to make my own vanilla extract for myself and others. I thought I'd try this paste and I'm glad I did. First of all, I can use it right away instead of having to wait 3 weeks for the extract to mature. Second, I like the fact that although I don't have to mess around with the beans when making ice cream, I still get the black specks in anything I make.The flavor is good.
Love to use N-M vanilla been paste in creme brulee & homemade ice cream in place of hard to use & expensive vanilla beans. Hard to find where I live so I was pleased to find it here at a great price.
this is the best thing since disposable diapers!! way cheaper than buying the actual vanilla beans and so, so much easier to use. it's delicious and i would recommend it to anyone!

I needed a jar of vanilla paste, but I did not want to purchase it locally at such a high price. I was really excited to find it on Amazon for half price. The flavor of this Nielsen-Massey vanilla paste is suberb and yes, I will most certainly be purchasing more when this jar is used up.
Great for making desserts of all kinds... very concentrated and much cheaper than buying vanilla beans and much less work too.  Considering all this, it's definitely well worth the price!
Nothing like this is available where I live. This is a very nice product, and I will buy it again.
I was completely satisfied and happy with my purchase.  I have been experimenting with baking and like high quality products to give the best taste possible.

column9: Nielsen-Massey Pure vanilla Bean Paste purchased via Amazon
column10: This was my first time to use Vanilla Bean Paste.  I loved it. Because it's not liquid, it's easier to get the right consistency to icing and still have tons of good flavor.  The vanilla flavor is perfect...not too strong but yet the vanilla flavor comes through it a scrumptious way.  Good service.  The seller answered a question very quickly and shipped with ample packaging.
I have used other vanilla bean pastes in the paste but this one is by far the best.  I can't tell you why exactly,  I just know that it is....

If you're trying to lose weight, this tea will become your best friend. If you like being in control of your food cravings, this tea will support your efforts. If you like blueberries, this tea will satisfy your senses. If you like energy, this tea will give you a supply of it. For a great tasting tea with all these added benefits, I believe this tea will make you very happy.And finally, if you like to increase your savings, buy it here.  Incredible value!

I'm a green tea fanatic, and have tried over 150 bagged/loose leaf varieties. I have a crazy job, and used to rely on coffee for the energy boost while sleep deprived. Coffee works, but at the cost of digestive issues, acidity and a dehydrated "run-down", stressed out feeling. Enter green tea, which energizes and rejuvenates in a completely different way form coffee. Green tea's antioxidants, small amounts of caffeine and theanines promote a feeling of relaxation as well as stamina, and you can drink several cups without  feeling stressed out and jittery (ie the over-caffeinated syndrome from coffee).  While bagged tea will never equate the taste and freshness standard of looseleaf, if you are looking for a convenient tea offering a true energy boost to take at work, this tea is fantastic. The triphala extract (an Ayurvedic herb blend known for promoting regularity, energy and well-being) really does seem to rev up your metabolism and digestion while sustaining a level of peaceful energy. I was very pleasantly surprised by the taste and quality of this tea - it's got a faint blueberry 'zing' to it and doesn't taste medicinal at all. In fact, I subscribed to have this item delivered to me regularly as I went through so many boxes quickly. It's a great price and the little peaceful sayings on each green tea bag help remind you to stay centered and happy with each sip!

column9: deliciously fragrant tea and energy booster
column10: I was surprised when I first brewed this tea -- it turned purple!  Turns out it has a delicious blueberry/orange scent which is a surprise since I wasn't expecting any flavor from this tea.  After drinking the tea, I got an energy boost and a clean feeling in my stomach.  It's a good way to keep going without snacking.

This tea not only helps control my appetite but helps me to bounce around all day with out getting tired. I just drink two cups a day , because it is all I need. It tastes good too. I am 82 years old and have been drinking this tea for many years now.

I have been a tea drinker for years and have always felt I was buying good tea when I bought the Celestial in the grocery story. Once I tried Yogi tea, I was hooked. I started it while going on a Juice Fast and needed energy and something to hold me from one meal to the next.This tea is perfect. It is great to take to work for breaks and just at home in the morning to get me up and moving. I have totally stopped drinking coffee and use my coffee maker to heat up water in the morning for my tea.I love the flavor (not fond of minty flavors) and it really seems to help me last from meal to meal. I no longer need a caffeine fix in the morning and my day often starts at 4 a.m. for work. I need all the energy I can get to get through a day at work.I have also lost weight which has been a battle after age 60. The tea with other sensible weight lose plans really has worked. This will always be my favorite, while also trying the other teas.

I've tried almost every green tea on the market, and this is one of my favorites.  It has a great flavor, and it really does help me keep from snacking between meals.  I don't think it's possible to find great organic green tea at this price anywhere else.

After trying Yogi tea, I'll never go back to Celestial Seasonings or Lipton.  The quality is 10000% better than non-organic teas.  If you are debating on trying this, just buy it.  Rating this a 5/5 in taste and quality.As for weight loss and appetite, this tea did nothing for me.  I hate when companies claim weight loss for products that don't work or are just regular green tea.  Rating this a 1/5 for living up the tea's weight loss claims.

Tastes better than 90% of the 'slimming' teas on the market and is NOT a laxative tea.  Definitely curbs hunger and makes me less likely to snack, especially in the afternoon when energy levels are getting low.

I have started using the Slimlife tea while also starting a wheat/gluten and dairy free diet. I was rec this tea by my accupuncturest and I love it. I have to admit I don't get hungry at all and have to remind myself to eat. I have nothing but good things to say about this tea, drink up.

column9: HBP individuals; can interefere with your meds
column10: Love the taste of the tea.  However, I strongly urge people with high blood pressure not to use this product without talking to their physician first.  After drinking the tea on and off for two weeks, I discovered that my blood pressure was increasing.  A review of my habits indicated that the only new introduction into my routine eating and drinking habits was the Slim Life tea.  It appears that the Eleutro root can interfere with your medication to the point that it renders your HBP medication ineffective.  Needless to say, I immediately discontinued using the product and as a result, my pressure went back down.Yogi teas are great but it appears that this one is not for us (consumers with HBP).

This tea is delicious, especially with honey.  It is a very fragrant yet "gentle" tea.  It does help control appetite in the sense that it helps reduce stress, one of the major causes of constantly grazing at work.  Being organic is a bonus.

Main reason for buying: weight lossCompelling force: Other reviews and product description influenced my decision to buy. I'd previously tried the lipton original green tea which was terribly bitter, so definitely needed an alternative option.Taste: light blueberry smell and flavour. Not bitter due to the blueberry. However, after trying it without any additives, I decided to add pure honey and low fat milk (1%) and these made it taste a lot better. Drinking it as it was prior to the additives was like drinking hot water with sprinkles of light blueberry.Effect: Tends to fill me up and does not make me feel hungry for hours. Be mindful of the caffeine as well as it may keep you up if taken too late at night. My belly feels less bloated as my metabolic rate increases with the tea. Remember to exercise as well for better results. I suppose that's just common sense if you're attempting to lose weight.Verdict: It does work and I tend to jump around a lot due to the caffeine. I have actually become more impulsive (in a nice way) and energetic. Went on a 10-mile bike ride last weekend and was never hungry or thirsty.Recommendation: Yes, I would recommend it to a friend. However, you need to make some time for it. I drink an average of 3 cups daily. Go figure !!! Good luck
This is an interesting tea that seems to taste best cold. I usually have a cup earlier in the day and it does help reduce my appetite. Definitely be careful not to oversteep it as it will get bitter.
I like this tea, as well as other yogi teas.  Delicate flavor, and it does help me not to snack between meals.

The first thing I noticed with this tea was the very dark color once it was made, then I took a sip and it really wasn't what I was expecting. But the more I drank it the more I liked it. It has a strong, slightly sweet, but very nice taste. No cream or sugar necessary.I don't know about the weight loss or appetite suppressant claims. I do find it helps me eat less, but the same is true of most liquids. In any case, I drink 3 or 4 cups of this a day (package says one cup is about 1/3 the caffeine in coffee) and it does help me reduce eating.
This is a very tasty tea, I love the flavor, it's very soothing. Not sure if I'm losing weight, but I drink it more Yogi tea than any other tea.I plan on buying more.Thank-you

column9: I Really Wanted to Like this Tea :-(
column10: I love all kinds of teas, I drink some every day.  I saw that so many people like this blueberry variety, so I decided to try it.  I am a big believer in the "groupthink" of customer reviews.  And I am rarely disappointed in anything Amazon.  I didn't see that stevia is an ingredient.  Stevia creates a very bitter taste in my mouth.  So I will be sharing this shipment with my friends who don't mind stevia.  I'm going to look at other Yogi teas and check on the ingredients closely.

I'm not a huge tea fan, but this caught my eye as a possible way to help curb my appetite in the evenings.  I was THRILLED with the taste! Subtle blueberry flavor and not bitter at all. Definately helps with cravings and my belly feels much less bloated.  Great price for a pack of 6!
Absolutely enjoyed this tea! This has been a great replacement for coffee. Would highly recommend this to anyone who is venturing into the green tea realm and needs an easy in.
Good tasting tea that really helps control appetite and gives me energy. No unpleasant side affects either!

Today is Sunday, December 26, 2010. This is my second reviews on this product. I could not create 2 reviews on the same product so I had to delete and edited the old one. On the previous review, I had given 3 out of 5 stars because it didn't help suppress my appetites. Anyways, I continued to drink the tea for over a month now. I got to say it does work. It did not make me feel jittery at all. I was 140 lbs on November 1, 2010 and now I weight 128 lbs. My weight goal is 120 lbs so I will keep drinking the tea until I reach my goal. Please understand that there is no magic in this tea. I was able to lose the weight is because I work out 3 to 4 days a week in the gym (cardio) and I also watch what I eat. By drinking this tea will help control my appetites and I don't feel that hungry. Oh I also don't eat anything after 6pm. If I get too hungry, I will eat a mini carrots are 1 orange.I only gave 4 stars instead of 5 is because I don't think it work compare to the first month when I first started to drink this tea. It does work but I just don't think It work like the first month. I was able to lose 10 lbs  in 1 month but now I'm on the second month. I was able to lose only 1 to 2 lbs at the most. My diet plans and exercisers were the same in November but I was only able to lose 1 to 2 lbs during the month of Dec. I am not sure why I was not able to lose more than 2 lbs after I lose the 10lbs. I will place another order soon...I hope my review will help some of you that are searching for a tea that you can enjoy drinking and at the same time it will also help to suppress the appetites. Thank you for reading....

I love this tea so much! It tastes great, gives me just the right of energy I need without wanting to dance on table tops or talk a mile a minute and it curbs my appetite so I'm not tempted to snack during the middle of the day! I like it so much that I bulk up and buy more than one box at a time because its hard to find Yogi Green Tea Blueberry Slim Life at my local store.Everyone reacts to things differently, but if you're looking for energy and a way to keep hunger at bay, you may like this tea a lot! I also noticed (and it could be a coincidence) that the times I've started getting a cold and been drinking this, the germs don't stand a chance!:)

I LOVE TEA. Ever since I've been trying to cut coffee out of my diet completely (cause of teeth coloring), I started to drink at least 3-4 cups in the morning to rehydrate and get my caffeine kick, and 3-4 more cups throughout the rest of the day. That being said, I never previously found a tea mixture that I could drink for more than 3 days in a row at a time.I've been on a life long hunt for a tea that's a little fruity without extra calories, actually tastes a little fruity, smells/tastes delicious, and gives me a slight caffeine kick.Now, before I go onto my rave about my love for this tea, this tea is not for everyone. If you're not really into the blueberry tasting thing, this is definitely not for you. My office smells like fruity blueberriness when I make this tea (luckily my coworkers don't mind it and enjoy it).I previously tried other fruity teas but found they 1) didn't taste like the fruit even in the slightest bit, 2) only had an amazing scent but no amazing taste, or 3) had some taste of the fruit but left an awful bitter taste in my mouth.In. comes. Yogi's Green Tea Blueberry Slim Tea. I have to be honest. I did not buy this for the slimming effects. I bought it for the promise of the blueberry taste. This is the only tea that fits exactly what I was looking for. I bought this 6 pack thing and zoomed through it within 2.5 months flat. Yikes. And this was with me doing my best to not use more than 3 tea bags a day (several times I broke and went through 5 a day :[[[ ). I loved it that much. Still love it. I've been trying other teas that promise the blueberry taste, but I find others are not as smooth as Yogi's.

column4: Chi "Who loves to find bargains and lives a g...
column9: Product development people at the Yogi are genius!
column10: I've tried quite a few Yogi tea, not once I was disappointed. But this Green Team Blueberry Slim Life flavor was THE BEST! OMG! The fragrance will linger in the air and just made me feel so good. I am drinking the tea to avoid craving. It is working out so far. I notice I don't crave for sweet and salty food. Well done! Yogi People! If you are reading the comments, I want to congratulate you for a brilliant tea flavor innovation.

column9: Great Tasting Tea with an Energy Boost
column10: I'm not a tea connoisseur, but I know good taste when I taste it.  This is some good tasting tea, let me tell you.  I've tried the original Green Kombucha and it is good also, but this one is my favorite.  I have also tried a few other flavors and many brands but this one still has the rest beat.  No need to add anything but hot water and you're good to go.Also this gives a little energy boost, for me anyway, that I can feel and almost as much as an equivalent sized cup of coffee.  The only warning I would give about this product is beware drinking a whole cup of this then some water, because you WILL have to pee soon and often.  Meetings and classes are hell after this so be warned.I also highly recommend you buy this from Amazon since it comes simply packaged and at a great price.  Thanks again Amazon for the great discovery!

Green tea is your best weight-lose friend. Several years ago, I gained 15 pounds with no change to my diet except for an introduced intake of diet coke, about one per day. I stopped the diet coke and took up green tea. Although I started seeing marginal weight changes pretty soon, the great long-term benefit of green tea is that now I can pretty much eat anything, and I never have to worry about my weight as long as I drink a few cups of this tea everyday (not once in a while or twice a week. And "eat anything" is within reason - i.e. no eating 8 donuts in a row everyday.) I highly encourage making green tea drinking part of your morning, mid-day and afternoon routine. Swap it for coffee and even water. Drink decaf if you prefer to remove the caffeine effect. Do it for 30 days to get in a routine. I'm usually on the receiving end of "how do you eat the way you do?" I'm quoting this only to show that you will be a size with which you are comfortable without dedicating yourself to a life of steamed chicken breast and spinach or abysmally small serving sizes "I'll just have a bite of the creme brule. No really, I can't have anymore - I already had fries for lunch." This tea also regulates your hunger, so you're not craving snacks all day. The blueberry slim life tea has always been my favorite, and the boxes I got from Amazon were exactly what I expected. Plus, they were a great discount from the retailers that carry the tea - usually it's like $4.99 a box, and I got the set of 6 for less than $3. If you're a tea drinker, this is a great deal. I was a little afraid the boxes may be squished or mistaken, but they were intact. I'll definitely buy this again through Amazon.

I am a big tea drinker and this is by far the best green tea!  The taste is pleasant and fruity and it doesnt taste bitter like other green teas...it is great with honey but not needed at all...  I think it helps keep me going throughout the day...i am a stay at home mom and need a extra boost in the afternoon!  Works perfectly and doesnt make me jittery at all!  Highly recommend it if you want to try out green tea but unsure of getting straight up green...due to the bitterness...this is a nice mix of flavors!

column9: Great tasting tea!  Berry flavor and appetitle control.
column10: I got this tea imagining it might not taste that good since it is for appetite control, but boy was I wrong!  The tea tastes great. There is some stevia in it so it is a little sweet without sugar.  It has a few berry flavors that really mix well.  It is now one of my favorite Yogi teas.

i love yogi tea! the writings on the paper tab attached to the string of the bag have wise, centering sayings and since i teach mindfulness to my clients, providing yogi tea for them reinforces their learning:-) this tea is subtle and easy to drink and helps shed toxins from the bloodstream.

i will definitely have to say this tea works if you want to suppress your appetite. I had this tea in the morning with my breakfast. I noticed that it doesn't seem to mix well with eating. It makes me feel wayy full after eating a normal breakfast. The tea takes about an hour to actually take any effects on me, but it gives me a lot of energy and no appetite! So, i would say eat a smaller meal with this tea, otherwise it will make you sick. Overall, it is a good tea and does what it says!
With a blueberry zing, pleasnat aroma and an almost violet enticing shade to the tea, the yogi blueberry green tea is a perfect answer to the craving for caffeine that afflicts all busy lifestyles!
Great tasting, refreshing.  Drink it hot or cold.  Great supplement to a diet!
The aroma, the taste in your mouth, and stomach is satiated. indeed this is one of my favorite teas including green tea within its depths. a+

I got some free samples from the gym and liked it so much that I ordered it from Amazon.  I love the blueberry taste and smell.  Haven't really noticed any burst of energy of appetite suppressant but it is a natural diuretic (beware).  I still think it's a great tea and drink it to distract me from snacking.

I love the taste of this.  It's the only tea that I've been able to drink without honey.  The lingering blueberry flavor is delicious!  I'm not sold on it as an appetite suppressant though.  That effect doesn't really come till after the second cup of tea, and there are just other things I'd rather be drinking.  Still, it's a very delighful green tea.
Delicious and effective!  I have a job where I often have to go a couple of hours past mealtime without food.  Drinking this tea beforehand, I don't even notice it's dinnertime!
Great price. Great product berry flavor keeps me going thru long hours of work and I think it is keeping my weight steady.

I've tried green tea verses oolong tea and read a report from The Journal of Nutrition, 2001, 131:28482852 that said oolong tea is better than green tea. This tea tastes good and has a nice flavor to it, but I'm going to stick with oolong for weight loss.  The best bang for the buck I found is 3 Boxes of Wu-Long (Oolong) Premium Slimming Tea - All Natural Diet Oolong Tea , 100% Pure and the Original where there are 60 bags in each box.  For the price, this is a nice green tea with a smooth finish and green tea does have other benefits outside of weight loss.

I purchased this tea because I wanted to detox from the fatty foods, chemicals, and little exercise I had been getting. I am trying to replace all soda, diet or otherwise, with flavored water and tea - but desperately need a delicious replacement. I also need to shed a few pounds, and find myself having next to no energy during the day. I cannot count the number of different teas I have tried and were not satisfied. Typically green tea is too harsh and bitter, and flavored teas end up tasting artificial. HOWEVER! Yogi Green Tea Blueberry Slim Life was a breath of fresh air. I always smell the tea in the bag first, and it didn't smell fake or overwhelming - a good sign. I brewed the tea and took a sip without any sweetener. The tea is not bitter, it is smooth and has a slight natural blueberry taste to it. I repeat, does not taste artificial and overpowering! I can already see myself ordering more of this tea, and soon. Each tea bag comes with an inspirational saying which was a nice touch. The packaging is eco friendly. This tea really makes me feel good, clean, and light. It gives me energy throughout the day as I sip away. I highly recommend this product if you are a fan of tea!

I am loving this tea, absolutely delicious flavor, naturally sweet on its own and very soothing to drink. I can't attest to if it will help with my weight loss journey but I can say that this is one of the best tasting teas I have had.

column9: DELICIOUS TEA - BUT NOT FOR WEIGHT LOSS.
column10: I finished my 1st box this week and let me just say ... This is by far one of my MOST favorite teas.  The flavor is extravagant !!  Its very light and is very tasty -- not too sweet.If your looking for weight-loss tea, this is a no-go but its still worth buying because it tastes so good.Great deal for the amount you receive !

column4: Rachel @ My Naturally Frugal Family "Rachel J"
column9: A Nice Way to Relax During the Day
column10: A cup of Yogi green tea is a great way to take a break during the day and just take a moment to relax.  The blueberry tea is supposed to help with detoxing your body (which is essential to a healthy inside and outside) and it helps give you energy so you will feel invigorated when you are working out (be it at the gym or yoga studio).In a word: Yum!  A delicious tea to enjoy anytime :)

Sweet blueberry flavor & aroma, perfect mild green tea energy!! I buy this by the case now..just wish Yogi Teas would stop playing the price yo-yo game with us. The subscription price changed from $17 to $30 to $20 to $17 again.My ONLY true problem with this tea is the packaging. Each tea bag has two tiny metal staples used to attach the little paper tag (with quote on it) to a string, to the tea bag, and then enclosed in a pretty colored paper pouch with the name of the tea on it. Wouldn't it be both cost effective & environmentally friendly to skip the staples, tag, string & colored paper pouch altogether and just have the 16 netted bags of tea inside the box? Obviously if you open up the box and grab one, you know which tea bag you are putting in the cup, so unless you really need to show off the clever Yogi quote by dangling the string outta the cup, I find it utterly unneccesary. Just think of all the thousands of mini staples and threads of strings and paper pouches that are being produced for pure aesthetic (and come on..the quotes aren't that life changing).But I digress....The tea IS DELICIOUS! :)

I loved the flavor of this tea.  I don't know if it was helpful for dieting, but the flavor is really appealing.  I was disappointed to find that it's not recommended for nursing mothers, so I had to wait a while to drink it.

I got this tea a few days ago and it has great taste...has a mild citrus taste. Love love love! Will come back in 4 weeks to review the weight loss aspect as today is my first day!Update (almost 2 weeks later): I am still totally in love with this tea and I actually noticed that it suppresses appetite. Great! I have been losing weight but I can't totally attribute it to this tea as I have also been exercising more. But the appetite suppression is a great attribute for me.

I absolutely am in love with this tea.  It is fragrant and has a flavorful, delicious, and natural blueberry taste.  I was worried that I wouldn't like this, as I often shy away from "blueberry" food items, since fake blueberry flavor makes me ill because of the sweetness of it.  This is not too sweet, but is also not too weak of a flavor to make a difference.  It fills my entire mouth with flavor, which is what I think aids in appetite suppression. A must buy!!

I bought this tea primarily for the flavor and secondarily for the appetite suppressant quality.The flavor is outstanding - I am a huge blueberry fan and to have this in a tea (a green tea at that!) is a treat. The hint of orange is just that - a hint, barely there but in no way affects the taste one way or the other.I have noticed that my hunger cravings have greatly diminished since I started drinking this tea so I believe it lives up to its claim. I've also noticed my energy level has increased dramatically in a not so dramatic way, another plus.I would definitely recommend this tea!

I have been drinking this tea with my breakfast for the past few months and really enjoy it. I am not a big fan of the taste of green tea in general but the addition of blueberry here makes it sweet enough that I don't even notice the green tea flavor. It does give me a bit of an energy boost but mostly it has helped supress my appetite. I was thrilled to see it available here at such a great price. I used the subscription option and now there is one less item to pick up at the grocery store.

I have been drinking this product for four years now. I was initially looking for a dieter's tea that didn't act as a laxative. This tea tasted great, but unfortunately didn't help me lose any weight or suppress my appetite. It did, however, get rid of my acne and continue to keep me energized, which is why I'm still hooked! Name is deceiving, but still highly recommended.

I has a nice mild taste, but does nothing to control my appetite.  Every once in awhile when I drink this my stomach does feel a little uneasy. So perhaps it does have some effect, but not exactly the desired one for me. As for just tea, it's good.

I bought this tea because I really wanted to try a green tea and was afraid I wouldn't like the taste. Blueberry sounded good, so I picked it up. I've bought at least 10 boxes since! It's wonderful...very flavorful without being overpowering or too sweet. I even like to steep it and drink it room temperature. I gave some to my mother when she was over and now she's hooked. Very recommended
I just like the taste and the fact that it's green tea I haven't lost any weight but I love it just the same.  Sweet mild taste unlike regular green tea.

column9: Excellent green tea with a hint of blueberry!
column10: Yogi tea is an excellent purchase and enjoyable tea for this price range.  The blueberry slim and kombucha quickly became my favorite flavors to date.As for this specific tea, it is your standard green tea but with a hint of blueberry.  The water actually turns to a purple/blue tint, and the aroma itself is delicious.  The aftertaste is a mild fruitful blueberry taste.  If you are looking for the benefits of green tea but with an interesting change of things, I highly suggest you give this flavor a try.

Before they came out with this blueberry flavored one the tea was good, but now the tea is fantastic! I am not a big fan of blueberry flavored stuff, but it isn't very strong, plus all the other stuff in it doesn't make it taste to much like blueberry. The tea smells kind of like it, but not a whole lot. The flavor is so nice and I think it works at helping you not be hungry. Try is you might really like it.
First off, I am not a hot tea drinker...but this tea has converted both my wife and I over... smooth and leaves you just feeling good..

I ordered the Blueberry Slim Life green tea by Yogi on the advice of my sister-in-law.  She's right!  It is much more flavorful than plain green tea.  For some reason, the blueberry isn't easy to find, although the Yogi brand is common enough.  The shipping was fast, and the price was reasonable.

column9: Best Tea we ever had, Drink it cold like Iced tea though
column10: Heat hot water with the tea let it sit for 6 hours in the water add a little sugar and let it cool, then put in pitcher and put in fridge and enjoy with ice, best ever and it does help with appitite. get it while its a good price.

I have been drinking this tea every morning for a year. It has a light but flavorful taste.  I would drink this in the morning or early afternoon, not in the evening since it might keep you up.  I had trouble finding this tea in my local supermarkets and it cost way more.  This price on amazon is fantastic.  Stock up!

This is my first order of Yogi tea on amazon. I wanted to get away from loose tea leaves to save some time and I also wanted to pop two bags into my thermos with some hot water and take it to work. In the past I have had issues where it seemed like tea bags exploded inside the thermos. These Yogi bags are great they don't do that. The tea tastes GREAT and it does help keep me from buying two pops a day at work (there are too many good reasons to NOT drink pop so I won't even go into it) and also curbs my desire to buy snacks. I used to have a breakfast and then by lunch I was so hungry I would overeat but since I started bringing this tea in and drinking a full thermos of it in the morning I don't feel excessively hungry over lunch so I tend to have a lighter lunch. Overall I feel more trim and I don't fall into the post lunch coma that came with eating too much food for lunch. It's doing what it says in my book.
This tea is so good in flavors. You can definitely taste the orange and blueberry. I don't notice the "slim" aspect at all though. But none the less, glad I got this!Shipper sent this very fast too.

Honestly, at first I didnt care for the tea.  The product says to drink it hot and I prefer cold drinks we live in AZ).  I made a large amount in a 2 quart container and added a little agave nectar and it came out GREAT! After 2 cups or so, I have energy to run after my toddler and clean up while not constantly feeling hungry.  I am also a nursing mom and it hasnt affected my son in the least.  I have been trying to get some of the baby weight off with diet and exercise and have been looking into a safe supplement while nursing.  This product is it! I highly recommend! It also definately beats the grocery store prices at almost $4 per box.

column4: Kathy "If I leave several reviews in one day-...
column10: I enjoy a variety of Yogi teas and I'm really enjoying the flavor of this tea.  I normally squeeze a lemon in to my green teas so that I can enjoy the taste without sugar or honey but this tea due to the hint of blueberry does not need any help.  I will stock up on this.  Can't say anything about the slimming part as I've just started drinking this today.  Very happy with purchase.

This tea is absolutely amazing!  This tea is great tasting and I have noticed it has curbed my cravings and has killed my coffee cravings.  It provides the perfect pick me up without all the side effects of drinking coffee.  Definitely a keeper!

I like the taste of the tea but it is very hard on my digestive system!  I have tried it twice now (for several days) and it completely upsets the balance, won't go into detail but you get the picture! As soon as I stop drinking it (2c. a day, 1 in the morning and 1 in the evening) I am fine. There must be something in it that I cannot tolerate.  I bought the case....I never have trouble with any other tea!  :(

column9: Don't be fooled, its just plain tea, not very good at that
column10: I bought this for the Blueberry, not for the "slim" claim. If it is supposed to do anything to your appetite it did not do anything to change mine. It just isn't very flavorful tea, especially if you are looking for blueberry. I can't tell what it tastes like and I drink tea twice a day.

column9: Just sippin' it for the first time
column10: I must say, I usually find green tea on the bitter side, especially if it has hibiscus in it.  BUT this tea, is beautifully refreshing! It has a hint of blueberry and orange essence that tastes completely natural and not over-powering,  while still being thoroughly refreshing.  If this tea does anything for appetite, that will be a plus, but even as is simply for the flavor, I give it 5 stars.
This tea tastes good but it does nothing for the slimming process.  It does not make you less hungry.  It has the same effect as regular tea.

I love blueberries, green tea and Yogi Teas but I do not like this!  It has an orange spice taste up front like the only flavored tea around when I was a kid, didn't like it then, don't like it now.  Then it finishes with a Stevia after taste!  Yuck.  I like my teas plain and would prefer to add my own sweetener if I feel it's needed.  This is a miss in my book and it's not surprising when the ingredients list 'natural orange flavor' before 'natural blueberry flavor' in the line up.  Why not something more natural like actual blueberry? Right? Silly me. It doesn't taste like a berry of any kind by my standards. So, if berry and green tea are the taste you're looking for AND you like the multifaceted herbal taste of Yogi brand teas then try their Goji Berry instead, it's wonderful w/ no weird sweetener after taste and no orange spice! Goji Berry is 5 stars in my book!

I love Yogi teas, but this one fell short of my expectations.  While the taste is not bad, it has almost no notable blueberry taste (although having too much blueberry flavor probably wouldn't be great, either...).  It doesn't seem to give me more energy or supress my appetite, either.  I'll stick with Yogi's Super-Antioxidant Green tea and Ginger tea.

column9: Very good if you love blueberries
column10: I have really been into Yogi tea and trying them all! I have all the green teas and after a month of testing them I conclude that Rejuvenation tastes the best. It has a natural peach and lemon flavor that is very natural and mild. Most say the Simply Green tastes the best but to me it was far too boring. I got used to all the special herbs and natural flavors and the Simply Green had none added. I do not like the artificial flavors at all, nor do I like the artificial sweet taste added by too much stevia leaf.This Slim Life tea is very good- Amazingly good compared to diet green tea pills! I do not ever feel the side effects of a diet pill with this tea and I drink a lot of it being I got 6 boxes from Amazon. I think it's a wonderful tea but I'd prefer it if the natural blueberry flavor was left out. It does taste natural and sweet but mixed with Green tea, I'd prefer the lemon or peach flavors myself. If you do love the flavor of berry in your tea, you will love this one and it is mild and pleasant to drink all day long.The Super Anti-Oxidant variety of tea tastes good except for the licorice. The licorice is okay in the bedtime and calming teas, but does not taste right in green tea. Other then the licorice it does have a very good lemon flavor that is soothing and mild. The Kombucha tea is also great which has a berry taste, that is good and natural passion fruit and plum, but I prefer the lemon flavor in my green tea. The Slim Life tea is also very good but it does have a blueberry flavor in it, but it is worlds better then the Fasting tea, which tastes the worst of all the Yogi teas. I just love the Yogi tea positive messages don't you? At first I just bought these teas for the messages then I learned to love the tea as well! Rejuvenation is my favorite green tea and Peach Detox and Redbush Chai are my favorite flavored teas and make exceptionally good iced tea as well! The flavors, however, are very close and it took me quite a while to figure out which green tea I preferred the best. This one is good if you like licorice in your green tea that is.Wise quotes from Yogi Tea by Yogi Bhajan"The universe is the stage on which you dance, guided by your heart.""The purpose of life is to enjoy every moment.""Delight the world with compassion, kindness and grace.""Laugh because that is your purpose in life."Happiness is every human beings birthright.""Be happy so long as breath is in you.""Real happiness lies in that which never comes nor goes, but simply is.""Travel light, live light, spread the light, be the light.""Your greatness is not what you have, it's what you give.""Practice kindness, mercy and forgiveness.""Bliss cannot be disturbed by gain or loss.""Compassion has no limit. Kindness has no enemy.""There is no love without compassion.""Appreciate yourself and honor your soul." Take care of it.""Truth is everlasting.""To learn, read. To know, write. To master, teach."

This tea tastes great - has a hint of blueberry flavor, and it really does what it says - it helps curb your appetite. I usually have one in the morning (between breakfast and lunch) and one in the afternoon (between lunch and dinner). I have found that my snacking has decreased drastically on days when I'm drinking this tea.I can't give the product a stellar review, however, because it comes from a bad seller. I had this on auto-renew and selected the "every 3 months" option. From the first shipment to the second shipment, there was a 40% markup on the product. With the markup, it's not worthwhile to keep buying it on Amazon - I can get it for the same price in my local Whole Foods.Due to this very poor business practice, I have cancelled my "subscription" of this product. Buyer beware.
Product doesn't realy agree with my stomach, please cancel any future orders. Please cancel all my credit card information. Thank You.

My Doctor told me to drink this green tea for weight lost.  It was hard to find and when you did it cost at least $5.50.  Being as I have used amazon for other purchases I checked on my tea, Wow less than $3.00 a box, and it comes every month to my door.

column9: Not just for cooking and baking, but it's a health food in it's own right!
column10: What a joy when I read about that!  The only problem is finding a way to add chocolate to my diet without all the extraneous sugars that are NOT so healthy.  In the past I have tried various higher percentage chocolates and found the Scharffen Berger bars to be excellent, so when I decided to get some cocoa powder this is one of the three I decided to try.For my purposes I have been mixing it in with a small amount of dairy to add to coffee. column9: A Spicy Meal Alternative... But Pricy...
column10: I actually purchased a pack of NongShim Spicy Chicken bowls (pk of 12) from a local warehouse in my area. Ever since college I've been a fan of these "cup of noodles" style meals during late Autumn and Winter. Makes for quick alternative meal that warms you up. How does Nongshim's spicy chicken version stand up against other brands I've had?Pretty good actually! Each bowl contains a fairly large amount of noodles, compared to the cup variety. The noodles are your typical standard dried Ramen noodle. I am not a big fan of microwaving these products so I make mine by boiling water. Just put some water up to boil, open the package and add the "flavor pouch" or Soup Base, add boiling water to the fill line and wait 3 minutes. Instant hot soup with noodles. While the noodles are standard , the broth is really good. It has a lot of flavor to it and a good spicy kick to it. Put the two of them together and you get a very satisfying meal that will fill you up, and wake you up.Despite having a good spicy broth and making for a filling meal... This product does have some CONS I am wary of. For one the product contains almost 1800mg of sodium for a single bowl. This is insane! Most of these cup/bowl of noodles are overloaded with sodium to begin with, but it still needs to be pointed out. The fat content is a bit high also, at 14g for an entire bowl. Another problem I have is that most of the products I've tried usually come in a sturdy container for your product. Nongshim's Spicy Chicken Bowls come in a flimsy plastic bowl. It works fine but once prepared I would definitely suggest carrying with two hands, as it has a very cheap feel to the bowl. The price per bowl is also a bit expensive. At the warehouse I purchased this, I paid $9 for 12 bowls. I could of paid $6.50 for 24 cup of noodle varieties. Compared to the cup variety, you are paying a premium for these; And while the bowl produced better quality broth, I don't see it being worth the price increase. (12 bowls = 24 servings.. $9 for 24 servings. the cups were $6.50 for 24 servings.. so basically $2.50 more for bowls vs cups)OVERALL I would give this product 4 stars. Despite having a flimsy bowl, and incredibly high amount of sodium the product makes up for it in the overall quality of its taste and sheer volume of noodles. You get a big meal here that will both fill you, and warm you up. It has a really nice spicy kick to the broth that lingers without becoming annoying(see NOTE). I've always enjoyed spicy foods so having a few of these laying around the house helps if I just want a quick meal. I would not recommend eating these everyday, in fact maybe I tend to aim for one a week. Products like this are not exactly the healthiest alternative meal for you, but if you need a quick emergency meal these are a good alternative.NOTE: The product contains chicken but I really wouldn't call it chicken. You might find a few tiny little bits of re-hydrated chickenNOTE: I do not use the entire flavor/soup base packet. The amount of sodium it contains is ridiculous! I use no more than 3/4 of the packet. I tried using the entire packet once and it made the broth start to taste far too salty, as well as making the spice in the broth overpower rather than compliment. Don't be afraid to use less of the packet...

column9: The First New Flavor of the Quintessential Condiment!
column10: This was the first modern variation on an essentially unchanged, bestselling product for more than 140 years.  Other flavors are:Orginal Pepper Sauce (hot) (2500-5000 Scoville Heat Units),Habanero Sauce (hottest) (>7000 Scoville Heat Units),Garlic Pepper Sauce (milder) (1200-2400 Scoville Heat Units),Chipotle Pepper Sauce (mild) (1500-2500 Scoville Heat Units),Sweet & Spicy Pepper Sauce (mildest) (100-600 Scoville Heat Units),but this is Green Pepper Sauce (milder yet) (600-1200 Scoville Heat Units).Dueling histories of the McIlhenny Company are available: (authorized) Tabasco: An Illustrated History and (unauthorized) McIlhenny's Gold: How a Louisiana Family Built the Tabasco Empire, for those curious about how this most remarkable product and business empire came to be.Note: "A pharmacist named Wilbur Scoville invented the Scoville Scale in 1912 to measure the heat of peppers. A 'Scoville Unit' is actually a measure of capsaicin (the chemical in hot peppers that is responsible for their heat).Scoville's test was a comparative taste test that is considered subjective by today's standards. A more sophisticated method is in use today, but in honor of Wilbur Scoville, the unit of measure is still called the Scoville.The capsaicin level in peppers can vary from plant to plant due to local environmental conditions. This means that a pepper's rating is an average measure.The hottest pepper on record is the Bhut Jolokia with a pungency of over 1 million Scoville Heat Units (1,001,304, to be exact). By contrast, the Bell Pepper comes in at less than 100 Scoville Heat Units."

column9: A Visit to the Peppermint Room
column10: Several years ago, I went on a tour of the Celestial Seasonings tea factory in Boulder, Colorado.  The guide showed us the bales of tea as they arrived, machines that ground and mixed the tea, and a machine that put the tea in tea bags.  The tour included a visit to the room where the peppermint tea was stored.  Our guide told us that peppermint was stored separately so that it would not contaminate the other teas.  He did not tell us what was to come.The doorway into the peppermint room was surrounded by bright red stripes. This should have served as a warning to us.  We all innocently strolled into the peppermint room.  The smell of peppermint was overpowering.  It entered my nose, my head, my lungs, and then my whole being was infused with peppermint.  What a rush!  The crowd stampeded out of the room in a hurry.  For the rest of the day and into the next, all I could smell and taste was the mint.I am now addicted to Celestial Seasonings Peppermint Tea.  Every time I have some, I am reminded of that fateful day in Boulder.  The events of that day have changed my life forever.  Amazingly, the tea is still legal, openly sold in stores and on the Internet.  I think that the tea is great, but then again I am not an unbiased observer.  On your next visit to Boulder, take the tour.  Or go a safer route; buy the tea from Amazon.

column9: Good taste, but for diet purposes I'd look elsewhere
column10: I love Pop Tarts. There's tons of different ways to eat them. Unfortunately they aren't the lowest calorie food item out there, so I decided to pick up the low fat variety & try them. After eating them, I was slightly disappointed after doing some fact checking.Taste-wise, these things are awesome & taste very similar to the regular product. Calorie-wise, there isn't a humongous amount of difference. With the regular pop tarts, there was only a difference of 12 calories. The fat content *is* halved in this set, but the sodium, sugar & carbohydrate levels are substantially higher in this than in the regular version.Bluntly put, you'd be better off diet-wise to go with the normal poptarts than to go for this option. If all you are worried about is the fat content, you are set. If you are looking at a variety of factors, you'd be better off going for the regular version. I'm giving this product 3 stars for the taste, but I took 2 away because of the other factors.

column9: I like this Nut Milk Bag (purchased from Amazon.com)
column10: This is my first nut milk bag and it works well for me. I usually use a cheese cloth for straining my Almond milk and it was a little more work. I had to be careful the cheese cloth did not slip and create a mess. When I make almond milk, I use a large strainer first, then I use the milk bag to get a smooth, silky almond milk. If you initially pour the almond milk directly from the blender into the milk bag, you would need to squeeze the bag to get your milk. When you squeeze the bag with a large amount of the pulverized almond, the bag could come apart at the seam. If you don't have a strainer, pour small amounts at a time into the milk bag and squeeze to get all the milk. If you are making your own nut milk, it's best to get a large strainer, it's inexpensive. After blending the almond, pour it through the strainer and then through the milk bag. You will get smooth milk with no gritty taste and your nut bag will last longer.

column9: Great nut milk bag - makes making home made nut milks much easier
column10: I've just purchased another one of these after heavy use for about a year and a half or two of my original one. I use this a couple times per week to make really great almond milk with maca in it (I use Maca Magic-Powder/Jar - 1.1 lbs - Powder - to me it tastes better than the others...)We ordered a couple of other bags in the past, but the weave wasn't tight enough and it allowed too much pulp through. This one has been just right for us, so I really recommend it.For those who may be new to making nut milks, here is my super-yummy nut milk recipe that works great with this nut milk bag:Super Yummy Maca enhanced Almond milk:1. Soak (fully covered by water and inch above the top of the almonds) about 1 cup of almonds overnight (they'll absorb some of the water and puff up a bit...)2. Drain and do a basic rinse of the almonds3. Add to your vitamix (or other high-powered blender) and add fresh water until the blender container is about 3/4 filled.4. Grind it up well till the bits are pretty tiny and no big chunks are seen.5. Strain it out with a nut-milk bag. The way I do this is: have a very large bowl, put the bag in, holding the top up and open, then pour the ground up nut/water mix into the bag. set the bowl below a kitchen cabinet and hang the string of the nut milk bag on the knob of the upper cabinet (so you have the filled bag hanging over the bowl.) Twist the top a few times so that when you squeeze the bag the goop doesn't come out the top into your bowl, then squeeze the milk out of the bag. What will be left is just the almond pulp. Some folks use this for cookies or other baking, or you can feed it to your chickens (if you have some) or toss it - your call.6. Pour the nut milk back into your vitamix/blender and add the following:1 tbsp vanilla1/4 - 1/2 tsp salt (start with less, but don't omit - it won't taste right...)1 heaping scoop of maca powder (do two if you like it, but start with one to see...)sweetener to taste: 6-8 pitted dates, or a couple tbsp's of honeyIf planning to drink right away put in ice cubes & water till about 1 1/2 inches from top of blender, or just use water if you don't care to have it cold right away.7. blend until dates have no big chunks, or until well blended if not using dates.8. taste test and see if you need more sweetness. If it is sweet but is "missing something" it is the salt - the salt enhances the sweet and makes it richer (always use some salt in sweet dishes...)This will keep about a week in the fridge, but ours is usually gone w/in 4-5 days max.Once you drink this you'll never buy store bought again and you'll love your nut-milk bag!

I would have thought from glancing over the ingredients that he would be fine with these cookies, but instead he was covered in a dry, scaly rash within 24 hours. Gluten-free treats are often considered to be safe for kids with food allergies, but the truth is that if they're allergic to one thing, they're probably allergic to something else you don't even know about.  Maybe it's the potato because it's a nightshade, maybe it's the soy lecithin.  I don't know, but I wouldn't feed these to a child with known food allergies without keeping a watchful eye on them.  And why they would put soy in a food for those who are allergic to something else is beyond me, given that it's a top 8 allergen and I'm certain that ingredient is genetically modified.

column9: A Visit to the Peppermint Room
column10: Several years ago, I went on a tour of the Celestial Seasonings tea factory in Boulder, Colorado.  The guide showed us the bales of tea as they arrived, machines that ground and mixed the tea, and a machine that put the tea in tea bags.  The tour included a visit to the room where the peppermint tea was stored.  Our guide told us that peppermint was stored separately so that it would not contaminate the other teas.  He did not tell us what was to come.The doorway into the peppermint room was surrounded by bright red stripes. This should have served as a warning to us.  We all innocently strolled into the peppermint room.  The smell of peppermint was overpowering.  It entered my nose, my head, my lungs, and then my whole being was infused with peppermint.  What a rush!  The crowd stampeded out of the room in a hurry.  For the rest of the day and into the next, all I could smell and taste was the mint.I am now addicted to Celestial Seasonings Peppermint Tea.  Every time I have some, I am reminded of that fateful day in Boulder.  The events of that day have changed my life forever.  Amazingly, the tea is still legal, openly sold in stores and on the Internet.  I think that the tea is great, but then again I am not an unbiased observer.  On your next visit to Boulder, take the tour.  Or go a safer route; buy the tea from Amazon.
