Best tasting Crystalized ginger on the market which is all natural with no sulfides or artificial anything. Sweet & tangy. Great for indigestion or for overall great health---You will be amazed

This is pure ginger coated with a light dusting of sugar to make it a little easier to eat.  It is very soothing for sour throats and colds.  I eat them even when i'm not sick cause they are delicious.

I bought this for my wife who was in her the early parts of her first trimester with our third child.  She is very reluctant to take any medication for her nausea but this Ginger worked quickly and very well.  I also tried ginger capsules and they didn't help nearly as much.  I would highly recommend this to any woman who is dealing with nausea related to pregnancy.I have also used it myself when my stomach was feeling 'off' and it has also helped.

column9: Delicious and helps with my morning sickness
column10: I ordered these to help with my morning sickness.  I feel car sick all day long generally.  Munching a bit on these really does help!  My husband also loves them!  The flavor it very good.  My son (who is 2) also enjoys them.  They have a good, strong ginger flavor, but it's not too much.  I'm glad we got so many little bags of them cause they will stay fresh longer.  The texture is good.  The pieces are firm to hold but soft to chew.  I'd recommend this product to someone dealing with morning sickness, or any ginger fan.  I'm both, and quite pleased!

I've tried different types of crystalized ginger and this one was a little disappointing. Very small bags for the value and lots of fiber in the bites.I don't think I'll order this particular brand again.

I bought these for my wife for her morning sickness. Those "Preggie Pops" are expensive, and I thought since they are essentially ginger candies, and since it's the ginger that helps with the nausia that I could find a cheaper alternative.Well the verdict is that the crystalized ginger is too spicy. My wife doesn't like raw ginger anyway, but she drinks Gigner Ale soda, so I thought that this product would be similar to that, but it was too spicy for her, and now I'm stuck with a bunch of crystalized ginger that nobody is going to eat.

column9: Lite Mayo in quantity, at a discount and Delivered!
column10: My title says it all about this product.  But -- I must add that this packaging does not leave as much product behind as does an ordinary mayo jar.  I think it's a great idea.  And it's more sanitary as well!
Just purchased this form under $3.00 a bottle. Great deal! It expires in December of 2011 but we will surely use it all by then! Can't even get it this cheap with sales and coupons in my area.

Hellman's Light Mayo is great. However, I am giving Amazon.com 5 stars for their customer service. My 4-pack of mayo arrived with one bottle broken and the contents oozing out. When I called Amazon.com customer service and explained the condition of this shipment, the customer service rep. immediately gave me a refund for the broken bottle and told me to discard it.

Looking at all the different light mayos available in my local grocery store, the Hellmans Light is the lowest in calories - 35/tbs. - as compared to Kraft at 45, and Duke's at 50. I've tasted the Kraft, which I don't like as much, and didn't even bother with the Duke's since the calorie count was so much higher. The Hellmans tastes great, and there's only 1 gram of carbs, so they haven't replaced the fat with sugar. The only drawback would be the squeeze bottle, because you can't really get all the mayo out, and when there's less in the bottle it's harder to squeeze it out and I end up using a knife anyway. But I get it through Subscribe-and-Save, so the price just can't be beat.

I ordered this & am very happy with my purchase. It tastes great & I'm happy I don't have to worry about eating pesticides and gunk for breakfast, and neither does my family. I'm especially happy, since winter's coming up. A nice, hot bowl of this cereal in the morning will really hit the spot! I'm glad that the cereal is not fortified with synthetic vitamins. I go through a great deal of trouble to make sure my vitamins are the best quality & easily assimilated into my system. I don't even use lotion that uses fake vitamin e oil.. So this is a great thing for me. I don't have to worry about man-made synthetic stuff clogging up my system & not being able to be absorbed by my body & if it does get absorbed, I don't have to worry about any consequences.One other thing that I really like about Bob's Red Mill products is that they're stone ground. I prefer stone-ground over using metal. People have lived for thousands of years, before the time of Pharaohs using stone ground grains. If it was good enough for them, it's good enough for me! Farina is also less processed than "cream of wheat".. Less processed is a good thing in my book!The only thing that I could complain about is the packaging. I would rather it come in a resealable bag, but it doesn't. That would make it more convenient to use and to store, but you can put it in a ziploc bag or in some sort of canister, so it's not that big of an issue. You just have to remember when it expires and use it before then.I don't know what else to say about this product.. It tastes as good, if not better than cream of wheat, doesn't have pesticides and synthetic vitamins, it's inexpensive & with free shipping for a whole case of it, you really can't go wrong.. Unless you're allergic to wheat. lol In which case I doubt you'd be looking to purchase this anyway! My recommendation is to go for it. :) This item also has a decent shelf life (around 2-3 years), so it would be great to stock up on as a food source if your power went out or something like that. Just be sure to store water, so you can hydrate it (and yourself).

The only ingredient listed is organic wheat.  So this cereal isn't fortified with additional vitamins and minerals like Malt-o-Meal and Cream-of-Wheat.  You may view that as a negative or a positive, depending on your preferences.I like to have those extra vitamins added, but it won't stop me from ordering this again.  The texture and taste of this cereal was fantastic and the kids gobbled it up.

column9: Love that I found organic farina!
column10: I have been eating Cream of Wheat for years, but recently got a defective batch that was very gritty even after cooking as directed. So I started researching an organic option and found Bob's. It's creamy, tastes fresh and was a good value. I don't think I'll ever go back to Cream of Wheat again!
All of Amber Lyn chocolates are to die for! They taste like the real thing, and I'm a sugar-holic!! These are my saving grace!

First tried these toffees after buying some shoes and they were handed out with the receipt. Wonderful toffees -- actually the best I have tasted, but they are hard to find here in the US. Excellent Co. to do business. I was updated as to the status of my order and received quick shipping.

column9: flavorless, doesn't represent Thai Kitchen quality
column10: This yellow curry in a jar is a complete disaster. It doesn't compare to the quality of the red and green curry pastes made by Thai Kitchen. Save your money and try something else. I tried it twice in one night thinking that maybe our first jar had a defect but 2nd jar was just as bad. The yellow curry paste has long been discontinued and I wish they'd bring it back.

column9: Delicious Out of this World Cookies!
column10: I ordered these for my 8yr old grandaughter's school birthday bash. They were a big hit having garnered rave reviews from all.  Packaged in the adorable 'birthday pail' was an enormous bonus. Very happy all around with this purchase.

column9: This tea is really about laxative
column10: I use Super Dieters Tea as a laxative. It must be prepared as to the directions, and it will work as a laxative. It should not be used every day, though. That is extreme.But, it works.

If I'm a sucker for anything it's chocolate, but Ghiradelli 72% Intense Dark Chocolates are among my favorites. The flavor is roasted and smoky-rich with hints of a sweet, fruity nature that melt on your tongue and delight your tastebuds. Truly delicious!

Ok, yes, I USED to work for Gharardelli and that's how I ended up trying this chocolate years ago.  I picked up a bag the other day on a whim to help my sweet craving while on a diet - one piece a day.  I forgot how lovely this chocolate is! One piece can be savored for 15 minutes because the flavor of each small nibble can last for several minutes.  The experience is super smooth on the tongue (not grainy at all as someone mentioned. If that happens, the chocolate must have been in a batch that wasn't temp controlled and it "bloomed.") With this chocolate you'll experience a tangy, fruity flavor that floods the mouth leaving your chocolate craving fully satisfied.  Delightful!

My new favorite chocolate is Ghirardelli Intense Dark Twilight Delight, 72% cacao. It's not as sweet as milk chocolate, and not as one-dimensional as, say, Dove's dark chocolate. The pieces melt in your mouth, starting out with a burst of dark chocolate but as they melt and flow onto your tongue, you get a very distinct cocoa bean effect. Slightly acidic, even a hint of bitterness. You sense a graininess, even though there are no particles in the candy, just smooth liquid chocolate. After it is done melting on your tongue, an aftertaste remains in your mouth which is sweet but not sugary, almost like the dryness remaining after a good Merlot. This sensation lasts for a good half hour or more.It's a symphony for the taste buds.
My friend loves dark chocolate and she loved this product. I would certainly use this firm again

Ghiradelli 72% Intense Dark Chocolate was not an eating chocolate for me. I received this as a gift at Christmas, and instead of eating it, I used it to make hot chocolate. I simply melted the chocolate in a double boiler, then added milk, sugar, and a little vanilla. It made for a great hot beverage. But for me, the chocolate by itself could not stand alone.http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00285DLZQ/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_title

A friend of mine's mom passed away and I sent the sympathy basket.  She phoned me to say it was absolutely the perfect gift and thanked me.  I have since recommened the site to others who have also been extremely pleased with product.
I sent this basket to friends and they said it was just lovely. The shipping was lightening fast too. Highly recommended.

Did not correspond to the picture on the web site.  This was supposed to be a sympathy basket.  The basket was not the same as in picture (inferior basket).  It had a bright yellow ribbon and bright orange leaves inside the basket.  The food in the basket was fine.
The basket was a good choice and much appreciated by my friend and her family.  The only complaint was that it took longer than expected to arrive.

column4: Mary Jo Sminkey "15 years of Amazon Reviews!"
column10: Mauna Loa is definitely my favorite macadamia nut, and I've had a subscription for these so I could enjoy them on a regular basis. Unfortunately the price has now jumped a ridiculous amount, they went from $22 to $35!! Sorry, I can get them MUCH cheaper at Costco. I like the convenience of using Amazon but not at that kind of markup.
These macadamias were excellent. As fresh and crisp as the ones we bought in Hawaii a month ago. Very pleased.

I haven't met a macadamia nut that I didn't like, but these really are great.  They are rich and flavorful.  They almost all matched in size, had a nice crunch, were not over or under salted, and are a nice change from other nuts.

Mauna Loa are the best Macadamias I've ever had. Walmart sold these for a long time but not any longer and I can't find them anywhere else. I have ordered these twice and they arrive quickly and are super fresh. I just wish Mauna Loa still packaged them in the larger size cans. Now they are only available in small cans, jars, or 12 oz. bags. Oh well, I shouldn't complain, and thank goodness for Amazon.com!

column9: Great Product but too much salt
column10: These nuts are really fresh and delicious! I have them on a regular monthly order.  I find them to have more salt than necessary, so shake them through a sieve to remove about 1/2 the sea salt.
Received three bags of dry roasted Macadamian nuts.The bags I received were all net weight = 11 oz.Description on Amazon website clearly states 12 oz.

Good product for a decent price.  Sea salt has many health benefits, and macadamia nuts do as well and are delicious to boot. I never have a long wait ordering directly with Amazon.  Very pleased overall.

Just got back from Hawaii and decided to purchase these from Amazon rather than hauling back bags from the islands to the US east coast.  Planned to give them away as gifts to friends, neighbors and business associates.Everyone thought the nuts were "the nuts"  Nobody complained about the taste  ---- just the calories.Whatever quality control existed in 2008, seems to have been worked out in 2010.  I am ordering some more right now.
I've purchased these a number of times, and they are quite yummy.  No quality control issues here.

I have always been a big fan of macadamia nuts  but the Mauna Loa brand is by far the best around.  They are always fresh, buttery tasting and salty..but not too much.  They possess that little crunch that turns into a melt in your mouth flavor and leads you to reach for one after another!  Beware..they are high in calories and they do cost somewhat dearly.  I have found that buying these 3 packs is quite cost effective and seem to last quite a while as I keep them hidden away.  For those of you that like to keep these lovely tasting nuts on hand, please know that placing them in freezer proof bags and storing them in the freezer will keep them fresh for at least a year if you wish to hold onto them for that long.  ( All nuts can go bad if left in cupboards for long periods of time.)
I love macadamia nuts. This order arrived quickly and they are very fresh. Will order these again very soon. We can't stop eating them.

column9: Mauna Loa Dry Roasted Macadamia Nut Bags
column10: Handy travel sized vacuum packed macadamia nut bags that pack easy and travel well.  My wife is a big macadamia nut and really enjoyed this in our recent trip to Florida.  A must for those who want to travel with their favorite snack!  Highly recommend this.
Needless to say, taste great, very fresh and it is reasonable priced compared to market near my home, need to get more after this review done.

column9: The best nuts, a little pricey
column10: I am addicted to Mauna Loa Macadamia nuts.  I normally buy them from Costco where they are very reasonable in price.  Because of the shortage, I gave in to looking on the internet and came across these from Amazon.  They are smaller and only halves, but just as good.  I would give them 5 stars, but the price keeps it from getting there when you can buy them locally.  (They have become available again at some Costco stores.)  I have tried several brands and packages from other suppliers.  Mauna Loa is the best by far.
One of our office workers went to Hawaii, so I broke these out to share while he was gone.  It was a hit, I was asked for more - so I pulled out the pistachio's that I also purchased.

For some reason Mauna Loa Macadamias are nt available at our local grocery stores any longer.  Thank goodness I can always depend on Amazon!  They arrived within days of placing the order, and were just what I needed.  Great service, great product.

column9: Hawaiian grown Macadamia nut is awesome.
column10: Just recently our local Costco (formerly Price Club) discount store discontinued carrying item in their stock inventory. I'm not going to find out the reason why, but my craving for the Mac nut stays. Ordering online is a little bit pricey (s/h included) and the only source. There are also  local nut store that carries Macadamia nut but not Hawaiian grown. I guess I will just have to re-acquire my old taste for less expensive peanuts or perhaps almond or cashews.

These are the best Macadamia nuts available.  I prefer the larger bags like this as the nuts are usually larger and more often whole as compared to the small cans.  A smooth buttery taste and a sizable helping of "good" fats make these a great treat for everyone.

After searching for quite some time, I came across this 3 pack of Macadamia Nuts at a great price. They shipped quickly, they were very fresh. Finally I can enjoy Macadamia Nuts again. I was so happy with the price and the product, I had them put on an automatic shipment. BUT, my Only complaint is they are out-of-stock and don't know when they will be shipped again.

Prompt service and quality product.  My only complaint was that UPS left it on my front porch IN THE SNOW, and I did not know it was there for TWO DAYS.  Fortunately the product was in a plastic bag and was not as wet as the box it came in.  Our local Walmart no longer carries this product.  Rather than pay a premium for it at the chain grocery store, I opted to purchase it from Amazon instead.

column4: Doreen B. Bishop "Doreen Bishop cat parent"
column10: These are so good we go through pounds a week. Amazon just had a sale that was wonderful in fact I bought up my limit and am waiting to find out when I can order more. Sit back with a cool drink and a package of these nuts and you will think your in Hawaii :-)
The Macadamia Nuts are excellent.  The sender sent me a coupon that expired on September 30; however, the shipment did not arrive until October 1st.  Not much use for the coupon.
So far no problems at all !!! love to shop with Amazon.comFrom Singapore
These were rancid. Amazon replaced them and the replacement was rancid as well. I would suggest finding an alternate source.

column9: R A N C I D !!!!
column10: I bought these through COSTCO, the really large econo can.  They were RANCID.  I contacted Nestle/Mauna Loa and they sent me coupons to buy more.  COSTCO, of course, would not accept coupons, so I went to Safeway and bought smaller jars with the coupons.  When I got them home, all the replacement jars I bought were also RANCID.  Something is going wrong at Mauna Loa with their Quality Control.  Somehow, they are letting their macadamias set out for too long before putting them in the "fresh seal" jars.  What good is fresh sealing if the nuts are RANCID to begin with?!  Why would they send me coupons to replace the macadamias when they know they are ALL RANCID on any shelf in any store!?
These are so good! They almost taste like cake! Great for picky eaters.  And they are all natural and gluten free, doesn't get any better ;)

Something like popcorn seasoning is sure to be subjective, which is why we see the "love it or leave it" 1 or 5 star rating from previous reviers.Personally...I like it. It enhances the popcorn flavor. Just don't use too much. But again, how much is too much? That is beyond the scope of this review. Do you trust my taste in popcorn seasoning? If so, buy this now. If not, just buy it anyway. You need seasoning. You know this or you wouldn't be reading this review. Your life is empty without popcorn seasoning. Spice up your life!

This product was great when we first got it, but before we could use the first jar it did something weird and the taste changed into something nasty and chemical flavored. It was stored in a pantry out of the sunlight, but something happened to make it go bad before I could use even 1/2 the jar.

Movie Theater Style is an accurate description.This products captures the taste you get from a movie theater or popcorn cart style popcorn maker. Rather salty and the butter flavor is not exactly butter flavored.That said, I LOVE that flavor, and it's delicious on the home popped popcorn without nearly as much grease as the movie theater machines need to add.

Wabash Valley Farms Popcorn salt is wonderful. It is very fine grainedand won't just glide across your popcorn and fall to thebottom of the bowl. This season sticks to popcorn andmakes is taste amazing. I ordered Wabash Valley Farm popcorn seasons to go along with Paragon's Coconut oil bars. Unfortunatley Amazon did not send me the Paragon Coconut oil bars I ordered but substituted with Lou Ann coconut oil bars. Which taste pretty good, just not what I ordered.The combination of cooking popcorn in the coconut oil and then topping itoff with this Wabash popcorn salt is a grand finish. You will get popcornthat tastes like theater popcorn.  I ordered this combo after reading reviewshere at Amazon. Glad I read the reviews. Because we are popcorn lovers and thiscombination of Wabash popcorn salt and the coconut oil bars gave us popcornperfection. You don't need much of this salt , a little goes a long way.It has a slight buttery flavor to it.I recommend Wabash Valley Farms Popcorn salt .Plus get some coconut popcorn oil to cook your popcorn in.We use the Whirly pop popcorn maker to cook popcorn in. It makes the fluffiestlightest popcorn of any popcorn maker I have ever used.

column9: Found what I been looking for
column10: I have found what I was looking for in a popcorn seasoning. I have been looking for at least three years. I plan to order more soon.

I purchased this at a local Home Outfitters and was really excited to try it out. Unfortunately, it was extremely salty, and did not really impart any butter flavor. I tried to just use it sparingly as other users have suggested on Amazon, but it didn't seem to help -- it was just... mildly salted popcorn now, rather than that buttery/salty flavor that you're hoping for in 'movie style' popcorn.I didn't mind the yellow color of the product but couldn't get over the fact that it really just tasted like regular salt. I really like Wabash's Zesty Cheddar Cheese seasoning, which is quite salty as well, but has a great cheesy taste - try that one out!
Makes your popcorn taste just like your local theater's popcorn. With this seasoning less is more. You do not need much to add a ton of flavor to your popcorn.

This is the best movie theater butter seasoninig I have found, but it is still too salty for my taste.  I used it with popcorn popped in coconut oil and personally felt that it could use more of the buttery flavor and a lot less salt.

I thought this was the salt that Wabash puts in their popcorn packs that you can use in the Whirley-Pop. This salt you are advised to use only as a topping and it doesn't taste as good as the salt flavoring in the popcorn/oil/salt packs. So I used it as directed. I didn't really go crazy for the flavor. I have another salt I like better and it's the ACT II-Buttery Popcorn Salt, 3 lb. 4 oz. jug which when added to butter really tastes like the movies. Won't be buying this again.

The old product finally got rancid from age.  Folks used to rave about my popcorn, and the secret was the seasoning.  I tried some thing I bought at the local grocery and it is not good at all so I examined the container of the "old" stuff and found an web place and placed an order.  Seems like this new batch is not quite the same.  We will still use it and is far better than the POOR product I bought locally.  I'll try it out on company and see if anyone gets excited.In a few words . . .what were my expectations?  More butter flavor.  Lots of product to use here, and not super cheep so not sure I want to experiment.

column9: Tastes good but it doesn't stay powdery
column10: I really like the way this seasoning tastes but it wasn't very long until the seasoning began to combine together so it wasn't like fine salt but more like big clumps of seasoning so it doesn't sprinkle well.

The butter flavor of this topping is decent. But the salt is beyond reason. I shook a minimal amount on our first batch of popcorn and none of us could continue to eating past the first few bites. Now, I sprinkle maybe 3 shakes over an entire large bowl and then I end up with several really salty bites and a bunch of popcorn with no topping flavor at all on it. I might consider a low-salt version of this, but with the amount I have left of these bottles, it will probably take me 3 years to get through it. I'll probably end up throwing them away.

I love the taste of butter on popcorn, corn on the cob, vegetables, etc, but don't like to slather on the butter. This butter flavored salt gives a nice buttery flavor with some salt with no after taste or artificial taste.

We were gifted a jar of Whirly-Pop Theater Popcorn Spice in 2004 and became fans immediately. When we tried to replace it we were unable to find it anywhere in Washington State and proceeded to search the net for our favorite spice. We visited a store in Everett, Washington that carried the Wabash Valley Farms seasoning but they did not have Theater Spice. We finally found it at Amazon.com in a three-pack and have shared it with family and friends who are now converts. This is a great product, it reminds me of my weekend trips to the movie theater back in the 50's and 60's because it tastes the same. Word of Caution: DO NOT USE TO MUCH a little goes a long way. Hey... Its popcorn night tonight!

I love this seasoning!  I do not pop microwave popcorn.  Instead, I pop it myself on the stove top.  It lacks the buttery flavor that you get with movie theater popcorn.  This product adds that taste to my home made popcorn.  I just sprinkle it on when I am finished popping.  I also use their butter flavored oil.  Together my popcorn tastes fabulous.  When I get low, I simply order more. I have used Wasbash Valley Farms products for some time, and they have all been good, high quality popcorn products.
far too salty.  Save your money.  You might as well get a salt shaker and pour salt over your corn.
We highly recommend this product.  It is a great addition to freshly popped popcorn.

I love this coffee as a sort of dessert or after dinner coffee when you crave something good but want to watch your weight and not stay up all night.  If you like Creme Brulee and I do, you will like the taste. However, if you are looking for a caffeine buzz, you will need to find it elsewhere as it is quite light.
I loved the flavor of these cups, and I would order again for sure but I would check the price first. I really thought it was too expensive but I had not tried this flavor before.  It was good stuff!
Very flavorful and a nice variety.  Would definitely order this again.  Nice savings too!  A better value than if you buy at a retailer.
This is a good solid pack for people who like dark coffee. IT came very quickly and I live at a PSC.

I have tried many main stream meat sticks and jerky products and thought they were all the same I have to say I was mistaken.  These Sticks from Pacific Mountain Farms have a kick with a unique taste that everyone I hunt with can't get enough of.  Great with a cold beer.

This product was arrived very quickly and was packed with care.  My wife and I loved the quality of the Salmon Roe.  We have enjoyed Salmon Roe at our local Sushi Restaurant and this was every bit as good.

This item sold and shipped by [...] is nothing like what is pictured, they mentioned x oz/jar, more like 5oz/can.  The first can I opened the pull tab came right off.  I'm no stranger to pull tabs I feed my cat from cans that are pull tabs.I recommend going to their site [...].  Their picture is more accurate of the product. The title of the site is "russian caviar since 2004, shipped from the USA".  Notice that this product title starts with "Alaskan Salmon", minor quib, but ...My order consists of 4 cans of "Grained Salmon Caviar"  looks and smells nothing like the sushi restaurant roe.  A lot of the eggs were crushed I'd say around 80% to 90%.  The ones I get from the sushi restaurants are all intact little bubbles.  It might be because its concentrate, but I don't remember the Roe in the restaurants smelling like olives. I don't like olivesThe can labels are russian but I can see "made in USA" and made on March 28, 2011.  This contradicts with description of 2 week shelf life.  So this product has already been expired, possibly they mean when its opened.  It was September when I received it.  I was a bit turned off by the large difference in ship and made date.The order arrived a day later than expected.  That is fine however it was only shipped after I inquired its status.  The shipper said he/she was "sorry I was out of town".  The product was pack tightly, but the ice pack that was packed with has already melted by the time I got it (I opened the package immediately upon receiving, knowing it was perishable).This is the first time I ordered Salmon Roe, perhaps they all come like this.  However there are still inconsistencies with this product's page, that needs to be pointed out.
I was impressed with the timely manner I received this product. My friends and I truly enjoyed this product

As another reviewer has noted, the product description was a bit misleading. I thought I was getting four 7oz jars of Alaskan Salmon Roe. What I received was six small 5oz tins of something purporting to be salmon roe. Most of the writing on the label is in Russian, but it does say "Product of USA." This is all a bit off-putting, as we were planning to give the jars as gifts. Now I guess I'll have to open one one to check things out. The can has a stamp indicating that it was packed only 2 week ago.If the product inside is any good, I'll upgrade this by a star (to 4), if so-so I'll leave it at 3 or maybe 2. If bad, the minimum one star.
Started using this a few months ago. My dogs love it and I can see a difference in how healthy they look and act. Great natural product!

column9: Pup loves it but we hate the aftermath
column10: I purchased six cans (all different flavors) of Merrick dog food because I was concerned about my puppy not eating enough.  After weeks of research, I discovered that this was one of the best canned food brands available.  I decided to start with this flavor. She loves the food and cleaned her bowl. The gas that follows, however, is horrid. We can only tolerate it in small doses; so she may only get to eat this once a week.

My dogs love this food. I love that the bone in is slow cooked and so soft for the dogs to eat. No GI problems with this food for my black lab or my poodle mix, nor my parents bernese mtn dog or border collie. We are happy customers!
Having one diabetic dog this food is great.  Both like it and for "picky" eaters that says something.  Packing good, shipping reliable, price $10 less than the Boulder, CO company.  Can't beat it.
Great light non-dairy creamer.  MIld vanilla flavor with more of a cream flavor.Makes coffee creamy and a tad sweet.The price is right too!

These are hard to find in your average grocery store especially at such a good price. If you have had the pleasure of a meal or appetizer with these caper berries, you are likely searching for them as I was. They are large, crisp and delicious just like the ones we have with our favorite restaurant's anti-pasta appetizer. A great find at a great price.

column9: No more olives in my martini!
column10: This is a wonderful product!  The two large jars arrived very quickly and were carefully packaged.  The flavor is outstanding and gives a martini a new and different kick!  I also use these for garnish on antipasto dishes, deviled eggs, chicken picata and other dishes.  Great in salads as well.  I couldn't find these in my local grocery store.  I'm happy to have found a source for them here.

I have had no luck finding caperberries in local stores, even specialty shops, so was delighted to find them on Amazon. The jar just arrived (earlier than anticipated) and packed perfectly. I couldn't wait to bite into my first one. It was juicy and crispy, but I was unprepared for the intense saltiness. I've had these before in restaurants but never this salty. Perhaps it is too early in the day, or my preference for low sodium foods, but I was slightly disappointed.  However, the worst disappointment was the shipping cost -- more than the product!

column9: Only for burghul/cracked wheat fans or die hard health food lovers
column10: I absolutely love this product.  It is simply wheat cracked into pieces and soy pieces.  I bought it as I thought it is a nice way to add protein to cracked wheat which I am used to eating in Middle Eastern food.  It is a very healthy food albeit on the dry side by itself.Rather than use it as a breakfast food, I use it as a substitute for rice in dishes or as a side for fish or meat.  You can add to it butter or oil in the cooking as you might do with rice or vegetables or meat.It will take getting used to for the commoners:-)  My mother and father told me I fed them feed when I convinced them to try it:-)  They see they may live long if they eat it but it would be a long and boring life:-)

I recently made a life change of what foods to eat, and one change was to go to whole grain foods. I never had Bulgar Wheat before but found it delicious, especially with fresh bluberries, bananas, etc. You can make some extra and keep it in the fridge for a quick breakfast on another day that is just as good as the first day you made it.  This is a good price for the quantity you get.

Makes a wonderful start to your day.  Healthy, good tasting, and inexpensive - what more could you want?  I eat this year round - even in the summer.  Sometimes I make a big batch and bring it into work, or sometimes I make it at work in our office microwave.

I've been eating Hodgson Mill Milled Flaxseed and Soy Hot Cereal for over a year - was on a subscription with Amazon to get it regularly because I really liked it. But I was ready for a change and decided to try the Bulgur Wheat. Wow. I am pleasantly very surprised by how good this is! Very, very flavorful and very hearty as well. I had to figure out how to fix a single serving in the microwave because there are no instructions for that on the box, but I just used 1/4 cup of the cereal with 1/2 cup water and nuked it for 3 minutes. Could have done with a bit less water, but it worked overall. One thing about the NI listed: It's different than what is on Amazon. Calories for 1/4 cup is 115, and it has 3 g fiber and 10 g protein, which is different from what was listed when I first looked it up for purchase.
A MUST re-order!  Fresh, and delish!  Ordered again before the 1st bag was gone!  Yum!  Thanks for still being out there to order!

We found Nutorious in a Whole Foods earlier this year and the Original was great but Pumpkin is just a great taste and flavor.  It has a great hint of spice along with the pumpkin taste which is great this time of year.  Nice to see it on Amazon.We have actually found this is a great topper as well for salads and for breakfast on yogurt.

column9: Memorable Christmas Gifts for 10 Fortunate Friends
column10: These chocolate are named after Leonidas Kestekidis, who definitely knew how to create chocolates for the true chocolate connoisseur. When he moved back to Belgium he not only married his true love, he created chocolates the world now adores. When you taste these chocolates, your taste buds will also finally know true chocolate happiness. Whether you try one of these with a cup of coffee or tea or enjoy one as a daily indulgence, these will impress.Each chocolate has a unique design and after you sample the variety of chocolates, specific flavors will stand out as favorites.Here are my favorite creamy fillings (ganache and buttercream) which come in dark, white and milk chocolate depending on the selection:Antoinette - A smooth Brandy flavored ganacheLingoit Lait - Absolutely delicious vanilla flavored fresh butter cream filling. Time definitely stopped while tasting this chocolate.For ever - If you love coffee this may be one of the most delicious milk or dark chocolate chocolates ever made as it is filled with a special coffee cream that has hints of caramel. I will be ordering an entire box of these sometime in the future.Merveilleux - Milk or dark chocolate filled with coffee ganache.Europe - Dark or milk chocolate filled with rum filling.Ganache - Milk or dark chocolate with pure ganache.Tosca - Milk chocolate with a special ganache.Antoinette - Delicate caramel hints in the milk chocolate coating mingle nicely with the vanilla filling.Eve - Milk chocolate and banana filling.Alexandre le grand - A milk or dark chocolate with caramel cream.Also Recommended:If you wish to also try the Napolitains, I'd suggest the 1 pound sampler Ballotin with six varieties. You may also want to look for the new Palet d'Or. A deeply delicious and strong bitter chocolate filled with ganache. The center is made with butter, cream and chocolate and the outer coating is a masterpiece with gold decorations.Leonidas now has over 1700 stores and sales locations worldwide and they offer over 80 varieties of fresh chocolates. The chocolates are air freighted weekly from Brussels so you will always find the quality to be superior.My chocolates arrived fast and were as fresh as if I had purchased them in Belgium. I can say this because I first tasted them in Belgium. They were carefully packaged in the famous gold boxes with signature/seasonal wrapping and a ribbon. The boxes were then placed in protective Styrofoam containers to protect the chocolates during shipping. The expedited shipping is recommended from May to early September.If you want to introduce your friends and family tothe Leonidas Chocolates, this a perfect way to orderthem and then give them out during the holidays.~The Rebecca Review

Since I'm a student and don't own a car, I couldn't go to a nursery to find a proper pot and soil and all the stuff for my bonsai from IKEA. I ordered this, and my bonsai is doing great! It has everything you need (except for wire) to repot bonsai. I looked online for over 5 hours, and this was the best deal.
Package came in the mail in 3 days, and I couldn't be happier. I am putting a clone of a pine-tree I collected from in front of my house in the pot/soil.

The shipping was fast, and the product description was accurate. First i was scared that there was not enough soil, but it seems that they put exactly the right quantity, no way of sparing some :p I highly recommend this product for beginners who want to repot a mame bonsai.

column9: These crackers are Vegan (no animal ingredients) & delicious
column10: These crackers are Vegan, comforting and habit forming. They were the only thing my son would eat when nauseated after surgery and from pain medication. I try to always have these delicious crackers on hand but for some reason that is becoming more difficult to do.

column9: Love these & they're corn free (I think)
column10: I like these a lot + I have sensitivity to corn & these work for me.  Used to get these & the 'Buttery' version at Whole Foods but they stopped carrying them; other local sources do not offer them either.  (They all offer other Annie's crackers, which are more snacky, but not these.)  I'm actually glad because I can order a pack of 6 at a lower price per box. They arrive fresh & unbroken.

I love Annie's products and these crackers are my new favorite.  Annie's Bunny Classics Saltine Crackers are just the right size, very tasty and not too salty.  They are strong enough to spread peanut butter on but not hard.  They are by the far the best Saltines I have ever eaten.  AND they are organic.
Utterly superior in every way to any saltine I've had. Arrived in pristine condition, great price. Will never be without them, my favorite folk remedy.

column9: An Apple (chip?) a day keeps the doctor away?
column10: I'm not sure if this really is healthier than potato chips--especially since I could eat several bags in a sitting--but they sure taste great!Sweet, crunchy, and satisfying! 1 star off for the slight greasiness: Beware, these are fried, so if you're looking for a truly healthy snack it would be better to go with dried apples. But if you're looking for a sweet snack that's not sugary sweet and full of chemicals, this is great

This product could have been much better (and healthier). When I bought these chips, I was looking for something healthy to snack on. Unfortunately, the product had tons of corn syrup and cane sugar. It tastes like candy or breakfast cereals like Captain Crunch.Too bad I now have 11 bags of the chips to get rid of.

column9: Sugary Apple Chips - For Sugar Lovers
column10: The first thing I noticed about these chips was that there was loose, sticky cinnamon-flavored sugar all over the inside of the bag.  This makes it very difficult to put your hand in without having it come out coated with sugar granules.  Very very messy and sticky.  The sugar is very over-powering and cinnamon is subtle.  Overall, it's good, but I was disappointed after tasting the original apple chips.  It's for someone who has a very sweet tooth.  Also, if you are familiar with these apple-chips, there are a lot of crumbs--about 1/3 crumbs.  If you are down to the last third of the bag, expect half of what you pop into your mouth to be sugar.
Really great snack when you wish something different. These apple chips are "blast from the past" when all potato chips were boiled in oil. These are deliciously soaked in oil, but taste great.

I just purchased these apple chips and they are incredible. I absolutely love them! I wish I knew how to get in touch with the other person who reviewed them and didn't like them. I would be more than happy to take the 11 bags they're trying to get rid of! lol. : ) I guess they aren't as "healthy" as some people would like, if you're really watching what you eat. They do have quite a bit of sugar on them, but they taste so darn good. They're still better for you to eat rather than greasy potato chips. I highly recommend them! Very delicious! : )

column9: Crisp, tasty snack for an occasional treat!
column10: These crispy apple chips are just that.  Unlike dehydrated apples, which are chewy, these chips are super thin and crispy.  But they get that crispiness because of the oil added when they make them.  Sure they have less fat than potato chips, but don't kid yourself that these are a low-fat snack.Still, these chips are a fantastic treat when you want something that crunches much like a potato chip, and they have much less fat and far more flavor than a potato chip.  But there's another trade off - you don't have the sodium of potato chips, but you do have extra sugar.I originally found these chips in my local coop at about twice the price I'm paying for them on Amazon, so I was thrilled to find them here.  Even at the high price, I occasionally bought a bag.  With the lower price, I can keep them on hand.All in all, despite the fact that these aren't the most nutritious snack out there and they're more expensive than an individual bag of potato chips, I keep them in my cupboard as I (and my family) love them.  There are supposedly 2.5 servings a bag, but I doubt many of us get that many servings out of a bag.  These chips are really tasty and satisfying - and once you open a bag, you'll likely keep eating until they're all gone.Why do I give these five stars despite the fat, sugar, and price?  They're one of the best light, crunchy treats I've found and they're incredibly tasty.  I love 'em!
I first bought these chips at Marshall's Department Store and wondered how to get more...Well I went to the web site and found them here...they are very tasty and fresh and I highly recommend them!

I bought these apple chips to try to copy the Fuji Apple Salad from Panera.  These apple chips are perfect for the salad and I received so many compliments on how they make a salad pop.  They are great with pecans too.They are sweet but compared to others I've tried, these by far are the best.
This is a great healthy option for packing in lunches or taking along places, and the savings by buying in bulk is nice.

column9: Five Star Taste, with some caveats
column10: These apple chips are incredible-tasting, so I give the product 5-stars.  They're sweet, slightly tart, and fried--what can be better?  As you've seen from other reviewers, it's easy to eat a whole bag in one sitting.  They taste great, because they're cooked in oil and does have a little less fat than potato chips.Besides the "non-healthiness" of it, the box of 12 arrived at my door completely beaten up.  The package tape was unraveling and the box looked like it had just come back from a war zone--slightly smooshed and tearing at the seams.  There are no buffers or packaging materials in the box, with only the apple chip bags in there.  Thus, half of my chips were really just crumbs.I bought one bag in the store and there were quite a few crumbs in there too.  I wish the chips came more whole.  I'm not sure what everyone else's shipping experience was like, but I was a bit disappointed.Update: I've since purchased another couple of boxes and Amazon has placed the original apple chip boxes into an Amazon.com boxes.  This kept the chips from being mangled too much.  Thanks Amazon!Also, FYI: watch out for the stems!

column9: Yummy but better if in whole pieces
column10: I was craving for apple chips one day when remembering the good things in high school.  Can't find them in the groceries store anymore so i had to order on-line.  They're almost as good as I remember: crispy, sweet (but not too sweet), with a touch of cinamon = yummy! But all 12 bags were crushed into small pieces and they were hard to pick up, and I felt that I was eating someone's left-over.  Better packing would make a huge difference.

column9: Not the healthiest snack, but oh so good!
column10: Sinfully good! I wish they were healthier, but they are crispy, sweet, and the cinnamon just puts it over the top! They didn't last 3 days at my house. I'll be ordering more.

We had this from the market (pricy) and my whole family loved it, but it was too expensive to keep purchasing, so I went to Amazon and got whole box of supply ..which brought down to the reasonable price for per package.We love it because:it's not too sweet,healty alternative than other stuffmy whole family love themI serve this at the party and so many people asked me where I got it!So, now I leave the package right by the dish, so that I don't have to fetch the bag everytime people ask...that's how much people seems to like this apple chip!Try it and you'll find out for yourself!
Another great health food store find.  May get these from Amazon from now on, they're a bit pricey at our local store.
It is a little sugary, but it is very crisp and delicious! One bag has 2.5 servings.
They are okay, about half the chips in each bag were crunchy and juicy where the other half were just crunchy.They do have corn syrup, though... so if you're anti-CS or HFCS... beware.
If you've never tried APPLE CHIPS, then you're in for a treat. These are such a wonderful snack. Try sprinkling the smaller pieces on Vanilla ice cream. Delish!

column9: Not the Apple Chip I was expecting
column10: If you're looking for a dried apple that is healthy without any extra stuff (i.e. oil or corn syrup), this is NOT the item.  They are fried. I somehow missed the part where it mentioned that they were fried.  Apparently I was mislead by the "Good health" title.  Hopefully you'll read this before you purchase if you were intending on purchasing dried apples, not FRIED apples.  I also have 11 bags that I now need to figure out what to do with because they were not what I intended.

The Naan Roasted Eggplant pizza has to be one of the most delicious frozens pizzas in the world. I used to buy it at Whole Foods and then moved to an area where there are no Whole Foods, which sadden me. Now I can order this amazing pizza online! The crust has a great texture and crispiness to it. I love the roasted eggplant; it is a wonderful and nutritious topping. It is filling, but not a heavy or greasy pizza at all. So fresh tasting, even from the freezer. Hope they always continue to sell this through Amazon.

The Indian spices make the Tandoor Chef Naan Pizzas especially appealing to me. That their calorie burden is relatively light, and that they are satisfying are an added bonus. They look beautiful, and fresh. If the Naan bread was whole grain it would be perfect.

I bought this from Earth Fare when they were "discountinued" items. I tried one first, and next day I went back to the store to get the rest (5 more) on the shelf. I love it! Every ingredient is great...sauce, seasoning, and the naan. Now I finished the last one, I am looking for more.
it would have been good only the expiration date was over due by about 10 monthsbut the dog loved them anyway they should really keep an eye on those dates for sureMarielle

column9: Dried chicken strips made in China
column10: Due to all the publicity surrounding the questionable quality of dried chicken strips from China, I have thrown out this order (it is not worth the money to return it).  I will not be reordering them.  I will only be ordering dog treats made in the USA.

This product arrived on time and it was in perfect condition. My dog loves these, she has a really sensitive tummy and these don't bother her at all.  I would buy this product again and I would order from this seller as well.
The reason I buy on Amazon is the price. I can't find this product anywhere else cheaper. BIC does a good job in shipping, and I ampleased with the service, product and life in general.

I have 2 dogs, and they love these. One of my dogs is choicy and he barks when he wants a treat. If I give him the wrong one, he ups the barking. When I give him this, he gets down to chewing. He chews the coating off first and eats that.

My three dogs love these. I usually give each of them one when our puppy displays the need to chew. He is teething and these have been great!! It also occupies the three of them for a long while as well as calming them down. They love all of the flavors!
My 4 year old Cocker has one a day at about 5:30Pm. He will not take any other treat, he loves them and that's good enough for me.

It should have been no surprise to me that the ZiwiPeak canned venison is a hit with my dog as he already enjoys the ZiwiPeak Air Dried Venison Dog Food...but I was indeed surprised at HOW MUCH he loves the ZP canned.  I've been feeding my dog, Titan, another brand of canned dog food so that I could hide his different medications and get him to eat them without having to wrestle his powferful jaws like the late beloved Crocodile Hunter.  While he enjoyed this other brand of 100% venison canned food, he was on to me with the whole pill hiding thing and would root around his bowl and eat around the pills.  Titan is a food motivated dog (you'd think he was a lab rather than a pittie) and usually I could count on telling him to sit, give me paw and then literally drop the ball of wet food with the pills hidden inside into his mouth and he would gulp them down.  Well, a couple of weeks ago, he wouldn't eat the wet in his dish, and when I tried the old 'drop in his mouth' trick, he let the ball of wet food hit him in the snout and didn't even lick it off; he just watched me pick up the mess and waited for me to wipe off his face.Enter ZP canned.  First, this stuff doesn't look like normal canned food.  It has such a fresh quality to it.  Titan loved it instantly.  In fact, I don't even have to hide the pills anymore.  I feed him just like an 80+ baby, spoon feeding him right from the can, except that I place a pill on the spoon as it goes in his mouth.  No getting my hands all messy with shaping the canned food around a pill to conceal it from him.  Titan knows the pill is in there, and as long as he gets a mouthful of the ZP canned, he doesn't care.Oh, and he won't even touch the old stuff with or without pills.  He knows he's moved on up in the quality of food  and there's no turning back!

column9: Dog LOVES the Rabbit and Lamb!!!
column10: Maybe it's cause the food from NewZealand, but my Shihtzu loves this stuff. She went to push the food aside out of her way and one wif and she started gobbling it down. I mix a big spoon full in with her kibble and she seems to really like it. I feel really good giving it to her because the ingredients seem to be really good quality. Dogfoodadvisor.com gives this a 5 star rating which is the highest they can give for a dog food.

Researched the product line on their official website.  Really liked what I read about the ingredients, where/how it is all made.  Found great prices through Amazon so took a chance.  The best deal is that it was offered with super savings shipping (free)!  I really liked the variety of flavors offered in this package to give each a try.  All 4 of my dogs loved all of them.  I would buy again.

My dog is the pickiest dog on the planet when it comes to food and treats, so I wasn't sure he'd like ZiwiPeak Venison Canned food, but I am pleasantly surprised. I put a little in his bowl and it was gone in seconds, so I mixed a little more with the air-dried venison from the same company and he gobbled that up too!This is the BEST dog food on the planet in my opinion and I receive the fastest shipping from Gulf Coast Pet Supplies on Amazon.

I am drinking this tea to deal with my allergies.  The first time I took it, I was like wtf did I buy. I sweetened it up with agave nector and drank it cold (just gulp it down one shot) and drink water to get aweful taste out of  your mouth.  The tickle is out of my throat and nose and approx 15-20 sneezing is gone.
This is good, but I still prefer Red label loose tea. For people on rush this is ok, but you should really enjoy making tea in a more traditional way. I prefer this Red Label Tea 900g.
Brooke Bond Red Label Tea Bags in 100 count received as ordered. Bag from powder or leaves resulted quality Beverage.

Really good true butter taste, great for popcorn. I have ordered other products from Snappy Popcorn, and they have all been good. When I ran out of the Butter Burst before, I made the mistake of getting a jug of Act II Popping and Topping Oil at the big box store, because it was cheaper. It was not so good. I learned my lesson, you get what you pay for. I will definitely keep ordering Snappy Butter Burst Oil.

This is the buttery movie popcorn topping I've been looking for.  This is the best topping product I've tried.  It has a butter flavor on the tongue just tasting it on your finger.  It is enhanced by Flavarcol but not required.  It is liquid below room temperature which means it can be put in a squeeze bottle and kept handy for those movie nights.  Get a gallon of this and you'll be happy.
Well worth the money. Has a great buttery taste, just like at the movies. I suggest warming it a little or pour it over hot popcorn. When you do...it taste just like theatre butter! Buy and enjoy!

If you like a buttery taste on your popcorn,,,,, this is it. I used this on my popcorn last night and was pleased with it. And because it's a buttery oil, it doesn't make the popcorn soggy. Sooooooo,,,,, ENJOY !!!!
the theatre butter has nothing on this..or perhaps this is the same butter they use..u will njoy this product

Very pleasant light and buttery. Takes only a small amount to make your popcorn burst with flavor. Snappy does not make the popcorn greasy or soggy. It is an excellent product to top off your special popcorn. I've even use it as an oil to pop the popcorn but I like it the best as a topper. You won't be sorry if you try it I promise. Buying and shipping with Amazon is a dream come true, they are truly the very best. I live in Alaska and it's a crap shoot when you buy something on line if or when you will receive the item. Thank you Amazon.Allan
This popcorn is a yummy, buttery flavoring that makes our popcorn taste like real movie theater popcorn use to taste!

column9: An Authentic Movie Theater Popcorn Experience.
column10: My wife is a popcorn fanatic and especially  loves that Authentic  Movie Theater Popcorn.  I have been trying relentlessly to re-create that experience at home using various products, from clarified butter, to flavacol, to movie butter seasoning.. all of which came close but not exactly it.  After trying the Snappy Butter Burst Oil we agreed this was the closest we've tasted that fit that flavor profile of Authentic Movie Theater Popcorn.  Of course you have remember  to include the other steps as well , like cooking on the stove vs. a hot-air popper and cooking with coconut oil while also using fine-grained salt to top afterwards. (not regular table salt, the fine-grained salt gives much better coverage  ).I could not find any nutritional information on the product so here it is :1 tablespoon Serving SizeTotal Fat : 14gSaturated Fat: 2gTrans Fatty Fat: 0Polyunsaturated Fat: 8gMonounsaturated Fat: 4gCholesterol: 0mgSodium: 0mgTotal Carbohydrate: 0gProtein: 0gIngredients: soybean oil, Artificial Butter Flavor, TBHQ and citric acid, Beta CaroteneSuggestion: purchase a pump for use with the gallon size or  , as we like to do,  use a cup with a pouring spout (measuring cup will do),  heat 1 - 2 tablespoons in microwave for 10-15 seconds and slowly pour warmed oil over popped corn ( layering in the popcorn to maximize coverage) .kick back and enjoy your favorite movie,  an episode of your favorite drama, or just enjoy the popcorn all to yourself - whatever suits your mood.

What 'Snappy Popcorn' did is verging law-breaking, they don't care about the 'little people'. Too bad.Thank you U.S. Bank!!! You truly have, always, put us firstAlthough we are pleased with the actual product, we find that there customer service is more than unacceptable.

column9: Crunchy, flavorful chip alternative for low carbers
column10: Just The Cheese snacks are perfect for low-carb dieters searching for a crunchy alternative to chips and other junk food. How many times have we been at the movies and smelled the buttery popcorn, yet knew if we caved in we would blow our carb allowance.Here's the alternative. Slip a bag in to the movies and you're set. They're also perfect for travel, a quick breakfast or snack, or any time you get a chips craving. I love that one bag has 20 g of protein and nearly 2/3 of the calcium RDA.While others have called JTC snacks dry and too salty, I rather like the flavor and mouth feel (as they say in the food industry).I do have a problem with the company proclaiming that "nothing else [has been] added" other than cheese. Here are the Herb & Garlic flavor ingredients: cheese, powdered cellucose, maltodextrin, disodium phosphate, spices, dehydrated garlic, dextrose, parsley, citric acid, natural garlic flavor. Ok, a FEW more ingredients than "just" the cheese!They're also pricey, though if you purchase them through Amazon they only come out to a little more than one dollar a bag. While the bags aren't huge, they are quite filling thanks to the high fat content. (240 of the 300 calories in the bag come from fat. And for the saturated fat-phobic, one bag has 14 g of saturated fat.)If you're on the fence, I would suggest trying a bag (see if your local health food store carries them) before buying the box. Your taste may be different, but for me JTC snacks are a flavorful and portable idea.

column9: Too salty and too much saturated fat
column10: Way too salty 52% and high saturated fat 70% per bag.  Weird taste -- not sure what it is but it's not "cheese".  Not for me.
I found the taste to to too salty & overpowering. Not a great snack choice

I had eaten these when I was on the Atkins Diet.  The store that used to sell them stopped and I was looking on line and found them at Amazon.  They are filling, crunchy and buttery. You can use them as croutons on salad or soups.  They make excellent between meal snacks.  My coworkers all want me to order them some next time I place my order.
Save your money. These Cheese Rounds are terrible. Very dry. Very High in Salt...that's all you taste. I would give this a Big Zero.
These were very good;  however, I found about a week after receiving them that I could have purchased them locally.  Service was great.

I combined this with olive oil and rubbed onto chicken breasts.  I let it sit overnight and grilled the next day.  Great flavor!  We ate this on pita bread with lettuce, chopped tomato and cucumber, hummus and feta.  Great summer meal.

Super easy to use.  I cut up chicken breast or thighs into strips and throw in a baggie with several good shakes to coat.  Massage chicken.  Throw on grill or grill pan, cook through.  Wonderful exotic but not weird exotic flavor.  Use in gyros, with rice or in salad.
When I bought my tagine I was looking for some unique spices to put in the food that I planned to cook in it.  This is really good on chicken, I recommend it!!!

Was disappointed in this spice blend. When I lived in SFO I was absolutely hooked on both Chicken and Lamb Shawarma from an Arab restaurant in the Haight...just yummy so I was excited when I saw this Shawarma spice as I no longer live in the City. Spice was very bland tasted sort of old and dusty. Will keep experimenting and try grinding fresh spices rather than buying a blend next time.

I have only used one bag so far, but I put in a 2-lb salmon fillet glazed with an apple juice reduction and the results were so delicious that my family of three ate the entire fillet in one sitting.  Neither my husband, nor my daughter have ever even liked salmon before.  It was incredibly easy, the directions are very clear, and best of all:  no mess to clean up!

column9: great trick and delicious for ribs or brisket.
column10: I've lived in apartments with no outdoor space for years-- but can always get nicely smoked foods by using these bags.  True, your entire home will smell like wood smoke, but not such a bad thing (you can always undercook a bit, take the meat out and finish it outside the bag if you don't want a strong smell to linger).  The times for cooking and the recipes included on the inside are right on target every time, you really can't go wrong.  Makes wonderful brisket-- I let it cool after cooking, slice it, and then add sauce and reheat.  My friends and I agree that the poultry/fish bags aren't quite as good.The first I tried was a similar import from William's Foods, but they no longer carry these.  Wish I could get them locally, but this works!

column9: EASY TO USE GREAT SMOKEY FLAVOR!!!
column10: I have been using these smoker bags for several years. the first time I used them I bought them from my local Cub foods grocery store. i however now just order them on line since I can get them year around. I have used them on the grill, but mostly inside in the oven. I use them mainly for smoking ribs and turkey legs. They always come out perfect. Everyone compliments me on the flavor and tenderness of the meat. I usually finish them up on the gas grill with barbeque sauce for that perfct taste. I have given these away to friends nd family and they are now using them. I would be really surprised if anyone tried them and didn't like them.UPDATEI used a smoker bag to make incredible pulled pork. I used a 6 lb pork shoulder and seasoned it. Placed in the smoker bag at 225. I put mine in the oven at midnight and let it slow roast till 7 am. I was afraid at this low heat it would not get smokey enough but it was perfect. I pulled the pork apart in the juices from the bag and it was as good as any pulled pork I've had.

To the person who rated this low to due getting just 1 bag...read what you order. Very unfair to rate a product 1 star due to your own error.The bags are great!! So far I've only tried the alder one which gives a lighter taste than the mesquite.*Read the instructions WELL on the INside of the cardboard*I bought a 4-pack of rainbow trout from [...] and rubbed kosher salt inside the fish a couple of hours before cooking. Preheated oven to 475F, placed 1 large cubed zucchini and the 4 fish inside the bag, folded closed and placed on a low rack. Lowered temp to 375F after 15 min and continued for another 25-30 min (3 lbs of fish) = perfection! My kids were crazy about eating "fish tummy" and this couldn't have been any easier to cook or easier to clean up.A very light smoke lingered around the kitchen, but nothing that I'd need to even open the windows for. I am a caffeine junkie, constantly buying the 16 ounce cans of Rockstar, Amp, whatever was handy that had caffeine.  I purchased a box of the Crystal Light energy at the local grocery and was pleasantly surprised. Taste good (at first just a little bland), but as you use this, it's really great and doesn't raise my blood sugar like "regular" peanut butter.  Just wish I could consistently get locally.

Tried these when Amazon had them on sale.  Pleasantly surprised: great crunchy texture with a high quality natural cheese flavor.  No artificial aftertaste.  The crostini has an excellent taste, like a good fresh crunchy pizza crust.  The cheese flavor is balanced perfectly and tastes fresh and natural.
These sugar cookies are a pleasure to bake. The dough is fun to work with and easy to shape. There is no cardboard after taste in your mouth which leads you to just wanting more.

Why get 5# when you can get 10#? I love these smaller increments of nuts and seeds. 25 or 50 pounds always seems like a lot, though these days with teaching raw classes and all, it probably makes sense... Remember to freeze the nuts and seeds! Helps keeps them fresh.
This is an organic loose leaf decaf Chai tea mix.  The herb mix in this Chai tastes too sweet for my taste; and my spouse agrees.  So now I'm stuck with several boxes that nobody here will drink.

For your health in general, and for your waistline, whole grains are good way to go. With this snack, Snyder's of Hanover provides a tasty, comparatively healthy snack that is organic as well! Not as salty as regular pretzels, these sticks make a delicious and really hit the spot. I think that they are great!(Review of Snyder's of Hanover Organic Whole Wheat & Oat Sticks)

These turned out to be exactly what I'd hoped...a great tasting, healthy snack.  A snack I never feel guilty about because it won't add any pounds!  And for my kids this is the perfect, healthy alternative to chips, crackers and other way over processed junk food that has no nutritional value.  I've read some reviews where people were complaining that there isn't enough salt.  It has the exact right amount.  Add a bunch of salt and these pretzels would no longer be healthy. Highly recommended...give 'em a try
We cannot get enough of these. They are a perfect combination of sweet and salty. And, I don't generally like those two flavours together. They are a great healthy alternative to potato chips.

I thought these sticks would be a great substitute for regular pretzels.  They are more sweet than savory.  More like a graham cracker type of taste than a pretzel.  Other members of my family like them, but I was looking for a whole grain alternative to a regular pretzel.  Gave 3* since family members like them.
Like the concept. the packaging and the taste. Would be much better if they hadn't made it low sodium. Not everyone is on a salt restricted diet.

column9: The BEST - You will be spoiled with this tea!
column10: After trying this and the 'Sunset' from Harney & Sons I don't want any other tea- it is so smooth and full of delicious  cinnamon flavor that it is like having a dessert!All other teas taste like lightly flavored hot water compared to this- You will become a tea snob with this one!

column9: It's a dessert in a tea bag
column10: I don't normally even drink tea but tried this out in the cafe onboard a cruise ship.  It knocked my socks off with the aroma and spicy taste, to the point I knew I had to track it down once I got back on land.  It still hasn't turned me into a daily tea drinker, but it's the only tea I stock in my house!  I'm not saavy enough to say if the teabag version is worse or better than the satchel version, but I stick with the latter because it just adds to the novelty of the tea drinking experience, somehow.  This item has proven to be a very warmly received gift by a couple of friends, one who loved tea and one who loves spicy flavorful drinks.
I absolutely love this tea.  Glad to find it in a larger tin.  I have the sachets and the tea bags.  I prefer the sachets, but the teabags are good as well.  Will definitely buy again.

I really enjoy tea and drink it frequently; however, I NEED coffee. I've been looking for something that can keep me away from my addiction for a while now. I'm not big on flavored coffees, or fruity teas so when my best friend (a guy) told me that I had to try this, I was skeptical...especially of a cinnamon tea. I've tried chai and  most people like it; however, I am NOT a fan. I was worried this tea would be like that. Man, I couldn't have been more wrong. This is the BEST tea...Naturally sweet, and perfectly spiced. I quickly became obsessed, and buying these at $2/bag at the coffee shop was really starting to hurt... So I knew I could depend on Amazon to have them. :)I just got my overnight order on Friday (10/5/12), so every morning this past weekend (and this morning included) I have had this tea instead of coffee. It's amazing. It's hard to limit myself to one cup a day, but I know if I don't I will quickly run out. :)This is the first tea I've ever had that doesn't make me feel like "man, I miss coffee".Also, my husband is a sometimes tea drinker and doesn't like hot beverages (he will wait for hot tea to go nearly cold before drinking it, lol). Normally when I make a tea for myself, I will ask him if he would like one even though I know the answer is usually "no, thanks".So here's what happened the other day:ME: "Would you like to try a cup of my 'special tea'?"HUSBAND: "Sure..."<<<5 Minutes Later>>>ME: "How is it?"HUSBAND: "Mmmmm..."The next morning as I'm making breakfast, hubby gets up and sees me in the kitchen:HUSBAND: "So, can you make me some of that special tea?"ME: "Oh,you liked it that much?"HUSBAND: "Hell yeah! That tea is awesome."'Nuff said. Buy this.I'm super serial. :)THAT BEING SAID - ***DO NOT BUY THIS FROM THIS SELLER*** This is way over priced for this tea. I picked up a tin of the Peppermint herbal variety from Starbucks for $10. They didn't have this variety, so I turned to Amazon. Amazon is always my first choice, but I really wish I had checked eBay. A seller there this same tea there for $11.50!! Also, one of the tins I received was dented, and it wasn't due to poor packaging. So $16.95, plus overnight shipping, dented tin... you do the math. I paid 2x as much as I needed to. So sad. Damanged tin AND totally overpriced.Sorry for the long review. I get carried away.

I used to work at Caribou Coffee, who carries Harney & Sons tea (little did I know). Ever since I stopped working there I've lamented that I no longer get my free weekly hot cinnamon spice tea. To my surpise, after much hunting online, I discovered that Harney & Sons in fact supplies Caribou with their tea sachets. I was beyond joyous when I discovered that I could buy this tea to enjoy, and not only that, it's much cheaper than Caribou packages and re-sells it for.The sachets are a clever invention because they give a lot more flavor than a standard tea bag but don't require the time and dedication that loose-leaf tea and a strainer do. This tea tastes and smells like the holiday season with a kick. Cinnamon, cardamom, cloves...okay, now I'm just making stuff up, I'm not really sure what they put in this stuff, but it's heavenly.
First tasted this tea at my hairdressers, had to have it.Loved this product, delivered promptly, taste is absolutely delicious, will definitely be reordering this product.
Sweet, a little spicy. A completely delicious tea! And a beautiful tin for the romance of it. I would definitely recommend trying this flavor if you havent already

LATEST REMARKS:A couple of times I had milk that was getting a little old so I scalded it first by bringing it to 185º and holding it there 5 minutes.  It's definitely a nuisance but I noticed both times that the yogurt set up much firmer.I am still incubating in a cooler and am happy with the system.  I usually incubate for 8 hours overnight and no longer add hot water halfway through.  Always looking for the easiest way.  It turns out fine every time.  Still love the taste and convenience of this starter. Still just using half the recommended amount of starter.My batch of yogurt is actually 5 and a half cups rather than a quart. I use great old heavy glass jars similar to big peanut butter jars. I've never bothered to measure it before, till another reviewer made an issue of the cost effectiveness of making homemade yogurt. So the cost per "quart" for me is even less than the 97¢ plus electricity I mentioned in my comments to "Are You Kidding?".ORIGINAL REVIEW:I love this starter. It's very convenient to have on hand since I live in a very rural area, and I think the taste is great. I get firm yogurt in my Salton in only 5 hours and I don't think it's anywhere near too tart. I find the flavor to be very pleasant when I lick the spoon. I eat my yogurt with fruit (no added sugar) and the flavor is not at all overpowering. Yogurt gets more tart when it incubates longer but sometimes I have let a batch go 7 or 8 hours and I still think it tastes fine.Because this starter is so pricey, I use just half of the recommended amount and it works fine. I first used it at the recommended strength for comparison. A half portion is a little less than a teaspoon. Then I tightly reseal the packet till next batch. I also save portions of yogurt for starter. I keep one in the fridge for the next batch, and freeze several. This way, a packet that costs a dollar or more, instead of just making one quart, gives me about ten quarts without too much fuss. On occasion I use second-generation yogurt for starter, but mostly just the first generation.Now that amazon is now offering a 3-pack of 6-portion boxes for a good price and eligible for Super Saver shipping, this starter has become much more affordable.Some additions/Dec. 13, 2009:My Salton died a premature death.  Now I incubate in an insulated six-pack-type cooler, using jars of hot water alongside the jar of yogurt (which sits in the insulated holder from my old Salton).  I refill the jars of hot water halfway through.  I use the hottest tap water--obviously this is a potential variable--but the jars of water can be a lot hotter than the yogurt if they're not right up against it.It sets up in 6 to 8 hours, flavor still great.  I add 1/2 cup dry milk per oversized "quart" and still use just half the recommended starter.  I use nonfat milk which is notorious for not making real firm yogurt.  Mine is totally firm (curd-like or gel-like consistency) for the first serving.  After that the whey separates out some.  I either eat it or pour it off. It is not as creamy as commercial nonfat yogurt; I don't think that's achievable at home.I  use store-bought milk and do not scald it.  I warm it to 110 degrees, using a cheap candy thermometer bought right here on amazon.com.  I believe anywhere from 105 to 112 is OK.  I warm everything I'm using ahead of time.I'm glad my tips have been helpful and hope these details might help someone else out.

column9: Not bad, but not the best
column10: First, I am quite surprised at how expensive this product is on Amazon; my local health food store (with a notoriously high mark-up on products) sells it for about 3.59/box. Otherwise it is a good product; definitely more potent than store-bought yogurt as a starter, but I've actually had much better results using my probiotic capsules that I use as a dietary supplement. Here's a quick comparison of results with yogurt starters:Store-bought yogurt: incubates in about 8 hours, results in runny yogurtYogourmet: incubates in about 5-6 hours, results in relatively thin yogurt2 probiotic capsules: incubates in 3 hours, results in thick, luscious yogurt
