With other flavors, I'm only able to take in about half of a packet.I use these while cycling.  They help me maintain my energy level throughout a long ride and keep me from bonking.  Any long workout requires an athlete to hydrate and take in nutrition along the way in order to keep going.  One packet of GU seems to be just the right amount for a single serving.  It stashes well in a pocket or saddle bag and is easy to eat on the fly.  Definitely wash it down with water (also to keep your hydration up).I am a quite the chocolate fanatic and enjoy the taste of the chocolate outrage so much that during a recent triathlon I was actually looking forward to the point in the race in which I was going to be able to eat the GU!Try out a few flavors and see what appeals to you.

I've tried several of the major gel brands, and many of each brand's flavors.  Without question, GU is superior in the two major areas for reviewing gel: taste and effectiveness.  The texture and flavor of each GU variety (the only one I haven't tried is "plain") is far better than the equivalent of another brand, and frankly just generally tastes good.  This is especially true for the chocolate burst and vanilla bean flavors.  With regard to effectiveness, I use gels for pre-workout "priming" and during longer workouts.  GU provides great, quick, and sustained energy in both phases, without too much caffeine like some products or too little or too slow a "kick-in" period like others.  GU is easily the best.

I really like the GU's for marathons/long distance runs. It's a great variety box for those who want to try out different flavors. My only advice is to drink a lot of water with them. If I don't, they seem to give me stomach cramps. Almost like a dehydrated feeling. Other than that, I really like these gels.
This product is great. Give you the right energy during hard work outs. Much better than the competition. Flavors are great and they get absorb by the body very fast.

I love the gu compared to other products I have tried that has similar uses. I have only tried a few so far, vanilla bean, lemon lime and mint chocolate. Thought I would not like the heavier sounding tastes like chocolate but they were great! The vanilla bean and several others have caffeine in them which I was leery of because I do not do well with caffeine. I get shaky and feel like crap but with these, I really did not even notice the caffeine. That is also good because it opens up a whole other variety of flavors.

I had been looking at prices for a while on a box of gnu packs. Of course I got the best deal here. Ordered the box and it came the next day (I have prime). Being a marathon runner it is so much easier buying the 24 pack box rather than running down to the running store and buying individual packs.
hard to go for a long run without my roctain . one every 40 mintutes race day maybe more way better then like brands
Have used powergel for years and wanted to try something new.  Flavor is good and has a little grittiness, which is a good thing.  I will deinitely buy these again.
These gels work great on the road for a quick burst of energy. They are a bit of a problem to dispose of and to avoid a sticky mess on your fingers and pockets.
Could not do my long runs without it! Must have to do get extra boost. I notice a huge difference in pace and distance.

GU  Expresso Love  tastes great. I have one every morning (with a full glass of H2O) right before I work out since I don't have time to eat and digest first. It gives me the energy that I need for a morning workout. Highly recommend it.
Solid product from GU as usual. I prefer these to the off-brand gel packs. Espresso Love is one of the better flavors.

column9: Delicious, and No Arsenc (like Cliff Gels)
column10: Or anything with Organic Brown Rice Syrup (high levels of Arsenic in them)----These have no caffeine and taste great (dont care for the other GU flavors.)  some are pretty nasty (dont do the caffeine ones either)-----these do the job...--Last time I order here though because I can buy them locally for less than these (AND NO SHIPPING COST)--That was anothe $7.99 to the order (so paid almost $35) and can get a box here from a health food store for $26....

I had my first shot at this during my first half marathon. Around the 6th mile I had this really dense thing called Gu. Man ... I have to tell I am a big convert form that point on. The difference was even more apparent when I decided to do my second half marathon without it. Empirically speaking I don't know whether Gu works or not (I believe the jury is out there) ... but it sure works for me. I will always have one in my pocket if I am running more than 10 miles.
I had wanted to try one of these gels for a while having had some from a food station whilst running the Providence Marathon. This has not disapointed and I use it during every run now.

Of all the energy supplements GU is the best for me, good hot or cold,easy to take and gives a great energy boost. Although sometimes during a tough workout there can be an initial energy high followed by a dip about 20 mins latermandarin taste is not that bad also
Taste is good. Essential for long bike rides and other high energy workouts. Doesn't make me gag like the vanilla flavor. I bring one with me on every bike ride.
Very reasonably priced and does the job. My only peeve would be the slight aftertaste that the Jet Blackberry has.

I do crossfit and I am an ectomorph by definition. I eat a lot and I just don't put on weight. When I workout intensely like in crossfit, I usually tend to puke or get exhausted very fast. This led to a lack of/slow muscle growth. I decided to give Gu a try after hearing about how it gives runners that endurance to for their runs. On my really heavy workout days, I take Gu right after my warmup and it kicks in about 15 minutes after that. I get to push myself further and harder and I do not leave the gym like a halfdead fish anymore. I am starting to see some gains and I really feel good after a workout. This product doesn't bulk you up and especially good for that endurance you need during an energetic workout.

I got this so I could try a bunch of flavors, and it shipped quickly and fulfilled that purpose. So far I like all flavors and this really helps me when I "hit a wall" on my run. Also, if you buy these from a store around me they are like $1.35 a piece, so this is better!

column9: Does the Job and Very Tasty
column10: I am a devout user of Gu, and had been fairly-exclusively using the Mint Chocolate flavor, but this flavor was a welcome change. So now I mix the two flavors in the box in my fridge and just grab one on my way to run or work out, and surprise myself.  I have not cared for several of the other flavors, but this one is a keeper, and gives me the same energy that the mint chocolate Gus do.

I use GU for running, hiking and bicycling. The packets fit easily into small pockets. The flavors are good enough for me, and I enjoy the variety in the mixed case. What I really like, though, is the energy boost GU gives me when I'm literally running on empty.

I'm a runner and training for my first marathon, and have found GU very easy to stomach, and good for the bursts of energy you need with a multi-hour run. I love the variety of flavors in this box, the box was shipped quickly (and free!), and best of all, they're quite a bit cheaper than when you buy them individually at the sporting goods store when you purchase them this way.All around yes vote from me. :-)

Typically a marathon runner's bread a butter, I use GU most frequently for late night ice hockey games.  Keeps me skating hard through the 3rd period.  I initially got the variety pack to try all the flavors but settled on mint chocolate as the best.  GU has a consistency that most people aren't used to but mint chocolate is certainly palatable and worth the energy kick.
Dont even bother in trying different flavors, if you are a chocolate fan this is the ONE! Great energy boost !
Gu Gel - what can you say.  Got what I ordered and using what I got.  Best price around, though; beats expo prices.

column9: GU Gel is easy to take down, tastes good and works
column10: Typically cramps, soreness and fatigue are all delayed while taking GU and recovery is enhanced. It brings my legs back to life if I start running without taking one then take one in during the run. For short 5 mile runs I just take one before the run for 10 mile runs I take one before and one about 45 minutes to an hour into the run. My times have definitely improved as GU give just enough energy to push a little harder. I'm making better times and pushing through the wall better with the help of a GU here and there.Additional note: I did a weight workout and core workout then thought I'd run a 5 mile tempo workout. I took a GU before I ran but legs fatigued badly at 3.5 miles from the weight workout before I imagine and not fully recovered from the solid 10 mile run the day before. For running, I find GU really supplements the energy when the body is rested and ready to push for a good run rather than after a hard work out and just trying to get in a good run time after the body is still not recovered.

you will enjoy this especially over the unhealthier stuff out on the market. I was on the NO Xplode stuff for quite some time and finally weaned off it and started this. This chocolaty flavor is like chocolate pudding lol and it gets you through a great workout. My husband thinks its not as great as NO Xplode - but then again - it doesn't have all the chemicals in it either. I think its a great product regardless and given its healther - I will stick to this.

I am somewhat new to running and would always run out of energy about 1 hour into the run and heard about this product.  It helps tremendously!  Very portable slips right into your pocket, I don't like to carry extra things when I run so this is perfect.  Great taste and easy to eat on the go!

I just wanted to leave a note of what the composition of the Mixed Flavors pack looked like.  I had a hard time finding information on what exactly I'd get.  I'm sure they change could change this from time to time, but this is what I had:"Roctane" Gu packets (1 each): Blueberry Pomegranate,Vanilla Orange, Cherry Lime, Pineapple.  These are the high endurance packets.  The Blueberry Pom and Vanilla Orange are both double caffeine and the Pineapple has no caffeine.Regular Gu Packets had 3 of Chocalate Outrage and Vanilla Bean.  The rest had two of each flavor: Strawberry Banana, TriBerry, Expresso Love, Mandarin Orange, Jet Blackberry, Mint Chocolate, Lemon Sublime.  The Strawberry Banana, Mint Chocolate, and Lemon Sublime have no caffeine, while Jet Blackberry and Expresso Love are double caffeine.If you're looking to shake it up or find a favorite flavor, I think this is a good buy.  I don't know that Gu is the best energy gel out there - I actually think everyone just has to find out what they like in taste and texture and what their stomach can handle.  I've had good luck with Gu myself and I look forward to trying all the flavors.

I train and race with Gu.  I never feel jittery or sick; it just makes me feel like I can KEEP RUNNING.  It's wonderful.  Just like natural energy.  And the chocolate outrage tastes like chocolate frosting!  Yumm!

column9: Gu Energy Gel works for me
column10: I use Gu Energy Gel for biking riding.  Over the last 5 years I've found that the combination of lots of liquid and one or two Gel packs an hour really helps prevent leg cramps.
It is convenient to order this on-line if your local shops do not carry it.  The price is very competitive.
I've used this gel for years now for my long distance running.  Easy on my stomach and I love the taste of the plain.  Highly recommend.

Gu gels arrived faster than I expected and the expiration dates on each individual gu gel was months ahead, so I'm glad about that.  I have order gu gels in the past (from other places) and the expiration dates on each packet are only 1 month away (or even expired), but this time around it was months ahead.  Thank You
Vanilla bean energy gel tastes a lot better than many flavored GUs. Would I eat it for fun? Nope, but it gives me a great energy kick during a long run, doesn't make me feel sick, and tastes OK.
Used the product to train for a 1/2 Ironman and would highly recommend it to keep up energy levels.  Easy to carry along on your work out and easy to open packages.
Enjoy the selection made, different flavor and taste for each day. Gives you a great boost of energy and drive.
I have tried all the flavors of this brand and this one is by far the best flavor (tri berry)

I have tried several flavors and the tri berry is my favorite. It really gives me a boost during my long runs and it doesn't bother my stomach at all. I have tried energy bars during a run and my stomach is a mess. This stuff is great, next I'm going to try the 2X the caffeine, I hear that really gives you a boost.

column9: Low Caffeine, Good Taste, Good Texture
column10: I prefer the Gu to other gels because the texture is thicker, more like frosting. I find this more pleasant.The taste of this product is the best I have tried among gels.I prefer a low-caffeine option, and I appreciate that the box identifies that there are just a few mg of caffeine from the cocoa powder, no additional caffeine.
GU expresso love is the only brand/flavor I use.  I like the caffeine in addition to the carbs, etc.  Its a little strong for some people, but I like it.
Amazing!  Best gel out there.  Really feel a surge while using it to bike.

As I prepare for my first marathon, I have been trying foods to help me through the multi-hour runs and Gu has helped me greatly. The chocolate flavor tastes great and the texture is just right, it doesn't upset my stomach which is #1 in my book. I would recommend this gel for endurance athletes.

In my marathon and triathlon training, I have tried lots of different Gels.  In the end, each individual has to determine what works best for them in terms of taste, consistency, and ease on the stomach.  For me personally, Gu has the best consistency as I find some of the other products a little too runny.  It also seems to be the easiest on my stomach and I very much like the taste of Chocolate Outrage and Espresso Love.  For some of my longer workouts (>1 hour) I've noticed a substantial improvement in my performance with Gu in my system.  I highly recommend this product.

column9: awesome energy source for long distance running
column10: My favorite nutrition gel for long distance running, tried various others but this is our favorite.
Best Energy Gel on the market. Tastes great and works well. The Chocolate is by far the best.
Great product, it's great being able to mix it up with different flavors. No issues with expiration date as others have mentioned.
A very handy and compact way to give yourself a boost when doing strenuous exercise.  Tastes good too.

I always carry and occasionally use GU on backpacking and day-hiking trips.  No preparation, very lightweight and compact non-perishable "food" stashed in my pack indefinitely for when I start to drag and feel "out of gas" during a long hiking day,  still have miles to go, and have no appetite for a larger meal (especially at higher elevation).  Because orange is the only flavor that appeals to me, I have not tried the other flavors.
I purchased the Gu for my son, he is a runner.  It was shipped to him a few days earlier than the website said it would. I would definately purchase this product again from Amazon.
I've tried all the energy gels out there and my two favorites (for taste) are GU Just Plain and Hammer Gel Raspberry. Also, it works.

I bought these first at the store, single packets, and I started using them before my ride home after work. Usually by that time, after 10 hours, I am a little tired anyway, but I have found these give me that much more energy I need to go the distance without tiring before I get home, especially when the temperatures get really hot, high 90's to over 100 degrees.But I also work out with free weights. So one day when I was doing my leg workout, I did my sets of squats before the leg extensions etc., then decided I wanted to do some more squats. So I took a gel about 15 minutes before I was going to tackle it again and found I had a surge of energy to do 4 more sets with heavier weights, after my leg ext's. So yes, these work quite well. The flavors I love the most are Espresso Love , (strange name but great taste) vanilla and chocolate outrage. But that is my preference since I am a lover of chocolate, and like who isn't?Another note, or update, (4-30-2011), I often use these after my workout (with weights) as an energy boost and recovery. Sometimes during a workout for the extra energy, but most likely to use it after. It works great, and at only 100 calories, it is just the right amount.The box is cheaper than buying the singles at the store, so for me it is the best way to go. I am sure there are other sports that could benefit from these gels. Buy it on Amazon's subscription, and the price drops even more.

LOVE the Gu! Easy on the stomach, easy to use during training, portable even during long runs or rides.It takes about 8 minutes after fueling with Gu for me to notice a difference during running. I have tried every similar product, and for me, nothing tastes as good and works as well as Gu. The new blackberry flavor is awesome and adds to the caffeinated product line (not all Gu has caffeine).

I use Gu gels for longer races and training runs.  Mint Chocolate is my favorite flavor, and I have tried a lot.  It tastes like a York Peppermint Patty!  They don't carry it in any sports/running stores around here, so I was very happy to find it on Amazon.

This is my new favorite energy gel. I've tried other brands and flavors of caffienated gu - because sometimes on hard rides or long runs, I need a little boost - and caffeine helps a lot. This stuff tastes great, too. I can't stand coffee-flavored anything, and the blackberry is very palatable and easy to eat and digest. Love it!!

Gu's energy gels are excellent for long distance running and their Vanilla Bean flavor is very tasty. Fast shipping on this product (item arrived in 3 days with standard ground shipping) and exactly as described. Total with tax was about $27 for 24 Gu packs...pretty good deal considering they typically cost $1.50/pop.
If you need to use gels for an intensive workout - this is the best there is!!! Love the taste
I am training for a marathon and use one packet per hour to keep my energy/blood sugar levels in check.  It is amazing the difference it makes.  Easy to use.  Tasty!

I was hesitant buying so much of this before I had even tasted it, but it has a great flavor, which is really all you can expect from an energy gel in my opinion.  I had previously only bought the orange flavor, so now I have a new flavor that I can depend on.

The fruity Gu's weren't to my liking but I'm a big chocolate fan and when it came to training for the Pittsburgh Half Marathon again, I decided to just buy the box.  I can happily say that I'm still enjoying the stuff and don't know what I'd do without it for longer training runs.
I know he uses these when he does the road ride.He has been using it for the last 7 years.

I've used this brand and this flavor for several half marathon training cycles.  I use it 1/2 way through my long run each week and find it gives me the kick I need to get back and sometimes even finish stronger than when I left!
Gu is a great workout energy burst, without the caffine like effects. Works best if you drink a lot of water during the workout.

Excellent product. Rode our annual Kingston to Negril ride in Jamaica October 18th 2008 (160 miles in 10 hours over hilly terrain) and completed it in the front group comfortably with no cramps using Gu energy gel.

column9: great boost of energy during workout
column10: gives me energy during long runs and other endurance sports - very easy to eat during a run, like having the option of 4 different flavors - I have tried all but Espresso Love so far (not a coffee drinker) and the other 3 taste great
Love, love, love this product.  It gives me a great energy boost during rides and swims.  Would recommend it to any athlete.

column9: Way to Go for Varied Tastes
column10: This is a great way to purchase GU if you don't want a full case of the same flavor.  It is a bonus to be able to mix up the tastes of this helpful product from time to time.  I like the benefits of this product which include:  easy to eat, quick to give energy and a good way to provide calories before the morning run.

If your picky about your gu - don't buy the multipack, but if you like the variety...this is your best deal. Love them for running...none of them are bad, but I don't particulary like the coffee ones.
I liked the flavors of all the GU energy gels and it gave me the boost of energy I needed before my workout without giving me the jitters. I would definitely recommend this product.

column9: The only thing I can stomach down during competitions
column10: These are the only food I can stomach down during competitions.  Unlike other brands, GU gels are not overly sweet nor too thick.  My favorites are vanilla, chocolate, and plain (in that order).  Although I expect energy gels to be sweet (I think it's to encourage drinking water to offset the concentrated ions), some are too much and it makes me gag.  (ie. powerbar, clif shots...)Side note: a plus side for clif shots is it is slightly more environmentally conscious.  The package is made so that it doesn't litter little pieces of ripped gel package tops.  It's hard to keep track of the small, torn off tops when you're on the run!

Until this year the longest race I'd trained for was a 12k.  I never trained for more than an hour at a time, even on my 'long days', so didn't need a product like Gu.  When I began to train for a half-marathon, however, I found that Gu provided a needed boost in energy toward the end of the longer runs.  I usually take it around 45 minutes in (like the package advises) and wash it down with a couple sips of sports drink.  It doesn't take all the pain out of 10 mile+ days,  but definitely helps.  I'll have a couple packets with me on race day for sure.
The GU energy gel is great for those long distance rides! The price is right, also!

Even the "plain" flavor was much better than I expected. I had my heart set on getting the Vanilla Bean, but it was often out of stock. I opted for to try other flavors to test others and was surprised by how good tasting they all were. I actually enjoy matching my workout moods with the different flavors! Now I will just get this mixed flavors box every time.

column9: The best of the energy gels
column10: Tasty but not too sweet, I have found that the GU packets are the most easy-to-ingest and effective energy replacement tools for endurance sports.  The Vanilla Bean flavour is especially easy to swallow without a lingering aftertaste.  I've used these extensively and never had a problem like I have with other similar brands.Buying by the box is economical, too.

Like most users of GU, I run marathons.  I chose this package because I wanted to find a flavor that I could stomach later in a race and this let me experiment.  This package has eight separate flavors:  orange, vanilla, espresso, berry, lemon-lime, chocolate, banana, and plain.  I won't comment on the taste because that is an individual preference, however, I do prefer GU to Clif Shots, which to me are pastier and harder to get down without a good amount of water.

I purchased the flavor mix pack a few months back.  It wasn't from this link, but I assume this is the same product.  I will agree that it is very frustrating they don't tell you exactly what it is.  This is the review I posted - hope it helps.I just wanted to leave a note of what the composition of the Mixed Flavors pack looked like. I had a hard time finding information on what exactly I'd get. I'm sure they change could change this from time to time, but this is what I had:"Roctane" Gu packets (1 each): Blueberry Pomegranate, Vanilla Orange, Cherry Lime, Pineapple. These are the high endurance packets. The Blueberry Pom and Vanilla Orange are both double caffeine, Cherry Lime is normal caffeine and the Pineapple has no caffeine.Regular Gu Packets had 3 of Chocalate Outrage and Vanilla Bean. The rest had two of each flavor: Strawberry Banana, TriBerry, Expresso Love, Mandarin Orange, Jet Blackberry, Mint Chocolate, Lemon Sublime. The Strawberry Banana, Mint Chocolate, and Lemon Sublime have no caffeine, while Jet Blackberry and Expresso Love are double caffeine - everything else is normal caffeine.If you're looking to shake it up or find a favorite flavor, I think this is a good buy. I don't know that Gu is the best energy gel out there - I actually think everyone just has to find out what they like in taste and texture and what their stomach can handle. I've had good luck with Gu myself and I look forward to trying all the flavors.

GU Energy Gel, Chocolate Outrage - 24 PacketsThis is a good product to use when you are training for a half marathon or a full one, and also during the race itself.  I always take it when I run 10 miles or more.  I carry it in pockets in my fitness shorts or shirt (they are coming out with more fitness clothes with pockets, and it's really convenient).  It makes recovery faster and I find my legs feel a whole lot better if I take it.  I also like that the caffeine in it is not that much.  I can't even tolerate a small cup of coffee, but the amount of caffeine in GU is just enough to give me a little fast energy while running, without giving me a "caffeine rush".  The chocolate outrage tastes pretty good too.  It can be messy too, so be warned and have somewhere to put the empty packets (because you wont want to carry them in your hand).  I wash it down with some fluids and stick the empty packet in the empty bottle.  If the bottle is not empty, I put it in my pocket.

Unlike most of the reviewers for Gu, I am not a marathon runner, or even much of a runner at all. I'm hoping that I will be one day!  I'm lucky if I can make it to 2 miles.  I have issues with my blood sugar getting too low and it really affects me during exercise.  I take GU about 15 minutes before exercise to keep my blood sugar from plummeting during my run.  It is EXTREMELY effective!  I have made more progress with my fitness level since starting to use GU than in the last 2 years of struggling with my blood sugar issues.  I tried several different brands and flavors of "energy supplements" and came to the conclusion that GU is the most effective and tasty version out there.One caveat - I'm not particularly fond of the taste.  I get the Strawberry Banana and Lemon Lime flavors as those are the most palatable ones for me; however even those flavors are somewhat off.  The flavors are not really all that bad, and since the results are so impressive, I've gotten to where I don't really notice anymore.In short, this is a great way to boost your blood sugar before or during a workout.  It is also be useful as a safety measure for hypoglycemics; I keep one in my purse in case my blood sugar suddenly drops off a cliff.

column9: One complaint: opening GU gels are problematic in colder temperatures!
column10: I highly value GU as a supplement, its the only gel I use in running and cycling. However, most of the popular fall marathons, such as NYC, Chicago, Philly, and MCM, are scheduled when temperatures are cooler -- sometimes downright cold! Well, I'm running Philly, which in 2011 is scheduled for November 20th. To train for this marathon, I run at night when temperatures drop. One thing I've noticed on long runs is that when the temperature is 40-45 degrees, and I reach for a GU at mile 13 (about the time I usually do), opening the package is labor-intensive, and ripping it with your teeth isn't the answer when breathing through a challenging point in a course. Try opening a GU gel when running up or down a hill in colder temperatures. Even the top tab (or nipple as I call it) is hard to open. My complaint: THE PACKAGE NEEDS TO BE PREFORATED AND MADE EASIER TO OPEN! I'll say it again, GU needs to make the packaging easier to open for runners and cyclists. It has nothing to do with hand strength. It has nothing to do with sweaty hands. The package should be easier to open. Period. Other than that its a 5-star product in my opinion.

I have tried many gels also.  Gu gel is not my favorite, I actually prefer the consistency of PowerGel, but the variety pack offered by Gu makes me buy more.  PowerGel sells only 1 variety, and you end up with an entire box of the SAME gel.  I like Strawberry-Banana PowerGel and all, but 24 of them is a bit much.  For the most part, Gu gel is good tasting, and I agree that Espresso Love is the best.  The plain is ... well ... plain, but the chocolate and berry are also good.  Like I said, I prefer the consistency of PowerGel better because it is easier to get down when you are running and sucking on a gel packet, a little thicker.  If you haven't tried gels, Gu is a good start, and if you want a runnier gel, this may be the one for you.

Love this gel. I have tried all others, and I do like this the best. It gives me the energy output needed to keep going. The extra caffeine gives me a mental edge. The expresso flavor is great tasting even though I don't like expresso drinks.I tried it for the first time during the 2004 Columbus Marathon when they were handing it out. It helped me finish my first marathon.-unluckyrunner

column9: This probably saved me during the marathon.
column10: In a nutshell:  Energy gel that keeps you going when going gets you tough. Well, until your knees give out or something.What it is:  It's an energy gel formulated for endurance athletes (never mind that not a lot of us who use the products like these will ever win a New York Marathon or something; if you participate, you're an athlete, right?)  I've got the Chocolate Outrage version, which has 32g of mixture containing various carbs, amino acid, and rather marginal amount of caffeine.  The price comes down to roughly $1 per pack, which might be a bit hard to swallow (no pun intended).What it's like:  It's a chocolatey paste that's easy to squeeze out and suck on from the pouch while running.  It recommends you to drink water while eating this; I recommend the same (and try for water instead of sports drink; water works better for washing this down).  I used this for my first (and last?) marathon, at the recommended pace of one pack 15 minutes before the race, and every 45 minutes of activity... it was cut closer to an hour than 45 minutes, as it does take some time to get absorbed to your body.  Thanks to it, I was able to finish the marathon despite my body basically refusing to run the last few miles.  If nothing else, I had the energy to go further, if not the joints.  And that's probably due to my inadequate training; this is no miracle worker in that it lets you do things you normally wouldn't do.  Or maybe it does... it's just that having the energy to do things doesn't translate to having the physical capacity to run ridiculous distances.Does it work?:  I think so.  But it doesn't seem to have replenished any electrolytes... so I guess you should use sports drink with this, after all.In conclusion:  these packs work wonders in keeps you going in the energy department--follow the instruction and I'm sure you won't bonk halfway through.  Don't forget to train, though!

column9: Great burst of energy when you need it
column10: I have tried numerous products before trying Gu and was not happy with them.  I could not find any where I liked the flavor, consistency, or the burst of energy that I needed.  I bought a few Gu packets before a long run one day and really helped during the run.  I thought this was fluke, so I tried Gu for about a month on my long runs.  I found that I consistently do better with Gu than any other product.  While I don't care for the Chocolate flavor (like eating frosting), all the other flavores are very good.

column9: Long expiration, great price for a great product...
column10: Expiration:I'm always concerned about expiration dates when I order sale items in bulk from Amazon.  I ordered in August 2010, they arrived in two days via Prime shipping, and the expiration on them was 09/11.  That's 13 months away from expiration, if you're an endurance athlete that's plenty of time to go through several boxes (and if you're not, don't buy the marketing hype you won't need these gels anyway).Product Review:These are a great product for a great price.  I got the 24 pack for $24.99 with free shipping, making them about $1.04 per pack.  They usually run between $1.50 to $2 a pack at sporting good stores.  Or you can stock up at marathon/tri expos for about $1 a pack.Everyone who uses these carbo gels has their own personal preference, I like the PowerGels best for their lighter texture.  The texture on these are between PowerGels (more watery) and Clifshots (much thicker).  But nothing new on race day...so I highly suggest you go to the store and buy 1 to see if you like the brand or the flavor before committing to a 24 pack.  If you do, then pull the trigger and stock up.  I highly recommend the price, product, and the expiration on them.Best of luck on your next race.
The Gu Energy Gel is a fantastic product. I got it at Amazon at a very good price when it was hard to get it from other stores.

Not only does gu gel give you the energy that you need but the chocolate outrage tastes great!  Sometimes with other energy gels and flavors I cringe when I take it but with this one I actually look forward to it!
I got the gels on time, the box was a little dented, but not a big deal. I got them within the time I was told. Happy customer.
It is good to have it because:1. You can use it while running.2.  Only 100 calories3. Effective in adding energy

column9: Good if you like flavored slime when you run!
column10: My husband loves these when he trains. I cannot stomach anything slimey when I run.  He swears by them. Amazon has a great price on the 24 count compared to buying them individually in the stores. It is one of the better flavors out there so if you like the slime this is the one for you!

I didn't know what to expect when I purchased these Energy Gel packs.  I intended to use one while walking a golf course for 4-5 hours for an added spurt of energy.  I didn't expect to get the shakes from the caffein content though.  Maybe for running a marathon I might suck down one entire pack, but I have scaled back to approx. 1/2 while walking the golf course.  I must say, the chocolate is "extremely" good.  Tastes like chocolate frosting or something equally yummy.  I recommend these for anyone needing a little boost while exercising...in moderation.  I would have preferred knowing the caffein content before I bought them, but through trial and error, I have found the dosage that works best for me.
receieved this product on time and use it all the time, great for tri trainning.
It cost a few pennies but it will give you an energy boost so you can keep on going!  I take one before the run, and one every 45 minute thereafter.
Gu comes with a 12 month expiration period.  They sent me a 24 packet box that expired in one month.  Not the quality of service I expected...
Initially bought a single packet in the store to try the flavor and product. When taking the GU more frequently, much cheaper to buy box than single packets in stores.

I wanted to pick up some Gu for Moutain Bike riding, but I had never tried it before, and wasn't sure what flavors would work well for me. I decided to go for this sample pack, which includes a rather large assortment that includes gels with or without caffeine and damn near every flavor I would have wanted to try. I have yet to find a flavor I truly despise, but some are definitely harder to swallow than others.It would be nice if Gu incorporated the "leash" to keep the tear off tabs from floating away (something cliff innovated on their packs). I thought this was a silly complaint until I started trying to leave the little tear off tab attached when gulping these on the trailside, it's just annoying.Other than the minor complain I love the flavor mixes and love Gu as a product.
Love the product but the "mixed" box isn't so much any more. The first box had 1 or 2 each this last box had 8 flavors and none w/ 2x caffeine.

Uhh.. what kind of review do you want?  GU is yummy.  Its has electrolytes.  It keeps you moving on down the road.  What more do you want?  Should I say which flavors taste better?  Ok, that would be stupid, because, like, um,.. we all have different tastes!  So, go get yourself a mixed sample case, and let your tongue explore a little.  Later.

column9: Tastes good with a caffeine kick
column10: I think taste all boils down to personal preference but I like the Blackberry flavor.  I was getting burned out on the orange flavor and decided to try this. Good taste and the 2X caffeine is a nice boost when the bonk is starting to set in.

column9: Love them for cycling, but wish there was more variety of non-caffeinated GU energy gels.
column10: I have used these for several months in road cycling.  I wish there were more of a variety of non-caffeinated GU energy gels (Lemon Sublime and Strawberry Banana only).
The seller was incredibly quick, and as always, I'm very happy with the GU product!
It's great for long periods of physical exertion like rock climbing or an ultimate frisbee tournament

column9: GU is not Gene Upshaw BUT....
column10: I had absolutely no intention of buying any GU Energy Gel the day I signed on to look up what all the GU emblems stood for on the football helmets and football fields. Well now I know that it was in honor of hall of famer Gene Upshaw who passed away in August. But I also found this stuff, read about it, read the reviews and ordered some. It is GREAT...what an unexpected discovery! It tastes good and it actually DOES give me a burst without drinking a lot of coffee and having to pee! LOVE IT!!
Of all the gels, I like the taste of this one best. Kind of like chocolate frosting. They all get old after awhile, but I find this one reasonably easy going down.

column9: Great buy,  not avaible in the area i live.
column10: I perfer the vinnila Bean.  but after the 6th one on a ride its gets to gag nasty.Great buy

Good stuff to keep you going after you have been active for a while. If you are going to be doing some running or other aerobic activity for a long stretch of times, these packets every hour or so will keep you on your feet.
Great gel to get you energy when you need to work out. Taste better then energy bars.
I thought that the new gu would taste like the old stuff but it has a pungent taste! It works ok, but the taste makes me gag. I'd recommend saving your money and sticking with the original gu.

column9: Tastes just like Betty Crocker frosting
column10: Of all energy gels, the chocolate Gu has to be the best. Chocolate Gu tastes just like cake frosting...mmmmm.  It stands on its own and would be a worthwhile dessert.Drink plenty of water with this one.  I've found that the chocolate flavor requires just a little more water to wash it down...must be the frosting texture.After my first experience with Chocolate Outrage Gu, I experimented with a Ziploc bag full of Betty Crocker frosting.  It had the same effect, but was a bit messy.
I am using Gu Gel regularly while training for a marathon.  It tastes great and is helping to keep me on road for my longer runs.
the product was exactly as described and arrived before I was told.  I'll buy from here again for sure!!!

Bought a box of this and it's certainly cheaper than buying the single packs at your local sports shop.  TriBery is a great taste as the taste is barely there, which is nice when you're doing long runs and need to eat 6 or 7 of them.  My only complaint is why do they have to put caffeine in it?  Hopefully they make a tri-berry without it.  I'd say give it a try.

column9: Needing to know more about the product
column10: I would love to buy in bulk but I need to know what flavors are in a mixed pack; more specifically whether it contains both caffeinated and non-caffeinated.  I have already experimented and found that caffeinated isn't going to work for me, so I don't want to risk buying a 24 pack with a dozen caffeinated gels. I don't see this information in the copy.

I'm one of those people who has a stomach that just doesn't tolerate food while I'm exercising, which makes fueling before a race or just a training day a hassle to say the least. I'm also one of those people who is naturally skeptical of any "energy" product that comes out. I've tried a ton of those as well, mostly out of curiosity, including 5 hour energy. Nothing compares to GU Energy gels or the chewy bites, my stomach has no problem digesting these little wonder packets and the taste isn't bad either. I usually take 2 packets 30 minutes before a workout, or 1 packet of the bites, plus one gel packet if I need an extra pick me up (sometimes you don't have time for a cup of coffee). They work out great either way, as far as running long distance like over 25 miles, I've yet to use them, but some of the other reviewers seem to have experienced good results.
the gu was very good and arrived in not too long of time

column9: It keeps you runnin', yeah it keeps you runnin'...
column10: Why you in such a hurry to be lonely one more night. I know what it means to hide your heart from a long time ago.  Oh darlin', it keeps you runnin', yeah it keeps you runnin'.

column9: Item is fine, seller lacks motivation.
column10: Gu is great energy for endurance athletes and I've used it during many marathons and triathlons.  The caffeine in the chocolate flavor makes it hard to sleep afterword, though.Main problem with this transaction was that the seller kept my money for several weeks before even bothering to fill the order.  Totally unacceptable, and I won't order from them again.
Doesn't seem to work at all, if anything it makes you even more tired than you were to begin with, and it's rather expensive.  Good for recovery though, but not what it was meant for (energy).

The vendor used by Amazon is terrible.  I ordered a 24-case of GU over a month ago, and have not received my order.  I wasn't told that the product was backordered until after I made my purchase, and the vendor gave me three consequective back order dates.  Due to this major inconvenience I have canceled the order.  Don't order GU through Amazon.

column9: Full inventory of Flavor Mix Box
column10: No Caffeine:1-Pineapple, 2-Lemon Sublime,  2-Mint Chocolate, 2-Strawberry BannanaWith Caffeine:3-Vanilla Bean, 2-Tri-Berry, 2-Manderine Orange, 2-Chocolate Outrage2X Caffeine: 2-Jet Blackberry, 2-Expresso Love, 1-Chocolate Raspberry Roctane,1-Vanilla Orange Roctane, 1-Blueberry Pomegranate Roctane, 1-Cherry Lime RoctaneI just got this pack through a different route but figured I post what was contained in more detail.  I've only tried one, the Mint Chocolate which was pretty good after a twelve mile run.  Although after a while I tasted it again and it had an odd aftertaste but I'm not really picky.  I'll give it four stars for now until I get through the pack.  Otherwise the selection of gels it very good.I also took a picture and will upload it if I can after this.

Ok, I am not a banana type of guy even though I know a banana is good on a long bike ride, but I can't stomach them. About 60 miles into the ride, I start to drag  and start wishing the ride was over.  Solid energy bars or even fig bars once again don't settle well with me an I experience zero positive effect.  I was skeptical  of gel but became a believer after  a friend gave me one about 60 miles into the ride.  This is the first energy 'fix' that I can say I noticed an immediate response.  I was enjoying the rest of the ride and riding strong . It then dawned on me that I was not wishing the ride to end!  The gel is easy on my stomach (as long as I drink plenty of water) and  is quickly assimilated.  The result is exactly what I would have wish for.  I recommend the Lemon lime because it's not heavy on the caffeine.  One more thing, much easier to carry than a banana.

Running longer distance races (half-marathon, full marathon, triathalons, ...) you need to stay energized.  Eating and exercising just don't mix well but if you don't eat something then you will "hit the wall" before completing your event.  Gu is a great way to go.  Packed with about 100 calories per packet they are easy to swallow, digest and they come in a wide variety of flavors that hopefully you will be able to find one that is palatable.  I prefer the Tri-berry myself and these I was able to pick up for about $1/packet including shipping.  Much better price than I can find at my local sporting goods store (when they even have them in stock!)

The Chocolate Outrage is my favorite -tastes just like chocolate frosting!  (I can't stomach most energy goos/bars)I ride (cycle) often and do a long 40-mile ride twice a month. I can notice a surge in energy and stamina a few minutes after savoring the chocolate gu (love it!) and my muscles have never had a serious hangover (I also drink Cyto-max on those long rides).I am a novice cyclist (My husband's the pro, and loves the Tri-berry flavor), and this stuff has helped me get through (and look forward to) some very tough rides.

Gu gels provide a quick energy kick, are small enough to easily carry, particularly on long bike rides. Once you get used to the texture, they go down quickly; I particularly like the strawberry-banana flavor.

column9: Decent but needs an extra description
column10: Gu is one of the best energy packs. It's tasty and it's well-designed for quick consumption (I find it less messy that Powerbar gels). This box of Gu is a great deal, how it would really help if it was mentioned in the description that over half of the packets are caffienated. I'm sure a lot of people would love the kick, but some people (like me) need to avoid caffiene due to preference or health conditions.

column9: Tasty energy for people on the run!
column10: This year I used Gu Energy Gel as an aid for long training runs in preparation for a marathon and also during the marathon.  Every six or seven miles I'd ingest a pack along with some water and I noticed that I didn't seem to hit the proverbial wall as I had in previous marathons.  I wasn't the only runner using Gu as empty packs were strewn throughout the course.  The race organizers had an official Gu station at the fifteen mile mark.  As others have previously mentioned, the chocolate flavor Gu does taste like frosting and did indeed hit the spot.

Just ran my first marathon in October and these were a godsend. Could definately feel the caffeine, electolytes, and carbs. Took them when I first felt fatigued, every 45 minutes to an hour, they kicked in just before I felt like I would collapse. Best boost ever. Use them on long runs, long bike rides, or when I workout and didn't eat much that day.

column9: Truly is sublime - the best flavor available
column10: Taking down the GU Energy Gels comes down to two things: taste and texture.  In regards to tast, the Lemon Sublime is outstanding, in my opinion, and better than all others.  It's a familiar lemon lime flavor that will remind you of koolaid or gatorade.  A perfect sour blend.  As for texture, if you're a big fan of sinus infections, then you'll love the thick mucus texture of GU Energy Gels (just joking).  It's not really THAT bad, but it does take some mental toughness and a bit of conditioning.  I recommend putting it into the fridge about 5 minutes before taking it so it stiffens ever so slightly.  Otherwise you'll be running along and realize there is some GU still in between some teeth from the previous package several minutes ago.Some may wonder if there is an impact, an actual, tangible benefit from Gel intake.  To that I can unequivocally answer in the affirmative.  Depending on whether or not you burn fat or carbs while doing extended exercise, you may need to inhale one of these - with water as directed - more frequently than the directions indicate.  What seems to work best for me is 15-minutes prior to the run, and then every 35-40 minutes during the run.  So, just a little bit earlier than the normal schedule.The one significant downside to this product is the mess.  For long runs it's necessary to bring multiple GU packets.  Since getting out every last molecule is sometimes difficult while running, there's often a slimy surprise when reaching for the next packet.  And that mess is there when the run is completed as well.Overall, great product.

Taking down the GU Energy Gels comes down to two things: taste and texture.  In regards to tast, the Vanilla Orange is better, in my opinion, than all but the Lemon-Lime and Jet Blackberry.  What that means is it's actually somewhat pleasant tasting.  Kind of mellow, with a hint of creamsicle.  I'd say the vanilla overpowers the orange somewhat.  As for texture, if you're a big fan of sinus infections, then you'll love the thick mucus texture of GU Energy Gels.  It's not really THAT bad (I'm just joking), but it does take some mental toughness and a bit of conditioning.  I recommend putting it into the fridge about 5 minutes before taking it so it stiffens ever so slightly.  Otherwise you'll be running along and realize there is some GU still in between some teeth from the previous package several minutes ago.Some may wonder if there is an impact, an actual, tangible benefit from Gel intake.  To that I can unequivocally answer in the affirmative.  Depending on whether or not you burn fat or carbs while doing extended exercise, you may need to inhale one of these - with water as directed - more frequently than the directions indicate.  What seems to work best for me is 15-minutes prior to the run, and then every 35-40 minutes during the run.  So, just a little bit earlier than the normal schedule.The one significant downside to this product is the mess.  For long runs it's necessary to bring multiple GU packets.  Since getting out every last molecule is sometimes difficult while running, there's often a slimy surprise when reaching for the next packet.  And that mess is there when the run is completed as well.Overall, great product.  Mandatory for endurance.

Started using Gu Energy Gels after a long hot day hike left me totally spent.  Not that these replace those valuable electrolytes, but the Gu gels will give you that boost for the last few hills.  These are convenient and store easily in a daypack or pocket.  Good price as these run about $1 more each in retail stores.  The gel is easy to get out while on the move and the taste is good-tolerable.  Only downside is that if you don't get all the gel out, it is a bit sticky on your hands.

This product is fantastic.  I rode 150 miles this past Saturday, downing a Roctane every 45 minutes.  I really felt a boost, and I'm confident it helped me avoid "bonking."  I will definitely turn to Roctane for all ultra-endurance activities.

My husband and son are both distance runners and compete in marathons and halfs.  They've been buying the GU gels at various running or cycling stores; but the convenience and value by getting them through Amazon Prime can't be beat...and they arrive at door in 2 days.  They generally prefer the fruit flavors for long training runs.  While my husband is a huge fan of peanut butter usually, he says that is not the taste he wants in his mouth when he's hot and tired.  At his last marathon in Quebec, other runners mentioned stringing a large safety pin through the tops of a few GU packs and then pinning onto the waistband of running shorts.  Then you can just tear off each GU as you need it.  My husband hasn't tried it yet.  When he's doing long training runs (16-22 mi), he generally wears a small hydration belt that has a pocket for the gels.  And gels were handed out at close intervals during the race.  With the safety pin idea, I'm not sure what you'd do with the used up pack.  Okay to toss on ground at races where there will be clean-up; but on training runs not too cool.

A few months ago I originally purchased the strawberry banana flavor. I personally though the taste was awful and the texture was so thick it was disgusting. I couldn't even swallow it straight out of the package, I had to chew on it and swish it around my mouth with water and then force it down my throat. I let one of my friends try it and we had to stop the workout because the taste made him sick. However, the Vanilla flavor does NOT have any of those problems. The flavor is great and you can really taste the vanilla flavor. One of my friends thought it was a little on the sweet side but I love it. It is also a lot thinner, I can easily stick it in my mouth and gulp it down without wasting any time. Gu is good stuff, I can feel the difference on longer rides and it definitely helps me maintain my level of performance.

The 24 pack GU Gels are a great value considering how much you pay for each one individually.  You do give up the variety of buying one at a time, but since the vanilla bean is so delicious it is certainly not that much of a sacrifice.  GU Gels taste the least medicinal and are easy to keep down during the long runs.  Just make sure to have plenty of water to swallow them.

column9: My favorite energy gel for running
column10: After trying lots of brands and flavors, I finally settled on GU energy gel vanilla bean flavor. I find that this gel not only helps me to revive during my run, but I also like the taste and can handle without water if necessary. I use it during my half marathon training runs that are 7 miles or more and for the race itself. Great product. It's the only one I buy anymore.

I am a noob runner.  Just ran my first half marathon this past weekend.  I only used GU toward the end of my training during longer runs.  I noticed a big difference when I would use one GU during a 8+ mile run.  Had more energy!  Great stuff!  BUT BE CAREFUL with the GU with caffeine x2. (I love the flavor of the espresso love.  Kind of a caramel/coffee flavor.) I took three GUs during my 1/2.  One before -- 2 during. I had never taken that many before.  But according to the box the GU comes in, you are supposed to take more than usual for a race. I really should have tested this prior to my race! I was fine until mile 8 -- felt super.  Then -- POW!  Stomach PAIN!!  I had to slow way down.  I'm almost positive it was the caffeine.  I don't think of myself as someone with a sensitive stomach - but I was in pain ALL DAY after the race.  Even today (the day after) my tummy is tender.  So my suggestion -- BUY GU!  It's great stuff.  But play around with the different caffeine levels.  AND DON'T TRY SOMETHING NEW ON RACE DAY!!!!
oh my. why did gu take so long? now if there were only chocolate & peanut butter combined. i love love love peanut butter and this is so yummy it's going to be hard to make my stash last.

I'm using this product mostly on long distance running workouts or races (25k+). During some Marathons I consumed 6-7 sachets of these & never had a problem on my stomac. They really help me going on. Just one reminder: Do not buy in big amounts, because the expiry date may be too close to consume all of them until that date.
I like several flavors of GU Energy Gel, but Chocolate Outrage is the only one my wife uses when she runs.  Tastes a little like chocolate icing and has that consistency when it is colder outside.

I have taken this gel during (2)13's, 15, 16,18 and a 20 miler training for a Marathon. The Lemon Sublime flavor is great and I take one 15 minutes before my runs and every 45 minutes during. You can use water, Gatorade or Powerade after taking them to wash them down. I also recommend drinking 2 or 3 16 oz of Ultra Fuel by Twin Labs for 2 to 3 days prior to long runs. This will top off your carb stores according to Tom Holland in his book Marathon Method. I believe in it and it kicks in around 13 miles !!!

Both the chocolate  and expresso flavors are excellent, easy to digest, gives your system the shot it needs during prolonged activity.  Use the GU during long bike rides.  No caffeine jitters, just a smooth lift in energy.

I'm training for half marathon and I usually use couple GU shot's per 12m runs... One at 5m and the other at 9m. It really boost your energy during the long runs, I can feel the sugar and carbs go through your lungs and boost the energy! I haven't tried any other gels but I'll stick to GU. The reason I bought GU mixed is to decide which is the best suit for me and I choose Chocolate :)
GU is the BEST product out there for long-distance running.  I feel like I can go twice as far whenever I use GU.  As always, chocolate is the best flavor!

I love the flavor and consistency, but the lack of sodium makes them unusable for me during warmer weather since I cannot handle salty drinks. Not everyone needs a lot of salt, but if you do, these are not the best gels for you.
Awesome GU, the orange is by far the Best. I use this before runs and sometimes as a snack in between classes. Super fast shipping on this item!

Most of the flavors taste pretty good, definitely not gag worthy.  And they actually work!  Gives the little boost of energy you need when trying to exercise, run, whatever, and gives that boost without the jitters usually associated with caffeine products.  A great alternative.
A slightly bitter aftertaste does not make these one of the better (easier to consume) gu flavors, but I attribute it to the caffeine which frankly is well worth it on long runs.

column9: Great Gu for a great price
column10: This was one of the best prices I could find for Gu.  I'm a long distance runner, so this stuff is a staple in my diet.  I ran a marathon last weekend and plowed through 5 in one day...  you have to shop around when you consume this much.The Vanilla flavor is my favorite.  The fruity ones are just a little too fake for my liking.

It tastes like chocolate frosting and it gives you a boost of caffeine on top of the needed sugar when running/biking long distance.  Essential to my marathon training!  Packets are easy to open on the go and buying them in bulk is convenient since I use several on a weekend.  Good stuff!

I have been using the lemon-lime for a while and thought I would change things up with the chocolate.  The flavor is surprisingly good.  Gels are personal (thicker versus thinner and all that), but if you like GU, this one is good.  I have only used this as a recovery gel, so far, since I do wonder what it would be like to burp up the chocolate flavor during a run (the lemon-lime is very subtle, so that is what I use pre-run and during runs).

Great product and very well packaged. My husband and I use these for fuel on long runs and they work out perfectly. Easy to carry in pockets/hydration packs and no stomach issues related to the product. Fast carbs are important to us as my husband is diabetic and has a lot of concerns when marathon training. We have tried the chocolate (Hubby is a fan, I'm not a big chocolate person... I think it's the texture combined with the flavor that bugs me), tri-berry (two thumbs up) and strawberry banana (this is the one we keep ordering).
Good product. Helped me get thru century ride. Fair price compared to local vendor.  Great tasting also.  Small packets fit in shirt and easily opened while riding.

This was the best price I found for the gu packets.  And strawberry-banana is my fave flavor :)  It's a great way to energize before a workout and even, especially with biking.  Sometimes I eat it as a quick snack if I have nothing else on hand.

great product that really gives you that pick me up without a horrible headache or crash afterwards.  I use them when I work out or just when I need a little help staying awake through class!  Also amazon has the best price on gu in bulk, I will definitely order again!

I use these for biking. Very easy to carry in jersey pockets and the packaging is easy to open and eat while riding. I have tried most of the flavors and this one is great tasting.  I like the quick access to calories while riding. I have used them on hikes too. Highly recommend.

Though this gel is functional and I use it on long runs (6-11 miles), I can't say I'm fond of it.  I find that more often than not I get stomach cramps in the hours following my run.  I had been warned that this was possible, but was told that if I take it with water, it's not a problem.  I stay hydrated on my runs and always take GU with plenty of water, but have found it makes no difference in the way I feel post-run.  (During the run, I feel great, so I trade one evil for another).

I normally run 7-10 miles, 3-4 times during week days, and 12-20 miles on Sat or Sun. Whenever I start to feel a little bit down during the run, GU gives me real energy. I always feel in the end that I can run some more.This mixed case is really good, because I get to try different flavors. While putting one in my pocket I don't see the flavor, so it is always a pleasant surprise as to what I am going to get during the run.I have tried other industry products also and liked them as well, but GU works out best for me. Try one and I am sure you won't be disappointed.
This is my favorite flavor of Gu.Come's in the box shown.  Is not caffeinated beyond whats in the chocolate.

I always used to think that all these energy products were a scam and they would give no energy while riding. But then one day I purchase a pack of GU espresso love from a local shop. I used the Gu 40 miles into a 70 mile ride. it was a hot day and I was feeling very tired. I took out the pack of gu opened it up and took a gulp. The consistency is kinda weird,but not bad. And what really surprised me was the taste. It tasted very nice and I actually liked it. After 10 minutes I was feeling much better and I felt more energetic. The gu helped me a lot and I easily made it to the end of the ride feeling fine. I have tried Hammer Gel espresso but it was a little too thick, but it did have a more "natural" taste. But I am sticking with this stuff, it really works.Only CON: You have to open the packet which might be a problem if you can't no hand or ride with one hand on a bike. Not a problem for me, but might be for some.
This was for my brother who does triathlon and he said it is a great energy booster. He said the flavor is not bad at all.

I am in love with Gu! So far I can only stomach the chocolate flavor, but I'm fine with that. It's like the only chocolate I ever "eat". I have gotten into running the past year and while I'm not fast, I love that I get a boost from the gu to finish strong. I don't like the chews (like clif shot) because they are too big for my mouth, so this is perfect for me!

I've never needed to use these for energy as I never feel drained. But my brother recommended them, saying he takes one before and every half hour of his runs. I still haven't noticed a difference but when I start running over 14miles maybe I'll need it.

Listen, I have tried several of these gels and chews and the Gu Vanilla Bean is the best tasting.  It tastes like vanilla frosting.  This stuff works well and tastes well.  Seriously, I would get this flavor over many others.

Gu seems to do a better job on the flavors than some of the other energy gels, and we love the Gu Vanilla!  Our boys love them for biking - it really keeps them going on longer rides, and of course they are great for racing because they go down so quickly.  The Vanilla (and all the flavors except banana) do have some caffeine from cola nut - the caffeine is 20 mg/packet (about 1/2 serving of Coca Cola), so take that into account if you are avoiding caffeine or don't want the youngsters to have it.
The only gel I will ever use, this gel has gotten me through marathon to ultra with great taste and sustained energy, Awesome STUFF!!!!

Athletes are very choosy when it comes to the foods that they eat. Their dietary regimen requires strict compliance to well balanced set of vitamins and minerals. Yet, they need sufficient energy to help them with their daily work-outs.Marathon runners are one of the athletes who require long lasting energy boosters. Energy bars are the popular choice for some because they can easily chew on it while taking their routine runs but I was fortunate to stumble on GU Energy Gel. Since then I made it possible to carry a bottle of it inside my gym bag because it provides instant release of energy boosting properties without any gluten contents.I am one of the many victims of gluten allergy. It is very inconvenient on my part since I have to stay away from products which have the slightest content of gluten in it if I don't want to be rushed to the hospital. I am also an occasional marathon runner (although I really want to become a professional runner but thanks to my chronic fatigue syndrome, it seems this will forever be my coveted dream.) I use Gene Eden Vir 101 to help suppress latent viral infection in my body. I am grateful to its manufacturers because it eases me of my CFS problems while giving long lasting energy to my body so I can cope with the daily challenges in my profession.GU Energy Gel does not only help me during marathon runs but even in my long hours office work as a paralegal. I store a bottle in my drawer in case I need a fast relief from sleepiness and the regulated caffeine content in it is enough to keep me awake. I know that my physician will not agree with my lifestyle but what can I do, am both a sport enthusiast and a responsible professional. I need to solutions that can keep me going! I have found the perfect combination: Gene Eden Vir 101 against latent chronic viral infection and long lasting energy plus GU energy level for immediate release of carbohydrate blend for my needs.

I've tried several brands of sports gels, and these are my favorite.  Easy to open and digest, even while riding. (although it does get sticky if you're not careful).  My recommended flavors are Vanilla Bean, Espresso Love, and Lime.

I think that the roctane Gu is thinner than the regular Gu.  It goes down easier.  The flavor isn't so bad.  I think it has a bit of tartness - not to sweet. I have has some of my best timeswhen I use roctane.  My husband used only roctane during the Boston marathon and rocked.  We both felt great and didn't notice a drop like other caffeinated energy gels.  We both give it athumbs up.  Definitely give this a try.

column9: The only flavor that doesn't irritate my stomach
column10: Amazon offers great pricing on GU gels for runners.  I bought in bulk because I discovered that Chocolate is the only flavor that doesn't give me cramps or irritate my stomach.

I trained for a marathon last year and used Gu Gel for parts of my training.  The label says "15 before and every 45".  I like to work out when I get home from work and if I'm already feeling hungry and a bit low on energy I'll take one before a workout and it helps me make it through.  On workouts longer than 45 minutes to an hour I take one along the way and again it helps on the tail end of the workout.  Where aerobically I might be fine but my legs just feel tired and sluggish Gu helps to alleviate the issue.  While I wouldn't eat Gu Gel for dinner, the Tri Berry is a decent enough flavor to enjoy during a workout.

column9: GU definitely helps with long runs
column10: I'm a recreational runner who has completed 3 half marathons in the last year. Not until the most recent one did I discover energy gels. I love the chocolate GU because it tastes like dessert!!! Be sure to drink a lot of water, though before your long run. I know these upset some people's stomachs but they don't bother mine at all - I'm going to be running a marathon in a few months and plan to use these the whole way through.

I haven't tried too many of the other gel products on the market, so this review may not have much context. However, the Gu gels have been great for my needs. I first tried the sampler pack, with a variety of gel flavors, and settled on the Espresso Love flavor. I'm currently training for the Chicago Marathon, and I've had Gu with me since my first "long" run of 6 miles. I recently finished a 20 mile run with 4 gels in my fuel belt, and I'll say that these things are a necessity for any run over an hour. The espresso flavor is pretty tasty and has a bit of a savory flavor. Recommended if you are a runner logging long miles.

My husband was hiking on the A.T. at the end of June. (73 years old) He overheated and his body gave out near Roan Mt. A man came by and gave him both Gu and Shot Bloc and he soon recoverd his energy, his ability to think, etc. and was able to reach the highway and call for some help. He will never hike without these items again.

Ihad a chance to try almost all the energy gels, since a freinf of mine brought me every kind of gel as a gift pack. GU was my choice after this trial, due it's taste and boost. I' use them on long runs, longer than 20km. Every 45 mintues to 1 hour period is good to take a new one. '"Just Plain" taste is my favorite, since  don't like the flavours after a while. GU makes the best tasting gels, but after taking 3-4 packs, the taste disturbes me. So I decided to go on with plain test. Easy to carry on a fuel belt, easy to open and good to eat&drink. The only problem I have with GU is to import them over amazon to Turkey where I live. I solved this problem via a cargo forwarding system. I recommend this item to every runner and endurance athlet.

I am impressed with gu lemon sublime.  Tastes great, good consistency compared to others I've tried.  I am a beginner triathalete and I notice the boost especially on the bike climbs...Good product and I'll order again.
Being a type 1 diabetic - this is PERFECT for quickly raising blood glucose levels.  It is sooo much better than glucose tabs.  It is easy to stash and tastes great.

column9: perfect energy for a morning workout before breakfast
column10: I prefer to workout first thing in the morning. I can't eat anything before I do, or I feel nauseous. Gu is the perfect solution to this. I'm able to do some mild exercises and 30 min of cardio without any dip in energy.
Surprisingly tasty - more like capuccino without the foam! With a double-dose of caffeine, it does the trick extra quick.

This product will give you the boost you need for completing those long workouts (without the stomach pain associated with working out on a full stomach). You do need to find the right flavor for you as there are several. If you don't like one just find another. If you are getting this product for the first time then you need to go with the sampler box.

My husband requested some energy gels so we bought these and he has been extremely pleased.  He runs triathlons and these seem to be just what he needs to finish the race.  He said that the flavors were really good, especially likes the orange flavor.
this gu is great. It's not to fruity and sweet, just bland enough to go down easy. Did not upset my stomach.
I love GU - for training and racing.  This is a must have for my runs over 1hr.  This stuff tastes so good it gives you a little extra motivation when running the long runs!

I used GU Gel for my last marathon.  Eat one about every 4 miles and I strongly believe that it helped keep me on pace and enabled me to recover much more quickly than in previous marathons that I have run.

This stuff works great. The flavor is OK. Someone said to mix it with water and drink as you run or bike, but it just prolongs having that taste in your mouth. I just swallow it in two gulps. It goes down easy and I can tell it gives my muscles added strength and energy for competing in olympic triathlons. I chose this flavor because it doesn't have caffeine.
Easily carried, these energy packets provide excellent quick charges for those long bike rides. I particularly like the strawberry/banana flavor, but there are several flavors to chose from.
I sometimes use this when I have noon workouts and didn't have time to get something to eat prior. Seems to do the job.
Another reviewer said this tastes like chocolate frosting, which is EXACTLY what I thought when I tasted it.  It's delicious.

Energy gels are kind of the unloved stepchild of the marathon world. You deal with them because you have to; they're sort of a necessary evil. But you sure don't look forward to choking them down! I have tried every sports gel I could get my hands on, searching for something that didn't feel like I was horking down some kind of disgusting fruit sludge.I ordered this flavor online because it's impossible to find in stores. Someone described the flavor as tasting like chocolate frosting, and that is exactly what it tastes like. After 15 miles on the road with another 11.2 left to run, a little chocolate frosting is quite a pick-me-up. Add in all the energy-enhancing ingredients, and it's the perfect energy gel. I cannot stress enough how wonderful the flavor is, or how well it works as a nutrient and energy boost. Treat yourself. Thank me later.

I have tried all of the different types of gels; Powerbar, Clif Shots, Hammer Gels, etc.  I always come back to Gu as my favorite and this last purchase was especially important as I was preparing for an Ironman 70.3 triathlon.  I used both the Strawberry Banana and the TriBerry (w/ caffeine) and used 9 for the race.  Yes that is right 9!  I have to say most people compain about the taste after awhile, but I did not mind at all.  I took them when I needed a pick me up (1 before the race - 1.2 miles, 5 on the bike - 56 miles, and 3 on the run - 13.1 miles.)  They worked great especially on the run.  When using Gu's for a race of this distance, always use two different flavors and one with caffeine and one without and alternate the flavors.  It worked for me.
Espresso Love is some flavorful Gu...this has to be the best flavored energy gel yet.  GU has really improved the flavor of its energy gels in recent years.Also try Chocolate Outrage.

column9: GU Energy Gel - Great for sports atheletes
column10: I was introduced to this product by an AYSO referee when my daughter collapsed on the field during a game.  He gave her the GU and within 5 minutes, she was back to being able to perform on the field.  We have been using it ever since.

I read about GU as a sport supplement (like Gatorade) but I immediately thought about my diabetic husband who has trouble with his blood sugar dropping too low when he exercises.  We got it for him to try out and it is wonderful.  There is nothing else he's found to bring him back as quickly from a sugar low.  He now carries one in his pocket when we head out for our 6 mile walk.  He also keeps one in each of the cars and his briefcase.  There is no comparison between those glucose tablets they sell for diabetics and GU.  GU gets him feeling better within 15 minutes- he swears the glucose tabs don't work for him at all.  And it comes in an amazing array of flavors.GU is great! If you or someone you love is a diabetic who is plagued with going low- I highly recommend you try it out.

Although I haven't ordered this product through Amazon, Vanilla Bean is my favorite flavor of the Gu Gels. I've tried several other Gu flavors, and I like this one the best. To me, it's the most refreshing during or after a long run. It's light and has enough flavor without being overbearing or heavy tasting.I like the GU Gels in general because they have less sodium than other sports/endurance foods I've seen on the market, and while some extra sodium is good during long runs and other distance endeavors, I am watching my sodium for health reasons, so GU gels are a good compromise for me.

column9: GU Rocks, but something else rocks more
column10: I've been using GU for a long time, 10 years or more, and I think it's a wonderful product.  However, I have noticed that when I'm consuming multiple ones during a race and such, they start to taste sweet, which I don't like at all;  the last thing I want when I'm 20 miles into a run is something sweet.  I thought all gels were pretty much the same, but alas, I now know that that's not true.I have recently discovered another product, gel from Hammer Nutrition.  Their flavors are superior (to me anyway), and they're not overwhelmingly loaded with sugar.  Also, after you take one you're not scrambling for the water bottle since they don't leave a syrup consistency in your mouth.  If you're only going to use 1 gel, then GU can fit the bill, but if you're going to consume multiple ones, you might want to look at the gel from Hammer Nutrition.Oh, about the carbs and sugar content.  There are more simple carbs in the GU gels, which means that it brings you up and down much faster.  Hammer gels have a great deal more complex carbs in them (and they're natural), so you don't spike up and drop down fast, meaning that you give your body a consistent supply of energy without the spikes.  This has been a nice change in my training.FYI, the flavors of GU I like are the Mint Chocolate and Vanilla.  For Hammer gels, I like the Huckleberry, Raspberry, and Apple Cinnamon.
LOVE Gu and love GU roctane.  Price is right and shipment was super fast.  So easy to buy on Amazon THanks!

column9: Runner who loves choclate can't get enough
column10: Training for my first marathon, GU changes my life during runs of over an hour.I believe they named it "Chocolate Outrage" because it tastes incredible, like chocolate frosting.[..]
Bought to use for marathon training and the race, this is a good flavor that does the trick re energizing

This stuff is scienfically proven to keep you kicking it for hours. Drink water and GU every 45-60 minutes and you will move better than ever. When you bonk-then it is time for a protein/energy bar or something like oil to keep you going.Guuuuu is GUUUUUUD  Stuff!!!

I really like gu energy gel because it helps me run long distances.  It tastes better than any other energy gel I have tried.P.S.However, I didn't like the fact that you charged me twice for shipping and handling because I thought it was going to be all on one ticket and I will never purchase from your company again.

It was my favorite tea until the damned peppermint was added. Now it's a completely different tea! This new tea is not satisfying at all unless of course you want to feel like you're brushing your teeth instead of drinking tea.Celestial Seasonings really shouldn't claim this to be the same tea because it really isn't. That's too bad considering it got the company started and all. I just wish there was a way to get the tea without the peppermint but it'll probably never happen.

column9: this is not the old Celestial Seasonings Red Zinger!
column10: I was so excited to find my old favorite tea on amazon. I have been looking for it in supermarkets for months, but thought it had been discontinued. However I wish I had listened to the earlier review. This is not the same formula as it was, the peppermint overpowers all the other flavors in this tea. It used to have a citrusy flavor, tangy and lovely, now all you can smell or taste is peppermint and I don't like peppermint tea.
