column9: Bold robust flavor. Refreshing for all occasions, great for colds and weight loss!
column10: Red Zinger is the tea that made Celestial Seasonings famous.  This was the must-have tea in the seventies.  Every well stocked hippie cupboard had to have this tea next to the brown rice and soy sauce.The ingredients are healthy and tasty, and blend into a tasty ruby potion that smells lemon-mint tart. Red Zinger is especially good for colds--the ingredients strengthen the immune system and the tea is soothing to the throat. It is also great for a diet tea--the bold flavor helps with cravings and the diuretic ingredients prevent and ameliorate water retention. And aside from its benefits it is just a delicious tea! The flavor is sour-cherry with a hint of mint and flavorful hot or cold.Hibiscus is the first ingredient.  First consumed by the ancient Egyptians, Hibiscus tea has diuretic qualities, can lower blood pressure, and has minerals and flavonoids.  The second ingredient, rose hips, are very high in vitamin C and are used in herbal medicine to prevent urinary tract infections.  Other ingredients include peppermint, lemon grass, orange peel, lemon myrtle, licorice and wild cherry bark.Celestial Seasonings gets extra points for their packaging: they utilize 100% natural recycled paperboard in their boxes and they don't package each tea bag individually. Instead they use a system of a waxed paper bag inside the box that stays shut when you fold it. It keeps the bags fresh and utilizes less packaging than individually wrapping each bag. The art they use on each box is beautiful as are the quotes and information they put on every surface.Quote from the box:"Passion colors all that it touches in its own hues."  Baltasar Gracian.

column9: Red Zinger Tea.....the BEST of Celestial Seasoning Teas
column10: My husband and I have been drinking this tea for over twenty years and of all of the Celestial Seasoning Teas it is our favorite tea, the mellow sweetness, the blend of hibiscus and other flavors make it a great ice tea mix too. I can't figure out why all of the markets we frequently visit have stopped carrying this particular tea (RED ZINGER).

column9: Perfect when you have a cold
column10: This is a classic Celestial Seasonings tea which is a staple in my pantry.  It can be overly acidic to some, but when I have a cold there's nothing like it.  Here's my special toddy recipe:Red Zinger steeped for 4 minutes1 generous tsp honeyjuice of 1/2 lemonjigger of dark rumThis will cure what ails ya! Truly, the Red Zinger and lemon clear the mucous, the honey soothes the throat, and the rum quiets the cough.

column9: It's a zinger and a half!
column10: So far, I have thoroughly enjoyed all of the teas in the "zinger" series. I like Celestial Seasonings in general. Of course, the tea bags have no strings and that is something of an annoyance, but other than that, the teas are tasty and enjoyable. Zinger really is a great description of the product. It has a surprising and deeply flavorful taste and an aroma to match. The lemon has a fresh, rich lemon flavor. The raspberry embodies the flavor of raspberry as well. The Red Zinger, however, is the best of them all.  I have yet to find a better tea in the series.  I would give it 4.5, but Amazon only allows integers.  There are some teas that I have tasted that are better, but only rarely.  It is a great option for those who enjoy herbal teas.

column9: Red Zinger Herb Tea:  The Perfect Pick-Me-Up
column10: A really refreshing beverage - perhaps the best discovery since lemonade!  Red Zinger is deep red in color, and has a delicious flavor all its own. Hibiscus flowers give it a smooth taste, enhanced with overtones of peppermint, lemon, orange and cherry. It's a bit reminiscent of fruit punch, only not as sweet and much more satisfying.  We began using it as a substitute for black tea, because we were trying to cut out caffeine and didn't like the constant battle with brown stains on our teeth.  Red Zinger turned out to be the perfect answer.Our family enjoys this tea iced and sweetened with turbinado sugar.  It's a favorite with my kids and a staple in our household.  I believe it helps keep us healthier, too...we've had fewer winter colds since we've been drinking it on a regular basis. It contains rosehips and wild cherry bark, both of which are known for their immune-system boosting benefits. Suggested use:  Brew 6 tea bags per half gallon of tea, or 3 per quart, and sweeten to taste.

For some reason, it is very hard to find Red Zinger at local stores. Celestial Seasonings seems to be introducing new "Zingers" and forgot about the one that started it all.Nice tasty tea and buying it on Amazon was a joy with free, quick shipping.

We used to drink this all of the time - for years - then it disappeared.  When I found a box I was thrilled!  Until I brewed it...Celestial Seasonings changed the recipe and added peppermint!  Seriously?!?!  So instead of that lovely bright flavor we remember so fondly you get something that tastes like liquid chewing gum - yuck.  Our family is not fond of mint teas.  Guess we are back to SV Teas until CS (HOPEFULLY) change it back.

column9: Mint and lemon overpower everything else
column10: The mint and lemon flavors are the only ones you feel and together with the others create a weird taste.I typically can eat or drink anything irrespective of how good it tastes, but I just cannot drink this warm !I tried to make iced tea with this which is bearable, because you don't feel the taste.

Celestial Seasonings Herb Tea, Red Zinger, Tea Bags, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)I have a subscription delivery for this Tea and it works beautifully.  I never run out of the Tea and get the best price.

I live in a very rural area and there are no stores within 40 miles that carry Red Zinger tea.  They did when I moved into my home but I found Amazon.com is very easy to use to get those things that country stores don't carry.

column9: Might eliminate need for prescription drugs
column10: Have not tried RED ZINGER TEA yet.  Just bought some today after reading in a health magazine that the Hibiscus component of this tea is rich in anthocyanins which can dilate blood vessels and block the enzyme which triggers hypertension in the same manner that ACE inhibitors work in common prescription drugs without their side effects.  The claim in the magazine article is that RED ZINGER can lower blood pressure up to 11%. after drinking it for about two weeks.One can also get these benefits of the HIBISCUS flower as a snack eating sweet dried flowers available in health food stores.

column9: Fascinating and Delicious!!! I'm glad I decided to try it.
column10: I found this at a local health store, much to my surprise, so I bought it, but I didn't know what to really expect from trying it. The first time I got the chance to try it, I was amazed at the flavor. I think the added peppermint was a good idea. It's not a strong peppermint flavor, but you can definitely tell it's there. I'm glad I decided on trying this, and I think I'll be getting more, once I'm done with the first box. I'm still relatively new to Celestial Seasonings tea, but I have to say after trying the Lemon Zinger, Wild Berry Zinger, Red Zinger, Mint Magic, Acai Mango Zinger, Perfectly Pear White Tea, China Pearl, and loving them all, I think I'll stick to drinking their tea, and their tea ONLY. No more Lipton tea for me!!!

column9: Lose the mint, keep the hibiscus
column10: This is, by far, my favorite tea, and the only one I always drink without any flavorings.  When I found its ingredients promote lower blood pressure, I decided to restore it to my daily regimen.  Local stores, however, were either overpriced, or out of stock.  Amazon's product comes at a lower than local price, and, of course, with the Amazon rep for superior customer service.This last is a significant factor.  When a case of soup contained several cans that were severely dented, I contacted Amazon customer service, and in less than three days, they had delivered AN ENTIRE NEW CASE - FOR FREE.  When I read reviews denigrating Amazon's customer service, I laugh, certain that the person was not dealing with a full case.The only negative is that the maker, Celestial Seasonings, decided to jazz up a perfect product with peppermint.  The scent is aggravating.  It seems to be less noticeable with recent deliveries, and the positives far outweigh this glitch.

My husband and I have been drinking Red Zinger for years but were often frustrated because we had trouble finding it. I'm so glad to have found it here and have been using subscribe and save so that we are never without our favorite tea.I drink it every morning with a little honey in it. Because it is an herbal tea and has no caffeine, it's good to have anytime of day, including evenings.  Red Zinger makes great iced tea, too! I love it in the summertime.

I recently quit drinking diet soda and starting drinking more green and herbal tea instead. I purchased several boxes of different varieties of tea and this has become my favorite. It's got a very bright, almost fruity flavor and is good hot or iced. I really don't taste the peppermint that other reviewers have mentioned.
I love this stuff cold.  I make a pot, chill it and keep it in my fridge ready to go.  No calorie yumminess.

I tried this tea on a whim because I was intrigued by the ingredients. Anything with hibiscus and especially rosehips is a must for me. Red Zinger tea did not disappoint! It reminds me of an "adult fruit punch" because it tastes a lot like fruit punch from the wild cherry bark and the rosehips, but the hibiscus and the peppermint give it a nice herbal flair. The reason why I opted to give this four stars rather than five is because, even though it's delicious, I felt that this tea was a little too overpowering for me at first. Now, I'm already a big fan of Red Leaf Tea's green apple matcha, but that one really does taste like a green apple, tart and sweet all at the same time. Which is great, but every once in a while a girl needs a smoother apple, a juicer, sweeter apple, which is what I hope to gain from this matcha. I'm eager to try it as a latte with vanilla soy milk and some of their Cinnamon Matcha...I'm hoping for a apple pie with ice cream kind of drink. I love apples and apple juice, so whenever I spot an apple blend, I have to try it. And there are so many things you can do with apple that I'm hoping to be able to do with this apple matcha. Apple matcha pie, anyone? Or apple fritters with an apple matcha icing...yes, please! I make homemade donuts occasionally...can you imagine a big apple cake donut covered in cinnamon sugar? I may have to make donuts in the near future. I hope this matcha lives up to all of the plans I have for it. And I hope it gives me the energy to follow through on those plans! Because now that I've mentioned it, if I don't make donuts in the near future, my wife will be devastated.Unfortunately, this is just not for me. The smell of the dry matcha has the smell of the more bitter matchas I've had from Red Leaf Tea, and that smell carried through into the taste of the brewed tea. It tastes something like apple candy when you power through the bitterness, which is nice, but far from the apple juice I was craving. I'm not an apple candy type of girl, unless it's a sour apple. It might still be good as a latte, but I won't be cooking with it, sadly. Still it isn't terrible, and the bitterness seems to fade over time. Maybe it will still hold up to donuts, as the amount of sugar in them will balance out the bitterness. I don't really think this is one I need to get more of, and if any of my local friends want a taste, I'm happy to share. I'll experiment with what I have left, maybe I can find a way to fall in love with this tea. But personally I'm going to stick with the Green Apple matcha, also from Red Leaf Teas.

column9: SNAKE OIL ON TAP - save your money
column10: SNAKE OIL ON TAP! Just like all those companies that claim to sell "alkaline" water. The body does not need help balancing its pH. The body's pH is normally between 7.35-7.45 (this is the blood and body cavities; stomach pH and certain other areas might have their own unique acid-base balance). Any deviations form this and you're talking SERIOUS health consequences (metabolic alkalosis/acidosis for starters).There is NOTHING on the market and approved by the FDA for food use that will alkalize the body - nor should you want something like it. This is purely a market gimmick, that will fade over time. This water is a waste of money!

column9: BLK is Black for a reason.
column10: I hate to blast the stuff, but it's major component is Fulvic acid, which give BLK in wonderful black color and unique mineral taste of iron and magnesium. Please note that Fulvic acid is a product of dead rotting organic matter. So basically if you went to your favorite lake or the Hackensack river, scrape up the soaked rotting leafs from the bottom of the water and squeezed out the water into a bottle, you would have made BLK.  It's not for me, But leafs more for you - Enjoy!

I have to say, this is an interesting product that I was very excited to try. It's different! I mean how often to you hear someone say they drink black water!When I received my package, first thing I did was open a bottle and took a whiff. I wasn't expecting any smell considering it's supposed to be just like water. I have to say there is a slight subtle smell to it initially, but after a while it was gone. So now it's time for the taste! I took a sip, expecting off-putting flavor and quite frankly, my body was prepared to gag because we don't normally drink black water. I couldn't get past imagining I was drinking a mixture of gasoline and water. Unlike regular water, blk tastes a little bit smoother. I do also detect more of a metallic taste to it but it's very subtle. Once you swallow, it leaves a little dry feeling in the back of your throat like when you drink gatorade. I wouldn't consider blk to be very refreshing. I find myself needing a drink of regular water after the sampling. The only reason I can see anyone drinking this is if they're wanting the benefits of fulvic acid.  Other than that, I can't see myself repurchasing this again. It seems to be like when Heinz released blue ketchup and it failed. Food/drink needs to be visually appealing.  Unless it is flavored, regular blk is just going to make people gag. I wouldn't recommend this product.
What a scam. why would I pay a premium price for this? We are paying for fame and reality show connections not for real results. PT Barnum snake oil.

Listen..."So, black water marketers have taken the sciencey angle to target the new age and organic folks and the alternative medicine subscribers. All bases covered! But wait, they also appeal to real housewives. Jacqueline Laurita on Real Housewives of New Jersey says, "Scientists called it [fulvic acid] the miracle molecule because it's so small." What doesn't it do?Black water has a dark side, for sure. It's a gimmick. Once you learn the sales pitch used to market useless dietary supplements or overpriced, overhyped food stuffs, you can begin to understand sciencey market-speak pretty easily. There is much of it in the organic aisle of the supermarket.I can't conclude that any of us needs fulvic/humic acid supplements, and there currently is no evidence I have found to support that the "miracle" fulvic acid does anything to benefit your health. I would predict that the oddness of the black water products and the price, combined with no observable benefits to the consumer, will likely result in this fad fading away. But give them a prize for their stylish, sciencey black marketing."

I like sparkling mineral water and I drink it because it contains those trace minerals that some bottled waters lack, and because I can still get some bubbles and not have all the sugar found in soda. I'm not 100% sure of the health benefits. Maybe offering a sparking version of this with some natural flavor like lemon would make this more appealing. I can understand the aversion that some people have. Dark, like a cola, yet a little bitter like hard water. It's a little confusing to the senses.

column9: I don't know what 'metallic' taste people are referring to...
column10: Because I just had my first bottle and I couldn't taste a thing. I'm pretty sure those who are freaking out about this probably just couldn't get over the color. Yes, it's a little strange drinking something that's black and has no taste to it whatsoever, but once you get past that in your mind, its really just overpriced mineral water.

Idk what everyone is freaking out about. It tastes like slightly salty smart water. The color is a little unnerving at first, looks like rust water. A  friend of (nutrition major) likes the idea of it so I can't be that bad...maybe

column4: Cajn Thunder "Holla if u hear me!"
column9: There's really nothing wrong with this water
column10: I bought it at my local grocery store as I was looking for a particular coconut water and I came across this as I know alkaline water is suppose to be better for you than just filtered water. So I picked it up and was scared to drink it because I was afraid it would have some sort of taste to it. I have drank water with charcoal before and so I thought it might taste like that but it is purely tasteless. It taste just like plain water. I haven't done much research yet on fulvic trace minerals so I can't speak too much on that and their website is launching in 42 days as I write this. I would drink it again and research the benefits. The color is off putting and it is very mental as to why people say it has a taste and they can't drank it or maybe I am just used to drinking alkaline, mineral enhanced water, I don't know. I'll buy it again too.

column9: Like an old penny at the bottom of your purse
column10: I really wanted to like this water. I'm a huge fan of RHONJ and wanted to support the Manzo/Laurito cause. I will first say that I had to mentally prepare myself beforehand. I imagined it being muddy water or tainted (I may just be weird like that). I made the mistake of smelling it before i took my initial sip, BIG mistake. It smells like an old penny that has been at the bottom of your purse. So, I grinned and took a sip. It has a thick and oddly slimy consistency. It doesn't even TASTE like water. I don't know what it tastes like, but it's not water.Overall, I would rate it a half a star if I could. Just horrible and quite creepy.
This stuff is a complete scam.  Don't spend a dime on this.  Any good review is a scam too, please don't support this blatant ripoff product.

I haven't tried the product. I am curious about the pH level. Most people have a very high acidic diet. Every patient with cancer has a high pH of acid. Too acid in the body causes nuero toxicity and wreaks havoc on the body. Illness, disease and mental disorders are all linked to too much acid. I am curious if the high alkaline in the is beverage would help to quickly neutralize that acid. In fact I may test this product in my wellness clinic in conjunction with a vegetable diet to see if it will speed up a change in the body's pH. Something to think about peeps...

I picked up a bottle from wegman's about a week ago after months of wondering. It really freaked me out because actually the bottle was clear and the water is just pitch black. But it tasted just like water. And that's that-- there's nothing else to say about it.Although I definitely remained freaked out as I drank it, like those horror movies where people just get addicted to whatever food product the movie is centered on and becomes a zombie slave army for some dark power. I feel like there's some evil inky alien octopus thing somewhere that's selling this stuff that will take a mental grasp of everyone who ever drank it, and I'd be one of them. Like I would just be sitting there one day and tendrils of this inky black stuff just start swirling around my eyeballs and I look down and realize that this stuff has turned me completely inky black like that black Spiderman and I'll be conscripted into this alien army of inky black slaves and this sounds really racist so I'm going to cut it off right about now. But this water, that's what it'll do, I swear.

This water tastes like sewage!!! Don't be hyped into buying it like I was. In going back and doing the research, there is nothing in this product that our bodies need except the water, which you can find in your kitchen. It looks horrible and tastes worse! If you feel you need to drink black/brown water, put some water in a glass, go out to your garden and dig up some dirt to add to it.

column9: Like Water, But Better! Love At First Sip!
column10: First of all, I'm the type of person who wants to try everything! Some of my favorite foods are what other people won't even touch. Anyway, I heard about BLK water a long time ago and have been wanting to try it since I found out about it. I actually found it at a local health foods store and was so excited that I bought a few bottles to try out. These bottles were stored at room temperature, but when I took my first sip, it was actually cool. I have no need to refrigerate this water because it quenches my thirst just fine.When I opened my first bottle I took a sniff to see if it smelled metallic or dirty, but I could smell absolutely nothing. And I really don't know why all these reviews say there's a horrible metal aftertaste or that they'd rather drink car oils. Yes, this water is black, but so are a bunch of sodas, and those are completely terrible for you! I'll bet that if you took a drink of BLK blindfolded you wouldn't notice any difference in the purity of the taste of this vs any other water. As for those that preach that there are no health benefits to this water, at least there are no risks. I've seen some questions on other sites regarding the color of urine after drinking BLK and I am going to be flat out honest. I can drink a few bottles of regular water and my urine will still be a pale yellow, but after just one bottle of BLK, my urine is very near clear.As for comparing other bottled waters, I'd have to say this is the freshest water I've tasted. Other bottled waters I've tasted have a strange chlorinated taste to it and make my mouth a little dry except for maybe FIJI, but even FIJI doesn't taste cool when stored at room temperature. When I was in my college class I had finished up my bottle of BLK and went to refill at the water fountain that I always fill my empty cups and bottles with and THAT made me want to gag. After having BLK, I really noticed the taste of the city's tap. It tasted strongly of metals and chlorine. Usually, after having any other bottled water, I don't notice a difference when switching to tap. BLK has made me realize that the city's water is contaminated with all sorts of disgusting stuff!All these other reviewers who say that they'd much rather sip on motor oil obviously have never drank anything this healthy and aren't used to its pure taste. The fact that this water is black should not scare you into thinking BLK is worse than fuel. I'm more scared of the awful chemicals in regular tap!
It really does taste just like water!!! :) I personally don't taste the mineral taste others have claimed they can taste- I would suggest drinking it cold!

Someone in the salon I work in brought a bottle of this in and several of us gave it a try. It was terrible. There was not a single person that tried it (about 20) could finish it. Taste really bad and on top of that I had diarrhea for two days. Thanks BLK! Big Load of Krap

I gave this water a 2star because, while the black color didn't bother me as much as some people. I tried it to see if it made any difference in my energy or helped with a health condition. I can honestly say it made no difference whatsoever. So that is why I gave it the 2stars. It is very expensive water, for doing nothing for me. Hope it helps out some other people. But, wanted to be truthful. Did nothing for me, to spend that kind of money on water.
Blk. is great...I can assure you that it does not taste like tap water!  It is great tasting and I would recommend it highly!

I had no idea this water was black, I thought it was just the packaging and as I was driving had no idea until I looked down, shocked to see that the plastic bottle was indeed transparent. So, completely unbiased, I thought that the water tasted just like another alkaline water ('Alka Pure') which is in the same price bracket. I have no idea as to the veracity of claims fulvic minerals are good for you or not but the taste of this water (and the cool fact that it is indeed black) put it at the top of my list for expensive bottled water. No idea what people are talking about that the taste is 'salty' or weird, it obviously has a slightly metallic taste because of the mineral content which I vastly prefer over the calcium-softness or chorine-tinged waters available by tap or cheap mass production. Hope that common sense will prevail over the overwhelmingly negative reviews this product seems to get; if people can look past the black (which I think is its chief selling point!) then I think consumers will ultimately champion this water.
It taste just like water. The color is the only thing that weirds me out a little. I just closed my eyes and drank it.

column9: Best tasting bottled water I've ever had.
column10: If you want to really taste water, drink it at room temperature. Drinking water cold deadens your taste buds.Besides drinking water directly from a spring, this is the best tasting water I've ever had. I drink it all the time.One critical thing to note:Recently I noticed that the labels on the bottles at the grocery store changed from "spring water" to "filtered water".The stuff in the new (filtered water) labels does not taste as good. I hope they put it back the way it was.

I read some of the other reviews and I just don't get it. I could not detect any grittiness or aftertaste. It tasted just like plain water. I do not know the full benefits of fulvic acid, but I intend to try more of this. After all, I'm from New Jersey. So, "blk" looks like I just scooped up a bottle of water directly from one of our polluted rivers. I intend to drink it on hikes while friends and relatives are watching just so I can elicit some shock value. Very cool, novel idea. Downside: It's a little pricey.
I was nervous trying this but when I received it (in a timely manner) it was great.  I shared it with family and friends.  They all liked it.

I bought this because of the great things I've heard about all the minerals in this water. It takes a minute to get over the color but it actually tastes just like water an I think it's pretty good. I would definately buy this again.
Its not bad! It is more of a mental thing to me. Its taste like regular water when cold but when at room temperature you can taste a something different. Im happy with my purchase.

column9: Did anyone read about the ingredients?
column10: First, I don't taste any significant difference between this and water.  Second, I'm not drinking it for taste - I'm drinking it for the health benefits.  Fulvic Acid is a powerful antioxidant.

BLK water is as nasty as it looks. (Why doesn't Amazon let you give zero stars?) I watch all the Real Housewives shows and enjoy them. I have no axe to grind, but you couldn't pay me to drink this stuff. It's just awful. Maybe Caroline's kids need to get a real job.

I don't know what these other reviewers were drinking, if you close your eyes it tastes just like cold spring water.  Maybe it is mind over matter with them.  I tried the water for the health benefits, which I don't really notice (maybe that is mind over matter too!). Anyway, now that I find out it is a business venture of the Jersey housewives, I probably won't be buying any more, SORRY!

This water does have a very SLIGHT difference in taste to "normal" water but by all means if you can get past the color, it's not bad at all.I love this water and drink it all the time. Have not had anything bad happen yet! I have not been sick in a LONG time and this water is keeping me healthy.If you can't get past the color, don't purchase it. You saw it before you purchased it... why would you buy it if you didn't like the color? Some people need to man up. It doesn't taste bad AT ALL. I love it.

column9: From an actual purchaser of the product!
column10: I ordered the blk water about a month ago but was afraid to try it!  I finally opened the box and stocked the fridge with it.  A few days later, I cracked open my first bottle and took my chances.  I gotta say, this was good water.  It tasted like regular water with NO discernable aftertase (closer to Dasani than Ice Mountain which, I think, has a NASTY aftertaste).  I've read the reviews here about an oily or muddy texture or flavor and honestly, I don't know what those people are talking about.  I've got a pretty sensitive palate and neither me nor anyone in my family detected any residual mouth feel.  My only gripe was the bottles looked pretty beat up. It's a nice heavy plastic bottle with a rich sheen to it, but my bottles were quite scratched up -- especially around the top curve.  It just cheapened the feel for me.  Since I have to order the product from Amazon -- at $55 a case, with S&H, I'm not sure I'll be reordering. If I could find it at a retailer here in Chicagoland, I'd definitely repurchase, because it's so cool looking -- and could make a really fun cocktail.

My family really loves this chili. We make it for burrito night and it is really good with added cheese,onion,salsa and soft taco shells...or just like the directions say to make it...It is our family favorite.
I made the mistake of ordering during heat wave which never ended and candy was melted and I put in frig . . .which ruined it. I've always loved these but don't refrigerate.

column9: A EASTER GIFT FOR MY DAUGHTER!
column10: Purchased this for my daughter, Gamer Rhi, she loves White Chocolate. It arrived in timely manner as promised. It was Perfect and my daughter was thrilled!by Carol Hulick "Gamer" Rhi's Mom

column9: Not as hot as the French market version
column10: I discovered the Fallot tarragon mustard while vacationing in France last December. The French version was extremely hot yet very flavorful with hints of tarragon. The jar I just got today is very mild and while its flavor is pretty decent, it is a far cry from the French version if you want your mustard with a definite bite. I wish the fact that this is an export version would be mentioned in the product description.
I found this condiment on a recent trip to France.  It makes seafood shine and a ho-hum ham sandwich make you feel as if you are sitting in a cafe on the bank of the Seine.

column9: Turns humdrum sandwich to gourmet feast!
column10: I discovered the Edmont Fallot Tarragon Dijon Mustard at a little gourmet deli here in Los Angeles.I love condiments, and I'm tough to please.This little jar will change the way you eat.Just a little dab -- and be careful, lathering it on like mayo will pop your eyes out, it's so spicy! -- and it will add this unique zest to your sandwich.Perfect for chicken and turkey. I bet it would also be delicious on salmon and maybe even pork.It really transforms that boring sandwich into a gourmet treat.Expensive, but so totally worth it. And since you only need a touch, a jar goes a long way. I think we added it to two sandwiches / day for nearly two months before we emptied the jar.Trust me. You will love it.
This mustard made my sandwiches wonderful, I love love love it.  Bought it at a gourmet shop in Saugatuck MI, and must go get more.  Highly recommend!
Amazon what are you thinking  I can buy this at Kroger for half of what you are asking  Dont let us down  Oh and LaCroix is great  I was so tired of just water

The product is good... a nice way to get soda out of your diet!  Tastes good (sometimes I add a bit of lime).I pay about 9 bucks less for the same amount at Kroger.  I don't know why it is so overpriced here.

column9: too pricey here but terrific product!
column10: I agree, this item is way too expensive with Amazon.  But I adore this unsweetened, carbonated, lemon-flavored water and am happy to almost always find it at my nearby Kroger, nowhere else but Kroger comes through!
How ridiculous is your asking price? Did you know that you can buy two twelve packs (24 12 oz cans) for less than $10 at Wal-Mart? I thought I was supposed to save money on this website.
This item is overpriced. You can buy an 8 pakc for 3 USD at any Whole Foods (which is supposed to be an expensive chain).Stay away from it.Other than that, this is a great tasting sparkling water.

column9: Tasty, filling, but only four servings per box.
column10: I am not on a gluten free diet. However, I find gluten free foods more filling. And so, I gave these crackers a try, after coming across them in my grocery store. I like the original and cheddar flavours the best (the cheddar flavour is very delicate).I find the vegetable variety to taste more herby then "vegetably" (is that a word? ;o) ).1) I have not experienced the breakage problem some mention. Yes, there is a broken cracker here and there, but nothing out of norm. Quite frankly, I think they pack them as they do, in two pouches, two servings each, in order to pump up the volume, so to speak. Each of these boxes contains only four servings (32 crackers). That's not much for the price. This is the only reason for the four, rather then five star rating.2) They are filling and tasty. I am addicted to these crackers with red pepper humus. Yum! They scoop well once you get a hang of it (they are flaky and will break more often then regular crackers would in the same situation).3) The box is made of 100% recycled material, for those to whom this matters.Enjoy!PS: There is a warning on the label that says they may contain traces of soy, milk, and sesame, in case anyone is alergic. Also, they do contain eggs.

Have a celiac GF so often stuck eating Gluten Free items when I COULD have the real thing. Often it is heart breaking how bad the items are. This is pretty good. It's not fantastic, but hey, its Gluten Free and for Gluten free these are good enough to eat without covering in cheese, etc. If you need Gluten Free you will not hate these!

column9: My kids like these cracker remnants but there are very few whole crackers
column10: Amazon's excellent customer service allowed me to receive a replacement box of these crackers when I started opening the bags and finding tiny pieces of crackers.However, the second box came exactly the same way.The taste of the Vegetable crackers is less vegetable and more herbs, which is fine by me- but don't expect it to taste Ranchy, or like Garden Vegetable grocery store crackers. My kids think they are spicy-they're not, but they are more herb, not vegetable flavored.I would order them constantly if they were not all broken upon arrival.

It's great to have a choice of flavors when it comes to gluten free crackers.  For the longest time, I could only find plain or onion.  Now, Glutino makes a multigrain, a cheddar, the original flavor, and this vegetable flavor.  We've tried all of them, and while this is our least favorite, it's still good.  They are much different from a saltine or butter cracker, much more starchy tasting, but the kids don't seem to mind.  I would like to see them improve the packaging so there is less breakage.

Very tasty crackers (especially for GF). Not many crackers in the box but if you're buying GF products you probably already know that. My whole family likes them. I bought a couple of cases last time to save money on shipping. FYI... they make a great substitute for bread crumbs in meatloaf and parmasean chicken.

These are really good gluten free crackers. I thought that I would have to give up on these in my future... until these came along. I will be ordering these again.CAUTION.... Amazon does not pack these well. The last order of these from them, most were broken. Needless to say, I have found another place to order them from.

These have the texture of a ritz cracker. Thy are strong enough to hold cheese, be dipped, use for appetizers, and any other use you can think of. The flavor is mildly herb-like, and reminds me of a hearty cracker. The taste does not overpower the cracker, so it can be paired with any type of food seamlessly. The box has two separate bags inside of it, which is good for keeping the crackers fresh. But around here, the crackers never last more than a day or two. I highly recommend these crackers for those with gluten tolerance problems. Even our GF family members love them!

These vegetable flavored crackers are a pleasant surprise for those of us who are gluten sensitive.  They have an almost pizza-like fragrance and taste very nice indeed.As a veteran of sampling rice crackers, cakes, etc., as well as crackers of other grains, I must say this Glutino texture is much preferable to the hard crackle rice flour gives to crackers and, too, the flavor is quite good.I have subscribed to have them delivered as a result.

I usually buy the multigrain crackers of this same brand but my Whole Foods was out so I opted for these. Being gluten free I really miss crackers with homemade soup and just the crunch of a cracker. I thought this flavor was just OK. I think they taste like Combos (maybe pizza or cheesy flavor). I would probably like them better as a snack by themselves.

column9: these r great! my kids 7 and 4 love em too!
column10: I've tried the multi grain and really like them. BUT decided to try the veggie ones and LOVE them. My kids and I both thought they kinda tasted like pizza!!! So I may even try melting alittle goat cheese on top...since we do limited dairy...BUT I've found them cheaper on other online sites...

This flavor of glutino crackers really disappointed me. I looked at the other flavors and I thought, "I want to try the veggie flavor!" But once I bit into one, it did not satisfy my expectations. It tasted like an herby, pepper cracker. I couldn't even finish one cracker. But other members of my family liked them, and others think them so, so. I like the cheddar flavor, but now I am hesitant to try any of the other flavors. Also there is so much corn in them! If you look at the ingredients, the first one listed is Corn Starch. Being allergic to corn I can only have these crackers in small amounts. I think these crackers might taste better with some tomato sauce, but I prefer the cheddar flavor and I suggest you buy that flavor and skip this flavor! :(

column9: Tastes like an Italian herb cracker!
column10: It's okay I was hoping that it tasted like ordinary vegetable flavored cracker. It has very strong Italian seasoning flavor. It would be good with a salad. Its not bad but I like the original cracker better!
These crackers are so delicious! They have the texture of Ritz crackers, but even better flavor. The entire family loves them, even those not gluten-free!

I picked up a couple of these while I was visiting my brother in LA. When I took my first bite, I thought, "Hey, these kind of taste like a ritz cracker! Cool!"The second and third cracker though, I noticed a really starchy, floury taste coming through. I looked at the ingredients. Corn starch was the first ingredient.I tend not to like gluten free products made mostly from corn starch. They are light, sure, but kind of flavourless and powdery if you chew for any length of time.Brown rice flour or millet gives such a great depth of flavor, and it's an actual whole grain, not just a grain after all the protein and nutrients are taken out. Even white rice flour would be better.Corn starch, however is cheaper so I think that's why it gets used a lot.If you liked white flour, starchy foods before you went gluten free you might like these. If you prefer whole grains or even actual flour (not just the starch) I would try something else. I like Christie's multigrain crackers or brown rice thins.

I bought a box of these at the store..got home..opened the box and there is 2 small snack size bags of crackers and this cost me 5 dollars!These companies really cheat people on this type of stuff cause they know people who have celiax have no choice..and poor people...people on disability...social security etc...it is hard to afford this high priced food and get a little amount for the price..

I love these crackers.  They are tasty on their own. They have that cracker snap.  They aren't slimy.  They hold up well with something on them.We have started eating these with tuna salad.  Seriously yummy.One of our favorite snacks is a nice chedder cheese and crackers.  That was gone when we went GF.  I found these by accident & was doubtful they were any good.  I was wrong.Well worth purchasing all the flavors available.  I have not been disappointed.

I've tried many gluten free crackers and the ones by Glutino are without a doubt the best ones.  They are tasty, crisp and thick enough to hold up under cheese and fruit. They are a bit pricey for the small amount of product, but well worth it.  I love the two bag packaging, keeping them fresh longer.
My husband is a celiac & we've struggled to find a cracker that we both like until now.  These crackers are great: nice flavor & consistency...as close to a "ritz" as we've found.
Excellent and very tasty crackers for those of us who can't handle gluten. My dogs love them, too.
This is a very good Jasmine tea. It is fragrant and a very smooth flavor. It is as described by Allegro. I like this tea a lot.

column9: The only GF bread that tastes like real bread, IMHO
column10: Okay, after 6 years gluten free and trying every GF food product I can find, these little rolls are one of the only REALLY good GF bread products I have encountered. They are easy to prepare (8 min in my toaster oven works perfect-o)and they taste like real bread -- not dry crumbly and flavorless like most GF breads.My only wish is that Schar made them in the size of hoagie (sub) rolls with sesame seeds on top so that I could make a real sub sandwich again. (Are you listening Schar?)I used to do all the GF bread mixes from scratch in my bread machine, and some are pretty decent, but these little rolls are WAY better. In fact, they taste much better than any of Schar's other breads -- weird, I know, but try them and you will see.

These rolls are great.  Bake them and then add some butter.  Who needs wheat, anyway?  They are not too dry or too hard.  They are just right.  I am going with an egg sandwich tomorrow morning.The downside is that they are pricey in the store ($1.00 per roll).  It's hard to believe they really need to be priced like that as it is a very simple product.

Most GF bread that I've tried is not very palatable to me for various reasons.  If you've tried it, you probably already know what I mean.  Not so with these little rolls, they're are actually tasty!  They come 4 in a plastic pouch, not compartmented, just all in there together.  Once opened, the extra's (if there are any) keep well in the fridge.  Each roll is on average 3 inches square, and around 2 inches thick.  Fairly light density.  Not pre-sliced.  Soft, porous interior.  Lightly browned top and bottom.  They come lightly dusted on the outside with GF flour.  Texture is similar to wheat bread.  Taste is light, mildly yeasty, and not overly sweet.  This roll is good as a dinner roll, small burger bun, small sandwich roll, etc.  Unopened, they are shelf stable.  The last order that I placed with Schar, I received in mid October 2011, with a "best before" date of March 5, 2012.  The rolls are parbaked (pre-baked, but you complete the baking with 8-10 minutes in a 400 degree oven), but they are good to me right out of the package.  Schar also makes parbaked sub rolls and baguettes.  Hope you enjoy these as much as I have!
These are the best gluten free rolls (and among the best gluten free breads overall)! Light and yet rich in fiber, they taste great!
Baked up perfectly in our little toaster oven on our boat!  Nice to be able to have great rolls away from home!

my son has dairy, egg, wheat allergy - Dr. Schar ciabatta rolls are UNBELIEVEABLE - taste like regular bread - par-baked so moist when toasted - by far the best gf bread (and we have tried them all) - the beautiful thing is that they are egg free - generally don't get bread (or any gf baked items) that taste this good with the fine texture that do not have eggs.  Although they don't specifically say egg-free, they do not include it in the recipe.  for those with egg allergies - just note that many of their products do contain egg.  I agree with another reviewer about the high cost - very expensive for few items - sometimes it makes me sad that someone has to suffer the actual allergy in itself - and then have to get whammed with high cost of food - but until more quality competition rivals - this is what it is...  I am thankful that some quality products do exist today...

I will start by saying I don't have to eat Gluten Free, but I try many, many things because of family members that do.  Because I eat both I am a tough critic on the bad GF tasting products.  This is absolutely wonderful bread.  Shar makes 3 versions of this bread that I have seen at my local regular grocery stores; Ciabatta rolls, baguettes and sub rolls.  I have personally had the Ciabatta and the baguettes.  These are by far the best GF rolls I have had and they taste amazingly similar to gluten containing bread.  I will mention that the baguettes don't get crusty/crunchy on the outside (althought next time I will try a warm water brush before they go into the oven)but still slice a piece of the baguette add brie and you have a piece of heavan!  Please note that these products are Par -Baked and they are different from  the other Shar variety of shelf stable bread and the Parbaked are much better.  What a great tasty option for the GF crowd!!!

BOTTOM LINESchar makes the best gluten free rolls, bar none.  They are indistinguishable from normal bread, except they taste better.TASTEI love to toast all my bread before eating and, when toasted, these taste better than normal bread rolls.  They are crispy on the outside and warm and soft on the inside.SIZEThese rolls are the perfect size for the standard sandwiches I like to eat.PRICEFor gluten-free bread, these rolls are not even outrageously priced!

I am a pretty regular coffee drinker and have used Kcups for almost two years now and was extremely skeptical of the half-caff Kcups when I received them as a gift because I personally do not see the point of drinking coffee without the caffeine.  That being said, after having a long day and needing a little pick-me-up late at night and fearing the late-night caffeine insomnia, I broke down and tried the half-caff. I was and still am very pleased with the flavor and level of caffeine of this product even though I typically prefer a stronger brew.  It has a typical medium roast flavor that is uneventful and can appeal to most coffee drinkers that are not too picky in their tastes.  There is very little aftertaste and I have not had any issues going to sleep after drinking this beverage later at night as I have had with other blends.
You can purchase Green Mountain Half Cafe at Bed Bath & Beyond and WalMart for $11.88 for 18.So be sure to check your local stores.

column9: Coffee great, seller not so great.
column10: We drink Green Mountain coffee all the time, and it is one of the few suppliers that provide it in Half-Caf. I am a decafinated coffee drinker most of the time but my wife likes a little kick to start her morning and the Half-Caf does the trick, and Green Mountain's Half-Caf has a very good taste without the decalf after taste. We also buy other flavors provided by Green Mountain and they all have a great coffee taste.

Fast delivery and best price found online. Although half-caffeine, this coffee has a definitive taste with hopefully only half the usual caffeine, since it is the only Kcup I will try in the evening for fear of insomnia.  Works for me!

Thank you, Amazon for sending me an email invitation to review my recent purchase of Green Mountain Half-Caff Coffee. Where to begin? If I may say as much, I was VERY pleasantly surprised in how much the Green Mountain Half-Caff Coffee tasted like honest to goodness coffee. Wow.
Keurig coffee is great just wish they had lattes , hot chocolate and chai tea available like other do. gl

I purchased the Half-Caff because I am trying to cut back on my caffeine intake, but love to have a couple cups of coffee each day. The taste of this coffee is not rich or satisfying. I would rather have one cup of delicious full-caffeine coffee than two cups of this mediocre blend. I'll go back to my Green Mountain Newman's Own Special Blend, which is delicious!
This Green Mountain Half-Calf K-Cups.  24 count is $13.32 and the 18 count is $18.50?????????  Can not understand this.

This marinade is awesome. We marinate pork tenderloins in this Skylake Ranch Pomegrante Marinade and the house smells amazing when its in the oven. It has a great sweet and delicious taste. It is perfect with pork and wonderful as a sauce.
By mixing this with a little olive oil, and smearing it over the chicken, it provides a spicy, easy to grill (no/low sugar, hence, not blackened) chicken.

Put about 6 lbs. of chicken breast or pork roast in a crockpot, add about 2 tbl of Walkerswood, and slow cook for 8 hours.  Drain the liquid off THROUGH A STRAINER and set liquid aside.  Dump the strainer contents back into the meat.  Use two forks and shred meat barbeque style.  Add about 1-3 tbls of Walkerswood (depending on your personal heat index) and mix well, adding enough liquid back to keep it very moist.  Put in an airtight container and let it sit in the fridge overnight.  Serve it, reheated, on buns, add a bit of cole slaw if you like, and it will disappear much quicker than you want it to.Also, try a tablespoon in homemade chile and spaghetti sauce!
This is the closest thing to being in Jamaica. Even the Jamaicans I know in Ohio use Walkerswood Jerk Seasoning. This is definitely the best I have ever had. I highly recommend it!

I saw this product on the Food Network. I went on a cruise about 2-3 weeks later and ended up sharing a dinner table with an older couple from Jamaica. We discussed jerk seasonings and they mentioned this product since they now live in Jersey. I decided to purchase once I returned home.I ordered on a Monday, it shipped on Tuesday and to my surprise I received on Thursday. I have since made 2 dishes and I am so happy. I feel like I can enjoy the Caribbean whenever I want in my own kitchen.My next order I'm getting multiple bottles.

This product is excellent.  The best jerk seasoning out there but hard to find except on the internet.  The vendor had an excellent price and was extremely prompt with shipping.  My first time buying from them, but I would not hesitate to buy again.  Thank you for distributing Walkerswood!

Spicy, smooth, with an incredible taste.  The vendor sends out the order quickly.  When we ordered the seasoning we also purchased another seasoning to 'taste test'.  Hands down Walkerswood Jamaican beat the other.  We grilled a few  pieces of chix after seasoning it and letting it sit for a day.  When we finished cooking it, we let it rest we sat down to eat and realized that Walkerswood has the perfect flavor.

Back in the 70's I was at a bachelor party and one of the guests brought jerk chicken. I had never heard of it, but one bite and I was hooked! I spent years trying to duplicate that flavor, buying various brands and even making my own from recipes I found online - dozens of attempts. Most were pretty good in their own ways, but nothing really special.Finally I stumbled on a brand that I hadn't tried, Walkerswood, and BINGO, that was it! The flavor had remained in my memory for at least 10 years. This is truly THE BOMB!Use about 1 Tbsp. / lb. of meat for mild heat; 3 Tbsp. / lb. for some real fun; more if you're a heat freak. The best, most authentic way to prepare jerk is to smoke it on a charcoal grill (sorry, gas-grillers) and use smoking wood like hickory, applewood, etc.

I brought some of this back from Jamaica a few months back, and am running low.  I was tickled to see it available on Amazon.  If you are looking for authentic jerk spices for your chicken, this is it!

Dude!!  Buy the big pack of chicken thighs, rub them down with Walkerswood, put them in a crock pot, dump the rest of the jar on top.  Go to work, come home, and Holy Moses!!  This stuff is awesome!  Nothing better.
I love this stuff.My husband is from the islands , and he loves this , however a do add a little more spices , liquor to spice it up. Just add a little wishky and olive oil.. YUMMY

I used to buy Walkerswood Jamaican Jerk Seasoning at Bev Mo, but they stopped carrying it. In fact I can't find it in any grocery store in San Francisco any longer. Why is this? This jerk seasoning is FANTASTIC!!!It's got good heat and does not need anything added. I put rub 2 or 3 tablespoons of it all over a whole chicken and then roast it in my Showtime rotisserie and it is excellent. The chicken skin even gets somewhat crispy despite the wetness of the seasoning. This stuff is outstanding.

column9: Some of the best Jerk seasoning you can buy.
column10: This is some of the best Jerk seasoning I have ever had.  It is VERY spicy and really taste like the real deal.  Most jerk seasoning is dumbed down and lacks any punch but not this stuff.  Great flavor.

column4: D. L. Brown "A Knower Of Good Things"
column9: The only jerk seasoning to buy
column10: In my opinion this is the best and only seasoning to buy for jerking your meats, it is spicy, easy to use and the absolute authentic jerk seasoning I will swear by. I have used this on all types of chicken and some other meats, I would not reccomend this for fish,unless you are going to pan sear the fish, fish is too delicate for this, try their marinade instead. We have used this for several years and it is the best seasoning.  You don't need much and make sure that you rub it all over the chicken or pork.  You let it marinate for one day and then grill. It is delicious and spicy.  I bought several for gifts as well.

I quartered a whole chicken and put it in a plastic bag for 5 hours with only this seasoning. Then I grilled the chicken at 350-400 degrees for 45 min. for the thighs and 1 hr  for the breast, which were significantly larger on my bird.  Chicken came out amazing.  I would highly recommend this product.
The best jerk seasoning out there but hard to find except on the internet.Tried it on a Roast cooked for 8 hrs at 250 degrees it was the best testing roast.I can't wait to try it on chicken

By far the best jerk sauce I've tasted.  Tastes like the authenic stuff you eat while in Jamaica.  Its worth the price the container goes a long way.  Its very weasy to control the spiciness of your food.  A little bit runned on goes a long way.

Started buying Walkerswood Jamaican Jerk Seasoning while on vacation in a  gift shop in Gatlinburg TN. many years ago. It is the greatest.  Have tried other rubs, dry seasonings etc.  None can compare.  Use it on salmon, chicken, pork.  Leftovers are great for salad of black beans, mango,.  Great product.  Grill on wood fire, gas,or charcoal.

This is by far the best jerk I have had. The flavor is addictive, not only good on chicken but on chips as well. A friend started me on it with 1 jar, I went through it so fast I had to order my own. I bought a case.My wife marinates chicken over night and then makes a mango salsa and she servers it over jasmine rice. I add extra jerk on top.

Bust out the napkins, grab yourself a beer, and buckle your seat belts cause this stuff is a properauthentic flamefest of Jamaican jerk heat. You can put it on straight, or cut it with a little oliveoil, but I've found it best to marinate chicken or pork tenderloins for at least 24 hours before cooking for optimum results.Its a little messy cause you really have to rub this stuff in and make sure you turn/shake your marinade bag every few hour to ensure an even distribution of this wondermous stuff. This stuff is wonderful!  Great spicy flavor!  We found it origianally in Jamacia and continue to order it and pass it on to our friends.  I mainly use it for marinading meat that I grill but I'm sure that it has a lot of other uses.  Use it sparingly...alittle goes a long way.  Often I will marinade a cut up chicken with about a small table spoon of this stuff.  I usually use some cheap marinade or salad dressing as a medium since this is a paste.  Or you can rub it on.  Either way, it is great!  Two small jars of this stuff will last you all year.

Walkerswood Jerk seasoning is by far the best out of the jerk seasonings that I used. I have never been to Jamaica, but a good friend who spent some time there was getting very frustrated looking for a jerk in U.S. that matched that of the jerk in Jamaica.....until he found Walkerswood. He introduced it to my wife and I, and we haven't stopped using ot since!It goes great on everything, and has just the right balance of spice & sweet! Jerk lovers that haven't tried it are seriously missing out.
Great on steaks, pork, fish and chicken. Makes the best hot wings! Try it on catfish, shrimp, crab, lobster. Brings out the best of flavor.
This is our favorite jerk sauce and it was sent correctly and speedily by the merchyant so all is well.

Ran into this stuff first at a Hops Grill and Bar, grilled salmon. Liked it so much I bought a little tub of it from the place. I've moved, and Hops is not around here. No worries. I can do my own thing with a jar of this, some clarified butter, sour cream and yoghurt.A little goes a long ways. But I don't know of anything that compares, let alone beats the taste.

i've used this seasoning for at least 15 years. turned everyone i know who cooks on to it...folks who cook, can't settle for subs... tried other look alikes, that are cheaper...always disappointed w subs.  walkerswood is just the best most flavorful.  it's highly concentrated seasoning, so you don't need to use a lot...mixing w a bit of olive oil is a great idea to help spread product... it is high in sodium, so be mindful. that said, use it to add spice and flavor to everything from deviled eggs to baked chicken..to red beans and rice...mix it w duck sauce, spread on any meat you like...bake and enjoy... make a dip for shell fish...for quick zest...it makes everything you add it to, seem like a specially fussed over dish.  a little goes a long way. once you use this, the others just won't do...worth every penny...enjoy
Best jerk seasoning out there!  I tried many and this has the most authentic taste.  Try smoking your meats with a bit of pimento wood.

Man, where has this stuff been all my life? I use it on all kinds of foods. I sread it on eggs, quiche, potatoes..etc. Excellent flavor when marinated on meats. Gonna try beef jerk this weekend with this stuff.

column9: Authentic Jamaica - "No Problem" with a 6-pack of Red Stripe beer
column10: On our first trip to Jamaica in 1985, our whole family fell in love with Jerk Chicken and Jerk Pork from the street-side shops throughout Jamaica.  We brought back 5 brands of this stuff in our suitcases from grocery stores on that trip.  I think Walkers Wood was one of the brands.  In any case Walkers Wood is great and is now on the menu in the households of my 4 adult children. We use it at least once a week on our gas or charcoal grill year around.My Chicken 'Recipe'Use a whole cutup chicken or equivelent package of chicken wings or chicken drummies . . . or for best value get a 10 pound bag of frozen chicken wings from Costco. $2.00/pound compard to $3.25 at grocery store.  Coat with about 2 heaping tablespoons of this sauce. If you have the time, let it marinade for a while.  Put on indirect heat on the grill for 1 hour+ for a whole cut-up chicken or 50 minutes for wings.  Turn over once during cooking.  Adjust the time for the temperature.  The built-in thermometer on my Weber gas grill runs at about 375-400 degrees when it is turned to about 20%.Dark Golden Brown . . . The Jerk Sauce darkens more than just plain chicken.  Indirect grill until deep golden brown.Slow grilling can chemically burn off the 'heat' in peppers. Depending on the audience, we sometimes add a little Tobasco Sauce to the Jerk Sauce to reinforce the pepper.  Some of the best Jerk Chicken & Pork vendors in Kingston serve jerk that is HOT! . . but nothing a couple of Red Stripe beers or coka-colas for kids can't fix.Other Vendors in Negril and Ocho Rios tame the heat but still have the spicy and lime flavors.If you want to complete the Jamaica experience serve with Fried Rice and Peas.  Prepare some white rice, add some chicken bouillon and 1 finely diced Serrano pepper, then finish in a fying pan with a little oil and green peas.
This jerk seasoning is amazing! It is an awesome blend of flavors and has good heat! I highly recommend this to anyone that likes spicy food. Also great as a spread in burritos and such.
I opened the seasoning and did not like the smell. It was very strong. I gave it a try and loved it. Warning it is very hot, but delicious !
This is just the best jerk seasoning we have had. Great flavor and heat. It's not jerk from New York, Texas, Mexico. This is the real thing from Jamaica Mon!

I had jerk chicken in Grand Cayman for the first time.  Sounded awful, but was awesome tasting.  Marinate boneless chicken thighs, smoke on your bbq grill and add cooked pasta shells, cooked brocolli florettes and cooked baby carrots.  Mix with alfredo sauce.  Just AWE-SOME....This seasoning is the absolute best.  I've tried others, but nothing compares.

The last jar I bought seemed under-salted. Wonder if they heard Americans are afraid of salt these days and changed the recipe. I doctored it my usual way, but with salt added to the usual lime juice and olive oil. I use it on chicken thighs or pork chops. Shallow slashes on the surface of the meat to increase surface area, 24-hour marination in the fridge in a zip-closure plastic bag, chicken pieces skinless. I wouldn't want it on the more delicate flavors of seafood, but whatever floats yer boat.
I've been using Walkerswood since restoration in Miami for Hurricane Andrew, referred my a Jamaican friend. It is the best, hands down.
This product is great.  Nice flavor with a little bit of heat.  I would highly recommend this product.  We bought some for friends and they all love it.

The best for slow smoked chicken and pork, but my little trick is to add it to ketchup (in place of horseradish) and other ingredients for a most interesting shrimp cocktail dipping sauce.  Definitely worth the expense and the shipping.
I have tried them all and THIS is the one!  All of you Jamaican Jerk lovers can stop looking - this is the best authentic "wet" jerk seasoning in the world!!  Nothing beats it!
This is the real deal right here, folks! Do try this if you like jerk seasoning!

column9: Good if you love VERY Salty Vinegary food
column10: I saw all the great reviews on this item and decided to try it out myself.  I couldn't wait to cook up some jerk chicken for my friends.However, I was very disappointed when with the final product.  The paste itself was very salty and VERY VERY vinegary.  I thought cooking will mellow it out. It didn't.  I will not buy or even use this again.  The taste and the sharp scent of vinegar overpowers the other spices and the flavor of the meat.
This seasoning is too hot for us. Tried to use it couple times, gave up and gave it to our friends who like hot spices.

column9: Beware the difference between Caramel and Classic Caramel
column10: I have been round and round a bit on this.  This item and UPC are for the CLASSIC Caramel flavor from Torani.  It is terrible.  Don't get this confused with the regular/plain Caramel flavor from Torani, which is fabulous.  Make sure you note they are DIFFERENT products.Amazon created this Classic Caramel page based on the Caramel page, then renamed the old page to Classic Caramel as well, which is a confusing mess.  You need to ignore the reviews on the other page as they are for a different product.  The UPC 089036241397 is for Classic Caramel.  The UPC 089036241434 is for regular Caramel.  Amazon, incorrectly, kept references to Caramel on this page.  It is not!The taste difference between the two is shocking.  This one tastes like turpentine-soaked shoe leather.  In fact, I spit out my first cafe lattes based on this thinking it was spoiled/rotten.Finally, note that Amazon does not allow returns of grocery items, so be sure you like CLASSIC Caramel before you are stuck with 3 bottles of the stuff.

The bitter taste flooded your mouth and was not washed away by subsequent sips of coffee;that cup went down the drain! Unfortunately we fared no better with the sodas; the bitter aftertaste was persistent. Needless to say, our subscribe and save shipments on this product have been cancelled.

I get three bottles of this for a little bit more than I would pay for one bottle in my city.  I love it!!  Free shipping when you do automatic shipment.
It is so delicious in my coffee!  I have it every morning.  Much cheaper than buying a fancy coffee somewhere.
This syrup is delicious in coffee, and I'm glad Amazon carries it now! My local store always runs out. It's so much more convenient to one-click order.
These are the best little cookies . I love them too much (calories) you can't eat the recommended serving. You have to eat the whole bag.

column9: Chocolate flavor doesn't come through really at all....
column10: These aren't bad cookies, but as "chocolate chip" cookies, they are lacking.Each package is an appealing rather small, cute size (roughly the size of a typical package of hot dogs).  It's hard to see at first, but the front of the bag has a pull-tab, which opens a U-shaped hole on the front, and which can be re-sealed.The cookies are truly bite-sized, being roughly the size of a quarter.  The chocolate chips are hard to discern and, as might be expected in that case, they don't contribute much to the flavor.  Depending on the particular cookie, you may detect no chocolate flavor, or a slight hint of chocolate.  Otherwise, these have the classic old-school shortbread flavor, and are the type of shortbread that is on the firmer side, rather than being very crumbly.One plus is that the calorie count is low for cookies.  Well, I don't really know that much about the calories of cookies on the market; but 7 of these cookies (1 serving) is 130 calories.  Since the cookies are rich, 7 is plenty, and that sounds like a low calorie count to me.I don't think I would bother buying these again because for chocolate chip cookies, I want a different sort of thing.  But for shortbread cookies, they are pleasant enough.[Later edit to above review:  I came back to edit this review a little, as it appears that the first two bags of the pack I received were different than the third, which I just opened.  I therefore think that there may have been something wrong with the first two bags.  In the third pack, most of the cookies did actually contain visible chocolate chips, and more of them.  Even considering that, the chocolate flavor still is very faint.  I'm still not impressed enough that I would buy these again, especially considering how much variation appears to exist from bag to bag.  But I thought I should post an update to my original review.]
YUM!!!  YUM!!!  YUM!!!  YUM!!!  Yummy buttery goodness with chocolate!  What could be better?!  YUM!!!  YUM!!!  YUM!!!  :-)Am I at 21 words yet?  YUM!!!

I have this every morning and on cold days I might have 2 or 3 cups of it.

column9: Doesn't last long for agressive chewers
column10: I don't like all the controversy surrounding rawhide bones and don't want take the risk of my Lab getting a blockage so I exclusively give him Booda bones which are safe. My lab is an aggressive chewer and considering this is edible it makes him that much more excited as he LOVES food. He enjoys these bones but devours them in less than 20 minutes. I usually give it to him for a few minutes until he eats half of it and then I take it away to save for next time. This obviously would get very expensive so he has his non-edible Nylabones most of the time and these are special treats.

column9: Great for dogs with stomach problems
column10: My dog gets sick eating a lot of dog treats (even Milkbones), but has always done well with all the Booda bones.  She really loves them & they're good for getting rid of the tartar on her teeth.  I highly recommend these.

Our Siberian Husky is overweight and on a diet.  She also is great at building placque and tartar on her teeth - baad breath! She has a touchy stomach on top of it all.  Tried these bones in all flavors and she loves them.  They help with her teeth and breath.  She gets one bone for her lunch (she's a 3 meals a day gal).  Her other meals are now canned green beans with either yogurt (plain) or low fat cottage cheese.  She has lost about 11 lbs and is doing great!  No more throwing up her food!

column9: Goodbye Rawhides! Hello Peace of Mind - & Dogs Love 'em!
column10: Love these! Well, because...we have 3 dogs (2 were unplanned children ;-) & our 60-LB German Shepherd AND our 40-LB we-have-no-clue-what-she-is dog have both choked on various shapes & sizes of rawhides. The Shepherd choked so badly that, this time, it wouldn't come up. She couldn't cough & started to literally choke to death. I actually straddled her back, attempting the only thing I  knew how to do - the human Heimlich Maneuver! Like where exactly is a dog's sternum, anyway? Well, I tried anyway and thank God it finally did dislodge & we got it out! Was it the Heimlich? I don't know. Probably not. I mean, she still won't tell me... After all, I guess it was very traumatic for her.But in all seriousness, what I do know, is that was the last time any of my dogs have had any kind of regular rawhide bones! Which, I really wanted to let everyone know of my personal experiences; I believe anybody who is at all concerned about giving their dogs rawhides and/or experiencing a similar problem is on the right track to avoid them.Our small part Chihuawa/part something else, first 2 times in-a-row, threw up repeatedly w/rawhide pieces and w/foam. He was VERY sick the 3rd time, so we definitely stopped that! The ONLY kind I did finally take a chance with were granulated rawhide munchy sticks, & they're all fine w/these; though I'm still nervous about them choking on a piece, but neither of them have had any problems with Boodas so far, & they don't swell up in their throats like regular rawhides.So, now... It's Booda Bones!Yes, they are a bit on the pricey side, especially for my 2 larger aggressive chewers. I agree with some other reviewers that they are not very long-lasting. But it's all I'll give them now. But, for my half Chihuahua/half something else(20lbs), I give him the smallest ones and they are like mega-saurus bones for him(it is my hope that the manufacturer will start selling these in bulk packages, for less $). I get 3 different sizes for my 3 different whatever-they-are-dogs. They absolutely love them! This includes the assorted flavors, the bacon-flavored, and the yogurt-flavored. Whichever is cheaper at the time and shipped by Amazon.And I owe a big thank you to Brian Amazon, all of you for all of your reviews, Booda Bones, and Amazon!** Confession: This was originally a comment I posted to a reviewer by the name of "Brian Amazon" a long time ago. I have been buying Bones from Amazon, and, only Booda Bones, ever since. They are so great that I've been wanting to write a review, & now finally have the chance to (I have, however, resorted to copying and pasting much of my original [brief... LOL] comment, with some editing).
My dog loves Booda Bones.  They are a bit pricy so I only give him a couple a week as a special treat.  I'll continue buying them from Amazon for the best price.

We have a dog with a liver shunt - so she can't have a lot of protein / can't digest protein.  Booda Bones are the BEST treat for her (and our other dog loves them as well!).  The only 'downside' whatsoever is that they're a tad expensive - but they're worth it!

column9: More of a treat then something to keep your dog busy.
column10: Let me start by saying our dogs love these. As soon as they see the bag they stop whatever they're doing and run to their crates (where we typically give these to them). However, for our dogs these are definitely more of a treat then an activity. I have one dog who is an aggressive chewer who finishes these in under five minutes. He doesn't chew them as much as bite of chunks of it. My other dog isn't quite as strong of a chewer but it usually takes her just around fifteen minutes to eat the whole thing (this review is specific to the Biggest Boodas). So for my dogs this is less of a chewing experience and more of a treat. And when the eat them this quickly, they do get expensive quick.

My dog loves the chicken, steak, and peanut butter booda bones, but he's not as fond of the spearmint/peppermint variety.  My dog will eat it if offered, but my dad's dog who I often sit for will not even touch these.  I wouldn't recommend for a dog who prefers meat.

column9: My dogs have rated Booda Bones 5 Stars!
column10: I have three King Charles Cavalier Spaniels and they are picky, picky eaters even when it comes to Treats.  They love the peanut flavored Booda Bones and have one every day.  They insisted I write this review on Amazon so their opinions could be known.  They're pushy that way...

column9: We're talking about Diet Coke -- not the price!
column10: Okay.  I love to find good deals as much as anyone else.  But that's not the best use of the Amazon reviews!You can see the price of an item on Amazon right there on the computer screen.  I can see it.  Everyone can see it.  It's no secret.  What's more, it's pretty easy to compare prices online -- I don't need Amazon reviewers to tell me that they can pick it up for half the price at WalGreen or WalMart or WalWherever.  What I can't see from the little pictures on the screen (or taste, smell, touch, or hear) is the actual thing-for-sale.  I want to know about your **experience** of the item.  Does it smell funny?  Is it smaller (or bigger) than claimed?  Were the instructions impossible to follow?  You get the idea.I don't see the harm in mentioning that you found an item for less money somewhere else in the review -- but the actual review star-rating should be about the product itself.  When you give a multi-million (billion?) dollar product like Diet Coke a one-star rating it makes the Amazon reviews appear foolish and unreliable.  Half the world drinks Diet Coke.Furthermore, the price might be high for you of the pedestrian class but for those of us who can't get around all that easily getting Diet Coke delivered to our door for 45 cents per can is a lot cheaper than paying $1.50 - $2.00 each at the pop machine in the lobby (at the corner, etc.)  Shipping costs aren't free and Amazon isn't a charity.  I think they've done a pretty darned good job of keeping shipping/boxing costs to a minimum and I love my Prime membership.  Soda pop is heavy.  So when some nice, smiling young man comes toting a big box of Diet Coke to my door come snow, sleet, locusts, or frogs, and says "Can I put that inside your door?" I think I am a truly blessed woman to live in such a day and age when such things are possible.And now, to take my own advice...Diet Coke is a classic American experience right up there with apple pie, baseball, and baseball parks that serve Diet Coke.  We like it a lot.  We drink it like crazy.  And I don't know anyone who doesn't already have an opinion about it, but I'm giving mine anyhow.  Five stars for Diet Coke!
