It is tastes primarily of chocolate and caramel.I really wished they work on the Hazelnut part.Nonetheless, I don't regret buying the box since they still taste very good.

I love these. The Hazlenut are my most favorite flavors. They have this outer chocolate shell and as you bite into the round chocolate sphere this yummy creamy chocolaty hazlenutty flavor comes out. This is a more expensive chocolate than that plain chocolate bars that you can buy at the check out aisle in the grocery store; but so worth it.

The quality of the chocolate is very high and the taste is great ... yes it's more expensive than your basic chocolate, but the taste is so much better ... give into your chocolate desires and buy these truffles!
I bought this as a birthday gift, and it went over fabulously. Said it was the best chocolate ever.  So, I will probably order as a gift again.

The product arrived with a slightly damaged box.  Perhaps they can come up with a more effective packaging.  I cared because it was a christmas gift for someone. The important candies, thamselves, were excellent!
Sambal Oelek is hands down the best chili paste out there. It is spicy but it is a different kind of heat than Tabasco for example. I put it on almost everything!

I can get this item, same product same size, for less than the case price here. A single jar cost less than one sixth of this price, and I don't have to pay shipping.Despite the pricing, this is the gold standard of chili sauce. I've tried many a brand, I've tried to make my own, but this is the winner by a mile.
This sauce is exactly what I was looking for.  Really hot so a little goes a long way.  Yummmmmmmmmm.

Very good producted, with poor package and shipping. I recieved 12 jars to get 9 good ones. The first order had one opened jar with the seal broken and the replacement order had two jars open with the seals broken.

First experience with this sauce was on vacation where it was used to saute vegetables for an omelet.  Definitely gets your attention!!!Great for adding to spaghetti sauce, sauteed vegetable, barbecue sauce, etc.  Have not tried in chili as yet.  To quote Emeril: "POW!"
OMG this stuff is so good. i know its is weird but i hate chocolate and love white chocolate and this is the best yet.

I have always had outstanding service and fresh product from Amazon.  Our last order of Kit Kat White Chocolate, Choclate Bars was received in a timely manner and in a fresh and undamaged condition.  Very satisfied with or experience.

Despite having just as much sugar as the troika of Kellogg's cereal that Moms hate but kids love (Corn Pops, Apple Jacks and Froot Loops), this escapes the bad press, probably because it doesn't contain the words Loops, Pops or Jacks which Moms seem to identify with artificial flavors (another Mom banned substance).So this is one of my favorite cereals that my Mom did not ban. (Kelloggs should learn from this and relabel the banned troika as Mennonite Corn Cereal, Delicious Apple Cereal and Old Fashioned Fruit Cereal.) But the sugar isn't that bad, this 2.1oz cup contains 23g of sugar vs. 39g in a 12oz can of Coke, plus it contains a decent amount of vitamins and supplements. And anyway, no one can eat plain cereal without the sugar, even with the basic Kellogg's cereal, I have to add some sugar to it to make it palatable.I love this individual pack. It's very handy. You can carry it anywhere with you and all you need is a small carton of milk to make it a meal or a snack. And this individual pack prevents you from overeating it (unless you decide to eat 2-3 of them at once.) To get rid of the excess sugar, just peel back the lid a little and shake out the excess sugar of which there always is some.And who doesn't remember Tony the Tiger saying "They're Greeaaat!" Now that's some inspired advertising.So:Pros: Tastes great. Handy size. Convenient on the go. Name does not contain the words Pops, Jacks, or Loops, which Moms don't identify with real food.Cons: None.
Healthy Kellogs always always do it best. I'm enjoying it. You should always try to eat Frosted Flakes at least four times a week.

column9: So much easier on my babies tummy.
column10: When we switch my daughter from nursing to eating her first solid foods we started with rice cereal.  The misery that caused will be forever emblazoned on my memory.  Colic, gas, and it backed her up right proper.My wife and I started researching alternatives on the Internet.  We found a bunch of references to how Barley was easier on a tummy.  That Barley soup/broth is often what is given to people recovering in hospitals etc...  I went to every local store looking for some.  Family and friends that had used it used to buy it locally.  I couldn't find it anywhere.  I found it here on Amazon and bought this pack of 12 boxes.We found rather strongly that this was much easier on my daughters tummy.  She continued to eat without distress after we made the switch.  We started using it just as cereal and then as she got older we started using it as a thickening agent and filler when mixed with pureed vegetables etc...  She liked things better when they were less runny and we liked things better when she was happy.We will be ordering more here shortly for the twins that have now joined our family.  For us it worked great.  I really do recommend it as a far better option that rice cereal.

column9: gerber barley cereal - very healthy choice for a baby
column10: Healthy choice for my baby, very convenient package, easy to prepare, my baby loves it, no added milk or fruit, which may either spoil the real taste of the product, or cause allergic reaction. Best choice for busy parents.
These boxes are smaller than the size I normally buy in the store but I think that's a bonus.  They stay fresh longer since they are sealed.  Great product.
I have to say, I'm definitely looking for a deal when it comes to baby food and this is one. Compared to the store prices even with coupons, buying by the case is a great buy.

column9: My son's 2 and this is still his preferred breakfast
column10: I mix cereal, cheese & hot milk, and my son gobbles up his breakfast.I find this to be the best when compared to nutritional value when compared with Rice, Wheat or Mixed grain.

column9: Good Nutrition, Doesn't Like The Taste Much
column10: It's good and filling for my child but when given to him by itself he doesn't like the flavor. I usually mix it with a banana but I have recently started to buy the mixed fruit cereal which is sweet and mixing one pack of each and that seems to do the trick. Plus, the oatmeal is cheaper than the mix fruit so it lasts longer :-)

column9: Easier online, no deal on price
column10: I purchased this product online because I couldn't find it in the stores at that time (2 days later it was in the store also). It's good that comes quick, save a trip to the store, however, no deal on the price; same as Walmart, Kroger, etc.

column9: 50c per box more expensive than stores
column10: I purchased this product online because I couldn't find it in the stores at that time (2 days later it was in the store also). It's good that comes quick, save a trip to the store, however, the price is so much higher than Walmart, Kroger, etc (50c per box more expensive, total 7$ more expensive than the stores)

column9: Gerber is always the best food for baby
column10: My baby loves this cereal. He is allergic to many foods, but with Gerber I can be sure that there are no hidden ingredients. EAsy to prepare, easy to keep fresh, convenient packaging. I highly recommend it to the parents as one of the first foods for a baby.

the only reason I purchased this on amazon is because I could not find it in the stores and the pediatrician had recommended it for my infant grandson.  It does not disolve well and tends to clump up in the nipple.

I keep Gerber 'Mixed' and 'Barley' on hand all the time. The 'mixed' consists of rice, oat and wheat so I mix a box of that with a box of the 'barley' and have a completely balanced breakfast cereal. I don't use it for people: I keep it handy for when the dogs have upset tummies and their regular food is too harsh on their digestive systems and they need soft, easy to digest food that fills them up and is healthy for them.  As their tummies return to normal, I reduce the baby cereal a bit and add in some of their normal foods and as they continue to improve, the baby cereal gets reduced while their normal foods eventually return to full bore.This is good for them, too, after dental cleanings/extractions, surgeries, when they need a little help in the 'bowel' department (fiber), or just as an added treat to change it up a bit in their daily diet.I have used this in place of bread crumbs when making a meatloaf (ok, I was desperate), but didn't care for the texture of the meatloaf once cooked. It was too soft for our liking, but still quite tasty.

Before I ordered these, I had never had white chocolate covered espresso beans. I always enjoyed the dark chocolate variety so I decided to give these a try.Quantity: First, the quantity is great. On my order, my "case of 24" actually contained 26 individual packs. I don't know if this is always the case, but it was a nice bonus for me. Little actions like this go a long way when winning over my customer loyalty. Each bag is also 2oz but I think there is actually more in each package than this. The entire shipping weight was over 4lbs so you do the math there! A+ here.Packing: The individual packaging is fine, albeit a little plain. Each pack has a UPC but not whole in the top, so if you are shelving this for resale, you will have to put a hole in it to shelve these. Not a big deal, but worth noting at least. B- here.Taste: Now here is the important part. These beans are some of the most delicious I have ever tried. They taste like a vanilla coffee drink (due to the pure vanilla in the white chocolate) and they taste absolutely delicious! I will try to just eat one or two at a time but that never seems to happen. The espresso beans taste fresh and have a smooth, roasted flavor. I also think the sweetness of the white chocolate offsets the bitter coffee taste better than any other variety I have ever tried (dark chocolate, milk chocolate, etc.)  A++ here.Overall, if you love espresso bean candy -- BUY THESE NOW!
This product is great if you're looking for a sweet syrup.  It's great in soda.  I've tried Torani, but it has a tartness that I just don't like. DaVinci is the best IMO for making cherry cokes.

Cherry Coke Zero, cherry limeade, cherry topping..... this is just a bit of the unnecessary to make a luxury out of something so simple.  Great taste and good value.  The bottles are plastic and shipped well.  I gave one bottle to my son and he also loves it.

I took cooking classes in Thailand and have tried just about every Panang Curry Paste sold in the United States. If I don't have time to make my own curry paste, this is my go-to product. It stores well for at least 6 months in the fridge after opening and tastes great! Plus it doesn't have MSG like some of the other canned curry pastes out there. Give it a try!

I normally use loose tea rather than tea bags since it tends to be less expensive and more flavorful. But on occasion it's more convenient to use a tea bag. These make a very nice cup of tea - good black tea flavor, strong but not overpowering. One bag per 8 oz of water comes out just right for me.I like that it comes in a round bag without any strings or wrapping - easier to use, less waste, and easier to compost.Definitely a step up in taste from the usual bagged decaf, such as Liptons, and much better than store brand decaf black teas. Excellent value if you can get it on sale.
This is the only tea I drink now.  Great hot or cold.  I use only 4 bags for 3 qts of water in my Mr. Coffe Ice Tea maker and still get a nice pot of ice tea.

I drink over 2 quarts of decaf iced-tea a day, and order "regular unsweetened" ice-tea at each restaurant we go to.  After tasting hundreds of different teas, this is the ultimate, and it's decaf.  It's just so much better than your typical store-bought tea.  It's rich, flavorful, and refreshing.

column9: My favorite black tea - in decaf!  You can have it all!
column10: I have always loved Tetley's British Blend black tea.  Great flavor, robust, but not bitter.  My only problem is, being pregnant, I've really been limiting my caffeine intake.I had not been able to find Tetley's British Blend tea in decaffeinated at any store I've visited.  Online I go, and once again, Amazon saves the day for me!Very pleased with this tea, same great flavor without the 'buzz'.  Enjoy - pinkies out!

We enjoy the Tetley British Blend Decaf Tea very much. Our local stores stopped carrying the decaf. We ended up with a subscription for a regular interval delivery. We like the stronger taste and the convience of automatic delivery.

column9: Tetley decaf: More tea in each tea bag
column10: It only took 2 tea bags to make our usual pot of tea instead of 3 of the tea bags with tags on. Also larger area steeps in the round design.  Appears to have more tea leaves in each unit too.  Will buy again with standing order delivery.
I have searched for a delicious blend of decaf tea and had found none until I brewed a cup of this tea and to my satisfaction I had discovered a delicious full body cup of tea. My  search is over.
Very good, smooth tasting tea.  I love it.  I'm sensitive to caffeine, too (another review), and it's fine for me. I never get tired of it.
We had a really hard time finding a decaf tea that tasted good.  This tea is good and it tastes as good as a caffeinated tea.  We are going to continue to buy this product.

Im a tea addict and for certain reasons I've had to stop having caffeinated tea....this has been the only tea I could enjoy! I brew it with mint and everyone enjoys it so much, they've taken some teabags home with them! They didn't even notice that it isn't caffeinated! I higjhly recommend.

Do not be fooled by the "British Blend" label, this is not British tea! We Brits like our tea with a lot of flavour. I frequently purchase Tetleys decaf tea in the UK and this does not even compare. It is weak and tasteless and even doubling the amount of tea bags per cup doesn't work. Perhaps the regular decaf is better but in my opinion, if you like a more full bodied tea experience,this is not for you.
very tasty and well priced with fast delivery. tea was fresh and well packaged. just need an authentic tea-pot to let it infuse.
I agree with some others, it is a very weak tea. I mix in a green tea or other herbal tea (I can't drink those on their own) and it becomes drinkable.. but on it's own, it is very weak.

column9: IT'S A MUST HAVE IN OUR HOUSE.
column10: Once I switched from Lipton to Tetley tea we go through so much iced tea because we all love it.  So, we switched to decaf and we like it even better.  If you haven't tried Tetley for iced tea, you really need to.  Not all stores carry decaf, so ordering it on Amazon is less expensive and easier.
a favorite.....Tetley tea's British decaffeinated blend is now at the top of my list of favorite teas - both hot and cold.
I am a big fan of teas. White tea is my favorite and Tetley is next. The flavor and aroma of both  teas are outstanding.

This tea has a nice taste but is not very decaffinated. My husband has rather significant reactions caffinated beverages. I thought this would be a step up in quality from the local decaffeinated tea from the grocery store. It is a nice blend from a taste angle but left the consumer with vertigo - dizzy, headache and nausia. In fairness to the tea he tried it a second time and had the same reaction. If you are looking for a less caffinated tea this might be fine but it is certainly not decaffeinated.

column9: this is english tea - from virginia ?
column10: it was ENGLISH tea - i expected it to be made in UK - the decaf was 3 bags to every pot - terrible

column9: Lower in sodium, yes. LOW sodium? NO!
column10: This tastes just like the regular soy sauce but if you're looking to reduce sodium, keep in mind that a serving (15g or about .5 ounce) is 575mg of sodium. Don't be fooled by the "lower sodium" label.

column9: Too much of a good thing
column10: This product is hard to find in the stores where I live. So, I went ahead and ordered the multi-pack. This should keep me in soy sauce for a couple of years! Glad I did though because I have used the heck out of it.

If you're going mainstream with your coffee, Peet's is the way to go. It's not burned, has a great robust flavor that doesn't get watered down by simple additions. There's nothing more annoying than making a should-be strong cup, adding a little half-and-half and then wondering where the flavor of your coffee went. Peet's has a large assortment of grounds as well, which is nice if you're the type that likes to venture from the ordinary with different traditional coffees. I used to drink Starbucks, but their coffee is routinely burned and acidic. This is well-rounded in comparison and strong, without being too bitter.
smoky delicious with aroma that I am looking for.  I drink it hot in black with blue agave.  3 full teaspoons in 4-5 oz of hot water.  Works well with French press or dripping.  Great coffee anytime!

column9: Le Village Black Label Papillon Roquefort
column10: The first reviewer must not have much experience with Roquefort cheese they are ALL salty! I have eaten many different varieties of this luscious cheese and this is by far the best I have tasted.  Pair a couple of thick slices of this well-marbled cheese with grapes, sliced apples and other fruits plus a nice wine (white is my preference). You can eat this as is or make fromage forte by adding 1 tbsp of butter, 1 pack of Philly Cream cheese, as well as grated cheddar, mix well with a fork and spread on crackers. Delicious! I will purchase again. What a great Roquefort!

The half-wheel Papillon Roquefort arrived via FedEx chilled, using reusable chilling packs (Hello, injured athletes), reusable foil bag, reusable durable carton.  The taste and and fall apart creamy cheese texture are indeed supreme; however, this Roquefort cheese's lingering taste is that of being over-salted.  The salt simply overwhelms Roquefort's purpose; creamy bulk, distinct blue breaks.  This product would go well with group wine or beer tastings, crumbled over salad or pasta.  I rate the product 5 stars, as not all eaters share my aversion to preservative salting, and not all eaters have experienced Roquefort Francais.Clint Williams

Arrived by mail on time. Still chilled. Ready to eat. Tasted just like purchased in France. Was a bit expensive. But worth it for the taste!French Roquefort Cheese - Black Label - Half Wheel - AOC - Approx. 3Lbs
they arrived on time but dont quite melt as advertised required much stiring and left something of a sludge at the bottom of the cup
I love coffee, I love mochas, I love amaretto.This product however was disgusting !!!

I love bunny fruits, I've been looking for a vegetarian alternative to gummy bears for years, now I can have guilt free candy. They are utterly delicious, you won't want to let the kids near them.Nom Nom Nom

While these are a little pricey they are well worth every penny.  The organic aspect is nice but what really is wonderful is the lack of artificial dye.  I know, you're wondering so how are they colored if there is no dye?  Well they use all natural things, tumeric, black carrots.  Sounds gross right?  I totally thought so as well when I first read the ingredient list but I've always been happy with Annie's products and one of my sons has some behavior issues that are really effected by certain dyes, plus they just aren't very good for any of us, so I decided to give them a try.My entire family is hooked!  The texture is softer than most gummy candies yet you still get a nice chewy experience.  The hardest thing is to remember that these are more of a candy than just a snack.  It's easy to fall into the "healhty' trap and forget that although these are soooooo much better for you than most gummies, they still are a gummy candy snack.

These are yummy, fruity treat.  Can't beat the fact that it's made with mostly organic ingredients, no artificial colors or flavors... it's what my husband and I eat when we are in the mood for fruit candy and it does the trick.

These rabbits were outstanding in taste and vibrant fruit taste. We had rabbits for over 20 years and so everyone in our family loved the shapes. The variety of flavors were all very tasty and very real tasting. Buy some you will like it.

I got these and they came melted and the caramel was sticking to the entire wrapper and took mins to eat one. I made a huge mess as well and became all sticky. This makes me think twice about buying this type of stuff online now.

I have a 12 year old golden retriever.  I have been feeding him Happy Hips treats for almost a year hoping the glucosamine helps with his arthritis.  He eats the treats like crazy.  I like the fact they are apple, banana, chicken and sweet potato.  They are healthier than store bought treats.  I have the same hope for the chicken & oats dry dog food. This dog food came the other day, I cut the bag open to dump it into a plastic tub and by mistake I tipped it over a little and some of it went scattered all over the floor.  Well, my dog with the arthrtis jumped right up and cleaned up the floor in no time, tried sticking his head in the bag and then wagged his tale licking my face.  If this is as good as the treats, I know it will help with his arthritis.  Amazon is the cheapest I have found for this food, plus the free shipping is a bonus.  I bought mine when Amazon had a 20 percent promotion so it was an added bonus.  Thanks Dogswell and Amazon.

Because of allergies to wheat and corn I decided to give Dogswell products a try. This is the first dry dog food my dogs will eat without adding gravy or meat or veggies or leftovers and they do so eagerly. It smells good enough for me to eat and they haven't scratched since they started on this product. Amazon's price is cheaper than I can get locally so not only is the food good, it's a bargain at that. I love you Amazon!

I was so happy to find this product online, it is difficult to find consistently in stores.  My two dogs showed noticeable improvement (after 2 weeks) from stiff joints.  A healthy 15 year old with the expected stiff hips and a romping 9 year old who has dry joints (who doesn't?).  They both love the taste and I'm happy not to have to crunch up the supplements into their food everyday.  I love the healthy ingredients and lack of fillers, I believe that is why my dogs live long lives. I put it on auto ship!  Yay! No more trips for the forgotten dog food!!  Thanks Amazon!

Really like this dog food. I am aware of what goes in pet food but I am also on a limited income so finding good quality pet food at a reasonable price was challenging. Glad I found this product and my dogs love it! Their coats are shiny and soft. Thanks Dogswell!

It's simple really, My dog is a very picky eater, not to mention she's allergic to so many things. We tried a lot of the name brand dog foods out there (Iams, Avoderm, Science Diet). Nothing worked, so then one night when she was out of food I went to the store and grabbed two small bags of dog food. Happy Hips was one of them. She immediately wanted to smell the bag right after opening it (which she never did before), and as soon as we put it in her bowl she devoured it. With all of the dog food we had previously given her we always had to mix it with something just to get her to eat it, that wasn't the case with Happy Hips, she ate it dry the first night and is still eating it dry 2 months later. She always got bored with the other dog food, after a couple weeks she would stop eating and/or put her nose up to it. She doesn't do that with Happy Hips. She absolutely loves it. Plus it's all natural and made in the U.S.A. You pay more for it, but it's well worth it. If you have never given this to your dog, it may be best to start them off with 4 pound bag or find somewhere you can get a free sample. But I would strongly recommend this to anyone who has a dog. I have also found that Amazon is so far the cheapest place to buy this dog food, and when I buy it, I get the free shipping as well.

I first found this product about a year ago through their free "mini-bag" giveaway. Nookie, my malamute, is a large dog that is susceptible to hip issues. I first had switched her over to the Happy Hips formula and saw that she walked without a limb for the first time in over a year. This took about six months, but was noticeable after about 4 months of eating Happy Hips. I was so pleased with the outcome that I transitioned my smaller, older dog to Happy Hips. My little dog, Steeler, was having back issues as she is getting older. After about 6 months eating Happy Hips, she is out running around like a puppy...she is now 13 years old. I would recommend this product to anyone who has a pet with joint problems or may have those issues later down the road.

column9: Very Satisfied with this dog food
column10: Our dog kept shedding really bad so we switched to this food and it has basically stopped her shedding!  We love the price of it since we have a large dog and go thru a bag a month.  We will recommend this dog food to others.

column9: Happy Hips Dog food is a life saver
column10: My dog can't walk with out this dog food!  I am not sure what is in it but she starts limping if she is without it for longer thatn a day or so!  I am so thankful to find it on Amazon.Dogswell Happy Hips for Dogs, Chicken & Oats Dry Dog Food, 22.5-Pound Bag

I was leary of tryin a new food for my 15 yr old dog. She has been on a prescription food for a sensitive stomach for 2 years. Happy to report this food has not upset her stomach and she running like a puppy again!!
My dog, a corgi mix (~ 28lbs) loves the food. His coat looks really good.I switched from his old food without any issues.
I highly recommend this food and the treats as well.  All dogs like it and it is really good for them.

I bought a small bag of this on sale, by mistake at Pavillions but when I went back it was not in stock. I searched it out on line as Jake loves it... Mysteriously his limping has all but vanished.There is no non nutritious corn filler,,, and lots of chondroitin and glucosamine ... and I don't have to carry it in and out of my car.... YAY

column9: This food really made a difference in my dog's joint health/pain
column10: My dog was 8+yrs old when I first bought Happy Hips by Dr. Dogswell for him to try - within a week my dog went from stumbling and walking slow, and occasionally buckling in the front shoulders during tight turns, to frisking like the younger dog he used to be - no buckling, back to a trotting gait, and no evidence of pain!  I've kept him on the food for the past two years, occasionally mixing in other food for variety - but this stuff really made a difference for my dog, so I'm swearing by it and recommending it to others.  I had been supplementing his previous food (Pedigree) with expensive pills that promised improved joint health, and they never seemed to do anything.  Now my dog is just primarily eating the Dr. Dogswell food (no supplements, but occasional mixing in of Newman's Own or Rachel Ray's food for variety) and he's still doing great.
My dog has had problems with his cruciate ligaments and this food seems to help him.  He also loves the taste!

I am delighted with this food. It looks nice, smells really great, has a smaller size kibble for my old dog's teeth, and comes in a ziplock pouch. More importantly though, my old dog who was getting a little lame has suddenly gotten frisky again since starting on this chow. We have also noticed that the terrible flatulence he had daily is gone too. To be fair, at the same time I switched his wet food to Harmony Foods, so that may also be a factor. I am extremely happy with this food and will continue to buy it.

column9: My 10 year old Dachshund acts like a puppy again.
column10: following through on a recommendation for Happy Hips was the best thing for my aging Fritz.  He's so painfree & agile now.  I love the result & he does, too.

After watching my dog sufffer from itchy skin for 5 years and hundreds of dollars on useless VET bills, I finally figured out that my dog had food allergies. Go figure..... HAPPY HIPS makes my baby very happy which in turn makes me VERY happy......

column9: Happy Hips makes my dog happy
column10: My dog loves this dog food - i had to switch her from another joint supplement food because of unavailability issues - and Lucy loves this!!

My dog is very picky about her food and she has a lot of itching problems.  We have been told many time that her skin problems may have something to do with her diet.  We have tried many types of food, but this one seems to work best.  She really likes it and, although itching problem hasn't gone away, it does seem a little better. I am no health food expert, but based on what I am told by some Vets, this is a healthy product.  Final assessment: The extra cost of this food is worth the benefits of her eating more regularly; that she is eating a healthier food; and her itching seems to be somewhat relieved.  Also, I like having the bag delivered to my house at no charge in 2 days.  Schlepping big bag of dog food from the pet store  to my house is a pain.

column9: My Juvie, Standing With Comfort, at Last!
column10: I was looking for dog food from Amazon.com so I wouldn't have to drive so far when I noticed this Happy Hips dog food.  I take care of my daughter's dog.  She lives in an apartment with her cat and couldn't take this sweet chow mix home with her when as a stray she entered her work place and make a bee line right to my daughter.  We are all dog people and so she asked me to take in another stray.  Soon after our little Juvie began to drag herself around.  We took her into the vets and her hips are really out of whack.  There was nothing we could do or afford.  She seemed happy but very inactive.  After I began feeding her the Happy Hip, which she loves, she began standing more and even playing with the new puppy.  I began feeding my other dog (he is two years old now), mixing the old food with the Happy Hips.  He will eat all the Happy Hips and leave the old food until I admonish him to finish his dinner.  Both dogs are really happy with Happy Hips.
I love this dog food and so do our 2 pekes.  I love how moist the food is.  Normal kibble is very dry.
Our "senior" dog quit limping around(arthritis) after a week or so of eating this stuff! Plus the bits are a good size, like marbles, not too big like some foods we've bought in the past.

column9: My dog enjoys it and it helps her hips.
column10: My dog was diagnosed with hip dysplasia as a 6-month old puppy.  The vet said it was the worst case he'd seen in a puppy her age and we were told that she wouldn't be able to walk by the time she was three if we didn't have an expensive surgery done.  I've tried various supplements and foods over the years and although she may sway a bit when walking and tire easily she's now 8 years old and we frequently go on short hikes together.I started feeding her Happy Hips about 4 months ago.  Since that time I've cut out any other supplements and paid close attention to how she does.  She readily eats the food and doesn't gorge herself when eating.  She seems to have more energy and stamina now.  I don't want to push her too hard but last weekend I took her on a 4 mile hike over aggressive terrain, much more than we normally do, she led the pack the whole way and even jumped in the truck quickly when we were done.  In the past I've had to lift her into the truck at the end of any hikes.  She spent the rest of the day sleeping but the next day was up and going again.  Overall I'm very impressed with my dog's health and since this has been her food over the last several months it has to be a factor in how she's doing.  I originally was going to rate this 4 stars but really have not complaints at all and my pup is doing great so I upped it to 5 stars.As a side note I read reviews online before feeding my dog this food and found that it is rated well by a few independent review sites.

I suppose that when you use loose flowers you get sediment in the cup and I have seen this happen with some brands of chamomile tea bags, these don't do that.I have also had organic chamomile (this isn't) but I can't taste the difference.Each bag is individually packaged and that is either good or bad depending on how and where you use it and if you are concerned about excessive packaging.If you like chamomile tea, this is a good choice.

column9: Olive oil sent was made in the year 2000.
column10: Yes, that is correct. I buy many things on amazon, and 99 percent of the time it is good. I checked the code on bottom of the can and it was made in 2000. As I writing this it is 04/08/2011. Olive oil does not get better with age in a tin can. I went on the zoe website to see how to read the code on the bottom of the can. On the zoe website click on blog at the top right hand side. It had on my cans the l= lot number, 00= year olive oil was made. I called Amazon right away to report this to them, and explained where I found this information. They agreed with me and issued me a complete refund. I don't blame Amazon for these old olive oil cans, but I do blame Zoe (New York City based Company). They supply Amazon, nationwide and slipped some old stock through thinking no one would notice. Guess what I'm from New York City , I know how these guys operate. Zoe may be good Olive oil , but check the codes often. You can find the code information on any Company website.
Excellent taste and smell, great for dipping and salads.  I hope the word doesn't get out too much, the price has been amazing for this quality

column9: Good oil. Info re. Mfg dates...
column10: Good olive oil.From the Zoe website blog:___________________________We have a new lot code system, which was brought into effect this year. Here's how to decipher them:The first four digits identify the bulk lot number.The next two digits are the year that the oil was bottled, and the final three digits correspond to the day of the year that the oil was bottled, using the Julian calendar.For example, if you come across the following lot code on the bottom of your tin, this is how you would decipher it:L-000111052Bulk Lot: 0001Bottling Year: 11Julian date: 052 (February 21st)This means that the oil was bottled on Feb 21st of 2011. It doesn't expire until the end of Feb, 2013!!Olive oil is good for at least TWO YEARS from the bottling date, and can last for longer if it is stored properly (away from direct sunlight, at room temperature).

column9: Excellent Olive Oil at An Outstanding Price...
column10: As someone who bakes breads almost every other day, I use a lot of olive oil during baking and when eating the finished product.  I saw the Zoe Extra Virgin Olive Oil as a Gold Box special, read the reviews, and decided to give it a try.  The oil arrived promptly, was well packaged, and there was no damage to the tins.This olive oil has a nice golden color, a lush mouth-feel, and a pleasant peppery after-bite.  The olive flavor is distinct, but not over powering - something that makes it nice for individuals who prefer a milder taste.  In my opinion, the actual taste was a bit nutty - but taste is subjective and very individual, so you must judge that aspect of this oil yourself.When using this oil as a part of my Italian Butter, I did cut the ground black pepper componant so that the other ingredients were not overwhelmed by the pepper taste.  That recipe takes 12 ounces of oil, pepper to taste (usually 6 turns of the grinder), ground sea salt (6 turns), 2 garlic cloves grated on a zester or crushed,  Mince 1 1 /2 teaspoons each of fresh oregno, fresh rosemary, and of fresh sweet basil.  Add all to the oil and allow to steep for several days before using.Unlike better oils, Zoe Extra Virgin Olive Oil does not give a harvest date or a specific location from which the olives originated.  If you are an olive oil afficianado, this is something that may concern you.  However, if you are looking for an excellent olive oil, at an outstanding price you should give Zoe a try.  I found this to be equal to Costco's Kirkland Extra Virgin Olive Oil in the 1 liter bottle.

I just got off the phone with a Zoe representative and she was more than helpful explaining how to read the expiration date on the bottom of the can....Here goes  The "L" stands for lot and the next 4 digits are the specific factory location in Spain (it helps them not us) the next two digits are the year it was made and the last three digits (or two) are the julian date...(for example  May 1 would be "121" or October 13 would be "286" Here is the link to an online julian calander if you need it....[...]  So a code on the bottom of L  123411286  would be canned on October 13, 2011.....Hope this clears up any confusion....Oh by the way I loooove the oil for the price...are there better oils out there? All of them are distorted..as if melted and cooled. It's almost impossible to get the foil "out of" some of them. Those go in the trash. I have yet to find even one that looks normal and didn't have some gray on it.What causes chocolate to become gray?"Sugar bloom is normally caused by surface moisture. The moisture causes the sugar in the chocolate to dissolve. Once the moisture evaporates, sugar crystals remain on the surface. If this process is repeated, the surface can become sticky and even more discolored. Although sugar bloom is most often the result of overly humid storage, it can happen when the chocolate has been stored at a relatively cool temperature and is then moved too quickly into much warmer surroundings. When this happens, the chocolate sweats, producing surface moisture.Fat bloom is similar to sugar bloom, except that it is fat or cocoa butter that is separating from the chocolate and depositing itself on the outside of the candy. As with sugar bloom, the most common causes of fat bloom are quick temperature changes and overly-warm storage.Although it might look a little less appetizing than a lustrous, rich chocolatey-brown piece of candy, chocolate that has suffered bloom is still okay to eat. You may find the texture of sugar-bloomed chocolate to be a bit grainy on the outside, but it should still taste good. To prevent this from happening to your chocolate, simply use proper storage methods."Guess I'll be returning this.

Tassimo was very popular and had a great selection of coffee when it first came out.  I drink regular coffee and that's usually what's in our regular coffee maker at home.  My wife, however, prefers decaf, so she uses the Tassimo to brew it when she wants coffee.  Previously, she liked to drink the Gevalia decaf for Tassimo, but that product is no longer available.She reports that this product tastes good - and she would buy it again.

The Tassimo pro duct in itself has become too expensive.  The coffee is only "fair". I drink the cappuchino and it is very difficult to find and. very costly.  Cant wait for another coffeemaker to come out with a new product that does lattes and cappuchinos.

Tassimo really hit it out of the park when it partnered with Maxwell House!  Both decaf and regular coffees are excellent choices, but I am especially impressed with the rich flavor of their decaf. I don't understand why this is, but I actually prefer Maxwell House BETTER from a T-Disk than from my drip coffee maker!  And at Amazon's price of $27 for 5 pkgs of 16 ct t-disks, it's half what I would have to pay locally.  What more could a girl ask for?!

If you feel like coffee in the evening but worry about the affects of caffeine, then this is your alternative. great tasting coffee without the hassles. Prices went up quite a bit recently, but at Amazon.com this is still a great deal.
For the price this coffee is hard to beat unless you need exotic flavors and deep roasted blends -  a good everyday drink

I just love this coffee.  Had problems choosing a blend that fit me and this one does.  Because of a health problem, I had to drink decaf coffee.  Most didn't make it for me but Maxwell house did.  Thanks.
It came right when it was supposed to. Well packaged. Nearly half the price I normally pay at retail stores!
The Brand speaks for itself.  Tassimo Discs make for a good cup of coffee anytime.  Buying the 5 pack saves you a bunch of money.
My husband and I both love this coffee. We now enjoy a cup of decaf almost every evening. I would definitely recommend it.

They sell cups containing 1/3 the coffee that Starbucks filled in its cups, and except the same flavor.  Of course, it fails.  This manufacturer continues to disregard the decaf coffee drinkers.  No wonder, Kuerig beats them, hands down.
This was a first for me.  I found the product full flavored and use it every day.  It was a good value.

I usually stop at half-cup (a complete automatic brew makes a 11 oz. cup).  Even then, though, I'm still disappointed with the lack of aroma and taste.  I'm now stuck with 75 more of these suckers to go.
This Limburger - with onions on dark bread - makes as wonderful sandwich as I remember from my youth. Dad loved Limburger and passed his love to me, no matter what Larry the Cable Guy says.
This cheese for some reason is hard to find in my area (Chico to Sacramento) and found this online and ordered four cubes. Great fast shipping and really good tasting cheese.

PERFECTION......This cheese is the REAL thing....I am part German and my mother taught me well. It is the freshest date and you can let it mature to your own taste choice....if you are able to wait that long! I bought 2, so I ate one right away!!!!!!! I would marry this product if that were legal. Love It!
The taste was great the cheese was really dry on the outside instead of having a soft removalbe shell.  Overall, it was what I was craving.

I received the package after great communication with the seller. Everything was well packaged and shipped fast. The cheese itself was fantastic. I actually ordered 7 packages for a friend but kept 1 package and it was delicious I will order it again.
Great coffee, terrific price--plus it is organic, shade grown, and benefits the Audubon Society.  What's not to like?

My husband is American and since we met in the Middle East, He loved the Turkish coffee taste when he first tried it in Iraq and Jordan. I was trying to get him the same flavor of the cardamom. This product is just great. I now keep a bottle beside the stove and use it all the time. I love to roast veggies and have been using this to coat them before I put them in the oven. Such a great flavor!!
This tea was great! Perfect for the Bridal Shower Tea Party we held. And it was easy because it was INSTANT.

column9: nice flavor but too strong for me
column10: I enjoyed this tea a lot, once I doubled the water content.  When I used the right amount of water, it was just too strong for my liking.  But once I figured out how much water I wanted to add, it was very tasty.

With the clear wrappers, they are perfect for what we needed.  They are being used in a candy gift box at each place setting for a wedding reception.  The smell just like the old candies that I remember from my childhoood and taste great!
I had this at a friend's holiday party, and it was very tasty. I purchased the Mini Popcorn 8-ounce canister for another friend as a stocking stuffer. it was very well received.

My go to hot summer drink is homemade iced cappucino.  I make espresso in my espresso maker, pour it in equal parts with whole milk over a glass filled with ice cubes.  No need for sugar.  Equal streams of milk and espresso, mingling in the glass.  No caffeine needed after my morning mug, so this works just right.
I've been getting imported Italian coffee beans for years now for my morning cappucchino. I decided to try Starbucks beans and I'm very impressed.

One of my favorite Starbucks coffee blends without question. You will fall in love with the Espresso blend as soon as you open the bag and smell the wonderful aroma of the beans. This coffee brews a delicious cup of Joe. It also makes a wonderful iced coffee.
This is my favorite morning Starbucks coffee.  It's a nice roast - not to sweet, not too bitter, perfectly dark.  It always arrives fresh and ready to brew.  I highly recommend this roast!

I placed my order on a Sunday and it was on my door step by Tuesday morning.  The coffee itself is a favorite.  It makes a wonderful cup of espresso!  Robust body, rich and smooth, never bitter.  You'll want to nibble the beans right out of the bag they smell soooooo good.

column9: I sprinkle this stuff on everything but Ice Cream!

column9: Superior quality and fantastic customer service!
column10: I have been purchasing these mushrooms for years by driving to specialty stores in either NYC or Philadelphia.  Even including shipping, this is the best price I have ever seen on these mushrooms! I even received an e-mail telling me shipping may be delayed due to Hurricane Wilma, But still got the product in less than a week! I paid more than double this in a famous Philadelphia cheese shop, and the quality wasn't as good as this! I will definitely be doing more business with this company!!

Absolutely excellent! I use Procini's all the time. The quality of these are first rate. In addition, the quantity of these are such that the value is high...no more will I buy little bags in the grocery store.

Most reviewers seem to agree the quality of these mushrooms will add that special magic to any dish requiring their use. There is a decent ratio of whole mushrooms to stems. I assume the more expensive Grade 'Extra AA' offering by JR Mushrooms has more mushroom cap slices instead of so many stems.As dried mushrooms have a very long shelf life buying them in bulk makes sense to anyone who like me loves to spontaneously prepare a good Porcini based Ragu Sauce, Polenta or Risotto but cringes at driving to the local supermarket to pay $6.99 an ounce for a skimpy cellophane bag of mushroom bits. This company shipped my order to the West Coast in what seemed to be overnight delivery. I will certainly be a repeat customer and will no doubt be preparing more recipes that include the wonderful flavor of dried Porcini mushrooms selected from my big gallon bag. Enjoy!

column9: Keep for ever, taste great, excellent quality
column10: I grew up up in a family that loved mushrooms, so I love using them in my cooking.  Dried mushrooms are convenient because they keep so well!  Porcini's are one of my favorite mushrooms, and JR Mushrooms brand have an excellent quality.  AB rating means they have caps and stems, and AA rating will give you get more caps.  Stems are slightly more chewer, but I like the flavor of both caps and stems.To reconstitute them I put them in water and then put them into the microwave for 4 minutes to get the  water boiling. Then let them cool.  If some of them are still hard I repeat the process on the ones that are still not soft.  Then I cook with them like I would with fresh mushrooms.They are easy to use in many different ways. They taste great sauteed in butter. I like adding them to stews or as ingredient for any sauce I make for cooking chicken. I also found they go great with any Indian sauce, like Pataks: Pataks Vindaloo Curry Paste 10 OzMushrooms, what do they taste like:* PORCINI  - sweet, nutty flavor reminds me of hazelnut* OYSTER - mild, slightly nutty* CHANTERELLES - sweet mushrooms with flavors that make me think of corn* BLACK TRYMPETS - smokey flavor* CREMENI - more flavorful than button mushrooms, but not as strong as shiitake or portobellos* ENOKI - very delicate flavor, slightly crunchy if fried* PORTOBELLOS - meaty flavor* SHIITAKES - rich, almost beefy flavorJR Mushrooms offer great quality at reasonable price. I recommend them!Ali Julia review

Wonderful flavor, premium quality, rock-bottom price. Makes a great gift for the foodies in your family. A huge bag of eating pleasure. Try a fist full in your next pot roast for a special treat. Omelets. Risottos. Stuffing for veal breast. Enjoy! They were shipped promptly and arrived in perfect condition.
i agree with all the other reviewers.  these are great value and excellent quality.  nice big slices and a huge quantity of mushrooms.  wonderful for holidays or every day.

column9: Very nice - excellent quality for price
column10: I'm extremely happy with these dried mushrooms. The only reason I give them four stars instead of five is that they are exactly as advertised (and I can't give them 4 1/2 stars); not the best grade available but close enough for frequent uses. After soaking, the broth needs to be strained through a coffee filter to remove some grit. Not a huge thing if you expect you will need to do it, but the highest grade dried porcinis do not need it and it does change the quality of the soaking broth, especially when using red wines and/or paper filters. These are an EXCELLENT bargain for the price though. Just remember they need to be cleaned slightly before soaking and remember to strain your soaking liquid before using it in a recipe and you should be all set.

column9: Tastes great and a LOT of worms...
column10: I have never cooked with porcini before and bought 16oz of these. They smell so amazing and the flavor is just wonderful! I made a soup of barley, italian sausage, and mushrooms.Though I must warn you... I only soaked about 1/3 of a cup of dried mushrooms and got a dime sized pile of re-hydrated worms. These things are infested! After an internet search I found that this is apparently a normal occurrence. I can't image the amount of worms I got was supposed to be normal though.The mushrooms were limp and looked very unappetizing on my spoon (could have been the cooking time, could have been the fact I could see the little worm paths in the mushroom), but that was some of the best tasting broth I have ever had. I think what I will do is just hydrate them and use only the strained liquid.I never thought I would give an ounce of respect to a food filled with worms.

My 16-oz bag of porcinis arrived a mere three days after I placed the order, which was a very pleasant surprise.  They came in a large resealable, Ziploc-type bag, and after cooking with them a few times I have to say I am very pleased with the quality.  For the types of dishes I make with dried porcinis, I don't think I'd ever have a need for anything more than the Extra AB grade.  I will definitely be a repeat customer, considering the low price and speedy shipping!
i was happy about the amount of mushrooms and the price but as soon as i put them in hot water i saw a lot of worms.

I've been purchasing products from J.R. Mushroom for some years now.  Be confident that the quality of their products and their service are both excellent.  From their dried porcini mushrooms to their vanilla beans, you can't go wrong.  A five star company for sure!

For Christmas this year I planned to make three glass gift containers with Arborio rice on the bottom and porcini mushrooms on top.  The recipe called for 5 ounces of mushrooms.  The local grocery store wanted a ridiculous price of $7.00 for one ounce, so I shopped on-line and found these.  I just received my one pound bag for much less than the grocery store price, and the mushrooms are of very good quality.  It only took a couple of days for the shipment to arrive.  Now I can proceed with my Christmas gift idea!  Thank you!!

The best price I have found for real porcinis from Italy. (Shoppers beware: when sellers don't ID the country of origin, the mushrooms are usually from Eastern Europe or China.) The "AB" grade is cheaper because it contains a higher percentage of stems, but that doesn't harm the flavor, which is excellent. Some reviewers have complained that these mushrooms "don't rehydrate," but they do--it's just that the slices are thicker than average, so it takes a little longer. Shipping was very fast, and the product arrived ahead of schedule. Overall, I am very pleased and would buy from this seller again.

Excellent mushrooms and highly recommended.  We only made mushroom and barley soup from it and it is always excellent and smells great!  But in retrospect (and that's just my own fault) I should have bought "Super Premium AA" grade instead of "Extra AB" as the pieces were kind of small.  Next time I'll buy AA.  Because of the size of the pieces, the lower AB grade is not worthwhile sauteing while I'm quite sure AA will be good enough for it. So, don't be too cheap.  Still the quality is excellent and the mushrooms are highly recommended.

There is no need to get dark woody porcini crumbs from the supermarket anymore.  These 'shrooms are mostly light colored, have large pieces and little or no dirt. (or other unidentifiable pieces.)  These are so worth it!

The product (Porcini Mushrooms) delivered was consistent with what was offered. Product was reasonably free of sand. It's durability could be improved substantially if delivered in a resealable plastic bag, instead of a rather delicate celophane bag.
the product was very good and about 10 times less expensive the an equal ammount at the local market would have been. I am very Happy with the product and the service.

I first tried these last year and absolutely fell in love. The only fresh mushrooms we can get here are the very basics so to add these is heavenly.Soups, stews, egg dishes, gravies, meatloaf, these mushrooms make just about everything taste better!And it's so easy. I rinse them quickly before letting them soak as I'm a bit lazy and didn't want to filter the liquid as they recommend on their website. I've never had any problem. I use the liquid as well, and if I don't use it in that recipe, I save it for another! It's that good!I cheat and use my Keurig to soak them in a 4 cup vessel with 2 of the large size cups. Perfect every time. I usually grab two very large handfuls of the porcinis to reconstitute.Beware:I accidentally ordered from the wrong vendor a few days ago and got a huge bag of... literally - garbage. It smelled so odd, was discolored (dyed?) and just gross. I can only think it was the victim of some warehouse flood or something. Amazon refunded my money and I ordered from here again and just got the most fragrant, delicious mushrooms. I'll never make that mistake again!Please enjoy these - they are wonderful and I'm so glad I can get them from Amazon!

column9: Elevates food to a whole new level
column10: I have always been a big fan of mushrooms, but had never cooked with porcini mushrooms before ordering these Grade Extra AB mushrooms from JR Mushrooms.These mushrooms are wonderful!  They make everything from oven roasted prime rib to braised chicken to stuffed portobello mushroom caps taste so much better.  I served my father what would have otherwise been a boring braised chicken dish, and he said it was one of the best things he ever ate.16 Oz of dried porcini mushrooms is a lot, and after seeing how big the bag is, I feel this purchase was a great deal.  I will be ordering another bag soon since I am finding all sorts of ways to incorporate porcini mushrooms into my food.  My one complaint is that they did not come in a nice resealable bag.  However, this is not enough for me to deduct a star.If you are looking to elevate your food to the next level, try using these mushrooms.

The mushrooms as received were large pieces, being of excellent quality and aroma.  Stem pieces predominated, but also made for easier slicing to augment presentations.  I've made some exceptionally flavourful sauces from these mushrooms, including a Marsala rendering that has been well received. There is nothing available in local specialty or general retail markets that comes close to the quality of this product.  And I finally add that this is one of the food items I would recommend ordering via the internet.

They were as advertised.  Not the top quality but fine for what I need them for.  I grind them into powder and add to recipes in equal quantities with soy sauce.  Sposed to enhance umami flavor.  Good value for the price.

God's best creation was neither Adam nor Eve.  It was Porcini.This single ingredient adds such an earthy and complex flavor to any recipe that it belongs to the realm of the surreal.Called Cepe in France, it is a popular item in both France and Italy and can be purchased fresh. I am puzzled that Porcini continues to be relatively unknown among the general american public.Try it in mushroom soup, or spaghetti sauce.  Try it as powder and sprinkle over BBQ foods.
The porcini mushrooms are wonderful. They have great flavor and very good quality. I will definatley order again!Porcini Mushrooms - Grade Extra AB 16 oz.
Seriously, how can one think of making risotto without these mushrooms???The aroma is fantastic.  They are clean.  Large pieces.  Couldn't be happier with the purchase.
The mushroom chips are too thin but the taste is unbelievable great.  Buy the higher grade if you want to feel the mushroom in the mouth. There is a 20% off coupon for next purchase in the package.
A fresh, fragrant bag of sliced, dried, quality porcini (Boletus edulis, not dreck) in different sizes. Plenty for friends- and mia soucera romana. I'll be ordering again.

I have seen other people high ratings of this product before I decided to buy it. Now I can confirm it is really good one; the soup I made out of these mushrooms was tasty and aromatic. I shared porcini mushrooms with my mom and she liked them too. Delivery was quick, package arrived within 3 days.
The mushrooms are perfect and they came super-fast.  EXCELLENT service and an amazing price.  Highly recommended!

column9: Great quality, Great price, Great company
column10: I couldn't be more pleased with this item.  These mushrooms have all the earthy and smoky flavor I wanted for a fraction of the standard grocery store price.  Also, as many of the other reviews have noted, JR Mushrooms is an awesome company with great service.One thing to note: these can get a little grainy upon reconstituting, especially if you're in a rush.  Chop them up a bit and you won't notice, or you could spring for something a little more expensive, like black trumpets if you want large pieces of reconstituted mushroom.  Be sure to keep the reconstituting liquid, it's amazing mushroom stock!

Fresh and fragrant dried porcinis.  Compare the price to expensive 1 oz packages of stale porcinis in the grocery store and see that you save big.  Extra AB grade is perfect for mushroom risotto since mushrooms are chopped up anyway.  Delivery was quick also.

I bought these a while ago but did not have a chance to cook them until now. I decided to make porcini mushroom lasagna for Christmas, and, what do you know, had to scrap that idea after trying to rehydrate the porcini. To spare you from the unpleasant details, "infested" is quite inadequate to describe the extent of it... What I should have done is rehydrate a few right away and return this garbage back...

Every time I make some store bought spaghetti my husband is looking for mushrooms to spice up that plain sauce.  I hated opening up a can because we would not eat that many.  My mom use to have dried mushrooms and would use them in soups or whatever so I thought I'd give these a try.  First, they came very quickly.  Second, I didn't realize what a huge bag this actually is.  Even with the bag closed, they smell so, so good.  I have not used them yet, just got them today but cannot wait to try them out.  Their website shows you can store these for a year in a cool place like the refrigerator so I know they'll keep for awhile.  Thanks for the quick shipment.  I hope to be trying these in other dishes also.  Three stars only because I wasn't happy with this seller's customer service department on not acknowledging an email on a different order.

column9: From the good folks at Panola Pepper.
column10: And this is by far their hottest sauce.A blend of habanero and jalapeno, this sauce is pretty good on chicken and fishand has a good long burn. Now personally, I dont like jalapeno elixirs, but theheat of the habanero masks the twangy flavor of those damn jalapenos, and reallyall you get is the heat with a mild citrus added by the lemon, and a flavor thatis totally unique among Louisiana blends.A worthy addition to any Pepperhead's collection.

I love this hot sauce. It's too bad it is a bit hard to find. It is a great all around sauce. I'd say it works for the same kinds of food you would use Tabasco sauce but it is better flavored even.Works well in my chili, on chicken nuggets, in my black beans, in corn chowder, etc...It's moderately hot but not burn your tongue hot. Good all around sauce.

The tree came excatly as pictured,packed well, soil were still a bit moist,even temperature outside was hot and tree drove all day on the ups truck,I think it survived the transportation.I put it outside in the evening,gave planty water,sprayed for bugs, it looks even fresher in the morning with other siblings bonsais.Now need to go and get recomended humidity tray.It was very nice to find instruction in the box as well. In overall very pleased.

I really like this brand of potato and also the tapioca starch for baking. I can get a great deal in bulk on amazon and everything I have baked with a combination of this and authentic foods brown rice flour have turned out great cakes, cookies, ect. I use this brand all the time.

This is great stuff, but this deal is a ripoff.  I can buy this in my supermarket for 3.50, somehow I bought this, 3 for 32.00 plus 38.00 for shipping.  This is a rip off, rip off, rip off, do not send your money to this supplier.....
I like amazon, but I don't approve of anyone allowing this to happen. Stop them Amazon, send them down your river!
You don't get the bang for your buck.  $70 for 3 bottles is sure not worth it... This is a great product, but just don't buy it from here.
The juice is excellent! High in natural sugar but the best thing you are going to get without juicing your own. You can purchase 64 oz of this at Sams club for around $7
i can get this at walmart for a still over priced (4.50-ish) for a 32 ounce bottle... but still much better price than amazon... this is ridiculous!

column9: Great Drink and Two 32oz bottles at Costco for $6.97
column10: Ok I don't understand how these people are allowed to sell this juice at this price on Amazon! I love Amazon but I really don't think they are aware of these people price gouging this juice!!! This juice is so good and sweet, it looks horrible but don't let that fool you.  Amazing stuff, just don't buy it from this vendor.
I just got four of the flavors from wawa for about $2.50 a piece it was the same size 15.2 fl oz (450ML). Not sure why its so pricey here????

I give it 5 stars because it has more greens and fruits in it than the other one, Odwall green machine superfood. It tastes better...more refreshing and not too thick.  I used to drink the Odwalla but then I saw this at Sam's Club.  They sell the biggest bottle for $6.99 here in Hawaii.  I was skeptical at first coz I wasn't sure if it would taste as good as Odwalla.  To my surprise it does taste so much better!  My 15-month little boy loves this stuff.  He is very picky with his food and he doesn't want to eat any veggies at all.  Some recommend that I stuff a meatball with broccoli and feed him this but I'm thinking, OK, does that little tiny piece of broccoli in the meatball really make an impact on his nutrition?  By the time it gets cooked, the nutrients are gone! Hello! So I tried giving him this after he eats his meal and I'm comforted that I'm giving him a well-balanced meal.  I think it's not fair to give this product 1 star because it is not a rating for the product itself but for the store above that sells this.

I'm on my third 32-ounce bottle in three days. You could almost live completely off this stuff. It looks green, yes, and everyone should really try it first with a blindfold on; the green somehow throws you off, you expect it to be gross, but it's sweet and fresh and filling. Not too thick, not too thin, delicious and so truly good for you. Spirlina is a pheominal nutrient/mineral rich food and it's in here and very expensive in the healthfood stores to buy seperately. I taste mostly pinnaple flavor in it, my step-son tastes mostly kiwi. It's vegan and kosher and made without any preservatives, colors, or GMO foods. I love it. My head feels clear, I feel calm and healthy drinking it. This is taking over my AM coffee for me. Much cheaper in the stores than advertised here currently. Enjoy, it's really really good for you.From their website on the product:--[Green Machine: apple and pear juice blend, pineapple juice, mango puree, kiwifruit puree, banana puree with powdered spirulina, chlorella, brocolli, green tea extract, spinach, barley grass, wheat grass, blue green algae, echinacea purpurea extract, odorless garlic!
