A Superfood is any food that is high in enzymes, phytochemicals, vitamins, minerals, Chlorophyll, and antioxidants.]

This stuff is a complete rip-off of Naked Juice. If you look at the quality of the way the label was made, you can tell someone just made this in their home and decided to pass it off as something legit.

column9: Hate the price, loved the juice
column10: I hate the price. They are stealing peoples money. I donot suggest this deal to other buyers. I hate it.
I get a 64 oz. bottle of this in the store for $8.  If it was three 64-oz bottles it still wouldn't be worth it.  Wondered if they made a mistake in listing this.

column9: Am I only the person who thinks this tastes like ketchup?!
column10: I didn't buy this from Amazon. I got it at Whole Foods. My husband, 8 year old and I all tried it. My husband and 8 year old said it was good. I couldn't even bring myself to hardly swallow the sip I took. It tastes just like ketchup to me (which could be why my boys like because they are ketchup addicts). I tried another sip after I found out they both liked it just to make sure I didn't get a bad sip (if that's possible - lol). Nope, still don't like it. I like most healthy fruit and veggie smoothies and shakes but just not this one. I gave this two stars because my boys liked it and it's good for you. I will not be drinking it again though.
I LOVE THIS STUFF THE NEWER BOTTLES DONT LOOK LIKE THIS BUT ITS SO FILLING AND DELICIOUS.CARROT JUICE IS MY SUPER FOOD

THE CANDY WAS GOOD AND THE MIX WAS SO-SO.  VERY HEAVY ON THE NESTLE CRUNCH'S. ALL THE CANDY WAS FRESHAND GOOD, BUT IT SEEMED REALLY EXPENSIVE TO ME?!  I  BUY CANDY LIKE THIS VERY RARELY, SO MAYBE I JUST DIDN'TREALIZE HOW EXPENSIVE THESE LITTLE CANDY BARS ARE NOW.

I like to keep crunchy snacks that aren't sweet and are relatively healthful in the office for the afternoon munchies. These are GREAT - not too salty or greasy, and not overly fattening. Serving size is 1/4 of a bag, roughly, and they're actually quite filling. Some MSG, butthat's about the only "red flag" ingredient (well, okay - I'd prefer olive oil to corn oil, but at least there's no corn syrup, and the first ingredient is green peas!)

saya baked snow pea crisps chips are a wonderful alternative to regular chip snacks. the taste is incredibly crunchy, and downright addictive- yet, also incredibly light... children and adults alike will enjoy these tasty snacks- they are BAKED NOT FRIED, which means they are not near as high in fats as regular chips, and they taste even better! (only downside is that there is some MSG in these... but really, who knows what's actually in those greasy chips in your kitchen right now)- my advice is to try these wonderful snow pea chips- you won't want to go back to your regular (unhealthy greasy high fat) chips after you've tasted something so much better- and it just so happens that these baked snow pea snacks are better for you as well- who knew a lower fat snack could taste this good! ;0)

These are excellent cookies without High Fructose Corn Syrup. Very real vanilla flavor with just the right amount of sweetness. They taste a lot like the Trader Joe's Vanilla Wafers but without any butter.
Great tasting cookies.  No other cookies are on the market like these.  They are like vanilla shortbread  rather than vanilla wafers.

These cookies are great little treats if you want something sweet but not too heavy. I love that they aren't too sweet or too big. Great for kids too. And I love that they are made of all organic ingredients.

Like so many food and supplement items ordered from Amazon in the past, these cookies arrived with a very short expiration date (1 month expiration date on a six-pak of cookies). In the past, Amazon would make good on the expired or almost expired goods even though their policy is "no returns on food". This time however, I found it impossible to contact anyone at Amazon to help in an exchange. Looks like they've made it even harder to get customer service on these types of issues. All that said, these are the best tasting vanilla wafers in my opinion. Sort of a combination of a sugar cookie and a typical vanilla wafer. Very nice vanilla flavor with a hearty crunch.

I rarely eat store-bought cookies because they usually use baking soda for leavening (I only like baking powder) and white flour.  These use whole wheat flour and no preservatives.  They taste great!  They were a real find for me, and I'm trying other back to Nature products, too.

Fiscalini Cheese's web site says about San Joaquin Gold: "At the 16 month age, this cheese won a gold medal in London, at the World Cheese Awards in 2004, and repeated with another gold medal in 2005 and a silver medal in 2006."I believe it.  This truly is a world-class cheese.  I recently bought 15 different exotic cheeses for a cheese tasting party, and nearly everyone liked this one best.

This is a really delicious cheese. The interior is about the consistency of a hard cheddar, maybe a little more crumbly, and suitable for cutting into snack size pieces. The description says it's somewhat like cheddar, but I find it more like a softer parmigiano, with a nutty sweetness along with the sharpness. Very nice with nuts and dates. It gets harder toward the outside, and works very well for grating like a hard parmigiano. The outermost part is quite hard.  I haven't tried to melt it, but it is delicious grated or shaved onto pasta dishes, salads and even into egg dishes.  I wish I could find it in our local upscale cheese shops - it's funny to me that while many of our restaurants are trying to use more local and California products, with cheese it seems to be that the farther away and more obscure the better. Too bad this comes from boring old Modesto, not some virgin-tended cave on an uncharted island off Sardinia.

San Joaquin gold is an aged, semi-hard raw milk cheese in the style of Fontina. harder and nuttier towards the rind, reminiscent of a good Parmesiano Reggiano, and softer and buttery towards the center. It pleasantly doesn't have the crunchy graininess of a lot of raw milk cheeses. As far as I'm concerned it's unbeatable as a snacking cheese, and I hear it melts and grates well too.

column9: Not as good as European cheeses
column10: This cheese has an Italian name, however it is not on a par with most of imported European cheeses. It has a nice firm rind, but inside it is grainy. Does not melt nicely either. Considering the expense of shipping, it is too pricey for the quality and taste.

I grew up in New England.  We had Cake Mate sprinkles or jimmies.  They are made in Florida by Signature Foods. I still get them when I go back as they are in the grocery stores.  The CK ones are okay, and I thought they would be quite similar -- same bad hydrogenated oils and the reviews.  These are certainly fine for a cupcake.  But for ice cream or the occasional spoonful of sprinkles, you need the Cake Mate.  These are available in 32 oz. from spiceworld online.  They are listed on Amazon but not as currently available.  I plan to get some soon.

These are very colorful but not the best tasting. I used them for my sons first bday as we were having a very large party and didn't want to buy 20 mini cans but taste wise the quality was not there....the look was great. I'm sure no one knew any better after all frosting fixes all.

The Jimmies had purple in the mix.  That was exactly what I was looking for.  Since we are not planning on eating these (but throwing them instead of rice). I won't know taste.  But color is excellent!

I used these rainbow jimmies for a rainbow cupcake topper and added them to rice krispie treats for my daughter's 6th birthday.  Obviously, it was a rainbow party.  The package didn't look like the picture, but I was not disappointed in the product.  I would buy from this company again.

We chose a Thing 1/Thing 2 theme for our twins' first birthday party, and these sprinkles were the perfect color. They lean more towards turquoise than a true blue, but with our red baking cups, and white frosting, they were the perfect finishing touch!
These sprinkles make a great presentation and are tasty too!  Used them for my french chocolate balls.  Would recommend them highly.
Exactly what I thought it would be. ALOT (more then I will ever need) of pink sprinkles, that taste like... sprinkles!
Great size bag for the price! I am making a funfetti cake with just purple. These sprnkles/jimmies are exactly what I wanted. Although, the color could be darker.

Jimmies sprinkles are the best i love them because they are soft and unlike the other hard sprinkles don't get stuck in your teeth. lol But it was a great buy. You have a better deal here that anywhere else.

Good quality sprinkles.  Pricing seems pretty decent.  Love the way they make my cupcakes look - takes me back to my elementary school days, long ago!  Only gripes: the "partially-hydrogenated" ingredient and non-resealable bag.  By the way, the advertised bag looks completely different than the one you get - it's not black.  Tastes like classic Jimmies too and isn't so sweet that it'll over-sweeten your frosting.
Pros - good price for its size, fast delivery,Con - not the best tasting jimmies, still better than getting the small grocery store size
This was perfect for my purposes! I made a personalized "funfetti" cake for a bridal shower for a girl whose colors were hot pink and black, and this was awesome to get it done! Fast shipping too!
I bought these sprinkles for my cupcakes and not only are they gorgeous but you get a lot for the money. The silver is very true to color and they make a lovely accent to your cupcakes.

I bought these jimmies because I couldn't find the needed orange color in any of my local stores.  A pound of jimmies is a lot, but I went through more than I expected, probably half the bag to thoroughly coat a recipe of chocolate truffles.  The taste is, well, jimmy-taste.  My only disappointment/surprise was how short these jimmies are -- about two-thirds of the length of Wilton and CakeMate brands I have in the cupboard.If you need a special color that only CK makes, don't hesitate to get them.-- Debbie Lee  Wesselmann

Seriously, sprinkles are not just for eye pleasing aesthetics but for mouth pleasing texture.  This bag is great value compared to buying the smaller size shakers with different colors. I can use two of containers of  those colors on one batch of 24 cupcakes.  I just have to find a proper container to put the bag ones in so they are easy to shake out onto cupcakes, as that is what I use them for mostly. I'll check on amazon to see if I can find an appropriate shaker.  I may just buy a smaller one (about 10 oz) shaker and use and re-use that one.  My son and I like them also on ice cream, topped with ready whip canned cream. Gives pleasing texture to  ice cream. Yum!
This is the best energy drink ever. I love it and will continue to drink it. If you haven't tried it Its your loss.
My ranch workers love this stuff. They grab one and go when there's work to be done and the appreciate the treat of having it available and on hand. It's good to have happy workers.
This is the only flavor my husband likes so I love that I can order a specific flavor instead of the variety pack or buying individually.  Shipping and delivery occurred as promised.

It tastes delicious and I love starting my day and my mid day coffee break with my Loca Moca.  Unfortunately, it's availability in limited in my area, that's why I was glad Amazon carried it.  My alternative is Starbucks Mocha, but that is a distant second to Loca Moca.

Ive been looking for these in bulk for quite awhile,  these are my favorite energy drinks, no bitterness, just a smooth creamy sweet coffee flavor and they also work great if you want to make homemade energy milkshakes.The one drawback is the cost,  when buying an item in bulk, I expect a good discount and there just isnt much of a discount here only about 4 cents a can based on my local grocery store.I wish I could order this item more often but paying that much just for a 24pk case of drinks even if they are energy drinks just isnt something Im willing to do very often nor something my budget can handle. The only reason I ordered them now is because Amazon had a great deal on gourmet food items at the time and I got 10 dollars off the cost.
taste is great. gives you a boost.I prefer it ice cold. the price is cheaper than convent store prices, oh and be sure to recycle.

column9: Great item for a great price
column10: Although the picture is not correct, these were the baked lays sour cream & onion that I loved.  I was surprised that all 64 bags were carefully placed in a huge box. They were great.
The baked chips came in single serving size packages, just right for one person.  The quantity was nice, too, 64 packages.  However, this item is no longer available.
We finished 1 bottle in one day! It's a hit in my kitchen!!Taste so much better than peanut butter. Love itl:)

I recently purchased Tully's Full City Roast, as well as Tully's House Blend.  They are both excellent, but personally, I prefer the House Blend by a small margin.  I like several of the extra bold k-cups, especially Gloria Jean's Black Gold, Timothy's Rainforest Espresso and Midnight Magic, and Coffee People Donut Shop.  But I find the Tully's House Blend to have a great mix of being rich and flavorful, but still very drinkable anytime.  It may be my favorite k-cup right now, and I will definitely keep a stock of it around our house.
If you like a bolder coffee with rich flavor, that is not bitter or burnt tasting, full of flavor this is the one to drink.

column9: I'm a Tully's Fan! The House Blend Is Becoming One Of My Favorites.
column10: If we had a 'I'm A Fan' button to push, I would definitely be a fan of Tully's K-cups.Usually I drink lots of Tully's French and/or Kona, and Italian is a new favorite that I know I'll be drinking now that I've tried it.When I think of Tully's Coffee House Blend, I think of going into a restaurant and smelling that wonderful aroma of freshly-made coffee. It tastes delicious!At first I didn't think of it as one of my all-time favorites, because it's just an excellent cup of coffee. Good flavor and aroma, not too dark, not too strong, not too bitter, just delicious. I just came back to edit this review and say that it is becoming one of my all-time favorites, just another great option from Tully's.I used to say that I like to keep it around to drink after I've burned out my taste buds on stronger blends and want to calm my taste buds down a little. Now I've found that I enjoy it pretty much any time.One thing I would say about Coffee House Blend is that it will probably please more people in a household or guests visiting than my all-time favorites, which are way too strong for many people. This is a good choice to please more people. It should please just about everyone!EDITED once more. I came back later to say that with all of my other K-Cup options available to me, I keep reaching for the Tully's House Blend. I don't know if it's just a mood I'm in right now or what, but the others just seem like they are trying too hard. Whatever the reason, I'm enjoying House Blend.EDITED still once more to say now my favorites are House and Italian, both Tully's. It's the best!
I have had this coffee before and thats why I purchased it once again.  Its not to strong, and not to weak, its just right. I also will continue to purchase it from now on.

column9: Bold But Not Extra Bold.  Smooth, Flavorful & Not Bitter..
column10: Tully's House Blend falls squarely into the Bold category, but it is definitely not an Extra Bold coffee.  It is smooth, flavorful and does not have a bitter aftertaste.**** For those medium blend coffee drinkers, this blend may be too strong.  For those that like a jolt in the morning, this coffee may not be bold enough. ****This blend, taste-wise, is not quite as full-bodied as Tully's Italian Roast, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) yet it is bolder than the Kona blends, which are no longer available.  I also find that it has a just a little more kick than Timothy's World Coffee, San Lorenzo Dark, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2), which is one of my favorite blends to-date.
I tried this coffee in a sample box and simply loved the flavor, I will buy this again for sure.

I've been drinking the Tully's House Blend K-Cup coffee for a few years now. I occasionally buy a different variety just to try it out, but always find myself wanting the Tully's more. I have to admit, I do like the new Starbucks K-cups, but they are almost as expensive as going to a Starbucks and buying coffee there, so I'll stick with my Tully's. I find the blend to be just the right mixture of smooth and bold. I can use a single K-cup twice to fill my 16 oz to-go mug and find that it's still strong enough.

I've been drinking bold flavors such as Timothy's Rain Forest Expresso and Coffee People's Wake Up Call but have grown tired of the somewhat chalky taste of both.  I recently tried Tully's Kona Blend and it's good but expensive and not available via the "Subscribe and Save" program.  So I took a chance on their House Blend and like it even better than the Kona Blend!  It's a "Bold"K-cup so contains enough coffee to make the larger size cup without it's being weak and the flavor is nice and rich without being bitter or chalky-tasting.  It's my new favorite K-cup!!!

I first tasted this at my uncle's house on Christmas morning, after he got a Keurig and hooked it up for everyone's enjoyment.I can say without a doubt, that this is the best coffee I have ever tasted. It's absolutely *perfectly* balanced, without a hint of bitterness. Just smooth as silk, it's the kind of coffee that makes you take a sip, curl up in your chair and sigh in satisfaction at the taste. This coffee is actually prompting me to buy a Keurig of my own now, and this will be the very first blend that will go in it.

Well I have a problem with this coffee. Me and my Mom find it so delicious we cant drink any other coffee that we already have . This includes Jamaican Blue Mountain and Kona coffees. Ya know that perfect cup of coffee you get at the diner well this is it. There is no other there is no better perfect cup of Joe.

column9: House Blend is a perfect Blend!
column10: I had received samples in the mail for Tully's coffee K-cups and as soon as I smelled the House Blend brewing, I knew it would be special.  No doubt....I was not disappointed!  Impressive indeed!

column9: Simply the best K cup out there
column10: I have been thru them all and Tully's simply makes the best K cups out there. The house blend is great, breakfast blend as well and the hard to find Kona is in a class by itself. Better than Green Mountain, Timothy's, Gloria Jean and Newman's Own. They simply use better coffee beans and the cups are all very consistent. All of their coffees are "Bold" (even the breakfast blend) but the are never bitter like some other Bold varieties. The superb reviews on this brand are accurate.
I am a picky coffee drinker and really like this House Blend by Tully. Very rich but smooth taste. Easy on the taste buds and stomach. This will be a regular purchase for me.
The price for these k-cups on Amazon is ludicrous.  They are actually cheaper in a department store paying sales tax.

I have tried many different k-cups and Tully's is my favorite. I like the taste because it is a little sweet and doesn't have much acid. It's perfect for that first cup of coffee, as well as at any time during the day or night. Really good coffee.

Its just dark enough for my tastes to be brewed on the 7.25oz setting. It has a dark chocolate and brandy aroma. The house blend has a boldness falling in between a medium brew (gloria jeans hazlenut) and a lighter bold brew (newmans organic). The taste is pleasant and has notes of cocoa and malt, and an aftertaste of walnuts. I would recommend this as a keep around the house brew, but not for something to impress guests.

column9: Less expensive alternative to the Kona Blend
column10: I have long been a fan of the Tully Kona Blend coffee. I was disappointed when my local retailer quit selling Kona products!I actually ordered this house blend by accident, thinking that I was ordering the Kona Blend. I had more than 4 cups of coffee before I noticed on the packaging that it said House Blend instead of Kona Blend. I would not have known that it was not the Kona Blend had I not seen the packaging. One caveat: I make "lattes" by adding an equal amount of steamed milk to my coffee, so the coffee flavor is probably diluted for me.  Someone drinking it straight up may notice a difference in the flavor.My bottom line is that it is much less expensive than the Kona Blend, due to vendor and shipping costs, and it is more than good enough for me.  I've since ordered another box.

column9: Starbucks is great, but Tully's is THE BEST!
column10: Here in Seattle you can't turn around without bumping into a great coffee kiosk, but there is nothing like being able to enjoy a terrific cup of coffee first thing in the morning while still shlepping around in my slippers at home.  As a new Keurig owner, I taste-tested a variety of brands (since it was so easy to do) but my local favorite, Tully's, came out on top.  If smooth, rich, full-bodied coffee can be called comfort food, Tully's has it nailed.  Happily, Amazon shipments arrive promptly.  Yes, K-cup packs are pricey, but life is short.  Drink good coffee!

column9: Tully's House Blend is One of Our Favorite K-cups.
column10: We received the Kureg coffee maker as a gift and have been trying out various brands of the cups.  Tully's is one of our favorites and a good buy at Amazon.

column9: Tully's House Blend K-Cup packs for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50)
column10: I received the Tully's house blend K-cups on time. I love the flavor of the coffee. I use the Keurig coffee machine when I only want one cup of coffee. I will reorder when I'm out of the coffee.

I like a strong rich coffee in the morning to wake me up. Tully's fits the bill. I have tried some of the others but they are either too dark or too weak. Ordering from Amazon is just TOO convenient--It comes right to your door. Try it you'll like it!!
Tully's Breakfast Brew in my opinion is the best coffee available for the price.  I drink two to three cups every morning, and it is a great way to start the day.
I highly recommend this coffee, it is a very good blend, has a bold flavor without being bitter tasting.  Looking forward to trying some other blends Tully's.

I found this product to be consistenly very good.It is strong,very nice flavor, and it benefits from the fact that Keurig produces a very hot coffee.If you pick "dark roast" instead of "regular", it will taste even better.
I purchase this product for the office. The clients like it and it is not too over-powering. I appreciate the savings through Subscribe & Save!

column9: First time I order Tully's coffee
column10: First time I have order coffee from Amazon. Tully's House Blend is a very good brand,has a good flavor.It was delivered to my house two days before amazon said that it would be here,that was great. Will be ordering again from here shortly.

This coffee came very quickly and I was pleased.  I ordered it from Amazon.com.  I was almost out of my regular coffee.  I enjoy Tully's coffee and plan to purchase it again in the future.  It has a very good flavor, without being bitter.

column9: If you like bold coffee this is the one for you.
column10: Nice wake up cup of coffee.  Good flavor.  Not a watered down cup of coffee.  This K cup has lots of coffee in it.  We like strong coffee and this one hits the spot.

Like many, I have cycled through many different brands and k-cups, searching for the perfect blend to satisfy my taste buds.  I prefer a medium roast, but slightly bold.  Tullys House blend fits that bill perfectly for me and my fiance.  The flavor is mild but not flavorless like some other medium blends, and bold enough to wake me up.
This is currently my favorite coffee...potent, but smooth. The autoship option is so convenient....now I never run out of k-cups, and the price is better than at any of my local stores.

Tullys is the best of the Kcups brands that we've tried, which is most, other than Starbucks.  We do prefer bolder coffees that are not bitter.  Kona blend is our top choice, but it is hard to find, so house blend is our go-to.  Subscribe and save for this item is a good value too.

Tully's "House Blend" has become the coffee I always have on hand. It has a  rich, deep, full bodied flavor without being bitter. I have a delicate stomach so occasionally I do notice the slight acidic content, but typically have no issues with this blend.
This coffee is not bad.  I was looking for a sronger coffee than the breakfast brend Ive been drinking for a while. Not the best Ive tried, but a good coffee nonetheless.
With the subscription, this item is $10 cheaper than Costco. Plus no taxes and they ship it to your house. Can't get better than than!

I've purchased many different K-Cups over the last year or so that I've owned my Keuirg.  I was always looking for that smooth great cup of coffee.  Not too weak, not bitter, not smokey.  Tullys House Blend is smooth and rich.  It's my "go to" coffee in the morning.  AhhhhhhAmazon makes it a great deal purchasing through them.  I make sure I never run out.Love it!

This product arrived quickly and is so convenient to have in k-cup format. The taste is bold and rich, and we love having it around. Plus getting it in a pack of 50 means you won't have to worry about running out too quickly

When in Seattle several years ago, I first experienced Tully's coffee.  It was the best coffee I ever tasted!  I was thrilled to see that Amazon started carrying their coffee.  Now all of my friends and family come into my home and look to make a cup of Tully's coffee.

I'm having a cup of this coffee as I am writing this review. It was the deal most of all that made me buy this Tully's blend. I think Tully does make some of the best kcups I have had though. Love the Kona blend but now is quite expensive. This has a nice flavor to me but could be a bit stronger. That being said, if I get another deal on this blend, I will definately by it again.
Wonderful taste, better price than the store and fast shipping.  Will definitely order again. Nice mild flavor. Why go out for coffee when I can have this at home.
it's make an ok cup of coffee I have had better...the Kona blend is great, this was ordered due to the kona being out of stock
I look forward to this coffee in the morning. I think Tully's is the best brand for Kcups I have tried.

column9: Tully's Coffee House Blend, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2)
column10: I've always appreciated my Keurig brewer but didn't realize how much until I was away from home, no brewer and NO K-cups! I hadn't anticipated the level of 'separation anxiety' I suddenly experienced. Undaunted, I purchased a package of Tully's freshly ground coffee and returned to a conventional coffee maker.  The result was ok - :} but not really the usual great.  Then came reality.  THE GROUNDs.  What a mess! Not only totally inconvenient to measure, but annoyingly difficult to confine to the basket since they always seem to prefer the counter, the sink, the floor, anywhere but where they're supposed to be.  Then, the challenge of disposal-what a mess. Next,the mixing. TOO weak(like "stump-water" I over-heard,) TOO strong...ugh!!!! It was back to that awful trial and error period  which had been so quickly forgotten.  Oh, and don't even ask about the bottled water.  Fortunately the trip was abbreviated and I was soon re-united with my Keurig brewer and my treasured Tully's K-cups.  Lesson learned.

column9: I order more of this than any other coffee. Ordering more today!
column10: I love Tully's House Blend K-Cups! I have several dozen other flavors and always find myself reaching for Tully's House Blend. It is just right when I wake up in the morning and throughout the day. Strong, bold, but not strong enough to make me so hyper that people run from me! I'm about to order more right now and thought I would stop and make a review while I'm thinking about it.

column9: As good as buying your coffee at Tully's
column10: Tully's coffee is superior and it holds its on against Starbucks and others.  With Keurig coffee brewers you get the same quality coffee as having a cup at your local Tully's.
This was a very nice addition to my coffees.  It does not have any bitterness and is very smooth.  I will buy it again.  And you can't beat the price.
My husband is a big coffee drinker. He enjoys this coffee. The price can not be found lower anywhere. I will continue to come back for re-orders.
I have enjoyed this coffee even though it is a little bolder than what I am used to and I will probably buy more for when I have guests who prefer a strong coffee!

Tully's house blend coffee is a bold coffee that isn't bitter but delivers good coffee flavor.  I use the K-cups for that perfect cup of coffee every time.  I was looking for a replacement for the Kona blend coffee since it has become very difficult to find and the prices have sky rocketed to ridiculousness when you do find it.  This house blend has been a good replacement.
Very good coffee.  Ease of prep and taste major considerations and it really comes through.  Time relaxing enhanced by flavor.
This house blend is one of the best coffees.  I have tried a wide variety of k-cup coffees and the House Blend is the best.

Tully's House Blend is the perfect K-Cup for me.  Sure, I occasionally enjoy the special flavors.....Mocha, Italian roast, French vanilla, but my favorite 'go-to'coffee is House Blend. Wakes me up in the morning with it's coffee house full hearty taste.
We like this coffee, it is not our favorite, but we do enjoy it. It has a smooth, non-acidic taste, no bitterness. It simply seems to be nothing special, just good coffee.

I was looking for a different type of taste from a coffee, something a little stronger, but it had to go down smooth. This coffee surely filled the bill. I was drinking another brand and it was leaving a nasty taste in my mouth and just didn't seem to go down as smoothly as Tully's. I really recommend you try it if you are looking for a strong but smooth coffee!
First time ordering this flavor, with excellent results.  Would recommend to others as a smooth blend.
Just wanted to say that it was a great deal and I won't shop for K-cups anywhere else.
This is good, flavorful coffee, but just not quite the right blend for me.There are others I like more, so will not be ordering it again.  Good price from Amazon, though.

column9: Taste great, but jam up coffee maker
column10: As many others have stated, the taste of this coffee is fantastic.  Flavor wise, it is by far my favorite.My concern is that these K-cups keep jamming up my coffee maker.  Every time I make this brand of coffee, I have to use a paper clip the next morning to un-jam the Keurig.  I've noticed that these K-cups have a unique behavior about them.  After making a cup of coffee, I go to eject the empty cup.  The empty cup has a large amount of coffee grains on the top of it.  I have never seen this before in my 4 years of using a Keurig.  I am guessing this behavior is directly affecting the coffee maker by jamming it up.
I bought this to attempt to replace Morning Edition which is no longer available. DH and Mom say it's too bitter to drink. I think it's just okay for a medium roast. I wouldn't buy it again.

Not a smooth taste; strong but without the quality taste you would expect. The way the packaging is makes me wonder how long they have been sitting...just doesn't taste as fresh as the normal ones I buy from Donut Shop. Going back to that brand.
Not as smooth a taste as I expected.  Not comparable to Tully's house blend bought at a Tully's coffee shop in Seattle.
Tully's House Blend K-Cups is a very good production coffee , but no protective stuff inside of these pack and that's make some K cups broken when i open it .
Since I drink my coffee black this didn't have enough deep flavor for me but still is a pleasant cup of coffee.

column9: Wanted House Blend plain but got Melange
column10: I ordered Tully's plain House Blend Extra Bold which is super, but received something different that tastes stronger and not as good.  I received Tully's House Blend Extra Bold "Melange maison" instead.  The carton reads House Blend, but the cups inside have the Melange label.  The plain House Blend is much better.  I'm disappointed.

First time I purchased from this company and very disappointed as the coffee came all lose in the shipping box..Not even in their original manufacturers Keurig Tully Boxes.. some tops ripped open due to the packaging not to mention there are no expiration dates on these K-Cups.. Maybe this deal was too good to be true.. Do not recommend.. rather pay little more for quality packing and product...:(

Like some of you said, I only got 48 also.  Why do they advertise 50 and then send 48?  It seems minimal to us but 2 times the number of orders adds up for them really fast.  I don't like feeling cheated probably won't order again.  The coffee was strong.  I would compare it to Starbucks.  The order information says they have three different strengths and I didn't see where you can choose the strength so they shipped me Extra Bold.  I usually drink coffee black but with this, I make a 10 oz and 4 oz with one k-cup and then add some cream so I guess that knocks down the per cup price.  Still with feeling cheated, I will look for something better.

column9: Good but not as good as Full City
column10: This is a good coffee from Tully's, but it is not as bright as Full City.  Seems to be a little strong without the flavor you hope from a stronger coffee.

I have no problem with Tully's Coffee or any of the coffees presented by Amazon.  I have a problem with ordering coffee through Amazon. The one time I ordered coffee it took forever and a day to arrive.  So I decided that made no sense when there are other websites that get the coffee delivered to your door much faster than Amazon can.

Was surprised when I opened the box and saw the k cups just loose, I wasn't expecting to receive it like that I guess. My first concern was seeing that some of the tops of the k cups are indented, so you wonder at first if their sealed. For the price, I thought it was a good deal. The shipping was slow though.

column9: K-Cups were BARELY out of date, but tasted very old
column10: K-Cup coffee was supposedly barely out of date, but tasted very, very old and I could not afford to order from Amazon as the ones I got were from Moriah Acres.
I bought this for my father as a Christmas gift.  Although I did not see or sample it, he loved it.  He said it came beautifully presented and that everything was delicious.

column9: It's nice, but certainly not a 5-star product.
column10: I purchased this as a gift.  The recipient liked the items in the basket, saying they were good, but nothing amazing.  She did say the items seemed fresh, thankfully.  One of the reasons I chose this gift was the cute coffee-themed gift box the items come in.  The product description states it "will look fantastic in any coffee lovers home or in the workplace break room, it can be used long after the goodies are gone", so I was expecting the box to be something nice.  However, it was nothing more than cheap cardboard, and my gift recipient said it was bent.  A bent cardboard box is not going to look fantastic anywhere.  I felt the product description was a bit misleading in this regard.

This was a gift for a teachers' appreciation breakfast.  The basket had a nice variety of items and the teacher who won the this basket was very pleased.  Delivered on time and I would purchase this again.

column9: wasn't quite what I had in mind
column10: I thought this would taste similar to Twinings Rose Tea but unfortunately this has more of a light fruit flavor. Which is ok. However it wasn't want I was looking for.

column9: Not as good as belly flops
column10: I bought 10 lbs of belly flops a while back and those were so good and very sweet.  These jelly beans or not as sweet nor tasty. There seems to be a lot more root beer beans than any other ones.  They did not come in bags just a box of jelly beans.  The value was very good for the money, but in the future I'm only going to stick to flops.

Quick chocolate chemistry lesson:1.  If you use "natural cocoa" it is acidic, and designed to be used in baking with baking soda as a leavener.  It is not intended to be used as a drink mix for hot cocoa.2.  Many recent "gourmet" cocoa products tout "natural cocoa" because it is cheaper than alkali processing.  However the high price will probably give you an acid stomach ache.  It does that to me.  Ouch.3.  "Dutch cocoa" is processed by simply exposing cocoa to baking soda, nothing more creepy than that. It just neutralizes the acids so you can stomach it, and to tone down the harsh flavor.  Your taste buds may prefer "natural cocoa" because you're used to it, but not everyone does.  I think it's too harsh.  Your mileage may vary.4.  Alkali processed cocoa is also easier to mix with liquids so you don't get a gloppy, lumpy mess like you do with natural cocoa.  It's a lot like the difference between masa flour and corn meal flour.  One has been processed with alkali, one not.  The traditional version, masa, has been processed with alkali (traditionally potash).Therefore, if you need to make brownies with a recipe using only baking soda leavener, use natural cocoa.  If you're making hot chocolate, use your own discretion based on the flavor you like, but if you get a stomach ache from natural cocoa, then use dutch cocoa.  Dutch cocoa is probably what you remember from childhood hot chocolate anyway, so if you like Swiss Miss or Hershey's Special Dark Cocoa, then stick with dutch cocoa, or the flavor will be "off" for you. The reason cocoa tastes "off" is because you're used to "natural" and bought "dutch" or vice versa.Re the comments about sellers...  I've been a customer here for years and I still don't trust anyone who doesn't at least fulfill through amazon.  Their rating had better be above 96% too.Products that have dutch processed cocoa (in order of my preference):1.  Ghirardelli Sweet Ground Chocolate and Cocoa2.  Hershey's Special Dark Cocoa3.  This productThere are probably more but I haven't tried them.Products I know are way too acidic for me and are natural cocoa (in order of nastiness / acidity):1.  Trader Joe's Sipping Chocolate2.  Ghirardelli Unsweetened Cocoa3.  Hershey's Cocoa "Great for Baking" (NOT the Special Dark)Best wishes for finding what you're looking for!  This one is for hot chocolate lovers only.

I thought it would be bitter and gross, but it is wonderful! I've been sharing pieces with my classmates and they all love it too. It makes me feel better in those times when I am dreading going to class. It is nice that they come in 10 count packages - they look pretty nice and would make a nice small gift. I highly recommend this product.

Just got my package today and I just love this chocolate though this is my first time eating a 88% dark chocolate. This chocolate is bitter and for those who are used to eat milk chocolate, you probably won't like the taste. But if you're trying to change your eating habit and do something good to your body, this is it.

I have to say that I have had better dark chocolate before, but I love what these bars stand for so I purchase them whenever I can.  This is my first time trying this particular bar and I was not impressed.  I mean it was ok, but I kept getting gritty pieces when I took a bite, so that was a little off putting.  The flavor is ok, but nothing to run home about.  I dont think that I will be getting this bar again, I will stick to my other favorites by this company.

The "Endangered Species Panther, Extreme Dark Chocolate" is very rich in flavor and to be savored.  The individually wrapped pieces allow you to select just that one small piece after dinner to enjoy with your coffee.

As usual, Amazon's description of how much chocolate you are getting with an order is unclear.  I can clear it up.  You get 6 packs of 3.5 ounce chocolate, resulting in 21 ounces of total chocolate in 60 individually wrapped squares.  Each square is about .35 ounces (maybe two small bites).I would not try to eat this straight up, since its just one step away from baking chocolate.  There are two ways I like to eat this chocolate.  The first way is to take some heated peanut butter (15 secs in the microwave), add a little sugar, mix it together, and use it as a dipping sauce for these squares.  It's scary good.  The second method is to replace half of the chocolate chips in a cookie recipe with chopped up panther chocolate.  It makes a mean cookie.

As a vegan, I still have a bit of a sweet tooth.  I used to buy these chocolates individually wrapped for $1.19 at a small natural foods store; and when I began eating them daily the box of 12 cost almost $12 for a bag.  Needless to say, they are substantially less expensive here.  I am always happy to find that my chocolate is never melted, despite arriving to hot Florida heat!  And I have never had any issues receiving a quality product.  Value is terrific, for the savings I get by buying in bulk.  The chocolate itself is delightful.  It is not too bitter, as some dark chocolates are, but rich and flavorful.  I am also very glad to support a company like Endangered Species that gives back to the enviroment and animals as well as being fair trade.  Bravo to the company for a great product and the seller for superb shipping & delivery!  I will keep buying again and again!

I agree with Pf who gives a higher rating to Ghiradelli 86%.  If you really like bitter chocolate (and I have a friend who eats unsweetened Bakers Chocolate) then this may be a great choice for you.  For the those of us that like the benefits of dark chocolate without the hard edge, this one may not be the one.  This one has a chalky, medicinal taste to it.

I originally thought that I was ordering ghiradelli 86%,but ordered these by mistake and was greatly disappointed. The chocolate is not rich and smooth, but rather dry ang chalky. I would never by this brand again. Try ghiradelli 86% dark and you will do yourself a favor because that brand has the texture and rich taste you would expect for that price.

column9: Bitter and delicious, great quality, and helps animals too.
column10: I love the Endangered Species brand of chocolates. I used to buy them at Target, but my store quit carrying them. I love the 88% Dark Chocolate as it is rich, a bit bitter, but loaded with delicious chocolate flavor. The company only uses 100% ethically traded cocoa beans, and gives a percentage of it's profits to helping endangered animals. I had tried other dark chocolate bars before as high as 86% but have never found a brand that tasted as good as Endangered Species. Every piece of their chocolate has a good consistency and tastes like a very high quality chocolate. I would recommend their chocolate highly.
I am a wicked chocolate freak and this is sooooooo good!  I like that they are individually wrapped, I throw some in my bag for a desert when out to eat for a low cal treat.

My kids love these (ages 15 & 12). One of my kids doesn't really like apples and she eats bags of these. Great to take to school for a snack. I keep several bags in my car to have onhand if we are out shopping and they get hungry. These tide them over until we get home so we don't have to hit the fast food drive through. I even have some in my desk at work. Quiet enough to eat in meetings.Ok so to respond to another poster that the "organic" apples come from places that organic is not regulated as much - I understand but as our busy lives go - these are great. I will do my best to get US organic as many other aspects of food shopping as I can.
I love Yogavive chips. Strawberry is one of my favorite flavors besides peach. Better alternative to greasy chips, just wish these were less expensive.
I love this product and save all my old small bottles to refill from this large one.  The savings in cost is tremendous.

column9: Hard To Find Item Is Excellent
column10: If you are a macadamia nut lover, these are exquisite.  Mauna Loa are simply the best because of the rich volcanic soil in which these nuts are grown. I know of no other brand of macadamia nuts that even approaches the freshness, caliber and flavor of Mauna Loa. This flavor is king on the Hawaiian Islands but is very difficult to locate in stores in the continental U.S. due to shelf space, slotting fees charged by retailers and supermarkets to stock the item and demand. Hershey Chocolate Co. has recently purchased Mauna Loa, and since this acquisition, these nuts have enjoyed a much wider distribution on the U.S. East coast. Amazon's price is competitive and the nuts are simply delicious.  Be sure to refrigerate them immediately after opening to retain their mellow, buttery aroma.
MLOGFM. Quite an acromyn, quite a nut. If aliens were to take one thing back to their world, it would be these Macs.  They are OUT OF THIS WORLD!!!!

I was a little hesitant to purchase this product due to the price, but my family and i love macadamia nuts. I been wavering between two different brands and finally decided on the Mauna Loa brand. I am very happy with their product and service! The nuts were fresh and the maui onion garlic flavor were bold. I could not stop eating those nuts! The only downsides to the product were size and price. The container was very small (it fit perfectly in a woman's hand, smaller than i thought it would be. However, every bite was worth the buck. I wish they carried macadamia nuts here. I would purchase this again in the future with extra cash to spend. Hehe.
bought this in Guam and from then on i cant stop munching to this nuts! amazing!
received the ordered item on the date promised. nice product, yummy! looking forward doing bussiness with you again.

column9: Never a fan of macadamias...until now
column10: A friend brought these back from Hawaii.  They are OUTSTANDING.  Good enough that I found them on Amazon and ordered some more, even though they cost 3x what he paid on the islands.
these are so good, great flavor and never last long enough.my family's new favorite treat.  thanksdenise anchorage, alaska

column9: Mauna Loa Macadamia Nuts-Maui Onion Garlic
column10: Love the product and great service.  I am a repeat customer.  First had these nuts when we were in the islands.  Ruth

These are the very best Macadamia Nuts anywhere.  The Onion Garlic flavor is perfect - not too much and not too little.  I recommend them highly - every time I serve them, I'm asked where I get them.  A great product!

I absolutely love these things, you do get what you pay for on this one but they cost a little more than going the cheap route. I set two cans out for a meeting and people practically wanted me to be local suppleir. There is a down side to these though, there's no kissing momma (or poppi) after eating them, there are delicious but your breath won't be helped witha simple mint! When I retire I want to be the sales rep for Mauna Loa so I get free samples!!!
I first tried this flavor in Hawaii, and couldn't find them in any of my local stores. But, couldn't stop thinking about them...They're THAT GOOD!! So, thankfully Amazon came through as usual!

column9: Maui Onion & Garlic are my favorite!
column10: I'm lucky to be born and raised in Hawaii because getting my hands on these nuts aren't as costly and hard to get as most folks would find.Mauna Loa Macadamia Nuts come in a variety of flavors including dry roasted, chocolate covered, Kona coffee glazed and Maui Onion and garlic.  By far my favorite is Maui Onion and Garlic.  The first taste on your tongue is packed with bursting flavor! Salty and onion/garlic taste.  Not one taste overpowers the others, but they all compliment each to make the taste that makes macadamia nuts so special.

column9: Can't stop eating these delicious nuts
column10: I've loved mac nuts since I was a child. Because they're so expensive, they were always a rare and welcomed treat in my family. This summer, my brother and his wife brought back a variety pack from their trip to Hawaii. There's chocolate-covered ones, plain, and sea salt. Out of the 4 or 5 different cans, this is my favorite by far.The dusting of seasoning is delicate and makes an already tasty snack even better. When I got to the bottom of the can, I ran my finger around the inside walls to get out all the extra bits of garlic and onion powder, showing how despondent I was at having eating them all. That's how good these are!Nuts are naturally high in fat, so try to control yourself if you're on a restricted diet! It's nearly impossible to stop eating these. Highly highly recommended.

I really love these nuts and have been eating them for the past twenty five years.  This was my first experience receiving old nuts which were far below the standard I have come to expect.  Instead of a nice white they were brown.  They were not as flavorfull as in the past and I suspect they were just starting to go bad.  The flavoring was clumped instead of being evenly distributed on the nut.  They left a bad taste in my mouth.  I thought I would get a box of six as I have received in the past, but instead, I received six individual cans which were repackaged in plastic.  There were no expiration dates since they were repackaged.  It makes me wonder if they were repackaged because they had expired.  I'm truly disappointed.
I was extremely pleased with this seller and item. I will be buying from this seller again.

All 6 cans were old and rancid!  I had alo ordered two cans from e-bay, and they were fine, but obviously not out of date as I'm sure these 6 cans were.  I still have all 6 cans if anyone is interested in the codes.

I used a vanilla bean from this package making a vanilla ice cream (from JENI'S SPLENDID ICE CREAMS, an excellent book by the way).  It was fresh and pliable and full of vanilla 'seeds.'  The price is very good (10 vanilla beans for $9!).  I would purchase again.
I like the quality and price of this produce and will buy it again when this order runs out.  I would recommend it to anyone looking for quantity AND quality.
I thought this would be good for my husband to have. Just awful though. The hashbrowns don't get crisp. The cheese sauce has a very unappealing flavor. Definitely not enough ham! Pass on this one!

I bought this product because it seemed very convienient.  You don't even need milk to make it.  I honestly can't taste anything in it because there is so much salt.  I understand that dried food is salty, but this is ridiculous.  If you have high blood pressure or just don't want to in the future I recommend staying away from this product.

column9: Pretty decent for out of a box
column10: I have tried several of the Banquet Homestyle Bakes. I don't expect good food from a box, but I do expect it to be reasonably edible. I live alone and sometimes I just can't force myself to cook. This one is my favorite of this brand's offerings. It is easy to make and it is acceptable. It can even be spiced up to make it a little better. The potatoes do not even remotely resemble hash browns-- fair warning. The sauce contains a decent amount of cheese and the ham is visible. This one is one I will keep on hand. The one I won't ever buy again is the chicken alfredo. The sauce was pretty good, but the pasta was inedible after being cooked according to the directions. I almost threw it away. I suggest that all pasta dishes from a box be looked upon with suspicion. Rice and potato dishes are more likely to be acceptable.

column9: These are very tasty and convenient.
column10: These can stay on the shelf for a long time and be readily available if one couldn't go shopping or for an emergency situation.  They taste good too!

My best friend and I live together.  I do the cooking and cleaning, and he is disabled so he does little work around the house.  We eat these meals, both this brand and the Betty Crocker complete meals, about 3-4 times a month.  We are fairly new to them.  I would eat them more often but the salt intake is too high for part of a regular diet.This one we first made the other day.  I made it for breakfast, with some scrambled eggs.  We haven't had hashbrowns in a while, so he was looking forward to eating some.  I have bought a frozen hashbrown casserole before, that was similar to this one.  It's not supposed to have a crunchy texture.  With the sauce in there it really can't have one.When I asked how it was, he said we need to eat hashbrowns like this from now on!!  I said really?  He said oh yeah this is really good.  I hate the thought of grating potatoes just for a side dish.  I love the cheesy sauce, and the ham pieces were consistent.  You definitely need something else with it, like all these meals.  But this one I will definitely get again for a nice morning meal.  Or a breakfast for dinner meal too, I am a rule breaker.

We ordered this for a small group of people at my job. So far, no complaints and we all seem to be enjoying it! We read that it's a low acid coffee (guess they have some coffee shops on the west coast, but none here where we are) and several people (including me) have noted that they haven't had any stomach troubles since we started drinking this. We had a little hiccup with the initial shipment (missing 10 bags and the individual bags weren't labeled -- reason for less than 5 star review), but Amazon was great about taking care of this and we plan to continue to get this coffee. Great find for the price!***UPDATE***Got our second shipment today and all the items were in the box -- still not individually labeled, though. We're still enjoying the coffee.

My dogs normal food is grain free, and I always like when I can find treats that are similar.  My dogs absolutely enjoyed this specific treat.  We have given them other flavors, but they seemed to go at these like they liked them more.

column9: My Pug with Allergies Loves Em'
column10: I purchased these with the Everlasting treat ball in small and my dog LOVED it!  The ball came with a beef flavor and I put the wheat, corn, and soy free on the opposite end of the ball and she preferred this over the beef.  I let my other pug try it and he preferred this one over the beef also.  I have bought this item 3 times within a couple weeks because they love them so much.

Each dog will have its own favorite, and that may vary day to day. This has an unknown flavor but it is the favorite flavor of my Havanese. 2nd is Chicken. 3rd is surprizingly vanilla mint. Disliked most is BBQ and liver. Though he likes freeze dried liver treats. Sometimes likes chicken and vegetables. I have tried all flavors and this is the one that is chewed non-stop.
I have three dogs and they all love these treats, it keeps them busy and happy, and that makes me a very happy pet owner.

column9: Playing with food.....an Everlasting treat (dog, that is)
column10: My little dog, Lacey, has been having a ball (literally).  Inserted in her treat ball, she plays for long periods and tries so hard to eat the treat.  So far she has not consumed it to any degree, but she keeps trying.  If Lacey could talk, she would want to express her thanks.
My 6 month old puppies and adult dogs love this treat. It is longer lasting than most chews when put in the everlasting treat ball.

My mom has bought me all the flavors of these treats. The Wheat, Corn, Soy Free is pretty much the only flavor that I like. And I don't just like them, I LOVE them. I don't know why they are called everlasting because I inhale the entire treat in under 30 minutes these days! (I'm now 80 pounds so maybe that's why). I highly recommend these treats.

These are so hard to get into the toy!  I have had to resort to using a screwdriver to actually get it in.  The medium size is also difficult, but nowhere near as hard as the large size.  I was really excited about these when I bought the toy, but it is so hard to get in that now I only use it when I know I will be gone for a significant amount of time.  The first time I gave it to my dog, he had it out in about 2 minutes.  Thankfully the next time it took a couple of days, but it is annoying to get these in.

Our dog has wheat, corn and soy allergies, so I was excited to see the option w/o these.  Unfortunately, she was not the least bit interested in trying the treat -- and this is a dog who eats everything!

Our dogs need to chew.  We feel comfortable with this product because there are no little pieces breaking off as possible chocking or digestive hazards. The dogs love it and could work on it for hours, but we set a time limit and save the treat for another day.  That way it lasts for quite awhile.  We prefer the ones that are wheat free. Most dog treats contain wheat which our dogs can't have so that's another plus. The biggest problem is fitting the treat into the ball, but if that were easy it would also be easy for the dogs to get it out! This product is safe and fun.

It's a good product and my dog likes them, but didn't last as long as I had expected.  She's a Cocker Spaniel and made quick work of it.  I like the combination of ingredients.  Seems to be a healthy snack.They are nicely packaged and arrived on time.  I will order again.

This toy definitely kept my guy busy. Unfortunately when he ate a chunk of it, it also kept my vet busy.I only allowed my dog to use this when I was around and gave it to him in the ball holder but he still managed to swallow a piece. It got stuck for a bit in his gut and caused him to throw up anything he ate and quite a bit of discomfort. Fortunately since this is a digestible item he was able to pass it without the need for surgery.My dog is a STRONG chewer and very determined, so you may have better lick, I mean luck, if your dog isn't so intent on liberating it from the holder.Also, if your dog has a Wheat/Corn/Soy allergy, be sure to test this with them before giving them the whole thing. I can't say for sure, but I suspect the package we had was NOT wheat-free b/c the boy reacted to it much like he does when he eats something with wheat in it. Unfortunately I didn't put that together in time to prevent what was described above.

I was unimpressed. These treats are expensive and super gooey messy. Once out of the ball, this expensive treat can be devoured in seconds. I have a rottie and bullmastiff, of course if you have a smaller dog you may not have the same results. See my review regarding the treat ball.

My dogs are 12 LB, they love to chew, I thought I would try these StarMark, I bought a 2 pack medium, didn't even last a day. SAVE YOUR MONEY!!!I need to buy Thick bully sticks they last about a week. (Where and when I can find Thick Bulky sticks at a inexpensive price)

I enjoy buying new things 4 my puppy especially treats and have bought Everlasting treats 4 him b4!  But, 4 some reason he seems 2 not enjoy this one as much as the ones I buy from the regular supermarket...tanks!

column9: Wheat, Corn, and Soy Free Everlasting Ball Treats....
column10: My 2 dogs have allergies so finding these treats for the Everlasting Treat Ball was excellant since this serves as a distraction for them from scratching which causes skin irratation.. ps - they are on allergy serum shots but still get itchy.. THANK YOU AMAZON for carrying the wheat corn and soy free treats for the everlasting treat ball!!

One of the only things my mini poodle gets to eat. They don't bother him has long it is in moderation, if he is allowed a whole one it will give him the runs. But he loves them for a few minutes a day and keeps him quite entertained for a little while. They don't smell really at all. I am not sure how a normal dog that can eat other things would like them, but he is allergic to everything so he likes them quite well. We use the Bento ball with them.

While my 11 month golden retriever LOVES the fire plug and the everlasting treats, these replacements weren't a good fit for the toy. He had them out of the fire plug in a matter of minutes. The everlasting treat that came with the toy fit much tighter and lasted a few hours.

This chewy taffy-like candy is a staple here in Japan.  Get a bunch of these and a pot of coffee and you'll be able to finish you thesis in one night!  Well, perhaps that's an exaggeration, but you get the picture.

I have always been a candy person as long as I can remember and I came across this candy while I was spending time in Japan. I was instantly hooked. The flavor in these candies are awesome. I found myself picking a pack of these up almost everytime I was near a place that sold them. I brought a bunch home and shared them with friends and family. I haven't met a person yet who doesn't love them. Personal preference is purple grape and green apple. Some may disagree but the version of this candy with the english words "Hi Chew" are not as good as the Japanese version. Different wrapping and different texture slightly. Buy some of these today! They are amazing!

I brought some of this candy and became instantly hooked as the other reviews had said.  It is a fruit chew, but way better than starburst or any other fruit chew candy that I've tried......This candy is fantastic.

the first time i tried this candy, i was instantly addicted!it's like gum or taffy but its really candy!  I was really addicted to this candy when i was in high school and still am and eversince  stocks here in the Philippines ran out, i started going crazy on where i could but more.  thank god for amazon!  try this! its really great!

I just switched to this food and my cats love it!  They have allergies and this food makes all their symptoms disappear.  I didn't know Natural Balance made an Ultra for cats without chicken, but am really glad we found this because even my picky tabby girl eats it!
We gave these out for Halloween and we are still enjoying the ones we had left over.  Very fresh and a great change from cheap candy.

column9: Super handy to have these snacks easy to grab
column10: I bought these thinking I would probably eat one a day and be all set for quick snacks for about three months.  Peanut addict that I am though I've been eating two or three a day so they haven't lasted so long.  Still, I can't imagine a better thing to put in a kid's lunch box, hand out at Halloween, or take to work.  The peanuts were fresh and not overly salty.  Being a peanut butter freak as well I don't dare keep a jar in the house but I find that two or three of these one ounce bags of peanuts in my small food processor provides me with just enough peanut butter to take care of a craving without eating up an entire jar.

column9: great peanuts at a great price
column10: I love the one ounce size, it keeps me from eating too many at once. Plus, you can't beat Planters in my opinion.

I can't find this at my local store anymore, and I'm happy I can order them here.  I eat one package a day at work and I occasionally send them as a school snack for my daughter.  It's just enough since I would eat more in a big package.  I like that they're pretty salty.

column9: ADOBO WITH NO SALT OR MSG,  YEAH!
column10: I am so thrilled to have found this product as I love the original Goya Adobo, however, I've had to change my diet in the past year and must follow a very low salt diet.  I've missed using the original Adobo which makes meats and fish taste wonderful.  Now I can enjoy it again with Marshall's Creek seasonings. This tastes great and allows me to control my salt intake.  It has the same ingredients as the popular brand except for the salt and msg (msg can also raise blood pressure).  When I opened the (BiG) jar the aroma was great.  I've used it on chicken, fish, beef and shrimp.  If you love the original adobo seasoning but have to watch your salt consumption you will enjoy this product. Thank you Marshall's Creek.

I bought this at a food booth that was set up at a crafts show. The jar sat on my kitchen shelf unopened for a good year. Finally, I decided to try it on a pan fried skirt steak. I had NEVER made such a tasty steak at home in my life. It was incredible. Just like a fancy steak house. You just have to try this stuff to believe it. Its like magic. When I ran out, I went online and ordered the $29 giant jar and I now stockpile it in my freezer. Everyone who tastes this goes WHOA what did you do to this steak?

column9: Great on everything from chicken to eggs to popcorn.
column10: It's not just your regular garlic salt, there must be other spices in there that really bring out the flavor.  Adds a little garlic flavor to just about anything.  Great for quick garlic bread, add to sour cream for garlic dip, sprinkle on popcorn, in scrambled eggs, mashed potatoes, salad, etc.  I like it because I can add the garlic flavor to my portion of food on my own plate too, when cooking for others who don't like garlic.

I'm so addicted to these crackers, totally lol! I figured that since it's roasted vegetables it would be a good snack...lol.  It's my favorite snack and try to keep plenty on hand. If I run out, I get spasy, lol

I bought a case of 12 16oz boxes and am down to the the last four.While very tasty these crackers are so fragile that they're not much good  other than adding a small slice of summer sausage or a smoked oyster on one.If you try putting peanut butter or other spread the cracker just breaks into pieces in your hand.When I reorder I'm going back to regular Ritz crackers...maybe that's the re reason they're on sale.

This is really something unique !  Especially if you like spicy food.Great with cheese and wine.For this price you can`t beat it anywhere.Also try the anchovies filled variation if you`re not on the spicy side!
these came perfectly packaged and are beautiful. but are waaayyy too expensive. i thought i would get much more than i did for the price.
This is by far the best turkey jerky on the market. It has just the right amount of tenderness and flavor. I highly recommend this product to anyone looking for real turkey jerky.

I first had the Big Franks while visiting a friend during high school and I've loved them ever since. They do not taste exactly like traditional meat hotdogs and the closest description of the flavor that I can come up with is something like a light-flavored vienna sausage. Otherwise, you can use the same condiments as regular hotdogs, or add mayo to add a bit more of a creamy flavor to them.

Loma Linda products are very hard to find in stores so I was thrilled to see them on Amazon. I have eaten these since I was a child and they are one of my favorite foods. Some of my friends say they are an acquired taste, but those who like them seem to love them.

I grew up on Big Franks, so I admit they are an acquired taste. They don't taste like regular hot dogs. The texture is softer, and more chewy. But they are flavorful, and I think the flavor grows on you--although others in my family object entirely, and they find the aroma very disagreeable. But my youngest--and pickiest--child lives on them! They are her main source of protein. Fortunately they are basically healthful, and they are a great source of B vitamins. Plus, they are so convenient. You can eat them straight from the can. Start with the one in the middle so you can wiggle the others out that are stuck to the side of the can. ;)

column9: Very different from Morningstar/GardenBurger frozen dogs
column10: This review is for people who are expecting Loma Linda franks to taste like Morningstar and Garden Burger-type frozen veggie dogs.  I bought these expecting them to be quite similiar.  They are not. They are, however, shelf-stable (I got them b/c I'll be overseas and need protein) and very nutritious at only 110 calories each.I just can't seem to get used to the taste and texture -- much softer and more pliable than the frozen variety, with less of a hotdog "skin". The taste is pretty different.  Less meaty.  Also, there are 8 per can, so storing the leftovers is a bit inconvenient.I can see how these might be great in a casserole or as part of another dish, but on their own (which is how I ate them), they weren't to my taste.I feel bad giving this product a poor review since it's my own fault for thinking that frozen veggie dogs and shelf stable ones in a can would be the same, but thought I should alert others like me who were unfamiliar with Loma Linda and expecting something comparable to Morningstar's product.

These are my favorite veggie dogs, tender and tasty. Morningstar frozen ones are terrible. I see they're back! Another way to prepare: Mash one up with mayonnaise and eat like tuna salad. They're precooked. Try it, you'll like it.Order now if they're available; they go in and out of stock.

This is just an FYI for those who may want to know--I looked up the ingredients for Big Franks and found that they contain Propylene Glycol. Please don't jump on me for posting this--I am simply passing this info on in case anyone else may want to know or even cares.  I do like the taste of these and was already to order a case but decided to look up their ingredients and this is what I found:Ingredients: Franks: Textured vegetable protein (wheat gluten, soy protein concentrate, water), corn oil, water, torula yeast. Contains 2% or less of defatted wheat germ, defatted soy flour, dried onion, mono- and diglycerides from soybean oil, salt, hydrolyzed soy protein, garlic powder, autolyzed yeast extract, hydrolyzed corn protein, soy lecithin, caramel color, natural smoke flavor, L-lysine monohydrochloride, spices, concentrated onion juice, vegetarian natural flavors, vitamins (niacinamide, calcium pantothenate, vitamin B1, vitamin B6, vitamin B2, vitamin B12), propylene glycol, red #3 for color. Brine: Water, salt.

column9: Great to try if you don't like other veggie hot dogs
column10: I order these by the flat, and try to make them last for 3-6 months.However, my Non-vegetarian girlfriend gets into them.  Constantly.  I usually hide a few cans so that I can have some when I want.  I'm sure that the taste is not for everyone, but most people who like these, love them.I get morningstar farms for most of my veggie meats, but this is my only choice for veggie dogs.  It's the only kind that tastes different.  The other kinds of veggie dogs are too rubbery and chewy and just don't taste good.

column9: Best Veggie Dog on the planet!!
column10: I've eaten almost every veggie dog that is offered here in the USA, Loma Linda Big Franks are in my opinion the very best and have been tops in my family for years.Thanks, Loma Linda!

With four boys and a husband who are all carnivores, I don't have much of a chance! Raised a vegetarian, I now know how to cook meat and will eat some select items, however, I just can't handle eating meat hot dogs. Just not knowing what is in them is very disturbing to me! Well, we finally found a hot dog that the whole family LOVES! Yes, loves! Even my husband will eat these! column9: Awesome if you have the right equipment
column10: This was the coffee in cafes, bars, and homes, all around Malaga, Andulcia where I lived for some time. There are really only two ways to prepare this coffee to make it taste like it did there.A stovetop bialetti espresso maker (or offbrand, it doesn't matter, but it has to be that style) and this was how it was made at home. From my flatmates to their families, to the people I worked with, etc, this was the method we used to make our own cafe con leche. (I'll post directions at the bottom.)At bars and cafes, they used professional grade espresso machines, not the cheap ones many people have - they cannot produce the same amount of pressure, so pretty much anything short of the 800usd range won't get you adequate pressure to make a cafe style cafe con leche. (Personally, for what it is, and how long it lasts, I have invested in a Nuova Simonelli Oscar. It has a high pressure steam and high pressure application for the extraction - and you can use the steam wand and pull a shot of espresso at the same time. For most espresso machines, you're looking at the 2,000usd and above range to get that to happen. Plus Nuova Simonelli's are serious workhorse machines, you just have to take good care of them.)Instructions for the stovetop method:1) Use good water if possible, otherwise tap will do but be aware that you will get calcium deposits forming on all the parts and you will need to soak the stovetop maker in a strong, hot water and vinegar solution regularly.2) In the filter, pack as much coffee grounds as you can without it overflowing, and pack it TIGHT3) Cook on low-medium heat, if it cooks too fast or too high, you will scald your coffee, and that just tastes terrible4) While the espresso is cooking, get whatever mug(s)/cup(s) (in Spain, we used glasses, foreigners and tourists got mugs at cafes) you are going to be serving the cafe con leche in, and fill it three quarters with whole milk. Whole. Not 2%, not skim, not cream or creamer, but whole. Whole milk/3.5% fat. Anything else and the texture will not be the same. Microwave the cup's contents for about two minutes, just until it starts to simmer, then if you have a hand pump frother, go ahead and froth it a little bit. Not a lot, you are not trying to make a macchiato. You just want the hot milk to be a little velvety.5) Pour in a shot to two shots from your stovetop espresso pot and stir well6) Raw sugar or white sugar, usually a tablespoon to two tablespoons was what I saw others use (I usually went whole hog and did 3 tablespoons) and stir.This will yield a velvety, thick, and sweet cafe con leche. It's how pretty much everyone I knew who didn't drink it black would prepare it. (The Brits all used drip style and had no idea what they were doing and would complain about how thin it was because they just used a drip Mr Coffee style set up.)

column9: HFCS  = Wont be feeding this to my family
column10: Go with Simply Heinz Ketchup not these packs its the best ketchup with real sugar. No poisons like HFCS.HFCS.. Here's why it's far more dangerous to your health than table sugarHigh fructose corn syrup is a popular sweetener because it is chemically different from sugar ,it has a longer shelf life and mixes better into beverages. Yet the corn industry likes to downplay these differences, pointing out that sugar is 50 percent fructose and 50 percent glucose, while HFCS is 55 percent fructose and 45 percent glucose.This framing glosses over an essential difference: sugar (sucrose) is a disaccharide composed of a single glucose molecule and a single fructose molecule. HFCS, in contrast, is a liquid solution composed of separated individual glucose and fructose molecules (monosaccharides).To make HFCS, a 100 percent glucose solution is converted via enzymes into a 42 percent fructose-58 percent glucose solution. This solution is further treated until it is 90 percent glucose, then mixed with more 42-58 solution to yield a 55-45 concentration. So while the final ratio of fructose to glucose might look similar to table sugar, it is in fact a very different product. Is it any wonder that HFCS is processed differently by the body?
