The latest shipment of the sardines had the following large changes in the nutrional profile:Before/After: (per 1 can)Calories 90/160 (the serving size increased from 1 to 2, so I'm multiplying the indicated calories by 2 (indicated 80 on the box) for proper comparison)Total Fat 3g/8gSaturated Fat 0g/2gSodium 280mg/560mgProtein 16g/22gI'm not sure whether to believe the old vs new.  Regardless, these sardines are good, just not sure about the accuracty of the data given the large change.

Very large can compaired to the standard Sardine can.  Excellent tasting Sardines.  I use these for a snack throughout the day with "veggie sticks" or crackers.  Protein, calcuim, low calories, just delish !

It has hidden MSG (a known neurotoxin). Terrible tasting and I love Triscuit. It tastes like old stale garlic powder and smelly feet. I actually threw the box away after a few bites. Try Triscuit Pepper and Triscuit Dill instead. They are awesome tasting and without MSG. I can eat Triscuit Pepper and Triscuit Dill all day:)

I LOVE these triscuits - and I guess everyone else does too - because our grocery stores can not keep them in stock.  They have every other Triscuit except Roasted Garlic - Amazon to the rescue - I just bought a case and no more worries of running out.  One word of warning - they are addictive!

I ordered 2 packets of the same item to save the shipping. I found the items are good and nice. I would like to have a mix version which include different flavors. Overall I will recommend this. The cons is expiry date is 3 months after only so I have to eat all 24 packets in 3 months ;).

I like Triscuit crackers because they are made with whole grains, and no trans-fats. I was glad they started making them in other "flavors" for variety.I'm pretty sure I had bought a box of the Roasted Garlic at the grocery store when they first came out and they were not so salty, and had a stronger garlic flavor, so I was disappointed with these. I guess if you love salt, and a milder garlic flavor, these are for you.Note they have MSG which is a migraine trigger for some people.
These tasty little biscuits arrived well packed and on time...the expiry date was 15 weeks from delivery..would have preferred more time given the amount of boxes bought.

Perhaps there is a real market difference in price around the country, but I've never seen that while traveling and buying Triscuits in Illinois, and going up the east and the west coast. I live in North Texas and the Kroger here regularly puts these 9.5 oz boxes on sale for $2.20-$2.40 a box. At least in my neck of the woods kinda makes the Amazon rate seem like not so great a deal.
I've had this cracker before and I love it.  Then Amazon has $25 off for buying than $60 grocery spending. Excellent snacks with excellent prices from Amazon.com
You'll want to consume these weaving wonders right after you take a massive hit from your bong, you won't regret it.

column9: Finally, a reason to keep the Keurig!
column10: I have had my Keurig for ten days now.  Since I was waiting for my Amazon-ordered Green Mountain Dark Magic Decaf to arrive via Fed Ex, I was using the free variety sampler pack that came with the machine.  I was certain that the whole Keurig thing was hype.  The coffee was weak.  The coffee was fruity-winy, just what I dislike in my coffee mug.  I had even tried the hot chocolate and thought it was about the same as Swiss Miss in an envelope:  crappy-tasting and limpid.  Last night, things started to look up:  I had a Celestial Seasonings Mandarin Spice herbal tea, and that was verrrry good.  And today, my Dark Magic arrived.  Just had two cups.  It's dark.  It's rich.  It's bold.  It's smooth.  It accepts my half-and-half and stands up to it.  It's a heckuva cup of coffee.  Maybe I'll keep the Keurig after all.

This is an acceptable coffee offering from the folks at Green Mountain. Rich without bitterness or burnt flavors, the strength and balance of this brew should satisfy most palates. If Sumatra is not available, this will suffice.

column9: Great for those who like their coffee strong and dark
column10: After we received our Keurig I tried numerous decaf coffees(that's all I can drink).  This was my definite favorite.  I make the most concentrated brew, and some cream and yumm.  It's a great alternative to my Starbuck's (short double decaf americano).

column9: You can have your coffee and decaf too!
column10: I love the flavor of good strong coffee but I am limited to the amount of caffeine I can have. This decaf is perfect and serves both of my criteria.

This is the best decaff coffee that I have found in K-cups.  Actually I like a 50:50 mixture of caff and decaff coffee so I blend the Dark Magic caff and the Dark Magic decaff in a 20 ounce mug.  This is a much better option than buying the Green Mountain Half Caff which has a really poor taste.

Recently my cardiologist forced me to give up my beloved coffee with caffeine. I have always been a coffee addict drinking up to 7 cups a day of Green Mountains darkest, richest blends. Sometimes for added oomph I would add a shot of espresso. So imagine my chagrin when forced to give up my beloved coffee? You may ask yourselves why was I giving up coffee? Why wasn't I switching to decaf? Well, lets say that what I remember from the past was that decaf coffee wasn't delicious. It was rather nasty to my taste buds. Sanka Instant and Postum...blech.Since I had been drinking Green Mountain Dark Magic WITH caffeine, I decided to try it in the decaf form. And WOW. What a difference from those weak wanna be coffees that taste like warm water that a brown crayon was dipped in and called coffee.Testing Dark Magic against the French Roast decaf...well thank god Dark Magic is even better since the French Roast Green Mountain will no longer be available.  At least according to Keurig when I asked them. I had previously thought that the French Roast was the best and that the Dark Magic rated a distant third, but I have a feeling that I had gotten a bad batch since what I have been drinking is excellent.It is surprisingly rich, full flavored, non-acidic and with none of the aftertaste that some coffees can have. I don't think for one minute that I would be able to tell the difference if I was to be served this in a blind taste test.Well this just goes to show that sometimes the past and how we remember things can come back to bite us on our you know whats. I would have been truly suffering had I not found this product!

I've been looking for a good Decaf k-cup since purchasing my Keurig coffeemaker about a year ago.  Found at last!  Green Mountain Extra Bold Dark Magic Decaf is wonderful!  It delivers full, rich, bold flavor, even at the second biggest cup size setting.  Now when I cap my caffeine intake for the day, I don't feel like I'm settling for for "less than" coffee.  With this great taste and aroma, you'd never guess this is a decaf. If you like strong, dark roast coffee, but want to limit your caffeine, this is the k-cup for you!

column9: Best K-cup coffee for everyday enjoyment.
column10: The Dark Magic was highly recommended by others, and I tried it. It is really good coffee, in both decaf and regular. It is my K-cup of choice for a great cuppa joe on a break from a busy day.On special occasions I like the flavored stuff, but when you want a good, honest cup- this is it for me.

I've loved Dark Magic since I discovered it shortly after buying my Keurig and it is my favorite.  Recently I decided to try decaf and ordered this coffee.  I absolutely love it and it is still my favorite.

A very rich coffee especially for a decaf and perfect for those that like larger cups of coffee but are trying to restrict caffeine intake. I find that Amazon has many more choices than most for the K Cup and most of the time better prices. It is nice not to be so restricted with the decaf choices and this one is a tasty one but definitely bold!

column9: A way for a coffee drinker to enjoy decaf
column10: I'm a coffee drinking fiend, but the caffeine ups and downs were really starting to wear on me.  I've been hesitant switching to decaf coffee becuase I thought I had to give-up the bold taste that I enjoy so much.  Green Mountain's Extra Bold decaf was the answer.  I still enjoy that bold coffee taste, but without the sluggish affects of the caffeine lull later.  It's a win-win!

I managed to taste this before purchasing and I have to say, in taste and character, it is easily equal to its non-decaffeinated counterparts. It makes a hearty cup with no bitter aftertaste. My sister in law likes to mix it with flavored coffee for strength (as the Green Mountain flavors tend to be on the light side), I like it on its own. An impressive decaf.
I gave up caffeine September of 2011.  Dark Magic Extra Bold decaf tastes like a caffeinated coffee.  It's hard to drink any other kind (except Starbucks decaf at a Starbucks location).
I am happy to have ordered this coffee. It is a strong dark coffee with a bold taste. I would recommend this to all people who like coffee, and worry about going decaf.
Dark Magic is one of my favorite types of K-Cups, and the decaf has the same great flavor as the regular variety. Recommended if you like strong, bold coffee.

column9: Deep fabulous rich decaf coffee for the Keurig
column10: Great great decaf.  Made the Keurig worth it.  Until then all coffees tasted like water.  Very smooth not at all bitter just full of flavor.

column9: If you like a big cup of coffee...
column10: If you like a big cup of coffee, buy the "extra" and/or "dark" cups.  They contain more coffee for the same approximate price as the non-extra cups (as the packaging is the expense in K-cups).I make 14 ounces of coffee from these Extra-Bold Dark Magic Decaf cups, then add two ounces of milk.  (Of course, if you like strong coffee, you'll need to make the usual 8 ounces.)Note: Be careful when ordering decaf coffee from Amazon: Amazon has a big fat bug in their search algorithm:  If you search for decaf, they will happily serve up regular coffee instead. Make sure before you click the Buy button that you really are buying decaf.  Otherwise, you may be awake for the next 40 days and 40 nights.
I love my extra bold dark magic decaf coffee.  It has a robust taste that is so satisfying. I would definitely buy it again.
if you are into decaf and looking for a bold coffee flavor this is a great pick. Makes a nice cup of coffee in the morning, even without the caffeine to get you going.

column9: A good first experience with k-cups
column10: I will readily admit that I'm not a coffee connosieur, I like what I like and I can't explain why I like it. I really liked this blend. I always hear people say that decaf doesn't taste as good but I thought this Dark Magic Decaf was very tasty!
Although the taste of this coffee is quite good, the acidity really upset my stomach.  I tried 3 or 4 cups just to make sure, and just can't keep drinking it.  Too bad, I have most of a box left.

column9: The Best K-Cup Decaf So Far and I've Tried Many
column10: What can I say. I've now tried nearly every Extra Bold Decaf K-cup made and this is my favorite. It's a full bodied, rich, complex coffee that tastes "better" than 95% of the leaded coffees I've tried over the years. I set my Keurig to the 10 oz. mug setting, push the button, and enjoy! My second favorite (and very different) coffee is Coffee People Donut Shop Extra Bold Decaf, although I am looking forward to trying Coffee People Extra Bold French Roast.PS. I have to drink decaf only now, but no compromise in taste thanks to this great coffee.
This coffee has all of the bold flavor of the regular, but can be enjoyed before bed.

column9: Bad after-taste, not bold, tastes awful.
column10: This coffee has a very bad, bitter after-taste.It's not really bold per se, either.  It's basically a morning blend light roast, but just made too strong.  A bold ought to be a darker roast in my opinion.  This coffee is for people who have lost their sense of taste.I feel bad throwing this coffee out, but once I tasted the Newman's organic decaf (smooth and tasty), I can't go back. The only hope for this coffee is that it will compost.
This coffee has a great bold flavor without the bitterness.  I am a dark roast drinker, and this one is a winner in my book. I am sold.
I love my coffee, and in the evening I have to shift to decaf if I am to sleep.  I prefer the bold, strong flavored coffees, and this ranks at the top.

Dark Magic K-Cup is a good option for Keurig based d-caf coffee.  A robust, dark roast that allows for "re-use" to get an over-sized mug (two middle button runs on my Kurig) of coffee which I take light, no sugar.

Love this coffee!! I can only have one cup of caffeine per day so I have been looking for a coffee that isnt caffeine but still taste good..well this coffee taste just like a cup of regular caffeine coffee!

column9: Thick, dark and a bite: Yum!
column10: Love the convenience of the Keurig, but the coffee was never as good (read dark with a bite) as the coffee brewed at home. Discovered 'Dark Magic' reg and decaf: problem solved! Even at the 8 oz and above this brews a cuppa with depth, flavor, and body, even in decaf. Amazing with a brownie on the side or on its own.

For anyone who still thinks that decaf coffee means Sanka crystals, you are missing out on good flavored coffee without the caffeine.  I enjoy drinking several cups of coffee a day, but the caffeine can make me edgy.  So I balance out my regular blend coffees with a decaf like the Green Mountain extra bold.  You still have plenty of robust coffee flavor, but no caffeine.  I highly recommend it.

Green Mountain Coffee Decaf Dark Magic, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig Brewers 24-CountI like the dark Magic Extra Bold, its a very strong cup of coffee Yummmmmmmm I will make a craft of 1 Dark Magic Extra Bold and mix it with Hazelnut. >^,,^< meowwwwwGreen Mountain Coffee, Dark Magic (Extra Bold), K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig Brewers 24-Count

Since purchasing our Keurig I have been consistently disappointed in getting a bold cup of decaf (or a bold cup, period!)  This decaf is an exception, and while it's still not up to regular brew standards, it's the best bold decaf I've found yet in a K-cup.  It's a deep, complex taste without being bitter or harsh.  Good coffee!

column9: LOVE this decaf! Like the real thing!
column10: If you want your decaf to taste like real coffee -- choose this one!  It is amazing!  I am not drinking caffeinated because I am nursing, so this is a very close second.  I highly recommend it!  I don't find it to be too acidic, but perhaps because I add half and half. Super delicious!

I've tried many of the decaf coffees available for the Keurig (not the flavored ones, though) and I've found this to be the best.  It's full bodied, tastes great (and I use the 12 oz water setting so it would be even stronger at 8 oz.) and it doesn't give you the jitters.  I just wish Amazon would offer it on their "Subscribe and Save" program.  It's a tad expensive.

Finally I have found a decaf coffee that tastes like coffee and not a watered down version of reg coffee. Tastes great, full bodied and no after taste. Even with a little cream and sweetner it still tastes like coffee.

This coffee is rich and tastes great!  Served it to friends who do not like "decaf" and they had no idea that this was a decaf.  The flavor is really good.  I took off a star because it is not as aromatic as the Nantucket blends.  To me, a coffee should have a coffee aroma when brewing and therefore making my anticipation greater.  Also, the fragrance of brewing coffee reminds me of my Grandma making (remember this?) perked coffee; and, truly, this is a good thing.

column9: Best Decaf Coffee Pod I Have Found!
column10: I recently stopped caffiene for a variety of reasons, but was having a difficult time finding a dark roast coffee I enjoyed.  This one hit the spot.  I am so grateful to the friend that recommended it.
I looked everywhere for a decaf that had real coffee taste.  I have tried many brands, but the Green Mountain Extra Bold is the best by far!
One of the better k-cup coffee out there.  Most k-cup coffee I've tried are pretty weak but this one is definitely a keeper.

I've tried several Keurig decaf coffees and the Green Mountain Extra Bold Dark Magic is by far my favorite. Most decafs are too weak and I usually have to change the settings on my brewer to a smaller size just to get a decent tasting cup. The Extra Bold tastes like a great cup of regular coffee. I doubt most people would even know it was decaf unless you told them.

We have tried many different brands and found Green Mountain Coffee products in general to provide the boldest, richest flavor. We prefer decaf coffee, but most large retail outlets selling Keurig products only offer a very small selection of decaffeinated K-cups. We are so excited just to be able to find our favorite, impossible -to-find coffee at Amazon, and to be able to purchase in quantities larger than the standard 18 ct. box. Even factoring in shipping costs, Amazon's unit price is less than most retail outlets, Walmart included!
Very good coffee, very good price.  It can be difficult to find a strong decaf coffeein K cups, but these are great!

If you are a person who loves a strong regular cup, but can't find a strong decaf, well now you have.  This Dark magic Decaf tastes so much like regular that I have to double check my k-cup after I brew just to make sure I put in the decaf.  It is strong, rich and has no weakness or after taste.  I have been searching YEARS for a good decaf. I wasted a lot of money on weak decaf,Starbucks Verona decaf was the closest I came, and this is even better, and it is a k-cup!Bravo Green Mountain, thanks for the great brew.

I have to drink Decaf coffee, and I got this one to use mainly in my tall travel mug.  It is definitely bold, too bold for my morning coffee, even at the 4th cup size on my Keurig, so I will use it up whenever I want to take a travel mug of flavored coffee with me.

If you enjoy a bold cup of coffee during the day you will love this decaf version the best.  I have looked everywhere for a good strong cup of decaf and hadnt found one until now.  This is the greatest tasting decaf coffee I have found and I love it!
Rich, great tasting dark coffee. Not bitter at all. A good coffee for those that enjoy a dark richer tasting coffee that is decaf.
We've tried many other decaf k-cups and this is the best by far.  We have purchased it repeatedly and will continue to do so when decaf coffee hits our grocery list.

I'm not generally a fan of decaf anyway so take this with a grain of salt.I found it drinkable with just a tinge of what I call "conference coffee" taste.  If I wanted decaf I'd go for this one or Emeril's Jazzed up Decaf.For reference purposes my in store drink is a Starbucks Americano.My favorite k-cups are:Starbucks French RoastStarbucks Caffe VeronaStarbucks Pike Place RoastGreen Mountain Xtra Bold Sumatran ReserveGreen Mountain Double Black DiamondGreen Mountain RevvGreen Mountain Dark MagicOther k-cups I've tried:  Coffee People Jet Fuel ,Green Mountain Dark Magic Decaf, Starbucks Caffe Verona, Coffee People Black Tiger,  Starbucks House Blend, Starbucks Breakfast Blend, Starbucks Sumatra, Wolfgang Puck French Roast, Green Mountain Lake and Lodge, Green Mountain French Roast, Caribou Mahogony, Wolfgang Puck Sumatra Kopi Raya, Emeril Big Easy Bold

Being the first time I have tried this flavor, I was not quite sure what to expect.  Well, I could not be more surprised or happy.  For anyone looking for a dark roast, full bodied coffee, you cannot go wrong.  Have restocked my shelves again twice since the initial purchase.  Enjoy!

These k-cups are certainly bold and strong, but the finish is flat and thin. It's lacking in overtones after the initial dark wave. I just started exploring k-cups since my machine arrived last week. Initially I was surprised how watery the house blends are. I wanted something dark and rich in texture. But so far, I'd rather drink Tully's French Roast extra bold k-cups which is just about as strong as Dark Magic but with a wider spectrum and better finish.
Gives the richest flavor of any decaf K-cups I have tried.  Some others were pretty thin in flavor - this one is quite good.

I was able to totally switch to decaf because of this coffee.  It is by far the best decaf I have ever had.  Usually decaf is very weak or has a funny taste, but not this one.  I like it even more than most regular coffee.  I have a hard time finding it in stores, so I always order through Amazon.

column9: Great coffee, get a better price.
column10: This is my favorite coffee.  I had to go off caffeine, so I love that this has a nice strong coffee flavor.  I didn't notice, however, that this is not for a 2-pack.  I thought I was getting a great deal, but actually I was overpaying.  Be sure to check prices since there are several links with prime shipping at different prices.

column9: Only KCup Decaf that tastes like coffee.
column10: This is the only KCup Decaf that tastes like good coffee. I have tried many other Decafs that tasted like water or nasty dark stuff. Buy this.

This is my second time buying this product- The first purchase , I thought the taste a little bitter- However, i adjusted my "additives(cream/sweetner)" and decided this was really a good cup of coffee- Ergo, i bought it again! Do you know how hard it is to find a good cup of decaf, well, this is it!
Have ordered this before and coming back for more.  A great full flavored decaf with lots of body.  Would not hesitate to order it again. Highly recommended!

This is the best K-cup decaf that we have tried so far. Haven't tried them all, however. I only use the medium cup size button on my brewer. I usually brew my coffee in a French press but when I'm in a hurry Dark Magic is my K-cup of choice.

This coffee is one of my favorites!! I love a rich roast coffee or expresso but I can't have all that caffeine. I can pop a k-cup in my Keurig coffee maker and have a fresh cup of hot or iced coffee when ever I want. Will definitely purchase again :)
I am happy that it was a nice dark bold cup of coffee. Some days I like a dark cup of coffee and this was the right choice.
A good strong coffee for those who aren't shy about flavor.  Great for morning.  Wakes you up without caffeine. I'd buy it again.

column9: Nice but it's a weak dark roast
column10: This was a good decaf but didn't live up to my high expections based on the labeling. I got this hoping for a rich dark roast but it was on the weaker side.  I'm still looking for a rich dark roast DECAF.

If you drink 1/2 gallon of coffee a day as I do then you have to make some concessions.  After my first 2 cups of 8 o"clock french roast in the AM, I switch to decaf, cold brew,dark roast with chickory. My greatest addiction is chewing Sonic ice by the bag over which I pour all this wonderful coffee. My sister introduced me to this Dark Magic espresso blend for an afternoon pick-me-up while on a visit to Shreveport, La. and I've been in love ever since. Hot or cold it is very smooth and a real treat any time of day,mixed with a little milk,or however you drink yours. Try some. What have you got to lose!!
After serving twenty years in the Navy, I look for a good strong cup of coffee, but needed it to be decaf, this Extra Bold hits the target.  Great tasting decaf.
A good cup of decaf coffee is hard to get but if you like a strong coffee, this one is the best!
I BOUGHT THESE FOR MYSELF I BUY ALL MY KERIG COFFEE CUPS FROM AMAZON AS THEY ARE CHEAPER THAN IN THE STORE AND YOU GET A WIDE VARIETY.

It is hard to find a BOLD Decaf-but this is it!!!  It is also hard to find this in a store, so thank God for amazon.com and Deals On Call for having this!  FAST shipping too, so you don't have to wait for your coffee!
Yes, FINALLY, a K-Cup decaf choice that doesn't taste like piss water.  It has a bold flavor that stands up to it's caffeinated cousins.  I've added this one to my "reorder often" list.

column9: The best decaf I've ever tasted
column10: This is a rich, complex coffee blend with truly bold flavor without a hint of bitterness.  I can't even tell that it's decaf, and that's saying a lot.

Usually I find decaf coffee to be too weak, but this product is an exception. It has a nice round full-bodied coffee flavor that isn't diluted by the flavored creamers I occasionally use in place of dessert. I would recommend this decaf above all others I have tried.

This is some of the best decaf coffee I've ever had. Many of the other commonly-available decaf K-Cups are weak or too light a roast for my tastes. This product holds up to plenty of cream and sugar. I've even started making Irish Coffees with it! If you like espresso drinks (even Americanos or straight espresso), this may be the blend for you. Perfect for settling a late-night coffee craving and then going to bed moments later - still tired, with nary a spec of heartburn (as some of us tend to get from caffeinated dark roast blends).The only downside for me is that the jury is still out on the decaffeination process they use in the beans that go into this K-Cup. I'm guessing it is chemically decaffeinated since Green Mountain is not exactly forthcoming with the info (not on their website or on the box). Many K-Cups do use Swiss Water, but I've noticed some K-Cups also note chemical decaffeination on the side of the box now. This is a small price to pay for a great cup of coffee before bed, as far as I'm concerned... and if you're using a Keurig, you probably don't drink too many cups of coffee each day, either (and thus are limiting your exposure to any harmful side effects from the decaffeination process). Still, I would be happy to pay a bit more for a Swiss Water version of this product.
Love this decaf that has extra body.  Twin packs arrived on time or earlier and without damage.  Would certainly order again.

The Green Mountain Extra Bold Dark Magic decaf is a very good, strong coffee. It does have a slight bite, but then I like that in a coffee. Many decaf coffees have little to no taste, especially using K cups, but this decaf actually tastes like coffee! For those interested, the caffeinated version of the Dark Magic coffee is great too! That is why I ordered the decaf to try. I highly recommend that you give it a try.

I have been buying the Timothy's Decaf K-cups for a long time now.  I think my taste buds have gotten bored as recently, I drank some Starbucks Via Decaf and was shocked with how much better that was.  I did some searching and decided to try this Extra Bold to see if the Keurig could produce something with more flavor.  It did!  I really like this coffee and will use it as my daily drinker from now until I get bored again.  The bummer is that I bought this last week and it cost me about $12 less than what the price is today!
This coffee  has great flavor for us strictly DECAF coffee drinkers. Priced good too! Amazon is the way to go if you need this type of coffee for your maker.

column9: Wrong product.  Ordered Dk. Magic Decaf.  Bad vendor.
column10: The sticker on the Green Mountain. K-cup box said: Dec Magic but it was placed over the real title of the box which was Our Blend.  When I opened the box it was not decaf but regular coffee: Our Blend.  As I am too busy to mess around with returning it, my husband will use it at work for the office.  Very disappointing experience with this vendor. No one could think this was the right product for the label unless they could not speak English!

column4: David "I like fantasy, sci-fi and other books...
column10: This decaf is great.I paid $29+ for the 2 boxes last time and now it is $10 more at $39+ I just found that I can buy from green mountain's website for $28 if I start a subscription in their cafe express. You have to buy 4 boxes of coffee but I always do anyway. I buy 2 decaf and 2 regular.

Excellent bold decaf which you can buy direct from Green Mountain for $.46 each (6 boxes of 24 cups no shipping) v.s. Amazon price of $.77 each. (2 boxes of 24 cups no shipping) Even at Amazon, "Let the Buyer Beware".
I absolutely love this product. I can't drink regular coffee so I have to drink decaf and the taste is awesome.
Just right...bold enough to carry the morning without a bite.  Perfect, you will not go wrong with Green Mountain Dark Magic Extra Bold.

When I received the product it was regular coffee vs decaf.  Amazon refunded my purchase price and told me to keep the coffee.  Would have ordered the decaf again but it had more than doubled in price.

What I bought is not what I got!  I thought I was getting Decaf and it isn't.  The shrink wrap on the outside labeled it as Decaf but it was regular roast coffee!  If you have to drink Decaf, be wary!  Luckily my husband drinks regular coffee and he can use this but I was really disappointed that it wasn't Decaf.  I had one cup and was pretty hopped up.  I can't drink regular coffee because of my thyroid disease so it was a tad unnerving.
Pretty good coffee for instant.  Flavor and depth are close to a brewed cup of coffee.  I have tried most of the other decaf and this one is my pick.

I love this coffee. Having said that, I order directly from Green Mountain using their cafe express program and pay 40% less than the price listed here. Even Green Mountain's full retail price without the cafe express membership is 25% less...
Good coffee but not the product I ordered. Was supposed to be Decaf coffee but received regular. Did not realize until after product was opened this weekend. Poor quality control....

I bought this and a case of the canned to try out on my aged Border collie and young Toller-because my sister in law uses it for her Lab pup and the dog looks great-the best coat I've ever seen. Unfortunately, it was a bust for us, because neither of the dogs will eat it. The canned is pasty-texture a lot lot mashed sweet potatoes-not meaty at all. Won't buy again, but if your dog likes the taste of it, it seems to do a great job on healthy, shiny coats.

We haven't tried it yet, but our dog seems to like it.She'll eat most anything, but has a touchy stomach- which has consequences we like to avoid. This one seems to work for her, and it's all we buy now as far as kibble is concerned.

I love this dog food because 1) My picky shih tzus love it!, 2)It's ALL natural!! also, no by products and such... 3)One of my three dogs has food allergies, and she can eat this, too. It's a bit expensive, but for me, very much worth it... they love the taste and the kibble is a nice smallish size, perfect for toy breeds.

column9: Best dry dog food there is
column10: I have a Border Collie and Sheltie.  My collie is allergic to almost everything and my sheltie is just plain picky.  They both love this food and no more itching and losing clumps of hair.  I alternate between the venison, buffalo and duck.  This is the best dog food I have found.

I have 2 Shih Tzus They are full sisters out of same litter and are as different as day and night. Tinkerbelle is "very lady-like" and can eat anything. Zoeie is my little"tuffie" and is allergic to grains and beef. I try to always get venison for her and wanted some variety so tried the New Balace Sweet Potato and Venison formula. Zoeie loved it right from the start and Tinker loves it too. I recomend it to evryone.

column9: Good stuff you won't find at Whole Foods
column10: I needed some pickled pork hocks and decided, what the heck, I'll order a sampler. Yum! These are the vinegared mysteries you used to see on the counter behind the bar at not-so-classy joints and think 'who on earth would eat that stuff?' The turkey gizzards especially look suspect. But when you try them, they're all really good. The hocks are wonderful cooked with cabbage or added to stews. The gizzards are good over rice. The eggs are great cut into a salad, and add an interesting twist to deviled eggs. And the little Polish sausages remind me of *somebody's* great aunt playing pinochle. Especially if you know someone who hails from the rust belt, this would be a great gift and a taste of the past.

I love pickled sausages though I'm used to the "Fat Freddies" and other convenience store/gas station products that have the texture of a vienna sausage.  The only problem is that not many of those places here in the Las Vegas area carry them so they are a treat when found.On a whim I started searching the net for them, and of course searched here on my favorite online store, Amazon.com and found this sampler pack.  Of the four products in this sampler, I'd only had pickled sausages before.My wife and I both loved the sausages.  They were certainly superior to the mass market ones I've bought as mentioned above.The gizzards were good and tender.  I'd never had them pickled, but they were a nice treat.The pork was good as well and another first for us, but I doubt that I'll be ordering them again.The eggs were a disappointment.  They weren't bad or anything but I guess I was expecting more.  Again, those were a first for me but I won't be reordering them.However, I used 5 cans of pickled beets and 18 eggs and pickled my own eggs last week, alternating layers of eggs and beets in a gallon glass jar, leaving them in the fridge for a week before tasting.  THOSE we love.Everyone has different tastes, so you all may love some of the things we didn't find all that special.  That's why this sampler is a good idea.  You get to try the foods without the risk of having a gallon of something no one likes.

Product arrived promptly and securely packaged. The turkey gizzards were very tender but somewhat mild in flavor (dipped them in mustard to add a little "zest" to them when I ate them). Pork Hocks were also tender with a mild flavor. The Polish Sausage I liked the best - a sweeter, vinegary taste (it was hard for me not to eat the whole jar of Polish Sausage in one sitting). The eggs were fine (used them - sliced - on salads).All-in-all, I was very pleased with the sampler as well as the service from WisconsinMade.

This candy is absolutely great!  If you like dark chocolate, chewy nuggat, taffy,...cannot be beat.  In the good old days the kids popped them in the freezer for ten minutes or more and wacked them on a table to break-up the bar.  The small broken pieces made it more convenient to eat.When I moved from L.A. to the mid-section of the country, this candy was very much missed.  My daughter found them on the internet and ordered some as a gift.  It was wonderful :)

These candy bars aren't available where we live so every-so-often just got to order them.  My absolute favorite bar.  Chewy taffy with just the right amount of peanuts within the taffy.  Plus a generous amount of dark chocolate on the outside of the bar.  A perfect combination of sweet and chewy with dark chocolate.A tip for breaking the bars up into bite size pieces is to place a bar into the freezer for about 5-10 minutes prior to eating.  "Rap" in on a hard object like the kitchen counter while in the wrapper and the bar will shatter into small pieces.  Makes the candy more enjoyable and easy to share.

Sometimes you try to go back to your childhood by eating something you enjoyed so much.  Often, there is something lacking and you just have to resign yourself to the fact that it simply isn't as good as you thought.  Not so with the Look bar.  It tastes just the same as it did when it was the most popular bar at the little league park.  You can stretch em, whack em into pieces, or suck on 'em.  It's simply my favorite candy bar and always will be.  The chocolate is bittersweet, and the nougat is well balanced with just the right sweetness and texture.  American confection at its finest.
We live in MO. And they don't sell look bars here.  I'm a California girl and loved them growing up.  Yummmmmy Fresh

column9: I am now a SunButter fanatic!
column10: Stumbled across this product after discovering my son has a horrible peanut allergy.  He can now have 'sun butter and jelly' sandwiches kind of like a normal kid!  This has completely replaced peanut butter in my house and tastes much better in my opinion.  We like the creamy style.  I have heard others complain about the texture of sunbutter, but I don't think they realize that there are multiple textures (creamy, natural, crunchy).

column9: Great for kids with food allergies!
column10: I have been using this product since my son was diagnosed with a peanut allergy. This size is so convinient ! He is a very picky eater and this is what he asks for every morning on toast. I love it too! Would recommend it for sure!
As a vegan mother of a child with several food allergies, I'm happy this item is sold through amazon.  Sunbutter is a staple in our home.

Our family has a severe nut allergy and Sunbutter saves us!!  We LOVE it!  We can eat our fill of"PB & J" this way as well as use it for baking and cooking.  It is creamy, with the same consistency of peanut butter.  The 5 pound tub makes it more economical for our family.  Even if you are not trying to avoid an allergy, I highly recommend this product.

We can't do nuts (allergies) so we love this product. In addition to putting it on bread and eating it by the spoonful, we make cookies with it and "sunflower seed butter cups" and "spicy sunflower seed sauce." It's awesome.

Amazon seem to run out of the 5lb pails all the time, because it's a MUCH better deal than the grocery store!  My kids and I love Sunbutter, and all of our non-allergy friends love eating it when they come over.  I really like it much better than peanut butter, and many non-allergies families I know have switched to Sunbutter out of consideration for peanut allergic kids, and because Sunbutter is delicious!
Great for tree nut/peanut allergies! Taste and creaminess is not quite like real peanut butter, but, is a great substitute!

column9: Great source of healthy mono and poly fats
column10: I like it on Apple Slices, the creamy style is great for packed lunches or snacks for car trips. Price can't be beat over health food stores.Amazon gives the best price, and you wouldn't believe the careful packaging it came in-couldn't be happier with the product, price or packaging.
My son has a peanut allergy. Sunbutter is our peanutbutter substitute. is has a similar consistency but tastes like sunflower seeds. As a peanutbutter lover, this is a great tasting alternative.

column9: SO thankful to have found this product
column10: My 2 year old has nut allergies among others, and this product has replaced peanut butter in our house. My 4 year old who used to eat regular peanut butter enjoys the sunbutter just as much and will eat it from the spoon. The taste is not exactly like peanut butter, but it is nutty and delicious and after a few weeks you will not even notice or miss peanut butter. We tried a couple other peanut butter alternatives and they were terrible. I am so thankful that this is around for my kids who would miss out on PB&J otherwise.

We love Sunbutter! I don't have to worry about using it, as it and the company is completely PEANUT FREE!. Sunbutter taste great, unlike Soy Butter which is gritty and awful tasting. I use Sunbutter for anything that I would use peanut butter for cookies, frostings and candies, dips, etc. Sunbutter has the same consistency and texture as peanut butter and doesn't need refrigeration. When using Sunbutter for baking you do have to cut back to about 1/2 of the baking soda and/or baking powder or you can add a little bit of lemon juice to prevent your baked goods from turning green from the sunflower seeds. If your cookies do turn green it doesn't affect the taste just the looks (guess how I know that little bit of information :). Sunbutter also has a great website at sunbutter dot com with recipes and information about their products. Check out their site and defiantly get some Sunbutter.

column9: The best tasting alternative to peanut butter -- maybe even better than peanut butter!
column10: I have two older kids that used to love peanut butter.  One actually ate peanut butter 2 or 3 times a day.  That was their main staple.  But then I had a third child who was severely allergic to peanuts & nuts.  I tried all the other peanut replacement products out there and they were terrible.  The Soy Nut butter tasted awful and was very gritty.  But then we found Sunbutter.  Oh my gosh!!! It tastes better than peanut butter and has the same consistency and health benefits of peanut butter.  My two older kids easily switched to Sunbutter and love it.  We use both the creamy and crunchy versions -- both excellent.In addition, I use Sunbutter to make cookies (peanut butter cookies made with Sunbutter) and Chinese Sesame Noodles -- without the sesame oil and seeds (my daughter is also allergic to sesame) and use Sunbutter.  It is excellent!  I love, love, love this product.  I love the fact it needs no refrigeration and is nutritious.

We became Sunbutter fans about five years ago, after our daughter was diagnosed with a peanut allergy.  I tried Soynut butter (gross!) and all the nut butters we could find had peanut warnings on them.  Sunbutter is a safe alternative.  I use it for baking (sunbutter krispies, sunbutter cookies), cooking (Thai dishes), and for just eating.  Check out Sunbutter's website for tips on baking, as you will need to decrease backing soda in recipes, so food doesn't turn green. We all love it.  Most of our friends, who have tried it, have switched to Sunbutter also.  I can't tell a difference and it has opened up endless possibilities, enabling our family to feel "normal".  When baby #2 came along, we used it "safely" from age 1-3, when most doctors tell people to avoid peanuts.

I developed a peanut allergy later in life so when I found this brand of sunflower butter I was so happy. It tastes more like peanut butter than anything else. Which also means you can use it as a substitute in recipes and it's very unlikely anyone will notice.  While I have never gotten a tub this big it's only because it isn't available for order right now. I buy it by the case.

column9: We feel "normal" again after finding Sunbutter
column10: When our oldest son had a reaction to a cashew and was rushed to the ED, we knew he had an allergy.  Little did we know, that day would change our lives.  Giovanni had to be antihistimine free for 30 days before being tested for allergies.  After having the test done, we discovered he had treenut, peanut, fish, egg, wheat, oat, and carrot allergies.  I was crushed.  No parades, trick or treating, holiday baking, etc.  Reading lables on EVERYTHING.  Then, I got a ray of hope.  Sunbutter.  With the help of Sunbutter our holiday baking can be done.  We didn't realize how many of our favorite holiday treats have peanutbutter in them.  I've used Subutter in cheesecake, cookies, bars, and obviously, sandwiches.  This product has made us feel a little more normal again.  Thank you!!

I was first introduced to SunButter on an interstate flight and feel in love.  I have never much cared for Peanut butter and SunButter is soooooo much better :  I have been ordering it in the 5lb tubs for several years now and have NEVER been dissatisfied.  I pay a little more for it, but you get what you pay for, IT IS WELL WORTH IT.  My grandchildren love the stuff either in sandwiches or just a spoonful or both....THANK YOU SUNBUTTER!

column9: Starbucks Makes the Best Instant Coffee Ever
column10: There is no such thing as a perfect instant coffee. There is no such thing as a perfect instant coffee. There is no such thing as a perfect instant coffee.Now that we've made that perfectly clear, Starbuck's Via is the best there is. The Italian Roast is absolutely amazing...for an instant coffee. I drink it when I teach, and it is so much better than the watered-down rat pee in the teachers' workroom. Incidentally, that an instant coffee is superior to a brewed coffee is a sad reflection on the quality of coffee brewed at the workplace, but I digress...The rich flavor of this coffee is an unexpected treat, and although it is recognizably instant to the taste of a true coffee-lover, it is not bad. The quality and character of this coffee are incredible... for an instant coffee.

This stuff is incredible, and is great for hiking / backpacking. Of course, it is also great anytime. We did find a better price at c o s t c o. I had to contact starbucks directly, spoke with a man named Courtney to cancel the order (had only been 1 hour). He said the order was canceled -- but the coffee showed up, and they charge my card. This part no so cool, but the coffee is still good.

As others have said, for an instant coffee, Sbux via is tops. It will never be as good as fresh brewed quality coffee, but hey, if you're at home then don't be lazy and brew some real java. This stuff is perfect for backpacking and camping- I also brought a large amount of it when I travelled to India and Nepal...my fellow backpackers were begging me to have some...Overall, it is the best instant coffee that I have ever tried. Try some.

I like one cup of coffee in the afternoon at work and I want it strong.  With Via I can make one cup of decent coffee quickly.  It's also a good product to take traveling.  It's so much better than restaurant coffee but you don't pay the ridiculous price you can pay at a Starbucks. It's a huge improvement over instant coffee, but it's not equal to the real thing.  Honestly, I think it deserves 3 1/2 stars.

I have been using Walden Farms products since the company came to North America and they are a regular part of my shopping list. Their pancake syrup is thick and fantastic. I didn't like it. It tastes nasty. I threw thew them away. I like their asian dressing and italian dressing, but the syrum not so much

Normally I don't even think about drinking vodka (too many bad college memories!) until my husband brought this home one night. He claimed it was a sipping vodka and in all honesty there was no way I could believe him. So against my better judgment I decided to mix it with some orange juice. I first tried this vodka while Dan was in town doing a meet and greet on Fremont Experience. This is by far one of the best vodka's I've tried. It's smooth and easy to sip. I have to say this beats Grey Goose or Belvedere ANY DAY.

column9: Average vodka in a premium bottle
column10: I bought this for a halloween party being primarily a vodka drinker myself.  I had heard that it was a premium vodka so I decided to give it a chance and live it up for the night.  The taste when one drinks it straight is comparable to that of grey goose.  So after that trial I think I will save the money and buy grey goose or belvedere.

column9: Fantastic Option for Chronic Pancreatitis Sufferer
column10: This has been a life-saver for my aging heeler.  He's had chronic pancreatitis for years, and I finally had to resort to cooking food for him daily (this gets old, with 3 large canine mouths to feed).  We found the Castor & Pollux Organix Adult Canine Formula, Chicken, Brown Rice & Flax Dry Dog Food, 25-Pound Bag, which was a great solution (wet down a little to provide enough fluid for digestion).  However, he also has worn down canines as a result of spending his first year living on the streets of Cody, Wyoming, and his teeth aren't completely adequate to a kibble-only diet.  Adding this canned food has been the best thing ever!!  We have struggled to meet his needs for years, and this just works!  He's comfortable, now.  No more tummy rubs and aspirin every night after supper (although he did do exceptionally well on the home-prepared diet, also, for about the same cost).  I love seeing my boy happy and thriving, and I honestly have this food to thank.

My 12 year old Shiztu throws up any food with "gravy", even other very expensive organic food. Dry dog food is not an option. She loves the Organix chicken. There is no waste, no draining and throwing away, and best of all, a happy, healthy dog.

column9: Very Safe and good brand for large breed puppies
column10: Large breeds such as Bernese Mountain Dogs should not be fed puppy food due to very high protein content in puppy food. So our Bernese puppy typically has adult kibble with lower protein content. However, his litter have a lot of digestive issues so now and then he needed a soft food versus kibble & needs t be bland - that's where this product comes in. Our puppy (who's never been a good eater) will eat Organix canned chicken& rice especially when he's not feeling so great. We've noticed that his tummy's able to handle this food without him being in pain or having diarrhea. He also loves the kibble version (once in a while for a change from his usual kibble).

White being my Corgi's and rice being this dog food(puns intended).Not sure if it is good for the dog but it smells like Pate. If the world was to come to an end tomorrow, and I ran out of food, I might eat this. Put it on some bread. Yum.
My cats really love these treats. They come running every time I grab the bag. I have also just gotten a new puppy, and he managed to get a couple of these and fell in love with them as well.
Using this product, our reflux happy baby has gotten much better, and I have changed my clothes less as well.!!!  ha ha
My husband loves these. We had the original before and he loves spicy foods. He uses them all the time on almost everything.

column9: Slap Ya Mama is true Cajun spice!!!
column10: We LOVE LOVE LOVE the Slap Ya Mama spices...the medium and hot are the family favorites for use on just about every dish except dessert, and I may try a chocolate mole with this spice also!

These bundt cakes come well packaged in a sturdy cardboard box which is sealed with plastic.  Inside, is a plastic molded bundt pan which is also fully sealed in airtight plastic wrap.Originally, I purchased both Tortuga and Wicked Jack's rum cakes to compare against each other for an upcoming party I was hosting.  The Tortuga rum cake was tasty and what you would expect from a pre-made cake.  However, the Wicked Jack's Tavern rum cake is so much more moist and flavorful.  It is amazingly moist, drenched in butter rum flavor and can go from box to serving platter in seconds.  Since I mention how moist it is, (after a couple purchases and messy flip-overs) I would suggest flipping it onto a platter and making sure to tap the bottom of the bundt pan several times so that when you lift the pan it fully comes out in one piece.I think that you could even pass this off as home-made if you wanted, it's actually that fresh.  However, since my family and friends already know exactly what my rum cake tastes like (a holiday tradition here for years) I have no problem bragging about the Wicked Jack's brand.  I have yet to hear a single negative comment about it and I've actually served these cakes about a half dozen times now for different get togethers.Huge thumbs up on Wicked Jack's and I'm glad I went ahead and tried this out through Amazon, having never seen it in a store.  This blind pick is actually one of my most satisfying (literally!) purchases I've made in the last few months!

This is the first time I've tried rum cake, and I'm really liking it. Rum cake is made by letting rum soak into the cooked cake, but the cake is not soggy - it is nicely moist. The cake comes sealed in a disposable bundt cake tray packaged inside a box. It does not taste stale or overly processed. There is obvious rum taste, but it is not overpowering. For those who might be concerned with alcohol content, I ate a rather large slice, and did not feel a buzz at all. You don't have to worry about having anyone 21 or over sign for the package, it's just a regular grocery item. The package seems to suggest slicing the cake into ten pieces (210 calories per slice), but that leaves you with a smaller slice than I normally like to eat. I could live with slicing it up into eights. The cake is decadent enough, you feel satisfied after eating one slice for treating yourself to something good for dessert, though I would happily finish off half the entire cake in one sitting.

My son is a US Marine stationed in Afghanistan. Wondering if they would still be edible, we sent 4 of these over for his Birthday and as expected he shared them with his fellow Marines. Well the reviews are in and it was simply stated that "Wicked Jack's was Wicked Good". What else can I say about a cake that traveled thousands of miles over a 2 week period and was considered excellent when it got there.

You'd expect a cake travelling thousands of miles to be dry and old, but Wicked Jack's is the complete opposite.  It comes in a scary amount of packaging, which keeps it soaked with sweet sweet syrupy rummy flavour.  If you're taking it to a party- make sure to unwrap it first as the packing really is scary.  But once out of the plastic, you could totally pass this off as your great-grandma's rum cake recipe.  It's that authentic.

I like the Tortuga original better than this cake. First of all the rum is cooked with butter and other ingredients, depending on how you like to make it, and made into a glaze. There are some people that think the rum is soaked in straight from the bottle and I am going to assume that these people don't drink. In this brand the rum is not as intense. I am not sure what brand or type of rum they use but it is weak. The cake is crumbly, it was falling apart as I tried to slice it. If you serve this with ice cream or create some kind of dessert dish then I am sure your guests wouldn't mind. On the other hand it is a good price.
Great flavor...great price.  I usually buy Tortuga brand.  I will switch to this brand from here on out.
I loved these cakes while we were on our cruise, and now I can order them as gifts for our friends.

I got this on the Friday Sale at a great price.  The packaging is good.  The cake is vacuum sealed. However, there are too many chemicals in the cake.  It tastes like a rum soaked twinkie without the cream filling.  I was able to salvage the first cake using some homemade rum-raisin ice cream.  I will not be buying these cakes again.

column9: DECEPTIVE PRODUCT: This is NOT "UMF 16+" manuka honey!
column10: I have researched and used Manuka honey since 2004, including UMF 12+, UMF 16+, UMF 17+, and UMF 20+, and write to warn against this product and this seller. This product does NOT have a "UMF 16+" level of MANUKA FACTOR and is NOT CERTIFIED "UMF 16+."WARNING: If you seek a Manuka honey able to provide the medical benefits of a UMF 16+ manuka honey, THIS PRODUCT IS A FRAUD. It is merely a basic table honey.The label is intentionally deceptive.  It seeks to confuse consumers by including "active" and "16+" but this is meaningless. STAKICH HONEY IS NOT CERTIFIED by the Active Manuka Honey Associaion to have methylglyoxal (MGO).  MGO is the factor present in SOME -- not all -- manuka honeys.  MGO is responsible for the medical benefits shown in scientific research.  (A side note: be sure to check the research itself, not the claims on sellers' websites, to distinguish the real from the illusory medical benefits of CERTIFIED manuka honeys.)Having consumed several different UMF 16+ and UMF 20+ honeys (the two strengths that I use for different purposes, in addition to manuka essential oil) across the years, I immediately could taste the LACK of MGO in Stakich's honey.  (I'd not been able to see the label detail in the small photo here.)  But rather than presume, I contacted Stakich for some validation of MGO in the honey.  In reply, Stakich sent a dodge rather than a substantive answer.I wrote a second time, indicating that mine was not an idle inquiry because I use the honey for medical purposes; I depend on an accurate UMF label to be assured I am using an appropriate product for the several purposes to which I put these honeys.  Stakich's second reply delivered an insult in lieu of a responsive answer.  Thus, in addition to warning you about the product, I'll also say that I am disgusted with the evasive and condescending "service" Stakich provided when confronted with their deception.Before you buy a manuka honey for other than regular table honey use, check the AMHA's website to see whether it is sold by a member of the Association and has been certified to have an MGO level accurately represented on the label. If all you want is a table honey, you can get one many times cheaper from a truthful seller who clearly lables both its higher UMF and its low UMF honeys.

column9: Really Great and a good price
column10: The other review on this is harsh and incorrect.  This honey is really great, I've bought it twice.  What the other reviewer fails to mention is that in the US the regulations are different and UMF if not a designation recognized by the FDA so it is not required on the packaging. You usually find it on bottles actually imported from New Zealand so if you really want to pay extra for that then go for it. However to call someone a fraud when their company has been in business for so long is rude. If you don't like the honey well then...don't buy it.Their customer service has been great, the only issue I had is that one of the glass bottles I purchased broke in the mail and I left a message which was promptly responded to and a replacement bottle was sent right away with many sincere apologies. column9: GREAT SNACK WHEN KIDS WANT SOMETHING SWEET

column9: The BEST Giant Breed formula out there ...
column10: We have a 15 months old Blue Great Dane ... we still consider him as a puppy, even he is already 120 lbs. When we first got him at 10 weeks of age he was on Nutro Natural, but we switched him immediately to Eagle Pack, veterinarians and breeders pointed Eagle Pack as the shrpest formulated food for Giant Breeds.Since then we tried with Boston several other samples, from other brands. He seemed to like Nature's Choice Farm Stand Selects and Nutro Ultra food, but only for sampling. He's always happy to find a bowl full of Eagle there waiting for him to take of it.Regarding ingredients and supplements, Eagle Pack Super Premium is the far best of all. And the fact that it is specially balanced for Giant Breed dogs is something that You won't find anywhere else.Consider this food for Your Giant Breed best friend. Look at the labels, check the ingredients, read about protein balance and other stuff that your dog needs. I guarantee that You won;t find any other food that will come close to Eagle Pack. Let me now if I'm wrong. I will be happy to let Boston sample something else and than look at him when his all happy to go back to good ol' Eagle.Cheers !!!

Long time online shopper, but first time ever writing a review. We have a 7 month old Great Dane pup. When we got her at 12 weeks, the breeder had her eating Holistic Select Giant breed puppy food, which was good for awhile. Then her stool became very loose. So upon reading other reviews we switched to Eagle Pack Giant breed puppy food. Her stool was still a little loose, but we thought that it was possibly the switch of the foods so we wanted to give it a chance. Well after about 5-30lb. bags of eagle pack, her stool was still very loose and she was eating her and our other dogs poop. (very gross to be kissed by that....YUCK) A friend told us that she was doing that because she was missing a vitamin or supplement in her diet. She was also consuming a tremendous amount of food as well as always voraciously hungry. We started researching what to do then all of the sudden she was having uncontrollable diarrhea, not good for a 100lb. puppy. We did not have time for anymore research we had to do something now!We ended up at a local store and discovered Chicken Soup for the Puppy Lover's Soul Large Breed Puppy Dry Dog Food. We decided to try a a 18lb bag, even though the protein levels were a couple percentage points higher than we had been told to give a Great Dane. But the list of ingredients was wonderful when compared with a lot of other top brands, I am no expert but just reading the long list of ingredients it seemed that they had more all natural ingredients, as opposed to the supplements that the others were putting in their food.We got it home and immediately made a complete switch from the Eagle Pack food she was on. We did not do the customary blending of foods for a week or so to introduce the new food and ween her off the old. We did not have time as her tummy was so upset, we also did not want anymore of the Eagle Pack in her system. She loved the taste and gobbled it up. Within about 24 hours her poops started to firm up a bit. This got progressively better as the week went by, but still a little soft as to make picking up difficult especially on grass. We added In Clover Fresh Digest Daily Intestinal Aid for Dogs to her food and presto she pretty much has a firm stool every time, She is also eating noticeably less food (YAY!$$$) which she seams to be getting better nourishment from it. She is also no longer eating poop (YAY!!!). We attribute that the little bit extra protein in this food is what she was missing from her diet. We are going to ween her off the In Clover Fresh Digest Daily Intestinal Aid for Dogs and see how she does without the supplement now that she is totally use to her new food.To sum it up:1. Good quality ingredients2. Less supplements than some other brands3. Slightly higher protein than we would like, but it keeps her from eating poop so that is ok4. Affordable5. Retains more of the food so she eats less, which saves a fair amount of money.6. Her coat is super shiny and healthyP.S. We also switched our senior citizen American Bulldog to the Eagle Pack Adult food, and she got a very loose stool as well, and she has never been loose a day in her life. We now have her on Chicken Soup for the Dog Lover's Soul Large Breed Dry Dog Food, and she is great and very healthy as well.

I was really leery of spending $45 on dog food when we first ordered this for our 100 lb German Shepherd.  After being on it for about 4 month or more now I am convinced that it is worth the price for several reasons:  Our dog eats less of this food because of the higher protein content so a bag last a long time, his coat is shiny and he doesn't stink like our other dogs did.  That is what amazes me the most is that his breath isn't horrible like most dogs and that he doesn't stink at all!  I will continue to buy this for our dog as long as I am able!

Magnus my 6 month old English Mastiff has been eating this food since we brought him home and it has been wonderful for him. The ingredient list can't be beat especially for the price. He seems to like the taste as he gobbles it down each time he is served. He has not had any stomach or skin issues caused by this food.
I have a great dane with a very sensitive stomach. We have tried a lot of good quality dog food brands and this is one of the few that won't result in loose stools and bad gas.

I bought this food for my 2 german shepherd dogs after reading all the good reviews. Right after eating this food they both started itching and scratching like crazy! They also had very bad gas and were belching non stop. Needless to say the 3 of us did not get any sleep at all that night. column9: Does not contain hydrogenated oil like many other American panko brands
column10: Once I discovered panko breadcrumbs a few years back when cooking from a Japanese recipe, I have never used any other sort of breadcrumb since. Since then, I've always used imported Japanese brands and so this was my first time trying an American brand of panko.Now, if you don't know what panko breadcrumbs are and how they differ from regular breadcrumbs, the main difference is that panko are more like flakes than tiny crumbs. Because the flakes cover a wider surface of whatever you're breading to cook, this means that it turns out crispier and crunchier. I also find that substituting in panko instead of regular breadcrumbs in things like casseroles where you are combining it into a mixture results in being much much lighter, which I absolutely love.As for this particular brand, it is very comparable to the imported Japanese brands I'm used to. The one thing I have noticed though for other American panko brands is that many of them contain hydrogenated oil which make them unhealthier than most regular breadcrumbs. The Progresso Panko Crispy Bread Crumbs (Plain) here though does not. Here are the listed ingredients: wheat flour (bleached), canola oil, yeast, dextrose, sugar, salt, and natural flavor.

When I first heard about Panko bread crumbs, I instantly thought: "This is hype." Well, so much for my first impressions. Panko bread crumbs add a nice crunch and texture to dishes. Standard bread crumbs are fine for dishes like chicken parmigiana. But Panko bread crumbs have a nicer crunch.I have been using this as one of the two brands of Panko bread crumbs that I have purchased for some time. I am a very satisfied consumer. And I would recommend this to anyone interested in Panko bread crumbs.

The Progresso Panko Style Breadcrumbs are, without a doubt, the best I have used.  They stay crispy while cooking and add great flavor to many dishes.  Because I use them so much, I now purchase them by the case.  Would definitely recommend them to anyone who uses breadcrumbs in their cooking.

The 'Wild Purple Smash' is has more flavor, more depth of flavor and is zippier and more reminiscent of the old grape Kool-Aid. The Citric Acid seems to cut the taste of the diet sweetener --I'm not a fan of diet sweeteners, but I'm on a diet so it's a necessary evil -- and it just makes for a more lively beverage. When I got my Keruig I thought this half-caff product would be the best answer for me, but it isn't.  This tastes like a mixture of weak coffee and dishwater.  Why Green Mountain put this out is a mystery.  Green Mountain has a good caff coffee called Dark Magic and a good decaf coffee called Dark Magic Decaf.  All they would have to do is use half of each of these in a K-cup and they would have an excellent half-caf.  I know because I have a 20 ounce mug that I have brewed 9.5 ounces of each of these together and the taste is great.  The only explanation for this Green Mountain half-caff product is that they must think that anyone who would buy a half-caf probably doesn't care much about taste, so they can use two cheaper coffees.  Half-caff coffee drinkers DO care about taste.  Message to Green Mountain: Give us a 50:50 mixture of the Dark Magic caff and decaff coffees and deep six this product.

Please do not drink this product if you are pregnant!!!  This is a decaffeination process that uses the additive Methylene Chloride to remove the extra caffeine.  This is a chemical that is banned in Europe.  It is used in a paint stripper and degreaser as well!!!"It may be carcinogenic, as it has been linked to cancer of the lungs, liver, and pancreas in laboratory animals.[9] Dichloromethane crosses the placenta.""methylene chloride in humans has resulted in effects on the central nervous system"I am 6 weeks pregnant and just drank a cup as I sat down to do my research.  I wish I could un-drink it.  At 6 weeks my baby is creating nerve cells at around 100,000 per min.  So....lets do the math....it is known to cross the placenta....and affects the nervous system in a disastrous way....This process is being phased out or already has been for many other types of decaf.  Newman's Own uses and all natural water process.  Or hey...you would be better off with one cup fully loaded with caffeine.  You would be better off...and so would your baby.

This is advertised as being a vegan dog treat product, but it is definitely not vegan. Its Amazon title even has the word, "vegan" in it: "KONG Premium Treats Sweet Potato Vegan Treats". I ordered one of these, and gelatin is in the ingredient list. Gelatin is not vegan.The product does not contain any animal "by-products" (rendered meat) and even says so on the package. I think that's what confused the person who labeled it "vegan".Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes, Barley Flour, Brown Rice Flour, Maple Syrup, Vegetable Glycerine, GELATIN [my emphasis], Natural Flavor, Salt, Carrots, Peas, Phosphoric Acid, Sorbic Acid, Citric Acid, Natural Smoke Flavor, Mixed Tocopherols, Rosemary.And if I were nitpicking, I'd say the Natural Flavor and Natural Smoke Flavor could also be non-vegan. I can't say for sure.The use of acids in this is also a little weird. I don't usually see three used. And phosphoric acid isn't typically in dog treats, I don't think. It's just odd.I also think it's odd that they used maple syrup, since it tends to cost a lot more than fructose syrup. I guess they suspect people avoid fructose syrup or HFCS. But maple syrup is just another sweetener, probably just as "bad" as HFCS.Other info: "Crude protein: no less than 6.0%. Crude fat: no less than 1.0%. Crude fiber: no more than 4.0%. column9: My dog will do anyting for one of these

column10: I love this light zesty italian and the extra virgin olive oil in it and the flavors really are so much more tasteful than the Kraft Fat Free Zesty Italian.  This light dressing is definitely zesty and I feel that I couldn't even tell the difference between this and a regular salad dressing.  Way to go Kraft!

This pumpkin spice syrup is perfect for fall days. I recommend mixing it with a little caramel syrup as well. The coffee shops usually combine 3 or more syrups at a time -- just ask for the mixture of anything you like at the coffee shop and then purchase them here.

I love the Dunkin Donuts pumpkin coffee and pumpkin spice latte, so I asked for pumpkin syrup for Christmas and received this as a gift.  I was incredibly excited, until I tasted my coffee.  At first, I thought my milk had gone bad, because the coffee just tasted unpleasant and odd.  I tossed the coffee and poured a new cup, adding milk from a different container, and was met by the same putrid taste.To me, the syrup tastes like rotten squash/pumpkin.  I didn't taste much (or any) spice, though that may have been the overpowering smell of something spoiled.  I tried several proportions of coffee:milk:syrup and could not come up with anything palatable.I strongly suggest you do not purchase this product, unless I got a terrible batch (in which case, Torani needs to tweak their quality control process!).
This is a great, versatile product! My order came very quickly and in time for pumpkin spice martinis at my Fall party.

column9: I thought this syrup was terrible!
column10: I bought this syrup hoping to be able to make coffee or lattes at home that taste at least a little bit like Starbucks or Dunkin Donuts pumpkin spice lattes.  Not only does this taste nothing like either, it is actually gross.  My husband took a whiff of it and gagged.  The bottle was sealed when it came so I don't think mine was tampered with.  I just think the flavor and smell is so far off from any other pumpkin flavoring out there.  We ended up dumping it down the drain.

This syrup is a terrific product!  It has just the right amount of pumpkin flavor and just the right amount of sweetness.  Instead of having to wait for Starbucks to bring it back out in the fall, you can make your own Pumpkin Spiced Lattes at home!  However, you can get this exact bottle of syrup on the Torani website for literally HALF the price! The bottle is 7.95 and the shipping is 5.95. You do the math.

column9: Does not taste like pumpkin spice!
column10: My son pegged it - "It tastes like butternut squash!" Ewwwww. Not up to the quality of other Torani flavors.

column9: It as pumpkin spice NOT PUMPKIN PIE.
column10: Very good syrup, but if you expect it to taste like pumpkin you are not reading the name close enough.They do make a PUMPKIN PIE syrup i have never tried.
This is a good, clean tasting syrup with mild pumpkin flavor.  It does not, by itself, replicate the flavor of the pumpkin spice latte from *bucks, but it tastes good and is a nice seasonal flavor.

What a disappointment. I had high hopes for this syrup since I live the Dunkin Donuts and Starbucks lattes. However this is nothing like this. column9: do not buy this product or anything else from this company

It's not overally strong, which is nice, but I only taste the spices.  It doesn't taste like pumpkin at all.

I enjoy a pumpkin flavor with my coffee. Before I had to wait till September or the holidays to get that type of coffee.
i never tried the syrup as it was a gift. but from what i heard it is tasty. i do know that the product arrived soon and in good condition. thanks!

These mints are pretty tasty, though not what I expected.  I thought I was going to get the kind of buttermints that melt in your mouth quickly.  These mints are really good, but just know that they aren't the super-melty kind, they kinda melt... it just takes a bit.

column9: Very good, rich, nougat a bit overpowering

Simply because a 5 star review is reserved for the greatest chocolate ever - the Ritter Sport Butter Biscuit.The Neapolitaner Waffel edition is basically Ritter Sport chocolate (one of the best in the world in my opinion) with Neapolitaner ("Manner") wafers and nougat.The nougat, unfortunately, is a bit much and overpowers the taste of the chocolate and wafers.Ritter's quality is always outstanding.Remember, the way you open any Ritter Sport is to break it in the middle. column9: my shih tzu pup loves them
column10: i have a very pampered pup he has a treat jar full of 3 diffrent treats but these are his absolute fave,so id say order if ur not sure my baby goes crazy for these

column9: My Dogs Love 'em and They're Made in the USA
column10: Nice small soft chewy treat. My three dogs love them. The listing doesn't say it, but they are made in the USA. Most of the Dingo products are made in China, so I avoid them, but these are American-made. Plus this price is a good deal. They are a dollar more per pack at Meijer.

I order this item thinking I was going to get 7 bags of them in a tray but all I got was 1 bag.  I contacted Amazon regarding this problem and they were nice enough to refund my $ but I really just wanted the correct item  Bad thing is I ordered a similar item which hasn't shipped yet and I hope they get that order right :/

My cat can't get enough of this food.  He suffered from UTI 8 months ago and I found out that the cause of urinary track infection is dry food.  After 2 visits to the emergency room its needless to say that spending more on cat food is better than spending thousands on doctor bills.  This food has cranberry juice which helps prevent UTI.  I read the label for my cat now, just as I do for myself.I buy them in bulk from Amazon, or individually from PetSmart/PetCo.

If you are looking for a cat food that is "ground" meat and is fairly moist, this is it. Mine want a ground food and this works. It is a strong smelling food. What do you expect from shrimp and tuna. lol.A little hint for leftovers or for finiky eaters. Spoon a little onto a plate and warm it for about 9 seconds in the microwave and then stir it back into the can. It releases the smell and softens it even more.Prices have gone up a bit since I bought it, but what hasn't. column9: Took a while to get them to eat it
column10: My 2 cats, age 14 and 15, looked at this food like, "Where's the GOOD food!". They had been eating Fancy Feast with gravy which is fine but contains corn and they throw up alot. They have been trowing up about 90% less on Natural Balance. They each put on about 1/2 to 1 pound. Their coats are glossy and I feel better knowing this food is alot healthier. I will soon wean then off the tuna but there was crying for a few days at first and my 15 year old flat out refused to eat for abot 4 days and lost a pound but finally started to nibble on it and now eats it well. The dry was better received but they need canned also. Worth the bother as now they cry when their dish is empty!!
These are the best tasting gummy fruits I have ever eaten. Can't stop eating them and the flavors are great.

I grew up on Sunmaid raisins and when they started to cover them with chocolate I thought I was in heaven.  I cannot get enough for these things it is dangerous, lol.I find the chocolate is smooth and creamy and a nice intensity, the raisins are always soft and chewy. column9: Baked apple offers more fiber, less sugar
column10: Through the work week, breakfast is perfunctory with oatmeal just another option among cereal bars and yogurt. We've stocked various brands of instant oatmeal but Quaker Oatmeal Express best balances our desires for tasty and healthy. Our sons - ages 6 and 4 - enjoy the different flavors. My wife likes the individual cups, which make clean-up a breeze.Quaker Oatmeal Express is office-friendly, too. You can prepare the oatmeal with hot water or a microwave. Either way, you've got a no-mess breakfast in less than two minutes. Again, the individual cups are great for a portable option much healthier than anything you'll find on a fast food drive-thru menu.We've purchased three Quaker Oatmeal Express flavors, Cinnamon Roll, Golden Brown Sugar and Baked Apple. All three are not overly sweet. The Baked Apple flavor has a slight fiber edge (1 g) over the other flavors.In summary, skip the sausage egg biscuit and pick up this healthier breakfast option instead. (Studies have found that oatmeal is more filling than dry cereal with the same calories and fiber content.) Quaker Oatmeal Express is healthy, portable and makes clean-up easy.One caveat: if time is not a consideration, the best oatmeal you can buy on Amazon is McCANN'S Steel Cut Oatmeal. We purchase it through Amazon's Subscribe & Save program. This is our Sunday-morning-family-breakfast oatmeal. We add frozen berries, or a tablespoon of brown sugar and an ounce of Drambuie to the cooking pot. The texture and nutty flavor of McCann's oatmeal sets it apart from anything else we've experienced.
I love this oatmeal.  Can't always find it in the storesand when I do the prices aren't this good. I have it everymorning (and my cholesterol is wonderful!) highly recommend it.
