column9: ease of use makes you use it more!!
column10: Yeah, OK, I know, these cups are wasteful.  And you can buy this and many other cereals in single-serving envelopes that you then cook in your own utensils.So why go with these?Because they're so incredibly easy.  And because something that's easy gets done more often than something that's not.I used to buy these with delight in my local grocery store -- always had them on hand.  More mornings than not, I'd have one of these, either before leaving for work or once I got there.  It would always hold me until lunch or later, without any impulse to snack in the morning.  Maybe a couple of times a week, I'd have another one for a snack in the afternoon or evening, just because it was so easy -- almost as easy as the pint of ice cream I'd have rather had but which would have been much less good for me (and even easier than EasyMac!).Then I couldn't find them at any local grocery store for years.  So I'd occasionally buy a new box of the instant envelopes, having thrown out the old box before ever finishing it.  There they sat, unwanted and forlorn, until they too got tossed.These aren't the best diet food or health food, and they certainly aren't ecologically wise.  But they work.  They're easy enough that they'll substitute for even less good choices (such as a take-out breakfast sandwich -- erghhhh).  And they're satisfying -- you really feel you've had something when you finish scraping out the last of the bowl just as it is (no need to add anything).I even looked for them occasionally on Amazon but could never find them.  Imagine my surprise when I googled them tonight in a sudden mad urge to go farther if necessary to stock up on them again, only to discover Amazon has them after all!  And on Subscribe-and-Save, no less!  Awesome.My case is on its way.  If you decide to try one, I think you'll be as happy as I am.  We're all in luck!!!  :)

column10: I thought I would give these a try. Dr Oz said they were great. Im not real sure their for me but their ok.

I purchased this item to help with bloating and eat it directly from the jar. Product has a strong odor and doesn't seem to be easily edible. There is no significant taste, but it is not something you can just munch on and feel comfortable like sesame seeds for example. Sorry I purchased it, probably it is much more useful as a seasoning.

DOCTOR OZ said this was good stuff and would quell stomach aches containing gas. Well I ate a small handful as he said to do, and an hour later I retched  and double over from stomach pains and developed rectal bleeding. This was the last time I took his advice and discontinued recording his show on my cable box. Beware, your'e on your own folks.

I purchased the caraway seeds after looking at a Dr. Oz show on healthy alternatives to prescription medications.  Caraway seeds may be the newest thing per Dr. Oz, but I tried a teaspoon of them and they tasted so bad I was unable to eat them.  Maybe I misunderstood the directions, but acid reflux is much better than the caraway seeds.
I watched the Dr. Oz show and he said to take this product and you would lose belly fat. I tried this product and did not like it as a weight loss product.
This product is amazing. I tried both Dream water and nuero sleep and dream water worked all the time for me. no matter what, it would have me knocked out with-in a half hour.
This product works like a dream!! Perfect name! I slept like a baby. Taste was very nice.  Definitely will purchase again.

I've had insomnia off and on for the past year +. I've been prescribed just about everything...including the main stuff like ambien. Ambien, unlike what the commercials promote, left me with horrible hangovers, terrible mood swings...and often times I would sleep walk/do things that I didn't even remember. I've also tried in store stuff like tylenol PM or sleep aids you can find in your local drugstore...really, nothing worked. Finally I discovered Dream Water from a random amazon search and found some at Duane Reade. It works (no pun intended) like a dream. I sleep well with little to no hangover at all...no mood swings...and it doesn't knock you out. It slowly relaxes you into a sleep, as it promotes. After all this time...a more natural remedy, and one that's not cheap necessarily, but definitely cheaper. 5 stars, no doubt about it.

column9: Works for me - at half dose.
column10: I am a nurse that works night shift and travels frequently. Between the two, I have a funky sleep schedule and sometimes go through periods of extreme insomnia.Then, at the airport in Long Beach, CA I found Dream Water. I was a little shocked at the price but decided to try it anyway. Because it was expensive, I tried half a shot and it worked, well, like a dream. A whole shot makes me do weird things in my sleep, but a half shot makes me fall asleep and get a good 6-8 hours with no hangover effect - even during my severe episodes of insomnia.As a nurse, I would like to recommend that you be careful taking it every day. One of the ingredients (5-HTP) can cause serotonin syndrome in certain doses. Since we don't know the exact dose they use, I would look up serotonin syndrome and be on the look out for side effects if you take it regularly. Just in case. I haven't had any side effects, but better safe than sorry.Also, be careful mixing it with certain other meds used to adjust mood (anxiety/depression meds) or other sleep aids - even natural ones. Just a heads up.

I have consistently had trouble sleeping... i tried it and the first night with just a half a bottle i fell sound asleep within 30 - 45 minutes.... you feel refreshed and relaxed! If you have trouble sleeping at night this is a good way to go!

This is the best stuff on earth!! I don't like medicine- I haven't even taken a Tylenol in years- so it was very hard for me to find a solution for my sleeping problems. Teas are natural, but don't work are all, and pills have nasty side effects. Dream Water is natural and effective!!! I also love that I don't have to count calories, because I do take this regularly.It is powerful enough to help you fall asleep, but mild enough that you can wake up whenever you want to, without leaving you groggy or out of it. Both flavors are great!By it for yourself- and if you want to make other busy/stressed out people very happy (your friends, your parents, your teachers, your coworkers, etc), spread it around!!

Well worth the money! I am very glad to have gotten this. This definiitely helps stress/anxiety and promotes a RESTFUL sleep! I don't think you'll be disappointed! HEADS UP though, for stress/anxiety try a sip and progress. DO NOT attempt to drive or operate anything once taken! For sleep try HALF the bottle to see how you react to it and REFRIGERATE it until you use it again. GREAT STUFF!

I've had sleeping problems for years now and nothings really worked.  I refuse to try Ambien or any prescription drugs for fear of side effects.  I use to use Tylenol PM but I found myself feeling a hangover effect in the morning.  I was recommended "Dream Water" by a pharmacist in a Duane Read by my job a few months ago and I've been using it ever since.  It both relaxes me and helps me fall asleep on the nights I am laying awake counting sheep.  It tastes great unlike some of the other products I've tried, I prefer the Snoozeberry flavor myself, but the Lullaby Lemon is just as good.  Finally something that works for me!!!

I came across this product in a local store by accident and decided to give it a try.  I must say I was more impressed than I thought I would be.  And honestly I didn't think it would work at all.Normally, I lay in bed for a while watching TV until I fall asleep. It sometimes takes me about an hour or better to actually fall asleep even though most mornings I awake at 5am. I wake up several times in the night, for no reason, but generally go back to sleep with no problems. I tend to wake up a little sluggish and not wanting to get out bed. Well I drank the Dream Water, the taste is pleasant, and in about 30 minutes I felt more relaxed.  But I think I was fighting it at first. But as soon as I laid down, I was sleep in time.  I slept through the night.  And woke up refreshed and felt rested and ready to start my day.Of course this shouldn't be used daily but for those days when I think sleep is going to be hard to come by, I keep some Dream Water on hand. Some of the ingredients (this products claims to be all natural) are maybe not for people with high blood pressure. So please pay attention to the label.  But if you have no existing health issues I'd recommend giving it a shot!

I really like dream water.  The lemon flavor is really good, and I get drowsy in about 45 minutes after I drink it. I have been sleeping better too.  I also take L-theanine and L-tyrptophan at night too.

I suffer from idiopathic insomnia, which is basically lifelong insomnia, every night, with no known cause. I've tried EVERY sleep drug - ambien, trazodone, lunesta, etc. etc. You name it! I HATE taking drugs, especially to sleep. So I'm always looking for a natural alternative. I've tried "sleep shots" in the past, but my body is very sensitive and most of them have tons of different herbs that can cause negative reactions. THIS DOESN'T! This contains only ingredients that are SUPPOSED to be in your body naturally.5-HTP is a precursor to serotonin.GABA is EXTREMELY relaxing and good for an anxious mind (I have been taking GABA supplements for about a year now)Melatonin is something we all know about to help induce sleep.This combination is just what my body wants before bed. Granted, I still have some sleepless nights. In addition to this drink I often will take magnesium and Passion Flower supplements to help calm me. The taste is great, very mild. This product has made a noticeable difference in my relaxation and sleep.Highly recommended. Let's get away from those sleep drugs!

column9: First OTC sleep aid that worked for me
column10: As an insomniac of many years, I picked up a Dream Water at my local pharmacy, where they're sold in individual 2.5-oz bottles in two flavors, Snoozeberry and Lullaby Lemon.  I've tried every over-the-counter sleep aid there is, and some help, some don't -- this stuff really works.  It makes me very drowsy, and far as I can tell, there are no adverse side effects.  Both flavors are subtle and pleasant, and contain no calories.  The active ingredient is sodium 80 mg, which might be of concern to those on a low-sodium diet, although 80 mg only represents 3% of the average adult's recommended intake.  The rest is their "secret blend" of what I presume is the usual herbals that are reputed to relax you. All I know is that I fall asleep within an hour and sleep better through the night with fewer interruptions.One minor complaint -- the stuff's expensive (hence the four stars, rather than five)!  Even if you buy it by the 12-pk, it's about $2 a pop! I guess it deepends, then, on how bad you want to sleep.  I like having the stuff around for when nothing else is working.So that caveat aside, highly recommended!
DreamWater is very effective and natural product to help you to fall asleep without the morning fuzz you might find with a pharma option.

I took this 30 minutes before going to sleep and felt a little tired but it did not last long.  I think I will lower the minutes.  I never get a full night's sleep but I did fall asleep which usually takes forever (I'm healing from a fractured shoulder which adds to this).  I am still going to take it.  It does'nt taste bad and also the delivery was fast which are pluses.  My metabolism is very high - so for other people it probably would work better

Saw this on an endcap at Wal-Mart and decided to try it. $2.65 was way too expensive for a product with such common and cheap ingrediants. Yes it knocked me cold but I had terrible grogginess next day.

Arrived right on time as usual and could not believe how fresh the aroma was refreshing.I am new to pickling but it was easy to simmer the spices in vinegar and pour it into jars containing cukes and or carrots. Two days later the greatest carrots and pickles I ever tasted. I had thought the spices were too much for it until I tasted the results. With pickling you do not have to use pressure cookers. It is so easy that just about any vegetable can be pickled. Add some tasty treats to the jars (garlic,onions,sugar,hot sauce.....) and you have your own brand right there. There are just too many ways and recipes for pickling to even begin to get bored.

This spice mixture is fantastic. I've been adding a tablespoon of it when making dill pickles and must say that it really does give the pickles much more flavor than just bay leaf, all spice, and pepper. Enjoy!
The product was as advertised and of great quality.  The speed of service was excellent and the product arrived safely.

I have several jars of spices from these Wonderful people!!  The jars are huge and the spices are absolutely fresh and flavourful!!  I personally recommend these spices and herbs to EVERYONE!!  I especially liked the Chinese 5-spice.  Not salty like others I have tried, but flavourful and tasty.Again, Absolutely Outstanding !!!!!

I use a lot of cumin and was spending a lot on spice jars from the grocery stores.  I am shocked how much cumin you get for the money from Marshalls Creek Spices.  The spice smells full and flavorful and my dishes tasted just as good, so I assume it's as high quality or better than the more expensive stuff at the grocery store.  I actually restocked my spice cabinet and purchased 10 different spices from this company at the same time.  I have no complaints about any of them.

I am on an Indian cuisine kick and cumin from the supermarkey is way too expensive. Marshall Creek sells large containers that are high quality and very reasonable prices. The huge jar is cheaper than the 1 ounce jar at the grocery store! Very happy.
This cumin is fresh and aromatic.  I put some in my salad or vegetable saute every night.
Don't know WHY this stuff is so horrendously expensive in the grocery stores, for a fraction of the amount you receive from this company.  The price/quality/quantity is a very great value.

column4: John A. van der Wel "John van der Wel"
column10: one thing about this product that i didnt like was the size since they were talking about large jars....well..when i think large i think 26 oz but it was about half the size i expected

During one of my safari's in the African Hi-lands, i was attacked by some native elephants and subsequently was left with only one arm. As you can imagine, I was devastated.  One of my true passions in life was grounding my own spices. O boy did I love grounding cumin. I would spend hours upon hours grounding cumin. The feel of warm cumin slowly drenching my face was intoxicating. While this isn't fresh cumin, this is, in my opinion, the best alternative.

column9: didnt taste like cumin at all
column10: it seems this is a blend of who knows which herbs, it really didn't taste awful but for sure not to cumin whatsoever. I will not buy this brand in the future

I was excited to find green tea with earl gray flavor.I also read my ingredients.So far so good,"bergamot flavoring".But I also happen to read Russian,and translated the ingredient reads "bergamot flavouring,identical to the natural one".Why use artificial flavor when the real one is easy to come by? I try to avoid artificial colors and flavors so this one was a downer(discovered it too late).It tastes fine otherwise.

To be brief: I enjoy the individual taste of both green tea and earl grey, and I find that this combination tea brings something very interesting to the table. I'm always left wanting more. Delicious.
Moist and Meaty is our dogs' favorite food; he has about 3 or 4 different kinds, but prefers that one!!We do the subscribe method from Amazon, which saves us a lot !!

There is nothing better than a genuine company with sincere interest in their customers.  Not only is the bean dip excellent, and for some reason it isn't available in my region of the US (why??), but the vendor went to great effort to assure that the order was correct and packaged safely for transport.The expiration dates are a couple years out, so the product is store fresh.  It really is hard to ask for any more...I look forward to my next order, as I'm not giving up the best bean-dip for Doritos around, just because it isn't available locally - yay for Amazon!!

If you think you're getting full boxes of candy as pictured, you will be disappointed! The popcorn box has 5 pieces of miniature versions of candy. There is one microwave popcorn packet, in addition to a plastic clapper that you would use at a sporting event that has basketballs on it?? Is that appropriate for a movie night? I'll keep it and use it as filler for a basket I'm making for a charity event, but I will still have to go shopping for theater-sized boxes of candy. I thought $6.99 was a great deal for this as pictured. I suggest changing the image.

I work with diabetics and people with very low immune systems and am always looking for a great sugar-free snack to serve them. I have been buying these stoned wheat crackers in bulk for quite some time but will not be ordering them again. The product itself it wonderful, delicious and versitile. The way it is shipped is absolutely appaling. I had contacted Amazon to let them know how dissapointed in the shipping I was, hoping it would improve so I could keep purchasing them, but to no avail. I would say that about half of all the crackers I ordered were smashed and broken and turned into crumbs. The excellent price was not actually a deal as I was being shorted half my order every time. Looks like I need to find another supplier.
Product should be called "Wellington Stoned Wheat Crumbs" since there are so many crumbs instead of crackers. If you like crumbs, this product is for you.

Bought this several times, but won't again.  The last case (they make you buy 12 boxes at once) contains broken crackers, cracked into several pieces and hard to use.  The case must be very old -- there is no date so it's hard to tell.

column9: Dry, bitter, hard to drink.... a.k.a  YUCK
column10: I'm a big tea drinker.  I enjoy a wide range of teas but my favorites are PG Tips, Republic of Tea double Green, Tazo's Apricot Vanilla White, as well as Lapsong Suchong and most brands of Earl Grey.I thought I'd give this one a try since I had heard that Oolong is a great weight loss tea.  Well this may be true, but find a different brand for sure.  Looking at the tea bag, the tea is crushed like fine soil and is so small and dry it flows right through the bag into your tea.The tea is very high in tannin which makes it bitter.  Also, keep in mind that tannin leaches iron from your diet so a bitter tea like this is draining your body of a vital nutrient.

I used to eat another brand similar to this natural flavor, but it disappeared from shelves, so I tried the O.R. brand and liked it better.  Now I'll need to order it from amazon because this has also been disappearing from my grocery store. I cannot understand everyone's fascination with the chemicals that go into 'butter flavor' microwave popcorn!  This has just oil and salt, and I've found that pouring it into a large bowl reduces the saltiness that others have mentioned here. Keeping it in the bag to eat from seems to keep that salty flavor more concentrated. But I don't think it's really that salty anyway. Obviously this is quite the matter of taste.

This is a great popcorn, though it IS very salty.  Our family loves salty snacks, so it's perfect.  I like that there are no artificial ingredients, and no milk products.  It is hard to find kid friendly snacks without wheat/gluten/dairy, and this is a winner.*********I'm updating to emphasize the SOY in this popcorn.  I honestly don't think it originally contained soy, but now it does.  We can't eat this anymore, but I'll stand by the 5 stars for tastiness.

column9: tastes almost like movie theater popcorn
column10: I love this popcorn. A co-worker let me try some of hers, and I was instantly in love. I eat a lot of popcorn, and so far, this is my favorite microwave variety. The salt, combined with the oil cooks up nicely to give it a very savory flavor, almost like some movie theater varieties! It doesn't leave your fingers greasy or oily like a lot of other flavors. I've served this side-by-side with several other popcorns, and this is always chosen by the group as the favorite. If you're watching your sodium intake, just be mindful of how much you have per serving, but otherwise, enjoy this delicious popcorn![...]

I like this popcorn.  I was looking for something without added butter/dairy or a lot of chemicals.  The label says popcorn, palm oil, salt, and mixed tocopherols.  It reminds me of popcorn prepared the old-fashioned way with just oil and salt, which does leave residual oil on your fingers.  (I am glad to see that palm oil is making a comeback.)  It is a bit saltier than what I would prefer but certainly not as salty as other brands I have tried.  Of course, the amount of sodium is given on the box for those who need to know the exact milligrams they would be eating.  In my opinion, they could put just half of the sodium in this, and it would be just right.  Overall, it is tasty popcorn with few and simple ingredients.
I just LOVE this Popcorn.  It's the only one I can find with NO BUTTER.  I can't seem to find it in any stores so I am very glad that Amazon stocks it.  Great Stuff!  :-)

This is my other favorite microwave popcorn.  It only has oil and salt and no other ingredients.  So it's kind of like you made it at home in a regular popcorn maker (but much better).  Well, I do use Orville's regular popcorn in my regular popcorn makers (yes I'm a popcorn nut - have 3 popcorn makers at home).  His regular popcorn pops up just as well as his microwave popcorn, if not better.  but this one I know I have on Subscribe and Save, again in the 3 count boxes which is a really nice size when it's being shipped in multi-packs.
I have a bag of Orville Redenbacher's Natural  Popcorn every night.  I have done this for years (I'm 76).  Orville's Popcorn is the best.  I love it.

I have bought this brand in the stores for several months and was happy to see I could get it with subscribe and save. But after this last order, I have cancelled my subscription, because EVERY bag in EVERY box was oily on the outside before even being popped. This is quite atrocious. I have not had this problem with the 6 count boxes I purchase in the store. I do not understand why it is like this, but I can't bring myself to continue purchasing this particular product in the 3 count boxes.

column9: Good, just a little oily & salty for my taste
column10: Overall, it tastes pretty good. The pieces of popcorn are more oily than normal and a little saltier, but I have a low daily salt intake, so that could be the reason as well. I also bought Orville Redenbacher's Smart Pop! 94% fat free butter microwave popcorn, 40 2.9-oz. bags 114 oz Box at Costco and prefer it over the natural oil & salt, just because it is less oily and with the butter flavoring it is surprisingly less salty. Still a good product, it just comes down to your personal preference.

I used to buy the low fat version of this popcorn, but found it to be slightly too salty so I tried this. Oops. What a mistake. This is equally as salty, but this is like eating grease. The grease literally oozes out of the package before you even stick it into the microwave. Someone out there must make a good popcorn. This is not it.
This by far the tastiest popcorn we have ever had. Had to buy it in bulk for as much as we eat it!

This is better than most of us can do with a pot and some oil.  And it's way healthier, though salty.  This is the tastiest microwave popcorn ever. It takes about 90 seconds to complete popping for me.  Any longer than that and you start to get some burnt popcorn.

This is great popcorn. I do not know why that in this day and age, most stores stopped carrying or do not carry natural popcorn. They have 90 different kinds of buttered. How different can it all be? Amazon is the way to go. I do watch what I eat and prefer this as a good snack.

I appreciate short ingredient lists and this is a great-tasting popcorn. Most other grocery store popcorns have a short novel for ingredients and contain way too much chemistry for something as simple as popcorn.  If you like a lot of butter, steer clear from this.Also, the Amazon ingredient list shows "Partially Hydrogenated Soybean Oil" as an ingredient, which is wrong. That error probably loses quite a bit of sales from people looking for a clean ingredient popcorn.
It is the 3.3oz bags just as the picture shows. We have several dairy intolerant in the house and everyone likes it and enjoys it. We have 9 in the household and it is the only popcorn we buy now.
This was a re-order of this great popcorn because we consumed the first one.  I will continue to buy this brand and flavor as long as they make it.

I bought this thinking it would be a healthy snack alternative. Plain popcorn is filling and a much better alternative to a bag of chips. This is not.The "simply salted" title is misleading. This product is perhaps the most greasy pre-packaged popcorn that I've tried. I needed a napkin before typing this review because my hands were too sticky to type. I know that there are plain microwave popcorns out there, but this is not the one if you want a healthy snack, which is seemingly how it is marketed.On the plus side, it tastes pretty good. Just wish I didn't feel like I ate a bag of potato chips after eating one serving.

This is one of the best of the Orville Redenbacher line.  Flavorful, with just the right amount of salt and butter, it's a classic that never fails to please. After microwaving, there are very few unpopped kernels remaining, so (dare I say?) this product is worth its salt!
Considering the fact that almost every store in San Diego has stopped carrying plain popcorn, finding this product at such a great price is astounding.

column9: Yuck.  Love Orville BUT Really Hate This Product
column10: I eat a considerable amount of popcorn every week and it's almost always Redenbacher.  I like the brand.  BUT this product is dreadful.  First, it's salty. Waaay too salty. Secondly, it's pretty greasy.  Not buttery mind you, but greasy.And it gets worse.  On top of those drawbacks is the fact that it smells awful.  It has a sort of chemically odor and what's really odd... it does not smell like popcorn.  You know how microwaving popcorn will make people come creeping out of the woodwork looking for a handful of fluffy corny goodness!  Not with this product.  Heck, my kids won't eat it.  And after experimenting to see if the second bag was as bad as the first, I threw out the rest of the box.THE SKINNY:::I've reviewed over a thousand products and given less than a handful 1-Star. I'm adding Orvilles "Natural" popcorn to that elite list because its just gross.  I despise it and fear to feed it to my children because of the unattractive smell.Stick with Orville's Butter or Lite-Butter or Tender White or one of the flavored types.  They taste good and the smell good.Pam T~upset mom/blogger

I loved the idea of a microwave popcorn without the "butter", but the "simply salted" in this case is a little misleading. It is "very" salty thus very high in sodium. Not for those of us with blood pressure issues. I'll got back to the Tender White variety which is very good.

Has an agribusiness flavor - not exactly stale, but not really fresh.A bit on the greasy side, even though not "buttered" per se.However, does pop well. Almost all kernels pop without the risk of burning.

This popcorn also has TONS of oil in it. Pops up light and tasty. Just like I might want in a theater. Unfortunately, I was looking for something that wasn't all that bad for me as a snack, and this just ain't it. Bring lots of napkins because there is a lot of oil in the mixture. It's almost too rich to eat.

I can tolerate half a bag of this stuff, but then I find I need to drink huge amounts of water, due to the very salty nature of this product.  Blech.I recommend buying the LIGHT natural instead, which has the same flavor, but almost no salt.  The only problem is that amazon frequently runs out of stock on the Light Natural, which makes it hard to get.  (An alternative is to buy Natural + Bearito's Unsalted and mix them together, thereby diluting the salt to a manageable level.)
This product claims it is "Simply Salted", though a read of ingredients I soon discover it has soybean oil.

I recently had a craving for some Virginia peanuts and could not decide on which ones. So I ordered both "The Peanut Shop of Williamsburg Handcooked Lightly Salted Virginia Peanuts" & "Royal Oak Gourmet Virginia Salted Peanuts".  The Peanut Shop ones were wonderful and was exactly what I had been craving - Just enough cruch and salt. The Royal Oak Peanuts were harder and were less salty. The after taste of the Royal Oak peanuts was just not as nice as the Peanut Shop ones.

These peanuts are very fresh and crunchy.  They are not salty enough to satisfy me, but I don't need to be eating so much salt!  The peanuts are heads above what is available locally.  Delivery was exceptional through Amazon!

column9: So THIS is how peanuts are supposed to taste!
column10: Eating these peanuts is like "discovering" the real pineapple taste fresh from the fields in Hawaii.  Warning!  These peanuts will spoil you for the run-of-the-mill peanut!  I have to limit myself to a couple of handfuls daily, and even so find myself re-ordering the pack of 3!  I went looking for Virginia peanuts after my local Ralph's grocery store stopped carrying them.  The Ralph's brand (even though labeled Viginia peanuts) was not even close to this product!

column9: The best roasted peanuts I've ever had!
column10: These are without a doubt, the best roasted peanuts I have ever eaten! I don't know how they do it, but they are amazingly crunchy and highly addictive. My only suggestion would be to reduce the salt a bit, but other than that...man! Talk about good!

These peanuts have just enough salt to keep them from tasting bland, but not enough to cause you to run for your water bottle.  They are fresh and crisp.  The only problem is that you can't stop with just one hand full.

I love the crisp tooth these have. They are also not over cooked, so they have a clean, deep peanut taste. These are what gourmet peanuts are all about. The texture and taste superiority is well worth the cost difference to store brands. I eat allot of peanuts and these are my brand of choice.

These peanuts are so good I would drive to Williamsburg, VA to get them.  But why bother when them can be sent to me in the comfort of my home .  Probably save some money too.  Shipping seems pricey until I considered gas costs and motel rooms.Thanks for the deal.

column9: Peanuts from The Peanut Shop of Williamsburg
column10: My family's favorite.The only peanuts I send to friends and families.Cooked just right.If you buy the big can - keep it in the refrigerator after opening,as it will stay fresh longer.Worth every penny.

I bought Peanut Shop peanuts for my dad's  birthday which recently occurred and I just gifted him The Peanut Shop of Williamsburg Handcooked Lightly Salted Virginia Peanuts, 12-Ounce Tin, 3 pack, $14.31.My dad is a peanut connoisseur and eats lots of different peanuts and gourmet peanuts so I was anxious to get his feedback on these nuts. Just got feedback from my mom. She said they were not very good, according to my dad. She had to cook these peanuts & add salt to make them more edible. She said they didn't taste as if they'd been cooked long enough so she added some salt to them and cooked them and that made them better.

THESES SO CALLED MEGA SIZE SMARTIES ARE THE SAME AS THE GIANT SIZE AND THE GIANT SIZE SELLS FOR LESS. I HAVE HAD SMARTIES WAY LARGER THAN THIS. DISAPPOINTED, DON'T BE FOOLED BUT THEY DO TASTE GREAT. THE MEGA IS IN THE LENGTH OF THE ROLL NOT THE SIZE OF THE CANDY, THE CANDY IS LARGE

I've been using this stuff for years.  My mom used to mix it with sour cream for dip for chips.  However, I'm now mixing it with plain greek non-fat yogurt and it makes a great dip for carrots, chips, veges, french fries, etc.If you're trying to stay healthy and want a tasty dip, get this stuff and make your own.  It's totally worth the $13.

This stuff is cheap, and taste like lychee.  The quality is so much better than the lychee syrup from the can.This syrup is great on desserts, ice cream, making lychee-flavored ice cream/frozen yogurt, and cocktails.  This stuff lasts forever, especially when it comes in a 4 pack.  I haven't use even half of the first bottle, and plan on giving some away to friends.  I doubt this stuff will expire because the sugar content in here is very high (sugar is a great preservative by itself). 1 shot of this stuff is 95 kcal.

column9: Did I pay for sugar and water?
column10: This is a poor excuse for lychee product. It is water with sugar and a very faint lychee flavor. You can do better with any brand lychee honey (syrup) from a supermarket in Chinatownwhich has 20 times the lychee flavor. I ended up throwing the 4 bottles away after a sip.

My husband loves worcester chips and can never get them.  Thank you Amazon for having a vendor on board for these.  He hadn't had them in a long while and was hoping what he remembered would have the same great taste.  They did and he is sooo happy.

This tastes just like Lays potato chips, except the flavor is different -- it's Worcester sauce. So what does Worcester sauce taste like on chips/crisps? It tastes like vinegar, but it does not have the vinegary taste, and it is a bit sweeter (very subtle). If you enjoy vinegar chips, or dill pickle, or anything tangy, you will certainly like this.

I love mac & cheese. Used to be able to eat this all the time, but not anymore. It has good flavor & is easy to make. But every time I eat it I get nasty diarrhea (happens with anything that has powdered cheese), so I'm not able to eat this form of mac & cheese anymore. Fortunately, Kraft has come up with mac & cheese with liquid cheese sauce & I can & do eat this. I am glad there are many others out there whi can eat this. Wish I could.

I got my Citiz w/ milk and used some of the included Nespresso capsules at the same time I ordered and received the Ethical capsules. I have had a Delonghi EC155 for years (using Illy and Lavazza). I wanted something a little less time consuming and was willing to pay more for it.Here's my review of the Ethical capsules after consuming 7 of them, all my espressos are served as breves with about the same amount of half and half as there is espresso.1) flavor - is smooth, not very bitter, kind of nutty/chocolatey even when I sipped it sans 1/2 and 1/2 it was smooth - maybe too smooth for people who take a lot of milk in their lattes (I don't). (or breves)2) not much crema - what there is seems to disappear pretty quickly3) it is quite a bit harder to close my machine with the Ethical capsule in place, however, you have to be impressed with a company willing to replace your machine if their capsules damage it.4) These capsules are not individually sealed, so you need to consume the 10 capsules within a short period of time, or you'll be drinking stale coffee.If you need/want to save the money, this capsule does that without really sacrificing too much, as long as you drink at least 3 a day, otherwise, that coffee is getting pretty darn stale by the fourth day.Edit: Ok I've drunk about 15 of these things, and when I saw the new low price, I popped for more. I like to drink a lot of espresso, these are good enough to allow me to feed the habit, without wincing. I've got the empty caps coming - can't wait to see how those work, I have a LOT of Illy left that I bought for my EC155 that died on me. RIP (2nd one) I have high hopes for the fill-able caps.Edit 2 - ok, the necaps came and though they are relatively tricky, I'm hoping I've hit the right combo of coffee/tamping, however the one thing they showed me is that Illy in a necap is better than the cremosa in a capsule I don't have to pack myself, etc.Edit 3 - now I've had at least 150 of these (I mentioned I drink a lot of espresso) I will not buy them again. Maybe MAYBE if they went down to the super ultra cheap price they were before, but at $25 there's no way I'm buying them. If you're thinking about it - at 50cents a capsule, just go for the Necaps and fill your own, or fork out the extra for the Nespresso capsules.6 months in and I'm still using this coffee. It's just been so darn inexpensive, and since I drink all my espresso as a breve - well, it' works fine for me. I did start to poke extra holes in the cap (thanks to someone else's review) I just put the cap face down on the counter and take a paring knife and poke a hole (it's easy) and twist the knife a little to open the hole. I also have a serving fork that I use the tine to do the same thing. Then I pop it in the machine. I think because the capsule is not aluminum the hole the punch makes is not wide enough to let the proper water flow through. My experience punching the extra holes has been a richer deeper flavor in the resulting espresso. Try it. :)

So as a espresso fan, and a Nespresso owner for the last few years, I was excited when I heard about these capsules... but after trying them, I was not impressed. If you just want coffee and don't like it strong and don't pay much attention to the flavor, these should be fine. If good flavor and strength matter... don't buy these.

I thought I would give these a try since the nespresso caps are so tasty hence we go thru them quickly. Thought I would try a knock off for half the price. NOT worth it! Stick with the real thing or try another alternative because these are WEAK, WATERY and YUCKY. Maybe if I was try to ween myself off a nespresso habit but I am not so I do not enjoy them at all. :(I tried the 3 strongest options and they were all week. Had to do short pulls and a 3:1 ratio was still not equal to 1 weak nespresso cap.The shipping and service was great, just not the product. Plus to add insult, they dropped the price from 25$ a box down to 10$. At $10 try them yourself and you can taste disappointing brown water too!

Hi,I have tried both the armonioso and the arabica capsules. The price is better than original nespresso's and they are "greener" but that is the end of the story for me since:1. Taste is for me only at minimum quality and therefore not comparable with the original nespresso capsules that I have tasted. Taste is of course different from person to person.2. I have a Citiz and when I put a capsule in the machine I have to press down the handle with a force that to me seems too much in relation to what is good for the machine. If you take one of these capsules appart you will see that just beneath the visible outer filter is a HARD plastic element, whereas the original nespresso capsules are only made of soft material. I guess this is why you have to press down the handle very hard. As you might have noticed the machine pops rectangular holes in the the capsule. I am affraid I will bend or break some plastic part in the machine.3. When the machine starts to "shoot" water through the capsule it hesitates for a second or two and then it says pop. During this second or two no coffee comes out, only water. After the pop coffee comes out instead. At the same time the flow of the coffee is VERY RANDOM, which means that every cup will be different from the other. There is even less coffee coming out of the machine because of the hesitation and the random flow, compared to an original nespresso capsule.In conclusion; with less coffee per capsule, random taste, and a questionable use of force to put the handle down, the lower price makes these cheaper capsules no longer attractive to me. One star is given for the green concept, but there is a limit of how much you want to sacrifice to go green. It should be noted, that all this could of course be because of my Citiz and how it is constructed compared to other Nespresso machine models.

column9: Not bad for the old price
column10: I'm not exactly an espresso connoisseur, so I have a hard time telling a huge difference between these capsules and the nespresso ones in drinks like lattes. Unfortunately, for less diluted drinks, the weaker flavor in these capsules was pretty obvious. They're not so much weaker that they're undrinkable, but they're definitely have less flavor.At the previous price of 25 cents/capsule, these were an awesome choice for lattes/cappuccinos, but for 50 cents/capsule, I'll just stick with the nespresso capsules.

column9: I so wanted to like these
column10: What attracted me was the savings over Nespresso capsules...I so wanted to like these, but the extraction is inadequate and espresso is weak and not as nuanced as most Nespresso varieties.  Since I paid $25 for the 5 boxes of 10 each, the price has dropped precipitously...now under $15.  I can only believe that despite the pretty package and the eco-friendly claims, Nespresso users will pay a significant price premium to get the consistenly good (if not great), no mess aspects of using Nespresso capsules.  I am reluctant to try other flavors after my experience with Cremoso.

Like many other people who have posted reviews of Ethical Coffee Company's capsules that are compatible with Nespresso brewers, I was excited to be offered an alternative to Nespresso's own capsules.  I have already written reviews of the Espresso and Decaf capsules from ECC, and I intend to write a review for their Indiad'oro variety as well.As to this Cremoso variety, I have to say that I preferred it to the Espresso variety at first because it seemed more interesting even though it was a bit less strong, but after having consumed about 25 capsules I must say that the Cremoso flavor is quite underwhelming.  It doesn't taste bad, but it simply doesn't have much flavor at all.  Even at the current, significantly reduced price -- exactly half the price of most Nespresso capsules available direct from the Nespresso club, I don't think I would order the Cremoso variety again.  It's just WAY too mild for my liking.

I use Nespresso Roma, and my wife uses Nespresso Ristretto.  We bought Cremosa and Espressivo as possible substitutes, because lower per-capsule price, free shipping with my Amazon Prime, and I don't have to use the Outpresso to recycle.  But we don't like the coffee. Others may prefer it, I'm sure, but its not for us. Too weak,  and we don't like the flavor.  The Cremosa is especially watery versus Nespresso.  I'm cheap and maybe not as picky  so I will use them up over time, but after trying both Cremosa and Espressivo, my wife will have none of it.  One of life's little pleasures especially for her is good coffee, and these are no substitute.

column9: I really wanted to like this!
column10: We bought a citiz nespresso maker and hate being slaves to the nespresso coffee cartel and liked the idea of Eco friendly pods. This seemed like the answer to our prayers. Sadly not. I've tried two styles of this brand now (cremoso and espressivo) and neither one of them is strong at all!  The flavor is nice, but who cares if you have to put four shots into one coffee? I thought it would be more economical than Nestlé/Nespresso, but it's not, because I end up havig to use more capsules. Also, there is no indicator on Amazon as to how strong the coffee is, so it's kind of a blind stab. Cremoso was weak to me and espressivo (which i believe is the strongest) was a bit better, but neither did the trick. I REALLY wanted to like them.  I guess it's back to the coffee duck for me, unless they develop a stronger roast :(I'm willing to give it another shot if the come up with a new roast that actually has the power to wake me up!

First off, the pods jam in my (brand new!) Nespresso Pixie.  Its easy enough to clear the jam, but they should work without a screwdriver. Secondly, the coffee isn't very good.As much as a like a lower priced option, I have to suggest you stick with the authentic Nespresso pods.

When I bought these they worked out to about half the price of Nespresso pods.  I thought it was a great deal until I tasted the first shot.  This particular variety at least is VERY weak.  I ended up using two pods per shot and it still isn't as strong nor full flavored like genuine Nespresso pods (even something mild like a 3 or 4 intensity).My wife said they tasted like plastic and wouldn't even drink them. Also I had some trouble with them jamming in the machine, but learned to just eject them immediately after it was done.  This was with a Pixie machine.  In short, don't waste your money.

I have tried the Cremoso and the Espressivo and love them both.  Great for a quick pick me up in the morning and early afternoon - the taste is perfect for me.  Im not one to love extremely bitter espresso's and this has just the right amount of humph!  Another great thing i do with them when it is hot out (and where I from, it gets extremely hot) is pour the espresso in a glass with some almond milk and lots of ice. So refreshing!Bonus is that the capsules are biodegradable - one should always go that route when deciding what to buy.

column9: I wanted to love these..but don't.
column10: I liked the idea of an affordable alternative to the regular Nespresso capsules, and when I read about these I ordered some. At first use, however, it's immediately clear that they don't work as well as the original ones; they don't quite fit into the machine properly, the stream of coffee isn't as robust coming into the cup, and most importantly, the taste isn't the same.So, yes, they are priced less than the originals however I wouldn't purchase them again.Thanks!

column9: You guys are too tough - this coffee is pretty good
column10: OK, so this is not Nespresso swiss coffee. It is however, very drinkable and smooth and a perfect antidote to those SKY HIGH Nespresso capsule prices (hello, Nespresso, are you listening). I am eagerly waiting for Starbucks to come out with their espresso capsule machine later this year - it's going to be a category killer!! But until then, I'll mix this coffee in sometimes (after dinner) and be none the worse for it. Thanks Ethical Coffee!!!

column9: Love the coffee and biodegradable capsule
column10: Bought this coffee in Europe when I was traveling and was pleased to find it on amazon when I returned home. Great taste and love the fact that the pods are biodegradable! The Nespresso capsules are an environmental disaster.
I bought these as a backup in case I forget to order Nespresso capsules. However these taste terrible and are not worth the low price i paid for it.
This coffee is absolutely the worst, do not even think about wasting your money on this. On the bright side it made me realise how good the nespressso coffee is.

I purchased this product a couple of weeks ago. I was trying to find a product that would work on my Nespresso C-100 Essenza machine but at a more affordable price than the Nespresso capsules. Ethical coffee capsules seemed to be the right product. I soon encountered several issues. First, it was difficult to close the lid of the machine with the capsules inside. Secondly, the coffee that came out was watered down and tasted quite bad. On close examination of the capsules after  using them, I noticed that the machine only superficially perforated the capsule, which would explain why the coffee was so watered down. Thus, I decided to make small holes on the capsules prior to inserting them into the machine. That did help, but the coffee quality was still bad. Even if the coffee was great, I really should not have to place holes on the capsules prior to inserting them into the machine in order for the water to go through it freely!! These Ethical coffee capsules either ARE compatible with Nespresso machines or THEY ARE NOT!  Based on my experience, I must say that these ARE NOT compatible with Nespresso makers. Conclusion: spend a little more money and purchase the Nespresso capsules for your machine. They are worth the extra money. Nespresso capsules work beautifully and the coffee is great. Thanks!
We're not using Ethical Coffee capsules on our Nespresso machine because of the density of the covering of their capsules.  We feared it would ruin the press used to puncture the capsule.

Bottom line, these taste like cheap hotel coffee. Your least favorite Nespresso capsule variety is 100X better tasting than these capsules. Taste is what matters, ECC capsules are awful.This goes for Cremoso, Indiad'oro, Espressivo - unfortunately, I bought all three types. Hardly a difference between them, but I listed them in awful to undrinkable order.However, if that's not enough of a reason to avoid, consider these;-they're difficult to insert in Nespresso machines-they're difficult to remove from Nespresso machines-they frequently blister during brewing, thus "brewing" coffee from the side of the capsules-they are stale right out of the package (though the expiration date reads otherwise)-all ten per box are not quite vacuum-sealed in plastic, hence opening the plastic hastens further spoilage-they are only a dime less than real Nespresso capsules!!!I actually threw away unused capsules, they were that bad. They are not worth free. Quite weak for a company started by a former Nespresso executive. Perhaps they have a serious quality control issue in the U.S.?

column9: Does these work with Keuric machines?
column10: Hi,  Does anyone know if these espresso "pods" work with a Keuric (sp?) machine or just the Nespresso device? Figured I could buy them to use at work.  These guys drink so much coffee they probably wouldn't notice how they tasted.  Thanks!  I appreciate any help I can get.  Don't want to deal with the hassle of returning if they don't work in our machine.

column9: Good coffee but even better company
column10: Let me start out by answering the question: Is this the best coffee? No. Nespresso still tates better. They after all are, created the system, have the research, and know what makes the ideal capsule.Will you notice a difference with a shot of pure espresso? Yes, BUT:Will you notice a difference in your cappuccino, latte, or other coffee drink? No.Will you feel better about supporting a company with far better business practices than Nestle, a company with nontoxic, biodegradable compost-able capsules (Nespresso capsules may be aluminum and recyclable but there are still plastics and glues that are not eco friendly in those capsules), and yet are still less expensive by far? Of course! What do you think?If you're worried that the capsule ruin your machine? Absolutely not. They give this guarantee on their website:"Our experience has shown us that the Nespresso Club* may try to make you believe that our capsules damage your machine.This is simply untrue. Our capsules are slightly more resistant.** This has no effect on your machine.As proof, we promise to replace your machine should any problem be caused by one of our capsules as part of the machine's routine use."After doing research I also discovered that the former CEO of Nespresso runs this company, so they clearly know their competition.Bottom line: i will keep ordering these capsules for quick shots, and morning cappucinos and coffee drinks, but I am still searching for something as good as the original nespresso branded ristretto and espresso capsules (as a frame of reference,  my two favorites would be the purple capsule aka the arpeggio and burgundy capsule aka the decaffeinato intenso).Hopefully the other flavors of this brand will make the cut because i love what they do.

New Update, Well as it turns out the Ethical Coffee Company has came through. They contacted me about the problem I had and have replaced my machine, so they do stand behind their word and will honor their guarantee. It took a few weeks but they did what they said they would. Therefore I will continue to use their products.
The capsules work perfectly as alternative to the expensive Nespresso, but the quality of the coffee is poor. Need to work on the content.

column9: Not Bad for the Price, but...
column10: Not bad taste and the price is a third of Nespresso brand capsules but these get stuck in my Essenza. Have to pry them out with a sharp knife. I've also tried Indiad'oro flavor which tastes better and don't seem to stick in the machine as often. The price is still worth the extra effort.

I bought all five of the different types of Ethical coffee capsules made for Nespresso machines.  Unfortunately,1. Coffee flavor-marginal-not great2. Quantity of Coffee-less in capsule than in Nespresso capsule3. We have a brand new Nespresso Pixie. These capsules continue to get jammed in the machine and we have to reach in, struggle with the capsule to pry it loose before we can make another coffee.4. Since 10 capsules are packaged in one plastic sleeve, the moment we open the sleeve, air comes into contact with the remaining capsules minimizing their freshness.Bottom line is that the espresso coffee is not worth the lower cost to purchase these capsules.

My office recently bought a DeLonghi Espresso machine, along with many varieties of espresso capsules to try out.  I was very excited as my love (and pickiness) of coffee and espresso has gone back many years since my first trip to France.  My definite favorite is the Cremoso from Ethical Coffee Company.  My mid-afternoon treat has quickly become a Cremoso double latte.  The aroma and the taste are wonderful, and it is the perfect pick-me-up to get through the rest of my day.  I have ordered a box of Cremoso to have at my desk as my own personal "stash".  My co-workers like several of the other varieties of Ethical Coffee, but my hands-down favorite is Cremoso.  An added bonus is that Ethical Coffee Company (the name says it all, doesn't it?) makes their capsules envinronmentally-friendly and biodegradable. I have been concerned about the millions of plastic capsules that are mounting up in our landfills. I will always support a company that combines great quality with integrity, and Ethical Coffee Company seems to be the only company in the coffee genre that does.

column9: These green capsules work flawless on my Delonghi machine and are tasty!
column10: I bought these pods along with the Delonghi Latissima 720 machine and they work flawless. They did fit the machine and are perfectly ejected after use.It seems that some Amazon customers are giving bad reviews for this product because it is cheaper and it's not Nespresso, which is not the point.Firstly, these capsules are green and compostable. They cannot be a "copy" of Nespresso pods that are in aluminum, which is highly polluting. ECC capsules would be a "copy" if they were made in aluminum too!Secondly, the ECC capsules are not that cheap, there is only a difference of 10 cents between Nespresso and ECC: I am not sure that people that bought a Nespresso machine and used to drink Nespresso pods are interested in a bargain of 10 cents because if they wanted to make real savings, they should have used ground coffee and stovetop espresso makers!!!As a result,THIS PRODUCT IS NOT FOR YOU IF:* you already have your favorite Nespresso "grand crus",* you like the look of the aluminum capsules,* you love George Clooney Nespresso commercials and keep saying "What else?" each time you drink a Nespresso coffee,* you have the feeling to buy something luxurious each time you go to Nespresso club and you like it,* you don't care about the planet.THIS PRODUCT IS FOR YOU IF:* you don't have a favorite Nespresso "grand crus", and you like espressos in general,* you are not convinced by the recycling Nespresso thing because they did not try really hard to increase 5% of the total current recycled capsules(1),* you think that ECC capsules is the answer to the Nespresso question "What else?",* you like the idea of doing REALLY something to reduce the amount of polluting materials in your daily waste and think that recycling aluminum is not enough,* you don't care about the Nespresso club.(1) If Nespresso/Nestle did care that much about recycling, they would have entice their customers by giving them coupons for empty capsules brought back (as for the recycle of glass for example).Another thing, I saw a lot of reviews saying that these green pods do not work on Citiz or Nespresso branded machines. I am not even surprised. Nestle made everything he could to prevent the Ethical coffee Company to sell their products, but ECC found success in Europe since 2010. If this product was not working and was responsible for breaking machines, we should know it! As a consequence, I am not a conspiracy person but I would not be suprised that some of the bad reviews could come from Nestle itself. We are in an espresso-capsule-war, so this is business!P.S. 1 : I am not working for the Ethical Coffee Company and they don't give me any money for rating their products. I am just a green costumer concerned about his carbon footprint.P.S. 2 : The espresso taste is good! I used to drink espressos and ristrettos from semi automatic professional machines at work, but I did not want to do all the process by myself, so espresso capsule process is the perfect alternative for me! I am not a Nespresso aficionado so I am just talking about espresso here.P.S. 3 : You have to firmly lower the level of your machine with these capsules. FIRMLY. The first time I tried, I was afraid time to break my Delonghi super expensive machine, but it's ok. It's seems to be due to the biodegradable capsule material that is less hard than aluminum (obvious).P.S. 4 : It would be nice if the Ethical Coffee Company could put all theirs different products in a single degustation box, in this way you could choose your favorite flavors and only buy them. Because if you do not like the taste you are stuck with 49 capsules... it's a bit rude!P.S. 5 : It would be great (and logical) if the ECC capsules were really ethical: organic and/or fair trade certified.>>April, 25th 2012After drinking ECC capsules for more than 2 months now, my conclusion is that -- at comparable intensities and blends -- the espresso tastes of both Nespresso and ECC capsules are good, and the differences between Nespresso and ECC are subtle. Since some capsules are compostable while other pollute like hell, I will stick with these green capsules because I hope soon to turn them (coffee+capsules) in compost for my palm trees.>>May, 2nd 2012I've just started to compost the ECC capsules, I am very excited! The capsules should break down in 6 months according to the standard EN#13432.I will let you know how quick they turn into compost! :)Go green!

column9: Too expensive for second-rate nespresso capsules
column10: You know, I was the person who recommended these capsules on the deal sites when they were half the price they are now. At $25, this is a COMPLETE rip-off. Basically you get like a 10% savings for a far inferior product to Nespresso's own capsules. Yes, these are biodegradable but you can bring Nespresso capsules in to have them recycled too. And ANY flavor of Nespresso tastes better than these; Cremoso is a very weak. I would only really use it for lattes, and of course you would need at least two shots to taste anything resembling espresso.I do not work for Nespresso. I wanted to get this out of the way because I myself was suspicious about the poor reviews of this product at first. As mentioned I recommended this product on sites like Fatwallet when it was half the price because some of us are broke and can't afford the far superior Nespresso capsules.I am really pissed off because I wasted my time, directing thousands of consumers to the Ethical capsules, assuming that the capsules were going to continue to be sold at a price that would save people money. Why in the world would a company launch an inferior product at no savings to the consumer? Nespresso capsules produce great tasting coffee, and Nespresso's capsules are sealed until they are used, unlike Ethical's capsules; once you break open Ethical's bag of ten, you pretty much have to use the capsules right away. BTW, these take a long time to decompose in a composter so be sure you cover them for months if you do decide to waste your money on these. Finally, while the capsules do work in my Essenza, it's a very tight fit and lately the Essenza lever kind of pops up at the end of the extraction. My Essenza was two weeks old when I started using these. I will amend this review if the company decides to do what is right, that is not gouge consumers.

column9: Not life changing but not bad...
column10: I was a little surprised by some of the really harsh reviews I've seen so far as well as some of the claims they don't fit the nespresso machine. I have the Delonghi Latissima (the older one, not the new square one released last year) and while it takes a little bit more force to close the door, compatibility has not been a problem. It's hard for me to imagine it fits one machine and not the others...As for the coffee, it's OK- doesn't compete with that amazing vanilla seasonal variation nespresso released this past year, but it's not as bad as the cherry variation either. Its definitely not as strong as the Ristretto or the Appreggio but has much more flavor then the cosi and some other the other weaker blends. I would most compare it to one of the new Lungo blends taken as a short pour instead of the lung pour.I have found them adequate to make my daily cappuccinos and honestly worth saving 30% per capsule vs nespresso. I will buy more!

column9: Tastes like a weak version of the real thing
column10: I really liked the idea of a cheaper capsule than Nespresso offer, with free shipping via Amazon Prime. Also I thought that the other reviewers were just being a bit sensitive, after all, coffee is coffee right?Uhhhh, no... I really should have listened to the other reviewers.Yes it's cheaper and yes it worked just fine in my machine, and gave a fine crema but no I would *NEVER* buy this again.It tasted like a very weak, watered down, version of the real thing.I guess you get what you pay for - save yourself the money, buy the real Nespresso capsules and don't get stuck with 50 capsules of coffee that you are not going to drink (yuck!) and can't return.Oh well... Lesson learnt.

Delicious espresso. I was hesitant based on some of these reviews but had to give it a try.No problems with the capsules fitting. I am using a Gran Maestria.  There is a little popping sound as described by ECC but in my machine it is quite faint.  No problems closing. You have to give it a more firm push than the Nespresso capsules.The flavor is rich and substantial enough for use in a latte or cap.  I have tried it as an Americano as well and it works for me.At this price what's not to like?Enjoy!

I am NOT a coffee snob but this is clearly NOT espresso either.  I have a almost new Citiz I used to prepare the drink.  Half way through the brewing process, the coffee is coming out light brown.  The coffee tasted like diluted weak coffee with no body or espresso aroma.  There was no crema either.  I tried it again with new capsules to make sure that the first one wasn't a defective capsule- same result.  Amazon does not accept return for this item.

This is the second ECC product I have reviewed. Out of the two I liked this the best and felt it was really similar to the Nespresso I have been drinking for awhile.  I think it is a milder version but I prefer that for this flavor.  I have had this flavor three days in a row and I seem to be a little less jittery compared to the Nespresso version. I would give this flavor a try and judge for yourself but I do think it is a good product with a good story.
I received the Espresso Capsules and I love the fact that they are biodegradable. The espresso tastes great! Great purchase.
These capsules do NOT fit the DeLonghi Nespresso machines. The company indicated that they do not make a coversIon kit either.

I have had and ordered this product many times, in fact I have 5 on the shelf right now. Yes, the sauce is really excellent considering how much sugar is in regular pizza sauce.The crust. I actually don't mind the crust, it gets nice and crispy, and YES it is very hearty due to high levels of fiber needed to counter the carb count. If you are a true low carb eater and looking to have a base to work from this is it. The benefit of low carb is I can add, bacon, italian sausage, pepperoni, etc on top. Those ingredients out way the high fiber crust.Find a lower carb crust and sauce than this stuff and I will look for it. It's not out there. Not to be negative towards the negative review, but I feel many people go into eating a low carb pizza with a mindset that it will taste exactly like a regular pizza, come on, really?This is the best low carb pizza solution I have ever found. Period.

The sauce was good. The pizza crust was absolutely horrible. Both took one bite and had to spit it out. Low carb doesn't mean food has to taste horrible. The people who designed the crust should be fired and new cook hired to create a crust that is at least edible.

column9: Delicious, my favorite brand of tulsi
column10: This is plain tulsi, but it's anything but plain. The sweet and spicy basil flavors make a well rounded cup of relaxing tea. Drink everyday for a build-up relaxing effect.

I love peppermint and mint in all of it's forms - but this is a really nice light peppermint, delicious and refreshing.  It's not strong enough that using honey would clash flavors, works perfectly with all sweeteners or no sweetener at all.I like how strong and high quality these teas are. :)

I give it two stars for recieving my order on time. I compare the size of the package to a bag of Oreos. I was disappointed in the taste of the mochi had a doughy very soft texture and a flower after taste, being that I am use to eating mochi like the ones at Tuttimelon and Pinkberry. If you are considering mini mochi that is compare to Pinkberry I would consider shopping at nutsonline.com Omg the best so far I have bought! I tried to get a refund at Boba tea Direct but when they responed the totally ignored the fact and didnt even mention the refund policy, which I thought was rude! Open the bag of mochi and let it sit for awhile it taste a bit better. I won't be ordering this product again. Customer service was very bad.

I went on a search for mini mochi after getting hooked on them from my local Yolo's.  They have them as a yogurt topping choice and they ARE authentic in taste and texture.  I was a bit worried that when I bought these "Mochi" (3 - 2 pound bags!!!) that it wouldn't have that authentic mochi taste.  My fears were realized when I popped them into my mouth and tasted...sweetened flour.  Ok it's not THAT bad if you aren't accustomed to real mochi.  I'll still eat them and and still use them as toppings at home, but I'm a bit disappointed in these and will not buy them again.

The flavor is poetry. There are very few Darjeeling teas that come close to Ahmad Tea London's Darjeeling.We have tried many, including teas from coffee & tea boutiques like Peets and none of them quite compare.Highly recommended, but also highly 'addictive'.
Darjeeling is a flavorful, delicate tea. Ahmad Brand is one of our family favorites.

I had tried these before from the local Whole Foods and was excited to get them in bulk for a better price and with more flavor selections. Out of all the freeze dried fruit companies, I like Funky Monkey the best (and Trader Joe's brand). They are crunchy, flavorful, and a good portion size for a small snack. I keep them in my desk at work for when I don't have time to shop for fresh fruit, and want something that fills the craving for a crunchy snack. They fit easily on the weight watchers plan. The pineapple and mango are my favorite for straight up and the bananas I like best mixed with oatmeal or yogurt. Very happy with this purchase!

As a stand-alone snack these can be a little weird, they taste good but stick to your teeth. But I have found a delicious use for them - I put them in my plain oatmeal (Quaker Instant Oatmeal Regular, 11.8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4))(made with milk not water), and cook the oatmeal - delicious! It's great to put some in, cook the oatmeal, and then add the rest so you get some of the crunchiness. It is even more delicious to pair them with complementary oatmeals - like Applemon with Quaker Instant Oatmeal Apple Cinnamon, Lower Sugar, 10.9-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4), Bananamon with Quaker Weight Control Banana Bread Instant Oatmeal 12.6 Oz - 6 Unit Pack. They are a great, healthy way to add flavor.

I had a variety pack of 12 shipped to my freshman son at college.  These looked like a good, healthy snack for him, and he called to tell me they arrived and that he loves them!  Out of the 4 flavors, his favorite is the apple/cinnamon called Applemon.  He has requested more.

I ran into the Funky Monkey street team a couple weeks ago here in LA and received some free samples of Bananamon and Applemon - I thought they were great so I purchased the Variety Pack and now have a new favorite flavor, Pink Pineapple!  Keep 'em coming!

The snacks themselves are yummy! My favorite was the apple and cinnamon, makes me remember when I would cut apples in half put butter in cinnamon in them and roast them over a fire! The snacks are good and the amount in each package are perfect, not to much and not to little. The only reason I gave it four stars is because I really wish the bags were resealable and they are not. This is annoying if you can't eat it all or don't want to finish it all. What I didn't finish got sticky and spilled all over the inside of my bag :(.Product is great! Packaging needs to be resealable.

I like freeze dried fruit a lot so I thought that I would give this brand a try. It did not disappoint. The unique flavors you get with this brand are some of the best I've found in a freeze dried snack.If you're a fan of freeze dried fruit then you owe it to your taste buds to give these a try.

column4: Just a Mom with her thoughts
column10: My children and I had the wonderful opportunity to try their healthy snacks. I have only had dried fruit a few times (I'm not a fan of fruit really) so I was a little worried whether I would like the flavor or not. Thankfully they included the Bananamon flavor in my sample kit because I loved it! The combination of bananas and cinnamon is so yummy! My children, on the other hand, enjoyed all of the flavors, even the stronger ones like pineapple. They completely devoured the Funky Monkey Snacks--and I have no problem with that because it's 100% real fruit!

Thank you Amazon for carrying Funky Monkey in a variety pack because my local retailer doesn't carry all the flavors!! My son loves the banana ones, my husband loves the pineapple varieties and me, i love them all!

I got these for my daughters to try..... They ate a piece of them and, literally, spit them out at me. So, my husband and I tried a piece and it was the most awful taste and texture I have ever had.... no wonder my kids spit it at me!  Don't waste your money, there are lots of better dried fruit options out there!!!

I am a huge fan of the freeze-dried fruit.  I have some every morning on my yogurt, so i decided to try this brand for a change from my usual...i was very disappointed.  the fruit tastes old and weird compared to other brands.  if you havent had any before, do not get this kind.  i would never have found my love for freeze-dried fruit if i would have tried this first because it is not good at all.
I did not care for these at all.  Brought them to work and only one person out of 12 liked them.  Would not recommend.

column9: Cute Candies especially for a baby shower - but they got me...
column10: Great product and the description matches the product perfectly.  However upon arrival I noticed the sticker on the bag said Oriental Trading.  I got online and noticed they were $2.00 per bag cheaper from Oriental Trading.  It was exactly what I wanted and a great product but if your trying to find the lowest price you may want to check with the original manufacture first.
I have a hard time finding this mustard in the store, so i just let my fingers do the walking. I used this in a lot of my salads and it has a little kick to it. Thank you.

A long time favorite at our house. Despite the zesty flavor, even enjoyed by our preschooler! I haven't been able to find this at local stores recently, so I'm thrilled that Amazon carries it. We cut up and brown Opa's Jalapeno sausage before adding to the pasta mix.

column9: WARNING: no microwave instructions included with product
column10: howdy y'all,i almost sent this back. [*sigh ...*]the product page here at amazon shows microwave instructions. i checked carefully for that. [*grin*] for reasons i never have figured out, i dislike cooking on the stove top. the BOX however, does NOT have any hint that you can cook this in the microwave. [*sigh ...*] again ...here's the nuker instructions from the amazon page re-formatted for readability ...*****Microwave:1. - In a two-quart microwave-safe bowl, cook 1 lb precut (diced) sausage, chicken or shrimp 3-5 minutes on High or until cooked.2. - Stir in 2 1/2 cups water and Zatarain's Jambalaya Pasta Dinner Mix. Blend Thoroughly.(When using shrimp, reduce by 1/4 cup and add the shrimp after the first 10 minutes of cooking. Zatarain's Jambalaya Pasta Dinner Mix tastes great even when prepared without meat or seafood.)3. - Microwave uncovered on High 15 to 17 minutes. Stir occasionally.4. - Let stand for 5 minutes. Sauce will thicken as it stands. Stir before serving.Caution: Cook time may vary depending on the power of the microwave oven.*****it works out fairly well. [*grin*] i made it with grilled sausage and two tablespoons of olive oil. i enjoyed the resulting meal quite a bit.rated a THREE cuz the instruction fubar reduces it from the four it would have received for the better than expected flavor.take care,lee

I picked this up at the grocery store thinking, oh this will make for a quick and cheap meal. That is was. As I ate it, I thought to myself this is pretty tasty considering it came right from the box. As the night went on, my stomach started to get very upset. It made me feel absolutely miserable.
