Each cat I've had really likes this variety.  They prefer the sliced versions over the ground such as this, but if I buy ground, they only like this one.  It smells pretty normal - not too stinky to make you faint, but it seems more appealing than most cat foods do.  I get pretty positive results with this variety and a lot of purring!
It is really high quality Mango Nectar produced from Egypt. The taste is rich and I feel lots of energy.

These are freeze dried blackberries and just what I was looking for so I could use them in cereal.They are large, so I use kitchen scissors to easily cut each berry into 2 or 3 pieces.The ratio of fruit to seeds can be particularly low in dried blackberries and while these have noticeable seeds, the ratio of fruit to seed is good.All dried blackberries seem to have an aromatic floral, slightly spicy taste that is not so familiar in fresh blackberries.  While the aroma is there, the effect on taste is relatively mild in these blackberries.They are tart and have a very good flavor.If you are looking for freeze dried blackberries for use in cereal these are great.UPDATEI have since tried the Just Tomatoes brand of freeze dried blackberries, sold as Just Blackberries.  The Just Blackberries brand are a little smaller and a couple of notches sweeter than the Harmony House.  They have a little less floral spicy aroma.For use in cereal, the Just Blackberries brand is my current favorite, just barely edging out Harmony House.It's really a matter of taste, if you want large and tart, then Harmony House is the way to go.If you want medium sized and sweet, then Just Blackberries is the way to go.
Harmony House..a NC family owned company.1 800 696 1395.BLACKBERRIES.They are tasteless and have no flavor. Iwill not buy them again.  Shipping is high.bbp okc 63  retired.

column9: Great candy that will help fight tooth decay.
column10: If you like the little round candies called SMARTIES, then you'll love these! Ricochet Fruit Punch Mints remind me of SMARTIES from their similar shape, texture, and flavor (but these are better tasting in my opinion). The big advantage of Ricochet mints is that these candies don't use any sugar, so they don't contribute to tooth decay. Instead, they use a naturally occurring sugar alcohol called Xylitol, which tastes refreshingly cool and bacteria have a hard time extracting energy from. I can eat a pile of these after brushing my teeth at night and my teeth still feel smooth and squeaky clean the next morning.

The only reason I bought this product is that I had a gift card for $20 and was looking for something to get as close to $20 as I could, that I would actually use.  I'm a coffee lover, and instant just doesn't do it.  The only thing great about this product is it is easy to take camping and make a cup of coffee fast in the cold morning!  I'm totally satisfied with it from that point of view.  Otherwise it's instant coffee and tastes like it.  Plus, the shipping cost was way more than the coffee was worth.  But I got to use my gift card (19.98 total) and get another product that I really wanted, so I'm satisfied.

column9: Packaging almost impossible to get into...
column10: I don't really like to write negative reviews, but I rely upon the reviews of others when I'm assessing items for purchase, so here's a summary of my experience with this product. While the flavor of this oil is okay (not nearly as great as I would have hoped based upon some of the Melina's reviews), the excruciatingly difficult and nonsensical packaging is enough to keep me from ever buying this again. Each individual bottle is quite small and then the narrow neck is covered with some kind of wax or foil cover that has no easy means of getting in--and as the top portion is so narrow that the only way to do it was to cut into it with a sharp blade, it would have been easy to cut myself. I finally was able to cut off tiny bits of the overwrap (which seemed to be a bit sick possibly with some minor oil leakage--perhaps from one of the other bottles) after about 10 minutes only to be confronted with a teeny, tiny cork jammed well into a narrow neck of the bottle with no gripper area or way to get the cork out. I tried two different wine openers with one almost pushing the cork all the way in... I was able to salvage it but then the cork was damaged so that attempting to close the oil bottle in any fashion that would preserve the rest of the oil is now impossible. I'm going to need to decant it into something else to keep it protected. The flavor--after the battle to get into the package was over, I'd have to say the flavor was good but certainly not outstanding. The battle wasn't really worth it--especially for the price.
Nice nutritious snack when you need something to satisfy your sweet tooth.  A handful of these and you're good to go.
Wolfgang Puck's Jamaica Me Crazy is that wonderful blend of island flavors in a coffee. Have loved it from the first time tasting. Great product.

Love Jamaica Me Crazy coffee and have ordered many times before.  This time it was shipped from Jeweltimes.  1st order was wrong, however, I was contacted by Jeweltimes' customer service immediately and shipped additional coffee that was more than original order.  Would definitely do business with them again!

I've bought these at the grocery store several times for pesto and it's $4-5 per pack there, so this is a really good deal.  I like having many small packets so they're always fresh when I need them.

column9: American grown pine nuts for pesto
column10: I was happy to find pine nuts that were domestically grown. Most places that sell pine uts in volume buy them from China. In today's world I am not comfortable with that.  Diamond is  a well known brand with excellent results. These pine nuts are clean and packaged individually in 12.5 ounce packages. I made a wonderful pesto and froze it for winter use. I will know that the pesto is grown with local basil and local pine nuts . You  have to be very particular today and have safe standards.
For someone who doesn't have an Asian/Korean market near, this is an affordable & delicious coffee!  I got a few of my American colleagues hooked on this too!

I ordered twice this Nescafe classic mix mild and love it. Its price is good and taste is nice as well. Since I like the mild version of the coffee, this one is my perfect choice. I want to order more but it is not available this time, so I will wait until it is in stock again.

column10: Based on another customer's review I took the plunge! I previously had Korean 3-n-1 coffee individual packets. Each containing instant coffee, creamer, sugar to make one cup. This product imported from Korea is absolutely splendid AND you cannot beat the price which is also pre-Starbucks...100 cups of coffee with cream and sugar for ELEVEN BUCKS and no wasted pots of coffee either! DO NOT BUY THIS.  this is the most overpriced candy i've ever seen.  for a 4.25 oz, i can get it for 1.65 in any grocery store, and here it is sold for 7 bucks!!! it's a rip off.  DO NOT BUY THIS

Great product. I have not found any other item as good as this one is. There are other coffee pods available, none of them are as good as this. I will continue to buy this product.

One can of this tried and true bean soup makes (6) 8oz. servings. A very cost effective investment.In my case, I make more of a healthy stew like recipe out of it. I add a cup of freeze dried potato cubes and a half cup of mixed veggies at the start, along with a bit of parsley and some celery salt. Then it's into the slow cooker on medium for about 4 hours.I reserve one portion for todays meal and freeze the rest in a number of 3 cup storage bowls. Yum!
... What's to say.. Campbell's Bean with Bacon soup is comfort food. Have a sandwich of your choice along with it.. Great any time!! :-)

I don't know if this is just settlement from the bottle being in storage a while, or what, but it was pretty unappealing to look at.  Then, when we tested the oil, the jalapeno was extremely faint.  You really had to be looking for it (er, smelling for it, or tasting for it).  Basically this seems like an olive oil that somebody waved some jalapenos in front of.  We probably won't be using it.
I have always wanted a Tea I could drink at night that would not wake me up at 3 in the morning.  I have always liked Black Currant. So this was a win win for me.  The tea is delicious.

Great product that has no crash (sugar) and much easier on stomach and wallet than 5-hour.  Definitely reccommend for anyone who doesnt like/drink coffee.  Good overall taste which is slightly different than the normal Monster Light beverage.  Resealable top is awesome!

column9: My Favorite Tea in its Class
column10: There are three broad categories of herbal tea that I rely on throughout the Fall, Winter, and early Spring:1) Citrus and lemongrass2) Rose hips and hibiscus3) ChamomileFor me, Tazo has held first place in each of these categories for the last several years. This is no small feat - I'm cutthroat when it comes to my tea collection! Passion is an absolutely fantastic tea, eking out a slim lead over Harney and Sons Peach fruit tea (mainly a rose hips and hibiscus blend) because it is cheaper, easier to find locally, has a bagged version, and is more-or-less just as tasty.For those of you who have never tried it, you will find it is robust and tart. I happen to love tart, fruity herbal teas and this is the first one that I reach for whenever I feel a cold coming on and I want a heavy dose of bioflavonoids to go with my Vitamin C tablet. It's so strong that I often only steep it for 45 seconds, and then I use the teabag again for a subsequent cup with a fresh bag of something else, like Wild Sweet Orange. Just a tip ;)One reviewer felt misled by the name. There is a category of "medicinal" herbal teas and some of them claim to help people experiencing problems with their libido, etc and I guess this reviewer felt that the name "Passion" should be reserved for such a tea. This is not that type of tea, so look elsewhere if that's what you need.If you like tart, fruity teas, however, I heartily recommend it.

So, going through Starbucks one day, not wanting a coffee, I came across their "Passion Shaken Tea." I plunked down my money, and found the best drink I've had in a long time.This tea has a flavor that I can't quite place, but don't care--it's so good that I'm actually giving up some of my soda addiction.If you like fresh, tangy flavors, this tea is for you.

****Tazo's Passion Herbal Infusion is a somewhat tart, deep, flavorful (hibiscus-y tasting) tea. It is not berry-like in taste, although it is red in color. It's difficult to describe what hibiscus tastes like, but I find it a most pleasant taste. My husband says it tastes like pomegranate to him. Although Passion contains licorice root it is not sweet.The ingredients in Passion are: hibiscus flowers, natural tropical flavors, citric acid, orange peel, licorice root, cinnamon bark, rose hips, lemongrass and red poppy. It is caffeine-free!Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "A tantalizing deep red tea made from hibiscus flowers, exotic herbs and natural tropical flavors." On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Passion as "berry, juicy, wine-like, merlot, sweet, earthy, dense". Tazo describes the aroma as "sweet, juicy, red fruits".I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as very good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not as good as Numi. I'm soooooo spoiled by Numi teas, which is why Tazo Passion gets only four stars.****

The deep purple/red color and hibiscus fragrance is enough to make anyone passionate about tea. Yet, is this really tea? It looks like tea, but it is really an herbal infusion made by steeping hibiscus flowers, orange peel, licorice, cinnamon, rose hips, lemongrass and red poppy in a swirling of hot water.The flavor is slightly reminiscent of hot apple cider or hot cranberry juice. This tea leaves a tingle on your tongue and I think it goes very well with a spoonful of honey.I do think you need two tea bags for each cup of tea to fully intoxicate the senses and experience the magic of the ingredients.Caffeine Free. You can drink this as you type into the night...~The Rebecca Review

This tea rocks my world.Never in my life have I enjoyed any type of tea.It's too watery. It's funky tasting.You have to add butt loads of sugar or honey just to choke it down to be polite.One day not long ago, a friend of mine convinced me to try Tazo Passion Herbal tea. I have to say I was hesitant, but to be a good friend, I gave in.One sip was all it took and I was pleasantly surprised and forever converted. I didn't have to add any sugary substance to make it tolerable. The flavor is strong enough that it doesn't taste watery. (Please note that the full leaf is not as strong as the filter bags.)It lists hibiscus, lemongrass, rose hips, mango & passion fruit flavors as ingredients. Since I enjoy things on the fruity side, this was perfect. Tazo's site gives this description for it's taste, "Berry, juicy, wine-like, merlot, sweet, and earthy dense."This is now my drink of choice whenever I feel like something besides water. I've used it to soothe sore throats and bad days. It's good on rainy days, snowy days, and if you can stand the heat, sunny days. I haven't tried it iced yet, but I'm sure that'll be a treat!
The tea is great.  This price is terrible.  Even on a bad day, you can get this for $4 per box in any grocery store.

column9: Cold or hot, Passion tea hits the spot!
column10: This fruity, herbal tea tastes delicious hot or cold. It is tart, and I like to add sweetener or sugar to mine. I don't care for honey with this one. In the summer you can use it to make the Passion lemonade, mix it with a lemon-lime soda for a fruit punch-like flavor & fizz, or just pour it over ice by itself. In cold weather, serve it hot for a flavor that's just as exquisite. There are a couple of drawbacks-- one is that it's hard to find in stores, and when you do, you won't get as good a price as you do on Amazon. The other is that when people see the rich reddish/pink color and smell the fruity aroma, they'll be slipping your teabags into their pockets for themselves. I've been brewing it by the pitcher to drink cold this summer and have cut way back on soda as a result. If you don't drink it that often, the bags are individually sealed, so you won't have to worry about them going bad. This is my favorite herbal tea and I bet it will be yours too!

This is one of my favorite herbal teas.  It has a delightful flavor both hot and iced.Previous reviewers have indicated they find the flavor very strong - there are two easy solutions for this.  Brew it with a greater quantity of water or reduce the seeping time, both amount to the same thing pretty much.  I'll typically get the equivalent of 3x 8oz glasses per tea bag.I went to a fancy spa last year for Mother's Day as a treat for my mom.  She raved about the excellent herbal iced tea they had in the serenity room.  I agreed with her, and found the taste very familiar.  Sure enough, I saw them brewing it using the Tazo Passion.  So when I want to do an at home pampering day, I'll pop one of these in to brew and voila! Instant relaxation.

Researchers in Taiwan have found that an extract of hibiscus flower contains some of the same health-giving compounds as red wine and tea. Many folk medicine traditions use the hibiscus flower to treat high blood pressure and liver problems." ~Susan Aldridge, PhD, medical journalistThe day after happening upon the idea of blending brewed and cooled Passion Herbal Infusion with orange juice, I found the lovely Tazo Iced Tea Collection. They have a recipe for Passion Lemonade and a Passion Tea Smoothie. I'm happy to blend orange juice, a packet of stevia and cooled brewed Passion tea. The taste is surprisingly good.Ingredients: Hibiscus flowers, natural tropical flavors, citric acid, orange peel, licorice root, cinnamon bark, rose hips. Lemongrass and red poppy.The deep purple/red color and hibiscus fragrance is enough to make anyone passionate about tea. Yet, is this really tea? It looks like tea, but it is really an herbal infusion made by steeping hibiscus flowers, orange peel, licorice, cinnamon, rose hips, lemongrass and red poppy in a swirling of hot water.The flavor is slightly reminiscent of hot apple cider or hot cranberry juice. This tea leaves a tingle on your tongue and I think it goes very well with a spoonful of honey.I do think you need two tea bags for each experience, so as to fully intoxicate the senses and experience the magic of the ingredients.Caffeine Free. Since the scent of orange reduces anxiety and hibiscus blossoms are said to lower blood pressure, this tea is a wonderful calming blend.NOTE: Many of my health/herb books say hibiscus flowers are not recommended during pregnancy. Please consult with your doctor before drinking herbal teas.~The Rebecca Review

column9: Love this tea! But don't get confused...
column10: This tea is my fav! I have to be honest I am not usually a tea drinker, to clarify if offered tea I will happily drink it but I don't seek it out. After trying this tea with a friend I had my husband search out this tea for me. Three stores later he finds it at "the expensive grocery store".He comes back and it turns out he grabbed the filter bag kind? Branded the same but the taste was much different. I had him go back grab the right kind and stock up. The cost at the grocery store was $7ish dollars and the price per box is $4.67 at the time of my review with free super saver shipping.

I first tried this tea iced with lemonade and sugar at Starbucks. Then I started making my own at home. It's amazing cold and I didn't think it could get any better until I tried it hot! Without any added sweetener, it's great, smells awesome and tastes tangy. I add a little bit of honey and it kind of tastes like a tangier fruit punch. I wouldn't buy it off of here as I can get it cheaper elsewhere, but I definitely recommend it!

Love this tea, it tastes so good. But I agree with every one that Amazon is not the place to get it. I just bought a box of this for 2.69 at Target. It was on sale, but normal price I believe was 3 something. So even if you are paying 4 dollars (max) for this tea, that'd still be cheaper than ordering it online and having to wait for it to come in. But definitely try it in some way - so delicious!

column9: slightly tart bold herbal fantastic tasting iced tea
column10: Normally I hate yucky flowery herbs like hibiscus and rosehips in my tea (such as Celestial Seasonings Tea) but one day while at Starbuck's, I was sweating, heated and tired in hot weather and wanted an iced drink but not coffee and since I'm really a tea drinker, I tried their Tazo iced teas and they tasted SOOOOO good and invigorating with just the purrrrfect balance of just enough herbs but still letting your senses know it was still TEA and the fragrance/taste comes out boldly!! The heated tea is nicely turned immediately, boldly, vividly, red in color. I don't need to add much sweetener even as it's tart but its tartness gives it more taste.The only drawbacks are its high price (compared to other teas which is why I'm always waiting for a sale on them) and having to wait to heat the water and waiting to cool it down in the refrigerator (or quickly in the freezer).  It's true as another reviewer said that it's very strong in taste after just leaving it in hot water for a few seconds so the longer you leave it in, the stronger and bitter or more tart it becomes and you could really be frugal and only need a tea bag for a half gallon to a gallon of water.  Adding ice helps dilute the taste as well as cool the tea down fast and cold, but I like my iced tea strong so i can taste its full flavor, so I try never to add ice.It's a delight as an everyday iced tea as well as a great gift for a friend.

Tazo Passion Tea is a lovely invigorating tea.FLAVOR:  Both tart and sweet at the same time.  Adding sweetener enhances the sweetness and tones down the tartness a bit.  Lovely, flowing flavor that is bold yet not  pungent.  Balanced fruit flavors that are fresh.  Slight floral notes.  No bitterness.COLOR:  Deep purple red.AROMA:  Tart pies baking in an oven.  Fruity.CAFFEINE:  None.- All Natural- Delicious

I love this tea.  It is light and refreshing as a cold drink.  Follow the instructions and add honey for sweetness and you will not be dissappointed.  It has a wild floral taste, and with honey it is even more exotic.

I originally had this iced at Starbucks, but was tired of paying $3/glass for it.I put it in with my Lipton Cold Brew bags & it tastes WONDERFUL. We love TAZO Herbal Teas and this one in particular.  The price was really good and shipment was quick so we would re-order from this site as needed.
