I found the Fantastic Foods Sloppy Joe mix.Fantastic Foods' Sloppy Joe mix is FOOLPROOF. It's incredibly simple--all you need is water, oil, and tomato paste. It's an incredibly versatile mix as well, as the recipe on the box shows (the variation has diced tomatoes,diced onions, brown sugar,chili powder) The result is delicious. It goes great with potato chips and pickles. It's a wonderful substitute for those going meatless for financial or social reasons. It'll please the carnivore,the vegetarian,and the vegan alike. These Sloppy Joes are NEAT!

I've tried a lot of meatless products out there and this sloppy joe mix is by far my favorite vegetarian meat alternative out there. EASY to make and we easily made seven good size sandwiches out of one box.  Even if a person isn't vegetarian, the cost savings alone (versus ground beef) makes it worth it.  Yum!!!
My boyfriend who is skeptical of all vegetarian food even loved it and couldn't tell the difference!

When my daughter said she didn't want to eat meat anymore, it was a real struggle transitioning to vegetarian meals we all liked. Tofu didn't work for us.  So I had some doubts about this product, but - suprise - it was good!  All 3 of my kids asked for seconds.  One is extremely picky so this was quite an achievement.The texture is somewhat finer-grained than your typical ground beef sloppy joe but the flavor is pretty similar.  It makes a nice, filling meal.  And for an added bonus, it takes less than 10 minutes to cook.Another product we like is the Morningstar crumbles.
These are one of my absolute favorite foods.Just add cheese and green onion on a toasted bunand you have a little slice of YUM!Easy to make, and quick too.Jaime Pico

I stumbled across this last year, and fell in love with it. In fact, I have my extended family of parents and sisters feeding it to their families! Throw in a handful of chopped green pepper, chopped onion, a squirt of yellow mustard, and a Tbs of white vinegar and voila...the real deal! I buy this for under $2.00 at the co-op and eat for a few days off of it myself. Add a side of oven baked fries, a side veggie, and you have a nutritious economical meal. Can't beat feeding a family of 4-6 for only a couple of dollars.
this is great and i love it! Everything this brand makes is great, i would not try anything else!

column9: Great for people on a diet
column10: I've been wondering how to cut back on meat, especially ground beef, because it is high in fat and cholesterol.  This tastes so much like meat, and is very satisfying.  I found it on sale at my local market for $1.29 a box, so I will buy from there until the sale is over.  Then I will come and order in bulk from Amazon.  I also like that it contains 3 grams of fiber per serving.  I am also going to try Fantastic Foods taco mix next.

I can't remember what "real" sloppy joe's taste like. It has been too long but I do remember I didn't like it. So, knowing that, this stuff is great!!! I want to eat it because it tastes good not just because it is a good source of protein. Reminds me more of my Mom's mulligan's stew base than the overly sweet sloppy joe mix that used to come in a bottle in the 70's.Update: I have given boxes and cooked sloppy joes for non-veggie and they all love it. My parents have regularly eaten beef sloppy joes and have switched to the veggie version and say it tastes better and easier to digest :).

column9: My 17 year old son (a big eater) couldn't tell they were vegetarian
column10: Made these for dinner one night when it was just my son and me. They are very easy to prepare.  I added a bit of chili powder to punch them up. My son liked them and didn't know they were vegetarian.  I like that they are fairly low cal and low fat. They are delicious and the texture is great. Five stars.

column9: Really Like Taco and Chili Mix by this Company; Don't care for the Sloppy Joe mix
column10: If you are attempting to get someone to eat a little less meat with out them knowing, I would not make this mix my first attempt.  I can tell straight away that Fantastic Foods Vegetarian Sloppy Joe Mix is made from soy.  It has that distinct taste and texture, similar to meatless burgers, which I don't like.  Attempting to hide that taste with BBQ sauce and cheese has not helped.  The Taco and Chili mixes are far easier to cover up that taste and feel.I will not be purchasing this product again.  If you want to give it a try, purchase a box locally, because if I had a pack of 12, 11 of them would be in the trash.

Fantastic Foods Vegetarian Sloppy Joe Mix, 4.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12) I like it so much I ordered the 12 Boxes... Another Great tasting product from the Fantastic World Foods Folks, I wanted to try it for a while and I am glad I did, just like the Taco Filling, followed the Cooking Directions and made the whole Bag in a Saucepan 1-3/4 Cups of water, 3 ounces =1/3 Cup of Tomato Paste and 1 Tablespoon of Oil, bring water to a Boil and added to it, reduce Heat and simmer for 5 minutes until liquid is absorbedSince I found the Sodium a little High for our taste 530 MG 22% (we don't use a lot of Salt) I decided to compensate all that Salt by adding one Big Tablespoon of Onions and another one of Green Bell Peppers to the Mix, very finely chopped that I had sauteed in a non-stick Skillet with two drops of Oil, even though in the List of Ingredients there is Dehydrated Green Bell Peppers and Onion Powder, I though it wouldn't hurt, ...and like Magic it turned into what it looked like Ground Beef and it was GoodWe do not really eat it on a Bun, well the first one I did, but I found many more uses than just a Bun, I even use it in Pasta Dishes as a Substitute for Regular Ground Beef. I Posted a series of Pictures under the Item's Image, Step by Step Recipe making Whole Wheat Pasta Shells and using Fantastic Sloppy Joe Vegetarian Mix as Ground Beef and other uses as well, Please Check it out. Thank You

column9: don't feel left out at the next summer picnic
column10: This meat-free sloppy joe mix is one of Fantastic foods best products.  I use the expanded recipe on the back of the box that calls for onions and tomato paste and the result is simply fantastic.If you miss some foods from your non-vegetarian life, are transitioning to a vegetarian life, want to fit in more with the crowd at your next picnic and/or simply want something delicious, you need to pick up this product.The texture is pleasant the nutritional profile is good; this is a low calorie meal option that packs on the protein.  My husband eats quite a bit of meat and devours these.This product is also fairly cheap, cooks quickly and makes you feel satisfied.  I couldn't recommend it more.

column9: How do they make it so yummy?
column10: This is quick and easy and meat eaters don't even think about what they're eating. It's lunch from your childhood cruelty free.

I first tried this product when sold in my grocery store, it was wonderful. Of course when I go back to purchase more, they had stopped selling the product so I had to find it. I am glad I did, this is the second order of 12 purchased. I do the spruced up recipe and it is wonderful. I even have my non-vegetarian spouse and children eating without asking any questions. It is easy to fix, tasty, and is a great source of protein. I really want to try some of their other products.
I could not be more impressed with this product. It seriously tastes and looks just like a sloppy joe! You will not be disappointed.

column9: And now I have 11 more to go through...
column10: I bought a case of these based upon the reviews.  Uggh.  It is disgusting.  We couldn't figure out what flavor it was - something between sloppy joes and fake taco meat like they serve for school lunches.  Absolutely disgusting. The 11 that are left will go in the disaster preparedness box, because we have no plans to eat this again by choice.

I've been eating Fantastic Foods' products for many years.  Their Vegetarian Chili has always been my favorite.  It's high in protein and can be mixed by just adding 2 cups of water.  I fix it up a bit by adding a can of tomatoes and a can of beans and it's as good as homemade chili.  I've given it a number of carnivore friends who said they really could taste any difference than chili with meat.  The texturized vegetable protein looks, tastes, and chews just like hamburger.
I finally found a meatless sloppy joe that I love! It's a hit with the entire family. A little goes a long way and it tastes fantastic!

I love this! It dosen't taste the same as beef sloppy joe, but it is really good. it isn't as sweet as the sloppy joe I'm used to ,but I like it better that way. My parents will actually eat it and they are hard core meat eaters.

This is so good I had to restrain myself from eating the entire cooked contents myself! Simple to make! Cooks quickly! A hardy fast healthy meal that everyone loved!This is my first time trying this product, but I will buy it again...and again and again and again!I will be trying other items under this brand name. I would suspect they are just as good.

column9: Even got my mom to like this.
column10: My mom's not a vegetarian and barely wants me to be, because while she understands the ethics behind it, she thinks it makes me pickier in eating. I bought this a couple of years ago when I was living alone and she stayed the night. We cooked it and she was instantly sold, as was I. It was my first time trying it and it was much better than the original sloppy joes or even the sloppy joes that I make with Morning Star's burger crumbles. It definitely has an amazing taste to it, quite spicy too.

I've been buying Fantastic Foods items since 2007. It has been a staple in my kitchen, so I consider Fantastic Foods to be part of the family. There is no comparison to any other line of healthy vegan/vegetarian alternatives. Infinite possibilities for those of us who like to cook, or a few short minutes in the microwave for those of us who don't. A+ every time.

column9: WOW!  As good as hamburger, but BETTER!
column10: How could a box of dried stuff come out sooooo good?  I don't know.  But I do know that I boil some water, add a little oil and the box contents and BLAM!  I have some DEEEE-Licious Sloppy Joes.  Throw it on a bun with a handful of shredded chedder.  Take my word for it!  Give it a try.  If you don't like it... I'll eat it!  (certain restrictions apply)It's so good... I'm gonna blog it![...]

The sloppy joe product is pretty good on its own, it has a nice flavor and can fool most people. Not a huge, huge fan of sloppy joes, but I was looking for vegetarian products as meat substitutes, and this one fit the bill.I've also used this as the "ground beef" for chili, and it works WONDERFULLY. The sloppy joe mix blends in with the chilis I make very well, allowing me to make easy vegetarian chilis.Only large issue I have with this product (preventing me from giving it 5 stars) is that it is relatively expensive. So wait until it's on sale, or do the subscribe and save.

column9: A great fat free salad dressing
column10: This is my all-time favorite dressing but it's very hard to find a grocery store that carries it. Usually "fat free" salad dressing means a tasteless thin, runny liquid that has too much salt, vinegar or sugar. This dressing has a full bodied tomato taste, not at all like a fat free product!

After reading the two glowing reviews for this coffee, I bought a couple of bags, and having tried it, I'm shocked that anyone could highly rate this coffee.I'm not a coffee connoisseur; I'll even drink instant coffee if that's all that's available, but this coffee pails in comparison to instant. It not only has a weak flavor, but the flavor is nothing like coffee. I can't even describe it. It's not simply weak -- it's just not recognizable as coffee. It doesn't even smell like coffee.Perhaps I have a bag that's somehow gone bad or something...On the plus side, the acid content of this "coffee" is definitely much less than that of traditional coffee.None the less, I think I'll end up throwing the two bags I purchased away. I'd give the unopened bag to my local food pantry, but I can't imagine that whoever received it would find it palatable, either. I hate wasting my money like this.

I love great coffee and I have tried many brands offered here on Amazon. This Lost Art Blend is perfect with the added benefit of being low acid. I would call this a full bodied medium roast, it is very smooth with a slightly sweet finish. Stands up well to cream and sugar too. The beans are not oily at all, they actually look dry like a decaf. I grind the beans about 25 seconds in my Krups grinder for a cone drip brew. I plan to buy a bigger bag while its on sale this month. No stomach or bladder irritation anymore either!

column9: Best tasting coffee I've ever had.  Smoof.
column10: I would not say I am a gourmet coffee kind of person, but this is one of the best tasting coffees I have ever had.  I don't particulary care for strong coffee, and this coffee is really smooth without losing flavor or tasting watered down.  OK.  I have purchased Barney's Coffees, Starbucks (there are four of them within ten minutes from where I live), and subscribed to Gevalia for a while.  I can always add the fancy flavors with the cream, but this is the best basic brew I've can remember.  Worth the asking price.  Highly recommend.I didn't even know what low acid meant until I tasted my first cup.  If you have a bad stomach I guess that's important.  I just go for the smooth taste.Just too bad you can't click on one of the little arrows like you do in the music department to get a 15 second sample.

You will not be disappointed when purchasing Trader Joe's Lemon Pepper seasoning.  I have tried many lemon pepper brands, but Trader Joes is the absolute best!  It is great on fish, chicker, pork, veal, salads and more.  It brings out the best flavors in any dish.

OK, let's get one thing straight. my girlfriend HATES Chocolate!!!!! i mean i can't even get here to eat one chocolate chip cookie!!!!! but for some reason she loves these little things, and to be frank so do I. now neither of us are what you would call sweet eaters, but we (my Girlfriend and I) love to munch these sweet treats while curled up on the bed watching a movie.

These "White Fudge" covered Pretzels are very good and make a good sweet snack since the white fudge covering is fairly thin, just enough to make it tasty but not enough to be overpowering. These get eaten up fairly quickly by my teens if we leave them out, so we generally put out one or two bags at a time.Recommended!CFH

I love these pretzels. They are the perfect combination of sweet and salty. I can't stop eating them!! They're so nommy! Although, i buy them in the store.. i wouldn't recommend buying them online. They cost 2 dollars and 33 cents for a 5 oz pack i believe.

My daughter introduced me the first time I went to visit her ... I could not stop eating until finish the package! since then, when it comes to Brazil she carries 50 packages! half and half for me to distribute to the family! the contrast of the chocolate with salty pretzel makes me mad. Delicious, addictive ...Minha filha me apresentou na primeira vez que fui visitá-la... Nao consegui parar de comer ate acabar o pacote! desde então, quando ela vem ao Brasil ela me traz 50 pacotes! metade para mim e a outra metade distribuo com a família! o contraste do chocolate com o salgado do pretzel me faz enlouquecer. Delicioso, viciante...

I love chocolate covered pretzels, and these are pretty good. The chocolate is above average quality for covered pretzels, but there isn't a heavy coating, which is a minus in my book. It's easy to eat the whole bag in one sitting.I have tried the dark chocolate variety but found those to be pretty tasteless, the milk chocolate definitely complements the pretzels. If they would just add a bit more chocolate coating they would get 5 stars.
Came on time, and was more than I expected!  There are twelve, 5-ounce Flipz bags in this package. They're sooo good though, so I ended up almost eating all of them by myself
Totally DEEEEElicious!!!  Love Flipz.  Especially from Amazon.com, great price and course very quick delivery.  Great, just Great.
These are the only chocolate-covered pretzels i've had and will be the only ones I will ever taste. These are the best snack treats around. You just can't eat one bag!

column9: good, but could be better in the chocolate department
column10: These are good, but the chocolate coating is a bit waxy and the chocolate could be more chocolaty.  The chocolate kind reminds me of a heftier version of the chocolate coating that Hostess or Little Debbie cakes have as an icing on their products.

column9: How anyone could eat this is beyond me
column10: The chocolate that they use on these things taste like they have been sitting out for a few weeks and have grown stale. It's just nasty to taste and almost makes me sick thinking about them.

I recently had the set of Apple Blossom Amaryllis' shipped to my aunt, and when the flowers started to bloom, she was speechless.  The colors were so gorgeous that she ordered more to have an entire room filled with them.  Thank you for the great bulbs!

column9: Great as a meal or side dish ...
column10: I purchased this from GoPicnic as part of a package for travel and purchased extras to "try ahead of time."This particular meal is both gluten-free and vegetarian. The GoPicnic Website also lists it as Halal and preservative free. It comes with a small fork as well as salt and pepper, so that you can eat it on its own either cold or hot. I tried it both ways and it was equally tasty.I love the fact that it includes suggestions inside of the package and for our first try I added chedder cheese and heated it, using it as a side dish with chicken. It was very filling on its own, and the cheese was a great complement.If you are eating it as a meal by itself, adding slices of cheese or a small can of tuna will increase the protein, however I would consider it an ample meal with a side of crackers or corn chips, or as it recommends on the side, over a dish of nachos!The packaging lists it as "two servings," although on the go you will most likely want to eat it as a single serving. This would give you 10 grams of protein, 36 grams of carb (14 of which are fiber for a net carb count of 22 grams), and 10 grams of fat.Tasty, healthy, and nutritious. I'm looking forward to eating it again on our trip.*** The one thing I have not been able to confirm is whether this meal is TSA safe. Please be sure to check if you are intending to take it with you on an airline, since it would be very disappointing to have it confiscated by security.

Amazingly delicious and convenient.  I love the 3 bean-salad right out of the can or added to rice, eggs, pasta ... anything.  Even my carnivore husband likes it.  I keep several cans in the pantry so I always have something fast, tasty and nutritious ready to eat as a snack or meal.  It is also a great gift.

column9: Great for on the run meal
column10: Great for on the run meal.  Tastes good with or without the included sauce and comes with its own spork.  Drink not included.

column9: Not horrible but below average still - Mfg Origin Confusing
column10: The packaging is quite confusing.  It states on the front in fairly large type:  "Product of France."  The word "France" appears in several places.  On the back, in smaller type, presumably referring to the little package of "culinary sauce" that comes with the little tin of beans, corn, etc., it states "Product of Taiwan"  and "Produced in Taiwan under St. Dalfour direction."  Then, to the right, this time presumably referring to the tin of beans, corn, etc., it states:  "Product of France.  Packed for St. Dalfour [address omitted]."It is difficult to figure out where some or all of the contents were actually made.  I am guessing Taiwan but who knows.  Maybe the manufacturer is reading this and can clarify.As for flavor, well that is so subjective, it is hardly worth a review.  But, for whatever this is worth, no, it did not taste all that great IMHO.  Very bland.  And, here's something to consider:  purchased this product in early 2012.  The expiration date you ask?  That would be 7/2014!!  Makes you wonder, eh?

A friend of mine just purchased these for a camping trip. I was curious to see what this product tasted like ahead of time, so we opened one up. Immediately upon opening I was hit with the distinct smell of cat food. How do you make beans and corn smell like cat food?? The beans and corn were mushy and tasted horrible. Maybe its a French thing, but my American palate did not like this one bit. Please do not submit your mouth to such torture.

This is a tasty convenience food, especially for vegetarians or vegans.  I've eaten it in the car (not driving) and in the airport.  Be careful that the little (included) "spork" doesn't fall out of the packaging and get lost.

I keep this in my bag for when my son is hungry and there is no healthy alternative. He really likes the little spork it comes with and enjoys the flavor. He's 3. I like this because it's healthy and very convenient.

My Mom has Alzheimers and we buy these to have on hand for us and for her.  She gets hungry at different times which makes it difficult and this is not only quick to make but good for her as well. It is quite tasty with it's own little packet of dressing and a spork to eat it with. The taste is so yummy.  We eat them right from the can. I eat crackers with it too.

My husband I love these little package "gourmet on the go" foods. We take them with us when we fly and find them perfect for that. They are tasty, include a fork and a little package of sauce you can add. They are low in fat and pretty healthy. They are also nice to throw in your bag when on car trips or even as a food to store for emergencies.I highly recommend this product and am thankful Amazon carries this product.Wholefoods grocery store did sell them but it looks like they have stopped.
Tasty and healthy-easy to open container complete with sauce packet and a spork (the sauce really adds a great flavor boost).  I love the fact that it is full of fiber.
Perfect for lunch, just add a glass of iced tea.  What else can I say?  Just exactly the right size, vegan (check the label), and delicious.

I was really surprised by the St. Dalfour Three Beans with Sweet Corn.  I did NOT add the sauce that came with the packet only salt and pepper.  It was pretty good.  The best part it's gluten free.  I needed something to take on an international flight with me because of my diet and this worked out great.

These are healthy, delicious, and very convenient. I travel frequently for work and I pack one of these in my suitcase in case I'm in a pinch. They have saved me from eating a processed, fast food dinner on many occasions.
Also great tasting, light and refreshing.....Although it comes w/ a "dressing" pack, I had to add a bit more of my rice vinegar to make it perfect.I will definitely purchase again....

This is such a tasty and convenient gluten free meal.  My husband takes it to work with a container of rice.  He heats the rice and adds the beans and corn over, unheated.  He also takes a little bag of tortilla chips to dip into the mixture.  He really enjoys it and it is much cheaper and healthier than eating out.  I have been buying this product from my local grocery store for $3.49 and on Subscribe & Save it is only $1.86.  Wow.
When I got these I thought they'd be great to put in my emergency rations bag. No prep, includes fork. Gotta be better than those expensive but deeply awful MREs.

column9: a better lunch at your desk than what's on offer at the local cafe
column10: Every time a colleague tastes my lunch "tin," Dalfour gains another customer. I find it a bit too oily before one adds the vinegar (which is mild & slightly sweet) based side dressing, but everyone else loves it as is. My advice: add a little water and drain it in the can, then add the packet. The packet dressing is very tasty, as is the bean mix. I like mine cold or at room temperature. If you prefer beans hot and microwave this, you won't need to drain it. Note: I generally like my food without much oil, so if that's not your taste, you should love this right from the tin. Each serving is packaged with a fork . . . nice touch!

I actually purchased this by accident, and I am so glad that I did!!  This company makes another one with salmon in it that is also SUPER excellent and that was what I thought I was buying this time.  I love both!This is so convenient to keep in my drawer at work.  I think it is so good I can eat it straight out of the can!!  I do love to add a packet of salmon to it or a can of chicken breast to get a little more protein, and for me this is a perfect quick lunch when I don't have much time (or a microwave).  If you go camping or like to go hiking, this would be FANTASTIC for that!  I've also dumped it on a salad at work as well and VOILA- super health lunch!I do feel it is a little on the expensive side, but for convenience and portability you really can't go wrong.  I have put it on the subscribe and save program because I eat it quite often and now it is cheaper so if you do like it I recommend going that route to save some $$.

This is one the the best-tasting, portable protein sources I have found! Perfect for after the gym, a nutritious alternative to airplane snacks when traveling, and super easy to throw in your purse for an anytime hunger attack :) Love, love, love this stuff!
I have been subscribing to this item for a while and it's always a treat when it arrives.  And I like the cute sfork.

This is canned beans. It may well be that the ingredients are above average, but it still tastes like canned beans. And it is NOT low salt, in fact a can has 600 mg of sodium. It would be very helpful to have the usual info from the actual product with any foods listed on the site. Only a few has it.

column9: LOVE these on the go meals
column10: whether or not you use the "gourmet sauce" pack (which has "natural flavors" which always makes me assume MSG) these meals are just darn good, filling, taste and "feel" nutritious--e.g. i'm not hungry when i'm done.  i eat them slowly and chew well to get the full benefit of the fiber.  i think they taste really good, really fresh, and i keep a couple of cases on hand as part of my "emergency" food stash and for taking to work for a quick and easy lunch.  I am so pleased to find them on Amazon!  I'd only seen them at one other store before (granted... i don't shop stores much now that I'm on Amazon, but i do go out for groceries and farm stands).

I have celiac disease and prefer to bring my own food with me when I travel.  I recently went on a week-long trip and brought a six-pack of St. Dalfour Gourmet on the Go with me in my checked bag.  It worked out perfectly!  I didn't need to reheat or refrigerate the servings, so they were ideal for eating in my hotel room.  Even though the servings were tinned, they were light enough that they didn't make my bag too heavy.  The average cost per tin made them an affordable choice.  They provided me with a solid amount of protein and vegetables per meal.  And best of all, they were absolutely delicious!  A little oily -- I skipped the additional oil packets after the first serving -- but the seasonings are wonderful.  I will definitely buy St. Dalfour Gourmet on the Go again.

So Delicious! I purchased the Salmon as well as the Three Bean and Sweet Corn Gourmet on the Go 6pk as a quick, handy, and occasional meal for my toddler. He LOVES them and they have been extremely convenient this summer when traveling or going to the pool because they do not need refrigeration (they also come with a spork!). They do not taste like the typical "canned meat" or bland canned vegetables. They are fresh and full of unique flavor. I have since ordered myself these two varieties to keep on hand at work. I only wish that the French manufacturer, St. Dalfour, would sell the chicken and ham varieties in the US. I'm looking forward to trying the others!

For snacks I used to turn to energy bars - those that had a balanced nutrition and some sort of chocolate.  I was trying to kill the hunger and the chocolate craving pangs all at once.  Sometimes it worked, sometimes it beget more chocolate!  Plus, the sugar content was high.  I find this product works much better.  It tastes good and I feel better eating it.  I'm usually on the go so I don't do anything fancy as the package suggests, I just eat it as is and right out of the container.  Sometimes I find I need to dab off some excess oil.  Otherwise it's a great snack.

column9: Gluten free, vegetarian, delicious, suitable for travel
column10: I buy by the case. Use for traveling. Have taken 1-2 packages thru security(carry on). They always get dusted to check if they contain explosives, then pass thru. If bringing more than 1-2, I put in checked luggage. Delicious. Each tin comes w a spork, salt, pepper, and sauce packet so ready to eat. You wouldn't believe how good just plain veggies could taste. Better warm than cold, but can be eaten cold too. Only downside-cannot warm in the tin they come in. I also eat them at home for a snack or a meal when I'm lazy or just got back from a trip and am tired/have nothing in frig yet.

column9: Surprised at how good this tastes
column10: Normally I'm skeptical about canned food from France, after a very disappointing experience with something else. But this turned out to be reasonably good at room temp and quite tasty when heated. The label somehow gave me the impression of "mixed vegetables" but it turned out to be mostly beans of one kind or another. Yum! Good nutritional profile too.
This was a great lunch item. I had to remove contents to heat in the microwave. That was the only inconvenience.

I was a little skeptical about this product... canned veggies are normally pretty gross. This was fantastic though! I have to stop myself from eating them too quickly. It is a little pricey per can, but I think this with a side, such as some toast to put it on or something, is a full meal. Very filling and tasty. This can be taken anywhere, needs no cooking and comes complete with a spork. I will definitely be buying more of this and other products by St Dalfour Gourmet.

column9: St. Dalfour's Three Beans with Sweet Corn
column10: St. Dalfour's Three Beans with Sweet Corn was disappointing.  I tried it because of all the high ratings.  I found this item to be very greasy.  Beans and corn shouldn't be greasy, so I scanned the ingredients.  Sure enough they added both sunflower and olive oil.  The total fat content for this little can was 10.  If some of the oil could have been left out, I would have enjoyed it better.  It is nice to eat beans and corn and get your protein and carbs without the fat.  Not so with this product.  Thus it gets only three stars.

column9: Don't trust amazon reviews (except this one)
column10: Based on the reviews, I bought this; it is pretty bad, and reeks of the tin/metal can it will have been in for weeks or months by the time you get it. The sauce is made in Taiwan and is bizarre. Sorry, but not even the French can save this one. Food like this needs to be fresh or not at all. Take bread, cheese, and wine on a picnic, not this. I'm giving these away to the homeless.
I really like the Keurig single serving machines and Timothy's Midnight Magic Coffee K-cups arrived on time and the taste of this coffee is magnificent!

There is some black stuff at the top of every bottle.  Assuming it is just concentrated mesquite product, I store the bottles upside down in the box it arrived in.  The cook has to remember to pour this seasoning on the bottom of the pan; not on top of the meat.  The mesquite flavor only seems to come out when  the seasoning is on the side of the meat closest to to heat source of the oven.  In other words,  if the cook bakes the meat and puts this seasoning on top of the meat, there will be very little mesquite flavor in the meat.  I learned this by trial and error.

I have used Wright's Mesquite Seasoning, Liquid Smoke for years and love the consistent good quality of flavor. It is a wonderful addition in marinade for chicken, beef, fish and add a few drops to chicken salad. Of course, it is fabulous in barbeque sauce. A little goes a long way.

Only two ingredients in Wright's liquid smoke: smoke and water.  I usually just dilute this in water and soak the meat for about 10 minutes on both sides.  You don't get that nice, pink smoke ring around the meat, but the flavor is there.  I had a small amount of leakage in the box that this product came in, but there didn't appear to be any significant loss of liquid.  Makes the box smell good, though!

column9: Wright's All Natural Mesquite Seasoning, Liquid Smoke
column10: I have only used this product for brining turkeys. Usually add half to a full bottle to brinig solution. Results in a very satisfying flavor in every bite of turkey.

column9: Wright's All Natural Mesquite liquid smokle
column10: I have been using Wright's orginal liquid smoke for years, but really love the flavor of the mesquite. It's a great taste on Chicken, beef or pork BBQ meats. I use this with supplemental seasonings and have never been disappointed. Great product!

the package arrived. seven of the bottles were partially full, and one was completely empty. Photos of the box were sent to Amazon. All the bottles were still sealed, but had severely leaked. My house smelled like smoke for 2 days. the product itself seems ok, but does not impart the taste as well as expected. Is this because they were sealed in a way that not only allowed them to leak, but to lose potency. Will probably not order again.

column9: An equal to JellyBelly at more than half the price
column10: These beans do not contain gelatin so vegans can feast.  I love the gourmet flavors, the standard fruit flavors not so such.I had been buying these beans from an online candy shop and the delivered price was $70.00+

Gimbal's Jelly Beans offer a great variety of colors and flavors that really light up your taste buds. They also have great ingredients that allow our son, who has quite a few allergies, to enjoy them with the rest of us. Enjoy!

column9: Try these and you'll buy them again and again.
column10: These jelly beans will spoil you for ordinary, fat jelly beans. The flavors are even fun to eat. Try to do the impossible and eat one at a time. Very difficult to do. You'll find yourself tossing them into your mouth by the handful, and you deserve to.I have found that the usual fat jelly beans don't really have much taste. They're just something to chew on. These gourmet jelly beans have wonderful flavors. I love them. I think you will, too.
these gourmet jelly beans are as good as, if not better than, jelly belly brand at half the price.  if you luv gourmet jelly beans as much as i do, do yourself a favor and buy, buy, buy!
These are just great. So many flavors, and way better than that 'other brand.'  We buy them in bulk to have them in the house, plus the RV.

To begin, let me state that I'm a jelly bean fan. The cheaper and bigger, the better. Gourmet didn't mean anything to me; now it means "tiny and strangely flavored."On opening the package, an unpleasant smell hit my nose.  Later, I was able to determine that a few of the claimed 41 flavors were simply NASTY to my taste and nose.For the first handful, guessing the upcoming flavor was fun. Then that wore off and I just wanted the 35 flavors that tasted good to me. I guess you can't please everyone all the time.  Knowing when a nasty flavor is coming is critical.The blacks were a very rich liquorish, if you like that sort of thing.  There are multiple shades of each of the main standard colors and usually a spotted variety for each too. All of the flavors were unique to me, some were very good.  I missed some of the old standby flavors.On the plus side, they are extremely satisfying. Normally, I could eat a bowl full of other jelly beans. With these, I barely had the top layer and was satiated.I just hope I can figure out the terribly flavored ones and avoid them.
These jelly beans are a treat. The different flavors are fun and taste wonderful. Unlike other jelly beans you will want to eat them one at a time to enjoy each flavor!

column9: Not as good as the other brand
column10: When I stumbled upon these, I was struck by how much they resembled (in appearance) my favorite candy - Jelly Belly jelly beans.  After I opened them I discovered that the resemblance ended with their appearance.  These have a very harsh chemical flavor and an unpleasant and lingering aftertaste.  I was thoroughly disappointed.

I bought a bag of these to give to my kids at Easter, but when I tasted them I had to go out and buy some Jelly Belly's. Literally every flavor was just awful, I mean awful. Each one I tried was stranger and more disgusting tasting than the last. I have no idea what flavor any of them were supposed to be. This is not a joke review, they were really that bad. I threw the entire bag in the garbage. Avoid these things at all cost.
Very yummy and would highly recommend these- have a stronger taste then the "other" brand and cost less.

PEANUT FREE!!! Yay for Gimbal's!  Did you know that jelly belly products have a peanut warning? I was saddened to discover that I could no longer buy my favorite candy, jelly belly jelly beans, thanks to my 6 yr old daughter's peanut allergy.Finally, I've found a safe alternative for my kids and will go to the ends of the earth to purchase Gimbal's products.  Gimbal's fine candies print right on the packaging, "Gimbal's facility is proud to be; nut/peanut free, gluten free, trans fat free, dairy free, gelatin free, egg free."Gimbal's candies are a blessing for the allergic child!True, Gimbal's beans do not contain the microscopic amounts of "natural" fruit advertised by Jelly Belly, but I certainly don't miss it.  True, some of the flavors get "muddied" by the strong coffee flavored jelly beans aroma, but this seems to be more of a problem in older/less fresh packs.Neither of these minor faults is enough to make me EVER pass up an opportunity to buy Gimbal's Fine Candies! I love the flavors; I love the fun; I love the low price; but most importantly, I love that my kids can eat them safely.

those are just 3 of the flavors I identified after starting to eat a bag of these beans. I thought I'd accidentally bought Bertie Bott's Many-Flavoured Beans. I wanted Jelly Bellys, but these were on sale, but NEVER AGAIN. Horrid nasty things, they are.

Chips are great to eat alone, instead of some cheap, waxy chocolate bar from the grocery store. Melt chips, add milk, stir with blender stick, and heat again. Then, mix with gourmet coffee. Makes the best chocolate coffee you've ever tasted!

This would be no start or minus stars if Amazon would let you. I have ordered from Dr. Foster and Smiths before however I had to stop. Their customer service is less then desirable. So if you like sweet potato treats for you pet look elsewhere.

We drink about 4-5 K-cups in our house each day, and this one always seems to be a favorite.  It's hard to find decaf flavors that actually taste good, but I really enjoy this one.  It's the same as most flavored coffees, in that it's a mild/lighter brew.  It tastes exactly like you'd expect a standard French Vanilla brew to, and I don't notice any fun aftertaste (like I do with some brands).  If you love dark/bold brews, this one won't do it for you, but if you just like a little after-dinner treat and don't want to be up all night, this is your K-cup.  Oh - and the person who said they sent the wrong product - you need to rate the seller that sent it (in your account/history settings).  It's not right to take it out on the actual product.

This coffee is very aromatic and full of flavor! When brewing the kitchen is filled with the aroma of warm vanilla! The coffee is very smooth and full flavored. I bought this for my husband because he doesn't tolerate the caffeine so this was a wonderful substitute! Love it!

I was very impressed with the flavor of these pods. I can't find French Vanilla decaf grounds anywhere, much less in pods.When I pack my Solofill Cup, Refillable K-Cup For Keurig Brewers with loose grounds I can easily get two cups of full flavor coffee out each fill. The product is great, but it came poorly packed!  The boxes containing the K-Cups were all broken apart. Some of the K-Cups were dented but fortunitly none have leaked so far.

column9: Who knew they made flavored decafs?
column10: For the 1st 2 years of owning a keurig I had only seen decaf coffees without any type of flavoring. I found this product and now this is all I drink for decaf. Great flavor and aroma.
We purchased this coffee primarily for when my mother-in-law visits as she only drinks decaf.  She loves it and now buys it at her house too.
the coffee had a great and different taste, not bitter but bold i will purchase again in the near future.

I love this decaf coffee.  It is very mild and tasty.  I use the highest size coffee setting for my k-cup and it is great.

I cannot wait until it's gone and I can try another decaf. Don't settle for this coffee when you have other choices available.
I love my Keurig and I love this coffee. Great flavor and great price. Got to me fast and fresh.
The huge selection, quality product, and affordable prices make Green Mountain a "go to" supplier for K cups.  This French Vanilla decaf is as expected, tasty and lacking motivator.

I have a single cup Keurig coffee machine. I can't have caffenine and I love the French Vanilla Flavor of coffee. I've tried several other K-cups of different French Vanilla and didn't like the taste of any of them. I ended up tossing them all in the trash. When I tried this Green Mountain French Vanilla in K-cups that is Decaf, I can't seem to get enough of it. There's no after taste, which is wonderful. What I do, is make this coffee during the evening (when I crave it the most) and add some cinnamon and stir. Then I add some International French Vanilla Cream for sweetness to my liking, and then add Fat Free milk to finish it off. The flavor for me is absolutely Heaven! Even drinking it in the evening, it doesn't keep me up all night, and when I go to bed, I sleep like a baby and get a good nites rest. I won't be changing to any other brand or flavor. This tastes so incredable! It's just as described being luschously rich and smooth. It's also a Light Roast, so It's perfect for me and I can add any extra flavors (like the cinnamon) I mentioned. I Very higly Recommend this for anyone, especially ones that can't have the caffine! And the price is very reasonable! Love it, Love it, Love it!!!
green mountain makes great coffee, yet to find a bad one. good flavor for a decaf. luv the Kuerig machine. not bad pricing
I live in a small town so it is next to impossible to find decaf k-cups, and even more impossible to find them at this price! Exactly what I wanted!
Was looking for a flavored decaf coffee, and this was perfect!  With a little vanilla creamer...couldn't have been happier.  Tasty!

She says it's definitely a 5 star.  Just the right strength and taste for her.I also order my favorite from Amazon on a regular basis. I've been drinking Green Mountain Regular French Vanilla coffee for several years now.  I wanted to cut my caffeine intake but had concerns about giving up taste.  I must say that I was pleasantly surprised with the French Vanilla Decaf....the taste is really good.
I am so glad to find flavored coffee  k-cups  My husband and I both love the taste and the aroma.

K Cups are great.Green Mountain French Vanilla Decaf is an above average with good flavor of french vanilla and good coffee
Even if you think you don't like flavored coffees, try Green Mountain. It is so delicious. Such a treat for your breakfast.

I have used other seasonings by Chef Prudhomme that were Ok. But this one was a little disappointing for me. I passed it on to a friend to get their opinion.

i wish Gevelia were not so expensive as I would drink it every day.  It is excellent.

column9: Not the best cat treat in my opinion, but they are cat approved
column10: The only good comment I can give on these treats is that my cat liked them when they were fresh, and they are really inexpensive! I can usually find these treats for under two dollars at the grocery or pet store, and even on occasion at the dollar store. As this treat proves, often with a low price, comes a cheap product.  It would be nice if these pounce treats had healthier ingredients, maybe some vitamins or a dental cleanser, but no, its just junk food and a long list of filler ingredients. They smell really gross to me but my cat seemed to enjoy them. My biggest reason for not liking this treat, aside from the terrible ingredients and smell, is the fact that it is soft and chewy and not crunchy texture. Soft treats reek havoc on pet teeth as the sticky particles just sit on their teeth and gums and just rot there. Crunchy treats at least crunch off and don't stick to their teeth- hopefully crunching off some tarter with it. For a really good dental product, I recommend Crunch N' Clean brand with DentaShield. Greenies brand doesn't have as many beneficial dental ingredients, but they are pretty good as well as they contain vitamins and a little bit of breath freshening ingredients in them, so they are much better than these. Any crunchy treat would be better than these. Even other Pounce varieties are MUCH better than these, such as the Tarter & Plaque control varieties. The Pounce Tarter & Plaque control are a bit more pricey, but still relatively inexpensive and they contain vitamins and are crunchy. Another strange thing about these treats is that the recommended daily allotment is 6-8 treats per day, which is just crazy to me. I only give my cats no more than 1-2 a day of these while I had them. I eventually threw them out as they got hard as rocks and my cats didn't like them anymore anyhow.Pros: cat approved taste while fresh; and very fair priceCons: bad smell, lack of nutrition, terrible texture for teeth

I use these to treat my cats whenever I have to take the dogs outside for a walk. When we get inside, everyone gets a treat and I use these and other flavors by Pounce to give the cats a little something to nibble upon. They have never refused them, they don't get bored with them and they yowl at me if I'm slow in delivering them.
I had been buying these at my grocery store and they stopped selling them.  I looked everywhere because my cat loves them and I think they look alot tastier then most of the treats on the market.
I got my dog back from the vet. She was very excited to tell me that my dog had great looking teeth. I feel that this product was very responsible for this.
Bought this product locally - but went out of business.  Ordered product not nearly as good as what I previously had.

Great salt -- just what I expected.  The care that went into handcrafting this product is clearly evident.  The taste is warm and full-bodied, a perfect balance of sea minerals.  I would like to congratulate the crafts people who are responsible for such a fine salt, made in the time-honored, traditional manner.  It warms my heart to know there are still people who understand and spend their time striving to make such a quality product in the old-fashioned way.  Omodetto, arigato gozaimas.  Please don't stop doing what you are doing.  And when you finally make your last batch, I hope you have trained others to take over and continue to make the same, fine product, in the same time-honored, uncompromising, traditional manner.  Good salt is the basis of our healthy life.  To be the salt of the Earth, we need good salt to nourish our nerves, our bodies and our spirits.  Thank you deeply for providing this essential nutrient.
This is the best finishing salt, when you cook fish. It enhances the flavour of the fish. Even my husband - who is not a big fish eater had to admit it.

You might want to consider this wonderful product.  It is identical to the orange can except that it does not gel, which is perfect if you want to use in any beverage and not have it congeal.  I only bought one can, but noticed the results of less pain in my joints and stronger nails.  I just ordered it in bulk from the website because it's something we plan on taking forever.  The only downside is that you have to cut your nails more often.

Collegen is central for maintaining a healthy body, particularly as one ages. It is like a glue that holds the body together. It contributes significantly to skin, hair, nail health. As one ages, loss of collegen is evident when you go for a blood test and the technician can't hold the vein in one place long enough to draw blood. In prior times, it was ingested in the organ meats people consumed; but these foods have long since lost their appeal for most people, including myself. So we turn to a more palatable, convenient source: Gelatin. I prefer the hydrolysate form, as it is "predigested", smoother, blends easily with other ingredients (ok, so I'm squeemish). But I do recommend it, having seen and felt good results with it.

column10: This has REALLY caused my ulcerated colitis to heal and has helped me get my life back. This coupled with ASEA[...]  I have stop having to get up at night , I have no pain, AND my nails are really growing!!

Both my boys love these cereal bars.  My son was getting them at the high school for breaksfast and told me about them.

column10: I love this tea.  I've never had a problem with it being hard on my stomach and I drink it from morning to night.  I can't buy it locally any more and I like it enough to now get it from Amazon.
Good product at reasonable price.  In terms of taste and use, very much like non-organic products.  Price is right in line with non-organic tea bags.

As a long time licorice fan but recently counting carbs to stave off type II diabetes, I was anxious to try these. To my dismay, I found that one serving contains 110 calories and 22 garms of carbohydrates. My disappointment turned to disgust when I tasted them. There is very little flavor in these. just don't eat too many...as is the case with any sugar free candy! ;)great taste and consistency (tastes/feels like "the real thing")...

column9: A great collection of regular coffee
column10: I have tried so many different coffees from Keurig.This collection encompasses a full range of coffee selections.From the milder Nantucket Blend to the strongest French Roast.If you have a variety of coffee preferences in your home, as we do here, this collection has something for everyone.If you want flavored coffee, this is not for you, but for a range of regular coffee, this is our household new favorite!

Not sure what kind of coffee you might be in the mood for?  Or perhaps you are going to have guests and don't know what they may like, then this assortment pack is an excellent choice to stock up and have a bit of something for everyone.  You get Green Mountain's Coffee Nantucket Blend for those that prefer a light taste, something a little more than a Breakfast Blend, but not much. Tully's French Roast, is for those that want a rich full bodied, take no prisoners taste. Newman's Own Organics Newman's Special Blend is perfect for those that are concerned about all things organic... and it tastes great to boot, and finally Caribou Coffee Caribou Blend for those that coffee, but not bitter aftertastes.  You get a dozen of each in this convenient pack, enough for you to make a choice of your favorite, or to provide some choices at your next intimate dinner party.

I purchased this set of Keurig Cups along with a Keurig machine as a gift for a charity event.  I have a machine myself and love it, however, when I first got my machine, it only had 5-6 various sample cups included with the machine itself and it took me a while to get a case.  So, I know how inconvenient it is to not receive a collection kit to start out with.  This collection is really terrific--there a a number of different types of coffee included and with 48 cups per box, it would last most people 2-3 weeks.  I really recommend this as a gift of for yourself to try out different flavors.

Good coffee and a nice selection, but it was more expensive than you can find at Walmart or on sale at the grocery store, etc.
I was very satisfied with my order. I like the variety collections the best and most stores only sell in one flavor. Delivery was on time and the price was good.

I prefer the Caribou for my morning "wake-up" and appreciate the smoothness of the Nantucket blend.  All around favorite collection of coffees for us!
