column9: special edition packaging leaves tons to be desired
column10: I was a little disappointed with this collection.  It came in a shipping box as if the different pods were just thrown in there according to the combination described online.  When I read it was a "collectors" edition, I assumed more care would be taken in the packaging and the packaging itself would be special. Instead it's just a print that they put in with the coffee -- it's a black and white print that isn't any better quality than your regular poster.  The coffee itself is as described (although there are so many "bold" flavors that I'm not sure how they can claim this is a medium roast collection).  If you are looking to sample different brands and types of coffee, this works.  However, being new to Keurig brewing, I'm not sure if this is price comparable and if it costs more for the special "limited edition" package for this collection, I'd skip it as it's not worth the additional cost.
Nothing special I guess.. my fault for not reading the description well enough.  It comes with 4 different types of coffee... not 4 different flavors.
This is a great collection of coffees.  There is a flavor for every taste, and this is a big hit in our facility.

I received this product in good time.  I enjoyed most of the coffee...just not crazy about items that were not coffee....but...that is me. I doubt I would purchase again. I would just purchase "coffee".  That has more to do with what I spend my money on then the service I received.

column9: Mom Loved It -- Used Em' All
column10: What Keurig would be complete without a nice assortment of 48 coffee lover's K-Cups? For the value and for the wide assortment of choices, this was a no brainer for someone who loves her Keurig, and made my day when they all went to good use and were enjoyed to the fullest extent.A no brainer for anyone with a Keurig.5 Tasty Stars out of 5!

There were at least 10 dark roast cups in the box, which is about a third of the box.  There were also a few flavored cups.  This box was shipped to and arrived in Alaska without problem.  More recently when I attempted to order more K-cup coffee via Amazon, the order was refused with the excuse it couldn't be shipped to Alaska.  So, based on that I won't be buying my coffee from Amazon in the future.  How dumb is that?

This is a good buy.  Great variety of bold and medium coffee, both with caffeine and decaf.  I would certainly purchase again and would recommend to others. If you are looking for flavored coffees this is not the right sampler

column9: I Love Cofee and I am Thrifty
column10: I love my Keurig coffee maker however, I also like saving money and not spending too much on the pods. This is by far my favorite collection of strong coffees. I am so hooked on this specific collection I just don't like any other coffee they way I love the coffee from this collection. For the price if you get Amazon prime I believe this is the best bang for your buck. Please note there are no flavored coffees in this collection, so if you want hazelnut or chocolate this is not the collection for you.
Nice selection of coffee but too many decaf cups. I was just looking for a mix of coffe with no decaf or flavored coffee cups
I got this because it seemed like it had a lot of variety, but my husband doesn't drink decaf and we had to give away about 7 of the cups to a neighbor because they were decaf.

column4: S. Paola "I Save More so I can Shop More"
column10: Bought this for my husband as he a new coffee drinker and wasn't really sure what he liked.  He LOVES two of the flavors, really likes a third and finds the fourth just ok.  Nice variety and great to have when company comes over.

column9: Good choices, a little Green Mountain Coffee trigger happy though
column10: Really good selection and variety, however I only got 20 different favors instead of 24, and they seemed to prefer one brand, instead of evening out the order. 7 out of 35 are decaf, so it's not bad, but not great. And since I am ordering medium roast, chances are I don't want a bold or extra bold flavor and 7 of them were just that. So those are going to have to get a lot of cream.13 Green Mountain Coffee, 2 of them blend over ice. Not sure I am looking forward to that.3 Donut Shop1 Van Houtte =( and it is decaf. I love this brand, and I only got 14 Caribou7 Wolfgang Puck2 Newman's Own, both extra bold4 Tully's1 Barista Prima CoffeehouseOverall, I would probably order again.
The shipment arrived on time.The Keurig bundle is a perfect gif for coffee lovers.It contains aside assortment of flavors and blends
The coffee lovers collection is a selection of very good tasting coffee.  They are full bodied and rich - if you like weak coffee, this selection is not for you!
I believe that this collection of coffee items was very satisfactory. I enjoyed the wide selection, especially the Tully's French Roast.

I've tried about half a dozen of the crazy cups samplers.  Except for the chocolate one that was mostly powdered hot chocolate in a cup and very little coffee, they're a great way to experience a wide variety of flavors from different companies without having to buy into a big box full.  I've found flavors and varieties I hadnt seen before that we liked.  What we tend to do is buy the 2-3 varieties we usually use in bulk to keep the cost per cup down, then we salt the collection with one of these variety boxes to spice things up.

I drink medium roast and my hubby likes dark, so this collection was perfect!  The Caribou is now my favorite coffee, I would rather make this at home than go out for coffee at this point.  I recently bought just a whole 48 count of the Caribou because it is so good.  The Green Mountain is not bad either but not as smooth.  And I have had no complaints about the other flavors from the hubby.  At the price we got it for I would recommend this product.
I love the variety including the decaf for a late day warm up without the caffeine.  I would buy this again next time I place my order for my kerrigan addiction.
I bought this as our office mix of coffee. It's a great price for a four flavor selection. My office didn't love the extra bold flavor, so I am giving it a 4 out of 5
Over half of my order was decaf coffee. If you don't want decaf coffee I wouldn't reccommend ordering. Otherwise good variety and coffee.
I was a little disappointed that these were not all medium roast, and a large portion were decaf.  It still was an okay buy, but have several stronger coffees I do not drink.
Would buy it again. Ordered for an event at Christmas. Great assortment. It was a hit. From hot chocolate to extra bold.

column9: Great idea for coffee tasting from Amazon
column10: This is a great idea when you're new to this whole Keurig thing (which I am) and I wanted to taste and test these brands before buying because this stuff is expensive.  I'm glad I purchased it but I must say that what probably works for most people doesn't work for me.  I like really bold and strong coffee and I found the coffee in this sampler to be "wimpy" which is to say it's probably great coffee for normal drinkers.  However, if you like bold and strong I recommend buying the Green Mountain BOLD or stick with Starbucks BOLD (any flavor) as long as you have the word BOLD.  Every other brand is too weak which is probably "normal".  I did determine in this experiment that I would only buy Green Mountain if I can't get my first choice which is Starbucks brand.

column9: Perfect selection to find your perfect brand!
column10: We bought to test out the different coffees since we just got our keurig machine.  It was good to try the different flavors a number of times to really remember which was which!
The dunkin flavor is bland. The package came with 4 pods broken  I was hoping for a bigger variety. Next time I will spend the extra cash to get a better product
If you want to try many different kinds of coffee and tea, this was a great buy, definitely go for it.

We order this box about twice a month and recently the k-cups have been sent to use warped and broken. We've had to throw away a few from the box in the past few orders. Will be hesitant to purchase again!!

The coffee is excellent, easy to order and always arrives in a short period of time.  Love the convienence and am about to enjoy a fresh cup this morning.  We used to have coffee made in a drip coffee pot but by the time we would have a second cup the coffee lost much of it's taste and at times tasted burnt.  Never happens with Keurig coffee.

This set comes with four different coffees.  Here's my feedback on each.Green Mountain Nantucket Blend: This is probably the best of the bunch.  Just an all around good coffee without being overly rich or laced with any extra flavors.  It smells great and tastes smooth.Newman's Own Organics Special Blend: This is my second favorite.  Paul may be known for his salad dressing, but he also makes a good cuppa.Caribou Blend: No complaints, but it's nothing special.  Just a regular run of the mill coffee.Tully's French Roast: This is my least favorite of the bunch.  The coffee seems a bit watery and bland.  I never have been a fan of French roast so that may weigh in on my opinion.Overall this is a good collection of K-cups for your morning coffee fix.  Perfect for someone who doesn't want any flavored or frilly coffee, just a straight up good cup of Joe.

column4: Big c "the big guy in the part"
column9: Best way to start your day
column10: I have a Keurig machine for 17 months and I have stopped throwing half pots of coffee down the drain, these cups are real coffee flavor, much better than dunkin donuts cups or donut shop..tha caribo will make your heart pump...

My sampler pack arrived the day after I ordered it, so kudos for quick delivery! Although I bought the 35 cup sampler, there were only 33 cups in the box, so the people packaging should be more careful. I would have made a stink about it, but since it's a great deal I thought it wasn't worth the time to complain. None of my cups were damaged.On to the coffee: I received a nice sampling of coffees...I think I got at least one of every coffee shown in the picture. Many were doubles, which is fine by me, and I was pleased that there were 7 decaf cups included (including the half caf). I'm loving the medium roast coffees so far...we have found the light roasts to be a little on the weak side (especially the flavored coffees), and this is a great way to sample different kinds without committing to a whole box. I recommend this option if you are new to the K Cups or you're looking for something different to try.So, overall, we are happy with this purchase. I would have given it 5 stars if they had given me all 35 k cups!

column9: Agree with Prev Review - not exactly as advertised... BUT
column10: I wanted to back up a previous review that you really are NOT getting 35 medium roast K cups.  This is a nice assortment though and of my 35 I would have guess that half were medium roast - I also had about 10 bold or dark and about 7 or so DeCaf.  Personally I was OK with the mix and I like the selection - Decaf is great for a late day coffee!  Also note that the price fluctuates greatly on this I paid $27.50 at one point and my next order is under $18.  I have seen this on MANY items on AMAZON so keep an eye on that if you buy.  All in All though I thought this was a good deal!!

I was a bit hesitant when I first ordered this coffee because I am the only one who drinks coffee and if I was not happy with them, I would be drinking coffee, unhappily, for quite sometime.  Fortunately, I was pleasantly surprised to find out that it was exactly what I was looking for and am enjoying them each day when I wake up and, at times, during the day.  I have served them to friends when they come to visit, and they have complimented me on how good the cup of coffee is.  I tell them that it was all done with the Keurig brewer and unfortunately, I had nothing to do with that cup of coffee.  They smile and enjoy their coffee.I will be ordering this assortment again when the current one gets towards the end.

I love coffee and get really bored if I have to drink the same kind on a regular  basis.  This sampler pack provided me with so many different kinds of coffee so that I didn't have to purchase an entire pack of some kind that I might not have liked.  I really enjoyed trying so many new ones and deciding which I like and dislike.

column9: Like the small set that came with the machine
column10: Its very similar to the original assortment that came with the machine, but more of them.  Green mountain, Paul Newman, donut shop, tully's, caribou, and probably more I cant remember right now.  I'm happy with it.

What you see is what you get....not a stunning variety, but adequate. There are 12 each of four different kinds: 12 Tullys French Roast, 12 Caribou Blend, 12 Newmans Blend, and 12 Green Mountain Nantucket Blend. Nothing out of the ordinary or exciting but a solid way to restock a collection with some variety for different tastes.

I got the Keurig for Christmas from my loving wife, and this was the first box of coffees I purchased after exhausting the sampler that came with the machine. There are four different coffees in the box; two are very bold, robust coffees and the other two are milder. I like all four, and will definitely buy this collection again.
I love having an assortment of coffees to choose from.  In fact, I've purchased this a few times - and bought the package as gifts.
Excellent variety and quantity.This was a gift to a coffee lover friend of mine.They were also pleased to recieve such a quality product.

package arrived on time and in good condition.nice to try a bunch of flavors without having to buy an entire box of each.disapointed with duplicates, but think not a lot of them, and only think if duplicated got 2 of the same flavor/brand.considering is a medium roast sampler there where a couple "bold" and "extra bold" flavors that seem shouldnt have been in the pack.Will likely buy another sampler, just to keep a variety of k-cups on hand
This was purchased for my wife as a part of her Christmas gift.  She loves the coffee.  Amazon was quick on the shipping, as always.  Cheaper than anywhere else.  Very pleased.

This collectionK-Cup Coffee for Keurig Brewers, Coffee Lover's Collection - 48 Count works out to nearly one dollar a cup. I can see that manufacturers would like to sell a machine with a high use cost [just like cheap printers with cartridges that constantly have to be replaced] but surely most people will give some thought to the cost per cup. Costco sells a box of Tully cups at $37 for 80, less than fifty cents a cup.
All my favorites in one box!! I have ordered this several times, and have been extremely pleased with the consistency of the great coffees included.

column9: Perfect for regular coffee lovers who don't like flavored coffees.
column10: My family is not big on flavored coffees so this was perfect.  From rich bold coffee to your milder coffee this collection has it.  If you have different tastes for coffee in your family this is the Keurig collection for you.

Three of the four coffees are excellent ... but the Green Mountain Nantucket Blend I thought was Rather qweak and unimpressive.They titled this "For Coffee Lover's" son I expected flavorful somewhat bold brands to be included. The other three were.I have since found a Green Mountain brand called Sumatran Reserve, extra bold which is excellent, but according to their literature, they have over 50 types of coffee availabe in the K-cup format........only one of the many brands for the K-cup... quite a selection.
What a great way to make a pure, coffee shop quality coffeee (& tea) each morning! It's clean, simple and so easy.
The K-Cups were purchased for my grand-daughter. She loves the coffees and teas and that it takes less than a minute, usually only about 30 seconds, to brew a delicious cup of coffee.
These are some of the best you can get for fans of non-flavored coffee.Newmans and Caribou are some of the very best and the other two are also very good!Enjoy!
I made of a great fun food box for my mother in law and auntie. This is one of the things I put in the box. They love the variety and were very happy with it.
The coffee seems to be going over quite well with our office- I haven't received any complaints yet!  K-Cups are SO convenient and the products are so easy to use.
This product was described as "Medium Roast Sampler, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers" but contained over 50% extra bold...no return available....complete waste

I ordered the 35 K-Cup assortment that was supposed to have 35 different flavors to sample. Instead I received 11 different ones and the rest were doubles (two of the same).I wanted to sample 35 different flavors. I only have 23 different samples since some of them are doubled.

column9: They are what they are; single cup coffee!
column10: The only problem I have when purchasing a product with this much Single Cup brands is that there is little or no decaf coffee.  I am a decaf coffee drinker and would like to see more decaf out there.

I understand that some of the coffee in assortment sampler packs with be decaf but a third of the pack was. I would not have bought it if I knew so much Decaf would come with it. Decaf in my house is unused coffee and thus a waste. Thanks for wasting my money.
Nothing spectacular about any of the included coffee flavors.  They're not bad, not great.  We liked other variety packs better.

column9: Very Small Bag but good cookies!
column10: I love these cookies. The package was very small. I would say the bag of cookies was the size of the palm of my hand (petite lady). So, for the size and price I would not buy this size again for this price. But overall again, the product is yummy!

At first I was disappointed when I saw the small bags.  But now I'm glad they are packaged the way they are!  Once I open the bag it's almost impossible not to eat the entire thing.  These are excellent shortbreads, and for what it's worth, Walker cookies are served on almost all European airlines.  So they're pretty popular wherever you go.
I liked the size of the Mini-Fingers Walker's Shortbread.  Though not more than one or two bites for each one,they'r mighty tasty!
The small size bags make sure they don't go stale, not that they have much chance of that with the great taste.  quick delivery. exactly what I was expecting.
good product, good tast. my children liked it,I am giving 4 stars because they were little dried and does not feel as fresh as Dole's quality.

This is my second date purchase on Amazon. The first time I bought Dromedary. This time I tried Dole since they were the cheapest and a well known brand. The Dromedary were much better. The Dole are dry and don't have much taste. If you want quality, pay a little more and try the Dromedary. They are excellent.

This gum combines the flavors of melon and mint to create a fruity, refreshing flavor that is very tasty.  It's fruity, but with just the right amount of spearmint and peppermint so that it's not sweet, and leaves a minty tingle behind it.  Thus, you get all the freshness of a mint gum, with the tastiness of a fruity gum.  I very much enjoy this, and I usually have a pack in my desk.  Highly recommended.
This is my most favorite gum on the face of this earth!!  I got it at a decent price here too.  Purchased this particular box as gifts for the guests at my daughters' baby shower.  Big hit I'm sure!
My wife loves this and can't seem to find it locally, so we buy a case every 6 months or so.

This product is really hard to find, so I had to snatch it up in bulk on Amazon. It's kind of a minty, honeydew flavor! Everytime I chew it, my mouth tastes super fresh (like I just brushed my teeth - but doesn't taste at all like toothpaste). The flavor also lasts forever, too. A great buy :)

column9: Tastes like Spearmint, no melon flavor
column10: I'm not sure if mine was mispackaged or what, but my Maui Melon Mint doesn't have any melon taste whatsoever - it is strictly mint.

Orbit's new flavor of gum, Maui Melon Mint, combines the flavor of sweet honeydew-like melon with the familiar cooling sensation of Bubblemint. This is a truly unique gum and I encourage you to try it!
I visited Zagreb one of the best 5 start hotel they used to serve illy coffee. The best  espresso yet for me.Regards,

column9: I drank this mid afternoon and had a 1 hr 20 min nap
column10: I couldn't wait to bedtime to try this as it had been so many years since I had it. I took lowfat soymilk and heated 1/2 cup and put in 2 teaspoons. Tastes just like it did as a child. Next thing I knew the dog was barking to go out and I had been out cold. I hope it works as well wen I have sleepless nights.The taste is wonderful if you like malt flavor like the inside of a malted milk ball.

It's hard to describe this to people who have never sampled it, but basically it's a powder to which you mix milk and sugar to get a sweetened malted drink. It is supposed to promote sleep.Quite simply it's a comfort drink when plain milk just won't do. You can also call it malted milk or a hot sweet malt drink.In the great British trifecta of British powdered drinks to be mixed with milk and sugar, Horlicks the most malty, Milo is medium chocolately and malty, and Ovaltine seems to be the most chocolately. It's actually named after the inventor, William Horlick.As far as taste goes, you can make it as malty or sweet as you like depending on how much of each you add to the milk. But to those who love and grew up on Holicks, it's just a great comfort drink.

This is a premier product, although pricey with shipping added in, for making a outstanding chocolate malt. I think that it is far superior to the typical products one finds on grocer shelves. My recipe for a Malt for 1 person is 1/2 pint chocolate or vanilla ice cream, 1/2 cup milk, 2 Tbs Horlicks Drinking Powder, and 2 Tbs chocolate syrup. Mix in a blender. Adjust as you see fit..... There are many recipes on the web.I also made a hot chocolate malt at breakfast one morning. I used 1 Tb Horlicks Drinking Powder, 3/4 cup of warm milk, and 1 Tb chocolate syrup. That also was good.Again if you love malt this product is an excellent choice.

column9: Horlicks is like 2 minutes of heaven every day
column10: I almost never review anything, but I had to review Horlicks. I have been a Horlicks addict since I was 5. And every single person who has ever lived with me: room mates or boyfriends and now my husband - are all Horlicks addicts too. I cant wait until its time to head to bed with my Horlicks and Kindle. Its the perfect amount of maltiness and sweetness and just heaven with warm milk. Enjoy!

This is a great tasting hot drink. It is not chocolate base like Milo or ovaltine. When added to milk the color of the milk barely changes. It gives the milk a smooth texture and a creamy taste. I mix 2 tbs with warm milk, sometimes I use sugar and sometime I don't. Without sugar added it still has a good taste. The only thing is the 300g container is very small I was expecting something a little bigger for $10. If I knew 300g was so small in size I would have order the larger size.Here is the Nutritional fact base on 1 serving 25gCalories 189Sodium 1 mgTotal Fat 4 gPotassium 0 mgSaturated 3 gTotal Carbs 27 gPolyunsaturated 0 gDietary Fiber 0 gMonounsaturated 0 gSugars 19 gTrans 0 gProtein 10 gCholesterol 0 mgVitamin A 36%Calcium 88%Vitamin C 28%Iron 19%
This us the malted milk product I remember from when I was a child.  Nothing else that is available on the market now compares.

I can buy twice the size of this container at my local Indian grocery store for half the price. This container was ridiculously small and was over within a week. For $9,xx this is highly over priced. Buy it locally.
It is a very mild flavored drink and a bit on the costly side.  I do not think I would reorder it.

column9: Great taste but gritty in cold drinks
column10: I used this for milkshakes and it was very gritty. In milkshakes this may not be the answer. I also used it in hot chocolate there it worked very well but in cold dont waste your time.
I grew up drinking a warm Horlicks before bed, sometimes one cup just wasn't enough. It's very tasty and helps you sleep. You MUST try this. Yummy!
Purchased for my son in law who loves milk shakes.  When added to the basic ingredients of milk, syrup, ice cream, it adds to really nice flavor.
I liked it very much. It was differant I must say. It did not help me with my sleeping but will buy it again.

Could not find vanilla malt anywhere.  This stuff is what legends were made of and kids today dont know anything about it.  "Malt Shops" were all the rage for decades and now mostly forgotten.The only domestic mfr of this malt makes it only in chocolate which does not work for anything but chocolate.  If you want vanilla, strawberry or any other flavor malt you have to have VANILLA!Im really happy to have found this source.

I purchased these to hand out with ice cream to my husband's  employees.  Unfortunately the majority of the bowls were broken.  They tasted very good and were very fresh but there were not many that were still in bowl form.  I would not recommend this product to anyone.

I wouldn't buy these if you are counting on the bowls to arrive safely.  I would estimate at least 25% of them arrived broken and unusable, even though they were bubble wrapped in packages of three per package.  The problem is there needed to be another insulating packing material around all the bowls inside the packing carton.

column9: Very Good Meat Snack - Highly Recommended
column10: Jack Link's "X-Stick Original" snack sticks are very good tasting and far less greasy than other "meat sticks" (like Slim Jim). These are great snacks for diabetics (like me) since they have a negligible amount of Net Carbs.The Amazon "Product Features" incorrectly lists these as 160 Calories each, and neither the box or individual packaging list the Nutrition Facts, so I visited the Jack Links web site and found the following:Serving Size: .5 Oz (1 stick)Calories: 60 (45 from Fat)Total Fat: 5g (2g Saturated Fat)Cholesterol: 15mgSodium: 220mgTotal Carbohydrates: 0gProtein: 3gThese do contain MSG, which can cause "gastric distress" in some people (like my dad).Overall, these are great as a snacks between meals and they are so much better than the competition.Highly Recommended!CFH

These are along the line of Slim Jims but have a milder, less spicy, taste. The X-Sticks also have a much better texture than Slim Jims, these things actually look like they are made of real meat, NOT the 'mystery meat - goat hair/cardboard' texture of the modern Slim Jim.The X-Stick is 'not exactly' a health food snack. They have a fair amount of fat, a little over 5 grams (each stick, in this package, is 14 grams total mass). Sodium content is about 224 mg and, about 3.2 grams of protein and only 64 calories (about 47 calories from fat) per stick.What the X-Stick is, is a very satisfying snack. I sometimes have to miss a meal, due to my work. One or two of these take the hunger away and puts some energy back into me. I do try to limit my fat intake but do not feel guilty about snacking on these once in a while.Enjoy.Ken

These are so much better than Slim Jim's they don't have that weird fur texture when you bite it; and as far as biting goes you can actually bite these without fighting with it. They taste good, but have that typical meat stick flavor. These are also MUCH easier to open than a Slim Jim. Packed well, arrived quickly and fresh.

This review is for the 0.5 ounce X-Sticks box of 50.First I will comment on the taste.  The X-Sticks have a mild and pleasing flavor to them.  They taste similar to Slim Jims, just without the chemical spiciness and odd plastic texture of Slim Jims.  In a taste test, the X-Sticks would win without a problem.Next is the price.  The price for the box of 50 0.5 ounce X-Sticks tend to fluctuate on Amazon but it's still worth it, provided the price stays below $20 a box.  When you combine this with the Subscribe and Save discount, you can save even more!  The price of the same type of Slim Jims is almost $10 higher, so once again, the X-Sticks win.So my final thoughts are if you're looking for a meat snack that isn't going to repeat on you an hour later, these are the way to go.  Although they can't claim to be "All natural", they have more natural ingredients than the Slim Jim.  These also are composed of beef and pork (yum), whereas a Slim Jim is composed of beef and mechanically separated chicken...  (Eww).  Anyway, I was very happy with this purchase and I highly recommend them for you.

I can't really compare these to other similar products (Slim Jim,etc.), as I had never had jerky-type snacks before I got these.  I decided to take a long road trip (4500 miles round trip), and I have a tendency to get drowsy if I don't get enough protein.  I decided to carry these plus some string cheese in the car to tide me over between meal stops.I really like these.  The flavor is good, the texture is fine, and the "damage" from a diet standpoint is minimal (these are 60 cal apiece, based on the Jack Links site).  They're not too salty, either.  Having them on the trip from Bellingham, WA to St. Louis, MO and back was a huge help.  One or two of these provided just the right amount of tasty protein.  The size and packaging is handy, too, and easy to open when driving.I now keep them on hand for when I need a little pick-me-up.

column9: Best of all the beef sticks I have tried
column10: My son and I love these beef sticks! I purchased these and slim jims at the same time and was amazed how much better taste and tecture they have over slim jims. Infact I'm tempted to throw my slim jims in the trash! Perfect for your 72-hour kit.

This stuff is great for snacking, has a long shelf life, and convenient to pack for travel.  The taste and texture is awesome.  Buying on-line saves money and time.  I keep a box in my office and another at home.  It is a great way to enjoy group discussions and family time.  Eric D., Wanamingo, MN

column9: Easy snack sticks on the cheap
column10: I am a meat lover and this makes a perfect snack for the road.  Inexpensive.  Can't say the taste is outstanding but is certainly not yucky.  Will get another box when this one runs out.
After eating these you'll Never want another Slim JimThese are Awesome.

So these sticks taste ok, I mean, it's jerky, how do you mess that up? My issue is with the expiration date, which was a little less than one month from when I got my box. How am I supposed to eat 50 of these things in 25 some-odd days? That's just cheap trying to offload these so close to the expiration date. Never buying these again.

This was my second purchase. Watching carbs, I look for snacks that are high protein with low or no sugars. Tiring of nuts all the time I tired these a couple months ago. Very surprised, they taste good with a bit of spice kick. Recalling that most convenience store sticks were dry or greasy or blah tasting, it was nice to snack on these. They are not the long sticks but a nice size at about 6 inches. Wrapped individually and easy to open. Great item to grab when looking for a quick munch.

column9: Just okay -- not nearly a Slim Jim
column10: While certainly edible, I don't think Jack Links brings a realistic competitor here with their version of the Slim Jim.  Honestly, there are some bites I take which remind me of dog food.  I know we are talking about meat sticks here and not fine dining, but the texture of these is just not right, almost too granular.  I know Slim Jims have that greasy taste but these guys have a bit of it too and I have to admit I kind of enjoy it.  Overall, in my opinion, Slim Jims are much much better than these guys, but to each his/her own!
Just letting ya know that I bought a pack of these before..they were perfectly fine..this time? no. They were moldy, so I just threw them out, what a waste of money!!
The first time I got these, everything was great. The second time, however, the sticks tasted a bit off... then I notice the 3-months-expired date on them.
My husband has tried many links is his day and these stand out.  Would compare these to Fat Freddies.
I first bought these at my part-time work at Advance Auto and since I could buy them cheaper this way, I did it.Good flavor and a bit of a bite.

column9: A bit on the greasy side, but the kids love them

In other words, excellent for sharing or a snack at school where eating a whole stick might be a problem.I also dump a package into a ziploc and can snack on it a piece at a time to boost my protein and fat intake a bit.A pack of 12 lasted my 7 year old and his friends about a week, which is way faster than most other meat snacks I've put on the snack counter.But even the 7-10 year olds say its a bit greasy, as they devour another package.

this will be the third time i bought this an enjoy it every time much better then slim jims  their tender an full of flavor i often want a snack at random times but don't want eat a lot or a full meal this ties me over an is worth the price

My kids love these beef sticks...... so this year I purchased these and stuffed lots of them in their Christmas stockings.  These were a much better replacement to all the Christmas candy they usually get.  Great item and great price!!!
Realy liked the taste, price and quality. Only downgrade would be that about 20% of the easy peel opening packages are not serrated and need to be cut with scissors. Only defect
I have ordered this item several times and am very pleased with it. Will order again. It is one of my favorite jack link products.

Having never had the X-Links before, I bought them based off some customer reviews I read here. Maybe I should have read more, but these are most comparable to a Slim Jim. These have a much better taste than Slim Jim does, although there is still a substantial "artificial" taste. Highly recommended as a Slim Jim upgrade, but don't buy these if you're looking for a more natural tasting product.
Very pleased with these. They had both a good taste and texture. The price was right for what you get. I would highly recommend.

column9: Very good, but not really EXTREME
column10: I like these sticks better than Slim Jims because they are less greasy and have a meatier flavor.  However, they could benefit from some more spice.  That's my only suggestion.
I love these sticks i have purchased 2 boxes from amazon and I have bought many from local stores. These are the best tasting sticks i have ever had just wish i could get them by the case yum yum.

The product is the same as what we had been purchasing in the store. I like keeping the box to store them becuase I dont lose track of where they are in the cabinet and now they are always easy to find. The price was better than in the store.

Very good snack sticks.  It does not feel greasy like Slim Jims and is easy to chew.  The size is perfect for a snack so I don't eat too many all at once.  I prefer it to be a little bit spicier though but they don't come in this size and price.  This is good if you have a craving for protein and should help hold off the hunger between meals.

I just bought my second box of Jack's Links because I'm sold on these!  I purchased a box of small Slim Jim's for my son's lunch box and for throwing snacks in my bag for the long afternoons of driving kids around to activiities and someone ALWAYS asking if I have something to eat!!  The Slim Jims were just ok, but after time got really hard, even in their individually packaged cases.  So I bought the Jack Link's X Stick and immediately my 10 year old son said they were WAY better than Slim Jims.  The 0.5 oz size is a little bigger than the small Slim Jims, yet not too big so that I'm filling my kid with even more fat and junk.  This is just the right size for a "snack" and the price is great.  At Amazon today I bought a box of 50 on sale for $17, which is about .35 cents a stick.  Don't hesitate to buy these if you are like me and need a variety of on-the-go, non-refrigerated snacks or lunch box fillers!!  Great product!
I'm not a beef stick/beef jerky eater.  These were bought for my son's school snack, however I have eaten a few and really like the beef flavor.

Sounded like a great product - pepperoni with an extra kick of flavor. This is much better than a slim jim. These are softer and have a good snap when you take a bite. The seasoning is not out of control like in a Slim Jim and the color is naturally brighter. Packing is good, much better than a Slim Jim, Jack Links have peel-able  packaging while with Slim Jims you have you to find a nice cut edge and wrestle with it.

column9: Jack Link's X-Stick, Pepperoni extra 1.25 oz X-Sticks
column10: Shipment is always on time. This is one of Jack Links best products. Just the right amount of spice and texture.

This will be the shortest review I've ever written, because it's based soley personal taste when it comes to beef sticks.I didn't like the X Sticks. I wouldn't even put them in the same universe as Jack Link's Beef Stick, Original, 0.92-Ounce Sticks (Pack of 72) or any of the beef sticks that Jack Links makes based on the 'Original' formula/base. Also, I have purchased the 7.2 oz.size in my local market.  This is also a good product.  I might be interested in buying these in quantity fron Amazon if offered.  Thank you for the opportunity to comment.

I don't really want to know what the put in these things anyway
These things are by far the best beef sticks among those that are commonly available.

Good stuff if you want a Slim Jim type of replacement that is of better quality.  Does not have that waxy taste that Slim Jim tends to offer.  If you want real beef jerky I'd pass on this. This has that mixed spiciness that you cant really find in any of their regular flavors but did remind me of Slim Jim.  Tastes like a hot dog in a way which is good and they tend to do the job as far as giving me a boost.  I give it 3 stars but I am going right back to the regular bagged stuff which so wayyyyy better.

This is by far,the best beef stick on the market.I have been a fan of Slimjims for years and this beats them and all the rest,HANDS DOWN!With today's frantic pace in living on this planet,when fast food restaurants are not an option,Jack Links is a quality snack on the go.Taste,texture,and convienience in small packages is the way of the future.

column9: Great Deal for a Tasty Snack
column10: These were only .19 each after getting 40% off with Amazon's snack sale, which is incredibly cheap.My hubby likes them in his lunches and I like giving him anything that isn't loaded with sugar or starches.I recently had a Slim Jim after about 20 years without trying them and it was awful. I like the flavor of Jack's Links ten times as much.Easy to get into the package, too, just peel it back.
These snack sticks are all individually wrapped and are very good! They taste a lot better than slim jims, plus my dog likes to lick the wrapper if i accidentally leave one on the floor overnight!

These are way better than Slim Jims for a fraction of the price. I order these through subscribe and save for even more savings. The flavor is outstanding. Love the portability. Makes a great protein snack any time of day. Even the picky eaters in the family love these. Also love these come from my home state.

column9: Good jerky for a quick snack
column10: I had tried one of the Jack Links snack pack, the kind that come with cheese, pretzel and meat, so after trying that, and loving it, I knew Id most likely enjoy this.  I took a bite from the first stick, and it wasn't too good, I guess it naturally tastes better with cheese IMO, but after eating the second and then third, they started to grow on me.  These things are perfect for that late snack and its convenient and does the trick for a hungry tummy.  They have a chewy consistency, but when you take a bite each time, you can hear a small snap from when you bite I also like the design, you just remove a piece of cardboard from the bottom and it becomes a dispenser, which is a little nice idea. I ended up liking these so much, I am going to subscribe to receive these once a month.  Price is great and if you do that, you get a nice little discount (15% off).  I definitely recommend this.
I bought these because I like meat snacks and Slim Jims are just way to greasy. I can't wait to purchase the next box.

I buy these by the box for my husband as his "stash" snack at work...he is always happy to receive them. Thanks for making a consistenly quality product. They ship ridiculously fast and we've never had a problem with our orders.
My whole family loves these and usually fights over the last package.  Great for on the road, quick protein fix.  Kids really enjoy them.
Better than Slim Jims.  Kids love them as a snack.  Not too salty, either.  Will buy again.

column9: Individual Jack Links best for sharing
column10: Have to admit I've never had Jack Links X-Stick (or any other Jack Links product) and have NO idea what they taste like.  I bought these because I know a Marine in Afghanistan loves them and so do his buddies.This particular item is perfect for military CARE packages: each unit is individually wrapped so nothing goes stale or gets sand in it after the box is opened.The small-size box is great for people without a lot of storage or 'personal' space.  The single-servings are ideal for sharing (without wiping yourself out of goodies) and fit into cammy pockets without taking up a lot of room or adding to the weight you're carrying.They make a welcome change from MRE's or when you need a quick energy boost (the convoy can't always stop for lunch).Even if you don't know if your 'fighter' likes them, I guarantee they'll be appreciated - remember when the kids traded lunches in school?  They may be older but trading goodies within the unit is a time-honored tradition, too!

I ordered this on April 29, 2011, and received it on May 2, 2011. The product expired in March. I am only giving this one star because that is the lowest rating that I can give. If it weren't for the one star minimum, I would give it 0 stars.

This stuff is great for snacking, has a long shelf life, and convenient to pack for travel.  The taste and texture is awesome.  Buying on-line saves money and time.  I keep a box in my office and another at home.  It is a great way to enjoy group discussions and family time.  Eric D., Wanamingo, MN

A quick, filling snack or not fattening beef stick, callit what you like...it is good! Most lunches for me is thisbeef stick and a cheese stick. That is usually all I havetime for. It is easy to carry and stays fresh.
Great snack, taste good and is a good value. Convenient package and just the right size for a snack.

column9: If you love beef jerky, you'll love this!
column10: I gave this as a Christmas present to my older, single brother.  He ate them all in less than a week!  I'd highly recommend buying this for someone!  I might even buy some for myself!  If you like beef jerky or Slim Jims, you'll definitely like Jack Links X-Sticks!

Edible, but not great. I like Slim-Jims ok when they're good (but quality control is a major issue with Slim-Jims, as for every good one you get, you're likely to get one that tastes rancid or worse).Obviously, these aren't like beef jerky, they're closer to Slim-Jims. EASIER TO CHEW, MILDER FLAVOR . I THINK LESS EXPENSIVE. MY KIT LIKES THEM TOO.

I first learned to like Wasa crackers (or crispbreads, as they're called) from my old Finnish surrogate mother. But I never took them very seriously until a year ago when my doctor put the heat on me to lower my carbs and lose some weight. Actually, the doctor scared the hell out of me. So I got serious. Since then, I have essentially quit eating bread. But, I like sandwiches for lunch. What to do? Voila! Everything that I used to eat on bread, I now eat on a Wasa--and sesame is my favorite flavor. So with no real effort (other than switching to Splenda instead of sugar), I'm down 30 pounds in a year. I'm wearing clothes that I haven't worn in five years.

column9: Love the Sesame Wasa, they are the BEST!!!
column10: The Wasa Sesame Crispbread is the very BEST I have ever eaten. I am totally addicted to them and have gotten most of my friends hooked on them as well. It is wonderful to order them by the case from Amazon, they are fresher than what you can buy in the stores and less expensive, too. What a winning combination!!!
The sesame is the best of the Wasa varieties, in my humble opinion.  My partner and I eat it by the case!  It's good for you -- lots of fiber. And you can't beat Amazon's price!
The last time you sent me the Wasa Crispbread Sesame pack of 12, it was damaged, most of the crackers were smashed.

These things are fantastic.  The perfect platform for delivering all sorts of goodies into your body :-).  The only knock, IMO, is the hike in prices.  $24 last fall for a pack of 12 (Sesame).  $36 now.

column9: Light and crispy with a fresh sesame flavor
column10: I've been eating WASA and other crisp breads for a long time, but I usually get the whole grain ones. Got these at the store once and really liked them, especially because I love sesame seeds. My family also really likes these, and my friends and guests really like them, too. In fact, I bought this case of WASA to share with them, as I prefer the really heavy, hearty WASAs. WASA breads can be served in many ways: they make great crackers to go with soups, stews or chilie, or to snack on plain or with butter spread on them. I like to eat them European style by making little open-faced sandwitches. A little cheese, maybe some meat, thinly sliced cucumber, onion or what have you. A great little snack.This is the ingredient list:Wheat flour, sesame seeds, water, yeast, canola and palm oil, sugar, salt. May contain traces of milk.Nutrition facts:  Calories 60  Total Fat 1.5g  Saturated Fat 1.5g  Trans Fat 1.5g  Sodium 85mg  Total Carbohydrate 9g  Dietary Fiber <1g  Sugars 0g  Protein 2gThe expiration date is 31 October 2012

I was first introduced to Wasa Sesame Crispbread in Sweden last year, and when I came home to the US  found them online and ordered a case. My wife has Croan's disease and has a hard time eating  any bread products and is able to have these with no ill effects. This is not only my favorite bread now but also my wife's, and 1 year old granddaughters. These are excellent with meats, cheese and most every dip we have tried  . We have tried the other Wasa crackers and have found them to be just so-so. The Sesame crackers are always in demand and will keep ordering cases.

Wasa Crisp Bread is an ideal product that is low sodium and high fiber that satisfies most nutritional needs.  I buy it due to past cardiac problems.  I buy it from Amazon since the grocery stores don't always carry the full range of WASA products.  Amazons quick service and very competitive prices are always welcome.
Wasa Crispbread is light, crunchy and full of flavor!  We've loved them for years.  They go fast around our house!

I love Sesame seeds and Whole Grain Rye.  This is however all Wheat flour and tastes like white bread.  It is also a smaller 7 oz instead of 9.8 oz.Less of an inferior product.  Notice it is manufactured in Germany and not Sweden.
Ordered these for my daughter who is away at college. Had them shipped to her dorm. These are her favorite crackers, and boy was she surprised to receive them as a "care package" from home!
These snacks are delicious and a must have if you love the original Ritz crackers. They came on time and most importantly they came fresh and no where near their expiration date.

Came ontime but the box it came in looks like someone dropped kicked it. Lucckly nothing was damaged inside and all the bags were still unopened and the crackers were not all in crumbs. They are very fresh and tastey.
The snacks arrived in a timely manner,are fresh tasting and are a great value. Nabisco snacks are a trusted friend!

I love these - I have to study a lot and watch my caloric intake because of inactivity and these are the best! I like this flavor the best and due to my many fruit allergies they are the only ones I feel safe eating - no allergic response at all!
One of the best K cup varieties around! Every drop is delicious, tastes better than a Tazo Chai from Starbucks and easier on the pocket book!

I look forward to this cup of Chai tea every evening.  It's PERFECT.  I actually like it better than what I previously paid 4 dollars for at THE coffeehouse.  It is creamy, sweet, and tasty.  I do recommend using a smaller keurig setting with it so it doesn't taste watered-down, but otherwise, it's seriously perfect.
The Cafe Escapes Chai Latte is AMAZING!! I've ordered a few times now and will continue to use this brand only for my chai. HIGHLY recommend!!!!
the flavor is very good, the price is in the ballpark, this is a good buy, don't hesitate on this one

column9: CAUTION: Contains Sucralose w/Artificial Sweetener Aftertaste!
column10: As another reviewer stated already, this is not labeled 'low calorie' or 'low sugar' so I didn't expect it to contain artificial sweetener. I guess that's my fault for assuming, as this does contain sucralose and has a terrible, artificial sweetener aftertaste. I understand that this taste apparently doesn't bother a lot of people, but I absolutely can't stand it and will be returning this product. I feel that this should be disclosed on the package a bit more prominently than just listed on the ingredients (I bought at Meijer, not at Amazon, where I was able to look at the package before purchasing). I know, I know, I should've checked the ingredients. I wish I would've. I'm only writing this review as a warning to anyone else who may be considering the purchase, but like me, hates that fake sugar flavor (not to mention putting whatever chemicals they use for that stuff into their body).
This Chai Tea is just the right amount of sweetness and great evening drink. I love my keurig and the chai tea is one of my top choices for a hot drink.

column9: I am addicted to this stuff!
column10: I ordered this when I bought a Keurig-K-cupKeurig B60 Special Edition Brewing System just to have something for friends who don't drink coffee. Wow, after trying one cup I became totally addicted to it. I am now drinking more of this than coffee. Who knew?

my daughter told me about this product; once i tried it; i have to have it every day. the flavor is fantastic, and it's very aromatic.it doesn't have any real caffeine; i'am caffeine sensitive; i can have a cup every morning and do not have any symptoms what so ever of caffeine problems. i highly recommend this product if you like cinnamon, and like teas, and coffee lovers will find this refreshing also.

This is the first Chai k-cup that I have tried and SCORE...it's amazing.  I'm actually drinking my first cup as I type this.  It's so good that I couldn't wait to review it.  It's sweet and tasty and simply deliciuos.  I used the small cup setting on my Keurig for this cup. I enjoy both my coffee & tea very sweet, but I actually don't need as much sugar for this chai tea.  I put in the same amount I normally do for tea, and it's extra sweet (but still great) so next time I know not to use as much sugar.I will definitely continue buying this one.

I was a little worried about trying a tea - my hot chocolate and cider attempts with my Keurig hadn't gone so well. I combined 2 6 oz. servings - absolutely delicious! Nice and spicy, not at all watery.
I LOVE THIS BRAND AND CHAI TEA IS BETTER THAN COFFEE, IT IS SO MUCH EASIER AND CHEAPER THAN GOING TO STARBUCKS, TASTES ALMOST THE SAME AND ITS QUICK IN THE MORNING
These are awesome Chai Lattes! And this was the best price I could find searching all over the net. I will definitely be ordering more very soon.
This is the best. used to buy chai latte at very expense shops. so glad that I can order the K-cups for home.
I'm not a coffee person this tea is great and the price is even better I recommened this to all tea drinkers
These Chai Latte K-cups are so delicious. I want to drink them all(the whole box)at once, but try to control myself. I wish they were calorie free, but no such luck!

I sure love chai tea and I was not dissapointed!!! It was just perfect! I brewed it on the 8oz setting like they recomended and I loved every drop! This I will buy always! I plan on brewing it,cooling it and putting it over ice in the summer!
I love this as a nice afternoon drink rather than coffee all day in my Keurig , I just wish there was a little more in the cups since it has to be on a 6 oz cup size or it will taste watery

column9: The ONLY Chai latte I love!
column10: This is the BEST!  We have a Keurig--99.9 % for hubby and his coffee---but, I found this Cafe Escape Chai Latte...and O'yum! Winner! I always take a few portions w/me when we go away for a few days, and just empty in a cup and ask the waitress for Hot Water!  LOVE this!

Was buying different K-CUPs to try and taste, but once I purchased this one,...oh my GOD !!!The whole family loves it, I cannot keep in my house, its gone within a few days, kids and wifedrink for breakfast, lunch and dinner ...................

Just aroma and spice-wise, I actually prefer the Celestial Seasonings India Spice Chai k-cups with a bit of milk added after it's done (http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B004779XHI/ref=oh_o01_s01_i01_details).

column9: Love chai - love Keurig - love these K-cups!
column10: I'm addicted to these chai k-cups.  It tastes sooo good and much cheaper than fixing my chai cravings at Starbucks.  Highly recommend!!

The spice blend is great, as is the sweetening and the dairy component.  This is the kind of thing I was hoping I could get from my single-serve coffeemaker!Order some, you will thank yourself every time you brew a cup.

If you do like sweet drinks, though, everything else about this was 5 star. So, I guess it depends on preference. Wish I had ordered this in a sampler because I don't think I'll be able to finish them all.

Got this as a present for my son for our Keurig. His only comment was that it tasted alittle sweeter than when he made regular Chai lattes for himself at home. At first I couldn't find it locally, that is why I ordered it from Amazon, but have found it now and a good bit cheaper  FYI.

column9: Not a bad chai latte but expensive
column10: If I could I'd give it 3.5 stars.The flavor isn't terrible. Not as good as a real chai latte of course but it has decent chai flavor and is relatively creamy. I do wish it was a bit spicier though (could probably mix this with real chai tea). Definitely would not buy a keurig just for these since there's readily available chai latte powders that are just as quick to make at a much cheaper price.
This Chai Latte is a "go to" when you want a little something sweet or just to relax and enjoy the moment.  Great product that is always on the mark.
I'm particular when it comes to chai tea but I drink it often. This kind, not so good. I'm going to have to try and sell it on craigslist or something

It's just like what I get from the coffee shop.  Having these available to me have pretty much guaranteed I will never order another one ever again.  And only takes 2-3 minutes to brew.
Awesomely easy cup of tea. For an extra dose of self satisfaction, add a squirt of whipped cream!Chai tea is also good for you so drink up.
My goodness, I love this stuff!!!  It is sweet, while not being too sweet.  I have turned all my friends onto it.
Cafe' Escapes Chai Latte K Cups-it taste so smooth and it's a quick treat for the middle of the Day just sweet enough.
This is the best price around for the quantity of kculs per box....stock up!!!!Café Escapes Chai Latte, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count

This is the best tea latte I have ever had.  Drink it daily and really enjoy the flavor.  I've found it in the warehouse section of Amazon.com and it's really a bargain price!  Cafe Escapes has other products and all the ones I've tried have been great.  Do not hesitate to order this!

I searched everywhere. Even discount stores. And buying in bulk (I purchased 3, which got me free shipping) meant that I paid even less than the sales prices with coupons at TJ Maxx or some other similar discount store for exactly the same brand. They taste great. I will definitely order again. They came on time when promised. You cannot do better that that anywhere, ever!
This chai tea is absolutely delicious. Very creamy and full of flavor. I mix it with the Starbucks Sumatra coffee for a tasty drink.  Buy it - you won't regret it!!

i'm a huge fan of chai tea's i find it very relaxing and mind clearing! usually before i start drinking a freshly brewed cup of chai tea, i will stick my nose in the cup and take a few deep breath, the aroma just clears my mind and relaxes me, then i sip slowly until its all gone, its great hot or over ice!I enjoy a slice of marble pound cake with my chai tea!

I have to say this is the most amazing taste I have ever had.  I searched everywhere for this.  The few stores in our town that carries these are always out of stock of this flavor.  It normally sells out the first day they get the shipment it.... Most I have to resort to buying my supply online here.  This stuff has everything in it and no need to add more the flavor is just perfect.
This is my favorite flavor.  I'm not sure it has the same amount of caffiene as regular coffee, but it's too good not to drink every morning.

If you like Chai Latte tea and don't want to fuss with making it the 'old Fashion" way, this is a good alternative.  Of course, you have to own a K-Cup coffee machine.  I've bought a few of these boxes of 24 k-cups.  The last time I ordered them they came in a package of 2 boxes (48 total) for about $32.  Now it looks like amazon is selling them as 1 box (24 k-cups) for about $18.  To me the key to buying this (or almost any item) on amazon is to do a search first.  There are many different sellers here and they all seem to have different prices and a different number of k-cups in their boxes.  Some add shipping and some have free shipping.As far as the tea goes, I really like it and would highly recommend it!
This tea is delicious, the hint of cinnamon helps to relax and soothe.  A great drink for when you want to kick back and relax.

column9: This is a Must Have in My House
column10: If you are a Chai Latte fan, you must try this product!  I 'spoil' myself with a cup whenever I'm off a day from work.
Love the flavor!  Not too strong, but not weak - just right.  My favorite morning drink!  I do not have to add any sugar, cream , or milk.  It is perfect the way it comes.
This is my favorite flavor to use with my Kuerig coffee maker.  It is the perfect way for me to start and/or finish any day.

column9: Cant Beat the Flavor.Better than any Coffee Shop
column10: I love this tea. It is so good and also wonderful if you add a little milk or half/half after it is brewed. Its also has less caffiene than what you would get at any local coffee shop. Can only hope they come out with a Vanilla chai tea.
Bought this for my wife she says it isn't Starbucks but it is the best Chai Tea to come out of a machine.
These are really tasty.  If you enjoy the Chai Latte from the popular coffee shops, you will love this.  Highly recommended.

This is the best tasting tea I have ever had.It reminds me of the Holidays,especially Christmas Holidays.It has a taste I cannot describe but is rich in flavor.Although I cannot find it easily in town,it seems this tea is carried most during Holiday Seasons so I looked on the net and found the price out of range till I looked on Amazon.Thanks Amazon.

column9: Buy the larger box - You'll thank me later!
column10: If you like Chai, this will be your new favorite!  So yummy!  Our only problem was that we kept running out!

column9: Even A Non-Coffee Drinker Loves It
column10: We've had the Keurig a whole week and the only flavor/box that's gone completely is this one. It's a household favorite. My husband who detests coffee drinks and most hot drinks, loves this tea as do I. We have ordered another three boxes of it because it is fabulous. Very reminiscent of the chai latte you can buy hot from one of the big coffee stores. Highly recommended.
Good Chai- cheaper than coffee houses. Convenient in the Keurig machine. Got it through Amazon, which was less expensive than other options.

This is my favorite keurig drink variety so far.  I found the chai tea latte flavor smooth and delicious, and with no strange aftertaste.  I almost purchased this item last week, but was hesitant because of some of the reviews.  Then, I received a free sample.  Wow!  So glad, otherwise I might have missed out on a great product.  Will definitely be buying more in the future!

If you like hot tea with milk and sugar, you will love this chai latte.  It has a slight cinnamom flavor, but otherwise, not nearly as exotic as it sounds.  I have also become hooked on this, my new favorite flavor of K-cups.

These taste great, but you can only make small cups. The K cup actually empties out, so if you have a large traveling mug, you might want to make 2-3 small cups (using different K Cups) to get the full flavor. But, I love it!
