Illy issimo caffè Italian espresso style coffee drink is a 6.8 fl. oz. (200 ml) blast of sweetened caffeine in a can.1930s Italy under the rule of Mussolini greatly contributed to the development of modern coffee culture, improved coffee-making, and new types of coffee-making equipment. The Horn of Africa (where coffee originated) was under Italian colonization and companies such as illy and Bialetti were founded.In that tradition, this drink is now made in Denmark under the issimo brand from illy and distributed in the U.S. by Coca-Cola.This canned cappuccino has a slightly bitter dark roast coffee taste with the right amount of sugar and a pleasant mouthfeel. It's not as good as freshly made espresso but it's not bad at all. I do prefer the illy issimo cappucino as a treat.

column9: NOT white chocolate chips, and bad tasting
column10: This are NOT white chocolate chips since they don't contain any cocoa butter in them, that's why they're labeled "Classic White" instead of "White chocolate". They don't taste good and their flavor is nothing near the true white chocolate flavor.The ingredients:Sugar, palm kernel oil, whole milk powder, nonfat dry milk, palm oil, soy lecithin, vanilla.The only good thing about them is that they don't contain any partially hydrogenated oils (=trans fat) like the nestle's white chips.

I thought these chips would be the same excellent quality as the Ghirardelli White Chocolate bar.  Instead of cocoa butter, which is the main ingredient in really good white chocolate, these chips have both palm kernel AND palm oil. This is very disappointing, since other Ghirardelli products I have tried have been excellent.  Don't waste your money on these expensive, horrible-tasting white chocolate chip wannabes.

column9: Listing is misleading - No cocoa butter to be found
column10: For some reason I thought these were white chocolate - you know, the kind with cocoa butter.  Silly me for assuming that Ghiradelli would sell chocolate (or at the very least products containing ingredients from the cacao plant).  The only thing these have in common with the cacao plant is that they are produced by a company with chocolate in their name.  Disappointing flavor and funny texture.  Not at all what I thought I was buying.

column9: Ghirardelli changed the ingredients and the product name
column10: I used to buy Ghirardelli white chips specifically because they were the only ones that I could find that contained cocoa butter.  A few years back they changed the formulation to not include white chocolate/cocoa butter, and removed the word "chocolate" from the product name (Amazon needs to update their title too).  Recently I was able to find "real" white chocolate chunks (not chips) at Whole Foods and I buy them for my cookies instead now.  Ghirardelli, if you are listening, the only reason I bought your brand instead of your competitors is because you used to use cocoa butter in your white chips.  The White chocolate chips are what introduced me to your brand and now I buy your baking bars, your milk and semi sweet chocolate chips, your candy, your hot cocoa and more - easily spending $200+ annually on Ghirardelli products.  If these chips were on the market without cocoa butter 8 years ago, I wouldn't be buying anything from your brand today.  Please reverse the bad corporate decision that was made and restore cocoa butter to this product.  Having no cocoa butter in your white chips changes your image from a premium brand to just a regular brand.

I bought these chips elsewhere, and not from Amazon.  Once I opened the package to taste them, I was very disappointed.  Ghirardelli chocolates aren't the most expensive out there, but not cheap either, so I was surprised by the subpar taste.  It tastes like powdered milk, and definitely not very smooth, either.  I thought that I had accidentally grabbed a bag that was past its expiration date or that I had left the bag sitting out in summer heat, but there was nothing that I had done wrong.  After I did an online search to see what others had to say about about these chips, I found that I was not the only one who did not like these.  Sure, they may be all natural, but for about $5 a bag, I would probably settle for Toll House morsels for a bit less if I didn't have any other choice.Next time, I will have to make sure that the next bag of white chocolate chips I buy contains cocoa butter, which these do not.  Cocoa butter really makes all the difference, and if you're aiming to bake gourmet quality goods with white chocolate, you might want to pass on these.

column9: Think butterfinger layers with Baby Ruth taste.
column10: Baby Ruths have always been one of my favorite American chocolate bars, so when I saw this crisp bar I figured I would give it a try, well I am glad I did it has that Baby Ruth taste, but also a bit of Butterfinger stemming from the crisp layers.  I also like that the bar comes in two pieces rather than one whole bar, this makes it a little easier to only eat a half and put the other piece down for later or share with a friend. As far as what kids might think well  I included somet in our child's soccer team's end of the game treat bag  as the sweet item.  Let me just say that wow,  they weere a big hit with parents and kids asking about them.  I only hope Amazon puts them on sale again.

I enjoyed these a lot, but they aren't an improvement on the real Baby Ruth.  I found both the Butterfinger Crisp Candy Bar, 5.64-Ounce Snack Tray (Pack of 24) and the Nestle Crunch Crisp Candy Bar, 5.36-Ounce Snack Tray (Pack of 24) to be better than the original, but these are missing the nougat so they don't exactly taste like a Baby Ruth.  They are still very delicious, but again it is missing something.  The crispy wafers are layered in chocolate with peanuts and carmel on top to make a great treat.  They are two smaller bars per package, so you could be good and just eat one, though I can't see why you would.
These are basically a rebranded Nutty Bar. They don't really have a caramel nougat taste. Just crispy peanut butter and chocolate. They taste pretty good.

Please note that Sweet 'n Low sugar free frostings are "sugar free." However, if you're diabetic, you are going to ingest something that has a higher impact on raising your blood glucose than does a regular sugared frosting! Maltodextrin is the first ingredient listed on Sweet 'n Low frostings. Athletes use maltodextrin in energy drinks and foods to give them a *BURST* of glucose. My diabetic family members' postprandial glucometer readings were incredibly high after eating this. I've written the company about the impact of their product & to stop touting it as a "must for diabetics," but they never responded. PLEASE, please, please realize that if you're a diabetic, eating maltodextrin is worse than eating sugar as it has a quick, rising impact on blood sugar--unhealthy for diabetics. It's your job as a consumer to be informed. I hope this helps diabetics out there who are enjoying this product not testing afterwards to see their blood glucose skyrocket.

This frosting is sweet, and it is low in calories.  Whenever I come across the term "cloying" I think of this frosting.  It is sweet and sticky and has an obvious chemical taste.  I also have had difficulty obtaining a frosting like consistency.  I enjoy using the Sweet 'N Low cake mixes so the first few times I used this product I assumed I had not followed the directions properly. (Okay, so the directions were basically to add water and beat.)  If you have to have sugar free frosting on your cake I suggest using the Sans Sucre brand dessert mousse mix and spreading it quickly on the cake as you would a whipped frosting.

I had gastric bypass surgery last year and I am not able to eat sugar.  In fact, there are very few "sweets" that I am able to indulge in at all. This frosting reminds me of the butter cream signature icing that my favorite bakery has!  All you have to do is add very cold water and beat it for five minutes.  I use the power boost button I have on my hand mixer at the highest speed and it works perfectly.  The final product is extremely thick, smooth, and creamy.  I highly recommend this frosting!

There are many diabetics in my family, so I like to prepare sugar-free desserts.  ALL my family members who are diabetic (my mother, 2 brothers, my son, etc.) have eaten my sweet,N Low cakes AND frosting with NO elevation of their blood sugar (which they monitor closely). They love the taste and so do I. I'm not diabetic, but I still limit my sugar intake for weight reduction and it's healthier. I like the vanilla frosting and chocolate cake mix the most. As with anything you eat, MODERATION is the key (although it tastes so good it's easy to over-indulge).  It works for us!!!!

Tropicana has gone the way of others in reducing the real juice in their product and adding flavor enhancers hidden under the words "Natural Flavors" which means the additions of a vegetable extract called glutamic acid.  This extract is bad news for your body.  This allows them to add more water and less juice.  Buy another brand. The apple juice flavor is weak at best.

These candies are as good as the similar ones with no jelly filling!  They melt in your mouth fast and allow you to put another one in your mouth immediately afterward.  Be sure to FLOSS afterward to get all the jelly out from between your teeth though.

The title I have chosen for my review pretty much says it all.  I was expecting the item shown in the picture, however the mints that I received weren't white (as pictured) but instead a butter-yellow color, which made even wanting to taste them unappealing.  I thought that because they were yellow instead of white that they must be OLD.  I checked the date on the package and was pleasantly surprised to see that they were indeed reasonably, "supposedly" fresh stock.  Next came the disappointing TASTE test.  It too was a failure!  Where was that MINTY taste I was hoping for, when I placed my order?  The worst part is that when I finally got around to complaining or "attempting" to return the disappointing mints - the time to do so had expired 5 days ago. Keep this in mind - if you are not happy with the product, DO NOT procrastinate in sending the item back. Do it right away so this doesn't happen to you. My review: Appearance=POOR, Taste=POOR.

I have tried the Taste Adventure dried soups in a few varieties: curried lentil, black bean, green split pea, and yellow spit pea.  The yellow split pea is my favorite.  I keep the pouches in a drawer at work.  When hunger hits, I just pour one into a large mug, add hot water and stir, wait a few minutes, and Voila!: a tasty, filling, hot and super-easy lunch.

column9: Best Instant Soup I've Ever Had
column10: This soup is so convenient and healthy too.  All you have to do is add hot water and cover it really.  Lots of instant soups with the water already added have the can factor which gives it a different taste and is not a BPA free can.  The taste on this soup is superior to what you can get in a can.  It basically serves two per package but I usually eat the whole thing myself.

column9: want to try, but s&h too high & a lie-48ozs is not 6 lbs !!!!!!
column10: the product description says this weighs 6 lbs.  what a sham. it = 3 lbs.  i would like to buy these, but they  charge so much for the product itself, the s&h needs to be complimentary. in fact, i'll wager lots of low carb dieters would like to buy these, but no one wants to help others rip us off. that's why the 3 stars.

I must admit that I am only a casual coffee drinker. However, I love nothing more than to relax with a nice cup of coffee after dinner. Kahve Koffee's Decaf Danish blend does the trick for me. Not only did this coffee win several awards in blind taste tests, but it is reasonably priced too! I strongly recommend this award-winning blend for all coffee drinkers. And for those of you, nay-sayers that turn their nose up to decaf coffee, just give it a try, I guarantee that you won't be able to taste the difference.

column9: Horrible, Bitter, All Salt & Chemical Taste
column10: If I could give it zero stars I would!! I have never tasted anything so bitter in a seasoning salt before! There is something in this that is not right. It made me queasy after sprinkling a little on a boiled egg to test it. I don't know if there is some chemical they used to keep it from not clumping or what but that is what it tasted like, chemicals and salt. In fact saltier than salt. The rest of the ingredients were hidden.It was not worth buying at any price or getting for free, these went in the trash because I was worried there was something wrong with this that would make other people sick.I have bought other items from this line and they are fine but this...vomit worthy.

column9: Great Flavor... but very little spice
column10: I bought this Tabasco variety thinking it was the spicy soy sauce that they make (my mistake.)  I was still excited to receive it in the mail, and started making chicken Teryaki that evening.  The sauce has a great sweet, and very, very mild spiciness to it.  It does taste good... but calling it 'spicy' is a HUGE stretch, it is probably only 10-20% as spicy as regular Tabasco or Sriracha at best.
Turkey is the first ingredient, which is a pleasant surprise for a cheap canned food.  My cats love it.  Canned food is much better than dry food because cats do not drink enough water.

My cats enjoy this food, and it is of good quality, however, now that I am a regular subscriber I have found that someone is being very careless in packaging and delivery.  My last order arrived in a box that was too big, poorly packed, and half opened at my door.  When I looked inside, I found several cans had exploded and many more were all dented and loose inside the box.  What a mess!  So, after a long day at work, I found myself rinsing and inspecting cans of cat food.  The price has gone up also, and at this point I am thinking it would be less trouble to buy from the pet store again.  At least I won't end up with a mess at my door!

Prior to the last few orders, I hadn't run into problems with the packing. On the last canned Friskies cat food orders, I get poorly packed boxes and dented as well as popped open cans which I then have to throw away and clean off the mess on the other cans. The product is good, whoever is packing isn't doing a good job.
This is so much easier coming to the house that shopping at store for it. When you place an order, it comes in about 3 days .

column9: Very Happy Cats ! and Subscription saved my Couch
column10: We live in The Keys and two cats have adopted us. Have you ever run out of Catfood and your Cat will retaliate by scratching your Couch until you feed him? We now get 2 cases of Friskies Delivered every 2 months for about 10 bucks a case which is alot cheaper than On sale at W-D. Thanks Amazon , great service and fresh product.

column9: We'll eat it ONCE in awhile....
column10: This is one of those flavors that you keep around just for the extra "surprise" to get through using the same old food.  It isn't her favorite, but she does like it once in awhile for a change. Not sure what Poultry Platter means, but I can just about guess. Anyway, it smells fresh, doesn't stink ridiculously, and it's palatable.  Recommend.

I bought this cat food because of the wonderful low price and I enjoy the adorable cat on the commercials. My cats did eat this food, in fact they really enjoyed it. However, after reading the ingredients and doing some research, I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my cats. The first few ingredients are (which indicates the most prevalent ingredients) are Turkey, poultry by-products, water sufficient for processing, and meat by-products. At least there is turkey in it, but other than that its all nasty stuff. By-products aren't even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product. It is just not a good quality cat food. I suppose you get what you pay for. I think the only reason why it was cat-approved may be because it contains artificial flavors that taste good to cats and because I usually feed them dry food for dental reasons and wet food puts off much more of a scent for them to enjoy. I recommend to stay far away from Friskies, as it is simply a very low quality filler food. Other Friskies flavors are even worse than this one. Even though the price is quite inexpensive, your cat will actually eat more than if you paid for a better quality food, because they will never feel full. Cats need to eat real, identifiable, pure, meat, and there just isn't enough real meat in this food. When purchasing a cat (or dog) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you can identify and would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural foods such as Natural Balance, Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness. All of those brands contain real, whole meats that I myself would eat, with no added fillers or low quality foods.

If you are looking at this you probably have a cat or two. You also probably know how picky they are about what they want to eat. This is one of the flavors my two like. They don't like the newer morsels or the sliced. They want the pate.Buying from Amazon is much easier than buying at the local stores. Although I still fill in with some from the store. The cats seem to know what I have stocked up on and then want something different.I would give this 5 stars but it needs more gravy.

column9: Poultry Platter is the only one my cats agree on!
column10: I have three cats...one won't touch wet food at all, and two who are very finicky. Poultry Platter works for both of them! I split the can into three equal portions, then give a very little bit to one, and the rest to the other. Cutting it into three allows for one can a day. They're so spoiled I heat it for 9 seconds in my microwave! Good product!

My cats love this food, and it is much better than dry food.  Several things to note about the poultry platter:  it has turkey as its first ingredient, it is very high in protein content, it is very low in carb content, and it does not contain corn, wheat gluten, or soy products.  Yes, meat or poultry by-products are not as good as regular muscle meat, but what do you think the guts, brains, and eyes are of a cat's natural prey?  Not everyone can afford Wellness or Evo (3-4 times as expensive as Friskies) and even many of the more expensive brands have a higher carb content than Friskies pate or use vegetable products (for example peas) to raise their protein numbers.  This product certainly should be considered in a food rotation for someone who wants to feed their cats something other than kibble and is on a budget.
Good to find this at Amazon as it is a favorite among all my cats and not readily availale in this area..good basic cat food at reasonable price

column9: one of my old cat's favorites
column10: She loves the pates best so I get it for her. I have issues about killing one species to feed another and was looking into veggie cats..Ive known people with them and they were aok..but mine is old..and obese but that would be more reason to try vegetarianism.

column9: Decent beans, but a bit too much chocolate for me.
column10: These are tasty and for chocolate lovers possibly the ideal chocolate covered espresso bean.  I tend to prefer a thinner coat of chocolate so only four stars from me.

This is a very welcome product.  It is so difficult today to find any candies that are made without GMO's.  Having said that I must also say that I was astounded at the price listed.  I purchased these candies in a local supermarket for $3 a bag.  That is THREE, not thirty [when you add shipping].  Unreal's website lists many stores that will soon be carrying these products.  They are great everyday type candies I would recommend to anyone but not at the price listed.

My kid's love these! Two of my children are allergic to food dyes so this is a great alternative for them since they cannot eat M&M's. However, there is no way I will ever buy them here as I can get them in stores for under $5 for the same size bag. I hope this is a typo and there are several 10.7 oz bags included in this offer.

column9: Mediocre Candy, But a step in the right direction. I refuse to call it "Healthy"
column10: I did a little research about these candies because I was invited to try them free. On their website you're able to compare a bag of Peanut M&M's, their #54's, and an Orange.. (or compare regular M&M's to the #41's in this review, and fruit). I was glad to see the list that they don't use partially hydrogenated oils (Trans Fats)...which I strictly ban in our house (but so do most candies nowadays, Corn Syrup is not a big priority for me as I don't consume much of it (and candy is a rare treat), ....GMOs (i'm not sure if the M&M's do (the side by side comparison should have shown us what they were up against. What I didn't like was that they failed to mention the saturated fat (which is at least around 3-4 grams...), AND the threw fresh fruit into the comparison. Why are you comparing candy and fresh fruit? This makes consumers think that your product is "Healthy" when in fact it is still candy, and should still be enjoyed in moderation, like all sweets that are heavy in fats, saturated fats, and sugars.Also, the #41 candy mentioned was 8 grams less per bag, which makes up for some of the lower amount in calories per bag, among other things. I'm glad to see the lower amount of overall sugar, which is a plus. But really, as someone who has struggled with weight all their life, this is still candy, not health-food. Moderation is key, regardless of GMO's, or high-fructose corn syrups.As a taste test, my husband and I decided to start with the #54's first. Ultimately these became our favorite. But we only each had a couple pieces and decided to call it quits. The #41's were fine. We just didn't feel like the candy was worth finishing. And we didn't finish it. This candy might satisfy someones sweet tooth, but if i'm looking for a sweet treat, I know plenty of other things worth the splurge!Please, please, please Unreal, stop comparing your candy to fresh fruit!! :)

Love this water and how the alkalinity balances acid. Was so excited when I found it on Amazon delivered to my door instead of schlepping the case from the health food store. Disappointed however that it is no longer available.

These are a much brighter pink than expected, the bright pink in the picture is accurate.  They look really great!  I used them to coat cake balls and everyone remarked on their brightness.  They melted smoothly.

I've heard the Mercken's brand of melts works great for things like cake pops. My order did not come close to meeting these expectations. I think the package I received was old because after just 30 seconds in the microwave, the melts were crumbling and never melted. These are also very expensive for the amount you get. I would beware ordering these from Amazon - maybe the ones you buy in stores are ok, but I don't have a store nearby they are sold in.

column9: Product Great- Don't Order Online During Summer!
column10: I love Mercken's chocolate. It melts great and I never have any issues when making my cake pops. My only issue is I ordered 3 different chocolates from amazon and ALL THREE melted on the way here. Duh, obviously chocolate is going to melt when it's over 100 degrees in parts of the U.S., I just expected they would ship it appropriately. I returned all three and amazon was great with the return service. I had to go to a baking supply shop to buy them, which I was trying to avoid doing with my three toddlers. So, to summarize, Mercken's is great, but don't order online.
I am into whole grains and this Japonica is a wonderful rice!  It can stand alone or be used in soups, stews, etc.  The wonderful flavor of the rice shines through!!

A while back, I ordered one of each of every tea-tree foot/body powder I could find, to try them all out. I was looking for a natural alternative to the various anti-fungal medicated powders I'd been using for athletes-foot and jock-itch.On first glance I was unimpressed by this product. It's rather plain looking, and the label is even kinda wrinkled up like it was badly glued onto the cardboard tube.HOWEVER, after evaluating all of the powders, this one is BY FAR my favorite one!The first thing you'll notice is that it doesn't poof clouds of powder everywhere. Secondly, it has a pleasant tea-tree oil scent - not too strong - just right. It does an excellent job of cooling, relieving itch, and healing and preventing chafing.It is labeled as foot powder, and it does that job well, but it's great for an allover body powder - not too strong even for the "sensitive" areas!
Great item, awesome chips. well packaged and treated throughout transit, worth every penny! Item came 2 weeks sooner than projected and very pleased overall.

Usually I skip writing reviews for my purchases, but this time I was really impressed by the great service.I've ordered this tea as a Christmas gift for my mom, I've paid standart shipping and recieved my package the next day of my order.I found it really cute that the sticker on the packaging said "Hand Blend Irina" ( Irina being my mom's name)I haven't tried the tea yet, but it passed the sniff test, and it has real black currant berries and leafs in it.Lately it was really hard to find Black Currant loose leaf black tea, and I was really glad to find this seller who has it and provides such a wonderful service.Great Job!!!
I used this tea to make a black currant ice cream from the Perfect Scoop book. It tasted great! The tea has a beautiful smell.
Great tea with a full body flavor.  Much better than other currant teas that I have tried.  Would make a great iced tea as well.

I found these and decided to try them a while back. My four footed friends don't need the garbage (aka fillers) in their treats and these fit the bill.  My two dogs love these treats. Even my sensitive stomach boxer suffers no digestive stress (aka green clouds) from these.  I don't buy any others now. Highly recommended.

My dogs love these treats. They are the perfect size for a bone, not too large and easy to break in half. Can't find them at my local warehouse store so I came to Amazon to find them. Haven't tried the other flavors but these are a great organic and tasty (per Jack and Jill) treat for your furry family members.

I love Tazo products, Rooibos Organic Red Tea, and a good latte, but the flavor of this latte concentrate just didn't cut it for me.  It wasn't bad; it just was not what I expected from the description.

We've made the switch from Sojo's (oat based) to Honest Kitchen. We've got two dogs 40lbs & 61lbs so these 10lb boxes of food don't last too long. Also it doesn't mix the same as the other flavors (chicken, fish, plain), maybe because the beef flavor is almost a powder comparatively. Anyways, the dogs slop it up just the same. We add other vitamins and nutrients in with the mix so they get the broad spectrum. We also add a 1/4 cup of regular kibble (Blue Buffalo) just to make it go a little farther and bigger in their stomach so they're aren't whining for food in a couple hours.We also buy from a local shop because their price is spot on, plus it's good to help the local places.
my dogs love this food.  they cry at the counter when i make it.  they clean the bowls spotless making sure not to miss a drop.

column9: Good food - best price I've found
column10: Amazon had the best price for Honest Kitchen dog food.  We were recommended to try this food because our dog has allergies.  The food was gobbled up quickly, but unfortunately didn't have much affect on the allergies over time.  We've since switched to another food for the next several months, and will hope to see a change.  But Honest Kitchen is good food, human grade quality (but made for dogs) - and the ratings with most dog food rating companies show this food is very highly rated.

This almond paste is a great product, it just that there is a lot of it.  I wish they would produce a 1 or 2 pound can.  One good thing is we can make a lot of almond cookies with it.The paste works well in recipes and turns out without being gritty which was a problem trying to make our own past.  Good flavor and no noticeable difference in finished product from home made.  this will work with just about any recipe that calls for almonds in a paste or even in some cases a powder form.

I love Amazon!  I ordered this on Tuesday for my weekend baking and we received it on Thursday.  Best price around and delivered right to the door.  Easy peasy!  The can was a bit dented on the bottom, but the contents were not affected.

I routinely purchase my dog treats through Amazon, for convenience, cost and quality. Unfortunately my last few orders of the Beefeaters Duck Fillets (1 lb jar) have been dry and powdery. My dog still eats them but I have to augment the snack with others. I depend on Amazon but quality control isclacking....?

I was just about to give these to my dogs and realized that they are made in China.  Unfortunately I realized too late and cannot return them.  In the trash they go.  They could be a good product, but I'm not going to take a chance.  I've heard too many scary stories about treats and food from China.  My pets are not worth taking that risk with.

they don't say that these are made in CHINA!  I sent them back immediately.  Google for all natural made in the USA jerky treats, they are the same price and take Paypal, and you wont risk your dogs life with a product made from who knows what.
But the vendor is going to fix it. My five stars are for the vendors response. BTW my dog loves these (when they are dry and crunchy). It's his after dinner snack and has been now for 5 years.
My lab thought these were the greatest. It's basically chicken jerky for dogs - so a bit tough and they have to chew for awhile...similar to rawhide.

People who are used to our typical American high-salt diet would complain as did another reviewer,because what they don't recognize is that to them, ketchup tastes like SALT, and so does much of the rest of their diets.As you reduce your salt intake, you become more sensitive to the taste and actually need much less for food to taste good.  In other words, you begin to be able to actually TASTE again, instead of having over-loaded salt-burn-out taste buds.  And you become more healthy.This product is a lifesaver for my husband, who has been placed on a very restricted diet.  Millions in America are going to be forced into this postion because so much of what they eat is fat, salt, sugar and corn syrup.  Keep this up, and you end up having NO ketchup, mustard, gravy, sauces of any kind including tomato, etc.  Everything is just straight up plain and boring.  This ketchup is one of the very few things that work (this product, and Kens Honey Mustard (regular version) which has only 130 mg sodium in a serving instead of 270 and up like most dressings.)
Liked the fact that this item was salt free, but it was so very sweet & didn't really even taste like Ketchup at all.

column9: Are you sure this is Decaf?
column10: Best flavor of all the decaf's on here.  My hat is off to Green Mountain.

We recently purchased the Green Mountain Decaf French Vanilla K-cups from Amazon. The price was good and the coffee is excellent!  When we need more we will definetly contact Amazon.  The service was great, the price, and the quality of coffee was outstanding.  We didn't wait long for the coffee to arrive either. Everything  was great!

column9: Wife likes it so I am happy!
column10: I love the Keurig, it makes me feel all Star Trek. Wife and father-in-law like the decaf. It makes them happy so I am happy!
I got a new Kuerig coffee maker for Christmas and this is the first coffee I have used but it is so good I don't plan on buying anything different because this is delicious.

You know that first sip of coffee you take? You can feel the warm liquid go all the way down. There's nothing like it. I loved flavored coffee but do not like hazelnut. I cannot find french vanilla decaf in any store. I got a Keurig for Christmas and I can now drink french vanilla decaf in the evening. I love me some coffee! Beware of of Amazon selling it as a pack of two. It's cheaper to buy two individually (2 units) than it is to buy together (one unit). My only "complaint" is that this only comes in a light roast. I prefer full, deep bodied coffee but I will take what I can get in decaf for evenings.
This is the best KCUP ever. It is fantastic... sweet. It doesn't have to much caffine but just enough. The flavor is fantastic. Great Price!

I bought some Honest Kitchen Embark for my two miniature poodles and they really love the food. Then I saw an offer for a free sample of Zeal. They also love this food and the ingredients are very good for them. I've started feeding them grain free foods for the past year or so since one of the dogs has bad allergies. But most grain free foods contain white potatoes which are very high carbohydrate. The allergic dog can tend to overweight so I also try to limit her carbohydrate intake. Zeal is one of the lowest carbohydrate foods HK makes. The food is very easy to re-hydrate. Just add equal amounts of food and water, stir, and wait 5-10 minutes. That 5-10 minutes is sheer torture for my dogs as they sit at the base of the cabinet and stare up at their bowls.

Zeal is perfect for our 14y.o. pup ;) He was diagnosed with kidney disease two Thanksgivings ago, and we needed a grain free alternative to the standard canned kidney diet. (He has been seriously grain intolerant all of his life). We feed him small amounts every 4 -6 hours, and because we re-hydrate the Zeal, we can easily adjust the amount of water he is getting depending on his activities, to be sure he stays well hydrated.It does smell of fish, but he does so well on it that that is a price we will happily pay :) Plus, Honest Kitchen just started packaging the mix in a heavy duty, resealable ziplock bag, YAY! so there is no longer any lingering fish smell in the laundry room!

The Honest Kitchens formulas are human grade raw ingredients and offer a variety of grain free formulas that I cannot find elsewhere. I use this as a base for my raw diet which consists of a rotation of chicken, turkey, duck and lamb. I had their nutritional analysis done after almost a year on this plan.  I was refunded the cost of the analysis for both dogs, as their blood work was perfect.  I do rotate between zeal, embark and force. Highly recommend either alone or with raw.

As a result of this new diet, my dog is off all medications and is having zero problems with reflux.

column9: Milk-Bone Dog Treats - Digest of Poultry By Products?
column10: WHAT!!When you understand what the buzz words mean, you become an educated and informed consumer capable of making a good choice for your pet and your money pouch.  So many of my friends' dogs are sick with cancer and other diseases.  Whay are they eatting...?  I made the choice will you; or do you like to have your ears tickled?The Painful Truth:You really do get what you pay for when it comes to pet food, as illustrated in Ann N. Martin's book, Food Pets Die For. First published in 1997 and updated in 2003, Martin's book was the first to expose the ingredients legally used by pet food companies, including euthanized cats and dogs, zoo animals, roadkill, and diseased and rotted meat unfit for human consumption. Lest you think that what Martin documented isn't widespread, she writes:"In later investigations in both the US and Canada, I was to learn that the collars, tags, flea collars, and even plastic bags in which (euthanized) pets are wrapped, are not removed before they are shoved in the rendering pit. Deceased pets are being 'recycled' into pet food, and pet owners have no knowledge of what is happening."* Poultry by-product meal. By-products can include: intestines, chicken heads, duck bills, chicken and turkey feet, feathers and bone, soy, cottonseed hulls, corn cobs, peanut hulls, citrus pulp, screenings, weeds, straw, and cereal by-products. Ingredients listed as beef, chicken and poultry by-products are not required to include actual meat. Rendered meat can be ANY rendered mammal meat, including cats and dogs. If the ingredient contained enough meat that it could be measured, it would be labeled as MEAT.* Digest of chicken by-products. Animal digest is a cooked-down broth made from unspecified parts of unspecified animals. Any kind of animal can be included, and the animals can be obtained from any source, so there is no control over quality or contamination.* Corn gluten meal. Corn gluten is a cheap by-product of human food processing. It offers little nutritional value and serves mainly to bind food together.* Soybean meal. Soybean meal is a poor quality protein filler. The Crude Protein analysis on pet food labels is only a measurement of the amount of nitrogen in a food -- not the quality of the protein. Because of this, pet food companies can use the cheaper by-products of human food production, such as soybean meal, to boost protein numbers.

I've been buying the Gevalia Signature Blend T-Discs for a few years and have been getting them from Amazon for most of that time. We just opened our latest shipment of Gevalia Signature Blend (3-pack) from Amazon and have found the T-Discs to be defective.  The foil around the center "port" is not secure all the way around and during brewing, the seal fails and the T-Discs "explode" for lack of a better word.  Essentially, the pressure in the T-Disc builds up, the foil seal around the port fails (and rips further) and the pressurized coffee grounds are expelled out of the T-Disc.  If the Tassimo is opened at this time, the grounds go EVERYWHERE.After trying a number of these discs and observing the result, trying other discs (Maxwell House) which don't have this issue, and finally dissecting some of the Gevalia Discs that hadn't been through the brewing process, I found the issue being the foil not being sealed sufficiently around the center port.  The Lot Number on these discs is J5411054 and have a Best When Used By date of "2012 FEB/FE 18".I've called Tassimo (800 number is on the T-Disc packages) and they are sending replacements.  They said this is a rare occurrence.If you have had this same issue, please post here with the Lot Number.I will still continue to order these T-Discs from Amazon, but am taking a break until I have tried the replacement discs from Tassimo.  In the meantime, I'll just be using the Maxwell House T-Discs that I also purchase from Amazon.I'm giving this 2 stars for now.  Prior to this situation, I would have rated these T-Discs as 4 stars. column9: Good for Everyday Cooking and Dipping; Great Price
column10: I use this oil for everyday cooking, salad dressings, and dipping. There are many other better, more expensive oils. Some are worth paying for, and others aren't. Most average American cooks don't know and can't tell the difference. Of course, cooking with extra virgin olive oil is generally not done because most extra virgin oil is usually too expensive and flavorful for most daily recipes. Even average home chefs should understand that. Many people will not use an entire gallon quickly enough before the oil turns rancid. And it's my advice that unless you know you will use the entire gallon quickly enough, you should probably buy olive oil -- extra virgin or otherwise - by the liter. My current gallon doesn't indicate the origin of the olive oil, but in the past, I have read that Genco contains a mixture of oils from Spain, Italy and Tunisia. It stands to reason that olive oil might be cheaper from Spain and Tunisia, because some people believe that those countries produce less premium products than Italy. That may be true, and it might not. From my last two visits in Spain, I found the olive oil to be of high quality, and quite a bit cheaper than Italian brands. But, let your taste buds -- and the price -- be the judge. I buy my Genco at Sunflower Market in Denver, Colorado, so I don't have to pay for shipping. And, Sunflower has other comparably-priced olive oils whose origin is Spain. Since I don't have a way to analyze oil, I guess I will have to trust that these oils are genuine. I guess it is possible that they aren't. In the meantime, I will continue to buy this oil. Thus far, I have finished 3 gallons for myself, my fiancée and our many dinner guests. So far, I have received zero complaints, and I have convinced others to buy this brand.

column9: Ok taste, but misleading nutritional info and pricey
column10: Just The Cheese Barbeque flavor are just about right to my taste: a little too salty, not extraordinarily cheesy, with just a tang of BBQ flavoring. Maybe I have a weird palate, but I'm not hating these snacks like most reviewers do.So why only two stars? For one, JTC brand is hardly "just the cheese." Pull up a chair while I recall the ingredients (other than the cheese) in the Barbeque flavor: powdered cellulose, salt, tomato, torula yeast, spices, dehydrated garlic and onion, natural smoke flavor, paprika, sodium diacetate, inosinate and guanylate, sucralose, and silicon dioxide. Got all that?Two, JTC brand proudly boasts "1 g carbohydrate per serving." Perfect, in other words, for low-carb diets. If you look at the back of the Herb & Garlic flavor, one serving is about 18 pieces, 150 calories, and contains 10 grams protein. So a bag contains two servings. All well and good. Until you get to the Barbeque flavor, where one serving is 9 pieces, 75 calories, and contains 5 grams protein. So the Barbeque bag, which contains the same 2 oz. as the Herb & Onion flavor, has twice as many servings! In other words, JTC brand has toyed with the serving size so they can boast 1 g carbohydrate per serving. Unless you're on an ultra-low carb diet, those few extra carbs won't matter much. But manipulating the serving size to get that crucial "1 g carbohydrate per serving" is dishonest in my book.And finally, JTC brand is too expensive for what you get. I know that cheese isn't cheap, and that JTC brand is a smaller company not affiliated with any of the big names like Nabisco. But a little over two dollars is a bit much for a small bag, even if the texture does relieve a chips craving.

Too good to be true it turned out....as they stopped selling the machine several months later and on April 1st the pods were no longer available in retail stores.  So I kept purchasing pods thru Amazon.  Until May....when I saw that they no longer in stock.  And no longer in stock anywhere online....including the Senseo Store on their own website.  Well I just called Senseo today, June 7th, 2012, to complain and they said they they "should" have coffee pods back in stock mid-June.....and they said Amazon "should" have pods the 1st week of July.  That wasn't good enough for me.  They sell (and then stop selling) a coffee maker and then claim they cannot supply the coffee pods due to operations problems and changes with their manufacturing.  I love my Senseo brewer a lot but it is too much of a struggle to get the pods....or wait for them....and I am not convinced that this won't be the case again the future.  So the people at Senseo (Sara Lee, Inc actually) helped me make a decision.....that I will be disposing of my 8 month old Senseo brewer next week when my current pod supply runs out and I will be replacing it with a new K-Cup machine.

From all the original Senseo Coffee Pods, I like this variety best.I follow the rules and prepare it using the Senseo HD7003 Espresso Pod Holder - that means it will be a smaller cup (not really as little as an Italian Espresso shot), but you can always use your regular Pod Holder, if that is too strong for you.The prepared coffee has a nice Crema and great taste. In the morning I heat some milk in the microwave and whip it using an Aerolatte Frother to make a very quick Cappuccino - the way I like it :)

Apparently, Senseo has decided to abandoned the US market. It is nearly impossible to find Senseo at any of the traditional retailers, including Amazon, Walmart, or Target. Walmart is carrying Melitta brand pods that work in the Senseo, but the quality is not as good.It is interesting to note Amazon continues to list the Senseo brand in email blast, but the items are always out of stock. I wrote Senseo customer service about the issue, but they failed to respond.I'm going back to Costco brand ground coffee and the old reliable Mr. Coffee or Bunn for the morning jolt. I refuse to buy into another expensive pod or k-cup single serve system that changes as often as Gillette changes razor blade models.

Had some of this on back order - four boxes of six bags each.  Yesterday they were $26.04 a box.  Look at today!!!After being out of production,  I suppose we should be happy to have availability at all,  eh?

column9: Good coffee, but let's not pretend it's Kona coffee
column10: This is one of the better tasting Senseo pods out there, but it is not Kona coffee.  It contains only 10% Kona coffee, the other 90% is something else.  If you want Kona coffee, go buy Kona coffee.  This Kona "blend" won't taste anything like it.Names aside, as I stated this is one of the better tasting Senseo pods.  Four stars are based on rating Senseo coffee.  It would get less stars if I was just rating "coffee".

Senseo pods are very convenient and reasonably priced--I only wish the brew was a little more "tasty".  Since I don't like dark-roast beans/coffee, I ordered the "medium roast".  Much to my surprise, it is TOO mild for me!  This is particularly so since a pod really is only intended to make an 8 oz. cup of coffee.  My coffee maker allows me to use up to 12 oz. of water and then it's really way too mild/weak.The Senseo pods are ordered by the case, so it's going to take me a long time before I can try a stronger brew.  My recommendation is to be sure and try all the flavor options before ordering a full case of pods.

Based on the reviews, I ordered a 6 pack of these.  BAD IDEA.We have tried a number of different varieties of pods,  these are by far the worst.This stuff is so bad no one here will drink it.You might want to buy one bag and try it before ordering a 6 pack.
Not as strong as the regular dark coffee.  Disappointing after having Sumatra at Starbucks. Wouldn't get it again.  It just didn't taste like the real deal.

The Kona blend pods are okay, but a bit weak and lacking in "bite" like the coffees I prefer. My favorite of the pods was the Espresso Blend, which is no longer available in the US.I've tried using the "coffee duck" as a substitute for the Senseo pods... and it works okay with a good, finely ground coffee, but it's much less convenient than just tossing a pod into the coffee maker.  And the "duck" doesn't produce the trademark foam on the coffee surface.  Melitta Dark roast is another alternative for those who like a bit more coffee taste, but the Melitta is not as good as the Senseo Espresso Blend was (when it was still available).My understanding is that in the very near future, the existing US supply of Senseo pods will be exhausted and users will either need to find a replacement or move on to a different type of coffee maker... maybe a Kuerig machine or, when it's available, the new Starbucks Verisimo machine.  I believe the latter is slated to be on the market in time for the 2012 Christmas holidays.I hate to see the Senseo machines go... and I believe the pods and the machines are still being sold in Europe... but due to some corporate mergers and non-compete agreements, we are about to see the Senseo line come to an end in the US.  (If my facts are wrong on this, please, post something to let me know!)

Senseo, I used to LOVE you, but then your products went dark for nearly 8 months, whats a gal to do without coffee?....now I have a Keurig, and Im happy again. Why do you come back to haunt me Senseo, and where did you go all that time???? Could I trust you again? I think not....
Cup for cup the senseo Dark Roast is one of the best coffees on the market for the price.  An excellent "day to day" coffee with consistent good taste.
Can't find these in stores anymore so I was happy to get them at Amazon.com.  My small single cup coffeemaker requires these pods.
Very good coffee for the Senseo but it cost too much. I drink a lot of cups of coffee a day and can't afford it anymore!
18 pods and great tasting. Was hoping senseo would come back  and amazon did it , now we need pods for under 30 cents
This coffee is just delicious.....smooth and yet very RICH...  Makes me feel like I am in Hawaii.......Just look forward to mornings with these pods in my Senseo machine!!!!
First experience with Senseo, I ordered the dark roast because I want coffee to taste like coffee!  Much weaker than the medium roast...wish I had my "pricey" dollars back!  Mediocre product!

Because there was a period last spring when I couldn't get the Senseo pods anywhere, I was thrilled to find some at Tesco (large grocery chain in England).  I bought a large quantity to bring home with me and the best news is they make a mug size pod (you only use one instead of two).  The other nice thing about the European product is they use nicer paper for the pods...it has a silky quality.  Any chance of getting the mug size here?  I prefer this product to Keurig etc as it is much more environment friendly, not to mention cheaper.....although the price has really gone up since it disappeared from the supermarket shelf.
I threw these away after making 3 cups - one cup with 1 pod, then one with 2 them 3 (as the others were way too weak). They all tasted TERRIBLE. I wish I could return them. Yuk.
I love this coffee.  Reminds me of the time I was in Holland.  Can't get it at my local grocery store.
These coffee pods are easy to use for a single cup - and have a good flavor. My elderly mother loves the convenience of the use and clean-up.
Easy to use, that's what I like first thing (5:00a.m.) in the morning!Good coffee flavor, that's most important.  Just what you want, especially in that first cup in the moring.
Best source for these coffee pods and best price.Coffee made by this method is never wasted.  It is always the same, no guesswork.My friends love having coffee at my house!
Great tasting coffee. Not too strong, not too weak. One pod sufficient for a morning mug. Cheaper by the subscription.

We've had the Senseo coffee maker for a few years now and really enjoy the coffee.  I like the dark roast (purchased) and my wife enjoys the decaf.  It seems other competitors are gaining ground in the local stores and the Senseo coffee pods are less and less easy to find.  Or, if you find them they are priced higher than usual.  We're really glad we located this product and vendor online through Amazon.  Hopefully, our Senseo coffee machine will continue to last and the pods will continue to be made available.  The only "complaint" we've ever had is that the decaf flavors are very limited.  Otherwise, love the coffee!
Can't find these anywhere else. This is my fave coffee so I'm very happy I can get them here. Tried others, just aren't the same.
I use my pods at work and even people who don't drink coffee comment how good it smells as it brews up!

senseo was the first to come up with the single serve coffee machine.I bought it and along with it came the coffee pods.After trying my first machine and the senseo coffee pods I have continued to use the senseo pods and have enjoyed every cup.I hope you will continue to carry these pods because I cannot purchase them any more through any of the food stores.Thank you amazon,Doreen
I have purchased this product many times over. Although the cost has risen,I find it is still a good brand of coffee.

column9: they're back and as good as before!
column10: After a long absence, Senseo dark roast coffee pods are again available.  I had heard they are made by another company,not Sara Lee, so I wasn't sure they would taste the same. I ordered them again from Amazon.com (I was previously on their subscription plan, in which they would automatically send me a 6 pack every month, but then Amazon cancelled it--lack of supply from Sara Lee).Good news, the coffee is the same, delicious!  However, in the many months of absence of the Senseo pods (did they think I was going to stop drinking coffee and wait?  Lol, NO!), I found another brand that is comparable, just as good, but just about the same price:  Baronet dark roast makes pods that are also excellent coffee.  So if Senseo again stops production, I have another brand to fall back on. Bottom line, Senseo coffee is back, it's still delicious, but I don't trust them to stay in production, so I have Baronet as my back up plan.

The Senseo coffe pods work with are Black&Decker Home Cafe single cup maker. We Love both of them!!! The pods are getting hard to find in stores and are costly. So, when we need more Senseo coffe pods, I order a 6 pack of them thru Amazon ... I also make sure it's a "prime" purchase for free shipping.
this is a great tasting coffee, have been ordering through subscription until I was told it was out of stock. I then tried Melitta coffee pods and found it cheaper and almost same great flavor.
Nice dark roast. When it's in your mouth it has very rich, earthy, and herbal flavors.. leaves a great taste in your mouth. It is bold, but is well balanced and is a favorite in my home.
Good tasting coffee that works with my Senseo Coffee Maker.  I'm glad this product is back, it was on backorder for several months.

I am not a coffee drinker but my husband is.  The sensa dark roast has made him an exremely happy person.  He finds it a blend that he truly loves and the fact that he can make one good cup at a time is great.  I have never seen him this happy with any other coffee brewed at home. It got to the point that I couldn't find this coffee locally and am thankful I found it on Amazon.

I purchased the coffee maker not knowing how good this coffee was. I purchased my coffee from Amazon.  It was a great deal and I got it so fast.  This coffee is the best I've had & I have friends who agree.
I loved this coffee,and I will buy it again.. soon.... I will try other brands of this coffee.. I might even try the tea that they have..

column9: My Favorite Senseo Coffee Pod....Sumatra Blend!
column10: This is the one I continue to buy time after time after time....! It's just that good, smooth and delicious and I never get tired of it!  The only problem I have ever had concerning this coffee, is that it sometimes is out of stock........even on Amazon! Then I run out and have to wait!! Just like it is now....out of stock!  So waiting I am..........guess everyone else likes it too!!

Senseo Coffee is the most enjoyable cup of coffee I have ever had.My favorite time of morning...Is having a cup of Senseo Medium Roast Coffee.The flavor is a blend of the best tasting coffee I have ever tasted. The aroma of  coffee brewing is an absolute pleasure to wake up to.

This is the best coffee!! Amazon is great and had the best deal. I was able to have a schedule of delivery and didn't have to worry about running out.  Very very upset that we can no longer purchase this on Amazon!!! Very disappointed. I still love Amazon though...
We like the Senseo Medium Roast Coffee pods but unfortunately they are no longer offered as part of the subscribe and save program.  I was purchasing them for the office.
Best coffee I've ever had. Also the easiest to make.It is getting harder to find in stores.I'm glad to see someone is inteligent enought to still carry it.

column9: I Enjoy My Morning Cup Now
column10: I've never been much of a coffee drinker because I could never seem to brew a good cup.  This has changed how I drink coffee now. I thoroughly enjoy my morning cup(or 2) now since I purchased my one cup coffee maker and discovered Senseo Medium Roast Coffee pods. I don't like strong coffee and the Medium Roast is just the way I like it.

I read the reviews and based on them I purchased these pods.  I know I like my coffee strong, not as strong as some, but really?  These pods are kind of weak.  It says espresso but it doesn't taste like it to me.  Yes, you get a little creama, but not much, and not every time.  I won't be purchasing these again.
These pods offer a quick and conveinent good cup of coffee when you don't have time to brew a full pot. Amazon provides a good and the best value I have found do far.

I have tried many different Senseo coffees, and I like the Columbian coffee the best. The taste is smooth and has lots of flavor. Senseo is a great way to enjoy good tasting coffee without paying the high price of the Kuerig coffee maker and the "cups" coffee.

I have not been happy with my order. I love this Senseo coffee but cannot find the Sumatra flavour in the stores.My first order was disappointing.Apart from two of the bags, every bag had one pod with a tear in it making it unusable. The other two bags... one had no torn pods and the other had two torn pods.So I am averaging one unusable pod per bag which bumps up the cost of the coffee. I find this unacceptable but will see how the second order pans out as I have already received it.If I have the same problem I will cancel future orders and buy my coffee elsewhere.

Finally we have found a Senseo Coffee pod that is close to what we could get in Europe.  We got hooked on Senseo while living overseas and had a large variety of different pod manufacturers to choose from.  Here in the United States, the majority of the selection tasted like water down coffee (YUCK).  This variety was the only one I could tolerate for my morning coffee fix.. Now if it can only get back in stock!
Love this blend.  I combine the breakfast blend with a flavored Pod and enjoy my morning java.  Sad to be told this is no longer on the Subscribe & Save program
These are so perfect for my cappucino machine. No fuss or mess involved. I love all the different flavors. Good coffee, too!

Fabulous coffee.  Kona is my favorite of the Senseo choices but even the medium and dark roast are good.  The decalf coffe is surpringly tasty!  Sure a whole lot less than the Starbucks down the street!!!

If you like a rich dark coffee, Sesseo Sumatra Blend is really great without being bitter.  While the pods are expensive compared to ground coffee in a coffee maker, we believe that this is equivalent to coffee you would buy at Starbucks and you have it at home.  We also like Senseo Dark Roast, but actually we did not like and do not buy any of the other coffee offerings from Senseo.

column9: Smooth, Rich Blend, simply the best!
column10: Our Senseo coffee machine was given to us as a house warming gift, and we have loved from the first time we used it!  The dark roast coffee pods seem to taste so much better than any other brand or flavor I have ever made from home.  The dark roast blend is simply the best. It is smooth, rich, and brews so quickly in our new machine, it's fantastic.  I suggest using stevia powder as a natural (and chemical free!) sweetener with this blend, 30 Grams (1.06 Oz) Stevia 95% Steviosides Bulk Powder.  I don't even use cream anymore, no kidding!

column9: Finally, a great cup of coffee
column10: I have tried them all...all the brands on Amazon, that is. Some have been less than thrilling and some pretty good. The Senseo Espresso Coffee Pods are the best I have found. You can make a great cup of coffee...I wouldn't really call it espresso with the convenience of a pod. I read a tip somewhere on Amazon about wetting both sides of the pod and it was the best tip I got in 2008. The resulting coffee is rich and full flavored, without bitterness. I think I will stick with Senseo Espresso. I did not use the special espresso pod, just the usual one pod holder, and it worked fine.

We were among the first owners of a free Senseo coffeemaker way back like 10 or more years ago. We have a white machine in our laundryroom & then bought my husband a black one for work.  Soooooooo I guess you could say we looooooove this coffee/method of making it, & medium roast is the best. I recently saw Douwe Egberts non-pod coffee @ a local gourmet shop & it was like $9 something for 12oz! Good to know one can get the coffee to use in a regular drip pot as well, however, @ that price, I guess we will just continue to have this as "treat coffee" via our machine.All this being said, I would like to say that @ both Target & Walmart here in Buffalo, NY area stores, I can get the pods for $4.24 each. However, when Target in particular, wants to rotate stock, they mark it down to the wonderful price of $4!!!!! Needless to say, I buy them out, go to another store & do the same. That's almost $4 less for 6 bags than Amazon sells it for!!!! I encourage all of you Senseoholics to do the same & check out the above mentioned stores. I wish Amazon would stop reminding me it's so cheap, when they don't mark it down to Target's level.

column9: Can't find Senseo coffee, here's the story
column10: Years ago Philips and Douwe Egberts were partners in the development of the machine and coffee pods.  The copyright on the pod system was ruled invalid and a decision was made to offer the pods via on line vendors only; no more brick and mortar stores.  Philips then sold their share of the coffee business to Douwe Egberts and are moving pod production to Brazil.  This is causing the delay, especially with the Dark Roast.  According to Senseo the coffee should be by June or July at the latest.  Or so they say.  I am surprised that they have not made this info more available.  Seems like many will simply move on to another coffee machine.  Meanwhile try using a regular coffee filter and espresso grind your own coffee.  I've tried Starbucks coffee and not bad.  Less creama, but good flavor.  Google 'make your own coffee pods' to see the methods used to trim the filter and pack the coffee.  It's easy, but not so easy as dropping two pods and pushing the start button.
These pods are excellent. They are great hot or cold. I did not purchase the special pod holder; I believe the regular single pod is just fine.

column9: Wonderful Coffee - absolutely delicious - love the frothy flavor
column10: Senseo Dark Roast is a wonderfully flavored coffee designed for use in the Senseo machine - unfortunately this machine is almost never sold in brick and mortar stores anymore and Amazon is about the last place you can buy one.  In fact, we bought a backup when we realized this was occurring so we would always have access.  AND we THOUGHT surely Amazon would continue to at least sell the coffee since it's so difficult to find in local stores - but about two weeks ago Amazon's Subscribe and Save service notified us Dark Roast would no longer be available and recommended another brand of Dark Roast - which was awful.  Senseo Dark Roast coffee is incredible - best coffee we've ever drank and I'm 62 years old and have been drinking coffee for nearly 50 years - honestly, if I have to purchase it from European suppliers, I guess I will because there is no other real substitute for this wonderfully delicious coffee.  I've even written to Senseo on their web site and they don't respond - so something is happening here, not sure what.  But if you can find this Dark Roast, buy it - because you will not be disappointed.  It is THE best pod coffee out there.Why would Amazon stop selling this coffee? Dark Roast has a very loyal following and comments on every blog or review site are almost all favorable - PLEASE - BRING IT BACK!  If enough of us indicate an interest, perhaps Amazon will reconsider - after all, the continue to sell the other flavors (for now?) but not Dark Roast - which is hands down the best.UPDATE SEPTEMBER 2012:  Senseo Dark Roast is BACK! YEAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!  Finally, after I had to switch to alternative pods, Senseo finally got their act together and started production at their new facility - I don't know all the details, but basically they shut down their production of this particular line (perhaps others) and sold the product line to another retailer - so we had a down period of several months when it was all but impossible to find this product on line (and it will never, I'm told, be in the brick and mortars again) - WHY!!!!!!!!!!!!!  This is THE best coffee out there, bar none.To add insult to injury, while we were anxiously waiting for our first shipment of Senseo Dark Roast in months our Senseo Supreme coffee maker broke down (probably due to using alternative pods that don't fit!)  So our shipment arrived and no coffee maker (we love the froth on top, so their new machine by Hamilton Beach I think it is, does not produce "froth" so not a viable option) - anyway, we reached out to Senseo Customer Service - we are many years out of warranty and Philips no longer makes the Senseo Supreme machine - OH NO!  Now what.  CS rep says there is nothing they can do to help.  So I clicked on the Corporate Relations link on their site and shot off an email to the big cheese.  GUESS WHAT?  A nice lady (Dolores) wrote me back and said she would get me a refurbished machine, no problem.  We thought great - and waited, and waited - and waited - almost a month and no machine came - so I wrote her back and ask for tracking - she checked and the order was still in the system; seems she forgot to click the submit button to the fulfillment center so it was just sitting there in limbo.  She corrected this and apologized, machine came a few days later.  Just like a new machine, could not tell that it was in any way refurbished - even included a bag of dark roast!! (stale, out of date by 9 months, but was still drinkable, just a little more bold than normal.)Senseo came through for us - they know they have very loyal customers and appreciate them - and while the disruption in supply was annoying, we are just thankful we can still buy this product on Amazon - although the price did go up by $13 a case (or $2 a bag) and there is no more Subscribe and Save capability (please Amazon, restore this savings and if possible, please lower the price back to a more competitive level with other pods - under or about $4/bag!?!?)

I enjoy my senseo so much more now that I have these pods.  I had worked as a barista for 8 years and was having a hard time adjusting to life without free lattes.  I certainly won't say that Senseo espresso by itself is in the same league as freshly ground, coffee shop espresso, but having the freedom to easily and cheaply make my favorite coffee drinks at home has been a Godsend.  I usually mix two shot of Senseo espresso with a spoonful of Xylitol, a spoonful of Black and Green brand unsweetened cocoa powder, and a splash of half and half for a sugar-free mocha that tastes almost as good as one from coffee shop, but for about a quarter of the price.  Try it!
I use one 'Espresso' on top of one 'Dark Roast' for a great cup of coffee.

First time I tried Sumatra in a large order from Amazon and I was not disappointed. I read the reviews before selection and was encouraged to try this blend. When I grind Sumatra beans for a drip coffee maker it is stronger. This Pod-style Sumatra blend is not too strong and should please most coffee drinkers. Very satisfactory - will probably stick with this selection for future purchases. The quick and easy brewing using Senseo is so great for people on the run - or too sleepy to grind and brew. Tastes great from first sip to bottom of cup!

I've been a Senseo fan for three years, and I subscribed to delivery through Amazon.  Over the past year or so I've felt the flavor fading, and with the ONE THIRD PRICE INCREASE over the last year I'm rethinking my devotion.  I just cancelled my subscription.  We'll see how I feel when the coffee runs out.  Back to the french press?
I love my Senseo coffee! The pods are made of a mesh that will decompose. I love that the only thing I have to was is my coffee cup. (No pot, filter, etc.)

column9: I hope they don't sell out to Melita completely
column10: I'm going to try this, hoping it is the same good coffee we've been buying for years - ever since the Senseo machine came out. We used to buy these pods at Walmart but now they sell something that says Senseo on it and Dark Roast etc. but It's a "Melita" brand and it's awful. Really awful. Some people on here say the Keurig is better but don't believe it. Plus, compare the price of using all of those Keurig "pods."There is another single serving coffee maker (Hamilton Beach) where you put your own coffee into a strainer receptical and it makes an 8-10 ounce cup of coffee that is as good as any drip coffee but you don't have to heat water, use paper filters, etc. We have one of those too.We also have a Pavoni Espresso machine ~$1,000. But it's a lot of work. Our favorite is still the Senseo with the original Dark Roast Coffee pods. If they stop selling these, our two senseo machines will go to the Goodwill store.One additional comment: After writing this review, I was going to order a box of six packages of Senseo Dark Roast Coffee as I have before. The price was $29 and some cents but with shipping it ws over $35 so I didn't order. Amazon says orders over $25 ship free but apparently not unless it's very small or you are a Premium member. So it might mean we will give up our Senseo because we can't buy it locally anymore. I refuse to pay 25-50 cents for a cup of coffee at home (as with Senseo+shipping or Keurig or other "pod" systems) when I can make a great cup with my own premium beans from Costco for about 2 cents with my Hamilton Beach single cup system. And this simple system makes hot water for tea or coffee with your own ground coffee in about 3 minutes and it cost about $60. I don't know why people buy these Keurig or other systems (Nestles has had this pod system in Europe for 20 years or more). Have you ever figured out what you're paying for each cup?

I purchased these coffee pods for my one-cup coffee makers.  My clients love the coffee.  It's not too light and not too strong.  Just perfect.  After I open the packet, I keep them in the freezer until I use the pods.  They keep perfectly fresh and aromatic.

column9: Good coffee, but do watch out for differing batches
column10: OK so most people seem to like this coffee; it's got a strong rating (4 1/2 at the moment), but there are still those that say they don't. It will always be subjective; many people detest Starbucks coffee, but millions more like it. Some like it bold, some like it weak, some like it mild, some like it bitter, some like it sweet; no way to please everyone.This coffee is on the mild side, meaning it has flavor but its not overpowering, and is moreso on the sweeter side, meaning it's not bitter like diner-house coffee. The great thing about this flavor is that it blends excellent for those that like to flavor their coffee; because it is not bitter but still has a noticeable coffee flavor, it compliments most flavored creamers. I've had many many different types of coffees with many different types of creamers, and it can be a real balancing act to find the right blends. The senseo medium roast so far has been the best "starting point", meaning nobody I've personally made coffee for has said anything but complimentary things about it. Some still like a more bold or bitter coffee, but so far nobody has said poor things about this coffee. I use a single pod in approx. 6oz of coffee in a cheap Hamilton Beach drip machine with filtered water, and it turns out great.One other thing, sometimes batches taste 'slightly' different from one-another; it's a product from a plant when all is said and done, and while controls are put into place to regulate the taste, sometimes batches are slightly more bold or bitter than another, it happens with all manufacturers (including Folgers and other large manufacturers, which I've personally tasted radical variations). I've ordered this 6-pack around 6 times so far, and only one batch was slightly odd tasting (had a much more noticeable/bitter flavor to it), other than that it has been very consistent. I left the bag slightly open on that batch, in essence making it "go flat" so it wasn't so bitter. While these packets are sealed, make sure you store them in a sealed container after opening to preserve the flavor.One other thing to watch out for: increasing costs. This pack is still a great deal on Amazon, but I am worried since they have made the decision to pull from retail outlets that it will increase in cost on Amazon as well. I still love this coffee, but if it goes up to $40 for a 6-pack of this, I may be rethinking the coffee I purchase. Keep it low in cost and at the same level of flavor and we'll all be happy.

Have been using Senseo for over 4 years and enjoy its flexibility (the coffee machine) and its flavor (the pods).  Now that the grocery stores seem to be dropping the product line, ordering through Amazon is fast and, again, flexible with each order.
After trying most all the dark roasts and also others, this tastes most like brewed coffee. It is strong and only requires one pod for up to an 8 oz. cup.  i will keep ordering this.
I have been using Senseo for several years, the coffee is the best ever. Thank you for coming up with such a great coffee.

I have been drinking senseo coffee for over 2 years and will continue drinking this great coffee.  The flavor has a true coffee taste and there are several flavors to select.  The package the coffee comes in is user friendly .  Easy to clean and store.  There is no life before coffee and I Love drinking SENSEO COFFEE.

When local stores ceased carrying Senseo coffee pods, we turned to Amazon and found them, surprisingly touted as both "new and used."  We elected "new" for obvious reasons.  Our package arrived earlier than promised and delivered to our doorstep.  The quality is the same as was previously purchased at our local grocery store except there was no need to drive.  What a deal!  Good coffee, too.
Yum, great coffee and so easy to brew a cup. Helps me avoid snacking, the creamy coffee gives a satisfying feeling, great for dieters like me. No sugar necessary. Delivery was rapid.
we love  this kona blend coffee for the Senseo. I's stronger and flaverful the way we like it.  I wish they'll have even stronger coffee from Belgium or pure kona.

column9: Sara Lee Senseo Coffee Pods, Dark Roast
column10: Despite the Douwe Egberts name on the label, Senseo Dark Roast is not particularly good coffee, but the price is right; the pods fit the Senseo coffee maker, and they are probably the least expensive dark roast available, although calling it "French Roast" is a misnomer.  When I feel wealthy and successful, I splurge on Community Dark Roast pods or Lavazza gran filtro, both of which are much better coffee and cost twice as much. column10: At my Christmas dinner, one option is Egg Nog latte.Use one pod of espresso, press the button on the Senseo machine for a 'small' cup.Add 1/2 cup of egg nog, add 1/4 cup 2% milk, add 2-3 tsp of sugar.Heat to desired temp and stir to dissolve sugar.  A dash of Nutmeg on top.It's close enough to Starbucks for me.  :-)

I love shopping Amazon for my Senseo coffee pods.  You always have a great selection, the price is right, and it is delivered to my door!!  This was the first time I tried the Kona coffee and it is delicious.  Thanks for the great service, as usual!!

The price on these pods is exactly what I was looking for.  I knew how much I would like them; in fact, I searched local stores before I went online to find Senseo Medium Roast Pods.  Am so happy I found them, especially at the list price.  Thank you for having them in stock!

The Senseo Dark Roast coffee is wonderful.  However, when I opened the first of six packages of pods it turned out that many of the pods were open and some of the coffee had come out.  I hope it is just a fluke and that the other five pods' contents will be in good shape .....

At least 3 of the packets had broken pods and I foolishly thought I could just shake off the loose coffee...actually the fine stuff just got into my coffee machine and it took me hours to get it cleaned out. (I actually thought it was ruined and got another Senseo machine.) What should I do when I open a packet and find it full of coffee??

I love Senseo.  Coffee in about 90 seconds or less, and has a nice little froth on top.  Amazon auto-delivery is the best price I have found anywhere... including the Senseo website.  And free shipping to boot!  Way to go Amazon!

column9: One of the best balanced Senseo Pod Blends
column10: It is only 10% Kona, so if you are expecting a true Kona taste you may be disappointed.  However, as a general blend, this is far smoother and has a more full flavored (but not full bodied), not burnt taste than most of the Senseo Coffee Blends.I wouldn't have minded if the coffee was a bit stronger or full bodied, but still, as it is, it is my go to blend for my Senseo.

I've spent the last 5 years or so trying different coffee makers and types of coffee. Jura-Capresso Super Automatic to a Rancilio Silvia a "true espresso lovers" machine. While traveling I needed a small easy coffee maker that would be an easy set up and inexpensive. After reading reviews I purchased the Senseo machine for $50. on Amazon and have tried several different Senseo pod samples..  settling finally on the espresso..  It is truly a wonderful cup of coffee..  Strong, not bitter and very close to the "real thing"  Any coffee lover will appreciate this product after trying several of the coffee varieties.  And although the unit has gone up to around $65. it is still a bargain in my opinion. I now purchse the Senseo Espresso monthly on Amazon and receive a 10-15% discount. A real bargain. Buy it.. you won't be dissapointed!
This is a great way to modify your caffiene intake and it has a delicious flavor.  I would definitely recommend.

Being from Chicago area, I love good strong, full bodied coffee.  And this product is just that.  The Senseo brews it well but these little pads of coffee give you only one European size cup not the big hit-you-in-the-eye cup. So don't go cheap, push the demi-tasse button and drink a real but small cup of coffee.

column9: This is so convenient, and I LOVE fresh coffee!
column10: Imagine having a freshly-brewed cup of coffee every time you want a cup? No more icky, old, disgusting coffee that has been sitting on the warmer for an hour - and you feel you ought to drink it because after all, you made it. Well, this is your answer. These are a nice balance between the old standby can of coffee, and the (very) expensive (for me, anyway) Keurig coffee pods. I only drink one big cup of coffee in the morning anyway, so these are so perfect for me. If I really crave a half cup more, just slip in one pod and make a half cup. It is a little more expensive for me because I use two pods at a time to make my coffee really zing. No more wasted coffee! And a fresh cup every time. I don't think it gets any better than that. Unless you can afford to go to Starbucks every morning - and up here in cold, snowy Michigan, who wants to do that???? I love this coffee!
