These are the best coffee pods I've come across.  Amazon's auto order makes them super affordable.  I wouldn't buy any others!

Received fairly quickly.  I have been using pods for years so not a new concept.  I bought for use with solofill which is another review.  Did not work that well.  I am now using the pods in my Starbucks French Press mugs with my Keurig.  Just throw the pods in, dispense the boiling water, put the cover on, pump a few times and you can either pour into another mug or just start drinking at your liesure.  I will have to see how the subscription works.  I had enough purchase for free shipping so I will see in two months when the next shipment arrives.  The medium roast is not strong at all.  No floaters to strain through your teeth.

column9: Great seneso pods!  Use 1 for the "2 cups" button on Senseo.
column10: I like regular strength coffee and cappuccinos/lattes...So, I use one of these dark pods while pushing the "2 cups" button on my Senseo maker.  It costs 1/2 to do this rather than use 2 of the regular Senseo pods, and it's still very yummy!  The flavor is strong, but not burnt, and is a great everyday coffee.

I have used this product before and am very pleased with it.  The coffee maker was a gift a few years ago and it makes better coffee than any in home appliance I have ever used.  I would highly recommend the Senseo Single Cup coffee maker and coffee pods to anyone who likes a quick, easy and very good cup of coffee whenever it's desired.  There are several coffee blends available to suit about any taste, so everyone can enjoy his favorite.  I also enjoy the subscription option for ordering products such as these.  The cost is very reasonable and it's easy to ensure that there is always a supply on hand.

I have been addicted to a good Senseo for ages.  Best coffee ever IMHO.  Just a little dollop of sweeten condensed milk ontop of a double cup of Senseo is a perfect beverage thats stimulating, warm, and simply tasty.

column9: Awesome coffee at a good price.
column10: This coffee is bold, and delicious.  Any day that I don't feel like getting a bold Sumatra from Starbucks, this is just as good (if not better).  To make your coffee even more delicious using the Senseo machine, always remember to run the machine once without any coffee.  After doing so, immediately brew using this Sumatra coffee, and it will be extra foamy and delicious.
Senseo coffee pods are almost extinct in our area.  Glad to be able to find them at Amazon.  Coffee was fresh and tasted great!

The coffee didn't seem to have any relation to Kona coffee in flavor. The pods in each package were damaged and at least one in each package was torn. Makes you feel cheated.I still wouldn't have been so disappointed if it had tasted at all like Kona.

breakfast blend coffee is very good,tasty coffee. I would have given five stars if the coffee pods came in better packaging that would keep the coffee fresher.That is the only improvement that this coffee needs,hope someone is listening...

I initially bought the senseo machine because I wanted a machine that could brew one fresh cup at a time for my office.I don't like the idea of hot water running through a plastic cup as you get with the K cups from Krupps.Additionally, the Kcups are very expensive in comparison.I have tried probably all of the senseo coffees and I love them all.The only recommendation that I have is that they put an organic coffee on the market.In short, if you're looking for a one cup machine, get the senseo.
My wife and I brew and drink a cup of Senseo Medium Roast coffee everyday--have done so for years.  We almost always buy it from Amazon.com and find the price to be best there.

I love the Senseo coffee pods. cheaper than the Bosch pods we have at work and better taste too. Simple to use and simpler to dispose the spent pods. PLUS if I really want to use the coffee outside of the pods; I simply empty 3-5 pods into a old school paper filter and I can make a entire pot of drip brew just as easily.I cannot understand why this system is not as popular in my area (North Eastern US)O-Well I guess that is OK; as I can get good deals on the pods when it is time to replenish my stockpile ;-)

This is by far our favorite coffee to use in the Senseo.  We discovered it in a variety pack we often ordered, and decided that we liked it so much that we needed to start ordering it by itself in bulk.It's awesome that both my husband and I like it so much, because he leans toward bold coffees while I tend to go a little bit mild.  I think this one would qualify as being on the more bold side of the spectrum, but not extremely so.  It also has a slightly chocolaty flavor to it somehow...  Just barely.

No, it's not Starbucks or Dunkin' Donuts.  It's not even a good home brewed cup.  But for a single serving cup of coffee it isn't bad.  I know that's condemning with faint praise but I will say compared to other single serving flavors it is, to me, the closest to a very decent cup of coffee.
This a full bodied, rich coffee with a wonderful flavor.  I would recommend it to everyone.  It is excellant!
First had this coffee in Holland.  It is outstanding.  The Price is right, lower than the Grocery Store.  These pads work in the Senseo Coffee Maker (Phillips).  Great bang for the buck.
This is by far the best flavor in my opinion - the others are too weak for me. And, this price can't be beat! If you're a Senseo owner or lazy coffee maker like me, this is a great option

I like this product very much, and living in an area where I am unable to purchase it locally, I appreciate being to get it through Amazon.  However, I'm disappointed that the Cappuchino is no longer available.
hard to find coffee pods in stores, lucky that Amazon has them.  Have tried different brands, and Senseo is very good, but Wolfgang puck is even better, but pricier
Easy to get a modified espresso bump even when I am asleep on my feet at 5:30 in the morning.

I am a a big coffee Addict!!! I have tried all kinds of coffees and coffee makers and decided on senseo coffee exclusively.It is easy to use, and is "environmentally friendly." A lot of my colleagues fell in love with senseo as well. buy the six pack and save!
I love this coffee. Strong but not bitter and smooth with a full flavor. I've tried them all and this is my favorite.

Senseo coffee is rich and satisfying--it has that froth on top.I recommend using these podds because they are biodegradable.  YOu need to buy a Senseo machine though.Save our environment from the plastic Keurig dispensers.

I use the senseo pods in my Hamilton One Cup Brewer, the brewer cost only $ 19.00 and it makes the best tasting coffee no matter what type you buy, I like the coffee mix with 10% Kona and my husband likes the decaffinated.  Taste like European coffee
This coffee is great stuff, people. And the coffee pods aren't bulky and cumbersome like other single-cup brewers on the market...

My husband and I have been using Senseo for about 6 years and love the frothiness.  We used the mild roast coffee until they discontinued it and we were forced to use the medium roast.  It was a little too strong for us.  We were so glad when they introduced the Breakfast Blend which we think is comparable to the mild roast.

column9: good price, good service, the coffee's not that great
column10: the more i drink this coffee the less i like it.unless you're mixing it with lots of sugar and milk, it's harsh and acidic (in my opinion).but the price is great, isn't it?i'm currently looking for alternatives.....

I use this in a Keurig coffee maker, using the adaptor cup.  It works fine, and the coffee is good.  Although the Keurig is nice and convenient, it is not the cheapest way to get a cup of coffee.  Using these pods cuts the cost about in half.I like this dark roast and will continue to buy it.  The taste of coffee, like the taste of anything else, is a personal preference.  I like it, but you might hate it.  The pods, though, are reasonably-priced and work well with my Keurig.

I love my Senseo coffee, have two machines. One in the camper and one at home. Have used them while living in various parts of the world.They come in different strength depending what you are in the mood for.

column9: Great coffee, but disappointed in quality of pods
column10: My husband and I have been buying Senseo coffe pods for about 3 years. Recently, I placed 2 orders a few days apart for a total of 24 packages of this coffee.  We love the coffee, but the quality of some of the pods is disappointing.  So far, we have opened 5 packages of the first order.  Inside 2 of the packages were pods that were not fully sealed, and the loose coffee had fallen out in the packages.  If we find more unsealed pods, all of the remaining packages are going back to Amazon.
I love this coffee system but finding the pods is becoming more difficult now.  The price is right, the delivery is fast and you can order a case so I always have coffee when I need it.

I love all the Senseo pods I've tried.  The sale price on these pods and the Espresso pods was too good to pass up.  If you're a Senseo fan, Amazon is the bes place to get your pods, especially if you can catch a special deal.
I really look forward to starting my day with a cup or two of Senseo coffee. This med. roast is one of my favorites.

column9: Almost as good as Millstone pods
column10: Our pod coffeemaker is by Krups and uses pods rather than the newer K-cups. Senseo is one of the few manufacturers still offering the pods, and while the Columbian by Senseo are good, they aren't as "rich" in flavor as the previously available Millstone Columbian Supremo pods. That said, these are the best we've found and we just hope that Senseo continues to offer these pods to fit our wonderful little coffeemaker.
Thanks so much for the fast delivery!  These pods were just what I wanted and just what was advertised.
I had been buying this product at Walmart, but they no longer stock it.No other stores in my area carry it either.

This is excellent dutch Douwe Egberts coffee for the Senseo coffee machine.  The Sumatra blend is my favorite, but other flavors are good also.  The on line price compares well with store prices, that is, if you can find it in your grocery store.  Tried other brands that fit the Senseo machine, but this one is the best in my opinion.

Have been using Senseo products off and on for several years.  They gave me their coffee maker for promising to recommend it to ten others. They later gave me another one.  I paid shipping on each.  This Philips coffee brewer works great, and is designed much better than Black and Decker, a competing product which does the same thing.  I've found the coffee from these pods to be a little thin -- just not quite as flavorful as coffee made from freshly ground beans. Go figure.  I've tried every coffee making device on the market, and some that aren't, in search of a great cup of Joe.  I've even made my  own pods using a home pod maker, and my fresh ground coffee. The coffee is pretty good, and you can always stop the water before the coffee maker shuts it off, if you want it a bit stronger.
I love my Senseo, but of all the flavors, this is the easiest to like. It's mild with no aftertaste. Have totally replaced Medium Blend for breakfast.
I was able to buy my Senseo coffee maker from Amazon but it appears Amazon won't ship the coffee pods to Canada.Anyone know why not?

column9: It's good but I'm not sure it's the same.
column10: I have been buying/drinking this Dark Roast for over 4 years and have had it on auto ship for the last 2 years. Needless to say I was disappointed when they stopped shipping.This new batch is pretty good but I'm not 100% sure its the same stuff. It seems a little more bitter then what I remember. This could be because I haven't had it in awhile too but I don't think so. It's still good but I just think it's a bit different now.
We like this coffee, but can't get locally any more.  It is cheaper to order than it was to buy at local store when it was available.
Love these coffee pods.  I need them for my one-cup pot.  My market hardly ever has them.  The price is right, too.
This is really good coffee.  Nice rich flavor.  Not bitter.  If you don't like strong coffee you may want to pick a different roast.
Great coffee, not as strong as medium roast, but seems to be smoother. Love it.

Senseo Medium Roast Coffee, 18-Count Pods (Pack of 6)I love my "Senseo Coffee Maker" but no store in my city carrys the pods any longer GRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR !!!!!! we are a small town (50,000) BUT if it wasn't for Amazon and the great great prices of the pods, I'd be up a tree so THANKS AMAZON !!!!!! Amazon is my go-to for anything from now on!!!!!!

I used to have a Keurig, but the pump went out twice, so I switched to Senseo. I prefer the Keurig and ended up buying a machine made by Cuisineart for Keurig cups in hopes that I won't have any pump problems.

column9: New delivery has stale, nasty taste?
column10: My wife and I have been drinking Senseo pods for years.  We have always used the medium roast.  On our last shipment we noticed the coffee tastes stale and old.  Very nasty.  The old pods have the sense logo on the pods themselves and these new pods do not so I don't know what that means but that seems to be the way to identify the bad tasting pods.  These are so bad we can't even drink them.  I'm going to try one more order and if that tastes the same we may actually quit sense and move to Keurig.  VERY disappointed in the new medium roast and I would not recommend as it tastes like coffee that is a week old.

This coffee, and method of preparing is simply the best. I will never go back to making pots of coffee. It's better than the K-cups because it does not fill your trash can with plastic and metal. In fact we compost ours. Besides the obvious advantage of making one cup at a time, this coffee simply tastes better. I have found friends that were not coffee drinkers but like this coffee. I brought one of these brewers aboard my last tug boat and the other crew is hooked. Everyone can put in the pod for th brew they like. Some guys insist on strong coffee and some on Starbucks. This brewer allows everyone's idiosyncratic tastes to be accommodated.Some people criticize the price but I have found it more economical for two reasons: for one you are not pouring any coffee down the drain. Second you only drink coffee when you want it. I usually make a full pot to get an acceptable blend/taste, and I will sit there and stare at it and drink it until the pot is finished. No more.The only thing this is not suited for is when you have a dinner party or more than one or two coffee drinkers. Then a pot type brewer is better.Another tip is to buy the extra large reservoir, this thing is cool. You will walking to the sink half as many times to refill it.One final tip: we have a couple of plastic universal pods. You can fill them with whatever coffee you want. We keep these around in case we run out of pods, we just throw some Cafe Bustelo in them, and we can have coffee. However with auto delivery from Amazon we hardly ever run out, unless I take a bunch out to the tug:)
When I Need a quick pick me up Senseo Expresso is the way to go!
It's coffee. I was out.Works in my Senseo coffee maker.Tastes good.Price is right.Why in the heck else buy this???
Very fast shipping, this is one of my favorite Senseo coffees.  Just the perfect bold flavor.  I also like that it was a pack of 6 and not 4.
This is one of the most delicious Senseo pod flavors out there. It's a great Kona blend with subtle, nutty flavor.
Just the right blend for my taste.  Easy to use and easy for disposal.

We have tried several brands of coffee pads, even the local store brands in The Netherlands, but only one has the right taste and that is Douwe Egberts Senseo pads. We prefer medium. Delightful cup of coffee. Neighbors make excuses to knock on the door, because they know we invite them in for a Dutch coffee.In comparison with prices, they are quite a lot cheaper in Europe. So we brought an extra suitcase loaded with 2000 Senseo pads back home. Hope prices will come down somewhat, in spite of the discounts it is a rather expensive "cup a java" in the States.

Senseo coffee pods are easy to use once inserted in the Senseo coffee machine.You get a great cup of coffee every time.No more coffee powder on your counter or mess all around the coffee machine no more paper filter.A great product,regards,HAns P. Plesman

This is only coffee I can drink nowadays. And you can also vary the taste a bit yourself by either using 1 pod and hitting the "single" button on the Senseo, or use 1 pod and hit the "double" button on the Senseo.  Both ways, you still get a creamy cup of coffee ... either very strong, almost like espresso, or like a good European tasting cup of coffee.  With the Senseo coffee machine you can also stop the flow of coffee a little earlier, or hit the single button again to add a little more water without hurting the machine.  It is geared for that.  For me its the only way to go for a good cup of coffee!

life without coffee, I tried it and it did not work. I needed that extra kick in the morning and a follow up in the afternoon. The Senseo Dark roast coffee has the taste and the kick to satisfy the esoterical and the physical.It is a winner if you want to be with it and the Senseo single pod coffee machine always gives you a fresh cup of coffee.

Excellent product, fast delivery, excellent price (because of subscription: $23.66 for 6 bags of 18 pods). However, Amazon's current (September 2010) price (that is $3.94 per bag of 18 pods) needs to be reassessed because of dropping Euro (1Euro=$1.30). Local groceries sell bags for $5.25. However, Target dropped its price to $4.19 (or even $3.86 with $1 coupon that Target prints when two bags are purchased). $3.86 is 8 cents below Amazon's price! Amazon needs to urgently review its subscription price (September 2010).

Senseo Dark Roast Coffee, 18-Count Pods (Pack of 6)Senseo Decaffeinated Coffee, 18-Count Pods (Pack of 6)Senseo Bold 4-Flavor Coffee Variety Pack III, 16-to 18-Count Pods (Pack of 4) All are tasty and fresh.
Very good stuff, I had a bag or two rip which kind of upset me because I wasn't rough handlign them or anything, but other then that, its great.. very good.
Good coffee, unfortunately, there was only one month left on the sell by date (when I buy locally there's usually a year or more).

column9: This stuff has turned me into a coffee addict!
column10: I'm no huge coffee connoisseur, but this stuff is great.  Full flavor, never burnt tasting, has a chocolaty flavor, and the foam is great.  The Senseo pods are a breeze to use. It's much faster to make a cup than with the Krups machine, tastes better, and it's more environmentally friendly since they don't use a plastic container.  I suspect the dark roast is fresher than some of the other blends since it's a bit cheaper and they likely sell a ton of it, so it rotates more quickly from production to consumption.My only minor complaint is it could be a bit hotter, and that's to do with the machine itself.  Unless you heat up the mug, by the time your java is ready it's barely hot enough, but acceptable if you drink it right away.I've tried all the various combinations of one pod, two pods, the right and the left button.  I always use the single cup (left) button and one pod for the best taste.  You need to use two pods to make a full mug, but it's no big deal, so just run the process twice.  Takes less than a minute from switch-on to quaff-down.  The price for a six-pack of dark roast from Amazon is great and it just scrapes over the free shipping minimum.  Order a couple or weeks in advance before you run out.  Having a cup now as I write this...yum.

column9: Less acid and full bodied taste
column10: My boss and I both adore this coffee!  I have owned a Senseo for a very long time, and will NEVER go back to drip coffee again.  I like the Sumatra because it has a lot less acid than many of the other coffee blends.

column9: excellent coffee, at a very good price!
column10: we use this coffee at work in a shared machine - it's delicious, and at such a great price!  perfect to help me wake up before my early morning meetings.
This coffee is great for a quick morning cup of coffee.  Arrived fully sealed and fresh.
Senseo is an easy way to make a great cu of coffee. I love the taste of medium roast. Sometime I mix the medium roast with a french vanilla flavored pod "Paris" for a very special taste and treat
The POD makes a great strong cup of coffee --- not bitter --- great flavour ---- Jan
I love this coffee and think it is the best!!  Amazon offers the best deals on it!!
Just good, easy to use coffee. A lot of cream. Taste not excellent, but good enough.

column9: Wouldnt start the day any other way...
column10: I LOVE this coffee! I was skeptical how good the coffee could really be coming from a pod, but I am a huge fan, and anyone who tastes it is converted (I should stock up on machines and just sell them as I go haha). Also the decaf pods are really great too (as far as decaf coffee goes).I have tried most of the senseo range, but I always come back to the dark roast. Thumbs up from me!

I like the bold coffees offered by Senseo, along with the different blends, but this coffee holds its own and can be used as a daily starter.  It gets good reviews from my coffee drinking friends, as well.  The Brazil Blend and/or Dark Roast satisfy my taste for a bold cup.

Caveat, these bags work in the Senseo coffee machine.  The machine makes 1/2 cup and 1 cup coffee.  The coffee has been very good. I broke a $3 a morning habit at Starbucks using this coffee.  If you buy in bulk, it is between 25 cents and 50 cents a pod, and two pods are used to make a cup for between 50 cents to a dollar a cup.
Delicious, not real strong but a bit more flavor than Medium Roast.  Go for it, you won't be sorry.
Sumatra is my fave flavor of all the Senseo flavors. It's smooth and silky. Love it!
Since I got Senseo coffee machine, I only drink Senseo. I choose dark roast, because I make 8 oz/pod and it still taste great.

We drink this coffee everyday in our senseo machine.  It is the only senseo brand that we like.  Otherwise, we drink columbian made by a different company.  The kona is a medium blend coffee, not too strong and not too weak.  We get it on autoship as it is hard to find in our small town and much more expensive here.  We always keep a supply on hand since it seems to be well liked by most everyone.

Excellent product, fast delivery, excellent price (because of subscription: $22.24 for 6 bags of 18 pods). However, the current (September 2010) price ($3.71 per bag of 18 pods) needs to be reassessed because of dropping Euro (1Euro=$1.30). Local groceries sell bags for $5.75, with coupon $5.25. However, Target dropped its price to $4.19 (or even $3.86 with $1 coupon that Target prints when two bags are purchased) that is a mere 15 cents from Amazon's price! Amazon needs to urgently review its subscription price again (September 2010).

I've been using Senseo coffee pods for a while. I am the only coffee drinker in the house and I don't have to make a pot of coffee. I can make as many or as few cups as I want with these pods with very little fuss.
The coffee is excellent, but this deal is poor.  Anyone can regularly buy them in a grocery store for less than $4.64/each.  Make it a better deal, say, 23.99 or 3.98/each and you'll have a winner.
This is the best tasting coffee out there. Don't bother with other flavors, varieties, etc. This is the one--rich, warm, and wonderful!
I have this set up to automatically order every three months.  It is convenient and easy.

Ordered this product for convenience.  Some difficulty in always finding Senseo Pods in grocery stores.  With free shipping, same cost as WalMart.  Senseo has a very good system, although not nearly the broad product line of K-Cups.

I have tried almost all of the Senseo coffees and this is hands down the tastiest!!  It is all I will buy for pods aside from their decaf which is also really good.  Full bodied and rich but non acidic or bitter.  Great product and with subscribe and save it is the best price around.
The first difference I noted was that it was more aromatic than the dark roast I normally purchase.  Nice coffee.

Senseo Dark Roast pods provide a strong, vibrant flavor that seems to me to be similar to the Starbucks regular brand,  I limit myself to two cups per day and really prefer this more robust variety of coffee. I am not disappointed by the brew and find it saisfying. Using Amazon's Subscribe and Save Plan helps my budget and is completely convenient.

It is a pleasure to order a six-pack of Senseo coffee pods from Amazon!  We have owned a couple of Phillips coffee makers and have used Senseo pods for years. So many times when I try to buy them at our local grocery stores, they are out of stock or the price is just too high.  So, Amazon is to the rescue again...in quantity, price, and fast delivery!
We have been purchasing this product for several months and have enjoyed it in the past, but this order is inferior. Did the company change hands or outsource their production?

This is the fourth time I've ordered this coffee from amazon and I will be ordering more later when I need it. The coffee is at a good price and delivered in a decent amount of tim. It is always fresh and in good condition when it arrives. If you like this kind of coffee, my suggestion is DO IT!

The Senseo coffee system has been our favorite for sometime now. Great tasting coffee and can make one cup at a time. Purchasing the pods through Amazon is by far the best price we have found. Who doesn't like to save money on the things you would be buying anyway.

I was buying my senseo coffee pods at a local grocery store and was paying much more than I am at Amazon.  It was even difficult to fine the dark roast pods many times.  I love the flavor of these pods and am very pleased with the service and price from Amazon.  If you are a coffee lover and have a machine that takes pods, you would be well served if you buy your pods from Amazon. Just recently I went to the automatic delivery because I have not found any better price for the pods.  It saves time and money, two things that we all should be thinking about these days.

These are nearly as good as any I've found, and much less expensive than many other brands.  I use one of these and one espresso pod in a 2 cup holder on the 2 cup medium size setting.  I run water through the machine first, and I dampen the top pod (tricks I've learned from reading other reviews/tips here for this machine).  After this whole process, which really only takes minimal time, it makes a very good cup of coffee, in my opinion.

The Senseo coffee maker produces excellent coffee provided one uses third party pods rather than Senseo pods. I strongly prefer Fratello, Millstone or Halo pods which seem to have richer, more robust flavors. The Senseo pods generally produce weak coffee, in part because they do not contain enough coffee. The above brands all fit in the Senseo maker despite containing more coffee in each pod. The Senseo Espresso pods are only ok, better than some Senseo pods.

column9: Not Bad, But There are Better
column10: As the popularity of the Senseo pod system wanes and that of the Keurig system grows, there is diminished availability of pods that fit the Senseo. The Senseo brand pods are available on Amazon at a decent price. Unfortunately, the Senseo pods are not as good as competing brands formerly available on Amazon such as Fratello, Halo, Millstone, etc. Of the Senseo pods, the French Roast has a richer flavor than most of the others. It is often on sale and is a bargain when that happens. I suspect that the Keurig system makes good coffee, but I cannot imagine paying so much for a Keurig pod (thimble).
Pretty soon its going to be cheaper to have your coffee at Starbuck than buying Senseo coffee podsSenseo Medium Roast Coffee, 18-Count Pods (Pack of 6)

column9: Not The Senseo Coffee Of The Past.
column10: I have been a Senseo coffee lover since 2004.  This has been the best cup of coffee I have found.  On my last trip to Europe I brought a suitcase full of Senseo Coffee Pods back with me.  They are much cheaper in Europe.The coffee in the pods is not the same as in the past.  It's no better than the cheap coffee in the can you get at any grocery store.  I like a full bodied dark cup of coffee, and that's what I used to get in the Senseo Dark Roast.  Now it tastes like dishwater.  I like brewing one cup at a time so I ordered the aftermarket filter insert so I can use ground coffee.  If it doesn't work as advirtised, I'll get a different coffee brewing system.I am so disappointed.  Why can't companies leave well enough alone.  If Sara Lee needed to make a bigger profit margin, raise the price, don't change the quality.

Now days it's a little hard to find these, so it's good that I can do a subscription on these.  As long as my senseo machine still works even after many years, I will continue to purchase the pods.  No need to buy anything fancy.

Very disappointed will not be buying again. The package says to use up to 3 pods for a strong cup of coffee.  One pod is like drinking water, two is better but using 2-3 pods surely isn't a value and the taste isn't worth the price.
Please do not stop carrying this product; it is a wonder product!  The rich taste and fit with my coffeemaker is excellent!

I don't know if the packs I had were old  (although they are stamped 06 18 11 so it seems fresh enough) or poorly stored or if it was just the coffee, but I was very disappointed with the coffee it produces.  It was weak, and bitter.  And did not have the same sort of buttery texture that can be produced with Sumatra pods for example.  I have an older model at home and the new model at work with an espresso holder.  The newer model makes a slightly but noticeably better coffee.  In neither case will you get an actual espresso but is a far cry better than drip coffee.  So far I have found the Sumatra blend pods provide the best results for those who are trying to get the texture and flavor of espresso.

I have been enjoying my coffee maker and pods for years.  The Senso dark roast is one of the best flavor of pods I have tried.  I like being able to make a cup at a time and alwyas drink fresh, hot coffee.

So far 2 of the 3 opened bags have had multiple opened pods in them making a mess on the other pods not to mention, making the opened pods unusable.I'm beginning to think I'm buying "seconds".Next purchase will be from grocery store or another online dealer for comparison.
This was one of our 1st choices for "all arround" likable coffee.  We have decided to quit trying other blends andjust stay with the "dark roast",  Thank you, JoAnne O

I love the coffee but they quit selling these at my grocery store so this is a convenient way to order. Only problem is I increased my order so it would be over $25 to qualify for free shipping but was still charged. Not sure why.

Since receiving a Senso machine for a Christmas gift a few years ago, I have not gone back to a regular coffee machine or regular coffee since.  I absolutely LOVE Senseo Medium Roast coffee.  Once you taste it, nothing tastes the same!  I just wish it wasn't so expensive!

column9: SENSEO DARK ROAST COFFEE IS EXCELLENT
column10: HAVE BEEN DRINKING SENSEO COFFEE FOR SEVERAL YEARS AND LOVE IT.  THE AMAZON PRICE IS MUCH CHEAPER THAN THE GROCERY STORE.
Senseo pods are the only coffee we use in our house.....and so convenient to have a standing order with Amazon.

Having a one-cup coffee maker is the best coffee I have found, and you don't have to stand in line.You have a choice of 4 or 8 ounce dispensing of water through the pods, and strong or regular coffee comes out smelling so wonderful, and tasting as good.

I just replaced my old Flavia SB100 with the commercial Grindmaster opod.This medium blend is the first pod coffee I've tried. It wasa very good cup of coffee; hands-down better than all of the Flavia'sI've tried. Part of the difference may just be the machine. I love theGrindmaster's hotter water. I intend to try other coffees that wererecommended to me, but I could easily just buy the medium blendall the time and really enjoy it.
Good taste but found a cheaper pod coffee that gives you more coffee per pod.
This Senseo coffee is the best, good tasting coffee that can be made very quickly. A fresh cup every time.
This coffee is the best tasting and very enjoyable especially in the morning!  We enjoy a strong taste and this Senseo product is excellent!

I love Espresso.  So what is better than a $10,000 commercial machine??  PODS!  This Espresso is really good, even though it is from a Pod.  It doesn't give the Crema like an expensive Espresso machine does, of course, but it tastes great!

column9: Great Sumatra Flavor & Easy On The Stomach!
column10: I have always been an avid coffee drinker, but after gastric bypass surgery I've had little tolerance for my old brands.  My sister turned me on to Senseo and their Sumatra blend, and I am a very happy coffee drinker again.  This one has very nice flavor and less of the acid of my old favorites.  I'll be sticking with this one now that I've found it!

column9: Best Dark Roast for the Price
column10: I have tried several other dark roast products for my Senseo. While the others are also quite good, I have come back to this product for the long term. The Douwe Egberts Dark Roast has been consistently good and I use it every day. The fact that it costs less then the other dark roasts I have tried is an added bonus.
I use this regularly. It has a great flavor and when ordered through Amazon, it is usually less expensive than purchasing in a grocery store. A good bargain with great taste.

I started using this product by purchasing it at my local store.  The pods fit great in my espresso machine although I use it to make lattes.  Local store no longer carries it and I had concern if the product would continue to be around.  I bought the six pack as that will give me 96 lattes and the price was right.  As for using as it is intended, I don't know.
Hands down, the best Senseo blend I've tried!  It's better than most of the "gourmet" coffee served at restaurants and coffee shops.

Senseo is my favorite coffee and it is increasingly hard to obtain the pods in my area, especially my favorite flavor, Sumatra.  I was pleased to find it available at Amazon at a price less than the Senseo Company website,, with free shipping included.  I am pleased to know that there is a supplier for the coffee that makes it a pleasure to rise each morning.

column9: Love these pods, and this price
column10: The Sumatra blend is my favorite all-around coffee from Senseo, and it's much less expensive from Amazon.  Thanks!
Since we've gotten the Senseo, no more buying coffee at Starbucks or any other coffee shop.  This coffee is the BEST.

column9: Kona Coffee Blend (10% Kona)  - Senseo Coffee Pods
column10: I was very disappointed in the Kona Coffee Blend. It is bitter, does not have a smooth taste and leaves a metalic after-taste in your mouth. Anyone looking for the Kona experience will not find it with this blend ... perhaps a blend that has more than 10% Kona would be better.
I have been enjoying Senseo coffee for many years.I appreciate being able to purchase it through Amazon and am pleased with the promptness of the delivery.
This is a good pod coffee.  Senseo pods are good for everyday use.  This one does taste like Kona

column9: not as good as other premium pods I use.
column10: I use a Grindmaster OPOD brewer.  These pods contain less coffee than other pods I've used(Fratello, Juan Valdez, Community).  I like a stronger cup of coffee.  This yeilds a smooth cup of coffee, but lighter than I prefer.
Excellent product, price, ease of ordering and speed of delivery (Super Saver Shipping).  I've ordered this many times and will continue to do so.
I DRINK THE SENSEO ESPRESSO EVERY DAY & LOVE IT.  THEY ARE MUCH MORE EXPENSIVE AT THE SUPERMARKET.  THIS IS SO MUCH EASIER & COST EFFECTIVE. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

I have been using Senseo for years and I love it.  I saw that they came out with these new Espresso pods and thought, "Why not?  The darker the better."  So...I ordered them and I have thoroughly enjoyed them.  Actually, even as I write this review I am drinking a cup using one of the pods.  Of course it's not toally like a "real" espresso, but it's strong, bold, and makes me think twice about stopping at a coffe place rather than just coming home to make my own.
This is a little cheaper per bag than my local store and delivery to the door.
The taste is nice though it is VERY mild. I need to use two pods per one cup of coffee.
I enjoy this coffee in the morning and the flavor is prefect for an all day coffee
This is a bit strong, I have had other brands that are more pleasing to the taste

The pod brewing system was the answer to my search for a way to brew my 1-2 cups of coffee a day with consistent repeatable results. Then, after trying several different blends, I found breakfast blend to be the perfect cup for me. Rich and flavorful, yet smooth and mellow. It's so good I don't even want to try other blends. Day after day I'm treated to the same delicious coffee to start and sometimes end my day. I'm rarely this satisfied with any product. Great stuff!
I use the medium pods because I don't like strong coffee.  I love the coffee from Senseo.
What a great way to get your coffee...When I travel and return the first thing I want when I walk in the door is my cup of dark roast senseo coffee.
This is what coffee is all about!  Full flavored with no hint of bitterness.

column9: Seems like the dark but more expensive.
column10: I'd like the darkest coffee possible, and this seems about the same as the less expensive dark pods.

I purched a Senseo single cup coffee maker because I had seen one at my son'e place in New England and the coffee was delicios. However, the coffee pods are almost impossible to find in the retail market, even in Manhattan. Thanks to AMAZON.COM I get my supple at a reasonable cost and in a timely manner

column9: Prefer it over Starbucks (and I love Starbucks ;-)
column10: It is all about the right mixture and the better way to brew a nice cup of coffee. We add lots of hot milk to it and make out own latte. This coffee is our espresso replacement and tastes so good! It is a coffee our European visitors really appreciate.There are 2 reasons to prefer it over Starbucks, it is heck of a lot cheaper and it tastes at least as good (to me).

column9: Good choice for a daily cup
column10: My first impression was that it was just a decent cup of coffee, but after a week of drinking it, it ended up trumping all other choices, even the espresso pods.  Largely because of cost - the espresso is highly addictive (yes, I think it's that good) and I can't afford to drink three double-shot lattes a day!!!

I've had my Senseo coffee machine for a few years and was very happy to find the pods available online thru Amazon. Two senseo coffee pods is all I need to make the best aromatic, convenient, and economical morning cup of coffee. The automatic ordering available is very efficient. Thanks for this wonderful product. Nancy Thompson

column9: Very pleased with the Senseo system!
column10: I have been looking for a simple, no-brainer coffeemaker that made delicious coffee -- and I cannot imagine there is a better nor more economical system than Senseo.  I really did look a long, long time for the right system, and Senseo is the first machine like this I feel completely happy with.

If you like a stong cup of coffee, then this isn't your Senseo pod. However, I love a medium roast with a little bit of a bite to it and Breakfast Blend is just that. I enjoy this cup of coffee each morning with a splash of a flavored coffee creamer.  The best!

column9: Sumatra is the best pod from Senseo
column10: I've tried all of Senseo's coffee pods and by far the Sumatra blend is the best they have to offer.  DH and I have been drinking this blend since it came out a couple of years ago.  Even my cousin's wife, a Starbucks manager, admitted that it tasted along the lines of Starbucks coffee.  This is a good buy from Amazon with their discount and free shipping with autoship.  Don't bother with the flavored blends (french vanilla, hazelnut, Irish blend) they are sure to disappoint with their weak brews, try this one instead for a full bodied, rich cup that is not bitter like their dark roast.
The Senseo Pods are the best!! It's the best coffee pot I've ever owned and the Senseo pods have wonderful flavor.

Senseo is a great product and the pod based system of making coffee yields a fresh cup time after time. It's just a shame this particular coffee is so average. There's nothing wrong with it, just a compromise of flavours that leave you underwhelmed. Described as a "blend to get you going in the morning", this isn't going to get you anywhere. It is, however, not going to make you spit it out and if you fancy a nice, average coffee that delivers a nice, average flavour then you'll like this.I use it as a third choice between decaff (for late nights) and dark roast (for mornings following really late nights!)
Tastes fine.  It is the cheapest way I can find to "feed" my Senseo coffee maker.  At $0.44/mug it is not that "cheap" but it is good.  They are cheaper in Europe.

column9: Close to Dark Roast, but nice to taste something with a bit more body
column10: Sumatra is very close to Dark Roast, but if you get bored with Dark Roast, you should try this one. It has just a bit more flavor than Dark Roast, just that extra you need. It may get a little bit towards Starbucks Coffee, but not too close, so it's not that sharp, but it does go more in that direction, but still smooth enough. Well, what else can you say about flavor, just try it yourself.

My wife and I have been drinking this for years and love it.  We keep trying all the supposedly "best" coffees from Kona, Africa and Jamaica.  This is still the best, and convenient too.  My wife prefers it without the foam, so we use a Malita brewer, which operates on the same concept, but you kind of have to stuff the pod into the smaller holder.  However, I'm not enthusiastic about the price like the other reviews.  I'm in south Texas and here we pay between $3.09 and $3.89 per bag at the local grocery store (HEB the largest store in our part of the state.)
Love this brand of coffee and find that Amazon's prices beat the company's prices so.........I buy from Amazon, my favorite site of all!

Senseo Dark Roast is my favorite of the pods I've tried.  Good, bold flavor.  Shipping was fast.  The question for me is always convenience versus cost.  Being in a 1 coffee drinker household, there is less waste and trouble making a cup in the Senseo than brewing up coffee in the coffee maker.
This coffee is good & the Senseo coffee maker brews a cup of coffee very fast. I am not sure if they are still making the coffee makers because I am having a hard time finding them.
It's stronger than the regular ones but not as strong as I thought it would be...

I use these coffee pods in my 5 cup coffee maker, I usually put one coffee pod in the basket and add 4+ cups of water and "presto, perfect coffee" - I only use senseo medium blend, I watch where ever they are on sale but I found these at Amazon cheaper than any others at the stores. These are the only ones I use after trying many others. I give it MY #1 Rating and the only one I use anymore.
This is the best coffee I have ever had.  I love Senseo pods. My seller was excellent from packaging to mailing.  5 Star!!
This coffee is the best I have ever had.  My seller sent it perfectly packaged and very promptly.  5 Star treatment!!

I've been through most of the pods for the last two years, and finally found my favorite about six months ago.  When the Sumatra arrived, I still had Medium, Dark, Brazilian, and Columbia on hand for comparison.  As it turns out, I didn't really need to compare because the Sumatra stood on its own from the first cup and is exceptional.  Sumatra is a dark, rich blend that finally fills my need for a stronger coffee with a pleasant character.  It took a long time but I finally managed to finish off the other blends.  Sumatra is all I order any more.

This is a similar blend to the Senseo Dark, but with a smoother finish. No bitterness or burnt taste at all. My only reason to give 4 stars rather than five is that the pods are a little weak. They contain about 10% less coffee than the Senseo Dark blend and it makes a difference in the cup. I normally make a two-pod cup anyway, and deal with this slight weakness by simply shutting off the brewer a little early. Another reviewer complained that the specific varieties in the blend are not stated and that therefore the taste may vary from batch to batch. I'm not an expert by a long shot, but I do drink a lot of coffee and I've been using this blend for about a year with no detectable variation.Sometimes when I want the slight extra kick of the Dark blend but still want a smooth finish I will use one pod of Dark and one pod of this Colombian blend. (That's one thing I like about the pod brewers over the Keurig style: one can mix and match).
The best coffee product at the best price with the convenience of timely automatic shipments.
Medium Roast is my favorite for an everyday coffee drink. I love Senseo -- so quick and easy!

In these days when we're all trimming our budget, buying my Senseo pods this way saves me quite a few bucks!  #1: This subscription  is the cheapest way to purchase pods that I've found. I paid $4.24 per box at WalMart, which is the lowest price in my area.  This way, it is $3.94 #2: It saves me a trip to WalMart, thus saving gas.  #3: When I go to WalMart, I will spend more money than just for pods, thus I eliminate any impulse buying. #4: Free delivery and no tax just sweetens the pot. #5: It is so convenient!  Frequently, WalMart was sold out of the dark roast pods.  I don't run out of pods anymore!  I am SOLD on this subscription arrangement.
I love Senseo's coffee pods.  They make an excellent cup of strong, flavorful coffee.

The Senseo Dark Roast pods onlong with the Philips Senseo coffee maker are a staple at my house.  It's by far the best investment I've made in my one vice, quality coffee by the cup.  At just $.45 per cup, I have the best coffee in town every day!
The dark roast is my favorite Senseo coffee!  The price has gone up in the local grocery stores, so buying it online from Amazon has actually been cheaper.  You just can't beat that.

My parents are coming to visit in a week and they drink coffee everyday.  I don't drink coffee that often and my husband doesnt like coffee so we don't have a coffee maker.  I was looking for coffee I could put in a tea kettle and make without any mess of coffee grinds and thats why I bought this (not going to buy the expensive little coffee makers for pods!).  I boiled a few cups of water and dropped in a pod earlier today.  Stirred it around then let it rest for awhile.  I added sugar milk and vanilla and served myself a cup.  It is very good, no bitter or yucky after taste.  I'm pleased. :)
I think the Amazon buy on Senseo pods (with free shipping) is a good value when compared to in store purchase prices and the convenience is a bonus.

Have been drinking Senseo Douwe Egbert Medium and Decaf coffee for many years. We even have a back up Machine just in case something fails, it never has. We pour in a dash of whipping cream, sit back and enjoy. RMB.
Why buy coffee in a store?  What's the point.  You can get it here so much cheaper, pay not shipping, never run out.... I'm in coffee heaven.
Coffee is OK not great.I can buy these at my local grocery store cheaper unless you take advantage of all of the discounts offered.

column9: Love This Coffee Like My Own Child
column10: I wont even buy coffee at starbucks because seriously this is better. I have had my senseo for years and have no desire to have any thing other than this one. I love it so much that I have a new back up machine in a box just in case this one ever goes out. I know that sounds weird but seriously I love this coffee!

column9: great coffee at a good price
column10: I was having problems finding this in the local store. To find it  at a lower price was terrific!
Coffee is very good, the order arrived timely and in great condition.  It's very easy to order and cheaper than buying in the supermarket.

column9: Best Cup o'Joe in the World!
column10: Senseo Dark is the best coffee. I couldn't start my day without it. I may have two or three, but that is good.It is like that song, "Nothing Compares to You".Easy to use, no measuring required, no brainer and good brew.Life is good!

column9: About as good as it gets for the Senseo brewer
column10: Re-write of earlier review after more than a year: I previously compared this blend to Starbucks Verona with (to quote Starbucks) a "bold intensity, with a rich, smooth and slightly sweet" flavor. I had more or less absent-mindedly migrated to the Senseo Colombian blend over the last year or so, and just recently again tried the Senseo Dark because it came with a new brewer. I stand by my earlier comparison - the Senseo Dark is similar to Starbucks Verona. And I still find the main weakness with this blend to be that it's just slightly too weak...which you can counteract by killing the brew process early and getting slightly less than a double cup from the two pods.You _can_ make better coffee than this in the Senseo brewer but not by much. The Colombian Blend is smoother, for example, but not as rich and not as sweet.
This coffee tastes really good, and the pods are very convenient to use.  Brewing is fast and cleanup is a snap.  I highly recommend them.
These dark roast coffee pods are a little stronger than the others I have tried but they still have a great taste.  When you need a quick strong brew this is what you want.
This is simply the best coffee I've had and this is the best deal I could find.

This is just wonderful.  I have a capuccino machine but I find that these pods are faster and taste as good as making it in my other machine.  I love my new Senseo machine also I have a steady supply of these pods delivered now.

I don't drink coffee, but my manager and my CEO said this was great.  They love the taste and the ease of use.  We had previously used the Starbucks pods and they never worked, we had to break open the filters to use them.  These Senseo pods work the way they are supposed to work and taste better than the Starbucks pods.

The Espresso roast is very smooth and very good. To be honest though, the dark roast has a much more pronounced flavor and is personally preferred over the espresso. Don't get me wrong, the espresso is worthy enough to buy again, but if you're going for "WAKE UP AND TASTE THE COFFEE" experience, the dark roast is the one you want.
We recommend buying the coffee pods through Amazon. They cost less than at the manufacturer's site.
This is by far the best blend.  The flavored blends in my opinion are really weak and artifical tasting.

We have totally enjoyed our Senseo Coffee Maker. It is quick and very tasty! While my husband enjoys the Decaf Pods, I am in love with the Sumatra Pods. The flavor is robust and full. A true cup of coffee. Maybe not be as strong as Starbuck's, but you will receive a very good cup of coffee using the Sumatra Pod.

I've been using the Senseo Douwe Egberts Colombia Blend Coffee Pods for more than a year now...It's a great coffee with a great taste!!  I use both the Senseo Coffee maker and the Bunn single cup coffee maker.  The pods work well in either unit!  I have recommended this coffee to friends!
If you are lucky enough to have a Senseo Coffeemaker you know how good the pods are and what great coffee they make.  This was an excellent price on the pods, and shipping was very fast.

I was turned on to this coffee by my dad.  The Senseo coffee maker is fast, easy to clean, and best of all, makes great coffee.  This dark roast blend is the best.  It is smooth and rich.  You won't be let down.
Too strong for me, but wife loves it and won't drink anything else except in an emergency.

Great coffee and a good price.  Very convenient having the Senseo Pods delivered to my house.  I have been buying my coffee from Amazon.Com for approximately 4 years.  I will continue to buy it this way.  Thank You.
medium blend is my favorite...wish that pods were less expensive, but they really are convenient so I keep ordering them!!
Great perk for working in our office. Everyone likes it. Still looking for the ultimate: the starbucks like flavor.

The Senseo Espresso Pods are good, we have the espresso pod holder for them and it seems to work well. I gonna give 4 instead of 5 stars because, I'd like it a little stronger.  But I will certainly keep ordering them from Amazon, they have great deal with the subscription service and I can't find them locally.
The Colombian Coffee pods are one of my favorites, nice clean coffee tastethat has been well liked by everyone that has tried it at our house.
Wow! Truly "instant" espresso. It tasts like you find at coffee shops. Be sure to buy the special pod holder from Senseo to make this. I'm thrilled!

Pretty good deal in comparison to in-store prices, a few cents cheaper a package and much more convenient to have it delivered to me at home! Coffee is fresh, and not too strong or weak! I love this coffee!

I love this coffee. I turn on the machine before I go to the bathroom in the morning, and then get my coffee and go back to bed to read my emails. It's very mild, still has a rich, creamy flavor.Perfect for single servings.The price on amazon is much better than at my grocery store, where a package is almost $6.

Senseo is the best home made coffee ever, thank god I found this machine and these coffee pods absolutely the best cup of coffee you will ever have I have been using the senseo machine and pods for the last three years and wouldn't be without the machine or this particular coffee try it you will be amazed at the great taste

column9: Best Coffee I Have Ever Had
column10: I like a good, strong cup of coffee.  This is the best.  I also purchased the French Vanilla which is weak for my liking.  I would highly recommend the Sumatra Blend.
I really enjoy using the senseo for a quick cup in the morning or evening, but the flavor of the medium roast is awesome!  I love the foam on top with the perfect blend of flavor beneath.

I'm not a coffee snob, barely drinking a cup a week, but my significant other needs a strong mugful every morning.  The pods and the Senseo machine are perfect for this; barely takes 2-minutes to brew.  The 6-pack box comes out to about 30cents a cup even with the added latte packets (60cents when two are used for a strong mug serving).  I'm hoping the money saved by avoiding Starbucks every morning will go to my potato chip addiction....

I have used a Senseo maker for about three years, making 3 to 10 cups a day. (I'm on my third machine.) Mostly I have used other brand pods for the bolder flavor, but these Sumatra pods are about as good as any I have tried.Some other brand coffees I like are from Wolfgang Puck and Reunion Island; however, these other brands wreck the mechanism of the Senseo due to the thicker pod. These Senseo pods work better and taste just as good.I lived in Germany for three years and really learned to like European style coffees. Nothing makes crema like a Senseo!
Delicious and fruity as described. I can only find this online so far. If this comes out in regular store, price might be little lower.

Went for economy in latest order and got the 6 pack as I could not recall what Dark Roast tasted like. Counted on all the positive reviews, but we all have different palates, don't we? I prefer Senseo's Kenya or Sumatra as a more reliably flavorful brew with Sumatra probably my favorite. Just opened my first of six bags, so I have a ways to go before I get to the end of my "bargain" purchase of a brew that is weak and one-dimensional. I guess I will have to play with the amount of water and pods as other reviewers suggest to try to get something strong enough to satisfy. Just can't throw it all out!

The other reviewer made an error.  He loved the stuff and gave it one star.  Duh!  It's wonderful coffee.  The flavor is great.  I love the delivery service - it's cheaper than buying it in the store.  You can't use double coupons any more, so why pay retail?  I love the senseo coffee blends.  Breakfast blend is my fave!

We love our Senseo, and the Sumatra Blend, which is rich and dark, yet smooth and not bitter.  Far superioe to their Dark Roast.We are starting to have trouble consistently finding it in the local stores, and buying it on autopuchase at a discount through Amazon makes a lot of sense, both for convenience and price.
Great coffee.  Stronger than "dark" and "medium" that I find in my grocery store.

Coffee has been part and parcel of my family's history.  Since discovering the Senseo machine and coffee I have used nothing else. I have tried other brands of coffee, but they're missing something.Imagine a fresh cup of coffee with every cup...That's Senseo.

We just received (July 10, 2012) a shipment of the Dark Roast pods from AMAZON after not being able to get them for the last several months.  The site still says "Out of Stock", but I think if you place an order they'll start catching up to demand in a little while.  Many thanks to the person who wrote the review explaining the move of production facilities.We tried a Mr. Coffee Keurig style machine while we were unable to get Senseo, but couldn't find any coffee as good as the Douwe Egberts pods.We're very please to see the return of the Senseo Dark Roast pods, and I hope that my subscription for the French Vanilla pods will also be available again soon.

Of the 6 bags, two that I have opened thus far have defective pods that have spilled coffee grounds throughout the bag.  Hence, I cannot use any of the pods as they are covered with coffee grounds.  I tried to return them, however the Amazon website states that they are not eligible for return.
Bring this coffee back into stock! Please! Very disappointed that you no longer are choosing to carry this great coffee! You can't do this to an addict :)

column9: Love SENSEO Coffee, not the cost
column10: I love this coffee but it's getting harder to find. I finally called the company and was told that yes, it is being removed from retail stores but will still be available "on-line" and from places like Amazon.I signed up with Amazon to have this coffee shipped to me automatically. I get 3 cases every 2 months. It's convenient but the price fluctuates and you don't know how much it's going to be. First time it was $70, two months later it went up to $90. I hope Senseo doesn't price me out, cuz I'll miss it.
The coffee is great!  I subscribed to receive on a continual basis and was to be charged only 24.79 for each shipment.  I just received my 3rd shipment and was charged 30.02.  I am not happy!

i've read allot of reviews that people say it's too weak a coffee but my opinion is i really enjoy this coffee and this is all i drink i can't imagine making a 2 pod cup of coffee bottom line i will keep buying this till they don't sell it anymore .

The pods are convenient for a lazy live-alone; I have tried the other types and flavors but they were not exactly what I wanted. Dark roast is a good start for me; I add what I feel like at the time. Or nothing if I'm really lazy. The pack of six bags costs significantly less than at my local store.

column9: Much cheaper to brew at home!
column10: We are sold on the Senseo pod system.  Every cup is fresh.  It's more expensive than fixing a pot at a time, but beats the pants off Starbucks.  The medium roast is most to the taste of my family, but we occassionally venture out to other flavors.  We are sold on Senseo.

I love coffee and this is not bitter or too strong,this goes wonderful with the senseo flavor Barista Blend additions- check it out!Senseo Espresso Coffee Pods, 16-Count, 3.92-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)Senseo Barista Blends Variety Pack, 10.72-Ounce Box (Pack of 3)
This has a good flavor and I like the ease of making only one cup.

I have been a Senseo drinker since the first machines came out.  I am now on my second machine (first one didn't last too long) and, while I find that these pods are not very strong, the dark roast works for me.  Very easy and convenient.  My wife isn't a coffee drinker but she appreciates the way I can keep the place clean with these pods!
I love this coffee I love the senseo coffee machine it makes the perfect cup everytime and the pods are fantastic

I've been using my Senseo coffee maker for few years now. I love it. I use different flavors for different moods.It's also great for parties as everyone can special order. This coffee is much better than average coffee. It is not quite Starbucks but sure runs a close second place to the cafe drinks.
Good Strong Pods..I can use these senseo pods in my Black and Decker Gt300 and they work much better than the recommended Maxwell House pods.
This is the best coffee maker I've ever had.  It heats up in seconds and makes the same froth everytime.  I highly recommend it.
Senseo coffee is delicious - rates right up along the well advertised coffee shops and kiosks.
A foamy tasty, cappuccino-like cup of coffee in about a minute, and no messy grounds to deal with after the fact.
These guys are making a killing on here! We were getting the 18 pod package locally for three bucks and some change!!!!

OK - so to start with, I LOVED my Senseo coffee system.  Have gone through 5 machines in 10 years - they eventually leak and cause problems so it's easier to buy another.  That being said the last couple of years it's been harder to find another machine (Ebay mostly) but I NEEDED my Senseo.  Then this past spring (May, June) I stopped receiving my Amazon shipment of PODS and found out that they were becoming obsolete everywhere.  Couldn't get them.  Period.I had to break down and purchase a Tasimo machine and the coffee to go with it (lots of plastic waste in the little cups) but I digress . . . so I've been 2 months with this new machine, and what arrives at my door last week ????  A CRAPlOAD of Senseo coffee pods!!!!!  Not one month's supply but THREE.Now I ask you if I drink coffee everyday, and you stop delivering my coffee for 3 months . . . . how (or why) do you think that when you do come into some inventory that I'd want (or need) to have the three months worth of coffee  . . NOW???  Those days are gone and I invested in a new machine.I'm sending them back, if anyone else needs them ;)

First you must have a sense machine.I prefer this over the popular keurig because the plastic waste in that system is a shame.The flavor is very good,though not as dark roast as a sterbucks( wHich is a plus to me).my only concern is the viability of the product against the fierce competition.also the cost is about  half of kcups.

Recently the products I have gotten are not the same quality they once were.... the filter pads used to be stamped with a senseo water mark ... now they are not I think they are counterfeit - yes I am serious

column9: So sad tht it's no longer available as a Subscribe & Save!
column10: I've had 2 Senseo machines - I thoroughly enjoy the coffee pods and was so sorry recently to be told by Amazon that they are no longer available as a Subscribe & Save product through them. After all these years (6+ at least) of drinking Senseo coffee - and it's getting impossible to find at any of my local grocery stores - I had come to completely rely on Amazon as the one place where I could always find Senseo coffee pods. I realize this is likely not Amazon's choice, it may be as sad for Amazon as it is for me. I have to echo the sentiment I read in another's comment on the site..."what do I do with my Senseo coffee maker now, plant flowers in it?"

I wanted the Kona taste and didn't get it with this coffee. It tasted bitter and old. I would not recommend buying it at any price. In the future I will fill my ecopod holders with store bought kona ground at expresso grind.
So far 1 out of 3 of the bags had unsealed pods which meant they were unusable as well as coffee grounds all over the outside of other pods in the bag. Yuk!
The  pods are easy to use and give a relatively uniform cup of coffee.  Somewhat expensive but the foam is great!  Wonderful for an easy, quick cup of coffee.

I only use this coffee, so that it is great is obvious.What my problem is, is with AMAZON.I have been buying it here forever.  The other day I get this email saying it is on a HUGE sale, BIG savings etc.  I got so excited, because as we all know coffee is expensive, but can't live without it.  I opened the email to see a huge LIE.  They showed the regular price, which wasn't the regular price.  IT was a crazy jacked up price.  Then it said you could save this huge amount...which was the regular price.  It made me so angry I almost quit my subscription.  That is so wrong.But yes, the Senseo is awesome.  Perfect, rich....wonderful everytime.  I will never go back to a conventional coffee maker.

Moving from a coffee press to these coffee pods was a culture shock.  I don't know if it's the medium roast, or possibly needing more than one pod per cup of coffee, to me it tasted like the coffee in a cheap diner. I would highly recommend buying a single bag before you invest in a case to make sure it suits your palate.
OMG, talk about price gouging!I don't know who you are but when I called Senseo, they themselves could not believe your price and had to go on line to verify it.SHAME ON YOU!!!

I purchased a single serve coffee maker that used the "pod" verses the K-Cup, because I thought it would be less expensive, and because I knew I could use 2 pods if I felt I wanted to make a stronger cup of coffee.  It turns out that it still wasn't strong enough for me, for the amount of coffee I drink.  In order to fill my travel mug to take to work, I found I was using 4 pods every morning, and the savings just were not there.  I ended up buying a new coffee maker (Keurig) and got a good deal on Amazon for Coffee People K-Cups and found that with the right kind, I can fill that travel mug using 1 of them and the taste is outstanding!

column9: Light is an understatement -- NO flavor is more like it
column10: Okay, so I like a strong cup of coffee.  I tried the Senseo Dark Roast and it was very good -- bold, but smooth taste.  The breakfast blend was really weak and tasted a little bit like wet cardboard or, as the Peanuts comic once said, like hot water with a brown crayon in it that needed more crayon.  I even used TWO pods for the smaller cup of coffee and it was still way too wimpy for me.  It still had the nice crema layer, it just had no taste.  I realize everyone has different coffee preferences.  But for someone who likes a stronger, more espresso-like coffee, I would tell them to steer clear of this roast.

column9: Beware Senseo Quality control-- Bags leak coffee
column10: I bought four cases of Senseo Breakfast blend, both caffeinated and decaf. Every coffee pod in every bag had a hole at the seam. None were sealed properly, and I lost a quarter of the coffee that I purchased, half of which was on the bottom of the bag that contained the pods and the other in my coffee maker before I figured out what was wrong. I had to staple bags in order to use them.  Called Senseo and they said to contact Amazon. They could not replace the coffee because they "did not stock it at the office." Huh?? They said that if I gave them my name, address and email, they would send me a check for what I paid. Of course they did not, and they got my personal information. Don't buy this in bulk. Buy one container at a time or you will end up with a wasted purchase.
I received exactly what I intended to order. It came securely packedged  and arrived sooner than I had expected.I am pleased that I have made a 3 monthly order for the Senseo dark roast coffee.

column9: Easy Way to Shop for Coffee
column10: We live in a rural part of California. Finding Senseo Dark Roast locally was impossible. Amazon has many choices of Senseo coffee pods including our favorite Dark Roast. Amazon has an easy way to get it to us. We signed up for the autosend monthly delivery and safe on the cost of shipping. The purchase price is discounted as well when we have it sent automaticaly. What's nice is that an e mail from Amazon comes before the schedualed shipment to ask if we want to adjust our order for this month. It's all so easy. Thank you.

The grocery stores in my area have stopped carrying the senseo products.  I happened to find it online which made me very happy.  The price was also very good and it arrived very quickly.  Thank you so much!!!

I like my coffee strong but not bitter.  Douwe Egberts is generally so so coffee but it at least has some taste. These Senseo coffee pods are different; no taste whatsoever!  It is as if they shipped old pods that had been sitting outside their packaging for a long time. Very disappointing.Note that I do get a "care package" from friends in the Netherlands sometimes which includes a dark roast coffee Senseo pod, also from Douwe Egberts. The package is different and contains more pods, more importantly the taste is entirely different.

column9: Broken pods, stale coffee, not like espresso at all
column10: These obviously don't sell well, the box I got had several broken pods and coffee grounds all over the place.  Just made a cup, had to throw it away.  Contacted Amazon and they gave me a refund even though the 30 days had passed.  Buy the Dark Roast instead; it tastes much better, is fresher and obviously sells better so they rotate stock more often.  I still had a little of the Dark Roast left, just compared the two, it's not even close.  Bottom line...1 star for this coffee, 5 stars for Amazon customer service...so a 3 overall I s'pose...

I had tried Timothy's Pod before going back to the Senseo Pods.  I prefer the Senseo Breakfast Blend over the others that I have tried.  It has a great flavor to it and love the foam on the top.  Do not use the Timothy brand pods in the Senseo machine as they do not fit without having to do some adjustments.  Also, this is a great price for 6 packs if you sign up for the automatic delivery.

Nice idea, very convenient, but pods do not seem to have the same strength and body as ground coffee that's measured out.  They certainly don't have the same quality as freshly ground beans.  The service, OTOH,was fine.  Order came promptly and package was in good condition.

This is an attractive machine, looks good in my kitchen.  My husband and I use different coffees and love the convenience of having whatever brew we need available, cup by cup.  It's easy to operate, the coffee smells good and tastes good.  Having said that, here's the downside.  It's not very well made.  It has been recalled for some electrical difficulty that could have been disastrous and the replacement broke down within months.  I am now on my fourth or fifth one and if this one goes bad in the next two years or so I am going shopping for another brand.  Sometimes I think I keep buying them just because it's so fast, efficient and pleasant to deal with Amazon.

If you have a Senseo coffeemaker, you already have a favorite pod flavor - ours is Dark Roast and we are always chasing around looking for the least expensive cost of these fairly expensive pods.  Finally, a discount on-line.  Love the pods, but it was the price we were looking for!

column9: Great coffee!! just perfect for us!
column10: I'm not a very big coffee drinker, but absolutely LOVE this particular blend. I tried the light roast and the dark roast as well but they were a tad bit too light/heavy ... this is just perfect!Everyone who comes to our home and tries this coffee is surprised how good it comes out -- plus the foam that the Senseo coffee maker adds in the end is just the perfect touch :)Will def. recommend and buy this product again.

column9: Better than the Dark Roast but Still Weak
column10: This is almost drinkable.  It is way too weak and semi bitter to be called espresso coffee.  Try the Millstone or if you can find it the Target brand pods.

Since "the big corporate takeover" I find that it doesn't really matter what products customers request on a local level.  All that matters is what "corporate" dictates. While I used to try to support local businesses, I have now almost completely stopped shopping at both Wal-Mart and Target because the local stores are forced to cater to corporate whims instead of being able to serve their customers' needs.  It is nice to be able to order the coffee I want from Amazon and have it shipped to my door.

I am a coffee freek. I have tried all kinds of coffees and coffee makers and decided on senseo coffee exclusively. I prefer the dark roast and on occasion the coppicino. Senseo Douwe Egberts Dark Roast Coffee Pods, 18-Count 4.41-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4)

Living in a fairly remote area, it is so hard to find pods for my beloved Senseo.  Now I order them in bulk from Amazon and never have to worry about running out or not having a variety of coffees to choose from.  Thanks to Amazon and Senseo for their program!

I ordered this coffee because of all the positive reviews for these pods.  I have tried making coffee from the pods, and I have found ALL of it undrinkable. My goal was to make a medium-sized mug of coffee.  With one pod, the coffee was way too weak.  I then tried two pods, and the coffee was still not strong enough.  It lacked flavor, and I found it very flat.  (For sake of reference, I like medium strength coffee.  Starbucks Coffee, for example, is too strong for me.)  Regardless, I managed to squeeze 3 pods into my coffee maker, but the coffee was now horrible.  Ok, so I thought, let's go back to 2 pods and vary the amount of water.  After some experimentation, I found that 2 pods and 10 oz. of water gave the proper strength for my taste.  However, nothing could help the flavor.  I detested the flat, stale taste. Do yourself a favor - skip this product.  Now I know why the pods are relatively cheap - you get what you pay for. I'm not a coffee gourmet, but this coffee is worst than the over-boiled stuff that is left at the end of the day in the office coffee pot.

This was the best coffee I had found for my pod coffee maker.  Too bad it's never in stock!  I have searched all over the web, and everyone seems to be sold out.  Makes me think Senseo may not be making these anymore and that my little coffee maker will be collecting dust real soon.

column9: Senseo Expresso Coffee - without Expiry Date
column10: Expiry Date - NOT found on any part of the packaging.........Not sure still good for use.Anyway to check the Expiry date?
I don't like the taste at all, look like a cheap coffe. I won't buy it next time. I do prefer Kona, more flavour.

All the products arrived on-time including a second box with a book item that I didnt order and was meant for a customer in Wisconsin.After emailing amazon they send me a link to go and print off a return label.It didnt work right away, but on the third try it did.I then had to take it to the Post Office and drop off.I just realized that I dont work for Amazon.com and that my services cant be deducted on my income tax under charitable contributions.So the recovered value of the book and my unpaid services go straight to the bottom profit line.
terrible swill.  I can't belive this is from the company that WANTS to sell you their coffee maker.  Try the Millstone or if you can find it the Target brands instead.

There's no denying the Senseo is easy to use, and 'greener' than any of the other pod brewers out there. But the Dark Roast coffee was stale and dry, with the same aroma and flavor of a canned coffee that's been left sitting out too long.A pod brew will never be AS GOOD as drip - I get that. But that won't stop me from looking for something close.If you want easy and are not picky about taste, this pod's for you. If you want a pod brew that is at all reminiscent of a decent cup of coffeehouse java, keep looking.

I ordered the expresso and the expresso coffee pod holder and waited to be delighted.  Well, Amazon didn't have a coffee pod holder for the Supreme model Senseo so I still don't know.  They shipped me a "tea pod holder" instead.  I ordered the expresso pod ho;der form the Senseo club and if I get time I will let you know how it tastes.k

column9: Item was returned.  And no communication from Amazon - very strange.
column10: This coffee was purchased in the past before for my husband.  Due to circumstances beyond my control I no longer needed it.  I had cancelled many automatic shipments in the past - hoping that I would be able to start them up again in the future, but unfortunately that wasn't the case.  Eventually I cancelled the entire Sumatra account.  I never actually took possession of the coffee for it was being held at the post office for signature - not sure why.  When I went to the post office they showed me the box and I asked them to return it.  Please contact me about the refund to my account at your earliest convenience.  TYVM.

I just purchased the Cuisinart cup o matic and just love it. I have been trying all different types of pods even though I can use regular ground coffee and the Senseo dark roast is our favorite. The deal with 6 bags of 18 for 27dollars is a better deal than most especially with no cost for shipping. I give this a 5 somehow it only shows 1 but AAAAA+

Ordered coffee pods.  Price was right, but half way thru the order Amazon said they could not process my credit card. So I started over and it worked the second time.  Of course, a double order showed up.
BEST COFFEE ON THE MARKET.  HAVE IT EVERY MORNING.  REALLY LIKE THE EASE OF USE

When I got the the pods i thought they were "fake" made by someone other than Senseo.  The pods were loosely packed and would not set level on the pod holder resulting in week coffee.  The pod also did not have the senseo logo printed on the pod.  Calling cust service they changed how the pods are made and some are still out untill they are phased out.  Sucks!  The new pods are packed better but you still need to place then carfully r the coffee is weak.  I would not buy a large pack.  Stick with the single pack so you don't wast money having pods that dont work

We have been buying Senseo Dark Roast for years.  Lately the quality has been varying - in batchA599269100 with a date of 11-24-12 - the resulting cups vary from great to watery.  Having used the Senseo for so many years, we can recognize when the coffee is going to be weak by the color of the flow.  The color varies from very light to dark in the middle of the process.  With the above mentioned batch the majority of the outputs has been light tan throughtout the run.This has happened once before.  We maintain our Senseo so the quality is not affected by the condition of the Senseo Unit.  Since I also have another Senseo at work, I took the pods to work to test.
