I wish it had no soy at all ( it has soy lecithin and soybean oil- but thats in every baby product out there, so I dont think it can be avoided).But any prospective buyers out there, please beware- Natures own does have a tendency to go into shortsupply especially the diary one. In the past 2 years that I have been using the formula, Ive seen 2 instances when the product was not available on shelves or online. Just this last week, it wasnt available anywhere - even on their own site, when I ordered it, the Customer service called me back to tell me that they were low on stock so would I consider the lactose free version!? Since my daughter has not tried lactose free, I would not give it to her. The product would be available in 2 weeks time. So, I suggest that you always stock up- atleast for a month in advance, if you do buy this brand(which I still think is the best one out there).

After researching formulas for what felt like forever, I decided on Baby's Only and am so happy I did. While we are breastfeeding almost exclusively, we were looking for something to potentially supplement my son as I had a supply issue with my older daughter.There are several reviewers that state that it isn't for babies. I am a RN in the maternal child health realm and an educator. Let me assure you that the nutritional content is incredibly similar to all infant formulas.There also have been several reviewers that state high arsenic levels. I would recommend that you do a more thorough investigation of the study that cited that. It's simply untrue, Nature's One actually had an independent lab test their formula using the EPA's standardized testing. They found nothing.This formula is without potentially hazardous hexane extracted DHA/ARA (which if you're breastfeeding, you're all ready giving the baby the all natural better version!) and would recommend this formula to anyone, especially for supplementing. I found this formula to be very slightly constipating on occasion (as all formulas are) and you have to mix it pretty vigorously.

I chose this formula to supplement my daughter because our first choice (similac organic) had been recalled and there was a shortage of the RTF. This was extremely constipating for her, because of the rice. The ingredients are some of the best if you have to use formula, but I wish they'd make a version without rice in it!

I really wanted this formula to work as it was the ONLY true organic formula that I found that does NOT contain corn syrup. I did NOT want to feed my child corn syrup, so I tried this and have been using it for about a month now. Unfortunately, it caused terrible constipation in my son- to the point where he was screaming while pooping. I would continue using this formula if it didn't cause this horrible constipation. Baby's Only smells like REAL food, not like chemicals. It mixes even better than Similac or Enfamil in my opinion, too- leaving some occasional clumps but if you shake the bottle again they dissipate. Not many bubbles, either. I would have given this 5 stars if it weren't for the constipation. I gave it a while to see if my son would adjust to it also, and I even started giving him prune juice, but his body just couldn't handle it I guess.

column9: Best Formula Out On The Market!
column10: I breastfed my daughter till she was 8 months old and was scared of the idea of formula only because you really don't know how it is made or what really is in it. After doing allot of research and finding out how they make Life's DHA I found this formula. It really is a great formula and it does not taste bad either. I compared it to the nutritional values of breast milk and it really does meet or exceed it. I honestly think this is the best thing to feed your baby if you can not breastfeed. Your not getting any harmful chemicals in this formula and the can does not contain BPA.

column9: BEST YUMMIEST SMELLING BABY FORMULA  THERE IS
column10: MY BABY LOVES THIS.  I TRIED SO MANY CONVENTIONAL STORE BRANDS AND BABY ALWAYS HAD FOUL SMELLING BREATH AND GAS.  I THOUGHT SHE WAS LACTOSE INTOLERANT.  I TRIED ORGANIC, SENSITIVE, YOU NAME IT AND NOTHING CAME CLOSE TO THE BABYS ONLY FORMULA.  SO GLAD THEY HAVE IT AT WHOLE FOODS AND SPROUTS FOR WHEN I GET LOW TOO FAST.  [...].  LOVE IT LOVE IT LOVE IT.  AND IT SMELLS LIKE VANILLA ICE CREAM!

column9: NOT GOOD!  ARSENIC AND NO CALL BACK, NOW USING HOLLE
column10: We had been feeding our baby for weeks using this formula, but then realized the studies recently found.I guess we did not want to believe it but call the company after all. First it was hard to get someone qualified about the issue, the lady was nice but couldn't help us.So she toke our number saying someone would get back to us, but nobody ever did, do they want to stay away from the arsenic issue???Nutrition is so important in a babies first few months of life that we now use another brand and have moved on from this one.It's so dissapointing that they have to add sweetner anyway! I mean it's a baby formula, and being one of the first ingredient it tells you a lot.We now use the Holle brand, it was very hard to get before but fortunately now avaiable on amazon! Much better quality, more organic and especially no added extra useless stuff that should not be in a baby diet!
I had hoped that this formula would work for us, but instead it caused baby severe constipation. I was somewhat disappointed.

My daughter turned a year on 12/29/10 & had been on Baby's Only dairy since 2 months old. We struggled with it at first dealing with her stools becoming hard pellets but I just had to come up with the right remedy of prune juice & we were good to go! Every baby is different but she is as healthy & smart as can be. I am so happy that we stuck it out with this formula because I wanted to switch many times because of the constipation. I still continue to give her one bottle of formula in the morning then she has milk in a sippy cup for the rest of the day. I will do this until I run out of the formula that I already have then we'll go all milk.If you're having trouble with the formula I recommend sticking it out. It will be worth it in the end & you'll have peace of mind knowing that they got the best formula out there!!
love it.. it has no chemicals added.. baby is not colicky at all.. i remember w my older son who was on enfamil , it was the worst experience for us.. gassy colicky.. couldnt go #2..

I was having trouble finding a formula that my 7 month old liked. I read about this formula and saw that some parents were using it for their babies. I felt comfortable, after talking with my daughter's pediatrician, starting her on this Baby's Only as a supplement to breast feeding (she was getting her teeth and starting to bite me which was not pleasant!).Now that we are almost all on formula we are running into some serious constipation issues. I do not know if it is this formula in particular or switching to solid foods at the same time that is doing it but I have been needing to give her prunes to counteract it since we started using it. The iron content isn't any higher then normal infant formulas so I'm not sure she would do any better on a different brand. Might switch to a gentle digestion formula for awhile to get her pooping happily again though.Other then the constipation she seems to really enjoy it. One other con is that it is very foamy after first mixing it up so making bottles before hand in order to let the formula settle might be a better idea.

I gave my daughter breast milk until she was 12 months old.  We needed something to replace the BM and didn't want to start with cow's milk this young, not 5 times a day anyways.  We tried several conventional formulas and she hated all of them, or if she did drink them they gave her diarrhea.  Have you ever smelled a conventional formula?  It smells metallic and it tastes even worse.  Another issue was DHA, sure this is a compound every body needs especially babies/toddlers.  However, the extraction process is sketchy.  Seriously, hexane extraction and your going to tell me all the residues evaporate off.  I find that hard to believe.  So I like the formula.  It smells good, taste decent and doesn't contain DHA instead it contains the amino acids used to make DHA in our own bodies.

column9: I wanted to love this formula
column10: I agree with others it is the best out there. It actually smells like food and not chemicals! It constipated my baby so I had to switch back to a diff organic brand.

column9: Best organic formula, too bad about constipation
column10: This is by far, the best formula out there. The fact that is uses brown rice syrup instead of corn syrup is a major plus in my book. This company is diligent about manufacturing a quality, safe product for infants and I applaud that. Sadly, b/c of the rice component, it made my 6 month old extremely constipated and gassy, despite only having one bottle a day (all the other feedings were still BF). I can only imagine how bad it could've become if she was eating this formula exclusively. Disappointed with our personal outcome, but all babies are different so hopefully others will have better luck with it.

column9: Best Infant Formula on the Market!
column10: After learning about the Hexane extraction process for DHA and ARA that all other formulas use, Baby's Only seemed like the natural choice. Another nice feature is that this formula doesn't use corn syrup solids like other formulas. We began feeding it to our son when he was about 7 months old. Our doctor said it was a fine replacement for breastmilk and there was no need to give our son the synthetic DHA in other formulas. Our son tolerated it perfectly. It also smells like milk not that gross formula smell that other ones have.
I like this formula a lot.  It's organic and my baby boy doesn't seem to have any problems with it.  It's easy to mix and it has great nutritional value.

I love this formula and my baby does too. It smells and tastes great! My son is BF and FF. He doesn't even act like he cares if I feed him a formula bottle or BM now. Before I was supplementing with Similac he would scream thru the bottle, he hated the taste of it. not any more! Also similac constipated him. No digestive problems with this formula. I can't say enough how great this formula is! BUY THIS!

column9: Great for my toddler with milk allergy
column10: I had my son on Earths Best until his first birthday, and when we introduced milk found out that he had a allergy. He is fine with yogurt/cheeses, but straight milk turns his face bright red. Earths Best was great when he was an infant, but I was always uncomfortable with the added DHA, so I decided to try Babys Only. He has been drinking 1 or 2 bottles a day for about a year and has had no flair ups, or digestion issues. I'd absolutely suggest anyone who needs to keep their child off milk, and prefers organic,  try out this toddler formula.

My son loves Baby's Only. In fact he wont drink anything else but this. We have tried everything - Similac, Enfamil, Earth's Best, etc. But he refused to drink any formula until we found Baby's Only. That said, we bought this product a couple of times off Amazon until we realized that we could buy it at any Whole Foods for a whole lot cheaper.

Nothing bad to say, actually.  It's very similar in flavor to when I've tasted breastmilk. That's good, I guess. She didn't get sick or anything whilst taking it.  Good product, buying individually was cheaper than buying the case, that was weird.

I'm only giving this three stars because it lacks DHA and ARA.  It does contain alpha-linolenic acid (ALA) and linoleic acid (LA), the precursors of DHA and ARA.  However that means the baby has to convert these into DHA and ARA, something humans don't do well (that's why we need to get DHA and ARA in our diet and why they are in breast milk).  Nature's One does make a seperate supplement to provide DHA and ARA for your baby and I would consider this a must-have if you use this formula.  Otherwise find a formula that contains these critical fatty acids.  Similac has an Organic formula with DHA and ARA and I'm sure there are others.

Like many parents, I was shocked to hear today that Baby's Only contained high levels of arsenic.  After reading the study for myself, I believe it is inaccurate to say the levels are too high.  The dairy formula tested below levels allowed in drinking water. The goal is reduction becasue elimination is unrealistic.  I have been mixing with some Earth's Best and may increase to a 50/50 mix until Nature's One releases more details on their testing and how they are going to adress this issue going forward.  Overall though, I still think this is the best formula on the market and I want to see Nature's One improve with this crisis, not be forced out of business.  I have bigger concerns about other formulas (organic and non organic) that have nothing to do with hexane.  To be fair, we prepare her bottles with filtered water so there is not much arsenic in that water. Our baby was breastfed for 7 months (we started supplementing the formula at 6 months) and she will continue to get about 20% of her milk as forzen breastmilk until she is 10 months old.

I am a breastfeeding mom who needed a formula as a back up in case we ran out of breast milk while my husband and I took a mini vacation.  I did TONS of research on organic formulas (my family eats organically whenever possible and it was very important to me to have an organic formula) and this was the only one I felt comfortable giving my baby.  She took it well and we use it on occasion if I am not around or don't have saved breast milk.  No side effects (gas, etc.) and my baby seems to like it just fine - of course, there's nothing like mama's milk- but if that is not an option for you I highly recommend this formula.

This is an excellent product! My son made a great transition from nursing and absolutely chugs his bottles. It's very competitively priced with the popular brands, especially if you shop around online. Totally worth it to give my son the best nutrition after nursing!! Also try their DHA supplement packs.

column9: Seems to be the safest on the market...
column10: I've been breastfeeding my son, but lately my milk supply has begun to drop off.  Between trying to breast pump for the times that I am away from him, and keep up with his normal feedings, I've had to supplement with formula - something that I really wanted to avoid!  I've read and heard a lot of negative things about commercial baby formulas on the market and wanted to go with the safest brand that I could find.  This seems to be the best compromise out there.There is some BPA used in the lining of the can, but it is only on the pop top lid, unlike most formula cans, which have it in the lining all the way through.  I like the fact that this is made with organic ingredients, and that the manufacturer avoids the nasty process of extracting DHA and AHA by treating it with acid and bleaching it.What is in your baby's formula?  I would recommend doing a little research before making a decision.

I could go on and on, but I'll just say this. If you're not presently using Baby's Only for your little one, then check the ingredients of whatever brand you are using. I can virtually guarantee you that one of the first--if not the first--ingredient is some kind of high fructose corn syrup solid. You really want your kid eating that? If so, then you're probably also the type of parent who takes your kid to McDonalds for Happy Meals. But if you happen to be the type of parent who cares a bit more for your child's diet, then there really is only one formula to use: Baby's Only. Plain and simple. We're all about giving our little boy as many advantages as we can afford, and this is a simple choice. It's only available at Whole Foods where we live at about $9/can for a 12.7 ounce can. That's right... about as much as you pay for the other stuff, but twice as healthy. This one's a no-brainer.
I wanted a good formula to switch on for my son because he needed a supplment between nursing so I was very happy to find something not made in china and was organic.  Love this product.

My baby boy does not like the taste of regular formula and simply refuses the bottle when I try to give it to him.  When I gave him Babys Only he was hesitant for a minute and then drank the whole bottle without stopping for breaks.  He likes it so much better than Similac and Good Start.The cost is comparative to the other brands, but the shipping adds up.  I didn't see it at the BabysRUs, still have to check the health food stores.
Note-- look closely, it's "Toddler Formula" and not intended for infants.  How's that for confusing?  The label clearly states that it's not meant for anyone under 1 year old.  Whooops.
My baby loved this formula the very first time she tried it. I highly recommend it.

I'm with Nclphx, I noticed the pricing discrepancy as well.  This is not 12 cents an ounce, it's 1 dollar and 24 cents an ounce.  The product is a great product.  The 1 star rating is to alert buyers to the price.
I'm reading that it's $.12/oz is that right? If that's correct lol this 12.7 oz can of formula would only cost $1.52. I wish somebody would learn to use a calculator on this site. Faulty advertising.

column9: Tastes WAY better than it looks.
column10: To concur with the previous review, this juice looks pretty revolting (a dark greenish/brown). However, if you can set that fact aside, it actually tastes amazing. I'd liken it almost identical to peach juice (almost as sweet as that juice you'd get with canned peaches). It's delicious. It is 100% juice. Ingredients (in order) are filtered water, apple juice concentrate, peach puree, pineapple juice concentrate, banana and mango purees, spirulina, chlorella, natural flavor, barley grass powder, ascorbic acid (vitamin C), gellan gum, broccoli and spinach powders. According to the label one 8oz serving contains 620mg of spirulina and 420mg of chlorella. These two ingredients, along with the barley grass, are supposedly effective detoxifiers of mercury. All said, this is a condensed, very nutritious, and great tasting juice. Just close your eyes if you have to to ignore the color.

I just started drinking this in the mornings with some drops of cell power.  It looks horrible, but I must say that it doesn't taste horrible. Very fruity but I can taste a little iron.  It is much better than taking the liquid iron.Very good.  My 2 year old and 8 year old cousins kept asking for more when they gave me a sample at Nature's Bounty.If your letting the looks stop you, don't.

I am comparing this product to similar products I purchased recently via Amazon and eBay. I must say that this was the best quality bubble tea mix that I have purchased. When mixed it has a smooth and fresh taste of real coconut. The color is actually a green coconut green color and I also used the black tapioca pearls in this. The picture is a bit misleading because you have to purchase the pearls separately. I probably made about 10 sets of 2 16 oz drinks with this which absolutely beats the $5 per cup boba tea that I previously would purchase at the Bubble tea house.
Every kitchen should have this product! Use it for seasoning meats, fish and even for making some really off the wall dressings!
I haven't used the product yet but I had great customer service and speedy delivery.

column9: Very large berrys, just not as tasty as they look
column10: The berries were packaged very well.  They looked just like the photos on the site when I pulled them out.  The berries were so large, that my guests were cutting the berries in half so they could eat them.  That is when I noticed that the chocolate coating started falling off the berries. The chocolate will also start falling off if the berries are left out on the table for to long.  I glade I got them but I do not see myself buying them again.

Well if it'll help. I've been eating them for 50 years, watched the cans get smaller, liquid to bean ratio get bigger but they still are the best P&B around. Tried the rest, Campbells is the best. Years ago they actually had a small piece of pork in the can, it was like finding the prize in a Cracker Jack box. Bush's Maple baked beans are a treat as well but not worth the price difference. I order them by the case so I don't have to lug cans in from the store. I do that with any staple I can, pasta, coffee, beans, socks.This is what happens to you when you retire, Amazon solicits a review of Pork & Beans an you do it, highlight of my day.

Excellent all around good food, perfect on a plate by itself or will add flavor to other foods,,,super for elaborate meals or a quick snack....healthy and delicious, recommend buying this great product,
The Campbell's Pork & Beans are very good.  Will be ordering again in the near future.  We add a little barbeque sauce to them and bake them.  Quick and easy to make every time.

These cans of beans are as good as they were 40 years ago. I guess they use the same ingredients, which is rare these days. Do yourself a favor and get some of these and taste the old fashioned taste you loved years ago.

column9: Eat them right out of the can
column10: My all time favorite pork and bean. I add a little ketchup and brown sugar to sweeten them up. The price has gone up over the years but the flavor remains the same. Should be in everyone's pantry.

column9: Good Stuff But a Few Warnings (see below)
column10: Overall, this is a good and fast hot chocolate product offering.  While I don't drink that much hot chocolate, my family does and they like the quick and easy way they can make a cup vs. warming up water in the microwave, stirring, etc.  I think it tastes a little better than the Butternut and Nestle brands - throw in a few marshmellows and you are set!The cost per cup seems pricey to me (hey, I'm an accountant), but I've done the math and it is comparable to other brands and traditional ways of making hot chocolate.  As an Amazon Prime member, I don't pay extra for shipping (well, technically I do with the annual fee) which helps mitigate the cost per cup.Here are the things to look out for when brewing hot chocolate with your Keurig:1.  Make sure you shake the cocoa container real well prior to putting the pod in the Keurig: the powder / mix tends to clump, and you don't want that to be the case when you brew a cup or else it will taste a little watery.2.  The hot chocolate tends to be thicker and can clog up the filtration / water lines (or whatever they call it).  After you make a cup of hot chocolate, immediately run a medium cycle of just hot water.  You'll see what I mean with the cloudiness of the water coming out at this cycle as it cleans out the water line.  Make sure you put a cup under it when you do it or you'll have a mess!3.  If you want a "richer" hot chocolate experience, use the small or medium setting.  It all depends upon your viewpoint: my son and I like the small setting, and my wife and daughter like the medium setting.  Don't forget the marshmellows!Enjoy!

column9: What it lacks in flavor, it makes up for in convenience.
column10: If you only read one thing about Green Mountain's hot cocoa, make it this: Don't ever use these K-Cups on a larger setting.When used on the standard setting, almost all of the powder in the Green Mountain cups gets used (unlike Timothy's White Chocolate cups), and produces an acceptable cup of hot cocoa.Admittedly, it's not much better than a Swiss Miss packet that you'd mix in hot water, but the convenience of slamming a cup in your Keurig and having a cup of cocoa in less time than it takes to microwave some water is pretty nice. And if that's your goal, this is a pretty good buy.However, if you're expecting massive chocolate flavor or a "gourmet" experience, these K-Cups are guaranteed to disappoint. Using two on the small setting might get you by, but that brings your cost per cup around a buck, which is pretty steep for what you're getting.

I enjoy the flavor of the Green Mountain Hot Chocolate. I found that after brewing, the nozzle (that sharp plunger that comes down from the top) was clogged with a small amount of chocolate paste. Nothing major, but I needed to clean it off immediately, before it dried. I used my cleaning tool, a thin tiny dental brush < DenTek Easy Brush Cleaners 10 ea >, and removed a bit of chocolate from the nozzle. Never a problem after that, as long as I clean it each time.  When I use coffee only, I only need to clean the nozzle once every 2 or 3 weeks. I think it's the different consistency of chocolate powder vs. ground coffee.  I own a Kuerig B40 at the office and a B77 at home, same problem.

For those who say the cocoa is weak, you might remember to give the K-cup a good shake to loosen up the powder before putting it it the machine. And take a look at it after it brews - sometimes not all the powder dissolves, so tear the top seal off and mix what's left in the K-cup into the cocoa. I've not had a weak cup yet. I find that the 6 ounce cup size works best if your machine has it but the 8 ounce works, too.There's nothing magical about this like with a coffee K-cup, it's just hot chocolate powder in the cup, no filter. You could forget the machine and just open the cup and mix it into hot water (or milk!) but that takes away the fun. It really tastes pretty good; I take a star off for coconut oil and all those weird additives in it. Inscrutably, it has 3 grams of fiber per cup, from inulin. Maybe to give it some body? Don't know, but it tastes fine.Also, it never hurts to run a cupful of plain water (no K-cup) through the machine to clean the needle out after using one of these. That will help with the clogging.

I enjoy a variety of Green Mountain coffees, so when I saw this on display at a local department store I picked it up. I absolutely love hot chocolate. I couldn't wait to take this one home and try it out. After the first couple of cups I was disappointed in both the flavor and body. After going through a couple of adjustments like less water, it still left me wanting more. Maybe I was expecting too much. Not only does it lose points for lack of flavor, I just don't like my chocolate this watered down.

column9: Yuck! Chocolate flavored water is what you get. Not good at all!
column10: This is some of the worst stuff I've ever tried to drink.  It's even worse than that awful stuff that comes out of those machines where the cup drops down and fills it.  I tried it on the various cup size settings with my Keurig machine and it just goes from bad to horrible when going from the larger size to the smallest.It's a complete waste of money.I just tried another brand that's similar and it's no good either.  If you like chocolate water, buy these.  If you have it in mind that you are buying "Hot Chocolate" with a milky or creamy flavor... that's not what this stuff is.Yuck!

I purchased these Hot Cocoa K cups for my husband.  Our local store is always running out of the Cafe Express in Hot Cocoa so I thought I would stock up on the Green Mountain brand.  He told me last night that they are just OK and not chocolatey enough.  He said he would drink them, but in the future we will stick to the Cafe Express.

column9: Best in Value; Okay in Taste; How to Improve It
column10: This is the best value in K-Cup hot chocolates by far among all brands.  It costs a mere 33 cents per K-Cup for what I paid on Amazon.  Green Mountain makes great coffees, but this product is rather anemic in cocoa taste, and it is not as sweet as some other brands.  This is either good or bad depending on you taste, of course.Now here are some tips to improve the taste:1) Shake the K-Cup prior to use in order to minimize clumping.2) Use the lowest amount of water setting on your machine.3) After the brew cycle ends, tear open the top cover and empty out the left over cocoa into your mug.  (You'd be surprised how much cocoa is left in there--therefore wasted if you don't do this.)4) Add a splash of milk for extra richness, and sugar for sweetness (optional).5) Enjoy!
I'm on my third cup today. This stuff tastes exactly like hot cocoa should taste. It's way better than the "Milk Chocolate" K-cups that I tried before this.

I don't know anyone who has purchased a Keurig single serving unit for the specific purpose of making hot chocolate.  If that's what you're most interested, save your money and get a hot water kettle for a heck of a lot less plus a good hot chocolate mix recipe (that perhap used dried milk).  So, in reviewing the Green Mountain Coffee Hot Chocolate k cups, you have to sort of start here - is this about convenience or taste?As far as convenience goes, there's no question it's pretty gosh darn convenient.  Toss a k-cup into the slot and hit brew - there you go.  A+ for speed.  Congratulations, you can make hot chocolate in less time than it takes to boil water.  I suppose if having a hot cup of cocoa is what you absolutely must have in 30 seconds or less, you lead a very wonderful life and I'd like to experience it once myself.  You know, the world where instant hot chocolate is the biggest worry of the day.  Truth be told, though, when entertaining, it's nice to have the option of a single serving - quickly - without the need for a secondary device or even a microwave which can superheat the water.Kids can use the device, so that's another plus.  Properly trained, a young child can make their own hot chocolate without too much risk of 3rd degree burns.  So the question then turns to taste....Our 7 year old and 5 year old were used in the taste test.  We served them hot choclate from a packet (swiss miss, with marshmallows), a single cup of the Green Mountain, and a cup of a family recipe we have that also uses water.  (They added marshmallows to the other two options as well).Family recipe won by a landslide.  Two to nothing.  Swiss miss was made, per the packet directions, with 8 ounces of water.  They liked this second best, but still complained of it being watery.  The Green Mountain came in third, because it was entirely too watery.I remade the Swiss Miss and the Green Mountain version with less water.  I used the next smalles setting on the Keurig and I only used 6 ounces of water on Swiss Miss.  Green Mountain was the lesser preferred, although the it wasn't so much about the "wateryness" as the actual flavor.My kids tend to like the creamier - which is largely milk based - hot chocolate.  Green Mountain just didn't provide that.I think with less water, the Green Mountain k-cup tastes fairly good.  No, it's not very creamy.  But for a quick single serving, it will do.  Then again, we didn't get a Keurig in order to make hot chocolate in the firt place, so I can't get too undone about the mediocrity of this flavor.  It's ok.  Not worth a higher recommendation, and certainly not worth the purchase of the machine.  But it's a nice flavor to add to the ensemble of other flavors.

I just love my Keurig and I've enjoyed tasting all of the different coffees in the sampler pack so when I ordered this hot cocoa I thought it would be as good as the coffee. I was wrong, dead wrong. This cocoa is terrible and tastes like sugary hot water. You honestly get no chocolate taste at all. I had such high hopes for this hot chocolate and all I have now is the hot cocoa blahs.

Is this hot chocolate....yesIs this good hot chocolate....um, sortaIs this gourmet hot chocolate....not a chance.In my opinion, the only advantage you get but using the Green Mountain K-cups of hot chocolate is the simplicity of using your Keurig machine to heat the water instead of using the microwave or stove-top. Other than that the finished product is comparable to any Swiss Miss or other brand of powdered instant cocoa. It actually may be worse if you use the largest setting on your machine. The largest setting makes it much too watery.Green Mountain needs to go back to the drawing board on this.3 stars because it does make hot chocolate in your Keurig without having to dirty dishes and tear open pouches, but if you're looking for good hot chocolate, keep shopping.
In my opinion, it is a good cup of hot chocolate.  What more can I say!?
This hot cocoa is drinkable, but the taste is bitter to me.  Some in our office thought it was okay.  I'll try another brand next time.

I love the Green Mountain coffees so much! Wish I could say the same for the cocoa. It's just not strong enough for me, even when I choose the smallest cup size on my Keurig. It's okay, I guess, but when I make my own cocoa from scratch, I make it super dark and rich. I think I'm spoiled. :)

I rated this 5 stars especially because of the price but I thought the hot chocolate was very good too - used the medium setting on my Keurig which is 7.25 oz. and it was just fine for me.  I'd buy it again and would recommend it to friends too.

Our kids love that we receive this through the Subscribe and Save program.  With four of them, we have to mark each k-cup with their initials so they get the same number of cups of hot cocoa.  Great product and price!
I got these for my in-laws who have the Mr. Coffee version for K-cups. They do enjoy them but prefer the milk chocolate version better.
Very good tasting Cocoa for a water based one, Ive found myself having a cup every evening now.  Remember to always run a cycle after of only water after brewing with cocoa to clean the Kuerig out.
This is easy the best cocoa drink out there, I'm an expert on cocoa and Green Mountian wrote the book on this product. A year around drink for me, it hits. the spot for after dinner treat.
A pretty good cup of cocoa- especially because it is made with water.  When I have the time I make the "real thing". This is a good quick fix.

column9: These are fine on a lower ounce setting
column10: I bought these, knowing they weren't going to taste like rich, flavorful hot cocoa, but they were on sale and my kids had been asking why I never buy hot cocoa K cups.  For the kids (teens), they didn't care what size they brewed on, they drank it anyway.  I've tried a couple and found that they are just fine on a 6 oz setting.  I also have used them on a 6 oz setting and mixed with a strong coffee k cup at a 4 oz setting and topped with foam or whipped cream.  If you are not expecting chocolate perfection, and maybe keep these around for making mochas, then it's worth it if they are on sale.
I have tried 3 or 4 different varieties of cocoa. This one is by far my favorite. I will stick with. This brand from now on.

Not very please with the green mountain hot cocoa product, lacking a good chocolate taste, even when you mix two of them together it doesn't make it better.  Will never buy these again, best kind is the Grove Square or Swiss Miss k-cups.

On a positive note, Green Mountain Hot Cocoa is one of the few (hot cocoa) products that is not made with hydrogenated oils.  I, like some other reviewers, had a problem with it clumping in some (not all) of the k-cups.  What you end up with is chocolate flavored water...yuck.  It didn't occur to me to shake them up before putting in the Keurig.  What I did with the remainder of the box was open them up, empty in cup, and then put boiling water in cup.  They do have a good milk chocolate flavor and for a richer taste you can make with boiling hot milk.  Since I didn't trust these k-cups to work everytime, it seemed like a waste of money to buy them so I started buying bulk powder mix such as Ghirardelli & Starbucks Hot Cocoa (brands that do not contain hydrogenated oils either).

I am slowly realizing that no matter what flavors they SAY are in the K-Cups, coffee is still just coffee. And as for this Green Mountain Coffee Hot Cocoa -- HO HUM. Soooooooo bland! Good thing I tried it in a sampler pack, I will not buy any more of it. I can make my own from cocoa powder and sugar, and ten times better.

column9: hot cocoa for a good deal
column10: hot cocoa was a good deal and was very tasty. would buy it againfor a good price and the brand name was good

I have purchased this in the past and recently restocked by Hot Cocoa through Amazon.  I must say, this Hot Cocoa is very good, but does have a thick texture as others have mentioned.  But this cup of cocoa is excellent with a little whip cream on top!
They came packed perfectly and my kids love them.  Will definetly purchase these cocoa cups in the future when I need more
This hot cocoa is great. It's not too sweet and for this price...you can't beat it. Would definitely buy again.
The best hot chocolate for the K-Cup brewers.  My daughter and I love it.  Makes 8 oz. of great tasting cocoa.
I was happily surprised, this is very taste and satisfying,  will always have it in my kitchen.have tired others but so far this is the best.

My wife likes it a lot!  So that is good.  Certainly it isn't the best hot cocoa you can buy but it is pretty good and it is very convenient.  She usually makes it on the 10 ounce setting.  We always make sure to run a rinse after as it does tend to leave some chocolate in the brew chamber which messes up the next drink if you don't rinse it.

I love the taste of chocolate. But it has to be a hearty taste, not a weak watered-down one. This small pod delivers on the taste factor for sure. Quick and easy straight into your cup and smooth and delightful onto your taste buds.You will not be disappointed.

column9: The adult version of hot chocolate.
column10: If you drink swiss miss now, like I used to, you most likely wont like the taste of this.  It does not have an overwhelming sensation of chocolate, just a nice subtle cocoa flavor.  I don't enjoy anything that is overly sweet, so this is perfect for me.
Was disappointed in the quality of the chocolate.  It tasted kind of like coconut??  Will not purchase again.

If there's one word to describe the taste of this product, it's gross.  Aside from the very watered down flavor, the powder has SALT mixed into it.  Not just one of the ingredients that goes into making the powder, it has uncut salt crystals mixed in with the powder.  You can actually taste that it is salty. I honestly thought it was my water, so I started using spring water.  The taste of my coffee much improved, but the cocoa was still nasty.  It was enough to make me throw away half a box.  I would not recommend this at all.  Order the Cafe Escapes Milk Chocolate instead.  It's a little more expensive, but it tastes 1000x better.Or, just use your favorite canister-pack hot cocoa mix, and use the Keurig without a K-cup to boil the water. This avoids two problems..  You don't have to run a hot-water cycle to clean the hot cocoa crap out of the K-cup housing, and you don't lose 1/4 of the powder that gets left in the botton of the K-cup as sludge.  The powder cups just don't work that well in the Keurig.

column9: old vending machine hot cocoa flavor...yuk.........!
column10: YUK! .....was my first thought during my initial sip of this cocoa k cup,,,remember when the old coffee vending machines tried to produce a cup of hot cocoa?;this is what this k cup hot cocoa reminds me of......watered down.....hot cocoa if used on the medium to large cup setting......,but much better flavor if made on the smaller cup setting and adding coffee creamer and a sweetener to the final product
We've tried a couple of other brands of k-cup hot chocolate, but my kids prefer this one.  It's tasty and creamy.
This product is surprisingly delicious being made from water and not milk.  I was absolutely surprised at how good it is.

Very disappointing.  Not rich chocolate, watery, flavorless  -- more like chocolate flavored water.  Even whipped cream and marshmellows could not help.  NOT worth the $40 at all.  Use Carnation mix  in the cup and add the water...or drink tea.

After the first cup, which required adjusting the water/cup level, I found this some of the best hot chocolate I have ever had! As good or better than any package or store bought mix. Very rich, with an inviting aroma, a person could get hooked on a cup of this every evening. Highly recommended.

I like Green Mtn. coffee; but at almost .70 cents per K-cup get real. I have watched the price climb from a standard of .50 cents (on sale at.40 cents) per cup to today's so-called bargain prices of .68 cents. I know that over a year ago coffee harvests were down but that is over. In fact Brazil has a coffee glut. The price is being controlled by investors just like oil. Do not give in. I say boycott the product until they bring the price down to previous levels.
Not the best hot chocolate ever have.  But the best in Kcup form!

I guess that explains the good deal I got on the price, they probably can't give this stuff away. So suggestions like I've seen out here if you made the mistake I did and bought 48 of these1) always use the 6 or 8 ounce cup top, no 8 - 10 - 122) add a little suger for flavor, a little cream for texture, and some whipped cream or marshmallows and top off with cinnamin.Enjoy and buy a different brand next time.

column9: Shipped with  less than 2 months dating....  NON-RETURNABLE????
column10: I love Amazon...but this product showed up with less than 2 months dating.  The Hot Cocoa tastes great, but I was shocked by the short date.  What was even more upsetting was to see that it is a non-returnable item.  Make sure to read the return policy and make sure you are ready to drink a lot of Hot Cocoa in a very short period of time.
My family enjoys this cocoa.  I prefer mine made with milk but this makes them happy, so I buy it.

All of the tips given in other reviews (size selection, running a cycle of hot water after making hot chocolate, etc.) are spot on. Regardless, this hot chocolate is pretty bad. It reminds me of what comes out of the old coffee vending machines you still sometimes see. It seems like Green Mountain went heavier on the sweet than on the chocolate and the results are disappointing.

This hot chocolate is really good if you add 2 teaspoons of a non diary creamer. I use a rich one. I also shake the container real well as advised by other buyers of this product. I wish the major hot chocolate manufactures would put there product in a k cup. Maybe it won't fitEnjoy

My husband bought me the Keurig brewer with a variety of coffees and hot chocolate.  I didn't really like the brand in the sample, so I ordered the Green Mountain brand.  I really enjoy the flavor - it is very smooth and has a good chocolate flavor and aroma.  I will definately order this product again.
Good product. Enjoy a cup twice a day. Learned fromreliable medical source that hot chocolate is excellentin controling high blood pressure
This hot chocolate makes a rather mediocre cup.  I cannot recommend this item.As with most K-cup products, this item is no deal price-wise.

column9: is it just me, or has the price doubled??
column10: I like these OK.  They are convenient and tasty enough.  But I just clicked on the link in my previous orders and it appears that they have just about doubled in price unless I read it wrong.  At almost $1 a cup, I'll pass....

column9: A good cup of hot chocolate.
column10: I bought this for my daughter to go with the new Keurig I bought her and she loves it.  We all had to sample them on Christmas and it was just a good cup of hot chocolate.
Since it is just an instant powder I often just open the k-cup, poor it in my mug then use a coffee k-cup and brew into the mug and MOCA!  Not bad at all!

Buyer beware, the worst flavored Hot Cocoa I have ever tasted. Never again would I waste my $ for this product, I tried different machine sizes and options, the rest goes in the garbage. What a rip off with two packages.
I BREWED IT ON THE 8.OZ SETTING BUT IT WAS WATERY AND NOT RICH.  WOULD NOT RECOMMEND.

My wife gave me a package of Buffalo Bills "Premium Hickory Beef Jerky Pieces" for my birthday. So being the cool guy that I am, I took it on a recent 4-wheeling trip and shared it with my compadres. Here's what they had to say:"WATER!!!!!!!!!!"LOL! Seriously, this IS good jerky. But it's a tad bit salty, and has a VERY distinct soy flavor. Maybe because the first three ingredients are beef, water, and soy. haha! If you do not like soy, you will NOT like this jerky. But that aside, it was a good-sized bag, and we demolished it in pretty short order. The pieces were not too big or small, and it was not chewy. It was maybe a tad bit hard, but it was not sinewy. This was premium beef - no grissel! I highly recommend this and other Buffalo Bills jerky products.Just be sure you have something to drink (it goes great with beer)!

This jerky is my favorite.  Is easy to eat yet has substance. Thick chunks that aren't mushy.  The flavor is excellent and you can tell it's made from quality meat- no stringy or "mystery" surprises.  I'm hooked!*************************************************Just got a new batch and I have to agree with the reviewer who also just got some of this- SALTY!  Can't taste anything else.  Does seem a little greasy but it was on my step (delivered there) and it was 100 degrees today.  May have been from that.  Texture is the same but that salt.  Hope it's a fluke.  I'm calling them tomorrow!

column9: Great Natural Jerky, the way I like it
column10: This jerky might not be for everyone, but this is exactly how I like my jerky.  It has a natural look and taste, as if I made it myself.  I have been struggling to find a jerky that is not processed, soft, and chewy like every Jack Links makes.  You can tell immediately Jack Links is fake.This jerky has a nice smokey flavor.  It's tough and gives you something to chew on.I'll be buying this Jerky again and again.

I've been a beef jerky lover my entire life and have sampled all different brands of beef jerky and this is hands down my favorite... Just a terrific product... I buy a few of the 1 oz bags every time I visit my local liquor store and can't get enough of it....

column9: Tooo Salty!!!! But great customer service!
column10: The meat taste way tooo salty that it feels bitter in my mouth even with small bite.  Check out their 1.4lb jerky, much better than this.UPDATE: I was contacted by Choo Choo R Snacks and they offered to replace this pack with one of my favorite (more expensive) at no cost to me which i gladly accepted. They said if you don't like it, contact them and they'll make it right. Other reviewers mentioned the saltiness is only with this new lot, so check for their update when you order. Thanks Choo Choo, i will buy again!

column9: Really Great Tasting Beef Jerky! Highly Recommended!
column10: Buffalo Bills 16oz Premium Hickory Beef Jerky Pieces are a great tasting, fairly low carb and low calorie snack!The flavor is strong, but not over-powering, and it is not too tough to chew.Buffalo Bills is by far my favorite commercial brand of Beef Jerky!Highly recommended!
One of the best beef jerky's I've had.  I got a sample with my order of hot shots and immediately ordered more of these.  Yum!  Chewable and salty.

Original Hickory Pieces are a kitchen cabinet staple at our house. Everyone enjoys the wonderful taste of this jerky. The hickory flavor blends nicely with the pepper and garlic, and is consistently good with each order. We can always depend on Choo Choo for great taste and excellent service.

When you are looking for that after work or after school snack, skip the chips and pretzels and grab a pack of this Original Hickory Beef Jerky. Great hickory taste with a little pepper zing. Chew slowly and savor the flavor while you unwind from the day's stresses. Totally satisfying!
S what if it is salty it is jerky.  Just eat a few pieces when you are out for a hike and drink your water.  No need to eat a whole bag at once and OD on the salt

I'm known to be a salty person, so that may be why I like this so much. This is so much better than chewy jerky. I'd much rather have dry leathery jerky than chewy, greasy jerky. To me, jerky should be salty to help keep your sodium during a long trip or physical activity. I don't write reviews on Amazon much, but felt I should chime in on this product. Funny, but my local Sunoco station in Pgh carries this brand and it's the only one I buy, except if I visit my home state of Texas and go to Buccee's gas station where they have a full and I do mean FULL jerky deli style counter with all kinds of fresh jerky by the lb. It is a jerky lover's dream.
I ordered this Beef Jerky for my dad as a Father's Day gift.  He said it was rock hard...like shoe leather.  I'm sending him a label to return it.  Not sure if it was out dated or just too dry.
The jerky is so greasy, if I want to eat a piece I am required to blot it with a napkin.  Very gross! One star because all prior purchases have been very good and high quality.
This is a very dry jerky. Dry and tough. It's great to chew on for a while and though it has a nice flavor, it is way too salty.

I am on an aircraft carrier, in the middle of the ocean and have been for 5 months now.  I orded this jerky and when it came in, I was salivating to try it.  Hands down the best jerky I have had, it wasn't full of tendons or fat, it wasn't chewy, and it wasn't as dry bark.  Perfect jerky, prime cuts of beef, the right texture and taste.  I shared two pieces out of the bag, then felt the urge to conserve the rest of the jerky for myself.  If you order a bag, order two, that way you can hide one for yourself then appear to be a giving soul with the other.  Keep it for yourself.Jason CohenMaster SergeantUSMC

I had earlier left some neutral feedback because my original order of this product was kinda dry. I posted that feedback around 9am yesterday morning and had gotten a phone call directly from the vendor less than 3 hours later.Buffalo Bills apologized profusely about the dry beef jerky I had gotten. They also said they were going to send me a replacement and assured me it would be good. I, of course, withdrew my original, neutral feedback and replaced it with this feedback.I am very very impressed with Buffalo Bill's customer service. Mistakes happen to everyone and it is the ones that step up and immediately resolve the issue like they did that get my full five star ratings such as this one.

This jerky is inedible.  You would have to reconstitute it in beef broth to be able to chew it.  Additionally, all you can taste is the hickory smoke and salt.  It might be leather for all I know.  I purchased several other varieties from this manufacturer, and they are all of similar poor quality.  Avoid.
Buffalo Bills is the best beef jerky on the market.  Delicious smoky flavor with lasting spicey overtones.  random size pieces are great for snacking (but hard to stop)!  Our family loves it.

I will say it over and over again. If you want good jerky Buffalo Bills is the way to go. I love all their products. Mind you i've only had about 5 or 6 different ones. I love thier spices, and that the jerky is not super soft. They are the way jerky should be, tough and flavorfull.I will be ordering more.

column4: John H. Austin Jr. "John Austin 'bookworm & geek"
column9: Great service.  Good, solid beef jerky
column10: This beef jerky is good and solid.  I use the word solid because it is not moist.  The heat also overwhelms the smoke flavor (at least for me).  I will definitely consume this, but will buy another flavor next time.I've also tried the original flavor which is very good and moist and the barbecue, which is very moist and absolutely delicious.If you like your jerky chewy with some fire and some smoke flavor, buy this!

column9: Honestly, the best beef jerky I have ever had...
column10: I have ordered probably $500 of jerky from various online companies in the last 3 years and I can say this is for sure the best jerky I have ever had.  The hickory flavor is great and salty.  It's the kind of snack you just can't stop eating.  The other great thing is I like the pieces, instead of long strips.  It much nicer to be able to just pop bite size pieces in your mouth, rather than try and use your side molars to rip a long piece of jerky apart.  I have probably gone through eight bags of this product and have two in the cupboard.  Just do it.
This beef jerky is full of flavor!  It's the best I've had for the price.  Probably going to order more! I don't think it will last long in our house!

column9: best beef jerky ive had in a long time
column10: this tastes like home made beef jerky to me. there is also a ton of it in one bag. for 20.00 i thought it might be a little pricey but its a good deal compared to store brands and a lot better. i did not find the meat to soy saucey or tough like some others mentioned. i went ahead and bought another bag.

column9: The best of the best #1 beef jerky
column10: I LOVE THIS BEEF JERKY!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! This is the second time I have ordered and both times i got it on time. The jerky is the best in the world. It is the only one I have tasted that lets me know that I am eating beef jerky not sugar syrup  jerky.I took some to work and my whole bag was gone by then end of the day.Thanks a bunch for the delicious treats
Not the best jerky ever, but it ranks up there in my top ten! Hard to put down once the bag is open!

This is good quality jerky like the trade shows.  If you are jerky enthusiast like myself you won't be disappointed.  Very good quality meat.  My only complaint if I can find one would be it's a little light on the flavor for me.  I prefer the maple pepper for a spicier flavor.

Since I really loved Buffalo Bill's Extra Smokey Links, I thought I would enjoy trying this beef jerky.Big disappointment.  Way too dry and tough.  Very little smoked flavor.  Average ho-hum jerky taste.  Buy Buffalo Bill's Extra Smokey Links instead!

This is my favorite beef jerky, hands down.This is the most bomb-diggety jerky around.Very salty, a bit tough, just perfect.I ordered from Choo Choo R Snacks. I got my jerky sooner than expected, and it was packaged well. I would definitely use them again to get jerky.I can't say enough how pleased I am. I highly recommend this jerky and seller.

I bought this jerky for the first time from a gas station counter. Then I finally found it here on amazon in bulk packaging. It is the best jerky around (besides my own homemade jerky). This jerky is a bit salty, but very, very good. It is highly recommended. I place it in a jar on the counter and it is gone within a week.

Good flavor, good texture, decent price but my god...SALTY! I love jerky and make my own as well as purchase. Others have accused my taste as being on the salty side but this stuff was way to salty even for me.Update-Cho Cho snacks customer service contacted me to exchange for a substitute product to insure my satisfaction. A+ customer service! I will continue to purchase and enjoy their other products for sure.
Highly recommend this product.  Purchased the hickory smoked jerky multiple times. Simply the best jerky around!!!

One of the best beef jerky products on the market, fantastic if you have a mason jar/ jerky jar and let them breathe in there. Found these at a bar and just had to order a lot more for gaming sessions. Great company too.

I really like ChooChoo R Snacks Jerky, their quality is exceptional as I have stated in a previous review for their "Big Slabs" and their "Country Cut". But this Jerky which I got today with the soy sauce is really not my taste, it is absolutely salty, and the soy overpowers the meat flavor itself, and far as smoky flavor is concerned, there is none I can taste,the jerky is also unusually greasy, really coated in grease to be factual. I will personally only stick with ordering their "Country Cut" and their "Big Slabs" where you taste the good flavor of the meat, and the jerky is moist, but NOT greasy.
we searched everywhere to find this jerky.  It is the best on the market and they ship very quickly.  We had it in less than 3 days. We have already reordered it.
Best beef jerky next to visting my local Farmer's Market here in PA!  Great flavor, hard not to eat the whole bag!

Buffalo Bill's Beef JerkyBuffalo Bills Premium SnacksI realize that taste is an individual thing, but I thought I'd share my thoughts on these products.First, customer service is excellent.  I've always gotten exactly what I ordered in a very timely manner.So far I've ordered the following products:1) Buffalo Bills 2.1lbs Mild Short Shots2) Buffalo Bills 2.1lbs Hot Short ShotsThe first two short shots are very similar to Slim Jim's, just not individually wrapped, I just put them in a zip lock bag and find them very convenient to munch on( about a quarter pound per bag.3) Buffalo Bills 1.2lb Extra SmokeysThese are very smokey, but a little too dry for my taste.4) Buffalo Bills 16oz Premium Hickory Beef Jerky Pieces (random sizeTaste great if you are a jerky lover.5) Buffalo Bills 2.1lb Pepperoni  Short ShotsProbably the closest to Slim Jim's of all the short shots6) Buffalo Bills 2.1lbs Honey StrungO.K. taste.  My wife hates the smell.  My Brother doesn't care much for them either.All- in- all, I highly recommend these products (in the order listed) and this company.Gunner  January, 2010Gunner  October, 2009

First, thank you for sending to APO addresses. My Army son-in-law enjoyed the jerky very much...very tasty. He also enjoyed the samples that camewith the order. I thought of sending Ben this item, because he hadrequested jerky as a comfort food while he was in Iraq. He and my daughter are now safely in Germany. Thank you again, Cassandra Rambo

column9: Too salty, doesn't taste like beef
column10: I was really disappointed by this beef jerky, especially since I ordered a whole pound.  The jerky is way too salty, so much that I worried about the health effects.  Also, it tastes like it has been soaked in some kind of artificial beef broth that completely eliminates the natural beef flavor.  What is the point of that?  Why would anyone do that unless they are using inferior meat and looking for a quick path to flavor.  Trust me, it's not worth it.  Truly hickory-smoked beef just accentuating the flavor of the meat would be wonderful.
Jerky was melted and pressed into one solid sheet.It was sent in a paper envelope that must have had frieght placed on it.Needs to be packaged better.

column9: Very smokey, too salty & a tough chew!
column10: There were enough good reviews to give this beef jerky a try.It comes vacuum sealed, which should make for a long storage life... until you open it.  The bag isn't reclosable, so you need to transfer the contents to a reclosable container.This beef jerky comes in small pieces (strips), which we liked.  The color is black, very black... thought this was odd?  The smell is smokey... no beefy smell... not real appetizing.This beef jerky is "tough" & needs to be worked over (chewed) before you can enjoy the taste... that is, if you like very salty + smokey!  Still... the meat quality is good, with little gristle or inedible pieces.We wanted to like this beef jerky, but it's down there with one of the worst tasting that we've tried.  We won't be buying this beef jerky again!
I have tried all different brands and these are one of my favorites by far.  The only ones I like more are Jerky Hut which is twice the price.

I was excited to get some "jerky like you get at trade shows" this was the worst jerky my family has ever had,inedible,salt lick.Jerky normally is gone in minutes this was gone all right out to the  garbage ,I was very disappointed
I am unable to review this product.  My intended receipient never received this product.  I became warn down on tracking this as no contact info was provided.  Unhappy!

These gluten free sugar cones are the real deal-in taste, crunch and good shelf life.  Good enough to eat without ice cream!  Also can be used for other sweet fillings, fruits, sorbets, yogurt, etc.  Going gluten free later in life a person can really miss the taste and mouth feel of certain things-cones being but one of those.  I'm good at baking and trying to find replacements for breads and cakes, but crackers and cones are something I have to find on offer from commercial bakeries.  I search and try until I find something that satisfies the best and then I stick with that product.
These cones taste good and are just the right size so you don't end up with more ice cream than you really want.  I have enjoyed them for years.
These ice cream cones are awesome. They taste just like the ones I ate when I was a child (before a celiac diagnosis).  One of the more authentic tasting GF products I've eaten.
These cones taste like the real thing but better.  An incredible product that tastes just yummy.  We are buying them from amazon because we eat so many of them.

column4: Donna's Reviews "I Love Shopping on Amazon!"
column10: These are great.......Edward & Sons Let's Do... Gluten Free Sugar Cones, 5.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)....I've gone gluten free...and theses are perfect to eat with my sorbet...Only 50 calories in each cone...Very Happy!

I bought a box of these to try while we were on vacation.  They didn't last long because my daughter and I liked them so much.  Such a yummy treat and the cone helps with portion control.  Nobody would ever guess these were gluten free if they didn't know.  12 cones per box. 50 calories per cone.

Edward and Sons gluten free ice cream cones taste so much like their "normal" counter part that we didn't feel like we were missing in that important Summer tradition at all.  These cones stand up well to a couple of scoops of ice cream and look the same as regular cones so my children don't feel any different than their friends.  I packed our leftover cones in a ziplock bag and they lasted 2 weeks with out getting stale.  They may have lasted longer but we ate them all.  This is not an item I could easily make at home so I'm thrilled to be able to purchase it from Amazon.  Their delivery was quick and easy.  I even traveled with a box in my carry on luggage for our family vacation so we could enjoy ice cream cones wherever we went.  Yum!
Gluten free, egg free, and dairy free yet these taste exactly like cones from an ice cream shop.  If you don't tell them, they'll never know these are gluten free!
If you love chocolate, get yourself a box!  The flavors are distinct and most unlike the usual chocolates you may be used to. Buy, buy, buy!

column9: Not as creamy as it should be.
column10: The bonbons were not as creamy as I had in Brazil.  Possibly processed (Dried out) for long lasting export, or old stock. Also the mix did not include a favorite of mine PELE (Large round multi chocolate) I will not be reordering.
Item shipped fast. Taste delicious. This is the second that I bought Graroto here. Highly recommend this to those love Brazil chocolates.
I purchased this for a candy buffet for a baby shower.  The color shown in the picture is true to the item.  It's very bright and colorful. The flavor was a bit floral/aromatic for me.
These blue jelly belly are beautiful and taste great.  Nothing special to say about them because they are just candy. They were not stall it that matters.

We used these at my sister in laws bridal shower as part of her 'candy bar' and these were gone extremely fast. They are soooo good, I would buy them again but then I would just be sitting on my couch eating them all in one sitting... so I will only be buying them for parties ;) The colors of the bridal shower were a 'tiffany blue' which is why I went for this particular color, and these were perfect not just for the amazing taste but also because these are a perfect tiffany blue. Loved them!

I bought a case on Amazone cause I had found this at Costco and was so impressed with the low sugar content, 4 grams per serving which is 8 grams cause it is a 2 serving container. No other "Aloe drink" I can find at Trader Joe's or other health conscious store has such a low sugar content, very great and the fact that stevia is being used is another big plus. So when I saw it on Amazone I was very happy and ordered a case. When I got the case I find out it is just like the others I have seen with a whopping 14 gram per serving which makes the sugar content a whopping 28 grams per container. WHAT HAPPENED. Did I get a fluke either from Amazone or from Costco? Or did you all change the formula? I would send it back if I could. Might as well drink soda. What a shame. I am a real Aloe Vera enthusiast. I believe it is a very fantastic drink but at 14 grams of sugar it becomes another sugary soda like drink. I hope this was just a mistake.Update: I wrote company and found that the pulp free flavors are 8 grams. Wish Amazone had the sugar content available. No worries from now on I will order the non pulp with lower sugar content.
Whats up with the smell? And feels like homogenized liquid with plenty of sugar! Wont buy any more that is for sure
But our 5 month old Siberian Husky seems to like it and she seems to be growing well which I guess is pretty much what you'd hope for out of a puppy dog food.

column9: My dog loves it, so do the cats
column10: I bought this dog food after my twelve year old pit/hound mix stopped eating another major brand. He scarfs this up like it was a bowl of beef liver. column9: My senior dog looks forward to her meals again.
column10: One of the problems senior dogs often face is a decreasing appetite. This may be caused by the pain of gum disease or broken teeth, decreased senses of smell or taste, and kibble too hard or too big for older mouths to chew. Pedigree does a great service to our aging canine population by formulating foods that appeal to the older dog; the kibble is easier to chew and appears to have a yummy smell to the dog. My 12 year old chow girl was just not eating and seemed sad. Cham seemed to be on a physical decline. I have used other Pedigree foods for decades and decided to try this senior dog food. She began eating a little more at each meal. Her coat shine has returned and her eyes twinkle once more. She has resumed barking at passing strangers-a sound that I was actually happy to hear again. She is definitely showing the benefits of good nutrition and I hope she will remain in good happy health for several more years.

Not sure if the Texas heatwave OR a recipe change was the cause. BUT my pooch ate it, just not with his usual gusto. Making gravies to enhance it pushed me to find some healthy "mix-ins". Searching the internet for reviews and pricing of various brands, led me back to Amazon and Pedigree on sale. I've been mixing this with his Harmony. He eats the combination heartily without digestive issues. Our 7-year old little poodle loves the Newman's Own Dry Dog Food.  He is healthy and full of energy.  We love this product.

As a retired breeder of Basset Hounds, I was supprised to see these "chew toys".  A lot is being said about brushing your dogs teeth, and here is a fairly pleasant solution. I have seven hounds living in and out with my wife, and myself. Hounds, od course, will pick up "almost anything " to chew on.  In the past, to keep our children presentable, we spent a good deal of money on dental descaling.  Some history... Dogs as a general rule use the front "Canines" to catch, rip and tear prey animals.  Once they have dinner, they chew with the premolars- the middle teeth, and only use the back molars for cracking marrow bones, and other long bones.  I haven't found a single marrow bone in any bag of dogfood.  The result is no molar chewing, and rapid plaque build up.  Now, dogs teeth do not decay like ours do.  The buildup is rather benign, unless it starts encroaching under the gums. Then, you have an infection.  Antibiotics will clear that problem, but what next?  Eventually, you have your dog aenesthatized for descaling, or extraction.  Basset molars are big and tough, and will not pull unless the root has rotted, and as they age,all dogs are more suseptable to trouble in "LA-LA" land.  I have never killed a coyote with plaque.  They eat bones.  Unfortunately, our bones tend to be cooked, and splinter, and can cause a perforated bowel.  Merrick has the answer.  They take the beef knuckle, clean but don't cook it, and our hounds chew them to their hearts content,even working the molars and all other teeth.  The result has been non-splintering marrow bones with the "goodies" stripped, so the bones are not greasy on rugs, and furniture. Yes, all seven live with us with a dog door to go out to their fenced yard.  The only issue we have found is Cleetis, our big, oldest male sneaks the favorites out at night and burys them, causing the younger kids no end of searching, and sniffing-outside. Not really negative.  For a while, I carved numgers in them for "inventory control", and had one come in that had been pre-numbers, and was brought in just before our first major snowstorm..  Okay, maybe I have too much free time, but these Merrick bones are the best.  I avoid all smoked, or flavored styles, and I cannot tell if they have a "new" smell, or not, but we have happy, healthy hounds, without semiannual dental descaling, of bad teeth.  Dare I even say they don't have bad breath?  Anyway, this is a shining recommendation of Merricks "General Panton" 7-9inch beef knuckle.  Oh yeah, no stuffed ones either.  Sign me "Bassets of the Tundra" retired.

I have a 6 month old Pom that chews on EVERYTHING. My idea was to get him a focal bone to attack. I've tried all brands of package mixes and every type of homemade recipe, most are dry and have to be made at the last minute. There are other bars out there that have a stronger peanut butter flavor. These are good. They are good for digestion, decent for breakfast, and not a bad treat. I respectfully disagree with the previous reviewer. I definitely enjoyed both flavors as well as the chocolate. If you love a sweet treat before or after a meal order these. They ARE fantastic!!

column9: I expected more playfulness from a box of monkeys...
column10: Monkey Bars are, according to the packaging, crazy healthy.  That may be the case.  They are intended to help your digestive system and are loaded with natural fibers to help regulate your system.  The ingredient list is predominantly natural ingredients and the fat and calorie content are a very nice `low' number for a breakfast food containing chocolate, peanut butter and bananas (three high calorie snacks).  That being said, these breakfast snacks usually boil down to flavor, and I'm not entirely impressed here.  Peanut butter is such an aggressive flavor and that really shows here.  The chocolate and the banana are basically non-existent and are replaced by a fibrous peanut butter, a chewy and somewhat off-putting texture that is too familiar (this tastes very similar to other breakfast bars) and leaves me wanting more.  I was excited.  Maybe it was the funny name and the cute packaging.  I just expected something new and fresh and what I got was the same ol' same with bigger claims.  If these are as healthy as they claim (the packaging also makes note that none of these claims have been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration) then great, but if you are looking for a tasty alternative to the bland `health bars' flooding shelves then look elsewhere.
I got a 5 oz bag at our cafeteria. I enjoyed every bite since I wanted to stay away from potato chips but wanted a snack with a crunch. I was not disappointed. Chip were good and crunchy

They will get pieces off and I have to throw them out so they don't choke on them, but it's not that often like other ones I've tried. I just purchased theses bones for my 95 pounds giant boxer and he loves them a lot. They last very long. They are simply the best bones i've ever had. Thank you very much Happy Dog Place !

I first heard of Gumbo File on Alton Brown's marvelous cooking show Good Eats.  He recommended it as a substitute for okra as a thickening agent for gumbo, giving an added authentic flavor as well as thickening the soup.  I have learned to trust Alton Brown's cooking advice, so I was looking forward to giving it a try.Gumbo File is made from dried and powdered sassafras leaves.  Even though I live in a major city, it wasn't something that I could find at my local grocery store.  Since this was my first time trying it, and you only use about a table spoon of file to a 2-quart soup, I didn't want to buy a lot of it.  This 1 oz. package was just the right size.I have to say, the Gumbo File worked exactly as advertised!  I made a pot of shrimp and andouille gumbo, using a shrimp stalk, and the end result was far too watery.  A tablespoon of file applied and a few minutes later the soup had a nice body and a distinct delicious grassy flavor that hadn't existed in previous gumbos I have made.I also set out some of the file powder on the table for people to add to the gumbo for flavor and extra thickening.  The dish got good reviews all around, and was some of the best gumbo I have eaten.  I am definitely a file fan.

Got an itch to make Alton Brown's gumbo recipe and couldn't find file locally. Barry Farms to the rescue. I have no other file products to compare it to, but it certainly helped thicken my yummy pot of gumbo.

I've eaten plenty of gumbo over the years (my family is Cajun and comes from Louisiana), so unlike other reviewers here I have something to compare this to.  Gumbo file should have a mild, sweet flavor.  This gumbo file tastes strong and very much like oregano - nothing I've experienced before.  It wasn't bad, but I really didn't like it and I wouldn't recommend it.

Have purchased green fava beans  from this seller and they were/are great. Fast shipping, great quality fair price considering I couldn't find 'em any where around here :) Just ordered, File Powder for Cajun cooking. Can't find THAT around here either. I expect it to be of the same high quality as the Fava beans.

column9: Vegan? Try this salt. You'll never miss eggs again!
column10: Fellow vegans will understand that though tofu scramble is DELICIOUS, it does't really taste like eggs. Garnish your tofu scramble with this sulfuric salt--it has the unmistakably strong taste of eggs. I've used this in vegan frittatas, omelets, and scrambles with great success. Also a little goes a long way, so you really get a good value for your money with this one.

This is the best salt. I have shared this with my daughter's family as we are all vegan. In recipes, it gives the "essence of egg". Delightful. I'm satisfied, and don't miss eliminating eggs from my diet.

This salt is nicely packed and is of good quality. It's a sulphuric salt and lends an "eggy" taste to dishes; if you're vegan it's definitely a great add to tofu scrambles to give them a more breakfast-like quality.

column9: Kala Namak Salt - Indian Black Salt - 6 oz Jar
column10: Tasted this salt for the first time on a cruise I just got back from and really enjoyed the egg flavor! Tasty!

I cant really decide if i like this salt or not, which is why i give it 3 stars. The sulphuric salt definitely carries that egglike scent and flavor as the other reviews have pointed out. It definitely sounded interesting, which is why i bought this, and at around $7, i am pretty much always willing to take a chance on something unproven. I have tried it by itself, an some veggies, and mixed into almond milk quesadillas, and i cant say i hated it, but as i said before, i cant really decide if i liked it either. I think this one is very much a question of personal taste. I am vegan, and dont really miss eggs, so maybe that is part of it. Dont know. I do know that it is interesting, and i certainly wouldn't dissuade anybody from trying it. You might find it to be a five star product like the previous two reviewers did...and they arent wrong. As i say, this one in particular is a subjective thing. I dont know that there is a wrong rating for this salt. Some will love it, some will hate it, and some will be undecided like i am.
