Guests always love it iced. It arrived fresh and on time. Shipping & packaging were great, too. Definitely recommend.

The blend of green tea and mate that Thrive contains is remarkable, and as with all Tazo teas, the final mixture of herbs and spices makes for a remarkable taste.This 6 pack is a good deal compared to purchasing individual boxes, especially in local stores.  I drink a couple of these every morning, before switching to Zen for my subsequent cups of green tea.  I just feel better on days when I get my Thrive to start the day, and I don't think it is my imagination.

These appeared singly in my local grocery store and in the 3 flavor pack in my local warehouse store (BJs) for about three bucks a canister.  They were marked as being for a limited time and they're all gone now, so the only place I know to get them is Amazon.  My stash of Mojito mix is already gone.The three flavors are Mojito, Margarita, and Appletini.  The Mojito and Margarita are refreshing and very similar to the real mixes that I get at the store.  The difference is, I can (and do!) drink this stuff all day long without any guilt since it's 5 calories a serving.Mojito: like limeade with a hint of mint, so good over ice!  Muddle some mint for an extra delicious treat, use club soda for mint juleps, or even add alcohol.Margarita: tastes like Jose Cuervo margarita mixer to me, it even has the salty tang.Appletini: the more I've had it, the less I like it. It's a bit strong on the fake-apple taste and smell, so it's like drinking a Jolly Rancher green apple candy.These are a wonderful treat!UPDATE: this is the response I got from Kraft when asking if these would be available.We are delighted to hear of your interest in our CRYSTAL LIGHT Mocktail Powdered Soft Drink Mix. As you may already know, this product is only being manufactured and distributed for a limited period of time. For that reason, we are unable to provide any additional information on the stores that may still have the product in stock.

I was actually very surprised by how good these are.  They taste very similar to the actual cocktails themselves.  I bought them thinking I could use them as a version of "skinny cocktails."  They work wonderfully in that capacity.  I've added vodka to the Appletini and rum to the mojito.  While I would never believe I was consuming the real thing, it's close enough, and low enough in calories, where this remains a winner in my book.Since it is stated that these are limited flavors, I am going to stock up.I did find that with the mojito flavor, a squeeze of real lime and a few leaves of real mint really adds authenticity to the beverage.
This is a great sugar free drink that tastes like the real thing.  Wish stores would carry this product all year long.

column9: YUM -- all three flavors are delicious
column10: After stumbling across the Appletini mix and really liking it -- I was thrilled to find Appletini, Mojito, and Margarita in a single package so I could try all three.  These are a delicious and novel alternative to the more traditional Crystal Light flavors.  I keep coming back to order more.  The Appletini is tart and apply, the mojito and margarita have a strong tart/citrusy taste.  All three flavors are refreshing; none were too sweet for my tastes.Each container contains five foil packets.  Each foil packet makes two quarts.  If you typically use single-serving packets of drink mix and don't plan to make this by the pitcher-full, you'll need to be careful to get the right amount of powder, cause it is easy to mix it a little too strong.UPDATE:I put these in Christmas stockings for my sister and sister-in-law, and I served some to a friend for lunch one day, with so-so responses.  I don't think that any of them share my level of enthusiasm.  I still like it -- but if you're not a Crystal Light drinker generally, and prefer fresh-squeezed lemonade or just sparkling water, this might be a little artificial for your tastes.

Love it. Love it. Love it!  I first purchased one of the mocktails an my local grocery during the summer. I was so pleased with the product that I returned to the store to make another purchase.  All gone!  I was told that that mocktails were a summertime trial and that no more would be coming into the store.  I searched and searched in several national stores. Not available or all sold out! I then began to search the Internet.  The product was so hot that bids on Ebay were absolutely rediculous.  I eventually found the product at a reasonable price through Amazon. Though priced higher than I had purchased at the store, the price was significantly lower than others I had found online.Crystal Light has a winner! I see no reason why the mocktails should not be made widely available in retail stores. I've seen nothing but good reviews! And they taste great.  Quite refreshing!

I bought these to use as a summery treat along with my recently acquired Prodyne Fruit Infusion 93-Ounce Natural Fruit Flavor Pitcher. I was presently surprised with how tasty they were and decided to pop them in my (also newly acquired) Cuisinart ICE-30BC Pure Indulgence 2-Quart Automatic Frozen Yogurt, Sorbet, and Ice Cream Maker and they made an AMAZING sorbet/icee-style treat!

I was disappointed with the mocktails flavors.  I tried every flavor and decided  to give these to someone that might enjoy them..I really like your lemonade and white grape flavors so keep making them.
The flavors are OK. There are only 5 per packet so not that many. Personally I prefer some of the store brands but I wasn't able to make it out so I figured I'd give it a try.

column9: Excellent Health Alternative to a Margarita
column10: I love margaritas but they are chock full of sugar and carbs. I think this is a very tasty alternative. It's not as good as a real margarita but hey, what do you expect considering there are No carbs and No sugar?  I add a little Fresca to jazz it up a bit and sometimes a splash of real margarita mix.
Please, please,please continue to make this Mojito mix.  It is outstanding!  I am telling everyone about it.  Please make it available without the Margarita and Appletini mix.  i will buy a case!!

Could not find these in local stores so bought on Amazon.  Light and refreshing, not cloyingly sweet like some of the CL drinks can be.  I also like that it isn't chock full of red dye either.  If you wants something that tastes like a grown up treat, here you go!

column9: I like the tart, not too sweet taste
column10: I like the taste of most flavors of Crystal Light and I like that they are very low or no calorie.  It's a good alternative to soda.  These Mocktail flavors are different from most of the run of the mill drink mixes on the market in that they are kind of like mixers for the cocktails they represent.  The thing I like best about them is that the flavors are a little tart and not overly sweet like some powdered drinks on the market these days.  I think the Mojito tastes the best with tart lime taste and a hint of mint.  The Margarita has a tart lemon-lime taste with just a hint of saltiness to it.  The Appletini is a tart apple/lime flavor.  They are all a bright green color.Each container contains five foil packets and each foil packet makes two quarts.  Instead of mixing them in a two quart pitcher, I just pour a little of the powder to taste in one of these Contigo AUTOSPOUT® Addison 24 oz. Water Bottles 3 pack Blue, Charcoal, Honeysuckle which I carry around with me all the time and add some ice to it.  The flavors are all somewhat similar to each other in that they all have that tartness, but just different enough for a little variety.I understand that these are available as a limited trial but I hope Kraft decides to continue them in the future, at least during the summer.
They all taste very similarAll three flavors taste like apple Jelly Ranchers.The only flavor that stood out for me was Mojito. And I had to use less water than suggested to get stronger flavor.
Great flavors without all of the calories. Just add water. Simple and tasty. I was looking for a sugar free alternative to all of the margarita mixes. This fit the bill.
These special mixes are great, my favorite is the Margaretta less so the appletini.  KInda of expensive by will save for special.
This is a great way to have a drink and now feel overly guilty.Ordering was easy and I had product in no time at all so I was able to enjoy.

Purchased these for a cruise, as you are limited to 20 oz bottles of soda, water or mixers and mixers come in liter sizes. These traveled well. We liked the Margarita and the Appletini. They mixed well with the alcohol we ordered through Bon Vogage Dept.I brougt a plastic pitcher with us to mix it with and a shaker for making cocktails. (Don't forget the Salt!)

column9: Sounded too good to be true
column10: Made according to directions, the Margarita tastes a bit soapy and you have to add lemon, lime, etc to make it OK.  The Mojito also--my daughter loves them, but not these.  Pouring it in some flavored tea is better--I poured too much Appletini powder--but it tasted exactly like apple.  So I'll use them up one way or another, but I wish I hadn't bought two sets.
1 of the flavors was GREAT and one was GROSS and the other was so-so.  Better to buy the right flavor in the store for $2.
I really like crystal light lemonade flavor.  I did not care for these flavors at all.  To sweet and an after taste.  I was excited to try them.  Wish I hadn't.

Incredibly bad tasting, but good if you like a distinct chemical taste.  All these flavors are a day glo color of green.  So in all, gross looking to go with the bad taste.  Sci fi drinks that no one taste tested.

Just think of a Margarita that has been sitting overnight on a bar and you will have a pretty good idea of what the Margarita tastes like.Not good.I made a pitcher of the stuff and no one in the house would drink it.The apple flavor is ok.Something different and though I can't say I enjoy it I do intend to use it up.I haven't tried the Mojito yet but I am not very hopeful.

I'm embarrassed to admit that I fell for the advertising and made an impulsive purchase of Crystal Light Mocktails Drink Mixes - Three FlavorsIt sounded like a good idea since I live in Tex-Mex food land to be able to have a Margarita without all of the calories.  Unfortunately, the product description doesn't give the ingredient list and, since it was an impulse purchase, I didn't take the time to research it.  I really wanted to like it and had high hopes for the product.For those who may find it helpful here are the ingredients for each.  You will notice that they are all remarkably similar and the sweetener is Aspartame :(APPLETINI:  Citric Acid, Maltodextrin, Aspartame, Natural Flavor, Modified Cornstarch, Acesulfame Potassium, Contains less than 2% of Magnesium Oxide, Yellow 5, Blue 1MARGARITA: Citric Acid, Maltodextrin, Salt, Aspartame, Natural Flavor, Contains less than 2% of Acesulfame Potassium,  Magnesium Oxide, Artificial Color Yellow 5, Blue 1MOJITO:  Citric Acid, Maltodextrin, Aspartame and Acesulfame Potassium, Sugar, Magnesium Oxide, Contains less than 2% of Natural Flavor, Yellow 5, Blue 1The taste is as one would expect from the ingredient list.  To me, it was not only vile tasting but also a headache trigger.

I bought this from Amazon to try the flavors. Been drinking Crystal light for years - tea and lemonade. Wish they would create a limeade. The only "drinkable" one in my opinion is Appletini. The other two are horrible and I had to throw out. My order was shipped quickly.

Great idea, but it tastes horrible. If you've ever had any regular flavored crystal light sit in your car for several days...and it's a hot day and you're sitting in traffic dying of thirst and all you have is a bottle of stale crystal light sitting there - which has been heated and reheated by the hot summer sun - and you're so thirsty you're wiling to drink anything so you take a swig....That's what this tastes like. Old, fermented, modly, stale, very little flavor, which barely resmbles the flavor it's intended to. I'll stick with the regular flavors and indulge in real alcohol...all the while not feeling guilty about the calories.  If I'm going to consume lots of calories I'd rather it be the real deal and taste fantastic, rather than fooling myself with no calories on something that tastes awful.

These Mocktails are very flavorful.  Margaritas have a nice, tart, lime taste.  Have not as yet tried the powdered mix, but can attest to the great taste of the bottled margarita mix.  Hard to believe something this tasty has nary a calorie, super good.
if you never ate organic whole grain pasta, you are missing something special. not only tasty, but very good for your health too. the price is also reasonable and my kids love it.
Cooks much faster than other whole wheat or whole grain. Has a very good rich flavor. Our kids love it too.
Taste is very good.  Be prepared when you cook it--no sooner in the pot than out, about long enough to get the collander ready!  I'll certainly continue to buy it.
This pasta is great. Easy to digest, organic, 100% whole grain and tastes good. Spelt is a grain that will bring you health, and health is your wealth!
I ordered this whole grain pasta by accident; I usually order the regular spelt angel hair. I like the whole grain, and was surprised that my family liked it also!

I have felt so much better using spelt and rice pastas instead of wheat.  Whole grain is always better for flavor and fiber than enriched pasta.  Of all the pastas, this is my favorite.  I love angel hair, and this is a very flavorful alternative to wheat.

column9: very helpful good price good product
column10: I ordered organic angel hair spelt pasta which I cannot find in my neighborhood-now I have enough for a few month's use.  My husband can't eat wheat and we get bored with rice pasta only. The small cans of tomato paste are also a good price and very useful.

Tried this for the first time the other night and was I impressed!!!  It cooks and tastes just like regular whole wheat pasta - can't even tell the difference!  Highly recommend for those of you looking to add true whole grains to your diet and for those with wheat allergies!

column9: Italian Greyhounds Gobbled up the Pinnacle Turkey & Potato
column10: Sofie and Bella, my 8 yr. old Italian Greyhounds just love this pet food. They are very fussy and I am in a constant search of foods that keep their interest. Glad I found this quality food and will continue with it until they if ever will turn it down.

I tried this product from a local grocer and LOVED it!  Of course, that meant that the store would stop carrying this.  Fortunately, I was able to find it here and now have a stockpile of pasta!  YAY!!!

Aeroshot is the first energy booster I've used other than coffee/soda.  It's convenient and they have improved the packaging so you no longer have to tap it on a hard surface before use--I like that they are continuing product development. It's easy to keep in the car and easy to use with one hand (not that I don't drive with my hands at 10 and 2).The energy boost is almost immediate and makes me clear-headed and alert.  The lime is a little bitter, but I'm looking for a wake-up, not candy.  Since it's a powder, be gentle when using it so you don't end up with a coughing jag!  I'm looking forward to trying the new flavors.

I absolutely love Aeroshots. I use them all the time. The product actually works. I don't trust any other form of energy supplement now. Most others give me the 'shakes' or a stomach ache. This doesn't do that at all, and I feel it right away! It's awesome! I use nothing else on long drives or at work now. They are easy, convenient and overall a great product.There are a few things that someone should know before they try them though. First, inhale slowly. The Lime flavor is very tart and very strong. I didn't like it at first, but I soon changed my mind. If you don't like it, try drinking some water afterwards. Some people say that the flavor grows on them. It is just so surprising the first time it is hard to enjoy. The Lime is made to be all natural with no sweeteners. The other two flavors are made with a sweetener and are supposedly not as strong. I have yet to order the new flavors, but I am very excited to try them. So if you don't like the sound of the lime, try another flavor (raspberry or green apple). Second, the powder is supposed to go on your tongue (not your lungs). Don't inhale so that you cough. Finally, my last suggestion is that you can't knock it until you try it. This is something completely different than most energy supplements on the market today. So give it a try. You wont be sorry!
A great, fun and easy way to get an extra energy boost during the day. It fits in your pocket or purse - you can take it with you wherever you go.

I love the convenience of the shots, a small package vs a big can. The Aeroshot is effective, at keeping you alert and active on the days that would otherwise have me sleeping at my desk.I would definitely recommend this product to family and friends (I already have).

Okay, so let me honest, I'm a bit of an energy-junkie and use some type of supplement on a daily basis.  So I'd like to review this product in terms of lift-off, flight length and landing:Lift-off: Take off is excellent, barely any delay, you're not sitting on the runway thinking...I'm going to miss my connecting flight.  In under 2 minutes, you do feel the difference and are ready to handle the tasks at hand.Flight length: There are no jitters or turbulence on this ride, pleasant attendants, but the in cabin movie doesn't last as long as some other brands.  Depending on the depth your inhale (really an ingest), you are likely to experience about 2-2.5hrs of task completion.Landing: MAYDAY! MAYDAY! You are in for a crash landing.  Again, I speak from mens nutrition, weight mgmt, coffee & soda and the latest caffeinated kind of experience.  I have never had a crash like this before.When I made the purchase, I actually bought 1/2 dozen in flavor varieties thinking I found a new bestie.  But honestly, I have completed the vials just because I made the purchase.  But as Levar Burton used to say: "You don't have to take my word for it!"

I know some people think adding syrups ruins good coffee. Sometimes you like a different taste. Have tried the Kalua (sp), a chocolate, and a cherry. They are all good. Am looking forward to French Vanilla and Hazelnut.

column9: Definitely less odor, but the cats don't like it.
column10: There is rosemary in this, and it just doesn't seem to appeal to my cats, unfortunately. Other than that the item arrived in a timely manner, and the bottle was in good shape. The pump works well and it doesn't smell terrible. The concentration of DHA is great, but why the rosemary?? What animal wants to eat rosemary? I'd rather smell fish and have my cats enjoy eating it over their canned food.

column9: Single Cup Tea Pods Variety Pack
column10: These pods fit nicely into my Senseo machine, which is what I was after.  The tea is decent, I use the 2 cup setting and still a bit strong but just add water.  Nice variety for when I'm in a hurry.  These can also be brewed in the cup when I have more time to spare.  Cost is not exorbitant.  All in all, a good purchase.

I have only tried 2 of the teas but they are very good! Was glad to find tea for my Senseo! These work great in it and my mom enjoys having tea when she comes over to my house now without having to pull out my tea kettle.
These are not K-cup pods. They are just large tea bags designed for some sort of Bunn brewer.If you are looking for tea to use with the Kurig brewers, these are not what you are looking for.
A friend gave me this for christmas last year.  I wasn't overly thrilled until I started using the items.  OMG!You won't be disappointed with this package of goodies.

Dry food, a vet told me, kills cats in time. He recommended this food and no dry. Kitty agrees... She was looking terrible, yakking up hairballs all over the house, every two or three days. After a 6 weeks of this food, she looks great, is like her old self... And not a single hairball!

I don't know why she won't eat it, she's eaten the other premium brands I've gotten her, and this food's first ingredients are sardines, shrimp, and lobster, stuff I can't even afford to eat on a regular basis!  I don't fault the company, I guess you just never know, but now I have to mix this with other food so I won't waste it, or just leave it there until she eats it I guess, but she'll go all day. :(  I don't want to give it less than 3 stars though because the ingredients are very healthy.  Like the other reviewer, my vet said only wet food for my cat.  She ends up with bladder infections and other problems when she eats dry, even just when I've given her dry treats.
...this one is really good in all kinds of coffee drinks.  It's hard to believe these are sugar free.  I will order again, especially with such fast delivery.  Thanks for good service.  ****

column9: It's much cheapper in my Local store
column10: As I'm always looking for a DEAL on Cranaple by OS there is no DEAL here at $9.54 a bottle. When my local store has it around $3.58 a 64.oz bottle Thanks but No Thanks

This instant Thai tea did not taste like  the Thai tea I've had restaurants, but it was pretty good. I liked it hot rather than cold. It's pretty sweet. I decided to add a very small amount of Cinnamon to it and it came out great. A bit high on calories-180 calories per packet. I would buy it again.

Like the first person who posted a rating, I believe this stuff is pretty good. It isn't exactly like the real stuff you get when you go out, but it's a great substitute. Not bad at all for making and keeping at home.
This tastes just like the Thai tea I get from Thai places.  I make it hot & then put it in the fridge or freezer for a couple hours.  It is so good when it's cold!

column9: tastes okay, but nowhere near restaurant quality.
column10: Doesn't even really taste like Thai Tea.  What you get is a rather non-descript sweet powdered drink.  Even adding copious amounts of cream or condensed milk didn't help.

column9: Not Quite it, but VERY convenient.
column10: I thought this was pretty decent for an instant gratification type of item.  It is a little on the sweet side but I found that adding a little extra water helped quite a bit.  I also like that is comes in convenient single servings, so it's easy to just pick-up and go.

column9: Not restaurant quality, but good for instant.
column10: This is nowhere near as good as fresh brewed Thai Tea with cane sugar and evaporated milk. But it's quick and easy, especially when you're in a hurry in the morning or on a camping trip (excellent addition to coffee and hot cocoa for variety when camping).It's not as good as what you'll get at a restaurant, but when you're out hiking and packing light, it's good.

Is this going to give you Thai tea exactly like what you'd get in a restaurant? No. But is it good? For what it is, yes. I bought it to keep at work so when the craving for Thai tea hits me, I can have it. Obviously I can't brew my own Thai tea and add in the ice and condensed milk at my desk and then stick all of that back in a drawer. But I can grab a packet of this instant mix. I am going to figure out how to make real Thai tea so I can have it whenever I want, not just when I'm at a restaurant or bubble tea place with it on the menu.

I absolutely can't believe the number of reviews for this product saying "It's not as good as what you get from a restaurant, but good enough in a pinch!".... No, it isn't. It's not decent in any way. It tastes like sugar and creamer with literally not even a hint of thai tea, when you smell the powder there is no hint of thai tea whatsoever. There was one other review saying this when I purchased, but I didn't listen because of all the positive reviews. Completely revolting product, waste of money, avoid.

The key word here is INSTANT. Don't expect a real Thai tea experience with this instant beverage. It's okay. It doesn't taste bad...  Just like Starbucks and instant Taster's choice taste different, so does this with a real Thai tea.

My wife and I really enjoy this tea.  It is super sweet and easy to make.  I enjoy it cold.  I just mix a small amount of hot water to melt the powder and then top it off with plenty of ice and cold water.
I simply love this brand of thai iced tea. It is a good summer drink. My friends loved it too!

column9: We love this Thai iced tea
column10: The taste is pretty close to the ones from restaurants or what I made from the real tea leaves mixture.  My only complain is that it's slightly too sweet, however, my family love the convenient Thai iced tea.
While nothing can beat a real Thai iced tea, this is pretty good.  I carry these with me to use while I'm in the cafeteria for convenience.  They have a nice creamy texture, and are quite sweet.

I found this at a local asian market where I buy fresh ginger for my chai tea, funny, ha.Try to find this product locally, I paid less than 5 dollars for the 12 pack.  Like others have said it is sweet, and you can taste the vanilla/anise.  I never thought to add cinnamon like another has siggested, but it is definitly a winner!Another thing you can add is cardomon powder.  I mix cinnamon powder and cardomon powder together and sprinkle it on top.Recommended, plan on buying again.  Eventually I will look for something more in bulk.

This is instant thai tea. It is not the real thing, but it tastes pretty close. Just like lemonade, we buy these instant packages because we don't have the time to make the real thing and it's messy.  This does the job when I'm craving thai tea, but I'll just have to wait until I go to a thai restaurant to get real thing.
This food is such an improvement over the normal Science Diet wet food, as it comes in a gravy rather than one lump of food. It's much moister. My cat loves it!
I am very impressed with these country ham slices. A very high quality prooduct greatly exceeds standard racecar driver ham slices from the supermarket. Great flavor not too salty or too sweet.
The cane syrup is great for summer drinks - nothing to dissolve and the flavor is not just "sugar" - there is a very subtle range of overtones to the syrup that add to its usefulness.

I needed two vanilla beans for the Love Goddess cake that my husbands adores. So you can spend exorbitant amounts of money at the grocery store for more vanilla beans than you need, or you can order the amount you need with free shipping. Each bean was in its own plastic vacuum package that looked like it could keep for awhile if you needed it to. The cake was, of course, delicious, and my trash smelled great from the two little plastic vanilla bean packages, so maybe you could use them to make something else smell nice.

I have used this Buttermilk Mix and found it to be very good.  I don't always have fresh buttermilk and having this mix on hand is great.  I am looking forward to the many more recipes that I can prepare on the spur of the moment.

Got this variety pack through a group deal and was excited to try them out. Let me tell you, these things taste terrible. This isn't coming from someone who thinks that energy drinks taste like cough syrup either; I've never had an e-drink I haven't liked. These Aeroshots are just plain bad. With only 100mg of caffeine, what's the point anyway? Get a coffee or e-drink and save yourself the money on this garbage.

We had been looking for Ferrara Espresso  coffee and found it at your page.Shopping for this product was real easy and quick through your system and additionally provided us with a chance to view other items we may want to get in the future.The coffee arrived quickly and we have been enjoying it since.Needless to say we will order through Amazon should we need this or similar products...thanks for the good service.Dr De("Retired Doc")

Wow! I've been buying dog treats for over 40 years and this one takes the cake! Pay no attention to the photo in the advertisement for this product. What you get is two (2) small chews in each of three (3) shrink wrapped over cardboard packages. That's a total of six (6) small chews for $30.00 not including shipping! I couldn't return my order quick enough.

I was not impressed about this product (Made in China). Cheaply made and not very good quality. Outside was coated with redish brown sweet something which stained the carpet.  My dog first tried to lick the coating and then bit the "bone".  It was like hard leather, more than bone, and left a mess of shreds about as well.

column9: Only rawhide my dog will chew
column10: Okay, my chihuaha is finicky...i have wasted lots of money on other rawhide chews and finally found one! Thank you beefeaters.

My little yourkie absolutely loves these treats. He chews all the chicken off first, which I think helps keep his teeth clean, and then goes to work on the rawhide.GREAT product, but the packaging wasn't too great. The bones were falling out when I got them... a little concerning.
Each evening before going to bed my dog gets a chick n top.  It relaxes her with a treat that she really enjoys.
My hound is surprisingly picky about treats.  But these are his all time favorites.  He, Wimsey, likes all the chicken top/treated Beefeater products
THIS IS NOT A PACK OF 12 BUT OF 3. I AM VERY UNHAPPY. PRODUCT IS NOT AS DESCRIBED  DO NOT ORDER IF YOU EXPECT 12 BONES. RIP OFF.  AMAZON SHOULD BE ASHAMED.

column9: wonderful treat but doesn't last as long as other rawhide
column10: My 30 pound puppy goes crazy for these, he really loves them.  He's just in heaven when he's chewing on one of these, but they only last about 20 minutes.  If you're looking for something that lasts much longer than a biscuit but doesn't need to last for hours like other rawhide treats then this is perfect.

I love Decaf Cafe Verona, especially in whole bean.  It's definitely one of my favorite roasts.  It's a nice dark roast, but sweet and cocoa-ey.  I like this roast with dessert or in the evening.  The beans are nice and oily and fresh every time.  I highly recommend this roast!
Whole bean Decaf Verona is a strong decaf that I blend 50/50 with either Italian or French Roast whole beans (usually French).  This blend makes a robust, richly flavored cup of coffee.
Out of the four blends of Starbucks coffee I have purchased and tried, this is by far the worst. Super bitter with a complementary disgusting after taste.
I have bought this dressing several times, and my family just loves it.  Not only is it delicious on a salad, it makes a wonderful marinade for chicken breasts as well.

column9: So Much More Than Salad Dressing! Marinade Too!
column10: Oh my gosh, I just love this Vidalia Onion Dressing.  This is the same company that makes the Virginia Brand Vidalia Onion dressing and has the same exact ingredients and same awesome taste.  Not only do I love this dressing on salads, I love this dressing as a marinade and cooking sauce.  My favorite way to use this dressing is with fresh salmon.  Take a pan and heat it up on the stove.  Add some Vidalia Onion Dressing and then add the salmon.  Add a little more dressing on top of the pan and cover.  The salmon will sort of poach in the dressing.  The taste is fabulous.  I also make my version of a Greek salad with a little Romaine lettuce, cut Roma tomatoes, cucumber, onions, feta cheese and then pour on Vidalia Onion Dressing!  It's a lunch I could eat every day.  You can also marinate chicken, pork chops and tofu in this dressing.  Just awesome.  Get this, you will not be sorry!

I picked up a pack of these at LAX airport because they seemed like the most appetizing of the least-harmful options.  I rolled my eyes a bit at the "gluten-free," "dairy free," vegan, yada, yada, but they sounded decent, and at least the nuts and seeds would provide some protein to balance out the sweet fruit.Wow!  They are great.  Not only tasty, but they definitely take the edge off the hunger.  The combination of nuts, seeds and fruit are formed into about 1 inch crunchy cubes.  My teenage daughter grimaced when she saw them but, once she tasted them, tried to abscond with my packet.  We are ordering more of these healthy, yummy snacks.  We're planning to try the other flavors, too.

column9: oh my, this stuff is good....
column10: The closest thing I can compare this to is just a handful of mixed nuts and dried fruit.  Except it is clustered together.  I'm pretty sure it's the dried fruit that holds everthing together -- it says there is a tiny bit of cane sugar syrup here, but it's so little that it hardly shows up.  But the nuts are crispy and fresh; the fruits are minced soooooo small -- it's just yummy.  None of that cloying sugary-ness of so many of the bars and nut/fruit snacks out there.  Just light and crispy-crunchy.  great as a snack alone, or crubled up on a salad... or on top of yogurt.  Or frozen yogurt....I've never seen these in stores down here in Texas, but I'll keep looking.  I can't wait to try other flavors.

column9: These Health Valley soups are both good for you, and taste wonderful.
column10: First:You can read and understand every ingredient in these Health Valley products! None of them would sound foreign to you.They are all natural, and this is good for you.Second:It tastes wonderful! Many Americans (respectfully :-  are used to being fed overly salted, sugared, and processed foods, whichis why their palates are destroyed, and so they can't appreciate good flavor in natural occurring foods. If one stops eatingsalt and sugar heavy foods, then within 2 - 3 weeks they'll start sensing the good flavor in natural organic products,... includingthe excellent flavor of this Health Valley product series. =:)I hope this helps you.

I was buying this soup at my local Health Food Store, but the price kept going up each time I ordered a case. I think it was $38.00 per case when I thought about Amazon. Sure enough there it was and for a much better price.This is a good, healthy soup, but unfortunately about 2 years ago I noticed a change in the taste.  I called the company and they had indeed changed the recipe.  I still eat it, but I don't eat as much since the recipe change.  It seems companies can't leave well enough alone...when will they learn not to mess with something and make it less desirable?NOTE: I always add a healthy dose of fresh ground black pepper and eat it with a salty cracker or add a little salt to the soup.Update 3-21-12: Unfortunately, this is no longer a bargain on Amazon as the price has risen more than $10.00 per case in the past year.
I know it's really good for you, has lots of good beans but I didn't care for the taste so much. This might be a great food to use in other dishes, like maybe chili?

column9: Don't pay attention to the other reviewer
column10: This kit appears to be made by the same folks who make the Vino Italiano kits.  The paperwork and ingredient packaging were identical.  I made it into a 6.5 gallon batch (my fermenter is 7 gallons and I didn't want air space) and my IG was 1.085, very good.  Fermentation lasted 24 days and FG was .985.  I added some toasted oak chips to my primary fermenter as well.  Wine was dry, crisp and quite easy to clear.  It even impressed some wannabe wine snobs.Overall, highly recommended.  These kits are no brainers, and with the price and free shipping the wine is about $1.75 per bottle and is comparable to an $8-$12 wine, IMO.  This is my second kit from this supplier and I am nothing but happy.  Nice to have a good bottle of wine with dinner and not have to cringe at spending $10 each night.  Besides, it's easy and fun. Heck, they even throw in free corks. I was already homebrewing for 15 years and decided to try my hand at wine.  I had built my own "kit" by buying concentrated juice, acid, yeast, clarifiers, etc.  I ended up spending about 25% more than this kit without a noticeable difference in quality. Go for it, you won't be disappointed.

This wine turned out great. Nice color and clean finish. It makes a great utility white table wine that is semi-dry that goes well with lighter meats. I will buy more, however, as many reviewers have stated, only make these and Vino Italiano kits to 5 gallons and NOT 6. Making it to 6 gallons or 23 litres will yield a weak and thin wine. The price per bottle is still a very good deal.
It's not total crap, just a rip-off; it's ok with lots of cream and sugar, but at 18$/lb (w/ S&H), it is no better than Dunkin Donuts at the store. Will not buy again, needless to say.

I live in Minnesota surrounded by people of Scandinavian descent and bland taste buds. Since I'm of Hungarian descent, finding a good Hungarian paprika is important to me for making some of my family recipes. My mom used it for years and I did too until I ran out of the spice my mom sent to me. This is the best paprika!

I used to be able to find this in my local grocery store. no more. i've always loved the heat with the paprika taste that you can't seem to re-create with regular paprika and hot spices (cayenne). Love this product, and this sender was quick.

column9: Tasty with a hint of spice
column10: I used it Hungarian Paprika when making home fries and it gave it a nice flavor.  My husband said it tasted delicious and I told him what I added made a difference.
I wish I had found this decades ago!  It's beautiful, delicious, and so hard to find!  Thank you, Amazon!  I use it on so many things - it's as necessary to me as salt!
These cookies are amazing! So yummy, but too pricey. I found out they sell them at Aldi for waaaayy cheaper.

column9: Good, but their Gourmet Medallion roast is better
column10: It is a good coffee - medium roast, decent aroma, slightly sweet taste. Very coarse grind.Try their Gourmet Medallion brand - it very similar, but has more aroma and taste.
Tastes and smells great, most bestest coffee everz!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Only downside, is that its about 2 times more expensive than your typical generic blends.

column4: D. Marquez "50D user in Lakewood, CA"
column9: great coffee at a reasonable price
column10: the first time i had this coffee was at ruby's at the crystal court in costa mesa, CA. i had to ask the manager the name of the coffee we were having and he was kind enough to dig up the information for me.we also use dunkin' donuts coffee but price has been going up steadily over the last two years. boyd's coffee offers the same great blend and robustness at a more reasonable price.this the fourth time i ordered this package from amazon and foresee more orders in the near future.

Yes, my pups love these chewy treats and I love the fact that they are made in the USA.  I'm currently using them for training treats since they are so popular, and since my pups are still small (13 pounds and 7 pounds) I break them into three pieces.  Now this would be a ridiculous thing to do with a big dog, but with the pups it takes them some time to eat even a third (about the size of a Chiclet) because they are chewy.Made from Chicken, Brown rice, barley flour, cane molasses, vegetable glycerin, chicken liver, gelatin, apples, carrots, salt, phosphoric acid, sorbic acid (as a preservative) mixed tocopherols (also a perservative) glucosamine hydrocholoride, and chondroitin sulfate.A 10-30 pound dog should get 2 treats/day.  This is graduated up to 5 for a dog over 95 pounds.Pam T~mom/dog lover

A few years ago I started using Agave nectar as a sweetener in my tea, and I have never looked back. Its mild, light flavor is an ideal additional to various teas as it doesn't detract from their flavor. I've tried several different Agave nectar flavors, and of all of them I liked the Madhava brand the best. This particular size works the best for me, as it usually lasts me several weeks. Highly recommended.

column9: better value than the smaller bottle
column10: It is good used in many things, easy to use and handy at a good price. it's worth the price

I learned about this little gem from Alton Brown's Margarita recipe.. no doubt you will enjoy this instead of Simple Syrup. Just mix about a tea spoon of it with the juice from one orange, one lime, lime zest and 2-3 oz of tequila and ice and you'll have a great margarita! (change ratios based on sweet:sour ratio desired.) Enjoy!

Agave syrup is essentially 100% fructose and is therefore the most toxic sweetener of all. Fructose leads to non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and all the rest that we have learned about high fructose sweeteners. From corn or cactus, fructose is fructose, and it's all bad.

I work in a dental office and we have a prize machine for the children after they have a good visit. The dental suppliers sell the same thing for so much more!! Great customer service, fast shipping. And best of all, the kids seem pretty happy with their toy!!

Still pretty yummy, even though they've reduced the fat content, making it not quite as yummy as it used to be (thanks nanny state [big razzzzzberry].) what more can I say? I have always eaten the Lance Sandwich Crackers and wanted to try out the popcorn.  I can tell you that this has a much better white cheddar flavor than other brands I have tried.
I Love this popcorn. I used to consume it when I was a child. It was a very rare find. I wish the bags were bigger though. Can be a little salty, but a Good occasional treat nonetheless.

This stuff is terrible. I bought a bag, thinking it would be like Smartfood white cheddar popcorn. I got it b/c it was cheaper and came in a larger bag, but I was very disappointed. It was overly salty and had a weird, gross flavor that was nothing like how white cheddar is supposed to taste. Do yourself a favor and if you haven't ever bought it, don't! Get the Smartfood brand or Rocky Mountain Popcorn instead.

column9: not too sweet, low cal, and great taste
column10: I love the taste of this tea. It's naturally sweet without being overwhelming and has just the right balance of tea/peach flavor. It does have a little peach sediment at the bottom, and is best when shaken.

column9: Great!! Is all I can say
column10: I buy these every month and I have nothing but great things to say about Blue Ribbon, from the golden figs to these they are nothing but the best. Like I said I but once a month

Don't know what happened to this batch! The last batch I ordered (same Blue Ribbon Orchard mission figs) it was more chewy, moist (just enough) and tasted good (yum-yum)! Couldn't stop eating! This one had a bitter/funny after taste, some figs even had a slight grayish look, was too dry and hard (was it due to too much preservative Potassium Bromate or sitting in storage for too long or what?), and wasn't that sweet either!  Disappointed to say the least..  I truly hope the rest (5 more 12oz cups to go) of the batch taste better than this first cup I opened, although I doubt that very much..  The price was decent with free shipping.  But then again price isn't everything!  Ahh..Live and learn..

column9: quality a little uneven but good figs.
column10: I get this six pack once a month. Usually the quality is good to very good, but sometimes I get a very dry batch.
You oughta see a 3 year old try one and then put'em away.  I like'em too I mean too much.  Best black mission figs I can find and I've been eating black figs for a long time.

column9: not as good as the kalamata figs...
column10: These are not as dry or as delicious as the kalamata figs. I set out to try different kinds of dried figs but I concluded the kalamatas are the best. Some people like the fact that these mission figs are not as dry but they were too mushy for me.

column9: Sweeter and a bit dry in places but good
column10: I have had Blue Ribbon figs for years in the store.  They were usually a bit more moist than these, perhaps because of packaging (they were in plastic bags like the ones prunes and other dried fruit come in while these are in tubs).  The figs are sweeter and more consistent than the other local source i have for figs here in Utah, and that I like.  These are not as moist as they were long ago, but similar to those days, you will have the occasional fig that's got sort of a dried, tough, perhaps sunburnt edge.  That just comes with the fig territory if you like to eat them out of hand as I do.  Overall - this is a great item to have on hand, a nice change from raisins or craisins, and very yummy.

I love these figs, they are very moist and tasty. I read a lot of reviews about figs, I know sometimes they can be bad even from the same company that packaged them. I guess I'm just lucky, I got a good batch this time. I'll definitely order them again, just hope my next shipment will be as great as this one.

Black mission figs can be difficult to find at a reasonable price, so these are both good and reasonably priced.  Most of the time the containers have good sized, moist figs, but once in awhile they are smaller and drier.  I have purchased these more than once, and find them to be a very good buy.
Figs were really dry and tough. Although the expiration date was Sep. 2011, there were white specs all over and it looked to me that the dried fruit went bad.

If you are looking for fresh, organic coffee roasted to perfection, Basecamp coffee is definitely worth a try! This is the most consistent, quality roast I've found by far. Living in Seattle, that is no easy task as I am surrounded by the king of coffee's. Yet Backcountry Coffee roasters comes through with an amazingly bold Espresso roast. I highly recommend this product... you won't be disappointed!

WOW! This coffee is amazing...Backcountry coffee is probably the most consistant, freshest whole bean coffee I've experienced. The Espresso roast (Basecamp) is full bodied and aromatic. Unlike other beans that end up dry or overly coated with oils, this roast is consistant from bag to bag. This is an exceptional value for the highest quality, best tasting espresso roast I've had! I highly recommend this coffee!

Coffee beans are one of those food items that can be very high in pesticide residues, so along with bananas, milk, lettuce and a few other things, we added coffee to our 'must buy organic' list. After being thoroughly spoiled by Lavazza super crema, Lavazza gran riserva, and Filicori Zecchini gran crema forte, we had a hard time finding an organic espresso that wouldn't disappoint. We've been using BackCountry organic basecamp espresso for three weeks now, and are thoroughly delighted. Although the crema (foam) isn't quite as pronounced as you get with the italian espressos I mentioned, the taste is excellent! It's creamier and less bitter than other organic espressos i've tried, and is a solid replacement for the Lavazza super crema (in taste, not crema). If the price stays comparable to Lavazza, we'll stick with BackCountry for our morning routine.

Very satisfied with this city roast (espresso roast)! The beans make a great cup of latte and americano, not sure how it taste as a shot as I don't drink straight espresso. The one thing that stands out with these beans to me is the fact that the coffee doesn't go sour after it's been in your cup for awhile. Yes...you're suppose to drink your coffee within 15 minutes of when it's made, but I like to drink some now and save a little later to see if I need more kick when the caffeine has activated in your system.The beans also smell great and I keep them in my bean-vac to ensure freshness and grind only what I need each time. The grinds seem more dense than most of what I've tried before. After putting it in the perc, it doesn't pack down as much as most other beans.

column9: Took a little getting used to
column10: This coffee was okay, nothing like Trader Joe's (my fave) but all in all, it was a great organic coffee.

column9: Forget the goldfish ~ go for bunnies! (and BIG)
column10: These crackers are great for the natural, health-conscious family as well as anyone else who loves "goldfish" or other cheese crackers... They taste great and are all natural with organic wheat. Nothing weird - you can actually understand what every ingredient is! (how refreshing)Plus, I love this new BIG box -- 12 oz instead of regular 7.5 oz. Not only does it save packaging and cabinet space, but it's a better price per ounce! Great for us because we go through them so fast. Now that these are available here, I also don't have to go to the store (some of my local stores don't carry the big size anyway).

My 14 month old son is a very picky, fickle eater. Some days he'll eat grapes, other days he'll throw them angrily to the floor as though I'm trying to poison him. But Annie's Cheddar Bunnies are a sure thing. He'll eat them for breakfast, lunch or dinner and bounces up and down happily when he sees the purple box. Though I'd prefer he ate something more substantial, at least I know they're made from real ingredients including organic flour and real cheese. They're also lower in sodium than many comparable cheese crackers including the Earth's Best Organics brand which I appreciate. Most importantly, since many of my meals these days consist of his leftovers, they're delicious.

these taste so much better than goldfish!!!!  They taste almost homemade- very fresh and strong cheese flavor.  I am switching over to mostly natural and organic foods, so I picked these up.  My kids were skeptically ( they love their goldfish crackers), but all yelled "YUM" after the first bite!

My kids (almost 4 and 1) love these crackers.  We always have a box in the car.  They are healthy and tasty - much better for kids than Goldfish.  My only complaint (thus the 4 stars) is that they are a bit greasy and can stain things.  My little one sometimes sits on them in her carseat and gets stains on her clothes and also on our couches ;-) .  I try to be careful, but sometimes it is invevitable.The price here is the best I have seen (better than Annie's own website) and this larger size is not available many places.  It is even better when Amazon is running an instant rebate on them!

column9: the best cheese crackers for kids (big kids too!)
column10: our family loves these!  Annie's is a great company!  my teenage son takes a box to each away ballgame to share with his teammates.my husband has a handful with his glass of wine in the evening...wine and cheese :)very cheesy and healthy too, plus who can resist the cute bunny shape?try some!

column9: A former addiction of my wife's
column10: I bought the case for my wife's birthday. She loved it! She has since stopped eating Cheddar Bunnies, but not because they're not delicious. She just wants to slim down a bit. And you know how it is around bunnies: two bunnies, then four bunnies, then eight....

My 2 year old is obsessed with these...if he could eat nothing else he'd be happy. I love that they are all natural. The only downside to buying these boxes in particular is that they are pretty large and not really usable for taking on the go, so be ready to use a sealing container if you want them to be portable.
We are all addicted to Cheesey Bunnies! From ages 1 to 37, our family of four is in love! Our very picky 1 & 6 year olds can't stop eating them! Way better than Cheese Nips or Cheez-its!

I only recently discovered these crackers and think they're a great product. They are very light and crispy, yet flavorful and not too salty. The ingredient list is reassuring as so many snack products are loaded with junk. Also, so many natural brands make snacks that can taste pretty bland.These are a win win. I higly recommend these scrumptious Bunnies!

column9: Blows Goldfish out of the water (ha!)
column10: I enjoy other Annie's products and figured I'd give these a try. Similar to Goldfish, but better. A more authentic flavor and certainly better for you. My husband, who doesn't like Goldfish, loves these. Perfect for a little "something" if you can't wait for lunch or dinner.

THESE ARE PROBABLY THE BEST CHEDDAR-BASED BUNNY SNACK I'VE EVER EATEN. AND LET ME TELL YOU, I'VE BEEN AROUND THE BLOCK (OF CHEESE - LOL!) A TIME OR TWO AND MAN ARE THESE THINGS GOOD!!FINAL VERDICT: BUY 'EM!!

I bought a whole case of these because my daughter loves bunnies, and I have eaten my fair share of them, too.  I don't really like how I feel after eating a whole bunch of goldfish, but I have eaten a bunch of the bunnies, and I still feel good after eating them.  That must be because they don't have all the artificial stuff.  Good for picky eaters like my daughter!

My boys and I love Annie's Homgrown Cheddar Bunnies. I have priced the cheddar bunnies at a few diffrent stores and found that the best price is on Amazon. I also love having the food come directly to my home.
Kids and adults can enjoy these! Crunchy, not too much salt and no preservatives or artificial colors. A good choice for a cheddar cracker

We used to buy baby goldfish crackers for our toddlers until we found these.  We bought a whole case and our toddlers love them.  It took about a month for our little girl to stop calling them "sishy crackers."  She couldnt tell a difference.  In my opinion they tast better than goldfish crackers.  They're not as salty tasting.  I think we have these with at least 2 meals a day, not to mention snacks.  I love snacking on them too!!  A great snack for the whole family!!!
My kids love these crackers.  They are a great snack.  The larger (12 oz.) boxes are harder too find, and are a better deal.

I bought this product from a local outlet several times and have always enjoyed it quite a bit. I usually brew 4-6 times in a row using my 16 ounce infuser and the same 2-4 teaspoons of tea. The price seems a little more worthwhile when considering this. The tea itself has a flavor that I would call smooth and green, a little strong but not bitter at all. I can only compare this to other Teavana loose leaf teas and various brands of bagged teas (Stash, Yogi, Lipton, and others), but gyokuru imperial is an all time favorite. I also like that despite giving a strong caffiene boost to my day it never has given me the jagged feeling or lift and drop that I have come to expect from coffie and strong black teas. It is a short steep tea made for 40 seconds to 1 minute per serving which I like as I am a little impatient with preparing tea. If you have a tea store nearby, do yourself a favor and ask to smell this, it will taste much the same when finished.

column9: A very nice mild green tea
column10: I love Japanese green tea and had read that gyokuro is the finest variety, so I decided to splurge on this tea. The tea is very nice, but not worth the price (in my opinion) compared to other sencha teas at a quarter of the price. I prefer a tea that brews bright green with a distinct grassy taste. This tea (using 1.5 teaspoons with 8 oz. of 175°F water and brewing for for 3 minutes) brewed tea with a faint green hue and a delicate, mild flavor. The flavor was fresh and sweet but not as bold as I had hoped. As one would expect, a second infusion (brewed for 4 minutes) was even weaker and only beneficial if one is being frugal (or wants to avoid the caffeine that is mostly extracted in the first infusion).

I have tried a number of gyokuros and this one is way to overpriced for what you get. H&S has good gyokuro as do others here in Japan that sell directly from their farms.Did I mention how horrible Teavana's customer service is? They don't respond to emails,etc. You have to wait on the phone for hours. Simply unacceptable. Feel free to check their facebook wall to see customers voicing the same concern. The company simply does not seem to appreciate its customers and apparently many people feel the same way. I will no longer buy from them due to their poor service and overpriced products.

This is a great morning tea it has no crash and keeps me going through the entire day.  I do love to drink coffee although this doesn't have the coffee taste it does have the kick I would strongly recomend this!
These are so different from all of the other Pop-Tarts Toaster Pastries. They are more like a dessert that anything else. Warm from the toaster with a scoop of ice cream - well, you tell me.

I bought these because I wanted something different than the usual Smores and Strawberry Pop-Tarts I always get.  My entire family really liked them.  The whole box was empty the same day I bought them.  I would definitely buy again.
This came from an outside seller, thru Amazon.  The pop-tarts were broken.I like this flavor as it's not available in stores anymore.  I won't purchase anymore however because of the packaging.

This is the worst thing to eat for breakfast! I was running late for work one morning and it was down between grabbing a sandwich from Hardees or throwing two of these in the microwave for 10 seconds because that's all the time I had. So anyhow, I opted for the latter. By the time I got to work and got halfway to my first break I had the worst stomach ache. Now, thinking maybe it was something else I didn't attribute that to these poptarts. On a Saturday morning I put two in the toaster and scrambled some egg beaters southwestern eggs with cheese and my stomach did the same thing. These would be nice advertised as dessert primarily but unfortunately these were too sugary for my taste. And on average I like to eat three very thick buttermilk pancakes and drown them in about 1/2 cup syrup and even for me it was too sweet. The flavor is great, however, which is why I kept eating them. If you are buying this for kids they may like it with no side effects but grownups, your stomachs are not iron made like it used to be; maybe the normal pop-tarts will suit your stomach better in the morning. For this reason I gave it a 3.5.

If you've got a hankering for a huckleberry pie and nothing else will do but you can't find one anywhere, here's the perfect solution:  make your own.  And look no further, this product is the way to go.  It makes one supremely delectable huckleberry pie - not too sweet or too tart, just right in every possible way.  All you have to do is supply the crust, turn on your oven and bake.

column9: The Best Huckleberries in the County
column10: It's a little piece of heaven and a little piece of Montana.  It's a little piece of Grandma's Huckleberry pie.  It's family holiday dinners and sweet childhood memories.  It the best!

According to my mom, for whom it was bought as a gift, she and her boyfriend couldn't detect any actual berries in this pie filling, though the taste was fine.  They DID like the huckleberry candies, though.
I used it in homemade ice cream.  And it was amazing, you could even just eat this with a spoon its soo good!

I have to assume that some reviewers are looking at a different listing.  I am looking at a listing that shows $9.95 for a 5 pound bag.  That is a gnat's hair less than $2.00 per pound.  Retail stores in this area do not match that price, assuming you can find it.  It's a good mix of the original flavors - watermellon, apple, cherry, grape, and blue raspberry.  If you are buying candy in bulk for events like Halloween, it's a good choice.  I would note that I paid a higher price at a different source before finding the listing at Amazon.

I usually shop from here, but their prices aren't that great for candy, and lately they've been eliminating large size bags of hard candy. These are the original flavors. Only thing is if you eat too many, they color your tongue purple-red, and you'd better be prepared to brush your teeth (and tongue) well before bedtime after these!
It was a little expensive i've purchased for less than 10 dollars but I needed them for a birthday party.. Although they were delicious!!

column9: A Childhood Memory to the Max
column10: I have never been disappointed about Jolly Rancher candy-they've always had the best taste in small candy. Now seeing it in 5-lb. bags, I wish it were ever so. Now if we can just get Cinnamon Fire in the bag...

column9: Price per pound is great.  Shipping is the killer.
column10: I see a lot of gripes about the price of this item.  At approximately $2.00 per pound, this can't be beat.  So, I put two in my cart.  The over $16.00 in shipping (cheapest ground available) turned me off!  That negates the great price per pound.  This seller needs to reevaluate their shipping costs. Like others have said, this review is no reflection on the candy itself, only on the seller.

A no star rating. The worst purchase ever from Amazon. Have no doubt, you really do just get one 5lb bag. It can totally be purchased other places for way less. I'm embarrassed to admit I bought it & angry on top of it. They must laugh while putting this item in a box to ship.......
Go to Walmart.  You can get a 3 pound bag for under $8.00, about $2.67 a pound.  This costs almost $5.00 a pound.

column9: Yummy but I think they changed the formulation!
column10: Very yummy - same great taste - but the actual "grahams" aren't as thick as they used to be before Mother's was purchased by Quaker.  I'm thinking they changed the formulation.  Same taste, though and my kids really like it.  It's difficult to find here locally (even at Whole Foods) so we order online.

We've used these with two dogs (an 11 year old and a 9 week old) and have had absolutely no issues so far. In fact, these are the first dental chews that our 11 year old has ever been able to handle without issue. No digestive issues and no ill health effect; only happy pups whose eyes light up when we open the package.  They are also the perfect size for our pups to finish in one sitting; a little tasty distraction without having an all day chewing event.Now, I had no intention on posting a review for this product. However, after I saw such a poor rating on these chews that we had been using for our pups, I was quite concerned.  When I saw that the poor rating came from someone who had used the product only once (that I can tell) and negated it based not on fact or ill effects to their animals but solely on where the product was manufactured, I decided to post a counter review from someone who had actually used - and is still currently using - the product. Rest assured that if these PROVE to be a detriment to our pups (based on either factual evidence or research that I find), I will post an update.  If you don't see any updates, then all is still going great on this end, and I am a very satisfied customer.

column9: DO NOT BUY! Made in china!!!!!
column10: Another treat I purchased at the store for my dogs and did not check where they were made. They are made in china. I check everything I buy for my dogs now because most products are made in china. Yes my dogs like them but I am not putting their health at risk. And they are a really strange rubbery texture. Does not look like something they should be ingesting. Anyway, I will never buy these again. Zero stars!
Both of my dogs did not want it.  The chew was a good size for them to handle but they just did not care to chew on it.  As if the flavor was totally missing from it.

I picked up a package of Dreambones at Walgreens as a change from our usual chew treats for our two small dogs. After I gave them dreambones they ate these completely without leaving a trace behind. They never finished the other kind (Dingo)and we would either have to toss them or wait for the neighbors dog to come in to pick up the leftovers. They now beg for dreambones, snub any other kind and will not share the dreambones with each other like they would with the other kind. I found these locally only once and can not find them anywhere now. I just wish a local outlet store would carry these on a regualar basis. Ordering on line is OK, but picking them up while shopping would be helpful. Our dogs love their Dreambones!Cindy ColeWinfield IL

I have a 7 month old poodle that's 7.8lbs, she just loves them. First I got the trial pack 2 tiny bones in the package.  Found out she just loves them! One thing I hate about raw-hides is it makes your dogs gums bleed and these don't! I just love the fact they look like a raw-hide but aren't actually a raw-hide.  These are a great bone to give your dog.

Both of my dogs really enjoyed this rawhide alternative bone. My dogs have been eating real rawhide for several years, with seemingly no issues. Recently, one of my dogs had a terrifying near-death experience; choking on a rawhide. After doing some research, I learned that this isn't an uncommon situation, and that rawhides are a known choking hazard. After the incident, I quickly researched different rawhide alternative bones, and theses ones were one of the first we have tried. They have more of a leathery texture, softer and more flexible than a rawhide. However, they are not soft treats that can be chewed up quickly, it still took my dogs some time to eat them, and enjoying them for about 10 minutes. One thing that I really liked about these bones is that they don't get stringy, slimy, and sticky like rawhides do. They get softer with chewing, and then brake off into smaller pieces, unlike rawhides that won't brake off, making the dream bones less of a choking hazard. They only reason I gave them a 4 star rating and not a 5 star rating is because the first ingredient (the most prevalent) is corn. Corn isn't the greatest thing for pets to consume because its not easy to digest. I avoid corn in pet food at all costs, but because this is a treat- and not a main food staple, I think it is okay. I do recommend these- especially over regular rawhides. I would recommend the dental version more as those ones smell really good and contain parsley and chlorophyl and other good smelling ingredients that aren't present in the chicken flavor.

Bumble Bee used to be a good brand but it has been on a steady decline in quality.Yesterda I opened a can of Bumble Bee "Chunk Light Tuna" in oil and what did Ifind?...Not one piece of "chunk" of tuna...Instead, I found liquified Tuna Slopswimming in a bath of oil. Even my animals refused it. I bought a store brand,took it home and when I opened it, guess what? - I actually found meat - chunksof light tuna. The store brand was cheaper and the quality was far superior toBumble Bee. The result: No more Bumble Bee tuna in my future.

column9: The ideal tuna for Tuna Helper
column10: This is not my preferred tuna for fine dining; it's not my choice for tuna salad.  But it is the best to transform Tuna Helper into an ambrosial delight.  No other tuna works as well.Over the years I've developed my recipe for Tuna Helper Fettucine Alfredo.  Here are the changes and additions in a nutshell.1)  Use butter.2)  Substitute Half and Half for milk to impart a far richer flavor.3)  Add a dash of Tabasco when adding ingredients.4)  Add 1/2 cup dry vermouth (I prefer Martini & Rossi) just before covering the pan.  People living below 5000' elevation should cut the water by 1/2 cup.5)  Simmer; don't boil.  As the mixture cooks down, keep lowering the heat.  The noodles should become very soft and resemble a casserole.  If there's too much liquid remove the cover and increase the heat slighty.  But be careful.  A mild brown crustiness is excellent, but do be careful not to burn the noodles.Don't skimp on the tuna; use two cans.  I've tried three but that's too much.The emendations I've described work for other flavors of Tuna Helper as well but are most suited for the Fettucini Alfredo.Never use lumpy tuna for this.

I can not locate sugar twin where I live so ordering it is the best way for me to get what I want and being able to use something that I have used and loved for well over 20 years, even when I was stationed Overseas my mother used to send it to me when I could not get it in them commissary.  Thanks Sugar Twin for staying available for those of us whom love the taste and the portability of the Packets...

column9: WOW! Better than that PINK Packet!!
column10: I've been an avid user of "SugarTwin" for over 30 yrs. Prefer this sweetner over any other substitute on the market right now. Does NOT have a Bitter or BAD after-taste like some others. Very easy to use in cooking and baking. Great for anyone to use, and/or if you're a diabetic. My hubby started "borrowing" my packets when he became Insulin dependent diabetic. He "used" to use the pink packets. Hmm. No problem, I'll just purchase an extra box for him. Even when "SugarTwin" became unavailable in my area stores, I searched the Internet and was pleasantly,pleased to find "SugarTwin" available for sale this way. AMEN! Their formulation is slightly different from other artificial sweetners and I believe this is why it tastes so good. Give it a try for yourself.
If carefully noticed, Splenda has a chemical aftertaste, Twin is just plain sweeter.

My mom used sugar twin to make iced tea and I do the same for my own family.  Suddenly, it is impossible to find in any store in my area.  I was very worried, as I have tried other products and nothing tastes like Sugar Twin.  I am so glad to see that I can order it online.  To the manufacturer:  Please don't stop making this product!!
Thank goodness for a decent tasting sweetener that doesn't turn into formaldehyde - - - or leave an after-taste!
I purchase the Sugar Twins for my Mom because she is not able to purchase them from a retail grocer.  She loves the taste and the ease to which she can get them on Amazon.

I am so happy that I can still get my "Sugar Twin".  None of the supermarkets in my area, or in the surrounding areas for that matter do either, so when I searched it on Amazon I was thrilled.  I have used this product for years and just am not happy with any of the new 'sweetners'.  Thank you Amazon.

I used SugarTwin for years prior to the introduction of Aspartame, and had been quite happy with it.  When the almost constant headaches I experienced were traced to Aspartame, I returned to SugarTwin and have used it ever since without headaches.  SugarTwin has a pleasant sweet taste and no artificial aftertaste unlike some other products.  For me, it is much better than anything else.

I grew up in Canada and am a big tea drinker.  I drink 4-6 cups a day.  I've always used Sugar Twin (so much better than the pink or the blue or even the "other yellow" ones), since I was old enough to know how many calories I would be consuming by using sugar in that many cups of tea.  I am addicted to my tea like most are to coffee, (and that makes me wonder if Sugar Twin is some sort of drug?!?!!) and so when I moved to the States 11 years ago and found the ST in bulk form to be different (like Kit Kat.  Bet you didn't know they are better up in Canada?  Made by different companies) I started buying large quantities when I went home and being my own importer (the border crossings haven't always been easy!  Tons of white powder...).  I went online today to figure out if ST is aspertame or saccharine and found that I can buy the individual packets at Amazon?!?!?!?!?!  I think I'm in love.
Can't find this locally.  Was THRILLED to find it on the website.  Price and shipping are totally reasonable and so worth it!!!  Thank you!!!

I have tried most all of the sugar substitutes and have found Sugar Twin to be the best for my taste. It disolves quickly and does not leave an after-taste in your mouth. I also like that one does not have to use alot to get things sweet.

I don't even remember what made me look online for the product, but I'm so glad I found it!  The shipment arrived on time, in its original box, in excellent condition.
This is a wonderful sweetener that is very hard to find in the stores anymore.  No aspartame, just good old saccharin.
The product was shipped when they said and  was received in great shape.  I would not hesitate to order again.

column9: Product Came Smashed With Other Amazon Items
column10: I've purchased these from Amazon vendors before with no issue.  This time, the three packs that I purchased came smashed so that the small nugget treats were mostly crumbs.  I didn't throw them away; I sprinkle them on my dog's food.  But, I still am without "treats" to give my dog at those times each day when he gets treats. This is a first for me but I am thoroughly disgusted with this product at this time because of the damaged delivery.

I cannot comment on product as it has not yet been tried. However, the order was shipped immediately and arrived in good order.
These chips are soooo good. Didn't buy them from Amazon, I found them at my local Homegoods. I'm in love with these chips! :D

Now, I'm already a big fan of Red Leaf Tea's green apple matcha, but that one really does taste like a green apple, tart and sweet all at the same time. Which is great, but every once in a while a girl needs a smoother apple, a juicer, sweeter apple, which is what I hope to gain from this matcha. I'm eager to try it as a latte with vanilla soy milk and some of their Cinnamon Matcha...I'm hoping for a apple pie with ice cream kind of drink. I love apples and apple juice, so whenever I spot an apple blend, I have to try it. And there are so many things you can do with apple that I'm hoping to be able to do with this apple matcha. Apple matcha pie, anyone? Or apple fritters with an apple matcha icing...yes, please! I make homemade donuts occasionally...can you imagine a big apple cake donut covered in cinnamon sugar? I may have to make donuts in the near future. I hope this matcha lives up to all of the plans I have for it. And I hope it gives me the energy to follow through on those plans! Because now that I've mentioned it, if I don't make donuts in the near future, my wife will be devastated.Unfortunately, this is just not for me. The smell of the dry matcha has the smell of the more bitter matchas I've had from Red Leaf Tea, and that smell carried through into the taste of the brewed tea. It tastes something like apple candy when you power through the bitterness, which is nice, but far from the apple juice I was craving. I'm not an apple candy type of girl, unless it's a sour apple. It might still be good as a latte, but I won't be cooking with it, sadly. Still it isn't terrible, and the bitterness seems to fade over time. Maybe it will still hold up to donuts, as the amount of sugar in them will balance out the bitterness. I don't really think this is one I need to get more of, and if any of my local friends want a taste, I'm happy to share. I'll experiment with what I have left, maybe I can find a way to fall in love with this tea. But personally I'm going to stick with the Green Apple matcha, also from Red Leaf Teas.

The sugar is great.  It has a tartness to it so it pairs great with a pomegranate martini.  I had a problem with the packing.  I had to order a second time because the first was only one tin of the rimmer when the description says a pack of 6.  I finally gave up and sent the second shipment back for a full refund.

column9: Tastes like Strawberry Ice Cream, but the charm is in the crispy texture and delicate slenderness
column10: Pocky is just plain fun to eat. I discovered these snacks at an anime convention (though I'd heard about them before and had seen manga characters eating them). They are very, very slim sticks of biscuity stuff (the flavor to me is a cross between waffle cones and pretzels) that have a charming tiny popping crispness. The flavor of the strawberry (which I prefer to the chocolate) is like strawberry ice cream. Very nice.This is by no means a health food (it's in the same category as a cookie, it's got fat and sugar), but a serving (five pocky sticks) is 70 calories. Unless you're really prone to binge-eating or can't stop yourself a whole one of these smaller boxes is not a huge calorie splurge. But if you can stick to just a few at a time, you can easily have a fun Japanese snack for 100 or fewer calories (figure 14 or 15 calories per stick).If you love the flavor of coconut-chocolate together (like Almond Joy) try the coconut chocolate ones. They're really so good, oh man. Hubby says the taste reminds  him of the Girl Scout 'caramel delights" cookies which are, in turn, similar to the old Yes Yes cookies (from the seventies or so).Anyway, if you have read manga or seen anime with young folks eating those stick-looking treats, or seen footage of cute Japanese girls nibbling at skinny little stick treats, this is what they were eating. :) Fun treats.

Love the Pocky strawberry, but they should not be shipped in warm weather.  They were all melted and stuck together, with most of the strawberry fudge left on the inside of the wrapper.  Also, not too thrilled that they do contain trans fats.

I LOVE Strawberry!The Strawberry coating is packed with flavour, but because each biscuit is thin, it makes you want to grab another!The Biscuit texture is perfect, and has a hint of sweetness.They'd probably go great with Ice Cream.I have no complaints, I loved these :3

I first discovered Pocky Biscuit Sticks a few months ago, They're somewhat like a long pretzel (without salt) where one end has been dipped in a fudge-like candy. They're an interesting treat and, because they individually come in small portions, I like to use them as treats for my young (4 years) boy. The first ones I discovered were chocolate. This last time I decided to try the strawberry. I'd have to say that I prefer the chocolate. My boy shows no preference for one or the other.Gary Petesron

Pocky is a great snack.  It's crunchy and not too sweet.  It's similar to a bread stick dipped in chocolate (or strawberry in this case).  Strawberry pocky has a strawberry yogurt type of taste to it.  I rather enjoy it.The strawberry pocky is far more reasonably priced over the chocolate pocky on amazon.  Be careful not to ship in hot weather or you will end up with one giant pock.
Pocky Sticks have been a favorite snack of mine for a long time. It's great that it can be ordered and delivered to me whenever I want.

These were given to us at our local Thai restaurant because our son (20 months) wouldn't stop whining or sit still in his high chair. The staff gave it to us and he loved them! They're great because they're light and slightly sweet and just the right size for toddler who can chew. I absolutely recommend as a snack on the go.
This pocky flavor is really good. Its light and sweet and good for a tiny little snack. Pocky's are addicting because of the POP, crunchy sound it makes every time you bite into it.
Very good pocky, especially for the price. It kind of bothered me that it had trans fat in it though.

My animals truly love this stuff. With their old food I was, as often as not, throwing uneaten portions away. This does not happen with this food as my animals are actually wanting to be fed more often. It really is amazing, my male cat will run over to the food bag and meow until I get the animals all fed. My three young cats are only happy with Whiskas Indoor cat food, so I felt safe ordering the 6 pound bag on line.  Sadly they will not eat the food that was shipped. They cry and looked up at me with hungry eyes. So I have purchased a new bag locally and they are happy cats again. I have no clue why they will not eat it other than it 'MAY' be stale.
