These are wrapped in powdered parchment and then an outer wrapper, easy to remove and pop in your mouth. And the Amazon 5-pack price cannot be beat. I paid over twice this price in a local health food store. Stock up - they have a long shelf life!
I enjoy the ginger taste of this candy.  And it really helps settle my stomach.  I had originally bought it in a store but found it at Amazon at a much better price.
I was really disappointed!!! I was ordering for a 70th birthday party...and some how it got mixed up and they sent 1970 candy. When it should have been 1942!!!!

This gum's flavor is more akin to orange, or basically a sweet citrus taste.  I chew a piece when I work out or play any type of sport, and it pastes at least 40 minutes to keep my mouth feeling refreshed.  Granted, the taste is obviously not as intense after the first 10 minutes or so.  A few added bonus is that unlike some other gum like Extra, the consistency of this gum doesn't degrade down to a nasty mush when your mouth's temperature gets very high.  In addition, even when the fruity taste is mostly gone, there is no weird or bitter taste either.Lastly, I'm not sure if vitamin b6 and b12 in this gum actually does anything, but for those who swear by these 2 vitamins for energy boost, they can't hurt.

I am not generally a person that enjoys gum. My first pack was given to me as a gift and I was really surprised. It tastes unlike any other gum that I have ever tasted. It must be experienced to be appreciated.

column9: tiny tin but loads of healthy green tea and flavor!
column10: There is no argument as to the numerous health benefits of drinking green tea.  In fact, it's actually used in cancer centers as it's been proven to actually fight some types of cancer and prevent free radicals in addition to also being shown as a metabolism booster in study after study. That alone makes it a find!The best type of green tea with the most benefits is, of course, matcha...regardless of what brand you buy.Although I found the size to be small as there is also a bag inside the tiny tin, a little goes a long way and I've used it to make everything from green tea biscotti to green tea smoothies.

This can is much smaller than I was expecting, but it is very strong and flavor filled. I do quite a bit of japaneese baking which calles for this particular ingredient. For the price paid I would have expected more. However I usually have to use less than a recipe calls for, because its almost like it's the concentrated version.

I ordered this matcha hoping it would be of the same quality are the $12 matcha I usually purchase from a local Asian market. I was very dissapointed. This is culinary grade matcha. It doesn't dissolve well and the color of the tea is dark, very different from the bright green matcha I am used to. The flavour is somewhat bitter and flat, at least in comparison to any good drinking-grade matcha I've tried. I'm sure this is a fine option if you intend only to cook with it or make sweetened iced tea, but if you intend to consume it as a hot tea, I would advise you to select a different product of better quality.
I make protein shakes that require Matcha tea as one of their ingredients..it's priceybut this tea is nicely packed in a storage tin and well priced too.
Bitter taste when brewed even with sugar. small amount in package. Not happy with purchase. would not purchase again. picture does not represent what size you receive.

The matcha tea was very good but a little pricey for the small amount. It was 1.4 ounce for the same price Teavanna gets for 4 ounce, I would not order on line again as I would rather see what I'm getting first.

The question about any product is always, Is it worth it's price? Here, no. THe tea's taste is reviewed elsewhere, so check it out, and maybe it's standard practice by certain connie suers to ignore price, but I never do. I gave it a try, like it, but won't buy it again. Tastes tannicky. I'll stick to Barry's, and that's double what Trader Joe's Irish Breakfast cost, which is pretty good itself.

column9: Indistinct. Not Up To Hype On Label.
column10: I've been trying out a few blended red California wines which I find at a nearby Fresh and Easy Store and a few of them have been exceptional bargains. They're totally unpretentious wines, of course, but some have been exceptionally good values, in my opinion. So, I was back for trying another. There it was up on the top shelf and boldly proclaimed as "The Big Red Monster," California Red Wine 2010. The bottle presented  a lot of hype about how good it tasted and how bold it was, but it didn't show any information about the grape varieties used in the brewing of the wine. Well, I should have known better than to buy. It just doesn't live up to the hype. It's not a bad wine at all. I'd say it compares favorably with many California reds that cost about five to six dollars a bottle. It tastes a little young, and is not really distinct in any way. Other much better reds are available for the same price.Gary Peterson

I had purchased and used the chocolate from a store in my home town. I loved it because of its texture and low calories but they carried just this one flavor. I noticed on the box that it came in other flavors so I came to your site and found all of them. I love them all except the lemon which is difficult to tell that it is lemon. I think I will try adding some real lemon juice the next time I use it. I highly reccomend Sans Sucre's Mousse Mixes and will buy again when I use the dozen I ordered!!!!
This is a good easy sugar free dessert.  Served alone or over a few fresh berries it is very good.  I will buy this item again.
I order these products all the time and find them very good.  The French Vanilla flavor is somewhat weak in flavor - the others are great.  The dessert is easy and fast to make.

I used this mousse with approx. 1/3 cup of pumpkin and unsweetened So Delicious coconut milk (50 calories/cup) to make a wonderful pumpkin dessert (also added a good 1.5 tsp cinnamon and a dash of pumpkin spice to the mix). Result was fantastic! Light and delicate flavor praised by guests. I then tried this out with a high quality cocoa powder and non-dairy milk to make a chocolate variation. (I prefer adding my own cocoa powder to many desserts to intensify the chocolate flavors and also lessen the cloying sweetness of mass produced mixes) Again, results were wonderful. I will definitely keep this on hand for entertaining. While the plain vanilla flavor is fine on its own, I think that what makes this product truly great is its versatility. It can be assembled very easily and is an elegant and delicious way to end any meal. I would definitely recommend this brand.
Wonderful taste and texture.  One of the best low calorie desserts to be found.  Has nice Orange flavor

I purchased this to try some low carb bread recipes I'd seen and all I can say is wow.  If you try to watch your carbs and like to bake the is the best way to go.  The fiber in this *is* the total carb count.  There's nothing else.  Plus, it makes a bread with a nice, nutty flavor.  I can't wait to find more recipes to try.

I love this flaxseed meal, it works as a great egg replacer and helps bind a batter when not using eggs.  Although I am not a fan of flax, it DOES provide a delicious nutty flavor when I use the right amount (like 2-4 tbs in a recipe).  It's also nutritious and contains omegas, so that's another reason why I love using it.  I think it tastes great in recipes using peanut butter, maple or chocolate.

Great product that I add to my morning health shake.  Two tsps. flax seed meal, 1/2 banana, two strawberries, 1/2 pear, 25 grams chocolate peanut butter protein powder, 1/2 tsp. cinnamin, 1 cup nonfat milk and two tsps coconut oil.
I bought these for a "candy bar" for a holiday party.  They were a great hit!  I would purchase again.  The sprinkles on the outside are salty and the sweet salty is excellent.
I love chocolate coffee but I hate the sticky sweet of adding syrup.  These are great because they have lots of chocolate aroma and flavor but also lots of great coffee flavor comes through.

column9: Trident Splash Orange Swirl =  Super awesome
column10: Deliciously satisfying orange-dreamsicle/ orange soda/cream flavored gum.Have purchased it online several times due to its absence in local stores and shops.Great value, ships fast and lasts long.Highly recommend.

Normally love this product and was excited about the individual packaging, HOWEVER, the cookies had a funny plastic-like taste to them.  Wondering if the plastic in the packaging off-gassed into the product.  Blek.

I can not understand why people think Hershey's chocolate is so great.  It's waxy, salty tasting and has a texture like sandpaper.  Pure garbage.  Ship this stuff overseas and it'll sit on shelves with the other chocolate laughing at it for being the poor chocolate child made from ratty scraps.  I've been to Hershey, PA and think that town is lucky they came around when we didn't have the ability to go out and buy a good chocolate bar elsewhere.  Awful, awful chocolate.

Definitely something to have around the house - quick bite to sate that craving (one or two folks, don't indulge too much) but even a single piece will make you smile!Wonderful taste - if you buy them, share them with those you love! :)

We spent the day in Chicago shopping and stopped at the Hershey's store. Picked up a bag of these to try. Got home, tasted them and found out they were fantastic. I wish they would have been giving samples of these in the store; as I would have picked up more bags than one. Can't find them in the local stores. LOVE THESE!!!

column9: An alternative to gluten type pasta
column10: a great alternative to gluten. beaware that although it says Quinoa, it does contain corn....so if you are sensitive to corn, then it's not a good choice.When cooked, it holds shape...does not get mushy.  it does have a different texture than regular pasta. it's worth a try to see if it works for you.
Very tasty. Make sure you cook it al dente, which will be a bit longer than regular pasta. Much better value than buying it locally.
Cooks and tastes great! We prefer this over wheat pasta! Love that it does not release so much starch while cooking like other gluten free pastas do.

column9: Look No Further!! Healthy and Delicious.
column10: Ask an Italian American about pasta... Say no more, look no further. I love the alternative for healthier eating and this is it, we just do not like wheat pasta, too pasty, no resemblance to the pasta I was raised on, so... Buy it, cook according to directions and add most veggies the last 4 minutes to your pasta water while cooking your pasta, drain and either use a tomato sauce or oil and garlic sauce, or a chicken or veggie broth seasoned with sauteed garlic/shallots and herbs as well (healthier version.) Oh, so easy but so elegant. Can add shrimp or broccoli/asparagus, again add to the water or to the broth saute pan, mix and serve. God Bless your efforts!

This my new replacement ingredient for wheat pasta.  I don't feel gluten deprived when eating these.  They hold up well after cooking.  I like to use them with pasta sauce, as well as a salad addition.
These are my favorite noodles! I've tried other gluten free pasta, and Quinoa Veggie Curls are the best!
I'm so used to eating quinoa now that it just tastes like regular pasta to me. Plus, it has all the health benefits of a whole grain and low glycemic index. Great with tomato sauce poured over.

column9: Great flavor, good texture (but different than wheat pasta)
column10: This is probably my favorite gluten-free pasta so far.  If I'd known about it before I was diagnosed with celiac, I would have tried it and liked it then too.  Plus, the nutrition on this is excellent--it's high in protein and fiber, and has a much better texture and flavor than whole wheat pasta, so I recommend this to all my health-conscious friends who aren't gluten-free as well.
The product shipped promptly. I have used it, and it's a little saltier than it needs to be but it tastes good.

The product arrived promptly and the merchandise is great for the price, allowing me to use it in  abundance without breaking the bank.  It costs so much less than what I normally have to pay in the local grocery chains.  The individual cans are hermetically sealed and that allows for consumption over a period of time without worrying about losing the spice's flavor.

column9: Do not purchase this item from Amazon.com
column10: We ordered this cake, however upon arrival this cake was unedible.  One could tell without opening the plastic package the cake is shipped in that it was ruined.  The cake appeared squashed and liquified, unedible.  There are no returns offered by Amazon.com so we basically gave them 30 bucks for nothing.  If Amazon.com does not refund our money we will discontinue using amazon for any purchases.
I bought the Tortuga Caribbean Rum cake as a thank you gift, recipients loved it. Said it was moist and flavorful, and tasted just like the cakes they tried when they went on a cruise. They loved it.

i don't actually like the taste of rum cake much. but, i have given these as housewarming presents, birthday presents and mothers day presents and everyone LOVES them! i have given all varieties it seems like the chocolate one is most people's favorite. it is heavy and well worth the price. most people come to know Tortuga rum cakes after going to the caribbean. i have always gotten rave reviews for this gift.

column9: Tastes great, makes a great gift idea
column10: I was given a smaller tortuga rum cake by a friend returning from the caymen islands. After opening the smaller (non 33 oz) version I was given, I knew they would make a great gift idea. Used 4 of them for the 2008 Christmas season, everyone loved them.P.S. The rum taste is very strong and the cake is very moist. It's also alcohol free (alcohol vaporizes during baking) for those that don't consume alcohol for religious reasons.

I was extremely disappointed on receipt of this item.  It came very poorly packaged and therefore arrived in a very unappealing way.  All of the nice decorations had fallen off and were crumbled.  The whole idea of the cake, was to be delicious and decorative for the holidays.  It could not be served in the condition in which it was received, unfortunately.On the other side of the coin however, the vendor did replace the item with another product of the same value, so I appreciated that.

column9: all right by me---with one or two minor drawbacks
column10: Progresso makes an excellent New England clam chowder in a 19 ounce can. The soup is hearty and makes you feel nice and warm; and this is important since the fall is here and winter shall soon be upon us! This is the best New England clam chowder I've ever had from my grocer's shelf!The can is easy enough to open with its pull off lid; just cook it in a pot and you're ready to serve! Put any leftovers in the refrigerator for the next time; you can also cook this in a microwave using the easy instructions right on the can.There is fat in this soup, so please ignore Amazon's error above that this is 99% fat free. Fortunately, there are no trans fats--great! It is low in cholesterol but pretty high in sodium. The can has two servings; and each serving has a whopping 35% of your daily allowance of sodium. If you are on a low salt diet I would encourage you to find another brand of clam chowder.The soup tastes great on its own; I sometimes add some pepper on top after it's in the bowl cooling down just a minute before I dig in!Use this soup by the expiration date stamped on the bottom end of the can; and ask your doctor if this soup would cause a problem for you if you have trouble handling clam, milk, soy or tuna. These ingredients are in the soup. In addition, because this soup has fat and sodium I will take off one star for that; this will be a four star review.Overall, this is one mighty fine New England clam chowder; and I recommend it highly now that cooler weather is just around the corner. Get some today and enjoy!

I purchased Chestnut Flour from Pasta cheese for a friend who was having great difficulty finding some in the mid west.We were dilighted to recieve the order in a few days ,all perfectly wrapped,and in good shape. My friend needed it for making some Italian dishes ,and was more than pleased with the quality of the product,and has since made some very delicious recipesMany thanksIs there a catalogue of the other products from Pasta cheese?Chestnut Flour

I have to maintain a gluten free diet and am always looking for alternative flours to use in my baked goods.  I ordered the Chestnut Flour to use in cookies and breads along with the other special flours I have to use.  I use just a small amount of the Chestnut Flour in the recipes and it really gives you a nice nutty flavor.

Chestnut flour aka farina di castagne is a flour made from dried ground chestnuts that grow near Rome, Italy.  It is very finely ground and makes delicious bread.  It also combines well with nuts.  Add this delightful flour to your dough and bread recipes and enjoy.

column9: chestnut flour is unique & tasty and hard to find
column10: chestnut flour is unique,hard to find and tasty,thanks for locating it for me.Will let you know how my recipe cooks out.

Another treat from Willy Wonka, this stretchy taffy candy is a really good. It comes in over 6 flavors listed seperately at Amazon. This deal has a box of 36 1.5 oz seperately wrapped bars. Each wrapper has jokes on the inside, to add the laffy.

I like the recycling aspect, but the foil is very thin and fragile - even tears when it's removed from the roll.  I won't be buying this again - will go back to the standard brands.  No sense in recycling a product when you have to use two or three times as much because it's so flimsy.

Really sounded like a good idea... Wrong.  Extreamly thin and requires double the foil versus name brand product.  Plus expensive.  If you buy into "If You Care" etc. I've got another for you, "A fool and his money are soon parted".

Only 11 1/2 in. wide which Amazon does not disclose plus it's paper thin and tears easily. You'll need to use 4x the amount of this product as compared to a decent brand. Note carefully: Amazon will not allow you to return this item if you're not satisfied though they did issue me a refund when I complained. I'm all for recycling but this company markets an inferior product as been green...just marketing nonsense.

.............They Would Have Made A Better Product. This should not be called aluminum foil, but rather aluminum "leaf". It's extremely thin and grossly over-priced. Too bad. I appreciate recycled products, but not when they are so poorly made and labeled with pseudo guilt-inducing names.

This is probably the worst kitchen product I have ever purchased.  It is so brittle you can't use it without tearing it, and it never holds the shape of a bowl or pan if you are trying to use it to cover something."If you care" about saving the world, don't buy any aluminum foil at all.But if you care about saving your leftovers in a bowl covered them with aluminum foil, avoid this useless product.

As other reviewers mentioned: it's thinner than regular foil.  It works perfectly well though; you just have to be a little bit careful.  I actually like that it's a little easier to tear when you are trying to get a piece in whatever size you want.I've no idea what it means to have recycled aluminum, maybe the environmental benefits are worthwhile -- or maybe they're negligible ...

I feel terribly guilty using disposable products and considered recycled foil somewhat redeeming. This product is extremely flimsy. We wrapped a few loose pizza slices in it, and they tore right through multiple layers. This foil is fine for covering a dish or lining a pan but beware its limitations.

column9: NO WAY; way too thin to be useful in the kitchen. Lunches, maybe.
column10: Simply put, this is too thin to use in the kitchen for wrapping pans or roasting. Try getting a cookie of this with a plastic spatula and all you get is torn aluminum and a mangled cookie.I get it: recycled is good, I love recycled things; I really do. But, I also like things to work right so that I don't have to double up the recycled foil just to get to to work. That defeats the purpose and is more wasteful.If you were to wrap a sandwich in this, or maybe use it for light duty, fine, it will work. But not for cooking purposes.  Maybe lining the bottom pan of the toaster or other places where things don;t have to come into contact with it, that might work.I like the idea, but it is just too thin and not a perfect replacement for heavy-duty foil.
Love that this is recycled, works just as well as any other store-bought product.  Certainly not heavy duty foil, but works well for general household uses
This is very good quality foil.  I can't find a difference between this recycled and 100% virgin.

I have bought If You Care a few times but recently tried another brand of recycled foil as I was in a rush in the grocery store.  I regret not waiting as the other store bought brand is so hard and heavy to use.  Definitely going back to my regular brand of If You Care now.  You have to try this.  Yes it's light but I recommend it.  I also use the parchment paper for baking etc and it's brilliant.  Please try this brand, I don't think you will be disappointed. The best thing is that it's recycled so you are helping the Earth.

My husband and I both find this dessert from EDIETS to be the absolute best. I have purchased this item several times and try to keep a box on hand at all times for a quick dessert. The 'sugar free sweetner' after taste is very very low.  It is our favorite of all the EDIET Mousse products. The texture is also the best of all the desserts we have tried from EDIETS.  It is smooth but has more body than some of the other items.  It is the closest to a 'real' mousse. If you like chocolate and coffee together give it a try.

For those who prefer sugarless desserts, finding something that's really good and not tons of trouble to prepare is sometimes difficult.  But this is an exception.  It's easy to prepare and delicious.  I was afraid it might be otherwise, so I was most pleasantly surprised.

I love this mousse and have been using it for years.  I am a person that can't leave well enough alone when it comes to directions or recipes. For instance I feel that if you make this according to their directions you get sort of a pudding consistency rather than mousse. I use about half of the milk, making it very thick, then I FOLD in some Cool Whip OR stiffly whipped whipping cream.  You get the sugar with the Cool Whip, but not much.  With the whipping cream you get the fat but no sugar and no carbs. I sweeten it lightly with some Splenda.  Now if you really want to add some luciousness, cut the milk by about a 1/4 C. and add 1/4 C. Coffee Liqueur when you are mixing it all up.  You can adjust to your own taste, but remember it is liquid, so subtract the milk for how much liqueur you add. Beat like crazy! Then FOLD in the cream. Once the mouse is done to your favored consistency, set aside. Take some Nabisco or any other chocolate wafers and into an 8X10 or 8X8 baking dish add one layer of the wafers and then scoop some of the mousse on top of that and smooth. Repeat until you end with at the top with mousse. Cover and refig for several hours (6-or how ever many you can stand, longeer the better) and then cut into pieces. Oh Man is this good! Any questions contact me at vegasdi1@cox.net

Husband loves flavor and texture but sometimes upsets his stomach.  Mocha cappuccino his favorite followed by the plain chocolate (not chocolate cheesecake, just plain).  NOT VEGAN though so beware if you are vegan.

Douwe Egberts Aroma Rood Whole Bean Coffee, 1.1 Pound PackageMy daughter and I first tasted this wonderful coffee while she was confined in the hospital. For five long weeks, she was only cheered by the prospect of getting a good cup of coffee from the visitors' lounge. When she finally was released, we both found ourselves longing for a cup of that wonderful coffee; so I went online to find it. It's going to be a staple in our homes from now on!
So I was trying to find that great Douwe Egberts restaurant coffee that I really like. This is NOT it. Tastes OK at best. I like the 8 o'clock coffee that I get from the Jewels a lot better.

we LOVE Douwe Egberts Coffee, so we were thrilled to find it available for home use!  However, the product we receivedcannot be compared to the DE coffee that is served commercially!  We were disappointed since the flavor was nothingclose to what we had experienced in restaurants.  Don't waste your money on the whole bean, it just isn't very good coffeeand certainly not the DE taste we were looking for!
This by far the best coffee I've had, good price in my opinion. Will continue to purchase from Amazon since not available where I live.
This is the coffee served at Fridays and when we found out about it, we researched it and found it available at Amazon. Fantastic!
It was fine.  I think it maybe was not as special for the price I paid.  Don't think I'd buy it again, but it was fine.
Had this coffee when we were out East on vacation and had to get some. We made it at home and it tasted old...Beans looked dry too. Will not but the product again.
I first sampled this at Mory's in New Haven.  Yes, that's the Mory's in the Wiffenpoof song. It was the best taste in coffee ever. I asked them what it was. Douwe Egberts. I have used it ever since.

column9: Douane makes good coffee, but not spectaualr
column10: We travel a lot, and really like this coffee when made in their machine.  We have tried all of the suggestions, such a Melitta brown filters, but it still lacks the taste that thier machine creates.  We have inquired with the offical coffee maker, useually a maid,on what package i.d. they use, and were told "it;s the machine, not the coffee".  We will still buy it and try to find their scret.

Really love this coffee.  Its just so smooth going down.  You need to make sure you have the amount of water to coffee correct (experiment), clean coffee filter, and filtered water.  It all makes a difference!!

The coffee: (Douwe Egberts Aroma Road Whole Bean Coffee,) was disappointing....taste was not better than  commercial coffees available in ordinary grocery stores. We were looking for strong coffee flavor and this coffee did not have it.

So glad to have found the Douwe Egberts Aroma Rood Coffee. First, I am a coffee addict, not just any coffee.  A goodaromatic, not bitter, delicious coffee. This one is so far the best I've found lately.  I spent over 40 yearsworking, managing and owning reataurants. The good old days had Continental Coffe, Weshlers, and one or two more, but, just like eveything else they were bought out and replaced with sub- standard products. The new kids on the block like Starbucks, and now even Dunkin Donuts, started out vey good but the quality has decreased as salesincrease.  The beans look old and dry upon opening the bags.  I must try the other varieties by Douwe .

I have been brewing my own coffee plus grinding the beans for almost a year and a half and I still have not discovered the ultimate coffee bean. I understand now that many aspects control the final results of brewing a cup of coffee. Temperature, water, quality of beans being at the top. This one is a little above average but nothing out of this world, sort of speak. I have been attempting to mix different varieties of beans and see if one of these days I discover the ultimate blend for the best cup of coffee. I do not pretend to be an expert but do enjoy a good cup of coffee, not too bitter not too watery, with the right amount of cream and sugar most of the times, but I do appreciate the taste of black coffee once in a very long while.  Putting creamer (in liquid or powder form), sugar seems to detract from the raw flavor of coffee. One gets used to loading the coffee with the extras and perhaps one day soon I will be able to enjoy a good quality cup of coffee plain black, no disguise of the taste. 3.5 Stars.

column9: Best stir fry sauce i've tried!
column10: mmm....so good!  great balance of sweet, salty, chinese flavor, sesame and garlic.  Knob Hill was selling it but I haven't seen it for a while :(...
Glad to find this, I had a bottle and we loved it, looked for more without finding any, now I will make sure to keep stocked with it. I have used it on chicken and beef, both came out great.

This sauce would be wonderful, but for our family it's way too salty.  I made a wonderful shrimp and vegetable dish and added the Iron Chef Sesame Garlic sauce to it and served it on top of rice.  I wound up throwing all my rice out to get rid of the sauce.  It was so salty I couldn't stand the taste.  My husband felt the same.  This seems to be a major problem with store bought sauces.  I'm not sure why they don't leave the salt out altogether or put just a small amount in the sauce.  Salt is inexpensive and so easy to add when desired.  However, it's impossible to remove it.  I tried to contact "Iron Chef" but there isn't any contact information on their website. If you like salty sauce, this may be for you.  Otherwise, either look for something else or make your own.

This produces some decent clouds once it gets going. the only issue i had with it was that the flavor wasn't that strong. you can definitely taste the lime in it but its just a small amount of flavor. my session lasted for about an hour i could of gone longer but i was tired and wanted t go to bed.

I tried using this and never told my family that its meatless. They all enjoyed the patty and even ate more than 2. This is indeed great for meat lovers but are restricted to eat meat because of health issues. No difference at all... and even more delicious and yummy!

column9: Brown lightly, serve on a bun
column10: I bread these with bread crumbs and just brown them lightly on both sides. If you over cook them they will be tough. Then serve them in a sandwich or on a hamburger bun with a slice of onion, tomato, lettuce, cheese and whatever condiments you would a hamburger. I like mine with mayonnaise and ketchup. It's a great alternative to meat.
Although the can's packaging might not look too appealing, the stuff in there actually tastes pretty good.  I'm surprised.  A great fat-free burger alternative with vegetable protein, give it a try.

column9: Quality? Maybe. Taste? Not so good
column10: I have tried some pu erh tea that I enjoyed for the unique taste, however this matcha is either bad quality or I would just not recommend this item. I have had red tea matcha and green tea matcha and this does not even come close in taste or the texture whisked in. I would reccomend not getting this type of matcha at all, that's not to say I don't like this tea, I love it, that's why I ordered the medium size one. If I had to rate this tea from one to ten, this would be in the three to four range.I was a little skeptical forking out so much money for this type of tea since I was well aware of the quality it could be and as well as 'fake' or lower grades being sold for good quality matcha. I downright would prefer the lose leaf tea over this.

There is nothing better than travelling and having that first breakfast on the road! Cook this up in your kitchen, close your eyes, take a bite and remember that vacation when the day started off with a delicious breakfast!  It did it for me and i bet it does it for you! Enjoy!
Love these fruits for a healthy snack, and more importantly, my 2 and 4 year old love them and eat them like they're candy.  Highly recommend!

The mango is edible once you get past the rubbery dry texture, but the apple and others are just awful! The apple was not only chewy in a bad way, and I like apple rings, but extremely tart- maybe it is because I am used to mrs mays freeze dried fruits but I will not order this set again... No idea what I will do with the rest of the packages...rubbery fruit that cannot be bitten is just the wrong texture for me maybe- very dry too!

column9: Quick, very filling with some additions, mild flavor, yummy
column10: I've bought this item lots of times at my local grocery store so was happy to see it here on amazon and at a better price! The package includes the noodles, sauce mix, and a tiny packet of sesame seeds. I usually add about 6-8 oz. very thinly-sliced chicken or beef (top sirloin works very well), a couple of cups of defrosted-in-the-microwave frozen veggies, and extra sesame seeds sprinkled on top since the included packet is VERY small. It's very quick and easy to make even with the additions, and pretty healthy too. Yes, it's high in sodium as one reviewer pointed out [this was from 2008 -- SEE NOTE BELOW], but then most prepared foods are. With the added chicken and veggies, the 3 listed servings become 4 or 5. Note that the sauce is quite mild - if you like spicier foods, you'll probably need to add some sort of hot sauce to it.  Like the Simply Asia roasted peanut mix, this is overall very easy to make and delicious too!Also, I don't know where the other [current] reviewer shops, but amazon's regular price is slightly cheaper than my local grocery store's, and the subscribe-and-save price is about 20% less.NOTE, the first paragraph above is from my review of this item from January 2008 ... I think amazon stopped carrying it for awhile as my old review now says "this item is currently unavailable," but here it is again (maybe the code changed for some reason, but it's definitely the same product).

Flavor is so-so (not entirely worth the calories). Without the massive introductory discount, I would not buy this product from Amazon again. Too expensive. I've found it significantly cheaper at my local grocery store.
I'm the only one in my family who LOVES SPAM.So it's wastefull to open a whole can just to make a quick sandwich or two for myself.These singles are perfect for a quick lunch on a busy day.

These crackers, which were shipped to me in November, had expired the prior September. When I made this discovery, I was not a happy camper/customer. I was accustomed to receiving only fresh grocery products from Amazon. Because of this exception, which I do not consider typical of Amazon, I have to rate my personal experience with these crackers at one single star.

column9: Great cat treat that is also good for them
column10: When a locale store started carrying Wellness products, this was one of them. I purchased a bag and my cats loved it. I went back to the store to buy more and guess what; they were sold out. This was almost a year ago!!! They still have not restocked this product because "their corporate computers do all the ordering for them" and not an actual human that knows what sells and what doesn't. Needless to say, this store is a chain pet supply store and well, they have since lost a lot of local business (from me alone) as I have found that I can purchase the same product for much less via Amazon and also get it in as little as a few days.
Wellness Pure Delights are very tasty, moist and healthy that most of our finicky cats seem to enjoy. Definitely will buy more in the future.

Although a little pricey, these are a great way to give your cat a healthy treat. My cat has a sensitive stomach and cant always eat the treats I have gotten for him without him throwing up. I stopped using grocery store treats and moved to Natural Balance but they were too much for his tummy, but these treats he absolutley loves and he never gets sick afterwards. Also, with the all natural ingredients I feel good about rewarding him.(p.s. since they are natural ingredients they are stinky like salmon.)

I usually give my kitten Catswell treats, because they are straight forward with ingredients, and use cage free chicken.  Well Petco did not have them in stock so this looked like a good alternative. He likes these just as much as the other ones.  I tried giving another cat these treats and he kind of smelled it and walked away, but ended up eating it once it was on the floor.

I have 4 cats, and none of them really like these treats. They will eat them eventually, but the certainly don't go wild for them. I do like that grain and chicken free, so they are good for cats with allergies.

column9: Not meant for my cat's whiskers
column10: I really wanted my 2 yr old cat to like these treats because I already feed her Wellness wet food, which is excellent by itself. Perhaps she's too used to the Whiskas Temptations that I normally give her, but she did not like the jerky bits at all. I did notice it was hard for her to pick up because they're pretty flat, and the texture is chewier than what she's used to. The 3rd time I gave her the treats, she vomited it out. Looks like it's back to the less healthy alternative.

column9: vet recommended and we agree, natural is the best....
column10: We recently adopted a shelter kitten and our vet recommended several natural food brands that she felt were superior to our regular supermarket cat food.  As we feel our new addition deserves the best we can give her we not only wanted to make sure her regular food was of high quality and good for her but as our vet said, don't forget to check that her treats are high quality/natural too.  As we were already purchasing the Wellness brand from her list, we tried these treats.On first glance I thought, wow, almost $5.00 for this little bag, that's pricey, but they are very small jerky type treats and they last a long time if you are only giving your pet a few at a time.  My cat loves these and we have found that her coat seems to be very shiny and silky-not sure if these treats contribute, but they could.  We love the fact that they don't have corn, wheat, soy or a bunch of other stuff she really doesn't need.  We also used these treats as a training incentive to teach her to sit for a treat....it worked!  People laugh, but now we call her and hold up the bag and she looks up at her treat and sits down.  If you don't give it to her right away she walks closer and sits again....smart kitty and she loves those treats.  This is the first flavor we tried, but have since tried others and she loves them all.If you would like to try something more natural for your kitty, I would give these a go.  We have been more than pleased and these are now the only treats we consider buying for her.
My cat absolutely loves these things. The only downside to them is that they will dry out after a while. Other than that, they're great healthy cat snacks.

Annabelle (my three year old Persian mix) absolutely adores these. She does not like any other treats. These are perfect, because they're chewy, so they feel and taste different from her food. She does tricks for them and always comes running when we bring them out. Definitely try them. They are healthy (grain free) and perfect for any kitty! To the comment about the bag, just buy a treat jar. Works much better, and it looks cuter on your shelf or counter :)

column9: LOL My cat attacks me for these!
column10: I have discovered the Wellness brand of cat food, and I (and my cat) adore it. I only wish it were easier to afford! Still, Amazon seems to either match PetSmart or have a better deal. (These treats, they only matched the price, but I like Amazon)When I open the bedside drawer that these are stored in, Ariel comes running! She would tear the bag open and eat them all if I were to accidentally leave it out! She LOVES these treats.I am glad that I can spoil my cat with healthy treats/food like the Wellness brand. I highly recommend these treats, although as long as they remain 4.99 you might want to first purchase from a local pet store to make sure your cat likes them.

I bought these for my cat and if I give them to him, he'll eat them, but it's not the type of treat he'll do tricks for or run over to eat. It's a healthier alternative to other treats, but I wouldn't buy them again because my main point of buying treats is to train my cat to do tricks or reward him for good behavior. These treats simply don't entice him enough to really be a treat.

column9: This is the one for Heidi
column10: The ingredients are good and my cat loves it. She's never walked away from it, so I was very surprised when my son's cats did. I decided to rate it from my cat's point of view.

column9: Sometimes my cat eats them...sometimes he doesnt
column10: This product is really a hit or miss. My cat does not seem to go crazy over these treats....Sometimes he does not eat these right away.

column9: Great soft little treats for your finicky feline
column10: I have 2 cats.  One will eat anything.  The other one is soooo picky.  She's had to have some of her teeth removed due to a mouth virus, so I needed to find some good soft treats.  She likes these more than anything I've tried.  They are really thing little tiny strips.  I like Wellness, all natural products.  Both cats like their brand cat food as well.

On the first offer my ferret didn't want the treat. But a couple of days later I noticed him trying to steal the whole bag, so I offered a piece again. This time, and ever since, he's loved it. Go figure!I like this treat for ferrets because the pieces are appropriately sized (ie- small) for a ferret, and the ingredients and stats are superior to most ferret treats! His digestion has been less affected by these than by many ferret treats also :)
Great natural treat for my cat, whose health I want to keep strong for many years. And he loves them!!!

column9: 14 week old Scottish Fold kitten loves these
column10: I got these for my kitten and he loves them.The comment made about the bag being hard to open isn't really that big of a deal, I haven't had any problems closing or opening properly. Though, I would much prefer a container type packaging since those are easier to get into especially if you're training a cat you don't want to hold a bunch of cat treats in your hand because the bag keeps closing on you. But the bag closes/opens like any other zip lock.I feed my kitten chicken flavored cat food, so I try and offset the treats with a different meat and Wellness salmon treats work great and it's healthy without all those fillers.This review is for the treat NOT the bag, so I highly recommended this. 5 stars.
My cat seems to really like these.  As one reviewer said, they will dry out if the bag isn't sealed.  I haven't had any problems with sealing the bag that I purchased.

column9: my kitties didn't care for them
column10: I liked that these treats didn't have anything gross in them (i.e., corn, wheat, soy, by-products).  My cats don't really care for salmon, but i thought since it was mixed with turkey, which they love, they might like them. Well they didn't, they took one sniff and wanted nothing to do with them.  Though my inside cats didn't want them, the stray cats outside loved them.

column9: The food is great, but the bag sucks
column10: My cats loved the treats but everytime I try to use the bags zipper to close it up I gotta fiddle with it for a while just to close the bag. Eventually The bag didn't close properly and all the treats dried out causing the cats to lose interest. I plan to buy another but this time I will dump it in my own container.

column9: Oh so good Gimmee Jimmee's cookies
column10: I first received Gimmee Jimmee's cookies from the salesman after I bought a new car from Freehold Ford in Howell, NJ as a thank you. They are very delicious cookies. Packed very well and always received fresh. The chocalate chip and oatmeal are to die for. I have gone on to send their cookies to others to commerate birthdays, get well etc. I think you will be pleased with your purchase if you give them a try.Blanche
Since I had this coffee last year in a coffee house in Wisconsin, it has been my favorite coffee by far.  Glad to see that it is being offered on Amazaon - makes it easy to obtain.
Got used to San Mig coffee in the Philippines and want to drink it everey day. Finding it available here in the USA is so MAG!

column9: Lucini Extra Virgin Olive Oil: Great olive oil for the money.
column10: I found this in my local supermarket (publix - Ilive in FL) for $11.99 if you can believe it.  At that price, has to be the best deal on an estate grown olive oil out there.  Clean olive taste, low acidity (very mild sensation in back of throat, no burning!)They make a similarly priced 10 yr old balsamic too.  Gotta try it!Phil

They're were really cute the colors are not as vibrant as they look in the picture bt thats not a big problem, I plan to put them on the cake, think it will be a great addition especially because they're edible. Oh and they were shipped super fast, im very satisfied with my purchase

Bought these for part of a pink and blue themed candy buffet for a bridal shower... Unfortunately, I put them out way too early, because they were already half gone by the time the guests arrived... My helpers just couldn't stop eating them!  Needless to say they were the first thing we ran out of.  Next time I would definately order a pound or two more!
please dont ever stop carrying this soup. i am a soup nut, and especially  this variety. it came yesterday in good shape. thanks
I love this drink!  It has blueberry, lime and yes, a hint of mint to it.  Personally, I found the mint to be both unexpected and refreshing.  Fewer calories and less sugar than soda.  I'm a big fan!

I came across these drinks by accident and was intrigued by the unique flavors. Blueberry lime was the most pleasing by far. I was actually disappointed because many of the other reviewers seem to taste mint - that I cannot taste. It smells of blueberries and the taste is a tart berry with a finish of lime (rind?). I did find the flavors were unpleasant if I let the drinks get warm/room temperature, but were fine when cold.If you're used to syrupy sodas attuned more to the American palate - I'd probably skip these. But if you can appreciate bitter notes with hints of sweetness, this drink may be a new treat of varying flavor.

i thought this would be a great tasting drink. i got it for my kids because my kids love blueberries. it also had less sugar and calories, but was  i wrong my kids spitted the drink out right away. the mint is real strange flavor and very nasty

Worst soda EVER! It tastes nothing like blueberries or lime-it tastes like MINT! I had several people try it, including a major soft drink fiend who spit it out. Everyone agreed: Mint Mint Mint! I guess if you were interested in spearmint soda you might want to give it a try. If you want fruit juice or any fruit flavor, stay away from this garbage. You've been warned!
It tastes nothing like you would expect. It is very carbonated, you can see the purple from the blueberries, but very underwhelming and not exactly pleasing to the palate.

The taste of the sugar on these sticks was good but compared to other sugar sticks I've bought the amount of sugar on these was a lot smaller. We use them for cappucino and we found that we would like there to be more sugar on the sticks to sweeten even a small cup of cappucino.

I have been using Annie's Organic Green Garlic Dressing for many years.  It tastes soooo good, and it's vinegar-free.  Since I have tons of food allergies (vinegar being one of them) it's the only dressing I've seen on the market that I can use.  I use it not only on salads, but just about everything i eat.  It was also very pleasing to find it on Amazon for half the price I've been paying for it.
Great Tea at a Great Value. You can't go wrong with a purchase of this flavor. Delightful tea at a value price.

It's a bit pricey with shipping, but I bought this because this brand has unusual colors.  I needed purple for a King Cake, and here in Illinois you just can't find purple sugar.  I actually like this brand quite a bit, and would recommend it.The colors are nice and bright compared to some cheaper brands I've seen.  The first thing I noticed, however, is that the sugar crystals are LARGE compared to the near-shavings I get from the colored sugars I got at the local grocery store.  I guess I'll have to go buy the Green and Gold ones too, so they match next time.
These were awesome on the cookies we made for my Son's Eagle Scout Court of Honor.  Would be great for 4th of July or honoring military.

*****Numi Tea's Ruby Chai Spiced Rooibos Herbal Teasan is a premium Numi tea, both certified organic and kosher. The ingredients are fair trade certified organic rooibos, organic cloves, organic allspice, organic ginger, organic cardamom, organic nutmeg, and organic cinnamon. There is nothing artificial in this or in any Numi tea.On the box, the manufacturer writes: "Earthy, vanilla organic Rooibos and a sultry blend of spices come together from around the world in Numi's caffeine-free chai. Warmed by the South African sun, Rooibos is lauded for its high anti-oxidant properties. It is full-bodied like black tea, yet soothing any time of day. We've sourced the highest quality cloves, nutmeg, and cinnamon, mingling them with sweet Indian allspice and vivacious Chinese ginger. A kiss of cardamom unites this fabulous caffeine-free alternative to Numi's Golden Chai. Share in the savory warmth of Ruby Chai."If you are used to black tea or coffee and are wanting to get accustomed to herbal caffeine-free teas, this is a great way to start, since the flavors are stronger and thus less subtle than most herbal teas. Although this is a "chai", note that it contains no sweeteners...I prefer this, but commercial chais often have sugar added, so be prepared for a wonderful no-calorie indulgence that is beautifully flavored but not "sweet" in the same way that sugar is.If you like Numi teas, get it---you won't be sorry. If you are new to Numi but love chai, this will probably be the best you've ever had.Highly recommended.*****

I'm doing a detox and can't have coffee for 28 days which is pure torture.  I can only have herbal tea, and I hate tea.  I searched the internet and saw favorable reviews for this brand and it is fabulous.  If you only love coffee and you're looking for a tea, this is the way to go.
not overly spicy.  i wish they made another version of this with double the spice.  but this is very good and the box is pretty.

This is a wonder spiced tea. Very soothing and a great flavor. It is often hard to find so I was very happy to discover it onAmazon. I highly recommend it, and it is caffeine free so you can enjoy it on cold winter nights without loosing sleep.Enjoy!
This is some great Chai tea, people.And it's caffeine free. Meaning I can drink it at night too.I'm in love. =)

good value by ordering in bulk.  teas arrived just fine and taste great, i would recommend purchasing from here.  got the individual boxes, other people warned about the flavors mixing in the variety packs.
This is great tea.  Full flavor but not too much.  Only Whole Foods seems to have it, so I bought it on line.  Love it.
I am often disappointed with Chai teas.  This has a wonderful full bodied taste.  Love that it is caffine free.

Milka is one of the leading producers of chocolates in the world. Founded in Switzerland in 1901, the brand quickly spread throughout Western Europe. In 1990, the company was acquired by Kraft, and their wonderful chocolate is now available throughout the world!I love Milka's Alpine Milk chocolate. It is absolutely delicious - not as sweet as many American chocolates, and with a rich and creamy texture. Want to try a great chocolate? Get Milka's Alpine Milk chocolate!(Review of World's Best Milka Chocolate - Alpine Milk)

I purchased these as a Valentine's gift for my wife. I knew she would love them, because they're practically all we ate when we backpacked through Europe years ago. These chocolates are impossible for us to find locally, so she's been getting Hershey, Dove, Godiva, Ghiradelli... for the past few years. Then I checked here. Totally worth it. I'd forgotten how good these chocolates are. Those others pale in comparison to the flavor and super-smooth texture of Milka. She'll be expecting these from now on. I wasn't sure if I ordered in time for Valentine's, but they actually arrived 2 days early. Excellent all around.

I was born in Serbia, so I grew up eating Milka chocolates. I guess I have become spoiled by their creamy consistency that I would rate them as one of the best chocolates (above godiva, even.) If anyone has the store World Market close to them, they carry Milka bars. Milk chocolate with WHOLE hazelnuts are my favorite of the MIlka variety!! I highly recommened browsing online and finding a retailer that sells them. YUM!!

I went to Salzburg, Austria a few years ago and discovered Milka chocolates. The I Love Milka boxes are the BEST chocolates ever. No chocolate in the Americas could compare. I'm just now finding these online and plan to order some for friends and family.

column9: Milk Chocoholics REJOICE!  One of the BEST tasting EVER!
column10: I never thought I would actually be reviewing milk chocolate here on 'Amazon', but in this case, I just had to since i'm sitting here salivating like 'Pavlovs dog'.  For years, I have been ranting and raving about how phenomenally great and smooth 'Lacta' milk chocolate (from 'Kraft Foods' division in Greece) tastes, but I could not find it here in the states.  As a milk chocoholic, I would actually have my cousins in Greece send me a box of 24 bars about once a year, until now.  Just today, I randomly discovered this 'Milka' brand on sale at my local 'Giant Eagle' supermarket, and was 'blown away' by the taste!  My immediate reaction was that it tastes just like 'Lacta'... EUREKA!  Upon reading the label, I noticed that it is made by a division of 'Kraft Foods' in Germany.  My guess is that this is the same as a 'Lacta' bar, but it was renamed and repackaged for the German and export market.  In any case, if you love superior tasting milk chocolate, you owe it to yourself to get your hands on 'Milka Alpenmilch'.  I would rank this as the world's BEST TASTING and unique milk chocolate, or in the top 2 or 3 ever.  It's THAT GOOD!

I ordered this at the beginning of August.  I wondered how they would deliver it without it melting, and when it arrived melted with an ice pack tied to the chocolate bars, I wasn't really surprised!  I refrigerated the package and the chocolate tasted fine cold, but it definitely became a weird, chalk like mess when it thawed.  I decided to heat it and use it to dip strawberries.  SO GOOD.  Will order again, in the dead of winter.

I consider myself a chocolate connoisseur, with dark chocolates being my ultimate pleasure. My boyfriend, however, is a very picky chocolate eater. For Christmas I had to get him his favorite chocolate, unfortunately they don't sell it locally. Honestly, after trying Milka, I have a new favorite milk chocolate. Smooth, creamy, and melt-in-your-mouth irresistible, Milka is definitely worth buying online, even worth coercing some of the local vendors into keeping it in stock regularly!
Even REDUCED FOR QUICK SALE -- this Chocolate is DA BOMB!!! Some of the most delicious ever!

Milka (Alpine Milk) Chocolate is yummy (in moderation).  My frustration is that it used to be carried by our local Wal-Mart which cut down on the cost.  I shared my chocolate with friends and family for the holidays.  If you can't afford this treat all the time I think Dove chocolates are a reasonable substitute.  Since shipping is so expensive I probably would not purchase this treat on a regular basis.

column9: One of the best flavored teas for daily drinking
column10: I like variety of teas, but my preferences shifted towards green and white teas recently. I like high-end green teas, but do not have time and proper equipment to prepare them at the office. I need quick gratification at the office, i.e. the tea I can prepare in communal kitchen, yet enjoy at my desk.This tea has rich fruity flavor, but it's good: it lets me forget that I'm at the office and think for a while that I'm on some tropical island. The fruits add natural sweetness to the taste of the tea, so no need to add sugar or artificial sweetener.Tea-bags are sealed in air-tight wrapper, so you don't have to worry that your 6-pack purchased at Amazon will lose flavor before you can drink that last one.

Once again, Good Earth has hit the nail on the head with their Mango, Peach, Pineapple Green Tea.  The flavor is delicate but strong enough to stand out.  This makes a fabulous sun tea.  I will definately buy this again.

I ordered this tea b/c I had had it before.  It had been awhile but I just remember how GREAT it was.  When I prepared a cup from the new order, it just did not taste the same.  It's good but not as good as I remember.  I would still recommend the tea.
I love this tea and local stores in and around my area stopped carrying it. Thank goodness for amazon.  It is much cheaper through amazon as well.

column9: OK, not as good as I'd hoped for
column10: This tea is OK, but the fruity flavors were very strong. It was more like fruit tea than green tea. I prefer my tea hot, but (as the other reviewer suggested) this may make a better iced tea. If you like strong fruity flavors in your tea, you will probably enjoy this.
This is one of the best tea's that I have ever had.  I recommend it to any tea drinker.

My husband likes teas that are flavorful, and he really likes this one.  Mango, peach and pineapple, add a nice flavor to the green tea.  Each teabag is sealed in a tight pouch.  This allows more of the antioxidants to be preserved.
I purchase this last summer from Whole Foods Market. It was just nasty to me, nothing like Yogi tea.

column9: I Can't Believe I Almost Passed On This One!
column10: This wasn't going to be one of the many flavored Matcha that I was going to order from Red Leaf Tea.  I mean, I love Matcha, sure, but I do not drink a lot of alcohol, and while I have enjoyed many of the various alcohol-infused flavored teas that I've tried, it just isn't a flavor that I usually go for.  So, I guess, you can consider this a "stepping outside of my comfort zone" moment.And I'm so glad that I did!This is amazingly awesome!  It is really good.  The overall flavor is remarkably smooth - and while most Matcha tends to be smooth and creamy - this tastes even smoother than most.  The flavor is more "fruity" than what I'd call "alcohol-like" but it is a very smooth fruity tone, with a very smooth brandy finish.  It is sweet and delicious.  The matcha flavor here is more reserved, with the vegetative tones that usually coat the palate being a bit more in the background rather than front notes.A very enjoyable Matcha - if you're on the fence about this one, I highly recommend taking the plunge and getting it.  It's really very surprisingly good.  I like it a lot.

column9: Like Juicy Fruit Gum! Yum yum!
column10: Okay so for those of you hesitating thinking this is going to taste too much like something a staunch old man sitting in a ritzy Victorian library would drink, its not. Its also not like the stuff the teens would swill behind the bleachers in high school during winter football games. Wait, maybe that was just at my school. Anyway this stuff is GOOOOOD!Someone else said in their review it reminded them of Juicy Fruit gum and they totally hit the nail on the head with that assessment! Had this not been named "Brandy" I would have thought it was a fruit blend - not a punch like Hawaiian Punch, not even a tropical mixture, but just a really yummy sweet fruit blend of some kind. I really wish I could pick out specific fruit flavor elements to relate to you but I can't. Fruit Medley is all I can think of but there is a whipped cream like aspect to it, something that really makes you feel like you bit into some ripe juicy fruit (no pun intended) and it really does taste like that gum! This is one your kids would LOVE! Seriously if you want to get your kids or anyone in the family into matcha I would suggest this or the butterscotch matcha! Just make a latte with some milk, and some vanilla or sweet cream non dairy creamer! Add ice, stir LOVE!Now as for the Brandy aspect here. Its really not all that present to me. Yes I do get a SLIGHT and I mean SLIGHT alcohol effect - sort of a little twang or ting, but not really so much warming as brandy is known for.When I was younger, in my teens, I rode both western and equestrian, and trained horses. That was another life time ago. We would always have some brandy on us to keep warm in the winter wether out on the ranch repairing fences or preparing for a fox hunt (we did not really hunt the foxes I would have no part in that so don't worry) it was more of a Mock Hunt. LOL This matcha does bring back some fond memories of that but its not the same, and I doubt that you really could get the same result from anything but brandy itself but for all intents and purposes this is a very good flavor, a really nice experience, and one I will absolutely be ordering again! I know I say that about a lot of the matcha I have tried, and I have tried a lot of them but this along with about 5 others are THE matcha I can't be without! The "alcohol" effect is just enough for those who have had brandy to recognize but not so much that those who do not like brandy, have never had it, or should not have it, won't even notice. Its like being able to recognize any flavor, you kind of have to have experienced it before to know what it is. Without knowing what it is all you will notice is this AMAZING fruit festival in your mouth!

The smell of Brandy Matcha is really fruity and sweet - very much what Juicy Fruit gum smells like!  The taste is just as good! And don't bother adding any sweetener - this is sweet enough on its own!  The best part: There's no sugar in this matcha to begin with!I can't wait to mix this with an apple or dark berry matcha!

And the sailor said 'Brandy, you're a fine girl, what a good wife you would be..." Okay, so, that song is the only real reference to brandy I have, and that's not even the right brandy. Well, that song and the singer from the 90s...anyway. In college, one of my roommates liked to mix (cheap, horrible) brandy with her cola when she drank, and so I've had a few of those, but that's really it. I'm a whisky girl, through and through. That's what happens when you go to high school in Tennessee and college in Kentucky. But it looked interesting and I liked the brandy I've had, so I thought "why not?" If nothing else, it will be good for mixing with the apple matcha. Or the cola matcha, for when I'm having a bad day at work and need a drink but can't have one just yet. At least I can pretend. But I don't really have a flavor profile in mind when I try this matcha, so it will be an interesting experience. For instance, when I try a pineapple tea, I have in mind what I think a pineapple should taste like and I can match the tea up to that flavor profile and see how it compares. With this, I'm just shooting in the dark, though I'm sure I'll be comparing it to whisky before this review is done.Oh wow, this is good. This is goooood. Yes, the unnecessary "o"s were necessary. It's fruity and smooth and...yum. I don't quite know how to describe it. It's not what I was expecting out of brandy, but I don't really have any experience with brandy, so what do I know? I can almost taste a touch of alcohol, but that might just be my imagination. It does seem warming, which is odd since I'm drinking it cold. I love cold matcha and how easy it is to mix. Add water to matcha powder, whisk/froth, and go! Done! Yum. Saves me a ton of time in the mornings when I'm barely awake and trying to get ready for work.Anyway, yes. If this is what brandy tastes like, I need to try some as soon as possible. I think my father in law has some...it might be time to hang out with the in laws. It tastes kind of like bubble gum but...juicy fruit gum, not double bubble. Definitely one I plan to keep around.

I agree this bread could be a little better.  It is dry and it has to be toasted.  I hope that it is currently unavailable because they are making it better, but I hope not by adding something I can't eat.  Meanwhile I am breadless.  This is the only bread I've been able to find that has no milk, no gluten and no rice.

This flax seed bread is not the best product for Glutino. While it has a very good taste, especially toasted, it is dryer than their sandwich bread. Heating did not soften it but toasting did. The whole flax seeds are more difficult to digest than flax meal. I'd like to see Glutino improve on this recipe as I think the idea behind it is a good one. Great way to get my omega-3.
Nothing wrong with it, just not my type of rice. It also didn't cook as well in my rice cooker compared to the normal jasmine rice that I buy

column9: Best Gluten Free Cake Mix Yet!!
column10: This is the first product from this brand I've tried.  To be honest, I usually make my own gluten free cakes, being that gf mixes can be iffy.  I've tried both from "Betty Crocker" (yellow and devil's food).  I attempted to make the chocolate one from "Bob's Red Mill" but couldn't get past the nasty smell (from the pea flour?), so I didn't even bother to cook it!  Before I bought this mix, I checked out the website first.  Here's what they list:"ORGANIC DEHYDRATED SUGAR CANE JUICE, ORGANIC RICE FLOUR, POTATO FLOUR, ORGANIC COCOA POWDER, ORGANIC CASSAVA STARCH, ORGANIC SORGHUM FLOUR, TEFF FLOUR, ARROWROOT STARCH, SEA SALT, BAKING SODA, XANTHAN GUM, VANILLA POWDER, BAKING POWDER, GUAR GUM.  Ingredients are 75% Organic by weight"  (There's a nutritional label as well, but I can't copy/paste.)  The 2 recipes included on the back of the bag are for using the whole bag for many cookies, and multiple cakes.  However, if you go to the website, you will find recipes for normal sized portions (I believe all call for 2 1/2 cups mix-- whether it be cake, cookies, brownie, etc.)  I followed the cake recipe cited, and put it in a bunt pan.  For a richer option, I added sour cream (the recipe online says you can add 6 oz. of dairy or soy cream cheese), and decreased the water amount to about 3/4 cup (instead of the called 1 cup).  The consistency wasn't as heavy as I expected, but still satisfying.  There is no grit to it either (some mixes add corn meal)!!  I also like the fact that it has more healthy flours like Teff, and Sorghum!Those that have an allergy to corn or soy ingredients are sure to appreciate this!  Plus there are "vegan" options to the online recipes!In conclusion, if you love chocolate, or are just looking for a tasty gluten-free cake mix-- look no further than "Mina's Purely Divine Chocolate Baking Mix"!!  (FYI, there are 2 other mixes; an "all purpose", and "bread mix".)

My only tweak to the super-simple cake recipe on the website was the addition of 1) 1/4 cup high-quality dark chocolate, for a deeper chocolate flavor, and 2) 1/2 cup nonfat Greek yogurt.  The cake turned out beautifully -- moist and flavorful.  Rice flour in the mix gives the texture a slightly delicate quality, but not so delicate as to cause crumbling. In my experience, gluten-free baking mixes often have a cornmealy, metallic, or milky (whey protein) taste -- none of which I detected here. Highly recommended if you've already tried the major brands (like Bob's Red Mill or Pamela's).

column9: A lovely array of spices and a nice, traditional flavour.
column10: This is a really lovely panforte with a hint of cardamom that, while uncommon, is a really nice flavour.  Panforte has no one single recipe. Each shop in Siena makes its own, and their recipes are closely guarded secrets. There's no way to say "this Sienese panforte isn't authentic," since there are so many varieties. This is the traditional Margherita panforte, which is the most common to be found. Think of it as the 'regular' panforte with other options being nero (dark) or panforte biano (white), etc, etc. Again, each local shop in Siena may make three to six different variations of panforte, and their recipes will be different from the shop next door. Similar, but slightly different uses of spices or fruits.I ordered this panforte because, living in Siena, where panforte originates, I really became addicted to the stuff, and have been trying ever since leaving to find a good solution to my cravings. Sienese panforte is a very local tradition that doesn't extend too much outside of Tuscany in any great variety, and the variants we get all seem to lack in one very important aspect: thickness. This is no exception, and for that, I've removed a star.  Most of the panforte you find in Siena is a couple of inches thick and cut as slices from a giant 'pie.'  These are far thinner and smaller, but no less delicious.

column9: I believe everyone should try this, especially children.
column10: This cereal is great on many different levels.  The most obvious is, I suppose, as a healthy food for, this cereal is packed with simple, delicious ingredients that haven't been loaded up with a plethora of chemicals and additives.  The top three ingredients are, in order: flakes of rolled whole oats, whole wheat and raisins.  The remaining ingredients for the most part add sweetness: brown sugar, skim milk powder and malt extract; but also barley, hazel nuts and almonds.  I list these ingredients to make it clear that although this cereal has sweetness on the level of a confection, it has come from a bunch of lightly processed whole grains, fruits and nuts.The relative sweetness of this cereal brings us to another level on which this cereal is great; the 'I can't outgrow my sweet tooth but I need to eat healthily' level.  Yup, that's correct, I too used to love Cap'n & Peanutbutter Crunch, Lucky Charms, and all manner of other sweet cereals and frankly, even the ones I could tolerate such as Kellog's Corn Flakes and Chex have loads of additional sugar, if I'm not mistaken.The problem with them, apart from the fact that I really don't enjoy eating the most cloyingly sweet cereals any longer is that they don't seem to bring much to the table; they are kind of like empty calories and as we age it is increasingly difficult to find ways to effectively burn them off.The beauty of this cereal is that even though it is sweet, the whole grains provide Lots of fiber.  Yup, that's right, this stuff moves right through one's bowels helping to ensure well, plenty of bowel movement.  As most of us who are lucky enough to ripen into old age are likely to develop some form of cancer it is foolish not to pay heed to the advice to consume a high fiber diet.On the domestic level, for those of us who would like to instill healthy eating habits into our children this cereal is a great way to expose them to something that may actually be better for them than the highly processed, sickly sweet cereals they are likely to crave.I was lucky to get such exposure at an early age when an older sister returned from Switzerland with a box of the stuff.  I thought it was a bit bizarre at the time but happily consumed it and the experience took so that as I grew older and began to search for a breakfast cereal alternative to the treacly sweet stuff this was an easy choice to make.  I believe that my childhood exposure to this cereal is what made this an easy choice. Although my go to cereal since adulthood has been shredded wheat sans sugar, when I get that craving for a sweet cereal, this stuff is the ticket.Buying this cereal through amazon in the large pack makes it surprisingly inexpensive and I think that if you get it you will be shocked to find how short a time it takes to go through it all.As a side note, this is an excellent take along on road trips where you know you won't be able to eat a lot of fiber easily.  I'm thinking that on a business trip little distracts one more from the business at hand than a bout of constipation from having one's normal routines upended.

When the Cetara anchovies we usually buy became temporarily available, we decided to try a couple of other brands. At the time I'm writing, it's less than twelve bucks for a grand total of some 700g of anchovies, divided into six resealable glass jars, and the wee beasties are eligible for Amazon Prime. You can pay twice that much for an 800g tin and still owe for shipping.The other main advantage of this brand is that it does come in those jars. Each one is small enough to use up within days or weeks (if you eat as many anchovies as we do; we use them on pizza, on pasta with pesto, in sauces, and so forth). Anchovies will keep for a long time in salt, but once their container has been opened I'm not comfortable trusting them beyond six months or so even though they'd probably be safe well beyond a year.Just be aware that these are _real_ anchovies -- you need to rinse them, cut off their heads and tails, and finish the filleting job before you eat them. Optionally, you can soak them for a while in cold water (or, so I'm told, milk, but ewww) if you want to reduce their saltiness. (I have no such desire, so I don't bother -- but do at least make sure you rinse them thoroughly or they'll taste a bit too "oceany," if you know what I mean.) Yes, they have bones and everything, just like actual fish, and the larger bones in these are a sign that they're good and meaty.They're tasty enough right out of the jar, so be sure to take out a couple more than you need for whatever you're making and nibble them as you work.

The Busy Bones were a joke, and I'd been warned away from deer antlers because they splinter. So, I did a little more research and found out about cow hooves.Pros: These things last, and last, and last, even with a very enthusiastic chewer like my dog. One hoof lasts him at least 3 or 4 days.Cons: SWEET BABY JESUS, DO THESE THINGS STINK! When I first got them for my dog, I thought they were just giving him a really bad case of gas. But it was such a persistent and distinct stink (see what I did there?) that one day I wondered if maybe it wasn't the hooves themselves. I took one away from him that he'd been chewing on for a day or so and took a whiff. WHEW!!! I rue the day I did that. It smelled absolutely horrible. I guess I really shouldn't have been surprised at the scent when you consider that a cow hoof is nothing more than a giant toenail. In fact, that's actually the closest thing I can compare the smell to--a giant, stinking, toenail that's been inside of a funky, humid, leather sneaker for a very long time; take that scent and multiply it times 100. Ladies, maybe you've never experienced that scent, but I'd wager most of us guys have at some point or another, particularly the big toenail during summer months.Another huge con for me is that these aren't made in America, but Chile. From all the research I've done on my own, animal treats/food made in countries other than America should be avoided at all costs because of the chemicals they use in processing, particularly dog treats like rawhide and such.In conclusion, these things are very long lasting, but because of the God-awful stench and the fact that they're not processed in America, I haven't given one to my dog in nearly two months. The Twix of dog chews! Time consuming with no unnecessary additives. We have a 8 month white Amer. Bulldog and the smoked hooves from Petsmart would discolor her fur around her paws and mouth.  Looking to see if this company has larger sizes but if you find a better brand let me know

Dogs love them.  and these have been nearly completely ODOR free.  unusual for these products without the pak saying so.  was very pleased with this brand.  no basting and no smell.  dog loves to sneak into my bed, and still NO smell while chewing.  Will definately purchase again and again.

I had started buying these 1 at a time from the local pet store, until I was buying 3 a week.  It definitely made more sense for me to purchase online in larger quantities.  I've always given my dog (1 y/o female pit) things to chew on, and this is the best to meet her need to chew. This is great for their teeth and it's really no calories.  The only downside is a funky smell.  The hooves do have an odor to them once they get moist.  I've tried all kinds of brands and the ones that smell the worst have a filling which is some type of mystery.  Also, do watch for small peices as they break off. I give it 5 stars inspite of the odor because I really encourage people who have chew driven dogs to consider this product. It will occupy their time and save your shoes!
My dog adores these. He likes to throw them up in the air & chase them when we throw them for him.
These are alot cheaper than in a retail store, stinky but the dogs love them and it takes them along time to finish them off, I means weeks.

My dog crunched one of these into bean sized pieces in about 5 minutes, and swallowed all the pieces.  That night he threw it all up.I will not get these again! The rest of them are going into the trash.

Cow hooves are great for getting a dog's teeth clean, but after they have been chewed the hooves as well as the dog's breath just reeks.  There is no other odor like nasty cow hoof.  Think on this before buying.

I have been trying to find cow hooves for my dogs that have thicker walls, perhaps these were from calves rather than adult cattle.  They splinter and chip very easily and do not last long.  Plus, they are somewhat hazardous for the animal if they crack off pieces and swallow them.
My 20 month old Springer Spaniel just loves these.  They are supposed to be good for the dog too.  The smell isn't all that unpleasant although it is distinct.And this is a good price.
love these little hershey bars was fresh and on sale what are the odd will order again when they go back on sale

My dogs love all the Dingo products so when I saw what looked to be a surplus "pdq tray" of six bags per tray under the product features I thought what a great deal! Unfortunately, it was only one bag :( It's too much trouble to send it back for a few bucks...but now I know better. I think the product feature description is very misleading. Guess I should have been able to figure it out if i had looked at the the shipping weight.
Description says 6 bags per PDQ tray. In fact, it is one bag per PDQ tray. Different product delivered than advertised. Not misleading, but outright deceitful.
Description says PDQ tray of 6... It is not. Only one package and priced three times a much as in the store. I will take the time today to send it back and reclaim my $8.

These candies are really nice when you are about to go for a drive and are worried about falling asleep or for when you need that boost to get you through the afternoon at the office.The candies pack a strong caffeine punch yet taste quite good with a strong menthol flavor.  Not as good as the Black Black tablets you used to be able to find, but it definitely hits the spot.Highly recommended if you want an instant way to wake up that packs more of a punch than an energy drink.

I think these reviews have been misleadingly low. Look at the reviews under this same product, but for the pack of twelve, to see more helpful reviews.  Why even write a review saying you are too lazy to use the product as directed? How helpful is that to those who want to know if the product works when used as directed?
