And then a review about not receiving the product from a retailer that is different than the retailer that is selling this product? All that does is drag down the rating and cause people to overlook a good product.I have had, and have been continuously using, a bottle of this product for about two years now. We have a small family so one 16 ounce bottle has lasted us this long. We can't believe how much dirt it cleans off of our fruit.  Like our grapes, for example.  We take a large bowl, fill it with water and a few drops of the product, then swirl it around with our hand to get a few bubbles. Then we put the grapes in a colander and place that into the sudsy water. After about ten minutes, we pour out the water (so dirty!) and then spray the grapes down (while still in the colander) with clean water to rinse them, until the water runs clear.  The grapes get squeaky clean, even in between each grape, where usually you can't get without having them fall off the vine.You can do the same with apples or other types of fruit - you don't have to wash each one by hand, as was said.  You can if you are only eating one, of course.One alternate purpose I found for this product was when I was cleaning my stovetop.  A guest had used grease to fry something that had splattered up onto my knobs, and when I pulled them off later to do a more thorough cleaning, the grease had hardened into a sticky orange mess that was stuck like tar underneath. No product I had would cut that gunk. So on a whim I tried this Biokleen product because it listed orange and lemon oils in it. Sure enough, after sitting on the gunk for several minutes, it took it right off.  My stove was like new!I highly recommend Biokleen if you are looking for a good, safe and inexpensive produce wash that also has other uses.  Oh and it smells nice, too.

How do you know if something like this really works, not sure but it seems to work based on look and feel and leaves no taste behind so I will assume it does work.I have used 2 other brands and decided to give this a try. This is the 2nd biokleen product I have used that says 'concentrated' yet direct you to use it undiluted. The directions tell you to put it on fruit like apples directly (undiluted) and for soft things like brocoli I guess you could call this a dilution but they want you to put 1 Tbsp  in 2 cups of water and soak the veggies. 2 cups of water does not allow you to soak all that much and based on these instructions I can do this 32times with this bottle. I needed 1 1/2 Tbs to soak 3 pints of blue berries. If this were veggie wash I would need only 1/2 Tbsp in 2 cups if I wanted to soak but most things you can just spray. This is too thick to use on anything soft like grapes so for most things you need to soak them and that requires a container.Other brands I have used are thinner and in a spray bottle and you can just spray and let it sit. I used to put stuff in a colander and spray it and let it sit for awhile and rinse. I think I am going to make up my own dilution (maybe 1Tbsp to 1cup) and use it in a spray bottle but since that is not the intended use and you have no real way of knowing if it worked I am not certain that it will work. I also feel I need to find a spray bottle that is safe for food use so I may just buy another pre-made bottle of another brand of produce wash and refill the bottle with diluted mix of this or just save it for things I do want to soak.Maybe it is just me and others are used to using produce wash this way.  I think this is a good product that is just not all that convenient for me and likely to run out fast if you use it as directed... still I did not really smell or taste anything (veggie wash has a stronger smell) and I did feel the berries were cleaner!

For solid fruits and vegetables, like apples and bell peppers, you put a drop or two on the fruit and rub it around. It creates some suds which stays on your hands, so you can continue to wash the next few pieces. Then you rinse them off. Pretty easy. It does a great job and leaves items squeaky clean, especially tomatoes which always tend to be sprayed with some kind of wax that feels greasy to me. And the product smells like licorice. For things that are not easy for rubbing, like berries, you need to make a soaking solution, which does use a lot more of the product. I'm usually too lazy to get out a separate container for this, so I tend not to use it for these types of produce. Of course it would be great if it was easier for these types. But if you only use it for solid produce, it does last a long time.

Our original order (placed on amazon.com, from Vitamin Grocer) of two biokleen produce wash bottles came completely wrecked (sad, because it is a really great product) - since there was no protective packaging in the box, both bottles arrived cracked an spilled. My husband received an email at his agency from the staff at our APO post office to pick up the leaking box - the box itself was not damaged, only the contents, since I'm sure they tumbled around quite a bit without anything to protect them (which makes no sense to send bottles containing liquid). Since we have been using our APO, we have spent thousands of dollars and received many many dozen packages with absolutely no problems. After writing initial review, I was contacted by the seller, Vitamin Grocer. Promised if I deleted my review, they would send a replacement for our order (plus additional bottles - I declined the additional bottles, but agreed graciously to the replacements as long as they were better packaged, because what would be the point?), they wrote me back that replacements would be sent ASAP - that contact was originally November 4. I contacted them again around January 4 to follow up, received an email stating it was sent, and I then followed up requesting tracking and they have not responded. I am disappointed and frustrated and feel duped.

I have to say this is the best and most flavorful jar pasta sauce I've ever had...in fact, it's one of the best I've ever had, including fancy italian restaurants etc...nothing beats the intense flavor these tomato's have.  I highly recommend this pasta sauce!  I've only had the marinara, I like it to much I have yet to try the others.
big and round.  Individually wrapped.  Good for a midnight snack.  Or just anytime. Arrived on time.  Packed in a manner to make it.

Even without a coupon, at a dollar a box and shipped to my door free with Prime, I am a happy camper.  Individual boxes at ACME are about $3.00/box in Maryland.  Love the savings, product and convenience!
I really enjoy this product and prefer the wild rice over plain white rice and the best part is that it's shipped to my front door!

This was the only wild rice we could find at a particular store, so we were initially "forced" to get it. I was hesitant when the seasoning packaged smelled of "sour cream & onion," but I replaced 2 cups of water with a can of chicken broth & cooked it anyway.Not only did it have a 15 minute shorter cooking time than bulk wildrice, but it tasted awesome. The only con is that like Kraft macaroni, the box is only half full & you need to buy 2 boxes to feed a family of four.
THE RICE IS GOOD, BUT I THINK IT IS CLOSE TO THE DATE WHERE RICE BECOMES MUSHY.
Really adds flavor when boiling shrimp.  Someone gave it to us as a gift years ago and we've used it ever since.

I used to consume Sun Brand Curry Powder for years since it was the best but not any longer since I mix my own curry powder and the main ingredient that I use more than all others, is turmeric and more importantly I want to avoid sodium which is added in all spices regardless of the brand. No wonder everyone is selling turmeric in pills since it has such a high nutritional value, manganese 26%, iron 16%, phytosterol 5.5 and most importantly inflammation factor of 1,523; all in one tablespoon. No need to consume pills since I put few spoons of this gold beauty turmeric into my dishes for its health benefits. Sun Brand curry powder has some 30 spices. If you are after a spice mix Sun Brand is the best but certainly with noticeable sodium. Bravo.

We recently fell in love with Indian food.Papads (after quickly toasted in a HOT oven) can be a healthy alternative to potatoe chips.  They are excellent alone or dipped in chip dip.They are a very thin bread.  When cooked they are brittle and crisp, just like potatoe chips.  However they are baked, not fried and made of chickpea flour which is a little more healthy than potatoe chips.

These papads are delicious! I love all the Lijjat papads but cumin in my favorite. I either roast mine or fry them, and it always makes for a wonderful side or a snack. Every now and then you bite into the cumin, and it feels like a burst of flavor in your mouth. Very highly recommended. Also, if you can get hold of some, try these with indian style mint-cilantro paste! It's chip-and-dip with a twist!

OMG, I thought my blood pressure would hit the walls of my artery and instantly kill me after eating just one papadum.  This food needs to be repackaged to contain less sodium content.  It currently has 620 mg and the daily sodium intake is 2300 mg. So who can eat just one papadum w/o going over their sodium requirement!  WARNING: If you have high blood pressure or hypertension, do NOT buy this product ... you will be killing yourself!!

This flour is so amazing you won't even be able to tell you didn't use wheat flour!  I use it in all my favorite vegan recipes and it work perfectly.  Baker's blend really makes gluten-free baking simple and painless.  Try it--you won't regret it!

My daughter is a celiac.  I'm allergic to wheat.  Between the two of us, we must have tried every gluten free product on the market.  Until Fusion Flours there was nothing that tasted 'real'!  The recipes are easy and delicious!  We make fried chicken and gravy using fusion flour as if it were wheat flour.  NO ONE can tell the difference! Oh my goodness-we can enjoy pizza with the rest of the family! We are grateful!

We used their product in our restaurant for Gluten Free pizza crusts and everyone raved it was the best they'd ever had.Our chefs found it easy to use. The variety of items this makes is astounding. If you want a gluten free flour mix, you willbe very happy with this one, made with care and love.
Finally, a superb flour for all us gluten-free folks!The recipes cover everything from bread, pizza doughand cookies to bread-crumb main dish options.
Fusion Flours mix is the best you'll find.  I've made many recipes with their product and loved everything I've made.  I am so grateful to have found them!!
I just broke one of these muffins into a bowl of creamy tomato soup...likehaving a blt/grilled cheese yummy and warms your belly.

column9: Item as decribed, arrived on time.
column10: Item as described and it arrived on time. I used them for a baby shower favor with a tag that said "look who is ready to pop". Everyone loved the idea and thought the suckers tasted good.
Mulino Bianco cookies are my favourite. I had them while in Europe. Very hard to find in the US. The cost of the product here is significantly more expensive, but indeed worthed.

I have never heard of this brand before but tried it since it seemed like something new and different.What I liked:- Natural snack that has some sweetness and slight heat in spice but not overwhelming- The nuts are very high quality- US companyReally not too much not to like in this product other than it seems like 4 oz's can go very quickly.Kids loved it as a snack.  This is probably a great item for this year's hiking trips.

column9: Might just save my Tassimo from the scrapheap - for now
column10: The demise of the relationship between Kraft and Starbucks was threatening to make my Tassimo redundant. I have tried many coffees from Gevalia and Maxwell House but none of them delivered that bold, full flavored hit that I got from my Starbucks favorites - Kitamu and Columbia. So I thought my Tassimo was on death row whilst I use up my stockpile of Starbucks, but the Carte Noir Kenya might just give it a stay of execution. This is a smooth, bold coffee/crema. It lacks the bite of Kitamu but is enjoyable nonetheless.It brews a little on the cool side if you want to add creamer, and only delivers a (near)4oz serving. However, two of these t-discs works out about the same cost as the Starbucks discs at Amazon prices. The inconvenience is the additional brewing time and hassle of using two discs. Overall, I am happy to have found at least one coffee that might delay the almost inevitable purchase of a Keurig, but it alone is not enough - one of the joys of these one cup machines is the variety on offer and Kraft need to find some quality Starbucks replacements soon.

column9: Very good... but not the best
column10: The Carte Noir Kenya is smooth and flavorful, but not really robust.  I'd call it a 'medium' roast.  Stronger and richer than any sort of breakfast blend, but not as deeply favored as a french roast.  And it lacks the bite of an espresso.  It is listed as having a 'fruity' flavor which I couldn't imagine until I tried it, but yes, it's a bit fruity, not smoky like an Italian roast. For a coffee novice, it's tasty and easy to drink and does not need a lot of syrup etc to smother it.  For a coffee fanatic it may feel too light.It brews 120 ml (4 oz) so it's perfect for a latte or cappucino, if you are looking for something with a touch less of a bite than a traditional espresso.  If I am out of my favorite t-discs (the Kenco Caffe Crema - which you currently have to buy from tassimo directly) for my morning cup, then this performs well as a second choice. I prefer to use two discs in the morning, with a little bit of soy milk (I'm vegan).  In the afternoon one disc gives a nice amount.Another reviewer compared this to the Maestro Lorenzo Crema.  I mostly agree, though I find the ML Crema to have a deeper, creamier, less fruity taste than this CN Kenya.BOTTOM LINE:  Smooth, flavorful, fairly rich... but not the darkest or richest out there.  Not robust.  Note it brews 4 oz of coffee.

I am from Spain and I enjoy strong coffee. This was very good. Still, I will by the nespresso if you really want a perfect coffee. However, if you have a tassimo and want to try some strong, nice coffee to wake up after lunch, you will be happy with this
We like many of the Maestro Lorenzo disks including the crema for our Tassimo coffee maker. But this a good one too.

This is what I use to add to the Maxwell House flavor to get an OK cup of coffee from my Tassimo machine.  With Starbucks dropping the T-Disc format, I had to start experimenting with blending what is still available in T-Discs to get something I like.  If this doesn't work out, I will soon have a used Tassimo on the market and will look to move to K-cups and Keurig.

This coffee has great bold flavor - a great breakfast coffee.  It takes 2 pods to fill a normal sized mug - it would be great if they used the Starbucks / Hot Cocca sized pods - and delivered a decent mug of coffee.

This is not a very good product. Not only does it put out a very minimal cup of coffee (fills 1/4 of a standard mug).  It has no flavor.  i Severley miss my Starbucks (the reason I bought Tassimo) so I hope they bring it back, get Peet's Coffee or I hear Gevalia is making a dark roast Tassimo product to launch soon?

column9: Fancy Name ... Poor Results! Here's WHY:
column10: First of all, due to Tassimo (Kraft) dropping the StarBucks contract ... the Coffee/Cappuccino options have been rather disappointing!And now, it appears that I'm stuck with a Tassimo Bosch Coffee maker, that I have fallen in Love with, but, may not be able to sustain our new relationship, due to some poor contractual execution and so-so option offerings, by Tassimo.Tassimo is now attempting to Match & Exceed their Customers Expectations, by offering a multitude of different brands of coffee's, tea's and fake chocolate drinks.The Tassimo Brand of "Carte Noir Kenya", 16-Count T-Discs for Tassimo Brewers (Pack of 3), is a good example of Nice packaging + Fancy name + Lower Price Point, than StarBucks, but, in the "RESULTS" Department, is so far behind that I'm considering buying Powdered Folgers coffee, for my New Shiny Red Tassimo.* Taste - Frothy, dark, fruity taste, with an Old Shoe Overtones!* Quality - Do not Know just What the 'Roasting' Process is that Tassimo uses, but, this was a bit "Over-Cooked".* Buzz factor - this is the natural caffeine content in and extracted from the coffee, during the Brewing process ... NOT like a StarBucks Kick!* Amount - Each T-Disc is ONLY 4 Ounces (120 ml), which I was able to make it passable by Adding 2 Milk Creamers!* Price - Fairly Competitive, which is the reason I ordered a 3-Pack, hoping that I would discover a fair "replacement" for StarBucks ... well, No Can Do!* Side Effect - I sustained a bad case of GI Reflux, about 20 twenty minutes later.Summary - Tassimo makes some Very Excellent Milk Creamer's ... they need more time to get together , or, Not, with their Coffee & Cappuccino offerings. I'm Returning this "Carte Noir Kenya" back.Nice try ... but No Cigar!

I purchased these when they were on special for 22 bucks or so for 2 lbs.  I had just purchased 1 lb at 18 bucks from a friend who had ordered a bulk order from a local health store so she could get that as a low price!  I was thrilled to be alerted to this deal.  Nuts came shrink wrapped but individually packaged in one pound packages and were delicious! Highly recommend if you are looking for raw macs!

Bergin's nuts are the best.  i have never had fresher & tastier nuts.  and I eat alot of nuts being a vegan.  I even have my non-vegan friends eating a handfull everyday.  "they" say that if you have a diet that includes nuts and seeds you will live years longer and much healthier.
I don't know how you could possibly give a bad rating for macadamia nuts.  I love these raw ones, I just wish they didn't have to cost so much.

But I thought the volume would be larger.  Yes, it says two one pound bags, but it just didn't seem like much for the price.  I would buy them again if I wanted delicious macadamia nuts; maybe just hope there's a sale!

Love Best Foods mayonnaise. Light is almost as good. Not the healthiest option but still better than a regular mayonnaise. My family and I go through a bottle a day. We put it on everything. Cool Whip is nasty and not sure why they call it a mayonnaise?

column9: Great chips, great flavor, came MELTED
column10: I didn't have time to complain so this is what it is, but I got the chips as promised with good delivery time but they had melted and reformed into one large chunk in each bag.  They were completely unusable.  I had to pitch them.  No clue what the seller would have done but I didn't bother complaining... ran out to whole foods and bought what they had.  I would have much preferred the Guittard chips as they are delicious.  There was no ice in the box, just 2 bags of melted chips.  Bummer.  My 1 star is for the seller not the product.  If its winter or you live somewhere cold, order away as these are fantastic chips.  If its summer, don't do it.

Many years ago canned grapefruit sections used to be available in grocery stroes; it has been years since I've found any.  It was a welcome treat to find these!This is the only way to eat grapefruit, as far as I'm concerned.  All the work is done for you.  Individual grapefruit sections packed in grapefruit juice are ready to go.  I like a very slight sprinkle of sugar on a small bowl of them.This is the perfect finish for a traditional eggs and sausage/bacon breakfast.  Good and good for you.Absolute top quality product - if you like grapefruit, you'll just love these!

column9: Gratefruit the Way I Loved It as a Kid...
column10: As a 6th grader, there were only two things I looked forward to every week in the cafeteria: Poor Boy sandwiches and grapefruit sections. Thinking about this recently, I went on the internet in search of grapefruit sections and found that they were available from Roland through Amazon (whoda thunk it?). When they arrived, I popped a can into the refrigerator, and a couple of hours later, Voila! They were delicious chilled exactly as I had remembered. I was also pleased to find that the juice was sweet but not overly so. I plan to continue ordering and enjoying this "simple pleasure."

The 46-oz canned Roland Grapefruit Sections taste almost like fresh. Very good product! I would like to order more, but the packaging was absolutely horrible!!!! There were cans rolling around in a box much too large for the number of cans and there was virtually no packing material in the box.  The result was that out of 8 or so cans in the box 7 out of the 8 were so bent on both ends that you cannot use a can opener to completely remove the lid without a lot of stops and starts.  Where the item says the product is in a 4 pack, they are not in a box containing the 4 pack.  What they actually mean is that 4 46-oz cans are inserted into a light-weight plastic bag and then thrown into a large box that would easily hold 24 cans and is too light weight to support the weight of the cans, then throw in a little packing and put 1 piece of tape on the top. The tape was actually broken on a box with nothing to hold the cans in the box and because of the rolling around in the box, the cans were no longer in the plastic bag.  Very good product that you cannot find elsewhere, but beware of the packing.

White Grapefruit segments are no longer available at any of the stores that I shop at, so way to go Amazon.The ones I bought before where from Israel, and these are from Turkey.I use them to make my own fruit cocktail for breakfast. To do that I add a can of Pineapple Chunks, a can of Mandarin Oranges and some fresh red or green grapes.

love grapefruit in a can, no peeling which i dont mind doing if I have the time but who has any of that?and you cant beat the price, could be packed a little better box to big but they arrive okay, could tell theups driver that they are canned food and wont spoil. I also order the rolands grapfruit and orange slices in a canequally delish.

column4: B. WILLIAMS "B WILLIAMS LOOKING FOR LIGHT"
column10: . . . We Really Like ROLAND PRODUCTS. Have yet to purchase anything of theirs that wasn't A+.Roland Grapefruit Segments in Light Syrup is no exception. Great in salads, at breakfast ormy sons like them as a snak with Graham Cracker Sticks also purchased from Amazon.com.I haven't been able to find Roland Products in this area at all.

Tried three major grocery chains in my area for grapefruit sections; no luck. Finally hit amazon.com and there Roland Grapefruit Segments were. They are great, low priced compared to the high-priced refrigerated sections in the grocery stores, and they have a much longer shelf life. Will purchase again.

Good product, wish it did not have corn (I have a corn intolerance).  Also, I thought it might be helpful to list the ingredients for other buyers.INGREDIENTS:"Corn starch, white rice flour, organic palm oil, vegetable margarine, modified corn starch, cheese preparation (cheddar powder, maltodextrin, yeast, salt, sunflower oil), dextrose, liquid whole egg, olive oil, yeast, salt, guar gum, ammonium bicarbonate, sodium bicarbonate, mono and diglycerides, natural flavor."NUTRITION FACTS:Serving Size 8 crackers (30g)Servings per Container 4Amount Per ServingCalories  140 Calories from Fat  45% Daily Value*Total Fat 5g 8 %  Saturated Fat 2.5g 11 %  Trans Fat 0gCholesterol 10mg 3 %Sodium 180mg 8 %Total Carbohydrate 21g 7 %  Dietary Fiber 1g 2 %  Sugars 1gProtein 2g Vitamin A 0 % Vitamin C 0 % Calcium 2 % Iron 0%* Percent Daily Values are based on a 2000 calories diet.

I was looking for a great cracker to be able to make "lunchable" like meals for my children to take to school.  They are age 7 and 9 and both gluten free.  These have worked wonderful.  We have tried the regular (good but kind of plain in flavor), whole grain (very strong spice taste the kids didn't care for) and Cheddar Cheese.  I recommend the cheese.  The only issue I have with these crackers is that they are a little brittle and 1/2 the bag (there are two in a box) is always crumbled pieces and there aren't many whole crackers.  But when you are gluten free and looking for a replacement you put up with a lot.

It's hard to believe these are missing anything, but they have no gluten, and are really outrageously good.  They don't remind me of goldfish crackers, but of Ritz crackers - buttery, crunchy and good.  They aren't overtly cheesy, and have just a faint tang of cheese.  These are awesome with Cheez Whiz, meats, peanut butter, just about anything you care to put on them.  A superior product from a superior company.  I have many of their items on my pantry shelves.  They are my dependable go to company when I want a gluten free product.  The only downside is that they tend to be crumbly; I wish they were packaged differently, but generally not a lot of them arrive broken, and even those taste fantastic.
I love Glutino crackers they taste so good even my non-gluten free spouse likes them. But, another approach to packaging is needed so there are not so many broken crackers in every box.

column9: Great tasting but many are broken
column10: Am getting regular delivery of these gluten-free crackers.  They are great with sharp cheddar cheese.  The price through Amazon is much better than local stores, but either way, most crackers are not whole but in pieces.  So if you like whole crackers, forget it.  I have contacted Glutino about this issue and received a number of coupons in the mail for my efforts.  But I don't see any change in the ability to have whole crackers even though there are two air filled bags of crackers in each box.  Otherwise, I would highly recommend these crackers for taste and texture for those on gluten-free diets like I am.

column9: I like these a lot, but they are always broken
column10: I like the taste of the Glutino cheddar crackers. The cheese taste is delicate, this is not full-on cheese taste.  But it's a very nice taste, a little bland, but that's what I was looking for, anyway.Each box comes with two foil packages of crackers. This is nice because it keeps the crackers crisper. Not that I have let an open box go uneaten long enough for them to really go soggy. These gluten free crackers are not as flaky or crispy as many crackers. They are more dense, sort of the way a graham cracker is dense (though they don't taste anything like a graham cracker).I do not have to avoid gluten in my diet, but I try to cut down, for me and my family, and these gluten free crackers help with that.That said, I do not know why every cracker is broken. I buy this set of six boxes, and every bag in every box will be full of broken crackers. This doesn't make a difference for snacking from the bag, but it makes it tough if you wanted to actually put something on top of the cracker to eat. And it's a given that you won't be able to use the Glutino Gluten Free crackers for any kind of appetizer that calls for whole crackers.I keep buying these, though, because I like the taste.

After recently discovering a gluten intolerance I have been struggling to find things that I can take for lunch that actually satisfy my hunger.  I have tried other gluten free products and have been disappointed with quite a few.  These crackers were a pleasant surprise.  Many in the package were broken when they arrived, but that does not make them inedible.  I think they break so easily due to the fact that they are "dry" in texture.  Keep this in mind when buying and make sure to top these crackers with cheese or some other type of spread.

column9: Great flavor but many broken crackers
column10: I bought these for my son who is allergic to gluten - he and I both love them! The only downside is that most of the crackers were broken into pieces. However, I bought these in a grocery store, not here at Amazon, so the problem seems to be with the manufacturer, rather than Amazon's shipping. Regardless, they are worth the purchase. The crackers have a very good flavor and are crisp - they go well with cheese or just plain. We will definitely buy these again.

If you have to have Gluten Free products this is a great one.  I love them and my whole family cannot tell they are anything but a good cracker.  Good price also.  The Cheddar ones are the best the plain I don't care for.

The crackers themselves are delicious, but I ordered pack of 6 boxes, and LITERALLY not one cracker was whole. As I opened each box, I held my breath, hoping that box would not just have pieces of what was once crackers...  All 6 boxes were just pieces of crackers!!  I wish they had been packaged better.  :-/

I felt ripped off.  Open the big box, and there are six medium sized boxes.  Open a medium box and there are two tiny pouches.  Inside each pouch, a handful of BROKEN crackers.  You pay for a LOT of cardboard and not much food.

These are unquestionably the best as compared to other gluten free crackers I've tried (Blue Diamond crackers and a Crunchmaster) A hint of cheese flavor that compliments rather than overwhelms the flavor of the spreads, cheese etc. spread on top. A great find for holiday dips!  Re: Blue Diamond and Crunchmaster--I put them out for the squirrels they accepted the Blues but they also said "no thanks" to the Crunchmaster even though it's January in Mich.!

Glutino Gluten Free Cheddar Crackers are so good!  They are crunchy but don't have a very strong cheddar flavor.I'd like maybe a little stronger cheddar flavor, but I'll eat them anyway, and other than that they are good.I didn't really have the broken cracker problem. Most of my crackers were intact or only a little had broken off them. But I didn't get them on amazon, so maybe that is why.
My 3 year old son loves these crackers. He's been gluten free for 8 months now and this is the best cheese cracker we've found.

Our daughter is gluten intolerant but wanted to have Lunchables like kids at school. We bought this product to make our own version. The crackers taste good, even for us gluten-tolerant types. The problem is that out of every package, you're lucky to get more than 3 or 4 whole ones. The rest are broken. So for snacking, using in soup and any other use where they don't have to be intact, this is your product. If you need them to be whole you are going to have to look somewhere else.

column9: Great taste and gluten free too!!
column10: We serve these regularly to non-celiac friends and family - and they love 'em too!!

These aren't overly cheesy. Instead they have a delicious buttery flavor like a Ritz cracker. I find these to be much more flavorful than the original variety Glutino crackers. Great for peanut butter or salami or cheese!These can also be crushed up to serve all kinds of purposes. I've been using them to bread chicken. The cracker crumbs from these make a wonderful oven-baked breaded chicken.

column9: a great cracker for any occasion
column10: Glutino Cheddar cheese crackers are one of the best crackers I have ever eaten.  Light with a mild cheese flavor they are great with soup, cheese, peanut butter or salad. The only drawback is that these crackers are expensive for the amount of crackers received in each box.
These taste like a cross between ritz crackers and saltines.  No cheese to be found. I want GF cheese-its! These are also expensive.

column9: Tasty, filling, but only four servings per box.
column10: I am not on a gluten free diet. However, I find gluten free foods more filling. And so, I gave these crackers a try, after coming across them in my grocery store. I like the original and cheddar flavours the best (the cheddar flavour is very delicate).1) I have not experienced the breakage problem some mention. Yes, there is a broken cracker here and there, but nothing out of norm. Quite frankly, I think they pack them as they do, in two pouches, two servings each, in order to pump up the volume, so to speak. Each of these boxes contains only four servings (32 crackers). That's not much for the price. This is the only reason for the four, rather then five star rating.2) They are filling and tasty. I am addicted to these crackers with red pepper humus. Yum! They scoop well once you get a hang of it (they are flaky and will break more often then regular crackers would in the same situation).3) The box is made of 100% recycled material, for those to whom this matters.Enjoy!PS: There is a warning on the label that says they may contain traces of soy, milk, and sesame, in case anyone is alergic. Also, they do contain eggs.

My son will not eat gluten-free bread or rice crackers.  I had almost given up, but decided to buy these.  They are similar in size to Ritz crackers, and have more of a normal cracker texture to them.  I personally think they taste bland, but my son thinks they are great.  I am just happy to have something to put cheese and peanut butter on for him.  They have just a hint of cheddar to them, not overwhelming at all.

What a great discovery! Finally, a gluten free cracker that tastes good and isn't TOO hard on the pocketbook. I love them! My only problem is that half of them or more arrive broken. Maybe it's something the company can work on....put them in sleeves or something but even broken, they're a nice treat whether alone, with a topping or in soup. I'll definitely buy these again.

I bought these for my 2 year old son who is a very picky eater. A gluten free diet and a picky eater can be a tough combination. He loves them, and the rest of the family enjoys them as well. They are delicious.
These crackers are nice for a gluten free diet, a bit crumbly and broken when received, but tasty.  My kids even like them, say they taste a lot like goldfish crackers.
This is a great gluten free cracker!Pricing was better than I can find locally.Each box has 2 foil sealed bags for freshness.Was shipped quickly.

column9: close to goldfish crackers for GF diets
column10: These are the closest to a goldfish cracker I will get with my GF diet.  The texture is great and the flavor is good. I think they could taste a bit more cheddar cheese like. Overall, great GF crackers. Just like other Glutino crackers, two small packages in one box. Yes, some crackers are broken. Small price to pay for good GF crackers. I prefer the Glutino vegetable crackers over the cheddar flavored ones. I put a piece of cheddar cheese on these crackers and that made them better.

column9: Best Gluten Free Cracker - Just like "Fish Crackers"
column10: When I crave "Fish Crackers," I eat Glutino Gluten Free Cheddar Crackers. They are great with an apple, with cheese, or just plain!

Kudos to Glutino and to Amazon.  Not only are these crackers magnificent but Amazon's policy of carrying a multitude of products for celiacs has made our lives so much easier -virtually normal in my case.  Keep up the good work.

These Glutino glutin-free cheddar crackers are incredible.  My husbands says that he can not tell the difference between regular crackers and these gluten-free crackers and they give a kick to whatever he is putting on them.  Wonderful to be able to have normal tasting gluten-free products and Glutino is the best.

column9: closest thing to a goldfish cracker that's GF
column10: These are the best GF crackers I've tasted.  My son is GF and used to eat Ritz and goldfish crackers before going off wheat and gluten. He likes thees a lot and I think they are pretty good too.  Great with a little peanut butter for a snack!

column9: Cheezy Cracker for Gluten Free Folks
column10: We really enjoy these crackers.  They have a great texture and cheezy flavor.  They remind me of those little cheese fish crackers.  This is a great choice now for us gluten free folks who struggle to find a good cracker.  Here it is!
Good flavor and gluten-free, but note that the ingredients include palm oil, a not-so-good for you saturated fat...

We must have received a fruitcake made a year ago - this was so dry, you could not slice it- it just crumbled.  You could tell the ingrediants were of high quality.Last year we purchased a Jane Parker fruitcake and it was great, unfortunately, the large ones are no longer available through amazon.com.  In addition, the tin ( which my wife wanted ) was damaged in 2-3 placed - fedex is rough on things
This fruit cake was just no good. It was even burnt on the top. I had to throw it away. The tTrappist Monk cake was better, and Collins Bakery is still the best.

Since I've been from Europe and lived in Switzerland for a while it was no question about it whether I wanted to order this Swiss Colony Fruit Cake or not. Listen to me my Dears...please forget the American traditional sweets for a few days and enjoy this remarkably precious treasure. Give your taste buds a twist and see you guys in Paradise!! :)
Just a note that the "Plus Extra Peppermint" is literally a peppermint candy, not peppermint coffee. Other than that product was as expected.

1 Kahlua, 2 Timothy's Irish Creme, 2 Caribou Mahogany, 2 Van Houtte French Vanilla , 2 VH Vanilla Hazelnut, 2 Green Mountain Mocha Nut Fudge, 4 GM Gingerbread, 4 GM Spicy Eggnog, 2 GM Southern Pecan, 2 Wolfgang Puck Creme Caramel, & 2 VH Raspberry Chocolate Truffle and 1 piece of Peppermint Candy

I have been enjoying this variety pack for a week now. I only got one flavor repeated 4x. Everything else I got 2 of. And I was glad because if I liked the flavor I wanted another cup of that flavor! And it helped me decide on flavors I thought I would like and did not. Glad I didn't buy a whole box of those flavors! The four stars is only because I didn't love every flavor. Its a good variety pack to start with.
I am thrilled with this sampler.  There is a wide variety of flavors including seasonal choices and you cannot discount the starlight mint.  I have now ordered it twice!

I bought this at Costco.  Thought it was amazingly wonderful and went back to get more.  It was gone.  I had the manager look it up and discovered that Costco had discontinued it - but the manager found some at a store 15 miles away.  I drove there right away and bought them out.  160 packets.  That's how good I think it is.  We are half way through, and I was getting a little anxious tonight as I made dinner.  So, yeah, Amazon carries it.  My kids love this.  90 seconds and it's done!

Yes, the flavor and nutritional value of this product is off the charts fabulous. However, it can be had for much less at vitacost.com! Initial pricing of $41.34 for a 12-pack with $4.99 shipping. But... they always offer a 10% off coupon for new customers, and once you get on their email list, they frequently offer additional discount coupons. I got my first order for $37.20 for a 12-pack (I ordered two since we go through this yummy stuff fairly quickly.) Also it is available to receive via an autoship schedule, which is offered at 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90 or 120 day higher day shipping intervals, and will save you 5% on each order. I am stunned that Amazon is charging such a significant amount more for this same item. Hopefully they will drop their pricing once they learn of their competition.

column9: Great - even my picky kids ate it!
column10: This is really, really good.  It's perfect for a quick side for dinner - it takes 90 seconds in the microwave, and it's so healthy!  Best of all, my three (young, picky) boys ate it up and asked for seconds!  That in itself gives it 5 stars!  This will now become a pantry staple.

Absolutely delicious. I wasn't expecting much from plain rice+quinoa, but this tastes very good. I ate it plain and couldn't stop with one serving. It was hard for me to believe that it has brown rice. I didn't buy it from Amazon, I just picked one packet up from a local store for checking it out. A great way to add quinoa for those of us who don't get around to cooking with it.

This is a nutritious, easy and delicious product. Its nutty flavor and mix of soft & slightly gritty texture along with a slight garlicky flavor makes this a surefire winner as far as a side dish (or main dish) is concerned.

Stumbled upon them at Costco and so far have had it twice (1st time mixed with a runny egg, and second time with tuna).  It is really really tasty!  I would definitely recommend it as a healthy side, even for people who might not normally go for this sort of thing.
That sums it up!  Quick, tasty and seems to be very healthy.  I highly recommend this product.  It takes 1 minute in my microwave and I eat it as is or add it to soups.

column9: Great, easy side....even for the kids!!
column10: We love this product! It is super healthy and delicious! The best part is that the quinoa is a great source of protein!! My kids down it like they haven't eaten in 6 months (even my pickiest who won't eat much). Overall a tasty, quick and brainless dish for the whole fam!!

I'm afraid, after reading the other reviews, that perhaps I may have purchased a 'bad batch' or something (I purchased from Costco like one of the other reviewers) as I absolutely did not like this product at all.I love quinoa, brown rice & quinoa/rice blends. I love garlic and lots of it. Raw, baked, paste, confit in oil...you name it. This, sadly, wasn't rice/quinoa/garlic as I know it.-First off, the blend doesn't quite look like it shows on the package, of course. The colours are more drab and khaki-hued. Yummy! There's also not nearly as much quinoa in the package as there appears to be in the picture. I normally expect packaging to be misleading but in the picture it looks like roughly 60/40 or 50/50 rice:quinoa. In real life, it's more like 90/10...MAYBE 75/25 if you want to be generous.-Secondly, whatever Seeds of Change did to the 'garlic' in this stuff shouldn't happen to a hardened criminal! The smell is unbearable. Pungent, cloying and slightly sour. Very unappetising. Mixed with the drab colour of the final cooked product, it doesn't really put it's best foot forward if you know what I mean. Just by the smell and look alone, I was already losing my appetite, and I was *quite* hungry when we prepared this. Great if you're on a diet, I suppose...-It tastes as bad as it smells, but fortunately not as cloying. There is no depth of flavour, so the taste doesn't really linger long on the tongue. This is actually in the 'Pro' column since the taste is dreadful. Flat, cardboard-like, faintly acrid, and the only thing vaguely resembling garlic is the aftertaste and smell it leaves on your breath. When there's more aftertaste than initial taste, that's never a good sign. It's as if they took immature garlic, slightly burnt it, dehydrated it, pulverised it to a fine powder and threw it in the package as an afterthought. VERY disappointing as I've had other Seeds of Change products and liked them quite a bit!-I *will* say that they did a great job on the texture. The texture was very nice, just the right kind of 'al dente' that I like. This, regrettably, put all the other defects of the product into sharper relief. If only it didn't taste terrible!-You might be able to doctor this product up with some sort of sauce or extra seasonings but 1)that could be risking making it worse and 2)why would you waste the time and effort. Simply buy something else.But, please, do yourself a favour and don't buy this.

column9: Buyer beware - pricing out of line
column10: Nespresso makes GREAT coffee and GREAT machines. I switched over to a Nespresso machine 7 years ago and have never looked back. I save a small fortune every year by making my lattes at home.That being said, the Nespresso capsule offers posted here are from a third party who is putting a large additional margin on their price.You can order the same products online from Nespresso for approx $0.55 each (half the price here).
I have not yet received my order when it said it would be here. It is overdue. First time this has happened.
It was a gift for our friends. They love it.How do I know? I have one just like it.

The actual product was pretty good, however, I was very disappointed when the package arrived and there were only 2 small bags which I paid over $38 for!  That seems a little high for 2 small bags of boiled peanuts!!

I have been looking forward to receiving my package for the peanuts thinking that it will taste nothing like I've ever tried before. I was not at all happy with the taste... may be it's just me.. but, no more boiled peanuts for me. I prefer raw peanuts any day...

When I lived in the U.K., I was exposed to Chocolate bars from all over Europe, and liked several very much, but when I was near American Air Bases, I would always get a friend to get me a Hershey Almond Bar, because I never found any candy I liked as well as this classic.For a short while I thought that Hershey had outdone themselves with the advent of the Gold Bars, but they were discontinued after a short run. I did get to see them made and got one from the visitor's center while they were still available though.So, although it may be relative to what you grow up with, if it is a choice between a gourmet chocolate, and a Hershey Almond Bar, give me the Hershey's every time. The Giant Size bars are the best since the end of the Golden Bar, but if you are staring at the vending machine and can't decide what you want... You can't go wrong with a Hershey Bar!

I bought the Orange Blossom and it was very smooth, light and just the right flavor. I don't see wildflower which is usually available.  Maybe I'll try the Tupelo, the Black Sage sounds good too.  I know it's pricey, and not something one would buy for a large family as you don't get too much.  But the flavor of this brand, I think is very nice.
I love it.  Works very well in many different recipes or just simply in beverages.

I live in South Korea, and needless to say, these suckers are extremely hard to find (if not impossible). Even though I live far away, the package arrived very quickly (quicker than most items of this size would), and the blowpops taste as perfect as they did in the U.S.Enjoying this candy, I could be shot in the face tomorrow and STILL die a happy man, knowing that on my shelf, in my room, next to a picture of my family and others, is a beautiful, gorgeous 100ct. box of Charms Blowpops.

The first time I tasted a Charms Blow Pop I was just a kid. I was hooked instantly. They are fruity, tangy and best of all, there's gum on the inside! It tastes so wonderful when you finally bite into the pop and you get that mix of gum and fruity hard candy. Delicious! This box was wonderful and very tasty, although I have to say that they put in way too many cherry pops. Those are my least favorite, and at the end, all I had left were a bunch of cherry pops. I ended up just giving the rest of them away at Halloween. That being said, the box was still great. It's nice to be able to eat a Blow Pop anytime you want!
What more can I say. These are great tasting with bubble gum surprise in the middle. These will always remain the best blow pop!
The kids said the taste/flavor is fine but A LOT of the suckers had holes in their plastic wrap cover.

I got these for my Middle School Boys Small Group at church and they love them.Only issue was I left them in the cupboard a few weeks without getting any and when I did go back to get them ant had gotten into the box and were looking for sugar yumminess.  Oh well, at least the boys got some the first time around.  Next time I'll know to take them out of the box and put them in Tupperware.

column9: Makes you feel like a kid again!
column10: How can you be sad and suck on a lollipop? These will brighten your day. They taste the exact same as when we were kids. The flavors are cherry, grape, green apple, watermelon and strawberry. The cherry and grape are pretty tame. The green apple and watermelon have a more sour taste, which I love. The strawberry is pretty tame, too, but it smells magnificent. They arrived fresh and ready to take me back to my childhood.
I just luv charms lollipop ever since I was a child decades ago...hard to find...glad amazon offers it for sale.

column9: Awesomeness! Good tasting treat that I remember
column10: When I "accidently" stumbled across these on Amazon, I just had to order these. at first I was bummed because it said that I would not receive them until 12JUL2011... and I ordered them on 23JUN2011. Yet again though, Amazon pulls through and I received them on 29JUN2011 (and I am currently stationed overseas.)Anyways, on the flavor... they still tasted as great as they were when I was younger.. I think I went through 10 suckers right away (especially the Green Apple.) Also the Suckers came in a pretty big box, but nothing was damaged or anything (so was pretty happy there...Fresh opening)I gave it 5 stars from the following:Taste: 5/5Freshness: 4.5/5Delivery Time: 5/5As good as I remembered them: 5/5In my honest opinion, if you love Blowpops and just want a good box to lay around the house / Workspace, Etc for the occasional great snack. I would def recommend buying from here as in my experience, I had no problem with them.

I wish these were sold more in stores!! I cannot find them anywhere so I went on here and found them and just had to get them! I ended up dividing them up and passing them out at Halloween and to friends.

I got these blow pops because I had a sweet tooth and I could not beat the price for them. Also they came very fresh and taste like the were just made. They were really good n when they got to my house none of them were broke. Thank You.
I purchased 2 boxes. Each box was over half full of strawberry flavor. So product should have been marked as being 50% strawberry--then I would not have purchased from this vendor.

I'm a OTR Driver.For some reason,many stores(With the exception of the large box places)no longer stock Charms' Blow Pops.Why?? Your guess is as good as mine.My daughters areenjoying this legendary candy as i write this review.A taste you'll never outgrow,no moresearchin' for succulence. Not really a complaint,but i wish there were more watermelonand grape pops.Must be 10 cherry pops to every melon and grape,wish they would make alemon pop too.May need to order another box soon. Thanks Amazon!
I ordered two of these.  One was opened. I do not know if it was customs or not. Delicious product.
Yum. Blow pops. BLOW pops. blow POPS. BLOW POPS. B L O W P O P S!(see title for description)
Ordered these for my mother for her Halloween trick or treaters , she loves to see the little ones dressed up in their costumes .

I loved these as a kid,so once I saw those huge box of Blow Pops I decided to order them. I like to have candy around just for when I crave something sweet and since it's a hundred pack not only will they last, I have plenty for family members and neighbors.

column9: My daughter loves it! (same with the whole family!)
column10: My whole family loves this gourmet lolipop! It all started on Halloween when my daughter came home with a bag full of candy. There was every candy you could imagine! Tootsie rolls,Tootsie pops,Hershey's,Reese's,Kit Kat,Milky Way, Snickers and then this mysterious candy in a wrapper. When I tasted it I was about to pass out. THIS WAS DELICIOUS! I told the whole family about it. I saw on the wrapper it said "Blow Pop". So I told them the name of the lolipop and they tried some. They said it was delicious. My daughter told all the kids at school and in the neighborhood. My wife told all her friends. Soon it was a Blow Pop party! We invited everyone we knew. Inside a Blow Pop is bubble gum which you chew when you are done with this yummy lolipop. You can buy this online like on Amazon and ebay. And you can buy them at party stores and grocery stores and toy stores. Anyone would like to try a Blow Pop!

I love blow pops. They taste great and last a long time. They have a big problem. It's very difficult to remove the wrapper. What happens is the wrapper sticks to the stick and you can't pull it off. They must use super glue. You might think it's a safety feature, but you can take the wrapper off the portion that covers the edible part fairly easily. You're forced to eat the lollipop with a plastic wrapper in your mouth. What I do is if the wrapper doesn't come off, I throw it out and try another. So instead of 100 lollipops per box, I get maybe 80 or so I can actually eat.
Bought for my husband as a stop smoking aid. he's decided that he likes tootsie pops better. However, they are what they are. Not enough variety in flavor, he said.
When ordered, forgot I'm unable to chew regular gum.  But the candy shell was very good.  Just taking me longer to eat.
This italian roast is dark, yet smooth and bold. You do not taste the roaster just the natural flavor extracted from the green bean

My 19 month old loooves these!  The only drawback is the price... I did find a good alternative in the Archer Farms Organic Fruit Strips sold at, ahem, a major retailer with a red and white bullseye logo.  You get 10 for 2 to 3 bucks and they are comparable in nutrition (organic, half serving of fruit, sweetened with juice not corn syrup).
I'm thirteen years old and I love these. The texture is a little awkward for me but I'm not going to mark it down for that, considering it's meant for little ones. Omnomnom.
My 2-year-old little girl loves them so much!~ When she wake up every noon or when we go out, she asks for this snack, and I tasted it, it is pretty good.

These are my son's favorite snack, even though he is really past the Gerber toddler line of food.  They are so much healthier than some of the other alternatives in the grocery store.  My only disappointment stems from that Amazon no longer offers this product as a Subscribe and Save item.

Great snack for the kids (I have a one and two year old). I like that they are soft so my one year old has no problem "chewing" on them. It doesn't seem as much of a choking hazard as other fruit snacks do.

column9: Can't keep them in the house for long!
column10: My child LOVES these!!  They are just the right size for a treat (they are pretty small).  The list of ingredients is great.  There isn't anything in these that is questionable.  I only wish they weren't so expensive because we go through them like crazy!
it seems and tastes just like dog-food to me but my 13 month daughter really loves it!it's 99% real fruits and easy to carry on and pill off the packet. i'll try wildstrawberry flavor next.

I get these for the car, and my son (7/2/08) loves them.  The best price is to get them through Subscribe & Save, and we get one pack of 6 delivered each month, which is just about enough for us.  He gets one in the morning on the way to daycare, and one in the evening on the way home.  It's nice because they're not messy and don't get his fingers very sticky!  But yes, as others point out, they're not exactly cheap...

I keep a steady supply of these in my house and pocketbook for my grandson.  He loves these things and I feel better giving him these than candy or cookies since they are made with real organic fruit. My only suggestion is check the local supermarket where they usually sell for about $2.50 a box.  I'm not sure why they are so much more expensive here. But if you have a toddler, check them out!

These are great. I have been buying them for my toddler since I first saw them in my local grocery store. He loves them and much healthier than candy. I always have one with me so he can have a snack when we are on the go.  The four rating is only because these aren't cheap but worth the money.

These thing are awesome. My very picky 18mo old son will eat them all day if I let him. They are soft and break down in the mouth quickly to reduce choking.Best description would be a mix of applesauce and strawberry puree thats shaped into a small bar. My son tends to eat everything whole, so I have to break them into about 8 small pcs for him. They are really expensive since the pkg only contains around 5 little bars, but are well worth it for the toddler who currently will only eat milk, pepperoni and cheese!!

I'm very pleased with this grain-free, healthy yet highly-palatable dog food made with human-grade ingredients. (By the way, duck is sometimes better than chicken for dogs with alleriges.) Both of my dogs love the Dogswell canned foods. I like to buy them a variety of canned food to mix in with their dry food. They never miss a beat when it's time for them to eat. They come running everytime! A couple of folks commented on the strong smell of this product (with duck) but I don't think it's that bad. The dogs love it. Plus, I always add wild salmon oil to my dogs' dinners for their skin and coat - the Omega fatty acids are so good for them. Just because we as individuals may not love gamey/fishy smells, the fact is the dogs love the food and it's really good for them. Besides, there are plenty of products that can help with their breath if an owner feels it to be necessary. I personally have never been bothered by the smell of this dog food, and I highly recommend it. Your dog will be very happy.

We tried this product and our Mini Schnauzer just loved the entire Happy Hips line. You really get the best value here. I've checked all our Feed Stores in the area and could not find a lower price. We even subscribed to the "Auto Ship" and it comes to our door automatically every 60 days. Gotta love it! The only thing that "bothered" me was our very first shipment of Duck (12cans) came with every single can of food dented in some way. I decided to chalk it up to chance and wait on the second shipment before raising Cain. The second shipment was in perfect condition so we're very happy.

I had been getting this product on subscribe and save for over a year.  The first couple of shipments had great quality.  The food was in half inch squares with a thick gravy.  With the middle shipments the food was cut in little slices but still had a thick gravy.  The last shipment the food was mush with running gravy.  I cancelled my subscription.

column9: they do have a quality control problem
column10: The manufacturer does have a quality control problem.  Sometimes the can is full of meat chunks with very little "gravy" and sometimes the consistency is like soup with very little meat chunks.  The dog likes it either way.

This product has been inconsistent in the amount of water in each can. Some cans are 40% water, while others have a reasonable amount. Since this food is not cheap, I don't like paying for water. I sent a case back, but the replacement was not a lot better. I may quit ordering, but on the plus side, my dog really likes it.

My mixed Rottweiler loves Dogswell Happy Hips or Vitality canned food as a mix in her dry kibble.  That makes me a happy camper after having thrown out so many other brands of canned food over the past several weeks.  Nice to find one or two without chicken too.  For us, Dogswell rocks, but it took a long time to find it.
Dog loves it. Mix it with his dry food. Does smell a bit but thats ok. Great price too.

We have 4 Chihuahuas, and they tend to have sensitive stomachs, gain weight too easily and don't tolerate grains. This product is their absolute favorite. The sweet potato is like pumpkin - very good for sensitive tummies. The duck just drives them wild and is tolerated as well or better than chicken. And it has no chemicals or additives or grain. Just the good stuff. I highly recommend this product. Even our cat tries to take a nibble -- it seems irrestible.

column9: Highest Quality Dog Food at this price!!!!
column10: I did a lot of research before settling on this product. The dogs love it and it is of the highest quality. Lots of protein, with little fat or carbohydrates. I use this mixed with Premium Edge dry dog food. You can spend more but your return on investment will be neglible. No by products, no fillers, chelated vitamins for easier absorbtion, and the list goes on. Compare labels to the so called "premium brands" and see for yourself. I suggest a gradual transition from whatever you are feeding now (2 or 3 months minimum) because of the drastic change in protein level of this dog food over the competition.

I was used to buying this item off the shelf, but was disgusted by the contents of my mail order.  First off, the product image is misleading.  The image shows the "Vitality" duck and sweet potato product (which I was familiar with and wanted), but what came was the "Happy Hips" duck and sweet potato product.  My roommate had actually purchased the "Happy Hips" product through the mail before and while we noticed some uneven quality, my order was disgusting.  The contents of most of the 12 cans in the cans in the first box had congealed into a super hard blob with none of the meat chunks and vegetables recognizable, and covering the top and interspersed in the contents were what looked like maggots.  I tried the can with the best looking contents, convinced myself that the white grains were rice (even though rice is not listed in the ingredients) and mixed some as usual with my dog's dry food.  When I came home from work today, my dog had thrown up twice.  I opened one of the cans in the second box just to see what was inside.  The contents of it looked much more like what I was used to, but I saw some of the "rice grains" on top.  That was it - I called Amazon and asked for a refund.  It's hard for me to blame Dogswell because I have liked their products for so long, but either on their end or the seller's, a BAD product is being distributed!  I won't be able to bring myself to try this project again for a long time, if ever.

I made the mistake and purchased the duck. Although my dogs coat was very shiny her breath smelled like fish after eating and after awhile I cancelled my order. The smell was too much.  I will be trying the chicken instead.
This coffee is comparable to Illy which I also love.I needed a Decaf so I bought Alessi at my local grocery, however, it is much cheaper here!!

All I drink is decaf and I've tried several brands; Alessi is right at the top of my favorites list.  It's full-bodied, rich and smooth. A nice espresso that tastes wonderful.  I have tried Illy and do like that coffee, as well, but it isn't as full-bodied as Alessi, for me.  Different strokes for different folks and this brand strokes my palette, wonderfully.

I have found this to be an excellent decaf espresso.  I make it in a Bialetti stove-top coffee maker, or, when we have guests who are not espresso types, we make it in a coffee-filter drip machine.  People like it. You can't tell it's decaf--until you go to bed.  You sleep.

This Alessi decafeinated expresso is perfectly wonderful.  It makes a very nice expresso, but if you love strong coffee, it is also very good as regular coffee.  Just measure it as you would any other coffee and use it in your automatic drip coffee maker or French Press.  You won't be disappointed in this product.

My husband and I ran out of Illy and decided to give the Alessi decaf espresso a try since it was much cheaper... what a mistake! It was REALLY bad. No comparison whatsoever to the Illy decaf we'd had before. So we threw out the one can we'd opened, and I think I'll donate the other cans. What a big disappointment... we're back to the Illy now.

I have used Alessi Decaffenated Caffe'Expresso for years.  It is sometimes difficult to find at local gracery stores and specility coffee stores are far too expensive.  It makes great expresso and excellent caffe' latte. The price on Amazon is excellent.  I buy it in a pack of six and price is even better.

If you want great great tasting coffee than look no farther. I use this in a MoccaMaster coffee maker.  You will use less coffee than with regular ground coffee.  You can use it to make espresso strength coffee then add your favorite flavoring or ice cream. I buy both Decaf and Regular.  I will not drink any other coffee now!

Alessi coffees bring a little Italy to our home.  They are great.  We enjoy mid morning and mid afternoon coffee time.  We brew two pots; one regular and one decaf and we can both relax with the finest of coffees.
My husband & I bought 5 cases of this.It is a good way to save money,& buying this item in the store cost more,buying in bulk is a better way to shop,save & stock up.
It's a buy! And since you can't buy larger containers of this I see this as an excellent buy. I'll be back next month for more!

Me and my husband go through this pretty quickly since we drink a lot of coffee in our house. I love that its so inexpensive seeing as in the stores its almost $4 each. or more. It is delivered pretty quickly too.

If you like flavored coffee creamer, Coffee Mate is the best.  I've been using the flavored Coffee-Mate products for years.  I've used the store brands, but they're just ok in my opinion.  Not as rich and and not as flavorful.Of course the big plus for store brands is that they are usually 1/2 the price of Coffee Mate.  I work from home, and I drink alot of coffee, so when I found this bulk discount on Amazon, I jumped on it.  Best of both worlds (quality and price.

This coffee creamer is so delicious! I use it in my coffee, my ice cream recipes, my pudding and cake recipes. It adds a wonderful flavor. I like it much better than the liquid version. I am thrilled to have found it in bulk form like this. The cost savings is terrific along with free shipping. (I am an Amazon Prime customer.)Can't beat that! Shipping is so fast, that it seems like I just ordered it and already it is here. Seems like no waiting at all. I love shopping with Amazon and will be a lifetime customer. Thanks Amazon!!!

It is Coffee-mate French Vanilla, what more can I say?  The yummy Coffee-mate you know and love comes in a shrink-wrapped flat of 12 conveniently sized 15-ounce containers.  You will smell the vanilla before you even open the box!  The creamer was fresh and packaged well and it arrived quickly too.  We are very happy!

I enjoyed the flavor, stronger buckwheat taste. I was used to milder flavor like Aunt Jemima used to make, but they quit making theirs over 10 years ago so don't make the mistake of picking a brand shown on line that no longer makes it. Bob's Red Mill makes a milder version similar to the Aunt Jemima. keep in mind that one bag of this brand doesn't make a lot so order a couple bags to have enough for a family breakfast.

I made these pancakes and thought they were a bit salty, but I made a smaller than usual batch since I was the only one eating them and didn't want to make a large quantity.. They were good, and next time I might add a bit of sugar to the mix or a banana for sweetness.  Good mix though!

Nice package, tastes o.k. Needs a little sweetner, like Splend or Stevia. It would probably make better waffles due to consistency. It is very good for you. This company has a wide variety of products.

I purchased the 4 oz size, and it arrived with a few sample packs of other salts as well. This stuff tastes very good, and is hot, although in my opinion, it wont kill you like other ghost pepper oriented products might. I've been using it on eggs and also threw some in with my beer when making brats the other day. Both have been excellent uses. I would say use it sparingly, especially if you are sensitive to heat, but the flavor is good and the extra kick is nice. A definite winner IMO.

I ordered a one pound package for my Dad this Christmas, so I can't really comment on the flavor yet, though my Dad has liked pepper flavored salt before.  However, I was very impressed with the speed with which The Spice Labe sent it.  I was also expecting to get a sigle large box or bag, like you'd see on a store shelf.  Instead, the salt came in eight 2oz. vacuum sealed, durable plastic bags, so I know that the salt will maintain its freshness no matter how long it takes for my Dad to get through it.  Very nice.  Also, they included several differnt little sample packets so I could try some of their different flavors of salt without having to order tons of it.  My package included a sampler of himalayan sea salt (larger chunks), french grey salt, himalayan salt (with crystals sized like table salt, hickory smoke salt, and habañero salt.  Very cool.  I will be getting more stuff from them.ADDENDUM 12/26:  About flavor:  my Dad says this salt tastes better than other ghost pepper salt he's tried.  He attributes it to both a better product and better packaging (see my above comments).

I love this as a finishing salt. It's pretty spicy, but not uncomfortably spicy.  We really enjoy using this on a variety of meals.  It may be too spicy for those who are not used to spicy foods.  Makes a great gift as well!
Fresh taste with the flavor of the peppers and aroma very strong. Good product if you like heat. Use for BBQ seasoning.

column9: Nice taste, not that hot though
column10: I just received the spice bottle of this ghost pepper salt. Large crystals like you'd expect from sea salt, infused with ghost pepper. I put in a pepper grinder and seasoned some deep fried french fries. Adds a nice flavor and a little bit of kick. I'd say hot store bought mass produced salsa is hotter. Flavor is great though, and I would buy again. If you want something really hot, look elsewhere. If you want nice flavor with a little kick this is a great product.

I felt it was very good but not great. I recently purchased a similar product from The Spice and Tea Exchange in Tarpon Springs, FL. Their product has a fresher taste and smell.If you're a heat freak like me don't be misled by "Hot! Hot!". More of a medium heat but the flavor is good.I will place another order simply to determine if I was unlucky and received a package which had been sitting around a while.UPDATE: My second order was perfect. Brett took a personal intrest to make certain I was completely happy. Still not as hot as I would like, but I will order again.

I absolutely love this product and fine myself putting it on a great number of foods.  My only complaint is it isn't quite as hot as I'd like so you end up making your food a bit too salty to get the desired amount of heat.  Still, a great addition to your spice cabinet.

column9: Can't go wrong with Demae Ichou Ramen
column10: You can never go wrong with the Nissin Demae Ichou brand ramen. I lived in Kyushu for many years and this reminded me of Hakata ramen. I'm glad I got this but I wasn't happy with the batch I got thats going to be expired in one month. It will take me a while to finish the whole box (I don't eat ramen everyday)! If you plan on buying instant food online, you should definitely contact the seller about the expiration date.

While I was in Japan I had the chance to taste real Tonkotsu ramen, I must say it's the most delicious soup I have ever had, I live in Peru so I am used to good cuisine, but none can get close to Tonkostsu. I am not able to find a Ramen House here here so I decided to try this, it is really good, they have made it very similar to the real one, I purchased several packed pork ramen and this is one of the best I could find. You got to try this, I am not kidding, it's very good, specially if you add some Nanani Togarashi to it, uhmmm, I will make one right now !!!!

We used to have another brand tonkotsu flavor noodle imported from Japan until a few years ago, but US has stopped importing any of them from Japan for some reasons.  So I was so happy when I finally found this product.  It is made in Hong Kong, but all of my family love the flavor and it tastes as good as Japanese tonkotsu noodle.  Strongly recommended.  You will enjoy it, too.
my father loves these hips and got me hooked on them aswell!! my father was super surprised when i gave it to him! thanks!

column9: Seneca Apple Chips $1.00--$2.49/bag retail. Why pay $4.00/?
column10: I love Seneca Apple Chips, so planned to buy in bulk and save $$. But at $4.00 per bag, I'd have to be crazy to order from this vendor. I pay $1.00 to $1.79 per bag at grocery stores, marked down from $2.49 suggested retail. I rate the chips 5 stars for taste and texture, 3 stars for fat content and 1 star for price.

This is a very lite sweet tasting cinnamon just as cardamom I was impressed by super fast shipping excellent packaging.I wanted to get true cinnamon from the source excellent product trying it with raw honey for my joints!!Wish me luck everyone.

I ordered 4 of the 2 packs and received only 4 packs.  So, while I love this ginger candy, I paid $27.00 for 4 small bags of candy.  This is misleading.  4 - 2 packs is a total of 8 packs not 4 packs.  Very unhappy.

Last time I got this candy from a local store and I loved it, it is great for sore throat and cold. But as the other reviewer said, the product description says 2, but I received only one..One pack for 6.99 is not the right pricing for this product, local store I got it for 3+$, so one for 7$ is double the price..I will demand them the second one, don't want to return and want the seller to find out where the issue is..

These are okay for a mass produced product frim a factory.  Nothing spectacular.Ordered direct from the company's web site. Faced w/ 3 confusing choices: ship & deliver ASAP, ship whenever, deliver in time for Christmas. I chose the first thinking it was the fastest. My items were not delivered until 12/27. When I contacted Swiss Colony, they said, "Too bad."Next time I'll get real petit fours shipped from an actual bakery.

These cakes are fairly exploding with flavor and the kids love making charts depicting which flavors can be found under the robes of confection.  We order these at nearly every special occasion.  One warning that merited knocking a star off is that there are invariably four or five within the box that are hard and dry within.  That's not very nice when serving these to guests and there is no way to tell just by looking at it.Also, my last batch had one whole flavor (the chocolate-robed with green diagonal stripes) where every one of them was dry.  It only happened once and my family loves these too much to knock it down another star for that.
The Petits Fours were excellent, moist and beautifully decorated. Great desert for a holiday buffet.  They also make a great hostess gift.
These Petits Fours have become a holiday tradition.  For at least five years, my now-seven-year-old granddaughter has looked forward to selecting a "cakey" after dinner.  (:
I sent Swiss Colony's petits Fours as a gift to my cousin and she loved them (as I knew she would).

I bought this to dip by french bread or italian bread. It is very good for that. Has a nice garlic flavor. You can also cook with it, but I would rather save it as a dipping oil. I would purchase this again as the price is right. Usually good oils cost twice as much.

I'm very pleased with my Organic Lemon Extra Virgin Olive Oil which just arrived very fast and in great condition, and its wonderful oil  for many different uses. Last night I used it over steamed broccoli with some chopped up fresh mint from my garden, S& P, and some lemon juice, and I'll be using it in many other ways and in many different recipes as it adds a delightful taste, and the price was very reasonable also. I'll be buying a lot of more of this particular brand  as soon as I run low. This is a wonderful product.

This stuff rocks! It's organic with a light taste of garlic ... perfect on salads and pastas. Can't find the organic/garlic combo even at Whole Foods, so I buy 3 bottles at a time through Amazon to make sure I never run out.

I have tried many different brands of garlic-stuffed olives and of all of them the Mezzetta brand is by far my favorite. I'm not sure what is it that the other brands do differently, but Mezzetta uses very large green olives and the juice that they are stored in is probably what distinguishes them from others.If you have tried other brands and really didn't care for them that much, try this brand. I can't guarantee that you'll like them as well as I do, but they probably have a better chance of also being your favorite than most other brands. I could be wrong and there may be better brands, but I keep sampling every new brand that I come across and I just keep coming back to the Mezzetta brand of garlic-stuffed Olive. I go through at least one jar a month.
I can buy a jar at local mega store for almost half this price ? Though i will say I would not buy any other then the Mezzetta !! Love them .
