column9: TNX to Russell Stover for Making Chocolate Candy Economical
column10: For diabetics. It's hard to get reasonably priced sweets for diabetics in chocolate. Hope they can continue to find a way. Too bad customers give sugar-free splenda chocolate such a bad rep. so the grocery stores won't stock them at a reasonable price.

column9: Best stuff on earth...but it's not "hot chocolate" only
column10: At the time of this review the title notes that this is a "hot chocolate tin" while it can easily be made into "hot chocolate" the buyer should know this is unsweetened cocoa...not a hot chocolate mix.  BUT...that said...Coming from a household of two foodies, two gourmet cooks (one a trained chef) and chocolate LOVERS...if you have yet to replace whatever cocoa you are using  with Scharffen berger, best do so now. :-)  Ohhhh this stuff is the best.I actually read about this cocoa, cough cough, in People Magazine about 10 years ago and was intriqued due to the level of true cocoa bean in it...unlike any other so called "gourmet" cocoa.  At that time I couldn't find it anywhere and had to order it from the company. Now I find it in some grocery stores...unfortunately just the "upscale" or "all natural ones"..not a bad thing, but I don't shop there every week, so not a good thing either for me at least if you are trying to find it locally.  I hope to see it more mainstream soon.Because we are foodies, if we like something at a restaurant it's not uncommon for us to wind up talking to the manager or chef about ingredients that stand out. In the past 3 years when I have asked about a chocolate dessert I think only once were they not using this.Is it great as hot cocoa? Sure...but that is SO limiting its use. I just use it for any recipe calling for cocoa.Negative: I have no negative on taste or quality and ratio of real cocoa used...that can't be beat. However, the price is higher...I'd rather have it in a less fancy tin and kick it down a notch on price...but I pay it and so does anyone else I know into baking...so maybe they don't have to consider that...still, it is higher so I have to grumble SOME...

This s truly the best cocoa powder on the market.  It is so rich and not at all bitter.  You can stir this into a cup of yogurt and it barely needs to be sweetened b/c it's not bitter.  It's the first choice for serious foodies and gourmands :)
I love that this cocoa is all natural and has added health benefits.  I sprinkle it on almost anything I can - pancake, waffle, oatmeal, etc. Just wish it wasn't so pricey for the amount you get.
I use this solely for baking. It makes the best icings, brownies, and so on. If you try it once, you'll never go back to Hershey's again.
I love having good cocoa powder and this makes great cocoa, brownies, cakes, etc.  Better than grocery store cocoa.  I keep Scharffen Berger Cocoa in my pantry.

column9: Not as good as it was
column10: I've now bought three 2 kilo boxes of Scharffen Berger unsweetened cocoa powder and drank them all as hot cocoa, a little each morning over a long period. The first two boxes were great, but the third box was quite a bit weaker and sweeter, as if they were trying to make up for lost quality by sneaking a little sugar in.Anyway, I'm not happy with Scharffen Berger cocoa powder anymore. I'm looking for alternatives.

I wasn't too satisfied with the roast date on the bag being more than a month old. If they are freshly restocked I would expect a roast date within a week or two. That being said the French Roast was pretty solid. It was not overly roasted like other french roasts. If the beans were fresh I would probably give the beans 5 stars. Next time I will pay the extra money and get the beans fresh from Intelligentsia's website.

So, I like to try random sodas, esp. the random ones that yoou dont find everyday, while the picture shows certain ones, you're not guaranteed to get any of them, this is a great buy if youre wanting something different. I plan to buy multiples of this item, to try new flavors.

column9: How many bottles do you get?
column10: While this sounds like an excellent idea, I am perplexed by the fact that they promise 12 bottles and 17 are pictured ...

column9: Very Good but also Very Pricey
column10: Okay: just in case you're not familiar, a whisky cake is basically a fruit cake with a good swig of whisky thrown in for flavour. That's what we get here. I think the term "shortbread" is just used as part of the "Walker's Shortbread" brand, because as far I noticed, there was nary a trace of anything even remotely like shortbread to be found.As fruit cakes go, this one is defintiely top of the range. It's a great cake. I confess my own pallet is nowhere near refined enough to specifically identify Glenfiddich as the whisky used, but hey, yours may differ.But yes, as fruit cakes go, this is definitely a five star one. No question. Hence the rating. On the other hand, it is also a very expensive one. If I were going to factor "value for money" into my rating, I'd probably knock it down to just four stars.One final thought: the tin in which this cake is comes is a nice and enduring one, and the lid is not of the type that is damaged when removed. So hey, as an added bonus you also get something pretty in which to store buttons, loose change, or whathaveyou. If you're like me, the tin will still be around for many years after the cake is long gone.Theo.

The first cake that arrived was so dry and somewhat stale-tasting as to be inpalatable. It was replaced after a phone call to Amazon. The second one was also dryer than it should have been, but judicious use of rum applied over a couple of months rendered it an interesting dessert.

I do a great deal of online ordering, and I have to say the Walkers Shortbread Glenfiddich Whiskey cake was the biggest disappointment.  Reading the ingredients, one would expect a refined flavor of shortbread and Scotch whiskey.  I expected a bit of buttery flavor with the shortbread in the ingredients.  What I received was a rather small round tin with a fruitcake inside that tasted exactly the same (we did a taste test) as the $1.00 fruit cake purchased at Fred's dollar store.  Visual comparison revealed no discernable difference between the Glenfiddich cake and the Fred's Dollar Store cake.  I expected a better product for the money, and did not receive it.  I am so disappointed.
I recommend this peppermint extract.  I make peppermint cookies and patties for my family and friends with this product and I continually receive compliments for the delicious minty flavor.

column9: Not Pure at all, Content 83% Alcohol
column10: I am very disappointed by this product. Star Kay White is claiming to sale 4 oz of Pure Peppermint Extract. In fact it is 83% alcohol by volume. when you buy this product you are buying 3.32 oz of alcohol and only .124 oz of peppermint Extract (3.12% as labelled on the bottle). The water must account for 13.8%.The product is weak and diluted, not good for my uses. I don't need the alcohol nor the water. If you call this pure is must be pure 100% or change the label and publish the details on the site to reflect the true content of the product you sale.Thanks for reading.Michel Gerard

People seem to get EXTRACT and PURE OIL confused. Alcohol has to be added because it literally brings the flavor out of the small quantity of peppermint leaves that were actually used. If you don't want a product with alcohol then purchase the oil since they're usually 100% pure, nobody's forcing anyone to get the extract. But anyway, I used this along with cinnamon oil to make toothpicks, this flavor is very potent (No weak, sugary stuff here) It's so potent that I had to make my cinnamon and peppermint toothpicks in two different areas of the kitchen, or else the flavors and scents will overlap eachother and you will have a cinnamon/peppermint tasting toothpick. This also feels amazing when mixed with lotion. Why pay nearly 10 bucks for some goldbond when you can put a teaspoon of this in your $2.00 lotion and feel that instant tingle. You can even soak the head of your toothbrush in it and it lasts for several brushings. All in all, great buy; but please know...THIS IS THE EXTRACT!!! The company that makes these products doesn't deserve the bad reviews based on people's inability to decipher the two. Once again, this product IS THE EXTRACT!!!
What the information fails to mention is that the majority of the product is alcohol, and a small amount of extract.
The burgers taste like fresh not frozen.  They are not loaded with water so they stay big and tasty. I will order them again.
I love these and have purchased several orders over the last 2 years. The 8 oz size is just right for me and I grill them. I've never been disappointed with these.Will order many more.
These burgers were good.  Not great not horrible just basic.  Didnt taste frozen so that was good.  I wouldnt bother ordering them I would just buy local instead.

column9: stale and crystallized, not as chewy as they should be
column10: These Sweet Tarts Shockers I recently got are unfortunately stale and crystallized -- not as chewy as they should be.  The colors are also bleached out and not as bright as fresh Shockers.

If love TART candy - this is for you.  It is a sour, chewy version of 'SweeTarts' but NOT soft like taffy.  From a size perspective, each piece is much larger than a 'SweeTart' sort of on the order of those chewy mints with the name like 'M---os'.This product used to be sold under the SweeTarts brand by the Nestle Company as 'ShockTarts'.  Then it was sold as a Wonka Candy Company product.THE ONLY PROBLEM: Shockers/ShockTarts are no longer made.  If you love 'em - get them while you can!
A candy that is hard to find....but in high demand by my teen!Thanks for the quick shipping, I will be ordering more soon.
The drug stores and supermarkets in our area no longer carry this item.  I was happy to find my sons favorite candy.

the shockers were a little hard, but still had their great taste.They came very fast, I ordered them on Thursday and they they shiped on Friday.I got them on Monday.The shockers were very good but a little hard.They were good for hte price. I would recommend this product,because you could end up with a very bad and stale product from somewhere else.Buy this iteam.

These are food service packs of one pound of the crumbs and broken pieces of the small snack-sized Nutter-Butter cookies. They are wonderful on ice cream. I just got a case of them (36 packs) for 33 cents each at the 99-Cent Store. $9.99 each seems a bit pricey comparatively.

column9: Dogs Love it!  And it's Good for Them, too.
column10: My dog would eat these all day long if he could.  He loves them.  Gets all bouncy and happy when he sees me getting one out for him.  They only last about 6-8 minutes, but I have a large dog who is a healthy chewer.  I feel good giving him this treat because of the ingredients, and because it's made in the USA!  Recommended, though a bit pricey.  I love my dog, so he's worth the cost.

column9: good for occupying for short periods
column10: These are a good edible chew that keep my extreme chewer busy for a decent amount of time. Do they calm? I'm not so sure. But I'll continue to buy them.
My dogs' absolutely loves these. -And I love the fact that they are not Rawhide, but still last them a while.  They are pricey, though--so always wait until they are on sale.

My dog LOVES these bones.  I haven't used them long enough to see if they will have a positive effect on tartar on his teeth, but breaking these bones down requires a lot of gnawing which in turn should be effective for tartar control.  I love that they contain minimal ingredients and I know EXACTLY what my do is eating when I give him one of these bones.

My groomer turned me on to these for teeth cleaning. My 2 shih-tzu's LOVE them! They go nuts when I reach for the bag. one a day is recommended, however, at this price x 2, that can't happen. This is the best price on line, even cheaper if you sign up for auto delivery.

These are wonderful for our dog's teeth, ingredients are nutritious and she really loves them. It's hard to find products anymore that work and have these kind of ingredients that are actually good for our pets. The only reason I don't give them 5 stars is because of the price.

My dog loves these treats...She actully expects them...she likes them so much she goes and sits where there at everyday and looks at them quickly...then back at you until she gets one ...best treat i've ever found too that doesn't cause my dog to itch...no corn or wheat...great product.
This product is excellent in coffee, plain yogurt, on fruit, and many other things as a calorie free topping or addition.

We made shredded chicken and cheese enchiladas with this sauce for our new years eve party, and everyone enjoyed it, many had seconds.  Very yummy!  A smoother overall flavor than most other enchilada sauces (it doesn't have that harshness that many sauces do), but at the same time it has a good depth of flavors.  We'll definitely be having this sauce again!

Not wanting to use the canned enchilada sauce I search my local (amazing) Nugget Store for a new brand.  I tried Amelia's and have not been disappointed.  The enchiladas I make with this sauce taste so much better.  My family loves it!

If you want tasty chocolate pudding with great texture, you can't beat this product.  (I prefer it to Jell-0 Chocolate Fudge for true chocolate flavor.)  Does require close attention while cooking, as all cook-and-serve pudding products, but is SOOOOO much better than the instant variety.

column9: Jell-O Cook & Serve Pudding & Pie Filling
column10: I purchased both Jell-O Cook & Serve Pudding & Pie Filling, Chocolate Fudge and the Chocolate only. I prefer the cooked version - it seems to have more body & flavor. I use DRY MILK - and contrary to the instructions does not thin out. Plus, if concerned about 'thinness' adjust the amount of water, using less in the beginning, while cooking to get a thicker pudding. I would recommend this product to anyone who wants to have a delicious cup of pudding. The time spent in cooking is well worth the effort.

column9: Great tooth candy!! Not too much Xylitol!
column10: My grandson HAD Early Childhood Caries [ECC] and so we started giving him  Xylitol products. SPARX candy was what we started him on [along with SPRY gum]; from there he's graduated to a stronger Xylitol candy.BUT his baby sister cannot handle the stronger stuff, so she now she gets SPARX Berry candies. It's perfect for her.And my grandson's little cavities have all remineralized or been arrested! SPRY stuff has my 1000% rating! Great Stuff!

I am never without some form of xylitol candy in my house because it helps us stay healthy (see the research on using xylitol to reduce strep and other infections), and it's a yummy health sugar-free option when you need a bit of sweetness after a meal.

Tastes get and good for your teeth too. I was able to find these locally at Vitamin Shoppe along with the gum. Def. worth trying, love the taste! I wish it had more Xylitol in it though or larger mints/candies for adults, this seems to be marketed for kids but I love this stuff only wish they were large with more Xylitol.

column9: Tasty Candy. Hard not to eat too much
column10: The taste, at first, is great. However, if you have a sweet tooth, and havnt had any real sugar in a long time, you may be tempted to over indulge. I could easily have eaten a whole tube at a sitting. This would be a mistake on 2 levels.There is some magical balance, where you can eat more than their specified serving and have no ill effects. However, if you have one too many, bam, your going to have some digestive tract issues that you may not enjoy. A few times I managed to tip over that balance, since i bought all 3 flavors. Speaking of which, I found that their various flavors are not terribly distinctive from each other.The second level of mistake is that as you have more the flavor begins to wear on you. My wife ate too many right out of the chute, and now cannot stand the smell of these things. It took me about 2 tubes over a couple to get to that point where I felt obligated to eat them, having paid good money for them, but didnt really want them anymore. I like candy, so I would eat them again, were the presented. But its going to be a while before I would actively go buy any again.
My grandkids and I love these little berry flavored candies. They are just like the ones we got in Japan. We love them!
I only buy xylitol sweetend candy and gum for dental health. We love these little fruit flavored candies and my grandkids think they are a real treat!

I purchased the 4 oz size, and it arrived with a few sample packs of other salts as well. This stuff tastes very good, and is hot, although in my opinion, it wont kill you like other ghost pepper oriented products might. I've been using it on eggs and also threw some in with my beer when making brats the other day. Both have been excellent uses. I would say use it sparingly, especially if you are sensitive to heat, but the flavor is good and the extra kick is nice. A definite winner IMO.

I ordered a one pound package for my Dad this Christmas, so I can't really comment on the flavor yet, though my Dad has liked pepper flavored salt before.  However, I was very impressed with the speed with which The Spice Labe sent it.  I was also expecting to get a sigle large box or bag, like you'd see on a store shelf.  Instead, the salt came in eight 2oz. vacuum sealed, durable plastic bags, so I know that the salt will maintain its freshness no matter how long it takes for my Dad to get through it.  Very nice.  Also, they included several differnt little sample packets so I could try some of their different flavors of salt without having to order tons of it.  My package included a sampler of himalayan sea salt (larger chunks), french grey salt, himalayan salt (with crystals sized like table salt, hickory smoke salt, and habañero salt.  Very cool.  I will be getting more stuff from them.ADDENDUM 12/26:  About flavor:  my Dad says this salt tastes better than other ghost pepper salt he's tried.  He attributes it to both a better product and better packaging (see my above comments).

I love this as a finishing salt. It's pretty spicy, but not uncomfortably spicy.  We really enjoy using this on a variety of meals.  It may be too spicy for those who are not used to spicy foods.  Makes a great gift as well!
Fresh taste with the flavor of the peppers and aroma very strong. Good product if you like heat. Use for BBQ seasoning.

column9: Nice taste, not that hot though
column10: I just received the spice bottle of this ghost pepper salt. Large crystals like you'd expect from sea salt, infused with ghost pepper. I put in a pepper grinder and seasoned some deep fried french fries. Adds a nice flavor and a little bit of kick. I'd say hot store bought mass produced salsa is hotter. Flavor is great though, and I would buy again. If you want something really hot, look elsewhere. If you want nice flavor with a little kick this is a great product.

I felt it was very good but not great. I recently purchased a similar product from The Spice and Tea Exchange in Tarpon Springs, FL. Their product has a fresher taste and smell.If you're a heat freak like me don't be misled by "Hot! Hot!". More of a medium heat but the flavor is good.I will place another order simply to determine if I was unlucky and received a package which had been sitting around a while.UPDATE: My second order was perfect. Brett took a personal intrest to make certain I was completely happy. Still not as hot as I would like, but I will order again.

I absolutely love this product and fine myself putting it on a great number of foods.  My only complaint is it isn't quite as hot as I'd like so you end up making your food a bit too salty to get the desired amount of heat.  Still, a great addition to your spice cabinet.

In case you haven't noticed, the manufacturer has recently changed the concents of the cans of the fish and shrimp feast.  Much more fish scraps and water, and correspondingly less fish meat, which I'm sure increases their profit margin, but it's not as good for the cats.  Our cats used to really like it, too, but not any more.

Flaked Fish and Shrimp most likely has the best ingredients in Fancy brand.  As another review pointed out, it's 15% more protein.  Not only that, if you look at the ingredients list, you can see "Ocean Fish, Fish Broth, Shrimp" at the top of the list.  The rule is that higher percentage component in the food goes first.  Having ocean fish and shrimp is great, as opposed to "liver or meat-by-product".  In fact, there is no meat-by-product in the list.Of course, it's also that my cat likes to eat this. Therefore, I subscribe to this on Amazon as my cat's regular meal.

I was a long term subscriber  on the Amazon plan for Fancy Feast Fish and ShrimpI just cancelled my subscription today.Let me start out by saying Amazon is top notch with their program of subscribe and saveWhich is why I placed it at two stars.However I would like to know what the Friskies corporation DID with this product....I think that there has been a change to the formula.It now stinks so badly my cat who is not overly fussy and ate this flavor happily and eagerly for 3 years and now will not even touch this stuff!! She is a healthy 3 year old cat, who loved her Fancy Feast treat.And I noticed the change when serving it to her with the horrid almost rancid over-fishy smell and texture within the last month or so.And yes, while I realize, that it is a fish and shrimp mix and will smell somewhat the smell seems now completely atrocious.My guess is that the company started using a lower grade of product.I put this review out here to see if anyone also has encountered this with this product recently also??So I was resigned to cancelling my subscription- Again through no fault of AmazonAnd I now ordered from Amazon,  "Halo Spot's Stew" Crab, shrimp, and chicken flavor mix canned cat foodAnd I will see how that goes...Just wanted to leave my feedback on my disappointment on what this product has seemed to become.

I have two diabetic cats and this is one of their favorite flavors.The price here on Amazon was very good and I thought it would be nice and convenient to have it shipped to my home.I received the case quickly and it was packed well.However when I opened the first can I noticed that the "meat" was much darker than the cans I purchase locally. My cats would not eat any of the Amazon Cans.I purchased some locally to check to see if perhaps my cats had tired of this flavor. They quickly devoured the local cans. The dates were good on the Amazon cans so that was not the issue.Anyhow, I am going to cancel my subscription for this product.

Fancy Feast Fish & Shrimp once was the number one favorite in our multiple cat household, but no longer.  As a matter of fact, our cats are walking away from most of the Fancy Feast selections they used to gobble up, returning to eat their food as a last resort only if we don't have fresh turkey or chicken to give them.  What has changed about the recipe, and can we expect it to return to its original formula in the future?  We're searching now for a replacement.

column9: Still wheat & meat-free, but lots more water-weight
column10: This is the only Fancy Feast recipe that I buy, as it is free of grains and meat by-products, but the quality has taken a hit.  Some of the fish chunks are so dense that I can imagine they dried on the deck of some ship before being rehydrated during the cooking process.  The cans are so full of "broth" that I need to be careful where I open them, preparing to clean up the inevitable spill.  This never used to happen; it is due to the much-higher proportion of water to solid food in the can.This food has gone from a special treat to a Fancy Feast in name only.

I would NOT recommend this cat food as a small sharp fish bone...sharp on 4 sides got stuck in my cats throat and thank god she finally got it out!  This could have really hurt her internally if it would have gone down her throat.

This is one of the highest protein canned cat food out there as I found out through a recent web search.  My kittens love it, and it is a great price-comparable to Wal-Mart or other discount stores when you do the Subscribe and Save.  I am very satisfied with the quality of this product, along with the price and the fact that it is delivered right to my door!

I have 6 cats.The one cat is very picky and it took me many tries to find a flavor she would eat.This is the kind she would eat.However,the last 2 cases,she will not eat.I have opened cans from each case, only to find she turns away from it! I went to the local grocery store and bought 2 cans to see if there is any difference.The ones from the grocery store have a better color and is not all watery.She ate both cans I opened.I don't know what is wrong with the last 2 cases I ordered from Amazon but I am cancelling any future orders.I think it is rancid.I tried to get one of the other cats to eat some and they too,would not touch it!I am not going to take a chance and get them sick! No more FANCY FEAST FLAKED FISH AND SHRIMP from Amazon.I am terribly disappointed that they would send me this rancid cat food.

This is a great product but unfortunately the price has continued to rise.  It is now cheaper for me to buy this product at Walmart ($13.63 including tax) for a package of 24 instead of paying the $14.44 (Subscribe & Save).  When I add my $1 coupon the price was $12.63.  The price of this product on Amazon used to be $11.12 less than 6 months ago.  Since then it has continued to increase and has gone up by 29.86%.  I rated this product a 2/5 due to the high price and the unreasonable increase in price over the past 6 months.  I will buy again if the price goes down to that of Walmart.-JON-

column9: Cats like it but don't "see" the sodium nitrate.
column10: First ... this is one of the Fancy Feast dinners my cats like. And I appreciate the fact that I can identify the ingredients visually.Printed here is the list of ingredients, finally in type I can read without a magnifying glass. I did not know they add sodium nitrate, which is carcinogenic. I have had three of my cats over the years die of cancer. Most of the tumors were in the stomach.I can see that the food looks like food, and it is acceptable regardless of how "red" it looks. To add sodium nitrate to a catfood, when the cats only care about the smell and condition, is simply endangering the life of a pet. Animals have difficulty enough. I still buy this, but not very often. At least it does not have animal or fish byproducts. But I will add an anti-angiogenesis product to their diet in hopes it will counteract the nitrates, at least until I can either find a product I can trust or start cooking for them myself.

Omar, the 18-year old diabetic tomcat who is the love of my life, has no front teeth and this is the only thing he'll eat besides treats. Even though it's a bit more expensive - I can never find more than 3-4 cans at the grocery, so, with Amazon Prime, this really saves me time. Thanks!

I think this is one of the best fancy feast flavors, and probably the best bang for the buck sweet spot when taken into consideration the following:1. available on subscribe and save2. Ingredient list(real ingredients listed first)3. priceI've noticed over the months that the consistency of the "goop" inside has changed. I'm not sure if they have changed up the recipe or what, but I haven't noticed anything else.

column9: excellent quality at an aforadable price!
column10: I usually purchased this food from petfooddirect.com, but I have to say that Amazon.com sells fresher food than petfooddirect.com.  The food in the can looks as if it was just recently canned.  It's very flaky with whole pieces of shrimp in it, and my cat eats it like it's going out of style! The food is nutritionally sound. If you allow Amazon.com to ship it to you with regularity you save even more money, just twelve dollars and change for a case of 24 and free shipping too!  All of petfooddirect's promotional codes still doesn't allow you to get the food freely shipped, and the same goes for petco.  The cost of shipping is really ridiculous!The price of flaked cat food is so expensive.  Fancy feast sells food called 'Fancy feast appetizers' that sell for $1.25+ and you get so little in the container! My cat loves them but they cost so much and you're getting less than 2 ounces in the little plastic container.  I'm afraid that I've begun to buy human tuna at my store for my cats since it's on sale all the time, mostly at 99cents per can, (particularly Bumble Bee chunk white tuna).  You get more in the can for less money.  The chunk light tuna is better than chunk white tuna and has less exposure to mercury which of course is the healthiest for both humans and cats alike.I also buy Bumble Bee canned Salmon and I give my cat just a little from it every day while refrigerating the rest in a little garlic powder and spring water and my cat loves it!  My cat loves the fish juice so I add a good amount of spring water to the salmon that I refrigerate in a Tupperware-like container I purchased from QVC(some plastic containers have a chemical-like odor that are not healthy for use so I never buy them).  The Bumble Bee Salmon also has bones in it that are edible(very crunchy).  Tuna in general & most de-boned fish are low in vitamin E, calcium, sodium, iron, copper and many other vitamins(according to pet specialists) but the Bumble Bee Salmon has bones and skin in it (with all that good fish oil in the skin)for the cat's coat.  I can get Bumble Bee Salmon on sale for $1.99 a can and sometimes less at stores like CVS, Walgreens & RiteAid and it's much cheaper to feed my cat this food than to buy him canned cat food that can make you go broke.  But, the only canned cat food that I can recommend in terms of affordability and excellent quality is Fancy Feast's Fish & Shrimp, may they never stop making it!
is higher than my local Wegmans.  There is no incentive to order here, pay more and wait for it to arrive when I can drive three minutes and get it cheaper.

column9: I  just love the flaked fish and shrimp feast!!!
column10: I am a female feral kitty that lives outside...on and around... my Mom and Dad's deck...actually for 5 years now.My Mom and Dad have tried many different foods on me....this is my #1 choice.Thank you...Fancy Feast...for such wonderful food~Meow....ppppuuuuurrrrrrrrrrr....Ms. Kitty :)
My three cats are very opinionated.  And, they change their minds frequently.  This flavor of Fancy Feast has remained in favor for several weeks.  It must be something special!
This doesn't even look like cat food.  There are large pieces of fish and shrimp in this, so I feel good giving it to my cat.  He loves it and has been eatting it for over 3 years :)

column9: Will be willing to eat for $35
column10: I try to choose wet food for my cat that i would be willing to eat if someone bet me $50 or less to. For the record i'm a very picky eater.There's some gross brown stuff in here that makes it borderline, but it smells like a can of tuna, and the texture is pretty similar. If i closed my eyes, and mixed some mayo in it, and slapped it between wonder bread, i'd be willing to eat it for at least $35. But for the price, and the quality of the food (whole chunks of fish, shrimp as you can see from my photo), this is a great deal. It gets a standing ovation from both Zeroichi and I.

column9: My cat's favorite canned food no more
column10: This last batch of 24 cans was different in texture and quality. Not flakes, more like mush. My cat doesn't like it anymore.My cat loves this flaked fish, and fish is the first ingredient. Sometimes local stores are out of this product. Also this is a great price.

column9: Top Notch Food For The Price
column10: As others have pointed out, this may well be the best cat food available from Fancy Feast.  Most of the foods you buy today have fillers, corn, and other by products that your cats don't  need and are not good for them.  This has fish and shrimp with no grains or fillers. For the money, this can't be beat.  And Amazon's S&S makes the deal even better.  I have a hard time finding it at supermarkets or WalMart, never seems to be in stock.  Glad to see Amazon carrys it and also is part of subscribe and save.  Wish more products were like this.  Of course, the best cat food in the world is useless if your cat does not eat it.  My cat is finicky, she will eat most of this, but not all.  She will not touch other wet foods such as Natural Balance, Wellness Core or Chicken Soup for the Cat Lovers Soul. My second cat will not touch any wet food. They are excellent foods, but useless to me. I bought a case of one wet food and can't get her to eat any.  With this food, I bought a single can before committing to a case. I feed my two cats California Natural dry food. They both like it and no allergy problems.  Wish Amazon sold this as well, instead of third party vendors with high shipping costs.  Hard to find locally.

column9: best variety fancy feast for your cat
column10: fish & shrimp feast has the best ingredients of all their flavors, and my cats love it.  it is less rich than the other fancy feast cans, so they don't throw up after eating it.  ocean fish is the first ingredient - that's uncommon.  it also has more protein and no wheat gluten or corn starch modifier or meat/fish byproducts or soy protein concentrate or artificial flavors or salt or added color (red dye) like the other varieties have.and through Amazon.com you can schedule just once to get it cheaply delivered to your door automatically, every month with free shipping!  this product gets an A++++

wow, this is amazing food....ok, so i am a human writing this on behalf of my beloved snowshoe Mocha.  My Mocha is a loving female who doesnt care to eat...she would rather cuddle than eat.  LOL  She nibbles a few bites of her wet fancy feast food (she has tried the grilled and all of the classic variety packs Fancy feast) and few hours later comes back to eat a few more bites.  She does this about 3 times til there is none on her plate.  I only put about 1/3 of a can in her plate.Well, today is her first day eating this and gosh she almost ate it all!  she lapped up the food so greedily.  lol. I think this is Mocha's most favorite flavor of the Fancy Feast flavors so far!I like how the food smells like real fish (think:  canned tuna smell) and has actual fish meat even with the skin(!) which is the healthiest part of the fish!  i even see those tiny tiny brine shrimp here!  wow!  This is really the REAL stuff!  If you check out nutritional analysis, the crude protein is at least 17%---the highest of all Fancy feast variety!  I also like that there are NO ARTIFICIAL ANYTHING included in this flavor unlike most Fancy feast varieties out there.  :(my only negative is that there is a bit more broth than what i like there to be.....kind of like the grilled Fancy Feast (but a tad less).I do not have a problem with this item being 'product of Thailand'.....better than 'product of China' which i would never buy cat food from no matter what.Other than that, this is top notch stuff!PS;  less than 5 min later, Mocha returns to finish the rest of her meal.  ;)

My cats give this Fancy Feast offering a four paw rating!  It's one of the "healthier" flavors from Fancy Feast, and compares favorably in pet food reviews elsewhere with higher priced brands.  Have just switched my gang of nine to an all canned food regimen for health reasons, and this particular choice will be a regular offering on the menu.

I've done a lot of research on soft food for cats and this one actually makes the grade. Not all Fancy Feast flavors can boast that, but this one can. I highly recommend it. There are real fish and shrimp chunks. I feel like my cats are eating better than me most days.

column9: Our picky kitties love Fancy Feast Flaked Fish & Shrimp Feast!
column10: Our kitties are 14 years old and very particular about their meals.  They love Fancy Feast Flaked Fish & Shrimp Feast.  Unlike many other Fancy Feast canned flavors, this one does NOT contain any added glutens, just fish, shrimp and the neccessary vitamins and minerals to meet the standards for a complete balanced cat food.

Sunny is not a finicky kitty, but she likes this a lot.  For the cheaper brands, it is rated as one of the best varieties available.  When you open the can, it clearly looks and smells (quite strongly!) like real fish/shrimp.  No gelatinous oozing mass.Sunny slurps it up like mad, and I feel good giving it to her.
15%+ protein, that's twice what most Fancy Feast meals (and other pet store cat foods) have. This looks and smells like good cat food, and my cats gave it two claws way up. Good value.

column9: The ONLY flavor of THIS I will buy! No gluten or fillers!!
column10: I would not normally feed any cat Fancy Feast brand- gluten, byproducts &mystery meat is NOT healthy for ANY animal! If you have done research ( which u should!) on cat food ingredients, you would realize that your  hurting your cats w/that &in turn will spend much more $ on Vet bills than u would on "grain& gluten free" foods. However, THIS particular flavor has NO gluten &minimal filler if any. Also @17.5% PROTIEN it towers over most more expensive brands!! So this is a good pick at a resonable price for those who don't wish to spend, or cannot spend the $for the better brands. Ppl, our Pets are our Children, u wouldn't feed ur kids any old' junk so "RESEARCH" your brands ingredients! It's not all the same & it's not all marketing hype- I lost my beloved cat of 10 yrs to a sudden Diabetic COMA, DUE to her wet& dry FOOD ( which was "fancy feast"!) So if this saves 1loved companion, I'd be thrilled.. Btw-my cat had never once had any problems, in her 10 yrs.by the time she had any symptoms( which I now realize they WERE symptoms) the vet said " at the time the finnally show symptoms, it's generally too late! So just because your animal "seems" to love the food & show no problems, does not mean there aren't any :( . Hope this helps Someone~UPDATE:  2nd case I have received  & I must agree w/others- THIS FOOD HAS CHANGED!  My cats USE to love this flavor, now it's a can of soupy mush! Yuck! The all ( but 1of 6!) walk away & it ends up wasted!  I am canceling my Sub &save immediately .this stuff is gross &I will no longer feed any animals this. Please read NEWEST reviews , as this formula HAS CHANGED! Will not buy anymore. ;(

column9: Dont buy if you value your cat's life
column10: Used to be an excellent brand and my cat's favorite. Over time, quality declined, and recently, I find several large (close to 1 inch sometimes) fish bones in most cans. Very dangerous to a small animal like a cat especially given how excited they can be when eating, not paying attention to it. I am now picking through each can with a tooth pick for a couple minutes and cleaning bones out before I feed the cat (is that your idea of feeding?), and once i'm out of those, I will not buy them again.If I learn of any future improvement, I will update the review and score.

I am so picky about what I feed my cats, but my one super finicky cat will only eat this food when she is not feeling well.  She is the weakest of my 3 babies in that way and you know how it is...you do anything to make them feel better.  This has been on the shelf for several years now just for those times when she won't eat anything else...until today.  I opened a can from a new case of food and it was totally different than any other cans she has eaten.  Instead of nice white chunks of fish, it is mostly brown and smells awful...not spoiled, just different in a bad way.  She would not eat it!  The whole case is packed up to go back to the store and I will not buy it again.  She loves the Natural Value tuna with toppings too, so I guess that will have to suffice.  Very disappointing when they change a good thing!!

column9: Fail . . . used to be a fav!
column10: This used to be a good product, with small pieces of light tuna throughout the can, tiny shrimp on the very top and a bit of broth. Now it looks trashy. The fish is in big pieces and the pieces are raunchy and red looking. None of my cats will eat it even if I cut it up for them (yuck!). Since my cats used to love it so much, I bought another case a couple months later and it was the same thing.Since tuna for people comes in larger cans for about the same price as this, I don't understand why they had to stomp on the quality of this. I guess there's nothing that can't be made cheaper and worse! (Makes me wonder about their other food, too - because I can't tell as easily what they're doing to it when it's not whole food).Well, back to reading reviews again. Time to switch brands.

It's so easy to shop for my kitty.  I go on line and an entire box of 24 is here as quickly as Iwould have been able to go to the store.  I tried an experiment, I put  out three  fresh kitty cans, open, to see which one my littlePrecious would go to, and guess what, Flaked Fish and Shrimp evertime.  So what does that say?It was just a "sniff or two away"
This stuff blows my cat's mind. It smells disgusting, which I take as a good sign. My little guy seems to as well.  He LOVES it.  Highly recommend.
My cats love this one the best.  I like that it is "ALL" real fish and shrimp and not flavored soy products.

She loves it and really enjoys her food when she eats. When I popped the top,my cat starts meowing.Misty has had a stroke and can't come to her bowl so I am the one that feeds her in my lap and she eats out of her favorite bowl. I mix the dry with the Fancy Feast in a container whicn is stored in the fridge so that the dry will soften and will be ready for her to eat. It gives her extra vitamins and nutrition that she needs to build her muscles and bones. I cant find Fancy Feast at this price anywhere here at my location...Thank You Amazon for the offer to subscribe and save..

I haven't eaten this myself. But, my little spoiled and finicky three cats refuse to eat anything but. Amazon sends me three cases every two months.  It works for me; and the cats.  Not too fishy smell on their breathe after they eat. To make you gag. We recommend it!

On Wed morning I chose to stop hauling Fancy Feast home from the grocery store on a weekly basis.  I said, I bet Amazon can hook me up.  I subscribed Wed and the shipment arrived on Thurs (and they will keep coming once a month).  I'm delighted.
This is a good value, we save even more with scheduled monthly delivery. Really helps with a 4 cat family!

This cat food is perfect: I dont like giving my cats food that looks weird "pate" that you cant identify and such. This food you can see all the ingredients, it's literally little shrimp, pieces of fish and octopus. And they love it, win-win.

My kittens love this cat food.  My vet told me to not feed them a lot of fish, so I don't feed them this as often as they'd like.  When I do feed it to them, they eat every last bite.  The cans are easy to open, and there are chunks of fish, with at least one whole shrimp in each can, maybe more.  Unfortunately, this like all other food has gone up in price.

I don't know if I've been depriving my cats, but the first time I opened a can of this Flaked Fish & Shrimp Feast they were already swarming me.  I had to drop off the dish and back off quickly as they pounced and devoured the food.  Not a drop of seafoody goodness was left behind.

column9: love this Fancy Feast Fish and Shrimp Feast  <3  =^,,^=
column10: Converstaion overhead between my two cats, Rusty and Wilma....."Boy are we happy that Mom started buying our goodies from Amazon.  We love Fancy Feast Gourmet Cat Food, Flaked Fish & Shrimp Feast, 3-ounce cans (pack of 24) We never run out and it feels so comforting to see that spare case in the pantry.  Just in case we get a craving......."Seriously, speaking from the human point of view; it costs less to buy by the cases, and it saves the dreaded TRIP TO THE STORE FOR CAT FOOD.

column9: Feeding Kitty Made Easy and He Loves It
column10: I wanted to be sure I fed my new cat the healthiest food I could afford and with a good review from consumersearch.com and free auto shipping from Amazon, this flavor of Fancy Feast fit all the criteria.  Now I just pop the can and spoon it into his bowl and he is one happy critter!

My cats love this, and I started buying it because it got such great reviews on the cat food review sites. However, I was trying to save a little money so I bought the Fancy Feast Seafood Variety Pack because it was on sale. Big mistake. While my kitten, Idgie, will eat anything and gobbles the other stuff up, my adult cat, Josie, will not touch it. She turns her nose up and walks away. However she LOVES the Flaked Fish & Shrimp! So, I've now signed up for Subscribe and Save on this product and won't make the mistake of changing foods again. The girls get 1 can a day split between the two of them. Idgie will literally do somersaults when I bring out the can! It's worth a little extra money to make both my kitties happy, so it's now a "must have" in our home.

My cats love this Fish & Shrimp Feast. It is actually flaked fish with some tiny shrimp and nothing else.  Finally, some real cat food. This is a bargain for me because none of the grocery stores stock this flavor, including our local Sam's Club; coupled with free delivery and no sales tax--this is a true value-added bargain. We subscribed and found that once a month is too often, but once every two months is a perfect addition to the 36 can carton plus the 48 can case of Friskies we buy at Sam's. A subscription is wonderful when the big snows come to our mountains and we can't get out of the driveway!
I've read all reviews of cat food and this is the best for the price. AND my 3 cats love it. They hated the more expensive kind lucky for me

I have a diabetic cat that requires a special food.  I love not having to worry about the store not having enough for me or having to wrestle all those cans into my house.  They are neatly packed and arrive the first of month not to mention the little extra savings without postage.  This is just the best service I have signed up for.
My cats really love this.  I have 4 cats and this is by far their favorite.  My son-in-law is always telling me that my cats eat better than some people.
lille langtry, blue point siamese and hubbell gardner, seal point siamese, thrive on fancy feast flaked cat food....they r healthy happy felines...smile, so naturally, so am i......

column9: My cat loves this flavor! and there are no fillers
column10: My cat loves this flavor.  No fillers.  Just fish and broth.  Seems like a natural product compared to wet cat food with fillers like wheat gluten.  I think I will subscribe to get an even lower price!

column4: Colleen "If it's not fun, what's the point?"
column10: I could not find the mix for the Chappli Kabab here on amazon.com, so I wrote my review for this instead.  I live in a remote area of the wild west Rocky Mountains where Indian or Pakistani cuisine is completely non-existent in the form of a restaurant.  Purchasing a cookbook online, even our grocery stores don't sell the spices needed to create such dishes.I met a Pakistani woman on a flight from LA who introduced me to these Shan mixes.  She said they are very authentic, spicy.  All you need to add is the meat/vegies.  The instructions are printed in English on the back of the box and are easy to follow.  She sent me some and I tried them.  They are delicious.  And yes, SPICY!!!!  I was afraid to use the whole packet of spice for my chappli kabab, so I used 2/3's of it.  Even that much was alomst too spicy.  The flavor was magnificent.
I had this for lunch today and loved it.  My only complaint is that after cooking I found it a little too watery.  Next time I will add a tiny bit less water and I think it will be perfect.

This is by far my favourite readymeal rice!  I'm pretty picky when it comes to rice, and I love Indian food, so this is just perfect.  Some tips: the rice tastes better if you give it longer to set.  I like to make a bit early and let it sit for maybe an extra ten minutes while I'm doing other things.  And when you come back to it, the rice is at the perfect texture and the taste is richer and the heat stays well in the takeout box.  I'm so happy I can buy this in bulk now cause I could seriously eat this all day long.
I thought I would like this product because I like rice and I like raisins but I ended up throwing it all away.  Too much spice of some kind made it just nasty tasting.
Tiptree's mini black currant preserves are absolutely delicious!  The individual serving size ensures freshness each and every time!
having a jar of food in the refrigerator slowly deteriorating and taking up space?this excellent preserve in just the 'right size' wont disappoint you!perfect for a single serving.......

column9: I will not buy from any company supporting Rush!
column10: Since flowers are mostly bought either for or by women, it seems self destructive to support someone who denigrates your entire customer base.  Not all of us have bought into the conservative war on women's health led by Rush and his Republican cronies., nor will we continue to support companies that do.The personal attack made on a college student is unacceptable and I do not accept any apology from this misogynist bully.I imagine my daughter in this position and go ballistic! All women are someone's daughter, wife or mother. How would you feel if these comments were made about your wife, mother or daughter?Rush Limbaugh has been getting away with these kind of personal attacks for years... well no more.  The climate in this country is changing and we will not stand for this any more.
These bags are very cute and just what I hoped for for my wedding favors.  My only complaint is that they have a tail of loose threads hanging off them, but that should be easy to fix.

column9: Decent Tea - Even If Samples Are Random
column10: I converted to drinking only loose leaf tea last year and gave this gift pack a try. While it was decent, I have since had better and will probably not be ordering it again.For one, it is impossible to tell the age of the teas in the tins. For Pu-erh, that's not such a big deal, but for green teas and the Jasmine, you want normally want to get a batch that is a fresh as possible. PierMall is a big reseller of products from around the world, and there is no telling how long what you get had been sitting in some huge warehouse, slowly losing flavor. Another consideration is that you get a random sampling of Chinese teas, no the specific types that is implied by their Amazon listing. If you visit their website, you will see that they draw from this selection:* China Black Tea* Tiekuanyin (Iron Goddess of Mercy)* Oolong* Lung Ching DragonWell Green Tea* Yunnan Pu-erh* Jasmine Tea* White Tea* PuErh Tea with Chrysanthmum* Lychee Black Tea* Rose Black Tea* Rose Green Tea* Osthsmum Green TeaI don't know about you, but I'd like a little more certainty when buying a product. If you are new to tea and trying different varieties out, or are getting this as a gift, then it isn't such a big deal. Of what I received, the Oolong was the best. The Pu-erh was okay, though nothing special, and the Jasmine has a slight aftertaste, leading me to believe it was artificially flavored. Good Jasmine tea should be flavored by the scent of the flower, nothing else. The green and blacks were just okay.You could do worse if you were to buy teabags, but not much. I would recommend buying good loose leaf tea from dedicated tea vendors who are more upfront about what exactly they are selling you. At this price, you really can't expect to get quality tea. But if you are looking for an inexpensive gift for someone who doesn't know their tea, you could do worse. At least afterward you have some cute little tins in which to store future teas! It may cost a little more, but I think one would be much better served by ordering samples from a company like Heavenly Teas or Adagio.

I'm no tea expert. In fact I just started exploring all the tea varieties to cut back on the coffee I was drinking. I searched for 5 star teas based on other people's reviews. This one deserves the rating. It has a  full and pleasant flavor.

I am rather new to Tea, but this sampler is great way to discover and choose your favorites. The tins are packed with, in my opinion, good quality dry packed leaves, no stems or dust, or at least nothing I could complain on.Tins are clearly labeled, and the quick search for the labeled names on Wikipedia makes a great learning experience going along with the tasting as well.I'm on my second round thru 6 tins, and with each teaspoon making more than one cup of tea  by multiple steeping, I think these 6 tins may as well last for couple of months, much more than its "sample" title may reveal. For some teas, second steeping(s) may give a better or different quality than the 1st one - in any case it is a good experimenting exercise, along with water temperatures etc...If you want to "try and see... what is this tea thing all about", go for this sample package!

column9: Great Intro to Loose Tea - Reasonable Price and Good Quality
column10: I got this sampler because it came up after a search for Pu Erh.  People wrote that they didn't get certain types of tea listed, but I got all 6 as listed.  The tea is good quality, like everyday Chinese drink.  I ordered some Rishi Pu Erh as well, and I must say, Pier Mall doesn't market as well as Rishi, but the tea is much better quality, regardless of wheter it is "Kosher" or not.  That said, I bought other Jasmine Tea, which I initially preferred, but I saw that the leaf quality is better for this generic brand sent in the 6-pack and I have grown to appreciate the quality.  Each box is about 5-7 servings, and has a good pure leaf taste.  If I could get larger quantities wholesale, at a good price, I would buy this tea, because I think it is good quality and very drinkable, and at bulk, should be reasonably priced, as opposed to these overpriced places that sell tea at $6/ounce.  So far, the best tea I've ordered off of Amazon, along with the Pu Erh cake from Generation Tea.

Purchased these as a gift.  I was told by the recipient (an advent tea-drinker) that it tastes wonderful, and the leaves blossom very big.  Pleased w/ my purchase.  Be warned that they are samples, and are not big.

The quality was terrible for some of the teas. One even had a moldy taste. I did like 2 of the teas but I don't think I'd buy from this supplier again. However I gave it a couple of stars since the containers were excellent and the amount of tea was ample.

The teas are fine and come in cute little containers. Remember it's a sampler so ya don't get a gang of tea, but more than many samplers contain. There are two teas labeled 'oolong' and I assume one is the puer? I'll need to find someone who reads Chinese to know for sure. One jasmine that I didn't like b/c it didn't have that fresh jasmine scent/taste. Overall, for the price (I paid around 11 bucks) it was OK.

Items received weren't damaged or defective, merely reflective of bad advertising and labeling. The sampler pack is described as "6 tins (Pu Erh, Oolong, Jasmine, White Tea, DragonWell Green Tea & More!)" What came were two Oolongs, one "Black"  that I guessed would be the Pu Ehr, two Green  and one Jasmine. No White, and no explanation of what kinds of Oolongs and Greens were sent. The labels on the tin had only these descriptors and some Chinese labeling. Fortunately my son is fluent in Chinese, and I sent him a photo of the tins. He replied, "Well, you have one that just says Oolong tea, the other Oolong is a Tie Guan Yin, a nice flowery Oolong (unless its a Taiwanese Oolong, in which case it will be a darker).  You were right about the black tea, it's pu-er.  The green tea on the top middle just says Chinese green tea, so its anyone's guess what that is.  The other green tea is West Lake Long Jing."I've tried all the teas, and they're not bad. In fact, I really like the one that is labeled as just "Chinese green tea" and would love to know what kind of green tea it is. I just learned that Long Jing is another name for Dragon Well. So for $12 I get to taste a good variety of decent teas, but gain little knowledge about what I am tasting. I'm really disappointed I didn't get a white tea, since this is where my education is really lacking. If I'd been sent a white tea and told the exact kinds of green, jasmine and oolongs I was getting, I would have rated this a 5 star purchase.I complained to Amazon and they refunded my credit card $2.50. OK, that's something. I hope they have this supplier deliver what they advertise and clearly label what their teas are.

The only great thing I can say about this product is that the tins are nice. The tea inside is about as low quality as you can get. I think there is more stems and twigs than leaves. I ended up throwing the tea away and reusing the tins.If you have a relative you dont like, this may be a great gift for them, otherwise continue searching for tea.
These teas are good. I am not a tea expert so I would hesitate to say yea or nay.  I liked them.

Thought I'd give this tea sampler a shot before I bought the big size. I'm glad I did, because these teas literally tastes awful. The Oolong tea is full of stems (good teas dont pack in stems, there should only be leaves) and has a weird smell to it, not to mention the flavor is kind of bland compared to actually good Oolong tea. I'm not sure why this got so many great reviews, because these teas are just cheap and awful. Would definately not recommend this product. Buy your tea elsewhere!!!
I'm new to the tea drinking world so I thought a sampler pack would have a wider flavor range. This sampler all taste pretty much the same.

I was more interested in breakfast teas, but these turned out to be pretty good when mixed with some of the others that we have. The oolong and black tea would be perfect for dinner teas. A couple of the teas have the same name (Oolong and green tea), but different chinese characters, and the tea itself looks different, but I'm not quite sure of the difference. Overall, a fun sampler pack.
My Dad's favorite tea was Oolong so I have many happy memories when I have a cup.  It's nice to try other teas as well, but the Oolong is still my favorite as well.

Based on existing reviews, I didn't expect this gift pack to produce overly tasty tea, but I have, in fact, been rather disappointed. Everything tastes a wee bit too earthy, and it's been unusually difficult to get a good steeping. There are many other options that are far superior to this product. If you're looking for a nice cuppa, then look elsewhere.
the tins are much smaller than I expected.  but the real stuff inside... just not as much as thought.  But then again, it was a sampler set.

I was very excited to receive this item; the description made it sound like the samples would be diverse.  I was disappointed to find that my pack only contained Jasmine, Black, Oolong tea, and two green teas.  I would have loved to have a white tea or at least some clarity on what I actually received.  The terms "black tea" and "green tea" mean very little since there are so many different types of black and green tea.  I would appreciate this product much more if they actually told me exactly which teas I was sent.  It's all well and good to say that it was a random selection, but if so they need to state what was actually selected.  Especially since different teas require different preparation, it is not appropriate to be vague; this could compromise the taste of the tea.I have yet to sample the teas, but since my initial reaction was so negative, I thought it was worth noting.

This tea is very smooth and pleasant, the Jasmine has a fruity flavor to it.  So far I have been able to get several potfuls of equal strength from just a little measure of tea.  So as far as I am concerned these teas are very flavorsome.  I will continue to enjoy these teas for a while.
This is a nice sample of different teas. There is enough tea leaves in each can for a few pots of tea. I know I will be ordering again.

The quality of the tea is poor. The six flavors are labeled correctly, but the tea tastes old. You can learn what the flavors of the tea are, only with an old tea taste blended in it. There is no aroma nor aftertaste for these tea. I am disappointed.
my mom and i are very happy. we love this tea. thanks so much. plan to buy more soon. if any one is looking for a really good tea, from china this is it,..  you will love it to...
I found it difficult to distinguish the odor of these teas from horse manure. I kid you not. I don't understand this. Can you not even get good tea from China now?

column9: Some of the teas were questionable...
column10: As others have mentioned, the selection you receive is random. I knew this before buying so I was not surprised.I received Pu-erh, Jasmine, Lychee Black, Oolong, and a few others. The teas were about what I expected except for the fact that some of them smelled and tasted of mold. I'm not sure if it is just because they are cheap teas.They tasted earthy but not in the way you expect tea to taste. It was definitely a moldy taste.Thankfully, some of the teas are great, and the tins they come in are adorable and reusable. So in the end, I got what I paid for. Just don't expect something mindblowing here.

I like the tins and they are the real reason I purchased the set. The tea itself is poorly filtered so it comes with lots of stems, twigs and broken up leaves of varying quality. I tossed the tea and reused the tins.

I love tea and wanted to give loose leaf a try. However, loose leaf tea can be pretty expensive and I'm picky with tea. Not a connoisseur at all, just flat out picky. This pack seemed perfect! It was cheap and I would be able to have a variety of teas. I received black tins that included:Lung Ching (dragon well green)Pu-erhJasmineLychee BlackTikuanyin (oolong variety)OolongSo far I've only tried the Tikuanyin but it's decent. Again, as I'm new to loose leaf I might not be the best judge but I find the flavor pleasing. There are stems in all of the tins and some of them are quite big. To their credit the tins are filled to the brim with tea. In the end I think you really get what you pay for. The tea is nice enough but not as high brow as typical loose leaf teas.**Update**Taken down to two stars. The more tea I try the less I like it. I'm probably going to end up throwing all of these out. You're better off buying bagged tea; it's a higher quality!Lychee had a highly metallic taste to it. Took two sips and threw the rest out.Lung Ching was bland and had a dull flavor. Not at all bright and clean as tea normally is. Seemed maybe it was old and stored poorly.Pu-erh was alright, nothing special. (I'm new to Pu-erh tea so I may not be the best judge on this one. I enjoy Foojay Dim Sum Pu-erh quite a bit. This was like a toned down version).I found the more of this I drank the more stems I was picking out. Seemed to be almost half stems.

The quality and flavor of each Tea was worth 3 times the price. This is my 2nd. order. Was very sup prized my original purchase was just to get the Tins for my new Tea Rack and transfer my over priced teas into the tins. but now I'm going to have to wait until I use them first.

I bought this tea to go with a tea tumbler as a gift, so I cannot attest to the taste (although the recipient said she liked it) but it did not smell robust, aromatic or bold. It smelled stale and mediocre. The tins are beautiful, but next time, I think I will spend a little extra money to get one flavor that smells robust and lively.

The tea sampler is to random. It would be great if the sampler was design to let you select type of favor then a sample is sent on your taste. This was so out there. I got a couple that, to me taste a lot alike and two others that also taste a lot alike. If you don't know what kind of tea you like, or want to try different kinds to get an idea you may like the idea of a sampler. That's why I got it, but the quality is not there. I believe that the differnet teas taste the same because it's old and been packaged together so long that they have blended together, if that is possible. It's ok but not good. If you are someone that is starting off with loose tea and want to try different favors to see what you like, this is not for you. I feel that by trying this old loose tea it could turn you off from wanting to take the time to enjoy loose tea.Please go to a tea store in town and try there if you're new.

Great product, nice containers - works great in the Adagio Teas 16-Ounce Ingenuitea Tea makers.  The tea is very tasty and only a small amount (like a teaspoon full is needed to make a delicious beverage).  These are great for folks that are not familiar with these teas and want to sample something other then the cheap bag teas.

Liking a specific blend of tea is such an individualized choice. I liked some of the teas in the little tiny tins but not other flavors. I originally chose this product to round up the amount of purchase so I could enjoy free shipping. However, I'm glad I chose this product because it allowed me to further explore some different teas that I had not previously tasted. I just think it was a bit too expensive.

At first I was disappointed with how small the container were, but when I realized how little it actually takes to make a cup of tea in my ingenuiTEA pot (which I got for a Christmas present and HIGHLY recommend), I became an almost instant fan.  Nice sampling of teas, seem to be good quality.  As someone new to teas and trying to switch from coffee to tea, I am very happy with this sampler :)

The tea was alright. I'm afraid it may have been sitting a while, but it was still drinkable. This product may have benefited from an airtight container while it was sitting in a warehouse waiting to be purchased.
Service was great and the tea was attractively packaged in small tins that might be collectible. Good tea with good taste.
Not being a tea expert, but wanting to learn more, I bought this sampler pack to learn more about which teas I like and those I don't.  So far, it has helped me accomplish that.
The tea was not too bad but I am sure it would have been better if it had been properly sealed or fresher.
the sampler gift pack has been a good way for me to taste-test a variety of teas.  I am enjoying the tea.
Teas are only ok, some taste kind of stale and not at all what they should. Green teas (like dragonwell) tend to taste the worst out of the bunch, jasmine and black are ok. Oolongs also taste fine.

Many reviewers did not realize and/or did not like that these are randomly selected prior to shipping. The surprise element was a major reason I chose this sampler. The teas I received were Oolong, Pu-er, Jasmine, Lychee Black, China Green, and Tikuanyin Oolong. All of the teas tasted anywhere from decent to quite good, with the China Green being the stand-out. The Lychee Black would be awesome except for a sort of stale, dusty aftertaste. Up front the Lychee is fruity and sweet, quite enjoyable. Seconds after swallowing though it's like you've just licked a dusty old book from someone's basement. Very odd. At any rate, the tins are adorable so when the tea is gone I will probably reuse them, they'd be great for storing buttons, loose change, incense or what-have-you.

I received six small samples of very different teas -- a good opportunity to get a rough idea of the different types at a very reasonable price.  The pu erh was undrinkable for us (not a surprise -- smelled like the bottom of a decaying boat), but the rest were quite satisfactory, the jasmine and lychee black especial favorites.  If you're a tea veteran, perhaps this purchase would not please, but for the novice just moving beyond the tea bag it's a terrific deal.

...For the price.I also received two green teas, one black, one jasmine, and two oolong. It seems that is the package, judging by the other reviews. As this was the first loose tea I have ever purchased online, I was not upset by this at all.Loose tea rocks my world.It came in a very timely fashion, however, the packaging left something to be desired. The tins were dented, making it pretty hard to get two of the tops off (think: rubber husband plus bending the lid w/ a knife)The teas are very delicious. Fragrant, tasty, and good quality.
Tea looked worse than lawn clippings. Was afraid. 2 and did not drink the nice containers. Very misleading don't. Waste. Your. Money.!!!!!!!!

You get four different teas in these air tight metal boxes.  The tea is wonderful.  The tea cannot go bad because it is sealed in an air tight container.  There is enough in each for about 10 cups of tea, depending how much you use to steep.  I received 4 very different teas, (two of them were repeats) but that's what I wanted was to try something new.  These are it.

column9: You'd better be able to read Chinese
column10: Received this e-mail back from the seller after contacting Amazon customer service. Tea was shaken loose all over inside of package, the tins were very tiny and instead of Dragonwell and Pu Erh, I got 2 Oolong, 2 Black and 2 Green Tea.  I assumed one of the two greens was the Dragonwell but nothing was labelled Pu Erh...in English that is, and Pu Erh was why I bought the assortment.From seller"Hi, we are sorry that you are not happy with the tea. However, Pu Erh (in Chinese) Tea is inside, it is labeled as Yunnan Tea.Since  the tea was not made by us, it is by the local Chinese people, whose English translation is not as good as it should be.  Sorry about it.However, the Pu Erh is definitely inside.We have authorized the Amazon to give you the full refund , and we would appreciate you to have a kinder feedback"Cannot recommend this seller.
i was very disapointed when I recieved this . I think a micro-scope was used on the camera lens to take picture for amazon.The items were very small. I will not buy any more of this tea from China.

The  bottom line, this tea is really good. I really enjoy the body and the flavor of the 6 varieties.Not being a tea connoisseur, I can't tell you which of the oolong teas I prefer or which of the green teas I prefer. The packaging just labels them generically as oolong and grean tea.The tea is very delightful and the cost is not that steep (pun or not, you can choose).Basically, if you aren't a tea snob (maybe even if you are), give this great loose leaf a try!

This tea is absolutely divine!! I always order hot Thai tea at the Thai restaurant I frequent, and ever since I tried Thai tea, I have been looking for a match.Well I found it, and it is this tea!! It tastes exactly like the tea that is served at my local Thai restaurant.I will definitely be purchasing more soon. Thanks!

This is the best blackcurrant preserves I've had. Strong in blackcurrant taste, mild in tartness and easy to spread. Very rich in flavor and texture. If you like blackcurrant, you'll like this. The current price is a great deal too.
These things are huge! I love the way the crystals crunch, and the flavor is not too overpowering or too subtle. You'll have plenty of flavored salt for a long time if you buy this.

You just can't go wrong with Miracle Whip! The flavor has a nice tang to it, just ever so slightly sweet, and goes great with just about anything - the yolk mixture in deviled eggs, ham and cheese sandwiches, BLT sandwiches, even as dip (with the right recipe) I like this far better than real mayo, mayo just tastes like Miracle Whip gone bad. I like the new containers they came up with for their product, it's a lot less messy than a jar and a knife, especially at group occasions. Definitely a product you can't go wrong with.

column9: Great gift for people in areas where they can't find Miracle Whip
column10: We were raised in the Midwest on Miracle Whip.  For people who have move away, it can be almost impossible to find in some locations.  However, Amazon solved the problem and put smiles on some family faces.

Remember the commercials that said "A sandwich just isn't a sandwich without the tangy zip of Miracle Whip"?It's not a sandwich, it's something else. Possibly with mayonnaise and mustard, a nice thick slice of ham and a pickle between two pieces of bread. But it is not a sandwich. A sandwich needs Miracle Whip. It also needs American cheese and possibly fried bologna.Miracle Whip has less fat than mayo and a lot more flavor. Lots of spices and a ton of sugar and/or high fructose corn syrup give it that signature sweetness. It's not to everyone's taste. People who grew with Miracle Whip consider it mayonnaise. People who grew up with mayonnaise are surprised to have a sandwich made with this instead.It's also very good mixed with tuna.

Yay Hormel! I seldom eat meats from any other brand. This is a good one. 8 grams of fat and 280 calories.These Hormel Compleats meals are generally a good choice. And the meats are lean and without nasty bits (of bone, gristle or fat).

Just as good as the Compleats Lasagna. Much better than you'd expect. Great sauce, perfect length spaghetti (not too long, not too short). A delicious, filling, inexpensive, and FAST meal!A+ Hormel---keep up the good work!!!

They're satisfactory as a quick cheap meal. I normally wouldn't eat this kind of cheap processed food but I am in the middle of renovating my kitchen and only have a microwave oven available. These will probably satisfy the college kid living in a dorm or as a quick meal for latch-key kids. The meat is barely visible and tasteless. The spaghetti sauce is very thick and sweet. The quality is on par with Chef-Boyardee.
Cooks great in 2 minutes in my microwave. Easy to serve in container. Taste is very good.All in all, this is very handy and very good. Five stars to Hormel.

column9: Best of the Compleats pasta meals
column10: This is the best of Hormel's pasta line of Compleats meals.  The sauce is very tasty, the tiny bits of beef don't surprise you with bone or grizzle, and the spaghetti isn't particularly mushy.  I find most of their other forms of pasta to be highly overcooked and starchy, and even among their other spaghetti dishes, the sauce in this one tastes the best.  The day they make this with 100% whole wheat pasta instead of unhealthy white, I'll raise my rating to 5 stars.
What can I say?  I loved the taste and it is very convenient. It is great not having to freeze or refridgerate it.

I love Italian food especially spaghetti. When I cannot make my own spaghetti at home I resort to canned store bought spaghetti. Recently I purchased Hormel's compleats spaghetti and was really surprised just how tasty this product is. While the canned product can be runny with the noodles soaked in overpowering tomato sauce, Hormel spaghetti has a really full flavor with the right amount of sauce,tomato flavor and spices. The chicken and noodle variety is also very good. Give them a try you might like them.
Very prompt delivery. Great product. Better than what I was expecting. I will order again.
Salty and nasty.Never again. I've tried these before, and every time, I wish I hadn't. Convenient....yes....good...no. I've learned my lesson this time....never again.

column9: One of the better Hormel meals
column10: The spaghetti with meat sauce is one of the better ones of the Hormel line but it does have its faults. The sauce is sickly sweet and has a tang of too much acidity for my liking. The noodles, though, are surprisingly good and the texture of the bits of meat add just enough to the meal to make it better. The meat itself, like most of the Hormel line, doesn't really have much of a taste of it's own but without it the spaghetti would fall much flatter. This would be definitely a five star for me if only the sauce was a bit more robust in flavor with less of the overwhelming sweetness. The other pasta dishes of the line can be doctored up easily by adding some hot sauce to mask the sweetness but for some reason I'm not a fan of spicy spaghetti so I can't bring myself to do it :)For what this is -- a non-perishable prepared food that is fairly cheap -- it's pretty good. It will fill you up quickly at very low effort and cost, but if you are going to compare it to spaghetti you can make yourself, well, there really isn't any comparison.

The spaghetti is not mushy--comes out just right, which surprised me. There isn't much "meat" in the sauce and the sauce is slightly acidic but if that bothers you, add a tiny pinch of sugar to it and it will take that acidity away. Honestly, this is a really good shelf-stable product for that occasional meal that you don't have time to cook and don't want to spend a ton of money ordering out. These are about $2 each and that's cheaper than a fast food meal. Probably better for you, too. :)

Can't say to much for this product. I love it and it makes a satisfying meal where there not much time or desire to make my own, ( which is better when time permits, and the grand-kids like mine better ).

Sometimes I get a craving for Spaghetti with meat sauce and don't always have leftovers of my own sauce to satisfy that craving so I purchased this product. I was disappointed. I expected a much better flavor considering it was Hormel. The meat was kinda hard. I picked it all out before eating the spaghetti and sauce. I dont regret purchasing it because it did fill the void, however I will not be purchasing it again.
The product is to sweet and to spicy.  It causes heartburn.  I endup taking five or six tums to fight the heartburn.Hormel Compleats Spaghetti with Meat Sauce, 10-Ounce Microwavable Bowls (Pack of 6)
The flavor is good but the pasta is way past al dente. Mushy really. This is something I would only eat if there was nothing else available. I like a lot of the other dinners in this product line.

"Hormel Compleats Spaghetti with Meat Sauce, 10-Ounce Microwavable Bowls (Pack of 6)HORMEL cOMPLEATS sPAGHETTI" -By far the worst tasting spaghetti I have ever had - it was not worth the difficulty of removing the lid.

column9: First attempt at Persian cooking was a huge hit!
column10: I used the recipe listed on the can, doubling it because I had a crowd coming for dinner. The chicken was delicious! My guests (family and friends) gave it rave reviews. I served it with basmati rice, sauteed garlic spinach, heirloom tomato, avocado, fresh mozzerella cheese, and arugula salad w/ good olive oil and lemon.  I will try the rub on more meats, and see if I can duplicate last nights raves.  However, I do think the price is very steep - $9.00. I bought the spice in Missoula where their restaurant is located, seems like they could offer a discount or something. I'll see about buying it locally where I live (California) and test it out. We have eaten at the Silk Road in Missoula twice, and it is an excellent dining experience.
