column9: The best hard candy I've ever had
column10: I had read great things about these candies, but was hesitant to fork out for a 7-lb bag. But, getting bored of the artificial taste of sour Jolly Ranchers, I decided to take the plunge. Also, it was October - if worse came to worst, they would become expensive Halloween candy.Well, the trick-or-treaters lose out - these are the best hard candies I've ever had. Despite the name, they aren't very sour. The exterior is like your usual hard candy, except with flavors that taste very natural and aren't cloying. In the middle is strip of sour sugar. After you've been sucking on the candy for a little while, the interior will start to leak out, and you get a trickle of sourness that mixes with the flavor or hard candy. The sourness runs out well before the candy is gone. While this may sound corny, the sourness in the middle prevents the candy from becoming boring, unlike most sucking candies.Even that center sour part isn't incredibly sour, or at least doesn't seem so at the rate it leaks out. Probably if you bit into the candy and released it all at once it would be much stronger. Sucking on it, it never gets more sour than, say, a Sour Patch Kid.All of the flavors taste great. I slightly prefer the pineapple, tangerine, and cherry over the lemon and line, just because they're a bit more exotic. However, all of them are easily recognizable, and none are overpowering.As a last note: while the candies are colored, they don't use anything like the quantity of dye in many American candies. After eating some flavors of Jolly Ranchers, I'm embarrassed to go out of the house because my tongue is so blue! Napoleon bon bons are much better in that regard.

Mid 1960's 10 year old earthling encounters tangerine flavoured "Bon Bon Napoleons."  Life is good!45 years later I have to order 7 pounds of the bloody things... in order to mine the "chosen flavour" which swim, intentionally steathy it would seem...within that ridiculously large saque (imitation French for sack...)  But it's worth it!Maybe I should simply separate the tangerine "sheep" from the lemon, lime and pineapple "goats"... but that would take all the fun out of it!Amid all the insanity and instability, it's nice to know that the IMPORTANT things never change!

Naturade's Bavarian Chocolate flavor is outstanding.  I've been taking this product for breakfast and lunch at work since about September 2005, and I'm not sick of it yet.  Not even close.  I'll consume as much as I want during the day when I want.  I feel completely full for a few hours with one drink. I mix it in a 20 ounce bottle with two scoops.  Your body will appreciate the health benefits of this drink, unlike fried or fast food that will take down your energy level and leave you feeling groggy.  You will lose weight also from taking this product.  I lost 20 pounds and am now at a level of maintaining my current weight, and I owe a lot to Naturade Soy.  I've also tried the Vanilla flavor.  I was not impressed. Buy the Bavarian Chocolate and try it out.  You'll be glad you did.

I'm not a big fan of the taste. I've tried mixing it with water (as instructed) and with soy milk. It just doesn't taste very good to me, but not bad. For an easy vegan meal replacement, it does the trick, and the price is good. I'll try the vanilla next, as that might mix well with some fruit in the blender.

Tasty, I love Vanilla, filling.  I have tried it with the following combinations so far. water , skim milk, cranberries, blueberries, clementine orange. very good and satisfying. I will purchase this again.
VEry good and this is the best price.  I will continue to purchase this from Amazon!  Love it!  Tastes just great!

Great flavor, low in calories, high in nutrients, high in protein! Usually protein powders are high priced and high in calories, this one is a great bargain and tastes great, I highly recommend for the lady gym rats, probably not "macho" enough for guys since it is soy based...
Great for when you are in too much of a hurry to cook breakfast or make a lunch.  The flavor is rich and chocolatey, add a bannana, a cup of 2% milk, blend it up and you are good to go.

column9: It has changed my life forever!
column10: Who would have ever thought a single, yummy, chocolately drink could make me feel like a whole new man! I am never hungry and I am saving so much money not visiting fast food places daily. Thank You Naturade for showing me the path to true health and weight loss salvation.
I have only been using this product for a week and haven't seen the health benefits yet (weight lost and lower cholesterol) but I love the taste and have been replacing 2 meals a day.
This product tastes good and this brand is one that mixes up better easier if you are shaking up a shake.

column9: New and Improved Formula Much Better!!!!!!!!
column10: I have been using this brand for about two months, but I was using the one with the new and improved formula. I decided to give this a try since it was cheap and I thought the Bavarian Chocolate would taste more chocolate-tier than the regular chocolate. I was wrong this one doesn't dissolve as well and it doesn't taste like chocolate, it's more of a bitter taste. Also it doesn't  keep me full 4-5 hours like the other one does.I will be going back to the one that is sold in the bag since it taste amazing and it's $20 at Sams Club!!! The new and improved formula is the way to go!!!!

This is the first and only meal replacement that I have ever tried but I have read and heard about how the taste of some are just awful. With that being said I consider myself lucky. Simply because the Naturade barvarian chocolate and strawberry flavors are really pretty good.I usually mix with either lactaid milk (2%)or rice milk (vanilla flavored)and I have tried water. I shake mine, does a very good job (IMHO) but you have to really shake things up. Works better than a blender, I think.Using lactaid (10 oz) the drink is kind of thick if you use the two scoops recommended which I do,  my wife uses one scoop in 8 oz. Using water or rice milk both have the same consistancy which is much thinner with a loss of some flavor. I prefer the lactaid milk...The powder is very fine and can be packed like moist chalk dust. With that being said packing the scoop makes mixing more difficult, which I believe maybe the source of the lumps.I drink one 10 oz cup in the morning with my vitamins and another after work then a have a smaller helping for dinner. When I first started I would have all kinds of cravings so I started eating more fruit during the day so from that perspective I do eat more little meals through out the day, but I have lost 6 lbs in a month without any excercise.I would strongly recommend at least giving Naturade a try...

column9: Tried others, this one is best value
column10: I have purchased another soy based chocolate power product (ASIN: B000HCX5RQ), and that other one wasn't as good as this Naturade Total Soy.  We have this just about every morning in smoothies (1 1/2 scoops, 8-12 frozen strawberries, 1 TBS chocolate cocoa mix, 3 cups milk, 2 bananas).  Although my recipe may not be the healthiest, it tastes great.  I have also tried the French Vanilla Total Soy as well, but we love chocolate too much to switch.Also with respect to the other brand mentioned, I had to use 3x as much cocoa to cover up the after taste.  This Naturade version has a very slight after-taste - probably due to the soy - but it's better than using pure cocoa!Update: All Star Health is very very fast.  I reordered it on 9/10 and received the very next day.  It wasn't expected to arrive until 9/16.  I will order from them again.  It's too bad this item from them is not on the subscription program.

Item says in stock and will ship in two days! Then after two days you get an email that says "Sorry for the inconveinence but your item is out of stock and will be 10 days later" (or MORE!) I wish AMAZON would just go back to doing it themselves instead of letting any dork with a website sell stuff. This is BS! This is probably the last time I will do business with AMAZON or ANY of it's so called merchants.
Items arrived in a timely manner and in excellent condition.  Will do business again with this vendor.

I am normally very skeptical of high praise on these reviews, as I generally think that it is coming from the seller.  No reviews can prepare you for how amazing this soup is.  I have lived in Eastern nations, and I have not been able to find a curry like this in the United States.  The taste is phenomenal and complex, and this soup would be great to mix with a rice, or as a filling thermos drink.  Again, I am in awe at how amazing this product is!!

To rate a product low because you didn't read the ingredient list to know it contained chicken broth is misleading on the products quality.  This soup is scrumptious, just as the title of this review says.  It's creamy, flavorful, and fulfilling enough as an entree.  We don't eat large portions of food and found this soup to be just what we need on weeknights, sometimes with a nice arugula salad on the side.  I imagine it would make a delicious base for other meals as well, including Indian dishes.

This is a creamy textured soup with a little bite. It does contain chicken broth, for those who are vegans to be aware of.It's a quick healthy snack, and I find I turn to it again and again.I buy it on Amazon as its no longer available at the stores I shop in. Its been a favorite for the past two years.It has a wonderful, interesting flavor, has a reasonable caloric content (1 C= 140 cal.) and needs nothing to make it more so, like many other soups which lack interest.I'm about to purchase my second case.

I got this because it was on sale. This is one of the best soups I've ever tried out of a box or can. Pacific brand soups are always good - but this one...Wow! Another reviewer had it just right - this has a complex and well balanced flavor. I will buy this for regular price in the future (and that's saying something for a cheap-skate like me!)

column9: My favorite all time soup ever
column10: This soup is very delicious if you like curry and lentils, a perfect blend of flavors and so healthy, too. It is so good it is addictive. I never get tired of it. I have tried many of the other Pacific Soups but none are as good as this one. For those of us saddled with restrictive diets (not vegan), a boring diet is hard to overcome. This soup meets all the requirements that I need to eat both protein and and gluten-free fiber at every meal. When it started disappearing from the stores (in Denver), I was devastated. Kudos to Whole Foods for turning me onto Amazon.com and kudos to amazon.com for selling discontinued foods.
My wife and I eat this with rice and chicken on a weekly basis. Can't find it at stores anymore, so we've come to Amazon to buy in bulk. And we are still running out of it on a regular basis

I have purchased Bruce's Sweet Potato Pancake Mix in the grocery store packaged exactly as it is shown on this site; unfortunately my store discontinued this product and I had to locate it on the internet.  However, when I received my order from Amazon.com the packaging I received was totally different (in color and size).  It is probably the same product but I would like to have been shown the "actual" packaging I would be receiving.
These are the best tasting pancakes I have ever tried. I wish amazon carried the larger bag. Hard to find in regular grocery stores in my small town.

This is really good--and hard to find in stores. American Heart Association-approved and good for diabetics. My daughter wouldn't eat a sweet potato when her dad offered to pay her, but when Grandma made these, she loved them.

These are better than any traditional pancake I've ever tasted.  The flavor reminds me of a spice cake or muffin, but not overpowering, more subtle.  They are still a bit high in sodium for my needs and the carbs are also somewhat limiting for those watching their blood sugar.  The bottom line is they are TORTURE!!!  If you can manage the carbs/sodium values, they are so good they are borderline addictive!  Killer good!

I was really excited about receiving this pancake mix. However, I found that the pancakes just tasted okay. I would purchase again, but if you are looking for an authentic taste then this mix is not for you.

We first found out about this pancake mix years ago, when we vacationed at Ocean City, Maryland (it has been our favorite family vacation destination since our children were toddlers.)Just by curiosity, we had them for breakfast one morning and loved them since.Anyway, we found it at Food Lions grocery stores, I used to get in trouble by getting about a dozen of these mix to take along home, since we cannot find these in Lancaster, PA. where we are from.This past summer, we could not find this mix anywhere, including the grocery stores in Ocean City, we though it maybe a local favorite. What a disappointment, we like Bruce's canned yam too, no problem finding them, so why don't they make more of the mix. We found some sweet potato mix at the local stores, but they are considered Kosher food, and they ARE NOT the same as Bruce's.If any of you Bruce's fan know a store in Lancaster area that carry this product, please post it here, we would be really grateful.

column9: Good for you and great tasting!
column10: For a yummy treat on Saturday mornings, these wonderful pancakes give you less to feel guilty about, eating pancakes with great nutritional value.  I really enjoy them and think they taste better than regular pancakes.  They've been a staple in our home for a few years now - just wish more grocery stores in the Richmond, VA area carried them.  Sometimes we have to hunt to find them.  Spread the word - these are great!

column9: WONDERFUL stuff-- you'll never go back to plain table salt after you try this!
column10: Tasty AND good for you, what more could you want from a salt?  Good price too.  Definitely get the coarse kind and grind it yourself for the best flavor.  Heaven on a ripe summer tomato!
Great price for Himalayan salt, very beautiful too. I grind it or use it whole in soups and mashed potatoes.

I have tried many kinds of tea, and quite honestly don't like many.  However, the tea I tried before wasn't fresh.  I know now, because I bought this tea.  Potent and aromatic, just opening the small twist-tied bag shows just what quality this tea is.1.6 oz for $17 may seem incredibly pricy for some, but honestly, you won't go back to drinking the cheap stuff ever again. Also, you don't need much to make a couple usable infusions.Flowery and light, this tea smells, looks, and tastes fresh in every cup.  It would be easy to overload with the amount of tea used... so try no more than a pinch for a 12 oz cup.  You may have to wait a few minutes, but the result will be fine.This supplier and this tea will not dissappoint.  Fast shipping, excellent quality.I will be buying my tea from them from now on.*edit(5/16/08): fixed embarrassing spelling mistake.

column9: Good product, fast delivery and no problems
column10: This is a good product, delivery was on time and there were no problems.  To help others who might have "problems" I will note the following:1.  This is not the best white tea I have had, but it is of good quality at a reasonable price.2.  Like other white tea, it is very sensitive to temperature and steeping time.3.  Some people find white tea flat or flavorless, a pinch of lavender or other agent will help.

I'm very happy with this purchase.  The tea not only has a great flavor with NO bitterness, but also has all those great health benefits.  I've been able to re-brew the tea a couple of times or more so a little goes a long way.

As a tea enthusiast, I have never tasted a finer tea than silver needle.It gives a light and yet rich flavor without any of the bitterness you find in bagged tea. It's so good, there is no point in adding sugar.This is expensive stuff, and worth every penny. Fantastic and exotic, it makes a real treat to serve guests.
Good White Tea from Fujian.  Mine was fresh - I'm not sure if that depends on the time of year you buy.  A bit pricy but this type of White tea isn't cheap anywhere.

This particular vendor's Organic White Silver Needle Tea is very good and much less expensive than others I have tried.  It too offers a very subtle flavor and is very light on the taste buds.  :)  Excellent product, superior packaging, it comes in a metal canister, and excellent delivery time from order. What's not to like?  Thank you!

Love this tea, it's as good as Teavana's silver needle and nowhere near as expensive. I ordered this like 4 days ago, and it's already here. I'm baffled, but grateful. The taste is great, but I mix my cup with a dried mint leaf or some lavender from the front yard just out of personal preference. The seller had time to hand-write a thank you with a happy face on my order copy and that, to me, is an excellent customer service technique of a growing business. The tea comes in a tied plastic bag in a nice tall tin container with an air-tight tin and plastic lid. I'm gonna re-use the container for sure, the label can be peeled off. Let's face it, coffee leave's a person's breath smelling like turd. White tea has half the caffeine of a cup of coffee if you steep it over 3 minutes, and this is a suitable (but not perfect) replacement for coffee in the mornings before class when I have to hold conversations with people. I can take the discreet container in my book bag to school, grab a cup of hot water in the cafeteria, and get my caffeine fix!
I have drank this tea for a week now and love it! I ordered it as a healthy alternative to my morning coffee.  Mix with honey for best taste. good price too!
I have tried other silver needle white teas, and I found this to be very acidic. Not sure if this is the tea itself or due to the metallic container and its material.I will not order it again.

column9: Good for the price but I have had better silver needles
column10: I think it's good quality tea for what you are paying, however one should be aware that this is not top of the line silver needle tea.  There are better examples out there.

I use garlic a lot when I cook (not only does garlic add a nicer taste to dishes, it is also a pretty healthy addition to one's diet). When I'm motivated, I use the real deal, chop it, crush it, etc. However, sometimes I prefer to take a shortcut. When that is the case, McCormick Minced Garlic does the trick.When I make my broccoli salad, using this product saves me some time, adds a nice taste to the salad, and, I hate to admit it, is awfully easy on me!So, if one is a bit lazy, this is a useful product. It's not the same, of course, as fresh garlic, but it does the job!

column9: McCormick's minced garlic great for arthritic hands
column10: For years I have always used fresh garlic. My special salad dressing calls for minced garlic. Now, arthritis prevents me from mincing by hand. I tried the minced garlic in jars with liquid. The texture and taste were very disappointing.A few months ago, I decided to try the McCormick's Minced Garlic. The aroma, texture, flavor are so close to fresh garlic. My family has not noticed the change. I am now on my third bottle and plan to buy the pack of 6 sold here on Amazon. If you use a lot of fresh garlic, try one 3 oz. container. You may never buy fresh garlic again.

column9: Dried garlic bits: excellent product, for what it is!
column10: I do like to eat, but... I am a combination of busy/lazy. Mashing fresh garlic can be messy, smelly and time consuming. Therefore, I believe I am a perfect consumer for this minced garlic product. The garlic bits are big enough to be noticed in soups and stews, but small enough to provide gentle taste for home made garlic bread and salads. In fact, last weekend I used it in olive oil for bread dipping (I made the mix a few hours ahead in order for the garlic taste to soak thru the olive oil, and then added freshly ground parmesan directly before serving; tasted yum!).BTW: Buying this product in bulk (the package contains six shakers), I was concerned about its freshness. However, I needn't have worried. The expiry date was Nov 29, 2012. Secondly, the price of the product on Amazon was excellent, particularly as I purchased it under the Subscribe and Save program. I highly recommend it!

column9: get some today and ignore the diet debacle for a while (three and one-half stars)
column10: Kellogg's Frosted Rice Krispies Cereal is absolutely scrumptious! Sure, it's all in the sugar (smile); but once in a while you can give yourself a treat. It may be a better alternative to nothing for antsy kids who really didn't want any breakfast before school. As long as you eat these before the expiration date stamped on the box they will be delicious!The cereal is indeed fat and cholesterol free. That's great. The cereal contains no trans-fats--that's even better! There are 27 grams of carbs in each serving; so please be careful of that although on the other hand it's only about 9% of your daily limit for carbs as suggested by the government. Each serving of this cereal also has 25% of your recommended daily intake of Iron, Niacin, and Vitamins B12 and B6.Unfortunately, as you probably guessed by now, there's a price to be paid for all this. The cereal has sugar--18 grams of it when served in milk! If sugar is a dietary issue for you, consult your doctor before eating any of this cereal. There is no calcium at all in this cereal; and that's a disappointment. Sigh.After all is said and done, this cereal tastes great and it's a pleasure to eat--especially in the morning when you may want a pleasant, sweet start to a tough day ahead. However, the dietary issues do cause some concern; and I will take off one and ½ stars for this issue. Of course, life still is rather short however you slice it--so get a box today and treat yourself now and then! You'll enjoy it!

column9: Love this hard to find cereal!!!
column10: Okay, this is not for the health nut freaks.  But sometimes, you just have to enjoy something.  That's how my family feels about the Frosted Krispies.  Their not too sweet, just right.  Our whole family of five enjoys these, ages 54 to 7.
This was my favorite cereal from the 60's, so glad I can still get them!  They are still delicious and not overly sweet!!
I love this hard to find in stores cereal. Gotta have it!! My whole family can't get enough of this awesome taste. :-)

column9: The Best Cereal in the World!!!
column10: I have been looking for Frosted Rice Krispies for years.  I finally wrote the Kellogg company and they told me that the Frosted Rice Krispies were still in production I could not believe it. I got hooked on the cereal when I was in Georgia.  I live in Michigan where the cereal is produced and could never find it at any store.  I was sooooo happy to find out it was still being made. I know it is just tons of sugar but eating it in moderation like you do everything else is the key.  I will be getting 4 boxes of Frosted Rice Krispies shipped to me every 3 months thanks to Amazon.

column9: A delicious alternative to Frosted Flakes.
column10: I love this cereal, but can't find it locally. (Can anyone?)I also love Frosted Flakes, so I alternate which cereal gets to go in my tummy each time I have some as a snack...or for dinner.By the way, just how big is YOUR cereal bowl?

column9: Can't find this cereal anywhere except Amazon
column10: Both my kids and I love this cereal but can't find it in any stores except Amazon. It's a little on the sweet side, but other than that it's delicious.
The product is not available from stores in this area. It was received in good shape and undamaged. It was fresh, as shown by the sell by date. I consider this very satisfactory.

After my grocery store stopped carrying these a few years back, I was crushed.  It is my all-time favorite cereal and I adore it.  Thank goodness I can get it here with super fast shipping and very reasonable prices.

These taste like regular rice krispies but sweeter, they are good, but actually a little too sweet for me (which I thought was impossible). There is no visible frosting on the cereal, it looks like a normal rice krispie but when you eat it, it's much much sweeter. The taste is great. The frosting taste is like Frosted Flakes. I also don't like how the cereal gets soggy so quickly in milk. Also, don't buy this expecting it to taste like Rice krispie treats cereal.

All I can say is that I love having breakfast with my three favorite guys, Snap,Crackle,Pop!!  Hard to find the Frosted version.  The grocery stores and some box stores had them on their shelves for a couple months....and then they disappeared again...never to be seen.  Thank goodness I found them on Amazon.  I got the RE-taste of them and just can't let them go AGAIN. Quick service and a good price. Com'n on Kelloggs bring them back to the stores!Thanks AMAZON/COM
this product is the best cereal I have ever eaten. It is not only for the kids it is good for all whom like alittle sweet with there cereal.
best cereal in the world - can't find it anywhere in Michigan - that's why I order it all the time on amazon.

This item is delicious. I used to have to put sugar on my rice krispies and I would always under-sugar or over-sugar, put this cereal puts EXACTLY the right amount on each kernel...I used to have this all the time, then they stopped carrying it in the north-east because it didn't sell well there...Thank goodness for Amazon, lol..
This product is so hard to find in the stores. It shipped quickly and I'm still enjoying it.

Good cereal...I had it when i was a kid and they don't sell it where I am so I'm glad to have access too it. The only thing i would change is the shipping cost..It's like I'm purchasing an addition box.
Kellogg's Frosted Rice Krispies Cereal, 12.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)These are very good.  I wish they were not so hard to find.

This cereal is no longer available in most areas and I don't know why.I found it ONE time in South Carolina, but that was it.  I am so happy to know that I can get my order delivered from Amazon on a regular basis and I never have to LOOK for it again!My husband grew up on it and eats it almost before the next delivery, but not quite!Thanks AMAZON

OMG!  I have found sugar-covered gold again!  I used to order these from Hometown Favorites and then they had a few issues with security.  But now, I can feast upon the cereal of my childhood joy.  As it is unfindable in Philly or anywhere close to it.  Snap!  Crackle!  Pop!  I love this cereal!  Amazon is officially KING!

This Kellogg's item is not easily found on the west coast of the US. It is popular in the UK, Canada and on the East Coast. Also known as Ricicles.Better than frosted flakes. Not too sweet, not too heavy. My favourite cereal ever.

column9: Hope you can get these again ! ! !
column10: Super Fast Shipping.  Very FRESH.  I NEED More....I'll keep checking.

growning up in the 50's i recalled eating a cereal called rice krinkles a sweetened rice krispies type cereal. having come across frosted rice krispies ,i gave it a try and boy did the memorys come back. thanks
Just wanted to say they taste just like I remember them as a kid.  They are Grrrreeeaaaattttt!!!!

Our cereal arrived very quickly, and it was very fresh.  The packaging was meticulous, and the price was very reasonable.  It was our first order from Amazon, and we have spread the word about the fast and  efficient service we received.  I will not hesitate to order anything from Amazon again!  Linny

column4: Angel_Boy "Treat the people around you the wa...
column9: Not As Good As You Hope
column10: When I saw this, I thought it might taste like the famous Rice Krispy Treats_ at first taste it did- but the more I ate- the worse it taste. Don't ask me why or how- but I liked the 1st box. The 2nd box was okay. I threw the last 2 boxes away because I wouldn't eat it. Maybe it was too sweet. Maybe I was hoping for something more like the marshmallow treats....be your own judge. If it's $10ish for a 4 pack- it's worth a try.

I first had Tim Hortons when visiting Niagra Falls in Canada. I couldn't believe how great it tasted. I had to try the shipped coffee to see if it was as good. This is the best home brewed pot of coffee I have made.

I like TIm Hortons coffee.  It is similar to Dunkin Donuts, but it has a slight taste difference.  It is the nuance I look forward to enjoying.  This vendor delivered this product in a prompt manner and the price was quite agreeable.

What can I saw, is there a better (non-gourmet) coffee than Tim Horton's? If there is, please someone let me know, because to find a bag of flavorful & rich coffee for under 7$ is quite a bargain these days. If you like Dunkin Donuts, this feels like its Canadian richer relative, same fine taste but slightly more sophisticated ;)Enjoy, Alex

My boyfriend's a big fan of Tim Horton's coffee, so imagine my surprise when I found it on Amazon. Believe me, he was well-pleased when he opened his gift to find his favorite coffee (not available around here) waiting for him?
Excellent service, and packaging is excellent. And excellent quality and sent on timeI will deal with them all the timeMy advice to deal with them
I think this is the best coffee i have ever made at home. Some coffees just aren't as good made in a small (pot) quantity, but I'm loving this one.
Well, being far from home I was craving Tim. Of course it is not the same but close enough to fill my craving. Received my item 48h after the order. Nothing bad to say except I miss Canada!!

column9: Finally available in the Southern States
column10: As a former Canadian, I have truly missed my Tim Hortons coffee and was very glad to see it offered by Amazon.  I used to have to stock up when I visited or had to beg family to send me some.  Now I can order some easily whenever I run low.  To me, no other coffee tastes as good.  Thank you Amazon!
..coffee. Ever.Well, maybe not the best ever, but it's absolutely worth every penny. If you like good coffee, you will not be disappointed.
Since moving to Arizona, it was wonderful to find I could order my favorite coffee online. I was having my family in Ohio to mail my treat often. This is the best coffee I have ever had.
This is great coffee at a good price. Costs less than in they're own store. Fresh, came quickly, will buy again.

column9: So happy to have found this!
column10: As a Canadian living in the United States, finding out that Amazon sells Tim Hortons coffee was thrilling to say the least!  I used to have relatives bring me the coffee each time they visited, or I would drive to the coast of Maine to purchase my own, but now if I order only four bags at a time, Amazon will ship it to me for free!  THANK YOU AMAZON!!!

column9: Great coffee and great price - not necessarily for iced
column10: I recently visited Canada where Tim Horton's is huge and I can see why, their brewed coffee is just great! It's bold and has a distinct, rich flavor. I was thrilled to find that I could purchase this from the US and at such a great price, and the coffee tastes just as good as I remember.Not sure how many others do this, but I recently started brewing iced coffee which is done by brewing regular coffee at double strength so it doesn't get too watered down when poured over ice. For that purpose, I find that I still prefer coffee beans I buy from a certain other popular American chain. Can't put my finger on it but I feel like the flavor of Tim Horton's was meant to be appreciated as hot coffee.

If you ever visit Canada you cannot miss the Ubiquitous Tim Horton's franchises, it seems as if they are on every corner (and small wonder: everything they sell is excellent, reasonably priced, and served with typical Canadian efficiency and politeness.) The quality of Tim Horton's coffee is pretty remarkable -- it is very, very good -- and the price is not outrageous (I picked up a 39 ounce can in a Canadian Walmart for about $16.50 in American dollars toward the end of november, 2010, which was about the same price they were selling for in the Tim Horton's stores.) Note: Their decaf is every bit as good, but I haven't been able to find it in cans larger than 13 ounces.

column9: Nice to Find Tim's in the US
column10: Coffee drinkers from Canada already understand this product.I'm from Canada and now in the US and have searched the US coffee shelves for years for a product I can brew at home that is similar to Tim Horton's coffee.  I've never had any luck finding one.It seems to me that the US coffee market has no shortage of brands that want to be perceived to be at the top end of the coffee market and all of them command a price per pound that makes no sense relative to the quality of their taste and aroma.  Similarly, the bottom end of the market is well represented on supermarket shelves.  Unfortunately they are all largely undrinkable.Tim Horton's coffee owns that space in between.  It is great coffee at an affordable price.  It is also remarkably consistent year over year, something I can't say about Seattle's favorite coffee company.Tim Horton's is a 40 year national phenomenon in Canada and the quality of this coffee is one of the reasons why.

Based on all the reviews I bought a bag and just made my first pot.  It isn't bad and it isn't wonderful.  It's just okay.  I guess I like a much more full bodied coffee and this isn't it.I certainly won't toss it - but I won't buy it aain

I've found that, for home brewing, Tim Hortons coffee is not as strong as Starbucks coffee, but it's a bit smoother and has a brighter flavor.  I find it comparable to Dunkin' Donuts coffee but I prefer this one.Every time I've bought it through Amazon the shipping has been really fast.
I was curious about this coffee sold in Canada.  It's smooth.  I can drink it in the afternoon and all night.Still, I don't see what all the fuss is about.

I purchased this coffee after hearing several of my Canadian friends raving about it. I cant book a trip to Canada right now I can buy the coffee here on Amazon. The flavor reminds me of Dunkin Donuts coffee but a little different. I will be back for more soon.
Would buy again!  Great tasting coffee.  Good price.  We use it with our new eco friendly filter instead of k cups.

I'm very pleased with this coffee!  It has a smooth and mellow taste; it isn't overly acidic and I feel like I can drink lots of it.  It also was delivered very quickly.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is that I think I prefer a slightly darker roast after all - something to give it more "body."  I will certainly buy this again, as it's something I can serve to just about everyone.

Many people rate things 5 stars because they like them.  I rated this four stars because I really liked it and drink all my coffee black.  This is a very flavorful, smooth coffee.  You won't likely be disappointed.
Many pieces have no peanuts. This peanut brittle is more hard candy than peanuts. Corn syrup is first ingredient. Try Ferdies.
I have been looking for the Wyler's Light Raspberry locally for a long time and was happy to see it available on here. Smooth transaction and everything was as described.

column9: My picky eater will actually eat it!
column10: My dog has been grain free for a couple of years now, (my choice, of course) and I had yet to find a food he will actually eat. Until now! This stuff is good (so I gather)...I will continue to purchase:)
This was a good deal for a three pack and the dog loves them.  They are also alot healthier than the pigs feet we used to give him.

column9: Absolutely my favorite coffee out there
column10: Working 12+ hour days in finance, I am accustomed to drinking a lot of coffee. There is not a better cup out there than Elite Aladin Turkish coffee. I drink it black, but I know the traditional way is to boil it with milk and sugar. No matter how you prefer it, nothing quite packs the punch of Turkish coffee while still delivering a bold (but not overbearing) taste. Each cup reminds me of what it was like to drink that first cup of coffee in my life. You can not go wrong with this at work or at home. I strongly recommend you give it a go.

We sell all the flavors of the Umpqua Oat line at our 2 coffee kiosks and I would say that this is one of the better flavors.  Its a well balanced flavor profile, not too sweet, not too salty. It is filling for a breakfast to go option.  I recommend it, if you definitely like nuts. I like the fact that it has the flax seeds too.

I first tried World Famous Pralines last year at River Street Sweets in Charleston. They were so good I salivated as I anticipated each bite. The rich taste reflects the simple ingredients: sugar, an abundance of incredibly plump pecans, half-and-half, and butter. The praline texture is crumbly--in my opinion, perfect. The only other pralines I'd ever tasted years ago were thin and dense to the point of being hard to chew. I hadn't enjoyed them at all, but maybe preferences in pralines are a regional thing.I've done my best to describe what I've so enjoyed. That first day in the shop my sisters and I were so excited we ordered pralines for our mother. I've since ordered them for myself and for friends and other members of my family. Everyone I know has raved about these pralines.Note: The pralines don't have preservatives. They have a 21-day shelf life, part of which is taken up in shipping. Plan on eating--no, devouring!--them within 14-18 days.

I first ate pralines on a visit to New Orleans and fell in love with them.  I've not eaten a good once since that visit until I received these in the mail.  These pralines are delicious.  I will order again and recommend them to everyone.  Great taste and texture.

These pralines are so delicious and not overly sweet. There are big chunks of pecans in each praline that leaves you wanting more! My family absolutely loves these pralines! I have purchased these pralines many times and come individually wrapped for added freshness and with great care! I highly recommend these pralines for praline lovers!
This candy is really sweet but it is so good. It is so good I am ordering more and it was a gift to me.

column4: Tatiana Champange "Praline lover from way back"
column10: I am a creole from New Orleans, I have eaten Pralines my entire life.  Im so very sorry to tell you that these sucked.  I only ordered them because I was given an amazon gift certificate.They were not creamy and they tasted strange also they were way to nutty.  OK so this is my option, but I offered some to my coworkers and they hated them too.  Im sorry i think they are BAD.  i would like to have my money back.

My candy bar of choice used to be Snickers ¬ I still like them but I prefer less chocolate these days.  Hence, Pay Day is the chocolate-free Snickers bar!  I enjoy the wonderful combo of the sweet chewiness of the caramel and the salty crunch of the peanuts in the Pay Day bar.  I find it satisfies my sweet tooth craving and actually gives me some nutrition.
product was fresh and delivery was quick.  our employees appreciated them on "pay day".

column9: My favorite candy can also be a substitute for trail mix. Really????
column10: Okay, so candy isn't health food. The ingredients would send my doctor into lecture mode. BUT, to me PayDay candy bars are a great substitute for trail mix on some of my moderate hiking treks, and an addition on longer hikes.Obviously I'm not a nutritionist, and my logic may be faulty, but I've been using PayDays for just such hikes during the past hot summer months. After 4 miles of climbing some "moderate" to downright difficult hills and trails, I need an energy boost. I also want to retain water which, with borderline high blood pressure, definitely seems counter-intuitive. PayDays have just the right amount of salt to accomplish the latter, and the nuts and sugar definitely give ME a boost.I start hiking when the temp is around 70, and in these hills, that can be 90 in a couple of hours. You really need salt, though I admonish anyone reading this to drink a lot of water as well.If my logic is indeed faulty - even if it has worked well for me - then give me credit for finding a positive reason for having my favorite candy bar with me "just in case."The only negative is that the price just went up $5, and it's fast approaching the very expensive "health bars." But it's still less than cocoanut covered carrot cake where you'll die from choking if not dehydration.

I love these payday bars. I carry one with me to work eveeryday. They make a good snack & take the hunger pangs away, as I cannot always eat when I Want to. I buy these in bulk at the Sams club store. They are cheaper there. The best candy bar.
The product was acceptable. The peanuts were not real crunchy. The packaging was terrible so maybe that had something to do with the freshness.

The candy bars were fresh, and affordable.  Its not easy to find a candy bar, that doesn't contain chocolate. Paydays are great, when you want a snack, and its nice having a box of them around the house.  I bought these 6 months ago, and I still have a couple candy bars left, so they last awhile.  I'd recommend these to anyone who enjoys Payday candy bars.

A big help in ongoing weight loss program. Reduced hunger was immediate and now feeling more energy and an overall sense of well being. Easy to use in that it can be sprinkled on or mixed in with just about anything. The consistency once it absorbs moisture takes some getting used to, but it's more "different" than unpleasant.

I've enjoyed Chia seeds now for several years and was pleased to find such a good price at Bob's Red Mill for quality seeds.  They are WONDERFUL to add to morning smoothies and baking.  So nutritional!
Quick service. Great product. Product is filling with no after taste.  Only downfall is seeds get stuck in teeth so make sure to check your teeth after use.

column9: Glad I discovered Bob's Red Mill Chia Seeds
column10: This product is great for me.  Gives me energy and has lots of fiber.I don't get as hungry either.Love it.Wish my husband could use it but it is not recommended for men withany issues with their prostrate.  Source: WEBMD and Life Extension Foundation.

What can I say. Bob's Red Mill chia seeds delivered right to my door! They are what they claim to be. Well within the "sell by" date on the bag... great packaging and arrived fast. I would order them again.

We live in a very remote area (3rd world country) and are very health conscious. Being able to order stuff like this through Amazon really fills the bill.  When I found these, I immediately ordered.  I love these things.  They add a poppy-like seed crunch, with a health bang.  There are so many recipes that chia seeds can be added into, upping the vast health benefits.
This company continues to turn out great products and this is no exception. Delivery was really fast and the value for the price can't be beat.will order this product again.

column9: Chia Seeds Are Very Healthy - Cautions for Men though
column10: WARNING: While Chia seeds are known to have many health benefits, some studies show that chia, like flax seed, can cause prostate problems with men. My husband has seen the bad side affects of flax seed (swollen prostate), but none from chia yet. Some studies suggest not just swelling, but cancer is a risk for men. I'm not fully convinced chia seeds can cause prostate cancer (in the quantity we eat them) but this is something you may want to consider if you're a man or cooking for a man. I'm doing more and more research on it and will update here if I find out more.Chia seeds are considered to be very healthy and can be added to just about any foods & recipes (tastes a little like nutty cracked pepper). I usually buy Spectrum and Nutiva brand but I also trust Bob's Red Mill. They all offer quality products. I have never got a "bad" or rancid batch of chia seeds from any of these companies and have purchased from all of them for many years. I've purchased Bob's and Spectrum chia locally and Nutiva chia here on Amazon.com. If you can't get Bob's Red Mill locally I would recommend you go through Amazon since I use Amazon for hundreds of purchases and customer service is always great.The price of Chia Seeds has gone up as much as 300% (most brands) in the last 18 months due to popularity and is expected to rise even more very soon. This Spectrum 12 oz bag seems to be the lowest price I've seen on Amazon lately. Personally I'm going to stock up since the prices are going so high so fast. If you want to eat chia daily I advise others do the same if you can afford to. Waiting will most likely just mean you'll pay more later. They can be frozen for long term storage, or vacuum sealed.I add chia seeds to my husbands meat dishes to give him the added nutrients and antioxidants he does not get otherwise.I add chia to just about all foods I eat, just a little in everything. I sprinkle them over Salads and Veggies like cracked pepper.I've added Chia Seeds to the following recipes/foods with great results:OatmealMeat Loaf & Meatballs (regular meat or tofu)Sauces & GraviesBaked Cakes, Cookies, Muffins, PastriesIce Creams, Sherbets, SorbetsSmoothiesSoupsScrambled Eggs & OmeletsBread CrumbsUse just a little and you can barely taste them (good for a start).Use a bit more and it will have a nutty peppery flavor.For example, I have to mix at least 1/2 cup of Chia seeds per 7 pounds of ground meat before my husband will even begin to taste it.Keep in mind the idea of eating Chia seeds is not so much for the flavor as it is for the nutrients.If you grind the Chia seeds to a powder (using a coffer grinder or similar) this will release the nutrients and give you more benefit from them.Studies have shown adding Chia seeds to your daily diet can help fight cancer, boost your immune system, and flush toxins from your body.For those who want to (or need to) eat a grain-free diet, Chia seeds are not considered to be a true "cereal" grain, and therefore is an acceptable "grain" or seed to eat if you're on a Paleo or similar diet.Chia seeds are high in protein (it's a complete protein), omega 3 fatty acids, calcium, boron (for bone health), fiber, potassium, and antioxidants.
I haven't ordered, but I'm confused: is this a 16 oz bag for forty something dollars, while others are around 12oz for like $15?

...a #2! I do eat other foods with some fiber but I think these seeds have more fiber and it definitely helps with bowel movements :D. So far, I've used it in baking (e.g. cookies, cake) and smoothies. Doesn't alter the taste in any form since the seed is tiny. As for whether I have more energy, I haven't noticed any additional energy since I've been using it.The pack I received has an expiration date of 2014 in case you might wondering.

Amazon purchase:I ordered 6 bags of chia seeds from Bob's Red Mill.  They sent me 6 bags but one was cut open and the contents along with the damaged bag was put in a zip lock baggie.  No way am I going to eat this product not knowing what might be in with the seeds.  I'm very disappointed that something like this happened along with being out 1 bag.Ted
I am hooked on Bob's Red Mill Chia seeds for my breakfast  cereals.  Great with oatmeal and with granola.  Not sure where to buy product  going forward, since you are no longer carrying product.

column9: Bob's Red Mill Chia Seeds 16 oz. bag
column10: Made low carb-gluten free brownies using a wonderful recipe from yourlighterside.com and they were really good! Very happy with this product and it's good for you too.
I was very pleased with the quality and the cost. I will order this again and am telling my friends!
Just as described. Good quality, well filtered and it arrived when it was supposed to. I'll purchase this product again.

I got a great price on this two pack. I love Bob's Red Mill products and have complete faith in their products.I love the chia seeds. I have been reding reviews of other brands and they contain complaints about dirt and unknown crunchy items. Bob's definitely didn't have these problems. I am very sad to find that they are not available and no return date.I really would like these to be a subscribe & save item. Please get these back in stock!!!
Just ordered my 2nd bag from this company. Wish the bag wasn't so flimsy - I had to double bag it after opening- but other than that, excellent quality seeds and very prompt delivery.

I purchased this product for its caffeine-free profile and the fact that rooibos is supposed to have so many health benefits (asthma/allergy relief.)  I just didn't care for it.  I'm sure there is an audience for it out there, it's drinkable, there just isn't anything special about it and it felt like work to get it down.  I drink a lot of tea, lots of choices on my shelf, and I reach right past this product and choose something else. You have to buy four tins at a time which is a shame because life is too short to spend it drinking unsatisfying tea.12-31-2010I still think this tea is rater blah but you know, it sort of grows on you and I have to say I felt better when I was drinking a couple of cups a day. I got used to and looked forward to the simple nature of it.  By the time I ran out I noticed that I was sleeping better, my breathing was better and so was my general sense of well being.  This brand was not available so I ordered another brand of loose rooibos tea and all I can say is I wish the Caranda brand was back in stock.
This Beef Jerky is one of the best out there. It is tender and very flavorful. It may be my new favorite flavor.

I've eaten gummies for years and I got stationed in Italy a few years back. I miss America, but I discovered these Frubidu (and other Haribo products) and I will never buy American gummies again. The flavor is ten times better than anything else and it costs (on average) half of what the Life Savers Gummies cost for 50% more gummy. Don't quote me on this, but I think it's actually healthier too. Haribo is the best.

I am not usually a big bottled seasoning person. I was given a bottle of this by a friend and one day I decided I meeded to use this stuff fir something and I put a tablespoon in my pizza crust dough before kneading it.  Good grief!  Absolutely amazing!  Now I go through it like water!

This is the perfect spice blend. We use it on chicken, pizza, pasta dishes, and all kinds of things. I cook with it a lot. It jazzes up steamed veggies nicely, too. We used to get it at our local grocery but they stopped carrying it. We were thrilled to find it on amazon. We were having withdrawals.

My family loves to eat home made pizza and spaguetti and with the Magic Seasoning Blends Herbal Pizza and Pasta that I use for the sauce they come out delicious and very tasty. OMG that this Italian seasoning tastes good. We just love it. It even has a hint of parmessan cheese that ads more flavor to the italian food you prepare. I hardly recommend it, but be careful if you don't like spicy food because it is a little bit spicy, but not too much.

don't know why you can't buy this at stores anymore.  it's not even offered on their website but amazon has it and we absolutely love this stuff.  good on frozen pizza, take-and-bake pizza, pizza wraps, pasta, etc....I'd pay twice as much.
I love this seasoning in my pizza sauce. Wish I could order them one at a time for a decent price, but if I freeze them, they stay good for a long time.

Our family loves the Magic Seasoning Blends, but particularly the Herbal Pizza and Pasta blend. Unfortunately, you can no longer find this blend in stores and I was thrilled to find it here. It adds a little "extra" flavor to many dishes other than pizza.

Our local grocer use to carry this seasoning blend.  We were hooked quickly.  Fabulous on pizza; add to either homemade or frozen before baking.  Good on just about anything else.  Some of my favorite non-pizza uses are sprinkled on pasta, on the inside of grilled cheese, and on mixed veggies.We really didn't need 6 bottles, so we gave a few to friends.  They love it just as much as we do.  Their favorite uses are on salad (instead of dressing) and on salmon.

column9: At last -- a distinctive low-sodium seasoning.
column10: Those of us who must limit sodium intake tend to be desperate for palatable low-sodium seasonings and grateful when we find them. BaconSalt has leapt way beyond merely "palatable," however, and brought new seasoning products to market that can make salt-hungry, bacon-deprived deprived folk like us absolutely giggle with delight. When we first learned about BaconSalt, we bought one of each flavor (the basics on Amazon, some special ones on the company website), plus extras for gifts. We sent a half-price gift package to loved ones at an APO address (as of this writing, the company actually gives military buyers/recipients a 50% discount -- imagine that!). We have no interest in the company, BTW ... we're just happy consumers grateful to find that we needn't abandon the savory flavors of bacon in the pursuit of good health.

I had never heard of Bacon Salt until I found it by accident, online.  I bought three bottles of it from Amazon, and I am NOT disappointed.  This salt is PERFECT on a BLT sandwich, sprinkled over fat free popcorn, in an omelet, etc.  It has a true bacon flavor with no calories.  This company (J&D's) also makes a product called Baconnaise, which is basically a bacon flavored mayonnaise-tasting sauce that has very little calories in a 2 Tablespoon serving.  The Baconnaise is also fabulous!  They have their own website....just look up J&D's on Google.  I would highly recommend the bacon salt and also the Baconnaise...

I have 3 different flavors on these and they are : jalapeño , apple wood ,a and hickory. I so far think hickory has the best smoke taste but apple wood has more bacon flavor. Jalapeño is good but not the best . All these products do and will add complex flavor to your food. They add great smoke and subtle bacon flavor. You can smell the bacon and taste it on most foods. I think it is the best on chicken. I disagree with the people that say there is hardly any bacon flavor and I think you guys have poor palates. Do not expect this to make your food taste like it was wrapped by 90 pieces of bacon for Pete's sake! No seasoning is meant to achieve this level of flavor and if you want full bacon taste then buy bacon and eat it! But JD's bacon products are amazing and my wife and I love it on most BBQ meats and I like to add it to chili's and anything you wish to add extra flavor to. Highly recomended and it will always be in my spice cupboard .

Ever needed a spice that could set your meals apart from the rest?  J&D's Hickory Bacon Salt is my secret weapon!  Use it to liven up mashed potatoes, sprinkle it on your burgers for pro burger status with your friends.  Use it as a dry rub on Chicken and grill the chicken in a foil pack with potatoes for a meal that'll drop the jaws, and earn the respect of your most challenging food critic, if they still don't like it, punch them in the mouth because they're lying!  Use it on your eggs for that bacon flavor right in the egg!  This has been by far my favorite spice of all time, about the only thing I don't use it on are steaks, for which I prefer Montreal Steak Seasoning for, but for everything from eggs to chicken to fish to potatoes to broccoli and more, J&D's Bacon Salt is my choice!
This is more like hickory smoke flavoring than bacon, but I loved it. I added it to everything! Great on eggs! Better on popcorn!

Okay, don't be put off by the label "Bacon Salt". Sure it sound strange but I am so glad I tried it. First off, even though it calls itself "salt" it is not overly salty and it does have a distinct bacon flavor. The hickory flavored Bacon Salt is my second favorite in their line of products. I use it in soups, meats, and even vegetables all with great results. Definitely a product to try.

column9: It's bacon flavored salt, need I really say more?
column10: It's salt that when used ads a pleasant flavor somewhat similar to bacon to whatever you put it on/in. I use the hickory flavor bacon salt primarily on hamburgers, but have tried other flavors of their bacon salt products in almost anything where salt is required or beneficial with mostly positive results. No complaints, I love this stuff, the other flavors of bacon salt, and their Baconnaise product as well.

My aunt had given me a jar of this to try, as I cannot eat pork anymore.  So many things are flavored with bacon, and so she suggested I try substituing this.....what great flavor!  I tried it in several dishes I would have used bacon in, before and guess what...I never missed the bacon!  I would recommend this product to those who cannot eat pork products.
Not great, but ok 'may' buy it again.  it also may be I have not found the right things to use it with.

column9: A little smoke flavor is all I get
column10: I tried the Hickory smoked bacon flavor salt to see if it was better than their standard bacon salt.I love bacon. I like it well done and crispy. I often add the fake bacon bits to salads or pasta. The flavor is okay, bacon like but not as good as the real thing. I have started using the packaged crumpled bacon by Plumrose, or Oscar-myer. That gives a very nice real bacon flavor to anything you put it on.So when I received the package, I couldn't wait to open it and try it on some food. What a disappointment ! It tastes like salt and MSG with a slight smoky yeast flavoring... not close to a nice bacon experience. I tried it on a sandwich, veggies, etc.... still a far cry from a nice bacon taste. Just salt, MSG and a little smoke flavor ...I can't see myself buying any more of this,it just doesn't perform, and it is not cheap...

column9: Doesn't make anything taste like bacon
column10: because it isn't bacon.  It tastes like Baco's, which don't taste like bacon.  I fail to understand how anyone who really loves bacon can be satisfied with an imitation.

I love these packets. They're amazingly easy to use. I usually buy 1.25 lbs or somewhere near there of hamburger meat (I prefer lean 93/7, but the 80/20 is probably OK), and I use two of these taco packets. I really love these things. I think that I'm usually able to find them cheaper in the grocery store than the prices listed here. You may want to try one packet in the meat, let it cook, taste it, and then add the other packet if you think it needs it. There's also the mild version and a spicy version that you may like more than this. I'm not the type of person to like terribly spicy food.From their website (as I just threw out the packets I used today for my tacos):Ingredients:SPICES (INCLUDING CHILI PEPPER, CUMIN, PAPRIKA, OREGANO), ONION, WHEY (MILK), SALT, SUGAR, GARLIC, POTATO STARCH, AND CITRIC ACID.Serving Size:2 tsp. mix (6g) (Seasons 2 tacos)Servings per Container: about 6.Available Size:1.25 ounces, UPC 5210009170Nutrient Information:Calories:20 Fat:0 g Cholesterol: 0 mg Protein: Less than 1 g Sodium: 420 mg Carbohydrates: 4 gSugar: 1gFiber: 0 gI think they've changed the image on the taco packets. I haven't tried the ones with the new image, and I can't comment as to whether or not there is a difference in flavor. As far as I can tell, there shouldn't be a difference in flavor. If they're too expensive, Walmart started making Great Value packets that are cheaper and comparable in taste. I also love the Thick and Zesty Spaghetti Mix that they make. I haven't tried others, but they may be worth it. I'd really only buy these on sale, though.

I always wanted to try out this product, but Amazon only sells these in bulk. I got my chance to sample this product at Stop and Shop, where I bought a single package for $1.50. Obviously, it's slightly pricy.The preparation is extremely easy. All you need to do is measure out the appropriate amount of milk and mix it with the appropriate amount of mix until there aren't any lumps, then refrigerate it for a few minutes. I did mine for 10, although the package says 5. I must warn you, however, that you must use milk containing lactose. I did an experiment, with one half package with soy milk, and the other half with 1% milk. The soy milk was nowhere near as thick and creamy.Nutrition wise, this pudding is AWESOME. Per 1/2 cup prepared, there is an estimated 140 calories, 3 grams of fiber, 15% of your day's worth of calcium, and 7 grams of protein. I'd say it's great for people on diets: good portion size, moderate amount of calories, very satisfying (protein and fiber), and quick to prepare.If you haven't caught up yet, the texture is very creamy and thick, and the taste is very rich and chocolately. There are no chemical aftertastes, simply because there aren't any SYNTHESIZED ingredients. Not too sweet, and not disgustingly bitter either. It's perfect, and you should try it. Holy yumtown.

This is my second order for this pudding.  We got it originally for a relative who had special dietary needs.  My kids tried it and loved it.  The texture is great, the flavor is fantastic and it has the wonderful bonus of being good for you.  This is the snack my kids make for themselves.  They think they're eating a real treat and I know that it's a treat that is good for them.  I highly recommend this for people with special diet needs who are looking for a healthy food with substance.  It's also great for anyone looking to eat good tasting healthy food.  We will definately be ordering this for a long time!

column9: Best ever am  good for you pudding!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
column10: The chocolate and vanilla instant puddings are  fabulous. Easy to prepare and great taste. Use any sort of milk,,,,they all work well.

Better Bowls Instant Pudding is great.  It is extremely easy and fast to make to make.  It is also high in fiber.  A single serving of pudding gives you 3 grams of fiber.  It is also gluten free.  And best of all---it tastes delicious.  A great buy.

Planters Peanut Butter Cookie Crisps 100 Calorie Packs, 6-Count Boxes (Pack of 6).  These cookies are so tasty!  I love the peanut taste and the crispness.  A one-hundred calorie pack is just enough to get started having fun eating them, but then the limitation of the size of the package helps me put the brakes on.  Probably the most important part of weight control is portion control.The cookies have 3 grams fat, 0 mg Cholesterol, and 2 Weight Watchers points.

It's very nice that the company put 100 calories packages out--great marketing idea.  They taste okay to me.  A bit subtle on the chocolate IHMO.  Mostly they're lightly-flavored, chocolate, wheat crackers.  They have very little nutritional value but over 39% sugar.  The 100 calories is achieved by a very light product--it doesn't weigh much.  So, 100 calories sounds great--but only if you eat but one package.  Not easy to do if you're hungry.  Still, it's a convenient snack to put in a backpack, lunch box, carry-on (now that they don't feed you much when you fly), etc. with less calories than most alternatives.  Could also tide you over between meals.  Still, I'd personally prefer something a bit healthier.  But that's why there's chocolate & vanilla--oops, they left out the vanilla!

I enjoy them a lot and so does my son. I have to say that this kind is one of my favorites. It is full of peanut butter flavor that you forget that it is only 100 cals. As for the amount you get in the bag, it is more than I expecting so I was very happy.
I enjoy the Peanut Butter Cookie Crisp, but they are definitely a departure from the originals.  Still my son LOVES them so for this reason I still give it four stars.

One reviewer writes that these are Oreo crackers without the creme--and they are right! These thin Oreo crisp wafer type cookies by Nabisco are easy to pack for when you're on the run and just need a quick sugar infusion. They also make for snacking anytime of the day--or night--and they give you that great Oreo taste without actually using creme as an ingredient.These crackers are cholesterol free and trans fat free--hooray!  There are only 100 calories in a serving and a serving contains only two grams of fat. They are baked crackers which helps make them healthier than other snacking choices including greasy French fries. These crackers somehow manage to give you the full Oreo taste experience while omitting the creme and a fair amount of the calories, too. Excellent!These Oreo thin crisps come in six smaller packets which will be inside the box you buy. This makes them even more portable for both children and adults. Another advantage of the cookies coming in smaller packages inside the box is that you know that each packet has been pre-measured to contain only 100 calories. This way you can't accidentally eat too many and take in more calories than you wanted to have.I notice that these crackers are made with cocoa. Please consult your doctor if you have any concerns about caffeine. Chocolate and cocoa could contain too much caffeine for you if you are sensitive to that.I recommend these crackers for persons on the go who want a quick snack. They should provide you with a sugar boost for quick energy. They make for a healthier alternative to other snack foods loaded with fat and/or cholesterol.Buy some and enjoy them today!  SMILES
I really like these.  They are so light and airy, almost like chips instead of cookies!  The flavor is that yummy OREO chocolate we all know and love!

These are good but the flavor did not resemble an oreo. I purchased these along with the chips ahoy and those did resemble the flavor of chips ahoy. In my opinion these tasted like animal crackers. I will stick to chips ahoy 100 calorie packs.

I have been eating the 100 Calorie Chip Ahoy for sometime. I really find that it is a filling, guilt-free snack. It has a unique taste of its own - not a `diet' food-type taste either, it taste like a `real' snack.

column4: Lonnie E. Holder "The Review's the Thing"
column9: Flavor in, Calories Down, Fat Nearly Out
column10: As I get older and fatter, I seek opportunities to eat snacks that at least make a nominal attempt to be healthy.  Oreo cookies fail to reach very high on my list of healthy foods.  However, Oreo cookies are delicious beyond belief.  Not only are Oreo cookies delicious, but I sometimes think I hear Oreo cookies calling my name as I walk by them.  Honest.  I am unable to buy Oreo cookies because if I do I know I will eat them; generally in a few days.  Not a good idea.Nabisco, realizing that many of us are making some nominal attempt at eating more healthy foods, have created a brand-identified snack eliminates all the bad fats and most of the fat, creating a yummy and crunchy chocolate wafer snack that is like a chocolate cracker.  To this point no one has ever created a truly healthy snack that is like a cookie.  However, this wafer snack, which Nabisco has decided not to call a cookie, perhaps because cookie sounds fattening, is reasonably yummy.  I have eaten these things several times and still eat them.  I actually eat them more than regular Oreos, which I count as quite a nod to health.You may be tempted to add icing to this baked cookie.  If you are going to add the fat and calories in icing, perhaps you should just skip in pretense at reducing calories and fat and go straight to regular Oreo cookies.  In fact, just revel in the calories and go for the Double Stuff Oreos.Oreos have been around since 1912, and remain the best-selling cookie brand in history.  According to our friends at Kraft, which owns Nabisco, and which is owned by the Altria Group (renamed from Philip Morris, presumably for marketing reasons), more then 450 billion Oreo cookies were sold in the first 90 years of their existence.  Though Oreo Thin Crisps fall quite a bit short of the real thing, they are high quality and have sufficient flavor that allows these baked chocolate wafers to have the Oreo name.Of course, you could just stick with rabbit food and be truly healthy, but where is the fun in that?  For those of us that find a constant diet of veggies to be just too healthy to be fun, and yet the thought of pigging out on a pound of Oreos smacks of chunks of fat floating through our circulatory system, Oreo Thin Crisps are a lovely alternative.  Or course, you probably should avoid eating pounds of these, even with the reduced fat.  Food is food and too much low fat food still is not good for you, even if it tastes good.  At least Oreo Thin Crisps do not talk to me when I walk by.Enjoy!

column9: Now we have the Oreo transformed into a baked chocolate wafer snack
column10: We are still six years away from the centennial for the Oreo cookie, which was first manufactured by Nabisco in 1912 as something more exciting for people to dip in their tea than the biscuits the English tend to use (it was copyrighted as the "Oreo Biscuit").  The sandwich cookie was quite similar to the Hydrox cookie produced by Sunshine, but Oreo dominated the market to such an extent that they stopped making Hydrox back in 1996. What would be considered the "modern" Oreo cookie was developed in 1952 (originally they were mound shaped, which is why some think the name comes from the Greek word for "hill"), with the two circular chocolate wafers with the sweet white filling commonly called the "cream" in between.Of course today consumers do not have to restrict themselves to just the tradition Oreo cookie.  There are Oreos with chocolate-flavored cream instead of the traditional white, as well as orange colored cream at Halloween and red at Christmas.  You can get Oreos with a double portion of filling, not to mention mixing and matching two flavors of filling (carmel and chocolate, coffee and cream, peanut butter and chocolate, etc.).  You want the original cookie with a coating of chocolate fudge?  They have that, or with white chocolate fudge in winter, and then there is the Uh-Oh! Oreo with the flavors of the cookie reversed.But what if you are interested in watching your weight because once you open a bag of which ever type of Oreos are your personal preference they are just sitting them beginning to be eating?  After all, once they are open they could go stale, and putting them in a cookie jar just makes them more accessible even if it allays fears about freshness.  Nabisco has taken a three-prong approach for weight watching Oreo lovers.  You can go with the Reduced Fat Oreo, which is identical to the size of the original but has less fat per serving.  Then there are the Mini Oreos, bite-sized versions packaged in snack packs rather than in really think wrapped trays.  Now we can add to that short list the Oreo Thin Crisps.These are baked chocolate six-sided wafer snacks, almost 20 to a pack, that are lightly sprinkled with white specks that are to take the place of the aforementioned cream.  Now, I am someone who likes the cream more than the wafer, so I was wary because I thought scarffing down a bunch of these would be like eating the chocolate wafers without the white cream, but they are lighter in taste than that, even without having the glass of milk handy that I considered essentially when eating the more traditional Oreo cookies.  Since they do have the Oreo taste I can round up on these.  These come in 100 Calorie Packs, to help you draw the line at a nice round number when it comes to caloric intake.  You can six 0.81 oz (23g) packs in a 4.86 oz box.  Each pack contains 0 grams of trans-fat, 2 grams of fat, and 0 milligrams of cholesterol.  You will also find one of 100 Healthy Living Tips on the front of the pack (e.g., #56: "Make a meal out of appetizers or side dishes instead of larger main entrees").  Of course, I was thinking of putting some of these in a bowl of vanilla ice cream, but that would really mess up the whole healthy living bit.

column9: not as good as the 100-calorie Oreos
column10: With any low fat or low calorie food, you're going to sacrifice taste of portion size.  With this product, you sacrifice both.It's a good idea, which was done well with the Oreos and others in this series of "100 calorie" snacks, but I think you're better off with a single cookie from the regular Chips Ahoy box than a whole bag of these.

how good these cookies really are.  They're delicious, satisfying, and really, really healthy.  Definitely a great alternative to "real" cookies.

column4: Heather L. Parisi "Robert and Heather Parisi"
column10: FIRST THOUGHTS: BRINGS BACK OLD MEMORIESWhen I recently tried these little wafers I recalled when I worked in an office nearly 20 years ago. Whenever the Director skipped lunch, he ran all through the department pleading with all the ladies to pull something out of their handbags or desks that might get him through till 5 O'clock. He usually ended up with a couple of packaged saltines which had long since turned stale and were mostly crumbled from being crushed at the bottom of a handbag or desk drawer. I came to realize that some of the girls kept stale crackers just for him - I guess they really admired him. These 'Nabisco Oreo Thin Crisps, Baked Chocolate Wafer Snacks' would have served his purposes much better than the saltines, but I would rather he have more of his old favorites.IN A NUTSHELL: NICE FOR A DIETER AT COFFEE BREAK TIME -- BUT NO CREAM & SUGAR PLEASEBasically, this is a minimalist snack for people who have to eat something in-between meals and they don't want it to be a 600 calorie confection. That's why the biggest print on the label says, "100 calorie packs" -- 4.5 inches across!WHAT'S THIS STUFF ALL ABOUT: ENRICHED FLOUR + SUGAR + "ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS" & "ARTIFICIAL COLORS" & A LITTLE CANOLA OIL2 GRAMS OF FAT & 9 GRAMS OF SUGAR in a 23 GRAM PACKAGE = 100 CALORIESBOTTOM LINE: NO PRETENSES -- SIMPLE LEAN SUGAR WAFER WITH THE USUAL ADDITIVESAs diet snacks go this is okay stuff to carry with you. One can avoid more calorie dense alternatives with these wafers on hand, making them a sort of antidote or vaccine against dropping energy and blood-sugar levels in the late afternoon which may lead to a large unplanned snack. For that purpose this is a great product and I know that our Director, 20 years ago, would have given anything to have these modest wafers available instead of the usual stale saltines that he subsisted on for many a long afternoon. When the Director didn't find any saltines around the office he'd head straight for McDonalds and the rest was history.

column9: Chocolate Wafers in an Identity Crisis as Oreos...But If Deception Helps Monitor Calories, Why Not?
column10: I hate to admit I miss the lard. I was the one in your 4th-grade class who unscrewed the Oreo, ate all the white middle, licked the wafers clean and then ate the hardened chocolate wafers. That's the image I have of this cookie. Even Barbra Streisand coyly named her singing trio at the beginning of "A Star Is Born" the Oreos because she had two back-up singers who were black. That's why the idea of an Oreo Thin Crisp is rather lost on me.It is a single, nickel-sized baked chocolate wafer that more resembles a bleached Wheat Thin than the original Oreo. It does have some dusting of a white fructose sprinkle as perhaps a nostalgic tribute. Don't get me wrong, as the Oreo Thin Crisps are perfectly fine as low-calorie chocolate wafer alternatives go. They simply lack the lip-smacking satisfaction of a disassembled Oreo digested in pieces. The whole point of the 0.81-ounce bag of wafers is to tout that they are "100 Calorie Packs", a fine idea for Weight Watchers advocates and the rest of us who should be watching our weight. It's just that I don't feel very satisfied after finishing just one pack.

Nabisco knew if they didnt put little things that give this much pleasure in little baglets, we would keep dipping our hand in the bag and in a couple years would all weigh 400 lbs, die an early death and no longer be able to give Nabisco money.Kidding aside, these are loveable. When a friend suggested I try these I was reluctant and kept telling her that I was not interested. She insisted so I tried a few and surprisingly did not find them to be bad at all. I would recommend them to anyone who liked the original version, but is watching calories. Good job Nabisco!
