column9: Delicious Mini Chocolate Treats Help Weight Loss Efforts!
column10: I was one of fifty families chosen to receive Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters for free to do a product review on.  Once I received my Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters in the mail, I and two of my grandsons decided to do the taste test immediately.The box of Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters comes with five individual packages.  Each package is 100 calories.  In fact, the Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters are advertised as being 100 calorie packs so that people will know exactly how many calories they are having so there is no guesswork involved.  Each 100 calorie package comes with three Oreo mini cakesters which translates to each mini cakester having approximately thirty-three and one third calories.The appearance of the Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters is one of tiny chocolatey goodness.  They are a dark chocolate color with a thin slice of cream filling and are soft and slightly crumbly.  When you put a Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters into your mouth, they crumble into a delicious chocolate cake flavor.  In fact, they do remind me a little of having a small bite of chocolate cake.  The Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters mostly have a chocolate flavor and the cream filling isn't as easily tasted or rather it wasn't possible to isolate the flavor of the cream from the chocolate but I didn't have a problem with this and neither did either of my grandsons.My oldest grandson ate almost two 100 calories packs of the Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters minus one or approximately 167 calories.  He enjoyed eating them and even gave Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters his `lick of approval' to the wrapper they came in!My youngest grandson isn't able to communicate effectively verbally (he's special needs) but I considered his dedication to eating his Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters as a sign of approval as seen through his chocolate face and intensity as he ate his 100 calorie pack plus the one loose one from his older brother or his approximately 134 calories.I definitely give the Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters a thumbs up.  I believe that I really got a true sense of how good they tasted from my two 100 calorie packs or 200 calories worth of Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters that I ate. I honestly didn't mean to eat both 100 calorie packs but that last one was sitting there calling my name and my adult daughter was not home yet so, I ate it.  But luckily I know that all I had was 200 calories which in the grand scheme of things is not too bad at all!I like the fact that the Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters are presented as a 100 calorie pack.  I found the thought comforting especially since I ate two packages of them!  I even found it fun to know how many calories my grandsons were consuming of them too!!  I am diabetic and overweight besides so knowing the calorie count is a good thing for me.  I think the Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters are good for a small chocolatey treat when you just want something sweet and chocolate but you don't want to overindulge.If I have any complaint about the Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters, it would be that they are too small!!  But since that is actually part of their appeal, I don't consider their small size a problem.I do recommend Nabisco Oreo Mini Cakesters for anyone who wants a small and controlled portion of a chocolate treat because they are the perfect size to keep you in control of your diet instead of letting the chocolate treat control you.
I love Oreos but hate the filling.  These prevent me from having to scape the filling out and they're good for you - calorie wise.

that price is to hight, you can buy in the store for 4,99!yes,is really good! i love it,but not on this price!

I love the taste of this salsa.  It is really, really tasty.  However, it contains preservatives not disclosed on the Amazon listing.  The ingredient list should be disclosed so buyers can make informed decisions.

The basic stock for 1,000s of Japanese recipes, dashi is absolutely essential for anyone wanting to cook authentic Japanese cuisine.  As famous chef Shizuo Tsuji once said " "many substitutes for dashi are possible, but without dashi, dishes are merely a la japonaise and lack the authentic flavor".Dashi can be made pretty easily from scratch, boiling some kombu or katsuobushi shavings, but you often make far more than you need for the particular recipe, and it can be a pain to spend all that time boiling.  Instant dashi does the trick just fine, and almost no one will notice the substitution.  This kind here, "Hon Dashi" (meaing "Real Dashi"), is the cream of the crop of instant substitutes.  Made by the company Ajinomoto, Hon Dashi is absolutely brimming with umami, the fifth basic flavor found in Asian cooking.  Hon Dashi is made from katsuobushi shavings, so it is a basic fish stock and not suitable for vegans, who would probably want to make their own kombu stock.I use Hon Dashi for almost everything, from basic miso soup, to tamagoyaki, to using it to boil vegetables and give them a heartier flavor.  Along with mirin and soy sauce, it is one of the most basic ingredients in a Japanese kitchen.

None of the other reviews even mention this marvelous combination of lousy ingredients...kinda stupid. If I'd wanted 3 packets of sugar, salt, and flavor enhancers....I'd have ordered salty/sugared MSG soup base.UPDATE: I did some research and I thought this was interesting, and since this product, and the topic of MSG seems to be so bantered about, maybe this will be interesting to someone else.The food additive, monosodium glutamate, was first used in the United States in any quantity in the late 1940s. According to Dr. George Schwartz, author of In Bad Taste: The MSG Syndrome, although considerable effort had been spent to introduce MSG to the USA, little had been accomplished prior to World War II. However, sometime during the war, the use of MSG in Japanese soldiers' rations was noticed. In 1948, a symposium on MSG, presided over by the Chief Quartermaster of the Armed Forces, was held in Chicago for members of the food industry.By the 1960s, Accent, the leading brand of the flavor enhancer called "monosodium glutamate," had become a household word. Simultaneously, other hydrolyzed protein products such as autolyzed yeast, sodium caseinate, and hydrolyzed vegetable protein gained in popularity. Every hydrolyzed protein product, regardless of the name given to it on a label, contains MSG.Although glutamic acid had been isolated in 1866 by the German chemist Karl Ritthausen, it was not until 1908 that its flavor-enhancing potential was noticed by Kikunae Ikeda of Tokyo, Japan. Prior to that time, the Japanese had used seaweed as a favorite flavor enhancer, without understanding that glutamic acid was its flavor-enhancing component.From 1910 until 1956, the process underlying production of glutamic acid and "monosodium glutamate" in Japan was one of extraction, a slow and costly method. Elsewhere, crude gluten or other starting materials were hydrolyzed by heating with hydrochloric acid. In 1956, the Japanese succeeded in producing glutamic acid by means of fermentation; and after considerable research to identify suitable strains of microorganisms for starting the requisite cultures, large-scale production of glutamic acid and "monosodium glutamate" through fermentation began.Even before the Japanese discovered the flavor potential of processed free glutamic acid extracted from sea weed, the potential of freeing glutamic acid from protein using acid hydrolysis was being explored in Europe. At the time, however, the method was not widely used. Indeed, it was not until some time later that the flavor industry realized that various of their hydrolyzed protein products contained considerable amounts of processed free glutamic acid (MSG) -- the flavor-enhancing component of the food ingredient "monosodium glutamate" -- and production of hydrolyzed protein products for their flavor-enhancing potential escalated.When "monosodium glutamate" was brought to the United States in the years following World War II it was still manufactured through extraction. By 1956, after considerable research to identify suitable strains of microorganisms for starting the requisite cultures, Ajinomoto Co., Inc. had succeeded in producing glutamic acid through a method of bacterial fermentation wherein bacteria (some, if not all of which are genetically modified)(10) are grown aerobically in a liquid nutrient medium. These bacteria have the ability to synthesize glutamic acid outside of their cell membranes and excrete it into the medium to accumulate there.(11) It was in 1956 that truly large-scale production of glutamic acid and "monosodium glutamate" through fermentation began.We find it fascinating that the first published report of a reaction to "monosodium glutamate" did not appear until "monosodium glutamate" was being made by bacterial fermentation. The first published report of a reaction to "monosodium glutamate" appeared in 1968 when Robert Ho Man Kwok, M.D., who had emigrated from China, reported that although he never had the problem in China, about 20 minutes into a meal at certain Chinese restaurants, he suffered numbness, tingling, and tightness of the chest that lasted for approximately 2 hours.The following year, John W. Olney, M.D. reported that laboratory animals suffered brain lesions and neuroendocrine disorders after being exposed to monosodium glutamate. Scientists studying retinal degeneration in mice treated with free glutamic acid had noted that these mice became grotesquely obese. Olney, who speculated that the obesity might be a sign of damage to the hypothalamus (the area of the brain that regulates a number of endocrine functions, including weight control), found that infant laboratory animals given free glutamic acid suffered brain damage immediately, and assorted neuroendocrine disorders later in life. Pharmaceutical grade L-glutamic acid was often used to produce these disorders until neuroscientists observed that monosodium glutamate, an inexpensive food additive, could be substituted for laboratory-grade free glutamic acid in these studies and produce the same effects.In the years that followed, neuroscientists replicated the work of Olney, and Olney spoke out repeatedly about the toxic potential of monosodium glutamate. In 1972, for example, Olney testified before the Senate Select Committee on Nutrition and Human Needs that ingestion of MSG places humans at risk, with the greatest risk being for the very young; and that a National Academy of Science panel organized to determine whether MSG ought to be banned from baby food had produced an "industry arranged whitewash" by a group of scientists with almost no experience in neuropathology. In the early 1970s, manufacturers of baby food voluntarily removed the monosodium glutamate from their products, but replaced the monosodium glutamate with MSG-containing ingredients such as autolyzed yeast and hydrolyzed vegetable protein. In the late 1970s, manufacturers "voluntarily" removed all obvious MSG-containing ingredients from baby food.Use of MSG in food has grown in the last 30 years and is still growing. MSG is found in most soups, salad dressings, processed meats, frozen entrees, ice cream, and frozen yogurt, in some crackers, bread, canned tuna, and very often in "low fat" and "no fat" foods to make up for flavor lost when fat is reduced or eliminated. It can be found in cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and dietary supplements. It is found in enteral feeding products and in infant formula. It is found in vaccines -- including vaccines used on children. It is found in hospitals where it is hidden in the jello, chicken soup, and some IV solutions given to very sick patients.Very often manufacturers use hydrolyzed protein products as MSG-containing flavor enhancers instead of using "monosodium glutamate." In the industry, an ingredient that contains MSG but is not necessarily recognized by consumers as containing MSG is called a "clean label" ingredient.

The coffee is fresh (I use whole-bean) and I love the aroma when I open the bag.  (I keep the unused portion in the freezer.)  This is delicious orange flavored coffee and I especially like the little bits of orange mixed in.
Hard to find in retail stores. Easiest way to get thiscoffee is amazon. Coffee is fresh and the same I usedto buy in Chicago suburb.

My husband and I became hooked on orange-flavored coffee several years ago. Our local Stop and Shop was our supplier of a different brand but they discontinued it. It took a lot of searching but we finally found this product from Coffee Bean Direct. It's not quite as good as the S&S coffee, but still very good.

column9: best orange flavored coffee I've every drank!!!!
column10: This coffee was delisious!! It had REAL orange peel in it. I thought the price was great for the amount of coffee I received. I'll definitely buy it again!

This is a great , mellow coffee.  The orange flavoring is so subtle, yet distinct.  The orange rinds with the beans make the difference and readily grind up nicely with the beans.  People will comment on my excellent coffee and ask me what beans I use and when I inform them of the orange rinds, they remark "this is excellent! Now that you mention it, I can taste the slight hint of orange."  I just bought another bag to give to my best friend for her birthday - it is that good!

With three dogs and three different appetites, this no-meat variety is a great topping for feeding time.  One dog in particular is subject to gastro intestinal issues and he can digest this with no problem!  Thanks for making this great food!

Good taste and texture (a bit high on sodium: 460 mg; otoh, kippered herring can't be salt-free, so it's not too bad.). Provides 1.0 g Omega-3 EFA per serving (one serving per can). Total fat: 8 g; Saturated 2.0g; Trans fat 0 g; Polyunsat. 1.5g; Monounsat: 4g; Cholesterol 65 mg; Protein 16g.That said, there really is a good reason ingredients are never available on online sites. Here they are:- Herring fillets, water, salt, natural smoke flavoring, sodium hexametaphosphate.The last one is, I quote from Healthy Eating Politics (google for it), "an emulsifier, a sequestering agent, and texturizer. Prevents scale formation and corrosion. Acts to stabilize product and prevent changes in appearance and texture. [HERE COMES! --] May cause respiratory tract irritation. Symptoms may include coughing and shortness of breath. Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to the ingestion of sodium hexametaphosphate that may produce mild chest pain. Also linked to pancreatic cancer in continual doses."So you decide if you want to eat that thing. Nice herring, but I don't think I will reorder.

While the taste was ok, i wish i had seen the ingredient list. I just had a case of polar kippers, with only salt added, and i assumed these would be the same.the polar ones are better, but they went up in price , and the crown prince are good, but not as good as the polar.  But these - you can taste a chemical. ...and therefore...i would avoid them

love this BRUNSWICK KIPPERED HERRING for years I bought it at walmart and kmart now nobody wants to carry it .now I have it coming regularly from amazon.com.16 grams of protien  and only 130 calories AND GREAT TASTE.thanks !

it began with me getting an idea of Cuban coffee.  than, i went to florida in january.  i spotted a cuban rest.  i ordered a cup post supper.  it did not have the stregth i envisioned.  although it was good.  my aunt that i was staying with took me 2 the grocery 2 bring some home.  i love it!!

Shipment arrived fast and in a nice, practical bucket. The wheat berries sprouted perfectly and grew quickly, thick and tall! I was a bit surprised as I'd never done anything like this before, and fully expected a few trial runs before getting it right. I used Ann Wigmore's sprouting technique, and the resulting juice was hearty and dark, though still sweet and great. Highly recommended! After a few trials, though, I would say be careful not to under water. I worried about molds and fungus on the third or fourth batch (tiny spots had begun showing up) and the grass suffered for it. More water means more, better grass.

I bought this seed to make centerpieces for a safari-themed baby shower. I did a test run with one planter last week. They sprouted beautifully - and close to 100% germination. The grass is tall and healthy (within only 8 days).

Butterscotch at long last I've found you!!!!! I have two wonderful  recipesfor breakfast sweet rolls  ( one from Paula Deen the other  from The Captain Lord Mansion in Kennebunkport ) that call for cook'n serve buterscotch pudding. Like everyone else who wrote, I could not find anywhere both in Atlanta, where I live. or in Los Angeles where my sister lives. Even tried in Tucson visting no luck!I googled it and found it on Amazon! Thanks!! Yeah!!

Finally, a COOK&SERVE "Butterscotch" pudding.  I live in SC and can always find the instant ( which is a joke ) but never the real thing. I now can buy it by the case at a reasonable cost.  Thank You.

I've been looking for cook and serve butterscotch pudding for months in local grocery stores, and it's disappeared from the shelves.  Just for fun, I checked Amazon...found it...and had it on the shelf at home in less than a week!  Thanks Amazon!!

column9: Cook and serve: good warm or cold.
column10: The only butterscotch pudding better than Jello's can be found at the Smith Brother's restaurants in Pasadena, California. If I use whole milk, it is identical!

column9: when you just can't find what you want on grocers shelves
column10: never could find butterscotch on grocers shelves in the jello brand  , could find royal.  it is great to have the jello brand butterscotch pudding.  brings back childhood memories

Yayyyy!!!!  I am prego and have been craving bubble loaf that is made with Cook and serve Butterscotch Jello.  I have been on the hunt and can't seem to find it anywhere!!!  Thank you Amazon!  Yes, 24 boxes is a bit excessive but since the bubble loaf is made by my entire family I thought I would share the wealth of Butterscotch jello!  Thank you again, you have made a pregnant woman happy!

What can I say except this is the best comfort food ever - the texture is awesome.  I love to eat it warm when the skin forms on top. My mom used to make this for me when I was little and when I couldn't find it at the stores I went online and was very happy to find it again. The instant puddings just do not do it for me. I make it with almond milk since I cannot tolerate dairy anymore and it still is MMMMMM-GOOD. (However,if you can tolerate dairy use milk because it does taste better). Online the minimum order is a whole case and that is ok by me!

I was so happy to find the cook and serve butterscotch here on Amazon. I wish they had it in the large size. Each pack uses only 2 cups of milk versus 3 cups for the chocolate or vanilla. It has been a good 30 years since I had the butterscotch pudding. I thought they quit making it as I have never seen it at any of the places I shop. Well, I got a case and it is now nearly finished. Tastes just like it used to. Also got a case of the chocolate but it is not as popular with my bunch. Rock on Amazon!
The Cook & Serve pudding is SO much better than the instant, and it's better and cheaper than buying the already-prepared pudding cups. Takes 6 minutes to cook in the microwave!

I grew up with puddings that you had to cook.  "Instant" had not been invented, yet.  My husband knows I love butterscotch pudding, but could only find the instant kind.  I looked online and found the "cookable" kind, so ordered it. It is not a big deal to cook it. By doing so, that "instant" taste that comes with uncooked is not there. I think that it would have been even better had I used whole milk, but being "seniors" who need to watch the calories, this is as good as it gets(I used fat free milk). Buying 24 boxes at a time is not a problem - it comes in a "display" box, which is good for storage.

column9: Jell-o Cook & Serve Butterscotch Pudding - Best Ever !
column10: This is by far the best pudding brand and flavor ever produced.  Forty-five years ago when Mom asked me what I wanted for dessert, my answer was puddingscotch!  It took me a few more years to figure out the real name.I've read in other reviews, and agree the case is the same in the Providence area, it is impossible to find this Jell-O brand Cook & Serve butterscotch pudding in any grocery store.  Sure, they sell the instant kind.  And as most of us know, whoever puts out hard earned cash for the instant variety deserves what s/he gets.  Give me Cook & Serve or give me death!
I'm totally satisfied with the Jello brand butterscotch pudding. I use it in a coffeecake recipe that is very easy to make.

I remembered this from when I was a kid and bought it because of that.  It's delicious, but it's really, really sweet!  So if that's something you might not like, be aware of that.  Rather than a straight pudding, I think it might be nice as a filling layer in a cake, etc.  I'm trying it that way the next time.

column9: Real cultured butter of high quality
column10: I usually buy the salted version of this butter since I mostly use it for spreading and for that I like the flavor of the salted version better. That being said, there are a number of recipies that call for unsalted butter and then the unsalted Lurpak is as good as you will find.Note that Lurpak is cultured butter (not sweet cream butter like most American brands) and as such it has a deep and rich flavor that no simple sweet cream butter can match. Cultured butter of this kind is produced by fermenting the cream with lactic bacteria that convert sugars to lactic acid before churning the cream into butter.In my opinion, the Lurpak Danish butter holds its own in comparison with far more expensive butters. I actually prefer Lurpak over brands like Echire, etc.

I am sure this is delicious as it had been recommended to me.However, it was completely melted when I received it, thepackage did not state PERISHABLE and the postage was expensive.I would not buy from this particular site again.

....to be replaced by Plugra.I became a 'butterholic' after tasting free sample of Lurpak at room temp spread on crakers at Wild Oats years ago.I had thought that butter was butter, and this premium stuff was just marketing gimmick, NOT!Ever since lurpak became my regular butter, I started 'testing' other premium butters, so far none ever surpassed lurpak till I tried Plugra at Whole Foods.Lurpak has this smooth, but tangy taste I crave for.  It's an excellent butter to use on fancy Eurostyle bread with organic milk on mornings.  But it's not a 'cooking' butter, yes one can use lurpak for cooking, but it's really a waste of flavor and such premium price to boot.Eventually I found another premium butter that replaced lurpak, Plugra, made in USA, and cheaper than lurpak, and even more complex and nuanced flavor than lurpak.Even Cook's illustrated declared Plugra a superior butter than lurpak, its former favorite just like it used to be mine.

column9: support denmark during middle eastern boycott
column10: Since the absurd boycott of Danish products in the Middle East over cartoons, it is good for the west and freedom to support Denmark. Their Lurpak butter and Arla cheeses are delicious and available on-line and at many grocery stores in the US. Buy, you'll like!

This matcha is incredible - I got hooked on plain matcha - so having someone kick it up a notch and add this incredible flavour is amazing.  I'm a big Boston Cream donut fan and this has the same taste too it.  Highly recommend it!

column9: Fresh, pastry chef Bavarian Cream flavor
column10: This is not a clone of French Vanilla by any means!  This definitely tastes like a freshly made pastry prepared the hard way, no shortcuts.  This has a light and lemony custard flavor and feels positively decadent and sinful even though I made my latte with skim milk and one teaspoon of sugar.  This is a very satisfying dessert!

Let me begin by saying that I've read all the reviews for this matcha, and although it sounds delicious, I never thought Bavarian Cream would be a flavour I crave. I love donuts with fillings, don't get me wrong, but they aren't something I jones for in the middle of the night. (I haven't been pregnant yet, so that could change! Haha). I guess what I'm trying to say is - I already have the Cheesecake Matcha, how amazing could Bavarian Cream be?The answer? Extremely amazing. Absolutely amazing. Exclaim it to the heavens!There's something about this flavour that took me by surprise and wooed me. The smell is sweet and creamy, no mistaking it for "vanilla" or something generic, it's quite a specific scent. The aroma is true to the taste, hallelujah! There's almost a "thickness" to it, and certainly a richness, that is reminiscent of its namesake. Creamy creamy creamy! The smell and taste of biting into that perfect area of donut where all the cream is. I personally like to save that part for the last, if I'm lucky. ;)Thankfully with this matcha, I get the best part all to myself!My personal favourite way to enjoy this matcha is as a hot latte with a pinch of sugar, to make the flavour pop and enhance the cream (if it can get any creamier - my goodness!). That said, I also shook it up in a water bottle and took it to work as an iced tea and again it really surprised me! No sugar added + true Bavarian Cream flavour = a happy Ash-Lee servicing customers with a buzz! Thanks Red Leaf Tea!

This matcha is great hot or cold. I think it tastes more like vanilla custard as a hot latte, and more like the whipped filling of a pastry when cold. Definitely great with milk! It also makes a great flavor for mixing with others. Peaches and cream, anyone? But even by itself, it's fantastic and definitely a must re-purchase when I run out.

When I received my package in the mail it came in a white envelope clearly labeled Red Leaf Tea! I was surprised at how quickly my tea arrived! The matcha itself came in a shiny golden envelope with lovely labeling and the type of matcha I ordered printed on a smaller label stuck on it.When I opened the bag containing my tea the smell was intoxicating! Vanilla, Cream, Butter. Those were the aromas that struck me.It is a pleasing flavor if you like rich, and creamy with a full lingering after taste!It tastes exactly like what you get in the middle of a doughnut! Oh yes...its good! :)This is on the top of my list of favorites from Red Leaf Tea but I dare you to make a list of only 5 or even 10 as they are all so very good!They taste exactly like what they say they will!Impressed as always!

I love Bavarian cream, it's such a nice luscious flavor. Though a big part of the reason I like it is the texture--and surely, a matcha couldn't really capture that, right? Well once again Red Leaf proves that they cam turn ANY flavor into a matcha and make it work! This is creamy, dreamy, vanilla custard with of course a lovely hint of grassy green matcha in the background. But the feel is smooth, creamy, and luscious. It really is like Bavarian Cream in a cup! It's got that same smooth custard-like texture as their Cheesecake Matcha, but I think Bavarian Cream edges it out a bit in terms of my favorites. Highly recommended!

I have wanted to order a vanilla-y Matcha for a while now, and I was debating back and forth between choosing the French Vanilla and the Madagascar Vanilla, when I finally settled on trying the Bavarian Cream.  And while this probably isn't as strongly VANILLA as the other two might be (but I don't know that for sure because I haven't yet tried either one of them, but they're on my list to eventually try too!) this one takes creaminess to a whole other level.I mean, you get the creaminess from the Matcha too, and combine that with the custard-y creamy taste of the Bavarian Cream, along with good amount of vanilla flavor and OMG you have heaven in a tea bowl.So very good.  Luscious, creamy, sweet and decadent.  Perfect!

column9: A yummy treat without the hassle
column10: I admit that my knowledge of Bavarian Cream is limited. I originally thought it was just a variation of vanilla. But apparently, it's more like a custard and quite popular in pastries. I personally try to avoid pastries since they are delicious but can also be calorie-laden and full of sugar. So it's nice when you can have a matcha instead that has the flavor without all the calories. Also, Bavarian cream seems like a hassle to make, so all the more reason to enjoy it in matcha form.I actually made this matcha iced and found it absolutely delicious. Normally I have to toss some milk in there to make it a little more drinkable, but this didn't need anything at all. The taste was very creamy and I could just detect the tiny bit of citrus. It's worth noting that if you do decide to chill your matcha this way, a lot of the powder sinks to the bottom, so you may have to froth it up again to get it to absorb.

I loved this matcha! It foamed up delightfully as I whisked it. I think that the foam and creamy texture is my favorite part of matcha. My first sip was delightful. I was met with strong green tea flavor followed by a hint of citrus and a bunch of creamy smoothness. It felt like I was drinking a latte! While it wasn't the vanilla I was expecting, the creaminess made up for it completely! I am super happy I bought the large one!I really enjoyed this cup of matcha!! I can't wait to prepare more!

I only ever had straight matcha prior to purchasing this Red Leaf flavored one. I never even had a matcha latte! And I never ever had Bavarian cream. So trying this as a latte was 3 firsts at once! And I have to say, I'll do it again. And again. And again.I love that I get to drink such a healthy drink and have it taste like dessert. It's energizing and delicious. I definitely taste the vanilla and cream, and I guess that's what Bavarian cream is, right? It's a very custardy flavor. And then I get some matcha flavor in the background. It's divine. I am in cream puff heaven...

Because of the way this is listed, I was expecting to receive 6 packs of 6, 1-ounce boxes, for a total of 36 boxes. However, I only received 1 six pack, which meant they cost about $3.00 per ounce. I do like the product itself, but recommend that others purchase it elsewhere.
I love these.  I start each morning with one so it is convenient to be able to buy in bulk. I will be back.

I travel a good deal and heading to the east coast from California is always a bit of a challenge the first day with customers.  Being a night owl I usually end up getting four or maybe five hours of sleep.  5-Hour Energy does the trick without the crash or the jitters.

I've been using 5 hour energy for a while now & the product works exactly as promised.  My problem has always been the availability locally.  The "wal" stores only have a couple flavors in the larger packs.  I've only been able to find grape in a 24 pack here.  The price per bottle is slightly higher than in the store, but an extra $.15 or so is worth it to get the flavor I like.The product was shipped VERY fast - I received within 3 days of order.  Will buy from this seller again..

I am buying this on Amazon because the price is better than buying it locally at the drugstore. As a night student, it is really helpful in keeping me alert during class, and I love the grape flavor. I have never liked the flavor of coffee, and 5-hour energy keeps me alert without the coffee jitters and the coffee tummy upset.
Bought this as a gift for a family member who swears by it.  This is a great price for it instead of buying them one at a time.

Wow, this tastes so good, especially compared to the lemon-lime flavor I bought previously.Works for hours, as they say, with no jitteriness & no "crash."  By the way, I only need to drink 1/2 a bottle at a time, which makes the case last twice as long.

I use this product regularly and prefer it over other "energy" drinks because it is easier to drink and I don't feel a "crash" after.  Grape is especially good (lemon-lime can be a bit bitter).  I highly recommend this product.  I also had an issue with receiving part of the order and was refunded right away - great product and great service.
I love that this is just a small shot with very few calories.  I drink it first thing in the morning for a little boost to start my day.  I really like the grape flavor.

I'm happy. Great price for the product I rely on, especially when I come home from work, the wife has been stressed by the baby, and I need that last little kick to help her out! I like the berry more than this grape tho.

How do you give something zero stars?I have tried it three times. It did nothing to give me more energy.I took one first thing this morning instead of the usual coffee and then took a nap.Tastes like hell too.Coffee works better.

Communication problem between Amazon and distributor, who has what.Product great. Price great.Problem, Only half, (12 bottles) of the order showed up after full payment.When inquired at both amazon and manufactuer, i played middle man to resolve the issue. Amazon offerd to pay for the other half of the order or i could return the product.I do not want to return the product, its not the product i dont like, just make it happen so that the rest of the order is here timely.  End result, i kept the 12 bottles and was refunded the other 12.Product not the problem. Not resolving the problem is.

So convenient having the food delivered to my door!  I have 3 adult outdoor cats.  One has had problems with his hair falling out even though I fed him a famous premium food. Our Vet said it is allergies, but I felt his symptoms suggested it was hyperactive thyroid. I bought 1 bag of First Mate and all 3 cats thinned down, got shiny hair, and the hair is growing back on the one with problems.  It was too good to be true, because now I come back to purchase more and I find the price has DOUBLED:(

column9: Not what it is cracked up to be
column10: My cats won't eat it.  I have kept it out for two weeks and they would starve before they ate enough to survive.

Scoop Away is good cat litter. Low price doesn't always mean low quality. This stuff is great. I've used it for many, many months. Sure it's a tad dusty if you're pouring it too fast but that goes away quickly. All in all, with different varieties of Scoop Away, there's one to suit any of your pet's needs.

We have two cats, one 4 years old and the other 5. Both are neutered males and we've had them since kittenhood. Of course, there's the litter box. Right from the start we picked up a big (40 pound) plastic container of Scoop Away at our local Costco Warehouse store and we've been using the brand ever since. Recently, Costco stopped carrying it and switched to Scoop Away Complete Performance cat litter, which supposedly has a variety of improvements and which comes in a large very tough plastic bag and weighs 42 pounds. Whew, that's a lot of litter but the bag is real sturdy and has a ziplock closure This new litter has been just excellent. It clumps into nice hard nodules and it's easy to clean the litter box. It has excellent odor control unless I forget to clean the box regularly, which I do at times. About the only complaint I might have is that the litter is somewhat dusty. This proves no problem with us in that the litter box is within 10 feet of the back door and we add litter by taking the box outside. Excellent Product.Gary Peterson

The litter has a strong scent to cover up odors. However, it does have a lot of dust so the cats smell like the litter when they come out of the box. I smell like the litter when i am cleaning the box! When shipped to me, the box was banged up and there was litter leaking out of the box.

column9: Dusty but gets the job done
column10: For someone with a cat that somehow spawns devil poop that WILL suffocate you, this litter is awesome. I've tried about 4-5 different brands and finally tried Scoop Away. So far it's been the only litter to really get rid of/mask the scent and do its job. It clumps when it's supposed to, it's light but not so light that it'll get tracked around, and it lasts a long time! An added bonus that my cat loves it and purrs whenever he goes in it.The only things I do not like are that the box isn't the most convenient design and it's a bit dusty. With the box, there's a perforated line at the top side where you push your opening for the litter.. if you don't push it outwards, the litter get trapped behind the box and then you have to hold the flap so that the litter can actually come out. And it's a small opening so when you're refilling a whole litter box, it's not the most efficient. And when you first pour it out, the litter is dusty but it settles almost instantly and you're not going to be covered in a layer of dust and neither will your floor or furniture. I personally don't think it smells bad either, I think the scent is relatively fresh, and it's not an overwhelming odor either.This litter really does work. I definitely recommend it and have not dared to try a different brand since switching to Scoop Away.

column9: Smells like a perfume factory that exploded- and dustier than a dirt road.
column10: Bought a big bag to save $$.. never again. This stuff is soooooo dusty. My poor cat was sneezing like crazy. And i love perfume but this stuff was  so over the top in smell that even I didnt like it. And I am the kind of person who people tease because I can never pass a perfume counter without testing everything.Do yourself and your cat a favor and get the expensive but recycled and biodegradable litter that is made from corn. I love that stuff. No dust and it absorbs all the odors.

Fast shipping, great price. Scoop away is the only cat litter i use, the wee clumps so it's easy to pick up with the scooper. The scent of the cat litter is not as strong as some people are saying, but you cannot smell the cats mess. No matter how many times i pass by the cat litter it doesn't smell bad at all. The only con is when the cat leaves the cat litter and the small trace of litter on the floor gets kind of hard to clean up.

column9: Excellent for odor, terrible for dust!
column10: Our little dude has arthritis now and since this developed, we've had to move his litter box to the first floor of the house.  So, when I found that this stuff totally kills the odors, I grabbed a box since Tidy Cats had begun to fail in the odor task immensely.  Quite honestly, I've NEVER had a litter that completely, totally, without a trace, ridded the air of all kitty odors.  This stuff, hands down, is the BEST I've ever tried.  There's absolutely NO odor whatsoever!  It's just a bit weird how you just do not smell anythiing at all.  However, don't have your cat sitting there waiting while you're filling the box.  As good as this is at clumping, odor control, and great smell, it's TERRIBLE for dust!  It just blows all over the place and I actually have to turn on the fan in the bathroom to get rid of it.  Why they can't get this without the dust by now is beyond me.  But, if you live in a small space and need the odor control, this is your litter.  Just get out the Swiffer and be prepared to dust.  Recommend highly, but with the above condition.

I just got my cat from a shelter in May 2011, so were still figuring what works ie food & litter. I used to use Tidy Cat but she would track it everywhere & it had a hard time clumping. So I bought this on a whim & love it. It does have a strong fragrant smell & is rather dusty but I don't mind the smell & a little dust when changing litter is better than having litter residue everywhere. Also this clumps really well so its easier to clean the box and it seems longer lasting so I use a lot less.ProsGood priceDoesn't 'track' as badClumps wellCovers odors wellConsCan be dusty when changing boxHeavy perfume smell (which I like) but if your smell sensitive your cat will smell like this after using the box.

I use this litter with an automatic litter box and it works wonders!  It clumps HARD, so it clears away clean and leaves no odor behind.  It is a bit dusty if you pour a bunch all at once, but I don't find it to be any worse than others that I've tried. I have on occasion, tried another brand of litter, and have always been severely disappointed.  I highly recommend this litter - especially if you have an automatic litter box!

I used Fresh Step and Scoop Away cat litters for many years and was quick to tell any of my cat owner friends that they were the best "bang for the buck" litters. They clumped hard, making the chore of cleaning the cat box a relatively easy one. Sometime around 6 months ago, that all changed. Now, they form a sludge in the cat box that is nearly impossible to scrape out. The amount of effort necessary to clean the box could easily induce a muscle strain or hernia for those unfortunate enough to purchase one of these litters. Both products are made by the Clorox Pet products Co. Consider yourself warned!

column9: Would not recommend, cats don't like strong scent...
column10: First the good:  this cat litter is decently priced, clumps fairly well, and is finer than other litters (cats tend to like fine litters better).The bad:  the scent is very strong.  People may not notice it as much but cats have a lot more sensitive noses and they can definitely tell.  In my experience from using this with many cats at our local animal shelter, only the more picky ones have actually gone outside of their litterbox rather than use this litter, but the majority don't like it and try to stay on the opposite side of the cage.  Cats really prefer unscented litter, and this is one of the more smelly litters we have tried.  This litter is also a little more dusty than other litters.Because of its strong scent, it does do a good job of masking odor.  It basically comes down to your need to mask odor versus your cat's comfort.  At the animal shelter, the cats' comfort is our priority, so we choose not to use this litter.  Overall, I would not recommend buying this litter unless your cat isn't picky at all.

I used to use another brand but it smelled too much like ammonia after a few times of my cats using it. I couldnt stand it anymore and i bought Scoop Away Multi Cat.I have two cats and with this litter it clumps great and it does not smell like ammonia. It smells great.

I found a great deal for this cat litter here and since I knew that it a great product I bough I much as I could. My cats love it and my husband loves it even more, because it is very easy to clean and last for a long time!

column9: The Best Cat Litter For Your Money
column10: The Best Cat Litter For Your MoneyI don't buy this from Amazon as a certain chain brick 'n' mortar has a much better price, but wanted to comment on this litter. Given the (other) price, it's the best litter out there. It scoops easily, lasts a long time and is just plain a good value. The other value brand that comes in the bright yellow pail is its closest competitor in price and I find it very had to scoop. This is so much easier.

column4: Los conquistadores del gato! "The cat conquerors"
column9: How Do You Do That Doo Doo That You Do So Well?
column10: I LOVE this product!  If you have Cats and you use Cat Litter then this is the product for you!  I have used Scoop Away for several years now with great results! The odor control is much better than higher priced brands such as Fresh Step or Tidy Cats.  I have previously used Tidy Cats crystal litter (which is supposed to have superior odor control); however the odor control for Tidy Cats crystal litter pales in comparison to Scoop Away!  Also one item worthy of mention is that while this brand may often times cost less than other Cat Litter brands; it is not a discount brand.  Scoop Away is a great quality brand that provides you with better quality and value than the more popular brands.Cat Litter in general is something that has to be maintained often, regardless of what brand is best for you.  I recommend scooping your Cat Litter a minimum of twice a day, more often if possible.  Scooping your litter often will help with odor control.The style of Litter Box I prefer is a covered Litter pan with an open lid.I usually buy the style of Litter Box that has the pan cover with a flap opening, though I always remove the flap.  While the flap will help with odor control, it seems for some reason to be very irritating to the oldest Cat.  I always buy the style of Litter Box that accommodates the air filters as well, though I have found them to not do much of anything for Litter Box odor.  The best thing for overall Litter Box odor control is Scoop Away Cat Litter.A lot of Vets and Cat experts recommend having one more litter box than the number of Cats you have.  We have 4 Cats and three litter boxes.  I scoop the litter a minimum of twice a day. Our Cats are indoor Cats, if your Cat is mostly outdoors or indoor/outdoor then you may not have to scoop and change the litter as often.I prefer to put about 17lbs. of litter in each Litter Box when changing the litter.  You may need more or less depending on the number of Cats you own, as well as the size of your Cats.Of the different verities of Scoop Away available, I highly recommend the Multi-Cat scented formula, even if you only have one Cat!  The Multi Cat scented formula will give you the best possible odor control.  If your Cat has allergies or is sensitive to scented Cat Litter, then I would suggest one of the non-scented verities.Whatever Cat Litter you decide to provide for your Cat, I again suggest that you use Scoop Away!Van Ness CP6 Enclosed Cat Pan/Litter Box, LargeVan Ness  CP7 Enclosed Cat Pan/Litter Box, Extra LargePureness Ebytra Giant Translucent Enclosed Cat Litter Pan, Assorted ColorsNatures Miracle Odor Control Universal Charcoal Filter, 2-PackJMK 07065 Pet Scoop - Various Colors

When I first bought this kitty litter I was very surprised with the strong smell it had, and was worried that the cats wouldn't use it because it was so perfumey. They use it just fine though, with no problems.I didn't notice that it's any dustier than any other kitty litter I've used, but maybe I'm just oblivious?And I didn't notice the smell clinging to the cats either, but I don't let the cats climb all over me right out of the litter box anyway.All in all, I approve of the strong perfumey smell over a regular litter box smell any day and it clumps very well, so I give it 5 stars.

This litter has a "maximum ammonia shield" that is great for oder, but will poison your cat if it sticks to their paws and they ingest it. Check out the product reviews for the item that pops up first when searched on google: www.amazon.com/gp/aw/d/B000633RG0Review after review says the same. Save youself an expensive very bill.
The boxes arrived busted up and there was litter all over the place.  This is a great product however in the future all cat litter will be purchased in the store!

This stuff is incredibly dusty.  I could taste it for 20 minutes after filling the cat litter box... It can't be good for the cats.  Also, after the cat uses the litter,  the cat then stinks like the litter deodorant smell.

I am excited about this, I have a handful every now and then.  I wish they had less salt but otherwise I am glad I don't have to shell the pistachios and deal with that mess.Also wish they used sea salt for less sodium as well.

Oh, boy! I could tell these were going to be good when I cracked open the bag. What a nice aroma! I was right. They're excellent! Well, I usually buy pistachios in the shell, but I passed by these bags in the nut section of my local Costco store, and I just couldn't resist trying them. They're great. Nice and fresh. Salted to perfection with the potassium content still almost double the sodium content. Lots of fiber and unsaturated fat. What more could you ask? Did I mention that they're delicious? Wonderful, indeed!Gary Peterson

So, these nuts are very dynamic in taste. They are perfectly roasted withjust the right amount of pistachio sweetness that a fresh pistachio nut should have.The nuts we're not overly salty in the least bit. The shipping was super fast.And the bag was tightly sealed.
Could have gotten a five but it is cheaper at Costco.  Eating this is as good as eating candy.  but without the bad for you part.

column9: Great as long as the bag arrives intact.
column10: Bag seems adequate, but sometimes gets a tiny hole during shipping (maybe from a sharp nut?). Perhaps better to order the ones in the bottles, but other than the bag problem, 'wonderful' company makes fantastic delicious pistachios.
I thought this product would be good as I am tired of shelling the nut, but I threw away half of this bag.  Maybe it was just the bag I got but it was over roasted and bitter.
K cups are the way to go and I love this flavor. I have at least two cups every morning. Of all the flavors, this is my favorite. Even my son who says he is not into flavored coffees likes it.
These cups contain coffee pellets (instant coffee) and not ground beans. There is nothing to indicate this in the product description. Zero stars. Amazon refunded my money.

I know that people have different likes and dislikes but I am truly shocked to see a one star review on this tea. I think this is my favorite flavor out of any tea I have ever tried and I drink a ton of tea!

This is great tasting tea and, quality wise, seems to rival the best tea brands out there in both tea quality and packaging. The problem is the tea bags and tea parts within the bag are small... I prefer tea brands where the bags are really filled. It seems like you have to use two tea bags of this brand to get the same amount of tea as some other brands. Anyways, its a good price for a high quality tea but you might notice the small quantity.
This tea is absolutely splendid, either iced or hot.  It's the onlydrink that gets better as it sits.  Its "zip" actually increases.
We own a hair salon and have served this tea for almost 3 years now and our clients come in and request it.  It has been a huge hit.Absolutley love it.

column9: Perfect blend of smooth and spicy
column10: This tea is wonderful to drink anytime. It doesn't have the tannin-bitterness of a green or black tea, and the blending of juicy peach and ginger bite, are amazing. I have tried many flavored teas...including the other Bentley flavors and this one is by far my favorite.
Not a tea drinker myself, but this is the best tasting tea out there!  Try it, this might change your mind.
This is a wonderful tea. Great natural flavors and can be enjoyed all year long.Tasty and soothing when served hot and flavorful enough to hold up nicely when iced.It is a favorite at our house.

For my sense of smell, this tea doesn't smell like peach and ginger.  It smells like something else that is very unappealing and distasteful.Besides this tea, I recently tried several other Bentley teas -- mango, blueberry, raspberry, etc. -- and I have to report that I also disliked them.  The Bentley teas seem to have very different smells compared to other teas, like Twinings, Tazo, Ahmad, etc.Although I've tried many teas that didn't impress me, the Bentley teas are the first that I have found that I completely dislike.  Given the mixture of very positive and very negative reviews for their teas, I'm guessing that it is a situation where people have strong reactions to the smell of their teas and either love them or hate them.For a comparison, I would recommend trying the Ahmad Peach & Passion Fruit tea, which I think is very tasty -- and very, very different compared to this Bentley tea.

I didn't like this at all.  I found it chemical, and not nicely redolent of the ginger I O so, love.  I just gave it away, cute little tin and all.  I am adventurous, so I do happen on things I feel aren't what I expected from time to time.  This was certainly one of them.  I'm sure some of you will like like it, don't let me stop you from trying out your own personal tastebuds.  Mine said: "This tea is not a real peach, either."

I was first introduced to this snack at my dog's training classes at petco. He really enjoys them! The pieces are really tiny but you can tell that it is made from quality ingredients (it also smells really bad), but my dog loves it. I highly recommend this product as it is a quality product that is actually healthy for your pup!

This soup is nice for a snack or light meal. The broth has a tasty, light tomato flavor and the ingredients taste fresh. The noodles don't have much flavor to me, but they are not bad.I like Muir Glen's Minestrone soup a little better.

column9: Horrible soup - the worst soup I've ever tasted. It literally tastes like vomit.
column10: I bought a few cans of Imagine organic Minestrone soup today at Grocery outlet, brought them home and tried some for lunch.  I love minestrone soup so I expected to like it.It was horrible. It literally tasted like vomit, and I've been trying every since to get the taste out of my mouth.  I only ate two tablespoons of it before dumping the rest out.  Grocery Outlet sells "old" food, which is nearing it expiration date, but this batch doesn't expire for another four months. I'll be returning the rest of the ones I bought to the store, and can't imagine buying something from this company agai.Grocery Outlet has a large number of Imagine products on sale for $1 to $1.49 a can; I can't help but wonder if it's because something is wrong with them.

column9: ONE OF THE BEST MIXES OF ANY SORT WE HAVE EVER FOUND
column10: Generally speaking, my wife and I are not overly fond of most "mixes."  We, over the years, have found them to be inferior to the stuff we turn out at home.  But that being said, we have also discovered that quite often we have neither the time nor the inclination to whip up a batch of stuff from scratch.It is also a fact, and not a general statement, that we both love cornbread as does the rest of our family.  We both were raised on the stuff...like as it was served with just about ever meal, day after day after day.You can imagine our delight when we found a mix that is not only quickly prepared, but one that actually tastes just about as good as anything either of us have ever whipped together...cornbread wise.All you need with the six ounce pack of this stuff is 2/3 cup of milk and one beaten egg.  You then take a 8 inch ovenproof skillet or square pan (we use a cast iron skillet...a very, very old one), and spray it with a no-sick cooking spray and stick the pan in a preheated oven (425 degrees) for 7 to 8 minutes.You then combine the cornbread mix, mild and egg in a small mixing bowl, stir until smooth and dump it in the skillet.  Bake at 425 degrees for 18 to 22 minutes until golden brown.That is it!This particular cornbread has a wonderful consistency and a very (I stress "very") mild pepper flavor as it dose have Jalapeno peppers added...one of my favorites of the pepper family.  To be honest, I have never tasted anything quite like it.  It easily reaches the category of comfort food.  I actually defy you to eat just one chunk and quite.  This is truly good stuff folks.There is a fancier way of fixing it by adding a small can of creamed corn and cheddar cheese, but we like the basic recipe so much we have never given it a try.The price here is a bit steeper than we pay at the local Wally store type place, but not much more.Trust me folks...give this stuff a try.Don BlankenshipThe Ozarks

column9: This is a fantastic black tea!
column10: I am so glad to see Peet's products offered for sale on Amazon!  You can't go wrong with any Peet's products.  The teas and coffees that their expert buyers search out are top quality and very often unique.  The product is always as fresh as fresh can be.This Pride of the Port blend is made from black tea.  This is not a strong breakfast blend.  It has a beautiful reddish brown color when brewed and it has a wonderful floral fragrance and a complex taste.  Brewed properly, one can taste many flavors.  It is very "nuanced" and provides a soothing and relaxing experience.  There is no bitterness, no off or odd flavors.  It's not my favorite of all Peet's teas, but it is my favorite of those offered here.If you want to get the most out of your tea experience, or if you're having trouble getting your water temperatures just right, check out the electric tea kettle we use:  Breville BKE820XL Variable-Temperature 1.8-Liter Kettle.  We love it!  It gets your water to the correct temp quickly!  And it's very safe to use.

We purchased Lupini Beans on Amazon.  The company is Parthenon Foods.  When we received the item we opened the first jar, the beans were incredibly bitter, so we opened the 2nd jar, same thing.  We poured out the beans and some of them were black. Contacted Parthenon Foods and this was their response:Hello,  We are sorry, but we cannot honor a return or refund for this order.  The order was delivered as scheduled by the shipping service selected.  The product(s) shipped were as advertised.  Please read our shipping and returns policies for more information. "You cannot return items that you do not like in taste or package shape"How convenient for them!!  The beans are bitter and bad.  I will NEVER order from this company again and I hope that all that read this review be careful in ordering any product from them.  I order many food items online and have never had a problem.  It is not that we didn't like the taste, the beans are bad, I grew up on Lupini Beans and have ordered other brands online and not had a problem.  So to Parthenon Foods, guess that was an easy $20.00 for you!!  So to the buyer beware, it may look good online, but you're taking a huge risk on when the product arrives!!

Very rich and everything else a new york cheesecake is supposed to be!  You won't feel like you are losing any flavor or texture by going without gluten!  These precious babies have a $4.99 MSRP and sell for that at my local stores so the price above for 8 must have s/h added on to it of $3 each to assure getting it to you fresh...  you can't go wrong with this item!  ENJOY!

column9: Not As Good As in Italy
column10: I cook two packages together and exactly 7min as the package instruction but it comes out too soft and falling apart. I bought some from Naples October,2011. after I boil for 7 min it comes out firm and nice.This product comes out soft and falling apart.

Since my wife put me on a diet and made me eat only whole wheat bread, I was searching for good tasting whole wheat bread. Finally I found Sterns whole wheat bread which is healthy and good tasting (probably the best whole wheat bread I  ever had). Since then I always eat whole wheat bread even though I am long off my diet.

I bought the peach flavored tea, because I'm a huge fan of the passion fruit one.  I tried it unsweetened and sweetened.  I couldn't find a way to make this drinkable.  Either way, it was awful!  It tasted like some awful medicine.  I threw the rest of the pitcher and box away.  This was a waste of my money.

I have a deep and abiding love for almost all of the China Mist iced teas. But, this peach tea has a dreadful, medicinal taste to it that is just awful. I am loathe to throw things out just because they aren't my favorite, but this tea was virtually undrinkable. I poured the entire pitcher down the drain. Get the orange blossom ginger or the blackberry jasmine tea instead. You'll thank me, I promise.
The lamb arrived in a timely manner.  It was also extremely fresh. My family enjoyed memorable  juicy, tender holiday eating.

Let me just say.....I am Pickie, Pickie, Pickie when it comes to Salsa. But when I went to Trader World and sampled this Salas I was Hooked and when it was gone I was upset so I looked and bought me 4 jars...I will only buy this salas "unless" I need some other kind in a pinch! Love itThanks one of you Favorite Customers!!!

column9: Mossy Creek Honey Apple Salsa Is Very Tasty
column10: I bought this salsa at the grocery store on a whim, and I am glad I did!  It is a very sweet salsa, just so you know, and I am looking forward to using it to cook with as well as using it with pita bread slices, or as suggested here, poured over cream cheese with some crackers.  A little sidenote:  I got this same size at my local grocery store (Freshway) for $3.19, so you may want to check around.

The salsa itself is very tasty and if you are looking for sweet salsa without much kick, this is definitely for you.  However, despite the webpage saying this is a 12 pack, it is NOT; it is a single jar!  I can buy this in my local grocery store for $3, $2 when it is on sale. I thought I found a nice bargain here on Amazon, but alas, no.  I will not buy this again from Amazon (overpriced) but will continue to buy from my local vendor.  Salsa gets 4+ stars, ad gets 1 star.

I'm baking whole wheat bread, using a recipe from Cook's Illustrated Pastry Recipes. I use a bread machine to make dough, and then bake it in the oven.They suggested using Graham Flour. I tried it, and found it OK. Now I use King Arthur's flour, and get great bread. I use a bit more water, and bake it at 350 deg instead of 375 deg. The bread is moister and delicious. You can buy graham flour if you wish, but King Arthur's Whole Wheat is excellent.
The product arrived quickly and was well wrapped so not to break.  The taste is wonderful and goes with everything we put on the table. Even the kids like them.

I enjoy whole-bean coffees from all over the world. Costco is my major source for beans and they usually come in three-pound bags. Kirkland Signature is the most common brand, but a few other brands appear from time to time. A problem with Costco is that at any particular time they may have only two or three varieties. But if you come back a month or so later, they still may have only two or three but they will probably be a different two or three. It's something of an adventure and a good way to exp[ore the coffees of the world. Plus, if you find some variety that you really, really like, you may find it available on line, as is this one.Well, here's an excellent coffee. It's a Guatemalan Whole Bean Coffee. Nice aroma, but relatively mild compared to other bagged coffees. Excellent taste, but it's a quite lighter roast than I'm used to. That's OK. I like variety. This one has an excellent coffee taste and is smooth and delicious. It goes down easily, that's for sure. Smooth and mellow. Nice lingering aftertaste. I would think that any coffee lover would find it excellent, but some may expect a deeper, darker roast in a whole bean coffee. For me, this is a really nice coffee.Gary Peterson

column9: I love this stuff - I wish my local Costcos carried it.
column10: I like this better than their Ruwanda and Sumatra and it was a welcome break from drinking Starbucks French Roast for about two years.  I like coffees that are strong, bold, have a slightly nutty or smoky taste.  I recommend this coffee highly.

I really enjoy the Kirkland's Guatemalan. It has a nice bold, smooth, rich flavor. You get what you pay for with this product and I like the 3lb package instead of 1lb. Will order again when it becomes available. Thanks.
The Kirkland name brand coffee sold through costco normally is an excellent alternative to shopping at their retail store....THANK YOU! THANK YOU! THANK YOU!

I like a lot of the Costco/Kirkland products, but this one is not premium quality. My girlfriend had the first cup and said it reminded her of Folgers, and I don't think that's too far off. It's really bitter. I've bought much better coffee at Trader Joe's. I'll be sticking with them or my local roaster.
Positively delicious.  Came quickly.  We served on toasted baguette slices, along with a tray of smoked salmon.  I will buy again.
sweet and Fruity - delicious (if you like very sweet jams).  There is fruit in every spoonful.  Love it!!!!!

column9: My daughter's favorite play date activity!
column10: The Zebra Mix Cookie Kit has been the perfect play date activity for our 9 y/o daughter. At this age they can do it all by themselves with a parent only in the background. The instructions are clear and fun to follow and the sense of accomplishment, when those cookies are baked, is huge.I am an avid baker myself and was a bit hesitant about eating cookies that weren't made from scratch,- but I have to say that they truly tasted homemade, thanks to all the natural ingredients.I recommend this toy for all kids who love science, reading, math, and cookies,- alone or with friends and family!

It's not often that a product at this price point can deliver on so many different levels. Not only did the colorful map of directions engage my 8 year old son in reading, math and a foreign language (spanish), but the sense of pride he felt when eating the finished product was priceless! What a great way to entertain and educate kids, and instill a sense of independence at the same time.  Well done Zebra Mix!

The tin is cool, the recipe is fun and easy to follow, the safari map makes for less mess and quick clean-up.  Best of all the cookies are yummy, with nothing funky to make me feel like I'm not giving my kid the best ingredients for her growing body.  THANK YOU ZEBRA MIX!

column9: Zebra Mix- total fun in the kitchen! and no mess!
column10: My boys love to bake and I had almost given up because their baking turned my kitchen into a zoo! Plus, I never really found any mixes or kids kits that tasted good and had any redeeming factors.But, I have to say I love Zebra Mix. They have taken baking and somehow weaved reading, math and science into the process. My 10 year old made these cookies and then told me he learned how to read a scientific formula and found out their was acid in the mix (molasses). Plus they really taste great, these cookies are even better than my traditional M&M cookies because they do not have ANY artificial ingredients and they have oatmeal and lots of good things.I also bought the cupcakes because both my kids want one of the cool lunch tins. I just  saw the kits at Borders and the people at the store they sell really well. I had never seen them before.

We got this kit for 7 year old for Christmas. We made them this weekend and the whole family got in on the fun. Its fun and well organized. Really easy for parents and virtually no mess!The finished cookies have a nice look and texture, but are salty for our taste.

column9: Did you not receive complete kit
column10: I'm not very happy with this product.  The complete kit was not sent and this was to be a christmas gift.  Will not order from this company again unless this is quickly resolved.

My friend has twice bought these kits for her sons--mainly because she wanted the cute box they come in to use as lunchboxes, but they've also made the cookie mix.  It seems to have been a fun activity and the boys were proud of having "made cookies."  But having tried them twice, I have to say, these are some of the yuckiest cookies I've ever eaten. The soft texture is nice, but they taste like some off-brand cookie you'd get at the dollar store.

Changing my review.  These actually really suck compared to the whole beans.  These nibs are all mixed up with stems and shell fragments; an occasional rock can be found as well.  Definitely overpriced for the quality.  If you're going to order cacao, get the whole beans and just break them up yourself, that way you can be sure to get out all of the stems and shell fragments.

Good deal, almost too good to be true. Product picture shows cacao beans, brown to dark brown in nature. Product received were "nibs" of blue-ish-gray color. Tasted quite good. Organic..? Maybe. Upon suggestion to change product picture I was invited to return shipment for refund. Too much trouble, waste of time for amount involved.

column4: Covered In Harmony "undeserving servant of Ch...
column10: These are great nibs. They're slightly bitter with a hint of sweetness and a nice creaminess at the end--just like nibs are supposed to taste. These are perfect in vanilla ice cream or smoothies.

Product is crushed Cacao beans, not whole as in picture.  So, you will get nibs not beans.  Flavor is complex, dark chocolate start with a fruity finish.  Texture is interesting, a little chunkier than I expected.  Some parts are hard to chew-as if some shell or similar material is in with the nibs.  I sprinkle it over my cereal for an added kick.  Overall I like it, but may try using a grinder or mortise/pedastal to make a little easier to chew.

I bought these cacao nibs to make chocolate. I actually considered buying already roasted nibs but this product's price is way better so i just ordered this product and roasted it myself (it is easy). This product makes great chocolate. Like another reviewer said 1 serving of of these nibs contains 314% of our daily need of iron, however as far as I am aware of, according to FDA there is no health concerns associated with iron consumption. In short this is a great product for anyone who wants to make their own chocolate. One small problem is the amount of bean shells, I needed to pick them by hand (to make smoother chocolate), if it was possible to put them in water most of those shells would float on surface I believe, however I wasn't sure if it was okay to wash nibs before roasting so I just handpicked...
Great quality nibs.  They store well and have such a depth of flavor you will enjoy them.  It is such a good price, it is worth making space to store them.

I bought the 5 lb bag to get a deal.  I usually buy Navitas.  These nibs are clearly roasted and not raw.  I contacted the company, and they said they roast the nibs at 175 degrees.  Don't fall for the false marketing.  You can see my detailed review under the 5 lb bag.
Check out other reviews about this. These are advertised as raw, but they're indeed roasted. Stick with Navitas Naturals cacao.

column9: CAREFUL:  These are NOT RAW CACAO BEANS - PICTURE IS MISLEADING
column10: I ordered a 2 pound bag of CACAO NIBS and what I THOUGHT was a 2 pound bag of CACAO BEANS, but I was not paying attention when I ordered this product.  THIS WAS SUPPOSED TO BE MY 2 POUND BAG OF CACAO BEANS, but instead, to my surprise, got two 2-pound bags of CACAO NIBS!!!!  I suppose it's my fault for NOT READING THE CAPTION BELOW THE PIC, but I was in a hurry that day.The nibs are a great product, but I do NOT NEED 4 pounds of it!  I WISH I HAD GOTTEN WHAT WAS BEING ADVERTISED IN THE PICTURE, INSTEAD OF WHAT WAS BEING ADVERTISING VERBALLY.  LOL
This stuff is simular to flavored Coffee Mate (the power kind), yet it rivals it, and some of the other private brand verions.

column9: Not same as Kroger brand Cinnamon Cream creamer
column10: I purchased this creamer hoping that it would be the same flavor as the Kroger brand of Cinnamon Cream non-dairy creamer that was recently discontinued.  It is good, but is not exactly the same as the discontinued Kroger brand - so not a direct substitute. Has a very subtle cinnamon flavor.
I have been unable to get cinnamon creamer in this area. I received the product very quickly. It is creamy with just the right cinnamon taste.

This was a Christmas gift for my Grandparents since I live out of state. I wanted to get them something that would be unique from Texas. They did not say they had any problems, and they said that they loved it!

column9: Just enough spice, makes a tasty meal!
column10: We tried this for the first time the other day, and WOW!  This dish is perfectly spiced and filling on it's own.  We added some extra steamed veggies and it was enough for 3 of us to eat for lunch.  Will definitely buy again!

The Osem Mejadara is simply a mixture of rice, onions and perfectly cooked lentils, spiked with a bit of cumin and cinnamon. It makes a hearty vegetarian one dish meal. By itself, this makes a fast, 5 minute tasty meal. If you have some extra time, cook up and add caramelized onions for the most authentic taste.

This tea is wonderful.  I originally bought some from a local tea house that went out of business, so I searched for the name and was hopeful that this tea from Amazon was the same thing.  It is ... I am thrilled!

I love Famous Dave's sauces. They are all good but my favorite is Devil's Spit. I really enjoy the depth all of his sauces contain. You won't find this kind of flavor from the shelves in the grocery store stuff! Get yourself a WSM and create your own bbq at home.

column9: Fantastic spicy aftertaste lasting several minutes
column10: Sunflower kernels are getting hard  to find at the supermarket, so I thought I'd try out some Amazon offerings.  These Habanero seasoned seeds are the best of the bunch.At about 7 kernels, the amount of heat is too high for me, but 2-4 kernels is quite tasty, with a spicy aftereffect lasting several minutes.  That makes it a really nice snack for anyone watching their diet.  I have a small saucer next to me here with a few pinches of these seeds while I write out some reviews, and I've barely dented them after half an hour.  A similar amount of the cracked pepper seeds wasn't quite as tasty, and lasted about a minute.I think these will now be my #1 snack. They aren't messy or greasy at all. At therate I'm going, it'll take me about a day to go through a half ounce of these.Highly recommended.

When I was a kid (and dinosaurs roamed the Earth), I used to get a bag of Gummi Bears just like these, and a bar of MilkaWorld's Best Milka Chocolate - Alpine Milk, 10 Bars from my Oma and Opa in Germany.  As I devoured the sweets, I used to think that I was the luckiest kid in the world.Unlike so many things from my childhood, these haven't changed a bit.  They still come in five colors with amazingly fresh fruit flavors. These little packets each contain about nine little bears, and are just the right size to stick in a pocket or purse for a surprise pick-me-up. I keep them in the house to comfort a boo-boos reward an unexpected high test score, or to celebrate a sunny afternoon.  This large package contains 75 little packets in a sturdy plastic box that the Haribo people encourage you to reuse.If these treats were a part of your childhood, you can buy these without the fear that they've changed - they haven't.  If you haven't experienced the bears that started the current craze of all things gummi, they're well worth trying.  But please, save the white ones for me!

Not as advertised - no tub.  Could not give this as intended gift, as it was sent loose in a plastic bag!  VERY SMALL gummi bears - not soft and chewy like normal size - just a few per package.  RIP OFF!

column9: Nice product, but not as described
column10: I do like this product, but it didn't come in the resealable plastic tub. It was all packaged in a big plastic bag. It shipped fast.

Mini is really the appropriate word.  You pay more for the packaging...better off to buy the bigger bags. What is in each packet is about the equivalent of two regular size gummi bears.  They taste great, but would recommend the larger bags unless you just want "cute".
Product was fine but it's not as pictured, it comes in a plastic bag and its tiny little bags of gummi bears.

column9: Small packages. Great if that is what you want.
column10: Ordered this to use as handouts for a presentation. Was great for that. The packages are small. Most have 5-6 bears in them though a couple had only 3-4. Also my tub of 72 actually only contained 69 packages.
Of course, since they're Haribo gummies... they are good.  But the packaging is too small, I would say there's about 4~5 mini gummi bears in each pouch.

I like to keep things on my desk so folks can just grab and enjoy. You can never go wrong with Haribo Gummis!  The classic Gummis in an easy individual serving. The actual bears are a little smaller but just as good. The tub the come in is reusable also. I'll keep a supply of these on hand!

Those bears are not made in Germany and they do not respect de recipe,they have food coloring ,red 40 in them and my son is allergic to that.very disappointed.Very unhappy with the customer service ,too.I will never shop with them again!

column9: Great price and size, easy to work with
column10: I volunteer for a German Immersion school PTO and we use these at various events to market our school to the public.
