column9: Good coffee, but not a "9 Pound Box"
column10: The coffee was decent but not outstanding. Very similar to most grocery store "bought from bins" coffees. Like Market District, Millstone or Howe's. Some were better than others & all seemed fresh & well packaged. The cups are nice too. But the "deal" isn't as good as it looks. There is only 5.5 pounds of actual coffee in this box. (The box WEIGHS about 9 pounds with everything in it.) I did receive a partial refund after complaining & Amazon said they would change the description to make it clear what you were buying. However it as been 2 weeks and this has not been revised. Hence, the sketchy review.  :O)

I believe the contex could be written more clearly. I was under the impression that it was 9 pounds of coffee not just a 9 pound box of stuff....As i read more closely I noticed I was at fault, but that wasnt until I recieved the package...

The assortment is a large box---the individual 8oz bags are much larger than they look in the photo.  With the bonus bag, the assortment comes out to 5 1/2 pds of coffee for $40 (subscription price at the time of this writing), which works out to a an economical $7.27 per pound--and that doesn't even count the mugs.  The mugs are well-designed, light and fit nicely in the hand.  Yeh, I know they are just mugs, but I have dozens of mugs, many of which are unnecessarily heavy and/or hard to hold.  But these are above average, in a functional sense.Although the bags look like kraft paper, in fact they are metalized-plastic inside, sealed air-tight, and re-seal air-tight easily and securely.  They even have a valve so you can squeeze out excess air, which is a good thing to do.  The presentation box is utilitarian but nice---the sampler would make an excellent gift for any coffee lover, even a wedding gift.The selection is SUMATRA MANDHELING, COSTA RICAN TARRAZU, COLUMBIAN SUPREMO, BREAKFAST BLEND, FRENCH ROAST, DARK HOUSE BLEND, ITALIAN DARK ROAST EXPRESSO, FRENCH VANILLA, HAZEL NUT, and DECAF COLUMBIAN.  Unfortunately, not the selection I would make if I had a choice.  The full 8-oz "free sampler" was CITY ROAST COLOMBIAN, but presumably other varieties may be substituted for the "free sample".Honestly, I'd prefer another bag of coffee rather than the mugs, and I wish I could have the option of a "no-decafinated no-flavored" sampler.  But, the French Vanilla and Hazelnut are not too objectionable, and one can always save the single decaf bag for evenings.  Ironically, you CAN purchase an all decafinated sampler Coffee Bean Direct Assorted Whole Bean Decaf Coffee Sampler, 9-Pound Box, or an all flavored sampler Coffee Bean Direct Assorted Flavored Whole Bean Coffee Sampler, 9-Pound Box, so why can't they offer a "no-decafinated no-flavored" sampler?If you are a real coffee lover, I strongly suggest purchasing a Mellita manual cone system, such as Melitta Cone Filter Manual Coffeemaker 6 Cup, 1-Count  For some reason I cannot link to the "10 cup" system, which I recommend.I'm working my way slowly though the coffees.  I'll add updates as I go through them.  Note that such evaluations are strictly a matter of personal tastes, and quality may differ between batches. In general I prefer light roasts, and loath flavored coffee.  Based on C being "typical American coffee":SUMATRA MANDHELING C+ glad I didn't buy the 5pd bag I was consideringDARK HOUSE BLEND BCOSTA RICAN TARRAZU BBREAKFAST BLEND BCITY ROAST COLUMBIAN AFRENCH ROAST B+COLUMBIAN SUPREMO B+Be careful grinding the FRENCH ROAST---it has alot of sugar as a glaze (not enough to taste).  If you overgrind the coffee you apparently melt the sugar, and the powdered coffee and sugar sticks, like a turd, in your grinder.  I use a wooden popsickle stick to scrape it out, but still it's annoying.  I do not know why sugar is added to dark roasts during the roasting process, but it is common.

column9: Great value, not 9# of coffee, some decaf/flavored
column10: This is a great way to sample some very good value coffeesAs other have mentioned, it is not 9lbs of coffee. That said, it is still a lot of very good coffee for the money, a very good value. Plus they throw in a couuple decent mugs. There's Italian, House, Columbian, flavored, decaf, a good mix of products.We have enjoyed the various brews, experimenting with different brew methods as well. We are not really coffee snobs, but like something a little better than Maxwell - this is a good value and great to experience different flavors and brew methods. Recommended. I knocked off 1 star because the description is a little misleading...

I thought I was buying 9 lbs of coffee. the Title reads.. "Assorted whole bean sampler, 9 Lb box"So any sane person would think your getting 9 lb's of coffee. To my surprise there was only 5 1/2 lbs of coffee and one bag was marked Free Sample. No where does it state the total coffee weight clearly. Classic misrepresentation. So I read the other reviews and someone else told Amazon about this problem a year ago! How can we trust the product pages?

I bought this sampler because I wanted to try their flavors before committing to a five pound bag.  I'm glad that I did.  I have concluded that overall, CBD roasts a bit lighter than what I'm used to, but that their full city and dark roasts are very tasty (even if not as dark as I'm used to).The coffee cups were unnecessary and, in my opinion, unattractive.  The sampler would be better without them.
Pretty good value for the amount of coffee and the 2 mugs you get.  There was a nice array of flavors that my husband and I split.  Some of the coffee was a bit dry.  Good value overall.

I sent this as a birthday gift to my father and he was very impressed!  The assortment was diverse enough to please any taste, the coffees had great flavor, and the presentation of the gift was well-done.  Overall, a nice choice -- pleased with the purchase.

First review for this was written April 2010. As that person mentioned (and all others to follow) the title is misleading.  I too understood there to be 9 pounds of coffee in this sampler, but that is not the case.  You would think that after 1.5 years and multiple bad reviews, Amazon would clarify this issue. This purchase is now much more expensive than I had expected. I couldn't care less that there are a couple of silly mugs in the box. My opinion is that they know this is tricking people and they don't want to change it. Very disappointed!

At first glance it appears that you will be getting 9 pounds of coffee,  how the shipping weight is 9 pounds,  only receive 5.5 pounds of coffee plus two heavy mugs.  This I believe is a mis representation of the product.  Coffee was o.k. but not outstanding.

column9: A wonderful collection of familar and new tastes.
column10: I've been using the Toddy cold brew system for making coffee and tea for months now, and this assortment of coffees has made is even more enjoyable.  I'm finding it hard to rate the different flavors, but have my favorites.  I will return to this review and list my favorites when I have finished the assortment.

Loved this ever since I was a kid! My grandmother actually brought it back from vacation for us and am so excuted to still see it unchanged and available online!
The prickly pear cactus jelly arrived as promised and I have enjoyed using the product every morning. It is everything that I expected and more. Will order again when needed.
I thought this product was organic but it's not. It has too much sugar. other wise it would be a great product,

The lime fruit slices are good, a bit much suger, but flavor is there. Had purchased raspberry also not as happy with them flavor was a little off.

I have been looking a long time for gum that is not made of materials bad for your health. I'm not worried about taste, but this tastes good and more importantly for me it is healthy and chews well. Some of the healthy chewing gums just fall apart. to me, healthy chewing gum means it doesn't have sugar or the horrible chemicals you find in the sugarless gums sold at grocery stores.

column9: Good Sugarfree Option w/o Unhealthy Additives
column10: I purchased this gum after an exhaustive search for sugar free gum that didn't contain aspartame, which is an additive that is bad for people with sensitive GI tracts (and may have other negative health consequences). Almost all gums contain aspartame and it's very difficult to find a product that doesn't.This gum met all the basic criteria I needed. I tried a few other brands that didn't contain aspartame including Glee Gum Triple Berry, 18-Piece Boxes (Pack of 12)). Between was the best, primarily because the taste lasted and the gum doesn't harden after a few minutes of chewing. Granted, the flavor of this gum won't last as long as standard commercial gum found at the grocery store. But that's the tradeoff for purchasing a more healthy product.As a "healthy" gum product, Between gets 5 stars. Even as judged by commercial gum standards (flavor, longevity, etc.), this product would get 4 stars.

You can usually get this at Walmart and Target for about $1.60 a piece, so I don't know why anyone would pay the $45 for 12 that is currently listed here.  It would be nice to buy a pack of 12 but you have to be competitive with B&M.  At least with B&M I can vary the flavors in my 12.

column9: Amazingly true-to-life flavor for a candy!

column9: The best non-hydrogenated peanut butter around
column10: I am always torn between buying the yummier peanut butter with the icky trans fat and the healthier peanut butter that doesn't taste nearly as good. Well, actually, I'm not torn, I've just been buying the icky tasting organic, need to be stirred type peanut butter. I saw the Skippy Natural in the store and quickly scanned the ingredients. No hydrogenated oils... sweet! The ingredients are roasted peanuts, sugar, palm oil and salt. I do realize that peanut butter is healthier without the oil, sugar and salt, but I also know that it's nearly impossible to have the best of both worlds, so it's a trade off. With Skippy Natural I get healthier peanut butter and a fabulous taste! Plus, when I compare it to the nutrition facts in Adams Natural Peanut Butter here's what I get:--------Adam's - Skippy Natural Serving size 2tbsp in bothCalories - 200 - 190Total Fat - 16 grams - 16 gramsSat Fat - 2.5 grams - 3.5 gramsSodium - 105 mg - 150 mgTotal Carbs - 6g - 6gProtein - 7g - 7gSo, we're not looking at the much of a difference at all. I will take the better tasting peanut butter in this instance. If the nutrition was severely compromised then I would make a different choice, but not in this case! Now every time I see someone at the store reaching for the gross, hydrogenated peanut butter I want to show them this and compare the ingredients for them and explain that it tastes just as good as what they're planning on getting. I politely mind my own business and move along. I would be awesome if they marketed this stuff better though. Grab a jar and a spoon and try the creamiest, yummiest peanut butter without the unnecessary trans fat.Nutrition from [...] and the back of my Skippy jar
I'm into eating foods that are'nt tainted with insecticides or mutated for feeding the multitude, natural foods are a god send.I love peanut butter!

I have been eating various brands of natural peanut butter for over a decade.  This is inedible.  It may be because in addition to peanuts, there is sugar, salt and palm oil. I assumed "natural" meant peanuts and nothing else, but obviously I was mistaken.  This tastes very different from natural peanut butter that has peanuts as the only ingredient.  Much prefer Smuckers. Oh well, the local homeless people will hit the food jackpot when they dumpster dive tomorrow...
I love clams in almost any dish and spend hours shucking them. This was totally worth it! Great price, nice big pieces of clams, just splendid.

I love freekeh! It is expensive and you will wonder how you just paid so much for so little, however, you don't need much to feel full. I thought this was easy to cook, easy directions and could be used in so many different ways. I cooked mine and used it in a spicy shrimp saute. I loved the way my house smelled while it was cooking. column9: JUICY JUICE'S MISSION: STOP BUYING SODA FOR YOUR KIDS: BUY JUICY JUICE
column10: JUICY JUICE'S MISSION: STOP BUYING SODA FOR YOUR KIDS: BUY JUICY JUICE is a simultaneously self-serving and altruistic mission.SO WHAT IS THIS STUFF?Libby's "Juicy Juice 100% Apple Juice, 46 fl oz" is part of a larger family of 100% juice products that has taken aim at the huge market share that Coke and Pepsi have carved out for themselves. Their target market is the youth of America. That, more than anything else, makes this and other Libby's products important. I first became aware of this targeting when I was watching the PBS program "Arthur" with my youngest child (who is named Arthur). At the end of the show there was a message from Libby's that said, "Juicy Juice Is Proud To Support Arthur". Since then I have regularly supported their 100% juice products, although I drink more of them than our Arthur does. Surprisingly, most "Juicy Juice" products are significantly less expensive than "Ocean Spray" and "Northland" juices, though I still buy some of those varieties as well.HECK OF ALOT BETTER FOR KIDS THAN DRINKER SODA!Though many critics and health advocates have pointed out that fruit juices are naturally high in sugar and after processing, including pasteurization, lose many of their healthful properties, they still represent a healthful alternative to soda for children. Surprisingly this seems to be a controversial statement, but 100% juice [with a little Vitamin C added] does help to engender healthful eating habits which begin with the choice of beverage. It is also a good source of potassium and is an excellent thirst quencher. All without added sugar and NO caffeine!PALATABLE AND CONVENIENT:It doesn't hurt that all of these juices taste very palatable to kids, probably because they are blended to taste sweet without any added sugar. Of course, it would be better to make your own juice, avoid pasteurization [made in a very clean environment], and include the natural vitamins, minerals and pulp, but who really has time. What's more, do you really think a child would drink such a homemade healthy brew? In the meantime, there is "Juicy Juice" and our children will most probably drink that thereby avoiding soda.FOR MORE INFO ON JUICY JUICE:To find out more about this product, see their website at "juicyjuice" on the world wide web. They have several useful links to pediatric nutrition sites and "Frequently Asked Questions" about their products.[I AM NOT AFFILIATED WITH THIS OR ANY OTHER PRODUCT.]

My canine companion is a 132 pound, five year old, Shiloh Shepherd.  The Shiloh Shepherd is considered a 'giant breed.'  With his enormous size, athleticism, and the general nutrient demands, we all must consider, his diet has always been a primary consideration.  Not to mention, he has the sensitive tummy often seen among the German Shepherd breed.  His breeder has always been partial to 'Premium Edge Lamb.'  This is the formula he was weaned on.  I had no desire to change what appeared to be a successful regimen.Then to my dismay, I learned 'Premium Edge' was placed on a recent recall list.  I knew that a change in diet was likely to be detrimental to my fur friend, but I had to take immediate action.  And, at the time of recall, I didn't have time to gradually transition to a new diet, which is always the way to go, to avoid negative symptoms.After carefully analyzing formulas of numerous dry kibble, I opted to give Pinnacle (Trout & Sweet Potato) a try, ordering a 15 pound 'starter' bag from Amazon.  In addition, I ordered some digestive enzymes to assist in the transition phase.The bag arrived.  I opened it with my dog assisting to see what his response would be.  The first whiff out of the bag was strong, smelling of fish.  I noted the kibble size, itself, was quite small for a large breed dog, but felt this was only a minor reservation.  The ultimate test was not what I thought about it, but what my Shiloh would.  He immediately had a positive response.  In fact --- he loves it!  He appears more enthusiastic about it than the 'Premium Edge.'I had to start the Pinnacle before the enzymes arrived, so I was expecting some terrible gas and possibly some diarrhea.  Well, that was not the case.  He has gone through the 15 pound bag, and half of the next order --- a 30 pound bag, with no diarrhea, or gas, at all.  In fact, his stools appear firmer and more consistent than on his previous diet.  Supplementing with the enzymes was actually not necessary.I'm delighted with this new regimen.  I also love that I can order a 30 pound bag through Amazon and have it delivered to my front door.  I'm now avoiding a considerable drive,  and,  the back-breaking-discomfort, of lugging around heavy bags of kibble.My dog is happy, and I'm happy.  That said, after an adequate therapeutic trial, I feel confident in recommending Pinnacle.

column9: Alternate meat source = less itchy dog
column10: My dog started developing signs of an allergy last year - nothing overt - just noticable skin twitches when I touched her in certain areas on her back.  Unsure if her reactions were due to environment or food, but they didn't seem to be seasonal grass allergies, so I chose to test the easiest source first.  I chose a food with a completely different meat source, switching from chicken to fish.  It's only been a week and I'm already seeing improvement.  She's still showing signs of itchiness, but her reaction is much less when I pet her back.  And on top of that, her fur is softer too!  It's early yet, and there can still be some progress made, but I have no doubt that the change in food is helping.  I sat and read review after review on dog foods with in-depth ingredient analysis before settling on Pinnacle Trout & Sweet Potato.  If after 6 weeks, she still shows some signs of being itchy, I'll happily try the Salmon and Potato Grain Free variety to see if grains are a factor in her allergies as well.Have seen some reviews mentioning breath after eating the fish based foods.  I have to say, I haven't experienced this with my dogs.  There might be a slightly different odor to their breath, but it isn't by any means too "fishy" smelling.  Just different.  And neither dog has experienced any gasiness or changes in stool since the switch was done gradually.

column9: High fiber isn't necessarily a good thing!
column10: I recently cut fiber one bars out of my diet after I noticed that I get all the fiber I need in a day just by eating whole wheat bread, fruits, vegetables and nuts. If you don't have many of the aforementioned foods in your daily diet, then one or two of these a day may be a good fiber supplement. However, this comes at the cost of making you extremely gassy all through the day, which can be embarrassing and sometimes even annoying when it's more frequent than the occasional toot that slips out. IMHO, it's better to get the daily dietary fiber your body needs via the more natural means that I mentioned above.Another thing to keep in mind, especially when dieting, is that these bars are pretty high in sugar. (As much as 10g added sugar per bar!) Considering a "healthy" amount of added sugar per day maxes out at about 40-50g per day, eating a few of these bars will chew right through that cap in no time. There's also emerging research showing that eating high-sugar foods (like fiber one bars) will make you crave more sweets, leading you to eat or drink even more unhealthy things like candy bars and sodas. So if you're on a diet, eating these bars probably aren't as great for your diet as you think!I've been fiber one free for two weeks now and I'm happy for the decision. (And so are my friends!)

Fiber one bars actually don't have real fiber.  They contain inulin (from chicory root) which is technically fiber because the body can't digest it.  Unfortunately fiber is defined by anything that can't be broken down easily.  These bars do not contain REAL fiber. (The real fiber usually found in whole grain breads and cereals) So if it says "chicory root" or "inulin" in the ingredients, you can be sure you aren't eating the fiber your body can actually use.  So if you want lots of sugar and fat without fiber, this bar is for you.

column9: Big Fan of Old Dominion Products Here !
column10: One Old Dominiom peanut snack leads to another, at least with me.I first became very fond of Old Dominion Peanut Company's Double dipped chocolate covered peanuts and since try every rich, delicious snack and candy I can find. Worst tasting peanut brittle ever (if it even earns the rating to be classified as peanut brittle).It simply just doesn't taste the way good peanut brittle should taste.At first glance, it looks good in appearance; but don't let that fool you- it tastes absolutely awful of plastic, preservatives, with peanuts.

This Old Dominion Peanut Brittle tastes fine the way it is but... ever since my teeth fell apart and several expensive dentist/oral surgeon appointments were mandatory (along with a couple emergency surgeries and potential hospital visits if said oral surgeon wasn't working at the time- thank God it never got to THAT point and he hadn't gone home yet!) I haven't really been feeling much of a desire or craving for brittle.  In fact just the name of it makes my teeth quiver. My imagination runs wild and I think about what would happen if my teeth were to suddenly shatter.  No more eating anything.  Anyway, this is actually really good brittle.  Just... I can't eat it anymore. :(  Alright, maybe I can still slide a little bit of brittle in my mouth when I'm in one of my "Who cares how my teeth feel tomorrow?" moods, but these are very rare times. :)

column9: Loses flavor SUPER FAST; but good tasting while it lasts
column10: My dentist recommended Spry, so I thought I'd give it a chance. It's pricier than most of the sugarfree gums I frequent, but it came recommended by an oral expert, so I figured it would be worth a try.NOT WORTH IT.Literally, after less than 4 minutes, the flavor is completely gone, and the gum itself reverts to a stale, slightly metallic, tough-to-chew state of existence. I'm not sure how much teeth cleaning the Xylitol in the gum itself is doing because it seems to lose flavor so fast. Correct me if I'm wrong, but xylitol is a sweetener, so if the sweetness of the gum is lost after a good (or bad?) 3 minutes, then there really wasn't that much Xylitol to begin with?Also, further research showed that you actually need more xylitol than the amount in the gum itself before it proves to be beneficial.Given how much xylitol is in the Spry gum, it's neither good nor bad to be chewing Spry, and what tips that balance towards "No Thanks" is the fact that it is not worth its value.Also (this is USEFUL), out of the three Spry flavors I've tried, inclusive of Green Tea, Spearmint and Citrus, I do have to say this flavor is the best tasting. It's original, not too artificial tasting, and does taste pleasant. Unfortunately, it only lasts for a couple of minutes, so it's a fleeting pleasure at best.

I love this gum because it's at least comparable in taste to the sugar free gums on the market that contain nutrasweet or other chemical sweeteners.  I've explained to my son why we don't buy Tri-dent and other brands, and since I give him a viable alturnative he's satisfied to just have a decent gum.  I like this flavor in particular, as compared to the other Spry flavors (peppermint, cinnamon) because, for some odd reason, this one doesn't get hard like the others.  It stays soft for a long time and, despite what other reviews have said, I think it keeps a decent flavor for a while.  Obviously not as strong as the first few minutes, but it keeps a neutral pleasant fruity taste for a while.  Try a pack from a natural food store first if you don't want to invest in a mega box.

column9: A wonderful dessert and here are some tips:
column10: The flavor and texture of tapioca is something I've liked for years. Kraft and their recipe makes it quick and easy. But here's an even faster way: forget separating the egg white, whipping it, and adding sugar. Just mix it all at the beginning. Here is a great addition for flavor and stretching the amount: double the recipe and while its coming to a boil mash 2 large fully ripe bananas into a paste and add that once it boils. You end up with full bodied banana flavor. It makes about 6 cups.
this return was faster than a trip to the grocery store. Very pleased! We have always loved the product and this was a super buy.

I use a modified version of her recipe.This doesn't cut tapioca time to a minute, but the soaking time and cooking time isn't as long. You can decide at 3 you want tapioca for dessert tonight and actually make it by dinner time instead of the 24 hour soaking time that the regular tapioca pearls can take.The grains of tapioca are smaller than regular pearls so you'll have lots of little bits instead of bigger chewy bites. column9: Identity Crisis for my Golden Retriever!
column10: My husband brought two of these home for our two dogs.  Goldy is a Ridgeback mix and Lucky is an allegedly purebred Golden Retriever.Goldy didn't have much interest but Lucky did.  And after he had one in his mouth for a few minutes, he started whining.  He doesn't whine often, maybe when the kids go outside and leave him in or something, but over a toy??  Never.  As time went on (maybe a day or two) he became extremely possessive of the toys yet at the same time, he would retrieve them when they were thrown over and over.  He's not much of a retriever, he prefers a hardy game of keep-away, something he learned from Goldy. The other weird thing was the way he would pick up one or both.  He would gingerly stand over it and gently pick it up, sometimes folding it over, then he would bring it back with his lips over the sides.  When told to "Give" he would put his head over my hand and slowly open his mouth, careful not to use his teeth on it, and would push it out with his tongue, often having to open his mouth wider to expel the item unharmed.At times, Lucky would pick up one or the other (we have a fox and a raccoon) and walk around whining.  The look in his eyes was of confusion, it was almost as if he had retrieved a dead fox (or raccoon), but wasn't sure what to do with it.  Was he looking for the shooter?The only time Lucky has been caught actually using this as a toy was when he snuck it out of the house and into the backyard where I observed Lucky and Goldy in a rousing game of tug-of-war.  Unfortunately, once a toy goes outside it becomes an outside toy so I had to retrieve it quickly.  I don't know if he was playing tug-of-war, or simply trying to rescue the toy from Goldy who wanted to play, but he doesn't play with it like that in the house except for the one time I finally got him to play tug-of-war with me.  Usually though, he'll just lay down with it and do this weird grooming thing with his teeth where he seems to be using his front teeth to "feel" the fur, like he's looking for anything that might be stuck in it - the same way he chews at his own fur from time to time.  One note of caution - these things get covered with slobber and drool fast.  And when they dry, they're kind of 'crunchy'.  So they probably need to be washed pretty frequently.Overall, I'd say for a non-retriever/hunting breed, this toy is probably a good idea.  But for hunting dogs like Retrievers, this toy can cause confusion, like some primal or instinct to return it to whoever killed it has kicked in, and he seems to question his life and it's meaning as he walks around with his soft lips over the dead corpse in his mouth, worrying about what he's supposed to do with it and seeming to be confused and at odds with himself.  These toys don't seem to have changed Lucky much, though he handles them as if they were recently-dead animals, he is mostly gentle with them and at times confused about them.  I'd caution owners of retrievers to watch for instinctive retrieving behaviors.  On the other hand, for those training their dogs to retrieve their kills, these are probably the best for the job next to the real thing.

I purchased this for my friends German shephard as a welcome home from hospital after surgery gift. I have been told that the dog enjoyed the treats and it lasted for a fair number of days so the portions must have been generous.

column9: The best GF/CF rice spaghetti we've found yet!
column10: Having a child on a gluten free, casein free diet has proven to be quite challenging, and we continue to try new foods.  I must say, Mrs. Leeper's Organic Rice Spaghetti is by far the best rice pasta we have tried yet!  Unlike other rice spaghetti we have tried, Mrs. Leeper's does not fall apart into little rice pieces while cooking, and it even stays together if it gets overcooked a little bit.  The texture is great, taste is excellent, and I'd highly recommend this product to others, including those on gluten free / casein free diets.

I have really enjoyed Mrs. Leeper's pasta.  It cooks in the same amount of time as normal pasta and tasts like normal pasta... Go figure!  This is by far the best spaghetti that I have tried and I would highly recommend it to other gluten intolerant or celiac folks.

Finally there is a great gluten free spaghetti pasta.  Mrs Leepers rice pasta.  I've been waiting 5 yrs to taste great pasta again.  Thank you Mrs Leepers!!  To all those on gluten-free diets, try it, I think you will love it!

column9: Tasty and filling... Can be frozen after cooking
column10: I am not on a gluten/wheat free diet. Instead, I came across this brand while shopping in my grocery store organic food isle. Since then, I have eschewed all other brands of spaghetti for Mrs. Leeper's Wheat/Gluten Free Organic Spaghetti. Here is why:1) I find it more filling then "regular" spaghetti. Typically, pasta leaves me craving more pasta. Not so with Mrs. Leeper's.2) Tastes like the real McCoy.3) Can be frozen after cooking. I boil the entire bag (6 servings) and place what I do not use in individual plastic containers. I defrost as needed.TIP: do not freeze with sauce. If you do, upon defrosting the noodles will break up into tiny little pieces (each less then an inch long). If you freeze the pasta by itself, either defrost it in the fridge, or put in the microwave on the defrost setting. I finish it off by adding the noodles to the sauce in a frying pan. Stir gently and the noodle length will be mostly preserved.4) Easy to cook. The box says boil 8-9 minutes. I find it needs full 12 minutes. At that point it is still slightly al dente.TIP: I do not bother with adding butter/oil. I have never had this pasta stick. Just make sure the water is boiling before you add the pasta. And stir. When I store, even if it seems like the noodles are sticking, once you heat them up, they will come apart. Be gentle, do not force them.One last TIP: initially, I thought the single servings seemed smaller then they are with "regular" pasta. However, once you place the serving on your plate with sauce, it is actually adequate. Enjoy!

column9: Great pasta even if not doing the glutten free diet
column10: We found this pasta when my son had to do the glutten free diet. Now that he no longer needs to be on that diet, my entire family still enjoys this pasta and it is a staple at our home. We love it.

We've been using gluten-free, dairy-free products for about 4 years now.  Mrs. Leeper's is a staple in our pantry.  It is easy to use, tastes great, and we get a good price on Amazon.  I use it in soups, over stews, or with homemade gravy.  It's a keeper!

My daughter has been following a gf diet for 3 years.  She's 11yrs old and the only person in our family of 5 that has to follow this restrictive diet.  We have tried many different types of gf pasta and this is by a mile the best yet.  She even said she forgot that she was eating gf pasta! Thank you Mrs. Leepers!

This product is by far the best noodle I have tried since my husband was diagnosed with CD.  It does indeed cook as normal noodles and there is no weird aftertaste at all.  In fact, I forgot we were eating gluten free noodles until after we were done!

column9: Took a chance with one more rice pasta... and so glad I did!
column10: I found this product discounted 50%, so I took a chance (after being greatly disappointed with practically every other rice pasta).  My highest compliment is that I cannot tell the difference from regular pasta.  I'm nothing less than thrilled.  Thank you Mrs. Leeper's!

My husband is gluten intolerant  and has a hard time finding palatable food choices for his favorite foods. After much trial and error, we came upon this product. For a long time, we did not even try it because we had experienced so much disappointment with other similar products. We were very surprised at how good this product turned out to be.kIt was easy to prepare and tasted great. There was no gritty taste that is often found with other such products. We also received it in great condition and on time as promised.

Who knew that really divine dark chocolate could be sugar fee and carb controlled!I first tried these Belgian Dark Chocolate Bites at a Costco demo and that was all it took for me to buy them and become a forever fan. The harder step was sharing them! I love these so much that I thought twice about sharing with my daughters and friends. BUT! this product is too good not to share with the ones you love.One serving is three heavenly squares (I am perfectly happy with just one) and only 140 calories for all 3! Thank You AMBERLYN for understanding that really good things only need to come in small serving sizes to be enjoyed fully and gulity free!
"Due to availability some flavors may be substituted without prior notice".The flavor that I really wanted, were the flavors that were not available :/. Spicy Egg Nog, Gingerbread, Pumpkin Spice.

The box I received was filled with teas, hot chocolates, and none of the "Holiday" flavors advertised.  Not even worth my time to return it.. totally disappointed!  And it took almost 2 weeks to arrive too.  My box contained mainly the Grove Square instant cappuccino/hot chocolate style k cups.  No Gingerbread, Pumpkin Spice or Spicy Eggnog.  The only "Limited Edition" flavors I received was Green Mountain Island Coconut. Don't waste your money on this one, not even close to what is advertised!
I like this pack of k-cups.  There is a good variety of holiday style cups and flavors.  I would buy this as a gift for people with k-cup brewers.

column9: healthy and wholesome, but not the tastiest
column10: This brand features a variety of protein sources for its first six ingredients, which is great.  It also has a pull top, which makes it a bit easier to work with than having to use a can opener.  My cat likes it enough, but she doesn't love it.  I'm quite sure that if I didn't switch between a few brands, she'd get sick of this.  As a comparison that may or may not be helpful for those feeding cats with similar tastes, she really likes the Wellness brand, dislikes Evo, and really dislikes Innova.

I switched to Felidae canned cat food to help control the weight of my cats; my vet says some cats don't metabolize the carbs of dry food well. I started with Science Diet, but that quickly broke the bank. After 4 months, I'm happy to report my cats have lost weight eating this cat food. My dog gets Canidae (same brand as Felidae) All Life Stages dry kibble which I also recommend.
My cats love this food! They will eat almost anything, but this seems to be the healthiest and cheapest premium cat food on the market.

I  fed this food during the hottest days of summer, as it has a lot of moisture to it. I prefer to feed dry food, but every other or every third day I have been feeding Felidae. During the hottest weeks one can was all I needed for four cats. A fourth of a can filled them up at once, though sometimes they came back a couple hours later and finished the portion. I feed under, and to the side of the air conditioner to keep the food fresher during the hottest days.Then they also have a pan of dry food in the bedroom, and another in the kitchen.I feel very confident with Felidae because of it being made in the United States.I have rinsed out the can and poured some of the water in with the food. Big mistake, they won't eat it. They won't eat it with anything mixed in it, i.e. pieces of cooked chicken.Straight from the can they seem to really like both flavors I have been buying.

I've been using this food for at least six months now.  I feed quite a few cats , so I was hunting for 13oz cans of a decent quality food at a reasonable price--this is quite a challenge!  The cats are all happy with it, I've heard no palatability complaints, and they're all in great health.  They get this in addition to Taste of the Wild dry food.  I'm really happy with this product for my needs, but I'll admit, if I was feeding just one or two cats I'd use the same brand I feed my dogs.10/11/12  What the heck!?  Since I last ordered on the 1st, the price went up from $19.29 to $26.24. Using a can a day, it's not so cost effective now.  Ugh.

Even after two weeks,  even mixing with prior food,  my cat refused to eat more than a nibble.  I have switched back to what he was eating before and he is cleaning his dish again. Sorry. Wish it had worked out.

column9: Good quality cat food at budget friendly price
column10: I can't say enough about Felidae. It's my favorite budget friendly quality cat food. There are better brands, that's for sure, but they will also help break the bank. Good quality ingredients- no by products, corn, or wheat. High protien. Cranberries for urinary health. The targeted urinary ph for this food is 6.0 which is perfect. These people care about their product and the animals that eat it. This is a good food and you can feel good about feeding it to your cat. :)Good health starts with quality food, and prevents expensive vet bills!

column9: My cats loved it, but now won't eat it!
column10: I recently was looking for a good brand of canned food to add to my cat's diet. Both my cats get dry food in the morning and wet food at night. I liked Felidae because it wasn't too expensive and seems to have excellent ingredients. I would have gone with the grain free option except for the cost. I went to a local pet food supplier to pick up a can of this before I bought a whole case (after reading reviews that some cats won't eat it) and luckily both of mine LOVED it. My male cat has had problems with urinary issues in the past and I wanted to get him off prescription food onto something better so both my cats now get Wysong Uretic dry food in the morning (because I am still paranoid about the struvite crystals my cat had) and Felidae at night. I also plan on switching every other case with Nature's Variety because that is also an excellent food that my cats love. Glad to find a good canned food at an economical price!I originally wrote this review in December. It is now the end of February, and both of my cats are refusing to eat the Felidae food. Luckily I only have 3 cans left from the case I bought, but 2 cans have completely gone to waste. Not sure why my cats suddenly won't eat it, the food looks the same and smells the same as the previous cans from the case. The only thing I can think of is the Nature's Variety food that I am also feeding them is better and they prefer that so they are refusing to eat the Felidae. I have since switched my cats onto all canned food, so it is possible that they only like this when it is offered every once in a while compared to every day or two. I still like the food for the price and ingredients, but unfortunately I won't be buying any more.

column9: 1 cat loves it. 1 won't touch it.
column10: It would be 5 stars if it came in chunks rather than a paste!  My 4 yr old cat will eat it without a problem.  My 8 mo old kitten won't get near it.  I don't blame him.  Although it has all the right ingredients, it looks like mush.  I'm having a lot of problems finding good quality food such as Felidae or Evo that comes in CHUNKS.  I would really appreciate it if anyone knows of something I can try.  I love my kitties like my children and want the best for them.  Thank you, Kate.

My cats are crazy about this food.  In fact, when I ran out and tried to get them to eat something else, they weren't having any of it.  Thank goodness the new shipment arrived today, they munched it right down!  This is a staple from now on, for sure!

This cat food is amazingly healthy for your cat or kittens. The ingredients really are good. However, some cats may not eat -- it took my kittens a couple days to start eating it and now they like it just fine, but my girlfriend's cats refused to ever eat it. Just beware of this before purchasing!

I have picky-eater cats. My kids ate whatever they were offered but not my two somewhat overweight rescue kitties. They are very specific about their food. They ate this new food for exactly two days and then refused it completely. The food looks good in the can, has lots of what is good for them, but if they won't eat it, it's worthless. I donated the unopened cans to the Charleston Animal Society.

column9: Good ingredients, cat likes it, less expensive than Wellness
column10: Essentially that's it. Good ingredients, cat likes it, less expensive than Wellness at about $1.60 a can. Amazon delivered the case within a week (free shipping), so keep that in mind when ordering.  Other orders of this cat food have included dented cans, but all of the cans in this order were fine.  Hence 5 stars.

column9: Excellent for your cat -- if he/she will eat it.
column10: Great product.  High protein low carb.  But my cat wouldn't touch the stuff.  Hard to figure how to rate it.  But I settled on a 3.

column9: Good ingredients, reasonably priced, cat likes.
column10: Ive been quite happy with Felidae canned products.They are reasonably inexpensive if you look at the price per oz which you should always do.The ingredients are noteworthy for several reasons.1) Because of very limited grains.  Cats cant process grains but you have to have something to hold the kibble together. They use alfalfa and brown rice which is better than corn.2) No meat by-products or even 'meal'.  Meal/byproducts could be anything pretty much.  It could be perfectly fine organ meat that humans don't eat a lot of, so theres a good supply.  It could be feathers, gristle, whatever.  It's generally best to avoid when possible.3) The first seven ingredients are meat-based.  This means a very limited amount of filler as an 8th ingredient could only theoretically be less than 12.5% of the whole product by weight.4) The variety of meats is also beneficial, especially inclusion of liver which is nutritious.It is a good idea to feed your cat at least some canned wet food to ensure kitty gets enough water.  We also feed her some dry food as snacks, and have a pet fountain (steel) to encourage water drinking.Best of all, my cat loves it!

Turns out I'm as susceptible to guilt as any other cat parent. I tried to switch my kitty over to super premium food - gradually as is recommended. Which is why it snuck up on me that this food was going to turn out to be a problem. While it was mixed with her old food she was tolerating it fine. She liked it by itself and had no trouble with it for the first few days. Then her poops starting turning really loose and she wouldn't touch it anymore. I tried transitioning onto two more super premium foods with the same results before I realized what the culprit was: one ingredient, flaxseed. All of the foods she had trouble with had it. The one super premium I finally found that she didn't have trouble with didn't have it. Flaxseed is known for greasing the chute so if your cat doesn't have problems in that area that ingredient might not be for you. It's amazing how many super premium brands have that ingredient prominently featured, which means I can't use them. Pity, as otherwise this food is very appealing: texture is dense but soft, the smell reminds me of Campbell's Condensed Chicken Soup (not unappealing for some of us) and the cat obviously liked the flavor before the inevitable reaction overcame it. Ah well, win some lose some. I'm keeping the rest of the carton as an alternate food since she doesn't have problems with it short term, only long term.

Texture is nasty by human standards but isn't all cat food? The main things are that our extremely picky cats love it, its grain-free, has truly healthy stuff in it and its much cheaper than other "healthy" cat foods. We only have 2 cats so we have to put some in the fridge each time so as not to overfeed them (the cans we get are 13 oz.) but its worth it and the cats love it so much they even eat it cold right out of the fridge. To start them off I mixed it with a little "cat crack" (friskies) to get them enticed but now they go for it straight up. We were spending around 100/month on food for them and now we will be spending 60 without sacrificing quality. Highly recommended!

My son urged us to buy this, after extensive research. We have a 17-year old cat who, while he remains healthy and active, is very skinny. After adding a mix of dry food and Felidae, his coat has become absolutely beautiful and he has added weight to,the point where his spine is no longer exposed. Wahoo, maybe Blackie will live forever!

I had originally ordered this for the cranberries and eggs for my 8 year old cat, but, we had to put her to sleep about 4 days after it got here. She went into acute renal failure. We miss her. My 15 yr old male cat like it though and since he has no back teeth it's still perfect.

Chelsiey had no problem switching from her crappy commercial brand over to this much healthier cat food.  No details yet for how it's affecting her, but I have high hopes.  She's 15 now, and I will be very happy to have her around for another couple years.  Being a poor college student, the price is definitely a relief for this stuff.  She finishes off a can every three days, so it lasts quite a while... I will definitely be buying more-- and different flavors!!
We used several Purina wet foods before settling on this. Its great! Our two cats love it, and the ingredients are top notch. When you open a can you'll see right away that its made with real meats.
Excellent food, super ingredients! This is the stuff cats are SUPPOSED to eat, folks.Unlike the other reviewer, my cats absolutely love it.

Smells terrible and my cats wouldn't touch it - I can't blame them. One of them isn't picky at all and eats anything that you put down in front her but she turned her nose at it as well. Now i'm stuck with a case. Disappointed.

I can't always find Scottish oatcakes in the stores so we were delighted to find these at Amazon! The pack of six is no problem as they will never be wasted and each box fits neatly into any kitchen cupboard. These mini oatcakes are small, two bite crackers with a nutty flavor. I feel as if I have eaten something substantial rather than some of the flimsy store crackers that taste of salt. If you haven't tried them before, go ahead and buy some! They are great with cheese or butter or fruit or plain and, if you are watching calories, you can eat five for 120 calories! Highly recommended.

not enough info to purchase this product also the listed name and product description are different. maybe thats way no has bought anyhad to put one star just to complete this review but my review stands with ZERO stars

We have 2 cats who were getting a little chubby on a nice, all you can eat, mixed variety of dry food.  I've been reading up  on best nutrition for cats, which does call for wet food, as well.  I tried numerous canned foods, to no avail (my dogs were happy about that; they get the leftovers).  Finally we found this food, and they lick their plate clean each morning.  First found this in our local health food store, and the ingredients seem to be high quality.  I went on Amazon and found it, bought a case, and continue to be really satisfied with the product.

If you're a Lychee lover like myself then you would love these. They're jello like with chunks of lychee on the inside. They're such a great snack that won't add on the pounds. Try them, I'm sure you'll love em.

column9: Beware,Don't buy, buy quality. These are not safe
column10: I ordered this brand from another company other than amazon. I ordered a 15lb box and was shocked as to the quality of these chews.some had sharp edges that could cut you plus they smelled far worse than any others I have tried and I've been buying hooves for my dog's for 35 years.I tried one on my dog and with in minutes he had shattered it into pieces and was devouring it.Normally it Takes him about a week to polish off the ones you buy at petco or petsmart.On my box it said they were a product of Chili. Mine were not polished or that clean looking. Looked like they had just come from a slaughter house.I've never seen any this bad before and am sending them back. From now on I am sticking to the ones that come in bag's and are cleaned and polished.I've also noticed the smoked type don't smell as bad when they are chewing them.
Dog loves them and got a good amount of hooves for the price, about 90+ in the box.
I didn't care for the polished effect that the hooves had on them. It made them look fake. The dogs didn't seem to mind though. They still had a ball chewing on them.

column9: Dogs Love them in pieces for training treats
column10: AWESOME!!I use it for training only and cut it up into small pieces.  It is much better than the other dog food roll brand (Natural....something) which has SUGAR listed in the top 5 ingredients. REDBARN has NO SUGAR or SALT added....All the dogs in the training class LOVE this AND my dogs will do any tricks to get a little bit of this roll as a treat.

The Red Barn Lamb roll is one of my german shepherd's favorite varieties of the meat roll "family" of products.  I really do trust the brand name because I have been using this brand for many many years with different breeds of dogs.  When holidays come around and there are sales promotions for this brand, I always try to buy the most I can afford at the time and really do save money.Lori, Phila.

Senseo pods have not been available so I tried these.  Mistake.  They do not fit the machine.  Each pod must first be wet and then forced into the carrier. Even so, it is hard to close.  It is impossible to get two pods in to make a large size coffee.  The flavor of the coffee is superb.
Good tea, but huge waste of paper.  The amount of tea in each individual sachet is small and the paper envelope is large.

When I want a clean,crisp,fullbodied tea - this is the one.No bitter after taste. Only complaint is that,although I like the pyramid tea bag shape - maybe 1 bag in a box is defective and tea comes out while brewing. Otherwise-it's the best tasting English Breakfast I've tried.

The tea taste fine, but I ordered this because I wanted a Pyramid shaped tea bag for presentation.  Yes they cut the bag in a triangle shape, but it's nothing like the picture or the fancy Pyramid teas you might me thinking.  It ends up looking like a normal old tea bag.

Walkers cookies or biscuits always are five star.However, these arrived broken to bits in spite of beingwrapped in bubble wrap.  Good thing I was not planningto serve these to guests!  On the plus side, I actuallyordered these because I want the container.  I collect tins,and this one is perfect for storing American style crackers later.Cheers!
These are the best cookies ever!  The metal box can be used for other things when all the cookies are gone.

column9: How did they make it so delicious with only few basic ingredients!
column10: Just flour, butter, sugar, salt and chocolate chips combined to make one of the most delicious cookies ever. Wonderful job Walkers!I got the 10.6-oz tin, the tin looks very nice and can be reused after eating the cookies.

I'm Walker's deserves its reputation for excellent shortbread but I received crushed and stale cookies-stale as in the 'butter' tasted rancid-they were inedible. Amazon offers wonderful specials, this is not one of them.

The chocolate chips give this delectible shortbread cookie a great twist.  Highly recommend this cookie but these cookies are somewhat fragile and don't travel all that well in the mail to their final destination so expect some of the cookies to arrive broken but taste great all the same.

Although Walker's shortbread are the best, I will not be purchasing them from Amazon again.  The tin arrived quite dented, and all the cookies were broken so I had a can of crumbs.  Very disappointing, and even more disappointing is that when I informed Amazon of the problem, I received no reply.

My bichon, Oscar, has the typical skin allergy problems suffered by many bichons.  He can eat the peanut butter mini naturals with no problem.  They're small so are the perfect treat for him.  They're also a perfect size for training.

They are perfectly sized for a training treat, and oh so popular with our buddy. We got our new family dog from a local shelter with zero training. He's 2 years old and super smart but I have not found any type of dog food or treat that he would like, until I found these. Our sweet little comedian of a jack russell has learned to sit, lay and stay this week alone. It has helped him to be more comfortable in his new house, and less frightened of his new kennel. No treat is the wonder drug for every dog, but for our very picky eating friend they were the perfect training treat. I just received this bag last week and they're already gone. I have read in other reviews to order the smaller size because they dry out quickly, but I have found that if they stay sealed they should be keep for a couple weeks. Just make sure you zip the resealable bag every time you use them to make sure they stay chewy and delicious...:)UPDATE: Our dog is such an avid learner I have had to start cutting these very small treats down into quarters. He can earn a half bag at a time, and yes he has to do entire performances to get even one. He has learned that these are the treats he gets from me and won't accept anything else. My son can use his dog food as a treat to practice with him, but he will not accept them from me. The second I walk over to the cupboard where these are kept he is hot on the spot with his tail going a mile a minute. He's 10lbs of picky but would do anything for these. We have had him for 3 weeks and gone through 3 small bags of these. The commands he now knows are as follows; Sit, down, off, stay, "hands up" (sit pretty), "bang" (play dead), crawl, and we are learning speak and quiet. I have no previous training experience or professional help unless you count youtube videos. I'm aware that he is an exceptional dog, but I am grateful for these treats as they have done wonders for both of our skills.
Comes in salmon, liver and lamb flavors also! Great size for treats, and all flavors have been a hit with my pups!
the product is excellent, a few of my friends asked where i got them from, and i told them AMAZON.COM , AND THE PRICE IS RIGHT. i will soon be ordering more.

I thought this would be a pleasant change from the old, tired Cheetos and pork rinds, but I found these a bit on the plain side. They were light and crispy, with the alveoli providing a satisfying crackle at the end, and the flavor was mildly gamey, but it left a little something to be desired. It was just a wee bit too bland...perhaps the addition of a little sea salt or garlic would give these snacks a little more oomph.
Great product for dogs with grain allergies. Not messy or crumbly. Cheaper to go direct to seller's website, pet food direct. com.
This product was excellent and exactly what I wanted. I just wish there was a way to get it here faster.
These were an answer to a very short Christmas list from my husband. Glad I was able to find them on Amazon!

when i ordered this i expected a big box full of fortune cookies like the one in the pcture, nonetheless, when i got it it was very small and the fortune cookies tasted weird. they were okay, but not he best i had ever had.
These were NOT Golden Bowl. Specifically ordered this item because they are described as being Golden Bowl. Instead they taste like paper. Will not order again.

its funny how i told my husband that i was buying 100 fortune cookies on amazon for a project of mine and he goes, "WOW thats a lot of cookies!!" then when it showed up it was in a meduim size box and when opened i said, "WOW...thats 100 cookies?" haha i didnt count them but im sure they are all there haha it just didnt look like what we imagined haha they are yummy and full of great fortunes!

Well, yes, it does contain Palm Oil.  Which, if anyone is wondering, is actually a natural oil.  Is it saturated? Yes. But it is not created in a lab - it is a naturally saturated fat that does good things for your health.But, more importantly, Amazon says right on the page the ingredients in this Peanut Butter.  They are:  Peanuts, sugar, palm oil, salt.I think it tastes great, and I love the super crunch of this variety.Enjoy, folks!  This is probably one of the best no refrigeration needed peanut butters out there.

I purchased a 6 pack of this peanut butter because it says it is a natural product. When I received it and read the ingredients I found that Skippy LIES!!! This has added PALM oil, a saturated fat not found in peanuts,SUGAR, and SALT. We don't eat this kind of crap! And neither should you. We gave it to the local food bank! WILL NEVER BUY SKIPPY AGAIN! I hope this review will be read by many prospective buyers.
This is one of the best tasting green teas I have found and I have been drinking it several years now. I can always find it on Amazon at a reasonable price.
They are by far the best flavor.  They really do taste like a hot fudge sundae.
I would highly recommend chilling this in the freezer first. It is a great cold treat that won't melt if you don't eat it fast enough.

I first tried these hot and they were just two sweet for me and did not taste like a hot fudge sundae to me. And the texture was unpleasant and the filling leaks out. Warm they tasted OK. Now when tried cold them out of the freezer as was suggested in the other review, they were great. I could have done without the sprinkles, but other than that a very good treat.

I already had tasted Slitti Cream with Cocoa and Hazelnut Pieces so knew it's really delicious.  It still is.  This has to be the best nocciola flavor (chocolate and hazelnut) product there is, anywhere.  It's soft/runny (depending on temperature), so like a spread for toast or whatever, but not really like a sauce -- well, I guess if you warmed it a little it would get fluid like syrup and would be pretty fantastic on ice cream.
Works well during the off-season when you can't get a Starbucks Eggnog latte. I love eggnog flavor so this is a must-have.
I've been using another, well known brand for years and tried these for the first time last month. They are excellent and I recommend them!Ken Roberts

When you open the tins, it LOOKS like there are anchovy fillets inside, but you'd need to be a neurosurgeon to extract an identifiable fillet.  They're all mushy, and it's more like a glob of anchovy paste surrounded with oil than actual individual anchovies.
The flavor is fine, but they have the consistency of paste, and you can't seperate the fillets - they fall apart.  Not recommended.
These anchovies were delicious, separated easily, and had none of the mushiness described in other reviews.  I will definitely buy them again.

column9: A lot of taste in a small container
column10: Anyone who makes their own spaghetti sauce will like these. Just the right size for one recipe. Unlike some other reviews, these are whole and have to be mashed up. I am not a fan of anchovies, but these did impart a noticeable but not overpowering anchovie taste to the sauce.
So far very good except for 2 tins that when opened were somewhat rancid and had a strong smell. Maybe from shipping damage. The others are fine and I will buy again.

One example of a way I use it is that I make my own vanilla yogurt by buying plain yogurt, adding the blue agave nectar and some vanilla flavoring.  IMHO it is the equal of any vanilla yogurt you can buy, and can be spooned on top of fresh fruit and topped with pecans for a fantastic dish.  All that without triggering an insulin overload.

After a disastrous run-in with Miracle Noodle Shirataki Fettuccini, 7-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6), I decided to try these "tofu shirataki" noodles, which supposedly have a slightly better texture than straight up shirataki.Once again, as with user reviews regarding the aforementioned Miracle Noodles, I am really mystified by all the histrionic reports of a "bad", fishy smell. This is the second time I've opened a shirataki noodle package expecting to be knocked back by a horrible smell, only to smell nothing but a mild odor reminiscent of some soy-based product.As for the noodles themselves, the texture didn't have that strange "cartilage-like" feel of fettucine-style Miracle Noodles. However, they were very rubbery and stretchy, requiring a lot of chewing. Personally, I found nothing offensive about this texture but those expecting it to have the consistency of spaghetti might find themselves disgusted or just plain disappointed by it, since these are being touted as a substitute for pasta.Flavor-wise, these noodles have none. This poses a huge problem for those hoping to turn to them to "lose weight." This becomes all too apparent when you come across recipes from other users for this product. More often than not, the recipes often call for rich, fattening sauces; meats, fish, seafood; and other ingredients that usually bump up the calories a hundred-fold. (One recipe I saw-- kid you not-- involved fried pork sausage!}Why do recipes for shirataki noodles tend to go overboard? Well, since they have no flavor, you can't just boil them up as you would other noodles and eat them with a basic soup base or sauce. You have to literally drown them in tons of other stuff to make them filling. So whatever health benefits you gain by substituting carbs with these shirataki noodles is canceled out by the calories and sodium you wind up tacking on from the sauces and other junk you have to add to make them "work."All in all, a "so-so" product-- not bad, not great. Adventurous chefs and eaters who like to try new things may get a kick out of them, because of the interesting texture and cooking challenge they pose. Dieters on the other hand may want to steer clear. Because these noodles have no taste, they'll find themselves needing to add so many ingredients that they may as well just be cooking a "regular" meal with these as nothing more than a side dish. In addition, this product isn't necessarily the best substitute for pasta, because the texture couldn't be more different. Three stars.

I am so happy I found these noodles!The noodles come in a pouch with water, and it is plenty for two people.  I drain out the water, add some fresh water, and microwave it in a bowl for 2 minutes.  They have a cool texture (like slippery ramen), and they have a very mild flavor.  I typically eat these noodles after adding some type of sauce and veggies.  Yummy!A warning:  when you first open the noodles, they smell strange.  VERY strange.  Almost so strange that you may not want to eat them!  Apparently this is normal (they are made with yam flour), and the package says to just boil them for 2 minutes to remove the smell.  After 2 minutes in the microwave, the smell really does go away!Overall, I love these noodles.  It is a low-cal, low-carb alternative to ramen noodles, and it has a lot of protein.  They are mild enough to mix with anything, and they are really easy to make.  Try it out and enjoy!

I bought a few bags of these noodles after reading a very favorable review of them on the Hungry Girl website, and I am glad that I did.  They work well in a number of different recipes, are filling, and add a "calcium boost" to the dishes I use them in, for very few calories.  These are not "pasta" type noodles, of course - the texture is different (softer and kind of "slippery"), and they have virtually no flavor of their own - they take on the flavor of whatever sauce or dressing you use with them.  I probably won't use these noodles with European-style or American-style sauces such as marinara or cheese sauce - those types of sauces were created for grain-based pastas, which these are not.  On the other hand, these noodles are fine in such Asian recipes as Pad Thai, Lo Mein and Dan-Dan Noodes (basically, noodles in a spicy peanut or sesame sauce).  There are a lot of Asian-style recipes in cookbooks and on the Internet which are fairly easy to make, taste terrific, and work beautifully with these noodles.  You can prepare yourself a real treat, if you use these noodles in the types of recipes that work well with their texture, and for a fraction of the calories you'd eat if using regular noodles or rice.  In short, if you attempt something like spaghetti with meatballs or chicken cacciatore using these noodles, you're likely to be disappointed, but if you use them in Pad Thai, any type of curry, other Asian dishes, or most soups, you're likely to find yourself enjoying a delicious and wonderfully low-cal, low-carb meal.One thing - when you open the bag, there is a slight ammonia-like odor (it smells ammonia-like to me, anyway).  If you rinse the noodles well and then parboil them for a few minutes, as per the package directions, the odor really does disappear.  It is not a strong odor, it won't permeate your kitchen or anything like that, but you will definitely want to rinse and parboil the noodles before using them.  Just follow the package directions.

I spent some time in Japan and the shirataki noodles are used in a bunch of dishes including Sukiyaki.  Maybe that's why the Japanese are thin.  These noodles should be parboiled to remove the preservative.  They don't melt easily so they can be cooked for a long time.  They have a hard gelatinous texture so they don't absorb flavors easily.  I think they taste better with strong sauces, smoked meats, etc.  If you are trying to lower your carbs and/or cut calories, you can have your noodles and eat it too.

Tofu Shirataki is simply amazing.  Anyone who says that it tastes or smells funny has not prepared it correctly.  To prepare:  drain and then rinse VERY well.  At this point, I prefer to cut the noodles up a bit.  Boil 2-3 minutes- any longer and the pasta will become tough.  Pat dry and add your favorite sauce.These taste just like pasta, but with SOOO many fewer calories.  This is not just a food for people 'trying to lose weight', as other reviewers have said.  This is a food for health-conscious consumers.  For me, this has been the find of a lifetime.  There are so many different recipes you can use them in, and they taste simply fantastic.  In fact, with sauce, they taste just like pasta (and who doesn't love pasta?).I learned about Tofu Shirataki through Hungry Girl.  On her web site, she has tons of low-calorie recipes using Tofu Shirataki [...]For anyone who has tried these and disliked them, please give them another try.  Make sure to drain and REALLY rinse the pasta before boiling.  The scent will vanish.  Cutting the pasta up helps as well, since it is slightly slippery.  Try it with a cheesy pasta bake, with your favorite marinara sauce, or even in soup!  The options are limitless.  This truly is a fantastic, fantastic product.
