I just recently switched to coffee pods to help save money on cost per cup. I tried the Miss Ellie's Breakfast Blend and It is now one of my all time favorites, perfect cup of coffee to start my mornings.
I first tried this tea at at French restaurant that had ran out of the usual black tea with mint. To my surprise this tea beats any tea (without milk).. no sugar needed. It is naturally sweetened!

This stuff is delicious but a little goes a LONG way because it is soooooooooo tangy! Phew! I took off one star because eating this straight is pretty hard-core SOUR and your nostril hairs might curl back and slap your brain. =OI recently tried this sauerkraut in a German beef roast slow-cooker recipe and it was soooooo good and really tenderized the beef and the dipping juices were to die for in sandwiches and cooking this kraut with meat really mellows out the flavor and turns the zing into a singing sensation of tastebudgasmic proportions. YUM.For you hard-core krauts who like a little sour cabbage on your sandwiches each day, this stuff stays indefinitely in a well sealed container in the fridge. I kept 3/4 can's worth in the fridge for weeks without it going funky or moldy AT ALL. So, you could reasonably keep a can of this in a sealed container in your refrigerator for quite a while before it went bad (if EVER).Happy Krautin'! :)

Years ago, I always made my own sauerkraut because it's the best. Now I'm old and lazy so I buy it. There is better pickled cabbage out there but this stuff is pretty good and low priced. It's not too soggy or salty like some canned kraut. Good buy.

Sauerkraut from Libby's seemed to be a good choice.  Product is usually reliable and tasty.  But when I tried to offer an honest review of these canned products shipped to me by Amazon,their censors  would not allow what I said.  If you like to eat your vegetables out of dented cans, you will not be disappointed with your purchase.  Maybe the food is safe, but I don't eat it.  Waste of money. I will buy locally so I can be sure the cans are not damaged.

I bought a couple of these for a party and did not end up using them.  So they sat in my cupboard for quite some time.  I decided to take them with me on a trip and share with girlfriends.  I did wonder if they would even still be good.  But I did not want to throw them away without at least trying to use them.  I don't think I have ever thrown away chocolate!  The directions were specific about heating this product and I followed them to a "T".  Heating 30 seconds at a time in the microwave at a lower power (4-5) and stir after each heat time.  It seems that it might take forever but be patient, it is heating within.  This was a wonderful treat and it tasted wonderful even after all that time of sitting in the cupboard.  We dipped strawberries, pineapple, marshmallows, graham cracker sticks and bananas.  It was delicious!  I am buying more just to have on hand and to send to those girlfriends.

So this was an excellent product.  I mixed it with half a cup of cream and a teaspoon of bourbon, and it was perfect.  The dog ate the second box of the two while we were out one day, so now I just need to figure out how to get more!!!!

I love coffee, but I also love not having to messing with the coffee maker sometimes. This instant espresso is the best I have tried and I have tried about 7 different brands.  I do not drink it plain, I use it in iced coffee drinks, frappes or mochas.Not overly acidic at all, I find that if I drink it on an empty stomach that I don't get a tummy ache like brewed coffee can sometimes induce.It melts instantly in hot water (no sand dunes left swirling at the top if your cup), is lightweight so it travels wonderfully (a godsend on backpacking trips) and is very versatile to have around for cooking:-- I but a tsp. in a batch of brownies to deepen the dark chocolate flavor-- I put a Tbs in a BIG batch of chili to compliment the spices and add extra richness-- I add a bit to Mexican mole sauce for punch-- I also put it in: chocolate icing, truffles, chai tea with milk for a java chai latte, coffee drink mixes for extra umph, etc.It is over 5 bucks a jar at some supermarkets, when/if you can even find it, so it is nice to know it is cheaper at amazon!

I had originally bought this product for hot coffee, but I heard that it dissolves in cold water and since I love iced coffee I thought I'd give it a try.  It works great for iced coffee and I no longer have to spend money on mediocre iced coffee from coffee shops.I just put about a tablespoon of the espresso powder in a cup and add about 12 ounces of cold water.  After stirring for a minute or two, the espresso dissolves perfectly.  I add a little liquid creamer (I like to use the flavored kind so I don't have to sweeten), stir, and I have the most delicious (and easiest!) iced coffee ever.  I keep a jar of this at work and make it at the water cooler.  You may want to adjust the amounts of espresso, water, and creamer for your taste.

Love this espresso!  I was camping and forgot our coffee and had to go into the local market and get some instant coffee(which I hate), and we stumbled on Megaglia D'Oro.  Everyone helped themselves to the Medaglia and they liked it.  The next day my brother came to the campsite with a coffee kettle and brewed some coffee for everyone, and after a cup of the brewed coffee, they said they preffered the Medaglia.  Good stuff!  My only complaint is that it comes in a tiny jar.

column9: HANDS DOWN FAVORITE INSTANT COFFEE I ALWAYS COME BACK TO
column10: This great instant expresso is truly sensational & in a class by itself !! What makes this so special is not only the fabulous taste, but its powdered form, making it versatile for baking, making truffles, chocolates, and is easily blended in iced coffee beverages. I have tried many other instant expresso coffees and the others are mostly freeze dried, so the taste is not as good & it does not blend well in iced coffees or as versatile for baking or truffle making. It is reasonably priced on Amazon & I go into withdrawal without my Medaglia D'Oro !

I'm no fan of instant coffees. They're usually extremely bitter and off-tasting to me, even if they are made from Arabica beans. But, I absolutely love this product. This is the only thing I use to make iced Americanos at home. The results are very good and I don't miss the Starbucks stuff or my money! Haven't tried this hot though. Overall, highly recommended!

I needed this exact product for a specific recipe from Cook's Illustrated.  I had gone to at least 6 stores to located it and was unsuccessful.  When I googled it, sure enough, Amazon came through.  There was another review that said she was looking for it for a recipe also.  Anyway, it really enhanced the chocolate in the recipe I was making and I'm thrilled to have it.  Pretty great that Amazon has pretty much everything you ever need.  I highly recommend the Cook's Chocolate Desserts magazine.  Each dessert in there will make you look like a professional confectioner.  http://www.cooksillustrated.com/bookstore/detail.asp?PID=520
I have tried several 'instant' espresso coffees, and although none are as good as the real thing, Medaglia is by far the best tasting.  Buying through Amazon is the most economical way to go.

column9: I'm so glad I found you on Amazon, Medaglia D'Oro!
column10: My local Von's supermarket just stopped carrying this instant coffee. Boo! But I just found Amazon sells it! Yay!First of all, the taste is great. You wouldn't know it was instant in a blind test. It actually forms a delicious crema like it came out of an espresso machine. I'm an ex-coffee snob that mostly cares about caffeine, but this is up to my old standards as a decent cup. If you're a coffee snob, go ahead and buy some. We won't tell your Peet's worshipping coffee snob friends.Second, it's convenient. YOU DON'T NEED TO BOIL WATER! I have a really hard time waking up some mornings. I need caffeine prior to even putting a kettle on. With Medaglia D'Oro, I can just use hot tap water to make that first (double) shot of the morning. And as other reviewers have mentioned, it dissolves perfectly in *any* temperature water, great for when you want an iced espresso or if you want to get fancy and make an ice blended drink. (If your tap water isn't hot enough, one minute in the microwave should get the water hot enough. It doesn't need to be boiling hot!)This stuff is great for camping, backpacking, road trips, and other travel. Also great for baking. I'm so glad I found it here on Amazon. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to order a case.

I bought this at Central Market for $2.89 just to try it. I've been desperately looking for an organic instant coffee that is available to me locally. I just don't have the time or energy to mess with a coffee or espresso machine early in the morning. I picked up some Medaglia D'Oro and tried it. It was OK, but I can't say I was overwhelmed. I expected it to be a lot stronger. I guess I'm used to Nescafe. However, I do have to say that it wasn't as bitter as most coffee. I could definitely get used to this brand.

The coffee itself doesn't taste amazing. It's tolerable. Perhaps it's on par with lower-end medium quality espresso.The coffee high that I get from this is insane. It is better than most energy drinks that I've had. Energy drinks really just get me shaky and on-edge. This gets me close enough to on-edge that I have comfortable control over myself. It is like speed.I love it.Good job, Medaglia!
Make an instant espresso latte or add a dash to your regular cup for a smooth flavor.  Once you try it, you'll always want to have it on hand.

After living in Europe for a while, I was looking for a decent tasting expresso minus the heavy and costly machine to buy. It doesn't make sense to make a pot of coffee for one person plus the regular coffee just hasn't been tasting the same no matter what brand it is. We were shocked at the great quality as the thought of instant coffee was counterintuitive.  I use it for latte's and love it.  We also like the small jar size as it keeps portions fresh. Great time saver!
I love a hot cup in the morning but the best is iced with sugar free vanilla or hazlenut cream.  You can mix directly into cold water....so easy!

Best instant coffee ever. You will not be disappointed. This coffee is delicious. And yes, it does dissolve easily in cold water. I use a shot of creamer, ice water and a tablespoon of coffee to make my iced coffee. It wakes you up. I'm not dozing off, I'm no longer sleepy in the middle of day, great for keeping me going at work. I can praise this coffee enough.  My other fave coffee is 1820, a Costa Rican coffee, I discovered while visiting Nicaragua, which is delicious and powerful (strong, meaning it wakes you up) but is not instant. You can only get that one for drip as far as I know. For instant coffee is this one. I bought it at my local grocery store but I will be buying from Amazon.com and stocking up on this great coffee.Update March 27th...I made coffee ice cream with my new ice cream maker I bought here at amazon.com.  I used 3 regular spoonfuls and wow, what flavor. Absolutely delicious and it was a hit with my family.  I love this coffee. Best kept secret.
Medaglia D'Oro brand makes the best instant espresso coffee. Tastes like freshly brewed in an instant!

We use this in our tiramisu.  It gets dissolved in coffee and then the ladyfingers get dunked in it.  Works great for that purpose.  I probably didn't need to buy a pack of 6, but oh well.  We have not been able to find espresso powder in our local grocery stores.
Amazing smooth flavor.  I use this mixed with skim milk and a high protein powder to make a wonderful iced coffee smoothie.  It is the breakfast of champions!!
Great taste for instant coffee. Just too small jars and I have to order a pack of 6 all the time as I drink this everyday!

Besides, being in the mood for one and being in the mood to go out and get one do not necessarily coinside.  Here is my solution.  I pour plain old regular coffee into my favorite mug.  Then I add a flovored creamer like the ones made by "International Delight".  Next I heat the mug of coffee in the microwave for a few seconds to make it a bit hotter since the refrigerated creamer cools it off a bit. column9: which peach tea is best?  not this one.
column10: I've tried three peach teas, including Bigelow Perfect Peach Herbal Tea, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6), Celestial Seasonings Herb Tea, Country Peach Passion, 20-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6), and Celestial Seasonings Blossom Green Tea, Peach, 20-Count (Pack of 6).  It saddens me to say that none of the three is worthy of a four or five star rating.  If you are just looking for a tea that has a nice fruit flavor, I would recommend Celestial Seasonings Herb Tea, Black Cherry Berry, 20-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6).  Here are my thoughts on three peach teas:Bigelow Perfect Peach:  Most Bigelow teas are very pleasant to drink, but this peach tea is the exception.  Unbrewed, the tea smells fruity and has a particularly heavy apple smell that is accented by cinnamon.  It does not smell like peach.  When brewed, the tea smells like fruit; the peach is still not evident.  This is probably not surprising given that the first two are ingredients rose hips and hibiscus. Usually, Bigelow aptly names its teas but I feel this is more of a fruit tea.  Unfortunately, this isn't even a good fruit tea.  The flavor is only memorable for its lack of good flavor.  The flavor is bitter, perhaps because of the lemon peel.  There is a strong aftertaste.  I just don't like this tea.  Bigelow's peach tea is made in the USA and is caffeine free.  1-1.5 stars.Celestial Seasonings Country Peach Passion:  Celestial Seasonings misses the mark with this tea.  It is a fine tea but offers nothing exceptional to want to come back to each morning.  The flavor profile is dull and lacks a distinctly peachy flavor.  When unbrewed, the scent is sweet and very much accented by orange.  When brewed, the scent does not change much; it is still quite citrus infused. This is probably not surprising given that the first ingredient is orange peel.  All in all this is a lackluster tea. Flavor wise, all I could focus on was the orange.  I feel like the company should have just put more orange peel in this and made it an orange tea.  I think I would have liked that.  As the tea stands now, I am confused by it.  It is not quite an orange but it is definitely not a peach tea.  It is certainly a better peach attempt than Bigelow's Perfect Pea flavor. This tea is caffeine free.  3 starsCelestial Seasonings Green Tea -Peach Blossom:  This is definitely a green tea.  The green tea scent is quite prominent when unbrewed and easily eclipses any scent that other ingredients might individually offer.  It remains a strong tea once brewed.  You really have to like green tea to appreciate this offering.  I couldn't really identify much peach flavoring in this  I no longer drink this tea hot due to its intense flavoring.  Instead, I brew a bag, water it down, and add ice.  This creates a better version of the diet green tea you might purchase at a grocery.  Contains caffeine.  3 stars.
My wife is the tea person in the house and she is very happy with this peach tea.  We both like the tea hot and cold and would certainly purchase again.

column9: The best peach favor in the US.
column10: After trying so many so-called peach flavored tea, I still think Bigelow Peach tea is the best in the US. Why so? Because most peach tea sold in the US either taste like Hisbicus Flowers, or with a strong citrus presence which resembles orange or lemon flavor. My only complaint is that this tea is caffeine-free. To solve this problem, I often put this tea bag in the same cup of my favorite caffeine red/black/white tea, and it works very well.For those peach-tea lovers, I also strongly recommend the British brand, Fortnum and Mason: Peach Flavored Black Chinese Tea. It is the best caffine-peach tea I tasted on earth. Unfortuantely, you can purchase that only in their UK retail shops, or through their web site.

If you want tea that tastes like a melted Popsicle, this is not it. If you want something subtle with aroma and combination of flavors, this is the one. This is more than "just peach" tasting. This is Peach and savory herbs. Soothing. Not meant to compete with syrup-y flavors of other teas that are like warm soda or melted candy. This is TEA.

I was so happy to find Amazon carried Perfect Peach tea!  My grocery store stopped carrying it and I was down to my last few bags before it occurred to me to search online (duh!)I love to drink this warm and sweetened with just a bit of honey.  I find it very soothing, especially when PMS is causing cramps or I have an upset stomach.

My hubby bought the 11 bags.  At that point it was a search onthe net to find where we could buy it. I have not checked all the pet stores, which I will be doing.  This product must taste very good for my dogs to continue to eatit and at this point, they know the bag!  *******  ******  ******Here we are in july of '10.  This is still one of three things our yorkies will eat.  They eat baby food and my husband BBq's chicken or ground meat on weekends for them when we grill. I keep dry kibble down for them and give them a vitamin.  I try anyway. This bag is known by sight.  If it is up on the counter, they jump to get it.  I can't tell you have many things we have tried over the years. Yes. I do know they are spoiled.  But seem healthy now at 10.  There seems to be slight change in texture. She loves this duck jerky though (and I am very tempted to try it myself! LoL).  Good stuff if you also have a finicky pooch.

I make a crab dip recipe that was handed down to me by my mother-in-law.  It requires one can of claw crab meat.  The flavor is much less flavorful if you use any type of crabmeat other than claw crab meat.  What I like best about Miller's Select is that I almost never find shell or cartilage in the meat.  Every other brand I have used, I had to carefully feel and examine the entire can of crab and pick out cartilage and shells and I still missed some.  Also, other brands have a few intact claw meat pieces on top and bit and pieces of claw meat underneath ; I opened a can of Miller's Select (my last can from the case I ordered nearly a year ago) this week and the entire can consisted of intact claw crab meat.  In answer to "Very Good Flavor but...," in forty years of making Granny's Crab Dip, the canned claw crabmeat I have used has never been pink. Miller's Select Claw Crab Meat is an excellent product and since I used up the last can this week, I am ordering another case today.

I must say, this product has very good flavor although, unlike the picture above, there isn't a trace of pink/red in the entire can...well, two cans, as I've opened that many.  Maybe the color disappears in the cooking process inside the can.  At any rate, I was taken aback that the meat was rather flesh tone.  Good news is that there's plenty of claw meat in there.  If the meat had been pinkish, it would have made a nice decoration on a seafood plate but as it is, it's best to just be used for sandwiches or inside a casserole, etc.  Good flavor.  Great sandwich material here.

column9: Safer than rawhide, don't last as long but also cleans teeth
column10: I picked these up from my local pet shop for a bit cheaper than what they are on offer for from Amazon, so you might wish to shop around.Over all I am quite satisfied with these "bones." They are much safer than raw hide chews given they are made from dried chicken, which means unlike raw hide you know these are actually digestible. This is the biggest reason I bought them. My vet recommended not giving my Sheltie raw hide as they aren't properly digestible. Whether this is true or not, I've heeded her advice.Baird, my Sheltie, really seems to enjoy them. When he sees one coming out of the bag, his tail is wagging like crazy. He enjoys these as much as our old family Sheltie McGyver enjoyed raw hide. The only difference I see between these and raw hide is that raw hide lasted roughly 30 minutes longer in chew time than these. I'd say Baird can chew through one of these in about 30 or so minutes, while our old Sheltie could chew on a single raw hide for an hour, at which point we would throw away the little nub. There is nothing left of these bones after 30 minutes.As far as the dental application goes, it does smell of mint, so I assume it should, if nothing else, help with doggy breath, though to be fair Baird has never really had "doggy breath." I also use some dog mouth foam so I don't know what really keeps his breath "fresh" between the two.If you aren't too sure about raw hide for your dog and want something you know can be digested, these are definitely worth it.For those that try to keep track of where the things they give their dog come from, these are made in China. I've tried finding something similar not made in China, but it seems such a thing doesn't exist or I just can't find them.

Great product but made in China. Once I realized this after purchase, I got a little worried. Kind of over priced in the regular retail market. My dogs like it & have been ok but I wish I knew ahead of time where it was made.

The girls lost their taste for rawhide, but were still looking for something to chew. They love these Smart Bones, and they are better for them as well. I will be reordering them when there gone!SmartBones Chicken Dog Chew, Mini, 24-Pack

there wonderful, my dog loves them, and I feel good giving them to him, I will always get these for him.
My dogs just love these and the chews are safe for them. Their breath benefits from the mint and their dental exams show much less plaque . I must keep bags on hand; they expect them.
I have given this bone to several different breeds and sizes of dogs and it is a major hit! And I don't worry about them choking on it as you do with rawhides. LOVE this product and will buy more!

Moulins de la Brague Extra Virgin Oil has an impressive body & texture: It is very rich, fulfilling, and incredibly smooth. However, its rich and fulfilling characteristic is not heavy and dominating at all, which makes this olive oil quite distinct from most other brands with similar products. It is one of the smoothest extra virgin olive oil I have ever tasted, 'silky' would be perfect choice of word to describe such smooth texture. The tin bottle is very French and chic for that matter, if not the prettiest looking tin bottle around.Moulins de la Brague Extra Virgin Oil is made from ripe black olives (of different varieties and from different regions), as opposed to green olives, which is certainly rare and even odd in olive oil industry. This partially explains the expensive price, since the Mediterraneans & Aegeans treat ripe black olives as edible olives instead of pressing them to make oil. This tradition also determines the olive prices in the market due to demand and support equilibrium, keeping the prices of black olives higher than green olives. Olive oil made by black olives generally lacks the fruity flavors, however. This is the biggest downfall according to most olive oil consumers.I have experimented with this olive oil and quite interesting results came out of it: Moulins de la Brague Extra Virgin Oil has the quality of 'bringing out the flavor' of the ingredients in your dish, whereas the majority of olive oils simply add to it. For instance, I have marinated a few slices of smoked Atlantic salmon in this oil with some freshly grinded  black pepper and a much better tasting salmon dish came out of it! Although it has not added any aroma or flavor to my green salads, it simply made every single ingredient in the salad taste better, more vibrant.On the negative side, it does not have any significant aroma (nose) or much of flavor (palate). There is no finish or after-taste either. Thus, it is not the best olive oil for dipping your bread, unless you spice it up with some oregano, red chili pepper and garlic. It is too expensive to cook with, therefore I would not recommend  cooking or sauteing with it. If you like the flavorful Italian-Sicilian, Greek and Turkish oils with rich aroma, this is not your oil. I strongly recommend Frantoia Extra Virgin Olive Oil instead. You will also save big bucks.Another reason for not giving it 5 stars is that my order has arrived in damaged condition, the tin-bottle was bent, which mattered since it is also a decorative item.

When I visited the olive mill in Opio, I tasted the product and bought only one can because I was traveling and had limited space in my luggage.What a mistake....now I have to have it shipped (I get it on line from Amazon) at twice the local price! If you are a true "gourmand" , you MUST try this olive oil. The best of the best!

Ekobrew Reuseable K-cup Filter Includes 2 Ekobrews and 2- 1.75-oz Packages of Kirkland Signature Coffee: I would have rated this product better if the seller was not the issue. The product was as discribed and works OK. Just put your coffee in the filter and hit brew. I have read other reviews and agree with most, about coffee grounds causing issues. Be sure to clean any grounds off the rim when closing the filter, also if you use finely ground beans you may end up with some grounds in the cup. Overall this product is a coffee filter and it works as one.Seller: I was not impressed with this seller. I have contacted the seller as requested by Amazon and after two weeks I have not heard anything. Anyway, I received the package containing: 2-Ekobrews and only 1-sample coffee (off-brand not Kirkland). Shipping was very slow, I received the package on the last estimated delivery date; and the package was actually shipped from COSTCO not the seller.
Disappointed, does not fit the brew system.  The lid does not fully close.  Product does brew coffee, but am afraid it will eventually harm the machine.

These are absolutely scrumptuous!  My husband and I both love them, however, as another customer put it, they are expensive to ship!  The cost of shipping is more than the tartlets themselves are!
What a nice alternative to an apple pie. Love the fact there was no slicing and dicing. Easy to prepare. I also loved the fact that you can make them fresh whenever needed.

I like Creme Brulee. I loved that these were so easy. Just sprinkle on the sugar that came with and broil. They look amazing and taste great. My guess thought I really went out of the way for them when really it took all of 5 minutes. I will be ordering more!
not what I was expecting in terms of the company's reputation for excellent home delivery products

column9: Busy Hearty Hide Dog Bones pourchased thru Amazon
column10: This product is a dog chew bone and my dogs love these...They are so difficult to find here in the South and I so appreciate the fact that I can purchase this product and have them shipped to my home....My little dogs just love these they look forward to getting these every night right after dinner and trust me they know when its time for there favorite treats....Thank you so much for carrying these ......they would really miss them......they arrived on time and were nicely boxed...great product great company will purchase from them again....

column9: Late but  rice arrived in a nicely sealed package.

The company never reached out to say why or anything which makes me leary their product is of high standards.  We'll see on that.

This Terri Medi white wine vinegar is exceptionally good.  I had been purchasing it at our local Target until for some disappointing reason they don't carry it any longer.  So my search led me to find it on Amazon.  Thank you Amazon!!  I have just placed an order for 2 bottles and when they run out I will order more. You won't be disappointed with this vinegar.  Superb when preparing your salad dressings, and compliments olive oil beautifully.  Wonderful in cooked skillet dishes.  Made a rigatoni pasta dish today with this vinegar along w/ cherry tomatoes, fresh pearl mozzarella, fresh snipped basil, and sauteed onion and garlic.  Drizzle in the Terri Medi white wine vinegar and a good olive oil and --what a delicious treat warm or cold!
I used cheap white wine vinegar in the past,basic safeway stuff. No more, this is a great upgrade. I  made a good buying decison.
My son was thrilled to add these to his Pez collection. They're cute.. standard Pez dispensers. They work very well.
So cute! Got them recently for my granddaughter who is a BIG fan of Phineas and Ferb.  She was thrilled!

I enjoy Sports Beans for their flavors as well as for being a replenishing snack while training during long distance runs. They aren't as messy as the gel packs during warm long runs, but the packaging can be a little hard to open up while running sometimes.

Use them for all training runs over 12 miles.  Great for marathoning, I hate the consistency of goo and gel products and don't like carrying bars when its hot because they turn to mush, these have worked great for me and buying in bulk like this saves a lot of $$$.  Berry flavor is my faborite.  Happy running

Was introduced to HobNobs while recently vacationing in the UK.  Absolutely loved them so I brought back a couple of packages and after those were gone I went looking for them on line.  Was thrilled when I found them at Amazon. Didn't care that I was paying double for them in the States, because they are worth it.  If you like a thin dense cruchy oatmeal "oookie" with a modest layer of milk chocolate, then these biscuits are for you.

column9: The biscuits are 5 stars, but the packaging is horrible with open gaps.
column10: ****Food Safety Alert****(see my pictures)I have asked amazon.com to update the product pictures, just like I have posted here over the months.I did get some open plastic wrap issue before. But the recently changed loose white plastic wrap inside the orange box has more open gaps, ruining the taste. And, I would rather not get sick from tasting it with these repeated issues.I have reported this issue to Amazon.com. And I am now reporting this poor packaging issue to McVitie's International. but I have not received any feedback from the manufacturer yet. And, there is no suggestion other than emailing them from their homepage. Frustrating.The package is definitely different from the one you will find in UK.This export packaging, however, results in more problems. By doubling the packaging, still the company could not prevent the exact same open gap issues, and, the result is, the buyer has to deal with finding the product gone bad, and spending more time reporting the issue, yet not hearing back from no one from Amazon.com or McVitie's, unless you call.The result I deal with here is, The Chocolate coating get gooey, and, because of this, the biscuits are all glued together and almost impossible to separate them even with a knife. And. it is already soggy(Yes, I attmpted to eat one unsuccessfully) Maybe some of this all happened from the hot sunny day delivery during the June-August period?For now, I suggest not buy this. I will never recommend this to Amazon buyers like myself. I even told amazon.com not to sell this unless they resolve the issue with McVitie's.If you still have some at home, carefully examine the white wrap like I do. Instead of enjoying the British Taste, I get frightened opening the orange boxes, or I stopped touching what I already have. Disturbed I guess?I don't think I will enjoy Hob Nobs experiencing this repeatedly.The product should be all 5 star, but the pain I had to deal with the manufactring/packaging issue definitely is 1 star experience.++update++After I wrote this, I still called and spoke with a CS rep from Amazon.com. She said the company would refund the unconsumed portion and I voluntarily suggested suspending my monthly prescription for fairness.Still, dead seriously warning you to examine the white wraps.

Being American, I'd call it a cookie.  Biscuit, cookie, it's still delicious.  I even tried it dunked in a proper cup of British tea.  Great that way too.  I love trying food from other countries and am learning that the English not  neccesarily known for good food, do have some tasty treats and the HobNobs are one of them.
I love love love hobnobs! Oaty, chocolatey, delicious. I was so happy to find them and at a great price too!

These are the best cookies!  Maggie Smith even smuggled them to India in "The Best Exotic Marigold Hotel".  They may cost a little more but they're well worth it.  I've even hooked my friends on them.
I like this product even more than the original digestive cookie with chocolate.  Love the texture.  It is crunchy.  My kids and husband love it too.
We first had these in Ireland, wow are these yummy! I have been buying them at Whole Foods at double the cost, this a great value! No artificial colors, flavors:) great with milk or hot coffee, tea.
American cookies that are bought in the store are to sweet and processed . If your going for quality and want to make a good impression buy it

column9: Great Taste - Perfect SNACK Bar for Diabetics!
column10: LOVE these bars -- best tasting of all the flavors!  I travel a lot and they are great to just throw in your purse or pocket for when your levels are getting low.  I highly recommend them!

Glucerna Oatmeal Raisin Mini Bars have proven to be an excellent food tocontrol and manage diabetes.Diabetics should ask their doctor if Glucerna Oatmeal Raisin Mimi Barswould be helpful in contolling and managing diabetes.

between meals or even for a quick breakfast, these bars do the trick.  this is my favourite flavour and the only bar without chocolate. i am type I diabetic and have extreme highs and lows. i can eat these bars as a snack or to boost my blood sugar, without tons of calories.  the gmi is low, so it prevents that diabetic bounce, from low to high, you can get when you eat a snack.this flavour has been impossible to find in my local stores, so i was thankful to find them on amazon. save even more by signing up for subscribe and save.

These are delicious Glucerna Snack Bars which are now imposible to find in retail stores. Glucerna, unfortunately, discontinues making product lines when they introduce new products (like their cold cereals). Apparently, they can't chew gum and walk at the same time!!!!!

Glucerna's mini bars in Oatmeal Raisin are the only mini bars I have found without chocolate. And they are very,very good tasting and they are also good for you! They are hard to find in our town so I order through Amazon a few months worth at a time.

Recently I was diagnosed with Type 2 Diabetes. I was devastated and worried about what I could eat.  A Registered Nutritionist gave me a Glucerna bar sample.  It was delicious and satisfied my sweet tooth.  It made me feel great between meals. I have stocked up on the Oatmeal Raisin and Chocolate Peanut Butter bars now. I was very satisfied with my Amazon Glucerna buying experience as the service was excellent.
This item was not received.  I just realized that when I received your request for an review.  Please look into it
NOT TOO FLAVORFUL..........ICING ON BAR IS FLAKING OFF...DONT KNOW IF THAT IS NORMAL.  I MUCH PREFER THE CHOCOLATE PEANUT.  THESES BARS SEEM SMALLER THAN THE ONES I HAVE PURCHASED IN STORE.

My husband actually turned me onto this flavor.  He had been introduced to it at his job; its a regular flavor there.  I've noticed this is not a common flavor hence its difficult to find, kudos to Amazon.  This flavor falls into the medium strength category, the blend of mocha/fudge is a true satisfactory tastebud delight.  Smells and tastes great.  This will be one of my regular varieties in my k-cup basket.

Mocha nut fudge is good but not great. It tastes best with a mocha creamer. We have tried about 20 different k cups and The Donut House chocolate glazed donut and Timothys German chocolate cake taste the best to us so far. This one is good to have once in a while for variety though.

My wife has been addicted to these K-Cups since we first got our Keurig 3 years ago. I couldn't tell you how many we have gone through, but she continues to enjoy drinking it. Lately, however, the Mocha K-Cups from Dunkin Donuts are starting to surpass this for her! Luckily for Green Mountain those are only limited edition K-Cups (supposedly).

Very good flavor of coffee.  I enjoy it very much.  It is very nutty, but the fudge flavor does come through.  It does present a slightly bitter after taste but does not take away from the good overall flavor.
i didn't like the flavor at all.. maybe its just me. it was VERY nut flavored and not very chocolate. if that's what you're looking for then maybe youll like it.
This K cup has a little bit of an artificial flavor and does not taste particularrly like mocha nuts or fudge.  It taste more like a genericly flavored coffee.  It isn't bad but not a favorite

I wanted to love this coffee. I am a chocoholic and love any coffee that has chocolate. BUT... there wasn't much flavor at all, most of the time my cup would come out smelling slightly burnt and I had to add ALOT of creamer. I can't say I would buy this flavor ever again.
Bitter and off putting can describe the flavors and aroma or just plain terrible! I hate this coffee!!!!! I wish I had never wasted my money on this but lesson learned.
The mocha nut fudge K-cups are a medium blend and not overpowering.  Both the nut and fudge flavors were distinctive.  I will buy this again.
This coffee has delicious flavor.  It is like having dessert without the calories. I will be ordering this again.  Terrific value.

I was really excited to try this flavor, so I was very disappointed when it didn't come in my variety pack.  I ended up purchasing the 5 pack sample from a different site, and I must say I am glad I didn't just buy a box.  Its not the worst thing I have ever drank, but its not that good.  It is sort of bitter and almost flavorless, needs lots of cream and sugar for me.
Clients really like this coffee, and it so much more affordable to order coffee from Amazon and the selection is much larger than in the stores.

This is a good coffee with a nice chocolate flavor.  The flavor is just right, not too weak or overpowering.  The coffee itself seems a bit stronger than in some of the other flavors, which in my opinion is a good thing...some flavored coffees end up weak and watery tasting. In this case the flavor balances with the coffee very well. Not too sweet for people who don't like sweet things in the morning (OK, I am not one of those people, but I hear they exist), but flavorful enough that I do not need to add much to it, a little skim milk is fine. No, it doesn't taste exactly like a mocha coffee drink from your favorite coffeehouse, but then it doesn't have all those calories, either! To me this is the best alternative to stopping by Starbucks for a $4 coffee...brew one of these into my travel mug and go!

Love, Love, Love this coffee! Great flavor, not too strong or weak, no bitterness. Just right! I recommend this for anyone who loves the Mocha flavors, as I do. Great transaction, no complaints at all!

I  have found many flavored k-cup coffees to enjoy; this is not one of them.  I used artificial sweetener in this one as I do in all of them, but did not use milk in my coffee when I had this flavor in the office.  Maybe that's why I didn't get the Mocha Nut flavor.  Perhaps the flavor would have been more evident with a bit of milk.
This is good, but it is a little weak. I had to put more sweetner and creamer than I normally use in order to make it more to my taste. It makes a small cup best.
Great flavor but it is weak.  Enjoy it as an afternoon treat or when I am in the mood for something different. Not acidic either

Hi All,I highly recommend Mocha Nut Fudge as a break from your normal coffee regiment. I am no coffee expert, I just like it. Really was looking at this as a mocha option which I haven't found yet in any brand.  It got 3 stars because it isn't bad, just not what you would expect from the name.

column9: The best mocha nut fudge coffee ever!
column10: All I can say is wow, this flavor is wonderful. When its brewing, the smell is outstanding and you can actually taste the chocolate. Very satisfied, not watery. Aroma is pleasing, not bitter and no after taste. I am ordering more. Yum!!!

We got our Keurig coffee maker for Christmas and have been trying out different varieties of coffee.  This Mocha Nut Fudge is by far our favorite.  It has a great combination of mocha and a subtle nutty flavor.  We'll be drinking this one for a while!

The coffee is not strong and you can taste the added flavors.  I first tried this as my first cup of coffee and decided it was definitely not the coffee I would start my day on. I prefer a stronger, bolder flavor for first thing. Love the taste of espresso double shots. I do like a flavored coffee, tend to go for one in the afternoon.  So I found this to be on the sweet side but then I never add any sugar or sweetener to my drinks. (nor syrup to my pancakes, gotta have butter) You get the idea I prefer savory to sweet.  If you like nut flavored coffee and chocolate you would probably like this. I like it.
If your dog is a real chewer, like my Husky, your best friend is going to like this.These are knotted up nice and tight.Great value. You won't regret buying these.

This tea is GREAT. I bought mine local, and I'm pretty sure it was quite a bit less than the $11.99 for 1/2lbs I'm seeing listed here, though I would probably pay that price for it given how good it is.

This is a nice jasmine tea, that doesn't get bitter if you forget it and steep it longer than 3-5 minutes (as I have done). There isn't a lot of jasmine aroma in the steam or the flavor, which is why I took a star off, but as an economical everyday jasmine tea it can't be beat. I liked it enough to order more.

I've tried other brands of jasmine tea, and none is as good.  This is just delicious tea, doesn't go stale quickly (ie, will last on your shelf for several years if you go in and out of tea-drinking phases), and reminds me of being in Montreal because so many of the restaurants in the Chinatown area serve it.  Great stuff!

I also buy this exact product locally and pay much less for it. And you can get it from other Amazon retailers for considerably less--I've seen it as low as $2.66, so this retailer is ripping people off. It's great jasmine tea. I drink it daily.

This is the BEST blueberry flavoring you can buy. We use it in our fudge and mix 1 part of LorAnn's Blueberry Flavoring with 1 part LorAnn's Cheesecake flavoring for a delicious mix. It is actually one of our best selling flavors!

column9: My favorite chocolate of all time!
column10: This is my favorite chocolate of all time. It has the perfect balance of sweet and crunchiness. The chocolate is very smooth, good quality. It never gets old. I can eat 3 of these a day. I especially love the raisins/dried cranberries and almond inside. Makes the chocolate perfect. I love chocolate with a lot of nuttiness to it. This supplier trade concepts is the cheapest around and they ship the package really well with thermal protection packaging and moisture absorbing packets inside.

I received this item as a gift.  It was really strange and unprofessional in the way that it arrived.  The return address had a personal name on it with "Heartwarming Treasures" underneath, the box was damaged,and the basket was kind of crunched and not very nicely wrapped.  Adding to the unprofessional presentation, there was a card with it that was inappropriate (a spring design card was sent for a Christmas gift) and the card was sloppily signed with cursive handwriting.  And there was no other note about this supposed company that sent the gift or what it was (it should have said something about being Pacific Northwest chocolates, which would have made it more meaningful since that has some significance to me).  Needless to say, these factors made the entire gift less desirable.  I opened the chocolates anyway and the one redeeming thing about this gift basket was that they contained amazing chocolates.  The mint chocolate truffle was the best I've had.  That said, if you're going to send Seattle Chocolates as a gift, I'd pick another gift basket vendor besides this one.
This is the first time I tried Seattle Chocolates and they're the best tasting chocolates EVER!!!  Highly recommended!

I set out to find an organic black sesame vendor after several bad tasting experiences with the store-bought variety. I have already ordered this item multiple times, because of its consistency in quality and delivery. The seeds are wonderfully tasty and, because they are raw, they can be roasted to one's taste. I recommend this product wholeheartedly.
The regular shirmp noddle soup's taste is very good, and this spicy srimp flavour has a better taste, I like it!
this is my second order of this flavor and i love it and will be getting more and more and more

Jars arrived well-packaged to prevent breakage. Four stars because we wish the jars were larger and the price lower.

It made me fall in love with Tuna again. I tried this smoked tuna while eating at my grandmother's house and it's wonderful. I had to buy a box for myself and one to send to my mother since I haven't seen it available at all stores. I recommend taking a little bit of olive oil and vinegar to mix with the tuna. That being said, this reminds me of smoked salmon, although not as good. This is great on a wheat bun tuna melt!

column9: This wild Alaskan salmon is right off the hook good ...
column10: If you are a fan of specialty smoked salmon or prefer to select your fish at a seafood counter you may not care for Bear & Wolf.  This is almost right off the hook good.  It has that "fishy" taste that I actually prefer, but if you serve this up to those who don't care for it you'll be getting a thumbs down.  If you've tried the Kirkland brand, which is delightfully pink and flaky, you might be taken aback when you see and taste something from the wild.  I do not like most canned salmon because it is farmed ... some farming conditions are less than optimal (such a turn off).  This is wild Alaskan salmon that crumbles when you take a fork to it. column10: I used to buy this at Costco when I lived in the area, but now having moved out of a Costco area, I can no longer find this item.  Only online, and only at Amazon.  hummmmmph! It is now double the price but still I love this item and will continue to shop to locate.  Thanks, WW

I'd have to drive at last one hour one way to find an outlet.

column9: High Quality, Handy and Easy to Store.
column10: Eat more fish. Eat more fish. I seem to read the advice everywhere. Well, that's not a bad idea for health reasons, and I like fish now and then. It just doesn't seem to work it's way into our diets often enough. Well, I discovered a way that may get around that problem. While shopping at my local Costco warehouse store, I discovered  a wrapped set of six six-ounce cans of Bear & Wolf Pink Salmon. It's wild Alaskan salmon, packed with a little water and salt, and it's skinless and boneless.I opened up a can when I got home. It has very little "fishy" odor, although my  cats certainly got excited when the top came off the can, and the taste is fresh and mild. Excellent! One of the reviews suggested eating it raw, so that's what I did with a variety of salad veggies. Mmmmm, good. Nice lunch. I'll surely repeat this. Plus the unused portion in the can was easy to cap and return to the fridge. Another suggestion was to put it in casseroles for baking. Of course, I can hardly wait. A scalloped potato dish with salmon ought to be excellent. Or salmon with noodles. I can even take it along as a quality source of protein when I go camping. That's what I like about this product. It's high quality, real handy and easy to store.Gary Peterson

We love this salmon and my two year old happily eats it twice a week straight from the can to her little plate with a squirt of heinz organic ketchup.We purchase it at Costco... but was checking here at Amazon as well to see if it qualified for the free shipping.

column9: Better than any other brand out there!

column9: A healthy snack food; bet you'll eat the entire package in one sitting
column10: Arare is an excellent snack food, a crunchy, soy sauce-flavored puffed rice.  In America, puffed rice would be an icky sweet breakfast cereal.  In Japan, puffed rice becomes a slightly salty, satisfying snack food.Traditionalists will eat arare with beer or sake.  About the only adult beverage that goes badly with arare is red wine.  One caveat:  this stuff is crunchy, LOUDLY crunchy.  There is no way to eat arare in silence.One variation of arare is this product, slightly sweetened soy sauce-flavored puffed rice covered with thin seaweed.  This seaweed is called nori by Japanese; the closest American eqiuivalent is laver.  Yes, this arare snack is actually healthy; you will get your share of green veggies with every bite.Nori will definitely give arare a fishy flavor.  Most people who have tried it the first time came back for more.  In fact, if there is a Japanese snack food that can be described as:  "Bet you can't eat just one."  - it will be arare.Arare is low calorie and low cholesterol.  This distributor of arare has had a near-50 year record of supplying top-notch, high-quality foods to America and the world.  Give it a try.

column10: This Yummy Spoonfuls baby food is organic and fresh-tasting, almost like homemade baby food.  And my baby loves it.  However, there's not really much of a difference between this brand and the shelf-stable organic baby food in pouches.  In fact, the latter are much more convenient because, unlike the Yummy Spoonfuls brand, the pouched baby food can be easily transported without refrigeration, e.g., in a diaper bag.  In addition, there's not much of a difference between these "Mushy Yummy" meals and the "Creamy Yummy" baby foods.  The "Mushy" baby food is more of a coarse puree than actual textured food.  Therefore, this may not be the ideal baby food for helping your baby learn to eat textured solid foods.  Perhaps this "Mushy Yummy" food may prove useful as in "in-between" step if your little-one is having trouble transitioning from smooth purees to textured baby food.  Otherwise, you might was well save yourself the money, time and trouble involved in purchasing, storing and heating up frozen "live" baby food, and go with a shelf-stable, organic brand like Plum Organics, Ella's Kitchen or Happy Baby.A final, albeit minor point.  For all the expense involved, I expected the product (packaging) to look at least somewhat professional.  The product I received had labels that looked like they'd been printed on someone's home computer/printer.  And the labels stated that the tubs of baby food were 6 ounces each, when it was clear that they were no more than 4 ounces a piece.

One of the pleasures of a Keurig is that you can serve a friend or a guest a cup of coffee that will please them and their tastes, not just what you brew for yourself everyday.  I happen to enjoy strong, deeply roasted blends (the kind that you usually find at the specialty coffee shops which seem to be all over the place now).  However, not everyone shares my enjoyment of a strong, full-bodied cup of coffee.I have many friends who often say something like "I love coffee but Starbucks is just too strong for me".  Enter Donut Blend.  I have purchased many boxes of Coffee People's Donut Shop Coffee and it is a favorite for many of my friends and family.  When Timothy's announced that they were coming out with the "Original Donut Blend" I got in line to try it.  Here is my take on it:It is certainly a little lighter than Coffee People's version but the taste is more complex with clean, bright notes of spice and low acidity.  Surprisingly, it reminds me a little of the Peaberry Kona coffee that I brought back from Hawaii.  It is a perfect blend for those who like their coffee black or with just a little cream and still want it to taste like coffee.  If someone drinks several cups a day I think that Timothy's Donut Blend will not overwhelm their taste buds and will still taste fresh cup after cup.  Mind you, I drink Newman's Own Bold Blend on a regular basis and will continue to do so, but if I am having more than two cups (for those "special" mornings when nothing seems to go right) or if I am having a cup later in the day I will drink this one.Just rating it on what I want in a coffee I give it four stars, but judging it for what it is (and not just what I like), it fully delivers and deserves five stars.Coffee People Medium Extra Bold, Donut Shop K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) [Amazon Frustration-Free Packaging]

My favorite way to drink it right now is to throw in a packet of Splenda and a little bit of Organic Valley chocolate soy milk, though it's good without sweetener or creamer.  It's chocolaty, with a hint of coconut.  I highly recommend for anyone who likes coffee (it's not a weak coffee, like most of the flavored kcups I've tried).  Also, Amazon's price for Timothy's is the best I can find, subscribe and save price comes out to around $0.37 a cup.  Enjoy!!

column9: Good Coffee Good Price  No Waste
column10: Timothy's Colombian Decaffeinated is a good tasting coffee for a good price.  The savings are even better if you sign up for the auto renew program.  Also, we have found that you can use each cup twice.  Therefore it's like getting twice the quantity for the money.  I checked with the Keurig company and they said by processing the cups for two cups of coffee or tea will not hurt the machine.  Best, Al

I bought a Keurig coffee maker for Christmas this year. We all enjoy different coffees in our household and making a pot of any type coffee is a waste. My husband is an espresso drinker, so I purchased Timothy's World Extra Bold Rainforest Espresso coffee to be made with the small setting on the coffee maker which uses 5.25 oz water. This makes it stronger, and he really has enjoyed this coffee. I really recommend this to anyone who enjoys a bold espresso coffee. He was born and raised in Italy and has purchased his coffee grounds from Italy for years to make an authentic cup of espresso. He is fussy about his espresso, so if he likes this one, it must be good.

Thanks to our purchase of a Keurig, I am a converted coffee drinker. Timothy's German Chocolate Cake is my absolute favorite. A delectable blend of warm caramel and coconut gives this coffee a deliciously sweet note while retaining a medium-bodied blend. It isn't too sugary - it's just right! In fact, my hubby and his coworkers all claim this as their number one flavored coffee too. It is scrumptious.

I currently use Coffee People's version of Donut Shop and when I saw Timothy's version I wanted to give it a try. This is not as full body as Coffee People's version but I really like the smooth low acidity taste. If you don't want a bold rich flavor I think you will love this smooth great tasting coffee as much as I do.

column9: Need to brew small cup size.  Check the price!
column10: I have been getting the Coffee People Extra Bold Donut Shop K-Cups but I used to buy and enjoy some of the Timothy's coffees too so I thought I'd try this.  Our family are Dunkin Donut coffee fans.  We even fill the my k-cup with preground DD coffee occasionally.  I found the Timothy's Donut Blend to be very bland, almost watery.  I have the Keurig that allows 4 sizes of cups to be brewed.  I usually brew on the 3rd largest size.  I decided to try this coffee with a smaller cup and it was better, but I wish it worked well at the larger sizes.This probably explains the discrepancies in the reviews.  Those who can only brew (or choose to brew) smaller sizes probably like this coffee.Make sure you check the price before you buy.  Click more buying choices to get to Amazon's price which is almost half the price of Liquid Nation's and it is eligible for prime.  Why doesn't that show up as a default?

column9: If you prefer a smooth cup of coffee
column10: I purchased this item after reading through the reviews on Amazon.  I have to say that I haven't been disappointed. The cups contain a blend of arabica and kona coffee.  They brew with a nice aroma and color.  I would describe them as a medium roast with a medium strength.  Depending on your mood you can adjust the strength by adjusting the cup size and changing your creamer.  I've had success using whole milk, half and half, and light cream, with light cream being the best in my opinion.  The taste is mellow and very smooth.  I have read other reviews here that have described them as weak or tasteless.  This is simply not the case.  I would compare it to the coffee from Dunkin Donuts.  If you prefer your coffee extra bold, dark roasted, or strong (Starbucks) then you are just not going to be happy with these.  Also, if you prefer to "double brew" your cups to get the most for your money, you will be very disappointed.  These will brew a delicious cup of coffee, but only if you use them as directed.  Finally I have to say that Amazon is the best place to buy these.  They have the best prices and fast shipping.  Add this to your subscribe and save to get 15% extra off.

For those who like a bit more flavor than the soft breakfast blends -- this is the best of the bunch.  I have worked through most brand "bolds" and come back to this one every time.  Black Tiger is similar but does not have some of the added flavor notes found here.

These sausages are very good, but they are not the Nurnberger style I had when I lived in Nurnberg and ate many many times at the schnellimbiss stands.  This version is much larger and more of a regular, off white brat.  My search continues...

When you send a gift of Bratwurst to friends and family who live in Wisconsin, it must be of the highest quality.  That's why I chose to send Nurnberger Bratwurst to my two brothers for Christmas gifts for each of the past two years.  I have never had such a great response; they loved the Nurnberger Bratwurst. The gift was a real crowd pleaser at their home!

If you love the bratwurst stands @ the train stations in Germany, you are going to LOVE the Nurberger Brats. I have tried a bunch of brats from the local grocery stores but they don't taste the same as what you get in Germany.This was the first food purchase via Amazon and was really happy with the quality and reliability of Wisconsinmade. They even emailed me to let me know they were delaying shipment so it wouldn't get caught in transit over the weekend.

There are plenty of imitators but none will ever match the quality or flavor of the Nurnberger Bratwurst.  An ideal gift for the palate that craves something beyond the bland bratwursts that are typically manufactured.
these are very good and authentic nurnberger type sausages. as many people know ,what is referred to as a "brat" in the US has absolutly nothing to do with german bratwurst.

I ordered the bratwurst (german style orginals) for a gift for my husband.  He has been a quest for "good bratwurst" for sometime now.  Personally, I have never cared for bratwurst and the sampling we did only confirmed to me that I didn't care for it.  My husband kept telling me it was because I have never had "good brats".  Well....now I have.  Your bratwurst is excellent.  Not too salty or over done on the spices and fillers.  Husband is very very pleased with the product and has pronounced that yours is "good brats".Will have to try some of your other products in the future.Sincerely,Sherry Bullard-BlanchardCoeur d Alene Idaho
Those sausages even not being Nuernbergers but Fraenkische bratwursts by shape and seasoning are delicious and will remain on my shopping list.

column9: A little bit of Bavaria right here at home.
column10: This is the second order of Nuremburg Brats I have placed with this company.  I was stationed in Bamberg, Germany for 4 years back in the '70s and have never been able to find true Bavarian Brats until now.  They are exactly as I remembered them and they crisp up so nicely with the natural casings.  Well worth the money.

I opened one can and could not eat it.Gave a can to a few friends and they said the same thing.I'm giving the rest of the case to the food bank.The food was not spoiled just way away from all the stuffed cabbage rollsI have ever had in the u.s.The product is from Turkey

If you're planning on eating this stuffed cabbage leaves, you had better, I mean: had better, be prepared for major, major gas emission bout! .... Be prepared, otherwise leave civilization for a while..... Believe me; civilization would not miss you until you have sufficiently recovered!

Disappointingly, this is IMITATION Almond Extract and a terrible value.  The $0.65/oz price is also quite deceiving and misleading.  That fact that this is an imitation product was not made clear in the description.  I bought this only because I needed a filler item to reach my free shipping, but will not make that mistake again.Comparatively, [...] currently is selling top quality 100% Pure Almond Extract for only $6.69/4 oz. It's disappointing when you pay for something that you don't get. And I am from the Caribbean, so it does not benefit me to send it back.Amazon, you should also have a symbol for negative rating. Why should it get even ONE star! PISSED OFF!!!!!!
As stated by the previous review, it is awful.  Spend a little more and get the Almond Extract, not this imitation flavoring.  Very disappointed.

My dog knows where I keep these. When ever I get near the bag, he is the most attentive boy I've seen. Keeps him occupied for a very long time and I'm happy it's good for him. Delivery was prompt from the seller. I'm going to be a repeat customer.

Slow Food Italy has declared the Saffron from Navelli a rare treasure to be protected."Production of DOP Navelli saffron demands an extraordinary degree of attention and dedication. This is immediately obvious when you consider that both harvesting and production, as undertaken by the Altopiano Cooperative of Navelli, is done by hand. It takes around two hundred thousand flowers to yield about two pounds  of saffron stamens.The saffron is obtained and then the stigmas from the flower of the Crocus Sativus are dired. This plant is traditionally grown on the  Navelli plateau (wedged between the parks of the Gran Sasso and the Velino Sirente) and Subequana Valley, where the ideal habitat of dry and windy climate and with soil that is very permeable (excessive moisture would rot the plant).Harvesting is done manually in the early hours of the morning, when the corolla is still closed. Cut flowers are collected in wicker baskets and open with  fingernails one by one, separating the stigmas from the stylus.  Afterwards they place the pistils in a sieve that hangs on the hot ashes of the fireplace. The roasting must be slow and uneven. Then it is  enclosed in bags and when dry, in small jars." Translated from the Italian on the Slow Food Foundation for Biodiversity, Ark of Taste

column9: Community Coffee Private Reserve Whole Bean
column10: We absolutely love the taste of this coffee. It is a full bodied coffee and smells as good as it tastes. We highly recommend this coffee if you like a french roast coffee. This is absolutely the best french roast coffee we have ever purchased.

column9: Great product, but bag difficult to reseal.
column10: These are great for cooking, but they make an excellent, healthy snack, too. My only complaint about this particular brand is that the "resealable" bag is extremely difficult to reseal. I buy them regularly at Sam's Club for only $10.98 per 3lb. bag.

column9: WOW, SIMPLE & SWEET...IMAGINE YOU ARE ON THE BEACH.
column10: This kit is true to word...simple. For the price it is too good to pass up, especially if you are looking for a quick and easy wine to help fill the gap while you are waiting for your other wines to age!  Definitely will try some other varieties, maybe the Pear Chardonnay next.
If you like coconut, you will LOVE this wine. It tastes like a Pena coilida, everyone LOVES THIS ONE!! YOU WON'T BE DISAPOINTED.

You can't go wrong with these kits. This is my third Cornucopia kit and all 3 have been stellar. We added 2 lbs of dextrose to the primary and aged it for 2 months. The coconut flavor was not overbearing and made for an excellent wine. It is a favorite amongst my family and friends.

This was our first time doing our own wine kit.  My husband learned to make the wine kits with a friend but they used a different brand.  I mainly shop at Amazon and with the prime membership you can't go wrong on these Cornucopia kits.  They included the wine making kit itself plus the corks, labels and wine wraps for the tops of the bottles.Making the wine ourselves was easy and fun.  I really enjoyed it.The Coconut Frascati is light, fruity and tasty.  Different from the average wine.  I love it!  2nd kit is already in the fermenter.  This time we're making the Red Blackberry Zinfandel.  Can't wait to try that one!

I made this at an sg starting at 1.064 allowing for about an a 6%-8% abv at the end. I didnt add sweetener, but just made it to about 5 1/4 gal to start, ending w about a 5 gal carboy and a liter left over after 2 total rackings and final addition of the f-pack. The stuff fermented and crystal-cleared, in NO kidding, 8 days total- box to bottle.... dunno what that was about, but talk about fast!!! I was shocked- coulda been the two Tbsp yeast nutrient after the first day? At any rate, this has a dessert wine sweetness but the coconut essence is complex, not cloying at all. Maybe it was the concentrated 5 vs 6 gal i did, but the heft and impression is just like ice wine. I love ice wine (and importantly, i love coconut), so for me this is a great thing. I brought some to my co-worker who told me he had expected to try 1/2 a glass and throw the rest away (nice confidence level!!), but that he drank the whole bottle by himself in that one sitting. He wanted more. My husband, who doesnt drink much, has been drinking a glass every night, and also asking for me to make more. This stuff is surprisingly good, and at the three week mark, is, in my husband's words, "exceptional." I figure he's actually mocking me in my attempts at homebrewing, but he is drinking it, after all! I'm pretty much patting myself on the back and thinking about the 13 bottles remaining, w repeated requests for more from friends and family, not being nearly enough.  :) im going to try this company's other wines. Awesome.Update: some people who only like dry, "serious" wines do not like this wine, and some have said that it can't even be considered wine. I say, enjoy life more! Heh- but it's pretty much love or hate. One big detractor told me he thought it tasted like suntan lotion smells. And this is...bad? I Love a Big inky deep cab just like the next gal, but that's apples and ...coconuts -- think--easy drinking like a wine cocktail or Sangria. This wine is fab for mixing with fruits or seltzer, although i like it neat. :)

We were so excited  to make this wine for summer parties. We were very disappointed to have it arrive damaged with liquid leaking through the packaging.  Needless to say we were not comfortable making it due to the possibility of bacteria issues.  We contacted Amazon and were very pleased with the way the issue was handled, they resolved it quickly.  We have ordered wine kits through Amazon in the past and will not hesitate to do so again, this was likely just one of those things that happens sometimes during shipping.

I just finished my first batch of the coconut and used this to make white sangria.  A bottle of this, a bottle of a drier white, club soda, rum (or flavored rum) and fruit (I used mango and frozen peach slices) and had a HUGE hit on my hands.  This stuff is going to go down like water on the deck after the beach this summer.  I'm back for another kit to make sure I'm prepared!  The actual instructions are super easy to follow - virtually fool proof.

Bought this coconut wine kit thinking even if it had a small coconut taste it would be refreshing for the summer. Well to our surprize it is AMAZING with the full coconut taste. When you first take a sip the smell and your taste buds go wild....... LOVE,LOVE,LOVE this wine. Everyone that comes over our house ENJOYS a glass or two....... ordering another kit to have enough for the summer, you will not be dissappointed with the wine.........ENJOY......

This review is based on my wife's comments, not mine. I don't like anything coconut and only made it because she wanted to give it a try. Those that like coconut are very pleased with the way this turned out. If you like coconut, I'm sure you will enjoy this.

column9: Great Coconut Taste in a Wine
column10: If you like coconut, you will love this wine.  It has a definite fragrance of coconut and all coconut lovers will like it.

Easy to order, easy to make, tasted wonderful even right after I bottled.  My brother, who does not like white wines and considers himself a wine snob LOVED it.  A good addition to anyones collection!
Amazing coconut flavor and very easy to make! This was the 5th flavor I've made and all came out better then expected.

Based on reviews, and the fact that I have NOT loved any of the many Timothy coffees I've tried (but I keep trying b/c of the fab prices here!), I was not expecting to like this at all. But I love Bailey's Irish Cream so I ordered a single k-cup of this flavor (from another website). What a lovely surprise! It really does taste like it has a shot of Bailey's in it, and the coffee underneath is quite tasty as well, at least, it doesn't get in the way of the Bailey's taste! I will be ordering the 2 box pack from here!

We enjoy a cup of coffee with Bailey's Irish Cream.  We decided to try this Irish Cream flavored coffee.  In our opinion, it seems to have a bitter taste and smell.  This is one of our LEAST favorites.

column9: Best cup of coffee I ever had!
column10: Absolutely the best cup of flavored coffee I've ever had! And the aroma! My house never smelled so good. I'm putting it on a subscribe and safe auto delivery! Yummmm!!!

I like to add a little Irish cream, like Bailey's to flavor my coffee, but did not want the alcohol, so I ordered this.  I found it to be awful.  It was bitter, and even adding cream could not hide the taste.  My wife said the same.  I've got 1 full plus 1 almost full boxes to go out with the garbage, I would not give this to a friend.I now just add a little irish cream flavored Coffee Mate (found in large bottle at local restaurant supply house) and a small amount of chocolate syrup to Timothys Kona Blend.  Its much better but not great.

This was the first and only flavor I have ever bought from Timothy's. This flavor was so ungodly undrinkable that I threw the remainder away and will never risk buying anything from Timothy's line. If Timothy's has the courage to sell this swill, they can't have any taste buds.

I LOVE THIS BRAND BUT HATE THIS FLAVOR. THE SMELL AND TAST OF IRISH CREAM OVER POWERS THE COFFEE. NOT FOR BREAKFAST NOT VERY SMOOTH EITHER. NOT MY FAVORITE, THE MOCHA JAVA IS GREAT NOT TO MUCH MOCHA JUST A SMOOTH CUP OF COFEE.

I bought this as a Christmas gift for my dad.  But, I also bought it last year and he loved it so I bought it again this year.  He loves Irish Cream and they can't find it in the store anywhere so I come to Amazaon every year to buy it for Christmas.

column9: A Great Substitute for the Real Thing
column10: This coffee actually smells and tastes like it has a shot of Bailey's.  I like drinking it with a bit of artificial sweetener and whipped cream.  Both bring out the taste.  This K-cup has a flavor unlike any other k-cup.  Try it if you like Bailey's and are looking for a unique coffee.

I love the flavor of this coffee. The only drawback is that you can't set it for the largest cup if you want a good strong flavored coffee because it will taste "watered-down." Still, I have purchased this flavor more than once so I really do enjoy the flavor.

Coffee has a real bitter taste, I bought 2 boxes of these and haven't finished 1 yet and I purchased these a couple of months ago. I am a regular coffee drinker and always trying different brands and flavors.

I think this is the most accurate "Irish Cream" flavor available. I imagine it tastes chemically and bitter without cream and/or sweeteners, but that's how most flavored coffees are. My guess is they were trying to compensate for that alcohol zing, so people expecting something like a french vanilla sweetness are going to be disappointed. Adding Bailey's to your coffee instantly makes it creamy and sweet - if you're looking for that experience, it's not gonna happen with black coffee. I brew my coffee on the largest keurig setting, this is a fairly strong flavor/brew even then, so it may be a bit much on a smaller cup setting. We went through it fairly quick and I'm ordering more now.

First off, I Love Timothy's Coffees. Especially the Kona Blend & the Colombian. I drink my coffees black so the Irish Creme is a little too weak for me. I like to brew my coffees on the largest size setting for cost effectiveness. When it's brewed on the middle size setting it's fine. It does have a nice flavor, just not a favorite.

First, let me say that this is one of my wife's favorite coffees.  That having been said, I cannot begin to understand why.  I can't even stand the smell of it brewing, and I like Irish Cream flavored coffee.Bottom line, I guess you'll just have to try it for yourself.  I would suggest trying to find a smaller amount somewhere before you commit to 50 cups.If Gloria Jean ever starts selling Irish Creme K-cups again, Timothy's version will die off very quickly, because it can't begin to compare with Gloria's.

Like one other reviewer, I was looking for the "Bailey's Irish Cream" coffee experience.Timothy's World Irish Cream left me "bitterly" disappointed.It was so unpleasant that I threw away the entire box after the initial trial.I've tried other TW products, and they were OK, so will not give up on the brand entirely.

I didn't care for the aroma of Timothy's Irish Cream. It's just been sitting there because no one in our household seems to like it. My husband had the brilliant idea of mixing it with a Hot Cocoa k-cup and it tasted like an irish cream mocha from a coffee house.So great if you mix with a hot chocolate k-cup, not so great on its own.
This coffee was purchased for my husband who enjoys some flavored coffees.  This is one of his favorites.  The aroma is very nice and he says the taste is very smooth.

column9: Nice aroma, but weak, watery coffee - Not so bad after all!
column10: 8/21/10 I'd like to update my review of late last year.  I found out that the weak coffee  wasn't the fault of the K-cups after all, but a malfunction at the time with my Keurig.  Tried it again after that issue was solved, and, I do like it after all.  Might even re-order it. :)  I like the aroma, not convinced that it really has an Irish Creme "taste".  Changing from 1 to 3 stars.  Will update you later.Earlier review: Nice aroma, but weak, watery coffee.This flavor Not recommended.  BTW, I do love the Timothy's Cinnamon Pastry and some other Timothy's flavors, but not this one. Very disappointed, and, unfortunately grocery products not returnable.

column9: A great way to start the day!
column10: I've had my Keurig for about 6 months and I have become hooked on this flavor.  I love several of the flavors but this is my favorite.  I start every day with one and sometimes two cups.When I planned an 18-day RV trip, I had to get a smaller Keurig so I could take it - and my Irish Cream with me!

This coffee is delicious, and even better, since it is already irish cream flavored, I don't need to add the extra calories from the irish cream creamers.  Its a nice way to wake up in the morning, and very well-priced for my budget.  Look forward to trying other Timothy's flavors, though I wish they had a "Variety Pack", or that you could "Make Your Own Variety Pack".

We've had our Keurig for over a year now and the novelty has about worn off.  I've tried many, many flavors of Timothy's, Gloria Jean's and Green Mountain but non have a hearty taste.  I just purchased a double box of Emeril's and that is an improvement.

Coffee is absolutely delicious!  And what a bargain these K-cups are compared to the prices in stores.  The subscription series to it is great--you don't have to use gas to get to a store that sells K-cups (in my case, it's about a 20 mile round trip to the nearest store that sells K-cups)--the coffee just comes to you.  The convenience of changing the subscription to match plans (such as vacations or whatever) is great.  Highly recommended for anyone who has a Keurig machine.

I absolutely love irish cream coffee from any cafe I've ever gone to. So naturally when I got my keurig a couple months ago, I tried this one out since it was a great price. I guess there is a reason Timothys is cheaper!! This coffee has a nice Irish cream smell, but the taste is weak and bland. The rest of their coffee is nothing special either.

I love Timothy's coffee pods, so when I bought a Keurig, naturally I bought Timothy's.  I bought two flavored coffees but they are way too bold and strong for a morning coffee drinker.  I am now trying Gloria Jean, Emeril and Caribou, looking for a pleasant morning cup.  I may consider opening up the K-cups to see if I can dump the contents into a toddy maker, I hate to toss these, but find them unpleasantly harsh.

I come to amazon for the cheap price - buying this from the coffee websites costs more.  Timothy's is my mom's favorite so I bought one of each twin-25 pack.  She loves all of them so I guess these are good.  We like Green Mountain (better than tim's) but there was a nice deal of 10 off if u spend 40+.  I dont know if it is still going on but if it is, it makes the k-cups ridiculously cheaper than anywhere else.  Hope this helps!!  P.S. we do sweeten this with coordinating creamers from international delight and coffee-mate.  :)

Picked up a box of Fryin' Magic at my local Kroger store for less than $2.00 and found it to be an incredible value.I've only tried this on chicken tenders so far, but I suspect it will also be a great choice for catfish nuggets.I like cornmeal breading and the mixture of cornmeal with multiple varieties of flour combines for a very pleasing texture and a coating that adheres well to the meat being fried. The mix of seasonings contained in the product is nearly spot-on perfect for my tastes, too, although the second time I used it I tried adding a touch of cajun seasoning and some fresh-ground black pepper to give it just a tiny bit more kick.If you enjoy McCormick's fried chicken seasoning, this product has a similar flavor (although not quite as strong).The only downside to this product is it does contain monosodium glutamate, so you may want to avoid it if you're sensitive to MSG or suspect you may be.
