It came in a card board box wrapped tightly within three layers of bubble wrap. It really looks like you would have to take a sledge hammer to it, if you wanted to break these jars....

I love this mustard. It has a kick that goes well with almost any sandwich. My only complaint is that I wish instead coming in six tiny bottles that it came in 2 regular size bottles. It is a pain to get that last little bit out of the jar.

A totally wonderful product!  The flavor is incredible, and will make a hot-dog a "dining experience" not to be forgotten.  It's more than wonderful on corned beef or pastrami as well, or anything else you would use mustard on.  Would probably be great in other dishes, but I was too frugal to use in my potato salad.  We were served this in a restaurant in South Carolina, and told it could only be ordered on-line.  One complaint - wish it came in a larger jar!

column9: Harder to Find in the States Than You Think
column10: An English friend sent Colman's Prepared Mustard to me as a gift and I fell in love with the stuff. He sent it in a tube which is really cool and very handy, but you can't find the tubes anywhere in the U.S. Last visit to England I brought home ten tubes. The customs lady gave me an odd look. Anyway, I can't find the stuff in the supermarket so I order it from Amazon. There are no substitutes for this mustard. I can't eat roast beef without it. Sure, it burns a little, but it's all a part of that pleasure/pain thing most of us don't like to talk about.

This is a great deal on Coleman's. The mustard is very mustard-y and super spicy. It is almost similar to Asian hot mustard heatwise, but with such a better flavor. It blows any regular mustard out of the water.

column9: Colman's Mustard at a great price!
column10: Finally, Colman's mustard sold in the US for a reasonable price! With the subscription service, this is the best mustard in the world for only a little more than your standard grocery mustard. Without it, the six-pack is still reasonably priced- especially compared with ebay and other places where jars are sold for $6 each.This mustard has a nice kick to it and will make anything you eat better.

I love this mustard and was unable to find it in my area. I found it here, on Amazon, ordered and it arrived in no time ! ! ! It ain't cheap, but boy is it good.  A little goes along way. It has a tiny kick to it.

column9: great mustard, a steal at this price
column10: Colemans mustard is one of the items of a supermarket shelf you love but cringe at paying 5 to 6 bucks a bottle.I got a 5 pack for 12 bucks, so average is 2.50/bottle. Great value if you order the right amounts and get free shipping.Only mustard I like more is Philippes french dip famous L.A. store mustard.Very spicy, goes great on hot dogs and sliced meats, like tri-tip and prime rib, or roast beef/deli sandwiches (yum)If your nose is clogged take a whiff of this for relief!

Before Colman's Mustard, I was a mustard wimp. If you are used to eating mainly French's mustard or another mild brand, take it easy on the Colman's the first time you try it. It has a hot kick that I wasn't expecting, and it really cleared up my nasal cavity! It takes sandwiches from boring to zingy. I also love it on veggie dogs, and it's also good as an ingredient to add a little som'n som'n to savory recipes. See ya, French's.

I love this stuff!  It's hot, but not too hot, and it has a great flavor.  I love it on ham (baked or sandwich), liverwurst, hot dogs/hamburgers on the grill. It's the Best on bratwurst (with chopped onion)! Used to be a specialty store in my area that carried it, then they stopped.  Glad I could find it on Amazon.  But don't buy just one bottle - the shipping is a bit costly and it goes fast.  Buying a six-pack gets the per bottle cost down and gives me a year's supply (hey, I'm worth it).  And it's too good to give away - get your own bottle is what I always say!

My husband is from the UK (No.Ireland) and this is the only mustard he will eat.  It is sometimes difficult to find in regular grocery stores and can be expensive if I can find it.  This purchase will keep him in mustard for quite a while and at a price we can afford!

column9: One ingredient if you buy the powder...
column10: Mom and dad have been making mustard from Colman's fer decades! One key ingredient when mixing, if you care fer it, is whiskey. Yes, whiskey. You won't get drunk, but yer sinuses will clear immediately. lol The taste is great, as it always has been. I hope to find out the rest of the recipe from my mom soon, but she likes to go by taste. I hope she isn't drinking, she's 83 years old now.  lol Enjoy the mustard....when possible, I hope to get some soon.  I still have 3 cans left!  :)
This stuff is AMAZING!!  Very sharp, tastes great on everything.  Just wish I could find it in a larger jar!

This is a power mustard, for sure. It has a horseradish kick to it, but obviously has no horseradish in it. I HATE horseradish, so it's going to take some getting used to. I'll still give it 5 stars, though, because it delivers on every front.
this product has a kick to it which you cant usually findwith other hot mustard brands but pay attention the jars are very small
Colman's mustard is simply the best. and this price is fare for a pack of 6. This may only last us a month though, I don't know.

If you are looking for a nice, HOT mustard, this is it.  We had it at an Irish Pub in Carlsbad, CA and liked it so much that we looked for it upon our return to Phoenix.  Bought this from Amazon, but have since found it at several stores around here.  If you like pretty strong horseradish and want a "kick" from your mustard, I think you'll be satisfied with this.

This is not a wimpy yellow mustard.  It has a kick!  If you want plain-old-yellow-mustard, buy a generic bottle from the grocery store.  If you want a mustard with a bit of a zing (like a little wasabi on sushi), then give Coleman's a try.  Beautiful color, wonderful flavor, and smooth consistency. Highly recommended.

column9: Brilliant Flavor that I have not otherwise been able to find
column10: I could not find this specific product at the store but it has a truly unique flavor that any mustard lover should try.  I like to switch around for variety and this is one of the ones I like to have regularly

column9: This is very similar to Karashi, Japanese mustard!
column10: I love British groceries so I decided to try this mustard after reading many fav reviews. I was surprised how it is similar to Japanese "Karashi" or mustard! It has the same kick to it, and I could not tell the difference between! I know Japan got a lot of influence from the UK more than the US in the past, especially in terms of adapting westernized dishes. BUT, I never thought, this is to be just like "Karashi"! This is for those who can stand the heat. This mustard makes regular yellow mustard so lame (no offence!!) Love it!

I've been using Colman's mustard ever since I spent a month in Ireland and the UK on business. The UK food was basically inedible, even the steaks, until I started slathering on the Colman's. Makes all the difference - the mustard has a horseradish type kick thats addicting. I've stopped asking for Colman's at US restaurants - they think I'm weird, but I definitely keep a supply at home. Its great on all meats and poultry, even vegetables. There's not many foods I won't put it on. Thank you Britain for this major contribution to the culinary arts.

Colman's mustard has a flavor like no other mustard that I have tried. First tried it at an Irish Pub outside Las Vegas last year and thought WOW!!!  Colman's mustard is hard to find in our area so I checked online and found it on Amazon ... I just had to buy some.  (Tastes great on bologna or corned beef sandwiches!)

It doesn't taste as spicy as the jar that a friend recently brought back from England.  Regardless, the mustard Amazon shipped is good and at a good price.  However, when I'm done with these jars I'm going to get Colman's Dry Mustard Powder 16 oz instead.  It will keep longer and is a more general cooking ingredient.

A bit of a horseradish-like nose hair on fire kick disappates on the finish.  I like a wide variety of mustards and use this with the meats I think it goes well with.  The maximum rating of 5 stars seems a little high, as if it couldn't possibly be a better tasting mustard.  Four stars is about right.
This mustard is not the same as the same-named Colman's Mustard in the store.  It appears to be watered down and diluted.  Does not last as long as a result and has a different taste.  Disappointing.

column4: Bartok Kinski "A casual stroll through the lu...
column10: Colman's Original English Prepared Mustard is fine for Hessians, but for more pronounced flavors, I would recommend German Mustards, which are far superior in taste, in my opinion.Colman's Original English Prepared Mustard relies too much on spicy aftertaste, which gives you heartburn and nothing more.It's okay for some bloke who eats cheap bologna sandwiches, but if you're eating more refined sausages, get good old German Mustards!
My grandkids, who eat everything in sight, took one taste of this and won't eat it.  Still well within expiration date but tastes old.

Bad quality. The "all the natural" on the box is really misleading. When I received it, the outside of box was wet. Also, the cereal taste like it's expired. I know that the food cannot be returned, but it's one of the worst cereal that I've ever tasted.

If you are a sugar addict...I warn you: do NOT buy these. They are DELICIOUS....and addictive. I loved the light and crumbly texture. They are buttery and sugary and sweet:I bought 5 lbs.I ate 5 lbs.I am visiting them on my hips.I just returned from the gym.

column9: This is how caramels should taste!
column10: I used to buy caramels that tasted much like these when I lived in Europe.  I hadn't been able to find them here -- that is, until Amazon sent me samples of these.  They are light, buttery and amazing! My preference is for the original flavor, but I'm sure the honey variety will really please honey-lovers.  In a word: YUM!

column9: Each to his or her own.
column10: Amazon tried to hook me on these by sending me a free sample packet.  I'm not sold.  Caramel should have viscosity and chewishness (doesn't have to be kosher, though), which adds to the lasting and lingering pleasure of the experience.  These tasted artificial to me.  2 stars.  Unfortunately, I shared one with my wife, who proclaimed them light, bright, and divine, a 5-star delicacy at the very least.  So in the interest of a lasting and lingering marriage, I'm inflating my rating and ordering a bag.

CARAMOO is a delicious caramel fudge candy that has the look of a caramel and the texture of a crumbly fudge. The milk and butter make them creamy and delicious. The caramels are made in small batches and wrapped in cute Vienna-style wrappers. The honey and the original flavors are both delicious but if you like a sweeter flavor, then you might like the honey caramels. I think I like the original caramels best. They remind me of a vanilla fudge I used to buy overseas.~The Rebecca Review

If you ordered these expecting a smooth gooey American-style caramel experience, forget it. Other than the flavor, which is somewhat of a mellower butterscotchy vanilla cream, you will find these have the texture of crystalized fudge. They are a bit hard & crumbly at first, but soon melt into a sea of creamy delight. I laughed when I read one reviewer's comments about "ordering 5 pounds, and eating 5 pounds". I meant to send some to my sister but ended up gaining about 7 pounds in 2 weeks myself. I'll have to recommend them to Renee Zellweger for her next Bridget Jones adventure.My Russian grandmother used to get the real Polish version of these "krufki" which may mean "cow" since the Russian diminutive version of cow is "korovki" (there was a picture of a cow on the wrapper). If you are looking for those candies, these Caramoo's taste exactly the same. Thank goodness they still come in the traditional wrapper - the only thing that slows down the feeding frenzy. (Please don't tell my dentist!)

I, too, received a sample from Amazon... and it was simply amazing!  I highly recommend it.  Please note that this is the "original" flavor caramel.  I also received samples for the "honey" flavored ones and I did not like those nearly as much as these.

Yummy, yummy is all I can say about these caramels, 5 out of 6 in my family love them (hubby isn't a candy fan).  These aren't your traditional chewy caramel squares we are all used to ... If your up for a change in your creamy caramel, you'll be pleasantly pleased.  These are crumbly as their name states and don't stick to your teeth, makes it easy to power them down so be warned.

I bought these and got them yesterday.  It is pretty sweet so be warned. I think if you like fudge, you will like these.  It reminds me of the Scortish whiskey fudge candy that I had before.  I love how simple the ingredients are.  It is addictive.

column4: K. Soard "online shopping-the best way to shop"
column10: Nice flavor but sweeter than what I expected from a caramel. Sweet as a piece of fudge. Serving size is 4 pieces [150 calories]. So sweet I can only eat 2 pieces. Which is good for me--I won't finish the bag in 2-3 days! Think I'll share it at work.

If you are looking for krewki, look no further.  No, these aren't "little cow candies", but they are the closest I have had in years.  My Polish mother proclaims them to be perfect.  Price wise, they are about on par with ordering from one of the European importers.  Use Amazon's Subscribe and Save to get a good deal and keep these sweet treats coming on a regular basis!  I ordered a bag to send to my husband in Afghanistan...we'll see if they actually get there.

column9: Could they be more addictive?  Yum!
column10: These are soft and dissolve easily as you chew, unlike a traditional chewy caramel. That makes them better, for me.  Alas, that also makes it easy to eat them by the handful.  They are too tasty to resist: I'm ordering more.
I used to get these many years ago when living in Italy.  I was excited when I found them on Amazon.  They are as good as I remembered.Unique and unmatched.

I keep a bag of these caramels at my desk for a quick treat after lunch or as an afternoon treat. They have an incredibly creamy flavor yet the texture is unexpectedly crumbly. I've found that most people are very polarized by these little candies as they either love or hate them. You can count me among the former.

The reviewer who said these were similar to vanilla fudge got it right. If you are old enough to remember it, I think they also taste a bit like penuche. Two is plenty for a serving, they're very buttery and sweet and crumbley. These are not like traditional caramels- I wouldn't try to make caramel apples with them. They aren't that sort of caramel- they're more like a hard fudge texture.My roommate said he hated them but I had SO MANY of them in the bag that I decided to put some of them in the food processor with some graham crackers and make a pie crust with them. I made a butterscotch pudding pie with the crust and it was roll your eyes over good. My roommate loved the pie and commented on the great pie crust. So I think some of the reason he didn't care for them was his expectation that they'd be like a Kraft caramel or like a butter toffee and they are actually both and neither.So- don't expect toffee or a chewey caramel with these. I think they're awesome.

This is a wonderful carmel candy.  I now know why it was the best selling carmel candy from Amazon customers.  Melts in your mouth and has a great after taste.  It is very soft and not the usual gummy variety of carmel, which I like as well.
This is what happens when you make caramels and they flop.  I paid $17 for a 2pound bag, and couldn't even GIVE them away.

I just received my caramels.  When I opened the package, one of the bags was ripped, so I tried one of the caramels.  It was hard, and seemed stale. I looked at package and it was dated  Aug.31,2006..outdated.  I contacted Caramoo and told them they were selling old candy..and I received an email back explaining that they had dated the packages wrong, and it should be 2007.  However,  if the candy bag gets ripped, the candy will get hard and stale quickly.  This is what happened to mine.  I am returning mine because of the ripped packaging.  Caramoo suggested that you keep the candy in an air tight container..so  I am passing this info on to you all.  Hopefully they will improve there packaging.

column9: I have to disagree with the Rebecca Review
column10: I received a few of these in a sample pack sent to me by Amazon Grocery. All I can say is Bleeeecchh!Personally, I found the taste to horrible.  The texture reminded me of lighter, crumblier mellow mint(which I like).  Mellow Mint might be the wrong name. I do not see them to often.  They are wrapped in a green and silver wrapper if that sounds familiar.

I felt it necessary to update my original review :)Another birthday means another order for fortune cookies from Greenfire. This has become an annual tradition in our family. Our son picks a theme and the experts at Greenfire come up with awesome looking fortunes to give to his friends. I have also used the cookies as gifts for colleagues as well as clients and they think they not only look cool but they are yummy too. I love the fact that we get to be creative and different at a reasonable price. Perhaps even better than the actual cookies -- the staff at Greenfire. Always accommodating and easy to work with. I am not just a customer - I am a part of the team.Original review - January 27, 2010Wow!  I can't say enough not only about the product but the service received!  I spoke with Jen on the phone about a last minute idea I had for a gift I wanted to put together for some colleagues.  She not only made it happen but when there was a problem with the shipping (a result of a shipper error and NOT the vendor) she went above and beyond to help figure out a way to make it work.  The cookies were fresh and tasted great plus the actual fortunes were beautiflly designed.  I will be back to get more for personal use (my 5 year old sons birthday) and maybe even some for Valentine's Day.  Thank you so much.

Well Happy New Year. These fortunes are awesome. Everyone at work loved them and said how did you do that? It was so clever. I wrapped them in celophane and left them unsigned so they had to open the fortunes to see who they were from.  Joel was the only one who knew instantly that they were from me.  I am definitely doing it again next year with a whole new set of  "zoo" fortunes..for the rest of you... here are the 2009 top 10 favorites:#10  If animals were online...they would definitely "unfriend".#9  The name for an animal that does NOT flee, OR fight its enemy is called lunch.#8  Got crap? let me get you your Union card.#7  You will stop procrastinating tomorrow.#6  A Real fortune: Do not upset the penguin today.#5  Don't poke the bear or you'll get the claw.#4  "Don't approach a goat from the front, a horse from the back, or a fool from any side."#3  Make the best of today, the rest of the week is gonna suck.#2  Your future is simple: carrot, apple, yam.#1  ...there is one thing that separates us from animals. We aren't afraid of vacuum cleaners.Thanks Greenfire....til next year...

column9: Commenrative Fortune Cookies steal the show
column10: I found this company on the intranet and wanted to talk with a REAL person about a special request to create fortune cookies with special sayings about fighting cancer for a Relay for Life. We ended up getting 300 fortune cookies, were able to put the pink ribbon for breast cancer, 30 sayings (which Jen helped supply) and our team name Breast Friends.  The cookies arrived timely, it was a very easy process and they were absolutely delicious and a huge hit to the several hundred attending the relay.  I definitely recommend this company for a very special product and experience.

I'm a repeat customer. After the success I had with the first round of fortune cookies last year, I decided to order more cookies for the night of the Opening Ceremonies of the Olympics. A representative of Greenfire and I worked together and came up with 60 different Olympics-related fortunes and I ordered three pounds of them. My staff loved them. I brought them to a meeting at the start of the day, and we spent almost as much time reading the fortunes to each other as we spent working. After the meeting, I left them out for the staff go nibble away at, and by the end of the night, all three pounds were gone. I got a kick out of hearing my staff laughing at the fortunes we came up with. Two successful rounds of fortunes, and I plan on being back for a third round.
As one who frequently smokes with apple wood, (I own an apple orchard) I've got to say this stuff is great!  I generally use it as an additional liquid in marinades.

This product is exactly as advertised, it is much cheaper to buy it in a package of 12 from here than it does to buy it directly from the manufacturer.  Great buy especially if you grill as much as some people do.
This stuff is the best! It's better than a caffeinated drink! I'm sure that's the yerba mate in it. Nice energy boost, and it tastes great too!

This smoothie is absolutely delicious! I credit this drink to getting me through my mother's death and the death of my dog one day later. I drank one of these every day during that time and I got through the stress of handling my mother's estate without any stressor illnesses. Great stuff in my book.

OKAY HOW SHOULD I SAY THIS, IT DOES NOT TASTE LIKE CREAM CHEESE...IT HAS A WEIRD ALMOST CHEMICAL TASTE TO IT, I EVEN STORED IT IN THE FRIG TO KEEP IT FRESH, IT DID NOT HELP...THING IS I HAD USED IT BEFORE YEARS AGO AND I HAD THOUGHT IT WAS GREAT THEN...MAYBE I GOT A BAD BATCH OR MAYBE THEY CHANGED HOW IT BEING MADE NOW..I KNOW I WON'T BE BUYING IT AGAIN..............

column9: Best pistachios I ever had & most consistent
column10: I buy pistachios a LOT. When I say a lot, I mean about once a month or so. And as far as I'm concerned Keenan is the best. I get very few "bad ones" in the entire container, whether it's this one or the plastic bags I also buy. The saltiness is perfect, the size is perfect, and Keenan really knows how to sell in bulk. I just don't bother looking at other brand names, though I am sure they are fine. But another thing to note is that Keenan's tend to be cheapest per pound. I did all the math for all the brands here on Amazon and I just get the most for my money with these or the large 32-ounce bags.

I love pistachio nuts. So I tried these since the price was good and I am always looking for good products at low prices.I wasn't disappointed. Out of the two jars of nuts, there were less than 5 duds (dried out or bad tasting nuts.There were less than 25 nuts that were not split open so no need for a nut cracker.The rest were very good to excellent in taste, ease of opening shells and amount of salt on them.The only problem was, I couldn't stop eating them so they only lasted less than a week. 3 1/2 pounds of pistachios in less than a week. I sure will be buying them again, but will wait a couple of months and eat pistachio ice cream in the meanwhile.Jewel Foods now has their own pistachio ice cream that is better than Ben and Jerry's and only costs $2.99 a half gallon instead of $4.50 a pint for B&J's. Just as many WHOLE pistachios in the ice cream (unlike the ground up ones Hagen Das uses) and the ice cream itself is creamier and better tasting than B&J's.

I bought these for my brother in another state and accidentally had them shipped to me.  I am so glad that I did because then I had the opportunity to try them.  By the time I reordered some for him, they were out of stock.  They are in stock now, but will arrive after Christmas.  Great taste, quality. I have not found one bad one yet!

I heard the health benefits of eating pistachios so I purchased some from the local store.  Because of the expense, I began to look online for a better price.  I ran accross these and I must say they are great.  The cost is low.  The nuts are very lightly salted, fresh and approximately 98% are fully opened.  I will purchase them again.

column9: Great nuts, well packaged, price can be more competitive
column10: Great, well packaged product from Keenan Farms, liked it. Would definitely go with "subscribe & save" if Amazon sells them for less than Trader Joe's does. We buy pistachios from local Trader Joe's store, $6 for a 16oz bag - $0.38/oz i.e. can have it whenever we want for a slightly better price.

column9: So Delicious, It's Hard to Keep Myself From Eating Them All At Once!
column10: These pistachios are the real deal!  They are large nuts, and almost 100% of them are wide open, which makes them very easy to shell.  These nuts taste great and come in a sturdy plastic container with a screw-on top which will help keep them fresh during storage.There are no artificial ingredients or preservatives in these nuts and, as a big added bonus, they are grown and packaged in the USA.  The ingredient list only has two ingredients:  California pistachios (dry roasted) and sea salt.  Doesn't get more natural than that, right?They are so delicious that the biggest problem I have with them is keeping myself from eating a whole container of them in one sitting!
I love love love pistachios and the price was pretty decent on these but there are LOTS of rotten, or bitter pistachios.  ugh.

I've ordered Keenan Pistachios previously, but not this size package. I was a little disappointed this time. They didn't taste as fresh as I remember the earlier ones, and there were many for which I needed a nut cracker to open.

I've tried many different brands of pistachios, and I must say that Keenan Farms is the absolute best. They taste fresh and are bursting with flavor. I've eaten Wonderful pistachios many times, but I prefer these. They have a great crunch and the right amount of salt. The fact that they are roasted with sea salt and are naturally tree opened makes all the difference. The pistachios come in two large containers. I finished mine off in about 10 days, but they should last you a long while if you don't attack them like I did. There are a few empty shells in the container, but it's not so many that I'd get upset about. If you've been debating on buying these, just buy them! They're worth it.

GREAT FLAVOR ~ JUST A TOUCH OF SEA SALT [THE BEST KIND IF YOU'RE GOING TO EAT SALT AT ALL] WILL DEFINITELY ORDER AGAIN. NOW TO FIND A BABY NUTCRACKER TO OPEN THE FEW THAT DON'T CRACK OPEN ALL THE WAY!  :)

I have ordered these more than once and really enjoy them. They are a healthy snack and so enjoyable. Love the bottles too. I use them to store rice as the bottle is air tight and keeps rice very dry, I order the 2 pack. I like that. They use sea salt so they are not overly salted. I only give it a 4 because some of the nuts are harder to open, Some are open shells and empty but I find the shelled nuts still in the bottom. If some are harder to open just take a half shell and use that to pry it open. That works!
Received pistachios very quickly. They are so fresh and delicious. Will def order again. They are so much tastier than packages purchased at wholesale clubs.

a good deal and received them fresh. These don't expire until 2013. where i'm at these cost twice as much and aren't as fresh. I share them with co-workers and they love them. They have enough salt on them for my tastes. I like the plastic container for storage as well. The bags I usually get are a pain to seal and keep the nuts fresh. Out of one container I've had roughly ten nuts not cracked but no biggie. thanks to amazon for free shipping.

These pistachios are of excellent quality and very inexpensive as far as pistachios go. I have placed 4 orders of this item and undoubtedly will be buying more. Great item for anyone that loves pistachios.

Very good for the price and will probably be my new go-to pistacio until I find something better.I have to disagree with another review I have seen about the nuts. There are plenty that are un-openable without a nut cracker (so if you have one, don't even worry about this). There are also a decent amount that have that funky taste. Most of them taste fine and are easy to open, but they do not differ much from any other brand I have bought in those two ways.The main attraction here is the price for the amount. Most tiny bags in local supermarkets go for over $6 for a tiny package. It would take about 2 and a half (maybe 3) of those other brand's bags to make up just one jar of these.

Good pistachios at a very good price. The container is a lot better than a plastic bag for storage and keep the nuts fresh.The only complaint is that these are a bit salty. If you prefer unsalted or moderate salt you may want to look elsewhere.
These pistachios are salted just right and taste excellent.  They also come at a very reasonable price so I see myself ordering more in the future.

I love pistachios. After reading all the superlative reviews I was expecting a wonderful taste treat. The comments about  the nuts not being too heavily salted, almost all the nuts already open and the freshness of the nuts were right on. Unfortunately the pistachio flavor did not ring through.Quite disappointing as the preparation and long shelf life indicate the producer is a quality company.

This is the second time I have ordered these and both times they came quick and were fresh with a exp. date of Oct. 2012. These nuts are the biggest I have found so far and only a few are left unopened when I get to the bottom of the jug. I wish they would put these on auto delivery because I will be ordering these again.

This is a great product.  I am happy with the quality of the nut itself along with the seasonings.  The order came quick,  was well packaged, and has an expiration date that is a ways out (that was my biggest concern when ordering online).  This is definitely my go-to for a salty-sweet snack.
These were GOOD pistachios with few bad nuts but there were A LOT of unopened pistachios or very hard to open pistachios, I had 50+ unused pistachios from each container at least

Lightly salted, fresh and infinitely better than most grocery kinds. I highly recommend these pistachios, as other brands are way too salty for me. This has just the right amount without being bland. The pistachio taste rings true.
These are some great tasting Pistachios. Good size pistachio with a nice salt taste. I can't stop eating these. Also, very good price!
The keenan farms pistachio's were the best i,ve ever tasted not to much salt which i hate great tasteing i would buy them again. I love them and my family did to and i will buy them again.

column9: GREAT DELIVERY BUT PRODUCT QUALITY BELOW PAR
column10: I JUST RECEIVED MY ORDER FROM KEENAN FARMS AND I WAS EXCITED AND PLEASED ON HOW QUICKLY IT WAS DELIVERED.  BUT WHEN I TASTED A HANDFUL OF THE PISTACHIOS, THEY WERE HORRIBLE; ARE THEY OUT OF SEASON OR WHAT?  I LOVE THE PRODUCT BUT THIS TIME THEY STRUCK OUT.
I usually order the 32oz 3-pack, and per ounce this deal was the same so I tried it.  Same delicious product.  Hard to find a better deal.
Good tasting pistachios, but I had to throw away too many unopened or difficult to open nuts.I'll stick with the Wonderful brand.
These are plump, fresh pistachios with a very light saltiness.  Great for a midmorning or midafternoon snack. Very few unopened pistachios.

This brand is not available at my usual local market, so I am pleased to have found it on Amazon.The quality of this product has been superb and this brand has exceeded our expectations for freshness on every single delivery.  It has been well worth the price for the quality in a healthy snack that my family regularly enjoys.
I bought two jars and they were so good, that I am going to order at least two more especially now that football season has started.

These pistachios taste great.  They were extremely fresh and tasty and out of the 2 jars there were very very few that were not opened.  I would say maybe 10 at the most and probably not that many.  Will be a return customer for this American tasty and healthy treat!

I purchased these because pistachios where I live (SoCal) are overpriced. They are fresh and roasted perfectly. These aren't at all too salty or difficult to open. Even the ones with the smallest opening are easy to open with my nails. I will be buying these as often as I run out.

Was a gift for my dad, he loves Pistachios, so I figured a 2-pack would be perfect for him. And that was right on the mark. He loved them. I didn't get the chance to try them so there isn't a whole lot I can add to this, but he's pretty picky and it passed his test.

We eat a lot of pistachios and these are the best. Used to buy Wonderful (and other brands) but then found they are not USA, too many are not cracked and they are smallish.Keenan's, on the other hand, are large, open, perfectly salted with sea salt and grown in the USA. The price is not much different for the best. My family will only be buying Keenan's from now on.
We loved these pistachios which arived on time. My wife could hardly keep her hands off from it. I will strongly recommend
It is fresh, inexpensive, easy to store. I would recommend it and I will buy more when before we finish them.

Just as described and a great value for the price. The only thing I didn't like was that the nuts seemed to not be ripe yet but they were still pretty good. I prefer Everbody's Nuts Salt and Pepper, however these are a cheaper alternative. Definitely would recommend!

My dad love love LOVES these pistachios. Pistachios are one of his favorite foods and he says these are the best. I also enjoy these once and a while, too. I just wish pistachios (in general) were not so expensive. These seem  be a good value, nevertheless.

Keenan Farms pistachios are my favorite. Better than wonderful. Just the right amount of salt. They don't leave your hands feeling salty like the others. Only a few that weren't open. Some empty shells, but the nuts were at the bottom. Will keep ordering, because I've yet to find anything better, and they're a great price :)

I received these pistachios as a Christmas present. They are fantastic! I can't seem to stop eating them, and neither can anyone else in the family. My adult son had never tried pistachios before eating these, and now loves them, too. I will definitely be ordering more of these.
These are by far the best pistachios I have ever eaten!  They have the perfect amount of sea salt and taste!

I have been munching on these every other day and got a handful of duds.  There were more partially open that weren't great, but given the value of these, they're still pretty good.  will order more in future.

This is my heroin, my nicotine! I buy two of these jars every 3-4 weeks. This is a great value for 56 ounces of pistachios; that's 3.5 pounds, they are for the most part fresh and flavorful. The salt level is just about right, not too salty and tasty. I would say that 90-95% of them are good, the others are unopened and after opening most times empty so not worth almost breaking your teeth. (Empty also means almost weightless so you didn't pay for them...)A little tip, the best time to order them is just after Amazon ran out of stock, and replenished, very fresh then! Keep them in your cart to see this happening. This just happened end of NOV2011!
This pistachio is just great, with reasonable price and good taste. I will definitely buy more. The only drawback is that it has several empty shells.
good presentItem was given as a gift for birthday, she was very happy when opened.  Still has alot left.
Hubby loves nuts and I heard pistachio has the lowest calories in all nuts. We order this once a month.

Seriously folks, we have been buying Keenan Pistachio nuts from Amazon for years.  The price is fantastic, the nuts are fantastic and it makes us and our parrots feel fantastic.  I didn't want to write a review because I didn't want everyone to buy them all up!

Taste Good, I purchase these for the late night snacking, plus I like the shells because it slows down my eating habits, so you gotta work for your food when you crack open the shells each time lols. This is my first time purchasing these so I'm not sure if the price was fair or not for $24. Anyways I would recommend giving it a try, it beats going out late at night to grab a burger

These pistachios are exaclty as advertised. Fresh, great tasting, good size _ I am extremely please with my purchase. This is my new favorite pistachio brand!  The price was good too - I will be ordering Keenan Farms from now on!
Pros:Price is reasonable and comparable to most brands.Great quality!Great Taste!Very little unopened nuts.Cons:NONE!

column9: Best Pistachios I Have Ever Eaten
column10: These pistachios are the best I've ever eaten-- the perfect amount of salt, the perfect amount of roasting, easy to open-- they can't be beat!
Tasty and crunchy.  This is the best batch of these nuts I have ever eaten.  Get them while you can.

I'm a pistachio nut (very punny, haha).  I've tried virtually even brand of pistachio out there.  I've even had my own pistachio taste tests where I try three or four different types/brands at a time.  Keenan Farms is definitely one of my favorites.  They have a great flavor and a low unopened nut rate.  Far far better than Planters and noticeably better than Wonderful pistachios.  However, perhaps on par with nuts.com.

I LIKE PISTACHIOS AND FROM THE BEST PISTACHIO PRUDUCER AND EXPORTER I SHOULD SAY IT HAS COME A LONG WAY KEENAN PISTACHIOS ARE VERY GOOD I TASTED DIFFERENT KIND BUT I CHOOSE KEENAN FOR THE TASTE AND THE SIZE OF EACH ONE AND THE EASE OF OPENING EACH PISTACHIO.SINCE I ATE THE BEST OF ALL (RAFSANJANS) I GIVE IT 4 STAR AND AS OF NOW 5 STAR BELONGS TO RAFSANJAN TILL HOPEFULLY KEENAN TAKES THE PLACE OF RAFSANJANS.

The nut are fresh and a good value for the money, the reason I only gave them 3 stars is because their not very salty. Part of the enjoyment to me, when eating pistachio's is sucking the salt off the shell before I crack it open and eat the nut. If you don't care about this, it is a good value.

Go order the Kirkland Signature ones on Amazon.. here is the link http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B000RZNY5G/ref=ox_sc_act_title_1?ie=UTF8&m=A1V3U717S8VN5TI got these in the mail very fast.. when we started to enjoy them.. most if not all were nasty & oddly chewy. They almost tasted old. I was VERY disappointed in this purchase. One of the tubs went to total waste cause they were ALL BURNED! UGHH

column9: Good Quality - - Not the best price
column10: I had read several reviews prior to making my purchase of these pistachios so I was excited to try them. We were happy with the quality but then saw that the price was significantly higher than if we would have bought another high quality brand at Costco for a fraction of the price. Unfortunately I will not be purchasing these again. Too bad they are priced so much higher.

As a tea drinker, I did not think Carmel sounded like one I would like.  Boy, was I wrong.  This tea is fabulous and addicting.  What I love about all of Dilmahs teas is that you first taste the tea and then the flavor used.  I do also like that it is all natural flavoring.  Dilmah Carmel makes you feel like you have just had a nice treat with none of the guilt.  I will make sure my cabinet is stocked with this one.

***This Decaffeinated Earl Grey Tea from Stash is plain, and definitely not subtle because of a strong bergamot component---way too strong! If you really, really love bergamot you may like it, but I much prefer a more subtle and more complex tea. It tastes like perfumed black tea; I could hardly drink it. I am an Earl Grey fan, but just couldn't stomach this tea.On the plus side, it is naturally decaffeinated, which I appreciate. Also, it seems like the quality of the black tea is very good, though, because even with a longer brewing time, the tea did not become bitter...so, if you can stand being hit over the head with the bergamot flavor, you might enjoy it.Only recommended for those who want a strongly perfumed bergamot Decaf Earl Grey.***
I used the frooties as a part of a candy buffet for my friends baby shower and it worked out great. Bag was large enough that I was able to refill a medium/large size bowl two times.

We have enjoyed the flavor and the natural goodness of  Elma chewing gum.  Derived from the sap or gum of the Mastic tree that only grows on the Greek island of  Chios in the Mediterranean, this gum has a mild flavor and doesn't stick to my teeth.  My 9 year old son, Hunter, loves it too.

I wanted to chime in and say that i really enjoy this gumi am waiting for the restocking and wish i hadn't waited so long before reorderingthis is my 3rd reorderingi love the idea that this isn't sweetened by chemical like sugarsTry it you will be pleasantly suprised

This is a real convenience food  and one I have used for several years.  However it isn't easy to find in my rural area so I am glad to find it here at Amazon.  I use any regular Bisquick receipe with it and it all comes out great.
I wanted the reduced fat bisquick but was given the heart healthy instead.  I hate the heart healthy, the bisquits were aweful.  Hopefully the reduced fat taste better.

This product taste great, but it does not always bake as-well as the original Bisquick mix does. You can use just about any original bisquick recipe, by substituting the bisquick mix for the HeartSmart Bisquick mix. But there might be a slight texture change, I do not reccomend baking biscuits with this mix, they come out flat and a bit sweet tasting (strange enough) However Cinnamon Rolls and Pancakes taste very good with this mix, its not the orginal but its close and a healthier choice.

This is actually a pretty good tasting lower fat version of Bisquick. I like it a lot. But do miss the richer taste of the regular Bisquick. That being said, the health benefits make it a more appealing product to use.

I have one lab and one beagle and they liked these rawhides. They are a good thickness and kept them busy for awhile. My dogs are 12 and 13 years old and they had no problems or issues with this product as another reviewer has stated (maybe a bad batch?). They finished an entire bag and I just ordered another.
Bad product.  Gave to my 2 Labs & Beagle 3 times over 3 days.  All 3 dogs threw up each time.  Trashed the rest of the bag.

I've ordered this product twice now the first time was as good as you can expect of mochi that has to travel. The second time they were stale and a few were burst open with filling everywhere. I reccomend just finding an adzuki bean seller and rice flour and just making your own.

I spend a period of time living, working and studying in Japan and now get Japanese food cravings.  I have always loved mochi and was looking for a place to soothe my cravings.But, I could barely choke these mochi down.  The rice cake part of the mochi is supposes to be soft and tender.  The ones in my package were extremely chewy and hard on the outside(especially the red/pink mochi).  The sweet bean on the inside was fine but the outside texture took away all my enjoyment.  I threw my package away after trying to eat two mochi (all the rest felt lumpy and hard too!).  What a waste of good money!It would be interesting though to know the packaging date and how long a package stays fresh.  The consistancy of mine seemed like it was past the "fresh" date.  That's sad because I have picked up packaged mochi in Asian markets in the U.S. that has been relatively fresh.  It can be done.
This mochi was tough and the filling was overly sweet, almost saccharine-like.  I have definitely had much better. I think im throwing the rest away.
This wasn't as soft as homemade mochi, but that was expected and it was very good nonetheless. I will be ordering again!

column4: Simply Aaronni ""It understood you just a...
column10: This is the perfect candy; not too sweet, not too bland! I love the consistency, the taste, and the bit size pieces! Buying some more rightttt...now.
These are very very small and taste really bad. The color of the cakes are really nasty. they look old and stale !!!They also arrived very late

I love red bean paste and I love mochi, so I couldn't resist getting this to try.  It is better than other store-bought mochi I've had.  They are a nice size (not very small) and are soft.  However if you want really good mochi, then you gotta find someone who'll make it fresh or make it yourself!

For a ball of rice paste full of bean mush, it's certainly much tastier than you'd think....  the red bean paste (which is the traditional filling for many japanese snacks) is very sweet and thick, almost like preserves... except, it's bean paste, so it has a slightly gritty texture that takes some getting used to.  they are pretty rich, so I don't think i'll be able to more than one in a sitting...

This is very good mochi - tastes exactly the way it should, in the best meaning of that! I am going to order one more pack.Mochi is not as terribly sweet as cupcakes and other sweets we used to have, it has amazing texture and a gentle, soft taste. A very healthy choice for sweets! Love it.

This was the first time I have eaten mochi and, at first, I didn't think much of it due to the fact American sweets are much richer, but I have to say that after eating two or three of them I got used to the flavour and came to love the texture! I have already ordered another batch because I finished mine! I am definately a mochi fan now. ^_^

this was my first time at trying mochi.... It isnt very sweet and i did expect sweeter.  I did not fine them to have a flavor and they are pretty big.  This would probably be good with tea, a snack alone to me wasnt the best thing...even if this was an okay experience this is still a very good Japanese candy that will stay on my mind.

A delicious treat that is a must if you are a lover of mochi.  The taste is similar to cotton candy, without being too sweet.  In terms of texture the outside is jelly-like while the inside has a more pasty texture.  A truely unique and tasty dessert.
These Mochi rice cakes are great. I would recommend putting them in the refrigerator first. From my experience they taste much better cold.

I bought these because I have never been to Japan, but I wanted to bring a little bit of Japan to me. They are good. They are not great. I am not sure why I didn't go 2 miles from my place and buy them in a store for half the price.

It is a very odd taste. Not bad. Just odd. One that you will probably have to get used to. I used to hate the taste of nori wraps but now I eat them as a snack. This is the same thing. Alot of getting used to with this.

These stew mixtures are great as a stew starter in a slow cooker. I add potatoes, carrots, mushrooms, canned black or kidney beans, canned tomatoes, and cut up chicken breast or fish fillets, plus some creamed condensed soup. Takes about an hour to prepare and 8-10 hours to cook. You'll have hearty stew for days, or freeze in individual containers for microwave reheating. Enjoy!

column9: Great honey in a great container!
column10: These little bears are great for dispensing honey without making a sticky mess. And the honey is high quality and great tasting! The price is fair and the little bear dispensers are reusable.
I purchased these bottles of honey for favors for a Baby Shower.The honey is wonderful and the price is great. The guests all loved them and it was something everyone can use.

My dog has been enjoying the Bench and Field Canine treats for many years. Until recently they were available nationwide at a popular grocery discounter. Now, the only economical way to get these, at least on the East Coast, is from Amazon.com. I expect Amazon will be getting lots of orders for them now. The treats are very healthy and fit nicely into the rubber kong toys to give a dog lots of chewing for clean, strong teeth and exercise. My dog also eats the Bench and Field dogwood and is healthy and energetic at 11 years old.
We have found that holistic treats helps settle our pets stomach. They have food allergies so we try to keep them on a all natural diet.

When my local specialized grocery store discontinued this product, I contacted the company and was told that the store would no longer be carrying this product.  However they went on to say that I could purchase it at Amazon.  I quickly went there and have been able to purchase it ever since.  This is the best dog treats I have been able to find for my 3 dogs.  I would do not nor would I want to give them anything other that these treats which are natural and healthy for them.  Not full of all kinds of nonsense they do not need.  I only hope that I can always find them on Amazon.  They sure love their treats..

I bought these recently, they don't expire until November so at least they aren't old.  However, when I opened them and gave one to each of my golden retrievers, they just dropped them.  If they have no choice of another treat, they will eat these, but otherwise, they wait for something better.  Won't buy again since they aren't popular here.

If I had noticed there was a date on these dog treats before I purchased them I would have checked it. Ater feeding my dog almost expired and now expired treats I wasn't happy.  You  can't sell 6 bags of treats with an expiration date on in this case one week.  When I looked back on bags I bought previously, (Jan 2012)  they had an expiration date of 5/2011.  Of course I only had two left so I dumped them, but I was feeding my pet dog treats I purchase in Jan. 2012 that expired in May 2011. Fool me once shame on you.  Fool me twice, shame on me.  Will not order these treats through Amazon again, unless I am guaranteed free return shipping if the treat expiration if not at least 3 mths ahead of the date of purchase.  Thank you for listening

Our English Boxer loves these treats!  If he likes them, I like them!  They are a small healthy treat, which is great for training and rewards.  The treats are well packaged, freeze and defrost very well without harming the treat. I will repurchase them again in the future.
I have three dogs and I cannot keep these treats around or get them fast enough.  Its a good price and a good holistic treat for the little critters. :)
My dog, who is a finicky eater, likes it, but since he is small and his teeth are not too strong, I break the cookies in two. This way the scent of the cookie is more appealing for him as well.

Wow! I've been buying dog treats for over 40 years and this one takes the cake! Pay no attention to the photo in the advertisement for this product. What you get is two (2) small chews in each of three (3) shrink wrapped over cardboard packages. That's a total of six (6) small chews for $30.00 not including shipping! I couldn't return my order quick enough.

I was not impressed about this product (Made in China). Cheaply made and not very good quality. Outside was coated with redish brown sweet something which stained the carpet.  My dog first tried to lick the coating and then bit the "bone".  It was like hard leather, more than bone, and left a mess of shreds about as well.

column9: Only rawhide my dog will chew
column10: Okay, my chihuaha is finicky...i have wasted lots of money on other rawhide chews and finally found one! Thank you beefeaters.

My little yourkie absolutely loves these treats. He chews all the chicken off first, which I think helps keep his teeth clean, and then goes to work on the rawhide.GREAT product, but the packaging wasn't too great. The bones were falling out when I got them... a little concerning.
Each evening before going to bed my dog gets a chick n top.  It relaxes her with a treat that she really enjoys.
My hound is surprisingly picky about treats.  But these are his all time favorites.  He, Wimsey, likes all the chicken top/treated Beefeater products
THIS IS NOT A PACK OF 12 BUT OF 3. I AM VERY UNHAPPY. PRODUCT IS NOT AS DESCRIBED  DO NOT ORDER IF YOU EXPECT 12 BONES. RIP OFF.  AMAZON SHOULD BE ASHAMED.

column9: wonderful treat but doesn't last as long as other rawhide
column10: My 30 pound puppy goes crazy for these, he really loves them.  He's just in heaven when he's chewing on one of these, but they only last about 20 minutes.  If you're looking for something that lasts much longer than a biscuit but doesn't need to last for hours like other rawhide treats then this is perfect.

This juice is so bad, we dumped over 3/4 of the bottle down the drain.  It was much too sweet and I had to dilute it with water just to take my morning vitamins.  This is without a doubt the worst juice I have ever tasted.  Any evidence of pomegranate or blackberry was completely non-existent.  I will go on to say that I have never reviewed a product online before.  That's how bad this juice is.

column9: THE BEST TASTING HONEY WE HAVE EVER EATEN!!!!!!!!
column10: THIS IS THE BEST HONEY WE HAVE EVER EATEN. I BUY THESE 6 TO 8 AT A TIME AND GIVE AWAY AS GIFTS. EVERYONE LOVES IT!WORTH EVERY DIME!!!!

column9: The Best Honey In The World
column10: Acacia Honey (Langnese) 17.5oz (500g)I discovered this honey while I was attending a cooking class in Ft. Lauderdale, FL.  The chef said that you must try this honey, once you do, you will never go back to regular honey.  Truer words were never spoken.  The chef also has a gift shop within his class, so I purchased a bottle and it is the "Best Honey".Claudette Diamond

Oh...My....Gosh! This honey is soooooooo light, so clean, and so lovely. You will NEVER go back to regular honey ever again. I save it for my favorite teas and it is just splended. One taste and you will be HOOKED!

Heaven on earth. Nectar of the Gods. Acacia honey is incredibly thick, drizzles smoothly & consistently, clear, & delicate flavoured.  Apparently it has natural (bee made) properties which make it more resistant to spoilage or crystallization, even as compared to other types of honeys. (Honey is a natural preservative, possessing natural anti-microbial properties, even used for wound care in some instances).For culinary enjoyment, bake it into breads & cakes, they will remain fresh & moist longer (honey is a natural humectant).  Spread it on fresh baked French bread & you will experience one of life's finer things- Go ahead, see how the other half lives! Also sooo delicious on desert cheese- even just plain ricotta- or drizzled on fruit, mixed into iced tea (in each/any case, a little goes a long way).  Always remember, honey is unsafe & must not be fed to infants under 1 year old, as their digestive & immune systems is/are not yet fully developed and therefore are susceptable to a natural bacteria inherant in honey, which can cause severe illness or even death.Acacia honey is truely an exquisite experience. It can be tough to get in the US (being primarily a European agricultural product), but if you can find it, it's so delicious that it seems underpriced at the $10 or so per jar you may pay for it- Enjoy!

The Langnese Acacia Honey is magnificent. It's very light in texture with undertones of vanilla. The clarity is a champagne color as it should be. After being unable to purchase Savannah Bee Co. Acacia Honey I took a chance on Langnese and am extremely pleased.

Acacia honey really is a different experience entirely. You know that taste your mind conjures up when imagining a perfect food, but nothing has quite satisfied that thought yet?  Well, this is it. And I don't even like honey. It should be called something else because it defies its category!  Light, airy, golden, buttery...even hard to describe!

This wine kit is a great everday drinker, especially when served to non-wine drinkers. As with all Vino Italiano wine kits, DO NOT make them to 6 gallon / 23 litre carboys. Only make this brand to 5 gallons and you will have a inexpensive but very drinkable table wine. Have made two Piesporters so far and plan to make more.

I have a 6 gallon primary and a 5 gal carboy, so I am limited when it comes to using kits. Most kits call for 8 gal primary and 6 gal carboy......so.....this wine kit is perfect for me. According to reviews make it up to 5 gal rather than 6....ok, I'm set! Yes, it worked out great without having to buy new equipment!! White wine is a little harder to degas, so after stirring...stirring..you get the picture...I quit with still bubbles in it. I think that made the finished product a little harsher, but after 3 months it greatly improved. I have some set aside for Christmas Gifts so should be perfect by then. I really recommend these kits, especially if your equipment is smaller, like mine. This was my first kit, then I did V. Italiano Merlot.....really got that degassing thing down..and it turned out Great!! Too dry for me, but I added 2 Tbls wine conditioner per bottle....perfect...sweeter in the front of the mouth....dryer in the back!! ha ha  I just ordered the V. Italiano Reisling..not here yet but anxious to get going on it. Fun, Fun, Fun........Try it!!!!!!

Last night my family tried the Patak Tikka Masala sauce.  Boy, that was good! Tonight, we tried the Patak Tandoori Paste-- and, yes, that was good, too!The paste is very easy to use.  I used boneless skinless chicken breast.  I mixed 8 -10 tbsp of this paste with 6-7 tbsps of plain yogurt and marinated for several hours.  Then, I baked the chicken for about 1/2 hour and it's done!  It's rare when I serve a meal that everyone in my family likes, but I've now served 2 meals in a row that everyone in my family raved about!I served this with couscous and a salad.  Very quick, easy, and very very good!

The one-star rating is for the vendor, not the product. As most people know, you can usually get this same item - a 24-pack of 16.9 oz bottles - for anywhere from $3.99 to $6.99 in your local grocery store. The price the vendor is offering is bizarre.

Poland Springs bottled water actually does come from one of the five springs in Maine that the company lists on each bottle; thank goodness! I have purchased a couple of other brands that are purified after simply being taken from the tap; but because Poland Springs bottled water actually comes from a spring I am impressed.The water tastes great and it is extremely refreshing to drink very cold on a hot summer's day. The water can be served cold or at room temperature, whichever you please.Have questions? No problem. The company lists both a toll-free telephone number and a website address for people to contact them. Good PR!Poland Springs bottled water is good for you. It helps to keep your system cleansed; and I prefer Poland Springs bottled water to other brands because it comes from a spring before they process it and put it in bottles for us to drink.Great job, Poland Springs!

We have used Poland Springs bottled water for years and find it very refreshing. These 16.9 oz bottles easily fit in the water bottle carriers on the bicycles that my wife and I use, as well as in the bottle holders on the treadmills at our local gym.It is important to shop for price. We routinely buy these on sale at the supermarket or CVS for $3.99, which is far less than the price on Amazon.
Let me put it this way ... they are all gone!  Guess I shouldn't have shared! See more in my future!  =)

column9: Taste wise it is a 6 star item
column10: The mouth says, "How do I love thee, let me count the ways..."If you like apple products a must have item.  The only draw back, shipping cost.  These are very heavy.
Arrived slightly thawed. My parents wouldn't accept it. However, the company was very helpful and issued a full refund.

The crust on these tarts are perfect.  My husband loves these, but I'm not so crazy about them.  They are just too sour/tart for my taste.  I'll eat the crust and hubby takes my filling.  My kids think they're great, so maybe it's just me.
These are absolutely scrumptuous!  My husband and I both love them, however, as another customer put it, they are expensive to ship!  The cost of shipping is more than the tartlets themselves are!
What a nice alternative to an apple pie. Love the fact there was no slicing and dicing. Easy to prepare. I also loved the fact that you can make them fresh whenever needed.

I like Creme Brulee. I loved that these were so easy. Just sprinkle on the sugar that came with and broil. They look amazing and taste great. My guess thought I really went out of the way for them when really it took all of 5 minutes. I will be ordering more!
not what I was expecting in terms of the company's reputation for excellent home delivery products
This is a really good product. I usually get them from a store near my house but for some reason they no longer sale them. I am glad they are avaliable online.
Haven't bought yet - can't determine number of oz.  It's on the jar, but I can't read it - can't find it in the description.
Tastes like dirt.Seriously if you want to experience this tea take some lipton and stomp on it in the garden.  Get it real dirty then brew it.

I have been searching for an all natural doggie treat for my west highland white terrier for a while, she has severe allergies to most dog treats because of all of the flour , wheat and artificial preservatives in them. So when I found these at my local pet store I thought I would give them a try, the ingrediants are all natural! Happy day! Well let me just say she absoulutly LOVES THEM! I order 2 bags at a time and they are good for her as well! She knows when I say its treat time she runs to where I keep them! Thanks so much for a great product!

The potatos and hot dogs are really good.... In fact they are great and will order again. The steaks and burgers are crap. Steaks are very chewy and dry. The burgers are too.... Id rather eat bubba burgers... They are much better.
I ordered this, again for my brother's Birthday.  He enjoyed it so much last year, I ordered another one for him!  Great tasting food!
i havent baught it online but i have used this tea and it is amazing. it tastes really good with honey or no honey

Our dogs like crunchy chews, but they can't be too hard. We made that mistake with poor Piper who lost a few teeth biting on chews that were way too hard for her petite mouth. Our canine dentist advised that we not give our dogs any chews that we couldn't bend with our hands. These Beefeaters pass the test.Our dogs tell us they like the taste and crunch of these chews. We also notice that these chews leave no stains behind and no crumbs either.I had to reduce the rating my one star because these Beefeaters are a product of China. I find this disconcerting, but we've never had any negative reactions in our dogs from the Beefeaters.Ingredients: rawhide, rice flour, red #40, chicken flavorVisiting the Beefeaters web page and reading about the quality control measures taken through the manufacuring process reassures me somewhat.
Someone left the tea at my house and I decided to try it.  It is wonderful. I am now seeking out where to purchase the tea.I love it!  :)
tried this flavor for the first time at Christmas from a gift package and looked for it online.  found it on Amazon for a very good price.  Coffee is excellent ... perfect if you like strong coffee.

Caffe Verona has been our coffee of choice for years, with a smooth great taste and no bitter aftertaste or acidy feeling. At the current price (lower than in a previous review) it is a good deal for the three pack, lower than any store price. Yay Amazon. Now if you would just carry our seasonal favorite, Starbucks Brazilian Ipanema Bourbon.

We have tried all of the different blends that Starbucks has to offer, and we always come back to the Caffe Verona.  It is dark, smooth and sweet all at the same time. A great cup of coffee if you like it strong.
This coffee was very good.  However, I prefer the French Roast or the Sumatra.  That is a personal prefrence and as noted this coffee was very good.

When I and Verona, it tasted different than before. I guess Starbucks changed the recipe? It's okay - I think I'll go with breakfast blend next time. The value though is great - 3 bags! And you can return each bag for a tall coffee. So really you are purchasing 3 premium whole bean coffee, and 3 tall coffees at starbucks. How can you go wrong? And your still getting it cheaper than at Target, Walmart, or Starbucks itself.

I was looking forward to trying this bold coffee flavor which was supposed to have a sweet flavor.  However, although package arrived earlier than promised, the beans were old (dull, not glossy) without evidence of oil on them (which fresher beans would have).  Lacked powerful smell (if fresh, would have been strong when opened).  Consequently, this coffee tasted poor/watery after beans were ground and dripped.
Nuff said. Not to be confused with Dark Verona.Only Amazon had any regular Verona in stock, since it is being discontinued by Starbucks.

I originally ordered this when it was $7+ for one 12 oz. bag and I needed an item to bring me up to $25 for free shipping. Today I'm ordering it for the the third time, and in the the 3 bag amount and not as a filler!I like medium-bold coffee most of the time and for me that's Eight O'Clock's Columbian. Sometimes I want it really bold and Cameron's Intense French does the trick. But sometimes I want something in between and Starbuck's Caffe Verona is just that, as well as wonderfully flavorful without being bitter.

column9: Famous Blend at Our Board Meetings
column10: My organization has weekly Friday morning board meetings, and I have gotten so much positive feedback on the coffee.  I always serve Starbucks Cafe Verona blend. I think our "famous" coffee is half the reason why they show up every week!  Buying in bulk helps to make it economical and it arrived fresh and well-sealed.

column9: Good deal for those hardcore caffeine-iacs
column10: First of the biggest feature after price was shipping time, and boy were they fast. I placed my order and in three days it was at my door with just the free Amazon shipping.  The coffee itself is a full bodied, robust coffee perfect for drip, espresso, and my french press.  I prefer the whole bean to control the grind but they do have the option of pre-ground, which is best for just drip.  It may be too dark for some people but those of us who work graveyard shift know the best coffee is when you have to chew it.  Finally the price.  You get three bags of the standard sized Starbucks, which compared to my local grocer and the local Starbucks works out to be close to a buy two, get the third bag free.
I try all types of dark roast, Starbucks & others. There is no other way to say it. For me, this has the most intense deep flavor. This is my ULTIMATE COFFEE!

I served Starbucks Verona coffee to houseguests in June. They commented that the coffee wasunusually good and asked what it was. This family grinds coffee beans daily for the freshestbrew possible, and they are very discerning. I then sent 3 backs of Verona to the family asa gift. The product arrived a day early and I am assured it is just as fresh and good as if theyhad purchased it at a Starbucks store.
Starbuck's Verona is my all-around favorite coffee. Unfortunately, the price on Amazon is no longer worth buying. It's cheaper to purchase at the grocery store.

column9: Great coffee but way cheaper if you buy from your local starbucks
column10: 5 stars for the coffee (I like the fact that it's much less acidic on your stomach than French & Italian Roast) + its slight mocha tasteminus 1 star for the fact that it would be ~$40 for 3-16 oz bags from your local Starbucks.

This is one of my favorites from Starbucks.  Dark, strong, smooth flavor without that nasty thin acid taste that some coffees can get.  It can be a little "muddy", but I add milk and sugar to mine anyway.  This is a good every day coffee, after dinner coffee, or whatever you like.  It also makes a great iced coffee drink.
Verona is one of my favorite starbucks coffees, it is great stong flavor with a smooth taste.  It is an everyday coffee.

I am a long time lover of Caffe Verona whole beans.  However, I bought a bag two days ago and noticed that the bag design is new, and in addition the most prominent word on the front of the bag reads "DARK", unlike the prior design with the word "BOLD" being less prominent.  This would not be worthy of comment if the product tasted the same as Caffe Verona Bold.  After grinding for three mornings I am convinced that the formula or process has been changed.  If this one bag is not an anomaly, Caffe Verona is no longer my favorite--same for other family members who are also discerning coffee lovers.

AMAZON ORDER: Ordered the 3 pack Verona after reading + reviews AND bec. I wanted to start ordering as many non-perishible items as possible on-line.I have no gripes w/ the Verona (it's nothin' special) BUT I was disappointed in ordering THREE bags in Jan. & they arrive w/ a "good by" date of April. That's waayyy tooo close.Just doesn't sound fresh enough to me. I felt like they took advantage of an on-line orderer to send the dregs to. Oh well, live & learn.
coffee is fresh and was received in the time frame stated. Price was cheaper than buying at Starbucks outlet store

I can certainly distinguish difference in different branded coffee beans, but all Starbucks coffee taste same to me, regardless of specific recipes.  This is just marketing gimmicks by Starbucks, conceivably to charge more with labels.My price is of $5.33/oz justify the order from Amazon instead of buying from local warehouse where I usually source my coffee beans, currently selling at 15-20% higher than this price.  As long as Amazon consistently beats the Costco price, I'll be glad to switch to Amazon.  For whole bean coffee, I only use high-end Saeco machine for years.
Both my husband and I found the taste of this coffee to be unpleasant, with a "muddy" aftertaste.  We are accustomed to drinking coffees from all over the world, but would not buy this one again.

I bought this on sale at Amazon.com and my husband was so proud of me since they cost a lot less than Starbucks or any grocery store that carries Starbucks coffe. They came in whole beans but it just means we can have a freshly grinded & a freshly brewed coffe.
We like the Verona Coffee. We do note the name change from Bold to Dark and will see if coffee is the same.Best part is the fast regular shipping.
Starbucks by far has the most flavorful and rich coffee of anyone!  I also believe in their goals of pursuing fair trade coffee exchange.

I was happy to see varieties of Starbucks coffee here in Amazon especially my favorite kind, so I ordered it right away.  However, I underestimated the size although it comes in 3 bags.  But for $27 something, I'd rather buy it directly at Starbucks stores because they are cheaper there.  Otherwise, very good coffee.

column9: If you see it, swipe it- and use slowly
column10: I remember my mom coming home with the distinctive jar of Red Cherry Favorit she saw sitting on a shelf at Ross, making a point of telling me she managed to snag it for only five or so dollars where it might have been even more expensive outside. I was a little thrown that it would be so expensive and hard to find. How good could it be if I'd never heard of it-? But one dollop of the stuff on a biscuit erased any doubt. The preserves, though very sweet, have a good consistency, are easy to spread, and have an uncommonly strong and pure cherry flavor that had me carefully rationing the jar to make it last as long as possible. It would be a long time before I saw another; imagine my delight to find the brand on sale for three dollars a jar at Harris Teeter. I bought several.

column9: a great tasting snack (small meal) substitute
column10: If you're a former junk food junkie like me, then you'll get an idea of what these things taste like when I describe them as a more fibrous (chewy) version of rice kripy squares with a chocolate coating on the bottom.  They really are that delicious.  And at 170 calories with 4gm of fat (1.5gm saturated), 9gm of protein, and 5gm of fiber, they are a healthy alternative to many other types of snacks that one could indulge in (pastries, candy, etc).These are easily my favorite protein bar and I've tried over a dozen kinds.Edit on 9/27/07:  This review pertains to the chocolate peanut Go Lean flavor.  I just noticed that Amazon is grouping reviews for all of Kashi's bars together, so without specificity in the review it's impossible to know which product is being reviewed.

If you are on Weight Watchers, there is no better snack bar. I eat them for breakfast and, get this, they are only TWO POINTS. You can buy Weight Watchers own bars and they are about one-third the size. These are satisfying and come on, they have one side that's coated in chocolate! I also like that they have plenty of fiber - five grams, and are loaded with many essential vitamins. I bought a case of these bars and am about to buy more.YUMMY!

This bar tastes very good! The consistency of it, however, is like a rice cake. That kind of stale popcorn texture. But the taste more than makes up for that. High in fiber and protein makes this bar perfect for an on-the-go meal. This bar doesn't keep you full as long as the Regular Kashi GOLEAN bars, but it does curb you appetite for a while.

column9: Kashi GOLEAN Bar, Crunchy! Chocolate Almond
column10: Yum!! Love these bars.  They've got it all: flavor, fillng and fiber!  Oh AND chocolate with almonds!  These crunchy bars are so much better than the other Kashi bars.  And all three flavors are delicious.

This is one of the best nutrition bars I have ever eaten.  As another reviewer stated, it is like a rice krispy treat.  However, dare I say, this bar is better-tasting than a rice krispy treat.  It's made with rice, oats, nuts, sugar cane juice, and a chocolate underbelly.  The bar is good for a quick snack if you're hungry between meals, and if you divide your meals up to five a day, then it's basically a meal.  Each bar has 6 grams of fiber and 9 grams of protien, so it will help fill you up more than that junky Snickers.  They're a little on the expensive side, but it's worth it.

column9: good, but not quite as good as Kashi's Chocolate Peanut Bliss bar
column10: I just submitted a review of the Chocolate Peanut Bliss bar, a product I've been enjoying regularly for the past couple of months.  This bar is very similar to the other flavor in terms of nutritional information as well as consistency, but I don't like this one quite as much.  To me the "caramel" flavor in this bar does not much resemble caramel and actually has a bit of a malty flavor.  I do enjoy these on occasion for variety, though, and obviously some other reviewers liked the flavor of these more than I did.

1. 150 calories2. low in fat3. high in fiber4. high in protein5. NO high fructose corn syrup6. NO partially-hydrogenated soybeen oil7. NO aspartame, saccharin, or sucralose8. LOADS of vitamins and minerals9. pleasantly sweet and chocolatey10. KASHI!
Wonderful snack or quick breakfast on drive to work, try all Kashi Bars, they are all nutritious and very tastey. Thank you

column9: Great snack for after a long run
column10: I don't eat these bars during the day as a mid-meal snack (I like the Kashi TLC Chewy Granola Bars for that). I love eating these after I get back from my hour+ runs.  With 27g of Carbs, 8g of protein they fit the 3:1 carb: protein ratio for post-runs, plus they have 5g of fiber to boot.  More importantly, they taste great!  I've tried other 'energy bar' type things, i.e. larabar, but can't stand the dense, moist, chewy texture. These are more in line with the texture of a Kashi granola bar.  Surprisingly they are cheaper ($13.99/box or $1.19/bar) at Wegmans.

This is a super snack to grab when you're about to miss breakfast.  It's not a full breakfast replacement, but you can supplement it with a bit of fruit or yogurt an hour or so later and have a happy tummy.Even better... this is a great dessert... one that satisfies a crunchy sweet craving but doesn't make you feel too guilty.  A lot fewer calories than a typical donut, plus a good helping of fiber and all-natural ingredients.Kashi's done it again.  Tasty, reasonably nutritious.

I have a really hard time finding a snack bar that I can enjoy and be good for me. This has to be one of Kashi's best products (although I've only found one Kashi product I can't even stand the flavor of). The chocolate doesn't taste fake, and the almond is not overpowering at all. The flavors blend in together very well with the brown rice. Great flavor, great bar!

column9: We'll buy it again and again!
column10: These are great!  Low calorie, light, crispy, great taste, and satisfying.  This is a staple snack item in my house!  Tons of dietary fiber and they taste great.  I recommend this to anyone who would like to replace the typical office bagel or donut.  Healthy and delicious.

I have insulin resistance so I need a snack that is low in bad carbs but can provide a good source of energy at the same time. So, I've spent a long time trying to find the right snack and I have finally found the best granola bar ever! Kashi's bars do not taste like cardboard and their texture is so much better than any other health/protein bar I've ever tried. The flavors are fantastic and I'm officially addicted to them, especially the chocolate & peanut bar. I personally love everything that Kashi makes but these granola bars are a real find!! I think I'm gonna go have one right now...

I stumbled on to these at Albertson's and find them to be a great afternoon snack and chocolate fix. Albertson's is frequently out of them so I am going to order them from Amazon.com from now on. Small, frequent meals is what is working for me.

column9: Healthy, convenient, even kids like them!
column10: I recently purchased a case of these for myself, and was surprised to find out that my children prefer these to rice krispies treats. They love the chewy texture and sweet taste, and it makes a convenient breakfast on the go or after school snack. I like the fact that these are whole grain and convenient to take anywhere.

OK I eat a lot of protein/fiber bars and most taste like cardboard or something worse.  This bar is the best - I eat it for breakfast, lunch or as dessert after dinner. The texture reminds me of a chewy rice crispy treat - seriously. Love it.

Like most people I don't always have time to cook up something tasty and healthy so I kinda' cheat by having a few of these in my desk or bag. The numbers are really good and it doesn't taste like other protein-fiber-board bars that I have had in the past. I was genuinely surprised how good the chocolate almond tasted.

column9: Crunchy is much better than chewy.
column10: The crunchy variety is a whole lot better than the chewy variety, if you ask me.  And this is my review, that's my story, and I'm sticking to it.

These bars are extremely tasty and can substitute a mini meal. They seem to slightly overpriced considering the size of the bars. I switched to Nature Valley granola bars for my daily snack, but would consider having the Kashi bars in between for a change.
