I didn't like this as much as the Chocolate Almond bar, but it was still very good. The peanut flavor blended well with the chocolate and really supressed my hunger for those snack times. Sits very well a little while before a run or hard workout.

column9: What can I say but yummy?
column10: Although available retail, this is a good price for this product.  If you like Kashi, you'll love these!  Just enough chocolate to make this chocoholic happy!  I'm on weightwatchers, and they fit well into my diet plan.
This nutrition bar has a good mix of fat, carbs and protein without being large (at 1.5oz as opposed to many bars that are larger). It is a small snack instead of a mini-meal and tasty.

column9: THESE BARS ARE SIMPLY THE BEST!!!
column10: Love the flavor, texture and overall yumminess of these bars.  I never knew what to have at snack time and would reach for a couple cookies or a few pieces of candy.  Then the guilt...now, having these bars has satisfied my sweets cravings with no feelings of having behaved badly :)  Since I am trying to lose a few pounds, I'll try these bars at snacktime alternating with popcorn and maybe a peach.  Nice to know there are healthy alternatives when the craving for a between meal nibble attacks!
I eat these when I am in the mood for a sweet treat, but trying to stay away from the junk foods.  They are a little dry, but tasty.

column9: Kashi Go Lean Crunchy Chocolate Almond
column10: This was an ok bar.  Not my favorite of the Kashi line-up, but still not bad in a pinch when I have nothing else for breakfast.The chocolate almond bar tasted mainly of chocolate.  In fact, I really didn't taste the almonds at all.  I'm sure they added to the crunchy texture, but predominately I tasted the other grains in there all liberally coated with a milk chocolate.  This was made even more chocolatey by the thick coating on the bottom as well.  So all in all, definitely chocolate if you couldn't tell from the description thus far.  I do enjoy the crunchy aspects of this particular type of bar as well, but compared to the Chocolate Pretzel and some of the other ones, I don't think it was quite as crunchy as it could have been.These are definitely a fitness bar.  8 grams of protein, 5 grams of fiber, and 170 calories are packed right in.  This makes it the perfect choice for exercise or as a meal replacement.  I wouldn't recommend just snacking on it when you're hungry.  Choose a lower calorie snack for that type of meal.  Sugars are 13 grams, which isn't high, but it isn't the diabetic special either.Ingredients are alright.  It doesn't boast the organic ingredients that some bars too, but it does have that Kashi special seven whole grains ingredient in it.  The main sweetener is brown rice syrup and there is some evaporated cane juice crystals and fructose as well.  They also add some vitamins such as folic acid and zinc oxide into the blend too.  And of course there are almonds in this bar, so those with nut allergies should probably steer clear.Not a bad bar but I'd choose other flavors over this one.  There just wasn't anything special or unique seeming about it.Review by M. Reynard 2012
Convenient and delicious, just like other Kashi GoLean Crunch bars.  The caramel popcorn flavor is tasty and unique and I think has the best nutrition stats for weight loss of all the flavors.

column9: Good price at Amazon compared to store price
column10: Delicious!  Arrived in a timely manner.  boxes are sealed to retain freshness.  They are a bargain for the price.  It's nice to have the ability to reorder as the need dictates.

I'm a big fan of Kashi products in general and these are super tasty! Fiber and protein balanced which makes me feel full and satisfied, no sugar crash.  Even my 8 year old LOVES them.  I like the convenience of being able to pack these for daily outtings or family trips.  Amazon pricing is super!
Pros:ProteinFiberFillingTastyEasy for travelCons:Very crunchyOverall:Delicious and a great fast breakfast
I eat them for breakfast every day. They're super tasty, low in calories and high in fiber and protein.
I love the Kashi products. But my favorite is the Chocolate Caramel bar. And it is only 2 points in Weight Watchers!

I really like these bars and have been buying them at the grocery store for a while.  I figured that since I was eating so many of them, I should order here to save money.  WRONG.  They are much cheaper to buy individually at my local grocery store.  I was very surprised by that as I thought I would save money by buying in bulk.  Too bad.

I bought this product because I love other Kashi foods. All I can say is YUM! I am currently tring to lose weight and so I figured the protein and fiber would be great. I was right... and the taste is delish! The only problem is that if I am using them to satisfy a sweets craving I have to really watch it or 1 bar turns into 2 bars... and well... I know it is more a self-control issue than a product issue. It is just that they are really that good. I'd take one of these bars over a snickers ANY day!.

I bought these on a whim and have found that my whole family just loves them!!  They are a great snack when you have the munchies, or can fill in for a light meal. My daughter describes them as a "healthy" rice krispies treat.
These are a great way to get fiber, vitimins, and a chocolate fix, without blowing your diet!

column9: Marvelous option to crush a hunger attack
column10: I'm trying to get more fiber in my diet, and these are terrific. Real food, great taste (better than chocolate caramel variety of these bars which have a few kernels of embedded popcorn which are really inedible). I'm changing my subscribe & save to switch these for the chocolate caramel which I thought were good until I found these.

column9: Great as a substitute for a cookie or other sweet, unhealthy snack!
column10: I can't imagine eating one of these bars for breakfast. First of all, they are definitely not filling enough to replace a meal. And second of all, they are pretty sweet! In fact, there are 14 grams of sugar in each little bar.I would definitely buy these as a healthier, more nutritious replacement for a cookie or candy bar when I wanted something sweet and chewy.
I LOVE these! Big, chewy, sweet, and only 170 calories. Good stuff in them too.

My husband and I have used this product for a few years.  Not only is it a tasty and convenient breakfast bar but our doctors and nutritionist have recommended it as well.  Works particuarly well when eaten before exercise because it is easily digested and provides steady flow of energy for a couple of years

I am not a fan of most bars---and I hate that soy aftertaste but these Kashi Chocolate Almond bars are great and they hold me for a quick lunch.Usually I eat a yogurt and one bar. They hold me better than "FULL BARS". (cheaper too!)

column9: super tasty beats Clif any day and sticks with ya
column10: Yum.  This chewy bar is better than Clif and is a perfect meal on the go.

This a great energy bar.  The bar has a great chocolate/peanut butter taste, but it's not too sweet.  The bar has 210 calories so its better to snack on this than a bag of chips.  This has the texture of a rice crispy treat.
I love bringing these to work for a snack. Of the Kashi Go Lean! snacks, this flavor is my favorite. They're filling and satisfy both salt & sugar cravings, and I feel satisfied for a long time. Yum!

We eat them raw by the handfuls, and we toast them the way the package says in a single layer on a baking sheet for 10 minutes at 350ºF.We tried the following recipe, which was on the bag, and loved it!DIAMOND CHILLED SPICED ALMONDSIngredients3 cups whole almonds4 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil (We use olive oil.)1 1/2 teaspoons paprika1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder1 1/2 teaspoons oregano1 teaspoon ground cumin2 teaspoons garlic salt (We substiuted powder to cut the salt.)1/8 teaspoon black pepper (And we added a few shakes of red pepper!)ProcedureCombine almonds and oil in large skillet. column10: Almonds are very healthful! (Eat a handful every day per nutritionists.) But bags are often NOT fresh. Freshly harvested nuts are a treat like none other, but most nuts in stores are very stale, or outright rancid. The origin and the packaging matter a lot! So, be aware of the different origins, especially of almonds and walnuts - the crops from California being the most delicious. Also, Almonds and Walnuts are harvested in the Fall - Walnuts in October, and Almonds earlier. All nuts are fragile and go rancid quickly, but especially walnuts, due to their concentration of healthy fats - so buy directly from the grower, or look for vacuum sealed containers - bags just are NOT good protection. (Most grocery store nuts are at least slightly rancid, and some people think THAT is what nuts taste like, so they "don't like nuts" or "nuts upset their stomach.") Then freeze the fresh nuts, taking them out as you need them. Frozen nuts will taste as fresh as the day you bought them, even a year, or more, later. California growers, and [...] sell fresh nuts directly to consumers. Two really good growers are Haag and Winter Creek Ranch. You can get on their mailing list and they will contact you when the "new crop" nuts are harvested. Once you taste what a really FRESH walnut or almond tastes like, you will order from them every year! You can get fresh English Walnuts at [...] or Hartley Walnuts at [...]. column9: Great salt, but be aware of very hard crystals
column10: I love this product for how natural and whole it is. I think the salt has a wonderful mild flavor and I know my body is benefiting from all the minerals that are in it.However, I have one MAJOR issue with this product and that is the fact that it contains a lot of hard crystals, some send, etc. These crystals do not dissolve and if you bite on it, it will sound crunchy and even painful.Unfortunately, I've tried this product on 4 different occasions to make sure it wasn't just a bad batch, and they all had crystals that don't dissolve.I'm sad to report that I chipped two of my teeth over a period of 2 months. The chips are microscopic, but I do have quite a bit of sensitivity in those teeth. Also, if your teeth are naturally prone to sensitivity, I would presume this product would irritate them even more.Great idea, but the filtration process leaves little bit too much of inpurities behind.

I couldn't believe the flavors that were brought out in foods when I started using this product. It's all I use now for cooking and baking. Flavors are enhanced, not covered up. I rarely used any salt unless I had to for baking. Iodized salt just tastes awful. Once you've used this, you'll never go back!! And it's better for you too!!

I've been a loyal Real Salt user since 1995, and I've converted countless friends to it. I don't prepare meals without it, and I never leave home without it. That's right, I have a travel-size Real Salt with me at all times, whether in my coat pocket, briefcase or travel bag.  Once you taste it, you never want to deal with refined table salts or refined sea salts ever again. Compared to Real Salt, they taste so harsh and bitter. Food simply tastes better with this product.
Received the package in excellent condition. Love the sea salt with minerals. No difference in taste, but love the benefit of having all natural, sea salt with minerals. Excellent product.

column9: The only salt my husband will use
column10: I have always felt that salt is salt is salt.... my husband however is another story all together. He brought a number of his own customs to our marriage and Real Salt Sea Salt was one of them. He won't use anything else and scowls ferociously at all other inferior salts I've tried to introduce to our kitchen over the years. I will give him this... the Real Salt does taste better than any of the other stuff out there, but it is a bit more expensive than the plebian grocery store stuff. I finally decided it's worth the price difference if he's happy and cooking (means I don't have to!) The fact that I can find this stuff on Amazon AND use our Prime shipping totally made my day!

I first bought Real Salt in Utah at a small gift shop when I was vacationing near Kings Canyon.  When I came home and tried it, it was the best tasting salt I ever had.  I don't know what's in this stuff, but it just tastes so good.  Kinda crazy because, salt is salt is salt, right?  When I ran out, I found it online and my kitchen has not been without Real Salt last 3 years.

This salt is truly unique, just like the ocean exactly, when compared to other brands like Morton, this is on is the best; you can feel a sweet taste at the end. Truly natural and makes huge difference. If applied to skin it makes it smooth and healthier cuz of the Ocean's salt natural healing properties.

I tried this salt before from a friend so I was thrilled to find in in your site, it is all what it says it to be and more. I like that it is beneficial to one's health as well as taste great. I would buy it again.
This allows me to eat salt with blood pressure problems. I thought I would never be able to enjoy food again until I found out about this.

We won't use any other salt. This stuff is so tasty, healthy AND reasonably priced (esp compared with Pink salt which doesn't have near as many minerals) I can't imagine using anything else... except to melt ice of course ;)

My wife and I love this salt. We don't use Mortons any longer. This salt has a sweet taste that makes everything taste better. You will have to try it to see what I mean about the sweet taste. Its just differant!

I switched to this salt years ago as I was cutting refined foods out of my families diets. At least to the extent that I can control at home. This tastes good, has a full spectrum of natural minerals and comes from right here in the good ol'USA. I have had a couple of bags that had some sandy grit in it though. Not enough to bother us or make me quit using it. They make a coarse grind too that you put in a salt grinder. I actually like it more for table use and the fine grind for cooking.

column9: Too much Sand!  Sensitive teeth beware!
column10: Great flavor but just can't stand the hard pieces of sand (I think it's sand anyway)I have sensitive teeth and this sand will actually put tiny chips your teeth.  It's not just one piece of sand per teaspoon either, it's several.  Maybe I got a batch that's worse than normal but I'm not ordering anymore.  If there was a way the company could filter this out it, this salt would be great!

column9: Positives: it's absolutely sea salt.  Negatives: the sand in it proves this fact.
column10: I got two bags of this sea salt after I had a small sample shaker that I really loved. It has excellent flavor, is genuine sea salt, and you use less sea salt than regular salt when seasoning food because it is a stronger flavor. All good things.Unfortunately, after many, many tries to ensure it wasn't my imagination...both bags contained sand as well. Something must have been wrong with their filtering system to eliminate sand from the salt during manufacturing. But, because it happened in both bags I had bought I felt it must not be too uncommon.Imagine when I cooked an egg dish to share with the office at breakfast...you know how it is when you eat something at the beach and, no matter how careful you are, some sand gets in so you bite down on grit? That was take one.  Then I made soup...with sand...take two....After two more tries I knew it wasn't a fluke of the kitchen or the dish or some odd salt. After all, salt dissolves in cooking. I tried both bags and gave up.I'm not saying it's awful. The taste was good and I might try it again in the future...but this is a fairly exceptional flaw so I gotta pan the cooking results it produced for now.

By far this is my favorite of the various unrefined salts I've tasted.  It is robust (can a salt be robust?) and has a taste that is far more than mere NaCl.  I use it whenever I need salt and even travel with it.  I get the pouches since it is a bigger bargain.

I use no other salt ever... this is the real deal...buy it try it and get rid of all your other salts...which serve no real healthy bennies, compared to the real Salt Brand ♥  love the taste and love how I can consume it and not swell up like regular salt does to me ♥
Great flavor - very healthy for you -- I think the flavor it brings out in food is far supieror to regular or iodized salt. Doesn't clump like some salts.
It's natural, not poisonous to my body, actually is good for my body. It taste good.  There is nothing more to say except I love this.
If you are looking for a healthier salt, this is it. It was recommended by my holistic doctor and I love it.
My son told me that pinkish salt is the best and purest form.  I was happywhen this salt arrived and it was just that color.  Very happy with my purchase.

I've been using RealSalt for a year or more, as well as several other brands of sea salt, and RealSalt is one of the finest I've tried. I like using this salt for cooking, and use the RealSalt Kosher salt (also available here, I think) as a finishing salt - for sprinkling on food at the table. The kosher variety has a larger grain size than the plain RealSalt, and a slightly mellower flavor. I still use the other brands as well when I want a different flavor profile. All of the standard salt in the kitchen now goes for salting pasta water, since it's flavor doesn't compare.

I was really excited to find this salt, because it is supposed to be so pure, but I was really disappointed. I realize that the company refers to the grit as mineral, but to be honest, the impression I got was of trying to eat after a sandstorm. Possibly I got a particularly sandy batch, because after I gave up on eating this, I used it for bath salt, and the tub looked like I had been to a beach party. To be clear, for me it isn't the idea of dirt that bothers me (I have used clay-based toothpastes), but this grit doesn't even break up and is unpleasant to chew. All in all, I'll stick to Himalayan Salt.

column9: Salt tastes great, the dirt and sand ...not so much...
column10: This crap is made by a lazy company that leaves the dirt and sand in there and calls it minerals. If you like adding sand to your salt before sprinkling it on your favorite foods, this is the salt for you! If you like a salt that is loaded with minerals and flavor without the grit, get Spice labs Himalayan salt. That's what I did and I will never again spend my money on this gritty crap that they could have filtered but that would take too long and cost too much?Yet another company out of Utah that cuts corners and compromises our health...the other company is concentrace mineral drops ... that product was endorsed by a scientist who now removed his endorsement after seeing the filthy conditions that company now uses! Something wrong with Utah?!

column9: Crunchy, and not in a good way
column10: I agree with the other reviewers who noted that the salt has insoluble particles in it. These can really hurt your teeth! OK it's supposed to be natural, but I do not see why I have to pay so much $$$ for salt that has sand in it, no matter how much more tastier it is. I mean seriously people, it's SAND... in your FOOD! Do you eat manure fertilizer with your organic produce? I don't think so.Maybe realsalt has sand in it so that it boosts the company's profit margins... I mean it adds to the weight that would otherwise be used by REAL salt.I also find the pitch about the natural minerals to be hogwash. I mean, yea it does have some trace amount of potassium, but also aluminum, tin and so on.
I had hoped that with all those 60 trace minerals, this natural salt would include iodine, but it does not. Something that some users will want to be aware of.

column9: Too Gritty--Does not dissolve in hot food or hot water
column10: I bought this product believing it to be a healthy product.  While it may be healthy, the salt does not dissolve--or maybe it's sand others have referred to.  Eating a casserole or pasta dish with this salt is horrible--it ruined the dishes because it was so gritty.  I prefer not to feel like I am chewing something that sand was sprinkled on.  The salt (or sand?) does NOT dissolve in meals where it's added & cooked with the meal.
When I received the product the salt's plastic container was broken and the salt came out.  i have to throw out about a third because it's all over the place.

Solay Gourmet Himalayan Sea Salt and Celtic Salt Soft Vanilla Caramels are without a doubt the most incredible, creamy caramel I have ever eaten.  I love the added crunch of the sea salt and have tried numerous brands, all ranging from pricey to more pricier.  These are worth every cent and are the best I have had.  This will be the second time I have ordered the caramels and will continue to do so.  I limit myself to one or two a day which is really hard to do, but with the cost I want them to last a little while before having to order again.  Try them, I assure you, you will not be disappointed.

I have a few family members who are absolutely addicted to caramels, and they both now have a new "favorite".  I had one and the sea salt added in with the caramels is GREAT.  Seems I will be buying these agin for christmas and birthdays in the future, and maybe even for myself!

Solay caramels are the most delicious buttery salty & sweet confection I have ever eaten.  They are pricey but they are such a treat.  Soft and chewy.  Makes a great gift when you don't know what to get someone.  This is delicious!

Very good medium roast coffee!  Makes excellent espresso! and works with drip too.The roast is not so dark that you miss the flavors of the coffee and only taste the roast.  The beans are a dark brown with a nice shine.  A rare bean has a dark spot on it where it was roasted more.  The only other coffee I tried at amazon was Rocamojo Organic Gourmet Coffee -  French Roast, Whole Bean, 16-Ounce Can (Pack of 3).  While it was good, it was darker and I only tasted the roast.Take a look at the picture for reference.One strange thing is that there is no date on the bags. No expiration date. No roast date. In fact there is no printed code or lot. Who knows how old it is? It is good that these purged bags do a good job of keeping coffee fresh while sealed.Don't trust me read a professional review on coffeereview.com:  [...]

My favorite coffee changed their beans and I no longer liked it, so I have been looking for a new brand.  Out of 4 I tried, this one is the best.  Some of the brands I tried just didn't have that real Espresso flavor.  This one does.

Life is too short to drink bad coffee and these beans make bad coffee.  I have a Compak commercial grinder, a Pasquini Livia 90 espresso machine and the experience to use them.  The beans are dry, the flavor is sour and thin.  These are the worst beans I have ever tried and we have thrown them out.  A waste of money.

column9: doesn't have that nutty espresso taste
column10: Espresso is OK -- but not the high-quality best. Doesn't have that nutty espresso taste that we love. My husband and I love an espresso/cappucino every morning, so we really taste and compare. It's also not really strong....
This is an excellent value for the money and worth every penny and more. This Espesso has always arrived promptly. It is very fresh on arrival and has a fabulous aroma and taste!
The coffee lacks body, taste, and aroma.  We are generally frugal and throw little away; we will throw this coffee out.
Great coffee and a bargain when buying it by the 5 pound bag.  California does some things better than us here in Indiana, coffee is one of them.
Smooth, flavorful coffee. I wouldn't mind a little stronger flavor, but it's very good.Huge bag!

column9: EXCELLENT TASTE & SUPERB DEAL ON THESE COFFEE BEANS!!!!!
column10: Delicious are these fresh and beautifully roasted dark coffee beans with free shipping.  This 5 pound bag of strong coffee will go a very long way.  A great bargain too!!

Not great coffee. Rocamojo and PuraVida, which amazon also sells is so much better--and those aren't great just good.  This is cheap coffee and tastes like it. I can't complain much at about $3 a pound but it's just ok, drinkable, but wouldn't buy again.

Not impressed with this water at all. To me it had an after taste that was not pleasant. It's like the Mood Ring...you have to buy it to see if it works...sorry to say it is not worth the extra money for the novelty of drinking water that is black. You would have to consume a large amount of this drink to get any of the benefits of the Fulvic Acid contained in each bottle. It's just pure hype orchestrated by a reality show participate. Save your hard-earned money and use tap water or regular bottled water, you and your wallet will feel better. Hope this reveiw was helpful to choose regular bottled water and consume the proper foods each day instead of being drawn into these hype-filled promo ads claiming miraculious benefits with this water.
It just taste's like water but it has a dirty aftertaste and it taste's really bad warm. Overall it was ok not bad or good and if you drank it with food the aftertaste was not really as strong.

column9: Wanted to try it, wanted to like it, but didn't
column10: As a fan of The Real Housewives, I decided to try the BLK water that they talk about and promote on the show. I have to say the thought of a BLK water made me a bit apprehensive but I wanted to try it. The bottle itself and design is really nice, packaging great. The color of the water looks almost like a flat coke. There is no smell to it really. However, I am so disappointed to say, the taste is really bad. It has a metallic aftertaste that does not taste good at all. I purchased one bottle for $6.99, this is not cheap water. And, I guess we don't even need Fulvic Acid to survive nor does it really do anything for us (based on opinion from what I have read online,not a Doctor). All in all, overpriced, tastes pretty bad with not good aftertaste that lingers for awhile. I am so sorry, I wanted to like it!

This product made my stomach hurt.  I thought it was just me, but when my wife drank the second bottle and stated the same thing I told her it had the same effect on me.  I don't know if it was the type of acid in it, but I will not drink anymore, nor recomend it to anyone.

I was really excited about trying BLK.  Boy, was i dissapointed!  I couldn't even get halft the bottle down!  Plus when I went online to read about it, I heard there is no nutritional value and it's not any better for you than regular tap water.  Feel like I've been scammed.

I came across Blk water as I was browsing the internet and was intrigued by its clever bottle slogan - "Enjoy the Dark Side." I decided to give it a try. I left the bottle in the fridge for a day after it arrived in the mail. It tastes just like clear water, no weird after taste. However, I still can't get my mind wrapped around the fact that it's "dirty" - not clear. Even though it tastes just like clear water to me, the color of the beverage plays a trick on my mind. "If it's water, why isn't it clear?" If you're considering purchasing this product, you should go ahead and do so. It's worth a try. After all, you'll never know if you really like it or not unless you try. Right?

What's the deal with this water? At 6.99 a bottle it should be pure magic. The taste is horrible. We don't need fulvic acid to survive. Also, if you really want fulvic acid in your water you can buy drops in the health food store and add it yourself. It's a lot cheaper!

I purchased one bottle for 6.99. I wish I would have spent it on something else.First the water looks disgustingly dirty and it has some weird taste to it.Do not drink warm it will taste worse.  I will stick with regular faucet water.
What a joke!  Six bucks for a bottle of dirty water?  It tastes nasty and if you read blog reviews, it has no effect on your health whatsoever.
this water is supposed to sell for $2.49. why is it so expensive on this site? the one star is for the price.

column9: Fulvic water?? No need for that
column10: This was perhaps the worst water I have ever had in my life.It tasted gross, it sticks in the throat and you just wannaspit it out.It is almost 7.00 a bottle and has this supposed Fulvic Acidthat helps you. No, it does NOT help you. There isn't enough in it.This water is gross, ugly, and has gotten horrible reviews across the board.Everyone I have ever met will NOT even touch this crappy water.It is disgusting, and do NOT waste your money. Seriously.Buy good water.

I'm a huge fan of blk! I have a case delivered every 2 weeks to my house! I love the idea of the health benefits and the fact that my children drink it not knowing how good it is for them! It's a win-win!

My sorority sisters were telling me about how BLK cures hangovers, however, I didn't really believe it at first but it's actually a helped my hangover a lot!! I was basically dying during class this morning, drank 2 bottles of BLK when I got home and seriously with in 45 mins I felt so much better! PS. COME TO BU!!!

Tried it out of curiosity, (free sample tasting) well to be honest it was very bad. Just awful, tasted like tin foil!  The metallic taste lingered for a long while afterwards too.  The color is quite gross and it had a funny smell too. It gave me nausea!  My friend who also sampled it said she had gas pains from it!  So make sure you sample it first to make sure you can stomach it. To sum it up in one word - YUK!

I am familiar with the benefits of fulvic acid so I was curious about how this product would be. First off, it looks totally unappetizing. At first it taste like regular water but then it has an aftertaste that almost reminds me of charcoal.Plus, it is way to expensive. You can buy a good fulvic supplement for pennies per serving compared to this stuff which is pricey at the health food store and a little better priced here on Amazon. I can say that I will not be buying this product again.
Shipping was quick and product came exactly as described. Expected it to have a taste to it but to my surprise it had no scent or taste... Just like water!

column9: Fulvic acid has many good qualities for health
column10: Once you get past the color the water is fine, tastes normal to me.  Fulvic acid has many good properties and you should really read up before you decide "tap water" is just as good.  Tap water is full of toxins that the govt says are "fine" but why risk that.  Distilled water is the best, fulvic acid is worth trying more than once.
Love the black liquid and it tastes even better on ice. Would purchase again and again. I love this water.

Upon receiving I put it in the refrigerator to get it nice and cold. Drank it the next evening after dinner. Tasted like water with a little mineral flavor. I had felt a little under the weather, but the next day I felt perfect. Coincidence? Don't know but I think I'll be ordering more. It's the price that gives me the hesitation.

Like most of everyone here, I was a bit hesitant upon trying Blk. water for fear that it would have an acidic, ugly taste to it. People, DO NOT LET THE NAME/COLOR OF WATER SWAY YOUR DECISION TO NOT TRY!!.. **BLK. WATER** IS, BY FAR, THE BEST BOTTLED WATER I'VE TRIED. YES.. LIKE SOME HAVE TOLD ME.. IS JUST WATER... BUT CONTAINS MORE OF A MINERAL TASTE TO IT!!.. IT IS ABSOLUTELY REFRESHING!!!.. I JUST WISH IT WAS SOLD IN MY AREA (SAN ANTONIO, TEXAS). THIS IS A MUST BUY PRODUCT!!!..

I haven't tried this and nor would I at a price of 6.99 for one bottle of water..The concept of the black water seems utterly ridiculous and the price is absolutely outrageous. I can't see this product surviving

I LOVE THIS WATER!  It is different looking, but tastes so good and makes me feel energized in a body way, not a mind way, as caffeine does to you. They sell it at my local health food store, but I am going to look on here for a better deal.EVERYONE should try this. If we Alkaline our bodies..sickness cannot affect us.  EVEN CANCER....YES!  WAKE UP PEOPLE! THE FDA IS NOT YOUR FRIEND

Although I have not tried it, I have seen it on the shelves.  The concept is interesting and unique - but I can't bring myself to drink it.  For some reason, I'm  afraid it will turn my teeth black.  I can't see the point of making something that nature created clear,  clean, pure and natural and make it "dirty."

I've had Starbucks, then found Green Mountain to be an even better brand and then I tried Aloha Island and I love it!  Their flavored coffee like Southern Pecan seems more subtle but a true authentic pecan taste and aroma.  Each pod is sealed so that they are fresh when you're ready to use them.These may be a little more expensive but it's really nice when you want to treat yourself!

I really looked forward to getting this coffee.  However, the coffee pods smelled much better than they tasted.  I could not tell any flavor apart from the other.  Decent tasting but a regular Senseo back for 1/3rd the price tastes just as good.

These are not particularly sour and the texture on your tongue is like chalk. There isn't any nutritional information for calorie and sugar content. So bad that I won't even try to give them away. I wouldn't want to ruin a child's Halloween!
They are wonderful; tasty and very crisp and the packaging is wonderful for a big bowl of soup or justy snacking which I often do.

These are great!  I use them in chilli and soup, two pouches work great in a normal sized bowl.  They also make a great snack when you just don't know what you want to eat, or if you are just a bit hungry!  Highly recommend!

These are delicious with any kind of roast, beef burgundy etc. If you have any leftovers cut them up and cook them in a pan with a little butter. Another idea is to fill them with a mixture of seasoned ground beef, leeks, bread crumbs and eggs, pour brown butter over them and serve them with apple sauce.

The Panni dumpling mixes enable me to have potato dumplings any time that I want. Unlike making them from scratch, which is labor intensive and occassionally prone to failure (resulting in a watered down soup), this mix is almost foolproof. I have used this product for at least 30 years and have never had a problem. I get consistent high quality dumplings each time. This makes preparing a special German meal for friends so much easier. I highly reccommend this product.

Having lived in Germany, I've always loved this type of dumpling, which is a bit different from other (usually drier) types.  The slipperiness is not for everyone, but I love them.  My sister-in-law makes the best dumplings, and though I've tried using her recipe, I end up with either very slimy dumplings or they fall apart and make the water thick and nasty.  I gave up.  I went back to Panni, which I had used many, many years before, and was sooo relieved that they were as close to my SIL's dumplings as one can get.  Yum!  Bon Apetit!P.S., I cook them in water, so that my son can add them to stew or chicken noodle soup, and I add mine to either vegetarian broth or smother with vegetarian gravy.

If you like German cooking and remember the days of potato dumplings, sauerbraten and rich gravies, then you will love these! I made my own dumplings for over forty years, and sometimes, depending on the potatoes, they did not come out that great. But this mix never fails! I just add an egg and some parsley flakes, sauteed breadcubes in the middle when I form them, and my family and friends all love them. Sooo much easier to make than from scratch. If you have a little German in you (or just love German cooking), than you have to try these, absolutely the BEST!

If you have no time or no experience with German potato dumplings, PANNI BAVARIAN POTATO DUMPLING MIX is your product! In minutes you can serve tasty and flavorful German potato dumplings, especially for Bavarian receipts, like oven roasted PORK, SAUERBRATEN, SAUSAGES, PORK SHANK, etc.YOU and your GUESTS will love them.

column9: Another taste variation of a favorite product.
column10: For added taste - combine a package of the Potato Dumpling and a package of the Potato Pancake mixes together. Just be sure to only use the liquid quantities called for in the dumpling mix or you will have a soupy mess.  We've made it this way for years & it just makes a good product better!

Both the 5-Star and the 1-Star reviewers have a point.  German potato dumplings are an acquired taste.  I married a good German(-American)girl and we were stationed in Germany (Bavaria) for four years, so I've acquired the taste.  The mix isn't quite as good as the Gastehaus staple, but the dumplings are pretty darn close.  If you try them on your redneck dinner guests without warning, however, you're liable to get a 1-Star reaction.  They are heavy and gummy.  With Sauerbraten und Rotkohl, that's what makes them great.

column9: Got these for my Mom and she was thrilled.
column10: Got these mixes (12 boxes)for my Mom when she was no longer able to find them locally.  She was thrilled.  I asked her what she liked about them and said "they make a meal festive".  She's 89, lives alone and still makes most things from scratch but, after giving this mix a try several years back, she said she preferred it to all the work that was involved.  She said the mix is similar, if not the same, to what she made from scratch -- I agree.  And I'm happy that it's much less work for her.  I think she makes dumplings more often than she normally would because they're so easy.  And since she really enjoys them, I'm glad.She said they have a new box that suggests substituting milk for water and she's said that although she always liked this mix with water, she likes it even better with milk.We used to get this mix in NYC and bring it to her whenever we visited but now, with Amazon, it's so easy to just order 12 boxes and have them shipped directly so she never runs out.

When my German mother-in-law discovered this more than 40 years ago, she was so happy. After years of grating potatoes for her much loved dumplings, she could finally do it the easy way. Only she made a change. The box says to add water, she added a beaten egg and half milk to the recipe to make the necessary ounces. It makes all the difference. I have been doing it ever since she taught me long ago. I never did learn to make it the old fashioned way. If it was good enough for Grandma it is good enough for us!
We are absolutely satisfied and the continuosly service of each months delivery is just perfect for us.

i am a naturalized citizen of the U.S.A. bred and raised in Germany and very familiar with Panni products, I reaaly like them a taste of home, even after 50 years. Thank you for carying them at a resonable price.

I am of Swedish descent and learned to make potato dumplings from my Swedish Grandmother.  Since I am not as adept at it as she was, Panni Bavarian Potato Dumpling Mix is an exceptional addition to my mashed potatoes to make a dough that holds together for my dumplings.  My family has been thrilled because I can now make them without the constant worry if the dumplings would hold together in the final cooking.  I've had a difficult time finding this mix in grocery stores, so Amazon was a gold mine for me.  Now I can make Swedish Potato Dumplings whenever I am in the mood.

I am so happy that I can get this product on Amazon.  My Mom makes these from scratch but my daughter and I have both tried and they just fall apart. Thank you Amazon for making it possible to have our traditional German meals.
Unless you can successfully make these from scratch this product does the job.  Homemade is always best but these come really close.

column9: Just like my Greatgrandmother used to make
column10: These dumplings are a traditional food in my family. My Greatgrandmother used to shred her own potatoes but, many years ago, she switched to Panni. I was thrilled to find this on Amazon.  I used to have to run from store to store trying to find it. We love them with pork. Our traditional Czechoslovakian menu is dumplings with roast duck and sauerkraut. Yum!

I love being able to get this product.  We can't always find the Panni in the stores where I live, so its nice to have them come straight to my door.I grew up with potato balls as a Sunday staple.  Of course, my mother made them homemade and it was a lot of work.  In later years, Mom always used Panni when making potato balls.They are quick, easy and delicious.  A family favorite.
A staple of the German dinner table, these are easy to prepare as well as tasty.  I keep them in my emergency food section as well because the product has a good shelf life.

my grandma used to make these from scratch, which if you don't know is a big job.one day she made these instead and the family agreed that they are not as great but still delicious.besides a small difference in taste the mix makes the dumplings yellow.which if you make them from scratch is not their color, they turn gray because of the oxidation of the potates.still they are a great side dish.

I've used these for some time when making sauerbraten, but I find the product is not always readily available.  Buying 10 at a time seems like a lot, but when your guests taste them, it's always nice to give them a package to take home.  Make them with milk instead of water, and use a mix of half water and half chicken broth when cooking them.
Sales and shipping was perfect, no problems, expiration dates where good, much cheaper than in local markets, if they carry it. Good product, very happy
Very happy that we are able to purchase this item through amazon, and it arrived as expected, with plenty of time left before expiration date. Very satisfied with this purchase.

column9: Non-vegan, health-food alternative to Kellogg's Raisin Bran cereal
column10: This cereal is made with the following ingredients, per the listing on the box: "Whole wheat flour, raisins (raisins, vegetable glycerin, vegetable oil [canola and/or sunflower oil]), wheat bran, milled cane sugar, barley malt syrup, whole rolled oats, vegetable oil (canola and/or safflower and/or sunflower oil), rice flour, oat fiber, salt, honey, annatto (for color), turmeric (for color), mixed tocopherols (natural vitamin E to maintain freshness), cardamom seed, fennel seed, fenugreek seed, nutmeg. Contains wheat. Produced in a facility that processes tree nuts, wheat and soy."Each one-cup serving is 190 calories, about 80 calories more than Kellogg's Raisin Bran (KRB). It has more fat than KRB, but also more fiber and more protein. This bran cereal contains 2 g fat (18 calories), 44 g of carbohydrates (176 calories) of which 8 g is fiber. The fiber is equivalent to 32 calories, which are not digestible by the body and can effectively be subtracted from the 176 calories for carbs, bringing it down to 144 calories. It has 6 g protein (32 calories). That comes to a total calorie count of 194, which is very close to the 190 calories listed. The minimal difference is because carbs and protein are slightly less than 4 calories per gram, and fat is slightly less than 9 calories per gram.This cereal is described by the manufacturer as "whole grain oat clusters," and given that the recipe for making them is different than Kellogg's Raisin Bran, it is not surprising that they don't taste the same as that product. However, in their own right they taste quite good.This product is not sugar-free, but it uses natural sweeteners which are slightly less unhealthy than the white sugar, brown sugar or high fructose corn syrup that KRB uses. These natural sweeteners consist of milled cane sugar, barley malt syrup, and honey. The milled cane sugar and barley malt syrup are vegan, by the way, but honey is not considered to be vegan, so it is too bad the manufacturer added it to this cereal, or they could have had another selling point. In terms of health, though, the truth is, all sweeteners which are either fructose or sucrose, which each of the sweeteners mentioned above are, raise blood glucose levels. The advantage for controlling blood-glucose spikes that this cereal offers over and beyond what KRB provides is more fiber, more protein and a little bit more fat, all of which act like anchors on blood glucose levels, lessening spikes of blood glucose due to the relatively large percentage of carbs that any breakfast cereal contains, no matter who makes it.A true advantage of this cereal over KRB is that it contains no artificial coloring, flavoring or preservatives. (Note that the KRB ingredient list does not admit to any coloring agents or preservatives, which I find very odd and very likely a dishonest omission--it's simply not possible that it has no preservatives in it of any kind to maintain freshness. Here are all the ingredients listed on the KRB box and on the Kellogg's website: "Whole grain wheat, raisins, wheat bran, sugar, brown sugar syrup, contains 2% or less of salt, malt flavor.")What this cereal has used to color, flavor and preserve its cereal are an impressive list of very healthy substances. Mixed tocopherols maintain freshness. This is the form of vitamin E that is best absorbed in the body. Vitamin E is a powerful antioxidant that fights cancer and heart disease. Annatto and turmeric are used to color the cereal. Annatto is rich in antioxidants that function similarly to vitamin E, and turmeric is particularly well known for its anti-inflammatory properties. This cereal also contains cardamom seed, fennel seed, and fenugreek seed, all of which are strong aids to digestion. Studies on the action of fenugreek have also found it is helpful in controlling cholesterol and blood-sugar levels. Nutmeg has antibacterial action, in particular combating the bacteria that cause tooth decay. In addition, nutmeg contains compounds protective of the heart and that help prevent Alzheimer's. It also tastes great and, much like cinnamon, when used in baked goods or cereals, can cause them to taste sweeter so that less sugar is needed.There is no mention of this product being organic, though the company makes this sales pitch: "By effectively combining the finest all natural ingredients, sustainable practices and regular giving to worthy causes, Peace Cereal truly delivers Peace of Mind in Every Bite!"All in all, as high-carb cereals go, this one is a good bet. It is not safe for people with wheat or soy allergies, though, and diabetics would be better off eating a cereal with no sweetener of any kind and using a natural sweetener with no calories that does not raise the blood sugar like stevia powder.

column9: My Dog Thinks This Is Her Treat For the Day!

I had to start crushing them and hiding them in a piece of people food. It was such an annoyance, I began a search for a different product form and found Zuke's online.  They are soft, she can't wait for her Zuke's treat every day! No more crushing, I still have the tabs left and will now only use Zuke's. The product also includes beef, fruits, vegetables and more. I am so happy with this product, I will continue to use it. My little Echo has perked up, jumps, runs and one would never know she has this condition.  This condition, at this stage, is correctable only by surgery; thousands of dollars which I don't have. I thank the founder of this company, Patrick in memory of his dog Zuke. They also donate to the Dog & Cat Cancer Fund. I know this is a long review, but that's just because this product really deserves kudos.As a side note, my pain management physician also recommended "Golden Aloe" daily to help with the arthritic pain that sets in with this diagnosis. So she both and is doing well. She's my best friend, I'm on disability and won't be able to afford the surgery if and when it's required so I am really relying on these products to keep her comfortable for as long as possible and she is only 3 years old.

She loves the way the treats taste and goes crazy at the sight of the bag. She can now navigate stairs, is more interested in play and she even runs on daily walks all because of Zuke's!

column9: Natural treat our Bichon loves!  A plus for his joints!
column10: We've been feeding our Bichon Zuke's hip action treats for years.  He gets one each day after breakfast and expects it. Yes, he loves the treats; yes, he walks every day; and yes, we're hoping the Zuke's is working to aid his mobility.  Nevertheless, he loves the Zuke's treat and we like the fact that they're made in the USA and are natural. The chicken is great.UPDATE 04/17/10I've updated my rating to a 5 because I recently took our dog to the vet who confirmed, at the age of 12 going on 13, he has no arthritis.  In fact, both front and back legs have full mobility.  I do attribute part of this success to his walking every day but also to Zuke's hip action treats.  Digby's had a Zuke's hip action treat for years and this treat is the only joint action remedy we feed him in addition to Nupro All Natural Dog Suppplement for his other nutrients, minerals, and vitamins.  While Zuke's hip action treats are not the only reason he is doing so well, I believe this treat in conjunction with exercise and the proper diet have significantly contributed to his overall well being!

I have a maltese and she is 11 yrs. she was limping and I took her to the vet. They said she might have cancer on her leg and probably need to cut off her leg.I didn't have the money to take her back to the vet to check up again when is was crying in pain. So then I read others reviews on Amazon and found Zuke's. I immediately bought it and gave her 2 doses a day for a week. And now she is running around the house ans jumps again. My dog doesn't like the taste but I sandwiched between the sliced cheese and she eat it with no problem. Thank you so much Zuke's. From now on I will buy every month for her.

We would do anything for him and he returned our love tenfold. At the age of 12, our little pupcake began *screaming* whenever attempting to rise from sleep. Throughout that year his pain grew far greater...my husband and I were *forced* to have "that talk".  How much pain was too much pain? Were we just letting him live because we couldn't bear to let him go?On a trip to Utah, our friends saw the anguish overwhelming us.  They recommended we try Zuke's.  HOURS later, Raider was *running* for the first time in years!  He is now a happy 17-year-old, and ONLY ran into trouble the ONE time his Mommy was late in refilling the Zuke's. I kid you naught, the screaming is GONE, and has been since Day One.  We owe *so* much to that awesome hiker who owned Zuke and developed this 'treat' to help him out. As much as we wouldn't wish pain on anyone, we're so thankful Zuke had *such* a smart Daddy!!!

My 10 lbs chihuahua/doxie mix is a picky eater.  He isn't motivated by food at all, and it's always a trial and error when it comes to trying out a new treat.  His treats of choice are freeze-dried tripe, freeze-dried liver, freeze-dried chicken - you get the idea.  The boy has expensive taste - lol.That said, since he's now nearing the 9 year old mark, I wanted to begin giving him Glucosamine and Chondroitin for his hips and joints.  I started to notice that he has become a little reluctant to jump up on the bed, preferring to be helped up.  I think this is happening due to getting older. My usage of these treats is to help with prevention - better to start early before it's too late, you know?Feeding him pills is a hassle, and I'm already giving him globs of peanut butter a day to hide his Nutri-Vet Healthy Vision Canine Chewables (I highly recommend these pills if you have a dog with vision issues).  Anyway, my quest for a non-pill form of Glucosamine and Chondroitin led me to Zuke's Hip Action.I love that it's wheat, corn and soy free.  My boy has skin allergies and I've been doing my best to keep his diet as clean as possible.  Each treat has 300 mg of Glucosamine and 50 mg of Chondroitin.  The treats also have antioxidants thanks to cherry, blueberry, rosemary, turmeric and seasame seed.  BTW - turmeric is a great Indian spice that also helps humans because of its anti-inflammatory benefits.  It also has egg shell membrane meal, which according to the package helps support joint health.  So, it has good stuff in it.  It's also made in the USA.  After all the issues with Chinese-made dog treats, avoiding treats from China is important to me and the health of my dog.For a small 46 lbs and under dog (like my Ozzy), only one treat is necessary per day.  For a medium dog of 98 lbs and under, 2 treats a day is necessary.  For a giant dog of 138 lbs and under, 3 treats are needed per day.  Each package has about 23 treats in it.  If you have a larger size dog, it definitely can get pricey.I feed Ozzy the peanut butter flavor, because, well, peanut butter is one of his favorite things in the world.  Each treat is square and has a moist look to it.  It has an interesting smell - not one of my favorites, but not completely a turn-off either.  Just...interesting.  But the best part is he LOVES them.  His eyes actually bug out more than the usual chihuahua buggy-eyed look, and he happily grabs it and runs off to enjoy it.  He looks forward to it every day.Ozzy recently had surgery on his ear, and during the time after his surgery, he was pickier than ever with food.  He refused to eat even the raw beef patties that he usually loves.  He barely even took the peanut butter hiding his eye vitamins, probiotics and antibiotics (and this is a dog that loves peanut butter)  But these Zuke treats?  Heck yeah! Never a problem.  Just goes to show how much he loves these treats.

I don't usually bother with reviews, but these results pretty much demanded it. Our 9-year-old shepherd mix is literally a different dog since starting to take these treats. For the past couple of years he's been acting quite old - slow, not much energy, and often would have arthritic-type pain in this shoulders & hips. He would play for a couple of minutes and then lay down, totally uninterested in continuing. You could just see in his eyes that he was tired and old. A variety of supplements hadn't done much, and we felt awful that all we could do was give him aspirin for the pain. We switched his food to one with higher glucosamine, but it didn't make much of an identifiable difference. Last month, after he'd been significantly worse with shoulder & hip pains for a few weeks, I went online to research arthritis supplements and orthopedic pet beds (the last step before deciding to put him on medication). After reading reviews on these Zukes Hip Action treats, I decided to give them a shot and bought two bags on Amazon. OH MY GOODNESS!! It's been about two or three weeks now, and I am BLOWN AWAY. He's acting like a 5-year-old! He has more energy, he's jumping again, and his eyes look so much happier! That's the best part, to see him happy & excited again. Previously, it had been years since he would run with me any longer than about twenty minutes, and by the end of the run I would be dragging him behind me... this week I took him for a run and he went with me for an HOUR! And he was still ahead of me when we finished!! We're so hopeful that he'll be able to enjoy his "golden years" without the misery of a poorly aging dog. I'm completely a believer in this product, and we'll be giving them to every dog we ever own. (Plus, you just saved me a bundle on an expensive pet bed.) ;D

column10: I buy these for my nine year old Chihuahua. He has bad knees, hips, and back. He also has lost the majority of his teeth due to former owners who neglected his dental health. It caused her immense pain when moved in certain positions and caused her to limp. Running fast was out of the question and jumping was only for the lowest of heights. Even when she sat her left leg would be out to the side at an awkward angle. She was stuck in a catch 22. She couldn't make it stronger because it hurt and it hurt because it was so weak.We tried glucosamine supplements, but they were powdery and she seemed to not like the taste. The chicken jerky with glucosamine all seemed to be from china with an FDA advisory for liver and kidney problems.That's when I found Zukes hip action.
