And they love them!  I've tried all the flavors, and have not had a problem with them eating it.  They think it's a yummy treat, and get excited when I pull them out.  I would definitely recommend for anyone with older dogs.

My dog loves peanut butter, but she really didnt like this particular treat.  I've given her Zuke's beef treats and she liked it very much, so thought would try peanut butter.  She tolerates one a day (I'm giving it to her for the glucomasine part) but thats it.  Will go back to beef after this bag runs out.  Just a heads up!  I still like Zukes' products tho!
Love their products! Love the idea behind them and the fact they help animals with cancer!  Zukes for president please!

Only the best for our little guy!  He loves them.  I pack a few for our hikes and they seem to give our 10 year old LAB that extra boost that he needs!  I can see the difference in his energy when we run out of them so I try my best to keep them stocked.  They seem to help him!  Amazon is the best price around.  His favorite is the Peanut Butter!

column9: Best way to give glucosamine that I've found
column10: My dog loves these treats. I love how much more fun it is to give him glucosamine and chondroitin in a treat instead of in a pill or a liquid. These are pretty affordable, too. They also travel fairly well, and they are soft enough to break in half if you only want to give half of a treat.The only possible problem is that I worry about giving my dog too many of these a day. The package does have guidelines for how many treats to give per day based on your dog's weight. But so far "over-medicating" has not been a problem (especially if you break them in half).I've been really amping up my dog's walks and runs to get ready for hiking this spring, and so far he's not only limp-free, but the stiffness he used to get just after a nap seems to be significantly reduced. All in all, we're both really happy with these. I'll be buying them again, and I'll be trying out more of Zuke's other treats.

What can you say about Zukes PB Hip Action treats that hasn't been said already? My dog loves peanut butter and these treats are full of peanut butter as well as 300 mg of glucosamine and 50 mg of chondroitin which keep her 6 year old joints flexible for those long hikes and swims.And Zukes donates a portion of its proceeds to the dog & cat cancer fund every year and makes all its products wheat,corn and soy free-who ever heard of a vegan dog?

I bought these for my 13 year old pug, who has very bad hips and arthritis, and very few teeth.Poor ole girl, she's a sweetheart, but getting around was hard on her.  These are soft, so she can chew them with no problem, and while she's still stiff if she's been sleeping a long time, she loosens right up once she starts moving.She was on Metacam, which worked just about the same, but is waaaay more expensive.  I love that these are made in the USA and part of the profits are donated to the Dog and Cat Research Fund.  These are just a win-win-win all around for us!Almost for got to mention....she loves them!

Boppy gets overly excited when Rodan (grey crane) flies up from the creek, or a squirrel raids the bird feeder.  She has torn her ACL more than once - when she takes off at top speed.  So I now get her treats with glucosamine - so much easier than trying to get a pill in her.  She like the chicken flavor best - she tried beef too.  I like that it is made in the USA.  She does much better with her hips and joints - vet tells me it is really her knee that has ACL problems.  Zukes has a great product here that I like to give her, and she enjoys the good-for-her treat.

column9: I saw a difference in my dog
column10: I gave my  14 year old terrier these treats and really believe that these have helped him to feel better. He has lately been playing with his ball, (he self plays and had not been doing this for years) happy to watch him on long walks. He is very happy to keep walking. He is doing very well

I order Hip Action every month for my dogs, I think they like it better than thier food! I wasn't looking for a treat for my dogs as they are getting older my primary reason to purchase Hip Action was for the "medicinal" properties. I can't say I see a huge difference in the dogs agility because hopefully I caught the issue before the dogs had a major problem. A must try dogs love them.

These are great dog treats that are made with natural ingredients and my dogs love them.  I give them these treats to provide the Glucosamine needed especially for my larger dogs.  They get a very good grain free dog food but it does not contain glucosamine and my older dog needs it. Zuke's Hip Action really seems to help her. I have brought this item for several years and highly recommend it.
These are just great overall treats that my dog loves. Easy to break apart to make them last longer. My cats like them too.

My dog loves these treats, I typically try to give one a day but with all the other treats she get's often a day or two is missed.  No worry as long as you supplement the desired ingredients for hip/joint in other products or food.  The treats are soft and good for dog's of all ages, no choking worries.  The nice thing about Zukes is the ingredients list is not a mile long and they don't use meat by-products and you also don't see a lot of strange ingredients that are common in the mass marketed products.

The vet recommended glucosamine/chondroitin for the terriers to help with arthritis and knee problems. I can really tell the difference in my 11-year old dog. They love the flavor of these bites which have a strong meaty smell.

Zukes Hip Action are great treats for our dogs. Our Lab/Shep mix was already having hip troubles at 5yr. old when we found these treats. He LOVES these and is running around like a pup! Thank you Amazon for selling these at such a great deal. We would have paid about $20 for one bag (2 bags for just under $40) and here we got 3 bags for the same price!

column9: Great supplement that my dog asks for
column10: My elderly lab suffers from arthritis.  Her pain is greatly diminished by taking glucosamine and chondroitin.  Unfortunately she is not a fan of the gravy, chewable tablets or pill forms.  Hip Action has been a fantastic find because she actually wants her meds.  You can set a clock by her these days at 8 pm she goes into the kitchen and stares at the cupboard where we store the Hip Action and waits for her two treats.
My dog loves these treats and they really have helped her arthritis. I have reordered! I have tried some items from the local pet stores but nothing she likes as well and that works as well too!
Helps the dogs as they age and keeps their joints working. It must also taste good, as they practically inhale it!

column9: Zuke's Hip Action Peanut Butter Treats
column10: My two Chihuahuas absolutely love these treats. They get one at bedtime and follow me around until I give it to them. These are great healthy moist treats for a good price. Would highly recommend.
Our older dog has arthritis in his right hip.  These had good recommendations so I purchased for him.  He loves them!  Our retriever is younger but I've given them to him also just as a preventative.
These treats are good for dogs, all natural and yummy! My black lab loved them and went through one a day! Hopefully they helped with her hips!

My dogs love these treats!  They get one after they take their medicine, and there's no problem at all getting them to swallow their pills as long as I have the jar of Zuke's out when I call them over.

I bought these treats for my 16 year olo husky/beagle mix dog. Within two weeks she showed a visible improvement in mobility and seemed to be pain free. She has pretty bad arthritis and these seem to be working very well. The only issue is they are a semi soft treat so they were all pretty broken and in a big lump in the bag. But other than that they are a great product.

I was first introduced to Zuke's at the Health Expo in Anaheim.  They were kind enough to give me samples to take home to my dog.  Firstly, she loves them and she's picky.  Secondly, it seems to help her Arthritis.

My dog has a fairly sensitive stomach and is a VERY picky eater, so I'm usually quite careful with trying new treats. But he loved the Zuke's Chicken-Flavored Mini Naturals Dog Treats, 16 Ounces, so I thought I might as well give Hip Action a try. And he loved them!They are also a great value - I actually took the time and counted the number of treats in a 1 lb bag - and I got 64, which means more than 2 months of hip protection for dogs under 46 lb (you only need to give one a day).

I have been buying this product since sep 2010.  My dog loves this the most.  He sometimes refuses other treats but never this.  So it must be good.  It comes in one and a half inch squares.  It's a little big for us so we cut into smaller, bite-size pieces that are great for training.  We are still young so can't comment on the hip action part yet. I just want to give my dog a good quality treat and I think this is worth the price.
My dog really loves these treats - and he's very picky.  He is 11 years old and was previously having problems with his knees.  Since we have been giving him these, it seems he feels better!

column4: Eric R. Hale "Just a regular guy"
column10: Got these to help perk-up our "Olden Golden."  She loved them.  Seemed to help a little.  But, I guess there's no cure for age.This is a far better way to get your dog to take glucosamine and chondroitin.  We had the hardest time getting her to take a pill.I will note that the treats get stale pretty quickly if you don't seal the bag well (it's ziplock.)

I have a finicky basenji and he loves these treats. My dogs are also getting up in years but their joints and bones remain strong. I don't know if these treats contribute to that, but I've been giving them to them for a long time, so maybe so.
my dog loves them and I think they help her, even though we do have her on medicine for her hips. You can also break them in half if you don't want to give the full treat all the time.

My mom purchased a variety of treats for my dog to try.  He does not have any hip problems but we needed a treat that he would not turn his nose up at and not choke on.  The pieces are 1 x 1 squares, about 3/4 of a centimeter thick.  They smell like fruity beef bullion to me even though the formula says it is chicken.  I have a Bichon Frise (5 yrs old) and he likes these treats.  The texture reminds me of a Lara Bar but just a tad firmer/dryer.

I have been giving these treats to my dogs for the past 3 years or so. Never upset their stomachs and every time I say a word with "tion" on the end they get so excited.Great products, great ingredients and above all a very trustworthy company!

column9: Great product! My dogs love it!
column10: These treats are great! My dogs love them and they are natural and healthy. You can't beat that. : )

My lab loves anything Zukes. He will do almost anything for a piece.  I'm happy knowing it contains glucosamine because he is still young large breed and walks up and down stairs. It also smells good and is easy to break apart for training.

The vet recommended we give our dog Dr Zuke's Hip Action and it was difficult to find in this area so we were pleased to locate it on Amazon.  Our dog loves the taste of the moist chicken flavored squares.
My dogs love these treats but to tell you the truth I can't tell if they are helping their arthritis or not.

column9: Great little treats that dogs love!
column10: My dog loves these treats -- they're perfect because they're small enough, so I can give her lots without feeling like I'm giving her something bad!
I should say...my dogs love these! I like the ingredients as far as dog treats go. They are nice and soft and chewy. Make great treats!

I have a 12 year old Corgi that has been having problems going up and down stairs, has had no interest in playing with toys over the last year.  Went to the Vet and they gave him Rimadyl.  This helped some but still was having issues, and having to carry him up and down stairs.Started giving him the Zukes on a whim after seeing it in the local pet store.  This stuff WORKS I am sold.  He is playing with other dogs now, goes up and down the stairs, brings toys for us to play with him again.  He is like his old self again.
My dog loves the treats and she is actually less stiff after a hard day of playing!  A great treat for helping our pets to be healthier!
the dog likes it and doing well with it. takes 2 per day. standard poodle is 11 years old.
My 12 yr old cat has soft tissue problems with her hips and upper rear legs and Hip Action has made a world of difference with her mobility.I highly recommend this product.

column9: Green and Quite Healthy in Appearance
column10: I truly was surprised by how green and healthy these plants appeared.  We used them for wedding favors and are very satisfied.  They arrived quickly and were well packaged.

Sent this to my parents last Christmas (entering their 80s) and they absolutely loved the taste and portions.  Dove into a portion and froze the rest in the handy clear packs. My Mom spent a lot of time in Virginia as a child and said this brought back memories of her Grandpa's own smoked hams.  He sent a LOT of stuff like this up north during the tough times around WW II.  This company KNOWS quality.  A BEST BUY!!!

column9: Really a great beneficial bar that tastes phenomenal
column10: I have had this bar before and decided to buy it in more of a mass quantity because its cheaper. They are expensive but they are expensive for a reason. The quality of what goes into it instead of poor/non nutritional supplements. This bar is low in calories and is high in benefits. The taste of it is excellent and it curbs my sweet tooth. For me to even write about a bar is huge. That's how because i think its a good product. I hate bars that tote they are healthy and have poor ingredients. Why eat it? because its great for weight loss? Read the ingredients! If you cant understand the ingredients don't buy it just because you think it will help curb your appetite or make you lose weight. Their are sooo many artificial enhanced chemicals out there that we are exposed to enough. Try putting something purer in your body and you will notice a difference.

column9: Bar Great But Item ordered is Wrong
column10: This was suppose to be 36 bars a deluxe package and twice they sent the box with only 12. Very disappointing.
This is the best irish breakfast tea I've ever had.  I love black teas in varying strength levels.  This tea tastes so smooth and is very satisfying.

column9: Great for a Chewy Chocolate Fix
column10: Very good for a treat, really didn't curb my appetite but great for a chewy treat.
It's very hard to find these noodles where I live.  I'm happy to find a reliable source through Amazon for these yummy noodles to use in stir fry dishes.

Who would have thought? This is great stuff! Vegetarian mayo that tastes like bacon. It works well on burgers, sandwiches, in salads (egg salad, etc), or just by itself as a dip. My only complaints are the jar is small at 12 ounces, and even though the sodium content is relatively low, it tastes on the saltier side. I actually take the Baconnaise and mix it with regular mayo. This cuts back on the saltiness, and makes the smaller jar last longer.

column9: Baconnaise tastes just like bacon and mayonnaise!
column10: Absolutely delicious. My only quibble is that it's a little saltier than I'd prefer so I use sparingly. A little goes a long way. It has no pork in it, which is great for vegetarians. Check out the blog on their website, it's got a lot of tasty uses and recipes. It doesn't seem to be widely available in stores so Amazon's 3 bottle price with free super saver shipping is a good deal.

You have to appreciate the uniqueness of this product. For people bored with condiment options for sandwiches and other dishes, then this product is for you. It is a bit salty for those that normally don't salt their foods, so beware. On warm foods like chicken patties, the sauce does become drippy (although I found it to taste best on chicken). Give it a try and have fun coming up with ways to use it.

column9: Oprah loves it, so had to give it a try! A truly unique flavor!!!
column10: When I saw this on Oprah a few weeks ago, I was dying to try it. Gail and Oprah said it made their sandwich taste like a BLT without the bacon. Well, sign me up!!! I found its sister product, Bacon Salt, on sale at Today's Goodie (and Baconnaise was backordered everywhere), so I tried it first. LOVED it on eggs, salads, pizza... everything. That same site put Baconnaise on sale and I couldn't resist scooping up a jar. If you love the TASTE of bacon but hate the THOUGHT of it, this stuff is for you.

column9: Great Smokey flavored Mayo, but not bacon flavored. We still love it.
column10: I am a bacon connoisseur since I was raised on a farm and we made our own. I love all kinds of bacon, and just got diagnosed with high blood pressure so no more real bacon. 4 stars since I love the Smokey flavor this mayo has, but to me there is no bacon flavor to it, only a good Smokey flavor.

column9: Doesn't Really Taste Like Bacon, But Is A Delicious Treat None-the-less
column10: Ordered this after reading a review on the AV Club.Right off the bat, it doesn't taste like spreadable bacon mixed with mayonnaise.  It reminds one of bacon, and goes great with items that you'd pair bacon with, such as burgers, eggs, etc.  However, the flavor is much better described as smokey seasoned mayonnaise. It's a little on the salty side, but that didn't bother me or most of my friends.This is to say that it's delicious, and again works well on just about everything you put it on. It's also vegetarian, and fun at a party or office pot luck.  Most of my coworkers were scared of it at first, but enjoyed it after they had a taste.

column9: Everything tastes better with REAL bacon on it
column10: As a true bacon lover I looked forward to this with taste-buds a-tingling only to be disappointed. The bacon flavoring apparently comes from a lab in New Jersey. Has a heavy chemical taste, and especially after-taste. As a party favor or gag gift it's fine, but if you're really looking for something to add pizzazz to your food, just make it yourself or hope some other company comes up with a better tasting version.

column9: Tastey but possibly too much of a good thing?
column10: Oh how I do adore the taste of bacon.  One of my favorite indulgences is to actually spread some  J&D's Baconnaise Bacon Flavored Spread, Regular, 15-Ounce Jar (Pack of 3) on each slice of my bacon at breakfast.  I don't use it every morning as it adds an additional 80 fat-laden calories per slice.  Spreading it on your bacon is the meat lovers equivalent of the popular chocolate donut with chocolate icing... crumble some pork rinds over the top and you have the equivalent of chocolate sprinkles.

I want to like this, but alas, it is awful.I love the concept, and I appreciate the sentiment that this small company has. "Everything should taste like bacon" is indeed a fine concept. Do you know what is a good way to make everything taste like bacon? PUT EFFING BACON IN IT. This hell-spawned abomination has no bacon in it at all.Not even hateful turkey bacon. No bacon. Only chemicals. It would be a fair approximation for bacon, I suppose, if I had never had bacon, but had merely had it described to me by a severely brain-damaged transient who had also never had bacon, but had read about it on wikipedia. Suitable only for the filthiest of hippies, and haters of bacon.

Really unfortunate.  This tastes like neither bacon nor mayo.  Not good at all.  I really wanted to like this, but not for me at all!  I am amazed at the positive comments, I just don't know what it tastes like at all.  Salty, and creamy - but not like bacon!

I saw this product on both Oprah and Steven Colbert.  My local stores do not carry it so I had to order it online.  I appreciate the fact that it is vegan.  I LOVE it and think it tastes like the real thing -- without the fat and calories.  We use it as both a condiment and to make 'BLT's.'Everyone in our family LOVES it . . . even the boys who made fun of me for ordering it in the first place.  My family is hooked!

column9: Bad rap not deserved for Baconnaise
column10: Far more flavorful than mayonnaise and contrary to all the bad press, it contains LESS fat and cholesterol.
a taste of bacon without the messy cooking. Will not replace the bacon itself but it does give off enough flavor to fool you.

My girl surprised me with a jar of Baconnaise this week after I'd gazed wishfully at the jar in a couple of fancy food stores over the last year. I was delighted to receive it, since I'm a fan of all kinds of smoky flavors, bacon and otherwise. I've had vegetarian "bacon strips" and vegan bacon bits that were tasty, and I think even turkey bacon is okay if you cook it right, so the bar was not set too high at all.Unfortunately, Baconnaise can't even reach that Bac-Os level of fake bacon flavor. One small dab for each of us, and we recoiled and put the lid back on. If the label hadn't told me to expect it to taste like bacon, I have no idea what I would have thought it tasted like, but it would not have been bacon. Or mayonnaise, for that matter. Its flavor is complex, and I could see someone developing a taste for it, as with other products with flavors derived from yeast or other kinds of fermentation.That someone will not be me, though. I offered some to our three bacon-loving cats as a kind of second (or third, fourth and fifth) opinion. They couldn't get away from it fast enough either, and one of them even steals the vegan "jerky" I buy from time to time. So the Baconnaise ended up in the garbage bin. For now, if I want to add bacon flavor to something without adding bacon, I'll stick with the bright red facon bits.Maybe it's just an individual preference thing. I see a wide range of opinions in the reviews to date. I may still try J&D's other products -- they have a version of Bacon Salt that's free of MSG, for example -- but for me, Baconnaise doesn't live up to the hype, the promise, or even its own label.

This stuff is great. I split a 3 pack with friends, we all agree it goes on almost everthing.Extremely good on sandwichs of all kinds.Even good for making dips! My life is now complete. Bacon rules!!!

To me the flavor is crossed between thousand island dressing and bacon bits. If you like both of those, go for it. I put it on sandwiches and it tastes ok. Probably not something I would buy again though.
Shockingly good! It's actually bacon-y (beware though, it may be a bit too strong). Fun to bring out at parties, gets a huge reaction!!!
Baconnaise adds a great taste sensation to most any sandwich. If you like the flavor of freshly fried bacon you'll like Baconnaise.

I was soooo excited when my brother emailed me about this product, as I love both bacon and mayonnaise.  However, AS a bacon lover, they miss the mark on the bacon flavor.  You're better off just putting regular mayo and some bacon on your sandwich.  That said, my vegetarian friends (it IS vegetarian) LOVE it.  Granted, they haven't tasted real bacon in years and they also love vegetarian bacon (yeah, right!).  I rated it with 3 stars because it's a fairly good sandwich spread on its own.

First saw this product on The View and was immediately interested.  What's not to like about bacon flavored anything!  A great alternative to mayo on a sandwich with fewer calories.  Don't expect to find this in a store though.  Looked and asked everywhere but it was worth the search.
this is quite possibly the greatest thing to make a sandwich with. buy it.you aren't watching your calories anyway. it's addicting with turkey!
This stuff is soooo good! My husband and I love it on sandwiches. I highly recommending buying!

I, like many of you, was very skeptical of Baconnaise.  Let me assure you, though, that once this magnificent spread invades your sense of taste, that there will be no going back.  It is the perfect spread for sandwiches, subs and anything that you would want to add it to.  It has been featured on The Daily Show and other media.  You can order Baconnaise here on Amazon, the website or your local retailer. Interestingly enough, Baconnaise contains no meat. It is kosher.  Feel free to purchase a jar for your Rabbi. It has a nice smokey flavor with a hint of salt.  Baconnaise - Because Every Meal Should Taste Like Bacon.  Order yours today.
Now I can fulfill all my wildest dreams! Peanut butter & bacon, bacon toast, fluffer-bacon-nutters, nutella & bacon...I only wish they'd make a bigger jar so I wouldn't keep getting my hand stuck!
I loved the Baconnaise! It tasted wonderful and it is a great addition to burgers and breakfast sandwiches. I will order more and tell others about the product. My whole family now loves it!

I bought this because my son loves Bacon and always asks for "double on the Mayo".  He will eat pretty much anything, but this he couldn't stomach.  It was so gross!  He gave it away, and even his friend who will eat anything can't stand it.  Pretty nasty stuff, made from 2 things most people like.  Beware before you buy it.

column9: We are open minded but this doesn't taste like bacon or even close.
column10: We were hoping to like this fairly pricey product but warm or cold we found it unappealing. Thankfully we just purchased 1 jar. We would have been happy if it didn't taste like bacon but was tasty just on its own merits. But it isn't something we would put on anything. Our advice save your money and get some real bacon:)

I gave this a try, as I love bacon.  I usually use the crumbled real bacon to put in salads, eggs, sandwiches...So although I am not a big fan of mayonnaise, I figured if it made my sandwich taste like I had a couple of strips of bacon, well that would be really great !The spread tastes like a very salty mayonnaise with smoke flavoring added. Not really like bacon.  I tried it on a sandwich and most of what I could taste was the salt, MSG and a little smoke flavor.  Fake bacon bits sprinkled on the sandwich would have been a better choice.

column9: This stuff is deadly - as in delicious
column10: This stuff is sooo good, it's hard to describe just how scrumptious it is. Just get some - you won't be disappointed.
It's not real bacon, it's basically bacon bit flavored. But that's not a bad thing. This tastes great on grilled foods, and is a hit with my friends. Noone believes it's kosher dairy after eating it.

if you have tried and like the various flavors of Bacon Salt, you will also like Baconnaise...or if you are not a big fan of mayonnaise, you should try this instead...bacon flavored mayonnaise is awesome.I have put it on turkey, ham and roast beef sandwiches, Arby's Roast Beef, Wendy's Hamburgers, made chicken salad with it, and will be trying potato salad made with Baconnaise instead of mayo this week.for lunch today to take to work, I am making a wrap by spreading Baconnaise on a tortilla, adding Dietz and Watson Homestyle Turkey that is chipped instead of sliced, American cheese, shredded lettuce, and diced Bread and Butter pickles. Not only will the Baconnaise add flavor and moisture, it will also help to seal the wrap, and keep it together.

As a dabbler who enjoys spanning the entire spectrum of taste, I am more than willing to try anything once.  Both as a food aficionado and a lover of bacon, I just had to pick this up.  One taste caused me to throw out my sandwich, and subsequently throw out the entire jar of unused mayonnaise.I would give this less than 1 star, if I could.Steer clear from this unless you're a major tool who has no sensibility past buying bacon-everything.

column9: I like bacon - I like mayo - I do NOT like this
column10: I love bacon and mayo.  I thought this would be fun and interesting.  Well, it does not taste good.  It tastes too artificial.  I ended up throwing away the mayo after using it a few times.  I just couldn't make myself like it.  Maybe I'm too much of a foodie and can pick out the artificial flavors.  I definitely don't recommend buying the bacon spread.  I guess I'll just cook bacon.

I am not a picky eater. I love mayonnaise and I love bacon. Naturally I had to buy this when I saw it. After tasting I am baffled at how the company that makes it could have messed it up so bad. It literally tastes what I imagine a bacon flavored dog snack would taste like. I forced myself to try it on a turkey sandwich and could barely stomach it. I can't imagine how anyone could enjoy this.

I have looked high and low for this product after seeing it advertised on Facebook. I found some locally and couldn't open up the jar fast enough to try it. OMG, it is horrible! It is salty beyond compare. I mean, it is inedibly salty. And it has that fake bacon taste that just doesn't cut it. It's also outrageously expensive, which I wouldn't mind if it tasted good. Great concept but poorly executed. Will not buy again.

How can you go wrong with bacon and mayo combined into one delightful spread? 3 jars will last you a long time as a little goes a long ways with this product. Plus, it's a fantastic party piece. I set it out at every BBQ and get comments galore every time!
Baconnaise is the most delicious sandwich spread I have ever eaten.  It makes all kinds of meats/poultry taste fabulous.  Good when mixed in potato salad too.

I like this stuff a lot and tried it on many things but then one day it hit me like a bolt out of the blue. I wonder what deviled eggs would taste like if I made them with Baconnaise? In a word, delicious.Give it a try. You know you want to.

This stuff is addictive - it's great on sandwiches and suitable for vegetarians! The bacon salt is also good sprinkled in eggs or vegetables. I would not recommend the "Lite" Baconnaise though - the regular stuff tastes better.

After accidentally getting the "Lite" baconnaise, which tasted just awful, I ordered the original, and boy is it good! It's just what I hoped it would taste like: mayo with a rich baconny flavor. I put it on just about everything! Although it's probably taking several years off my life, it's well worth it! I've decided that I don't want to live to be 100 eating like a rabbit. I'd rather live to be 68-ish eating whatever the hell I want. And baconnaise is definitely one of those things I want!Highly recommended, just don't get the "Lite"-- (I wouldn't wish the "Lite" version on my worst enemy.) My only real gripe is the thin, cheapy plastic jar....
Baconnaise is DELICIOUS!! I spread a ton of this stuff over sandwiches. It's especially great w/turkey or chicken sandwiches, add some cheese & perfect!  It also be used as a great dip.

I like bacon on burgers and BLT's and was hopeful that this would give the bacon taste without the health concerns of bacon.  Big disappointment.  Smells like the Bac'n Bite dog treats I give my dog, probably tastes similar also.  Imagine a cheap store brand Mayo with liquid smoke and salt added you'll get the idea.  Full of artificial ingredients and chemical additives. Too salty and fake tasting.  I'll just stick with a good Mayo and skip the bacon.

This sauce is quite good and very full of that bacon flavor that everyone seems to love. The only thing I don't like about this is that it's way too salty, so use it sparingly because a little will go a long way. I guess by using it sparingly just one jar can go a very long way.Looking forward to trying some of the other bacon flavor ideas that J&D's have.

I like it and think it has a nice smokey bacon flavor, although salty.  My wife does not like and does not think it tastes like bacon at all.  Several others opinions were similar to ours.  I think it's worth having around in the fridge and adds a nice depth of flavor to sandwiches and hamburgers, etc... although as others have stated - go light with it because it definitely is salty!

Bought this on a whim, great Amazon pricing, by the way.  A lot less than buying from the Baconnaise website.  Now, my husband is hooked on this product! Me. Cat.  I am a hunter, a living weapon.  I crave blood, fresh warm meat between my teeth.  I yearn for crunchy bones filled with hot marrow.  Not Chicken and Tuna shreds in sauce. Last month I almost caught a moth. Ahh, the chase. First, my lethal approach...subtle yet as perilously accurate as an arrow.  Inch by inch I crept up to my prey, every muscle alive, every sense at it's peak, yet as silent as death.  The juicy moth just sat there, never sensing my presence.  I came close, very close, paused and then -- I pounced!  If the fools had a shorter table I would never have overshot the mark and hit the wall.  Damn them forever. Ever.Finally The Vet creatures returned me to my captors...but they would not remove The Cone of Humiliation from off my head.  "Two more weeks, Beebo, you need to wear it for two more weeks and then you'll be fine, azza bwave Beebo, bwave bwave boy."  That's the sentence they handed down.  The Cone of Humiliation is designed to break me.  It will not, even though the dog now laughs at me.  At ME.Let him laugh.  I have plans for him.  Yes indeedy. I have plans.The Two-Legs call me Beebo.  "Izzee my baby Beebo. Izze wanna skwatchie skwatchie ittle Beebo, come to Mommy, Mommy wuv Beebo" they say. To Me. Me, the Warrior King.  I am not a cocker spaniel.  I am a living weapon, a Cat.  Were it not for the ear-scratching, head-scratching, special pillow near the fireplace and opportunities to torment the dog, I would dispose of the two-leggers and escape.  I do not wish to harm two such well-meaning but stupid creatures, but I must have meat.  I would eat the dog, but I've seen what he eats, and quite frankly, I'm appalled.Please, if anyone is out there, help me.  Send meat...a box of mice...fat and juicy ones...would make a life of captivity almost livable.  Also, since you are putting the package together, I could do with another Feather on a String, two boxes of Fishy Treatz (not the liver, mind you), oh, and one more thing...a chicken bone. A nice, easily-shattered, sharp edged chicken bone...with a nice little piece of bacon to wrap it in. A gift for a friend, shall we say...Act fast. Please.

I bought this cat food because of the wonderful low price and I enjoy the adorable cat on the commercials. My cats did eat this food, in fact they really enjoyed it. However, after reading the ingredients and doing some research, I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my cats. The first few ingredients are (which indicates the most prevalent ingredients) are Water sufficient for processing, liver, wheat gluten, and meat by-products. By-products aren't even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product. It is just not a good quality cat food. I suppose you get what you pay for. I think the only reason why it was cat-approved may be because it contains artificial flavors that taste good to cats, and because I usually feed them dry food for dental reasons and wet food puts off much more of a scent for them to enjoy. I recommend to stay far away from Friskies, as it is simply a very low quality filler food. Even though the price is quite inexpensive, your cat will actually eat more than if you paid for a better quality food, because they will never feel full. Cats need to eat real, identifiable, pure, meat, and there just isn't enough real meat in this food. When purchasing a cat (or dog) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you can identify and would eat yourself- provided that you eat a typical (not vegetarian or other restricted) diet. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural foods such as Natural Balance, Blue Buffalo, Halo, or Wellness. All of those brands contain real, whole meats that I myself would eat, with no added fillers or low quality foods.

column9: Great mix is even better when prepared correctly
column10: I'm no chef but I love a good Belgium waffle. After reading all the positive reviews I finally gave it a shot. My first attempt was tasty not as fluffy as I'd imagine. I followed the instructions to the T and they tasted great but I thought I was missing something. After googling a bit about making waffles fluffy I found the solution!First separate your egg. Put the whites in a desperate bowl from the yolk. Then use a mixer to beat the whites until 'stiff'. You can do by hand but it does take a few minutes and Pretty rigourous whisking but Itll happen. There's a few really good videos on it if you google it. Basically you want the whites to be so fluffy and frothy that they don't move - kinda like meringue.Now mix your yolks and the water together and mix really well. Then slowly mix the flour in being careful not to over mix. Shouldn't take long.Now the fun part (Google this for a video too if you don't know this term) Fold the egg whites into your batter. The better you do this without over mixing or deflating the whites, the fluffier the waffles will be.Don't know why they don't say that on the box but I did this and just had the best waffles I've ever had! Good luck!
