I have a 3/4 box left of a Belgium waffle mix that I purchased at the grocery store that I imagine I would have to dispose of because neither my husband nor myself want to use anything but your Carbon's Malted Waffle flour mix.  Once we start on the last of the 3rd can, we will be ordering more.  Please. Amazon.com, do not discontinue carrying this item at this affordable price.
A very good waffle/pancake flour. Folks love the waffles and they come out light and crispy. Add a little vanilla.

column9: This is the stuff they sell @ Williams Sonoma for 3x the price! It's awesome!!
column10: I used to buy this at Williams Sonoma when I worked there and now I get it for even less!! we love it - both the pancakes and the waffles are awesome!!!

So my wife and mother in law only make pancakes and waffles by scratch, so needless to say they shook their head at me when I bought not one can but 3!  After making waffles my wife was sold on how easy it was and how really good they taste!  My mother in law said she still liked her waffles better (she likes the yeast flavor).  The ingredients on the can are all the same stuff as if you made them by scratch, without yeast.  The malted flavor adds a nice hint of taste.  Like other reviews said, I first saw this mix at a Holiday Inn Express.One down side, I dont like the flavor of the pancakes.  They have different directions on the can for waffles and pancakes.  The taste is just not the same with the pancakes. That being said, I didnt buy this for the pancakes so I still give it five stars.
I have been using this waffle mix with my waffle iron for years. It is the best around, light and fluffy and very tasty. You won't be disappointed.

column9: Best Mix you will find ... golden crisp waffles every time.
column10: Really the best ... found it at best western Inn in California at their Breakfast bar ... and had to buy some more.  I will not use any other.... Makes 1/2" thick pancakes too.  :)

column9: Follow the directions and you get awesome results
column10: I first tried this brand at Dons Drive In and they were the best pancakes I've ever had. I got them to tell me the brand and I'm hooked. Follow the instructions and you won't be disappointed. Makes great waffles also.

For years these were our "vacation" pancakes because the only place we could find the mix was at a seasonal shop in Michigan.  You can taste the malted in the waffles/pancakes and they are simply wonderful.

bought this pancake waffle mix upon amazon suggestion I ordered the Waring WMK300A Pro Professional Stainless-Steel Belgian Waffle Maker. I wasn't disappointed in adding to order, very good flavor. I normally mix my own from scratch and whip up the egg whites to make it fluffier... IF you normally buy mix anyway this certainly is better then Krusteaz mix...I doubled the suggested recipe on can, using 2cups of mix. made eight waffles..have 3/5 of first can remaining... probably will not reorder mix again only due to my required need to feed family of 7 people. looks like about 18-20 waffles per 33oz can

column9: Origional Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle Mix
column10: Anyone who makes Waffles for any length of time knows this is the ONLY mix worth buying.  It is the one served at the better breakfast restaurants. motels, hotels and homes.  I hate to give any product 5-stars because there is always room for improvement.  However,I have no idea how this product could be improved on.  Add you own berry's, bacon, ham, etc.  But don't do it too often.  It really is best right out of the container.

column9: as good as in the hotels
column10: We often stay a Hotels that have these waffels for breakfast. It's a lot of fun having them at home too!

column9: This the reason I joined Amazon Prime.
column10: It makes amazing waffles.  This is the brand the hotels use.  I used to make them with milk and water 50%-50% but straight water makes nicer waffles.  I can't find this mix in Canada, so when I am heading down to the good ole U.S. of A I order them online and pick them up.  Prime's 2 day shipping makes this possible.
Carbon's Golden Malted mix clearly has a malted taste.  It's no wonder that virtually all of the hotels that offer a continental breakfast offer this mix for their waffles.

I ordered this pancake mix when I originally purchased my Presto Flipside waffle maker and went through all 3 cans within just a few days.  We've had waffles for breakfast, lunch, and dinner!  (I think my family might be tiring of them by now.)  I've already ordered my second "3 pack".  We compared this to another major brand waffle mix (starts with a "P") and this has the other brand beat hands down.  I also love my Presto waffle maker.  It makes great waffles and I didn't have to spend a fortune on it.

column9: Greatest waffle pancake mix ever made!
column10: Oh my gosh...you will become addicted after you try this mix the first time. It has an old fashion down home taste! Everyone asks me why my belgium waffles are the best they ever tasted. I had to order extra cans to send my guests home with one. Absolutely the best!

I was a bit skeptical about purchasing what amounts to "special" pancake flour on the internet. However, I got my box, opened it up, and the scent of light malt vanilla greeted me. I decided to make pancakes at night!After my first few pancakes, I became a believer.  Not only are do the pankcakes/waffles smell amazing while cooking, they taste absolutely delicious.  My family agreed and wanted more.  They cook up light, fluffy, and I especially love the fact that when cooked, the color turns perfectly brown and looks like it came out of a restaurant. It is no surprise to learn that this mix is used in restaurants across the country.One tip that makes it taste even better: use real syrup. It may sound cliche, but in this case, real is better and will make you want to have pancakes every day.If you like to make your own waffles and pancakes, do not hesitate to get this.

I bought this to go with my new waffle maker, and it makes perfect waffles. That's the good part.The only negative (to me) is the sweetness. I can't eat more than a quarter of waffle IF I put maple syrup on it - just way too sweet. That's why I only rate it at 4 stars, and it's just a matter of personal taste.

I love this mix!!!!! It's so easy to make and ready in seconds!! My friend was surfing around in the Internet and found it. She tried it and let me taste it. I fell in love with it! It was sooooo good!!!!! :P I actually had it for breakfast this morning! I use it for Pankakes and Waffles. It is the best pancake and waffle mix I've ever tasted!!!! I would highly recommend it!!!!!!lollipopluver

Was planning to sell Belgian waffles topped with ice cream and a topping at our ice cream store, and went on a search for a quality mix. Based on the reviews, I decided to try the Golden Malted. It's very good, though at least in my Kitchen Aid waffle maker, you have to be careful to add a little extra oil or the finished waffle sticks to the griddle. Everyone likes the taste and consistency of the waffle.
I love waffles. The taste of these are wonderful. Very easy to make, too. Just add blueberries and you're even in better shape!!!

column9: Amazing taste and light as a cloud!
column10: We recently bought an expensive Belgian waffle maker, and first tried some waffle mix from the grocery store.  They were very good!  Then I bought some of this mix at Williams-Sonoma and the waffles were even better tasting and light as a cloud on the inside.  Amazon now sells the same mix for half the price!  My kids were amazed at the difference in taste.  Impress your family and friends with a waffle that tastes like it was made at the Four Seasons Hotel!!

column9: The best tasting waffle mix that you can buy.
column10: I first heard about Golden Malted Waffle mix here on Amazon when I was searching for a new waffle maker and saw that on pratically every maker this mix was recommended. After reading up on the mix and finding out that it is the same mix served at various hotels across the country, I decided to give it a try. I have to tell you that this is the best waffle mix I have ever had. From the moment you open the first canister and you get that malt smeel hits your nose, you know that this is going to be good. The flavor is great and it is not an overly sweet batter which makes it good for both breakfast and for using for dessert waffles with ice cream and fruit. Also I recommend using milk in place of the water when making the waffle batter. It makes for a much better waffle. So if you are on the fence about trying this mix do yourself a favor and order. You will not be disappointed.

Plenty of folk have praised Carbon's magical waffle mix so I won't tread in their tracks.  What I can offer is a delicious alternative using Carbon's magical mix.I'm from Texas and we put pecans in almost everything.  Here is a Pecan Waffle version using the Carbon GM mix:1 cup CGM mix1 cup fresh chopped pecans3/4 cup milk3 tbsp butter1 large eggBeat egg then add milk and melted butter.  Follow with waffle mix and pecans.  Don't under cook, it should be a little crunchy.  Also, don't insult by using anything but real maple syrup and butter.  Count calories at some other meal.

Everyone I know loves this waffle mix. It makes wonderful waffles. I've shared this "secret" recipe with friends since I found out about it from a relative. Last year I even purchased some for Christmas gifts! The mix is so easy and does not require special ingredients. I even keep a can in our travel trailer. I would suggest you order enough mix to qualify for free shipping because it keeps very well in the pantry. The waffle mix is wonderful as is, but I plan to try making them with milk or soda water as some reviewer have suggested. Enjoy!

I was invited to friends house for breakfast one weekend and she prepared belgian waffles with this mix and I couldn't believe how good they were...I've always loved belgian waffle in the waffle houses, but didn't think I'd ever find any mix to compare. I got home and immediately ordered the same waffle maker she had and this mix...My family LOVES it when I make them. I know some of you may think I'm a big dummy,but the mix calls for 5/8 of a cup of liquid and it took forever for me to figure out that 5/8 of a cup is 5oz..

We bought a new waffle maker and I saw this batter first at Williams Sonoma. They don't carry it anymore though, but I am glad I found it here at Amazon. My husband absolutely loves the waffles made with this mix. They are so light they melt in your mouth. Excellent stuff! No more Bisquit waffles for us!

column9: Excellent, easy mix - let it rest though
column10: This is a great waffle mix for using in a belgian waffle maker.  I use it most Saturday mornings (including this morning) and love that Amazon ships it to my door.  I have gone through at least 6 cans of this mix and have never had a "bad" batch.  This mix is far above any of the ones I've tried from my local mega mart.  One piece of advice- let the batter rest for about 5 minutes after mixing it.  The batter is easier to measure accurately and the waffles come out better.  Enjoy!

column9: BEST Waffle (and Pancake) Mix out there!  5-STARS!
column10: I'm pretty picky when it comes to waffles.  We spent a small fortune on our waffle maker (Chefs Choice Pro 850) and was determined to find the perfect waffle recipe as well.  So when my husband bought this MIX, I was hesitant - how could anything out of a can be better than homemade? Well, I soon "ate" my words and needless to say was delightfully surprised.  This mix is just as good - if not better - than anything I've made from scratch.  Yes, it's THAT GOOD.  Nothing compares.  I could eat waffles for every meaal thanks to my new waffle maker & Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle mix.  Can't find the mix in local grocery stores so we order it online from Amazon to get free shipping.

column9: Doesn't get any better than this!
column10: We first discovered Carbon's Waffle mix while on vacation at the Kennedy Space Center in Titusville, FL. We stayed at a Fairfield Inn and the continental breakfast included waffles and about everything else you could ask for. But what we kept coming back for were these incredible waffles. I've had nothing like them before. We begged the lady to tell us what the mix was and she brought out Carbon's Pancake and Waffle mix. It wasn't long til we got back home and I ordered it off Amazon right away. It arrived pretty quickly and it was just as good. My boys love them (ages 5 and 3). Whenever I have a day off from work they beg me for these pancakes/waffles. The texture, sweet flavor, and buttery taste make them almost like candy. They are best in a Belgian waffle maker as this accentuates the light buttery taste. We use a Waring Pro professional grade waffle maker. We had friends over the other night and gave them some of these waffles, and of course he took the empty can home so that he could order some for his own family. No doubt, we are sold on these babies!

This is the same product as used to be carried at Williams-Sonoma, for half their price.  The only difference is that there is picture of a waffle on the can instead of a happy child.It makes tremendous waffles and pancakes, and I know of what I speak, because I am a mediocre and inexperienced cook and can make marvelous breakfasts with this mix.

so i first ordered this on the 2nd or 3rd and i came back on the 11th to reorder another 3pack. Yes, they're that good and i live on my own so i'm the only one who's been eating them. I tend to buy frozen waffles and these are soo much better and cost wise, i think they come out about the same or less. They're more tasty, more filling and i actually freeze the leftovers and pop them in the toaster and they taste great! These are melt-in-your-mouth waffles and i look forward to making them. i purchased the villaware waffle maker with this and i just love it. I've frozen waffle in the freezer from before i purchased this and i can't go back to eating those. I'm a cheapie but when it comes to this mix, i highly recommend. I haven't made pancakes from these so i can't say how they taste but the waffles are SUPER!

Love this product!!  I used to buy ONE can of malted waffle mix for about the same price, so I decided to try this 3 can combo to see if I could get away from spending WAY too much on one can of malted mix at William Sonoma.  Tastes the same, possibly even better.  My kids love pancakes and waffles, and my whole family loved the first batch I made with this mix.  Probably the best waffles I've ever made.  Next time it is on sale on Amazon I will buy it again.  I LOVE THIS PRODUCT AND I LOVE AMAZON!

column9: Best Waffles I have ever eaten.
column10: I have bought this waffle mix twice and will definitely buy it again.  Had company over for waffles and sausage and they wanted to take a can of mix home, so I had to order more.
This makes great, light cripsy waffles!  Very good and cook quickly in a modern waffle maker.I recommend this Pancake and Waffle mix, can't wait to try the pancakes.
I usually try to make pancakes from scratch, but my kids enjoy this mix just as much and it's a lot easier!  This is a big hit in our house.

MOST - AWESOME - PANCAKES - EVER!They are very sweet & malty, but I've never had such an awesome pancake, waffle, funnel cake, or crepe as this mix creates.  And the aroma they fill the house with is like being a kid with a hand full of ride tickets at a carnival.  I can't ever go back to my normal shelf varieties - NEVER.  I think I'll stock up for the apocolypse, because if the world does nearly end I think these are good enough to make me not care.  And if society doesn't all fall apart I don't have to worry about ever running out of these.  That's a WIN-WIN.
I knew of this mix from hotel stays. When I got a waffle maker it was the first thing I searched for on google and then lead here. I never thought of looking on amazon for it. They are great.

This is the same waffle mix most motels use in thier hot breakfasts.  I have now made it my staple wedding present.  A big belgian waffle maker, a couple cans of this waffle mix and some gourmet syrups.  It has always been a hit!  Something they will use all the time.  LOVE THE TASTE AND EASE OF USE!
I love this waffle mix. This is served at quite a few restaurants, light and fluffy and a nice crisp on the outside. Now you can have restaurant quality at home.

Sent this to both of my children along with the Waring Double Waffle maker.  The waffles rival ANY that you can find at the finest breakfast buffet.  The malt just adds a wonderful flavor.  And ALL the grandkids loved them.  They actually ASK for them!!!

I used to only be able to get this at World Market when I drove to Spokane, 100 miles away.  The last time I went in to buy some they no longer had it so I started looking on line.  I have signed up to have it delivered every six months and now pay only $4.71 a can instead of $7.99!  This makes the best Belgian Waffles you will ever have!

These waffles are delicious and fast.  Perfect recipe and flavor.  I have always been against mixes because of how easy it is to make a batter, but it isn't about that with this mix.  The flavor is amazing and worth having a mix instead of a regular buttermilk recipe.

If you have ever stayed at a Hilton property or a Comfort Inn, this is the same waffle mix they use. It took me about two weeks to track it down but I finally found it and I'm not sorry I did. It is the best tasting waffle mix ever.
I bought this Waffle mix with my new Waffle maker and the mix makes good waffles, and the price is good, You get Big Cans..I am was happy with the choice I made for the waffles and the maker..
bought this to go with the waffle iron i bought as a gift, the love this product and continue to order this waffle flour

We fell in love with these waffles when we ate them at a hotel at each stay. Finally we found the mix online - unfortunately we haven't found this at our local stores. The waffles taste great - not like your everyday plain tasting waffle or pancake mix! Kind of pricey but well worth it to us, and this 3 pack is the best deal we've seen.

Good stuff makes perfect waffles. Tried for years to find the perfect waffle iron but it is the batter not the iron that makes great waffles. we use one tub a month so put it on there subscripton service. Good Eats.

I really enjoy this product.  I thought that this pancake and waffle mix was the best I have had. I was able to add the ingredients that I wanted to make it even better like raisins, blueberries, and corn. I appreciate the fact that amazon has offers such great variety

I bought this waffle mix on a whim when I saw it while browsing on Amazon.  I am so glad I did.  My daughters love the waffles made with this mix and they do remind us of the ones we eat when we stay at hotels.It is very easy to use.  You mix water, egg, and melted butter with the mix and you are ready for delicious waffles.  We have also made pancakes with the mix and they turn out very nicely.The container the mix comes in is a nice, handy size and stores very easily.  I am using the subscribe and save option which makes it very affordable and assures us we won't run out of the mix.

Perfect for making light and crispy waffles. My kids wanted chocolate waffles and Amazon is out of stock on it so I changed this mix to work. I added 1/4c coco powder, 1/4c white sugar, 1tbsp vegetable oil, and 1/8c water. These turned out very good! I noticed they stick a little more then the original mix does so be sure to re-oil your iron every couple of waffles.

This is good stuff.  The directions on the can call for one egg plus mix and H2O.  The result is the perfect amount for making two waffles with a Waring Pro Belgian waffle maker.  Thanks to another reviewer for the suggestion of freezing the extra waffle for later use, much better than saving the extra mix. The waffles still need something more, so far I have added pecans and syrup, and pecans and Brown Cow maple yogurt.  The yogurt is far easier and more economical for me than whipping cream.

I tried this waffle mix when I bought my new waffle maker and I am amazed how tasty these waffles are. Why would you go to the bother of measuring out all the ingredients for a small number of waffles when you can just use this mix? Besides the convenience, these waffles are absolutely delicious! I can't imagine not having this mix on hand in my pantry now. Definitely a winner.

This mix makes really great waffles in my Belgian-style waffle iron. It really is the best mix I've tried, and it is also better than any of the waffles I've made from scratch. My only comment on it is that it needs to cook a little longer than other waffles to get the crispy golden outer layer that I prefer on waffles.I have not tried the mix for pancakes yet.
I don't do a lot of this review thing, but I had to comment on this great product.  Light, fluffy, and a wonderful taste.  Containers are very storage-friendly. Highly recommended.

I bought this waffle mix along with a Waring WMK300A waffle maker as a gift for my family.  The mix smells delicious, like sweet cake flour.  The waffles are easy to make and taste great.  I sometimes mix the batter the night before so breakfast moves along smoothly the next morning.  I had never tried the Golden Malted brand before, but glad I did.  We'll get more once our 3 cans run out!

We bought this mix due to all the positive reviews. They were right, it was so easy to use and tastes very good. However, I felt it was missing something.  So I added a Tsp of Vanilla Extract to the batter before cooking and it made them taste more like the Restaurant Waffles.Would I buy Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle Flour again, absolutely!
Even my neighbors get up early to come over for breakfast when I tell them Waffles are on the menu. While somewhat pricey it is a nice treat with a great taste.
Waffle flour is extremely good.  You just have to add water and butter. It makes the best waffles I have ever tasted!
great taste just like I expected.  I have a waffle a day and the 12 year old daughter loves making and eating her own for breakfast.  Her friends love them.

Excellent product and has become a regular Saturday morning ritual for my wife and I. She likes me to mix in some mini chocolate chips in hers and drizzle a little chocolate syrup over it, and then whipped cream.I prefer plain or either strawberry or blueberry.  It doesnt take long to mix and we have found that it keeps pretty well so we'll make enough for six or eight and keep it in the fridge. All things considered,price,quality, etc. a good buy!
Bought this as a suggestion to go with UNO Waffle iron.  Makes excellent waffles.  Easy to use with simple steps.  One can is enough though unless you are cooking for a large group.
This mix is fabulous!! It taste just like the kind you eat in hotels. I got this as a gift along with a Belgian Waffle maker and it couldn't have complimented it more. =)

I purchased this based on other reviews and we had our first waffles this morning and they were amazing!  My husband is the foodie of the family and he said they were the best waffles he has ever had and I agree with him!  I also purchased the Presto Belgium Flip Waffle Maker (not sure if that's the exact name but probably pretty close) which also had excellent reviews and it worked great!

Absolutely the best waffles and pancakes.  Follow the direction exactly.  My whole family agrees that this is a super product...the kind they have at most hotels/motels that offer breakfast,,,,,make your own at the breakfast.
We found this product after buying a waffle maker.  It makes great waffles and even better pancakes.  You will love the malt/vanilla scent.
This product was very highly rated by most reviewers so I purchased it along with the Villaware Belgian Waffle Maker.  This is the best tasting pancake/waffle mix I have ever tried.

We first had this product at the "make your own breakfast bar" at a La Quinta in Dallas during spring break.  Everyone, not just our family, really liked it.  That's why I came home and ordered it as well as a waffle iron.  It's fast, easy and always comes out right...which is a help when packing lunches, fighting the clock, etc. each morning trying to get everyone out the door.

I was looking for a light and crispy waffle in my Belgian Waffle maker. The mix I had made decent waffles but they never turned out as crispy or as light as I wanted. Trying this mix I went out on a limb and even though it was a little more expensive I tired anyway. The Malt in the name was what pushed me over to try. I feel that the malt is a little lacking, but the waffles turn out great. I also tried beating my egg white and folding in after the batter was mixed and there was no significant difference, so just make them as the instruction says and you should be happy.

column9: best waffle mix on the market
column10: I discovered this mix several years ago at a world market, and have been making occasionally making a special trip (90 minutes away) for the stuff.  How silly, in this internet age. This seller has 3 cans for $16, essentially getting one can for free.  It is simply the crispiest, best-tasting waffle mix you can buy (and I have tried quite a few).
Not as good as I was thinking it was when I stayed at Hampton Inn which is what they apparently used. Excellet though, and good price.

I purchased this after having wonderful waffles at a hotel. I make these at home almost every weekend. They're so easy, just add butter, egg and water. You can also use the batter for pancakes. They're pretty hard to screw up. They come out golden every time in my waffle maker. I have one of those flip over waffle makers, but I'm sure this batter would work just as great in a non-flipping waffle maker. I've even used the batter in the place of flour if I've run out of flour.

The majority of reviewers are right....this mixture makes great pancakes and waffles.  I bought my husband a new waffle iron because he loves homemade waffles versus frozen prepackaged brands.  The pancakes and waffles are light, fluffy, and melt-in-your mouth good!

I was pleased to find this waffle mix available on Amazon.com in quantities appropriate for my family.  We have enjoyed Carbon's Malted Waffles at several motels we have stayed in and recently purchased a flip over Belgian Waffle maker, so we wanted this mix to use at home.  We weren't disappointed.  I don't know what the secret ingredients are, but these are the best tasting waffles we have found.  We were pleasantly surprised when the the order arrived in two days using the standard shipping! Thank you, Amazon.com for a great product and great service.Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle Flour, Original, 33-Ounce Cans (Pack of 3)

I absolutely love belgian waffles. I always look forward to staying at hotels where they have a "make your own waffle" breakfast. Those waffles always seem to be the best. Well, look no further, this is why. I received a Waring Pro flip style belgian waffle maker for christmas. Makes real, deep-pocketed, belgian waffles. Using this mix with that iron makes the best belgian waffles ever!

column9: Super but needed to tweak proportions
column10: I bought this together with the Oster wafflemaker.  I just ordered another 3 cans.  While going through the previous cans I periodically compared this with several "made from scratch" mixes (including yeast-raised).  This was by far the best.  However, I found the final mix too thin for easy use; it flowed over the side.  I resolve this by adding about 25-30% more of the powder mix and find it easier to use, while it improves the texture of the final baked waffle.
You cant go wrong with this waffle mix. I haven't tried the other flavors, but this is great.
Amazon came through with the malted pancake and waffle mix I have been looking for and at a great price.

I wanted a waffle mix just like what is available when we travel and breakfast is provided by the hotel/motel.  This mix is perfect.  I just purchased a waffle maker that mkes a waffle when you turn the iron over (just like in motels/hotels).  This mix is great.  I add oil instead of margarine and mix water and milk instead of just water.Bon appetit!  Enjoy
My familly all agree this is really the best mix we have used. Even my 3 yr old granddaughter loves it and she would never eat a waffle before.

My wife and I stayed at one of those motels that serve Golden Malted Waffles on their breakfast bar and we were so impressed with them that I asked the motel staff the brand of them. To my supprise we found an incredable offer on Amazon for these exact waffles. We order 3 cans every month and share with out closest friends.

This product makes great, crispy on the outside-tender on the inside waffles.  The flavor is wonderful, not bland at all.  Amazon's price is far lower than the manufacturer, which makes this a terrific buy if you make waffles just once in a while, or all the time.  Buy it-you'll like it!
This makes the best waffles ever!  Very easy to make!  Will be buying more soon.

Last year I looked low and high for a good waffle batter that was like the restaurants and hotels.  This not only is like that batter, but it is EXACTLY that batter.  You will see the boxes with this branding on it in hotels and food joints where they have great waffles.  One of the best things is how simple it is to make, just water, egg, butter and mix.I recommend one of the deep/thick waffle irons that flip because this stuff rises into a great waffle.

I purchased this because of the waffles that I have had at the Holiday Inn Express and Staybridge Suites for the past two years.  Got the name of the mix during a recent stay and ordered it.  It has not disappointed.  All of our guests have also raved about it and wanted to know where we got it.  We will definately keep buying this one.

column9: So good I sang a little opera!
column10: I'm not one to give a product review, but in this case, I definitely want to give my input. My first experience with this waffle mix was at a hotel a couple months ago, now I'm not a big waffle eater, but I had a change of heart with this mix big time! I enjoyed the waffles so much, that I planned to order the mix AND a similar waffle maker like what the hotel had as soon as I returned home. After reading the reviews, I decided to place an order last week. My package was delivered yesterday and this morning my family and I had chicken and waffles for brunch. So delicious!! I had read in the reviews to use milk(for better flavor)in place of the water as per the instructions on the can of waffle mix. I forgot to do that, but the waffles still came out great tasting, light & fluffy on the inside and crispy on the outside. Give this a try, you will be glad you did!

We have a great waffle maker, but could not find the mix we wanted. Tried many kinds.  While traveling in Washington, D.C., we stayed at the Holiday Inn and in their great breakfast buffet, we found the Golden Malted Waffle Mix and made our own waffle.  Ordered it from Amazon, and the rest is history. It is crispy and has that special malt flavor I love.  We also tried it for pancakes, but we like it better with the waffle maker.  Enjoy

Great product.  The cans are huge and are a bargain.  You add butter, milk and eggs so they are a little more involved then your basic pancake batter.  The taste is so much better though.  They are light, fluffy and rise a lot.  I haven't tried them as waffles, but I will believe me.  So delicious.  I am ordering other flavors as well.

After a couple of months on the road and eating breakfast at motels I fell in love with the Carbon 180 degree rotating waffle maker and their batter. So when I got back home I researched and bought a similar waffle maker, but it just wasn't quite the same without the Carbon batter. Now that I have the batter the waffles are simply perfect, and my families weight is increasing. Easy to prepare and use and simply delicious.

When I got home from work yesterday, my new Presto Flip waffle maker and Golden Malted Waffle Mix were waiting for me.  I made a batch immediately. The recipe was so easy - egg, water, melted butter.  As I mixed it up, I was afraid the batter would be lumpy, but it smothed right out.  I just used a wire wisk and a few quick strokes - nothing strenuous.Wow! The waffles baked up crisp, golden, and delicious.  We ate them before I could even get them in the oven to keep warm.  My kids begged me to make more for dinner, so I did.  We'll be having waffles very often.  We love this mix (and the Presto Flip Waffle Iron!)

column9: From now on the only waffle mix I'll use
column10: I read such great reviews about this mix that I really wanted to try it out. I have only made waffles with it so far, but what wonderful waffles they were! Yes it takes a bit more time and ingredients than your average mix, but the result is so worth it. For waffles you have to add eggs, water and melted butter. I used the batter in my new Presto 03510 FlipSide Belgian Waffle Maker and it was just 3 1/2 minutes to perfection. My daughter liked them so much she was snacking on the plain leftover waffles throughout the day. I think they're best served with real butter and maple syrup or strawberries and whip cream. YUM
The Golden Malted Pancake and Waffle Flour is THE BEST.  I didn't know my grandkiddos could eat that many pancakes - they loved them.  I'm using this as gifts for showers, events, etc.

I stayed at a hotel that offered the most awesome waffles for breakfast. When I arrived home I immediately bought myself a waffle iron(waring pro). I tried several recipes that were somewhat complicated and did not taste remotely as good. I came on amazon and looked up the name of the to this waffle batter that was used at the hotel and found it. I ordered six cans so that I would not have to pay shipping. The mix arrived today and as soon as it did I opened it and made waffles. I was not at all disappointed they are just as good and the recipe was very fast and easy.I HIGHLY recommend this product.

This product is absolutely awesome.  I first had it in the hotels that have the "do it yourself" waffle makers.  This batter is excellent.  We use it in our belgian waffle maker and the waffles are superb.  We also will use it for pancakes on the griddle and they are delicious.  The kids (and I) cannot get enough.

I bought this mix because Amazon was out of the Stonewall Kitchen mix.  It is easy to review elecronics and such because you can talk about those things objectively. In reviewing things that relate to taste and flavor, its difficult to say anything other than "I don't like it!"  So here is my best effort....the taste, the texture, and the color were all off.  I have only used it as a waffle mix so I can't speak to how the pancakes taste.  For the waffles, the taste was 'too' malty (yes, I know its a malted mix).  Also, the waffles were too dense and it was hard to get the insides cooked and the outside to look perfectly golden.  For me, Stonewall Kitchen wins hands down!!
The batter is easy to prepare, blends smooth, not lumpy. With the malt, the waffles are light & have good flavor. A real treat!

I've tried 4-5 different waffle mixes now.I bought this one because there are so many rave reviews on this item on Amazon.But to be honest, after we got it and tried it.  I wouldn't say it's as good as those reviewed them.First of all, it's too expensive.  In 3 days, we ran out one 33oz can and we made a total of 8-9 waffles from only one can!!!  That's too expensive of a unit price.On top of that, we made our own whip cream and our own cinnamon syrup all of which added the cost tremendously.  If we used this mix, we couldn't sell this in our restaurant.The mixer is not sweetened at all.  It is pretty after it's cooked.  Golden brownish color, looks very delicious.I added a little bit of baking powder to make it even more fluffy.I also added different flavors such as green tea powder or marshmallows to make it more interesting.I even tried putting small bits of mochi into the mixer and cook it in the iron.  The mochi got melted and chewy but very hot. So be careful if you use this recipe.Must have a good whip cream with this otherwise the flavor is not enough.

column9: If you want great tasting waffles, look no further!!
column10: I have enjoyed Carbon's Golden Waffle's for years now. These are the best waffle's you will ever encounter. Trust me, once you make and eat these bad boys, you will be hooked for life!!
DO YOU WANT A PRODUCT YOU WILL LOVE AND LOVE TO EAT THEN BUY THIS IT IS THE BEST I EVER HAD AND BETTER THEN GOING OUT TO BUY

I was tired of the store bought pancake mix and was looking for that restaurant taste.Looks like I have found what I was looking for in Carbon's Pancake and Waffle Flour.From the moment that I opened the can I could smell the differents.Then when I make the first batch and tasted them I know that I had found what I had been looking for.So light and fluffily I could not have asked for any better.When I get a waffle iron I will be trying them next.
If you want to make your home smell like the free breakfast bar at a mid-priced hotel, this is the product you need.  8^)

column9: Golden Malted Will Ruin Your Taste For Other Pancake/Waffle Mixes
column10: Your search is over.THIS is the Holy Grail of pancake & waffle flour.I used to buy Carbon's Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle Flour at a fancy pants gourmet store (and later from a fancy pants mail-order/online catalog) for our annual Christmas Holiday breakfast, and grudgingly returned to the brands available in the supermarket for the rest of the year.But I suffer no more. Thanks to Amazon, I can now afford to enjoy sublime pancakes and even more sublimer(?) waffles throughout the year.The praise that the other reviewers have lavished on this pancake & waffle flour is richly (get it?) deserved.

column9: Best waffle mix you can buy!
column10: My wife had been hinting that she wanted a waffle iron, so I got her one for Mother's Day (yeah, I know, I'm such a romantic!  :p ).  She loves waffles, so she started using it every weekend, making us and the kids a tasty breakfast.  The only problem was, there was something just not *quite* right about the taste.We tried all the brands, Krusteaz, Hungry Jack, Aunt Jemima, but never found that certain taste we expected.  Then I remembered that every hotel I've stayed at that offers breakfast displayed a sign that they use Carbon's Golden Malted waffle flour.So, on a lark, I check Amazon, and sure enough, here it is!  I ordered a pack, and three days later (thanks to Amazon Prime), my wife made waffles.  We both agreed - THIS was the taste we were expecting when we thought of waffles!Very tasty stuff, and we can get about 3-4 breakfasts from a single can.

I thought that this pancake and waffle mix was very good. I was able to add the ingredients that I wanted to make it more personal. I appreciate the fact that amazon has made it possible for small companies to sell their products online.
This waffle mix is so tasteless.  I'm shocked to hear this is the brand that is sold in some hotels. I would not recommend it to anybody.
this is a great pancake but i expected more of a malted taste and there is none.  i will enjoy the whole order but may not reorder rhis 'MALTED PANCAKE MIX"
My family was un-believing when this came in the mail, then they said  what add eggs and oil,  come on they said.Well the proof is in the 'waffle' !  great stuff  good-bye bisquik!

column9: great price and great item for so little!
column10: This three can pack of pancake and waffle flour is to go with the Belgian waffle maker I ordered...the one that turns upside down and bakes two at a time...It is intended as a Christmas gift for my son, and this gift goes along with it. Hoping he will make pancakes/waffles for us Christmas morning!
The waffles were good, but for some reason they didn't have the malt taste that the ones I had at the motel. Fixed them for company and they enjoyed them.  Haven't tried fixing pancakes yet.
I don't know if I got an old batch but this stuff is horrible.  Mine has no malt flavor.  In fact, it has almost no flavor to it all.  It is bland and disgusting.

I didn't read the product info very carefully before buying it, and didn't realise that one had to add oil, water and an egg. It doesn't save much more time than making the mix from scratch, therefore, but it tastes good.

column9: Luckily I placed 2 in my cart by accident
column10: I actually did research on waffle irons before I bought one for my father. One thing I kept running across was the fact that people were recommending the Golden Malted waffle mix. I figured it would be a good idea to order the mix along with the iron, I mean what good is a great waffle iron if the recipe is lacking? :) Well it turns out I put it in the cart twice so I ended up with 6 cans instead of 3...."I sure hope he likes it" I thought when receiving the "case" of waffle mix.He hasn't stopped bragging on his great waffles, had them 3 days in a row. I'm thinking that he will be able to use all 6 cans afterall. haha

I bought this product after reading so many positive reviews, and unfortunately, I am not a big fan like everyone else.  We have tried it twice, following the recipe exactly as it states and we found the waffles to be bland at best.  We prefer the Bisquick version which is much cheaper than buying this.  Oh well, we tried.  You can buy waffle mixes at your local grocery stores better than what this taste.UPDATE: Because the order is a pack of 3, we decided to give one to our neighbors to try and see if we were being picky.  They also did not care for this product at all. They said they were dry and had no taste.  They even wondered if the other reviews on here were authentic since they could not understand what was all the fuss about.Now what shall I do with the third can?

The rave reviews for Carbon's Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle Flour are a mystery to me. This pancake mix is mediocre. Nearly all of the rave reviews have come from people who use the mix to make waffles. The few who have made pancakes have found the mix to be very disappointing. Although this mix is called "malted," it lacks malt (or any other) flavor. The pancake texture isn't particularly good either. If you live in Michigan, Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, or Kentucky, go to your local Meijer grocery store and buy their brand of malted pancake mix. The malt taste and fluffy texture are far superior to Carbon's, and the mix costs less than half as much. If you don't live in one of those states and are primarily interested in making pancakes, use Amazon to order Bruces, Mix Pancake Sweet Potato, 24-Ounce (12 Pack) or Heidi's Cottage Classics Oats n' Apple Pancake Mix, 12-Ounces (Pack of 6), both of which are unique and much better for pancakes than Carbon's. I haven't used Carbon's mix to make waffles, but I'm guessing that the rave reviews are due to the texture, since flavor is lacking. Carbon's mix is a very fine powder, similar to cake flour, and apparently this results in a better waffle (though not necessarily a better pancake). Since Meijer's mix is also a very fine powder, it would probably also make great waffles in addition to delicious malt-flavored pancakes. Don't let the hype fool you into thinking that Carbon's mix is something special. It's good but not great.

With the packaging well done and wrapping inside to secure items, for reasons unknown one of the three cans was bent out of shape restricting the cap from being placed on, also the seal was broken and powered in the packaging.Unpleasing to find this discovery.Message about packaging review was sent with photo comparing a regular can to the deformed crippled one.

After reading all the great reviews and being a waffle lover I had a friend get me a can.  He carried it half way around the world for me.  Followed the directions to a Tee, used my George Foreman waffle grill and it made beautiful golden waffles.  Take away the butter, maple syrup and blue berries and it taste like nothing, cardboard must taste better.  Made my first and last batch, even the cheap mix is better than this, yuck!  Don't waste your money on this tasteless product!  Can I give a half star, or no star???

This waffle mix is good, and better than most, but it is grossly overrated. Yes, it smells absolutely AMAZING, but it is seriously lacking in flavor. Be prepared to doctor up this flour with flavor extracts, sugar, and extra oil.If you want to fill your house with a wonderful aroma, this is your answer. If you want to cook excellent waffles, change up the ingredients and experiment, of course you could do this all purpose flour for much cheaper.

I've used half a cannister and I've yet to come up with a good waffle.  They are always doughy.  I gave the rest of product to a neighbor who also was not pleased with it.  I don't know if I used too much butter or what the problem was. I went back to my regular brand Krusteaz.

I dont even know if the product taste any good but I need to give only 1 star for them. I opened the box,they were packed very poorly, 2 of the 3 can which were made of cardboard papers broke in half which created flour all over the box. The only good can was all covered and got pretty dirty, too much work . I am very disappointed and I need to say I never gave 1 star to anything , and this product deserves it.I actually want to return them.

column9: Incredible value for this top quality mix.
column10: Our family owns 3 Pancake and Waffle franchise restaurants.  This is the exact mix that we use in our stores.  Honesty prevent us from using the business supplies for personal use so we buy this mix on Amazon instead - it ends up at about the same price!!  We have tested a few other mixes and recipies that are slightly better tasting, but they are a royal pain in the neck to pre-make, store, and they cost 5-10 times more per waffle!!  Unless you have lots of time to devote to more involved waffle making, this is a 4.9 star product for taste and 5.5 star for ease of use.

Having been a waffle lover for more than 80 years I feel that I am eminently qualified to be a judge of what waffles should taste like. Add to that the fact that I had, before retiring, been a Quality Control Manager for 42 years. I know Quality.The only problem my wife and I had with the results was, she likes thin waffles  and I like thick. We solved that problem by making a thin batter and made her'sand we then added some more of the flour and made mine. That in turn made us overly delighted with the results.Never having been satisfied we decided to try the mixture on a batch of pancakes and the results were SUPER.We have tried every kind of recipe I can think of and nothing, and I mean nothing compares with the waffles and pancakes we had with Golden Malted Waffle Pancake Flour.Great Job and thanks.

You have probably had these waffles before if you've ever gone to a gourmet ice cream shop and they make those waffle cones for you while you wait.  The waffles are decent, and I suppose most people would like them,  I found them a bit too sweet and too much butter . . so you may have to adjust the recipe somewhat.  I thought the pancakes were horrible using this product  .  . . Aunt Jemimah won't be losing any sleep over this pancake mix, that's for sure.Bottom line:  Pretty good waffles if you like them sweet like a waffle cone . .  Pancakes are not as good as store bought brands.  I wanted to return the unused cans, but Amazon won't let me return grocery products.

column9: Found the Waffles I have been looking for!!
column10: My family and I stayed at a Hampton Inn while on vacation and had breakfast at their breakfast bar. I LOVED the waffles they served! I had never tasted waffles like that before! Months passed by and all I could think about were THOSE waffles. I tried various recipes at home and nothing came close to the texture and taste of the ones I had while staying at Hampton Inn. FINALLY, after alot of research online I found out the brand that they used- CARBON'S GOLDEN MALTED. The day I got my package in the mail I made a batch- they were sooo good- We decided to have breakfast for dinner!!

I purchased a waffle maker after enjoying the waffles at a motel breakfast bar.  I tried many recipes, but never got close to the flavor that I was looking for.  When I enjoyed the same wonderful waffles at another motel, I noticed the brand name and found the mix on Amazon.  I don't know why I didn't sign up for auto delivery, but I will when I order again.

I pride myself on making things fom scratch but this is an exception.  I decided to give it a try. I have to tell you that this is the best waffle mix I have ever had. From the moment you open the first canister and you get that malt smeel hits your nose, you know that this is going to be good. The flavor is rally nice and it is not an overly sweet batter which makes it good for both breakfast and for using for dessert waffles with tofu and fruit. Also I suggest using milk in place of the water when making the waffle batter. It makes for a much better waffle. So if you are on the fence about trying this mix do yourself a favor and order. You will not be disappointed. I first heard about Golden Malted Waffle mix here on this web site. when I was searching for a new waffle maker and saw that on pratically every maker this mix was recommended.

column9: Ah, the quest for the perfect malted waffle...
column10: So far, this is the best malted waffle mix I've used, and while it's close to some of the best waffles I've had in hotels, there's a little something missing... I'm not sure what it is, but I think I'm expecting even more of a malt taste. When you open the can and while cooking, the malt and vanilla aroma is there, but the malt taste, while it is there, is on the subtle side. The texture is great -- crispy, light and airy. Don't get me wrong, this is really good stuff and the best I've ever been able to make at home, but I'm still willing to experiment with other brands to find that grail of the waffle mixes. I also am curious about adding some Carnation Malt Powder to the mix, but that would involve increasing the liquids to balance the mix, and that requires a little more figuring on my part... But for now, this mix is king -- you're sure to enjoy!

column9: The best waffle mix we have ever found!
column10: We love eating waffles at our house, & have traditionally made belgium style waffles from scratch.  A friend introduced us to Carbon's Golden Malted, touting the quality of the waffles it made.  I was skeptical, but definitely agreed after tasting our 1st batch.  The mix makes light and fluffy waffles without the fuss of whipping eggs and folding batter.  The malt in the flour adds a welcome "nutty" taste as well.  This product has never failed us.

If you are buying a new waffle Iron, or just want some very tasty waffles, this stuff IS really pretty good. Actually, most name-brand Waffle mixes made with an egg and milk in the batter instead of instant with water, with a very light splash of Vanilla will make really good waffles. Be sure to have the  large jar of strawberry preserves and whipped cream and a quality Maple Syrup on hand. I use Log Cabin Maple Syrup. I make a large batch of 7" waffles on Waffle day once each month, and plastic wrap them individually, and freeze them.  10 mins in the toaster oven on 350 degrees makes them ready for eating.  Waffles are way more fun to eat, than dull looking pancakes. And they hold the syrup and toppings better for each bite. Dammit,....I want one NOW.

column9: Great waffles with very little effort!
column10: Love this mix.  Found this when I did a web search for best waffle mixes and it definitely met our expectations.  Most pre-mix waffle batters are too pancakey and don't get the right texture.  After trying several from scratch recipes, I was beginning to think there was no easy way to make great waffles.  This mix is simple (egg, water, butter, mix) and tastes great.  The waffles are crispy but not dry and the flavor is just right.Definitely will be ordering more of this!

This mix makes very good and tasty waffles. However, they are just very good and do not reach over into excellent or extremely delicious. When you first open the mix, the flour smells wonderful! You get a distinct malt scent and it makes your mouth water. To make waffles, you add water, egg and melted butter to the mix. Once the waffles are cooked, the mix browns and crisps nicely on the outside and the inside of the waffles are soft and fluffy. Upon tasting them, there is only a slight hint of the malt flavor and they are just a bit bland, especially compared to the initial scent of the mix. But the waffles are still very good and get even better with some good syrup.I tweaked the recipe by using half and half rather than water and adding vanilla extract to part of a batch and molasses to another. That substantially improved the taste. As a base mix, this was very good and made tasty if not outstanding waffles. But I can see unlimited potential for tweaking this mix by adding various enhancements and taking waffles to new taste directions. Overall, I enjoyed the waffles and yes, I do recommend this.

I've been buying this product for at least 5yrs or more. Easy to make and they taste wonderful. They are light and not heavy in your stomach. My kids love them, and they're great with vanilla icecream and hot fudge. Well worth the money to buy on Amazon. A lot cheaper than the store.

column9: Definitely an award-winning and YUMMIEST waffle mix ... ever ...
column10: Have you wondered (or are you still wondering) why the hotel's waffle mix tastes so good, and it seems like you have a hard time replicating the recipe with the waffle mix you got from the grocery stores ?Well, I have and it was baffling! I didn't give up on my wish to be able to make the YUMMIEST waffle at my own kitchen.I went to Amazon.com and encountered this product "Golden Malted" Waffle mix. Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle Flour, Original, 33-Ounce Cans (Pack of 3)At first, I was hesitant, especially after seeing that it only comes in a pack of 3 -- "I still have those 'failed' old waffle flours in the kitchen, why would I buy 3 to simply try? "After extensive reviews both on amazon and google, I decided to try it as a lot of people gave it good ratings and agreed that it tastes like the hotel's waffle mix.The result ? OMG, the waffle was mouth-watering. I followed the recipe written: Mix waffle flour + eggs + some water + butter.Using a Belgian waffle maker, cooking was about 5 min. The aroma was just heavenly. I paired it with "Grade B - dark amber" Real Mapple Syrup Coombs Family Farms 100% Pure Organic Maple Syrup Grade B, 32-Ounce Jug. (Yes, there are imitation waffle syrup out there!) It was really the YUMMIEST waffle I ever made -- crispy on the outside, moist in the inside and it's not heavy (like pancakes)I have been buying this waffle mix and truly recommend it to those who have been in 'the hunt of the perfect waffle mix'They have the "all natural" Golden Malted All Natural Waffle & Pancake Mix, 33-Ounce Containers (Pack of 3) and "blueberry flavored" Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle Flour, Blueberry, 16-Ounce Cans (Pack of 4). I have not tried these. And, I think I am staying with the "original".Enjoy !

column4: Jasmine Rose Reyes "Confessions of a Shopaholic"
column10: I hardly write reviews... but ironically i rely on them on most of my purchases on Amazon. I am a HUGE Amazon shopper. Everything i buy is from here. I have PRIME (which is awesome).This waffle mix is by far the best you can get. YOu will not be disappointed. It's fluffy and soft and i've ordered about 22 cans because all my cousins and family want some.I use the Proctor waffle maker which is perfect too that I also bought from amazon.For anyone that has been buying the store bought waffle mixes you MUST convert to this one!

Having purchased Stonewall Kitchen Waffle mix and thoroughly enjoying the wonderful Belgian waffles, I decided to try Carbone's Golden mix.  When traveling, we have fixed ourselves waffles at the breakfast bar of Hampton Inn and learning that this is the mix used by that chain, I thought it was worth trying at home.  The price differential was a big factor in so doing, I must admit. Though a very satisfactory product, the flavor does not rise to the level of Stonewall Kitchen and my next purchase will be reverting to that product.

column9: BEST Waffle/Pancake Mix I ever Tasted!
column10: This mix makes the best waffles and pancakes ever!!  The waffles come out perfectly crispy, light and delicious (I like mine very well done so I set my waffle iron accordiingly).  I also love the pancake mix.  I make the mix a bit thinner than the recipe calls for and they make up tender and scrumptious.  Another thing that I really like is that the mix is easy to get smooth with just a bit of stirring with a regular fork.  This definitely has a permanent place in my pantry!

When we first got out new belgian waffle maker, we made a few throw-away batches to break it in and then made our first true made-to-eat waffle using the store bought Aunt Jamima and it tasted OK.  The next day my partner used the Golden Malted Pancake mix (which is actually healthier according to nutirition label) and it tasted 10X as good as the other.  In fact, just as good as any restuarant or hotel I've partaken at.  Keep in mind, I'm more of a bacon and eggs person, and now I can't wait to eat a waffles.

column9: needs buttermilk and real butter to get that Wow! factor
column10: I fiddled with the recipe on the canister and found that the liquid must be buttermilk although buttermilk powder is one of the ingredients and that butter not oil must be used to make these waffles worth eating in my family.  They're fantastic.  Waffles and pancakes are basically delivery systems for butter.

For years I used Krusteaz Waffle mix and added extras to make it better like oil, eggs, vanilla and salt. This waffle mix is the best I have ever used!  I do add a little pure vanilla extract and a little salt and I use 1% milk instead of the water it calls for. These are the best darn waffles my husband and I have ever eaten so give this a try if you love waffles!
This mix makes waffles just like the hotels or Waffle House.  It is great.  I bought a Waring Pro waffle maker so I could duplicate Belgian waffles, and this mix is a must.

The Golden Malted Waffle mix is very good. Light and fluffy on the inside, crisp on the outside. Only one problem....it is not made for a standard beligum waffle iron. Works best in the waffle irons that turn upside down once closed.

We made our own waffle batters from scratch and various flours from Bob's Red Mill -- until we discovered this mix. A waffle from this mix has good flavor, has nice texture, and is a great base for fresh fruit and fruit compote.

While on a short vacation, we were at a restaurant that offered complimentary breakfast. At first the spread looked like a standard, medium-priced hotel morning offering. They had cereal, muffins, breads, and juices - but they included some hot items as well.  That was great, but once I saw the Belgian Waffle iron, I was delighted - I love Belgiam waffles, so I figured I give it a try. Well I LOVED the waffles and found out that the iron and oven came from the same company.While I was at the breakfast table, I went online to order the same mix. I was delighted when my waffles at home ended up just as delicious as the ones at the restaurant.I have tried three different Belgian Waffle mixes and this brand tops them all in ease of preparation, consistency of batter, and storage. I have to say, the Krusteaz Belgian Waffle mix has a flavor equal to the Golden brand, but Krusteaz is more expensive, and I haven't found it in a reclosable container with a sealing lid.I strongly recommend this mix, it's delicious!Enjoy!

It's just like the waffle mix we had when we stayed in a hotel that let you make your own waffles in the breakfast bar.  Only thing simpler would be one that only wanted you to add water but they never taste as good.  Nice product and we will buy it again.

After lusting after my sister's waffle maker (she posts pics on facebook...cruel!) I received a waffle maker of my very own for Mother's Day! My wonderful husband also bought a 3pk of this waffle mix. As empty-nesters, the serving size is perfect..we make 2 "batches" for 4 waffles. The waffles are SO tasty. Malt > buttermilk any day! :) This mix is easy and delicious.Whenever he and I both have Saturday mornings off, we have waffles..no fail. It is a wonderful "new" tradition, and this mix makes it easy and tasty!
It is good with the amount described in their manual.  Taste great and easy to make.  No complaints here, just wanted to give it a good feedback.  Will buy again once my bundle runs out.

This was a wonderful surprise! I have long been a fan of Belgian Waffles, and my favorite are malted waffles from the Tammarack Inn in Lake George, NY.  NO matter how I tried I could not replicate their amazing taste- until now! No one in my family likes "malt" flavor, but these waffles will make you a believer! They were the best we have ever had, and now the whole family is hooked! Easy- yet perfect and delectable! Crisp on the outside, melt in your mouth, soooooo good.
This Carbon mix is the best tasting Belgium waffle mix I have eaten. I'll never buy another brand.  I made them for the ladies at work and they loved them.

Makes excellent waffles, crepes and pancakes. I followed several recipes and they all came out great.  Make sure you whip up your egg whites first and fold them in right before cooking for the perfect waffle.
The best need,to buy more. Can not seem to buy a similar product locally. Yum Yum. The Malted flavor is what makes this product different from other pancake, waffle mixes.

I make pancakes from scratch.  I buy this flour from Amazon for waffles because I cannot get the same texture, thin crisp outside with tender inside, from regular flour.  Although this is a mix, I still separate my eggs, beat the whites, and fold them into the batter to get a lighter waffle.

Can't say enough about the taste of these waffles. They are delicious and this mix makes consistent great waffles every time! I purchased it with the Presto Waffle Maker which is also awesome to use and makes delicious waffles!

column9: Fabulous (when using right waffle maker and consistency of batter)
column10: I love the waffles from this mix; they have an absolute wonderful flavor and texture in my opinion.However, the results are VERY different depending on which waffle maker I use.  I have made these with an old, traditional square grid waffle iron, a light-weight circular "Belgium" waffle maker, and a light-weight flip "Belgium" waffle maker, and the results were completely ordinary.  It's only after I purchased a heavier-duty flip Belgium style maker did the waffles come out gloriously light, fluffy, with a slight crispy outside:  just perfect for me.The results are also dependent on exactly how thick the batter comes out which depends on the size of the eggs used and on how precisely the water is measured out.  I prefer the waffles when the batter is on the "runny" side.  When you fill the waffle maker, a runny batter spreads quite quickly and you actually don't use as much batter per waffle.  You can still see the black parts of the "insides" of the grids of the waffle maker poking through the batter when you go to close the maker.  The waffles then really expand as they cook and you get a very light, fluffy waffle with a crispy outside.  Yum!
This is the best waffle mix we have ever tried! If you haven't tried this mix, you will not be sorry that you did.

column9: I don't see what the big deal is...
column10: I purchased this pancake mix a about 6 months ago or so and for some reason got yet another shipment of it 2 months after that although I was pretty SURE that I cancelled my subscription. Anyway I thought that this mix would be sooo amazing like so many reviewers led me to believe. That the product would be worth the price that I was paying. Boy was I wrong. To anyone who is on the edge of buying this recipe, my opinion is that you should NOT. It is a total waste of money. Not only do you have to add the milk (or water), BUT you have to add the eggs, AND the melted butter as well to this mix. So pretty much the only difference between this mix and regular all-purpose flour is your leveler(baking soda or powder) and a tiny bit of sugar, (maybe about a TB per 2 servings. How cheap are those ingredients to buy? All you have to do is measure them out into some AP flour and you have the same thing as this "mix" except with a better more home-made taste Takes about 20 seconds more people. They say that it has 'malt" in it, whatever that is, but I don't taste it. The worst part is that this stuff expires REAL QUICK for the quantity. Really In 6 months My 3 person family was only able to use 2 of 33oz cans (making waffles or pancakes about once per week) and I just tried using it again yesterday and it turned out all crumbly/inedible. I look under the box and it's EXPIRED ALREADY. So unless you have a large family, you might as well throw your money in the trash because now we have 4 unopened cans of the stuff now in the trash outside. My advice, just find a good pancake recipe online and buy yourself a 10 pound bag of flour for about 5 bucks at the store instead of  wasting your money on this highly over-rated stuff. I gave it 3 stars ONLY because my expectations may have been a bit too high due to reviews on here and because MORE OR LESS I got what was promised by the company. But this product merits AT LEAST a deduction of 2 stars (I was on the verge if deducting 3) for the value for what you're getting, ease of use (which is none compared to way cheaper regular plain flour), and amount of time until parish/expiration.

Equal is a very good sweetener for beverages like coffee or iced tea. It has no fat, no calories, less than 1 gram of sugar (which is, of course, next to nothing), and it has almost no carbohydrates, either.I usually prefer Sweet And Low for my sweetener; but when I can't get my hands on that Equal is a fairly good substitute. Equal is my second choice because it's not quite as sweet as Sweet And Low. On the other hand, if you prefer a non-sugar sweetener that's not too sweet or potent, then Equal would be a good choice for you.Equal is a powdery white substance. Just open the individual packet or packets and pour it in to your beverage. It is probably quite good for certain recipes as well. Keep the individual packets in the box they come in or you can put them into any container you wish.Just one warning: This product contains phenylalanine. If you are allergic to that or if phenylalanine makes you ill in any way I would definitely avoid this product.Overall, Equal is a good choice for a sweetener substitute for sugar. It isn't quite as potent as Sweet And Low; that can be a good or bad thing depending on how sweet you like your beverages or recipes. I myself prefer the taste of Sweet And Low. Of course, you can always add a little more Equal to make the drink a bit sweeter.Four stars.

I've been weight training for about 6 years and in that time have used just about every major brand of protein supplement and meal supplement - EAS (Myoplex, Whey), NitroTech, Optimum Whey, MET-Rx, Designer, GNC, etc. Labrada's V60 continues to be my favorite.As far as flavor, the vanilla tastes as good or better than the other protein powders I've had. The chocolate is mediocre, not quite as good as Myoplex. The banana flavor...well, you might want to pass on that one. My personal recommendation would be to get the vanilla and add a small amount of chocolate or strawberry syrup, bananas or peanut butter if the flavor becomes boring.It mixes easily so it can be put in a shaker cup or tossed on a bowl of cereal for breakfast.It's not a meal replacement, and doesn't contain additional vitamins and minerals like Myoplex or ProPlete, so I wouldn't recommend it as a complete meal replacement - at very least take a multivite with it. The plus side is that this keeps the carbs and calories relatively low for consuming 60g protein (most other brands deliver around 40g protein for the same calories/carbs).Now whether the body can actually use 60g of protein in one dose is still up for debate. Since this is a relatively high dose of protein (assuming you're consuming 4-6 30g scoops per day), I would strongly recommend consuming a half gallon of water each day to minimize the strain this puts on the kidneys.

column9: Loaded with sugars and contains undeclared fats; not a health food
column10: People, learn how to read nutrition labels. Servings are typically divided into just one or two cookies. Two cookies contain about 100 calories, 24 g carbohydrates and 14 g sugars. The calorie breakdown is over 90% carbohydrates, mostly from sugars. This is a BIG red flag. No one should consume junk like this. Don't be misled by the "Fat Free" label. (see second paragraph) Refined sugars are far, far worse for dieters than fats are; poly- and monounsaturated fats are in fact beneficial, and calories from fat provide more stable energy. With the exception of trans and saturated fats, (they raise bad cholesterol) you really shouldn't be on a low-fat diet. Sugars are the worst thing for dieters, as they aren't as likely to be metabolized as energy, and will typically be stored as body fat. (mostly around the mid-section) High-fructose corn syrup (an ingredient in SnackWell's products) is specifically linked with an increased risk of obesity and diabetes. The human body simply is not meant to metabolize this much sugar, nor sugars that are unnaturally processed. I can't provide links to research on the subject, because Amazon has rather ridiculous policies that censor URLs, names of other sites, stores, competitors, etc. from reviews. Be sure to complain to Amazon.com about this practice. Still, it's easy enough to open a search engine and type "snackwell devil food nutrition facts" or the like.Bear in mind that products are not required to declare nutritional content when the servings are divided into small portions, and the content would be less than 0.5 g. Each cookie actually contains 0.17 g saturated fat, which Nabisco neglects to mention. Trans fat content is entirely unaccounted for, though it may actually exist. This means that "Fat Free" claim was just a blatant lie. Will anyone hold Nabisco responsible for unscrupulously deceiving consumers, though? Can anyone demand that they pull misleading products off the shelf? Nope. Welcome to corporate America.Don't let Nabisco and other "health-conscience" snack companies scam you. Read labels closely, and be suspicious of small servings. If a single serving contains less than 0.5 g trans fat, then it doesn't have to be declared; the label will inaccurately specify 0 g. If the portions seem ridiculously small, then it's safe to assume they're trying to hide something from the consumer.On a side note, please ignore "helpful review" ratings. Re-distributors of products will often vote down critical reviews, because they demote the very products they're trying to sell on Amazon. It's all politics.

The only problem, Walmart can't keep it in stock, neither can Publix in Florida.  We are now ordering online!

It's even great on sandwiches (hamburgers, roast beef and other lunch meats).  I would not go back to the regular. My husband bought me my first pouch of this tea as a gift. He knows how much I love vanilla and similarly flavored teas. He's always buying something new for me to try.Over the course of the last three years he's bought me every variation of vanilla tea that he could find. Teas ranging from local tea shops to English and Australian teas. I have to say that this one is my favorite!Tea has a good vanilla flavor, while not being overly done. Some of the ones I've tried have tasted like they've just added cheap vanilla syrup to the leaves before drying. It is flavorful with a quick brew (1-2 minutes) or a longer brew (5+), but 3-4 minutes is a little bitter to me. I use an Adagio (http://www.amazon.com/Adagio-Teas-16-Ounce-Ingenuitea-Teapot/dp/B000FPN8TK) tea brewer, and I am able to use the same leaves for two brews without compromising the flavor (quick initial brew, longer brew on the second).All in all a wonderful tea. You can't go wrong with this one!

There is a huge difference between the pizza offered in America as compared to that in Italy - especially Napoli and Sorrento. While visiting there I learned that the flour is not the same and began searching for it. This was a great buy and the results are as I remembered in Italy.

Nothing compares to traditional Neapolitan style pizza.  This is not going to be anything like pizzas you order at your favorite pizza place or buy frozen at your local 'mega-mart'.The only way to make traditional Italian pizza is to start with good pizza flour and this is it.It doesn't matter what you top your pizza with, if the dough is not perfect, the pizza is going to be so-so.You want great pizza use this flour, a simple recipe and check out [...] for topping suggestions.buon cibo!

column9: A VERY PLEASING PRODUCT AT A VERY GOOD PRICE
column10: Our daughter ordered these raw pistachios as her family love the things and she knows that they are one of my big weaknesses.  I must tell you that I was a bit leery of ordering such a product but as she pointed out the price is certainly attractive (even with the shipping), as these cost a fortune at our local stores.Anyway, she was nice enough to share with us and I must say that I am quite impressed with this product.  The nuts are not salted, which due to dietary/health considerations on my part is almost a must.  These shelled pistachios are ideal for cooking (my wife uses them in her baking, and I constantly snack on them.  We found the flavor to be extremely fresh and as a matter of fact much fresher that of those  purchased locally.  As another reviewer has pointed out, these freeze quite well and the quality is not lessened when done correctly in nice sealed containers.These nuts are on the large size and after close examination we found only one or two that we had to cull from the bunch.  Shipping was quite fast and the order, for my daughter, went quite well with no problems what so ever.We will be ordering these ourselves when the time comes and I do highly recommend this product.Don BlankenshipThe Ozarks

I worried about ordering such a large amount, but the savings were so good per pound I took the risk. I was able to share some with family and we enjoyed the rest. Some of them are frozen and we pull a little out as needed. They freeze great. Nuts are fresh enough. I am pleased with my order.

After a couple of weeks i thought I was gonna be sick of pistachios. But guess what? They were all gone in less than 2 months and now I can't wait to order more! I love the fact they're not salted, raw and shelled. Such a great product! I'm ordering more of it right now :)

This is my first time to try these unsalted shelled Pistachios for my low salt diet. They taste very fresh and good when they arrived. I was very pleased they are still tasty and still pretty fresh, just like before they went into the freezer. Very good product and reasonably priced comparing with the local store prices.

Today my order of pistachios came in. I was so pleased that they were in a box as well as 2 plastic bags,which kept them safe from all hands or anything else that might touch them during shipping. They arrived untouched and I am enjoying them as I write this. Thank you so much for your great product and shipping. I will definately use you again and again and again. You have a very satisfied customer! Thanks again. Trisha
These arrived in time for Christmas and were exactly as my picky vegan son had specified.  I would definitely recommend this vendor.
The pistachios were as described.  They taste fresh and were well packaged.  I have not used them in cooking yet, but do not foresee a problem.

amazon asked me to write something about this pistachioswell to be honest the company that sent me the pistachiosare honest people, in that four pound I did not even findone bad pistachio. I will order it again because I alreadyate it, and I will send it to my friends as a gift too.What better gift than delicious and nutritiouspistachios.

column9: Made my dog sick; $400 vet bill.
column10: I bought these for my 3 month-old lab. I also bought some other treats (dehydrated liver, Kong biscuits, bully sticks). 1-2 days after feeding these to my lab she got violently ill -- vomiting and diarrhea. Took her to the vet and after an overnight stay and IV fluids, the vet had no idea what it was. They decided to x-ray her to see if something was blocking her intestines. Nothing. After antibiotics and rest she was back to her normal high energetic self. I gave her more of these sweet potato fries about a week after her first sickness episode.... and 24 hrs later she was vomiting again.  I was worried, but figured that it must be something I was feeding her. I then examined the package and saw these are made in China.  I threw them out and my puppy has been fine since. Logic points to these treats.... I will no longer buy food items for my dog from China. Nobody else has posted anything about ill reactions to these treats, but search around, lots of dog treats from China are making our dogs sick.

I got a dog from the SPCA a few months ago, and learned that in addition to being slightly overweight, he also requires a grain-free diet due to allergies. He also can't have chicken and a few other things, which makes it hard to find treats I can give him. My vet suggested these, since she gives them to her own dogs. My little guy loves them! They're also low calorie, so I can provide them liberally without worrying. I have since shared some with friends, and their dogs love them, too. I have seen these in my local pet shop for a few dollars more, so I think the price is good. I've gone through a couple of containers by now and my dog still comes running for them when I say "treat!". Highly recommend these.
THESE POTATO FRIES ARE AS HARD AS ROCKS.I KNOW THAT THE SUPERMARKET HAS POTATO FRIES AND THEY ARE SOFT CHEWABLES. THESE POTATO FRIES ARE STALE. DO NOT BUY!!
Ordered this product before and contents were very soft and fresh.  This time contents were hard and dry.I was very disappointed but my little puppy was even more disappointed.

column10: I used to buy these from Amazon at least 2-3 times a month.  The last 2 shipments were hard as a rock and the potatoes looked like plastic.  I definitely did not give these to my shih tzu. The treats used to be softer and you could tear them into smaller pieces.  The last ones I received I couldn't even cut with a knife.
