It is really scary.My dog is like family to me.  I'm not going to risk his life or a huge vet bill to save a buck or two on food made in China by a culture of people that lace toys they sell us with lead and other harmful chemicals.

After reading the negative review about the person's dog getting ill from these, I had to add my own 2 cents.  Like that person, I never buy anything made outside of the US for my dogs.  Until I bought these, on accident.  I can sympathize with his dog getting ill -- but I have 7 dogs and they all love these and have never gotten sick. Switching to another brand. Freshness date was many months away so it wasn't a rotate stock issue.  Changed my star rating from 5 stars to 1 star.

All I have to do is reach for the jar and  I've got their undivided attention. Will keep buying these as long as Amazon offers them at this price.

i'm noticing some people complaining that in recent times the sweet potato treets are coming "hard as a rock"...i too have gotten them that way and frankly don't understand why one shipment can be perfect while another can be so "off", but Ive figured out a way i can still give them to my dogs and they can still enjoy them and they don't go to waste (frankly they're too expensive to) ... have 2 dogs, so i usually give them 2-3 sticks each per serving. i take them put them in a small bowl put enough water in the bowl so they are floating and then microwave them for exactly 22 seconds, then let them sit for about a minute, afterward i swirl them around in the bowl , them drain out the hot water and then put some cold water in the bowl to cool them down, drain again, dry them a little on a paper towel and then give them to the dogs...they actually like them better this way, they're still chewy but warm and softer. You might give it a try.

I have never like instant potatoes. When my sister-in-law tried to get us to buy some with her (quantity order) I staunchly rejected the offer. Who was she to even insinuate that dehydrated potatoes could take the place of freshly whipped potatoes on our dinner table? Can you believe the nerve?  I was tricked into trying these a few months later at her house for a holiday dinner. I say tricked because no-one told me they were instant before I dug in. It never even crossed my mind that someone wouldn't make home-made mashed potatoes for a Thanksgiving dinner!Well, I was pleasantly surprised to say the least. I won't say these are better than fresh whipped potatoes, but I will say that potato pearls are very good. We use them for day-to-day meals and only make freshly whipped potatos for holiday dinners or dinners with a lot of people. It is just too easy to make the pearls and get exactly how much you want in the time it takes to boil water. The taste is great and they don't have that institutional aftertaste that you get when digging in at a buffet or cafeteria.A great example of how versatile and easy these are: I didn't want the pasta my wife made with dinner last night so I put 6 tablespoons of water in the microve and brought it to a boil in 45 seconds. I then added 3 tablespoons of potato pearls and viola! I had the perfect single-serving of mashed potatoes in less than a minute. Another example is my granddaughter (19 months) loves potatoes and we will make some of these up with almost every meal. The fact that you just make them using the easy-to-remember 2-parts-water to 1-part-pearls methodology means you can make exactly the quantity you need. If she doesn't want to eat her vegetables, they get mixed in and she wolfs them down.Honestly, you can't go wrong with these. I don't know if these have an extensive shelf life for you doomsday preppers, but if you have a well stocked pantry and also store emergency rations to a reasonable extent, then just make sure you rotate your supply of the potatoes. But hey, if you keep emergency rations, you probably already know about rotation...Happy tater eating to you!

A long time ago (early 90's) I first found these at Sam's Club. Then, it was no longer reasonable for me to continue membership, so I missed them for a lot of years. After that, I worked for a Personal Care Home and was able to get some again. That was 6 years ago. Now, finally, we meet again, and I can rest assured that I will always have descent mashed potatoes quickly at my fingertips.I tried others when I didn't have Potato Pearls. They are not as good. Especially the ones that begin with I and end with oan. You can't have those as leftovers. They always turned out runny the second day, with only warming them up and not adding anything.Now these, these Potato Pearls, they're the bee's knees of instant mashed potatoes. I hate calling them instant mashed potatoes, I feel like it cheapens them. They are just mashed potatoes. They are so good in flavor, texture, and ease of making them, I want to tell everybody. You can't go wrong with these. They're worth it.

If you buy this particular box, you will have to share or give away various pouches unless you want to develop cavities.NOTE THAT THESE CANDIES ARE NOT SUGAR FREE, they are ONLY GLUTEN FREE for people with various disorders.  They are still very sweet (and sour).

I ordered this variety pack to try candy made with natural flavors, and so far everything I have tried I love.  The peppermints are strong and wonderful, and the Root beer candies are great.  (Edit because I have tried more of the variety)  So far I have not come across a flavor I did not enjoy, even ones I was not sure about (pomagranet pucker?)turned out to be wonderful treats.  I do limit myself on how many I eat, but I find the serving size is more than enough to satisfy an occasional attack of the sweet tooth.  So far the peppermints and the Vitamin C citrus drops are my favorites.  I wish some of the flavors came in drops without the variety pack, or a creat your own variety, as I can have hard candy but cannot walk around with a sucker stick hanging out of my mouth at work.

column4: Lingering Lethal Poisonous Lene of Death
column10: I discovered YummyEarth in a Deal of the Day, and was immediately taken with the good tasting candies. So I decided to "branch out" from the lollipops, and taste their various treats. I got a big box with 12 different sorts of candies in, and most of them are really yummy. However, like in any variety pack, there are some you like and some you don't. That's why it's only 4 stars, and not 5. I have, however, figured out what to do with the candy, I will make nice little boxes and cones in bright colour and make presents of the ones I don't particularly like. I would say only 2-3 of the bags wasn't to my liking, the rest is just as yummy as I had hoped for.I really like the real taste of the candy. There is no artificial flavour, it's all got clean real taste. I loved the mint ones, and of course the strawberries (I ordered a big bag of those... I will have candy for years!), did not care so much for the spicey ones, nor the root beer one. But that's just me, I think, I don't drink root beer either :)I am glad I got these, though, it's always nice to have some candy in a bowl for visitors, and the fact that the taste is real, and no artificial anything in them, makes me very happy. Definitely recommend these!

YummyEarth Organic Lollipops, Assorted Flavors, 5-Pound BagYummyEarth Organic Candy Drops, 15.2-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4) This candy is amazing. Each flavor tastes like real fruit. I love the hard candies for helping with dry mouth. My son used the drops as you would cough drops, during a cold. They are a fantastic long lasting snack for during a movie. I will always have some in my house. They are the best had candy I have ever tasted.

Thanks to co-founders Rob and Sergio of Yummy Earth candy company I finally have a true confection to offer friends and family worry free.  These are by far the very best sweets I have tasted, a testament to the power of all natural ingredients!  I can only hope this will inspire other manufacturers to follow their brilliant example.  I will be eagerly awaiting the release of the next batch of fabulous flavors!Don't take my word for it, try them for yourself...YummyEarth Organic Lollipops, Assorted Flavors, 150-Count Container...or better yet purchase this item and give the gift of deliciousness!YummyEarth Organic Lollipops, Assorted Flavors, 30-Count Containers (Pack of 5)
It's great to know that organic can be so delicious.  Whether you're watching your weight or just want to eat more naturally, these Pops & Drops offer terrific taste and variety.  I will order again.

I ordered the sampler pack and totally loved all of them.  I found that when my stomach was upset, they help settle it. There were no after tastes at all. They all tasted very good and when I was craving something sugary or sweet, I would take of these and the craving would go away.  I am totally addicted to these and will buy them again.
Not sure it is necessarily healthy.  But, in our opinion, it is a much better alternative to HFCS and dyes.  They taste great and the kids love them.
i bought the variety pack.  everyone loved the suckers.  the flavors are outstanding and different than you find elsewhere.  It is also helpful that the candy is organic - but you tend to eat more!

column9: Candy you can feel good giving to your chicldren
column10: This is my second time buying this sampler.  I think it offers a great variety.  There is enough that I can have the drops at my desk at work and the pops at home for my kids.  The flavors are all very good.  I especially enjoy the root beer and lemon drops.
Yummearth makes the best organic lollipops we could find, so we are constantly buying them here from amazon. price and quality are always good.

These candies were purchased for the youngest in the household due to food/dye sensitivies; however, the whole family enjoys them.  They are small in size, but they pack a flavorful punch.  I recommend them for anyone who enjoys hard candies and/or suckers.

I was definitely not expecting this many samples! They seem to be a full size package of each, which I think it's great because I could not decide which one I wanted. They taste great! I've enjoyed every one I've tasted so far.

We purchased the mixed variety for our children's pinata, wanting to avoid the crap additives that one finds in the store candy. We've known about Yummy Earth lollipops for some time, but in the basic flavors. Finding these were great! My husband and I snuck a flavor of each drop and lollipop prior, just to taste and have since purchased more of our favorite flavor (root beer, so much better than the A&W barrels, in my opinion). They are still sweet, so if you are trying to go for less sugar, that won't work. But if you hate food coloring either out of knowledge or child having reactions (our first son), this is the way to go! These also got us to try interesting flavors (Chili Lime, I admit, I was scared, but I enjoyed it)that you can't find in store candy since supposedly children only like strawberry, cherry, lemon, grape, and orange (as evidenced by lack of more variety).

I haven't gotten to try them all yet, but so far they are great! I gave certain ones I know I wouldn't like (the chili ones) to family. I have severe nausea issues, I'm not sure how much it helps, but it at least gives me something to eat that I won't throw up. I will continue to get YummyEarth products.

I found these while I was looking up some other products. They sounded interesting, so I decided to give them a try.  I've only made it through about half of the flavors in this sampler set, but so far I am enjoying them greatly.  The fruit flavors are zippy and last to the end of each item (pop or drop).  I think my favorite so far is still the Cheeky Lemon drops - the first ones that I tore into.  ~grin~  Although, the Mango Tango is giving it a lot of competition for my taste buds.These candies actually have a lot less sugar than I had figured, but taste wonderful.  When you look at the number of sugar grams on the label, remember to divide by the number in the serving size (5 for the drops; 3 for the pops).

column9: Excellent selection of a wonderful product!
column10: So first I tried the pops which were wonderful so I decided to try this variety pack to decide what flavors I really liked and wanted to get a full order of.The hot chili pops -...The chili-lime is *phenomenal*...think lime with a kick!...The chili-mango is not nearly as good - the mango doesn't meld as well with the spice of the chili.The fruit pops, vitamin c pops and drops and strawberry smash:...The Sour Apple Tart is wonderful, some have commented "wow this is tart" but it's not like the sour apple neon green you get in other mixtures... you can taste the apple as well as the sour...Tooberry Blueberry is the best in the whole bunch. Smooth and tangy and fruity without being sour. Extremely popular....Wetface Watermelon is my second favorite in this bunch, just tart enough with a lot of watermelon flavor...Other flavors such as pomegranate pucker, strawberry smash, and razzmatazz raspberry are quite good and actually taste different from each other.The Ginger Zest is a little too sweet and doesn't have as much kick as I'd hoped.The Wild Peppermint is as strong as altoids but with a starlight mint texture. Highly recommend.

So far every flavor is liked a lot. I'm not even a big fan of hard candy and I really like them, especially the pepper ones!

I had planned to use the sampler to determine which ones to to repurchase.  We love all the flavors so much I will be making repeat purchases of the entire sampler!  Yummo!

It is so strong that every time you would open your mouth to talk,you would be able to freshen everyone elses breath around you-maybe a good candy to take to the office. I was very disappointed in the lollipops-they are small-thats not the problem-problem is the taste-one bag says super sour-ok so that one pkg is a given that they are all super sour. However on the bags not marked that the candy is sour-well it is so i think if the candy is sour then it should say that on the pkg.Watermelon is a very sweet fruit-however the watermelon lollipops are a little sweet with a SOUR tang to them. The hot chili pepper lollipops don't seem that hot --until you swallow the juices from it.The rootbeer drops are good but they taste like the rootbeer candy you can already find at the stores. I would NOT buy this sampler again-too bad halloween is not around the corner or i would be handing this out to the trick or treaters. I would buy the ginger zest again. Surprisingly good -- I use this with linguine or angel hair pasta to create a tasty side dish to go with grilled scallops or salmon. I use just a little less oil than called for, and it works just fine. Just follow the directions on the package, and you can't go wrong. Each packet makes 2 servings, so it's perfect for singles or empty nesters.It's not too salty -- a big problem with a lot of things like this -- and the sun dried tomato flavor comes through loud and clear. Amazon's price is very reasonable, too.Here's another use: it makes amazingly good stuffed portobello mushrooms! Very easy -- here's what you need for 4 servings:1 lb of Italian sausage, casings removed (I use good very lean sausage that I order online from a place near Hermann, MO)1/4 C dried bread crumbs (I use plain bread crumbs, NOT the seasoned ones)1 envelope Mayacamas Dried Tomato pasta mix4 medium-large (4" or so) portobello mushrooms, cleaned, with stems removed and finely chopped (remove gills and discard)2/3 C shredded mozzarella cheese, divided.In a bowl, mix sausage, bread crumbs, Mayacamas mix, chopped mushroom stems, and 1/3 C of the cheese until well blended.Spray mushrooms with non-stick spray and place "hollow side up" in a shallow lighly greased (I use non-stick spray) baking pan.Divide sausage mixture among the 4 mushroom caps, packing it into the hollow left by the removal of the gills and stems.Top with the remaining 1/3 C shredded cheese, distributing it evenly over caps.Bake at 325 for 30-40 minutes. Test for doneness with a meat thermometer - filling is done when it registers 165 degrees. Cool slightly; serve with garden salad and breadsticks. Enjoy!!I've been using this stuff for over a year, a couple of times a month or so.  Really, really tasty!

A colleague from the UK recommended I try shortbread during a trip to Scotland "as they don't know how to make them 'right' anywhere else apparently." column9: just a retired instructor, grandma and lover of oatmeal raisin/craisen cookoies

The lifting ring must never be used to tighten or loosen the top of the coddler. The ring should be used only to lift coddlers out of the water bath, or lower them into the water bath. Any torque (rotational force) placed on the ring may cause it to separatefrom the lid.When cooking with the coddler, do not screw the lid on very tightly. A loose turn is sufficient.When storing coddlers for extended periods of time, it is best to keep the lid attached to the coddler as loosely as possible ... this will help avoid fusing if there is much humidity in the air.

The lids for these egg coddlers are poorly made. Its difficult to get them on and off when they're cold, and when they're hot its even trickier. This is a great flavor for these kisses. I had never tasted them before and they are great.  The price was also very good for the amount you received. The delivery was very quick and received in good condition.

column9: Not my favorite, but it's OK
column10: We have tried many many different brands of coconut water and when we purchased this one at the store we thought it had the best taste on the market and quickly ordered a case. The box arrived in great condition but, as many reviewers have noted, every single can was dented and scratched. On top of that, it didn't taste nearly as good as the ones we had purchased at the grocery store. I don't know if the dents would have altered the taste but there was definitely a difference. While still drinkable, we probably won't order again.
The product itself is fine, but the steel cans give it a sour aftertaste to me. I won't order again.

column9: Good but price just went up ~30%...not worth new price
column10: Purchased one time with subscribe and save but then price went up 30% recently.  Don't think worth the higher price...would have kept subscription otherwise.Regarding dent cans, can report that most of ours were also slightly dented, but didn't bother us much at the previous low price.
Length:: 0:46 MinsEvery single can of Blue Monkey Coconut Water is dented.Blue Monkey 100% Natural Coconut Water, 11.2-Ounce (Pack of 24)

I recently received my second subscription delivery.  First of all, all the cans were horribly dented, as many reviewers have commented.  The cans from my first delivery were all okay.  This tells me the product handling is irratic.  Still, it would not have bothered me, until I opened one.  To my surprise, the taste was different than the first batch I received.  The product is 3 months old based on the date on the can, but it tasted like it was off.I really liked the idea that Blue Monkey is not from concentrate and slightly cheaper than Zico, but with such quality control problems, I have gone back to drinking Zico.

I had purchased this product at Whole Foods after another customer highly recommended it to me.  It was the BEST tasting coconut water I had ever tasted so I quickly ordered a case from Amazon.  The case arrived quickly and none of my cans were dented or damaged in any way as noted on many of the other reviews.  I chilled a couple of cans and couldn't wait to drink them.  What a disappointment!  Every can that I drank tasted like metal.  Yuck!

I assumed you guys get some proof from suppliers that they are honest with how they pitch their products.Not a bit of coconut water taste.  Wondering where this water came from, used 23cans to water my house plants. Good they did not die. Will never buy this product again.

I tasted this brand of coconut water while vacationing in Hawai'i & loved it! I was so excited to find it on amazon. Despite negative reviews for dented cans, I ordered a 24-pack for $26.56 which I felt was a steal & signed up for subscribe & save. The 2nd shipment I received 2 months later (per my selected frequency. I didn't even check before I got my shipment, but apparently, the price jumped to $34.71!!! So, fine, my fault for not verifying before the shipment went out, I really liked this coconut water so I'll just eat it & look at the pricetag next time around. I got my 2nd shipment - cans were dented (a lot more of them w/ a lot deeper dents - this couldn't have happened in shipping since just about all the cans were dented - even the ones on the inside??? But who cares, dented cans, whatever...the worst thing - THE TASTE WAS AWFUL!!! I have to pour the coconut water out of the cans into a new container & let it sit (covered) in the fridge for a few days so the weird metallic/fermented taste dissipates...so weird...I was willing to drink it a little rancid - thought maybe it was 1 can, no, 2 cans, OK, maybe I should let someone else try a 3rd can...I then figured it helps to let it sit a few hrs in a different container. Needless to say, I canceled my subscribe & save subscriptions - sucks that I paid almost $10 more for a crappy shipment - boooooo...

column9: Blue Monkey is yummy and a good value
column10: I spent a month trying every coconut water I could get my grubby little hands on. During my trials, I went to Whole Foods (booooo!) and took home at least six different brands.  I got another five from Sprouts (yay Sprouts!), and found at least another seven varieties at Central Market (yeehaw Central Market!!).  Of all the ones I tried, the one I liked the most that I could order in bulk was Blue Monkey.  I would definitely rank it among my top 3.  However, the other factor that made it a top pick for me was the 12 oz serving size and the attractive price point.  My orders were always fulfilled on time, and I had a consistent flow of good tasting coconut water.  I was actually planning on increasing my order to two cases per month.Today however, I'm sad because my automatic monthly order for a case of Blue Monkey through Amazon has been cancelled with no explanation.  My only recourse seems to be to let them notify me when it becomes available.  I don't know what happened, but I'm very disappointed.  I hope something changes soon.  Until then, I guess I'll buy O.N.E. or Amy and Brian's at Sprouts or Central Market.  If it becomes available again I'll switch my four stars to five.

Just received my first order of Blue Monkey coconut water yesterday and my first impression after opening the packaging was "what the heck happened to all these cans?" as virtually 21 of 24 can were substantially dented and scratched. Looks like someone was playing catch with them while wearing a concrete mitt as the cans somehow got beat-up something good. Fortunately there does not look to be any punctures or spoilage of the actual coconut water itself. Am sipping my first one as I write this and the taste is a but stronger and not as sweet as other coco water brands I have tried, but overall a decent taste. The manufacturer/distributor must offer the swell pricing on a case because they are pretty much only shipping the cans with external damage.

column9: One of the best I've tried!
column10: I've tried just about every brand of coconut water. I find the Blue Monkey brand delicious...on par with Amy & Brian's and C2O, which I consider to be the best. Blue Monkey is a product of Thailand (like A&B's and C2O), therefore the coconut water is naturally sweeter and more flavourful than the Brazilian-origin coconut water brands such as Zico and VitaCoco (which I find to lack flavour).The current price of Blue Monkey on Amazon beats the price of A&B's and C2O so no reason not to buy!

I have tried every single brand of coconut water out there. I usually buy ZICObrand and up until today I thought ZICO was the best.OMG this has the best flavor. Smooth, sweet, no "gamey" aftertaste. Perfect.

column9: Cans arrive dented but it's delicious!
column10: After trying to order Vita Coco through the mail, I finally decided to try another kind. It comes in cans so it was less likely to be damaged during shipping. I am SO glad I did!! This is the best coconut water I have ever had; it is delicious and refreshing(as long as it's ice cold). I can live with the dented cans; I used to throw 2 of the 6 Vita Coco cartons away so I'll take dented cans any day!
Great Product.  Cans may be dented but this is still my favorite coconut water brand of all time.  Thanks you did a great job.

column9: Best coconut water in taste, low pulp, and ONE INGREDIENT!!!
column10: Best coconut water in taste, low pulp, and ONE INGREDIENT!!!  17.6 oz quenched my thirst. Keep up the good job!!!
Without any added sugar Blue Monkey has managed to make the sweetest (but not too sweet)most refreshing coconut water.  It is my daily treat after a hot yoga sesh.
Blue Monkey Coconut water is delicious, pure and natural without any additives.We like it very much. Amazon has best price!
Blue monkey is my favorite coconut water drink, I recommend it to anyone who is willing to pay the price for a healthier drink than soda pop.
I'm from El Salvador , leaving in the USA so i know the real taste from coconut water  and this brand is amazing!!!!
Shipped fast and is what it says! It didn't take forever to just ship out the items even at a large quantity.

column9: Great taste, great value. Try it!
column10: I've just begun drinking coconut water, and this is my favorite so far both in value and in taste. It is the sweetest I've found that doesn't contain any added sugar (like some brands of "coconut juice"). If you've tried Zico and have been disgusted by its lack of flavor, give this one a try. It's cheaper, and muuuuuch tastier. And it's good for you! Only 76 calories in a can: much healthier than a can of soda.As to the packaging, mine arrived with perhaps 5 cans slightly dented and all others perfectly intact. I can't complain about that, considering that it's an imported product. And mine arrived nicely chilled, so I could enjoy a can right away! That may be the product of the colder weather, but it was a nice surprise.The one thing to note is that this brand comes without coconut pulp. I rather enjoy having bits of coconut to chew on, but it isn't a deal breaker for me.I used the subscribe-and-save option just to get the better price the first time around, but this product won me over. I plan on keeping my subscription.

this and Amy&Brian's coconut juice are my favorite. I've also tried vita coco, O.n.e. and generic brands. Blue monkey is also the cheapest i've found on amazon at $0.10 an ounce using subscribe and save. i find this to be a better serving size than 17 ounce Amy&Brian cans at 11.2 ounces for Blue monkey. Definitely recommend.
This is delicious, fresh tasting coconut water. Our whole family loves it!  The best at the best price from Amazon, of course!

column9: best tasting coconut water, and the dents aren't that big a deal.
column10: Please do not take to heart that the cans may dented upon arrival. Keep in mind that this coconut water is coming all the way from Thailand, and dents could occur from all the handling from place to place. The coconut water inside the cans is unharmed, and well worth the price paid on amazon.com. Plus, the cans can be recycled, to where many other well known mass-produced and advertised brands cannot. This is the best tasting coconut water hands down, and I've tried ALL of them, seriously. Give blue monkey coconut water a try if you could care less about dented cans, care about recycling your packaging, and are looking for the best tasting coconut water.

The Blue monkey coconut water is absolutely natural product that tastes great when cold. Unfortunately, almost all of the cans were pretty bent or smashed. Other than that the quality of the product inside is top-notch. Oh, and Blue monkey is a cute name for coconut water.

column9: Best-tasting Coconut Water but Crappy Packaging
column10: This brand tastes AWESOME!  It is by far the most natural and best-tasting of all the packaged waters on the market.  I give the product itself five stars.As other reviewing noted, however, the vast majority of the cans arrive dented. Amazon packs the Blue Monkey box within one of its boxes so I suspect the issue is with Blue Monkey, not Amazon.If you're looking for a fabulous-tasting and refreshing dink, Blue Money Coconut Water is it!  Hopefully the packaging issue will get sorted out.

I knew nothing about this brand, but I bought a case because it has a good price. I was very pleased to find that it has just one ingredient: coconut water. There is no added sugar or preservatives. It's unfortunate when you buy a coconut water can for the health benefits, only to see that it has tons of sugar and other unwanted additives. This product does not have pulp, which is one thing I prefer. Other than that, this is the best canned coconut water I've had, and it's well priced. Highly recommended!!!
This is the BEST  tasting coconut water out in the market!! I wish it was available in more supermarkets!! Tastes like coconut water from the Caribbean Islands :D

column9: My favorite coconut water, and no dents!
column10: I'd rather not write this review, because I want to keep this product a secret, but I just have to give praise to the Blue Monkey :) I guess I discovered Blue Monkey coconut water at the right time, because the price is right and when I received my order, it was packaged by Amazon as a box-within-a-box. Not a single can was dented as some other reviewers described. The cans are a heavy duty aluminum like I've found when I had a soda in Europe or S. America. Speaking of the product specifically, the portion is perfect and the taste is by far my favorite. No added Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), which I find gives other coconut waters a somewhat sharper taste (for lack of a better discriptor). The 11.2 oz. can is great, too. I would rarely drink an entire 17 oz. can , so here I don't feel like I'm wasting any or letting it sit open until I come back for the second serving. The flavor is most similar to C2O or Amy & Brian's, and less like VitaCoco or Zico. I've had most every brand, and even though taste is pretty subjective, I would rate this as 5 stars for the overall experience and price. I got it on the subscription program for once-per-month delivery, and the price savings are a great deal.

We have tried all of the brands of coconut water available in our area (Dallas, Texas) and this is the best tasting. The only thing I can say that is negative is the packaging from Amazon and the manufacturer. All of the cans are dented, but this doesn't impact the product. Just realize when you order the case from Amazon, the cans will be dented. Otherwise, this product is wonderful! The best tasting product!

I rated this a 1star only because out of the 5 coconut water brands in order of 5to1star (Zico 5, Taste Nirvana 4, Amy&Brian 3, C2O 2, Blue Monkey1) it wasn't bad but not as good as any of the others I've tried.

column9: Make sure you get without pulp
column10: I had  pure coconut water product in canada ,which I liked and therefore ordered this product over here. They send me pure coconut water with pulp instead. I do not like the pulp in the pure coconut water. The canister I recieved had a bold yellow label stating " with Pulp" . And the can showed in the picture on this website does not show " with pulp" . It was misleading. If you like the pulp go for it its great product. Just that pulp in the water gives some strong coconut smell which I donot like.

I bought a can of this at my local Whole Foods / Harry's and I was disappointed. I felt like the only thing I could taste was the can it was in. This does not taste like fresh coconut water. It tastes like a tin can with some musty coconut flavor. I'm not very picky but I didn't even finish it. I wonder if this issue is why many other brands use the paper box style containers.

I was disappointed in the condition of the cans as they arrived almost all with big dents, sometimes more than two on a can. I have heard that it isn't safe to drink from cans that have dents, so I had to research the risk and check out each can for the location of the dents. I contemplated sending them back, but have decided it is most likely safe to drink. Still, this isn't what I had in mind: to drink a beverage that is supposedly good for one's health while being concerned about the remote possibility of botulism! In the future, please package this product properly so it arrives in flawness condition.
Each and every can I got had dents. Not sure whome to blame, the manufacturer or Amazon for the packaging.

the rice is beautiful, just as i expected from whole grain brown rice, but when i checked out the price i got it here (including the shipping), it didn't really compute to a deal compared to my local grocery store.  it came out about the same- my grocery working out a few cents cheaper. so i guess if you can't find this grain of rice locally then it works out well to order it here.

This is excellent short grain brown rice.  As good as any I have seen.  Many rice users do not know the difference between short and long grain rice.  Locally it is impossible to locate the short grain variety, especially brown.  Most oriental dishes uses the short grain variety which is starchier and generally stickier than the long grain. Long grain is harder and the grains are not plump like short grain. The rice from Angelinas is very nice, clean and uniform.  Delivery was extremely fast.  In fact it arrived about the same time as the Email saying it had been shipped.  Shipping charges were kinda dear considering the nearness of the source.  But very pleased with the service and quality of the product. Expect to go for the 25 pound sack next time.

column9: Angelina's Gourmet Short Grain Brown Rice
column10: I highly recommend the short grain brown rice sold by Angelina's Gourmet.  The rice tastes just right and has a nice chewy whole grain texture.  I had a very good experience shopping at Angelina's Gourmet; the product arrived very quickly and was exactly what I wanted.  I wouldn't hesitate to try any other product they have to offer.
I have given up caffiene and other sugar drinks and was looking for an alternative. The rooibos red tea is great. It tastes good without sweetener or I add a little stevia for a treat.

The best tea, bar none!  The smooth Vanilla flavour is very subtle but distinct. My second favourite (after Zulu Peach).  The fact that this tea is organic, naturally caffeine free, and full of antioxidants is just a bonus.  I love that I can brew a big pot and it never becomes bitter or overly strong, even when it sits. The low tannin makes it great for settling an upset stomach and very agreeable to drink.  The more I learn about rooibos tea the more fascinating it becomes. What a great product!

Love reg  jasmine rice but hated the glycemic load, so i was oh so pleased to find the brown, healthier variety. It cooks well in the rice cooker and is great if u follow the cooking directions.  Will be the only rice i am using going fwd.

Like the previous reviewer, I have yet to be completely blown away by any k cup, but this is the best I've found so far. I'm giving it 5 stars because it is the best k cup, not because it is the best coffee. But don't get confused, it is a very very good coffee if you like the bolder taste of Starbucks type coffee.

column9: The best I have found but expensive
column10: This is the best I have found so far, strong and ok tasting. I like the Keurig for its convenience but have not found the perfect coffee yet. This one is expensive and just alright. I wish Starbucks or Peet's made coffee for the Keurig.
I lived in England, and traveled most of Europe, and that is what this coffee reminds me of, every cup

I ended up choosing this from the numerous mint tea options available on amazon because I'd tried Revolution's Earl Grey before and loved it. This stuff is just fantastic! First of all, it comes in a tetrahedral teabag, as opposed to a flat one. The bag is made out of a sort of nylon-type mesh instead of paper, so you don't get any weird paper taste (it matters more in the more delicate herbal teas than the darker black teas, for me anyway). Secondly, inside the tea bag, you get actual mint leaves, not tiny flakes and dust. And because the tea bag has a more 3-dimensional shape, the leaves don't get crushed as much either. The flavor is absolutely delightful! It's very smooth and aromatic, no bitterness or anything unpleasant at all. Great night time tea or anytime relaxing tea! If you don't like your tea very strong, you can use one tea bag to infuse two cups. Also, if you're not that into hot tea, this tastes pretty good cold as well, especially if you add a little sugar. Very reasonably priced high quality tea and probably about the best you can do without going loose leaf. Will definitely keep buying this!

column9: Spearmint tea, caffeine free with nothing else
column10: When my husband's favorite brand of caffeine free mint tea was discontinued, I went on a quest to find a replacement.  Almost all of them have caffeine and/or something else like "mint with green tea", etc.  And, what type of "mint"?  I determined that the one he had liked was spearmint only.  He likes Revolution's Southern Mint much better than Stash orHEB's (locally grocery store) brands.

This is the kind of tea that will perk you up without a hint of caffein.  It's really nice how it tingles on the tongue and you can keep refilling your cup with hot water without it losing the flavor since this is simply pure mint leaves.

column9: Revolution tea is fantastic (for bagged tea)
column10: Delightful mint tea as one would expect. Note that each tea bag is NOT individually wrapped; there is one bag inside the box which holds all of the tea bags in a ziploc pouch. I purchased these as a wedding favor (herbal-themed wedding) and it was fun bagging each one in its own small bag with a nice printed label and ribbon. The tea bag itself is good quality; I've never had one rip open and spill tea leaves into the tea.
This is some of the best tea that I have tasted.  The smell of mint followed by a smooth minty taste.  This tea helps me to unwind at the end of a busy day.
Honestly I drink a lot of tea and I love mint tea but it is hard to find good mint where you can actually taste the flavor. Revolution Mint Tea is by the best!!!

This was my 4th batch of homebrew since I received my True Brew kit as a gift.  It came out so smooth and delicious that I can't wait to brew another!I am normally favor Sam Adams type beers so I tend towards the amber or darker beers.  This brown ale is root beer dark and has a wonderful aroma and smooth malty taste.A must try!

column9: Good, but not quite my taste
column10: To be fair, this was my first attempt at home brewing.  With that in mind:I thought this was a well thought out kit, and the instructions were easy to follow.  Even though I did make a few mistakes in the process, the beer turned out better than I expected.  For a starter kit, I give it high marks.  There are a couple of things that, had I known, I would have accounted for and possibly had a better result:1)  The hops are in pellet form, and they fall apart when they hit the wort.  I strongly recommend that you use a natural cloth steeping bag to make clean up easier.  If not, expect to be picking flakes of hops out of your buckets, brushes, strainers, and teeth for a couple of weeks.2)  The instructions say to take the label off the can of malt extract.  What they forget to mention is that the label is pasted on with an industrial strength adhesive, from end to end, top to bottom.  Getting the label off requires a fair amount of patience and a lot of hot water.  It would be much better if the manufacturer would simply glue the label to itself so you can rip it right off without having to scald yourself on a hot can.Overall, the beer, while a touch stout for my taste, has been tasty.  The kit was well put together, especially from a beginning brewer's perspective.  I will likely purchase a red ale kit from the same maker for my next batch.

column9: Darker than I thought it would be
column10: This kit made a great batch of home brew.  It ended up being darker than I thought it would be (almost black) but that's alright. The flavor was about what you would expect from an all malt home brew.  It was smoothe but lacked in some flavors that I personally want in a beer.  It's great though if you want your first batch easily.
First beer that I brewed as an all malt brew, (no grains).  Came out tasting wonderful.  Very smooth and clear.  This is a definite do-over!

After lots of research, we decided to give Fromm's a try for our "middle aged/slightly overweight dogs and the transformation has been amazing.  They've regained their energy and even their stools are smaller and firmer.  Best of all, they love the taste.  This is the last/best dog food we'll every feed our kids!
I have a 14.5 year dog who is NOT an eager eater and he loves this food.  If he weren't so old, I would limit the amount he eats.  However, it keeps him happy which makes me happy.

I just had to let you know what a miracle this food has been for me and my dogs!  I have four Chihuahuas of my own and a fifth as a foster, and I spent a long time researching foods to make a switch after P&G took over Natura (we were on Innova).  My female can be picky and does horribly with food pieces that are too big, so I was thrilled when I saw the thin triangles in the bag.  She happily crunches right through them, which is great, since she and one of my boys have horrible teeth and having to chew the food helps.  My only guess why the other reviewer had an issue with the food was switching over too fast.  I switched slowly over a few weeks as I always do (the vet at the zoo I used to work with recommends no less than a 2 week transition).  Especially if you are switching from a lower quality food, the richness of this food would throw digestion off if you switch cold turkey.My alpha male has been on Hills C/D almost all his life because he was diagnosed with struvite crystals as a young dog (he is almost 11 now).  He was the only one of my pack who looked old.  Dull coat, dandruff, and a gaunt look to his face and body.  I knew it had to be the food, so looked at all the levels and decided on the Whitefish formula as a food trial, hoping he wouldn't develop crystals again on a hollistic food.  WHAT A DIFFERENCE!  He looks fantastic, he and the female (same age) are more active, and I'm happy to report that after 2.5 months, his urinalysis was clean!Our third dog and our foster dog both have very course hair, and since starting this food, they have both become much softer.  Everyone is shiny and (before the weather got so dry) dandruff-free!  Best of all, each and every one of the dogs is absolutely CRAZY about the taste of the food, and even my girl who we used to have to push to finish her dinner now eats with everyone else in under two minutes and then licks the crumbs up off her eating blanket.  It's truly miraculous.  I couldn't be any happier with this food.  It may cost more than the lower quality foods, but if you added all the supplements it would take to get this level of nutrition, you'd be spending more anyway.  Love it, love it, LOVE IT!

I LOVE Fromm pet foods and agree with an earlier review about my dog's coarse hair becoming soft and smooth after eating Fromm, but this particular variety is his worst enemy.  He puts his tail between his legs and delays eating it until late in the afternoon when he just can't stand the hunger pangs anymore.  Unfortunately, I had purchased a 30 lb. bag and he is a small dog.  We made it (barely) through a third of a bag before I sold the remains on the cheap to a friend.  Her dogs didn't care for it either, but her somewhat overweight dog ate it anyway (because she eats anything).Our local supplier of Fromm said that this variety is the least popular.Ironically, one of my CATS loves it!  Must be the fish in it!Anyway, I haven't given up on Fromm foods for my dog, but I will never buy this variety again.

Two dogs threw up the first night I fed. None of them liked it. I had to doctor up just to get them to eat it. One of my girls got the shakes and tremors like she'd been poisoned. Scared me to death! Thank goodness I only got one bad to try.

I have tried every one of Cafe Britt's coffees and, although all are very good, I like this one the best. To me it has a rich, nutty flavor that I can drink all day. Cafe Britt uses an all-purpose grind which works well as drip or as expresso. I brew it as expresso and find that the flavor remains smooth and is never bitter whether I'm drinking it hot in winter or iced in summer. In the summer, I make a carafe and put it in the fridge to chill. Then, when I want iced coffee, I just put milk, ice and my cold expresso in a large glass for "instant" iced "cafe con leche". Very refreshing on a hot summer morning!

column9: The Best Coffee in The World
column10: The Britt Poas blend is a bit spicier and nuttier than the regular dark roast but it is still relatively low acid and is very drinkable, very pleasurable. I first tried it on my honeymoon in Costa Rica in 2004 and I have drunk almost nothing else since. Much more robust and flavorful than Dunkin Donuts blend. I stopped going to DD and now brew a pot of Poas before I leave the house every morning, filling my thermos to the brim; this saves me huge $$ over the year AND I eat fewer donuts which is good :-). If you are a coffee lover I promise you will love this coffee as much my wife and I do. I have found nothing better.

column9: A definite must try for a coffee lover
column10: I have visited the beautiful Poas coffee plant that Cafe Brit has.  Poas Volcanic area is one of the better places from which to get coffee in Costa Rica. The altitude and more northern, inland location is slightly different from other growing areas in Costa Rica and oddly that has some impact on the quality (temperature and rain).Costa Rican coffees tend to be among my favorite because the flavor is mild and yet rich at the same time.  The roasts do not have that burnt feeling that comes from french roasting.  Despite that the coffee is grown in a volcanic region, the coffees tend to be less acidic then the Kenyan or Javan counterparts.  There is something just more, rich or coffee-ish, that separates them from other coffees as well (Panamanian, Columbian, etc).  I think the only other coffee I tend to like slightly better is Jamaican, but a good Jamaican coffee is significantly more expensive.If you take cream drinker, this blends splendidly to the point where you feel almost no acidity. I would definitely get this coffee if you can't find it locally in a store.  I almost always grab a few bags on my trips back from Costa Rica.
When I saw this coffee I was very excited.  Some of the best coffee I'd ever had came from Costa Rica.I was very pleased.

Let me start by saying that I am a big fan of Britt coffees and Costa Rican coffees.  I don't have an issue with the product or the price for the product.  My beef is with the outrageous shipping charge for a 12 oz. sealed bag of coffee.  That was about $10.  The coffee cost $9.50.  The shipping box was big enough to hold ten bags of coffee.  Why not just a sturdy envelope?  I will definitely find Costa Rican coffee in my local area and buy from a brick & stick store.  Usually I try to offset the state sales tax (8.25% in  the DFW area)with the shipping and handling charge.  There seems to be a trend of increasing shipping and handling costs.  Local sales tax on this purchase would have been in the range of $0.80.  Soon we will all be paying sales tax AND shipping charges through on internet sales unless something keeps us from paying ANOTHER tax which will surely affect the internet market.  Anyway, just my 2 cents worth.  No more Britt through Amazon for me.

I bought this and the White Chocolate syrup and was very satisfied.  When I added the syrup I needed to cut out the sugar (I usually only added 1 spoon of sugar to begin with) because it is very sweet, but the taste is amazing.
If you enjoy flavored coffee from a small coffee house or any large coffee chain place you'll love this product.

Perfect addition to my wedding reception candy buffet!  They were so vivid in color, which was perfect for my all purple candy buffet.Everyone was commenting on the great flavor, too.  Never seen purple gummi bears, but these are something I'd recommend to others now that I've seen and tried them.

Used these as part of my wedding favors. Purple was one of the main colors and everyone loves gummi bears. The only problem....everywhere we looked it was the one color that was not available. How can you have a "Rainbow" of gummi bears without the purple. We decided to order these and were very impressed. They came in a nicely padded envelope with a freeze pack to keep them cool. They arrived still cold and in perfect shape. The color is exactly like the photo and they have a very grape flavor. Quite a few people were surprised to see grape gummi bears and thought they didn't exist. It was an excellent addition to the favors. We will be order these delicious gummis again.

column9: Can't beat it for the price
column10: This is the best and best-tasting organic cocoa powder available for the price. That said, it can be found at a better price than Amazon is currently asking. This is NOT hot chocolate. It is pure organic cocoa powder without added sweetener of any kind which means you can add your own sweetener of choice in the amount you like. This cocoa powder is also great for baking.It mixes easily with water and other liquids if you go about it in the right way: place the desired amount of cocoa powder in a glass or cup, then add a small amount of liquid, hot or cold, stir well till smooth, then add the rest of the liquid and stir again. I use protein drinks daily and prefer chocolate to vanilla but no longer purchase the chocolate flavored protein powders. I get better results by using vanilla protein powder, adding 1 or 2 tsp of NOW Cocoa Powder to the protein powder and then adding liquid and mixing as described above. I've been using rendered duck fat from another company that's 4 times as expensive but not any better.  I use it to make a chicken liver pate that convinces even the best palletes that it's duck liver pate.  This is enough duck fat for about 1-2 pounds of raw livers (depending upon your fat tollerance).My secret pate recipe:5 ounces rendered duck fat1 lb chicken livers1 large shallot, peeled and coarsely chopped (2 1/2 tablespoons)1 tsp herbs de Provence (rosemary, marjoram, thyme work well)2 cloves garlic, peeled and crushed through a press1 tsp sea salt1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper1 tbs cognac or dry sherryOne loaf of 2"x2" rye or pumpernickel bread (look for this at the deli counter)Olive oilGarlic saltPate: Fry the first six ingredients until the livers are cook thoroughly.  Allow mixture to cool slightly so you don't melt your food processor.  Add cooked mixture to food processer and blend away.  Adjust seasoning and add cognac.  Cool in refrigerator.Bread: Heat oven to 400F.  Coat bread slices with olive oil and place in a single layer on a sheet pan.  Sprinkle with garlic salt.  These cook quickly so check them after 3 minutes.  You want a hard crouton-like doneness.
When my friend turned me on to using duck fat I was initially turned off. That was before I tasted it. I never eat duck by itself but this stuff is pretty incredible.

column9: Delicious and delightful tea for anise appreciators!
column10: First of all, it should be noted that I REALLY REALLY like anise, fennel, and caraway flavors. For those who aren't familiar with these (and it seems many Americans are not) anise has a similar (but not identical) flavor to licorice, as does fennel (albeit more mildly). Caraway, meanwhile, is the same stuff that a lot of breadmakers add to rye bread to give it that unique zing. If you do not already like these tastes, you will probably find this tea vile, but for those of us who happen to enjoy them, seriously, this stuff is the bee's knees.I've only got one bag left due to the rate I've been drinking it! It really is a lovely after-dinner treat, and in addition to being delicious, the combination of anise, fennel, and caraway is quite soothing to the stomach.The only "negative" about this product, IMO, was the fact that the box was not sealed in plastic film (it was just cardboard, with the teabags in a smaller non-sealed bag inside), which seems like it could result in flavor loss if shipping ends up taking a while. I put the whole box into a Ziploc bag when I opened the package, though, and as far as I can tell, that helped keep the flavors fresh when the stuff was being stored in my cabinet. I didn't so much like paying $8 or whatever it was for shipping a $2 box of tea to the USA from Europe, so I'm going to look around for a domestic source, but I am very happy I ordered it because it has been a tremendously enjoyable beverage (and I never would have thought of mixing caraway with anise, but these tastes do actually play very nicely with one another).
