The most delicious almond butter ever!  So much better than any other almond butter that I have ever had.  My local store stopped stocking it, so now I'm buying it online because I can't bear to go without it.

This stuff is completely fantastic! It's the only completely peanut & dairy free almond spread out there and it is soooo yummy! What a great company for people with allergies. Now my son can actually eat nut butter and jam sandwiches. They also have other products that you can find on their website. p.s. when they say crunchy, they mean crunchy. There are a lot of almond pieces in it. Which I love but I'm also excited to try the smooth kind. :) Happy Eatin!

I have been trying to stay away from peanuts due to mico-toxins. Also, many kids at my child's school have sever peanut allergies.. cant even touch them. The school asked us not to even send peanut butter sandwiches to school. This stuff tastes great! I was a peanut butter lover, now its almond butter. Low in carbs too!

column9: Best I have found so far.
column10: This stuff is awesome. It does not separate like a lot of other almond butters tend to, and it tastes great. Awesome option if you are a teacher in a peanut free school. I buy it for my girlfriend, so she can have her Almond butter and Jelly Sandwiches at work. Dogs love the stuff to.
It's a very delicious almond butter. The only negative is the small size - which could also be considered a positive!

I agree with another reviewer, Silverdrake: this is NOT "almond butter," it is an almond spread made with almond butter AND palm oil, sugar and salt. If they just call it "Barney Butter" with a sub-text of "a tasty almond-butter-based spread" I would not have purchased it.I didn't see the fine print, which is my bad...however, they should change their label...and Amazon should change their description.I gave it 2 stars (instead of 1) because it IS tasty...but it is more of a dessert than it is a healthy alternative to natural peanut butter (which IS 100% peanuts, by comparison). If they re-labelled it and sold it as a spread, I'd give it 3 stars (because it is too pricey for a spread, even though it does taste good).People wanting real almond butter would be better-served by the real thing eg Maranatha Natural Almond Butter 26oz Lightly Roasted

column9: Natural and good? i dont think so
column10: I was under the impression when buying these jars of almond butter that they were going to be all natural heathy and good tasting. in fact it was exactly the opposite. the almond butter tastes nothing like almond butter ive had before, it contains many unnecessary ingredients, like evaporated cane sugar, which is not listed on the seller page. why would you need evaporated cane sugar in almond butter? i hated the product and i am forced to throw it away because not even my dog will eat this stuff. Never but it! its a waste of money.

HOW SICK and DANGEROUS.  The jars of Barney Butter had been opened and were not sealed and leaked all over the packaging.  THIS IS NOT ACCEPTABLE.  I did not want pre-owned almond butter but freshed sealed jars.  THIS IS NOT ACCEPTABLE!!!  THIS IS A RIP OFF!!!Fred

Basically these are large fig newtons, cherry flavored. They're also small sized, good for toddlers and calorie-conscious adults, but be aware that they are less than 1/2 the size of an average cereal bar. I bought these thinking "healthy snack", but really I'd be better off giving my child some whole grain toast w/ jam and nut butter. These are convenient, though, but very crumbly/messy--not good car seat food IMO.

This product is very healthy for babies and toddlers since it uses whole wheat flour and cane sugar (instead of high fructose corn syrup like other cereal bars). The only problem with these is that they are smaller than other cereal bars so my toddler has to eat two for breakfast instead of one.

I got these at snacks for my toddler (20 months). They're pretty convenient, but I don't love the taste of them, and neither does my daughter. She'll usually eat them, but sometimes won't (unlike other fruit bars I've given her). I find them too sweet.

This is my sons favorite snack.  It is the perfect size for him to hold, and taste like real fruit.  It is soft, so good for many ages.  It even holds up well and doesn't make a big mess, so perfect for the car or purse.

We purchased the strawberry and banana bar and my daughter loves it, we have tried two other brands with no luck.  We were looking for a healthy breakfast bar that did not have high fructose corn syrup.  I recommend trying this this cereal first.

column9: OK, but expensive, quite small, and overly sweet
column10: I ordered these for my daughter when she was about 7 or 8 months old.  They are quite similar to a Nutrigrain cereal bar, but I wanted to avoid the processed sugars that are in Nutrigrain.  My daughter loves cereal bars, including this one, and it is a very convenient food to bring on the go.  However, I found these Earth Best bars to be expensive and quite small (although my daughter does tend to have a large appetite!) and overly sweet.  I prefer the TLC Cereal Bars (found in the snack section of y grocery store rather than baby food section).  They are less expensive and larger than Earth's Best, but are made of whole grains and avoid a lot of the processed ingredients found in Nutrigrain bars.
my 18 month old liked these bars, however they seemed a little messy (crumbly texture).
great tasting, natural, my kids love them. A good healthy snack without a bunch of artificial junk in it. I buy a case at a time.
Our three kids (ages 4 and under) love these bars. Although the apple bars are their favorite, this is an extremely close second. They're also great for travelling.
My son (1 year old) loves these bars, they're just his size.  I like them because I can throw them in the diaper bag if we're going to be gone for a few hours.

column9: great bar, just a bit sweet
column10: My child loved these bars for a while but then got burned out on them. They are a bit sweet and I didn't realize that until I tried to eat one to get rid of the last few. It was my mistake to buy so many before tasting them myself, so I hope other people try them out first. It did serve as a healthier snack for my child for several months so I am grateful for the product.The expiration date is a great indication that they are all natural and do not have a bunch of preservatives in them, so I threw the leftovers in the compost.

column9: Small for little hands, to small for the wallet.
column10: There are other brands out there that are natural or organic for toddlers that provide a little more per bar, either in quanity or ingredients.  They aren't bad, they just aren't the best.  They also tend to fall apart very easily and that will make your kid frustrated.

Our 2.5 year old son loves these cereal bars.  I love that they are organic.  They are a bit small, but I feel confident when I give them to him that he is getting a relatively healthy snack to which he will not have an allergic reaction.  (He broke out in mild hives when given a Nutragrain cereal bar.)  He enjoys them, and they are a good go-to snack when we are short on time.

column9: Great snack for an on-the-go toddler!
column10: I have a 15 month old son and he just loves these cereal bars!  He prefers these to a cup of yogurt, or any other food that may have him sitting for more than 30 seconds!  He loves to grab them and snack while exploring the kitchen in the morning.  I also throw one into the diaper bag for a snack in the afternoon (for him or me).  They are a fun way to get calories into your active kiddo.

If you make your own baby food and have been avoiding added sugar and salt - this snack is not for your baby.  It is un-naturally sweet!  Make your own... It will be nicer on your pocketbook and you can control the amount of sugar!!

I LOVE these organic cereal bars and I love giving them to my daughter. I usually couple one of these bars with a banana and some yogurt for her breakfast, and she always goes for the bar first (she LOVES bananas, so that's definitely saying a lot). Definitely preferable to the breakfast bars laden with HFCS and ingredients whose names you cannot even pronounce. The only reason I am giving these 4 stars instead of 5 is because they are a tad on the small side. Would be nice if there were just a little bit bigger! (My tot is a lean one, but when she finds a food she likes, she could eat it all day - I wish one of these would last her a little bit longer!)

Through Subscribe and Save we have consumed hundreds of these bars. Our twins love them. When I do not have time to make a sandwich for their lunch, these are a very healthy alternative. My daughter saw me typing this review and asked, "Please have cereal bars." A must have for mothers of youngsters.

This is by far my daughter's favorite cereal bar.  She usually has one for a snack everyday.  I've tried others but she likes these the best.  And they are vitamin and iron fortified so I feel like I'm not just giving her empty calories.

I bought these for my child and he does eat them and I've ate a few myself.  They are drier than any of the store brand bars that I have had, but they aren't like cardboard.  I probalby won't purchase again.
Great tasty snack. My only complaint is they are very messy/crumbly. Not a good on-the-go snack.

column4: Karissa Eckert "Devourer of all books fantasy"
column10: My son loves these breakfast bars and I love that he eats them.  They are lower in sugar than some of the other options out there and higher in dietary fiber.  They still have the added vitamins of other toddler cereal bars.  Overall he could eat worse things for breakfast :-)  We use it as a snack on the way to daycare in the morning, he eats his full breakfast later at daycare.I guess my only complaint would be that the bars do break apart pretty easy.  This has lead to tears a few times in the mornings when my toddler is sad that his cereal bar broke.  They also don't stand up to being thrown into the diaper bag very well.Other than that we love these bars!

My son will be two in a few weeks and he has been eating these for breakfast for several months now. he'll eat about two or three of these bars in the morning along with his cup of milk. we love these and they're great to keep a some in the car in my purse...perfect little healthy snack!

column9: Great taste and price but early expiration date
column10: My daughter loves this product and it becomes a little treat.The only reason I give only three stars here is because of the expiration date. When I ordered (April 09), the expiration date was about the end of July 09 (About 3 months away). I called the customer service but they said it is "the freshest" one. I don't know whether it is because they don't use preservetives or that is the freshest one in the Amazon warehouse.  My husband helps eating them out now.
My kids (1 and 3 years old) love these.  They make a great snack because they are not full of refined sugar, but still taste sweet.

My son, who is almost three, LOVES these.  They are a great snack that I'm happy to give him and they make a great breakfast for mornings when there's not enough time for anything else.  And, there's no high fructose corn syrup - I don't care what the commercials say - I still don't want my family to eat it.
Great product.  Daughter loves them and they are good for her.  Great source for the extra Iron toddlers need.
i bought these ones for my toddler and he loved them,as i love them too,because the flavor is so rich,smooth.I give 2 at breakfast with his eggs.I recommend this product to anyone.

The other day Mrs. Ulinov and I were wondering what the earth's best tots cereal bar cherry would be?  And we also were wondering if it would come in a 5.4 oz size or a more manageable 5.3 oz unit.Lo and behold, the earth has declared these cereal bars to be THE BEST.  I only wish they would come in pear-rasberry or blueberry-apple flavor....and they have an organic label on the box so it must help to keep the global temperature down.

my son loves these bars! i alternate buying regualar cereal bars from the grocery store with these they can get a little pricey because my son will eat like three of these for breakfast. oh well they're great!

so the kiddo loves (think angels flapping their wings in joyful triumphantness) these things!And great value to boot, plus organic... BAMM!Problem is the mess.  They end up all over my wood floors and in the crevasses of the walker and johhny jump up material.
My daughter loves these.  We actually switched to the Nutri-Grain or Target brand cereal bars when my daughter got old enough to be able to eat a large bar.  They are much cheaper.

I found this gum to be an average chewing gum. Im not able to find large packs of gum that i can store at work, so i go through amazon. i dont mind waiting for items to be mailed. I would however recommend stride chewing gum. There packaging is a little different but the gum flavor last slightly longer.
This is a decent brand of coffee if you like it fairly strong.  Easier than grinding my own when I don't feel like doing it, and nearly as fresh.
This is my second time purchasing this coffee from this vendor. I have been very satisfied on both occassions, and will purchase again.

column9: Healthy food for your cat may be more affordable than you think!
column10: It was brought to my attention by a friend who owns a local pet store that many of our three cats' problems -- weight gain, shedding, and inability to hold their food down -- were undoubtedly a result of their diet of Meow Mix. So 2 weeks ago I picked up a bag of Precise on her recommendation, and the difference in the cats is astounding.Their energy instantly improved. Even our old, lethargic cat started playing again. As active as they now are I am sure their weight will improve as well.  Their coats have a new shine and the shedding has been reduced drastically. As for holding down their food? I have not had to clean up a mess in 2 weeks!I was concerned that the price per bag for 6.6 ounces of food might stretch my budget, as it is a bit more than your average grocery store/Wal-Mart cat food, but what I have learned is that with a diet rich in vitamins and meat (not just by-products) the cats actually consume less. Factoring this in, I think the cost for a bag of Precise is very close to that of a lower quality cat food.I also worried the cats would not like this food, as they are extremely picky and it had reached a point that Meow Mix is all they wanted.  They love it!  I will NEVER go back to cheap grocery store cat food.

My vet recommended these capsules for my cat who has chronic urinary tract issues (probably stones). These work really well. My cat has had very few UT issues since beginning Chondro-Flex. I sprinkle it in his wet food and add a bit of water to get him to take in more fluids. He likes it, and there are no "pilling" problems. He has to take it every day for it to work.
this is great stuff, saw remarkable improvement in my 20 year old cat's mobility in just a month

column9: Helps old kitties be more comfortable!
column10: I bought this as a supplement for my kitties, ages 12 and 14. Both of them are having hip issues- one walks really stiffly, and the other one's hips squeak when he's shifting position. Poor guys, can't be comfortable.My vet recommended this Chondro-Flex for them, and I add one capsule daily to their wet food. It stinks like fish, but they love it, and they are both more agile than they were a month ago! I will keep giving this to them.

From the name, I believe this product is for joints and bones however, I must administer it to my 13 year old cat for urinary issues. Vet says it helps. I do note the cat is in the litter box less (he gets in and out straining to "go") and no blood tinges in his urine. Seems it is working and I would not have guessed a product such as Chondro-Flex would have been effective.
We have tried a few of the rubs and they don't have a lot of flavor to them.  So they are just ok for what you pay

column9: These are the best rubs around!
column10: These rubs are great for cooking!  I tried them a few months and have been hooked ever since.  The make your meats more flavorful and delicious than you ever imagined.  I usually marinate the meat with the rubs for a few hours than put it on the grill.  You won't be disapointed with these rubs. they make your food come alive and are great for every night of the week.

column9: Good rub, seems a bit overpriced.
column10: Four different rubs, okay quality, but seems a tad overpriced. i found similar rubs at a farmers market that gave me more and was $9.00 cheaper. Still this broke my cherry to use rubs on meats and still like it greatly.

my 9 yo daughter really loves this product. it's easy and quick to make, which makes it a convenient after school meal. it makes about 2 portions if you only eat noodles without adding chicken or tofu or veggies. but it's really tasty.

column9: A Nice, Simple, and Tasty Dish
column10: It's a nice, simple, and tasty dish to make. Add chicken, shrimp or tofu, bean sprouts, etc., and, if desired, garnish with chopped peanuts, lime wedges, pepper flakes, and cilantro for a fuller, more flavorful meal.

column9: Best Stir Fri, Thai Peanut and Gluten Free!
column10: Thai Peanut Is the perfect gluten free meal, easy and quick to make it's very delicious.  The best Thai stir-frys I've ever made.  I've been searching for restaurant style pad thai, in a box for quite some time now, my search is over.  It's as good as eating in a Restaurant, and if you have a gluten allergy it's you best stay home and make Thai Kitchen pad thai in your kitchen.  If you're making dinner for three, buy two boxes, one won't simply be enough. I made the Thai Peanut stir-fry with shrimp and added scrambled eggs to the finish patch.

column9: Thai Kitchen Thai Peanut Stir Fry Noodles (pack of 12)
column10: This will be my second purchase of this item today.  For a boxed product we found this item to be tasty.  We purchased a jar of Thai peanut sauce from the grocery store, and add about two teaspoons to the pack of seasonings, when soaking in a bowl of 1/4 cup water (as per directions).  It went a long way to enhance the overall flavor, as will a fresh lime, to squeeze over the finished product.
LOVE IT!!!  Can't beat the price from here.  I was paying about $3.50 a box at Publix.  Got these for less than $2 a box (shipping was even free)I AM VERY HAPPY

column9: Makes a fast flavorful meal with veggies and tofu
column10: I am so glad Amazon has it now, I used to buy it from Trader Joes. It makes a really nice meal with scrambled tofu and vegetables.
This is really good.  My whole family likes it.  It's really easy to pack in a thermos for school lunches too.

column9: Delicious, health, and easy to make!
column10: Mixing this stuff together with chicken, a bit of lime juice, and green onion, makes one of the best, easiest, and healthiest dinners I can make!  Surprisingly low sodium content, reasonable calorie count, low fat, and each box has enough for 2-3 full meals (depending on how much other stuff you add to it).Highly, highly recommended.

column4: S. Kirkpatrick "Country girl stuck in the City"
column10: I thought this would be a great meal. However the noodles burned! I put them in the container as instructed. After 3 and a half minutes in a 700 watt microwave the noodles were burned completely in the middle. If they need to be broken up or if there needs to be more water it should say so on the package. What a waste!

UPDATE:  NOW AVAILABLE FROM AMAZON!!!  Great price, no shipping if you're a Prime member, and Subscribe-and-Save to boot!  Can't be beat.  Yeah!!!  Try all the shapes:  spaghetti, angel hair, penne, elbows, farfalle -- you'll love 'em.ORIGINAL REVIEW:This pasta is awesome.  Tastes so good that my husband, who hates whole-wheat anything, actually loves it.  He now prefers this to any of his old white-pasta favorites and won't buy pasta at all if this is out of stock.  You won't even know that you're eating a healthier pasta, and you can successfully foist this off on non-health-food-eating guests.  We would like to order from Amazon because the stock isn't reliable at our local store.  Believe me, this is worth jumping through hoops for.  All of the different shapes are great, including the farfalle (bow-ties) which, so far, doesn't show up on Amazon, although it is available at some Walmarts.

column9: Love this stuff!! If only it was organic!
column10: Barilla Plus pasta saved me when my oldest son was a toddler and would eat almost nothing. I searched for something he would eat that was high in protein and fiber. That's when I found this pasta.It's high in protein (egg whites so not for vegans or egg-allergic), high in fiber AND has a bunch of healthy Omegas too!Most importantly--it doesn't TASTE "healthy". A lot of whole wheat pastas cook up mushy or too hard or taste grainy...just not like regular pasta. Barilla Plus doesn't. It really tastes like regular pasta. And my kids love it.I've been using it (fusilli, penne, spaghetti, farfalle) for more than 6 years now and my whole family loves it. I've even made it for guests (adults and kids) and no one ever guesses or even asks if it's special pasta. It's yummy stuff.The ONLY reason I didn't give it five stars is because it's not Organic. Then it would be perfect. :)

as a parent of 2 smaller kids who can be picky eaters, this is a must.  if we go on 'strike' and don't eat much protein for a few days this is a lifesaver.  my kids dont' know or care that it's full of protein but as a parent it makes me feel great.  my husband also likes the taste, they cook nicely too!

column9: You should not use this vendor unless you can wait for a long time.
column10: I placed this order on May 23, 2011 along with several other items. All of the other items arrived as scheduled. Today is June 13, 2011 and still no product. I have contacted Rice Bakery via Amazon email and not received a reply from them. This is the first time that I have had any problem with Amazon or their vendors. How long can it take to package and ship 3 bottles of rice wine? I will eventually find out if the product is worth the wait. That is if I Live long enough.

column9: Reminds me of Sunday at Nanna's
column10: These are so delicious and dense with pistachios. They are soft but chewy, and not overly sweet compared to some other brands.  They arrived fresh from Amazon.  I have been eating torrone since childhood, and this brand is now one of my favorites.

This Torrone nougat is very flavorful and nutty.  It is a little denser and more chewy than the other Torrones available at Amazon.The drawing seems to depict Pistachio, Almond, and ? Hazelnut, but just almond and pistachio seem to be present in these bars. Enjoy this well priced taste treat!

I bought this in a hurry, not realizing until it was too late to cancel (5 minutes later O.o) that this product is in fancy packaging meant to be used when hiking or camping.  Black beans aren't my favorite thing; however, I love hummus, and thought it would be good to try something different.  As it turned out, I don't care for the taste of it at all, and it triggered a migraine both times I ate some.  I threw the rest of it away and nobody else that I know is willing to try it...hopefully whoever picks up the remaining 5 packets at the food bank will enjoy it.Casbah makes a wonderful traditional hummus and is sold in 12 - 6 oz. units, whereas you get only get 6 - 3.6 oz. packages of this stuff.  My advice is to try to find a single package in a store to try before purchasing it here...otherwise you could end up blowing almost 20 bucks like I did.

I normally feed Acana grain-free but saw this on sale and decided to save some money.  At first my dogs were leery of it because it has a strong fish smell.  Once they tried it they liked it.  It has excellent ingredients and no fillers and is very high calorie----not for couch potato dogs or they'll gain weight.

I transitioned my little Shih Tzu over to FirstMate puppy food.  She is doing really well on it and she poops less.  Her activity levels are good and her coat looks great!  I think it is very important to know what your dog is eating and what fillers are used in their food. I was very impressed with the ingredients that go into their dog food.  At their website, [...], it will educate you about their products.  I highly recommend them to anyone with pets whether you're a breeder or buddy!

I have two dogs. A terrier-poodle (5 years old, 13 pounds), and a purebred maltese (4 years old, 7 pounds). They are both very active, and maintain their weight without much difficulty. They are healthy and active dogs, and I absolutely adore them! I care about the foods that they eat, so I make a concerted effort to make sure that I am feeding them the best foods that I can provide. While I believe the best foods, nutritionally, are whole foods, eating human foods frequently has not been good for my doggies teeth. It makes their breath smell worse and increases the plaque on their teeth.The next best option is frozen dog food or raw bones, but neither of those options are suitable to our lifestyle. So I look for dry dog kibble made with a solid ingredient profile.With the melamine, pet-food scare that was in the news a while back, I was/am more comfortable with food that is made in North America. FirstMate owns and operates their facilities in British Columbia, Canada. They were the first company to produce grain-free food in 1995. 73% of the protein is from wild herring (local from BC!) & Chicken. The remaining 27% of protein is from the barley, rice, oatmeal and potato.My dogs are happy on this food. It doesn't seem to cause them any stomach upset, excess gas, and their coats are nice and shiny. 5 out of 5 in my books. :)

I can't say enough about this cake mix. You only have to add water and a small amount of butter. I ran out and recently purchased a store bought cake mix and I was grossed out by the stick of butter and 3 eggs the recipe called for. This cake is light, moist and rises perfectly every time. They also have white and yellow cake mixes as well. I'm going to purchase one for my Mom.

We switched to this when Canidae changed their formula and my dogs got incredibly sick.  We either alternate this with the chicken and rice or mix the two bags for our two labs.  Their coats and teeth are beautiful and the nutritional content helps keep them active, healthy and happy.  Definitely recommend!

column9: Doesn't have to be creamy or sweet - microwave recipe
column10: This is one of my favorites, but I don't like hot cereal that is creamy or sweet.I found a method that works for me using the microwave oven, which isn't mentioned on the package.I have a 1000 watt microwave oven.For one serving: Heat 1/2 cup water on high for 2 minutes in a tall microwave-safe container. I use a 4" high covered Corningware pot.Add 1/4 cup cereal and heat at 30% for 2 minutes. The reduced power keeps the cereal from boiling over.Add a very small amount of water, if needed. (Having insufficient water can impact how well cooked the cereal will be.)Cook an additional 5 minutes at 20%.If desired, poach an egg on top for the last 1.5 minutes or so. Drizzle a teaspoon of oil on top before serving. Add seasoned salt to taste.

I am avoiding wheat, but used to love Cream of Wheat.  I had been eating pretty low carb, but wanted to add back a few good quality carbs, so I picked this up when I saw it at a local store.  I cooked it in water with sea salt, added some walnuts and frozen berries, and took it to work for lunch.  I heated it up, added a little stevia and some good cream, and it was amazing!  It would also be good with coconut oil, for dairy free good fats, or coconut milk! Yum!

First time user. Was surprised how creamy this cereal is.  Since I need to gain weight I add a banana & olive to it & will be doubling the receipe for breakfast tomorrow. I need to be gluten , corn,peanut. & soy free.
This bouquet is even better in real life! I've had it sitting in my front hall for over a week, and it's still beautiful.

I've been looking for a tasty canned iced coffee ever since the short-lived availability of Caribou Iced Coffee, which, amazingly, was sold by Target.  This stuff aint it.  It really has no coffee flavor.  In fact, it tastes almost exactly like one of the Slim-Fast "dieting" drinks.  It's WAY too sweet, and that's coming from someone that regularly adds a healthy amount of vanilla creamer to his morning coffee.

When I received the product I was surprised by the caloric count at 260 calories a can (more than a coke) and it is very high in sodium with 14% of the recommend daily value far higher than many comparable products.

I love these Main St. Cafe drinks!! I always buy these at the grocery store individually but was looking to see if I could buy in bulk and get a deal but no!! I can't believe how expensive these are on here!! For 12 cans it's $22, I buy these for a dollar at the grocery store!! Guess I'll just stick to buying them individually.

column9: Locally brewed in Germantown Wi, great choice for a chilled beverage when you are on the go
column10: Great choice for something to have in the fridge when you lack the time to make your own chilled coffee drink.  These are very sweet and more mocha flavored then coffee, so the hardcore barista types may not enjoy these as much as I do.  I buy these often and have never had a bad one.

I love this, but I disagree with the other review saying that hardcore coffee drinkers would enjoy it too.  I am not a hardcore coffee drinker, and I think most elitists would consider this much to sweet and chocolaty to be really considered quality coffee.  If you could melt down s'mores into a liquid and put them in a can, it would taste a lot like this.

This brand of coffee is SO good! The flavor is super chocolatey & not bitter. It doesn't wind me up too much either. It has been a real treat now that Summer is here. Not watered down, just thick & creamy. Main Street is just as good as Shock Mocha! I will definitely keep buying this, hope Amazon re-stocks soon. Otherwise I'll just buy it from an official website. I highly recommend this product to die hard coffee lovers!

column9: The best ones I have found
column10: I had bought the Reese artichoke hearts from  Amazon on a couple of occasions and they were uneven quality-wise.These are far better.  No stringy bits, no thick leaves too chewy to be delectable, and no dented cans.The only caveat, if this could be a problem for you, is that these are small, quartered pieces.As I usually cut them,  this saves me a step, but if you want them whole be forewarned.

Cento still maintains its perfect record in my kitchen. I have never been disappointed in the quality of their products and these quartered artichoke hearts are no exception. They are medium size quartered chokes - just right for almost all recipes. They are packed tightly in the can so you get what you pay for.The sections are tender but not mushy - no tough outer leaves either and not over salty - just the clean natural taste you would expect.With subscription pricing you can't beat the price.
This is an excellent value for the quartered artichokes.  They are yummy and we add it to soups, stews, pastas...

column9: Much better than the other brand I bought.
column10: I was getting the Roland quartered A H's for a while but decided to switch to these. They really are MUCH better.  I haven't found any brown pieces or tough leaves--something that is in EVERY can of other brands I've tried.  They taste better too.  Great in salads, pizza, pasta dishes, spinach casseroles, etc.

I would really like to have the knowledge to prepare fresh artichokes, but I do not. However CENTRO provides a good alternative. I use the product as a side in meals but mostly as a additive to salads with black olives. The salt content is low and respectable. I someimes just pick a small bowl for an apppertizer!

I love them straight from the can in salads,but even better in pork casseroles and pasta dishes.  Probably the very best artichoke hearts in water out there.  No mushy pieces or brown tips.  A quality product for those of us who adore artichoke hearts-yet must adhere to a budget.  These babies freeze beautifully in pork casseroles....I adore this product!

I purchase these through Amazon's subscribe and save program. I'm a big fan of artichoke hearts and love them in salads or just as a quick snack. The taste of these is very good and they are firm, not mushy as some brands I have tried. The problem is the consistency of quality is not there. Some cans have hearts that are brown (or turning brown) and do not look good enough to eat. I have unfortunately thrown many cans out because of this. Amazon is very good in their customer service and refunding my money if I ask them to. I don't think the poor quality is just from the inventory Amazon has as I have this same problem with this brand if I buy a can in the grocery store, some are good, some not so good.

After trying another brand in much bigger cans and hating having to cut so much inedible pieces off, I went back to a brand I knew from the supermarket.  The price from Amazon was quite a bit lower, and the quality is excellent.  Also, I find I waste less with the smaller cans because I eat all the artichokes before any spoil.

On Subscribe and Save these are a very good value. They are very tasty and surprisingly not very salty at all. I rinse them off as a rule, but they really don't need it. I like just snacking on them instead of sweets, each can (not each serving--each CAN)is 90 calories, can't beat that. You can really tell the difference between brands when, as I needed to do, I had to use up one can of another brand in my pantry to add to the three cans of Cento I was using in a recipe. I noticed that many of the outer leaves were tougher and more fibrous, inedible. Cento brand artichokes are tender. I like them in salads and on top of homemade pizzas. I also appreciate the pull-tab opening, no can opener to dig out of the drawer.

I had switched to Cento artichoke hearts a while back when our local store stopped carrying Progresso and found them to be better than most canned artichokes.  Back in March, I purchased a can as usual from my local grocery store, and when I opened them, noticed a fermented smell.  I emptied out the can and found orange, slimy looking things that looked nothing like artichokes.  I suspect that they might have been figs, but I didn't test out the theory.  I returned the can to the store where I purchased it, but they just offered me a replacement can which I refused.  Major disappointment, and I will never trust Cento again.

column9: Best bonito flakes ever, great value
column10: Highest quality we've ever found, and the big bag of high-quality flakes makes it a great value.

column9: I only pay $7.49 for the same thing!
column10: Wow, that's expensive.  My local Asian market sells exactly that same brand of 100 gram bonito flakes for $7.49.  I buy a package a week for dashi and as a cat treat.  About the product...fantastic but some of you shoppers may want to check your Asian markets if you have one handy.

Finally!  I found the true bonito flakes in its proper size, instead of the dusty-looking flakes from the other brands.  I haven't tasted it yet in any of my dishes (I'm still using up the rest of the "dusty" leftover flakes).  I can't wait to try them on my okonomiyaki though.

I buy this same brand of bonito for six dollars a bag at a popular online Asian grocer. Very high quality and great flavor (the kitties go crazy for 'em, too!), but save your money and buy elsewhere. ;)

One of my kitties LOVED these. Couldn't get enough. They were my baby's last meal before he had to be putto sleep because of cancer. This bag was less than 1/4 the cost of the container at pet stores on a per-ounce basis. My other cat doesn't care for them strangely. Never tried them myself, but imagine them to be very healthY!

I usually buy the more expensive brand and was a little apprehensive about this one being so much cheaper.  However, the cats don't seem to be able to tell the difference and they're really enjoying it
I used this to make Dashi - it brings a light fish flavor to the soup. I will be giving some to my cat loving friends as supposedly this is better than catnip.

column9: I'm rating this as a cat treat
column10: I learned some time ago that dried shaved bonito flakes make a healthy and tasty cat treat.  That's what I buy it for, not being much of a fan of fish soup.  I can report that all of my cats love it, although my mischievous 4-month-old kitten likes to spread it all over the room before she eats it (something that's easy to do because the stuff is basically weightless).  I can report that the purchase was without a single problem and my cats approve of the product.  If you have never fed dried bonito to your cat and want to feed a very healthy treat, try this!

I know these bonito flakes are used for all kinds of japanese cooking by my cat moochie loves these things.  We call them kitty chips and she will do just about anything to get them!  They have made her coat nice and shiny and she seems to be a happier cat!  Buy this product here because the dog and cat stores sell this for about twenty five dollars in smaller packages!  You're cat will go crazy for them!

Although these flakes are generally used for asian recipes, I generally buy them in bulk for my two cats.  They absolutely love these.  I call them kitty chips because they go through a serving pretty much like my husband goes through potato chips.  The difference is that the tuna is low fat and very high in protein.  Wish I could get my husband to like these.
I BUY THESE FOR MY TWO PRECIOUS CATS WHO LOVE THEM AS A TREAT! THESE WERE PARTICULARLY FRESH...THE PACKAGE ARRIVED QUICKLY...

This is worth the $10 this thing can catch a good 50 - 100 hornets, yellow jackets ect before you have to change the atractive sent. This is awsome especially if you don't know where the hive is. The only bad thing is if the sent gets on you it smells really bad and may take a day or so to get it off.
Too bad for me - had bought 3 of these useless pieces of garbage.  As other review only caught ONE insect in the three in the past month.  Do not waste your money - WISH I had saved my money....

column9: Knat trap? yes. Wasp trap? no.
column10: I bought two of these at my local hardware store. 2 weeks later, the only bugs in this trap are knats. Am I doing something wrong? does anyone make a wasp/hornet/yellowjacket trap that WORKS?

column9: My final foray into the insect killing sciences. (Attempt Number 3)
column10: My prior two failed traps: the WHYTR-BB8 W-H-Y Trap for Wasps, Hornets and Yellow Jackets and the Victor Poison-Free M370 Yellow Jacket Magnet Disposable Bag Trap both ended without success and both left me red and swollen.  Once I was able to move again I took a trip to the hardware store and purchased the Safer Brand Deluxe Yellow Jacket/Wasp Trap, since it was the only product on the shelf that I had not purchased.Strike three!  This thing didn't work for me either.  I followed the instructions and filled it with grape juice (apple didn't work in previous attempts) and set the bait up.  I gotta say, of the three traps I used, this one has the stinkiest bait.  I hung it on a tree and waited three weeks.After three weeks I checked it and nothing, NOTHING was floating in this little plastic coffin.  I was so mad that I took a baseball bat and knocked the trap right off of my tree, spraying my grill with bait.  If you've read my other reviews, then I'm sure you know what follows next....Yup, raccoon attack.  I know, completely predictable right?  Unfortunately for me, I like to have a midnight burger.  Meat in hand, I sauntered out to the grill at 10 past midnight.  I felt confident that, since it was night time, and wasps are not active at night, that I could use the grill despite not having washed the bait off.  I popped the top of the grill and was confronted by a 20 pound raccoon, no wait, it must have been a 300 pound mutant raccoon... yeah, that's it....  I dropped my meat and turned to run.  As I sprinted right into my reinforced sliding glass door (I bounced off of it) the raccoon reared up and launched itself at me.  Before a passed out I saw its little beady eyes peering down at me.I woke up the next morning completely naked and covered in raw meat.  My wife claims that there was no raccoon, and that I was acting out some strange fantasy... but I know the truth...

Currently have a number of yellow jackets and wasps around my deck area, so thought this would be worth trying.  Unfortunately, the original description did not include enough information to know that this would not work on my species of "wasp".  But even the yellow jackets were not attracted to it.  Another bad thing if you accidently get some of the solution on your hands you can't get rid of the smell on your hands easily.  Probably took me 8 handwashings and using vinegar to finally get rid of the odor on my hands.

column9: Hasn't attracted any wasps so far...
column10: ugh, we put it right by the yellow jacket nests-near the eaves-and hasn't caught one so far and it's been quite awhile now.
IT WAS FREE WITH A GREAT MEMORY FOAM MATTRESS TOPPER SO, WHY COMPLAIN?NOT THE BEST FOR MY HEAD, HOWEVER, I NEED TO ELEVATE ME FEET WHEN LYING DOWN SO IT'S A COMFORT FOR THAT.

I can't rate it fairly yet so I'll give it  3 stars. I haven't tried it yet but the inside label on the product says that it does not attract paper wasps which is what I am trying to control.I didn't see this on the description.  I will see what happens.

column9: Delicious and healthier alternative to other fried chips.  Nice cheese flavor.
column10: I recently tried these, after usually sticking to the Black Bean Sea Salt flavor.  These are certainly different from that flavor, but just as enjoyable.  The cheese flavoring is the perfect flavor for my pallet.  I won't switch to these from the Sea Salt ones, but will definitely add them to my chip rotation.Since these are fried in oil, they are by no means a health food, especially if you are focused on calories. That said though, they are an excellent snack and a much healthier alternative to potato chips or corn chips.The main thing that surprised me about these chips is how good they taste. To me, they taste just as good, and are just as fulfilling, as the other salty crunchy snacks that I tend to munch on in the evenings. I enjoy them plain out of the bag, and also find that they are good with salsa or dip.I wish the price was a little lower on these and wish that the bags contained less air and more chips, but otherwise I think they are great. I highly recommend that you try them.  The pricing here on Amazon, is usually about 30 cents per 6 ounce bag cheaper than what they charge at the local grocery store, HEB.  Specialty stores like Sprouts and Whole Foods charge even more for them.
Delicious!  Came on time.  Packaged exceptionally well. Didn't want to share.  I did think the price was awfully high for a pound but ohhhhh so goooood!!
My son really liked this flavor when he was between the ages of 6-11 months.  He is now 1 and prefers the real stuff in his hands.
I have ordered these for myself to use as a healthy snack on long work days.  Very convenient and tasty.  I think they should market them for adults too.

I think the other reviews seem a little dramatic.  I'd have to guess that the BPA is in the very edge of the babyfood jar lid, to help seal it.  so unless you are storing the food upside down or letting your child suck on the lids, it really shouldnt matter...hey...by the way, they ship them to Targe in a rusty metal truck that live in diesel fuel...  why this guy is even reviewing a pouch of pears is questionable.  If he wanted to hate the jars...fine, but this is a bpa free pouch product.The actual product.  Excellent.  5 month old loves it...and our 2 year old tries to steal them too!

My baby loves this stuff! I even copied the ingredients and my own homemade version for him as well! It's so tasty that I even sneak a squeeze for myself at the very end once I've given him most of it! Yum!

column9: My Son Vomited immediately after eating it
column10: Bought 12 packs of it in amazon,everything is waste now.My Son Vomited immediately after eating it.He is not allergic to regular pear fruit.He eats pear fruit regularly.But Pear from the earths best pouch is not the bestEarth's Best Puree Pears, 3.1-Ounce (Pack of 12)

My son loves it! I stayed away from bananas because of constipation issues, but the high fiber blueberries counteract it. Great combo. My little guy devours this! Great price at Amazon subscribe and save, plus they're hard for me to find consistently at my local supermarket or Target.

These are organic, easy and the most practical when we are around town. At 18 months, I can finally trust her completely not to make a mess. The orange/banana is her favorite and it's healthy and something I feel good about. They taste like an Orange Julius. We get a lot of these and I love them.

column9: Good Food for my Fussy Tot
column10: My son (21 months) absolutely loves this flavor. He's not a big veggie guy... loves his fresh fruit but can't get him to go for the fresh veggies yet. This is a great alternative. Earth's Best quality ingredients with the combined convenience of on-the-go packaging. Great for road trips, errands, restaurants, home, wherever! I keep this well stocked in my pantry!

My baby loves all of the Earth Best Puree style foods. These were perfect for our recent road-trip when I needed to easily feed her on the go. Less mess & BPA free packaging! I do like the Happy Baby line better....less expensive and they include some non-meat proteins.HAPPYBABY Happy Tot - Spinach, Mango and Pear, Stage 4, 4.22  Ounce Pouch (Pack of 16)

This verson of butternut squash with the added pear is yummy! The pear makes the squash just a bit sweeter but not too sweet.My son prefers this to the other two and three ingrediant squash or sweet potato options

Most importantly my son likes eating this flavor.  I like it because it has pumpkin and not only fruit. We also liked the pear carrot puree by Earth's Best, but don't know why it doesn't sell at the same price as this flavor.  It always is quite a bit more.
What can I say its candy.  They taste just as good as they did when I was a kid.  Try not to eat the whole bag like I did.
These are my favorite candies, and it's so nice to have them delivered to my door.  Love coming home to find a nice surprise on my porch.  Fast shipping from this vendor.

Delicious!  The whole family loves these, yet they can be difficult to find in local stores.  Just 60 mg sodium/serving and now 100% whole wheat makes them a bit healthier than your average cracker.  The Hint of Salt Triscuits are excellent too, but the Wheat Thins are a particular favorite at our house.  Stock up as you may find they disappear quickly.
These chips are light and tasty.  They are not greasy and salted just right.  We put them in Goodie bags at my daughter's wedding.  Everyone thought that they were yummy!

column9: Not as good as the syrup used by Duncan Donuts
column10: Good but a bit too sweet and not as good as whatever it is tht Duncan Donuts uses to make coconut coffee

Cooper's all that razzberry teapods can be made and enjoyed without the special gizmo. The tea can get too strong though if you leave it to seep in a cup like an ordinary tea bag. I just add more hot water and it is perfect. I like this tea because it has natural ingredients--hibiscus, licorice root, and natural flavors. The tea is a pretty reddish brown and smells fruity.
The chocolate was fresh and delicious.  Unfortunately, a third of the ballotins in the Signature Collectionarrived melted in the trays, which took out from the enjoyment of the chocolates.

column9: New Formula - Ingredients do not match Amazon description
column10: Just a warning that Old El Paso has changed their taco seasoning and the ingredients do not match the product description on Amazon.  The new seasoning made me ill and food products cannot be returned to Amazon but they did credit me for the purchase (great customer service on Amazon's part).

Fast shipping and packaging was appropriate. Expiry date was good almost 2-years from the product received date. Couple of my friends are using this product and I bought it from Amazon, better price than retail stores.

This seasoning is outstanding!  I don't use it to make taco meat.  I use the packages for that.  I use it to flavor almost everything else.  It is great on sandwiches to pasta with only butter.  I love it on steamed vegetables!  Wal-mart carried it for a short while but does not carry it anymore; so, I will be purchasing more from the internet.  If you have not tried this - you must.  It is a very mild flavor.  It is very noticeable but not pungent.

Old El Paso Seasoning is so versatile, and this particular canister is a VERY good deal compared to buying the little packages in the store that make one recipe of taco meat.  Flavor is great as is, or you can add more heat with a little cayenne.  The seasoning is good to use with pork in a slow cooker to make shredded pork too.  Soups, chilies, layered dips--tons of uses for this.  With Amazon Prime it is an even better deal.  Let's eat!

column9: Great product; great price from Amazon!
column10: I eat lots of Mexican food and go through taco seasoning like some people go through salt and pepper!  Buying in bulk from Amazon was great; I gave some of the canisters away as gifts; the rest I stored in my refrigerator until needed.  If you refrigerate, the seasoning stays very fresh!
After using 2 bottles of this product, I notice absolutely no difference in my cats dander or shedding. Waste of money!

I had ordered this for our outdoor cat that seemed to have dry skin compounded with terrible shedding.  She would constantly groom herself with no improvement.  I have been using the product for approximately 6 weeks and have had a wonderful turn around in her coat.  It's shiny, smooth, less shedding, just an all around improvement.  I squirt just a small amount on her dry food each morning and she doesn't hesitate to eat.  I will definitely be ordering more in the future!

My older cat has dander problems so the vet recommended this product.  While I was at it I put it in both my cats foodIt might have helped his skin and fur, but after giving him the quantity specified on the package, he got diarrhea.  I decided dander was preferable to diarrhea.The other cat ran when she smelled it in her food.So, bottom line, I use it rarely in smaller amounts for one cat and not at all for the other.

This is the only brand my cats will eat. They actually meow at me to give it to them in the morning. It works too. I have noticed their fur is softer,shedding less and my one cat has dry skin in one spot and it is going away. This is really a great product and cheaper here then at the vets!
I have bought at least 6 bottles for my cat and he now waits for me to add it to his food before he starts eating.  He loves it!

I have 3 cats I could not get 2 of them to even taste the product and the one that did ate some with her food and vomited it up about 15 minutes later.  I did also buy the product for my dog and she loves it.  Eats it with her food fine.

Mine arrived melted completley to the bottom of the box. No care was given in shipping and handling. The candy bars were the size and kind you by at the local store but cost more money. My kids scraped it off the wrappers and ate them anyway. Will not reorder!
The box did arrive on time and the product was as shown. However, the Hershey bars were discolored-purpleish, and the Kit Kats were melted. Will not order again.

column9: Wow! The Cinnamon taste is Strong!
column10: I added this to chai and to holiday plum herb tea (both have a cinnamon-y essence) and it was a kick!  This is intense, sweet cinnamon flavor.
This stuff is great.  I add to just about all of my drinks.  Over apples, in tea.  Good stuff!!!! FYI a little goes a long way...

Stevita is my favorite brand of Stevia.  I've ordered it numerous times (my bottles keep disappearing!), and gotten my family and friends hooked on it too.  The cinnamon is my favorite of the flavors, perfect for coffee and tea.  This has a really strong cinnamon taste, so just a few drops can be more than enough.  Anyone who complains of bitterness (as in another review), used too much.  Less is more!  Try a few drops first, and then add more to taste.  It adds sweetness and cinnamon without adding carbs and bitterness!
Sorry but this product tasted just awful.  I bought a few different flavors and did not like any of them (and I am a diet drink lover!)  It was very artificial tasting and left a strange after taste.

I absolutely love this flavor Stevita liquid in my morning coffee to give me that hint of sweetness with that wonderful and relaxing cinnamon taste. This is worth the price, pair this with your coffee, on a warmed sliced apple, to give water some flavor or whatever your preference if you like cinnamon you will love this!!!

I am making the swich from the artifical sweeteners to natrual stevia. I thought this might help in the coffee in the morning. It is very concentrate so don't use more than 4 or 5 drops, but seems to taste ok. In the past I have tried stevia but found it to bitter to the taste. I think I was using more than I should have. So if you are making the swich think less is more with stevia.

column9: My favorite of all the flavored Stevias!
column10: The cinnamon flavor was the one I found took the least amount of drops to get a real cinnamon flavor.  Many of the flavors took quite a few drops and then I got that strange aftertaste that Stevia has.  Highly recommend the cinnamon though!
Where have these been all my life? I love them and will be getting more for gifts for my parents.

I am trying to consume less sugar and I was turned on to Stevia. Cinnamon is my favorite flavor to add to coffee, tea, or even apples. The flaor isn't as strong as more expensive brands, but overall, I am happy with the product.

column9: Stevita products are cheaper and just as delicious as it's competition
column10: I am trying to cut out as much sugar in my diet as possible, and one of the major steps I have taken is to flavor my coffee with Stevita products.  They make a number of different flavors for much cheaper than their competition, and their bottles are small and tough enough and to survive without leaking in my purse!

The product was in perfect condition. I have ordered Stevita before that has come with labels that had dried spill marks on them, which does not look good and is disappointing. These did not, thank you!!

I purchased these hard candies online because I can't find them locally at any of the stores here. They make a pepperment lump candy also. The wife and I love these types of candy. Glad I was able to find them again.Will buy them again in the near future. Price wasn't too bad of a buy either.
Another great example of this fine chocolate makers produce. Good service and fast delivery too
This was really yummy, can't wait to get more! I love white chocolate, Ghiradelli chocolate is the best! I received it quickly

column9: Absolutely disgusting-not white choc, chemical aftertaste
column10: I bought these because they are listed in the white chocolate category and therefore should be white chocolate. I expected the "inside" dream part to be some kind of vanilla cream or something but the candy bar part, the chocolate part, is supposed to be actual white chocolate. It's a solid white square that tastes funky.This was the worst tasting, most chemical aftertaste I've ever tasted in candy and there is nothing remotely white chocolate, except for the color. This was some kind of dreadful lab created super sweet fake vanilla square. Even the vanilla flavor was not like actual real vanilla, unless maybe they used an entire bottle of flavoring or 50,000 vanilla beans. Still, that would give it a real vanilla taste, not a chemical/fake vanilla flavor.If you are not looking for creamy white chocolate taste and are not looking for that light vanilla flavor, maybe you'll enjoy it for what it is but I was going by the description and the name and giving Ghirardelli credit in advance that it would have a taste that was consistent with white chocolate with a slight vanilla flavor. I don't understand how a basic taste - white chocolate, milk chocolate, dark chocolate is a simple concept, and yet, Ghirardelli white chocolate is nothing close to white chocolate.By the ingredients, I suppose it is accurate if they are truthfully listing ingredients, but the taste is absolutely horrendous.

These came just as ordered and were given as a gift to my father who loves white chocolate.  He ate the entire bag in one day which probably wasn't a good thing since he's a diet controlled diabetic but he enjoyed himself.  Wish they sold this kind in stores!

As an unofficial chocaholic I must say that the Ghirardelli CWV squares were confusing by name mainly. Very sweet without much of a vanilla flavor at all they were by accident very good when combined with Ghirardelli's Intense - Premium Dark chocolate squares which from 70% to 80% pure chocolate were way too bittersweet if that even applies to their inedible taste without Ghirardelli's CWV squares. I purchased this item out of pure mistake not being a fan of white chocolate and wouldn't purchase these again for that reason alone. All said I liked then and wouldn't turn down one if offered to me.

I love figs, fresh and dried, and I've loved every Oskri product I've tried...until this one. The expiration date says 2012, but either I had a bad batch or these bars were intended to taste very bitter and sour. They're not sweet at all and even kind of burned in my throat on the way down.  I am not in any way a picky eater, but this is definitely one of the worst foods I've ever experienced.  Don't say you weren't warned.

I love real figs and really wanted to be able to have some small size "healthier" snacks to carry with me when I travel.  Love the size and how they are wrapped so well.  It is great to just throw these in my computer bag, suitcase or purse when I head out the door.  Even though I love so many of Oskri's products, these are not my all time favorite; yet I'm not quite sure why.  I like figs as an ingredient in other bars and when they are fresh.  I think what these are missing are the little seeds like regular figs have and I personally love the little seeds.All in all these bars are really handy and quite good if you like figs - without the seeds.  Another real bonus besides the small snack size is the packaging.  Packaging like this is great to keep on a shelf in our house or to keep at work.  Makes healthy snacking easy - just keep bottom open and grab-and-go.  Snacks like these would be great to have around for kids because the size isn't so large (reduce risk of obesity) and the packaging looks really appealing and fun - so kids would be more inclined to grab these instead of candy.

These are great little bars to snack on. Great for taking along to school or work. They are pretty good tasting and just the right size. I have consumed about six boxes of these over the last year and found them to be consistent in quality. They are slightly moist and not overly sweet like figs should be. If you are looking for a substitute for candy bars, these will do the trick. Nothing but figs, no crust.

column9: The bars are a lot smaller than expected.
column10: I was disappointed in the size of the fig bars. I received some as a gift in the past, and they were three times the size of these bars. The ones I received here, look like they are bite size, fun size, or children's size. I think I was misled by the image shown of this product. I think it would have helped to show a horizontal picture of the bar. Also, maybe put in the description that these are "fun size" fig bars so people know they are not the normal size they should be.On a good note, these bars are very tasty. I will just have to make sure I order the correct size next time.
My voice teacher gave me one of these and I thought they were amazing. I am going to buy a whole bunch of them now.

Somebody gave me this bottle when cleaning out her fridge. She doesn't use syrup much but it was brand new and had a long way from expiring. Well, she gave away a great tasting syrup!Compared to the store bought brands out there, this one knocks them out of the water. You can taste that it's much more natural than the preservative laden stuff out there. The sweetness is just right and it's nice and thick like you want it. I kept mine in the fridge so that it'd stay fresher.I was sorry to see that we've finished it and I even rinsed out and kept the bottle. Now that I've seen it here, I may purchase the bigger bottle. Looking at the price, I'd say it is worth it!

I first tasted Tasty Licks BBQ - "REDEYE REDMEAT RUB" - ONE POUND BAG on chargrilled Ribeye steaks and enjoyed it very much. It has a unique flavor that does remind one of coffee. It is especially aromatic and quite different from the other meat rubs I have tried; both store bought and homemade. Since then, I have used it again on strip steaks, allowing it to work its way into the meat for at least 4 hours before grilling. I did try it on St. Louis Pork Ribs and didn't really care for the flavor combination. I would recommend a bit of salt added to the meat in addition to the rub.The product is so good that I will definitely try the other Tasty Licks rubs. Enjoy.Recommended.

column9: Excellent Turkey Stew for Dogs Spoiled at Thanbksgiving
column10: Our three dogs, our dachshunds Wiener & Schnitzel; and Polly our rescue mixed terrier, love Blue's Tasty Turkey Stew.  When we bring out the can they know by sight the can. Wiener & Schnitzel sit up on their hind legs and whimper while I open the can.  Meanwhile Polly sits, her energy held at bay, while the meal is prepared.When I move the three bowls towards the dog eating area, all three dogs follow me.  All three bounce up and down on their front feet until I stop and hold the bowls out.  All three then sit.  Their dinner is then served.  The dachshunds usually finish first and attempt to go to Polly's bowl.  But they are warned away by Polly's growls, until she is finished.  All three dogs then exchange bowls and attempt to lick-up parts of dinner the others have missed.What a wonderful product.  Polly, who is scarred from a fire, has increased in size and vitality.  Her scar, which is bare of hair, seems to shrink as she uses Blue Buffalo products.  We think this is because of the balanced meats, vegetables and fruits in her diet plus the extra vitamins she receives from Blue Buffalo products.Thank you Blue Buffalo.
I would buy it again if the flavor lasted more than a minute, at that.  Not worth it with such short-lived flavor.

column4: H. Sherman "Riding in the Shenandoah Valley"
column9: Xylitol is good for your dental health
column10: Spry Cinnamon Xylitol gum is a good product and, according to dental experts, great for dental health.  I enjoyed this product.  However I have two problems:1. I can't find it in any retail store and paying $6.00 plus for shipping makes this product expensive.2. The cinnamon favor fades after a minute of chewing.Still, I would gladly use this product regularly if I could find it retail.

Spry gum is an excellent product.  My kids chew gum frequently during homework or playtime.  I like this gum because it has no artifical color or ingredients and Xylitol is a natural sugar, doesn't cause tooth decay!
great flavor, long lasting, good for your teeth and body.  Inexpensive....good value.  Repeat customer.
This gum is easy to use at home but when I eat something away from home, it's not so easy.
when I received this sesame bar it was very oily, it had unpleasent smell , there was no indication of the expiration date neither on the box nor on the individual bars

These are one my husband's favorite treats, and I have a hard time finding them! Just the right amount of sweetness, and a toasted sesame flavor that knocks your socks off. I wonder if the other reviewer tasted a bite before writing the review?

column9: A St. Louis Original -- Best Chocolate EVER
column10: My husband grew up in St. Louis (let me know if you want to know which High School ;-)  and the first Christmas he came to our house, he brought us a pound of the Milk Chocolate.  He certainly knew how to win over my family because our entire family practically had fist fights over this chocolate.It is incredibly creamy, rich, and full of flavor.  It makes Nestles taste like cardboard.  Their Bissinger's Dark Chocolate Peppermint Bark (10 Oz) is also like Nirvana.Service from Bissinger's is excellent and they often have free shipping. Every year, I send this all over the country to all of my family members and it is always the most popular part of the holidays for many.I've had a LOT of chocolate in my 40+ years... this is by far the best I have ever had.

As a St Louis native who now resides in Virginia, Karl Bissinger's Chocolate was at the top of the list of things I missed after moving.  Thank goodness for the internet.  Prior to purchasing these online, we routinely made trips back to St Louis to purchase Bissinger's Chocolate.  No we aren't really crazy, but this chocolate spoils you for any other chocolate). I have used this chocolate for years to make fresh chocolate covered strawberries for friends.

I can tell you that Zataar is great on bread and with meats as well. It is absolutely the best spice and even well tolerated on salt free diet reccomendations by the Doctors. Enjoy some and add olive oil to the dip.

column9: Worth every cent if you enjoy sour candy
column10: I still have yet to find any type of sour candy/gum that I enjoy more than this.  This gum is hard to find in the stores so I hope it stays available online.  I do miss the days when it used to be filled with sour powder in the middle though.  Still the best that you will find.
I found these at the dollar story, for you just it $1.  Please! The only good thing about this purchase was the container. Do the math.

Wonderful product.  It brings a distinctive flavor to fish that I couldn't capture before.  I would highly recommnend this product to any fish or seafood lover.  Combine this with a little lemon juice and you have a delicious seafood meal.
My sister told me about the product and it is everything she said.  Had good flavor and seasoning.
I love this seasoning for crispy tilapia. It is very salty, but it pairs well with a sweet/tangy salad dressing, like raspberry. It has a spicy kick, but it does not overwhelm the flavor.
This is a good all purpose seasoning.  It is saltier and hotter than Old Bay.  It is not a "boil" seasoning.  I used some for stocking stuffers since there were 6 bottles

column9: 5 Star Product, 3 Stars For Product Description
column10: I absolutely love these fruit snacks!  In fact they are my favorite out of the other "natural" brands I've tried-- "Yummy Earth", and "Surf Sweets".Amazon for a time was selling the 2.75 oz. bags for about a dollar a piece (but now they're back up to $2.50+ per).I thought I was getting a similar deal through VitaCost, but to my dismay, it's only a box of five .08 oz. pouches, and therefore not worth the price (in my opinion)!Nowhere on the product page does it say how big the bags are. I should have checked VC's website to make sure; next time when it's not specific, I guess I will.

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column9: no cookie dough and fudge unsatisfactory *updated 03/14/12
column10: Update: this listing has been corrected to reflect that the item is fudge flavor only; the rating has not been changed since the review does reflect the product currently sold. Original review below. - DGThis was supposed to be a mix of cookie dough and fudge brownie bites but it was all one flavor, just fudge bites. I've notified Amazon of the issue.Other notes on this product:The fudge bites are very lacking in "fudge" flavor - very cheap, overly sweet and artificial tasting.The "chocolate-y" coating has that cheap Whitman's sampler type taste, not very much like chocolate, more artificial-type chocolate-y taste.The whole thing is a little gritty and waxy in texture.It arrived in a bag within a box and the inner bag resembles a blue opaque trash bag; I am  used to food items being stored in clear bags only; this may be some new way to package bulk items?Rated as just the fudge bites I would not purchase again nor recommend.

Bought these as a gift for someone that loves Malted Milk balls. Should have asked before assuming they WERE Cookie flavored malted milk balls as pictured. They aren't...They are small blobs of cookie dough that is covered in chocolate.
Not available where I live.  I order it by the case.  Great with baby back ribs in the slow cooker.

column9: The Best BBQ Sauce Ever!  Really!
column10: My mother found this Bonnie's BBQ sauce a few years ago while on a road trip.  Since then, we have bought about 30 jars of this fantastic BBQ sauce.  We ran out early this year and my husband had to use a grocery store brand on his steak this week.  Horrors!  (Well, that was actually me.  He wouldn't eat much of his steak without his Bonnie's BBQ sauce and most of it went to the dog.) I'm ordering six more jars!
This bbq sauce is exceptional, and I highly recommend trying it out if you haven't already.

I was lucky to get this sauce in a corporate gift box. When I tried it on my smoked ribs I had all the downwind neighbors on my driveway. The sauce was a hit to say the least. I am very happy to find this excellent product on Amazon rather than to depend on some trucker from Jamestown, ND to get it for me and deliver the sauce to Cleveland.
Walkers Shortbread reputation remains stellar with regard to the quality of its product. I have enjoyed my purchase and those who shared in it enjoyed it as well.
This is the best shortbread ever and the only kind I buy.  Highly recommend.  Wish Walkers had a local store (Texas).
All cookies arrived brocken. Such expensive cookies and so poor pack! I believe the manufacturer should improve the way that they pack.

These cookies are GREAT!!! I purchase them often with my coffee @Starbucks coffee house..I'm glad that Amazon made it sooooo affordable, due to the shipping on the actual Walker website is quite expensive...I highly recommend them with your favorite cup of coffee or tea

Mrs. Dash Fiesta Lime seasoning is one of our new favorites.  Just enough heat with a kick of lime to add to your favorite Mexican dishes.  Not overpowering, just enough extra flavor to make the dish interesting and just perfect.  A little garlic, lime, sweet peppers, paprika, thyme, onion, and a few more flavors that work well together.  Tengo hambre!

I ordered these organic pistachios directly from Braga. And I ordered from Amazon when Braga raised the price. Either way, they ship directly from Braga. These organic pistachios are moist, plump and tasty ... a very pretty green and purple color. There were no discolored or dried ones. All good. I highly recommend these pistachios.
I use it as a glaze for ham and other pork dishes.  It's also excellent in pecan pie or as a topping for ice cream.  I always keep a bottle in my kitchen.
So good.  I like to put it on burgers.  Always a hit with guests!

These are the best bars out there..I was told my cholesterol was high and Ineeded to eat more fiber and flax...A friend recommended these bars when wewere on vacation...What a difference...They sure provide what I was told to doand they taste Great...Would definitely recommend these to all my friends.

First, I love Andes mints, but I also love a good deal.  You would think buying this bulk item you were getting a good deal but you are getting about 11 per dollar where you can get 18 for a dollar with Andes Creme de Menthe Thins 240 Piece Jar.  In closing, just cause it says bulk, it may not be a deal.

column9: Smuckers Sugar Free Breakfast Syrup single surve
column10: I love the Smuckers sugar free in the bottle.  For some reason, these single servings have an awful taste.To put it mildly, they taste horrible.  Do not recommend wasting your money.  YUCK!!!!!!!!!!!!!
As a diabetic household, this sugar free breakfast syrup product is perfect...very convenient and always fresh.  Order received on a timely basis.

I purchased the coffee maker based on being able to get Starbucks. I purchased boxes of Starbucks, Columbian and Breakfast Blend, but am now running low. I decided I would try some others. I hated Grevalia, the Maxwell House is OK coffee, but like drinking flavored water, when I saw the French Roast, which is supposed to be DARK and assumed stronger and fairly inexpensive, I thought I should at least try it. It is hard to replace Starbucks, but the French Roast is OK, not wonderful. I tried the Narob and several different others, but FOR ME this is going to have to be my Starbucks replacement.I had heard that Tassimo was supposed to get a better choice by mid to end of summer and it appears they have fallen short. I had heard that Starbucks was to partner with Cruinart, but so far it's not showing up. I'm not sure these single cup guys are so great, when you are forced to a limited brand of coffees. We are back to Corporate America manipulating our morning cup of wake up.
I'm not a coffee drinker so I'm going by my husband's taste. He likes it. Still a strong coffee but not overwhelming. I enjoy the fragrance more than the darker roast, that made me sick!
This is a really good coffee. I think this taste much better than Gevalia and at a fraction of the price. The auto delivery is the way to go because you save even more with this method.

I believe I have tried all the coffee T-Discs for the Tassimo.  The Maxwell French Roast hands down is my favorite.  I'll still try all new products offered but I usually go back the the French Roast.

column4: coffee drinker in PA "coffee drinker in PA"
column10: Surprisingly good! My favorite is the Starbucks Africa Kitamu.  However, if you purchase a two pack of the Maxwell French Roast from Amazon it's a better deal than the 5 pack....for some reason, they don't allow subscriptions for the 2 pack.
Maxwell has always been a great coffee. To put that same flavor in a T-Discs is great. I'm sure I will order more of the Maxwell coffee's.

I have been using this brand of coffee in my TassimoBrewer now for a few months and am pleased with it.I own a business where I offer my clients a cup andthey are pleased to receive a fresh brewed cup. If theywant it a bit stronger, I just end the brewing cycle sooner.

Maxwell House Cafe Collection French Roast is a good choice for those who like bolder, darker blends.  It has nice body and great aroma, without being bitter.This is a nice step up for an otherwise middle of the road coffee company.

This is a great strong roast, my husband and I drink it daily. We were drinking the Maxwell House morning blend, but we prefer the richer flavor of this one. There are no better prices on T-discs than on Amazon!

My husband and I were so disappointed when they discontinued Starbucks coffee discs., after reading the reviews on amazon and trying several different coffees, finally found this one, it's the best coffee so far and my husband is very pleased ! I didn't think its possible to find anything to replace the Starbucks coffee but this is it. We love it!

The cost is considerably less, however the loss of the Starbuck brand and African Kitamu t-discs was a real downer. I have tried many single serve coffees and Starbucks was the best. I'm sure it has had a negative effect on Bosch single serve coffee maker sales. At this time I'm considering a Nesspresso machine because of the bold, dark coffee blends available.

ordered a 5 pack and received a 4.5 pack. one pack had only one sleeve/box of t-discs. i took pictures and sent to amazon... but received no response. they got their cut of the sale so why should they care... . the coffee had a rich and bold flavor. i think it is a good value (so long as the quantity is correct). i will definitely buy this 5 pack again.

You've already discovered Tassimo, now discover one of their best and cheapest coffees!  This French Roast is just as good as the more costly Gevalia.  It's also better than the regular Maxwell House blend, I think it's called House Blend.  I used to buy it directly from Tassimo, but they have gone up a dollar per package so this is the best deal going.  Hope Amazon continues to offer it forever!
This coffee is a good choice for your morning cup, but isn't as great as some of the other offerings: Gevalia or Starbucks. However, at this price, I'm very happy with it.

You get a full (American sized) cup of absolutely delicious coffee. You'll be drooling while brewing! The aroma rivals any of the more expensive versions of coffee that I've sampled. You won't find a better price on any auction or shopping site. This coffee doesn't taste like it costs less than thirty cents a cup. This is the all around package. You will not be disappointed. Enjoy...I am!

This coffee isn't bad but it's nowhere near as good as the Gavalia Morning Roast.  It has a decent flavor and is fine if you don't like a strong coffee.  If I couldn't get the Gavalia Morning Roast, I would buy this coffee again but it would not be my first choice.

Latte's, Cappacino's and every other delicacy is fine but you can't beat a cup of Maxwell Coffee. This was a wonderful prchase my coffee habit is taken care of for a long while. Seller was prompt in shipping and it was everything they promised. This is a relationship I will cherish for years.

column9: Smooth, silky and always in my cupboard.
column10: This delectable brew always reminds me of eating in a Chinese restaurant where this black tea is served, rivaling in popularity with green tea. The taste is smooth and mellow, absolutely delicious with some sugar and even tastier when chilled. There is no harshness and no aftertaste and this would please even the most finicky tea drinkers. I used to make two or three cups of it, and leave them in the kitchen only to return later to drink the cool, silky tea. Also wonderful with milk or lemon, this black tea is my second favorite after The Prince of Wales also from Twinings and even though they are both black teas, they taste little differently. Oolong is my everyday drinking tea but it's delicious enough to be served to guests or to sip a steaming mug of it on a rainy afternoon.I have tried other brands of Oolong, but so far this is the gentles and less metallic and smoky tasting than others. I am drinking it now with some fried rice as I type, and in my mind I am ready to have a refill or two. For those still stuck on Lipton and Tetley this is the tea they need to change to, for the price is not high and the taste is absolutely fantastic. This is one tea not to be missed, as it's delicate and smooth, and so much more than just "tea".- Kasia S.
