Great flavor, a ton of fiber, and really well priced with subscribe and save! I highly recommend these to everyone. Great snack while driving to work or in between meals. Be kind to your colon and have a tasty treat at the same time!
These are so GOOD.....a great between meal snack or when you are on the go.

I used this seasoning a lot especially when I am seasoning seafood. It gives  it a very nice flavor . For me it brings out the flavor of the product that I am using. I also use it on poultry and meat.
Old bay is great with all kinds of meats-- fish, chicken, beef.  I use it all the time to add flavor.  Get some...
a MUST for Blue Crabs..But then if you eat them you already know that..Crab Cakes or ANY Crab recipe!!!  Most shelfish also
This seasoning is just awesome!  It makes the best steamed shrimp and is good on anything from veggies, to eggs to steaks!
I have tried Old Bay on chicken, steaks, pork chops, and catfish. I really love this seasoning and so does my friends.

column9: Delicious seasoning, cant get in stores in CT
column10: Delicious seasoning to use on wings and seafood, cant get in stores in CT.  Received the bottle of seasoning pretty quickly from shipper, very happy!

My daughter in law brought out Old Bay to season her hash browns Christmas morning so we gave it a try -- it was great!  She said she always uses it on French  fries and Old Bay's site recommends it for mashed potatoes too.  It's now on our list to buy and we will be trying it on everything.
Great as ever, you can't find this in local stores in Northern California.I love the shipping from Amazon.  It takes care of my having to buy in Virginia and send it to my daughter.

column9: Good flavor but WAAAAAYYYYY too salty.
column10: I like the flavor in this seasoning, I have put it on ribs and chicken as part of a rub and sprinkled as desired on almost anything. (baked potatoes, veggies, seafood).  Unfortunately I MUST use it sparingly because it is WAAAAAAYYYYY tooo salty.I will be looking into a similar lower salt alternative.  If anyone has suggestions please let me know..
was able to buy Old Bay in quantities needed for Seafood boil and at a reasonable price.

Can't being to tell you how much i love this pizza.  Not only is it low fat / low calories it's delish! I introduced this to several friends and they love it, errr rather crave it.  I get this product at the Whole Foods Market near my place, sometimes they have em on special 2 for $5. Amazon is a bit more expensive.  You will not be disappointed with the Cilantro Pesto Pizza either way!

I've tried several of the Naan Pizzas from Tandoori Chef and the Cilantro Pesto is THE BEST! It is filling, bakes up really crunchy and crusty, has sufficient cheese and the best part - it's really garlicky!  Smells great when it's baking.  Delicious and filling - the whole pizza is 420 calories.  That and a delicious salad with fat free dressing and I have a filling and quick dinner.  Love this stuff.  I must not be the only one - half the time when I go to Whole Foods for this particular Naan pizza, of the four varieties they carry, they are always out of or short on the Cilantro Pesto.  Why?  Because it's DELICIOUS.Cilantro Pesto Naan Pizza, 7.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)

add milk and/or ice cubes, fruit juice, coconut water, fruit, yogurt, egg...use your imagination. Lost 25lbs & am no longer anemic. Also great when you have no energy or inclination to eat anything. (It's like a smoothie, but if you were in hospital they'd use another product that costs more and tastes horrible).

My 98-year-old mother isn't supposed to have much sugar but she needs to get a few extra nutritious calories and likes this. It costs more than the bulk drink mixes but she prefers the variety pack so she doesn't have to drink the same flavor every day and she prefers the packets because they are easy, convenient and she doesn't need to measure anything. I've pretty much tried them all and I like the flavors and mouth feel of Instant Breakfast better than the other drinks. The Instant Breakfast vanilla tastes more like vanilla to me than other brands.

I was surprised how good tasting the vanilla is,and how versatile it is...If you can't have caffeine, but love chocolate,add a teaspoon of Chadfield's Carob powder.Add two drops of peppermint flavoring with the Carobfor a refreshing "peppermint paddy".Using the blender you can add 1/2 banana with Carob.You can also add shredded unsweetened coconut.Or blend a couple of fresh or frozen strawberries.For a "banana split", add Carob, banana, and strawberries.These drinks are all yummy AND nutritious!

I ordered this for my father, who is undergoing cancer treatment for throat cancer.  He is also diabetic.  In our area the stores either don't carry any sugar free or only the milk chocolate flavor.  he was getting sick of the chocolate flavor, as well as it being limiting in what could be made with it. After removing the meat from the pan I added 1/2 stick butter. If I didn't have the drippings, I would have used a whole stick. In addition to mushrooms, I added sliced onions. Saute the vegetables in the butter. Add the water, then the sauce packet. Stir with a whisk or spatula until the sauce thickens, which is fairly quickly. Remove from the heat and let the sauce set for few minutes to continue thickening. I served this with Thai jasmine rice. I will try adding bell peppers the next time for a colorful variety. column9: an effective weapon in the arsenal...
column10: In certain applications, Terro's Ant Dust can be an effective tool in attempting to control ants.  Contrary to what some have said, the dust does not kill ants on contact, but given some time, the dust does seem to be effective in combating ants, as they will generally avoid areas treated by the dust.  As the dust is white, it's usually easy to tell where the dust has been applied, unless the area happens to be white.After spreading the dust under bricks and various rocks where ants are nesting and egg cases are present, I found that there were no live ants in the area the next day.  When dust was sprayed into cracks in rock walls and sidewalks where ants were present, once again, no ants a day later.  The dust will keep them out of the area for a while, although how long depends on things like the weather.  The powder isn't quite `waterproof' as cIaimed, but it does resist watering or rain washing it away.  You may need to reapply occasionally.The thing about ants is that they are resourceful, determined, and relentless.  Unless the ants are killed, they almost never give up.  When this ant dust prevents them from taking a particular path, the ants will take an alternate route, if one is available.  Be prepared to either spread more dust, or kill the ants.  Unless they have no other options, they will probably keep coming.Of course, you always want to use this product in a safe and approved manner.  Do not apply it anywhere near where food is prepared, or where there is any possibility that children or pets might be exposed to it.  I only use it outdoors, and recommend wearing a surgical mask and safety glasses when applying, especially when there is wind.  Shaking the dust from the container works fine for some applications, but with the one pound can, you may not have a lot of control.  Applying the dust into a tiny hole or crack could be a problem.The dust is very fine, and can be applied as a spray, but the trick is that you will need to come up with a suitable spray container.  An empty nasal spray bottle, works well for me.  Enlarge the opening in the nozzle, and with a little practice, you should be able to apply the dust into nooks and cracks.  The dust isn't always easy to apply evenly, so I use an old toothbrush to spread it around when necessary.This dust probably won't wipe out the colony, but could be an effective tool for helping to control ants.  Ant colonies are generally sensitive to any kind of attack, and often will withdraw when they experience losses of life.  Good luck! :)

column9: My Terro cheer...Let's hear it for Terro, Terro, TERRO!!!!
column10: This is the third Terro product we've tried this year.  The first, Terro 300 Pre-Filled Liquid Ant Killer II Baits, 6-Pack, proved successful in enticing carpenter ants to eat its tasty poison. You can see inside the 6-pack bait, and can tell instantly if the ants have been eating it. All 6 of ours were emptied within a day or two of the ants discovering its goodness.  So, we ordered Terro 1800 3-Ounce Outdoor Pre-Filled Liquid Ant Baits, 3-Pack and were a bit dismayed that we couldn't see inside; however, we're confident our carpenter ants like it too.  But, every day, my hubby would say, "I don't like all these carpenter ants coming into the garage."  So we ordered Terro ant-killer in powder form. It works a bit differently than the liquid baits. The powder bait kills on contact, is waterproof and lasts for 8 months. Once the ants know how bad it is, they stay away from it. We have no more carpenter ants coming into the garage. We then put it around our home's foundation, and sprinkled some onto/into our railroad ties that the ants had taken up residence in...well, at least that's how it looked to us. The only problem we have is trying to remember to step over the poison, otherwise we track it into the garage...then into our home.  yikes! We must remember to clean our shoes off!  If you have pets or young children, well, any kids that play around the house, you might want to be careful where you put this powder.I like Terro ant killer enough to cheer about it!

They attacked me while I was mowing the lawn, and invaded the house and helped themselves to the dog's food.This meant war.After doing my research, I decided to buy the Terro Ant Dust.  It was the cheapest, and had high marks from my fellow Amazonians.This stuff works.  I sprinkled it on the dirt ant hill, and watched the ants go crazy and die.  To speed things up, I poked their colony with a stick.  This made hundreds of them pile out of their ant hill and walk all over the white powder.I'm not sure how Terro Ant Dust works.  It doesn't look like the ants eat the stuff.  But, die they do.CAUTION:  Every single time I applied the Ant Dust, I took care to not get it on my hands, eyes, or to breath it in.  Still, I felt sick after each application.  Next time, I guess I'll wear a haz-mat suit so that I avoid all contact with the Ant Dust.UPDATE:  After 24 hours, most of the ant hills are without activity.  BUT - new ones have popped up.  Huge ones.  These ants are active.  I hit the new ant hills with more Terro.  Next step - Spray the entire yard with indiscriminate bug killer.  A man's got to do what a man's got to do!

I had ants tracking from outside the front door all the way to my kitchen.  This stuff took care of the outside ants within hours and there were no more intruders.  I also bought the inside liquid bait traps, but not a single ant got to those - this could be because it was late for the bait, or the outside stuff just demolished their track.  I did watch to see if they would continue to track, but after laying this powder down the ants all died or moved on.  I recommend this highly.One warning, this product is waterproof.  I went heavy on the application and that was a mistake - go light! - it will kill them!  I have some caked powder around my door that I have to clean up, but had I applied lighter, would not really be an issue.  This stuff works.  I bought it through Amazon and it arrived within a week.  Recommend.The only reason I'm not giving this a 5 is that it will not go away once applied, but as mentioned above I went heavy with the application - go light, and it will not be a problem.  Worthy of 5 stars for those who follow directions better than I.

I recently discovered Annie's Homegrown Organic products and I have absolutely fallen in love with the taste. Out of all the bunny grahams the chocolate bunnies are THE BEST! Great taste and it's so chocolate-y! MMmm, yum yums!
My whole family loves these bunnies. They are so good and better for you than most of the junk on the market. I love Annie's products!
My 2 year old loves these!  He doesn't even miss the usual brand of chocolate graham snacks he was used to before I found these.  It's so great to know he's snacking on something that is all-natural.
Great chocolate taste with a satisfying crunch. Love the size for little hands. Whole wheat and organic! Gotta love that!

column9: yummy , yummy in my bunny's tummy
column10: She loves em !!!!! my three year old does! very chocolaty taste & not overly sweet ! Soo hopping goood !
These are delicious and also a healthy snack for your kids. No artifical ingredients or high fructose corn syrup!

column9: Not as good as cinnamon flavor
column10: Okay but chocolate Teddy Grahams or the cinnamon flavor Bunny Grahams have far superior flavor.  My preschooler will eat one or two but mostly leaves the bowl if I give them to her for a snack.

For this item I withheld the 5th star in my review because it's expensive (less expensive than others that I've tried, but because I buy a lot, it gets expensive).  It's the best TASTING sea salt I've tasted (I've tried twelve gourmet brands b4 finding this one).  It's not overly salty; the salt plus whatever minerals embedded in the Blue Crab Sea Salt tend to make everything tastes better.  (The mineral flavors in the salf is more pronouce when used with unheated food.)  The only downside is the possibility of the taste becoming inconsistent: mineral/chemical composition changes according to condition affecting sea waters, so taste may vary--Hey, I bought enough to last a while.  Yum, yum.

This is my very favorite salt. Some people can't tell the difference between various salts- but I can and this is my very favorite! (I also have tried various other sea salts from around the world!)It's a good deal for sea salt- there is a lot of salt per canister.

Yum, yum, yum. I've wanted to try sea salt for a while now. It really has a flavor, unlike table salt. I will never go back to table salt. I love that I could buy 9 ounces (Pack of 6). I will do fine for a while. I'm giving some to my mother for Grandparent's Day; And why shouldn't I?
This seasoning is amazing - I wasn't a fan of roast until I used this seasoning. Very prompt shipping by seller.

I purchased this as a last minute Christmas gift for my wife. It arrived as promised and was everything I hoped for. My wife loves smoked flavor uses it on everything. She couldn't be happier. You can smell the smoke as soon as she opens the container. My next problem is to find a covered shaker that will trap the smokeand keep the salt fresh.

If you like smoked sea salts this is a very good product.  The smoke flavor is mild and the taste is great.  I put this salt in a grinder and find that the crystals are a bit small so it comes out fast.  I may switch to a small jar and salt spoon or a large holed shaker.  The 12.4 oz jar is enough to go a long way as seasoning salt.

This is a quick and easy to make chocolate pudding that's DAIRY FREE!  We take this when we travel, shake it up in a  protein shake shaker and it works every time.  Don't add too much water.  It does make a small amount as you only add 1 1/4 cups water, which does not make 5 servings, but for my husband and I it's a real treat since we can't order desserts in restaurants (gluten and dairy allergies).  And it's fat free!!!!
I have always used the Nestle Mousse, but since they have stopped making it I bought this kind.  It is very fluffy, but not quite as sweet as the Nestle.
I found out that the Nestle European Style Mousse mix (the leading brand in the U.S.) is now sold under the Inspired Cuisine brand name.  It's still the best out there, by far.

I bought this because I enjoy a light roast coffee in the morning + it was on sale for $15.35. I wish I had bought more for that price. This is one of the best light roast coffee's I've ever had. I read a few reviews of this on [...], which gave very high marks, now I can see why.Wow, what a great cup of coffee. Try it if you like any of the breakfast blends available out there. If your a light roast lover like I am, you will love this single origin coffee.

I'm pretty much in concordance with Will the first reviewer. I use to drink Costa Rica Tarrazu when I bought it through Gevalia's coffee program. So when Amazon had it on sale I bought a two pack just to see if the two brands were similar. I can report yes they are. I brew mine in my B40 7.5Oz setting and what a wounder coffee it is. I love the aroma when it first starts filling my cup. A light roast with a mild after taste. Never overpowering. I drink my coffee with cream and a sugar substitute. This one wins a spot on my 10 top most favorites listIf you like a light roast, this coffee is for you. You will not be disappointed.Hint #1 I highly suggest that you get some type water filtration system for your coffee waterHint #2 I immediately remove the used K-cup after brewing and leave the K-Cup holder open to avoid  the accumulation of that stale coffee smell to permeate the k-cup holder.UPDATE I just purchased another 2 pack of this coffee :)

column9: Breakfast is a little better now
column10: Amazon placed the Van Houtte blends on sale recently.  I had tried Van Houtte coffees on a trip to Canada and really enjoyed them. I figured the K-Cups would probably stack up to the batch brewed coffee I had on my trip.  My thought turned out to be correct.  The Costa Rica Tarrazu is a very smooth, medium roast. It has a bright, slightly sweet and lightly acidic flavor, followed by a pleasant, lingering finish with no bitterness. The aroma when brewing is pleasant. I don't use milk or sugar in my coffee, so I'm not fond of really acidic roasts. This is one of the better K-Cups I have tried.Not for you if you like a very dark roast. But if you appreciate a good City roast, definitely put this one on your list. I'll be a repeat customer.

column9: How much should you pay for Van Houtte Tarrazu coffee
column10: I love this coffee a lot because it's mild and has flavor .However I'm shocked at the price of this Van Houtte Costa Rica Tarrazu Coffee .Since Van Houtte wont ship this coffee to the USA and has dismantled their web site ,you only have 1 choice , Amazon .There for around $50 you can buy 48 cups roughly $1.04 per cup .But wait ,and I spent a few hours researching the availabilty of this coffee .I found a web site "tweedandhickory" where they sell 24 k cups or loose coffee in a bag for around $17 , and they do ship to the USA although expensive around $18 .BUT!! here is what you do if you like this coffee so much as I do.The shipping charges while high for 1 order ,increasing your order the shipping is a tiny bit more .SO!! if you buy 5 24 cup boxes and ship to the USA (Boston area) the cost including shipping is $89 thats .74c a cup .This is what I'll do ,maybe we can break the Tarrazu cartel ,because not even Keurig carries it .I hope Amazon will publish this review because it would be a great saving for the readers that like this coffee . I think no one should pay more than .75c a cup .Since I wrote this review I discovered another online site "filterfreshlv.com they sell this Tarraszu for $14.95 for 24 cups plus shipping .Spend $50 ,shipping is free .I can't understand why Amazon my favorite company deals with this company that lists the retail price at $33 which is crossed out and the price is now $45.95 plus tax .Unfortunately a big scam is being is being played here Filter Fresh and the Amazon seller are both advertizing Tarrazu and are delivering Costa Rican coffee .The only similarity is the Van Houtte printed on the box .It's virtually impossible to buy Tarrazu in this country so some sellers are showing a picture of a split label cup which says Tarrazu ,but when you buy and open the box the cups have a black label which says Costa Rican coffee .Folks there is a difference and these sellers are substituting Costa Rican coffee knowingly and charging outragious prices.This should be stopped ,and twice I have bought what was advertized as Tarrazu and wasn't .After pointing out to these sellers they told me to keep the coffee and refunded my money ,but continue to bait and switch the public.The only place to get Van Houtte Tarrazu coffee is in Canada and most companies wont ship to the USA.In conclusion the Costa Rican coffee is good but not as good as Tarrazu ,so you will have to drink this slightly inferior coffee .I just get upset about the games being played.2/26/12At last I found it Tarrazu coffee ,not Van Houtte but from George Howell in Newtonville ,MA web site www.terriorcoffee.com .While it isn't Van Houtte it's a delicious quality coffee in a 12 oz bag (no K-Cup )at $13.75 .I live about 4 miles from their coffee shop and because I bought this bag of coffee ,they gave me a free cup of their coffee of the day .That was El Roble from Colombia  and boy was that delicious .For those people who don't know who George Howell is ,he started Coffee Connections in the Boston area many years ago ,only to be bought out by Starbucks .Well he's back at it brewing great coffee and he carries Tarrazu .

I've tried more than 20 K-cups found on Amazon since purchasing my machine in early 2009. To give an idea of what other blends I enjoy-Donut Shop, Wolfgang Puck Vienna, Kona Blend, Gloria Jeans Hazelnut-so generally medium roasts with decent but not overpowering coffee flavor. This is my favorite. It is a very smooth aromatic cup of coffee with a wisp of nut flavor. I usually add a bit of creamer and a splenda to my coffee. This is perfect. I like it on all settings but I tend to use the medium most.

I'm not a coffee snob or anything, but this is simply the best tasting coffee we've used in our K-cup machine.  We've only tried about 10 or 12 different varieties, so keep that in mind, but this now our go to flavor.

column9: This Coffee Has An Amazing Taste
column10: This coffee delivers a strong flavor without being a dark roasat. By comparison, it makes many other coffees just seem bland. This is a coffee that will appeal to everyone.
I REALLY like this... right now, it's my favorite. It's not bitter and has great "coffee taste". I thought dark roasts were my favorite, but this light roast is surprisingly good.

column9: Only buy this if you like really weak coffee.
column10: We have not enjoyed this coffee at all - it is very weak and tastes like it came out of a regular coffee maker - not a Keurig!  If you like very weak coffee I am sure it would suit you...but to use up the K-cups I bought, we are now brewing two cups - one Costa Rican (middle cup size) and one dark roast bold and pouring half of each into each cup when we have our morning coffee! We will never buy this one again.

It's a lighter roast as the title indicates...and good for the early morning for me.I got this on a special..48 kcups for $15 shipped.  This is a pretty good coffee...4.5 stars.  Giving it 5 stars for the ridonkulous price.I will keep my eye out for this again.

Makes a great cup of coffee as others have written, and I particularly enjoy making iced coffee with it. I fill a 16oz cup with ice and brew the small size on my B50(older model).  It stops brewing just in time with a full glass (just enough room for a little cream).  Price was decent and received quickly.
I would recomend this to anyone who does not like a strong coffee. I will buy this coffee again....

I ordered this coffee cause it was the cheapest K-cups I could find any whereon the Internet.  Don't let the inexpensive price fool you, Van Houtte has some taste rich, quality blends.  My only complaint ... I went through ten boxes way too fast.  I am more annoyed at the grocery chains because they don't keep K-cup coffees on their shelves.
Nice light roasted coffee with no bitter aftertaste. If you'd like a nice smooth cup of Joe in the morning you will like this.
I just brewed my first cup and it does have a good taste.  However, I thought this was regular coffee and on the bottom of the box it says it is decaffeinated.  So is it regular or not?

column9: One of my favorite K cups!
column10: I've sampled many different varieties of K cup and this one is in my top 2.  If you enjoy Costa Rican coffees and the distinctive flavor that goes along with them then chances are that you will love this K cup.  The flavor is great while also being very smooth and a great compliment to breakfast.  Highly recommended!

column9: Terrific flavor has changed, but Amazon keeps the old pictures
column10: Van Houtte's Costa Rica Tarrazu was the BEST, but unfortunately the manufacturer has changed the formula. Instead of a sweet, mild, light roast that even people who dislike coffee could love, VH changed it to a more medium, more bitter, more dark roast (even though it says light).  Even though I dislike coffee, I love my Keurig - and was so happy to find a great flavor and devastated that VH changed it from "Costa Rica Tarrazu" to just "Costa Rica" (you'd think coffee manufacturers would want to keep a flavor that would be a "gateway flavor" for folks with sweet tooths!) I was thrilled when Amazon pictured the old style of Tarrazu (two colors, word "tarrazu" included) and tried buying it in December from Royal Buy.  To this date, they STILL have not responded to my two letters complaining that they did not send the old style as pictured, but the new formula (single brown color, "tarrazu" not on it). I have 47 k-cups I don't want to drink, no response much less an exchange or refund, and it was a terrible price.  What's worse, Amazon is continuing to show pictures of the old formula from other sellers.  "We3_Sell_Stuff" was kind enough to write and warn that they are selling the new formula; have not heard yet from Coffee Filters.  This is not the only product where Amazon pictures a (better!) old formula (liquid soap comes to mind), meaning it is hard to trust what to buy for those of us hoping to find the last of an older formula of a favorite product.  Caveat emptor!(Rating is difficult - 5 stars for old flavor; 1 star for new flavor; 0 stars for Amazon's misleading photos & for Royal Buy).
This is my favorite coffee but the cost went way up. I used to purchase it from here but then I found it cheaper here [...]

I could not wait to get this coffee after reading all the raving reviews.  It was okay to me.  I LOVE Costa Rican Tarrazu, this is just not quite light enough for my taste buds...but I've kept it and I do drink it with something sweet and that helps get me past the not so light tasting roast.

I drink a lot of coffee.  I like it black and medium to full bodied.  I like french roast and Sumatra but not in the morning. In the morning I like something lighter but not weak. This is the best morning K-cup I have tried.  It is full bodied and flavorful. It has a slightly nutty flavor and is in the true tradition of single origin South American.  I wish they had a Guatemalan but this is the next best thing. My only complaint is they stopped offering it as a subscribe and save.
I've loved almost every Van Houtte K-Cup I've ever tried.  This one has a bit of a bite for my taste. But I've known other's who love it. I'd say it's worth a try but it's not one I'll buy again.

Van Houtte Cafe, Costa Rica Tarrazu (Light Roast) Coffee, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2)Of all the coffees I tried since getting my Keurig, this is the best so far. This is my 3rd refill. My suggestion is to try using a Capresso frothPRO that  also got on Amazon. Makes great crema using skim milk. Then add a spoonful of Splenda Brown Sugar Blend for Baking - 16 OZ, mmmmmmmm good!

Got hooked on Tarrazu coffee while working in Costa Rica. This is a pleasant cup that tastes just as I expected it to. Not for people who want coffee so strong that it walks around on its own... they will be disappointed. Glad to find it in a k-cup... the stash I brought from CR for my conventional coffee maker was all gone!

This light roast is absolutely delicious.  I normally buy dark roasts, but my husband wanted me to get some lighter roast K-Cups for him.  I was was so pleasantly surprised at how much flavor this coffee has.  I would highly recommend this.

column9: Van Houtte Cafe "Costa Rica" is great
column10: I love this coffee.It's more on the bottom end of medium I'd say then light roast.It smells so good brewing and taste wonderful.A hidden gem in my book.I got 2 24PK's at $26,happy camper here
Purchased this for my husband.  He prefers a light tasting blend and this seems to suit him just fine.

I bought these on a Friday special on a whim.  I was running low on k-cups and thought I'd give them a try.  These are fantastic.  I prefer a light roast coffee and these fit the bill.  They are smooth and do not have a bitter aftertaste.  I'd definitely buy these again, whether on a Friday special or not.  It was my first Van Houtte Cafe purchase and I look forward to trying some of their other k-cups.
Best when using smaller coffee settings (5 or 7 oz).  Too weak with the bigger setting.  Great flavor, but Donut Shop by Coffee People still the household favorite.

column9: Excellent, smooth coffee for anytime of day...
column10: First, I'm not a huge coffee drinker, my wife is and loves this. I had to write the review, since of all the coffees I have tried, from DD, Starbucks, about 20 different KCups, this one is for me! Not bitter, clean, with very little if no aftertaste, so good in fact I found myself yesterday have a cup in the afternoon to warm up after working outside in the yard. Good job Van Houtte.

This coffee is my husbands favorite. He says "you don't need coffee so strong it knocks you over to be good". Well this one has a very good flavor and is just perfect for drinking all day. I like it. But I really "love" the Spicy Mayan Chocolate. Get it delivered from subscribe and save and get your favorite coffee at a decent price.

This is my favorite one of the Van Houtte unfavored coffees.  It is really smooth with and a slight nutty flavor.  I tend to like my coffee a little bit bold but even as a light roast it is wonderful.  You can't miss with this one.  I bought this for one of my mother's Christmas presents and she loves breakfast blends.  It is her favorite coffee now.
I really enjoyed this coffee. It's not too strong or too weak. It is an overall good coffee!

column9: What a wonderful way to wake up!!
column10: I LOVE this coffee.  I love how smooth and clean it is.  I like my strong coffee but not first thing in the morning and this one is absolutely my new favorite.  I've tried so many different brands through Amazon and I have to say, this is the BEST!!  Give it a try, you won't be sorry.

I actually have the pleasure of being related to a Costa Rican and she has brought me home true Costa Rican coffee straight out of the country.  So, with that being said, I still love the taste of this coffee compared to the true coffee and it is nice and easy to be able to use my Keurig brewer.
Coffee is as good as going to a coffee shop with all the taste and aroma that makes for a dlightful morning--and for me a quiet ending to the day!

This coffee is flavorful but gentle, not harsh or bitter. Unfortunately, the filter inside the K-Cup seems to be a little weak. On about 1 in every 5 brewed cups, the filter has split inside and a significant amount of coffee grounds are deposited into the brewed cup of coffee. We CAREFULLY autopsied the K-Cup after noticing the grounds in the coffee and saw the split filter and only a few grounds remaining in the K-Cup.  We switch around brands and strengths throughout the day and this is the first Van Houtte coffee that we have purchased. We have not had the same problem with the K-Cups made by other brands of coffee roasters.

I've had three cups of the Van Houtte Café, Costa Rica Tarrazu (Light Roast),... bust and get grounds in the cup. Anyone have a similar problem? I'm sure it's not my machine. At $.50 + a cup, they ought to be better.

I ordered 2 packages of Tarrazu coffee which is what I like. I got the coffee that said it was Costa Rican Tarrazu but in the ingedients it said it was 100% Arabica coffee. It does not taste like Tarrazu because it has a much stronger taste.
Best for chicken enchiladas.  Mild and medium are very similar.  Also tastes great on fish tacos.  We have been using it for years.

... so if you want to buy it here it's up to you, but why would one? In any supermarket that carries them you can get them for less than $4. So even the upfront price here is somewhat excessive, but if that was not enough they got a nerve to want you to pay $10 more in "shipping" costs, an about 250% markup over the actual shipping cost!
These figs were not as flavorful as other figs I have ordered.They were nice and big and were best if soaked in a small amount of water to rehydrate them.

column9: average figs, expected more compared to in-store
column10: No issues with fulfilling the order, but I wouldn't order dried figs online from ANYBODY again. This brand was the best and freshest and softest I ever had when I bought it at my local store, not all dried out and hard like all others.But my store has had trouble getting them, so I thought I would try online.These arrived in "normal" condition - like you can always find in the storein any brand - not soft and extra-delicious.So it's not the brand that determines how good and fresh they are,it's how long they've been sitting around.
I can get fresher figs right here in America.  Still, they were good.

rye oats wheat rice and barley are not part of a dogs evolutionaly history so why feed unnatural foods. Dogs are carnivors. Green Cow is a good value and will extend your pets healthy life. i started feeding green cow to my 13 year old Golden 18 months ago. this is my 7th golden and number 8 will get tripe from the start. also it should be noted that she gets 45 minutes of hard exercise daily. dont let age slow your pet down. if you have an older large dog with hind leg and back arthritis you may want to try Pyhcox, I double the recommended dose. my observation is these 2 products have decreased my pets pain and stiffness increased her muscle mass and improved her daily life.

column9: A Bit Stinky, but FANTASTIC for the Picky Eater
column10: We have a new puppy Yorkie who has decided to be the most finicky eater on the planet.  We have to continually mix up the types of foods we give her or she'll get "bored" with what we're feeding her.  Anything that smells like actual dog food is out of the question - she won't touch it.I've tried all types of kibble and wet dog foods and have had no luck, UNTIL I tried the Green Cow Tripe.  It came as a suggestion from our obedience class teacher and I haven't been happier.  Our Yorkie loves this dog food, and although many complain about its smell, I personally don't think it smells too much worse than other canned dog food.Mixing up the canned tripe with other dog food, rice, some cottage cheese, etc. virtually guarantees an appetite.Couldn't be happier - try it out if you have a picky eater.

My puppy, who used to always leave some kibble behind no matter what I mixed it with, eats the last little piece since I began mixing it with Solid Gold's tripe. I haven't tried any of the other ones besides SG. There is little smell to it, as tripe can be quite stinky. That is a plus. Since she is a growing girl and I really want her to get the full nutritional value of her meals, I will be using this regularly now. She also loves tripe treats.

This tripe product is not nearly as strong smelling as the other canned products and my dogs love it.  I will continue to use it when the raw product is not available.  I add it to their meals a couple of times a week.
Some of my dogs are finicky and won't eat most canned dog foods, but they all love this food. It makes a great treat or topper for kibble, and is thick enough to hide pills.

I was a little hesitant to get this because all too often, these things lack in flavor or texture, if not both.  The batter was thicker than I'd expected and kind of oozed slowly out of the mixing bowl.  You can tell as it hits the pan that it isn't going to get any fluffier.  The box says to cut and serve after they're cool, but of course- who can wait?  We gave them a few minutes and had them warm.  Wonderfully chewy with a hint of gooey, and they tasted just like brownies made with oodles of sugar.  I will definitely be making these again!

For the price, I think this item could have been moister. It was hard around the edges, and I didn't even bake it as long as the directions said. (There's nothing wrong with my oven, the temp was fine).And it should be noted that this product contains Maltitol. This ingredient causes diarrhea and gas- BIG time. There should be a warning on the box.But it's the tastiest laxative I've ever eaten!

column9: Best brownies--Can NOT even tell they are sugar free!!
column10: I bought these and made for my husband who is diabetic----and I could not tell the difference --very good--the best sugar free I ever tasted!!!! Choc Fudge is the best!

Just made a batch of these, and although I'm not neccessarily a brownie fan...these really hit the spot! We tried them because I am Diabetic, and the wife and I are on low carb diets. Dropped a few walnuts into it, and they were a great dessert!

These are some of the very best brownies I ever tasted; very rich and moist. One would never guess they're SUGAR FREE!!!!! Wow. What a wonderful treat -- and you can serve them to anyone with or without an issue with sugar; no one would guess these are not regular, premium brownies. No kidding.To add some serious pizzazz, try adding some Torani Sugar-Free Syrup, Raspberry (just add it to the mix), which is also sold via Amazon.Torani Syrup, Sugar Free, Red Raspberry, 33.81-Ounce (Pack of 3)BTW, I never had any odd intestinal problems whatsoever from eating these brownies. If you eat a whole bunch of brownies, have a weak/very sensitive constitution, or have problems with Splenda or sugar alcohol (not a real form of sugar) in any amount, then common sense would point toward, "you're only asking for trouble." Besides, diabetics beware: these brownies are indeed SUGAR FREE -- but NOT CARBOHYDRATE or FAT FREE. -- Always be very careful how much and what it is, one eats!!!
Very good. Nice chocolate flavor. Do not overbake or brownies are a little hard and chewy, best if taken out of the oven just before tester comes out clean.

These brownies are about the best sugar-free dessert that I have ever tried.  They are moist, full of flavor, and indistinguishable from their sugar-filled counterparts.  This is an excellent product for those who are on a sugar-restricted diet.  It is a shame that the product is being discontinued!

I just purchased my first box of these at my local market, for under $4.00 a box.  I was surprised to find them.  Pillsbury told me they are available everywhere.  I don't think so.  I think they are as good as any other box brownie mix.  So glad there are products for people who have sweet tooths, but cannot have all the sugar for health reasons.
can't go wrong with a whatchamacallit but you can't find them in stores either. fast shipping and YUM.

Living in Southern California, it seems almost impossible to find these candy bars...and they're my absolute favorite. Figuring that Amazon sells nearly everything imaginable, I took a shot and searched Whatchamacallit. So glad I did. At this price, my long sought after candy works out to about .60 cents each (a steal) and I get to enjoy 36 of them at my leisure. The box arrived in perfect condition and well sealed. I'm in chocolate heaven.
I'm a true chocoholic and enjoy American chocolates, watchamacallit and kit kat are by far the best two, I recommend this one very much.

I really do enjoy these. I think that combining the peanuts, caramel and the wafer together. It makes for a very delicious bar. I think that all of the flavors meld really well together. Then it also has the delicious Hershey's milk chocolate to top it all off!Although I will say, after eating about two boxes of these in about one month (many went to my coworkers too) I am pretty tired of these. I definitely will be buying these again, it just may be awhile until I crave them again.

column9: Um... I love a less popular, older candybar?
column10: I had a tradition, when I went to my hardware store - buying a Whatchamacallit from the only store in town that carried them. They stopped. I grumped, and bought a box. Honestly, the description is sufficient. Crisp with caramel and then chocolate around it. Love 'em!

These gummies are the most delicious I have tasted. Compared to their American counterparts, these are practically the real fruit. Their flavor is fresh and bright, and they taste just like the real thing, but with that fun gummy texture.The grape ones are tasty, as are all the flavors, but I personally prefer the perfumed quality of the Muscat gummy. It almost has a floral, wine-like flavor. The Muscat gummy has a stronger taste than some of the others, and it is a little unusual, but I really enjoyed it and think it's worth a try.

These little gummies are very tasty (as you can tell by the title) I bought them right before I left for college and they were gone from my room within a couple of days. I've been looking for them ever since and just now found them. I will definitly be ordering some!

I've had Muscat Kasugai gummies before and I loved them.  They taste like real muscadine grapes!I'm only giving this a 3 because when I bought this - I thought I was getting a variety pack!  Even though the picture shows a variety, you only get muscat flavor! Also, the picture shows them in a kind of box, they arrive in a bag (25 pieces).  Therefore - Read the description carefully! The description says that a variety of flavors are available, not that you actually get a variety!

I love all the Kasugai Gummies I've tried. They're soft and loaded with flavor. However, these are my favorites. They taste just like the grapes that used to grow in my grandma's backyard along the garden fence when I was a kid. Highly recommended.

Very nice. Individually wrapped which is nice too.Growing up in upstate NY we grew grapes in the back yard.  They were not like the grapes you buy commercially.  Much smaller, with very tart skins, but delicious insides.These gummy candies taste and smell exactly like the inside of those grapes.When I first opened the bag in the car, the scent filled the air and I immediately succumbed to redintegration.Even absent your own childhood memories though, I still highly recommend these.Very tasty and not too, too sweet.- mike

Muscadine grapes are my favorites.  These gummies are remarkably close in taste, texture, and smell to the real thing....sweet with a touch of sour.  I enjoyed the different shapes (heart or round).  The smell is incredible!
packaging is great, individually wrapped. very tasty. i also like the mango flavor.

This candy is awesome...upon first hitting your mouth it sends a little zing to the sides of your jaw, then it's a mountain of juicy flavor. They are bite sized gummies that pack a powerful punch of taste. This candy tastes like real juice, which is more than I can say for its American counterparts. Eating these are a wonderful sensation that you'll be sorry you went so long without trying after you've had them. Highly recommended if you are a fan of all things gummy.
These biscuits are the greatest treat I can give my dogs...they smell so good you almost want to eat them yourself!! I will definitely order them again.  Thank you for such a great product!!
My pitbull loves these treats. I found them the first time on clearance at Marshall's for 2.99 a pack, so its a little more expensive on here, but the quantity is convenient. Highly recommended.

My roommate had the red version of this. The bad news is that the internal mechanics are kind of brittle and fragile and we ruined it in just a few weeks of dispensing.The GOOD news is that if you remove the finger tab that works the door and touch up the paint, you are like 30% of the way toward making your own Tom Servo. And who doesn't want their own Tom Servo? People who hate fun, that's who.

My cats are addicted to Whiskas Temptations - which I buy in bulk through Amazon.  I thought I might be able to teach them to work this gumball dispenser, which is filled with Temptations, but so far, so luck.  But, the dispenser stays on the countertop, and they can hear me pushing the lever from anywhere in the house - and come running.

This is a great product. I gave this to my 5 year old niece as a Christmas present... Except I put M&M's in it instead of gumballs. It is very easy for her to pull down the handle and get a handfull of candy. And, you don't need coins!
seems pretty cheaply made guess it will work okay for a 9 yr old.  Not as good as I was expecting...

Being a diabetic I am always on the search for sugar free products that actually taste good. I always loved caramel corn and have tried several brands. The last was expensive and tasted nasty. Then I tried one that was great but very (over 12.00 per bag) expensive. Thatcher's tastes great , is reasonably priced, and the service was fantastic. I ordered it and was told it could take 7 to 10 days to get it. I was surprised when it arrived 3 days later! And it tasted great! I would highly recommend this product and company to anyone looking for sugar free caramel corn!
this is a great product. it is as good as cracker jacks like i ate brfore i had to give up sugar.

column9: Sticks to your teeth......tastes OK though
column10: Sugar free but it sticks to itself in the bag and to your teeth while eating.Not that big of a deal if you drink some thing while munching,but annoying none the less. Satisfying popcorn fix for those with thisdietary restriction.

The nutritional label on this product is way off. It states 28 carbs and 28 sugar alcohols. That would mean it's zero net carbs - IMPOSSIBLE! I emailed the company for the correct label info and never received an answer.

This is a great blend for Italian Sausage. It makes a mild sausage with a little kick. It does 50 lbs of sausage and I make it in 10 lb batches. I measured the level of the blend(5") and with a permanent marker made lines every inch on the container for my 10 lbs of meat. I ground up my shoulders, mixed in the spices, then reground a second time. Some of the best sausage I have ever had. Tastes like NY style sausage with the fennel in it. I would recommend to anyone who is looking to save money on sausage. I estimated I have about 1.75 a pound into it where store bought is over 3.50 a pound. It is also very healthy. I will be purchasing other blends in the future to also try.

so i tried the garlic one and i made a mistake.... and didn't wear a gas mask when i used it ... i LOVE garlic but wow this is over powering in powder form when i first got it i opened it up to give it a smell and almost fell over it was like i got mased eyes tearing up nose burning regardless i bought it im trying it and i mix up some sausage and if you add water like it says it gets toned down so you can work with it after stuffing it and letting it sit for 24hrs for the casing to firm up i grilled them and im not impressed its not bad like someone just dumped a bunch of garlic powder in my sausage and no other spices i feel like it needs more flavor then JUST garlic powder i mean even salt and pepper would be nice

We followed the directions closely for a 10 lb. mix of 1/2 venison and 1/2 pork. (We did mix the seasoning directly into the meat, then added a bit of water.) We then let it sit overnight in the refrigerator.  We fried some patties up the next morning to taste test.The pepper seasoning came through, not excessively so, but it did linger a bit.  I have been known to like things hot (although my tastes have mellowed with age) and I would rate this between mild and medium.  I have tasted commercially prepared breakfast sausage that tasted hotter.  It definitely makes this a great sausage for using in spaghetti and other italian dishes.  By itself, the sausage is very flavorable.  We plan to pack 1/2 into casings and bulk store the rest for cooking Italian dishes.I do agree with one reviewer, it is a bit salty tasting and could be toned down a bit.  But, it is within the limits for a spicy sausage and will be fine used in other Italian recipes, IMHO.I would buy this again, but back off of the amount to mix into the meat (due to the salt) and add other Italian seasonings.
This some good sausage seasoning, has a great garlic taste, I use half the recommended seasoning on a 10lb mix and its just right for me. Great product
I know others like salt more than I do but I am not on a salt free diet or anything like that.  I love sausage but this was way too salty for my taste.
We are so happy to have the small packs.  We cannot find this product in the store anymore...everything is in slim packs.  These are great to fit in pocket.  Product was fresh.

Well, I thought I'd buy some gum to help me with snacking during the day. Bad move. After chewing this gum regularly for a few days, I developed a lip rash and now I'm currently on a corticosteroid prescribed by my doctor. I had to work from one one day this week also. I see the primary ingrediant is Phenylalanine or Aspartame, a nuero toxin.Had I known I would never have purchased this toxic product.

These red vines are packaged nicely and are great for road trips. The red vines are nice and soft and keep nicely when stored. I have always liked my vines a little on the stale side, (I'm weird like that). You can't go wrong with this product. Make sure you share!

I have tried Brewers Yeast many times through my life and no matter how good it is suppose to be for you if you didn't hold your nose and drink it in one gulp it would gag you. But this nutritional yeast in a green smoothie is not only good your you but taste good too.

column9: Red Star Nutitional Yeast Nutritional Yeast Veget Support Formula ( 6x5 OZ)
column10: I love this Nutritional Yeast. I will definitely buy it again and again. The flavor is wonderful, and I use it for many good recipes. It also makes an awesome and cheesy flavored sauce.
I use this in my cooking all the time! It gives foods a cheesy flavor and is very healthy. It takes awhile to use this up. I also sprinkle it on popcorn. MMM!
I am glad i could find what i needed in amazon.comI really like the taste when i add this to any curries and great addition to any vegetarians

The real taramosalata I am used to contains a lot more roe eggs and lemon, and a lot less soybean oil. This is mostly emulsified soybean oil with a tiny bit of lemon juice and roe eggs in it. Tastes ok, but definitely not great; and not nutritious either. Won't buy again. :(Can anyone tell me where to find some good tarama?
I agree with the previous reviewer. This product is not of the quality I expected. It's one of those ordinary bottled products that fails to satisfy people who are looking for the real stuff.

These are absolutely the best tasting high protein organic food bars. If you like marzipan and chocolate, you will love these bars. I eat many brands of organic food bars and enjoy them, but these are number ONE.

column9: The best tasting nutrition bar around-bar none!
column10: I've been a vegetarian for 38 years and have tried countless nutition bars. I thought I would never find a bar that I actually looked forward to, but the Dark Chocolate Almond is a dream come true. I have enjoyed several of the other Nugo bars, including the Chocolate Blast, Orange Smoothie, Organic Dark Chocolate and Organic Dark Chocolate Raspberry, but, for me, the Organic Dark Chocolate Almond reigns supreme. I'm ordering a couple more boxes now so I don't run out.

I do a lot of sports and have tested many high protein bars. This bar is by far the best. All organic ingredients, lowest sugar content and absolutely delicious. The only "problem" is that it tastes so well that I am tempted to eat more often than I should. But you can't blame the bar for that...

let me first say that we are a family of 6 and nugo bars addicts.  you will find at least 7-8 boxes of different flavors in our household on any given day.  Our favorites are nugo dark mocha, chocolate peanut butter, chocolate pomegranate and several others.on to this particular bar.  quality and nutritional values are great - just like with any other nugo bar.  that said, a combination of crunch and almond is quite strange.  Crunch in this bar seems a bit tougher than many other nugo bars, but not really hard.  then they add small chunks of almonds into the mix, and eating this bar feels like you are eating something partially stale, as you bite a piece and feel a chunk of hard product ( almond) and a chunk of semi-soft product (soy crunch).  .  it's neither crispy, nor crunchy - JUST VERY STRANGE.  this bar should have had whole almonds mixed in so there is clear "separation", but with poorly crushed almonds mixed in,,,,,,,,well, enough said.
This is an excellent product IF fresh but the boxes I received were shipped on/past the expiration date.  Bars were stale and discolored.

These are the greatest health bars ever invented for the following reasons:First of all, if you like almonds and dark chocolate, then these bars are absolutely delicious.Second, these bars don't have any more sugar than the limit recommended for a health snack (<15).Third, they will stave off hunger for hours because they are made from brown rice and almonds, a great combo of complex carbs and protein.And they are good for your heart because they are made with the darkest chocolate possible.  In fact, I'd prefer their being less healthy with milk chocolate, as I'm not a big fan of dark chocolate.  But the combination of ingredients is well balanced so the dark chocolate flavor doesn't overpower the other flavors despite it having the darkest chocolate possible.Finally, the company owners and employees are extremely friendly.  I used to buy directly from nugo.com, which can at times be cheaper than Amazon.  Unfortunately, these bars are so popular that they go out of stock quickly.  Once I complained to the company about their changing the dark chocolate content to make it darker, and I received free samples of other flavors.All in all, this product is a recommended must buy.

If you like dark chocolate and almonds you will  like this protein bar. The best part is that is keeps you full for 2-4 hours. I originally bought it for the dark chocolate but 10 grams of protein out weigh the chocolate by far! Its delicious and chewy but keeps you full.

I think I've ordered these at least three times.  They are my favorite.  My husband is definitely NOT a vegan and he thinks they are awesome too.  I think these have just the right amount of dark chocolate to not be overpowering.  They are so good!! Great for breakfast or on the go!
Would order these again they are not so sweet and I feel they are better for you. Delicious and nutritious.
This is a great tasting organic bar.  Great when you're on the go or pre or post workout.  I buy them a lot for road trips.

I found these bars at a local store at over $3 each. they are soooo delicious and I especially love that they are organic and dark chocolate because i don't like milkchoc. When I saw them on Amazon, I purchased a whole pack of 12 for $21.23 .  anywho....here's the thing....I also ordered at the same time another item...which I wanted to receive quickly...so when I went to check out i selected the 2 day shipping option..what a huge surprise and NOT in a good way, when I saw a $19.07 shipping for a total of $40.30 I was shocked, because ofcourse that put the price for each at $3.35 a piece. . .I  could have just poped into the local store for that!! I felt ripped off...I thought my larger item would possibly cost more for shipping but it did not...it was only $11.74 for a large item...so I am eating a very expensive bar right now, but it sure is good. I will be more careful and only select the 'normal delivery' time option from now on. live and learn I guess.

I absolutely LOVE these bars. They are wonderful for an afternoon snack...and the added protein keeps me satisfied for the rest of the afternoon.  I am lactose intolerant and can't eat eggs, and I have no problem with these bars at all. They taste great and are very satisfying.If you like dark chocolate, and want a slightly crunchy texture, you'll love these!

I LOVE nu-organic bars; all of them. i got tired of buying a few at a time, so ordered a box. i received a box of stale, powdery brown (typlically shiney dark chocolate) bars with a date of 2008.Very disappointed, will not order food products again.

I just LOVE "Honest Earth All Natural Mashed Potaotes", ALL of them!  They are absolutly the BEST instant mash ever with nothing but potatoes in them.They are very difficult to locate and I have no idea why.  I used to find them at CostCo and Safeway, neither place carries them and now Amazon is out of them too!Hey Amazon, Bring back the BEST mashed potatoes ever!  PLEASE!
I had previously stated that this product is organic, which it is not. My apologies! But it is the best I have found so far. Have not been able to find anything organic in the plain variety.

These mashed potatoes are incredible.  Quick, easy and taste like homemade.  The only issue is the cost.  This same box was about half the price at Costco, however it's apparently a seasonal item for Costco and they won't be carrying them again until Fall.  Other than the price, the service from Amazon was great.

These are simply the best instant mashed potatoes I have ever had. What's even better is that there are only 3 ingredients..potatoes and little bit of butter and salt. If you look at other brands you'll see an ingredient list list of 10-20 different things..including preservatives. I have been buying them at Costco for the last year now all of a sudden they are gone. I would think this prodict would be hugely popular..they are really that good.

column4: Donna's Reviews "I Love Shopping on Amazon!"
column10: hands down the best ever ....Honest Earth All Natural Creamy Mashed Potatoes Net Wt 5.6 LBS (2.54 KG) (14 Individually Sealed 8-Serving Pouches)...I tried another brand based on other reviewers they were good...BUT these are so Much Better. I like the individual packages it's just the two of us...No measuring them out of a big box!

These are the best packaged mashed potatoes, much better than any other "artifical" prepared mashed potatoes.  I highly recommend you mix it with either Chicken or Beef Broth, they add great flavor to the mashed potatoes like you have never had before!

column9: Honest Earth All Natural Creamy Mashed Potatoes Net Wt 5.6 LBS (2.54 KG) (14 Individually Sealed 8-Serving Pouches)
column10: I love these but that is a ridiculous price...Costco used to sell same thing for $9.95..and still had to break even at least...

These instant potatoes beat everything that you find in regular grocery stores.  As soon as you make the first packet, you can tell they will really be good.  They look, feel, and taste just like real potatoes!

You're not going to believe me, but I just looked at my receipt, I paid $9.99 at Costco on 4/19/12 for this same 14 package box.  We LOVE these mashed potatoes.  This is the first time we've bought them, and providing Costco continues to sell them, they will be a staple in our pantry.  They are very easy to make, no mess like when you make them from the big ole box.  The package says it has 8 servings, we have a family of 4 and each of us has a hefty serving (or 2...) with some leftover.  MUST TRY!

I normally can't stand instant mash potatoes, but these are the best.  My wife is even a potato snob, and she thinks these are great as well.  Creamy, easy to make, full flavor with no funny processed taste.  I've even made them low-cal with just water, and while not as good as the version with milk, still outstanding.  Get them!

column9: Think you hate instant Mashed potatoes? Think again...
column10: I loathe instant mashed potatoes. Seriously. I can always taste the difference. I get upset with restaurants that tell me they make their own but don't. I won't eat them, though others in my family will. My local store had a clearance on these--a real deal (3 packets for $1), so I bought them for those that do like them, a rainy-day kind of thing. Well, it 'rained' last night. After I made them, I tried them, just to see how much they needed doctoring and what I had to add to make them nearly palatable. To my shock and amazement--they needed NOTHING! They tasted like my own homemade mashed 'taters. I ate them along with everyone else. Now I'm sorry that I only bought a dollar's worth. We're having them again tonight--by popular choice. Try them. I think you, too, will be pleasantly shocked. And no mashing, either:)

Am delighted to discover others who agree that Honest Earth All Natural Creamy Mash (mashed potatoes) are the best "boxed" mashed potatoes, because they are! For several months, have searched for them at Costco to no avail.  Resorted to writing them, imploring them to restock the item.  Thought I would sample a few competitive products, including Idahoan which manufactures Honest Earth, and to our family's utter disappointment, returned them all.  Without exception, they emitted strange odors when prepared as directed, and worse, off-flavors when served and taste-tested.  May we soon see the return of an excellent product which contains no additives, preservatives--just potatoes, butter and sea salt.

I can't go back to any other mashed potatoes after eating these!  I would honestly prefer these over real mashed potatoes.  They are so creamy and just seems to have a nice balance of everything that comes together to make a great texture and taste!  Had these for Thanksgiving dinner and several people wanted to know my recipe for the mashed potatoes. Ha!  Honest Earth can't be beat!

I have had several instant mashed potatoes and these, without a close 2nd, lead the way.  I make them a couple times a month, very easy and quick.  No one complains when we have them as our side dish!

column9: Great taste but watch the price
column10: Purchased these a few days ago at $17 with Prime shipping.  2 days later, the package arrived.  The individually packaged 8 person serving size (should feed about 4-5 in the real world) is great - no more box full of potato fluff sitting in my kitchen closet, waiting to explode on my floor if dropped.  The day it arrived, I re-checked the price at Amazon - over $30...WTF that's a big increase.  Next day, we tried the 'taters.  As all the previous reviewers here have stated, they were great.  Creamy and smooth just like my family likes it.  Healthy ingredients, just like I like.  Quick and easy to prepare.  Current price with shipping (no longer prime and no free shipping) is $41.  At $17, these are fantastic.  At $41, it's crossed off my list.  How do you justify a 241% price increase in under a week?  Hopefully they'll restore the original price.  I hate finding a great food that's too expensive to buy on a regular basis.

column9: BEWARE Shelf Life to expire shortly.  Very disappointed
column10: After paying way too much for a product, and then receiving it only to find the box opened from both ends; the expiration date for a large box to be in just 2 months, I am very disappointed. A warning label should have appeared stating that the food product packaging is damaged and the food needs to be consumed immediately. Who would have thought!!! This item has been on the shelf a very long time. I am one disappointed consumer and if I can return it, I will.
If you can boil water, add milk, open a packet, stir and serve the creamy potatoes, you will love this product. And it's just potatoes - no added chemicals. What's not to like.

I won't buy any other kind of instant potatoes for these reasons: these taste the closest to real, homemade, boiled and mashed potatoes made from scratch, are truly natural with no artificial ingredients, only 80 cal. per serving and takes only as long as it takes to boil the water.  I've given up boiling and mashing myself because my son will only eat these.
These are by far the best instant mashed potatoes ever!  Every time we have them, no one can tell they are instant.  We always get compliments when we serve them.

LOVE these potatoes, they're so good & can be made quicklythe finished product is non-lumpy & tastes greatthey work in the stovetop or in the microwave just as wellI will be making them again when the weather cools
GREAT GREAT GREAT GREAT GREAT GREAT GREAT GREAT GREAT GREAT  MASHED POTATOES -- KEPT SELLING HONEST EARTH POTATOES  THEY ARE GREAT GREAT GREAT GREAT GREAT ...........

column9: As  good as homemade. My family loves these potatoes
column10: I will search to the end of the earth to find these mashed potatoes. We have tried every product on the market trying to replace them when they were sold out on line and could not come close to the taste, texture and ease of use. They are as good as homemade and I am a real potatoe lover.

These work out amazingly well for my family.  They are quick, really yummy and contain three simple ingredients...potatoes, butter and sea salt.  No yucky stuff or weird wonder words.  Excellent value too as they are 14 packets that feed 8 people each.  You won't catch me peeling potatoes anymore.
The BEST mashed potatoes I've ever had...real or instant. Quick, convenient, and delicious. Bought them at Costco, but they're no longer available in my store. Happy to find them here on Amazon.
I love this product!  No unpleasant ingredients and it's delicious - goes together in minutes while I'm warming up something to go with it - it's a life saver on my busiest days
Thanks for the prompt shipment and good packaging.  These packets make great instant mashed potatoes!  Would definately suggest trying them if you don't have time to make real ones!

Box and packages were open when I received them today. Be careful as this is a food item. Not safe to eat when open. Tried to replace and the site won't let me.....only return them. Now I know why. They are now around $5 more then when I ordered them. What a rip off Amazon!!!

Wow what a great price for onion powder. I have been searching for a large container of onion powder at the markets and get amazed at how much they charge you for a 2.62 ounce shaker.  For the same price I paid for 20 ounces of Tone I would have only been able to purchase 3 little shakers at the supermarket or only 7.86 ounces total.  If you use a lot of onion powder this is the only sane way to buy it.
this is the best onion powder i have  ever used.the texture,the taste is awesome.it has a nourishing smell.

Last time I bought a jar of onion powder, I couldn't smell anything at all. This time, I opened the shaker container and the smell of real onion was unmistakable. I used it on a roast and it was excellent.

column9: Not impressed.  Directions says to make a slurry
column10: Not impressed with the flavor.There are others with much better flavor.The grind is very very small.It may be okay for soups and stews but too powdery for sprinkling onto anything solid like a rub.In fact the directions says to mix with the broth of what you plan on adding it to first.I will probably use what I have for a brining solution for pork and chicken, along with salt and sugar.

I'm a big fan of Tone's products and this product is no exception. I had been using a different brand of onion powder, which would probably be described as fine granular in texture. This product is actually a powder, more like a talc in texture. It has a very dense and surprisingly tangy onion flavor. Works great in a rub!

I absolutely love this product!!! The fine tasty powder makes it an essential in my kitchen. It dissolves easily in gravies and stews/soups. If you like onion powder, you are going to love this fine powder!

This onion powder is a very fine (tiny particles) powder - much more fine than most brands.  It is not just for mixing into sauces or meats - which is does well.  It sticks very well to dry foods such as chips, and is really great when lightly sprinkled onto potatoes (fries, hash browns, tater tots, etc).  Great for grilling also.

This onion powder when mixed with a small amount of water contains many small black specks that under magnification look like animal waste.  None of the other onion powder I have looks like this. I will try to contact the mfgr but meanwhile, will not use or recommend.  It could cause disease.

This jerky is the best jerky I've had - period.I'm an omnivore and this stuff tastes better than meat jerky.It has a rich meaty flavor without being overpowering -unlike most jerkies, meat-less or otherwise.Also it's low in sugar and sodium, which is rare for ameat-less jerky. Other meat-less jerkies usually use thatand a ton of spice to over compensate for being meat-less.Totally worth it.

column9: A great health anytime snack for the whole family!
column10: Okay, I am hooked on this stuff! They did an absolutely fantastic job of replicating traditional jerky texture and taste (but without the meat and all the MSG and preservatives). It is so tasty and healthy and you can literally eat it anytime...before workouts, or as a really healthy snack for me and the kids. The Hot N' Spicy and Ginger are my favorite flavours. I would like them to create a Spicy Ginger..yum! I would like to see greater availability, perhaps through local supermarkets, Trader Joes, and maybe even Costco/Sams Club (if their production would permit). The world needs more healthful tasty eats like these!

column10: Okay, I am hooked on this stuff!  They did an absolutely fantastic job of replicating traditional jerky texture and taste (but without the meat and all the MSG and preservatives).  It is so tasty and healthy and you can literally eat it anytime...before workouts, or as a really healthy snack for me and the kids.  The Hot N' Spicy and Ginger are my favorite flavours. I would like to see greater availability, perhaps through local supermarkets, Trader Joes, and maybe even Costco/Sams Club (if their production would permit). The world needs more healthful tasty eats like these!
I got the hot n' spicy. Could stand to be a bit spicier but the flavor and texture are good. My only complaint is the packaging. It comes in a sealed bag inside of a sealed bag- seems excessive.

I want to preface my review by saying that I tried Primal Spirit jerky first, and absolutely HATED it (sorry, Primal Spirit). The texture was all wrong (very moist, not chewy), and the smell and taste really reminded me of dog treats. I decided to give Tasty Eats Soy Jerky a chance, and it is SO much better!First, the flavor is really delicious. I got the Hot & Spicy variety, and it's very tasty with just a little spice (I would like it a little spicier, actually, but it's still great). I can't wait to try some other flavors next.Second, the texture is very similar to real jerky. It's drier and chewier. I am a vegetarian, so sometimes I miss really chewing on something. This jerky is great for that.All in all, Tasty Eats Soy Jerky is a fantastic product. My carnivore boyfriend likes it too, although admittedly not as much as real beef jerky. I highly recommend it!

column9: SOY JERKEY- GINGER AND TANDOORI FLAVOR
column10: Being vegan, I like the soy jerky concept but the Ginger has too much sugar and sodium for a quick snack.  Unfortunately I did not realize until I ordered a full box : (I wish the Ginger was unsweetened like the Tandoori.  I really like the the flavors of both but actually the Tandoori texture better (tougher actually, ginger is MUCH softer- hence tandoori is a longer eating snack : ), but the tandoori does give me heartburn and the ginger did not.Really wish Ginger and other flavors had less sugar : (.  Only tried these 2 flavors available on amazon.

I was excited to get the ginger jerky in the mail after the good reviews, but I find it very bland.  The jerky by Vegan dreams is much better!  This has no taste and am pretty bummed I have 11 packs I am never going to eat.

I purchased Primal Strips brand vegan jerky about a year ago. It was absolutely delicious! The texture and flavor were perfect; reminiscent of beef jerky (which I've not had in over a decade), but better. Cleverly spiced, and very savory! Slightly rough to chew.I planned on ordering Primal Strips again, but went with Tasty Eats due to the strength of the reviews. I just cracked it open and had a pack, and I'm regretting my decision.Tasty Eats jerky is good, but it does not compare to Primal Strips. Tasty Eats jerky is VERY rough to chew. It's quite a workout for your jaw. I can feel it in my teeth, jaw, and the top of my head. Not to sound like a baby, but - waaaaa. The main flavors that come through are salt and red pepper, rather than various spices.Though Tasty Eats may taste more like real beef jerky, Primal Strips taste better.

This jerky, along with all the jerky products, *we called the company, is made without any onion or garlic powder. This is the real deal and unsweetened. For any one with diet or who wants to simply refrain from sugar, this is the best jerky available; all three flavors that are unsweetened.  Yet, most people prefer, at least all our friends, the Teriyaki, Original, Hot n' Spicy and Peppered as well as the Ginger flavor. These are sweetened. I ordered 6 cases of Ginger direct from the company because I and all my friends find this to be the best quality and best texture of them all. We are also getting a great deal; yet, I would pay more for this jerky.
It was a little too spicy for me but it did taste good apart from the spices. It gave me a lot of energy
The jerky taste pretty good. The soy was a little hard for me to digest but it sure does give you a lot of energy and kept me full.

column4: A. Powell "Workout Junkie and Kitchen Queen"
column10: You just have to love something that is filling, has less than 100 calories for the whole package and tastes great!  Each little packet is supposed to be 2 servings at 45 calories each, but who are we kidding?  Is there ANYONE out there who could, or would, divide a 1 ounce package into two portions?  Doubtful.  That being said, this stuff is terrific.  It has great jerky flavor and texture and is wonderfully packable.  I keep some in my office desk in case of a munchie attack.  Yum!

column9: Wish I Could Say That I Liked It
column10: I wanted to like it, since it is so much healthier than most alternatives. But the taste just isn't there. My daughter and I both immediately said the same thing after tasting it. While it is indeed spicy (i.e., hot), it is also sweet, which sort of deadens the spiciness of the flavor. We wish that we hadn't ordered two boxes of this, but had tried a different flavor instead. Perhaps we will. But it is somewhat disconcerting to consider that we might also not like the taste of the different flavor, since the cost of the product is not inexpensive. Thus we are not yet sure that we will order more.

This has a definite Jerky texture. It is low in calories. Does state Hot N Spicy but its not. It is actually a bit sweet. That is just my opinion as I eat raw serrano peppers. I have had others that were good tasting yet too high in fat so that was not worth it. This one has been a regular one for me for quite some time.

I just got this in the mail and immedaetly tore into a pack. I enjoy the texture and taste of the jerky itself but I ordered teriyaki which sort of has an almost cocoa taste to it and the smell is bothersome. I'm going to try peppered to see how that is. If the teriyaki didnt have such a strong cocoa smell I would rate this a 5 for sure.
A little on the salty side but I like it that way... great vegetarian alternative!

It's nice to have found a tasty, nutritious vegan food I can take on the run. I wanted something to get me over the hump for those days I'm out running errands and hours from a regular meal. This is easy to carry and very satisfying. Love the taste too.

My friends and I have tried many vegetarian jerky products and this is the Best. 1) the Taste of the Ginger Jerky is by far better quality and texture than others. In fact, many consider tastyeats Teriyaki or Original to be even better. They were sold out of all those, so only had the Ginger and three of the Jerkys that are unsweetened. Most important, they do not use any garlic or onion in their products so, to use an Ayurvedic term, it is Sathwic. In other words, it doesn't give one the effects that garlic or onion has on the system. Also, the taste, we feel, is the very best around. The company is simply first class to offer this product, so I have phoned them direct and ordered 6 cases of the Ginger. I will order the Teriyaki, Original, Hot n'Spicy, Peppered when those become available.  As an aside, we have tried other products/companies, and in fact, one jerky company has the ingredient as "vegetarian spices" and in this ingredient is granulated garlic, possibly onion. Other jerky companies may have "spices" but at least list garlic or onion powder, so forth. This Company has found a formula without these and it is a Blessing.

The first time I experienced these little delights was at the annual Green Festival and I fell in love. I've tried almost all of the flavors but the Hot N' Spicy is one of my favorites. Perfect for an on-the-go snack that is flavorful, protein-packed and easy to keep on hand. I would highly recommend this to anyone!
This are so damn delicious..great texture and taste.  I first tried them at the Toronto Veggie Festival summer 2007 but haven't been able to find them locally since.  Hope Amazon stocks more soon.
Compared with other meatless jerky brands this is the one I like the best, peppered is spicy.

I ordered Soy Jerky for four reasons:  recommended by HG, was a source of protein, was easy to send to a relative who is stationed overseas, and was easy to take as a snack when going to ball tournaments.  The jerky satisfies all of the reasons; however, the taste was not even close to the teriyaki beef jerky (pre-vegetarian days).  My granddaughter even commented that it tasted like the dog's treats (which she had tasted at some point), and my dog does like the jerky better than anyone else who has tried it.Overtime I will still eat it, but I won't order more.

column9: Dry, far too tough, and flavorless
column10: Having been used to the moisture and texture of Primal Spirit and Tofurky Jurky, I have to say I was utterly disappointed by these.  They're far too dry and require much more jaw-work than should be required to enjoy some jerky.Plus, with only 12 packets, it seems you get less product for the price than you do with the other vegan jerkies available on Amazon.  With so much better stuff out there, I wouldn't waste my money on this product again, even to try a different flavor.

As soon as I opened a package of this, I had regrets.  The smell doesn't invite you to take a bite.  After I tasted it, I was still repulsed. The texture alone makes you gag!  This tastes and feels like a very salty turd wrapped in plastic.  I don't recommend this to anyone!

column9: Bull's Eye Hickory Smoked BBQ Sauce
