column4: Bartok Kinski "A casual stroll through the lu...
column10: Roland Green Fageolets From France are pretty good if you like Fageolets.  Fageolets are tiny, tender French bush type beans that are very popular in French cooking.The Fageolet has an inedible green pod about 3-inch long and small, light-green, kidney-shaped seeds. Fresh Fageolets are occasionally available in the summer. They range from creamy white to light green.Fageolets are removed from the pod when tender and just maturing. This bean of French origin is grown in the fertile soil of California. Its versatile flavor compliments lamb, as well as fish and chicken.Fageolets are usually prepared simply, in order to show their delicate flavor. Fageolets are a great source of fiber.Preparation:Soak in cold water overnight. Rinse thoroughly. In a saucepan boil 1 1/2 cups water. Add 1/2 fageolets and 1 tsp. salt to the water and simmer slowly until water is absorbed(about 1 hour). Makes 3-4 servings.If you can't find them, substitute navy beans instead.

The only negative I can add is that the flakes get soggy pretty fast. Like the other reviewer I discovered the local supermarket stopped carrying it.

This is a family favorite cereal, but our local grocery store quit carrying it for some unfathomable reason.  So, now a monthly shipment comes to the door! I was a fan of the Honey Bunches with Almonds, but the cinnamon has a wake-up flavor--and is good for you.

column9: Cinnamony, not as good as the peach or strawberry ones
column10: So I love the strawberry Honey Bunches of Oats. I'm not a big cereal eater but I love that one. I discovered the peach one last year and love that one too. So I thought I'd try this one because hey, I love pecans.Nope. This one has a cinnamon flavor to it and I don't like cinnamon. Most people seem to so you may, but just know that this one has a different flavor to the cereal.

Post seems to have discontinued this product much to my disappointment.  I really don't care for the other flavors of Honey Bunches of Oats so will no longer be a customer.  I simply do not understand why such a good product was shipcanned.

column9: Honey bunches addict likes this best
column10: I love Honey Bunches of Oats and have been a fan for years. Of all the varieties out there, I prefer this pecan version the best. It seems to be slightly less sugary tasting than the original, and more flavorful than the almond version. The pecans are delicious. Overall, this is a fantastic everyday cereal. Its light and flakey, yet satisfying so you don't feel hungry again in an hour. Easily my favorite cereal.
Cereal tastes good as always, but very hard to seen any peaches, which is sad because they taste so good.

column9: Is this how to spell Lethargic ?
column10: "If you don't mind waiting the better part of a week for stale baked goods, this is the shop for you. I'd have said bakery but there doesn't appear to be an actual bakery.... "
It tastes just ok for the first box but it comes with 3 boxes.  I think I wouldnt wanna try this for a long long time after I finally finish all 3 boxes.
This Tahini is superb. It's smooth and sweet not bitter like many others. It makes excellent hummus but it's very tasty on it's own, spread on apple slices for example or toast. Simply delicious!

When my Lebanese grandmother told me that you dip grape leaves into yogurt I was skeptical, yogurt?. However, she sent me this yogurt and after the first taste I immediately understood why you would want to. It has more of the consistency of cream cheese. I have been mixing it with spices spreading it on crackers with cucumbers and/or tomatoes. Amazing stuff, highly recommend it. This shipped from Parthenon foods and arrived cold and ready to use.
This Labna is thick and delicious.. Great with grape leaves, pita and anything middle eastern.
This yogurt is thick,sour,creamy and yummy!highly recommend. Try it with baby carrot or crackers. It's so delicious. There is a lot of recipes you can make with it.
The spices arrived quickly they have great sent and taste which indicate freshness. If in need for Persian cooking I would suggest this pack.

This is good stuff!  It comes in a two pound, vacuum-packed bag. It steeps pretty quickly in 4-6 minutes and tastes great.  If you leave it steeping for much more than 10 minutes, it starts to get bitter.  Enjoy!

column9: The unflavored ice milk of tea
column10: As no one has reviewed this, I thought I'd take the plunge and be the first. I'd like to give it a bad review, but "bad" would imply it having some qualities to describe. This tea can no more be "bad" than distilled water can be bad--there is essentially nothing to like or dislike about it.It was a bad sign when I opened the bad and smelled...nothing. But that doesn't always mean much, so I brewed up a pot, using about a tablespoon for a 14-ounce mug. I tried it after a couple of minutes and it didn't have much flavor, so I gave it another two or three minutes...still nothing. While it develops a lovely color and is composed of what open into large leaves, it has no aroma, no flavor, really no distinguishing characteristics at all. At work later on, I filled up the strainer in my three-cup Chantal teapot and gave it a good 10 minutes. It's possible some flavor may have developed, I'm not sure. I could have been imagining it.And now I'm stuck with 2.2 pounds of this stuff. I'd better develop a taste for a nice, hot, steaming cup of water, because that's what I'll be having for quite a while.I previously purchased the Malden sencha; it's more than adequate.Fine Japanese Sencha. Premium Gourmet Loose leaf Green Tea. Net Wt: 1/2 lb.,^$ä<
Sure, it's cheap. But, you get what you pay for. If you are looking for old, stale, tasteless tea - then this is for you...

When I first opened the bag a sweet complex aroma arose as I stirred the crisp air that was sealed within.  I new this was a very good tea at that moment.  I heated some water on the stove and then place the tea-ball in it for 45-130 seconds.The aroma was still very present.  I enjoy this tea so very much, I will be exploring the other teas offered by this company.

These were one of my favorite treats when I was little.  Not too sweet and the perfect amount of crunch.  But the Prime price is very high for the individual pkgs.  I hope the price comes down a few dollars!

I won't say this is the best coffee in the world; because I have yet to try them all and everyone's tastes differ.  However, from my 20+ years of coffee drinking and of all the Kona coffee's I've tasted, THIS one reigns supreme.  And it better for that price!  But if you appreciate a well rounded, flavorful coffee, then this is the one to try.I lived in Hawaii for 3 years and was introduced to Kona coffee at the source.  Of all the coffees I've had in my life, Kona is my favorite.  It is the richest and smoothest you could imagine.  Others are good, but not in this class.  Also, watch out for Kona coffee blends.  They can be tasty, but are usually only 10% Kona beans and not the top crops at that.  This is the primo stuff here!  There really is something in that Volcanic soil on the Big Island.A word of caution though.  Drink this at your own risk.  It is very hard to go back to "normal" coffee after tasting this nectar of the gods.  Enjoy!

I am a medical school student and you might imagine how much coffee goes through my system in any given year.  I had Aloha Island first when I was an undergraduate and have since given up all other coffee.  Kona is by far the best there is out there, and Aloha Island is amazing.  I have tried 100% Kona from other retailers since my first dalliance with Kona, but not even the best of the premium coffees compare to the rich taste of Aloha Island's gold collection (which is their lowest grade).  The rich, dark grounds are perfect every time and make the perfect study break.  Now they say that the diamond collection is a special treat, but once you have a really good coffee it is so hard to go back to something that is below it.  I highly reccommend the diamond collection.  Word to the wise: don't stock up on this coffee; while it does last quite some time even with the most careless keeping, the coffee is best when kept in an airtight container and ground fresh for every cup.  The longer you keep coffee around, the more flavor it loses.

column9: This is the best coffee I've experienced on planet earth. period.
column10: I am not a raving optimist and am a highly ciritical comsumer. I have never before publicly rated any product 5 stars. This is a 5-star product.Why? It tastes good :)Seriously, it has near-zero acidity, an inviting aroma, and can be drunk without prior consideration as a "dessert coffee" just as easily as a "breakfast coffe". It's as versatile as a swiss-army-knife and as refined as the highest grade Damast linen.I have had 7 other distinct Kona coffees purchased on my behalf on the Kona island and brought home for me to try. All others Konas were compared to this one and found lacking (in some cases seriously lacking). No "Kona blend" will ever again be found acceptable once you drink this coffee.So, not only is it a 5-star coffee among general coffees (including the "Charbucks" of the world...yech!), but it is a 5-star coffee among other high-achiever coffees.

This is by far the best coffee I've ever tasted.  I drink coffee black so I'm a comparison shopper for gourmet beans.  While it is expensive, you can taste the difference.  It definitely has a woodsy flavor with no aftertaste.  It's pure.Although I wouldn't drink it every day - it's an awesome treat and highly recommended for those that can appreciate it.

I bought this Kona brand of beans based on reviews and think the responses are somewhat exaggerated. I would imagine that some of these reviews are employees or friends of Aloha Island Coffee?  After shipping I paid $27.45 for a bag of beans that are okay, but nowhere near phenomenal as the review rave. Milestone brand found in most supermarkets retails $10 a pound and easily rivals the flavor of this brand. I will accept the fact that my disapproval may be due to my specific low acidic taste requirements. I do not like strong coffee with a bitter overtone, albeit this medium roast is on the strong side.In favor of Aloha Island Coffee, they did not hesitate to refund my money, keeping true to their claim of 100% satisfaction guaranteed.

The Diamond II is great. Rich but very smooth, not bitter at all. This is one that people will try and comment on without knowing anything about the coffee beforehand. I ordered it as a present for my dad, who loves coffee, but as soon as he brewed a pot it disappeared because of the amazing aroma. Everyone would suddenly decide to have coffee once they could smell it. The only people who didn't seem to really enjoy it both drink coffee that I find revolting. My stepbrother, who regularly drinks coffee that's been heated all day, and his girlfriend, who loves instant coffee, thought it was too weak. My advice: if you really love good coffee, then keep the Kona for yourself.Caveats: other reviewers imply that this is 100% Kona. It is not. It is a blend, although a very good one. Also, it is a medium roast.
The Diamond II is a very rich and strong coffee.  A bit pricey but worth every penny.  If you don't want to fork out the money for this, the Gold blend is nearly as good at a much lower price point.
This purchase was received as described,  good quality, well packaged, very timely, and I would purchase from this seller again!

The coffee is exquisite, there's no doubt, and if you are looking for something impressive to give as a gift, this is a great choice.  The packaging is unique & very rich looking.  You'll know that you're holding something special before you even open it.  The best part, however, is that once you do open it, you'll find something wonderful on the inside too.

In one word,WOW.This is definately the icing on the cake.Bought this coffee along with the platinum.The platinum is peaberry,the diamond is even more rare.Beans are incredible.taste is fabulous.This is definately the best in the world.Better than Jamaican Blue.But then not all our taste buds are alike.This is a high end coffee.Would drink this every day if it was possible.It is expensive.But very much worth the money.Low acid,smooth like velvet with a slight smokey taste.Makes for a great gift to anyone.Having tried over probably 50 different coffees this one is the best of the best.

My husband and I agree; this is the best coffee we have ever had!Delicate and lovely flavor, low acidity, and no aftertaste.  It is more expensive than other coffee, to be sure, but it is also considerably better.

My wife and I like strong coffee. Even brewing this at twice the recommended amount it tasted weak. There may be subtle tastes and flavors involved but there just was not much coffee taste. The experience is more like drinking tea.The only plus is that there is not any bitterness.

Roland Chipotle Peppers in Adobo Sauce have a strange and unpleasant, vaguely chemical taste that is hard to describe, slightly metallic, perhaps an artificial smoke flavor or dried spices.  Roland doesn't generally manufacture their own products but private-labels those from other manufacturers and I have to wonder who cans these.Other brands that I have tried like San Marcos and Casa Fiesta are much better and cleaner tasting.  My advice is to buy one of those brands or at least try one can before committing to a case of these if you haven't tasted them.Besides this fatal flavor flaw they are pretty much the same as any other chipotle in adobo, nice whole peppers swimming in sauce, smoky and addictive to people who like to eat hot peppers.  They will squirt when you bite them so I usually cut them in half in the kitchen.Bottom line, I have been using them in recipes where they lend heat and the flavor will be buried but I can't eat them with chips or use them as a sauce on top of anything because of the flavor and I won't be ordering them again.

column9: Good, but these cans are BIG.
column10: I really like the taste of these peppers in adobo sauce, but there is no way I could use a whole can at once.  I am the only one in the house who likes spicy food, so I have to go easy on it.  Would be great if you were making a HUGE pot of chili though.

WOW this jerky cannon is really NICE I mean super NICE. for many years I've been using the Nesco jerky works jerky maker yes the red & white cheap piece of plastic thingy LOL. I've been wanting to replace that for years just never got around to doing it. I just happened to see this jerky cannon and thought I would try it out. well I'm kicking my self for not buying this years ago as soon as I opened the box and seen this thing my Nesco jerky works thingy went right in the GARBAGE. now for this jerky cannon this thing is SUPER nice heavy duty and works fantastic. this cannon is big and very well made and should last a life time. the barrel it self is just under 15" long & is solid Alum, the push rod is solid steal, the nozzles are solid seal, the handles are plastic coated steal as well. over all length from end to end is 22" long. it also comes with a brush to clean the barrel very nice. it also comes with two packs of backwoods jerky mix, looking forward to trying that out and comparing it to the Hi Mountain stuff I've been using. the only thing left to say is about this L.E.M jerky cannon is this is well made & solid and WELL worth the money. I would highly recommend buying this I'm VERY VERY happy with this product well done L.E.M. will also be buying the double jerky nozzle & the 6" round nozzle for stuffing casings.

Great product, very solid, should last a lifetime.  First time I used it I found that it was easy to setup and use.  Made my first batch of deer jerky using the ribbon attachment and was very pleased. If you are looking for a good jerky maker, look no further---highly recommended.

Much better than the plastic one I owned before. I make Jerky from Ground beef for my booth at a local market. I produce on average 15 pounds a week. This gun makes it easier bye reducing the amount of refills. It is a little clumsy given it's large size. But not needing to refill so often, helps. Metal tube is a winner. Just be careful of air pockets. This builds up unwanted pressure. Thats how I shattered the plastic one.

column9: This is one bad ass jerky gun!
column10: So I was tied between buying this or the Weston jerky gun, and boy am I glad I went with this one.  The gun is extremely well constructed and everything on it feels very solid.  The only plastic parts are the thread on ends and the piston itself, and those are probably around three-eighths of an inch thick.  It was very quick and easy to setup and use.  The brush made cleaning it quick and easy as well.  This should last forever, unlike the Nesco jerky gun I previously had.

I've been buying jerky for, oh, 40 years. This is one of my favorites. It's salty but not too salty. It's not shredded and re-formed but instead solid slabs of beef. The product has always been moist when I received it. And to top it off, the price is very competitive with other quality jerkys. Can you buy another brand cheaper at the outlet store? Sure, if price is your only driver. But if you want actual good jerky at a good price, this is an excellent choice.

column9: The filet mignon of beef jerky!
column10: Do I need to say more? This is the best jerky I've ever had, and quite different from the usual stringy stuff that sticks between your teeth for weeks. Is it possible that this is composed of separate chunks mashed together? Possibly, but the result is the most tender jerky ever, with no hint of fat or gristle. The only downside I can think of is that because it's so much easier to eat and chew, you could go through an entire pack before you know it.
Product was as advertised.I have not used much, as yet.  So I am assuming the quality is good as well.

column9: Bah Humbug...Arrived late and the tin is TINY!
column10: I bought this for my sister for Christmas.  Not only did it take over two weeks to get to her, this tin is TINY.  It looks much larger in the picture.  Check out the weight measurement before buying and compare to others out there.  The taste was good, but not worth the price given the size.

The Pan Ducale Bastoncini Almond Biscotti are less than 1/2 the size of a regular or normal biscotti.  However, they are very tasty and of good quality.  I actually prefer them because of their small size.  I would recommend them to anyone who likes Italian biscotti.

When visiting Tuscany a few years ago I fell in love with cantuccini (the smaller size biscotti) that was put out by the hotel to dip in your coffee.  I found this brand at home in Northern California and was buying it regularly until I recently moved to Southern California.  San Diego does not offer any good specialty foods.  So I have been ordering on the internet.  I can't wait for this product to be available, as I have just finished my last box.

Alexian pate is so smooth, delicate and creamy....you MUST try it you will not be disappointed ... you can also purchase their slice pkgs. 5oz or 7oz in specialty stores or grocery stores...look for it in the specialty cheese departments.

column9: The worst tasting butter flavor I have ever bought!
column10: Great service on delivery but this has to be the worst ever butter flavoring.  I made a double recipe of buttercream icing and had to throw it all away. I could not even stand to smell it and there was no way I would put it on a cake!  I thought that since it was a CK Product that it would be great but I was so wrong! Don't waste your money!

This is one of those products that is at best "finishing" a dish. Maybe dry roast some seeds in a skillet (no butter or oil). Once the salad is finished, for instance, sprinkle the seeds over them. I find it a nice complement to a stir fry, sprinking some of these on top while plating the dish.

I sent a package of these via Amazon to my little brother to kick off his fall semester at college. It made for a great care package and he loved it! This is his/our favorite kind of Chex Mix; sweet and salty. It has the usual Chex Mix cereal pieces and pretzels, but our favorite pieces are the little dough sticks and swirl pieces. Yum! Maybe I'll order some for myself now...
Two thumbs up! Quick shipping and the snacks were just what I wanted. They don't taste like diet food at all. In fact everyone keeps stealing them from me whether they are counting calories or not!
These are amazing and taste exactly like a 100 Grand bar!  YUM!  So glad to find them in larger quantities.  Gotta hide them from the kids!
These taste amazing!  They are so helpful when I'm craving chocolate, they have just the right amount of sweetness and crunch.

These are delicious... and I don't mean they're delicious for being relatively healthy. Even without the healthy aspect, they are great. I'm not a fan of the cripy bars... but these I could eat alllll day long.
These are sooooo good! I had to find them on here, since they sell them in a single packet at the supermarket. But yummy and only 110 calories.

I received my plant last week and it was packaged well but it is not healthy.  It arrived with light yellow/cream color around edges of leaves and now after a week outside, I am afraid it doesn't look any better.  The color of the plant overall is not a healthy green like in the picture at all.  I am so disappointed because I was thinking about buying from another company a much larger one but it was also twice the cost.  It may have been worth it though after seeing this very small plant.

column9: According to Rocky, this is delicious.
column10: Our puppy, Rocky, has recently outgrown puppy food (maybe because he's now fifty pounds), but for his first six months we fed him Pedigree Little Champions Morsels in Sauce with Chicken over a scoop of dry food. He was much more enthusiastic about eating dry food when it came with this "delicious" topping.We have been getting our pet food from Amazon for several months, and it is working out well for us. The price is competitive, we don't have to lug home cases of food, and--most importantly--we don't have to deal with the local Big Box, where sometimes they have food that our pets will eat, but more often they are out of stock.
These taste great. I would have ordered them much sooner if I had realized how few carbs are in each. If sugar free were mentioned in the description I think a lot more diabetics would try them.

I haved used Fleischmann's yeast for over 30 years and was always happy with it until this year. My breads were inconsistant and the texture was coarse.  I tried a jar of Red Star yeast and what a differrence!  I now get a beautiful rise and flavor that reminds me of fresh baked breads and rolls from the bakery.  If you want the perfect loaf I suggest you use Red Star regular or their bread machine yeast, both are made by the SAF company, the other perfect yeast and all are available through Amazon at a great price!

column4: MagnoliaSouth "As soon go kindle fire with sn...
column9: Works great if fresh, but expensive here.
column10: I bought this at Walmart because it was cheaper than buying the envelopes. It says to refrigerate it after opening and to use it in six months. I did just that. When I first opened it, my bread rose very well and had no problems. The next time I made it, it wasn't so great and the breads got shorter and shorter as time went on.I really am not a typical bread baker so I cannot compare it to others. I just know that this is really only good if used quickly.Besides, the price here is absolutely too high. At present, it's  $19.49 + $5.49 shipping = $24.98. That's $8.33 a jar! I checked my local Walmart just yesterday, it's $3.98 a jar.

I've used this yeast for years but it recently disappeared from the stores.  I am not sure why Fleischmann's is discontinuing this product in favor of versions with additives.  Glad to have a supply for now.

I bake a lot and found myself constantly looking in all the stores where I shop for the jars of yeast rather than the envelopes and very seldom finding them. I spoke to managers about ordering it, never came in, etc. By purchasing three jars through Amazon I am now set for all the baking I care to do without worrying about getting the yeast all the time. By keeping the jar in the refrigerator after opened, it lasts a good long while. I never run out the way I did when I used the envelopes. A huge help in the kitchen.

I've been baking for many years, and have been making my own artisan bread. I have used this yeast for a long time in the past, but I suspect when the company changed hands in 2004 something happened to the production, as the yeast has decreased in quality by a GREAT amount since then.This yeast, while it does work, is not active enough to properly make REALLY good bread. This is a "get by" kind of yeast that should be bought in a grocery store as a last resort.The yeast needs a significant amount of added sugar to properly activate, and even then this is unreliable. I have had some batches of this yeast simply fail to proof at all. Generally only good for pan baking, as opposed to freeform or artisan baking. The yeast does not provide enough leavening during the baking process to rise the loaf in the oven after the transfer to the baking stone. (Transfer in artisan bread tends to degass the dough slightly). Loaves end up flat and the crumb very dense.If you are truly serious about your baking I highly suggest picking up some SAF instant yeast, or if you are stuck with buying it last minute get some of the Red Star yeast packets. SAF is superior (as is instant yeast), but either of those options will provide you with better results than Fleischmann's.

I do not understand why the price difference in this product.  Our dog LOVES this treat.  It is the first thing we do in the morning and any time we leave or come home she knows she will get her "Breath Buster" treat.  But we buy them at Wall Mart for $2.66 for the same size bag.  Just wanted to pass that along.  Love the product!!!

I have purchased these snacks in a plastic jar in the past.  Could only get them in Iowa and couldn't find them locally so I was happy when I saw these on the Internet.  WRONG!! The snacks are so stale and hard that I'm afraid to give them to my dog.  He'll either break a tooth or choke.  Vendor seems to be selling an old product.
Dogs love these. I would give them a 5 star rating except they stink so bad I can hardly stand the smell.

I'm not going to argue for or against circus peanuts as an idea; you either love them or loathe them, and I happen to adore them, though I understand why you wouldn't. They're bright orange marshmallows shaped like huge peanuts and flavored like bananas. The inventor must have been on some serious drugs to think this was a good idea.But there is wide variance in quality between the brands. The very best -- lovely soft texture, bright color, just enough fake banana flavor -- are made by Brach's, which are quite hard to get online unless you want to buy them by the case. These are not quite as good as Brach's, but they're pretty good -- texture mostly soft with small patches of crystal, good color, fake banana flavor almost just right.

column9: Best marshmellow-based orange-colored banana-flavored candy ever
column10: Circus peanuts are delicious, they are quite possibly the best candy ever invented.  As long as you get them when they're somewhat fresh and aren't so hard that they destroy your teeth when you try to bite into them, that makes it rather difficult to get all of the circus peanut goodness out of them.

How do you say DELICIOUS with 2 words? Circus Peanut. The artificial banana flavoring always makes my mouth water. If you are lucky you'll get a peanut from the original batch made in the 1800's! I like to give these out to the ungrateful neighborhood cretins at Halloween, but they just repay my kind gesture by egging my house.

My four-year-old and I used the marshmallow peanuts to make beaks for the ducky cupcakes from What's New, Cupcakes for her birthday, and they worked really well.  The banana flavor threw people off, and that added that much more flavor/fun to our creation.

column9: Hard as a rock, small bag
column10: I had to return this item. The peanuts were not marshmallow at all, but hard as rocks. I doubt it would be humanly possible to bite and/or chew these peanuts. They were all stuck together in the package and there was residue all over the inside of the bag. I'm not sure if they are super old or the bag was not sealed properly. The bag I received was from sweetgourmet.com. First item I have ever had to return to Amazon. We are prime too so we are buying on here a few times a week
Mom says they are the freshest she has ever had. You know if it pleases an 80 year old mom, it has to be good!

I used these circus peanuts in goody bags for toddlers.  Our theme was "Leaving On A Jet Plane" and since airlines used to give peanuts as a snack, decided I wanted to give out circus peanuts.  Circus peanuts are difficult to find in stores.  The brand I did find was harder than a rock so I took a chance and ordered online.  These circus peanuts arrived soft and fresh.  I ate one to make sure they were soft enough for the toddlers and they actually were!  They also tasted like I remembered from my childhood.  Each individual peanut was also bigger than the brand I had looked at in the store.  If I need circus peanuts again, I'll definitely buy this brand!

These are the worst tasting circus peanuts ever.  I tasted one and threw the rest away.  They were soft and chewy but tasted nothing like any circus peanuts I've had previously.  Don't waste your money.
I don't know a single person that likes these things.  Why do they keep making them, and who the hell is buying them?

column9: The graphic is the best thing
column10: I was not expecting a large box, but this is teeny tiny! The graphic is cute, but that's not what I thought I was paying for. I had sent some as gifts before I saw one in person -- they weren't supposed to be big gifts, but when I saw how small they actually were I was mortified. Part of the fun of a gift like this is the feeling of expansive celebration -- but, despite the colorful packaging, this just seems stingy.
Great as a gift for someone from that era.  A real throwback.  The packaging was nice too, but the candy "haul" could have included a little more...
I love this flavor.  I am currently deployed in Iraq and brought a supply of the "on the go" packets with me.  It makes even the hot water we get in the desert drinkable.

I love these fruit punch packets.  I have a sweet tooth, and I also love to cram food in my mouth in the evening when I sit down to read a book.  I seem to have a need to read while I'm eating, and also a need to eat when I'm reading, even if I'm not hungry.  Since I *love* to read, reading can put me in danger of destroying my waistline.  So, I mix a packet of fruit punch into a tall glass of cold water, stir well, then add ice and a sipping straw.  Very sweet and satisfying, and I don't notice an artificial sweetener taste at all.  I'll easily drink 3 of these a night, and it keeps me from eating junk food while I read.

My dentist told me to stop sipping carbonated diet soda all day because the carbonation was hard on my teeth (who knew?), so I've switched to drink mixes. I use this, frequently mixed with the pomegranate variety in a large jug, and I'm good to go. I also frequently mix one of these with the new K2O pink lemonade with protein & fiber since weight loss is always an issue, and this definitely perks up the somewhat bland pink lemonade. I'm on subscribe & save which makes this a real bargain.

This is the flavor of Crystal Light that I loved as a kid, now available in small single serve packages.  The only difference is that I now use one packet to flavor TWO 16.9 oz bottles because the flavor is quite potent.  I carry bottled water with me everywhere, so this is a nice change of pace.  It quenches thirst better and is an improvment over soda, though after paying for bottled water and the Crystal Light, it's about the same price, if not a little more expensive.  I'm giving this 5 stars because Fruit Punch is my favorite flavor of all the brands and flavors of single-serves that I've tried, however it really is too sweet for a single serving unless you're craving Kool-Aid level sweetness.

column9: Wow, who knew diet stuff could taste so good!
column10: Let me start off my saying that I'm a guy and I saw my wife drinking this stuff.  She also "loved" the vitamin water zero which when I tried it thought that it tasted basically like TheraFlu so I was skeptical in this.  I'm a skeptic no more. It's got a great taste and I don't taste any of that nasty artificial sweetner after taste. Not sure how they do it but I have to say this stuff for having under 10 calories is amazing!

column9: Loved it even though I thought I hated Crystal Light
column10: I, at least used to, hate Crystal Light. I always found the aspartame to be a little too heavy, and after drinking a Light mix I'd get a sort of irritation that felt like I had a sinus condition. Whatever that issue was, I don't have it at all with this drink mix. I'm not sure if that has to due with a perfected recipe or a change in my body's chemistry, but either way I'm happy to enjoy this mix.So what do you get? At the time of writing, this product was being sold with 10 packets at a relative cost of under a dollar per packet. Considering the quality of the product, that's a good deal. Pop a packet a day to mix up your drinking water, and one box can last two work weeks. Not bad. To note, this is the sort of packet that flavors one roughly twenty-ounce bottle of water at a time, instead of the larger variety that might do a whole pitcher at a time.The flavor is, to me, Kool-Aid Fruit Punch. This is a high praise, as I remember Kool-Aid's fruit punch flavor fondly from my childhood. Of course we're trading sugar for aspartame, so there is a difference in the final effect, but the flavor is there. And the aspartame isn't bad. This tastes like a light fruit punch, it does not taste overly much of artificial sweetener. There's never any grittiness, nor does the flavor linger for too long as a sugary drink might.The packet also mixes very well. Drop the contents into a covered cup or bottle of water, and I'd reccomend shaking but it doesn't take too much work to stir. Not once has the mix formed any undissolved chunks or required excessive shaking or stirring in my experience, while I have sometimes seen this with off-brands.So it's a high-quality, tasty drink mix. I couldn't ask for more.
This is a great product and is very convenient for those health conscious - or newly health conscious - looking to improve their water intake.

This flavor is sooo good.  Many people say that it's really sweet tasting (and it is), but I love feeling like I've had a treat in the afternoon when I drink this.  Warning - your teeth and tongue will be red for a bit after unless you swish with water after drinking.I don't think it has an artificial sweetener after taste.
I drink water when I am at work and these little packets help! I hate the taste of plain water for some reason. But using these packets I drink plenty of water for the whole shift!

I Hate to drink just plain water, and it was becoming a real dehydration problem for me. I decided to try Crystal Light because it was low-calorie and came in many flavors. I have tried many flavors and Fruit Punch is the only one I can stand. I love the "on the go" packets so I can just pop it into my water bottle at work. I do however water it down a little, since I find it very strong for me.
I drink this all the time - love it, also mixes well for an 'adult' low cal beverage. The only one I keep ordering again and again.
I love Crystal Light and this would have to be my favourite flavour, along with the grape.  I'm so glad to be able to buy this from Amazon and have it sent to Australia because I can't get it in Oz.

column9: Very red, very sweet, and I like it a lot!
column10: If you are a fan of Crystal Light and aren't put off by a really really red drink, this fruit punch is for you! I love the convenience of the individual packets.

My Husband HATES to drink just plain water, and it was becoming a real dehydration problem for him.  I decided to try Crystal Light because it was low-calorie and came in many flavors.  His favorite is Fruit Punch, so I started with that and got the "on the go" so he could pop it into his water bottle at work.  It has worked like a charm!  He is finally getting the water he needs every day, and he loves the Crystal Light!  He says the Fruit Punch is the best! So if you aren't a big water drinker but need more water in your daily life, this is totally the way to go! (If you don't like Fruit punch, there are plenty of other flavors to choose from, so search away my friend!)

And I don't allow Koolaid in my home because of all the sugar.  This is a great alternative for me and the kids.  They get their fruit, sweet taste and water, and so do I.  I am picky about just drinking water, so the flavors help a lot, and at 5 calories you can't lose!  Fruit Punch is by far my favorite flavor, it is really good.  This really helps in my fight against pop!

column9: Nice fruit punch additive to my water!
column10: This product tastes great, and gives me that "sweet" flavor I crave in sodas, without the extra calories. I drink a lot of water every day, and this helps take the bordom out of drinking regular water. Works great in my lunch and dinner water, keeps me away from that sweet craving that gets me in trouble ! Is a little sweet for 16 ounces, I like one package for 24 ounces seems to be perfect.

I simply adore the flavour of this product.  Though the aspartame sometimes upsets my tummy, the flavour is wonderful.  I tend to use 20-24 ounces of water, instead of the package suggested 16.9, but I prefer I the lighter flavours.Also quite good when mixed with Sprite or Sprite Zero ... 2 cans per packet, you just can't shake as much.

column9: If you can stand the taste of aspartame...
column10: If you can stand the taste of Aspartame then you won't mind this product, the fruit punch flavor is ok except for that. Personally the aspartame taste was too strong and bitter for me to enjoy this drink. I wish that they could/would use sorbital in this product like they do in some of the bottled varieties.

column9: I've never had so many split ends in my life!
column10: I have long, fine hair and this product made my split ends worse! I have never had so many in my life!! I'm almost through with the bottle and am probably just going to throw the rest away.
I haven't noticed any positive results. It smells nice, but the condition of my ends hasn't improved. I'm using all the suggested products for maximum results, but haven't seen anything real.

The conditioner is just as bad as the shampoo. I see no results. It hasn't gotten 80% rid of split ends.Tresemme can be a little more expensive than some people want, so don't waste your money. It has not done its job. Not even close.

I saw this at the store shelve and it was a lil more expensive than its other products.Split ends has always been a problem for me coz i bleached my hair every 3 months. When i bought it, i had strong doubt, but it was only $1 more expensive than what i was using, so i gave it a try.I don't know why it didnt work on other people, but it def. worked on my hair. (I use the anti-breakage shampoo and the split end conditioner)3 uses, as said on the bottle, most of my split ends are gone. I was so excited and amazed that i recommended all my friends lolI guess it really depends on the person. Anyway, I love it.

Aspen booda bones are made in china and are on a list of products that are causing kidney failure and death in dogs!  Petmate brand booda bones are made in the USA and do not have this warning!  If you care about your dogs health only buy Petmate  booda bones!

Even though this product says BPA FREE right on the front, they are not in fact BPA free.  In very small print on the back, it says "Lid not included".  I'm sorry, the lid is part of the can.  To say these are BPA free is false advertising and completely disingenuous.  If you follow BPA testing at all, even small trace amounts are harmful.  Will not recommend this product and hope others see this review if you're concerned about contaminates in your food.

column9: Simply Delicious!!! It's worth the cost overall.
column10: Totally unexpected in how good this tasted! I eat organic as much as I can. No pun intended I don't associate organic or healthy in a can. But I saw this in my organic food aisle and I took a shot. Yummy! I ate it with some organic texmati brown rice with some fresh dill. Wonderful.I'm one of those that follows the body for bloodtype diet. I'm AB positive. Unfortunately, meat intake is limited to lamb and turkey. I can seriously get bored with that. And shrimp is out. I love shrimp being asian. But salmon is great for me. I was debating on going online to buy wild salmon online and it just was too expensive for me to buy in bulk.Obviously you're going to pay a bit more for it. But ask yourself how much does your health cost to you in the long run? People spend far to much money tricking out their car. Or clothes and makeup to look gorgeous. I admit I do put in the effort to look attractive on the outside. However what about inside your body?I can't believe they sell this on Amazon. I never buy food online but never say never. I think I'll make an exception. This stuff is great. And based on my own protein intake per day this makes for two meals. And I'm a 5'1" athlete. Single and on the go. I still save money compared to going to a gourmet sushi restaurant to get fresh fish. And what's great about this company is they are eco-conscious. Part of their proceeds they donate to help support marine conservation. A++++ overall. Thanks for putting out a quality product that makes me feel healthy and contributing to the conservation of the global community.
We love Henry & Lisa's line of canned seafood.  Their salmon is fantastic & we highly recommend it!  Expensive, but well worth it for storable salmon of this quality.

My family was skeptical at first when I began serving canned salmon, but this has become a must-have product at our house. It's simply the most tender and tasty salmon I've had from a can, and I often simply eat it  for lunch with nothing more than pickles and a bit of mango chutney on the side. Worth the money, although I do wish it were cheaper if purchased in bulk from Amazon.

Tried hard to like the Henry and Lisa's Salmon, but could not.  Often found small "glass like" particles that crunched in the salmon.  Henry and Lisa's informed me that these particles were actually "Struvite" a harmless, naturally occurring mineral in the salmon.  The customer service was very helpful and polite, however I could just not enjoy the salmon with the crunchy particles in it.  I have turned to Natural Sea and/or Crown Prince and have not had any of the "Struvite" problems.

(I have had roughly 30 cans of this. ) 2 stars stands for I don;t like it. 3 stars is "it's OK". But I don;t think what I have been experienceing is OK for the price and hype.There is no denying how good this salmon is, it's premium wild salmon. But! The quality varies can to can. Which is unfortunate.For instance:Can 1: A nice almost single filet with medium chunks.Can 2: Medium Chunks of fillet with some flakey tiny tiny pieces. Big pieces of struvite.Can 3 and 4: Like Light tuna like consistency (gross and not warranting this high price), basically like filler. Lots of small struvite particles. Like biting into rocks, glass, crystals, etc.I decided not to buy this stuff anymore, as I like more of the fillet, or medium size chunks. I got too many cans that were flakey stuff, the same consistency as light tuna is. WAY too expensive for the inconsistant quality. Addressing the struvite, while it is commonly known that it is a mineral and natural, and that it is rare to get...I tend to doubt it...unless I have won the struvite lottery.Conistantly with my order of 4 cans, there are two cans that contain it. Generally the ones that have the flakey filler in the whole can. While most if it is small, I have had what looked like a geode, about .75 inches long, and .5 incles high, fanned out crystal. No way my teeth could crunch it. This is entirely too high for me, and nothing ruins an almost $5 can of salmon like crystals inside.My theory is that they noticed their salmon had huge struvite particles (Can 2), and started to almost puree the stuff (can 3 and 4) to save from a loss, or to pass the buck the the consumer. Which does not go unnoticed.This is how I view it and it is my opinion. If it was $2 a can I would buy more, but the supermarket alternatives are less expensive, and while most of those do not have the occasional fillet piece, I feel it is a better value over all. If the quality control was better on these, I would be buying them every week, but consistancy needs a lot of work, and company either needs a better QC supervisor, or to lower the price. The quality does not match what is advertised in the 30 or so cans I have had. You be the judge.Enjoy!

column9: Out of all canned on market - these are the best yet!
column10: I absolutely love this brand and we have tried many of them. We used to order Wild Planet but ever since the earthquake in Japan we got weary since they pack theirs there. This company claims to be packed and shipped from Alaska and that makes me feel a little more comfortable. My husband and I have chemical sensitivities and so many foods are off limits for us. We tolerate this very well and feel a difference in taste and quality. I highly recommend trying this kind. I saw one review badly rate due to "glass-like" substances - that's bones. They rarely have bones in them but on occasion you will get some bones BUT it isn't as bad as some out there and really people - it's seafood! You are going to get bones here and there - otherwise go buy some spam. lol... Anyway, highly recommend!!!

A full, nutircious tastey tin of wild caight salmon. It is a full can, with firm and flavorfull meat. I would recommend it for novices in regards to wild caught salmon as well as for veteran wild-caught salmon eaters.

column9: NOT BPA FREE!!  Enough to make you flip your lid!
column10: As you can see, the company has a prominent PBA FREE CAN seal on the label.  If you look closely, perhaps with a magnifier,  you will see an tiny asterisk after the word "CAN", however, there is no corresponding asterisk on that side of the box.  On the back of the box, in an inconspicuous place, at the bottom, underneath the recycling information and the larger print address and email address, in tiny print you will see "*lid not included. Obviously the company believes it is important for consumers to know if their product is BPA free, as they clearly state it on the front of the box in LARGE LETTERS, so isn't it deceptive that the description does not apply to the lid, which is indeed part of the can?  Even if I were not concerned about ingesting BPA, I still would not support a company that would intentionally mislead their customers, especially in matters of health and safety.

column9: Absolutely the BEST...Especially for We MSG Allergens
column10: When I saw on the label it contained salmon, water "And nothing else!"  I immediately purchased it and continue to do so.  Love salmon. Love WILD Salmon. And I love even more being able to TRUST a product NOT to slip in MSG in one form or another.  I make salmon paddies and loaf and sometimes just eat it from the can. I just wish they would make red salmon as well.  Actually, it's not that much more expensive than pink salmon you buy in the store, but it is BETTER.  I have it on auto and plan to leave it there as long as Henry and Lisa produce it.  Highly, highly, highly recommend.

column9: great product at a good price at Amazon
column10: Henry & Lisa's natural seafood wild salmon is great tasting and natural. We have been enjoying this product straight from the can or in salmon patties for years. Amazon has the price set to beat our local healthfood store. And their's no bones or skin in the can.

I'm buying more.  I don't even like salmon but this is delicious with mayo.  Eating because I am a breast cancer survived and dr said eat more fish and veggies.  Tastes fresh sort of.  No canned taste.

column9: Great with lemon and a kick of oil
column10: First, I must state that I appreciate the lack of preservatives, chemicals, antibiotics and hormones in this product (from what the sellers say anyway)! The salmon is as fresh as canned fish can get and it's an awesome meal filler and protein and omega source! Great product for healthy appetites and interests -- just add your own seasoning and your all ready to go! Keep up the great fishing  Henry & Lisa!!
Yummy. High quality. It is a staple in our household. I make salmon salad out of it. It is a good alternative to tuna for those trying to avoid the mercury content that is found in tuna.

column9: It was great until they got rid of the attached can opener
column10: This used to be my must-have food for my hiking, biking or xc skiing trips, but no longer so since the maker changed their cans.It is superior in terms of taste than most of other brands I tried (from Wholefoods) for two reasons:- It uses wild Alaskan pink salmon. This type of salmon has higher fat content and is much more tastier than the leaner/dryer sockeye salmon.- It is canned in its own juice instead of spring water.I have had the older version (the one w/ attached can opener) for years. The new can does not have opener anymore as of July 2012 at Amazon and Wholefoods. The product picture is outdated. As I buy these cans strictly for my outdoor trips, attached can opener was a crucial feature to me. Therefore, I take off 2 star for this product.For now, I will stick to their canned tuna that is still packed in cans with an opener.

I should have read the box correctly. 25 jelly beans and look at the cost! LOL. The laugh is on me. Going to contact Amazon though and let them know about your gross misrepresentation (seller). I think it's about 50 cents per jelly bean.
Too busy enjoying this wonderful lavender extract in homemade ice cream and muffins, I forgot to send in my review. Thanks for a great product. Shipping was awesome, too.

I like this the least of the three lavender extracts I've tried. For my palette, there is an unpleasant, harsh, chemical aftertaste.I understand that not everyone tastes things the same way. I often find the same taste in artificially-sweetened products with xylitol and sorbitol. If you're not sensitive to those, you may be fine with this flavoring.I liked the Herb Pharm Lavender Extract 1 Ounces and the Bakto Flavors Natural Lavender Flavor-4 OZ much, much better.A related, also high-quality product would be the Sonoma lavender syrup Sonoma Syrup Co., No.3 Lavender Infused Simple Syrup, 12.7 Ounce Bottle, 12.7 Ounce Bottle.
arrived in excellent condition, on time,and is a rather exotic addition to my pantry.  will use in lemonade, lemon based baked goods.

One of the most delightful flavor memories from Southern France is lavender ice cream.  Although lavender grows  easily here, this product lets me make lavender ice cream on a whim without the bother of preparing a syrup using the flowers.  The flavor is wonderful, and I would recommend it without hesitation.

column9: Lavender just the way you always dreamed it would smell/taste
column10: I purchased this bottle from this seller who has a number of interesting gourmet food items that I have enjoyed. When I saw the Lavender Extract, I was immediately intrigued. I bought a bottle and have made Lavender Simple Syrup for mixing with cocktails, delish. I have also added Lavender Extract my homemade Limoncello which is also wonderful. I often add a drop to my Crema di Limoncello for that extra "je nais sais quoi". I love this product and will definitely purchase again, the ideas for using it are endless. The seller is wonderful, too!

I bought this based on the positive reviews..WOW either I got a bad batch or everyone is reviewing a different Lavender extract.  This is the worst tasting extract I have ever tasted, I am so disapointed.  It doesn't even smell good :( I was so exceited to make lavender yogurt, well ended up tossing the yogurt, waste of money!! I would be very cautious buying this because this does not taste like lavender and is really just awful.Wasted my money. (I am almost jealous of the other reviewers because they seem to have somehow got a good lavender extract whereas mine is in the trash :(

I sometimes like to cook with lavender and this extract smells and tastes wonderful (in moderation, it is very concentrated).  It can also be used for other purposes (in baths, etc).  I am very pleased with this purchase and would order it again.
Great product - pepper/vegetable mix, heat level/taste and service  outstanding!Thank you

These Szechuan ones are 99.9% just the husk (shell) and virtually none of the peppercorns. Roast them and crush them to get the flavor and texture right. If you don't roast them and crush them up they'll be chewy and lack the flavor you expect. I am used to seeing more of the peppercorns mixed in which I crush up with the husks as I roast them. Yummy.

These tasted just as I remembered them as a child. Even better, no one else in the family would try them because they said sugar free. They are a bit pricey, but for those on a low carb/sugar diet it may be worth it if you are craving something sweet and chewy.

I bought these in San Francisco in a candy store, never tried them before. I was amazed at the taste, so much so that I had to go online and order more! Amazon's price is pretty good: direct from the manufacturer, the cost is just under $12 for six bags...try them, I think you'll like hem!

This is a perfect sytem for brewing loose tea leaves that need to unfold in a long container with holes in the bottom. The top portion consists of that. The lid helps the tea brew by keeping steam in. All you do is lift out the inner brewing chamber with holes in it; and the brewed tea remains in the cup.

Holes are small enough that most loose tea won't get through the holes. Typhoo tea seems to be just too small for most strainers though. Good weight and size. Tea stays hot. Good color and paint job. Would buy it again.

Saw this package advertised on Sam Adams website with a 30% discount and decided to give Robinsons prime reserve a try instead of Omaha Steaks. I don't know where this cut of steak is supposed to rate as far as being a prime cut but it is really good! The other offerings on the Robinson website are pricey, but judging by the quality of these steaks I'm going to take the plunge! Also, this package comes with 2 Sam Adams pint glasses, but I received the wrong glasses. One simple e-mail through Amazons customer service and Robinson apologized for the mix up and sent me 4 glasses for the inconvenience.

I have already done a review for this product at Amazon.  I said the product, Angie's Caribbean Black Cake, arrived on time and well packaged in a festive red tin symbolizing the Christmas Season.  On opening the package the Cake was moist and extremely delicious.  I will not hesitate to order from Angie's Caribbean Cake Connoisseurs again.
This is the first time I have ordered Mariani California Apricots and I will definitely order them again.  They are absolutely delicious! I also appreciate the fast service.  Thank you!
This item is difficult to find in my area of western North Carolina.  I was pleased to see it available here.  The product is a great snack loaded with fiber and nutrition.

I was thrilled to find the California Apricots for my brother-in-law! They live in Costa Rica and these are his favorites so he was absolutely floored when I brought him the entire case when we visited!They haven't been able to find them and I couldn't find them locally so this was great!

column9: california apricots the best to get
column10: These Mariani California are not only the best apricots you can get but the price is also a great value. If you like dried apricots California is the only ones and Mariani should be the only ones you buydave Plotkina very happy customer

The apricots were not what I expected, they didnt taste that great.  They seemed liked they were older and were not that flavorful.  I was expecting them to be like the pictures showed and have more flavor and be larger.

Mariani's dried California apricots are absolutely delicious. I've tried Mariani's Mediterranean apricots, but they are definitely substandard in terms of flavor, and they lack the tangyness that also accompanies the California apricots.
I just received my order and OMG these are the best dried apricots ever.  I suspect the 12 packages I purchased will not last long and I'll be placing another order very soon.

I am very pleased with the quality of these dried California apricots.  Dried California apricots are difficult to locate in the stores anymore.  You can find "dried apricots" or "dried Turkish apricots" which are often good but are a sweeter variety without the tang I enjoy. These add a nice counterpoint in a sweet baked item and are delicious cut up in hot cereal/oatmeal.I am very pleased to be able to purchase these through Amazon.  Previously, Amazon sold another brand on the subscribe and save program but they were discontinued.  Mariani brand is even better!

I use many dried apricots in trail mixes and in homemade bread.I also eat them as a snack. I have tried many brands and varietiesand this brand is by far my favorite.  They are always soft, easyto chew, and very flavorful. I am a repeat buyer and will continueto select these for health benefits and pleasurable eating.

My dog (Precious) absolutely loves NutriDent dental chews.  My vet presented me with a $600 estimate to clean my dogs teeth so I decided to check out the alternatives.  After some research I found Nutri Dent.  Precious is allergic to chicken so I had to find something that didn't include chicken bi-products but could also clean teeth.  After dinner every day, Precious is given one chew and she loves them.  We noticed a difference in the tartar build up right away.  It has been 4 months and we (me and the dog) couldn't be happier!

On the bottle, it's advertised as containing the hottest pepper in the world.  That very well may be the case, but this puree is not the hottest.I ordered this at the same time as some dried Ghost Chile (Bhut Jolokia), and I have to say, the Bhut Jolokia was far spicier in my opinion, and this puree was extremely disappointing.  When I ate the dried Bhut Jolokia pepper my face turned red and my nose ran, going right to the fridge to grab some milk. With this puree, none of that happened.  Sure it's spicy, but if you're looking for the hottest pepper ever, it's probably better to just get the actual pepper itself, and not this puree.

column9: Break on through to the other side!
column10: I am always on the look out for the severely hot, and the other day I spied this one at the Beef Jerky Emporium. I took it home and used 2 or 3 drops initially, and ultimately pushed the limits of heat when I added 5 big drops to some macaroni and cheese. My entire face slowly and surely turned red, and sweat poured down my brow. Definitely one of the more powerful pepper concentrates on the market right now. Use it in everything if you're insane like me!

This is one of my favorite sparkling ice flavors.  It has a nice tropical taste and decent ingredients, making it a good substitute for soda for me.What I really taste in this soda is the pineapple.  That's the most predominant flavor with the coconut being very light.  It does put me in mind sometimes of a alcoholic tropical drink, but maybe that's just because that's where those flavors end up mostly.  It's rare to see a non-alcoholic drink incorporate the same flavors.  And I liked the fizziness the carbonation added, it's one of my favorite elements of a drink.The ingredients are good although sucralose is the sweetener, which I'm not a big fan of.  I would prefer real sugar if anything.  But it uses natural flavors and spring water, and the ingredient list is relatively short compared to a lot of other things.  Best of all, it's zero calories, so I don't have to feel too guilty when I drink it.  And they even throw a few vitamins into the mix.Great soda and one that I buy several times a week.  It never seems to grow old.Review by M. Reynard 2012
This is my favorite of all the flavors. I love Pina Coladas and this tastes like a party drink.I wish it came in larger sizes to avoid having too many containers to discard.

Check it out!  None of the other bottled waters (that I know of) have this flavor.  While it's not sweetened with Stevia (preferred, for sure), it's still a wonderful tasting NO CALORIE water sweetened with Sucralose. Got a little leeway?  Try adding a shot of rum!

column9: Love it, all it needs is some rum!
column10: I loved everything about this beverage!  It had just the right amount of carbonation, the flavor was there (it was really hard to believe it was sugar and calorie free - I even looked at the label three times while drinking it!) and it reminded me of a pina colada!  It was yummy.

I concur with ALL of the positive reviews.  I had seen the product on sale for $1 in my local Publix and Kroger stores on several occasions, but did not purchase the product until my co-worker mentioned how great they tasted AND the fact that they are a zero calorie beverage.  Most bottled water products have aspartame (which I hate).  I LOVE every flavor EXCEPT the lemon lime (maybe it will "grow" on me later).  My cousin was visiting my home and I offered her one in lieu of water.  She is now hooked. :)

While the product did taste exactly as it's described - pineapple with coconut - it was far too sweet for our taste. This extra sweetness is surprising in a zero-calorie drink. We decided to use our remaining bottles in mixed drinks at social events. We are fans, however, of the other flavors we tried, which had just the right amount of sweetness and bite. So, no need to avoid the entire ICE line - just, maybe, this one if you don't like super-sweet drinks.

I picked a bottle of this up randomly at the local supermarket after tiring of diet coke ALL the time.  Made with Splenda it doesn't have any nasty aftertaste and the added B vitamins are a definate bonus.  Chill it and its nice and refreshing in this hot weather.  Tastes more of more pineapple than coconut to me.  Love it so much I've subscribed to a regular delivery from Amazon ... can't beat that :)

Actually, I was drinking one of these when I thought I'd check if there were any reviews.The votes are in, and all two of us give it 5 stars. Coconut & pineapple puls refreshment.What's not to like?I looked forward to trying it with Alacer Electro Mix, Lemon-Lime 30 [0.1 oz (4 g)] Packets, and the Tangerine-Lime water I've been addicted to for about 12 years is still great, but a change to this is refreshing.

I recentaly started drinking ICE sparkling water and have tried all of the flavors.Even though they are all very good The coconut pineapple is the very best.It is so refreshing, both of the flavors work so well together.I would highly recommend it to everyone. Even my daughter who hates coconut has decided that this flavor is her favorite.

Reminds me of a pina colada. It's very sweet, and refreshing. My favorite so far is the Mango Orange, so I probably won't purchase this one again. Don't let that deter you from purchasing, it's just my personal preference.

This product tastes great,like a vacation in a bottle. As a canadian,i have to cross the border to get it,as its not for sale here yet,but i live close to buffalo anyway. Thing is, in the local tops store,these sell for about $1.29 i think (though they never have this flavour,but the other flavours are good too). A store in the galleria mall has them for about $2.29, way more than tops,but less than Amazons price here,especially adding the $12 to ship. If you are near a Tops,or the galleria mall,buy the singles and save some cash on a great tasting product.
This is a great drink that is healthier than most and tastes great.  Has a little carbonization.  My entire family drinks this instead of pop and loves it.

I tried this today as I enjoy the other flavors and this is a nice light Sparkling Water/soda. I enjoy this flavor. The flavor is light, but enjoyable, reminding me of a Pina Colada. I wish it had a bit more Pinapple and Coconut flavor but is pretty good. I would definately buy this again.
This is my favorite Flavor in the ICE product line so far, Coconut Pineapple.  No after taste and thirst quenching.  A winner.

I loved Clearly Canadian when it was out but the company stopped making it. So I searched on here for something similar and found this product. Now I buy this stuff by the case, I drink it all day long!!! Try it!!

column9: Love Sparkling ICE Brand (Stay away if you're sensitive to Splenda)
column10: The Sparkling ICE line up are all extremely addicting, this one included. I love that they are all flavorful, calorie free (and carb free, gluten free, caffeine free), and carbonated. I used to have periodic cravings for one of my husband's cokes and always hated myself for giving in. I always thought it was the sugar I was craving until I tried these a year ago and realized that it's actually the carbonation I would crave. These are a guilt-free way of feeding those cravings.The only thing I would note is that it is sweetened with Splenda. Splenda doesn't bother me at all but my husband can instantly tell the difference and ends up with a stomach ache any time he consumes it so unfortunately these can't help me to get him off his soda kick. So if you are also sensitive to Splenda, this isn't the product for you.The Coconut Pineapple flavor isn't one of my absolute favorites (that goes to Sparkling ICE Mountain  Spring Water, Pomegranate Berry, 17-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12) and TalkingRain Sparkling ICE Lemonade, 17-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)) but it is delicious all the same. My only complaint about this flavor is that it is so strong and overwhelming that I can't actually drink while eating anything. If I'm looking for something to toss in my purse while I'm out running errands, this one is great. But if I'm about to sit down for a meal, I have never once grabbed this flavor because it doesn't blend well with any sort of food I can think of. The other flavors tend to be milder and so they go better with different types of meals. Other than that, though, this is a fabulous drink.
I WAS INFLUENCED BY THE GOOD REVIEWS. IT TASTES NOTHING LIKE PINEAPPLE. HAS A VERY ARTIFICIAL TASTE. SINCE I CANNOT RETURN IT, I WILL THROW IT AWAY.
I love many of the Sparking Ice flavors, and I love pineapple and coconut.  But this combination?  Tastes like drinking sunscreen, very "chemical" taste.  Ick! :(

I really got this mainly as a mixer. I tend to lean towards the more complex, dessert-y matcha flavors like Pumpkin Pie and Cheesecake, and Earl Grey seemed like it'd be the perfect compliment to a lot of my favorites. I have so many different Earl Greys in my cupboard, it seemed blasphemous not to have an EG matcha as well even if it's just for experimenting with. But of course I have to try it by itself first! Bergamot is what makes Earl Grey, well, Earl Grey, and it's nicely present here. I'm really happy with the amount of flavor used: while I do like a strong EG, I didn't want it overpowering here at all. There's that classic citrus tang, with just a hint of floral qualities that really go well with the fresh, grassy matcha. I'm not sure if bergamot is the only flavoring used here, because as the description states there's just a tiny hint of warming smoke. It reminds me of a brisk EG with a strong black base, mixed in with my matcha! Refreshing, bright, and very different from all the other ones in my cupboard.

This was added to the box in an continuing effort to seduce my wife to the ways of matcha. So far, the best I've gotten out of her was "That's....interesting." Ah well, more for me. London Fogs, also known as an Earl Grey with vanilla and milk, are her favorite winter drink, so that's what I had in mind when I snagged this little beauty. That and she's a sucker for anything Earl Grey. But I'm looking forward to mixing this with, you guessed it, vanilla. An Earl Grey/vanilla was my very first tea, though I'm not much of an Earl Grey fan nowadays. But still, it sounded very tasty and I had to at least try it. I'm a bit worried, after the bitterness of the lemon matcha, but I was worried about the watermelon and it turned out amazing. And we're big fans of the Earl Grey from Red Leaf Teas around here, so we have a lot of faith in this blend. Their Earl Grey Oolong is one of the teas my wife absolutely cannot do without, and their Raspberry Earl Grey was one of the few teas I've actually seen her mourn when it was discontinued. So yes, if there was ever an Earl Grey matcha to get her into matcha, it would have to be from Red Leaf Tea.Success! We went to the zoo on Friday and my poor wife was only running on a couple hours sleep, so I made her a matcha London Fog and she loved it. Loved it! I stole a few sips of the Earl Grey before mixing it in with everything else and it was perfect Earl Grey, and I knew that I'd made the right choice. I mixed together equal parts Earl Grey matcha and French Vanilla matcha (both from Red Leaf Tea, of course) and whisked it together in a bowl to be sure to get all the lumps out. Personally I don't care about a clump or matcha or two, but it really turns her off of her drink. Anyway, I heated up some vanilla soy milk, frothed it up, added it to the blend and it was perfect. She loved it! And it's so much better for you than the regular London Fog, full of syrup and dairy...blegh. This is one I think I'll have to keep in stock, if only for my wife's sake, which I am more than happy to do.

My sisters and I started the GFCF diet about 3 months ago for all six of our children. We each have two children. Anyway, my mother bought these for the children for a snack and I will tell you everyone in my family who has tasted these finds them absolutely addictive. My husband and my brother-in-law now both have to have a can of these every week. They won't even share with my sister and I so we, of course have to buy our own can. lol. Our children can't get enough of them. Seriously the best cookie ever. None of us even liked macaroons before Jennies. Buy them, try them and love them, just know there isn't a patch to get help when you become addicted, but there may be enough of us to start a meeting or two. lol.

I bought these delicious coconut macaroons a couple of days ago at a local natural foods store, and am so happy to see them at Amazon. I hope they will add them to their "Subscribe and Save" program.  The ingredients are:  unsweetened coconut, honey, and egg whites.  The can also states:  no synthetic color, no artificial flavor, and no chemical preservatives.  It's great to be able to enjoy something so tasty without any dangerous chemical additives.  If you buy these, you will not be disappointed!

These macaroons are great! They aren't too sweet and have a good flavor and consistency. We like the fact that they are made with quality ingredients, and tell ourselves that they are a healthy indulgence. They have been on our menu for years.

column9: What happened trading honey for evaporated cane sugar?
column10: These were my absolute favorite, but my most recent batch lost the honey for evaporated cane sugar.  Even my 3 year old noticed the difference in taste.  Little does he know the loss was not just in the taste.  Please Jennie's tell me it is temporary.  I cannot believe Arnold would make that decision.

The product now includes table sugar in addition to honey. Previously, it was just honey. The result is a new product that tastes sugary and undercooked and is probably less healthy. I couldn't eat it, tastes poor.

column9: USED TO BE!! SCD (Specific Carbohydrate Diet) Friendly...But No More!!
column10: Jennies Coconut Macaroons have three ingredients: Egg whites (so if you are on the SCD, eat them when you are able to eat eggs), Coconut and Honey. There are no other sweeteners, no artificial ingredients, nothing else added. They are tasty, chewy, goodness, and the ingredients can be tolerated by many people who otherwise have to avoid most of what they see at a typical grocery store. The packaging keeps them fresh. I tried the SCD diet recipe (which contains the same ingredients plus optional lemon zest) and can't get them as good as Jennies.For a sweet treat with wholesome goodness, Jennies coconut macaroons are the way to go!REVIEW UPDATE!!! As I have seen from another reviewer - in my most recent order, Jennie's changed from HONEY to EVAPORATED CANE JUICE WITH HONEY!! This is a HORRID DEVELOPMENT! WHY DID THEY DO THIS?? I can't eat them now! They are no longer SCD Diet friendly :(

We have loved Jennies Macaroons for quite some time.  They are naturally sweet without additives and chemicals in other cookies and are great for a energy boosting snack in the afternoon.  They have the added bonus of being gluten free for those who are sensitive.  The price from Amazon makes them even more appealing!

column9: What happend to Jennies "All Honey" macaroons?
column10: Just purchased two cans of Jennies coconut macaroons. Opened one can and detected a different taste. Checked ingredients and was shocked at the addition of evaporated sugar. I'll be taking the other unopened can back to the health food store. I am thankful for the many years enjoying Jennies coconut macaroons, but will be learning to make my own now. Jennie's Coconut Macaroons, Peanut and Gluten Free, 8-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 6)

column9: Very good for people on chemo
column10: I wish they had not added the sugar but this is one of the few non medicine products that actually helps alleviate the intestinal problems that go along with getting chemo-therapy. My wife uses these regularly. She is on a very strong chemo-therapy treatment and these counteract the intestinal cramping and allow her to maintain weight.
I love macaroons and I figured that was one thing I wasn't never able to eat again after being diagnosed with Celiac disease. These are a God-send. I always have a can of them near me at all times.

column9: Not the same recipe as the individually wrapped macaroons
column10: I bought these thinking they were made exactly the same way as the individually-wrapped macaroons.  I was disappointed.  They do not taste the same; there's a slight flavor of preservatives or something that's off.Anyway, I used to eat 4 ounces (2 individually-wrapped ones) per day.  When the local grocery store ran out, I ordered these.  It's been almost two months and I've only eaten 2 of the 6 cans (16 ounces/1 pound).The ingredient list for the product is also incorrect.  The canned macaroons have the addition of evaporated cane juice, whereas the wrapped ones have only honey as a sweetener.

After reading so many rave reviews, I was eager to try Jennie's Coconut Macaroons.  Unfortunately, they were a disappointment.  They were far too sweet (I like macaroons that only have a hint of sweetness in the coconut) and far too moist (they almost tasted wet).  Now I'm stuck with 6 canisters of these macaroons.  Trader Joe's makes a far better macaroon!

These amazing little cookies are two-bite size and not too sweet! They are perfect for those on a limited diet, like Celiacs or those with food allergies. These macaroons contain only three ingredients and are beyond tasty. They are so addictive that you'll find yourself easily eating more than your fair share of the tin. Comes with a resealable top that is not shown in the picture.

These Coconut Macaroons are merely Okay, and not great. Certainly not anything to brag about. They lack the strong coconut flavor that I expect. And there isn't any evidence of the advertised honey ingredient. -I won't say that I really regret ordering these, this time. But I will not be ordering them again.
I read all of the reviews thinking these were EXCELLENT, bought a whole case...,I'm giving them all away except one.

I just got my 6 pack of coconut macaroons by Jennies. Let me tell you, it was depressing. These are the worst macaroons I ever had!! Let me rephrase that, they were old! I could not bite through them, TASTED HORRIBLE. I would feed these to my dog even. Don't waste your time. I got them today and I am already requesting a refund right now.

column9: Better Than Any Store Bought Cookie
column10: These macaroons are amazing.  I do not know why the other reviewers said they weren't very sweet.  I think they are plenty sweet and delicious.  If you love coconut, you MUST try these.  Buy them now!

These are excellent macaroons and the price is better than I can get them at the store.  My only complaint is that sometimes the bottoms are overcooked/burned.  This has happened in 1 can out of 3.  Great customer service as I ordered 6 and only received 1.  When I notified cs, they shipped another 6 for me right away.
I have Crohn's and can not eat anything with sugar. These have sugar though it is not listed here as an ingredient. DO NOT BUY IF YOU ARE ON SCD.

These are absolutely to die for. A great tasking all natural snack that NEVER gets old. I bought them because macaroons are the closest thing to a snack I used to purchase from roadside vendors while attending school in Kenya. The snack called "kashata" is made of almost the same ingredients as this product so I'm glad I am able to finally enjoy a tasty treat from my childhood days!
I cannot have gluten or dairy...I happened to find these macaroons and they are awesome!! I cant get enough of them.

My mom is 86 and has a heart condition. We almost lost her before she was diagnosed. She grew up in New York City and has always loved macaroons.  When she was diagnosed, her salt intake was all but eliminated.  We could see that she was obeying the doctor but her diet wasn't very appealing to her.  When I found Jennie's Coconut Macaroons (NO SALT) I immediately ordered some.  That was about 3 years ago and I have been a regular customer ever since.  These cookies are delicious, well priced and they are my mother's regular, salt free, healthy treat.  They give her something to look forward to each night with her tea.

column9: good just a bit too sweet
column10: These macaroons are delicious; for my taste a bit too much sweetener and sort of crumbly but still very good.
My husband has Celiac Disease.  I buy these for him and he LOVES them.

column9: SCD Legal and Good For You
column10: Diagnosed with Crohn's disease a year ago, I, too am on the Specific Carbohydrate diet.  I make my own bread and treats at home, but my choices are still pretty limited.
