I was delighted to find Jennies Macaroons, as there are no added "illegal" ingredients. I keep a can in my cupboard for treats (SO nice not to have to bake everything myself!).  And with all the health benefits of (unsweetened) coconut and coconut oil, I can indulge guilt free, knowing I am eating something that is actually good for me!
I adore these cookies. They're moist, chewy, and delicious. Containing only 3 ingredients, I feel that they are a very healthy snack.

I love these macaroons - even if I weren't GF, I would love them. But I get them from Glutenfree.com, a package of two cookies for .99 cents. If this can Amazon sells only has 6 cookies, it's horribly overpriced.

This is the first time I'm trying the almond flavor and it was a disappointment.  These macaroons were overbaked and were very brown and dry. I was very disappointed since the plain macaroons that I had before tasted much better.
Was looking for a low fat/no fat pretzel and this one was recommended by the Slim Fast diet plan.  Well, my husband (who is not on a diet, of course) loves them, too!

column9: disappointed w/ changes made to original product
column10: I ordered the product, because it stated it was the original Snyder's Organic Oat Bran Pretzels.  When it came, it was not the original product it said it would be, but the new version of Snyder's Organic Pretzels.  UPC was different!  Disappointed.

column9: YUM! Delish, don't let the "oat bran" part fool you

Don't be put off by the idea of a "bran pretzel," this is not a weird-tasting or -textured health food store product (I think we've all had those, right?). Delicious and good for you.
Synder's Organic Pretzels are always fresh and tasty. Knowing that they are made with whole wheat makes them even more enjoyable. They also have 0 fat!
but $30 for shipping is ridiculous. are the 12 bags individually packed in bubble wrap?seriously!
These are great tasting pretzels!  I especially like the oat bran and the fact that they are not so salty like most pretzels.  Our 12 bags are almost gone.  Great snacks for children.
Snyder's of Hanover Organic Oat Bran Pretzel Sticks, 8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)  Only one word needed to describe these pretzels:  DELICIOUS.

I discovered Miso soup at a sushi place in Spokane, Wa. and loved it's unique flavor. These packaged sizes are perfect with Asian size soup bowls. It has a wonderful flavor and is a nice snack food for my daughter after school instead of milk/cookies.--It only takes 3min. if you have a hot tap. Nice, large sizes of greens with a mild soy flavor. It's a unique flavor, truly tasty and much cheaper to purchase by the bulk on Amazon (love the free 2day shipping) than at Walmart.

Boil a cup of water and add a packet of soup mix.  It doesn't get much easier than that.  The tatse is very similar to the soup served in Japanese restaurants.  The only real difference is the tofu which is spongy and tastless (well tofu is always kind-of tasteless).  Yeh, the sodium content is high but it would taste right if it wasn't.  There are less expensive miso soup mixes on Amazon but I know and trust the Kikkoman brans.  The cost here is abot 35% less than at my local supermarket.
These are absolutely great freeze pops, especially if you like anything that's a little sour.  These are very unique and certainly worth trying.

My husband is addicted to sour anything!  He even eats citric acid by the spoonful.  I got these as a gag father's day gift, and they were a huge hit!  I wasn't sure if they'd be sour enough, but surely, they are!  If you like sour and you like ices, get these!!  They are a pucker-up, refreshing mouth pleaser.

column9: Good , but wait - THESE ARE JUST 1$ at TARGET Stores!
column10: These are so yum, But be careful not to waste money, because Target Sells these for just a dollar per Box, yes a DOLLAR, usually in the dollar/discount section , so Check that out!
Sour cold yummy ness buy more than one box cause they'll go in a day adults and kids love them in our house? A bit expensive though!

My family likes sour items, so be forewarned it is definitely sour but the flavors are so very good! I have had other otter pops and as you suck on them the flavor gets sucked out and you are left with an unflavored chunk of ice but these are definitely not like that. Great product and the only way I can find them is here on Amazon because I am to isolated to find them in stores.

i just recently started buying this item because i myself like sour things and these are just right not to sour but not to sweet my 6 yr old grandson and my 30 yr old son love them to.i really reccomend them for anyone as a good and different frozen treat.i just hope i can buy them all year not just in the summer!im addicted and i love it.

As another reviewer stated, these are available at Dollar Tree for $1 a box of 20.If you eat more than 3 or 4 of these, the top of your mouth will become quite sore and raw.They do taste good if you like sour things.

When we ran out of Frank's RedHot wing sauce my boyfriend purchased this to replace it because it was cheaper and we figured it would probably taste similar. It is disgusting. We closed the bottle back up and shook it to make sure that the flavors hadn't settled, and we even checked the expiration date to make sure that it hadn't gone bad -- that's how gross it tastes. It is not spicy, instead it tastes sweet and a little "chemically". We threw it away immediately. Don't waste your money!
This syrup is a great diet staple.  I mix it with plain yogurt for a great treat to help with sweet cravings.

Much to my surprise, this coffee is excellent. I say it that way because years ago I had a mail order subscription for Gevalia coffee and the product was entirely unsatisfactory at that time. Something has changed. I only tried this because there was a very good incentive at my local supermarket, and I'm glad I did.The package says this blend is new, and that it is 100% Arabica. I am brewing it in an automatic drip machine that strangely enough is also from Gevalia (via our local Good Will store). I find the taste rich, dense, chocolatey and smooth.For some reason very good coffees are roasted and marketed in several European countries - well, at least to MY taste they are very good.A word of warning: There is also a House Blend decaf, and the two are hard to distinguish if one is not careful, because the word "decaf" is in a very small green box, easily missed. (Voice of experience!)

When I began to write this review, two things came to mind. 1) Sweden is not a country you normally associate with coffee, 2) Coffee is generally hard to score because taste is subjective.Furthermore, Sweden is not a coffee grower so Gevalia is going to be a company like Starbucks who buys, roasts, blends and packages their coffee. Old Victor Theodore Engwall might have started this company in 1853 but it has been owned by Kraft since 1971 and I just hope that Kraft is not going to do the same as GM did to Saab or Ford to Volvo.  Lastly, this is a house blend (100% Arabica), something I usually avoid because it's just someone's mixture of a few different kinds of coffee; if I'm going to drink blended coffee, I would prefer to blend my own. But I got this as a gift so I decided to write a review anyway.Anyhoo... this is a surprisingly good coffee. The pouch lists this medium/dark roast, 3 out of 4 beans on their scale, but it's very light to me, and I'm using a little bit more coffee than it suggests. But I like it, I also used it to make a latte and it's rich and creamy. I wouldn't say this was bitter at all.Overall, I'd say this is a pretty light flavorful coffee. Good quality, not burnt, not bitter.  This is definitely a coffee I would buy and drink in rotation with my other coffees. Gevalia has a good reputation in Scandinavia and thereabouts and I'm glad that Kraft hasn't screwed it up.

I am not a coffee snob, and not very up on the various types of coffee's out there, but I certainly know when something tastes like burnt crap! I recently got a breville coffee maker that came with an assortment of cups. Most of the coffee that came with it were OK, but this Italian Roast stuff was horrible! I took one sip and dumped it. I'm sure there are people who like this taste, but not me. personal preference I guess. If I could give a 0 I would.

Dutch cooking requires the usage of bay leaves in many of our dishes.  I have customized some of these dishes for shorter cooking times.  So, putting in ground bay leaves is just the ticket, except I can't find any in town.  This bottle arrived on time, was huge and the potency was premium.  Thank you so much for this wonderful product!

My husband got me into drinking diet sodas.  I didn't like them at first, because they do not taste like regular soda.  Diet Dr. Pepper is the exception.  It doesn't taste like diet soda.  In fact, I can't tell the difference between diet and regular Dr. Pepper.  If you want to drink diet soda but can't stand the taste, try Diet Dr. Pepper.
A very tasty little cake. The cake was surprisingly moist, and the caramel rum sauce was very sweet but not too overpowering. We'll definitely be buying this product again.
The cake was a little smaller than I thought, but it was delicious.  My husband and I enjoyed it so much, we are ordering more for Christmas!

I bought three cases of this stuff. It is all going back. Unfortunately, I did not notice the tiny TRUVIA label on the picture of the can when I bought this from Amazon. When I got this stuff and saw the label, I did several hours of internet research and found the following: This sweetener is NOT from stevia.  Natural stevia sweetener is a mixture of extracts of steviosides and rebaudioside-A from the leaves of several varieties of stevia plants and has been used and studied worldwide for decades and is classified "generally regarded as safe" by the FDA though some may not care for the taste.Truvia on the other hand is a Coca-Cola/Cargill partnership brand name for FAKE stevia sweetener; a mixture of .9% rebiana (not even an ingredient of steviana) and 99.1% erythritol sweetener derived from corn plants grown by Cargill, who have admitted that 30% of their corn is Genetically Modified. Regardless of the fact that the FDA is allowing this on the market, like many products these days this substance has not been properly tested and reviewed for negative or dangerous side effects of which many have already been reported by consumers of it. If you are smart you will not buy this, and if you already have... I suggest you GET RID OF IT in any manner besides drinking it. It may well be dangerous to your health!I will also be contacting Blue Sky Natural Beverage company about this unnatural ingredient in their "100% natural, no calorie, no artificial sweetener" sodas. Since my main goal in trying this soda with was to get away from genetically modified foods such as high fructose corn syrup and aspartame, I now do not trust Blue Sky enough to even try their regular sodas which they claim are made with "real" sugar, since nowadays that usually means a percentage of cane sugar mixed with sugar from genetically modified sugar beets. It is infuriating that companies like this can lie through their teeth to sell a phony product with no regard for the buyer and face no legal consequences.

Once a diet coke drinker, but then moved to a natural alternative, and have tried most brands. This one has less aftertaste than Zevia, at least the cola flavor. Its overall really good, I only wish it had caffeine like Zevia for that additional pick me up. Good Stuff, cheaper than Whole Foods if you subscribe.
Blue Sky Free Cola is the best tasting diet cola I have had.It's sweet and no after taste. :)

column9: Really like the taste, but where's the fizz?
column10: This stevia sweetened, natural soda has a really great crisp, clean flavor and is very refreshing because it's not too sweet.  But it loses fizz way too quickly.  If you leave it in the opened can longer than about an hour, it goes competely flat.  It also loses fizz quickly when poured warm over ice.  Please fix the fizz issue, Blue Sky, and we'll buy more.

I didn't buy this from Amazon, but I did buy a six pack of it, put it in the fridge, and have a cold can today - and let me just say it's wonderful. Its sweet like "the original red can" we all compare cola to, but not heavy or overly syrupy. It has a great cola taste, and no aftertaste that I can detect. I like it a lot and will be buying it again. Its nice to have a "naturally" sweetened cola that won't add to my waist line - a nice, smooth, light, sweet treat.

I've always disliked the regular diet colas because of the aspartame taste they have.  Now with Coke Zero, and Blue Sky Free, we can drink zero cal colas that actually taste good.  If you want caffeine, try Coke Zero, if you don't, this cola is great.  As others have said, not too syrupy, not too sweet, no bad aftertaste.  Oh, and guys, can the religious artificial sweetener wars.  Everything has pros and cons, even, and especially, sugar.

I really like this soda.  My younger sister likes it too.  She was a "coke-aholic" before she joined me as a type II diabetic.  We now watch our carbs intake.  Natural ingredients and great taste - perfect!

I read the reviews and ordered...skeptically. Could it really be that good?  I have Stevia in my coffee 6 days of the week and treat myself to sugar on Sundays.  Could I again enjoy a cola, that tastes like a real cola?  YES....PEOPLE...YOU CAN!  I am addicted to these and just ordered the cherry cream!  Zero calories and yummy.  SOLD.

I've been waiting for an all natural, zero calorie soda and am so happy I've found this line of products!  I actually do prefer the taste of Blue Sky's Free line of sodas over Zevia.  Although, I do wish that Blue Sky Free Cola had the caffeine.  Definitely going to subscribe for monthly deliveries =)

column9: Next best thing to real coca cola...
column10: I love coca cola, but started eating the low carb way earlier this year.. I haven't had a real coke in over 6 months. Out of all the things I gave up, coke has been the hardest.. I just discovered the Blue Sky pop and it is DELICIOUS.. I use stevia for all my sweetening needs, so I was so glad to find this pop sweetened with stevia/truvia... I signed up for the subscription price. It's about time pop manufacturers started using stevia! I've been waiting for a loooong time.

Blue Sky Free cola has about the same ingredients and taste as Zevia and we buy either one of them depending on the price. The current price of Blue Sky on amazon.com is too high compared with to the prices of both Zevia and Blue Sky at our local stores.

column9: Maybe it is just me but I can't drink this stuff
column10: I am a Diet Coke girl and have been sick and house bound for a while and ordered this because it was hard for me to get to the store and I needed a diet cola fix. Did not get it with this! column10: I'm reviewing this based on the taste difference between Blue Sky Free and Zevia. I like this much better and would choose it again. There is no bitter stevia taste. column10: Which isn't wholly positive for me, because I've never been the biggest fan of Blue Sky sodas. "So why did you buy this product," you may ask. My answer: 1. It's mega-cheap compared to a case of Zevia. 2. I was curious about how Stevia would change the Blue Sky flavor.  The answer to that question is "not much," which is a good thing for Blue Sky fans.  I like Zevia better, but this is quite drinkable, especially when it's ice-cold.

column9: Yummy food for my two dogs
column10: Always order Purina One for my two dogs. On subscription to get those canned food monthly as the delivery was on time and very good packing. Strongly recommendation to have someone to subscribe the amazon.com to deliver you the dog canned food every month for those who do not have a car or any mode of transportation.

column4: Lady Who Longs to be South of the Border
column10: This coffee has a smooth, carmely, dark finish that I love! My husband gets other dark blends that taste like charcoal to me. This one is very smooth, with just a hint of sweetness. I wish that Amazon had it on its monthly purchase program, would love to save 15% on it! However, I was glad to find it someplace besides Green Mountain. As prime members, we can get our coffee replaced in 2 shipping days v. a week or longer over at GM. Sweet!

This is the fifth different type of coffee I've tried with my Keurig coffee maker. Right now, it is tied with a Newman's Own k-cup as my favorite. A couple k-cup products seemed fine when I first tasted them, but have come to pale somewhat in comparison with other flavors and makes.This is a really smooooooooooooooooooth tasting coffee. It does not have a strong taste, but goes down very easily. There is a richness to the taste as well.Bottom line? I will be purchasing this again when my supply runs out as I continue experimenting with different flavor k-cups.
Great coffee.  Rich, robust.  A coffee-lovers choice.  If you like French roast or Italian roast, you will like this coffee.

I am a coffee snob. Yes, I admit it. I prefer fresh roasted Kenyan coffee, but also like Sumatran, Jamacan, Guatamalan, even Etheopian. I generally say that I don't drink Columbian. Most K-Cups are weak and less than stellar, though I have found several I enjoy. I was surprised by Caribou's Mahogany! It is excellent. Strong enough with an earthy, winey taste and smoothe finish (my description).  I eagerly tried their Daybreak, to my disappointment. Just ordinary. I don't often write reviews, but if this can get someone else to enjoy Mahogany it is well worth the time. If you have similar taste in coffee give it a try!! (and no, I don't work for them.)
I love this coffee. Very dark but not at all bitter. I finally found one I like as much as Jet Fuel.
My husband loves strong Caribou coffee but I like the milder one or "breakfasttype. I will drink this but Caribou of all kinds is a great coffee,no matterhow strong. It will not disappoint.

column9: The Best Coffee for Depression and Lifting up Your Mood
column10: This morning, for the first time in my life, I tried Mahogani Caribou Coffee only because I had run out of my usual type of coffee, which I would usually brew and drink. In short, I should not even categorize Mahogany Caribou as coffee!!!! You know why? It has far more anti-depressant and uplifting effect on me than I had previously anticipated. From now on, I will only drink Mahogany Caribou.

column9: Most Cozy flavor I have tried.
column10: You can taste the wood in the respect it taste like the coffee was roasted over wood.  It is VERY smooth, I detect no bitterness or over roasting.  Nice flavor.  My newest favorite amoung the k-cup line.  My old favorite was Donut Shop but not any more.  I am not as pleased with the other Caribou flavors but this one really surprised me.

Most Caribou coffees are too weak for me. This one is a delicious exception. It's right up there with Revv, Emeril's bold, or Van Houtte's eclipse. A Dark bold coffee without tasting burned or bitter.
Caribou's Mahogany is my favorite k-cup coffee.  It's got a great, rich taste.  It's dark, but not bitter.
It has a nice strong flavor with no bitterness.How strong is it? I would say it is similar in strength to auto-drip using 1 rounded tablespoon of coffee per 8oz of water.

I've been drinking Green Mountain's Dark Magic and really enjoyed it, however I wanted a change.  After some searching I discovered this coffee and am glad I did.  It's got an excellent deep flavor that I really enjoy.  Strong enough - yet not overpowering.  I recommend you give it a try.

I agree with the other positive reviews I see here.  Nice flavor, strong-ish, no bitter, grind-y or conference coffee flavors to mess it up.For reference purposes my in store drink is a Starbucks Americano.My favorite k-cups are:Starbucks French RoastStarbucks Caffe VeronaStarbucks Pike Place RoastGreen Mountain Xtra Bold Sumatran ReserveGreen Mountain Double Black DiamondGreen Mountain RevvGreen Mountain Dark MagicOther k-cups I've tried:  Coffee People Jet Fuel ,Green Mountain Dark Magic Decaf, Emeril Jazzed up Decaf, Starbucks Caffe Verona, Coffee People Black Tiger,  Starbucks House Blend, Starbucks Breakfast Blend, Starbucks Sumatra, Wolfgang Puck French Roast, Green Mountain Lake and Lodge, Green Mountain French Roast, Caribou Mahogony, Wolfgang Puck Sumatra Kopi Raya, Emeril Big Easy Bold
This coffee has a good flavor and a good strength.  At first it seemed strong but then I got use to it.  I recommend this flavor coffee. Good wake up in the morning.

Very nice, smooth cup of coffee.  Caribou Coffee has been a favorite of mine since the first time I visited Minnesota and had the opportunity to go to a store and have coffee.  I have since done mail order for their coffee and after purchasing a Keurig coffee machine was happy to see it was available in K-cups.  I also enjoy the Caribou Blend but I have to say this blend has a little more "kick" to it but still a smooth coffee with no after taste.

I hadn't tried Caribou brand K-cups before and am extremely picky.  I like a rich, intense, well-bodied coffee and this product delivered.  Strong but no bitter taste, when brewed with 6 oz. water.  I would recommend this product to anyone with similar tastes and will definitely buy it again.

column9: Like it but hard to find
column10: This is one of my favorites.  It's smooth and rich and not too strong for morning but also bold enough that if I like a cup in the afternoon it will do for that too.  My only problem is that I can never find it locally - I almost always have to get it online which is usually more expensive.  I've tried the Obsidian as a substitute and I don't like that one quite as much as the Mahogany.

This is probably my favorite k-cup so far. I'm no professional taster so talk of flavor notes in coffee or elsewhere usually leaves me scratching my head and thinking, "if you say so...". But at my first sip of this dark, smooth coffee, I though chocolate. It's not flavored or sweet but, for me, it has a "note" of good, dark chocolate. Highly recommended if you like your coffee strong and full of flavor.
Very Smooth Rich flavor even on the largest setting, dark blend a very satisfying cup of coffee. I will recommend this to my friends.  This product arrived on time well packaged.

Obviously taste is an opinion but in my humble opinion this is the best coffee out there for Keurig and I have tried a billion. I love dark roast but Starbucks' French roast, Sumatra, and others I can't remember off hand seem to taste stale to me or not as bold. Can't stand any of Caribou's other dark roasts, such as Obsidian which you can get at Target sometimes. All in all, I am hoping this one sticks around, Ange's personal fav.
Smooth. Full of flavor. Not bitter. No nasty aftertaste. People that like Newmans extra bold, Starbucks Verona and Sumatra, Tullys French Roast and other dark cup should love this.  It's better!

column9: Smooth and tasty and an absolute dream come true for those who enjoy bold dark roasts...
column10: Although I've only been able to try three of Caribou's k cup blends (Mahogany as well as Caribou Coffee, Caribou Blend, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-Count and Caribou Coffee, Daybreak Morning Blend, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-Count), I've found that Caribou consistently produces the highest quality k cups.  They are head and shoulders above their competitors like Green Mountain and Van Houtte.I should mention that Caribou's Daybreak blend is far and away my favorite k cup flavor of the 20 or so I've been able to sample so far.  But I enjoy a flavorful medium roast.  My boyfriend, on the other hand, prefers an extra bold dark roast.  After our favorable experience with the Caribou brand before, we picked up a box of this coffee and hoped that it would be a great choice for a dark blend.Let me just say that Mahogany is full of smokey delicious flavor.  It's quite strong and dark, but there is no rancid bitterness or acidity that accompanies a lot of the dark roasts.  This coffee packs a powerful punch.  Although that isn't normally my thing, I can enjoy a cup of this with milk and a bit of sweetener.  My boyfriend adores it, though, and it has become a staple blend for him.  I will still drink this on occasion, but it's a bit too potent for me.I think this is the best dark roast I've had the chance to try.

column9: Not like fresh but gettin better!
column10: Nice bold taste but with a little "packaged" overtone.  Like other K-cup products this is just a shade below fresh.

Got this in a k cup sampler, the best k cup so far.  If you like good strong coffee with a lot of flavor, slight hint of cocoa, this is it.  No bitter after taste.  This one goes on top of my reorder list, perfect for the K Cup System.  The one reviewer on this post that gave it one star has no taste buds.

my wife and I are avid Keurig coffee fans (with three brewers between the two of us). We started out ordering all the flavored pods and soon learned than are likes were back to the basics ..... we each have a couple of "full" strength and then go to the "de-caf" for that last cup.Mahogany is my choice for the full blend.  It's smooth ....has an excellent taste and aroma.We are totally satisfied with this order .....

column9: Coffee is good; name is good....
column10: The name of this coffee is Mahogany, in my mind a deep rich brown. The coffee flavor is deep and rich, and the color is dark brown. It is delicious.

Carabou Mahogony is the worst tasting cup of coffee I have ever had, and I've been drinking coffee for over 4 decades. It tastes just like a piece of burnt toast. The only way I can make it palatable is to put it over ice, add lots of vanilla sugar syrup and milk. I've got to find some way to justify the purchase and icing it seems to help.
I ordered the Mahogany Caribou Coffee K-Cups and adore them.  I recommend this product if you like bold coffe with a smooth taste.
This is a serious cup of joe. Yummyness!I have turned at least 3 friends onto this coffee.Robust and aeromatic
this is maybe the greatest coffee ever made.  i have had this many time before in regular bean that i grind myself,  but never in k-cups.  Tastes the exact same and its maybe my favorite coffee ever
I like the taste of this coffee. Tried the other brands but got stuck on this one, I also like the ECO friendliness of the company.
This is the best Caribou kcup if you like a dark, hearty roast with good flavor and little acidity.  Will definitely buy again.

I have been drinking Tully's Kona for the past 2 years, but with the price increase of kona, I needed to find something less expensive. After trying numerous kcups, this Mahogany is just as good as the Kona, with a full coffee flavor, and a hint of caramel. I am happily converted.

I enjoyed this because of the full taste I get out of it without it being too bold or having a burnt taste.  To me it is a bit above the medium blend.  I do take creamer with my coffee so the boldness may be tamed down. I will definitely order more of this when I'm am out.
I could get very used to this!  This is a nice, strong, robust coffee without bitterness.  The K-Cups are so convenient and make no mess.
I really enjoy this coffee - I have used a variety of the K-cups and this is one of the best.
Strong smooth velvety flavor.  Mahogany describes the color and the mood you get when drinking. Absolutely the best. I've found my favorite.

Of all the coffees I've tried -- and I've tried A BUNCH -- this is hands-down my favorite.  Great bold taste but no bitter aftertaste.  I drink coffee all day, and I like it strong and fresh.  It can be difficult to find a stronger tasting coffee that's really great without cream or sugar, I drink my coffee black.  I've not yet found anything I like better.  Yum...

column9: Nice smooth flavor - but not strong enough for me
column10: Too mild for me... I like a strong flavor. My wife likes this coffee. Has enough flavor and boldness to keep it enjoyable and not feeling like water downed coffee. If you like strong, bold coffee, you will be disappointed. For a mild coffee, I found this good, but not good enough to warrant the higher cost over many of the other brands.I will not be re-ordering Caribou Mahogany. My wife prefers Donut Shop brand over this. Again, not strong enough for me, but still makes a good cup of coffee.

If you're a fan of full-bodied coffees, give this one a shot.For my taste, the vast majority of k-cups are too watery and weak (even on the small cup setting), so I gravitate towards the extra-bold varieties.  I had previously been enjoying Newman's Own Extra Bold and GM Dark Magic.  After reading some favorable comparisons between those and Mahogany, I decided to give it a chance.I find that it's slightly less bitter (not that bitter is bad) than Newman's EB or Dark Magic, and a little smoother.  I also think it's more full bodied without any burned bean flavor.  I've tried the Mahogany on the larger cup setting and actually still liked it -- something I've never said before.

I've sampled many different k-cup coffe types. I prefer a really robust coffee and Carbou mahogany really dosn't provide that. I would cassify it as medium roast coffee with a smooth melow taste. If that is what u are after , then give this blend a try.

column9: Excellent presence, not too smokey, smooth finish.
column10: No bitterness.  A strong, full-bodied, cup but does not taste like ashes.  Smooth, very drinkable.  If you like bold, dark coffee, this will please.
In my office, and for me personally, this is the smoothest and best tasting coffee you can buy for your Keurig machine. Great price too!

I have tried about every k cup brand....Caribou Mohogany is my all time go-to brand.  Flavorful yet not strong and no jitters.  You get the same great flavor whether you make a small cup or a large one.
If you like a bold cup of good coffee...and have a Keurig single up brewer, this is the flavor to buy!  Never dissappointing with Carbou Mahogany!

i have this strong flavorful mahogany coffee by caribou in my Keurig.  I love the taste.  I do like strong coffee and this seems to be the right blend of strong to medium.  I use a vanilla diet supplement in the coffee every morning with a splash of torani sugar free syrup and there is breakfast on the move.Caribou Coffee, Mahogany, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-Count
We love this coffee. It is the best K cup we've found. We like strong coffee and struggled at first to find one that we enjoyed. The prices on Amazon can't be beat and the shipping super fast.

column9: A bit too strong for me
column10: My husband enjoyed this coffee. We usually use Newman's Extra Bold but thought wewould try something different. It was a bit too strong for me; I prefer Newman's. But it wasstill good.
This coffee is inoffensive, but not strong enough for my tastes.  I do use cream, and I'm sure that makes a difference.

I like strong coffee, but I don't want it to taste burnt or have an acidic after taste. Caribou Coffee's Mahogany is full bodied with a nice balance of dark notes and acidity.  It's one of my "go to" coffees when my favorites like Coffee People's Wake Up Call are out of stock.
I like my coffee strong. This is the first brand that I have tasted that provides the kick I need without the bitterness. I keep my pantry stocked with Mahogony and I do not share!
love to order my coffee on amazon.  easy and shows up quickly.This k cup is great coffee.  dcaf is very good as well
One of the richer coffee for k cups! We typically grind our own even for the Keurig but the Mahagoney from Caribou is a great alternative. Order was shipped very quickly.  Will definitely buy again.

column9: Lives up to its appealing name
column10: This is my favorite K-cup coffee (I've tried about twenty different types) and, so far, everyone I've served it to really likes it a lot. Even the pickiest coffee connoisseur I know thought this k-cup made an excellent cup of coffee. Two non-coffee drinking friends wish they liked coffee because they love the sound of Caribou Mahogany.
This is a great coffee.  Its dark but not bitter, a little chocolaty, and it reminds me of an Adirondack lodge.  I can get them for a better price in a Caribou Coffee store, however.

I've tried quite a few coffees and many end up tasting the same. However, this and the Italian Blend by Timothy's are two that are very good black or with cream/sugar. If you're looking for a simple coffee without all the flavors, this is the one for you.
I've tried over a dozen varieties of K-Cups and this is, by far, my favorite!  It's strong but not bitter and just has a great flavor.  This will be my choice from now on.

Without beating it to death - If you like a full bodied, but mellow brew this might be for you.  It is hearty, but not at all bitter.  It holds a nice full body, even when the Keurig is set to the oversize setting.  It's now my favorite blend.
I go for the bold varieties of coffee and this Mahogany is not only bold but very smooth.  My all time favorite!

So Far this is the only K-cup I've found thats tastes great with a normal brew!  It's not watered down like the regular stuff, and dosen't taste burnt like the bold stuff. They only K-cup i'm buying from now on!

We've tried every coffee brand available for the Keurig, and this one is, by far, the best.  It's extraordinarily smooth and rich - the closest to Starbucks, if that's your thing.  I add to it a healthy splash of Bolthouse coffee/mocha - very good.
The Mahogany has a smooth full bodied character.  I highly recommend this coffee to drinkers looking for a bold but not overpowering taste!
This coffee is not really bold in my opinion - it falls more along medium roast flavor. It's a decent, smooth coffee, but I didn't think really bold. Like all k-cups though seriously overpriced!
If you like strong coffee, as I do this coffee is over rated. I found it weak, with a sickening after  taste.

This coffee is very full bodied, and has a great aroma; however, it is the only K-Cup coffee I've had that has a bitter aftertaste. I would still drink it if someone offered me a cup, but I won't buy it again.
This was sold out at Cafe Express site.  Thrilled toFind it here. Quick delivery and great service!  Happy to know that I can find it here.

My favorite blend of my favorite coffee.  Used to have to smuggle a few pounds of the stuff back in my suitcase everytime I went out to the midwest! Now I can get in k-cups.  Yay! Good price on amazon, but super saver shipping takes forever! Fedexing it to the post office makes no sense.  just fedex it to me and shave 2 days off the wait already!
This coffee is very smooth but rather flat compared to Starbuck's brews.  It doesn't have any bite to it.If you like a mild coffee, you will enjoy this one.

Honestly, I'm not sure why so many folks like this coffee in their reviews.  It's a little weak but mostly just doesn't have a rich flavor.  It is really missing something.  I drink coffee black.  Maybe it tastes better with cream and sugar?  Before buying this coffee, I had been drinking Starbuck's French Roast and Folger's Black Silk, both of which taste SO MUCH better than this coffee.
this is really good ginger. Has some tumerick in it, so wear gloves when chopping it up or your hands will get yellow. I love making spicy salads with it, or indian dishes.

column9: so this is what oolong tea is suppost to taste like
column10: If you want the best Oolong tea that comes in a bottle buy this!!Once you have drank this tea you will know what real quality is.Great taste and flavor.  This is what teas are all about.BUY THIS TEA.

I like the convenience of these bottles of tea, but the odor of Oolong is so strong it started coming out of my pores.  It is cool and refreshing tea in easy to hold bottles, but I stopped buying Oolong and went back to black.

I've been looking for a good low calorie tea as I've been trying to drink less soda. I thought I'd try to find something a little different on Amazon and came across Anteadote. I read the reviews on Oolong, which were generally positive, and gave it a shot. After trying it, all I can say is "Eh," as in it was okay. I drink a fair amount of unsweetened tea and I will say that Anteadote Oolong does have a slightly off taste. Not bad, just off. All in all, it wasn't horrible but probably won't order again. Still looking for something a little better tasting.

I like the fact that this tea is organic, but compared to the taste of Ito-en's Oolong shots (which are not organic, unfortunately), the Anteadote teas lack a freshness and purity that the Ito-en has. Too bad. I'd like to have organic + great tasting tea with no sugar. Will keep looking.

This is the first product that has compelled me to leave a review.  It is a really tasty, smooth oolong tea that is organic and affordable!  It is great to have around when I need a pick up or to throw a few in my bag on my way to work.  It is probably the best bottled oolong teas I have had - I like Ito-En but I think this is smoother.

I never thought I'd go thru a pound of stevia, but here I am, just ordered my second pound, after taking about 2 years to go thru the first. I love having such a bounty of good quality stevia available, and it is sooooo much cheaper than any other way I've found to buy it. I put some in baggies for friends to try out to see if they like stevia - it's so cheap, it's no great expense if they don't like it.This stevia is great quality, unlike some of the "green"-ish cheaper stevia. Also know that this is the uncut pure stevia - oftentimes companies will mix in some maltodextrose or other mixer to make it less strong and more comparable to sugar in volume. Because stevia is VERY strong - serving size is 1/32 teaspoon, which equals one teaspoon of sugar. On the Now container, they say that it contains 16,214 servings - that cracks me up.I used to buy it at Whole Foods in bulk at $150/pound, and I'd just take the smallest little amount. Then they discountinued selling it bulk because it was so expensive that when moisture got in and ruined it, it was just too expensive for them. So I asked my Whole Foods buddy who the supplier was of their bulk stevia, and he told me it was Now.I use stevia in my tea, my kefir, and in some recipes as a sugar replacement. Often I'll cut the sugar by 1/4 and add in a small amount of stevia. If it is all stevia, it doesn't always taste that great, but when it is blended, one can hardly tell.I also use lakanto, which is better for baking. But unlike stevia, it is not inexpensive. The only place I know to buy it is thru Body Ecology (which is my preferred eating system BTW)[...]

I am very happy with this product.  The 1 lb container will likely last for years because it takes so little to sweeten my food.  Both my husband and I use this in place of sugar in everything that doesn't require sugar for structure, (like some baked goods).  At first we felt that the sweetness was a little different than sugar but after 2 weeks, we cannot really tell the difference and find on fruit, like berries, it is enhances the fruit flavor in addition to adding a little sweetness, making it better than sugar.  We even had some watermelon that didn't have much flavor or sweetness and once I cut it up and sprinkled a pinch of stevia on it, it tasted like good watermelon.

I have been using KAL stevia powder for some time now, but thought I would try a lesser expensive brand. I have used NOW products, and had good experiences with them, and due to the reviews, I decided to give this a try. What a disappointment.Serving sizes and # of servings is exactly the same, weight for weight. However, I have to use 2 to 4 times the amount of NOW in order to get anywhere near the sweetness of KAL. So, I didn't save any money, and it is evidently not the same grade as the KAL. It has a larger particle, which may be one of the factors in the amount needed. The KAL is a very fine powder. Back to the KAL as soon as I can afford to buy more. This is too much money to waste, and non-returnable, so compare before you buy.

I had been using two packets of Wholesome Organic Stevia percup of coffee and liked the taste but not the cost.  So Itried the NOW Better Stevia organic powder. It did have a bitteraftertaste if I used too much of it, but if I use just a tiny amount-- around 1/8 t., maybe less -- per cup of coffee, my tongue registersthe sweetness while the bitterness is barely there. Obviously,one pound of the NOW Stevia is going to last a long, long time!However, it would be better if it had no bitterness at all, soI gave it only 4 stars.

All the store brand Stevia is 85% FILLER. This is pure Stevia and will last a LONG time. About 1 Teaspoon equals 1 Cup of sugar.  About the "after-taste"? Atfer making a Gallon of Cherry KoolAid with it (using 2 full teaspoons of Stevia) I can taste NO Aftertaste! Maybe NOW Foods earlier stevia had an after tatse, but this "Better Stevia" to me is very smooth. So why should you buy this version of Stevia: the price you get on this this pure Stevia, plus it beats FILLER ADDED store brand Stevia! My only beef is the new container thye use is so big that it's only half filled, why not sell me 2 LBS in this jar? I'd buy it.

To be sure, this is STILL Stevia. However, this is VERY palatable.  There's still a hint of the Stevia taste, but it doesn't overpower whatever it sweetens and the best part is that it does NOT HAVE THAT HORRIBLE, LINGERING AFTERTASTE!!!!! That's really the best part of it in my opinion.  It's palatable.  For all the health benefits touted about Stevia, this is the first product version of it I had that I can actually live with.  Too bad it costs a fortune (albeit cheaper here than retail stores!)

This stevia is a highly concentrated white powder that requires very little to sweeten my ice tea.  I once used sugar, then switched to my wife's artificial sweetener, however upon reading about stevia, I decided to try it.  I went through a number of brands and packages, most of which were pretty good, but then I found this.  This has the best flavor of all the different stevia formulations I have tried.  If you use the right amount, it is very hard to tell the difference in taste from actual sugar.  I drink from a very large insulated tea container (28 oz.) and with this stevia, it takes less than 1/4 teaspoon to sweeten my tea.  That means that a little 4 oz bottle of this powder lasts months (it is even more economical in the 1 lb jar).  Now Foods has hit a home run with this product.  By the way, they make several stevia products.  Just make sure you get the one labeled "Better Stevia", because it truly lives up to its label.

With over 10,000 servings, this container will last quite a while. The flavor is superb compared to many other stevia products. There is no aftertaste. The great thing about this stevia, you dont need to use very much. Other brands are not pure and are usually cut with other ingredients. This is certified organic and pure. Great buy!

This is a very inexpensive way to buy straight stevia.  It does take some getting used to since it is so much sweeter than sugar.  For baking I usually mix it with a small amount of honey and my recipes have turned out great.

I've used stevia for close to 20 years now. I put it in tea, coffee, on fruit salad and in baking. Some people claim that stevia has a bitter aftertaste, and some brands can have that problem, but not this one.This stevia is finely ground and exceptionally pure. The label states, under Supplement Facts:Stevia Extract Powder (leaf) (stevia rebaudiana, min. 80% glucosylsteviosides). Other ingredients: None. Stevia Extract is hypoallergenic and contains no sugar, salt, starch, yeast, wheat, gluten, corn, soy, milk, egg or preservatives.Some people claim that stevia is 200 times sweeter than table sugar. In my experience, it is about 8 times as sweet. If you have never used it before, I wouldn't start with a 1 lb. container. I'd start small, such as the one-ounce size.As for baking with stevia, for puddings and pies, you could probably get away with using it as your only sweetener. But for cakes, cookies and muffins, it won't give you the same texture as sugar and doesn't work for that except as a supplement to other natural sweeteners such as coconut palm sugar.
I love this Stevia. It is sweeter than the previous stevia product I purchased at a local health food store.

After buying other Stevia products I have finally found one that is just Stevia. You use a very small amount of this to sweeten your drinks or anything that has liquid to spread the sweetness. Haven't tried it for baking but so far in drinks soups or sauces it works well just don't add very much a little bit goes a very long way.

I had been using Now Stevia packets for ages, when it occurred to me to try to find the same product without the added ingredients like maltodextrin. THIS IS IT!!! Not only does it taste better, but less goes a LOT LONGER WAY!!!! I LOVE IT!!! I have tried several stevia brands over the years, and in my opinion, Now brand tastes the best by far!! Now that I have this pure version I am ever so happy!!! I even use it in foods that I previously didn't like to use stevia in, it's THAT good!! Well worth the money!!
Great product, I use this to bake with cook deserts, in coffee and tea and on frest fruit, i like it as much as i did sugar.

Have to agree with bella voce. I've been using the KAL Stevia very happily for a couple of years. Saw this and did the math, and instead of 6 dollars (approximately) per ounce for the KAL, this worked out to a little more 3 dollars per ounce. Sounded good.Well, using the same small spoon that comes with the KAL Stevia (one of those nicely sweetens a good sized Cafe Americano or double shot of espresso), this Now brand Stevia was NOWHERE near as sweet. Had to use 2.5-3 times as much to get the same flavor. Also, and this is subjective, the flavor of the KAL tastes better to me.Still, it's Stevia, and not sugar or one of the artificial sweeteners, so it's got that going for it. But if you're looking at this as a bargain compared to the KAL, it's not: You get what you pay for.

This is my second pound jar of stevia. We love it for everything except baking and it takes such a small amount to get just the right sweetness. My husband likes to take a zero calory drink for his lunch and just a half teaspoon of this product replaces a cup of sugar to sweeten a package of Kool Ade. This was a quickly shipped item and is concentrated 100% stevia extract powder.
This big bottle of sweetness is a much better deal than packets or droppers. I liked the taste of Erba Dolce brand a bit better but when it comes to the price this product is definitely acceptable.
My dog just loved these treats, she hasn't been this excited about a treat since she was a puppy. Chubby Chews are great!
Caused a fight over who was getting what lol. Perfect gift and have told many others to check out this box and the others they have available. Very quick delivery

This pasta was heavenly!  I boiled it as directed and then added the cooked pasta with 2 cups of sour cream, 2 cups of asiago, 1 cup of parmesan, and a cup and a half of the boiled pasta water.  I baked it in the oven at 350 for about 30 minutes.  It was absolutely divine.This pasta is great and I will order it again.  The company has a special promotion of free shipping with a $50 order--not sure how long the promotion lasts but I suggest that you take advantage of it.  I can't wait to try the other pastas I ordered.
Images for this item displayed a much coarser salt than that which I received. It's not the end of the worldbut a picture is worth 1000 words and I'd much rather get what I see.
This salt is fabulous.  Adds a level of flavor like nothing else.Great seller with a wonderful customer service.Highly recommend.  I'll buy again and again.
I make bath teas and I am proud to use this salts to provide my clients with the best avaliable and Himalayan salt provides 84 vital nutrients and minerals.  I am very happy with this product
This salt has very good flavor and works very well in our salt grinder that we use on the dinner table. I've been looking for some time for course salt for our grinder and I'm glad that I found this.

I can't believe I found this! My mom used to use this all the time and it was SO good! I thought about it and came on Amazon, and sure enough here it was, I couldn't believe it! As soon as it had arrived, I made it for dinner that same night and it was just as I remembered...AWESOME!  Since the directions on this bag are in bulk, to make a large quantity, I had to research a bit to find the correct amount to use for home use. I hope this helps you!1 Envelope (the way it used to be sold) = 2 Tbsp + 2 tsp.Here are the directions that used to be on the old boxes, since it will not be on this large bag.In medium saucepan, combine 1 envelope, 1 Tbsp Oil, desired tomatoes & water (see below). Bring to a boil, then simmer stirring frequently. Makes 1 pint of sauce (Four-1/2 cup servings)1 can (15oz) tomato puree & 3/4 cup waterOR2 cups crushed tomatoes (16oz) & 1/2 cup waterOR1 can (6 oz) tomato paste & 1 1/2 cups waterI hope I have helped! ENJOY!!!
Been looking for Spatini for a long time. Use to be able to get it out east but it got sold and was gone. My friends and I are so happy we can find it again. It's so yummy.

I am thrilled that I was able to find it again...brings back so many wonderful memories....this also has helped me with my Christmas shopping...I will be giving this to friends who also have not been able to find it, but love it...
love the mixture of spices used in this mix - glad I was able to get this since it is no longer sold in the grocery store

I have looked at every dental bone on the market, and these have the healthiest ingredients in them. They have no gluten or potato starch in them, which I love. My dog is very picky, and he always loves these. I definitely recommend these because I really feel they help to keep plaque from sticking to my dog's teeth. Mercolahealthypets have a bone similar to this one, so I alternate between buying those and these.

I have 3 English Cocker Spaniels all 9 years old. I decided they were getting too old for rawhides (with the help of my veterinarian). I found these at the pet store and the dogs were wild for them. I bought one bag at the store. I went online to Amazon and found them way cheaper. Then I was offered a "subscription" to them where I could save even more money. I chose two packages (the subscription required two packs) once a month. Wasn't enough. I now get two packs twice a month. These are just sensational. Only one problem---dogs get up an hour earlier now to get one!!!!
It is good quality peppermint and makes very good tea.  For thew price you can not beat it.

I've been drinking peppermint tea for about 25 year. In fact my family used to grow and harvest peppermint tea from our own patch. To me, this tea tastes great, and has a good minty kick to it. I'd certainly purchase this again. I use a little mesh tea ball infuser and pack it full regardless of the size cup I use. At this moment I am drinking a 20oz cup and the strength is good. I declare this a phenomenal value!

Excellent value, makes delicious peppermint tea.  I have to use 2 spoons of tea leaves per cup rather than 1 as in the directions, since I do not like weak tea, but smells fresh and minty and has a good flavor.  Huge package, great buy.  It comes in packaging made of paper which does not seem substantial enough, so I put the package inside a ziploc bag to keep it fresher.

This is quite possibly the best peppermint tea we have found.  The surprise was that we ordered it in a hurry and received two pounds rather than two ounces!  Two pounds of tea is an amazingly large amount.  However, we have shared with many friends and would not hesitate to order it again.  Having such a surplus amount allows us to be liberal with the amount used per cup and the taste is wonderful.  We highly recommend it!

column9: You Have to Really Love Peppermint Tea...
column10: ...if you order the 2-pound bag as I did! We got this loose tea to use in our Keurig brewer. The tea is really wonderful -- so aromatic and flavorful. But 2 pounds of tea leaves is a huge amount! Although it is light in weight, the bag it comes in is bigger than a 5-lb. bag of Coffee Bean coffee, also available here from Amazon. We keep this in an air-tight glass canister in the pantry, but there's still so much to use. So, we wonder: will it lose its flavor like the spearmint gum on the bedpost overnight...? ;-)
I am happy with this tea, it is flvorful and fresh. You get your money's worth and I would buy again. It comes  brown bag, not the black  one pictured.

This is very pepperminty, almost spearminty tea - you need very little for a good refreshing kick :) The bag is huge and the price can't be beat. However the leaves are crashed, they are not full tea leaves as advertised. There are also some white flakes here and there - stems or may be flowers? So 4 stars for that.

Upon quick delivery of my big brown aluminized inside bag which had a peppermint strong odor. Once inside this tough bag it was really peppermint  intense. So clean and fresh, Consuming the tea and the leaves is so soothing on the tummy, all fun and refreshing ! My roomy can't stand peppermint ! He's allergic ! But I love it ! Thank You !!

LOVE this tea!!  It's a LOT of tea!  I shared with my daughters and will still have enough for a long time!  It's very very good and very strong peppermint which is what I wanted.  I love the loose tea because I don't have to worry about chemicals in tea bags.  I am so pleased and I am sure you will be too!

2 pounds is a lot of peppermint unless you REALLY love this kind of tea.  other drinkers looking only to sample here may want to keep most of your leaf stored in a Ziploc Vacuum Bags, Gallon, 8-Count(Pack of 3).  I suggest you use this leaf to mix 50/50 with Green or White leaf to help dull any unpleasant leafy taste you may like to avoid with those teas.  this peppermint tea also makes a great addition to popery, though a peppermint oil would probably hold it's smell longer.  Coffee Bean Direct impressed me by shipping 2lbs by weight, not by volume.  the leaf are small 3mm bits, so large hole steepers may not work well - you may need a strainer or paper filter to brew this clean.

column9: Very fragrant tea, well worth the price
column10: I had accidentally ordered this tea for use during the Lemonade Master Cleanse, but gave it away because it was not organic. When my friends and I tried it, the aroma from opening the bag was intensely pepperminty. This tea is more flavorful than Wegman's organic peppermint tea, but that might be because Wegman's teas have been exposed to a lot more air.The minty taste was very strong but not overpowering or bitter, and I think I used about a Tbsp for 10 ounces of hot (not boiling) water. My vegan organic friends stated that it was a very good tea. So if you don't care whether a tea is organic, you can't beat the value.As a non-organic tea, I give it 5 stars.
This tea has excellent flavor.  I enjoy  2-3 cups a day and am very pleased with the quality and price.

I ordered two 2 lb bags of tea. The first one looked like a standard 2 lb bag but I couldn't understand why the shipping carton was so big. Then I removed the peppermint bag and all was revealed: By measurement, the 2 lb peppermint bag was 4-5 times the volume of the other 2 lb bag. In other words, you are going to get a lot of tea for your money. I experimented with amount needed to brew a good tasting batch and I found that I should use the same amount (volume) I would of a heavier tea. Therefore, you are getting 4-5 times the amount of brewed tea for the same price. The tea tastes very good, about four and a half stars. I made it five stars because of the super bargain. The taste is very minty with a subtle bitter tea back taste. I don't use sweetener but this is one tea that might improve with a little.
This is good tea, but be prepared to share it with your neighbors. Two pounds of tea is an awful lot of tea. BTW: My neighbors enjoyed it too.

I found this to be a delicious, subtly chocolate coffee. I added a bit of sweetener and some cream, and thought it was delightful. I'm not usually a flavored coffee drinker, but picked this up because of the Godiva name. I'm put off by very strong flavors, so I found this to be just my taste. If you like mocha lattes from the coffee shop, give this a try. I subtracted one star because it was not as foamy on top as I'm used to from Senseo pods.

Talk about resting on your laurels, the only thing this coffee is good for is adding a nice aromatic accent to the kitchen in the mornings.  It has no real coffee or chocolate taste - just a bland nothingness.  You'd be better off squirting some Hershey's syrup into a cup of Folgers than drinking this bilge water.  Save your money...

I hoped with Godiva's reputation for excellent chocolate, that this coffee would have a rich chocolate taste.  I found it bitter and the chocolate tasted artificial.  For this reason, I'd rather buy Senseo's Vienna flavor next time.

I figured I'd really like the Godiva Chocolate Creme Coffee pods for my Senseo because I like both coffee and chocolate. Having used these over a few weeks, I now feel that the coffee is fairly weak and so is the chocolate aspect. It's definitely drinkable, but won't leave you with a taste you can remember. If you're looking for a stronger coffee or chocolatey taste, this is likely to be disappointing.

Tried it, retried it, wife tried it, conclusion: insipid.  The only barely acceptable way to prepare it, in my opinion, is to run two pods at single-pod followed by a single-pod Sumatra.  Godiva is highly overrated and with absolutely NO returns, we're stuck with two more undesirable packs.Avoid if you like coffee and avoid if you like chocolate.  This ain't no mocha by a long stretch and it's a very poor choc creme.

column9: it's not chocolate, it's not coffee
column10: Sigh.  The smell is very strong, but I can't describe it as either chocolate or coffee.  It sure doesn't taste like either.  I love mocha, I simply can't call this mocha.  I'm easily affected by the caffeine in coffee.  This doesn't do a thing to me.  As for the chocolate, some other reviewer said it tasted artificial.  I totally agree.

We didn't like this at all. The rich chocolate flavor? Nope. Just a smell that I think smells like moldy socks. Everyone perceives taste differently but our family, at least, agreed this was not a good one.

column9: Taste nothing like Godiva and everything like Senseo
column10: I'm very disappointed this this product.  The coffee taste bland.  I'm surprised Godiva collaborated with such a poor product.  Had I known that this is a Senseo product I would never have bought it.  The flavor isn't rich even when I brew the 7 oz cups.  There a slightly sour after taste.  All in all, its a great deal for the money.  But if you're into coffee, its probably not something you would want to put yourself through.

column9: Godiva Coffee--not as sweet as you'd think
column10: I was disappointed with the taste and price of this coffee.  I don't recommend it unless you're looking for a VERY subtle flavor of chocolate only.
Weak, unimpressive, tasteless and way overpriced.  Tastes like a coffee for little children.  I will not repurchase!

I am a HUGE Godiva chocolate fan, so you can imagine how thrilled I was to find these for my coffee maker. Unfortunately these really disappointed me as far as the flavor goes. It's very strong, and just doesn't live up to what I would expect from Godiva.

We love the aroma and taste of flavored coffee and were looking forward to this given the name that Godiva has in chocolate!  But what a disappointment we had.  The coffee was weak and had very little aroma and even less taste.  Why is it that we can't get the same nice aroma and flavor from our pod machines as friend can get from their cup machines?  Anyway, we had set this up for automatic delivery and will cancel future orders.  Not worth the premium price, Godiva needs to go back to the lab on this one!

I tried this out, because I love mocha's and Chocolate in my coffee.  This is good, but I like a much bolder coffee.  Great if you want a dessert coffee, or love chocolate.  I will stick with my bolder blends however.

These coffee pods might make delicious coffee, but they are too small for the Senseo coffee maker. They hold less coffee than Senseo's own pods therefore the coffee comes out watery. I was very disappointed since i enjoy flavored coffees as a rule.

column9: Godiva Chocolate Cr¿me Coffee Single Serve, Coffee Pods
column10: Smells great.  Was not what my husband was looking for.  He had tried a chocolate pod from France that he really enjoyed and was hoping this would be more like that.  It wasn't.

This coffee is very good. It is a nice change from the other Senseo pods. I have been buying more pods from Melitta and others just to change it up.  It was nice to try one from Senseo.  The chocolate is subtle, as others have mentioned.  But you can tell its there. I recommend it!!
Great flavor ot quite as foamy as regular Senseo coffee. No detailed ingredients listed is the only real negative.

Don't buy this product, they'll cheat you out of your money.  You'll just waste the shipping charges, and your time.  They sent me the wrong flavor pods, for the wrong machine.  Now I have a bunch of Tassio coffee pods that I can't use, and I have to find the time to send it all back, and then get them to refund me the shipping because I refuse to pay for their error.  In fact, it wasn't even from the listed seller, it was sent from Bed Bath & Beyond!  I don't know what's going on here, but these people are liars and thieves.

Godiva Chocolate coffee pods smell delightful, but they are not as flavorful as some other pods.  Perhaps more suitable for an 8 ounce cup, rather than the 10 mugs.  Quick and easy to use for those of us in a hurry.

column9: Dessert in a cup of Coffee
column10: Decadent rich wow sit back and dream while you enjoy this fabulous cup of coffee truly wonderful and smells fabulous, no chemical taste just rich and delicious

I am in love with this coffee! Perfect for the Senseo machine. When I start the day with this coffee I start the day with a smile on my face. It's so yummy and sweet. It goes really well with Coffeemate Chocolate Raspberry cream.

This coffee isn't that bad I would recommend it to anyone because if you put some hazelnut liquid coffee creamer in it, its the best cup of coffee you have ever had. I plan on purchasing some more when i run out,just using regular milk makes it kind of plain, but with flavored coffee creamer its the best.

I am an espresso purist and rarely imbibe "fru-fru" flavored coffee.  I had bought this for women friends and when I tried it...wow!  It is really an excellent brew.  Use only a real (Senseo or other pump-type) espresso machine, there are other AWFUL pod machines that churn out colored water(see my other reviews).  Thank Godiva for Godiva, they came through again.

Probably my favorite Senseo coffee pod. When combined with the Coffee-mate Creamy Chocolate cream and sugar, this is an excellent way to start my morning. I like the flavor added in the coffee better than the Medium Roast coffee for the Senseo coffee maker. It tastes and smells better.

column9: Even Starbucks people will find these pods DELICIOUS A++
column10: The Godiva pods have an excellent flavor for both arabica coffee lovers and chocolate lovers.  We've drunk our 3pm coffee with chocolate for years, since discovering the rather fattening Starbucks mocha coffee. (It's Lipton Green Tea, Mandarin Orange, Premium Pyramid Tea Bags, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6) green tea in the morning for us now, as no 11 o'clock droop with it.) The Godiva coffee is a delicious arabica medium roast similar to the great Senseo Douwe Egberts Colombia Blend Coffee Pods, 16-Count 3.92-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6) you can only get on Amazon.  I use 2 pods per cup, but we're chickens so I make this with 25% Senseo Douwe Egberts Coffee Pods, Decaffeinated, 18-Count 4.41-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6) and it tasts great and lowers the buzz level to manageable.  If you want a different taste you can make it 25% dark with a pod of Senseo Espresso Coffee Pods, 16-Count, 3.92-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6).  Any way it is great by us.  We like it with a little Starbucks mocha powder added (1T rounded/cup) + a dash of Starbucks Carmel Sauce.  I avoid some white sugar by sweeting to taste with Emerald Forest  Xylitol Sweetener, 2 Pound Composite Containers (Pack of 2) which also saves your teeth.  The taste is the same as table sugar.Avoid the fat of the Starbucks mocha drinks by making frothy milk to pour over your coffee with a BonJour Café Latte Frother, Battery Powered, White/ Gray.  The taste is just like whipped cream without the calories.  You will be amazed.Big Secret:  you do not even need a Senseo Coffee Machine to use these pods.  Just brew them in hot water for 5 minutes to taste before you add milk.  The machine just does a little finer extraction and puts some tasty foam on top.  You can put your own frothed milk on top instead if you take it.
Nice change from the regular pods. The coffee smells and taste yummy. A nice treat after dinner.

I had this salt at a friends today. It a perfect salt as it had no fillers and comes in the form of flakes. I used it on browned potatoes and it made the potatoes jump. I thought I had sprinkled on too much but since it's thin flakes I had to put a bit more. I loved the way it made my potatoes taste. I'm ordering some now.
I thought I couldn't go wrong with orange flavor, but I was mistaken! This has no orange flavor at all.
This stuff is the best pizza/pasta topping I've ever had. This can be added to so many foods and makes them taste so much better. Perfect for spice fans.

I like to use pimenton in a wide variety of foods and my first contact with this smoked sweet pimenton De la Vera, was because a friend give me one can about 3 years ago, and I felt that he was giving me that can even with pain, like if he was loosing something very valuable. When I tried the first time in an omelette I discover that: is not an excellent product ...is a treasure. There is no dish or preparation that don't get better using this product. I highly recommend to everybody who likes flavoful dishes . It's really amazing, even when you only smell it. Thanks for this product beyond all expectatives

column9: uhh, 99 cents more than at the store.
column10: Its my understanding the the idea to buying bulk is that the per unit cost decreases versus going to the store and buying one unit. Its this principal that lets stores make money. Now. I've done the math and 45.99/12=3.83. Something look wrong to you? I buy a can or two every day, and at 7-11, quick-chek, wawa, etc,they cost 3.00 or 3.50 if they feel expensive that day, sometimes a deal 2 for 4. Amazon is the only seller of these bulk on the web (besides the starbucks supplier stores use) so they know they can gouge pries. My recommendation is to go to the nearest 7-11 and buy 12 for 36 dollars and avoid amazon all together.There are things they are great for, buying energy drinks in bulk isn't one of them.

I love this stuff.  I could drink 3 or more cans every day.  It has that perfect blend of coffee and chocolate and gives me a boost. What I find odd is the price here.  I got excited discovering that I could buy in bulk as compared to 1 can at a time at local gas stations.  As others stated, I assumed the price per can would go way down because of the quantity.  Well, at $50 per 12 pack it's well over the cost of my 1 can-at-a-time cost at gas stations!  I pay from $2.29 to $2.69 locally while this Amazon cost is $4.11 per can.  What's the point in buying in bulk if the price goes up??  And I'm not even considering shipping cost. As a price threshold, for me if the price exceeds $30 for a 12 pack, I say forget it.

Starbucks is known all over the world for producing quality coffee but with a price of $79.99 for a pack of 12 I believe this is too much to ask for. Other brands can offer the same quality of taste and energy boosting effect but at a cheaper price. If name is all we are buying in this product then I hope Starbucks should better think about it soon.There are different reasons why men and women purchase a cup or a can of coffee. Some want it for the sake of leisure while others wish to have an additional energy booster. But many have grown accustomed to the taste of quality coffee beans so they stick with popular brands like Starbucks.Starbucks Doubleshot sure comes in handy since you can carry it around wherever you may go. You can instantly have that needed jolt of energy so you can finish your pile of office paperworks or school assignments. Instead of walking over to a starbucks cafe then you can readily cool it in the fridge so you can readily enjoy it anytime.The problem with caffeinated drinks is that the energy effects will not last for so long. Most of the time the mental alertness will only keep you going for a maximum of 12 hours. I have personally tried it and no matter how much I wanted to sleep the amount of caffeine was not yet used so was awake until 12 noon. Soon after, my eyes felt tired and I was off to sleep.I had no problems like this with my regular Gene Eden Vir 101 supplement. It gives me longer lasting energy without any side effect. I take it three times in a day and can feel how it helps my body work efficiently without any complaints.Choose the coffee drinks you will take but if you are indeed a fan of Starbucks then having a pack of Doubleshot in your fridge will definitely be a delight not only to you but also to your coffee buddies.

When I received this basket I was disappointed at its size.  When I looked at the picture and read the description I expected a bigger gift.  However, when I called and let them know my feelings I was told that there had been a mistake in the size of the product that was sent to me.  Apparently they had a larger size that I should have gotten.  They let me keep what I had and gave me a full refund.  I felt that this shows the company stands behind it's product and I would buy from them again.

Product arrived as scheduled.  No problem with merchandise as I purchase this product at my local grocery chain as well as from Amazon, which is cheaper.  Have scheduled regular shipments of this product.
By far the most fresh licorice mix I've ever eaten!  Obviously wasn't sitting on a shelf for months!  I just ordered two more.  You won't be disappointed if you love the freshest licorice!

column9: Licorice bridge mix the very best
column10: You can't beat this for flavor and freshness the quality is the very best coming from a Licorice Lover I wish my grandfather was still around to enjoy his favorite treat.
Definitely would order again.  Each time I get it, it is fresh.  If you like licorice, you will like this mix.

I LOVE Licorice Bridge Mix.  It's very expensive, so I won't be ordering it very often.  The only place I have found it is Betty's Country General Store in Helen, GA.  Anyone who likes licorice will love this bridge mix.

The licorice was fresh and excellent as usual. This was the second time I had ordered from this vendor. I ordered four pounds, which were shipped in four individual hard plastic containers in a cardboard box. Each container was about 3/4 full. During shipping one of the boxes came open and a couple handfuls of licorice went everywhere in the shipping box. I had sent the package to a friend's house and fortunately the kids weren't too particular about searching for the loose candy in the folds of the box, although I'm not too sure how healthy that was. I'd recommend a different size or type of container for the future. Also, I didn't know if I should have reported it to the shipping company. I live outside of the US and don't know the expectations or allowances for this type of problem. In addition, it seemed to take a while to reach the address in Portand, Oregon - maybe eight days or more. Perhaps that's normal for the US. I would order again from this vendor.
loved the candy, did not like the price, I love good licorice, so it was worth it

column9: Solid God Katz-N-Flocken Dry Cat Food
column10: I ordered this discounted food knowing the discount would off set the shipping.  My cats LOVE this cat food, I've fed it to them for years and will keep buying it.  Solid Gold is an excellent brand, never had any of the cat food recalls.  So I felt I made a wise decision even though the product listed didn't include the size bag.  Turns out the size was a 4 lb bag, still a savings with the discount.  I've also ordered through PetFood Direct, never had a problem with their service or with their products.  The drawback was the bag was expired.  Ordered 12/10 and expired 2/10.  I am very disappointed I spent the money on expired food which I will not feed my pets.  There is a reason why a manufacturer puts an expiration date on their food.  So no, I won't order this product again and I wonder if that was what the discount was all about - Getting rid of expired food the only way they could.  I won't order dry cat food on line again, not through PetFood Direct, not when their people do this to a customer.
Thank you so much for making this product .it is hard to find items made with flax i wish more could be made. the flax provides the fiber I need thanks a billion.

column9: nothing beats small egg bows for lentils and bows meal
column10: I have always loved Ronzoni's small egg bows. While growing up we used them for lentils and bows meals and you just can't beat the flavor. I recently found out Ronzoni has discontinued the product so I am surely disappointed in that but I will keep ordering them until I can't get them anymore.. and I also found out De Cecco sells them now too so one one supply ends I'll have another.

column9: Cats Initially Goobled Up This Food. Interest Waned ater a Month.  Wish I Could Pronounce Some of the Ingredients.
column10: Since my cats are getting older, I decided to supplement their dry food with a daily can of wet food.  I orginally had them eating Friskies Special Diet canned food because of a friend's recommendation; however, one of my cats had an allergic reaction to the Friskies.My cats are already eating Castor & Pollux Ultramix Indoor Feline Fomula Dry Cat Food, 15-Pound Bag, so I tried out this Organix Turkey and Seafood as well as Castor and Pollux Natural Ultramix Chicken and Vegetables Casserole Adult Feline Canned Formula.All of our cats, young & old, like this Organix food. Even the allergy cat seems to tolerate this canned food.  It is a typical canned cat food consistency (no chunks of meat - kind of a mush - easy to remove from the can).  My only hesitation is that the ingredients do not seem to be completely "organic", and I cannot pronounce some of the ingredients.  However, with any commercially manufactured pet food, I believe you have to "settle", and this food seems to be of a higher quality than other similarly priced cat food which contain meat by-products.NOTE: after about 1 month of eating this food on a daily basis, only 3 of my 5 cats will eat all of their food.  The other two nibble at the food & then walk away.Ingredient list:Organic Turkey, Salmon broth, organic chicken liver, organic brown rice, organic chicken, shrimp, organic guar gum, calcium sulfate, tricalcium phosphate, organic flaxseed meal, salt, potassium chloride, minerals (iron amino acid, chelate, zinc amino acid chelate, cobalt amino acid chelate, copper amino acid chelate, manganese amino acid chelate, sodium selenite, potassium iodide), vitamins (vitamin E, A, D3, B12 Supplements, thiamine mononitrate, niacin, d-calcium pantothenate, pyridoxine hydrochloride, riboflavin supplement, folic acid, biotin), taurine, choline chloride.Guaranteed Analysis:crude protein (min) 8.0%, crude fat (min) 6.0%, crude fiber (max) 1.0%, crude moisture (max) 78.0%, ash (max) 1.8%, magnesium (max) 0.03%, taurine (min) 0.05%Made in the USA.

I love the ingredient listing. I love that I can see the bits of shrimp that are in there. And I love that my kittens cry as soon as the cans clink when I get them out.Wherever they are in the house, they come running and cry cry cry until I set the food down.They usually gobble up a bit, and then leave some in the dish to save for later. They always finish their portions before the next day.With the 3 oz I feed 1 can per cat for dinner usually. Then after it's done I free feed dry, which they nibble at but don't eat a ton. I used to have set feeding times with measured amounts, but found them to gorge. Now that I free feed they eat more sparingly and throughout the day.Love this, love the can size, and love that it's subscribe and save ready - makes it affordable for mom.

column9: For a quick fix...try some couscous!
column10: This is one of the great way to fix a meal if you're cramp for time or lazy to cook. For a guy, one packet is good enough to fill you up. Goes great with salad or fried egg on the side. I like that you can buy a box of 12 and does save you some money.

column9: Best Coconut Milk - But Buy It Locally
column10: This is the best brand of coconut milk/cream I have found.  I am still exploring other brands, but this is better than Thai Kitchen, Roland, etc.  It makes delicious curry sauces and soups.  But $6.95 a can is outrageous.  You can get it at your local Asian market for about $2.00 a can.  (I have paid between $1.69 - $2.29 a can).  $6.95 a can is outrageous.

If you are looking for coconut milk for making curries, this is the brand to buy. Mae Ploy brand is highly recommended also. Do not settle for less. Please search either of these two out! Warning: Shake the can before purchase. If it sloshes around like water - put it back. Chaokoh and Mae Ploy both are uniformly thick and creamy. Try to find the 19.5 oz can.

I have tried many brands of coconut milk and Chaokoh is my hands-down favorite. It's thicker than most brands--almost like whipped cream--and has a uniformly creamy taste and texture. It makes an excellent dip for fruit and adds delicious creaminess to smoothies and soups. The Chaokoh brand is recommended by many Thai cooking experts, as well as by Food & Wine magazine and Cook's Illustrated. Be warned: it's addictive!
This is my favorite coconut milk. I used to buy it at my local safeway, but they have been out of it for weeks. My order was received in a timely matter.
THIS STUFF IS AMAZING, I LOVE IT. I DO NOT HAVE TIME TO GO TO THE STORE AND GET THIS (I DONT EVEN KNOW WHAT STOES SELL THIS) ANYWAYS THIS SMELLS GREAT AND TASTS GREAT

column9: way too weak, hardly tastes like coffee
column10: way too weak, hardly tastes like coffee.  I wish that Starbucks or Seattle's Best would produce a decaffeinated T-disc.

The decaf Gevalia coffee and cappucino are delicious and come out perfect every time in the Tassimo. Unfortunately, they're the only 2 varieties of decaf coffee they have available currently, but both are excellent and come very close to coffee house quality.
