I feel that this is a rip-off.  It has 1/3 of the coffee of the drinkable brands, and lacks taste and character, such as is possible with other decafs.  It makes me want to return an otherwise good coffee maker.  If I were Tassimo I would not license this product unless they gave it a full-size portion of coffee.  I agree with other reviewers that this is like drinking diluted coffee.  I wish Starbucks or another maker would weigh in on decafs for Tassimo.
I found this variety of Tassimo coffee pods to be undrinkable compared to some of the caffeinated varieties. It's like cheap diner coffee. Going in the garbage.

Over-all just a great robust flavorful cup of decaf coffee.  The cost is a little high at a dollar and five cents a cup.  However, I will enjoy each and every one at my desk, the location of my tassimo.  Giving it four stars because of the price.

First of all, I love the Tassimo... it's the best.  This particular flavor of coffee is good; not quite as smoothe as I like coffee, but not at all offensive.  It leans more towards a Starbucks type flavor which I know a lot of people like.
if you drink more than 4 cups a day - this is the perfect coffee.  mild, wont give you the shakes and the runs.

I must admit, I'm a dark roast lover.  This decaf is no coffee but rather American tea.  If you like a touch of taste at night, this is ok.  Otherwise, we Tassimo'ers are sunk without a good decaf beverage.
A good tasting, mild decaf that could only be made better if it generated a full cup of coffee like the breakfast blend
The Gevalia coffee was good but did not have strong flavor that I was expecting.  It is a medium roast with subtle flavors.

column9: Tassimo Signature blend decaf T Discs
column10: Taste is very good, but not rich enough for those who prefer very dark roasts.

THE TASSIMO MACHINE WITH IT'S DISC TECHNOLOGY, IS AN AMAZING PRODUCT.THE CONVENIENCE OF BEING ABLE TO SELECT SO MANY DIFFERENT HOT BEVERAGES IN ONE MACHINE IS BENEFICIAL TO OUR BUSINESS. OUR COMPANY USES THE TASSIMO IN OUR SHOWROOM, SO CUSTOMERS MAY ENJOY THE BEST QUALITY BEVERAGE, WHILE BROWSING OUR DISPLAYS. THUMBS UP!

I love the Tassimo system and have bought 2 (one office and one home) plus gifts for friends and families.  You'll have to try all the different coffees/teas for your own personal preference, but all work as advertised.  Great system, easy to use, and a fresh cup of coffee every time.I buy the decaf for guests, but they seem to love it.

I became addicted to Knudsen's Tangerine spritzer... until I tried this Ginger Ale spritzer.  Now it's my main drink, besides coffee or tea or water.  I happen to love the flavor of fresh ginger.  In the winter, I kick a cold using boiling water, fresh ginger, honey & lemon.  Mmmmm.This drink contains 65% juice.  Ingredients are:  Sparkling filtered water, brewed ginger root, white grape and apple juice concentrates, and ginger extract.

For those people out there who love the taste of fresh ginger, this is the carbinated beverage for you.  A great alternative to soda - no corn syrup or artificial sweeterners.  Made with fruit juice, sparkling water and ginger root.  Awesome!

Tried this just today at Nature's Food Patch for $1.39 plus tax. It is flavorful with distinctive ginger taste and is not over-carbonated--just right. Found it here on Amazon a few minutes ago and ordered a case. Good price even paying $3.99 extra for overnight service. Naturally flavored is another plus as I don't often eat or drink anything with refined sugar and conscientiously avoid  high fructose corn syrup in everything.
Delicious gingerale without all the sugars and chemicals of commercial brands.  A nice balanced flavor.  The ginger really helps my stomach.

The reviewers who said the cake is flavorless or doesn't Taste good are right. Unfortunately I had already bought this sat the store and hadn't checked out the reviews and was loathed to return them.I like it because it is organic but if you are looking to impress guests this needs some modification to have the rich chocolate indulgent flavor.This is what I did and turned out tasting decadent and rich.Add an extra egg.Substitute vege oil with melted butter.Add 2-3 heapful tablespoon of unsweetened cocoa powder. (the more you add the richer it gets)I also baked at 25 degrees lower but for at least 25 mins longer in my shiny Kaiser 9" round. Cake was very moist.
I love Ovaltine and have loved it since childhood. Our local Pakistani version is much more concentrated than this English version. I think it is lighter but good if you drink it before sleeping.

In the great trifecta of British powdered drinks to be mixed with milk and sugar, Horlicks the most malty, Milo is medium chocolately and malty, and Ovaltine seems to be the most chocolately.All 3 are basically comfort drinks when plain milk just won't do. All 3 are powders to which you add milk and sugar to get a sweet malty drink, the latter two with chocolate flavor as well.I love all 3 drinks. But if you are drinking this for nostalgia's sake, make sure you get the Ovaltine from where ever your nostalgia springs from because Ovaltine is made in different countries and they all taste a little different. For me, Ovaltine is the most chocolately of all 3 and a great comfort drink for cold nights. I like it more than simply hot chocolate because it's not as sweet and has a slight malty flavor to it. Best of all, you can control the taste because you can adjust the amounts of sugar and Ovaltine you add.

column9: Captain Midnight, you lied to me!
column10: I can still remember Captain Midnight sitting there in the uniform of an astronaut of the 50's (khaki shirt and black four-in-hand tie) telling me solemnly that I should drink my Ovaltine because it tasted good and it was good for me. It was, after all, brown and that meant it had to be chocolate, my favorite flavor.What the Uranus traveler never told me was that they were crystals that would sit at the top of the warm milk and never dissolve. Furious stirring with a metal tool called a spoon didn't do it, nor did trying to grind them up against the side of the cup.  Even using a tenderizer tool didn't work as I soon discovered that as you pushed it down the cup, the warm milk came up and out. You had to compromise by trying to round up the little critters on the spoon and that offered little comfort as the crunchy buggers didn't taste all that great anyway. To top it off, all you had left was warm milk.The jar of Ovaltine was also very resilient. It lasted a long time in our home. It was the same one. Even my father who liked the "old standbys" of Shredded Wheat and Corn Flakes we never ate, didn't go near this stuff.I only recommend this for those who have lost their taste buds through constant sword swallowing or that fire breathing trick.Captain Midnight, you lied to me!

The product came well packed and it was shipped and received promptly.  One can't find the "old fashioned" malt beverage very easily and I much prefer it to the kinds found in the stores in Tulsa.  It's a product I hope will be around so I can continue to order it.

If you're tired of the sugar laden junks sold as Ovaltine by major retailers across the US then buy this product. It taste just like the old fashioned Ovaltine. I cannot wait for Amazon to carry the original Cadbury Bournvita too. Great taste and highly recommended.

Forget the stuff called "ovaltine" here in the US. This is the real stuff (purists would say the real stuff is the Swiss version). The UK ovaltine does have more a malty flavor than the Swiss or French ovaltine (sometimes called "Ovomaltine"), but is still close enough to the (Swiss) original.

This is by far my favorite base to use in place of traditional stocks or bouillions. Much less sodium, lasts 10 times as long in the fridge and the flavor is more akin to a home made stock from reducing beef bones then the flavorless bouillions or stocks. It is great to add to a pot roast or chili or as that extra flavor to a quick beef stew. Absolutely love, I buy this over and over again. Wish I could get this locally!
Wasn't sure about giving up my store-bought cubes, but this product has more flavor and is less salty tasting.  Happy with purchase.

Now that it is difficult to find bones for making stock - this beef base really helps "beef up" soups, sauces, and gravy. I have tried many bouillons and bases over the years and find this one to be the least salty. The tomato paste in it is sometimes not the flavor I am looking for, but, I am going to try their Au Jus for when I prefer a less complex flavor.

I give these to my 49 and 30 lb dogs all the time. They simply love them.I've had co-workers tell me the rawhide chews can result in surgery, and with these I know the small bits are digestable.My dogs love them, and they seem to last much longer than other chews.The only down side is when the chew gets really small, my big dog can swallow the remaining amount.So I find it best to put into a kong toy to allow here to continue to gnaw on it without swallowing it.If she does swallow it, it will make her ill, she ralphs, and feels fine again. Not a huge danger, butwatch out for that.I will continue to order these, really saves 5the other stuff in the house from getting chewed up, andthe dogs love them.

My dog can't have rawhides and is allergic to a lot of food ingredients. This is the perfect chew for him! All natural and keeps him busy (he's an 80 lb monster am staf!) I thought he didn't like it at first... but after a bit of licking and softening at it...you can't take it away from him!  This is my go to when frozen raw bones are not an option.

I can't believe how great these are. They last a really long time, so my dogs can't be getting much off of it, but they absolutely love these chewies. Also, my dogs don't seem to want to swallow these. They'll swallow any other chewie once it gets small, but not these, so I don't have to watch them as closely or worry.These are great! I give these chewies when I want the dogs to calm down and relax for a while, great for after dinner or while I'm doing some work.

We have tried multiple chews and this is the best one we have found for our Bouvier puppy. They do not smell and they provide many hours of chewing enjoyment. She also loves bully sticks but they smell horrible (even the ones that say they have no odor). We recently had our dog spayed and she chewed on her Himalayan Dog Chew for days and did not bother her stitches at all. Granted, these chews are expensive and do not last forever, so you may want to save them as a special treat. They can also break when your dog drops them on a hard surface. Although they do not smell, you may find some little chips from the chew around the house. When they get too small, you will have to throw them away because your dog will continue chewing on them. In summary, we absolutely love these chews and our dog does, too!

I gave my Aussie a bone in the evening and he had it all chewed up in a couple of hours. That is way too much money to spend for such a short "chew" time. They are good bones, perhaps for a dog with less sharp teeth.
Like many of the reviewers, I have an big, 80lb boy that is a mega-chewer. I was excited to find another treat option for him except he has ZERO interest in the chew... It was a total bust.

I was introduced to these Himalayan Dog Chews in a local pet store.  My GSD pup loved it at first while it was fresh and she could nibble down the flavor.  But as with all dog chews, she gets bored with them so I have to switch it up so these seem new again.  Two things to note:  1) This dog chew shreds...like into very very fine 'grated cheese' like particles that get all over the floor.  So either make sure your dog is on an easy to clean flat surface or on washable dog bed.  2) The larger sizes tend to break in half easily.  While my pup has been enjoying them, she will occasionally drop it and it would break in half.  We are on our 2nd one with 4 unfinished pieces lying around the house.  Otherwise, great alternative to having the pup chew on our furniture!

Is it possible for you to have a non-stinky chew that your dog is actually interested in?!?!  YES!!!!  This chew is really hard and feels almost like hard plastic when its dry, but softens up a little when really wet.  I got this for my 12 lb Shiba puppy (3 months) and he's BARELY made a dent in it!  I initially got the smaller pieces (pet store recommendation), but i thought it was kind of a choking hazard in case I just wanted to leave it out, so I opted for the magnum!!!  My puppy can barely get his mouth around it but he loves this big chew and I'm sure it'll last a month or two.  This chew doesn't smell and sometimes little pieces come off, but since it hardens, its easy to vacuum up off the carpet.  Puppy smells like cheese after too!  And no staining on carpet or other materials.  I gave my neighbor the smaller chews I bought-- this product may not really be for super heavy chewers, his dog went through the chew in a DAY where as my puppy took a week before I got too paranoid and had to microwave it to make a cheesy pouf.  (30 seconds works well).  Really great buy.

Our 9 month old bernedoodle loves this yak product and it keeps her busy so we can enjoy our dinner.  Once she figured out the 'trick' to getting through the hard exterior, she became more efficient.  Nonetheless, we've really enjoyed having it.  It doesn't affect her stomach which is sensitive to many foods.

We got these chews for our husky's 2nd birthday (of course sis got one too) they both love them. We have a hard time finding chewies that will stand up to all of our criteria and were recommended these at our pet store, now we're hooked. Both pups are on wheat, corn and soy free diets, and we try not to give them super processed/unnatural treats.Despite being an incredibly agressive chewer our female husky/shepard mix has unfortunate tummy reactions to any beef and pork based chews. These chews are amazing for our needs. Our little girl's is actually lasting longer because she only chews it, where our little boy licks and sucks on his making it softer, but he is also very slow and delicate chewer so it typically takes him way longer to eat anything.The website says that some dogs may have slight tummy reactions at first but it typically goes away once their system gets used to it. We have not had any such reactions and are so happy to finally find a natural chew that satisfies our needs.

I have 2 dogs, a 50lb coonhound and a 30lb mutt mix and they absolutely love these!  It took them 3 days and 3 hours of chewing each day to get through them!  Its great bc we live in an apartment and cant always let them out to run around so this is a great way to keep them occupied for a few hrs.  These are the best chews Ive ever bought.  Kinda pricey but you get what you pay for.  And because there's just enough give I don't worry about them cracking a tooth or a sharp piece splintering off and hurting them.  I HIGHLY recommend!
I've been giving these to my boxer since she was 6 months old and she loves them. hey last a long time, make very little mess and don't smell offensive

they don't smell like bullsticks. As for lasting, my lab shes still a pup likes them so much within 1 hr has all ready eaten a 1/4 of it. I cant blame the product like some of the other reviewers. Puppy's chew, you cant expect anything safe to last.  Once she isn't teething these will last longer !

My 6 month old Aussie puppy loves these chews. The first one I got her was a medium, then a large, and now an extra large as she has grown. The medium ones used to last for weeks with her puppy teeth but now that she's getting her adult teeth, the XL I got her was gone in a little over a week! So not as long lasting as I thought they would be, but she'll probably stop chewing so much once she's done teething. I like these chews for her because they are healthy, they last longer than bully sticks, and they don't stink. I let her chew them on the couch next to me or in my lap without much mess other than a few shavings that I brush off.  Also, she prefers these to deer antlers which she gets bored of and might move onto something not meant for her, like a sock or the couch. Give her a himalayan bone on the other hand and she is set for as long as you want her to be. :)

We have tried everything for our lab mix dog.  He loves to play with toys and chew, but destroys everything within minutes to a few hours.  My mother-in-law got an x-Large Himalayan Dog Chew for us to try and it lasted more than a week!  Our dog constantly played with and chewed it and it still lasted.  A great product!

I was really excited to find a chew that's supposed to be super long-lasting AND natural so I can feel good about giving this to my dog and enjoy some quiet time!  Plus, my dog LOVES cheese and yogurt and anything dairy so I figured this would be a huge winner with her.Obviously since you're reading this review you realize that this thing is pretty expensive.  Ok...not PRETTY expensive, it IS expensive.  Unfortunately it didn't turn out to be quite the incredible new chew discovery I had hoped it would be.First of all, I am not new to dog chews.  My fiance and I have an 80 lb Doberman who has had raw hides (in many shapes and sizes), bully sticks, tracheas and a bunch of other kinds I can't even remember the names of.  Since she is quite the spoiled little princess dog, she gets chews on a pretty regular basis and has learned to make quick work of chews that used to take her longer.  Raw hides and bully sticks last the longest with her.  She'll usually work on it for an hour or so (maybe less) before wrapping it up and saving it for later.  They usually last 2-3 sessions.Since this is supposed to be ultra-long lasting, I expected it to last longer than her raw hides and bully sticks.  Well...in an hour (maybe a little longer...but only by 10 minutes at most), she had finished half.  So pretty much that means it would last 2 hours if she ate it in one session.  After half she decided she had enough and lef it for later.  So really, this lasts no longer than her raw hides and bully sticks except it costs about 4x (or more) more.  Granted the benefit of this is that it doesn't smell (like bully sticks) and it doesn't stain (like raw hides).  However, I don't think that benefit is worth all that extra money.  Obviously this is expensive because of its source and the process for making this and I completely appreciate that...I just don't want to spend money on that.Really though, if this was something she absolutely went crazy for, I'd say it's still worth it to purchase for her (like I said...she's spoiled)...but she's not even that into this thing.  I thought for sure she'd love it since it's dairy-based but she's pretty 'meh' about it I guess.It took her awhile to get into it.  She was crazy sniffing and sitting for it when I first took it out to give to her but after she got it she spent quite awhile trying to find a place for it and then pretty much just left it there for a few hours.  I figured it was because she wasn't familiar with it and wasn't sure what to do with it, but now I think it's just that she has other chews she prefers.  After she finished half to leave for later I was worried she would finish the whole thing in one day so I took it away for awhile.  When I gave it back to her she pretty much just found a place for it and left it there...she'll pick it up occasionally but not to chew.  She likes to pick things up when she gets excited and that's the extent of her interaction with this thing.  Since then she has received a few other chews that she has chewed, left, and gone back to and finished...this one is still just sitting there.I'll probably buy another one at some point in the distant future to see if she takes to it more (maybe it IS just a novelty thing with her) but really, this is no miracle ultra-long lasting chew...at least not for my dog.  2 hours is a good amount of time but there are other chews that provide the same chew time at a fraction of the cost.Oh...I should also mention that there didn't really seem to be any adverse effects with this for my dog (stomach upset, diarrhea etc.).

my dog is a 3 yr old 70lb American bulldog/German shepherd mix. after buying the thicker 12 inch bully sticks for her I wanted to try something that might last longer. (she goes through a 12 inch bully stick in about 20 mins.) I also wanted something that would be good for her teeth. I started w the large bone but she got down to half of it in about 15 mins. i had read that its not a good idea to feed one that's too large for your dogs size because it could fracture their teeth but i decided to try xl bone anyway (i think it says 80 ir 90+ lbs on the pckg) shes chewed on some pretty hard things before with no issues. but the XL (19.99 where i bought it) she managed to bite chunks off of so I had to take that away and trade her for a bully stick because I was concerned about her trying to swallow the large pieces. i was hoping it would be like rawhides n bullysticks and would get softer as she chewed so she could eat small pieces. but its really hard and stays that way. I'm sad it didn't work out for us because it is healthy and definitely would have been good for scraping her teeth. back to bulky sticks we go.

I got these for my two golden retrievers. I was concerned about them making a gooey mess - but they really didn't and that was a nice surprise. I think that they were so good that they made sure every bit was swallowed.However, the one thing I did not like about these was how quickly they were consumed. I was looking for a dog chew that would keep my dogs occupied. I usually give them sterilzed bones but was looking to mix it up a little for them. After only 4 hours they were already through 1/2 of the chew! That is too fast for how expensive they are. Also consider they can't consume the entire chew - you need to pick it up when it gets to be a choking hazard. This was well over half the chew. I do have aggressive chewers but I'll need to stick with sterilized bones that they can get days and weeks of entertainment out of.
My dog liked this chew, but it did not last.  She was able to tear through it easily in one day.  Too expensive for only one chew session.

Such a disappointment! I ordered 2 of these for my Lab/Weimeraner mix puppy. She destroys everything within minutes, and finishes store-bought chewies within a day. These chews would have been great had they not broken immediately. She dropped it on the ground and it split in two- which made them perfect size to choke on. So I had to give them to my other smaller dog, and only when they're in their kennels at night so super dog won't choke. Not worth the money.
I love to make smoothies with ice, fresh fruit, soy milk. I wanted to make one that would taste like a peanut butter shake without adding peanut butter. This worked out perfect

i was worried this was going to be really fake tasting / smelling but I'm impressed by how much like peanut butter it really makes things taste. I make frozen yogurt at home and put some of this flavoring in it with a little chocolate -- yum.
Although this is no substitute for the real thing, the flavor is good enough when you need a substitute.

****THIS IS HORRIBLE***IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR SOMETHING THAT WILL GIVE YOU A P.B. TASTE THEN THIS IS NOT IT. It takes terrible, like you are having pure chemicals. I use a lot of extracts and oils for flavoring and this is BY FAR the worst one out there. AND the worst part is that it is NON REFUNDABLE! So I just WASTED $15 on this crap. **DO NOT BUY**
this was the awfulest tasting stuff ever.  Tasted like some type of alchol based gas.  Nothing what so ever like any peanut I ever tasted.

I took one vial and felt great. I felt like I'd never want to use any medication again. Then I had another and didn't feel any different.Ginkgo on its own improves circulation and is a mild stimulant, but combined with eleuthero (aka siberian ginseng) and rhodiola, it can create a significant feeling of relaxation and concentration.I suppose it works for some people (like the previous reviewer's roommate) and doesn't for others. But, based on my experience, I can say that it works best if used sparingly and if it is taken on an empty stomach.Once I started taking it while I ate and doing it every day, I stopped feeling any effects. But if I avoid it for a long time and then take it on an empty stomach, I feel awesome again.In any case, it's a good supplement and at under $10 a box, it's a good deal.
This is one of the greatest purchase I have made... the stuff works great.. not only on my memory but has done wonders for my health!!!!

These little bottles definitely have a noticeable effect on my memory and energy levels. I take one every day, M-F when at work. I haven't experienced any decay in effect like the other reviewer posted.They do taste pretty bad though, but the taste doesn't linger in your mouth after a drink of water. For the price, they're worth it.

I've got a room mate that swears by these. I bought a few packs of these, and didn't notice a single difference in my memory/mental capacity, the way my room mate raves. I think it's more of a placebo for him.

I bought the 1 lb. bag for something like a trial-pack, and I regret not buying more! This was the first time I had ever used oat bran, so I was not quite sure what to do with it, but I have found that it works EXTREMELY well when mixed with old-fashioned oats (for my typical breakfast of pumpkin maple oatmeal =]) The oat bran is finely ground, but it does a great job thickening up oats and giving it more texture as well as a little additional fiber. I highly recommend this product, and I look forward to purchasing more from Barry Farm

This is great oat bran.  I usually buy it from our local health food store, but I never get a chance to drive there any more.  This was a good price and arrived really fast.  I am going to re-order this brand from now on.

I have been drinking this tea for years, and have found it to be the best.  It has gotten very hard to find lately.  But thanks to Amazon, I not only have my favorite tea, but I got it at a fraction of the price.  I couldn't be happier.  thankyou

I first learned about Ahmad tea living in Europe.  The quality is very good. I have seen this sold at London heathrow airport for @ $14.00/pkt of 25 bags.  English afternoon is my favorite.  It tastes like a mild earl grey tea - a nice flavor that goes well with milk.

column9: Delicious Tea - Update* Only the first box was fresh.  Tossed the other 5 boxes.
column10: I'm not picky when it comes to tea but I love tea.  I got this as a loose leaf a couple of years ago and I was surprised how delicious it was. I had to get more and ordered this Afternoon Tea.  I also have the Breakfast Tea but hands down the afternoon tea is much better in my opinion. $23 for 300 tea bags seemed to me like a good deal for quality tea.  Also the tea bags are pretty big so in a large cup I usually get to pour for 2 with one tea bag.UPDATE** Sadly after my first box, the other boxes had a different odor. It was not a good smell and I couldn't even drink it.  My mom ordered one at the same time and she felt exactly the same.  We realized we were sent a very old bath of tea.  Amazon has amazing service and they were kind enough to refund the money to us.  We were really sad that 10 boxes had to be thrown out.  It was so gross.  Hopefully others didn't have a bad batch like we did.  We really love the flavor of this tea.  Just make sure when you get your order to open all of them and check the smell.  You will notice it right away if it is OLD.  I had to go from 5 star to 2.

I first purchased Ahmad tea at Covent Gardens in London in 2004.  When I used it all up, I was quite sad.  Friends from England would mail me some from time to time.  Then I had an idea to search for it online and I found it was available from Amazon.com.  Who knew?  So I filled my cabinet with it and I am so happy when 4PM rolls around.  I highly recommend it.

This is my favorite non-decaffeinated tea.  This is currently the best value way to purchase through Amazon to refill you Ahmad metal tea caddy holder.When I serve this tea to my guests they all say:  "this is a really good cuppa."If you need to a decaffeinated tea, try Ahmad Evening Tea; or see my "Do It Yourself" way to decaffeinate this and others teas up to 80% under Ahmad Evening Tea 50 teabag.

I have been drinking Ahmad English Afternoon Tea for several years and it has been my favorite black tea.I had been buying this tea at the "British Isles" store in Houston, Texas. However, a few years ago I moved to Hawaii, and had to order this tea from Amazon.comI bought 6 boxes of 50 bags of the Ahmad English Afternoon Tea and upon opening the boxes the first thing I noticed was a VERY strong smell of bergamot. Upon brewing the tea,the taste and smell of bergamot was overwhelming. I think the bergamot is even stronger than Earl Gray tea. So I am sadly disappointed that this Ahmad English Afternoon Tea wasvery different from the one I had been buying for years.Maybe the blend was recently changed? Could it be a quality control issue? I emailed Ahmad Tea and got NO response about this matter so I am posting this after a fair attempt to get an explanation.Buyer beware, Ahmad Tea may be selling "rejects" on their online store.

I have been drinking tea for about 50 years or so, and Stash makes a great-tasting full-bodied tea.  This tea has a smooth fruity taste (peach).  It is not overbearing, but a nice subtle peachiness.Individually sealed in a paper/foil pouch for added freshness, this tea is listed as having 100 % natural ingredients.  They are, in the order listed, wuyi oolong teaorange peel, lemongrass, and white peach flavor.It has been said that oolong tea was named after the part of Wuyi mountain, in China, where it was originally produced. It is among the most popular types of teas served in typical Chinese restaurants. (I have also found Jasmine tea and varieties of green tea in typical Chinese restaurants¡Xand plum wine.  Yum.)It is also suggested that oolong tea is useful for weight loss.  In my (non-medical) opinion (I am not a doctor), like anything else, it can HELP but won¡¦t carry the load.  Oolong appears to be a diuretic, helping you to loose excess water.  If you lose too much water, you might dehydrate or lose valuable potassium.  So, I suggest that you limit yourself to 24 oz a day.  As with anything else, seek guidance from your health care practitioner.I suggest adding agave cactus juice, unbleached natural brown sugar, or honey, if you want a sweetener.  I like fruity teas often in the evening, and instead of dessert.Darn it!  Now I¡¦m craving Chinese food and am snowed in--in a blizzard¡Xwith over 40 inches of snow on the ground.  I wonder if they will deliver? º

Wow, this is good stuff!  I brew mine up and pour into a mug with 4-5 drops of apricot liquid stevia and a little soy vanilla creamer.  Wonderful to sip as an after dinner treat.  So creamy and tropical...yum!

Generally, I don't like flavored tea. And the experiences I've had with chocolate flavored tea left me convinced it really couldn't be done in any palatable way. I was wrong. I don't know what led me to try Stash's Chocolate Mint Oolong but this tea is outstanding! It does NOT taste like Palmer's chocolate coins dissolved and diluted in too much water, which is what most chocolate tea tastes like to me -- not even a Hershey's kiss, but Palmer's -- yuck! This tea has a very light yet distinct chocolaty flavor followed by sweet mint. It's refreshing in the evening after dinner when I want something sweet but don't want to load up on sugar right before bedtime. And, truth be told, it's a delight any time of day.

This Stash flavor is so deliciously tropical I love it hot or cold.  Made with 100% natural ingredients of :wuyi oolong tea,  orange peel, and flavors of coconut, pineapple, and mango.  It's caffeine free and I like this espeically as a cold drink in the mornings vs coffee in the summer time;  very refreshing and tropical.  Takes 3-5 minutes to steep and if making iced tea Stash recommends using double strength...2 bags per cup.  As with many of the unique Stash brand varieties ; licorice and pure peppermint,  this is difficult sometimes to get at the local stores so I buy either direct from the company or here on Amazon. Delicious. 5 stars to a great brand of Stash.

Love this tea.  Unlike a lot of (supposedly) flavored teas, this one actually has a strong flavor; more coconut "tropical" than mango but really tasty, with a strong smell too.  I think it tastes best with a touch of sweetener (honey, agave, etc.) to further enhance the flavor.  After finding it once, I haven't been able to find this flavor at any of my local grocery stores, so I ordered the box of 6.  Everyone I have shared this tea with has loved it too!.
I drink a lot of tea and Stash's White Peach Oolong is by far my favorite.  It's smooth and has a great flavor.

I like this tea because it has a nice subtle flavor without the bitterness that one often experiences with black teas.  And, I'm told that oolong tea is good for your health too, and that's why I tried it.
This tea has a fresh peach flavor, not artificial-tasting like some others I have tried. It has a natural sweetness, and is refreshing served either hot or iced.

I love this tea!  If you like peach flavored teas, you'll probably like it.  Good amount of peach flavor.  Mild overall - not strong like black and not grassy like green.  Now and then I try other brands but end up always coming back to Stash.  Their blends/flavors are always my favorites - especially their Earl Grey.

This isn't bad - peach but also a bit of citrus.  Was looking for a substitute for Celestial Seasonings white peach and it's not quite what I wanted.  However, a friend of mine whom I gave it to loves the product.  :)  Each to his/her own!

I love drinking different peach tea's during summer. The white peach oolong has a sweet peach flavor that has a slight lemmongrass flavor with a hint of citrus. I drink this tea with milk, sugar, peach bits, then chilled, and the taste really comes together well. Not as strong as Celestial Seasoning Country Passion Peach tea. I've also tried Liptons Peach tea which has a light pina colada flavor, but as far as white peach, it's definitely a great Summer treat for the family picnic.

These are just terrible. They look and taste burnt, very dark brown with black specks all over. They have a terrible flavor and I just can not imagine anyone would buy these a second time. They literally taste like throw up. Surely something is wrong with them. I purchased some similar (possibly the same brand) at Fresh Market and they were delicious. They were the color of cheese not black and they didn't taste ANYTHING like this. These things are really horrible.

The kits I received are not what was advertised,,,I received 7lbs DME and 1lb corn sugar as opposed to the advertised LME.  DME is lighter than LME of course, but the inclusion of corn sugar bothers me a bit.  Also received .25 lb of Crystal instead of the promise 1lb.  Just be aware that the recipe contents seem to be variable.  The character of this beer is much different than  what the advertised contents will give you.That said, the kit itself has potential though it's sad that I have to add more ingredients.  I'd suggest dry hopping with an extra 2 oz of Cascade.  You may also want to add a bit more in the way of specialty grains (really, a quarter pound isn't that much...).  The hop character itself is lacking a bit  although the kit only included 2 oz of northern brewer hops...) and since most of the hops are bittering hops you don't get a tremendous depth of flavor...you may want to modify the hop schedule somewhat to add an ounce at about 30 minutes instead of all the Northern Brewer at the beginning of the boil.  Better yet add an extra ounce over what the kit includes.Lastly, I'd also suggest using a liquid yeast like Wyeast 1056 instead of the included dry yeast.  Yes it's five bucks more but I think you end up with a cleaner tasting, better fermenting beer.All in all, it's an acceptable kit but much different than what is advertised.  It's almost a pound short on fermentables (and I don't consider corn sugar an acceptable substitute for malt extract...) and missing an ounce of hops.  I can't help but feel a little shortchanged here.  It's doubtful I'll be purchasing fromm this vendor again.  Three stars based on the value of the raw materials and the buy three get one free special.  I figure combining all the kits gives me three good batches instead of four mediocre ones,

column9: finally a food peanut will eat!!!
column10: We are pet nannys to a tiny chihuahua named peanut.  Mom went on a trip and Peanut and her sisters came to stay with us.  Sisters eat their food like champions.  Peanut would not eat anything....any kind of kibble, cheese, turkey, chicken, cottage cheese.  nothing.  So looked into this type of kibble for her.  And WALAAAAAAA she ate a bowl of it asap.  Loved it!  We are so thrilled for Miss Peanut.  She has found her food.  Yeah!!!!

column9: Dr. Chew Sweet Potato dog treats
column10: We have a pure breed dog who is allergic to almost everything and can't eat most dog foods and treats.  After trying every kind of veggie, no wheat, no soy, duck, etc. treats and spending copious amounts of money only to find that he won't eat them, the only two kinds of treats in the world that he will eat are Milkbones (go figure) and Dr. Chews!  He LOVES Dr. Chews and they have only one ingredient, sweet potato.  Cooked, sliced, sun dried sweet potato.  They're full of fiber and vitamins and they don't stain fabrics.  The only concern we have is that they are made in China.  We found no negative history on this product (although we are not professional researchers) but we are still careful to give him only one at a time and let a day or two go by before he gets another.
It's cute but I had thought the bos would be more of a collector's item, either tin or wood or something, not just regular packaging.  Kind of overpriced.
I sent them as a gift so I didn't get to taste them myself but the recipient was very happy with them.
As always Jelly Bellys are the best. I bought a different assortment for each of my kids for Easter. They loved them.

Unfortunately bought the product based on the picture, clearly showing a pack of Stollwerck Xmas candy. The description correctly identifies the product as Bonboneti. Probably does not make any difference for a first time buyer, but if you happen to know the product and crave for the real deal, this one does not satisfy it. A 3 start effort at best, a 5 star learning for me to read the description fully and 0 stars to the seller for the misleading picture.
This goes really fast when I buy it for Christmas. It is chocolate covered jelly, not overly sweet, lemon and orange flavored.

column9: It is a chocolate covered candy. Very Good!
column10: It is my personal favorite. We hang this chocolate covered candy on our christmas tree. My kids love it!

column9: The Best-Tasting Brand and Very Inexpensive
column10: Many green teas leave an oily residue on the surface of the beverage and in your cup. They taste bitter and have an unpleasant taste. This is a nice, clean tea, and it works for weight loss as long as you have commitment. (You have to drink a LOT of green tea to see results, but I've taken off 12 pounds in a few months drinking it cup after cup.) It helps suppress appetite. And it's organic, free from pesticides. Green tea is naturally low in caffeine, mcuh lower than black.
THIS IS THE BEST TATSING COFFEE OUT THERE IN ITS PRICE RANGE. DONT SETTLE FOR FOLGERS OR MAXWELL HOUSE. THE VACCUMN PACKED BAGS ARE EASY TO STORE IN YOUR FREEZER, SO STOCK UP HERE

This is a great brand of coffee....made in Knoxville, Tenn. I am no coffee expert, but I will describe it as best I can. I enjoy a medium to mild roast coffee with an extremely smooth, non-bitter taste that still had that true fresh brewed "coffee" flavor. This fits the bill exactly for me.  I get mine fresh off the grocery store shelves in Tennessee, and keep a stock of it in the freezer until my next visit. This price is not much higher than buying it off the shelf, and it really is worth a try. Everyone I've served it to really loves it. I drink it black.  I prefer the one marked Special.....but have noticed the newer Bonus Blend recently....have no knowledge of that one. Hope this review helps someone decide.

For some reason butterscotch disks have become hard to find where I live. So I turned to the trusty Internet to satisfy my craving.Although these looked exactly like what I'd been searching for, their difference in manufacture is evident in their taste. They taste delicious but they're richer than the brand I grew up with. This is not a bad thing; just an unexpected one.Meanwhile, my local grocery now stocks the candy in the flavor I'm used to. Since this was an "old times sake" search, I won't buy these candies online again in the near future. But that's the only reason; these candies were quite tasty.
Perfect for training, small and swallowed fast. Plus the dogs love them.  Different flavors to mix it up and give variety.

I got this product after having purchased other bonsai from this seller.The tree does look good (it has lost some foliage, but this is normal after changing the environment for the tree).However, there were two deep indentations on the trunk from careless wiring for shape. Furthermore, one of the wires had not been properly removed, so there was some of it left (rusted, big time) deep in the trunk.It was a big disspointment, but nothing that can't be reversed (over a very long time).

column9: Product has changed and now includes almond butter. :(
column10: **Update** The recipe for this product has changed.  The second ingredient listed is almond butter.  I didn't realize that it had changed and bought some.  It's cheaper now, but not as good. Very disappointing.Old review: I love Nutella, but I stopped eating it because it has dairy (I'm allergic) and hydrogenated fat.  So, I was very excited to find Justin's Chocolate Hazelnut Butter.  This product is non-dairy, has no hydrogenated fat, and has less sugar than Nutella.  While it is good, I think it tastes a little too salty, especially if you put it on a cracker, since they also tend to be salty.  My final descriptions would have to be: good stuff, could be great with a little less salt.
I have been alive 44+ years and believe that I have just found my favorite food.  YUM!  Tastes like a delicious Belgian truffle but I can eat it for breakfast?  I'm in.

Recently while shopping at Alfalfas Grocery a friend told me I had to try out Justin's Nut Butter squeeze packs. I have a sweet tooth, so the thought of buying a tasty and yet healthy snack seemed to be a genius plan. I quickly bought one of each flavor they carried and sat down by Boulder Creek to try one out. Next thing I knew, there were eight empty wrappers surrounding me. Yes, I felt embarrassed that I had gorged myself in public, but the blame certainly fell on the chocolate hazelnut flavor being far too tasty. This wonderful snack discovery made me curious... What is Justin's Nut Butter? I decided to investigate. Once I found Justin's website and read the mission statement, I knew Justin's would have a customer for life. Discovering that they are a homegrown business that strives to use local, natural and organic ingredients sold me. Not to mention the importance of reducing ones environmental footprint and giving back to the community.

I LOVE Justin's chocolate hazelnut butter.  I eat it with apple slices or use it in smoothies with chocolate rice protein powder, almond milk and fruit.  I like the portion control and convenience of the packets.

Love this stuff! It tastes delicious and is healthier than Nutella. It's much nuttier - now when I have the other, it tastes like frosting. The single serve packages are nice too - keeps me to one serving. :) I love chocolate and this gives me just a hint in the morning to get me going.  My kids (teenagers) have discovered it now too and love it. I would recommend purchasing.

So much better than Nutella. no comparison. not as sweet (Nutella is too sugary for me), much richer flavor and this package makes a lot of sense also as a nice not too unhealthy snack for kids. Enjoy!

column4: Emily Davis "Avid Reader of All Non-Fiction"
column10: Another 'Hit' for Justin's Nut Butters!  These products are the answer for those of us who are allergic and have to travel frequently!  The hazelnut kind is similar to Nutella, but much much more tasty, NO dairy is added, and they are convenient to carry and eat - in short, just what I need!  As for being too salty, I eat this product on the 'cardboard rice cakes'(yes, the whole concoction is quite good!) so the amount of salt included in this product is just right!

This product gets good marks for the quality of its ingredients and for its taste.  Similar to Nutella, which I love, but a little different texture.I will warn you, though, that two different packets had pieces of hazelnut shell in them.  Since both of them were in smoothies,  I wasn't chewing, but if I had used them on a cracker, I could easily have broken a tooth.

All of Justin's products are great!  This one is really awesome.  I compared it to Nutella and I like it much more.  It is also a very cool company out of Boulder, Colorado and all their products are all-natural and mostly organic.

I don't usually go in for convenience packaging -- but these packets are the perfect size for a purse or pocket-able snack when not at home, and much less wasteful than an open jar.I bought this chocolate-hazelnut spread at the local market first to see how it stacked up against Nutella and I really loved this product.  It has a grainier texture (more like natural nut butters than the super-smooth spread) and just the right amount of cocoa and sugar.  The market also had these little single-serving packets, but they were outrageously expensive -- I could have only bought 4 for the price of the jar.Amazon's price made the packets very close to the cost of the jar -- and each sealed packet opens fresh, without time spent oxidizing and going stale between servings.It's just the right size serving to go with one of Fiber Gourmet's bags of tasty wheat crackers -- making for a 255 calorie snack with 15 grams of fiber, and 10 grams of protein.  Can't beat that!I give the 4 stars instead of 5 because the hazelnut/cocoa blend is slightly oilier than the almond version, and could probably be stripped of a bit of the fat with no loss to taste or shelf-life.
While these are good, they are to sweet and provide to many carbs and not enough protein.

I LOVE the Sassafras kits.  I have bought about 18 of them in the last few years for gifts.  There are many of them for boys and girls if you just search Sassafras they will pull up.  I always buy a book that coordinates with the kit that is a reader book since most of the gifts have gone to 5 and 6 year olds.  I have never had any shipping issues and they have always come bubble wrapped and in great shape.  These are really fun and cute.  I have 7 in a closet right now because with 3 kids there is always a birthday party to go to!

I grew up in New England.  We had Cake Mate sprinkles or jimmies.  They are made in Florida by Signature Foods. I still get them when I go back as they are in the grocery stores.  The CK ones are okay, and I thought they would be quite similar -- same bad hydrogenated oils and the reviews.  These are certainly fine for a cupcake.  But for ice cream or the occasional spoonful of sprinkles, you need the Cake Mate.  These are available in 32 oz. from spiceworld online.  They are listed on Amazon but not as currently available.  I plan to get some soon.

These are very colorful but not the best tasting. I used them for my sons first bday as we were having a very large party and didn't want to buy 20 mini cans but taste wise the quality was not there....the look was great. I'm sure no one knew any better after all frosting fixes all.

The Jimmies had purple in the mix.  That was exactly what I was looking for.  Since we are not planning on eating these (but throwing them instead of rice). I won't know taste.  But color is excellent!

I used these rainbow jimmies for a rainbow cupcake topper and added them to rice krispie treats for my daughter's 6th birthday.  Obviously, it was a rainbow party.  The package didn't look like the picture, but I was not disappointed in the product.  I would buy from this company again.

We chose a Thing 1/Thing 2 theme for our twins' first birthday party, and these sprinkles were the perfect color. They lean more towards turquoise than a true blue, but with our red baking cups, and white frosting, they were the perfect finishing touch!
These sprinkles make a great presentation and are tasty too!  Used them for my french chocolate balls.  Would recommend them highly.
Exactly what I thought it would be. ALOT (more then I will ever need) of pink sprinkles, that taste like... sprinkles!
Great size bag for the price! I am making a funfetti cake with just purple. These sprnkles/jimmies are exactly what I wanted. Although, the color could be darker.

Jimmies sprinkles are the best i love them because they are soft and unlike the other hard sprinkles don't get stuck in your teeth. lol But it was a great buy. You have a better deal here that anywhere else.

Good quality sprinkles.  Pricing seems pretty decent.  Love the way they make my cupcakes look - takes me back to my elementary school days, long ago!  Only gripes: the "partially-hydrogenated" ingredient and non-resealable bag.  By the way, the advertised bag looks completely different than the one you get - it's not black.  Tastes like classic Jimmies too and isn't so sweet that it'll over-sweeten your frosting.
Pros - good price for its size, fast delivery,Con - not the best tasting jimmies, still better than getting the small grocery store size
This was perfect for my purposes! I made a personalized "funfetti" cake for a bridal shower for a girl whose colors were hot pink and black, and this was awesome to get it done! Fast shipping too!
I bought these sprinkles for my cupcakes and not only are they gorgeous but you get a lot for the money. The silver is very true to color and they make a lovely accent to your cupcakes.

I bought these jimmies because I couldn't find the needed orange color in any of my local stores.  A pound of jimmies is a lot, but I went through more than I expected, probably half the bag to thoroughly coat a recipe of chocolate truffles.  The taste is, well, jimmy-taste.  My only disappointment/surprise was how short these jimmies are -- about two-thirds of the length of Wilton and CakeMate brands I have in the cupboard.If you need a special color that only CK makes, don't hesitate to get them.-- Debbie Lee  Wesselmann

Seriously, sprinkles are not just for eye pleasing aesthetics but for mouth pleasing texture.  This bag is great value compared to buying the smaller size shakers with different colors. I can use two of containers of  those colors on one batch of 24 cupcakes.  I just have to find a proper container to put the bag ones in so they are easy to shake out onto cupcakes, as that is what I use them for mostly. I'll check on amazon to see if I can find an appropriate shaker.  I may just buy a smaller one (about 10 oz) shaker and use and re-use that one.  My son and I like them also on ice cream, topped with ready whip canned cream. Gives pleasing texture to  ice cream. Yum!

column9: You gotta use it quick. (according to the manufacturer)
column10: I purchased this filé from Amazon after not being able to find it in any store near me and let me be the first to say (literally this is the first review) it's a great product. It's by far the best value around on filé. At about 50 cents an ounce, you cant beat it. However, one would think since it's so cheap it would be of poor quality, but this is simply not the case, this filé is high quality potent stuff. I use a ton of it in my gumbo and nearly a year later, about 6 large pots of gumbo, I still have over half of it left, and that is after I gave my cousin a quart sized container of it! One cannot simply do that if you bought a tiny 6 ounce container of filé. My advice is if you're a Creole like me and use a bunch of filé look no further than this. However, if you're just a casual spice experimenter this may not be for you as filé has a unique taste and smell that may not appeal to all and this being such a large container it would be a waste should you not like it. I recommend buying a small amount first in order to make a determination.Note: The container says it will expire about a year from when I bought it, but I have never know filé to go bad as my mom had the same little jar the entire time I was growing up.

I made some Nutella Puppy Chow with them - turned out pretty well- but I think it'd be better if there was a little less salt.  As can be expected, it's oily on top - so be careful when you open it or you could splash some on your shirt.

I tried another brand before I tried this, and this is what I was looking for. It took maybe a week to arrive, but worth the wait. Delicious! I've almost finished my first order and I'm ordering again.

column9: Seems to live up to it's claims . . .
column10: I have only used a pack of the Mastic Gum to date but find it pleasant and it being a smaller piece of gum makes it easy to carry around in the mouth for long periods.  Maintains it's level of freshness and does seem to cleanse the breath.  Too early to judge other dental claims.

column9: Great Improvement to a wonderful Product
column10: Our two Standard Poodles have been on Purina One Rice and Lamb since we got them.  We have had our male for 4 years and our female for over 8 years.  We also had our last two Standard Poodles on Rice and Lamb for even longer.  We originally put them on because we had studied all of the available foods and decided this was the best for their health and well being.  A fantastic thing about the food is that it really reduces the volume of their feces to about 50% of other dry dog foods.  We had both of our old poodles with us when we went full time in our RV for a little over two (2) years; reduced output was a real bonus when scooping all the time.  Overall all four of our dogs were health and happy while on this food and had no problems with their skin or coats.  A recent change was a new formula with the "Smartblend" which seems to have made our dogs eat the food even better.  Both my wife and I believe that this food has helped to make our dogs healthier with the bonus of being easy to find as we travel.  I can highly recommend this food.  If you switch to it, remember to gradually introduce it while reducing the old food.  Feeding all dry is the best way to help prevent dental problems also.

This is a great natural nutrition. Most people don't eat enough vegetables in a day and this wheat grass rich in vitamins, minerals and other nutrition to replace the lack of greens. 1 scoop should give enough serving of vegetables for the day. I combine it with Nutrex Hawaii Hawaiian Spirulina Pacifica Powder, 16-Ounce Bottle to make yummy smoothie in the morning.

This product has not been the "wonder supplement" it is cracked up to be on videos and online.  It does help to make your smoothie greener.  Taste wise by itself...bleecch, however, in a smoothie, it adds that "green taste" which I miss when I forget to put it in.  What it does for me?...well, I have added this to my daily green smoothie along with my other supplements and find that I can extend the time between breakfast and lunch to about 6 hours withouta blood sugar "low".  My fasting blood sugar has dropped by about 10% which is a good metric for me.  So  I give this a 4 star rating, with no complaints, I just can't say I love it, but I will be ordering more.

column9: High quality wheatgrass...for the whole family...
column10: This product has been so good for me that I quickly went from the 30 serving size to the 100 serving size.  Ive tried it in smoothies...but since our family takes up to 4 servings a day...it got to be a pain to make a smoothie every time.  Plus,  my grocery bill was really going up trying to hide this in fruit.  Now,  I take it straight...after I dissolve it in an 8oz glass of water and I chase it down with a morsel of something.The amazing thing for me is that I cannot take vitamins or other supplements because I always have a problem with reflux.  Not anymore and I dont taste a product all day!  I make a banana/blueberry/strawberry smoothie for my 4 year old...she gulps it down...and she is less hungry all day. My 10 year old...hems and haws...eventually he will drink the smoothie just before it becomes gross and separated.  Another family member also takes wheatgrass in the triple wheatgrass/barley/alfalfa.At first, since wheatgrass has been so good to us...I thought that I would start to grow my own...but I am too busy with kids...and this product quality is so high...I dont see the need.
really amazing super food it has every mineral and clorofile for your buddy it,s amazing product i advice you to try it :D
I read lots of reviews that say this wheat grass gives you a boost of energy but it didnt work for me. Im sure its really good for you but i dont think its worth awful drink.

I purchased after reading many reviews.  Use on face, chest and hands.  The first application was not dramatic as far as results go; but I use daily and the results are fantastic.  It took me about a week to get the impressive results.  I have very dry skin. My serums and creams were not penetrating into my skin to give me a hydrated look.  Now I can easiy tell when the serums and creams are penetrating.  My skin is much more even in color, hydrated, healthy looking.  I apply the mask work into my skin for a few seconds and leave on for 15 minutes.  Remove  in shower and use a microdermabrasion product to remove dead skin after I rinse off the mask. I use a heavy cream on my skin after my serums to seal in moisture.  The skin on my chest was pebble like and I hated it.  This product has removed that look. That took over a week to change, but wow I can wear lower cut tops now and my skin is radiant!  My hands were looking rough.  My knuckles were so dry even lotion did not help.  I use this on my hands every night, remove with a microdermabrasion product then apply a thick lotion.  Finally my hands look very nice.  I have stocked up on this product, I never want to run out.  I also use the eye treatment, spray toner (use throughout the day to freshen up makeup), body polish and body creams. Sometimes I can get lucky and find this product line in stores; but not very often.  Finally a product line that works!
It's goes on really easy, and only requires a thin layer so it will last a while. Stings at first, but then feels great and your skin will glow. And as the previous reviewer said, it smells great!

This product is amazing. It works great, smells great, is all organic and is about 4x cheaper than any other enzyme peel on the market (because it is half the price and twice the size). You can also get it almost anywhere. It made a huge difference on my skin and I would recommend it to anyone who has acne or a dull, bumpy complexion. The one down side is that it stings quite a bit, but it's supposed to do that. And afterward it feels great.

I'm really happy I tried this moisturizer, it is amazing. At first I didn't think 3oz of this stuff would be enough to last me very long but a little really goes a long way. My skin soaks it right in but you only need a little bit of it. I think I use less a dime-sized amount to cover my entire face. It's not greasy at all and just leaves your skin feeling incredibly soft. The first time I used it at night, I used it before going to bed and when I woke up the next morning, my face was noticeably clearer. It even helped diminish my pimples.

This seems to be a good all-around moisturizer.  I use it at night, as I like my day products to contain an spf.  It sinks in well and leaves my skin feeling very soft and smooth.  It doesn't cause breakouts (which is easy to do with my sensitive skin).  My luck with Alba products has mostly been great with one exception.  The Sea renewal cream was way too oily and harsh on my skin.  Other than that, I've never been disappointed.  If you are looking for gentle, oil-free moisture, this is your golden ticket.

I don't know how I will ever use any other face wash ever again! This cleanser is amazing! It's very light but very effective at removing my makeup (I wear Bare Minerals). Unlike other cleansers, my skin doesn't feel dry and tight after I rinse. Instead, it feels soft and moisturized so I know it's not stripping my own natural oils.The cleanser is clear, with a fantastic scent, that works up into a rich lather. I have not tried the Pineapple Scrub, but when I want some exfoliation, I lather up my face with the cleanser and dab on some plain white table sugar. After some gentle massage, I wash everything off and my skin feels great!I have combo skin with acne around the chin and cheeks and this cleanser never hurts, stings, or irritates my blemishes (unlike a lot of other products). Since my acne is mainly from resting my chin/cheeks on my hands, until that habit stops I will always have breakouts. Luckily, this cleanser works so well and now that my skin feels so good, I don't want to touch my face anymore!

When I bought this I was really going out on a limb. I like to read reviews for all skin care product before purchasing. This cleanser has a surprisingly cooling effect on the skin. Reminds me of a mixture between Noxzema's foaming face wash that was discontinued and the Clean & Clear Morning Burst (which dries my face out beyond belief). I love the smell, and it cleans my Mac foundation off way better than Cetaphil. Great product!

I bought this because exfoliants with small granules were too rough on my dry skin. I got a professional facial to help with my dry skin and they recommended a fruit enzyme peel that will dissolve dry skin without being so rough. Of course they wanted me to purchase an incredibly expensive product, but I decided to do some looking on my own. I settled on this product and have been very pleased. I can use it daily without it being too harsh on my skin and it dissolves all flaky, dry skin on my face. Even using it daily or every other day, the product has lasted a while (bought it in mid-August and still going here at Thanksgiving). It smells pleasant and feels soothing on my skin. Also, I think that Amazon had this listed as a liquid, but in reality it's a thick gel.

column9: Love the smell, how it feels, skin looks refreshed after!
column10: I am usually critical of skin care product that doesn't come from a dermatologist's office.  Mainly because those products and brands can have more active ingredients than store product getting better results.  This stuff is so great! I love the smell, it feels really cool and refreshing on my skin (almost like aloe), and my skin really does look shinier and refreshed after I use it.  Also, it only has to stay on for 5 minutes so it's something I can do more often than masks that require 20-30 minutes.

Love this facial cleanser.  My skin tends to be oily and flaky.  I'm no longer shiny, and I've had no break outs at all since I started using it. this stuff works great however it took almost three weeks to make it to my house. its very tastey and it smells wonderful

column9: Amazing product for what you pay for it.....
column10: I've used this product considerably since I've moved to a different climate.  In this climate I break out along my t-zone, which I never had an issue before, but using this product enables me to help minimize and control the breakouts.  I also notice that this product helps fade away old acne scars.. not completely, but it does help minimize the appearance.  I have combo skin, therefore I only dab it on the affected or broken out areas rather than putting it all over my face because I noticed it did dry out my dry areas.  I also use it everyday on the affected areas without any issues.  I can't answer in terms of pores, but I do feel like the next morning after applying this product my skin tone looks more even.

I have been using this for a few months and love the way it works. The scent is nice and it goes on smooth. I bought to use on my face and started using it on my chest and back. I've noticed that my skin is more clear than it's ever been.

I have sensitive skin so cleansing my face has always been a factor I've always used alba products body washes are great oils are great so why wouldn't I try this well I'm so glad I did because it evens your tone,cleans and smell great all at the same time. column9: It smells great!! It's very mild though so if you have a lot of acne or scarring you may want something else.
column10: I use this product when I want to relax because it smells great but I won't buy it again because it is too mild for my liking.

column9: MADE MY SKIN SUPER OILY THEN BEFORE
column10: SO disappointed! I have oily, mild acne prone, sensitive, combo skin. This product DID NOT absorb into my skin AT ALL. It sat on top of my skin creating a 'slippery' greasy layer. Eww. After about 30 minutes, my skin was extremely oily, shiny & greasy looking. It looked and felt like baby oil on my face! I have oily skin but this product brought MORE excessive oil onto my face even in areas where I normally don't get oily. I don't understand how this is a oil-free moisturizer but yet makes your skin extremely oily. Glad I was able to return it!

I bought this product because I was looking for something more natural for my sensitive skin.  Says its "gentle for all skin types" but it's not.  Literally 2 seconds after I put the first dab on my face it started burning. I could see my skin turning red and getting a rash under it.  I had to wash it off immediately.  The spot that had it does feel softer than the rest of my face, but the burning and rash is SO not worth it.  My second complaint is that it's a gel mask versus a clay mask.  I should have read the ingredients better for that one though.

I love this product.  I have sensitive skin, & this is really gentle & soothing.  I also try to avoid wearing foundation, but this moisturizer wears well under Physician's Formula Organic Wear Foundation.  (I haven't tried it with any other foundation products).  I exfoliate every other day & apply this afterward, as well as after getting out of the shower.  The fragrance isn't too strong, and I love that its oil free, because I have extremely oily skin.  (I obviously wash my face on a regular basis as well in addition to exfoliating.)  This is a hard product to review because people's needs, opinions, & skin types are so different.  I was initially hesitant to pay so much for it, but in comparison to other oil free moisturizers, this one is about the same cost, & isn't full of harsh chemicals, fillers, & other crap that clogs your pores up.  Just my two cents.

It is much richer and it's a bit too rich for my skin. The fragrance is also stronger. I'll stick with green tea & aloe.

This mask smells amazing and does clean my face well.  I didn't give it 5 stars because it did dry out some parts of my already dry skin!  I don't think I would purchase this particular one again but definitely would try another Alba mask.  I LOVE ALBA!!
I have been using this product all month with very little to say about it. Initially it does make your face feel really soft and hydrated, BUT it does not last.. I won't be purchasing this again.

This is the best line of products. It has helped clear up my acne and I've noticed the scars are slowly fading. I use the Aloe & Green Tea during the day and after washing my face before bed I use the Jasmine & Vitamin E cream. Our skin is very important and fragile, take care of it right!

column10: AMAZING!  I love this stuff!  Uncovers glowing beautiful skin everytime!  I use it once a week for a real 'treat' pick me up.  Fabulous product!!!

column9: Not for Sensitive Skin - Read Ingredients First
column10: I love the Alba products because they contain lots of natural ingredients and are a great value for the price, plus I've always had good resutls with them.  I use the sea kelp products and really like them but decided to try something different for the summer, so I ordered the Jasmine moisturizer and the hibiscus facial toner.  The jasmine cream is wonderful and works great on my dry skin but, unfortunately, the hibiscus facial toner caused severe burning to my skin. After I read the entire ingredient listing, I was shocked to find this toner contains sodium hydroxide which is used in such harsh cleaning products as oven and drain cleaners.  I do have sensitive skin which, I am certain, caused the reaction.  I don't think this product is for sensitive skin, but be sure to read the entire ingredient list before you decide to purchase it, and if possible, try a sample of it first.  I went back to the sea kelp facial toner and have had no further problems.

My only problem with this lip balm is that it tastes so good I lick it off! If you like coconut anything you'll love this!I love that it's made with 100% vegetarian ingredients and is never tested on animals. The ingredients are also 82% certified organic, which is a nice plus.

This product moisturizes very nicely. It goes on very smooth and stays on for awhile. I really wanted to love this cream, but the smell is just so overpowering. I was expecting a soft, light scent, but this is just so strong and overpowering that it almost makes you dizzy. The smell does not diminish the longer you wear it; I put the cream on before bed, and woke up the next morning smelling like I had just put it on. It's very unfortunate, in my opinion the smell makes the cream unwearable.

I actually ended up buying this from walmart because I was in need of an oil free moisturizer for my face...BADLY and didn't want to way 4-5 days for my order to process on here. So I purchased it (and I cringed at the thought of spending 15 bucks on a small container of moisturizer), and applied it to my clean face in the morning and before bed. Finally a product in a price range that I can say WoW about!If your looking for a product that delivers positive results that isnt 80 to 100$, I swear this is it. I have combo skin and some light scars around mouth/chin area from acne. The results Ive had from using this is diminished scars (not erased scars), clearer skin. It keeps there appearance down. column9: Alba Toner - great for sensitive skin!
column10: Love this product because I have rosecea on one side of my face and it is gentle enough for that buut strong enough to get rid of any remaining traces of makeup or oil, leaving a nice fresh feeling on the skin. I purchased this product to use during a weight loss program, to eliminate unnessary oils in my body. I am very happy with this alba oil-free moisturizer. At my age "over 50" I wondered how well a moisturizer without oil would work. Surprisingly well. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed. I used it a few times as a body lotion as well; until I found something more practical.
I purchased this product as a Christmas present for my daughter... per her request!  She really likes this moisturizer.  I would highly recommend it.

I have very sensetive skin (and very hard water!) so it's hard for me to find a cleanser that doesn't irritate or dry out my skin. Albas Pinapple face wash is gentle, cleans my face very well and has a wonderful, refreshing pineapple scent to it. A small amount worked into a lather in your hands will do the job. Why only 4 stars? It's VERY thick and needs a little extra time to wash off. I've opened my eyes in the shower a few times thinking this was rinsed clean only to find excess pineapple enzyme wash in my eyes...and it stings! This is the only face wash I've used like that which is very odd. I attribute it to its thick texture and the fact that I have very hard water. Be careful with this! Make sure it's rinsed really really well before you open up your eyeballs. Other than that, it's a great product and my favorite facial cleanser :)

Feels great on my skin. The only thing about it that bothers me at all is the smell. It's not a bad smell and it's not that strong but I'm pretty sensitive to scents. It probably wouldn't bother most people at all but you might want to be aware if you have allergies or are really sensitive to smells.  I only mention it because I suffer from migraines and scents can be a trigger for me. The product works wonderful for my skin and I love the way green tea makes my skin feel so refreshed.
