column10: Wow, this one's a real winner.  I don't usually like to add anything to my brewed beverages, so this morning in the ongoing taste tests I brewed the Latte Macchiato coffee capsule for 23 seconds and did not add milk.  It was quite good, nice and dark and bitter.  This afternoon I made one with the milk, and it's very nice.  I thought perhaps Latte Macchiato had sugar in the capsule, but it doesn't.  I like this one a lot.

I really like Latte in general. I am especially pleased with this one because it is frothy, creamy and delicious, as though I bought it from a Batista! It is the real deal. The separate layers of the latte make the glass mug, I drink from, even more attractive to the eye. It is a bit costly, but that's why I don't drink it everyday since it does require the milk and coffee capsule. Now, instead of stopping at my favorite cafe, all I have to do is insert the capsules in and enjoy my gourmet coffee. My husband tried other flavors and loves them all. I think the machine itself was well-made and makes a great gift!

It is a great product or I would not be ordering it.  I have had coffees in many countries in Europe, Ireland, New Zealand, and Australia and this fits the bill for an international flavor, for my taste buds at least.

This is probably my favorite of the Dolce Gusto capsules. I usually add a little more sugar but thats just me.  I like that you can fool around with the mixes to fine tune it to your own tastes.The only problem I have with this particular product here on amazon is the price, $36 for a 3 pack, who are they kidding? Thats a 40% markup.  Check out the dolce gusto online store instead and save yourself some coin.

This makes a beautiful cup of Latte Macchiato. I first didn't understand why the milk pod/cup was shot into the glass first, then the coffee one, since it looked like the milk is on top. Apparently this is what a macchiato is....a "little mark" in the milk that shows it is not a cafe latte (where the milk is added after the espresso.) I am not really sure what difference it makes flavor-wise to add one before or after the other, but at least I understand it now.The cups for the Nescafe Dolce Gusto indeed make a beautiful serving. It tastes milky...not as watery as I expected it to be...I added a little shave of nutmeg on top, and I am sure something like caramel or chocolate might be even better. I followed the instructions on how much milk to coffee ratio in mine, but I am sure the more you drink these, you may find your personal preference to be slightly different. That is one of the positive things about the brewer, that you can adjust amounts so easily. I did use the included glass to measure, and it may be more difficult to judge amounts in your own cup..that is why I took away one star.

This machine makes some FINE-looking beverages, but it seems that the Nescafe food components are not living up to the fine Krups mechanics.This drink looks barista-quality, and the Krups machine does its job handsomely.  However, it tastes like instant coffee mixed with powdered milk.  Well, I guess that's sorta what it is...."Appearance over taste" seems to be the theme here.

column9: good coffee, milk not so much
column10: The coffee capsule has a nice, full flavor topped with a lovely crema layer.  The milk component, unfortunately, leaves an odd, cloying aftertaste.  Next time I'll buy one of the plain coffees and add my own milk, a cheaper and tastier alternative.  The rising price and smaller selection of capsules for these machines worries me.  Is the Keurig domination of the market driving the Dolce Gustos into oblivion?

column9: My absolute favorite latte of the Dolce Gusto collection of fab drinks!!!!!!!!!!!
column10: I have two Dolce Gusto coffee machines..and am getting ready to buy the latest beauty--from Amazon.com of course!! They are the "great temptors" because they always have all the newest and latest in every category and I can't resist!!! This latte macchiato is the best I have had in this country. Supreme ingredients paired with fifteen bars of pressure in the machine (professional grade) render a true luxury for the palate!!!I can wholeheartedly recommend one of these machines (the coffee machine that starts with a "K" is pitifully lacking in comparison). Then the lovely variety of coffees,hot chocolat--like that cup of rich decadence that you stand in line a mile long for in Paris!!!!Yummmmm. This stuff that I am ranting and raving about is worth your trying...My palate is no "newbie" for I am a graduate of that culinary institute where so many James Beard winners have come from (I am not one of those.... but I have a very educated palate). I hope someone reading this review will join me fot a cup of"jo"....then write a review here and tell what flavor captures your fancy...Can't wait to read the reviews...It's sort of like sharing your secret with someone!!!!!FUN!!!!!!!tha
It's very easy to prepare and it tastes pretty good. I wish it would be a little cheaper, but, what can I do...

OK I admit I am a Starbucks junkie, but my monthly expenditure is out of control. This is really almost as good as what I order at Starbucks, but it is half the price. Plus I can wake up and make it in under a minute without leaving the house. There are five adults in our family, and the coffee maker is the first thing we all rush to in the kitchen. Sometimes there is a line. I like the Cappuccino, but we all like different flavors. Now I wonder if I will maintain my "gold star status" at Starbucks, because I just go on the week-end for my Cinnamon Dolce, and will they still remember my name?! My bank account is much happier though.

These items are awesome.  Delicious, easy to use, and the best prices I have been able to find.  There are a lot of flavors available, and we first ordered the variety pack, in order to try several of them.  I have even set up auto-delivery of my most-used favorites.  Easy-peasy!
This is a really good Latte. I use my own programing and put a little more water than the pre set latte. Either way it is a great cup of coffee

I love, love, love this coffee.  You cannot beat the ease of the lattes.  I simply take one in my travel mug and save a fortune.  The coffee is so good and I am a complete coffee snob.  I also have a variety of syrups to go with it.  I also like the other flavors.  Just wonderful.  You also cannot beat Amazon's price and free delivery by signing up for regular delivery.

column9: Lightly sweetened and Oh so fluffy
column10: I'm not a renown cappuccino explorer but I like my coffee. I always drink mine without any sugar or added flavor, but this Nescafe Dolce Gusto Latte Macchiato is awesome! The only thing I would be better is having more per pack to go around.

column9: Excellent coffee for a home machine!
column10: I have never been a regular coffee drinker and rarely indulged in a latte or cappucino. The local coffee house and Starbucks are just so overpriced, it seemed like an insane daily expense. However, after vowing to reduce my Dr Pepper consumption, yet still needing the caffeine, I bought the Nestle Dolce Gusto machine and a variety of the various coffees for it. After three months I find I am drinking two or three of these per day and have cut my cola habit in half and significantly reduced my sugar intake as well. (Nice bonus there!)The Latte Macchiato is a good one. It's got a simple flavor without being too strong or bitter. The milk doesn't have alot of sugar (no artificial sweeteners). I do add a teaspoon of sugar to the entire drink. I tend to make my latte larger than the portion size suggested on the box - I don't care for really strong coffee. The Vanilla version of this drink is lightly sweetened & flavored - this one is not. You could add a shot of caramel syrup to this to "fancy" it up for guests very easily. I like this one so much I've done Amazon's Subscribe & Save plan with it. Compared the local big box store prices per box, Amazon's prices are about $1.50 cheaper per box!

I am in love with this coffee and coffee machine!  To me it tastes awesome!  I am no longer spending money on Starbucks everyday, I am even considering buying another for my office.  This is my favorite flavor, but because I usually don't like strong coffee, I use more water than the amounts recommended for the capsules.  I have recommended it to all my friends.

column9: DOn't know how to generate those milk bubble.
column10: Maybe the coffee maker isn't suitable. I can't make any milk bubble like the picture on the box. And the taste, is just OK I think.

I LOVE this coffee... I drink at least two cups a day.  When my daughter comes over, it's the first thing she asks for.  I love the fact I can just turn on my machine and two minutes later a great cup of Latte..I just wish they also had a decaf, so I could enjoy it at night!

This is a wonderful coffee, i really enjoy having  a cup or 2 a day. I bought the nescafe dolce gusto single cup coffee maker from HSN and i just love it . wonderful coffee, other ones to try is the cappuccino.

column9: Yummy way to start a day
column10: This is absolutely the best. Elegant, delicious, and a real "wow" factor when you make it for friends!

My favourite coffee is espresso, but sometimes I drink different varieties. This latte macchiato is delicious. From Dolce Gusto i think these capsules are my favourite. Thanks to Amazon for the fast an free delivery on 3-packs set, nobody offers free shipping on this item, only Amazon!
The best coffee ever. Thank you amazon for saving my time, by delivering this product strait to out home every month. I would recommend to all coffee lover to purchase dolce gusto machine and coffee.
Some of the best at home espresso I've had...  and I've tried several other brands/espresso machines.  The milk gets frothy with no mess, and the espresso tastes fresh.  This stuff is great!

Truly bestter tasting than anything StarBucks could make even on their best day. I have had all the flavors offered by the Nescafe Machine and this is wonderful. Matter of fact when I'm done with my review I will be ordering more...along with the other Nescafe pods!

Initially, I was concerned about the powdered milk more than anything.  Happily, the concern was unfounded.  The Macchiato is delicious.  The coffee is strong, the milk slightly sweet.  The whole drink is wonderfully frothy.  My preference, when I have a fancy coffee drink, is for something on the sweet side.  Therefore, I add a little simple syrup of sugar to the bottom of the cup before brewing.  It's great.

I gave four starts because I love how this machine offers the ability for milk capsules to be added to your coffee drinks. The taste was fair to good, and did help smooth out the flavors of the coffees. In general, I like coffee black but I also enjoy cappuccino, but found that these capsules helped mask some of the dry, tasteless coffees.

Another great flavor from Nescafe Dolce Gusto - I really enjoyed this drink! As others, it was really easy to make, and also lighter on the calories! You do get the 8 servings instead of the 16 because of the milk capsules, but I think it was worth it. I love vanilla lattes, so I actually added some vanilla extract to the brewed cup, and it was perfect!

This flavor is definitely my favorite of the bunch. Contrary to the instructions, I prefer brewing the milk FIRST and then adding the coffee (I know it shouldn't taste better that way, but I assure you it does). I also typically let the coffee run through a little longer than recommended and do not put in quite as much milk as the instructions -- yummy! The amount of foam on top is very pleasant, and the flavor is not overly sweet. Very balanced. For 90 calories a serving, this is a winner!5/5

My favorite Starbucks drink is the caramel Macchiato but I hate the cost and even more the calories! This drink gives me my fix at home for a quarter of the price and with only 90 calories (I do throw a small shot of both sugar free vanilla and caramel syrup in there). In sum maybe not as good as the full fat/sugar version I used to get at Starbucks but a pretty darn close second that I feel good about drinking!

What a great tasting Latte.  Put the milk cup in first and watch carefully...you have to stop the machine on your own when you think you've added enough milk, then put the coffee cup in and add just enough to your liking and *poof* perfection.  One of the best Latte's I've ever had.  Why only 4 stars?  Price.  I think the price is a bit steep for all of the Nescfe Dolce coffees.  I realize that you pay more at specialty coffee shops, but I think that the price is to steep and they aren't readily available except for on Amazon.

column9: Nice with a pump of syrup, if you like milk based coffee drinks
column10: I'm not a big fan of heavy milk based coffee drinks, but this was nice with a pump of Torani Syrup, Raspberry, 25.4-Ounce Bottle (Pack of 3). I tried it twice made per the directions, but since I'm not a huge fan of milk, for the third drink (in two days!) I reduced the milk and increased the coffee to find a balance of flavors that I enjoy.With that in mind, I still feel that the Nescafe Dolce Gusto Espresso, 16-Servings (Pack of 3) capsules combined with fresh frothed milk rather than the included milk capsule makes a better drink so that is my reason for knocking a star.

column9: Perfect Combination of Coffee & Milk; Not too Sweet
column10: Wow! All that I can say is that on first taste of the macchiato that comes out of the Dolce Gusto machine, "I'm hooked!" It avoids all of the extremes that a poorly made macchiato falls into. It is not too sweet; nor is it bitter. Not too much milk and the coffee is not overpowering. It is the perfect early afternoon light coffee drink. I actually prefer this one to Starbuck's version because it is a little less sweet.The best part in my opinion, is that you can slightly customize your beverage, a little more milk for a lighter drink...or a little more coffee for a bolder drink. Fine tune your beverage to your liking (But be careful, too much of the coffee pod and the drink becomes bitter). Don't get me wrong, you could probably do better and fine-tune a little more if you drew a shot of fresh roasted, fresh ground espresso and made your own. But I have certaintly tasted much worse (and few better) macchiatos.

column9: Order another selection without the milk capsules
column10: Though this is a tasty coffee, it's not worth the price to me for 8 coffee and 8 milk capsules. Choose another coffee-only flavor and add your own milk (I microwave the milk while I'm brewing the coffee). You'll still have the foam but twice the servings.

Since we cannot assign half star ratings, I have to say I would give this product a 2.5 which rounds to 3 stars.  This is probably one of my least favorite of the available flavors available for the Dolce Gusto coffee machine.  I personally am not a "frou-frou" coffee/latte expert by any means, so my rating is based on my own personal experience with just this product.  I actually prefer my coffee served black, with no sugar, creamer/milk, so I am probably a little more biased when it comes to rating something like this.I have to agree with another reviewer who said this coffee looks better than it tastes.  I mentioned in a review of another flavor that I don't care too much for the milk, and I think that may be what primarily affects my opinion of this particular flavor; I find it too has an aftertaste and even a powder-like feel.  I do not feel that the available hot chocolate version suffered from this as much.

Of all of the Dolce Gusto flavors,this has received the best comments from our guests. However, the comments have not been overwhelmingly positive. Most have been "it's not BAD", which is less than the response I would like from a product I make for my friends and family.  We won't buy more.
The shipment was very fast. I had the product at my house 2 days after i ordered it. The latte is very good.

I enjoy the flavor of this product very much. I almost never get any sort of flavored coffee from Starbucks, I'm typically a regular coffee guy.  I've seen the light and I'm enjoying my Dolche Gusto machine almost every night.This is probably my 3rd favorite flavor. Cappuccino and Choochino beat it out but this one tastes VERY similar to the Cappuccino so it's a tough call. Try one, you'll probably like it.  The downside is the expense, you're talking about $1 a drink, not to mention the price of the machine.  That's pretty steep for a homemade coffee drink IMO.

column9: Good, Frothy, but Watch the Water
column10: Of all the Dolce Gusto coffee drinks I've tried, this was probably my least favorite. It's still a good drink, but every time I make it, it feels a little weaker than I think it should be.  My advice is to be careful with how long you let it steam through. The caveat I'd give my own review though is that I like strong coffee and a latte is by definition made with a lot of milk.

column9: Familiar Like the Girl Next Door: Latte Macchiato Meets a Delicious Need
column10: My Nescafe Dolce Gusto Latte Macchiato was born on my counter, not royal, nor so humble that I would not enjoy her company. Finding companionship with wine glasses, she smiled at me, and together, we ran through the morning with celebration of sugar, caffeine and artificial milk. It lacked the superb richness of a true, cafe-birthed Latte Macchiato, but brought me a plebeian convenience, like a girl next door's beauty and familiarity.The process for her creation was three-step. First, the mere heating of the machine. Second, the insertion of the milk-foam capsule and pulling hot water through it. Third, and lastly, inserting the espresso-like coffee capsule, and likewise pulling it.I can, and often do, make a more sophisticated latte macchiato, but the time it takes, though worth it, is not always available. I enjoyed tasting this drink, knowing fully what it could be, but accepting it as it was.--Brockeim

column9: Not a Starbucks Caramel Macchiato just an idiot proof "latte"
column10: First of all, the reviewer who said if you like Starbucks Caramel Macchiato thinks this is close, they should have their palate tested as the drink at the chain has syrup flavoring and CARAMEL sauce all over the top of WHIPPED CREAM.  This however, is a powdered milk that heats to liquid with a weakish "espresso" added.  If you throw a 1/4 tsp of raw sugar in it you might have a bit of comparison but otherwise no.This said, by far my favorite of all of the drinks that are available for this machine (sans the mocha as I have yet to try that one).  It's barely better than the cappucino though, with this machine you get what you can buy from Nestle.  The manufacturer would do well to make the Nespresso coffee available for these as the quality of the espresso roast is far better in those bar coded pods.That said, it's all taste.  Machine is only as good as the coffee and the bottom line is that I normally enjoy an americano (real one that is) and this "latte" does the job in the morning IF I drink two.

I bought the Dolce Gusto machine along with the Latte Machiato capsules. I thought the drink tasted horrible. The milk was too sweet. I can't quite pinpoint the exact taste, but is wasn't like anything I had tasted before. I really believe it came from the milk capsule & not the coffee capsule.

column9: Just do not like the milk pods
column10: I've come to that conclusion. I don't know whether it's the milk itself or the plastic container which influences it, but the milk pods just make the coffee untasty to me.  This was was heavily milk-laden, and so did not set well with me.

Everyone's tastes are different. With that said, I would definitely recommend trying these first. I tried Nescafe Latte Machiatto pods (along with some other flavors) in the machine I bought that uses these pods. Really wanted to like them but they were AWFUL. Bitter, synthetic--like something from a vending machine. The Dolce Gusto espresso/cappuccino/latte maker has been returned to Amazon; unfortunately, the pods are a grocery item so not eligible for return. I have two boxes--50 dollars' worth--of the cappuccino pods sitting in the box they arrived in--feel like I put fifty bucks into my office shredder. Bottom line is, should have tried them before ordering any equipment/pods off the internet. Save your cash--try them first!

I was very excited to try the latte.  Unfortunately, I was very disappointed.  It tasted like no other Latte I have gotten before and that is not a good thing.  I have had my share of great lattes and ones not so good.  I was very unimpressed with the taste.  I have noticed that other reviewers seem to like the taste.  Perhaps the directions are off and I should try to experiment a little bit with the water amount that is put in or maybe adding less of the milk.  It seems that the instructions have you put in a lot of milk compared to the coffee.

column9: Too Sweet, Too Watery, tastes like a gas station beverage
column10: Length:: 2:42 MinsTrust me, I want to love this coffee. The machine is so easy to use/clean. But the coffee is watery, too sweet and just not very good. Take a look at the nutritional contents as well: 4g of Fat, 9g of Sugar, etc... Ouch...See video for demo/review.
Very good tea for the price, the jasmine is not too overpowering and the quality of the leaves are good. The packaging is like that of teavana.
DAB Nutrition sent chips that had already been expired for two days when shipped.  They must buy these cheap and resell them.  They are off my trusted seller list.

I ordered this stuff on Aug 6 and it was shipped to me this morning Aug 11. And when i opened the box. it's said it's expired on AUG 11.Then i think about the cost 45 cents per pack? at least it's cheaper than my company snack bar (50 cents per pack)...dang!!!i just bought this stuff cuz i want free shipping from Amazon.con...at the end i end up sharing these with my co-worker before it will be expired tomorrow.....bad bad

This item would be ok if it wasn't delivered with 4 days till it was expired. I got it for people at work, not to give in 1 daybut what choice did I have, when it expired in 4 days. Oh did I say I got it on a Friday Night and don't go back to work till Monday. So now it's 2 days. No more.

This product would have been great, if it weren't for the fact that the chips were delivered on July 7th and they all have expiration dates of July 14th. I ordered these as office snacks for clients and there is no way that we can consume all 50 in one week! Thanks for sending me almost expired food, Amazon and DAB Nutrition.

column9: WOW - finally, my favorite potato chip flavor... HEALTHY STYLE!
column10: I must say that I was hesitant at first to try these - in this flavor... Salt & Vinegar style chips are my all time favorite! But I was not disappointed in the least! These "crisps" were spot on - all the crunch and texture I expected from a potato chip - and an explosion of flavor in my mouth from the first bite! Now I can have my favorite chips the healthy way! Way to go Medifit!

High quality product and having four 32 oz containers works perfectly.  If one reads about Canola oil, essentially, there is no difference between brands.  Thus this product is perfect in terms of price and taste.  Highly recommend.  Additionally, it is a kosher product making it great for passover potato pancakes.

I use anchovy paste in place of added salt in most dishes I cook. I also smear it on a slice of good bread and enjoy it straight. It lasts forever due to the high salt content with only an occasional olive oil topping (sparingly). Very strong anchovy taste even if salty.

this was a pleasant surprise to have the awesome texture of licorice with such a strong peach flavor. I was very satisfied with the taste and it surprisingly did not melt during shipment, great product!

It took two sticks of honey to sweeten a bitter black tea. I prefer the Ahava honey sticks to these. They are sweeter, and you don't have to use as many. Aside from that, the flavor was excellent once I used enough.

I am so happy to find an orange flavored sugar free drink mix that is made with Splenda.  I do not drink anything made with aspertame, due to headaches it causes--plus that upsets my stomach.This tastes a lot like the orange flavored crystal light or sugar free Tang, just as I said, it is made with Splenda.  I like it as a drink, and it is also good with milk, vanilla protein powder and ice in a blender for a sugar free Orange Julius type smoothie.  Yum!!!

column9: Tastes like Tang, without the calories, sugar or carbs!
column10: I've cut high sugar, high calorie drinks from my diet but still enjoy the taste of fruit juices and soda pop.I used to enjoy "Tang" but it's a calorie bomb so I've avoided it.Lo' and behold, along comes the 4C "Totally Light 2 Go" packets. I enjoy the other varieties too but the "Morning Orange" flavor tastes surprisingly like Tang, though a bit less artificial and more like real orange juice than Tang.Highly recommended!

After trying many orange flavored water additives, I find that the 4C product has just the right taste that I am looking for in a morning orange beverage.  It isn't too sweet or overpowering, and it has no lingering aftertaste.  I find that it works better for me if diluted in a 20oz or 24oz bottle instead of a 16.9oz bottle.

column9: totally light to go / Morning orange
column10: I love this flavor the best of the totally light drinks. I can use spenda as, opposed to aspertane which gives me headaches. I'm glad amazon carries it as here only Price Chopper store carries it and they are often out and also, its nice to have it delivered to my door.

I am new to Quinoa, but have seen it in bulk in the stores for awhile. I just never knew what to do with it.  I love the new flavored quinoas, especially the Toasted Sesame Ginger and the Mediterranean.  And they are gluten free, which is big in my family.  Even my 5 year old can't get enough of it.  Does it come in bigger sizes?
I am not sure what the previous reviewer was tasting but this flavored Quinoa was fantastic!  I added some dried cranberries to it after cooking and was well received by my whole family.

I love quinoa, so I was excited to try these flavored Roland Quinoa mixes for quick, easy side dishes.  I bought 3 varieties and tried the Mediterranean last night.  I was so disappointed!  It had a peculiar, almost medicinal taste. It was inedible. I hope the Black Bean and the Garlic flavors are a lot better. . .

This Tandoori BBQ Chicken mix is very good.We received a lot of compliments on this recipe when we grilled it last summer and our guests went out of their way to say "wow", that's good... what recipe is that?  It's very flavorful and a little spicy but not hot or anything.We originally found Shan Tandoori spice mix at a tiny 4 table restaurant/grocery store for $1.99 when the owner happened to stock it for a while.  I went back to get more but they quickly ran out so I'm glad to find it here also.  There are literally several hundred other interesting spice mixes like this from overseas once you know where to look.Maybe Amazon can work with more vendors on this type of product since Shan Tandoori mix sells online for $1.25 at 'America's largest online India Grocer'.  Amazon has them as a partner already so I figured it's ok to mention there's hundreds of other recipes to try that aren't listed here yet.Most of these recipes call for lots of fresh vegetables such as garlic, tomatoes, cilantro, fresh ginger, etc.  Over the next few weeks we'll try some of the other variations....Aaloo Bhaji Curry MixChappli Kabab MasalaTandoori Chicken BBQBombay Biryani MasalaDopiaza / Stew CurryMaesri Masaman CurryTikka Seekh Kabab BBQParampara Prawn Masala

Well heart issues is forcing me to eat asalt  reduced (a lot reduced) diet.  And while I really hate most of the products made  as a substitute for salt, this product with  garlic and herbs is actually pretty good.  I especially like it sprinkled on steaks and chops when grilling.  It is a lot more convenient to have everything pre-mixed than to have all these spices/herbs on hand and then to mix these all up for myself; and the price here can't be beat.I sprinkle some on just before putting the meat on the grill and then I sprinkle on some more  just before eating.  No it really doesn't replace salt and as far as I'm concerned nothing can beat a lovely grilled steak with a light sprinkling of salt, but since I want to save my allowable salt mgs for other things, then this is a pretty good replacement.  I use it to flavor other things too, so for the price it is very versatile.  Just be a bit careful not to use too much separate pepper as this product  seems to rely heavy on pepper to pique the taste buds.In this product you will find:GarlicOnionBlack PepperParsleyBayMarjoramOreganoCayenne PepperCorianderCuminMustardRosemaryCelery SeedCarrotOrange Peel]andSpice Extracts

column4: FOREVER student of Life:D "Always learning co...
column10: I love pasta glad I saw there is Brown Rice! I don't have wheat anymore! That's a good thing Think I've lost weight cus I;'ve changed the foods I eat now :D I break them up to small pieces in the bag! Use my knee to snap in half then half again! Wish I had done this before with other Spaghetti, makes it soooo much easier! I don't have tomatoes anymore! sometimes I'll put Tahini Roland Tahini (Pure ground  Sesame seed), 16-Ounce can (Pack of 4) And Almond Butter Almond Butter, 12 oz. YUM!

I have used other brown rice pasta products and loved them......this is no exception.  I love the taste and texture and to know how healthy it is makes me very happy.  I can also serve this product to my diabetic friends when they come to dinner.  I buy nothing but brown rice (and sometimes whole grain) pasta.  With brown rice pasta you would never know you weren't eating fresh pasta...I get rave reviews when I serve it!

This pasta is so good.  I have served it several times to non-GF guests and no one can tell that it's gluten free.  Do keep in mind though that it is only 12 oz (the non-organic comes in a 16 oz bag).  For my family of four (2 being small children), one bag is barely enough to feed us all.

I used to eat a lot of Tinkyada pasta until I read that rice grown in the US South may contain high levels of arsenic. According to Tinkyada, their rice is grown in Arkansas. I emailed them to find out if they had tested their rice for arsenic.  I never received a reply.  Their website does not address the issue either.  Until they print assurances that their rice is safe, I plan to avoid all their products.Lundberg rice, which is grown in California, is safe from arsenic according to the company.
Love the product, but the price is now over $41.00??? I purchased this for $33.63 in February! What's going on Tinkyada?

column9: Excellent Wheat/Gluten Free Alternative (Egg Free Too)
column10: This is a tasty alternative for gluten sensitive people.  Even my son with no sensitivities enjoys these noodles....Best ever purchased...
This is by far the best gluten free pasta. Tastes great and is as close to regular wheat spaghetti as you can get! Cooks perfect every time.

column9: Oh my goodness-best non-wheat pasta ever!!!
column10: I ordered these because of all the reviews here on amazon, and everyone was right: these really are delicious. They beat other whole grain noodles, including whole wheat noodles, by a mile. The texture is a bit denser and chewier than regular noodles, but still wonderful--not gummy or rubbery. (My husband actually prefers their texture to regular noodles, while I find them equally good.) And there's no powerful "healthy" flavor to throw off your recipes. Excellent. Highly recommended!

column9: Amazed at the smooth texture!  Delicious!
column10: I bought this on a whim (we're not gluten free). Sat in the pantry for months and decided to either throw it away or try it. OMG!  Its delicious!  And I'm a total pasta snob.  I don't think kids or husbands would know it wasn't "real" pasta!  I'm cleaning house and replacing all the traditional pasta with this!!!!!
I am very happy with this product, Tinkyada puts out with good pasta, I also like Mrs. Leepers but Amazon hasn't had it for a while now.  I highly recommend this product.

We have been using this brand of pasta for over a year now and absolutely love it.  It does not taste funny as the whole wheat pastas do, nor does it have any strange chewiness. column9: Best Turkey Jerky that I've tried
column10: I've tried some options on amazon.com such as Jack Link's Turkey Jerky and Turkey Nuggets, Snackmasters Range Brown Turkey Jerky, Golden Valley Natural Turkey Jerky, among others from various retail outlets. Totally, I have had ~7 different brands of turkey jerky and ~8 of the beef variety .  Among turkey, Oberto is my favorite by far.Given that jerky is made by a dehydration process, dryness is inherent to jerky as a food.  Also, turkey is a dryer meat than beef (the most common jerky) and I've found turkey jerky to be, on average, dryer than beef jerky.  I prefer my jerky relatively moist.Oberto Turkey Jerky is by far the most moist jerky I've had (aside from the Oberto Pork brand). The package usually has very large strips that hold their water content for greater lengths of time.  The other brands I've tried are broken into small pieces and are very chewy & dry in comparison.  Another key aspect is the flavoring.  This product is well-flavored whereas other products often taste like proteinated cardboard.  For a teriyaki flavor, Oberto doesn't overdo on salt either and the entire product is natural and less processed.Overview:Pros- Moist, Tastey, Natural & Minimally ProcessedCons- Oberto Turkey only comes in TeriyakiBottom Line: If you want Turkey Jerky and don't mind teriyaki, this is probably the best, easily obtainable product out there.

I'm a really big fan of the Jack Link's peppered beef jerky, but it can be hit or miss with the freshness. This stuff was pretty good though. I think the Jack Link's has a better taste due to more flavourings (the secret is in the soy sauce they use, I suspect) where this has a cleaner beef taste which some might like more.I think the beef strips in this brand are a bit too thick, but maybe that's just me.
For me: too sweet. It's like eating candied meat. Not the savory item I was hoping for! I'd skip this option and go for original.
Oberto probably makes one of the BEST beef jerkey products. The packaging keeps it very flavorful and the Teriyaki is definitely my husband's favorite jerkey!

To me, the flavor was a little overwhelming. There was no turkey flavor. Just the sweetness of the Teriyaki. I think 7 grams of sugar in a 1-ounce serving (1/3 of a package) seems like a lot. And look at the list of ingredients: Brown sugar is the #2 ingredient, sugar is the #4 ingredient, and pineapple juice concentrate is the #7 ingredient. That's quite a bit of sweetness. Too much sweetness for me.

Only use 1/2 the bag at a time.  I originally used the entire bag and after soaking the beans overnight and starting to boil them, the expanded so much that there was not enough room in the pot I used for them to heat/cook properly.2.  After cooking, draining and running the beans through the food processor I will mash the beans through a fine mesh strainer to remove the bean skins and produce a finer paste.  I did not care for the bean skins in my first attempt.3.  Use a cheesecloth or several paper towels to strain any additional water that may remain in the beans after mashing them through the strainer.  The first batch had too much moisture.Overall, these worked well and are much more cost effective than purchasing pre-made red bean paste.

column9: My picky kids love them, I love the veggies.

If we've dined out and they didn't get a lot of veggies I give them a "Peter Rabbit" for bedtime snack.  If I'm just adding a little something to their lunch box I'll throw in a Mashup. column9: Bob, could you PLEASE use a FINER grind?????
column10: I have been baking gluten-free on a daily basis for approximately 3 years.  Believe me when I say that I have tried just about every brand of Brown Rice Flour there is.  Here is the skinny:If you want a very tender, melt in your mouth baked good that is reminiscent of your wheat flour days, use Authentic Foods Brown Rice Flour.  Their BRF is so fine that it is almost silky.  If you bake as much as I do, and want to use Authentic Foods BRF for everything, you should look into getting a second job.  That stuff is PRICEY.If you don't want to get a second job, Bob's Red Mill BRF is the way to go, but your baked good will suffer a bit due to the sandy, gritty texture of this flour.  Through trial and error, you will find that it works fine for some recipes, but others may seen a bit more gritty and crumbly.  Processing this BRF in the Cuisinart or blender doesn't seem to help.  So, I plan to beg Bob to choose a finer grind for the BRF his company produces.  PLEASE.  Pretty please?  I would love you forever.

We like the brown rice flour as we feel we get a little nutrition with it.  Rice flour browns and crisps nicely.  It makes a fabulous fried chicken and pancakes are crisp on the outside and tender on the inside.  Being gluten-free is not such a bad thing.  Some things even taste better.

column9: the answer to being allergic to wheat
column10: I don't know what they did to wheat. I have been eating bread for over 60 years and love it. All of a sudden I started having trouble breathing and spent nearly $5000 on doctors and drugs. column9: It all comes down to reading the ingredient label.
column10: Selecting a healthy dog food is just like selecting healthy food for yourself:  You have to read the label.  You're want specifically named sources of protein like "chicken" or "chicken meal" and  you do not want things like "meat byproduct."  You also want to avoid corn or soy, which is used as a filler to make the volume of the dog food appear greater to the human feeding the dog, but since dogs can't digest corn, it comes out the other end at best and causes digestive tract problems at worst.  Neither the "Holistic"label nor the relatively high price is what makes this dog food a good dog food.  It comes down to the ingredients:Lamb Meal, Ground Brown Rice, Ground White Rice, Chicken Fat (Preserved with Natural Mixed Tocopherols), Oatmeal, Dried Beet Pulp, Flaxseed, Dried Egg Product, Carrots, Sun-Cured Alfalfa, Peas, Potassium Chloride, Organic Quinoa, Apples, Blueberries, Cranberries, Dried Kelp, Taurine, Yucca Schidigera Extract, DL-Methionine, Vitamins [Beta-Carotene, Vitamin A Supplement, Vitamin D3 Supplement, Vitamin E Supplement, Riboflavin Supplement, Vitamin B12 Supplement, d-Calcium Pantothenate, Niacin Supplement, Pyridoxine Hydrochloride, Thiamine Mononitrate, Folic Acid, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Biotin], Minerals [Polysaccharide Complexes of Zinc, Iron, Manganese and Copper, Cobalt Carbonate, Potassium Iodate, Sodium Selenite], Choline Chloride, Lecithin, Rosemary Extract, Glucosamine Hydrochloride, Inulin, Dried Lactobacillus acidophilus, Lactobacillus casei, Enterococcus faecium, Bacillus subtilis, Bacillus licheniformis, Aspergillus oryzae and Aspergillus niger Fermentation Products, Mixed Tocopherols (a natural preservative).Hey, if I wasn't a vegetarian I may even consider eating this stuff (don't try this at home, kids).I have two dogs: a 65 lb. senior husky and a 25 lb. young jack russell mix.  I admit, this food is expensive compared to grocery store brands BUT I have found that it is worth it because it cuts expenses in the long run.  For example:  (1) You feed less.  My husky eats about 2.25 cups a day of this food.  If we were to feed her one of the vet brands or grocery brands she would need to eat almost twice that much.  (2) Your dogs will have fewer health problems to treat.  When my jack russell mix started having runny, bloody stools, the vet  diagnosed him with colitis and put him on a prescription vet brand dog food, the first ingredient of which was CORN.  When that didn't work, she continued him on the diet and prescribed medication.  I suspected he may have a corn allergy so I switched him to the chicken formula Holistic Select.  Within 24 hours my dog returned to solid, blood-free stool. I never gave him the medication and he switched vets after that.  (3) This food was not subject to the recall of bad food that sickened so many dogs a few years ago.It is worth noting that this dog food is not grain free, which many dogs benefit from.  For that I recommend Innova Evo, which is what I used to feed my husky when she was younger and more active.  This has fewer calories for the more sedentary pup she's become.

I want to be clear, I am not speaking of nor picking on just this one product, but like most dog foods out there that have these lovely names, "Holistic",'Natural','Healthy',etc,there is usually nothing to back up claims of being healthier nor of better quality than the less expensive brands. The ingredients often are the same as most other dog foods, comprised of substances of the poorest quality, including ingredients that are not even considered food.'Made with chicken' can mean as low as 3% chicken legally. Generally, only meats totally unable to be used for any other purpose at all are added to dog foods, and often includes feces, talons, feathers, hide, teeth, tumors and worse. Many of these poor grade and disgusting 'meats' are also then soaked in chemicals before being added to dog foods, the FDA's great idea to keep the meat  from actually being used in 'people' food--but I doubt you want your dog's food soaked in chemicals. People truly love their pets, and for some of us, it's all the family we have or certainly the ones that seem to understand us best. I'm working on a recipe that will work well for my dogs, human-grade. In days gone by, we raised our 'mutts' often on just left over table scraps and they flourished... because they were getting 'people grade' food. If you use canned dog food, smell the opened, refrigerated can on day 2,3 or 4--if it smells good, you will know. If not it's rancid--bad, spoiled, musty. We feed organic dog food now, not much more $$ but I don't 'trust' any of them,& try to make sure it's not from China or anywhere but the USA, and I keep an eye on ingredients and smell regularly, and I rotate. Even those with added supplements and vitamins may use those that are useless, poor quality that are not absorbed.Manufacturers preserve with either synthetic or "natural" preservatives. Synthetic preservatives include butylated hydroxyanisole (BHA) and butylated hydroxytoluene (BHT), propyl gallate, propylene glycol (also used as a less-toxic version of automotive antifreeze), and ethoxyquin. There is little information documenting their toxicity, safety, interactions, or chronic use in pet foods that may be eaten every day for the life of the animal. Propylene glycol was banned in cat food because it causes anemia in cats, but it is still allowed in dog food.Potentially cancer-causing agents such as BHT or BHA, and ethoxyquin is permitted at some levels. The use of these chemicals in pet foods has not been thoroughly studied, and long term build-up of these agents may ultimately be very harmful. July 1997 the FDA's Center for Veterinary Medicine requested that manufacturers voluntarily reduce in half the maximum level of ethoxyquin by half. Some pet food critics and veterinarians believe that ethoxyquin is a major cause of disease, skin problems, and infertility in dogs. Hey, who loves my pets more, me or these companies? Hmmm?

column10: I'll apologize in advance for the length of this review, but it's more of a story than a review.After adopting a five-year-old Golden Retriever last year, I had to spend a few hundred dollars to have her teeth professionally cleaned. I committed to buying several of these while they were on sale.The only downside to these Busy Bones is that they get really sticky when wet.  Your dog's paws and legs WILL be sticky after chewing on one of these, so be prepared.  Either let them do it outside or plan on wiping their legs afterwards.  (It's a small price to pay, though.)I really feel for the guy with the corgi whose dog almost choked when the Busy Bone became lodged (see review titled, "Dangerous Choking Hazard").
