In the past I have used other yeasts with good success.Recently I tried a different brand from Amazon with TERRIBLE results.NOW I have THIS old-time brand which WORKS EVERY TIME.
Just as I had hoped it would be. Buying this here is such a better buy than the grocery store.
This item is the best for bread machines. Quick and efficient rise. If you need to make a bread I advise you to use unbleached flour and this brand yeast!
Good value for the price - just need to properly store it (sealed containers - avoid freeze/thaw cycles).
Love it use it in most all my cooking of bread bisquits and the such.Thank youInstant Yeast (Fleischmanns) 1lb - 2 PACK

I'm not going to tell you what kind of yeast to buy, although I prefer Red Star.  I'm looking for VALUE and great results.  First, let's talk about VALUE.  I purchased two (2) 16 Ounce vacuum packed bags of the Fleishmann's at Sam's Club for $4.20 with Free Shipping.  (That's a joke, - I drove it home!)With regard to storage, I store my yeast in FoodSaver vacuum packed ball jars in my freezer!  I'm not sure if it correct, but it works for me. (Your mileage may vary!)  But, for $2.10 a pound, you could keep this yeast under your pillow and still come out ahead!Did you ever wonder WHY Sam's Club NEVER comes up in a Google search?  Dah?Secondly, I've had GREAT results with it, regardless of my love and devotion to Red Star.  Peter Reinhart's Artisan Bread's Every Day also helped.  I have many many books on bread and bread baking and there is NONE better.  Now, European artisan purests might argue with me, - please don't.  I'm simply talking about the best bread that I've ever baked!  I could do better, but my one (1) hour in the kitchen compared to two days of toil and devoted European love wins for me.  If you're serious about your bread baking, buy the book or simply continue to bury your head in the sand.There is simply NOT enough time in my life to solve everyone's problems, but I've tried to help!Fleishmann's gets 5 Stars from me.

Tried on a very delicate recipe and I either blew it or did not used it properly. Therefore I am giving it 3 Stars. For some reason that familiar smell that comes when you mix the yeast in perfectly warm water and reassures you that everything is fine, was absent this time. I was trying to make, the closest I can describe it, is a doughnut that is deep fried and that the batter is supposed to be compliant for this purpose. Have to note that the instructions for this creation did not call for Instant Yeast but upon reading about its uses I felt that it could be interchangeable if used in the right amounts. I am sure it was human error so for now I am only giving it 3.5 Stars and hopefully will use it again to determine if in making a tasty bread it might work better. Yes, I have been known to assigned fault to  products such as yeast so I do not look half as bad in the kitchen. Still, for now, I can only recommend a serious understanding of this type of yeast before purchasing. The expiration date was okey but something about that particular smell eluded me. Please don't tell me it was my sinus because I do not recall having this problem at all! 3.5 Stars!

If you are looking for yeast that does yeast things, this yeast is exactly sufficient for any yeast-based products you will be using yeast for.The yeast comes in a bag.  The yeast bag is exactly sufficient for housing the yeast that you will be using for yeast-based products.
as always it was great doing buisness with them. The product was sent fast and in perfect condition.

column9: If I could give this zero stars, I would.
column10: I was very excited to find this product. It is suppose to be the same yeast as in the "Rapid Rise" and the product for bread machines. I used the exact amount for my recipe: a typical 1/4 ounce strip envelope equals 2 1/4 teaspoons. The end result was a baked product that tasted foul. I contacted Fleishmann's Company the next morning. I was told that they would replace the two pounds of yeast I had purchased with a (three envelope strip with a total of 3/4 ounces). When I pointed out that this did not seem reasonable, they said they would replace the two pounds of Fleishmann's yeast with a coupon for a 4-oz glass jar, and pointed out that I had complained about another product from their company in the past. I was further told that I would not have any future defective products compensated for. (?) This is not a company that stands behind their products, and apparently they are not committed to a reasonable level of quality control.

Hi. My name is Mojito Joe, but you can call me Mojo.  I think these treats are YUMMERS! My mom buys these treats and a whole bunch of kitty crunchies for me and my buds.  We like most all the flavors 'cept salmon.  Salmon makes some of us sick.  Mom says it's cause of the dye it it.  Tygrr says it sure makes him want to dye cause it made him frow up all day.  It was icky.  I like all the crunchy ones but not the ones that are like pencil erasers.  One day mom was cooking dinner and going into the little room where she keep food and all of our cat food and I snuck in while she wasn't looking and found the crunchies and chewed open one of the bags and it was so much fun!  She didn't even get mad! Just picked me up and said I shouldn't do that.  That's why I love my mom so much, she gives me cuddles and crunchies and yummers for foods.

My cats, as all cats are, are very picky.  Three have food allergies so I have to be careful with what they eat.  They love all of Purina Friskies Crunchy Treats variaties.  I wish Purina would make larger package size.

column9: My cats are party mix addicts!
column10: My cats love all the purina friskies party mix flavors. I purchase them often and in bulk. This price is ok and delivery is fairly quick. All in all, good product, delivery time and seller

All 3 of my cats love these! I buy lots of treats and some of them they just won't even eat. Or one likes them and the other two don't or whatever...but all 3 of my kitties go crazy over these! My mom's cat loves them, too. Highly recommended for fussy kitties!
Diarrhea is what my cat got from eating Purina Friskies Party Mix Cheezy Craze Crunch. I will not feed him this again.
These are highly addicting to our cats as they are always wanting more..very expensive for what you get...works out to about 8-11 dollars per pound..there are a lot of better alternatives.

If you like seaweed snacks and if you like wasabe, this is the right combination for you.  Once you place it in your mouth, the wasabe gives you a kick immediately.  Tasty.We have a Trader's Joe close to our house, this sells for a buck.

I've been addicted to these lately, even got some odd stares one day when I cleared the whole shelf of these little bags into my cart at Trader Joes. Its the prefect thing to fight a mid afternoon craving while still having tons of flavor. I tried Annie Chungs once and was amazed how bland they were compared to these.

column9: Like licking a dirty fish tank
column10: My wife bought these for me because she knows I love wasabi and will eat just about anything coated with it.  There was almost no wasabi taste to the two chips I tried (I threw the rest out).  The only taste I got was a strong nasty "fishy" taste.  Now I'm not one of those nuts who orders fish in a restaurant and then complains about it tasting like fish (gasp).  These tasted like fish that is spoiled, hence my title.  Two cans of diet pepsi and I can't get the awful taste off of my poor tongue.  On the plus side, the guys at work got a good laugh out of my misfortune.

I only tried these a few weeks ago (they're 99 cents at Trader Joe's for a packet of about 20 pieces) and I think they're the perfect snack. At only 60 calories for the whole thing, you can't beat it for a quick salty treat. I fold one piece into 4 sections and pop it in. Since it has a wasabi seasoning on it, at first taste you think "Oh my God, what have I done", but the heat only lasts for about 3 seconds and then the flavor sets in. You really do have to get these by the 10 pack cause you can easily scarf down 2 boxes without even thinking about it.

We purchased the first bar of this wasabi seaweed on a trip to Seattle ,always have to stock up on Trader Joes stuff since there are no T.J. Stores in my state! Hint, Hint...My son loved them! Took some to work and everybody Loved them! Not ready for another 8 hr drive to sestock this high demand snack I Figured I'd try Amazon! Happiness! Great price, fast delivery! Everybody is thrilled. Thank You! We Love Trader Joe'sand Amazon!
Got these at Trader Joes and was so excited to find them online.  They're a great guilt free snack.  Yum!

column9: The best but just go to Trader Joe's - it's much cheaper
column10: It's only $1 per pack at Trader Joe's and you can buy whatever they have in stock.  We buy boxes a time to to have in stock.
The best brand of seaweed snacks I've tried yet. Much spicier than you'd think from the nutritional write-up. Crispy. Gluten free.

If you like roasted seaweed and wasabi you will love these. One negative reviewer probably does not like wasabi and seaweed. I have had several brands of wasabi seaweed and this is bar far the best! I buy 10 at a time now from Trader Joes. If you can get online, go for it!

column9: If heaven came in a bag...
column10: It would be called Trader Joe's Roasted Seaweed Snack.These dried pieces of seaweed are lightly coated in sesame oil and salt for a crisp, delicious snack. I'd never tried roasted seaweed before but I decided to give them a try. Needless to say, I now consider myself a seaweed addict.Seaweed has many healthy things in it that we most likely don't get from other sources of food we eat. The best thing about this snack is that you can eat the whole bag (and trust me, you will) and it's only 60 calories.You will pay a lot lower price if you buy it in the store rather than from Amazon. Not everyone has a local store to them so at least you have somewhere to buy this yummy treat!

I guess I should have driven to Trader Joe's and purchased one bag only, as this item taste terrible.  This item on Amazon came in 6 pack only. Very strong taste and the Wasabi is quite hot. I watched Dr. Oz and that's what made me order it. I thought why not, a healthy snack and it appeared fairly good tasting on the show. Lesson learned, purchase in store if any doubt that a product may not taste good.
If you wanna taste Cigarette Ashes, this is just the right item for you.Horrible, Just Horrible! Took One Bite and threw away the rest.

column9: Healthy, great taste, filling...and suitible for building a brick house.
column10: After trying the Eat Think Smile cherry chocolate bars, which I really liked, I went right for these mixed berry ones, assuming they'd be about as good. Taste-wise, they are. The dark chocolate, oats and almonds are a great match, and the nutrition you get from a single bar isn't anything that's going to leave you feeling guilty. In fact, these are some of the healthier snack bars I've had over the last couple of years, with my main favorite being the various Odwalla ones. As if that weren't enough, the price for a pack of 6 of these isn't too bad.But...the problem is getting used to eating them. The first bite I took out of one of these bars, I had to really dig into it, almost the same way you do when taking a bite out of a big piece of jerky. The difference being that jerky isn't as thick as one of these, so the first bite is a real pain unless you keep these in a warm area, or even microwave them for a few seconds to soften them up. It's weird too because the box describes these as chewy, and that sure as heck isn't the case. After that first bite, you get used to the texture, and finishing the bar off isn't bad, but I wish they'd have made these softer. My only other complaint is that the berry taste is virtually non-existant, but that's not really a bad thing because of how great the dark chocolate/almonds taste is. Still, it'd be nice to get a little taste of berries in there.Since I got my order last tuesday, I'm down to my last two boxes. Obviously, the hardness isn't enough to keep me from annihilating these bars, and they're great for a pre-workout snack or something to have during a break at work. I'd recommend buying a single bar and trying it out before ordering the pack of six, or even one box. They might not be as healthy, but I think I'll stick with the chocolate cherry ones.

column9: Did not like these granola bars.
column10: Not sure why they advertise these granola bars as chewy. These are not chewy. Glad I have good teeth because it felt like I was chewing a thick stack of cardboard. They had very little taste and I was not interested in eating anymore. But for the sake of writing this review, I ate the rest of the bar.Wish I hadn't. Would not purchase.

I have enjoyed other Eat. Think. Smile. products but I can't recommend these granola bars. The fruit berries have a somewhat dirty taste and combined with their natural CocoaOne flavoring don't jive well.  The combination of the two just doesn't work.  The other problem is that these are crunchy but instead almost have a gummy consistency which just doesn't work in solid bar form.
These bars are delicious and filled with good ingredients.  For me, they are perfect snacks for the golf course. The price is right through Amazon.

As one who enjoys various types of granola bars, I was looking forward to trying the EAT THINK SMILE all natural granola bars. At 160 calories, with only 35 calories from fat, these sounded like a great alternative to other higher fat items. After the first bite I was not impressed but I decided to finish the bar to give it a fair chance. The verdict.... it tasted like berry flavored styrofoam. A nice berry flavor was evident, but it was not sufficient to overcome the cardboard - styrofoam textured base.Aside from the displeasing texture, I found the box rather misleading in that it states "the natural antioxidant power of cocoa". I assumed from that statement that these bars were loaded with antioxidants, but the nutritional facts do not prove that true. Each granola bar has only 2% of vitamin C, 4% of vitamin E, and no vitamin A. Not an antioxidant packed product in my opinion.Try them and judge for yourself, but for me... I give them thumbs down.
There is just so much wrong with these things!Rock hard, dull flavor- I am NOT a fan.and I mean hard- not crunchy, hard. I feel like my teeth are going to fall out now.

column9: Very Promising, Sweet but Rather Dry
column10: The Eat.Think.Smile 5 Mixed Berry Chewy Granola Bars are promising, but have one major flaw: they are rather dry. On the plus side, they are not as dry as their Rich Cocoa flavor Eat. Think. Smile. Chewy Granola Bars, Rich Cocoa, 7-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6) but still, they are more dry than one would expect from a granola bar of this kind. This one is saved by the fruit bits that give it some moisture (cherries and raspberry juice concentrate according to the ingredients list).Other than the dryness, this is a rather promising granola bar, promising the antioxidant equivalent of one cup of green tea thanks to its cocoa content. There are five bars in the nicely designed box, with each bar clocking in at 160 calories, 4g fat (0.5g saturated, 0g trans-fat), 0% cholesterol, 50mg sodium, 28g carbs (3g dietary fiber, 10g sugars), and 3g protein, with 10% magnesium, 8% iron, 4% Vitamin E and 2% Vitamin C.This is a sweet granola bar, so if you like the sweet taste it is a plus, if you don't, then you may not like it as much.If they fix the dryness in their recipe, this could get a lot better!

column9: Soy nuts are not organic, tastes slightly smoked
column10: I reviewed the cocoa once as well, and if you want to try these kind of granola bars, I suggest you try the cocoa ones first, as they are slightly better than these ones.These are not too sweet, use more wholesome ingredients as a whole than regular granola bars, and could have been a good snack substitute for cookies or other more highly processed foods.However, they have an odd smoked flavor - something that might be ok with ham, but tastes weird in a granola bar. At least 2 people who tried them agreed with me - but not everyone did, so your mileage will vary here. What doesn't change though is the fact that they used regular soy beans here (one of the most genetically modified crops right now, and also has increasing amounts of pesticide). Given the widespread availability of organic soybeans, and the fact that these are actually not expensive (*yet*) this seems like a big oversight.Note: I don't eat all organic, I eat a bit of everything, from stuffed crust pizza hut to organic tempeh. But I try to eat a few organic things, and soy based products are one of those. Specially since there isn't much difference in price between organic and non-organic soy products. (as opposed to say, organic tomatoes vs traditional, which cost 3 times more)Note: These are still a healthier alternative than high fructose corn syrup filled granola bars, filled with highly processed ingredients. This uses brown rice, whole oats, etc. So if your kid really likes granola bars, maybe you could try these instead of the regular ones they are eating. (but I'd take a look at others and compare prices with some organic alternatives, since these aren't cheap either)

column9: Adequate snack, not chewy - on the dry side.Mild flavor.
column10: These bars are a middle of the road snack item that travels well, is filling, has somewhat healthy ingredients, so-so flavor, and a dense, dry, crumbly texture. The 4 gr of fat per bar is only .5 gr of saturated fat which we do watch in our household so the low saturated fat is a bonus. I didn't feel the taste was really berryish, you could kind of taste a bit of the cocoa and it was sweet but nothing jumped out as being a berry flavor. I liked the slivers of almonds and pieces of fruit incorporated into the bar breaking up the solid consistency of it somewhat and giving a better twist on the flavor when you ran into them.I'm not sure I'd buy these again, but I wouldn't turn one down if it was offered to me and I was hungry. I wouldn't go out of my way to get one, I'd probably buy something with a bit more flavor to it. It's nice that there are antioxidants in the cocoa but I'd probably just drink a cup of green tea and ingest less calories.

column9: Delish, though I prefer the chocolate flavor!
column10: These are great bars - they have a wonderful light and airy consistency with a bit of crunch. They are not too filling though do satisfy my hunger in a pinch. They are nutritious and actually make me feel better after eating them, unlike many other meal replacement bars. They are not too sweet by any means, so do know you are getting a subtle flavor here. That's what I like about them. I have a box of chocolate ones and these berry ones and do find myself reaching for the chocolate ones more often! The berry flavor is subtly sweet and refreshing and definitely a good choice too. Not a big berry flavor, just a hint of it. Definitely worth buying.

column9: Not very "chewy" but some what enjoyable
column10: Eat. Think. Smile. Chewy Granola Bars (Mixed Berry) are okay.  I really enjoyed their granola bites so I decided to try the Granola Bars.  The bars tasted good but they're not chewy. I felt that they were a bit stale at times.  I really enjoyed the taste and the ingredients but I had to gnaw at the bar at times in order to digest it.  If they found a way to make the bars chewy then these would be AWESOME.  Until then I will have to give this review three stars.  I really wanted to give it five but the bars are not "chewy" as advertised.

column9: Eat Think Smile Chewy Granola Bars
column10: The mixed berry in Eat. Think. Smile chewy granola bars was my favorite part of the bar. The berry comes out strong. Although, I can taste the cocoa, I felt it made it somewhat dry and I don't think it is very chewy at all. It is a good size bar for a healthy afternoon snack, but I most likely wouldn't buy them.

column9: Great Taste Ruined By Bad Texture
column10: The Mixed Berry Chewy Granola Bars from Eat. Think. Smile. are really a mixed bag that could have been a lot better.  Like other products from this brand their keystone ingredient is unprocessed cocoa.  With chocolate, berries, and nuts, you really have the makings of a great, healthy granola bar for snacks or breakfast.  So what's the catch?  The base of the granola bar is a lot like Styrofoam.  While they aren't so bad that I won't eat them, I don't think I'll purchase them in the future.  It's a shame because I really liked the idea.  However I would advise people to check out the offerings from Kashi instead.  They have a variety of good flavors with a much better texture.
These do not have a real flavor to them but taste bland and rough eating them. Not very chewy either. would not buy

column9: Fills me up, but the bar is rather dry
column10: I was pretty excited to receive a sample of Eat, Think, Smile's chewy granola bar.  I eagerly opened the package and sat to enjoy an afternoon treat. I have to say I am disappointed that I don't love these.  I do enjoy other products from this line (LOVE the Eat. Think. Smile. Crispy Thins, Red Raspberry, 6-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6).First these bars are not very chewy and second they are rather dry.I can taste the chocolate & berry flavors, and one bar makes a healthy and filling snack, but this just reminds me of diet food, boring and bland, but filling.I'll stick with their crispy thins, those I'd run to get more.

These bars are not exactly "mixed berry." I was expecting berries, but could not quite identify the flavor when I tasted the first bar. I noticed that the bars are crunchy, not too sweet, and have a chocolate flavor.After, getting over my surprise at the taste, I read the list of ingredients. The "berry' flavor is actually cherry. Also, there is cocoa in the bars. The sugar content is low, about one-quarter. Many granola bars are one-third or more sugar, which makes them softer and sweeter.I have come to like these bars. The taste reminds me of chocolate-covered cherries. This product is not for those who have a sweet tooth. However, I prefer the low sugar content. They make a good afternoon snack. The price is good, just over twenty dollars for six packages of five bars, or thirty bars.

I begin this review by saying that these bars are quite tasty.  The berry flavor comes through cleanly, and they are not cloyingly sweet; it has the flavor that reminds me of a chocolate-covered cherry.  Unfortunately, for all the wonderful natural flavor, the texture leaves a bit to be desired.This reminded me more of a crunchy granola bar that didn't fully "crunch-i-fy" vs. an actual chewy granola bar.  You are left with something of moisture-sucking dryness, but without the crunchy satisfaction of a crunchy granola bar.

I like chewy granola bars.  In fact, the Cascadian Farm Organic Chewy Granola Bar are the best I've had in terms of flavor and texture.  Next up, the Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars have a great flavor, but they're crunchy.  Good, but crunchy.These "Eat.  Think.  Smile." granola bars, texture-wise, could be considered the unfortunate offspring of the above chewy and crunchy goodness.  Mine were "mostly crunchy" (but not dry like those that are advertised as crunchy) but when a small enough piece was in my mouth, it softened up enough to not be crunch.  If you take the entire bar and fold it in half, it will break, not bend.So, kill one star for the "Chewy" not living up to its name here.And the other star goes away for a variety of reasons:  "mixed berry" is misleading, unless you consider juice a berry.  The only actual berry in here is cherry, and while it does provide a burst of sweetness, it doesn't taste much like a cherry.  And the cocoa powder they use seems to be more for health benefits (anti-oxidants) and coloring than for flavor, because these neither smell like nor taste any like cocoa/chocolate.All in all, I wouldn't really recommend these unless you're don't mind the texture, and can tolerate a granola bar not tasting like granola, chocolate or "berries" (cherries) that they're advertised as.

I eat a lot granola bars as a snack or part of my lunch. Some like Nature Valley have so much sugar to approach being a candy bar minus the chocolate coating. I avoid high fructose corn syrup and try to eat as much whole wheat products as possible, which typically means buying granola bars from companies like Kashi. This means I don't expect my granola bar to taste like a Snicker's bar. With that in mind, I found these Mix Berry bars to taste like mildly sweet dried fruit, with reminded me of Kashi TLC Chewy Granola Bars Cherry Dark Chocolate 6 - 1.2 Oz (35g) Bars (Pack of 6) but with minimal chocolate taste. I like the taste of them and their chewiness. They seem like a healthy choice for a snack, if you don't expect it to taste like a candy bar.

column9: A healthy snack, just don't think of it as "granola"
column10: This unique snack bar doesn't taste at all like a traditional granola bar, with an unusual chew, distinct cocoa flavors, and a berry sweetness.I enjoy these unusual bars, which eat more "slowly" than regular granola for me (a positive since I like to snack).  Almonds and cherries punch up the flavor and add to the list of healthy ingredients, also making this into more of a "premium" granola bar.  While I enjoyed, the girlfriend didn't care for these bars, although she commented on the fruity smell and thought that they'd appeal to people who like dark chocolate (turns out, I like dark chocolate).The eye-catching packaging is attractively designed and the easy-open wrapper don't hurt.  Somebody has put serious thought into making these granola bars as aesthetically pleasing as possible.  Considering that, it's a little odd they don't feature organic or fair-trade ingredients, either of which would surely appeal to the target demographic (including me).My favorite granola bars remain the Cascadian Farm Organic Mixed Nut which have a appealing blend of texture with organic chocolate and nuts.  But these EatThinkSmile bars are nice variety if you like the flavor of dark chocolate.  Recommended.

column9: Very chocolaty and not too sweet
column10: These bars have plenty of chocolate flavor mixed with tart berries. They're soft, but dry, not sticky like Quaker Chewy Granola Bars. They do have somewhat of a "styrofoam" texture, but I got used to it; you may want a glass of water or milk to wash these down. Bonus: they don't taste too sweet.

column9: Less like candy, more like breakfast than other bars
column10: The description of these bars made me think they'd be sweeter and more treat-like. In reality, they have a natural sweetness from the dried cherries, but are not sugary tasting at all. I do enjoy the combination of chewy crunch, with enough nuts added to keep my mouth busy for awhile.Although they don't have enough substance to replace breakfast for me like some protein bars will, they are a very good afternoon "pick me up" that satisfies some cravings without giving me a sugar high.The cocoa powder is not very noticeable at all in the flavor, it's more of a hint or even an aftertaste. If you are looking for something that will be a healthier replacement for a candy bar, I don't think these will satisfy that craving. But as a slightly sweet and nutty snack, they're very good.

I keep a few of these at the office for a nice break. The cherry and cocoa mix is a bit of a surprise. Based on the label, I was expecting more of a mixed berry flavor but it turns out the only fruit component is dried cherries which is slightly tart. The cocoa flavor is light and not as sweet as chocolate chips. But the great thing about this mix is that the bar ends up being a nice balance of the tart and sweet. The almond and oats add a nice chewy/nutty texture. All in all, I really like it. For less than $4 for 5 bars, it's not a bad deal. But, I'd probably wait for bigger discounts with a Subscribe & Save option.

It's a berry rush up front with a hint of cocoa to finish.  Like any granola product, you don't want to eat a ton of it in a day or week or it'll crash your diet, but this is a nice option if you're on the go and don't have a lot of time for meals.  They're handy and a decent size, more flat than thick, but watch out as the bars are a little crumbly.  Overall, Eat. Think. Smile mixed berry chewy granola bars are a surprisingly tasty but not overpowering treat.  Scrap your power bars.  These are better and they have some nifty antioxidants to boot.

At first I did not like the taste of these bars. I found them dry, bitter and very grainy. But then for some unexplainable reason I had another bar and loved it! WIth all the negatives I mentioned I couldn't figure out why I had another. Then it hit me - they taste very GOOD! And they fill you up. I had one early in the morning before work and didn't have an extreme need to eat by ten. All though the aforementioned negatives might deter some folks from giving these bars a shot, the positives far outweigh the negative, the boost of energy, feeling of being full and TASTE make these worth it.

YUM, YUM, YUM..... I'm not a health food nut but I do love anything loaded with berries, especially mixed berries. These are chewy and crunchy at the same time. The berry flavor is very prominent and I love that. Seems like most granola bars are fairly small but this is a nice size. Plenty of every item in it all the way through. Kids would love these too as a healthy snack after school or a sporting event. Very good, I would definitely buy these.

column9: Love that these are all natural
column10: I had to adjust to the taste of these after a few bites, but I found the smoky chocolate flavor and acid of the fruit blended nicely. It has only a slightly gummy chew, but that is ok because it soft enough that it doesn't wear your jaw out.  This is not a crunchy granola bar.  I really enjoyed these, though I thought the calories were a little high at 160 each and I suspect they gave me gas.

These arrived in the mail after work right before I made dinner. Perfect snack to tide me over before cooking and I was very surprised at the nice balance of the chocolaty taste vs. the zing of the cherries!  They are crunchy and satisfying and I actually ate less dinner!  I loved the nuts too but were glad they didn't overpower the bar and the cherry flavor. I would buy these for snacks at work for the 3 pm "looking for food but don't want to spoil my appetite or eat a candy bar" time when I am bored more so than hungry.  The kids liked them too and I think they will be taking them in their lunches or snacking on them after school.

column9: nice blend of flavors, a bit sweet for me
column10: Overall, I like the blend of flavors for this bar. The chocolate is more of a cocoa flavor than traditional chocolate, which works nicely with the tartness of the berries.  I would prefer if they were a little less sweet, and looking at the ingredients you can see there is some added sugar for a total of 10grams per bar.  Not overly high, but I would have liked it to be around 6grams of sugar per bar.  The bars are not overly chewy, which is a good thing, so you don't need to worry about any dental work - they taste more like a soft oatmeal cookie with a bit of bite.

Although the expiration date on the bars I got is still 8 months away, the bars are stale. The flavor seems okay (at first), but it also makes it clear that there are no berries in this product. The only fruits in the ingredient list are cherries, and raspberry *juice*. It also leaves a bitter after-taste in my mouth.I was hoping for better, but I was very disappointed.

Very dissapointed, this was a holiday gift. I ordered the exact same product, only 1 lb. box instead of little package, from another vendor and they were perfect.  These were all white and nasty looking.  I contacted vendor and they have done nothing.
Great product. Hard to find in USA. They sell it all over Greece. From the island of Chios. Cost the same as it does in Greece.

Great product! I first had the dressing in Hawaii at the restaurant. To purchase Angelo Pietro Salad Dressing here on the mainland I had to go to Japanese grocery store. I use this dressing to make snadwich spreads and dips.

Though they've messed with the formula a few times, I think it's back, or at least close to the original they used around 5 years ago. I love this stuff though (with a little clove added) and go through a can every few days, year round now.I do have to say this price is completely ridiculous. It's around $3.30 a can in my local supermarket. They also often have a special that gives you around $1 off per can (For example "buy 4 or more, get a $4 off coupon for next store visit".)
I do not drink this as intended, instead I mix it with some frozen peaches and vanilla yogurt for a tasty smoothie. The spices are just right!
I have waited a long time to get more of the tea. Its so good and I enjoy it every evening.  Great service, but a bit high in price of shipping.

Bigelow's Chamomile Mint is a great relaxing tea to drink throughout the day. I usually use the teabag twice to fill up my 20oz mug and it brews as strong as the first time. I love chamomile and mint tea by themselves, but Bigelow combines the two really well. I've noticed that the mint is not very strong, but it leaves a pleasantly light tingling feeling while the chamomile is a lot stronger. I will definitely purchase this again!
I love this tea.  It is caffeine free, naturally sweet, and very relaxing.  The blend of mint and chamomile is perfect!
Chamomile Mint tea is just wonderful after dinner. Of course it is a very nice break any time of day when no caffeine is a plus.  What can I say; there is also Pomegranate Pizzazz for a nice change.
I am British and tea is a must have for me...the combination of teas are flavorful and the benefits are exceptional.
This is probably my favorite Bigelow tea, Chamomile Mint.  I also love Constant Comment by Bigelow with the orange peel and black tea.

My order of Bigelow tea was very easy to understand and simple to do. The case of tea arrived at my home very quickly, even during the Christmas rush. Which helped me to cope with the hectic holiday, as in the evening I would enjoy a relaxing cup of tea and a movie. Thank you AMAZON for the convenience of shopping on line, as well as the speedy delivery to me home. YOUR THE BOMB !!!!!

I got addicted to this tea when I went to visit some friends in England. I had never enjoyed unflavored tea with milk before, but my friends drank this all the time and I started drinking it as well. By the time I came back home, I brought some with me, I was hooked!When I saw my stock getting close to empty, I was pleased to see the grocery stores here sold Tetley. But unless it's imported, the tea is really not the same. I bought a box of the stuff they sell here in the US with 100 tea bags and it's still sitting on the shelf with 99 bags in it, it's not the same thing. So I logged on and was glad to find it here on Amazon. Because free shipping doesn't apply to this product and it's a bit high, I went ahead and purchased enough to last me for a few months.I really love this tea and there's nothing like it with a splash of milk and a couple of sugars! I have to say I could never understand why the British drink so much tea, but after trying this brand, I can tell the stuff they drink there is nothing like what we get over here.For your reference, Tetley is a milder tea. If you like the more bitter stuff, like PG Tips, you probably won't enjoy it as much. In my opinion, Tetley with milk has a creamier flavor. I don't really like PG Tips because I find it too harsh or bitter. So, if you're like me, Tetley will probably be more to your taste.Enjoy!
Super tea.  Good price.  Easy purchasing process.  What more can you ask?

The title says it all, really. I love violet and this was a good way to get my fix. The sweetness didn't overpower that delicate floral flavor I was craving. The orange is not your typical variety of orange candy, so if you want a flavor like Jolly Ranchers or similar, look elsewhere. It's a deliciously subtle taste that makes me want to savor it. I can't give a personal review of the anise as I dislike anise candy, but my husband liked them and he's... particular about candy, shall we say.The tins got here without any broken candy or dents in the tins. The tins, by the way, are very pretty and are good for pill cases and organizing tiny odds and ends. They withstood hot glue without warping. That last one probably isn't the biggest selling point, but hey, I can't be the only crafter that will order these!All in all, wonderful candy and I will buy these again.

Sophisticated and warm, 100% smooth the entire way down, medium to medium-full body.  The flavors blend together nicely, but i'm still wanting just a little more oomph in a dominating flavor.  It's very luxurious with the silk satchets and i would definitely consider it a "fine" tea.  My ultimate favorite from harney & sons is their cinammon spice!
This tea is so delicious and FRAGRANT! Sometimes I make it just to smell it.  Try it -- you'll love it.  :)

This is one of my favorite teas. It has a lovely fragrance and delicious taste! Keep in mind that each bag can be used two or three times (using a 12 oz cup), so it's more like the box makes 30 cups, not 15 -- which definitely makes the steep price a lot more bearable!UPDATE TO REVIEW: they seem to have changed their bags -- putting less tea in, so I no longer feel that it is worth the purchase as the bags no longer bear repeated steeping very well.

These tea pyramids continue to delight me, and these are especially fun - the leaf balls are fun to watch, the smell of jasmine puts a few moments of escape into my work day. Overpackaged for the environmental crowd.

After similar tea disappeared from Trader Joe's I went to Amazon. Thanks god for Amazon, you can find everything there. Adagio Tea is a great product, just what my husband wanted: jasmine pearl tea (if you haven't tried it, you must!), individual tea bags, reasonable price, and convinience of prompt delivery when we need it.

column9: Poor packaging choice for jasmine pearls
column10: The packaging of this product makes me sad. If you are going to buy jasmine pearls, buy them loose. Part of the fun of the jasmine pearls is the touch of pearls themselves, and watching them unravel in the tea cup or pot. You also want to give the tea lots of space to unravel. Teabags are for small loose leaf and spice fragments. These are beautiful hand-rolled tea leaves that shouldn't be trapped in a bag, even a trendy pyramid bag.
My boys mooch for this all the time.  What the heck could be in this stuff that cats go crazy for it????I can see why this stocks runs out all.  HIGHLY recommended for all CatMoms and CatDads.. :)

column9: My cats are party mix addicts
column10: My cats love all the purina friskies party mix flavors. I purchase them often and in bulk. This price is ok and delivery is fairly quick. All in all, good product, delivery time and seller

My cats looove these treats! Every night before we go to bed I give each one of my cats several of these treats. They can't gobble them down fast enough. I was worried that by buying so many packages of them that they'd get tired of them, much to my luck they have not. They like them just as much as they did the first time.

Well, I can't begin to say how much my mousers love the Party Mix collection, and the Original especially.  I have a bunch of mousers and if you're a cat owner, you'll know that these critters have very differentiated palates.  In the case of Originals, let's say the exception makes the rule:  they all love this one.  The introduction of the larger package, with a major cost per ounce reduction built in, is a double whammy in a good way.  So, I'm a subscriber as well because a few of these on hand is a no-brainer.

I wasn't sure exactly what to expect after purchasing, but the product definitely exceeded the expectations I had. As I was out of town when I ordered the product, I didn't expect to receive the tea set until after I came home.  In actuality, the package arrived much faster and was already delivered before I came home.  Definitely a plus!  After opening the box, I found three sets of teas inside.  Each pack of tea was properly labeled with a tea I had never tried before(Strawberry Kiwi Fruit Tisane, Rooibos Capetown, and Sencha Cherry Rose).  After spending time trying each tea, I can really say this is an awesome tea set.  The teas complement each other very well, each having their own distinct aromas.  The Rooibos(my favorite) in particular seemed to have a number of different flavors within each taste.  An example of this would the hints of lemon you could taste right at the very end(sooooo good!)  The amount of tea was really great as well.  Although it says "sampler set", they really gave you a lot to try and was very happy with the amount in each tin.  Overall, an excellent buy for any tea lover and if a tea novice(like myself) a great introduction into new and great tasting teas.

The sample pack had a terrific variety.  This also made a great Mothers' Day gift for my wife from the kids.  They arrived promptly in 6 separate metal decanters with clear covers each nicely labeled with the flavors.  The package also had a double sided nicely printed page describing teas and each of the varieties.  This was packed with great information.  I have been given a lot of failed gifts given over the years, but this one was a homerun.  My wife has been drinking the teas over the last month and has since re-ordered more.  She had been using one of the tea chain mall stores for her teas, but the pricing and the flavors exceeded the mall store.
This tea was delicious, and at a very reasonable price.  They have a very large selection to choose from.  I know where I'm buying my tea from next time!

our baby was formula fed due to lack of breast milk production. Plus, there has been atlest 2 generations of children who were formula fed and are now gorwn up, proving that formula fed babies grow up same as those who are breat fed. PLs Don't hold me to that statement, If you can produce breast milk and have the  time, patience and strength to breast feed, I would much rather that my baby gets the natural breast milk than formula.Our baby started with Similac, which was given to us at the hospital, within a week, she was having gas and tummy issues, the pediatrician advised us to get the Similac sensitive, it seemed to work for a week, but then the tummy issues were back, she was having trouble passing gas and having BM's. we tried gas medicines such as mylicon and gripe water, but those were helpful only for a few hours. Then our friend recomended Enfamil gentlease. although it was a little more epxpensive ( a few cents here and there), we tried it, and now our baby is almost 3 moths with no problems in terms of gas or tummy issues. Its a huge help, and I would completely recomend it. I would also say it will depend from baby to baby.We did have a few days ( 2-3 days) of trouble when we switched to the different formulas, but that is the transition period. It does not work overnight, but when it does, its a big relief.

column9: Great for babies that are used to breast milk
column10: My preemie twins were breast milk babies, but there came a point when I could not keep up.  We tried many different formulas, all of them giving them tummy issues.  They are now fully formula feed, I still have some breast milk in the freezer but they prefer the formula.  Difinetly helps with tummy problems, one of the twins had some gas  problems on breast milk but after we switched him to gentlease he is a much happier baby.

column9: My son uses and loves..His body however doesn't
column10: It smells better than most formulas, also is sweeter in smell, Great flavor it seems to be for my son. He has been a highly colicy baby, and very gassy. He has finally adjusted at 4 months once he has started on some fruit. It's not an instant gas helping formula. Little tummys gas drops have been my priority choice for gas.  Colief infant drops is now put in everyone of his bottles made. I have not had any problems from him since I began him on Colief.

column9: Does what it says it will do
column10: Our baby was VERY, EXTREMELY gassy. We started him on this formula and we no longer this issue. Would highly recommend. Purchased this item through amazon.com.

column9: My son totally rejected it - Tastes awful
column10: The pediatrician told us to try the Gentlease Enfamil since our son was a little gassy but he totally rejected it.We even tried a couple times to mix it with the regular Enfamil he was used to (he was having it for a month) but it only took him seconds to taste the Gentlease Enfamil and spit it out.We tried it ourselves and in fact it tastes completely different from the regular Enfamil and also from the Similac that we still had at home. None of them taste good, but this is one is really awful!Maybe he was so used to the regular Enfamil that he wouldn't take it no matter how it tastes but the fact is I was totally disappointed with this product.By the way, since he refused to take it, we simply don't know if it would help him or not with gases.
I am British, live in the USA. Cadbury, made in the UK is the BEST chocolate, now I can bulk buy from Amazon,,,,,,,,,yeh. thanks...

This is the real deal, British chocolate from cadbury.  If you are a British chocolate fan and are able to tell the difference between British Cadbury and other countries, then this is the item you want.  My wife is British and able to tell the difference and this scores me huge brownie points every time I order it.

While I dearly love the Cadbury bars from England, I did not have much success with enjoying them, even though they were shipped to me twice.  Shipping candy in the summer months or anywhere where it is hot is difficult.  My first shipment took 10 days and arrived a melted mess in the box.  The second shipment was sent 2 day delivery, arrived 5 days after my order, but was in better shape.  Melted soft but still intact.  In future, I will order these in the colder months and always request 2 day delivery.  Perhaps ordering on Monday will ensure no layover on the weekend.  Amazon did a fine job of packaging, even included a small freezer pad in the container.

5 star. This is the BEST The UK version. Hope Amazon has this one in stock forever! Creamy. Silky. Yummy. Deliciousness. Made with cream not wax like the US version. Oh My God are these good! I will be back for more Dairy Milk Chocolate Candy!

column9: Favorite chocolates in the world, but hazardous shipping when the temps are high
column10: It's very difficult to find UK Cadbury in my area of Florida.  I had no problems when ordering these chocolates during the winter months, but once the temperatures hit the 80s, they did not arrive without being semi or completely melted.  I did pay for overnight shipping and Amazon packed them with two freezer packs, but they shipped from Texas to Florida overnight and the UPS truck has no air conditioning.  It was placed on the area truck early this morning (7AM) and didn't arrive to me until 3PM.  Several hours in the heat managed to completely melt the two freezer ice packages.  They were nothing but liquid.  Most of the chocolates seem to be intact, with only some melting around the edges.  One bar is completely turned into an almost pretzel shape as it fell to the side of the others in the box.  It is only 85 degrees here today, so I know things will be much worse once summer hits.  I will have to wait to order these again when November or December arrives to bring cooler temperatures.This is my favorite chocolate and deserves my highest rating.  If you live in Florida or another hot climate, be warned that even one day shipping and the careful packaging by Amazon will not help these chocolates survive.
I was looking for this chocolate for a long time. I'm glad amazon sell this. One of the best chocolate.

This is THE chocolate product to get if you or your kids have food intollerances/allergies.It is one of the only chocolates on the market that does not contain "lecithin," but only the English, imported, version.  (Lindt changed their receipe, so now we can't eat it)I don't feel drained and grouchy after eating it - and my kid does not get spazy, weird, belligerent after eating this!!We thought it was the sugar that made him react, but after oodles of research, we found out that the lecithin was the primary triger.Hope this review helps others!PLUS it tastes divine, like it should  :)
Adds a nice bite to beer.Six words described my experience but I have to write at least twenty to make it count.

This is much better then the US version of KitKat. However is it worth the price? as a novelty or a gift to a huge KitKat lover which is what I got it for then yes. For a regualr person just wanting a good candy bar, NO! it is not so much better as to be worth the price. If the two were sitting side by side for the same amount I would pick this one every time though.
The whole package was very good.  We were not disappointed at all.  I would recommend it to anybody who likes this kind of fruit.

Rarely can I say that a GF product tastes better than the gluten version.  Thse cookies do, though.  Melt in your mouth delicious, and just the right amount of lemon.  I am confident tht if you gave these to gluten eaters, they would not be able to tell the difference.

Although at first I wasn't sure about the texture of the wafers, I found these lemony wafers to be really addicting. The lemon filling flavoring is delicious and much better than the chocolate version of the same wafer. i would definitely buy this again!
We really like these. The lemon flavor is heavenly. The cookies are crisp and light... VERY VERY good.

When I first ate one I thought Wow... that is lemony and not sure if I liked it but by the end of "just trying one more" I was addicted. I have to hide them from my non-gluten free husband. He likes them better than the vanilla or lemon ones I used to buy for him in the grocery store that are not gluten free. I am trying to get a local store to carry them.

column9: The best gluten-free cookies I have ever had
column10: I feel like have tried every gluten-free baked good out there. Since I am allergic to dairy, eggs, soy, and bananas as well this product is a lifesaver for when I need a cookie. They taste really , really good and don't make me sick.  I love these things I pray they never stop making them.
These are actually superior to any similar vanilla cookies I've had - they are absurdly addictive, so watch out for that...
These cookie and the chocolate version are the best gluten free substitutes for Oreo cookies on the market. Filling very creamy and cookie is nice and light.
My two little boys love these.  I can't tell them apart from the real gluten version.

column9: Vanilla wafers -- beware they can melt in shipment!!!
column10: These tasty chocolate coated wafers are a great way to get a chocolate fix without too many calories. Be warned however that if the weather is sunny and in the 70's or higher, you're likely to be disappointed when you open the box because the chocolate melts. You'll have three solid blocks instead of 18 wafers, even if you used next day delivery. Best to order this product when cloudy weather is forecast, and high temps will be in the 60's or less -- apparently those brown UPS trucks get pretty warm in the sun!

These are so good.  I love them as a quality , gluten free sweet treat.  My kids , who are also gluten free, just think they are great cookies. They have a great lemon taste.  I dont know of any afater taste or any particular potato smell.  They are just real good cookies in a gluten free world!
The lemon flavored wafers ARE really good, but the STRAWBERRY are BEST!I'm going to ask Amazon.com to get them on the subscribe & save program.J.

These wafers are awesome, if you like the ones you buy normally in a local grocery store or use to buy you will love these, but be careful, very addictive, just like the others.yummy Great product that is free of gluten.
my kids were thrilled to have this kind of treat gluten free and tasty.  It has become a favorite in our family.3

column9: Gluten free, but NOT taste free
column10: I got these for my daughter who has celiac.  I usually can tolerate the gluten free foods, but rarely do I find something that I would choose to eat.  These go beyond that.  They are so good.  Now, I LOVE sugar wafers and so I was skeptical.  But, you'll not be disappointed.  The biggest problem was stopping myself from eating them and saving them for my daughter.

These wafers remind me of those regular chocolate, vanilla, and strawberry wafers I was addicted to as a child...now if Glutino could only make those flavors gluten-free!  Yummy!!  Lemon flavored is a great start!
These wafer cookies are every bit as good as the ones I used to eat that are wheat-based.  They are light and airy and just plain good!

These are the best gluten-free cookies that I have ever tasted.  They are as good as the regular wafer cookies (or better!).  The only problem is that in shipment (during the summer months) the chocolate all sticks to the paper and the container that the cookies are in.  If they could be put on ice packs for shipment, they would get to the customer in much better shape.
I never thought I'd bother to review a cookie, but . . .  These are terrific, indistinguishable from 'real' cookies.  We go through a lot of these.
These remind me so much of a KitKat, which I can't have anymore due to a gluten intolerence.  I literally have to hide these from my daughter so I know I'll get some!!

I bought these cookies because I love lemon, I'm always looking for something that tastes good and is gluten-free. These cookies had everything up until the after taste - they had this funky fake lemon taste that wasn't there at the beginning. I was disappointed in the box and never bought another.
Chocolate Chip has a nasty smell and taste. I would never buy this flavor again. But the oreo ones are very good.
These are wonderful.  I had low expectations for some reason, but wow, very good.  I'm thinking I might make them into a crust for a cheesecake for Thanksgiving ... yum.
Delicious "oreos".  A little less sweet than regular oreos, but I think thats a good thing.  Overall, very excited, even my non-gluten-free friends enjoy these oreo-ish cookies.

My daughter has a wheat/gluten allergy so we have purchased a large number of gluten free cookies for her, trying to find something to serve as a substitute to real cookies.  Of all the brands and types of cookies, these are her favorite.  I have tried one as well and as far as prepackaged, store bought cookies are concerned, these are great.  The cookie is made up of alternating layers of waffers and chocolate creme and the whole cookie has been dipped in chocolate.  If you like chocolate I think you are going to love these cookies.

column9: To make good even better - keep them in the freezer!
column10: These are very good, but in the very warm weather the filling can go soft.So I keep mine in the freezer.  Try and keep them sealed to avoid moisture -all I do is fold the silver packet over - and they are really good. Thereis not enough to them to taste cold - but they are crisper.  I only keepthe packet I have open in the freezer.  See what you think.

Before becoming a Celiac and switching to a gluten free diet, I used to love Trader Joe's Vanilla Joe Joe's. I found these on sale at the Grocery Outlet the other day and decided to give these a try. These were so much better than the Trader Joe's Vanilla Joe Joe's and significantly better than Vanilla Oreo's. Even my gluten eating friends said they were addicting. They are great dipped in hot chocolate, milk or tea but are even better on their own. Will definitely buy again.
I bought these locally.  The price was high and I don't like the licorice taste!  I couldn't even finish the box...  I prefer the Schar brand vanilla wafers.

I've purchased most of the gluten free cookies available on Amazon and in local stores.  These are best of the bunch.  If you like wafer cookies -- they're good whether you can eat gluten or not (I grew up eating cookies with wheat and these compete with any "normal" wafer cookie (I wouldn't go as far as I would with Blue Diamond's Nut-Thin crackers, which I would say are better than regular crackers -- but they are at least as good as most cookies -- if you serve them to friends they won't wince (or even know they are eating gluten free) when they bite into them).  The other Glutino flavors aren't bad either but the chocolate is the best -- I find chocolate tends to help mask the glutin free flour taste in most cookies.I would recommend some caution in shipping them during the summer as you are more likely to recieve a cookie block rather than individual wafers (although the cookie block was pretty tasty too).  Also, an added bonus for anyone shipping to APO or DPO, they will ship to these addresses(again a caution about the heat, especially if you are shipping to Afghanistan during the summer).

column9: Might just be better than Oreos!
column10: Love these cookies!  I finally found one that tastes just as good as Oreos.  I think I can handle being on this gluten-free diet now as long as there are decent tasting cookies like these around!  I don't feel nearly so deprived.  Just made my day!

We have been on Gluten Free for a few months now, and when you first start, many things are hit or miss. I don't usually like vanilla "Oreo" type cookies anyway, and worried that my boys (6 and 4 years old) would never go for them... BUT- they are so sweet, flakey, and delicious that our whole family (my husband included) couldn't get enough of them.BUY THESE COOKIES, for real.
Crispy, light, but overloaded with sugar.Sweeter then any GF product I have tried!!!  The price is one the high side, but Amazon has a good deal.

CHOCOLATE. When going GF 10 years ago, I was bummed cause there was suck a lack of store bought goodies. I once had an addiction to Keebler Fudge Shop, Fudge Sticks. I was hesitant at first to but these cause of the price, but they are worth it if you have the craving. I like them frozen/refrigerated the best. I gave them to a GF co-worker and she really liked them too. The only problem I have is once I open one box, I have trouble not finishing the whole thing. oops. I've also tried the vanilla ones, but they are not that good. Buy these!!!
These vanilla creme cookies taste great! Some gluten free items lack taste and texture, but you'd never know these cookies are gluten free and they are a favorite of ours.

column9: Best gluten-free vanilla cream filled cookie ever!
column10: I have been on a gluten-free diet for nearly ten years,and these Glutino Vanilla Creme Dream Cookies are by far the best I have ever tasted!  Try them for yourself and if you like vanilla filled cookies,you won't be disappointed.

Ok I am a chocolate snob. If things have chocolate in them they have to taste really good. and these do. I bought a box and the local grocer today, there are about 16 wafers in a box and now there are just 2 left.

I'm surprised! These are awesome! They are just like the organic ones I used to buy for my kids before we stopped eating gluten. They're crunch and tasty. They are quite sweet though. Not something you could eat a lot of in one sitting. I'm done at 2. Maybe that's a good thing though. :)

I love these!  They have the same flavor as Oreos, with a very similar texture.  As with most gluten-free things, they are a tad grainy, but this is easily overlooked!!!  Definitely something to keep on hand (and in hand).
These wafer have a very bright lemony filling and dont taste like they are gluten free cookies. I have to keep them away from my kids!
There are very few "good" gluten free cookies out there.  These are quite good, nice and chocolaty, but not too sweet.  Ps. don't forget the milk...

These dark chocolate covered wafers are wonderful. I don't even realize they are gluten free. With a rich dark chocolate covering and good tasting crunchy wafers they are the same as regular wheat wafers but without the problems for my condition.
These wafers are delicious.  My daughter has celiac so I buy them for her, but I love them too!
Best cookie ever - if there are Glutino Lemon  Wafers on my kitchen shelf, I can sleep well at night... best dessert .... fabulous fix for the sweet tooth. Top notch cookie that deserves top praise.

column9: These cookies are to die for.
column10: Since going gluten free, what I have missed the most is a good cookie.  The gluten free breads and cookies on the market are not very good.  When I found these, I thought I had died and gone to heaven.  Can't live without them.

These are good, rich cookies, but I would not buy them from amazon again because they were so poorly packed that half of them were falling apart or already crumbs. I'll go back to buying them locally.

I keep these on auto-ship and hope I don't run out! But once a box gets opened here...they disappear at once. Crisp, light, so flavorful....and gluten-free! Whole family is hooked on the entire brand..but this flavor cookie is the MUST have. Especially refreshing refrigerated on a hot summer day.
These are delicious and such a treat if you are on a gluten-free diet.  I could eat the entire box at one sitting!
The cookies are okay in taste. They are a little too sweet for me. They also came completely crushed which didn"t help the texture.

I've been gluten free for about 10 years now and love my cookies!  I generally order Schar products and love their vanilla sandwich creams which really are as good as or better than gluten cookies.  With Glutino I feel it's hit and miss.  Their crackers are generally delicious and I love their pretzels but these cookies tasted like styrofoam and the icing was super sweet.  Not my favorite product from Glutino.  If you didn't care for these, you might try the Schar vanilla cremes.  They're amazing!

column9: Very close to Nabisco Sugar Wafers taste
column10: The wafer part tastes very close to Nabisco sugar wafers but it's so much lighter. The light, crispy wafer combined with the strawberry flavor is not too sweet, like most GF products are, it's just right. We love them.
DELICIOUS. In summer heat they get soggy rather quickly, but freshly opened they are amazing.
these little cookies taste fantastic! not too sweet, just right....chocolate melts easily, so we will be ordering these in the cooler months only

I love these! After discovering a familial gluten intolerance, premade items that are gluten free have been difficult to obtain. Therefore, I now order these by the case each month. Light, refreshing, sweet and no grainy aftertaste. Yahoo! I don't have to break my dient now and I might not starve to death! I am so weary of lettuce....
a great gluten free product wityh a real taste of lemon. This is not a washed out flavor but a excellent mix of sweet and tart in a light crunchy wafer cookie.
I got these not expecting much but they were realy good. For gluten free they were great. I am so glad i found these. There great for when your craving something sweet.

column4: Marc S. Gibian "Enjoying the outdoor world"
column9: gluten-free and corn-free cookies that truly satisfy
column10: These are cookies that give a satisfying crunch, taste great, yet still are both gluten-free and corn-free. Finally, something to satisfy my sweet tooth while also providing some of the hard to find gluten-free crunch.

Having tried a couple of other brands of gluten-free sandwich cookies, these are the best of the bunch.  They're crunchy and true to the texture of the other "real" cookies that aren't gluten-free.  Some might think that the filling makes them a bit too sweet, but for me that just means I've satisfied my sweet tooth sooner!  The chocolate version from Glutino is just as good and has a true "chocolatey" taste - something that isn't there with the other gluten-free brands out there.
These chocolate wafers are delicious.  It's hard to find gluten free products that taste great, but these hit the mark.  They are a staple in my pantry.

This product is very tasty but if you are also lactose intolerant, better forgo the pleasure.  Milk is not listed on the allergy advisory (May contain traces of...) but the ingredients section lists whole milk powder as a component of the chocolate coating.  Otherwise, it's a great product.
These wafers melt in your month!  I buy by the carton.  we all love them.  Highly recommended.

column9: Wow! Just like the real stuff!
column10: These are absolutely wonderful, great tasting cookies. People who are not celiacs can't tell the difference. You'll like them, too!

It's really hard to believe that these cookies are gluten-free.  They are like those really yummy cream-filled vanilla wafer cookies from childhood, only these have a heavy chocolate coating. Extremely good and if you're gluten sensitive, they are oh so good for you ! Indulge yourself.
It isn't easy to find really delicious cookies that are gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free, and don't contain chocolate. These lemon wafers are all that -- truly yummy.

column9: Excellent- but do yourself a favor and try them from the fridge!
column10: I loved these cookies when I first tried them, but found that in the humidity they will get soggy and gross if left open for too long.  Easily fixed with a Ziploc, but one time I tossed them in the fridge to keep them extra fresh.  That was when I fell IN love with these cookies.  When cold the creamy layers really hold up against the crunchy wafer and make a wonderful combination.  They are truly addicting.  Also, because we keep our entire house allergen free for my boys, these cookies are some that I can confidently serve when entertaining gluten-eating friends.  They often ask where they can get their own!

I recently had to go gluten free.  I have disliked so many products, because I can't get used to the tastes of some of the flours.  I would NEVER had guessed these were gluten free.  They are delicious!  I really have to use self control so that I don't eat them all in one day. If only I could find a gluten free bread that tastes good.
The cookies are the best GF packaged cookies.  The only complaint I have about them is they seem to disappear!

These are excellent. Expensive, but so good. You'd never know they were gluten-free. I don't know what the person was talking about them smelling like potatoes. They really do taste like a Kit Kat. So good!
These are my favorite gluten-free cookies, and I have tried a lot of brands. What more can I say?!

I have a three-year-old celiac who knows more about GF cookies than most adults, and these are his favorite cookies.  I like them too.  They really taste just like regular wafer cookies.  Totally worth the cost.

With 3 Celiacs in the family, the entire house is gluten free. Friends and family can't believe when I tell them that these cookies are gluten free. Another note, the cookies are packaged well, so they arrive INTACT, not in pieces, like other cookies out there.

Well, my kid who isn't gluten free likes them, and my kid who is won't touch them.  I cook and bake most of what we eat, so desserts are very homemade and natural in their flavor.  These are really, really artificial-lemon flavored....they remind me of my dish soap every time I try one.  I really don't like the flavor, but the texture is nice.  I'm a little dizzied that I have so many boxes of something I don't care for... it was worth a try, though.
My hubby and daughter LOVE these cookies. They are kinda spendy though. I did not enjoy them as much as I like gluten containing cookies!!!!

My son is 6 and he has celiac.  He loves sweets, however when he took a bite of this wafers he was done with it.  He said that it just was not good.  I tasted it and had to agree with him.  The only thing I could taste was the extreme sweetness and the fat sticking to the roof of my mouth.

column9: Very good.  Also, they smell like potatoes.
column10: I really shouldn't complain:  the world would be a sadder place without these.  They are like gluten-free Kitkats, which is wonderful.However, they also smell like potatoes.  The chocolate covers the potato taste and smell, for the most part, but, it's still a little bit like eating chocolate-covered crispy potatoes.However, as you are probably aware, there are variations in what people can taste and smell.  Personally, I can tell what vodka was made from--potatoes, wheat, whatever--even though it's so finely distilled that there shouldn't be any way to distinguish that.  If you're not super-sensitive to tastes and smells, you probably won't notice the potato at all, in which case, these would be fabulous.

column9: It's good junk food.  They also smell like potatoes.
column10: First, let me say that I love this company.  They have somehow managed, with very difficult flours, to make normal junk food.  (These kinds of cookies are sold in American supermarkets in packages that are three times the size.)The packaging is pretty;  the cookies are crispy, light, and very appealing in your hand.  They are an exact duplicate of the wheat version.  However, once you get them up to your nose, you can smell the potato flour they are made from.Pull them away from your nose, and you have a very pretty cookie.  Bring them back in to your nose, and it's a surreally icky potatoey experience.  Cookies like this shouldn't smell like potato vodka.They do have a chocolate-covered version of this that you can't really smell, because the flour is covered. It's such a sugar rush that you may not care what it tastes like, particularly because it has an excellent chocolate-sugar-bomb wafer cookie texture.Just hold your nose.

My son and I who are both Celiacs loved Glutino wafers in both chocolate and dark chocolate varieties. We were on our 3rd box when I opened one of the bars and went to bite into it. It was the equivalent to biting into some sort of spongy rock. I immediately spit out what chocolate had fallen into my mouth while biting it. The bar itself seemed extremely stale to me. I went ahead and opened the remaining 3 bars in the box and the rest were normal. I also noted on the package that the product is made in Israel then processed in Canada, then sent to USA to be bought. It seems to me like one of the bars I had floated around a facility for quite some time before it was actually packaged and sent. Or worse who knows. I'm glad it was me and not my 3 year old son who bit into it.I tried contacting Glutino about what happened. I tried calling several times as well as sent messages via the internet. But no response. It went from being suspicious to down right scary, what are they hiding and if this is how they treat their costumers- how do they treat their food?Please be forewarned. Going gluten free isn't easy and Glutino is a big brand on the celiac's grocery list but since our incident we avoid Glutino at all costs.

I enjoy visiting a nearby Fresh and Easy Neighborhood Market because they stock so many exotic gourmet items. It's a British company and a lot of their items are imported from the British Isles. For example, on this latest visit, I picked up a jar (12 ounces) of sliced beetroot that was nicely pickled. Mmmmm. They are just exceptionally good. We always called them pickled beets, and I haven't seen any for years and years. Well, these are a nice reminder. Not only are the beets themselves quite good, but the pickling juices are good for a refreshing drink.Gary Peterson

I love this mix. It contains most of the ingredients. I like it because everything is measured. I add extra dried cranberries and nuts and use the same size baking pan. I line the pan with foil so that I have less cleaning, jst thrown the foil away

My kids love cranberry bread, as does my husband, but it's nearly impossible to find locally.  I was delighted to find this on Amazon.  The price is reasonable, and getting it delivered is great.  One variation you can make which my guys just love is to add 2 tsp of milk powder, and substitute orange juice for the water; adding a little orange zest gives it a little extra zip.  I also always add walnuts for flavor and nutritional boost.  I recommend this to any lover of quick breads or nut breads.

Over time (as is typical with manufacturers) the packaging of this product has changed as well as the name.  The emphasis is now on the "Cranberry" but I still love this bread.  I first tried it in 1996 and the thing that sold me was the great Orange flavor that was such a standout.  I've been buying this Bread Mix ever since.  However in the recent pass it never seems to be in the stores where I shop which is what prompted me to search it out on Amazon.  I am glad I found it there and was able to stock-up.  It's great fresh from the over or later, if you can keep it around for later.  It's good alone or spread with butter, or other favorite spreads.  And of course it's versatile - bread, muffins, or even pancakes, whatever you desire.  I usually add a little extra orange zest and chopped nuts...it's great! Oh, I think I smell it now!  Got'a go check my oven...

this is a lovely tea.  found it for a good price at my local market.  i drink a lot of yogi tea, meditative time smells great.  hints of sage and lavender..very calming for me, a stay at home mom of three under the age of three.  another great tea by yogi.ps this is not a fake review!! i am a real person who loves all the yogi teas i've tried so far!! you can check my other reviews to see.  sad that some companies are putting fake reviews on here.  shame on yoU!!!

column9: Tasty but tiny, and fairly expensive.
column10: I was extremely excited to order these bars after reading about the health benefits of chia seeds - the Health Warrior bars looked great.  Unfortunately, I was disappointed to find how small each bar is - maybe I should have looked at the product details more closely, but it turns out that each bar is VERY small (think about half the size of a luna bar) which was disappointing.  Luckily, at only 100 calories each, the small size was not a huge deal, I just found that I wasn't entirely satisfied after just eating 1.  The taste was great, but I'm a health nut and some people might find that the Health Warrior bars are not as sweet as traditional granola bars.  I will happily eat the rest of the box but will reconsider before buying again, especially considering the price.

I kept the wrapper to this bar so that I could google it and find it again. It tastes great and keeps you satisfied for a long time ~the perfect in-between meal snack! Great source of fiber and protein and of course Omega 3. Would definitely recommend! Chia seeds fill up with water (or saliva) and become kinda slimy but not too much in this bar.

I love these bars. They are on the smaller side so if you are expecting a big snack, this is not going to be it. I've been eating these for 3 o 4 months and they keep me full and give me the energy I need to get through the afternoon.

column9: not as good as I thought
column10: This licorice is not bad, but it's not the kind of licorice that I like.  I usually purchase from a bulk candy store but thought I'd try online.  This candy is a lot stickier (on the hands) than what I usually buy and a little more stiffer.  I don't mean stale, just a little bit harder to eat and enjoy.

I purchased this coffee when my normal source for Jamaica Blue Mountain beans (Balducci's) ran out for a few weeks.  The Marley's Coffee was not great quality and did not smell like any of the Jamaica Blue Mountain beans I have purchased from other sources.  It smelled musky and damp, not delicious.  The taste was also very disappointing.  In sum, I wil not purchase this again and do not recommend it!

column9: Price went up 20% with the new packaging and there is less Cinnamon
column10: Barbara's Bakery hyped the new packaging but neglected to mention that the weight went from 12oz per box to 10 oz per box.  I use to purchase a 4 pack of the 12 oz old package for 15.57 and that works out to 32.4 cents per oz.  the new price for a 6 pack of the 10 oz box works out to 39 cents per ounce.  That's a 20% price hike in a period of low to no inflation.  Thanks for the nice new package guys.  I much prefer the old package at the old price and will be checking out other cereals with the intent of eliminating cinnamon puffins from my diet.The cereal also tastes different - not as good.  I looked at the ingredients and noticed that in both the old and new product there is 150 mg of salt.  However, in the old ingredient list cinnamon came before salt. In the new ingredient list it comes after salt.  Thus, there is less cinnamon in the new cereal. You can really taste the difference.  The old recipe was much tastier.  Again, my hat is off to Barbara's Bakery.  The price went up and the taste is not nearly as good.  Great job guys.January 20, 2011 Update:  I have replaced cinnamon puffins with other cereals.  Bring back the old taste which I loved so much and I'll buy again, even at the increased price.
I used to LOVE the cinnamon flavor Puffins.  Unfortunately, they did indeed reduce the cinnamon flavor - totally different - while they changed/reduced the packaging.  What a disappointment.

column9: Reduced individual cereal, reduced taste, reduced box, increased price per oz
column10: Puffin cereals used to be one of my favorites.  Cinnamon was my favorites among Puffin cereals.The new Puffin Cinnamon is not an improvement.  The size of each individual cereal was reduced.  But it appears they reduced not only the size but the formula of the cereal itself. I don't like the flavor as much, it appears to be sweeter and has less cinnamon.  The box size was reduced from 12 oz to 10 oz, thus becoming more expensive per oz.I am attaching two photos: The first photo shows the new packaging highlighting the reduced size.  The second photo show the ingredients and nutritional fact from the side of the box.  Puffin calories are shown using a serving size of 2/3 of cup, which is a pretty small portion. The box has 9 of those servings.  What I use as a serving is larger. For me each box has 4 servings. I noticed that cinnamon moved down on the ingredient list (when I compared it to the old box), which confirms my taste difference observation.With the new packaging you get something less tasty for more money per oz.  Barbara's Bakery - please bring back the old cereal!

column9: I agree with the past reviewer
column10: I've been eating Barbara's Cinnamon Puffins, and I agree they do not taste as good before they changed the package.  Also, I wish they were using organic, non-GMO corn for the price of this cereal!!!

I have to disagree with all the negative reviews.  As to the packaging and weight, I only just discovered this, so have no opinion on that.  I think they are delicious!  I like them for snack or to carry in the car for nibbles.  I'm doing WWers and a serving is only 3 points and 2/3 cup (the serving-size) is plenty for either breakfast with milk or for an "I can't make it until supper" snack.
