column9: Really Good Fresh Murray's Sugar-Free Shortbread
column10: These cookies arrived quickly and are in great shape.  They are very fresh and are all Shortbread.  The brand sent is Murray and looks just like the picture.  Ignore the 'Kebbler' title.  The Shortbread is made with Splenda and has a pleasant vanilla-like aftertaste.  Eight little cookies come in a packet.  Each is 1-1/2" in diameter.  The packet is 130 calories and has 140 mg of sodium. The packet says it's equivalent to one diabetic exchange each of fat and carbohydrate.  I feel that one packet is just the right size for a mid-morning or mid-afternoon snack.  Highly recommend.

I first tasted the Keebler Shortbread Sugar Free cookies at a hospital cafeteria.  I had never seen this sugar free brand on a grocery shelf, so I started searching the WWW.  I was grateful to find them available through Amazon, but somewhat surprised that, upon receipt of my order, the label is Murray's instead of Keebler. I've seen Murray's in my grocery but the label is not appealing like Keebler's label.  Taste is the same.  Thanks
This is suppose to be a variety pack, it contains 60 packs of shortbread cookies, 30 packs of lemon and 30 packs of chocolate chip cookies.  Not much of a variety as far as i'm concerned.
I was happy to find this in bulk ... it's our secret ingredient for our cookies.
This is a great way to purchase cream of tartar which I use to make play dough for my preschool education classrooms.Highly recommend this economical way to purchase it.

This cream of tartar does everything it is supposed to and arrived very fresh. We use it in baking and also for DIY kids crafts, and it is very effective.Frontier is one of my favorite brands. I buy their bulk cinnamon, cocoa, and other herbs and spices. I have always been pleased with the quality I have received from them. The packaging is always very solid, and the product arrives very fresh and in perfect condition.

I bake A LOT. Snickerdoodles, which require cream of tartar, (a.k.a. Angel Cream) are a friends-and-family favorite. I found Frontier Bulk Cream of Tartar to be the best value for the money, and just as good tasting as the store brands. The reason it got 4, not 5, stars is the foil bag: It should be rezipperable. So, I rolled up the top of the cream of tartar bag, & put it in my own zip-lock baggie. Voile! Problem overcome.
The purchase went smoothly, price was good, and the product was received within a couple of days.  I will make this purchase again, when needed.
The product was delivered quickly. The price was very reasonable. I would definitely purchase this item again.

This is the only dog food my fussy Chihuahua will eat. She has been eating it for about 6 months now and she went from laying around to acting like a puppy again.This is the only kind I will feed her.

My dogs love this food! It is small but what used to take 4 cups to feed them the balance in this food only takes about 2.5 cups (I have 4 yorkies all under 5 pnds). They have energy and seem more filled and satisfied after eating!

column4: Barely There "Never regret anything that made...
column10: KEEP YOUR RECEIPT.Tastes weird ...artificial & the stuff has white plastic crap in it."I started to put it on a hamburger and said "Oh Hell no".Save your money.Was ok in "tarter sauce"..recipe:mince onions.add lemon pepper, lemon juice, dill relish.some stevia if you like sweet..and a small amount of this mayo.***I tried to use as a pseudo sour cream...and well it ruined the entire recipe.***As with all Walden Farms if you are not on a very low calorie diet..then do not use zero calorie products.Walden Farms did refund my money.I bought a half dozen of their products.
Good substitute for mayo when you are looking for zero calories, zero fat, zero sugar, and gluten free!  We used with the Ideal Protein diet and were very successful losing weight.

I've ordered 10 different Walden Farm products and this Miracle Whip is one of 7 products that are gross. They use too much artificial sweetners and that's all I can taste. Artificial sweetners are okay for their BBQ sauce, ketchup, and syrup but not for mayo or ranch.If your on a diet plan like I am (Medifast) use laughing cow cheese as a substitute. Laughing cow is amazing!

I'm not sure why the listing shows "Miracle Mayo" but when you click on it the picture is of regular mayo, but this review is of "Miracle Mayo," if it's different from their regular mayo, which I haven't tried.  I love this stuff- takes almost exactly like Miracle Whip and has a nice, whipped texture too.  Great for heart-healthy, low-fat & vegan diets.  I use this on sandwiches, and in carrot or cole slaw.  It's VERY sweet, so a little goes a long way (I thin it with unsweetened almond milk for use in salads), but I love the flavor- fresh and no chemical after-taste.Added later: as a commenter pointed out, it contains egg whites so is NOT vegan- sorry.

These little packets of hummus are lifesavers. As a vegan, healthier, filling snacks can be hard to come by when traveling and these little packs travel well (even in a very full backpack!) are handy, easy, versatile and everyone from kidlettes to kids at heart dig it. They've been breakfast paired with a bagel, lunch with salad and pita chips, a snack with veggies, the list goes on. Tasty with a great texture and perfect portion size, you have no excuse to not have some on hand during your hike/long workday/other food emergency.  Bonus: also gluten-free, so it's a no-brainer choice when I want to share with my celiac friends.
This is a great product.  The taste is as good as any hummus I have ever tried.  The packaging is wonderful for lunches or snacks on the go.

Wow, for a Hummus that is pre-packaged and needs no refrigeration it tastes fantastic, if not better than most Hummus that you can find in the refrigerator section of the supermarket.  I bought a "go picnic" box which contained this and was really surprised at how delicious this hummus is.  It is the perfect portion size and would be great in a kid's (or adult's) lunchbox with a handful of crackers.  You can slip this in your purse or back-pack, it's quite durable the packaging, and eat it when you need something healthy and filling.  By the way, check out the Go Picnic ready-to-eat meals.  I first found them at Cost Plus World Market, but have since found them on Amazon.  Their meal with this same "Wild Garden" Hummus also comes with rice crackers, some chocolate, edamame and a fruit and nut mix, it's fantastic, especially if you don't have the time to put together your own healthy snack or lunch box.  I left mine in the car for months and just ate it and it was still really good.GoPicnic Ready-to-Eat Meals, Hummus + Crackers, 4.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)

When it comes to añejo tequilas, it's time to put your shot glasses away and use a vessel that best accentuates the color, flavor, and bouquet of the pricey aged spirit you're about to experience. Like wine, añejo tequila is aged to give it characteristics you'll want to enjoy. The slight bowl of the Riedel Ouverture helps direct the sweet vanilla and cinnamon notes to your nose, and is perfect for sipping to fully appreciate the unique qualities of the particular, and likely limited, batch of añejo in which you've invested. Yes, they are fragile. They're made of glass. Treat them with care. I've run mine through my dishwasher several times with no problems, but I'm always cautious not to crowd them and to remove them slowly. These glasses were a tiny investment compared to what a bottle of high quality tequila costs, and I strongly recommend them to anyone out to deepen their tequila experience.

Excellent product!Riedel makes some of the best stemware around.This particular glass allows a person to enjoy some very good Tequila the way it should be.Highly recommend this product to everyone who enjoys good quality!

I ordered these glasses as a birthday gift for my son-in-law.  Needless to say, as a gift, I wanted them to be a quality glass and they were exactly that!  They are a nice weight to hold in your hand. I was proud to give them!

I bought these to serve sipping tequilas and they work great. People actually took the time to sniff and sip their tequila, rather than down it fast as a shot which you don't want your guest to do while sipping pricey good tequila. These also arrived in great condition.

column9: The proper glass to enjoy a fine tequila
column10: These are sturdy glasses that go thru my dishwasher constantly. They feel well balanced in your hand when held by the stem. The body of the glass is short and allows the color of the tequila to travel upward. If your buying fine tequila or just sipping your favorite variety, this is the perfect glass.

Good for ppl who know how to appreciate tequila. You can really Smell the aromas while drinking it.  Of course it's not stemware you want to throw around it is delicate but not overly delicate. Used it dozens of times and have no complaints about build quality.

Just kidding about the floor.  You won't want to put any shooting tequila in these glasses.  If you want to shoot, stick to your shooters and cheap tequila.  If you enjoy sipping tequila by itself or with nice a plate of carnitas, these are the glasses for you.  I received two sets for Christmas 2010 and have not been disappointed one little bit.  I went out and bought two bottles of my favorite tequilas after I received them, both anjeos.  The first is Jose Cuervo (keep reading) Reserva de la Familia and the other is 4 Copas.  These are two very different, both high end, anjeos that you enjoy even more so when served in these glasses.  With the narrow bowl, you can get more of the aromas from the tequila without the burst of alcohol you would get from a wider bowl.  This allows me to enjoy the aroma and full flavor of the tequila with each sip.As far as the durability of these glasses?  I haven't tested them for durability nor will I do so.  Like anything you value, treat them kindly.  Like other reviewers have said, wash and dry the bowl while gently holding the bowl and wash and dry the stem while gently holding the stem.  That being said, I ran these through the dishwasher before I used them the first time and they came out great.  But I was careful in stacking them too.And finally, a tip if you want to find some high end tequila at a mid level price, go to a store that rhymes with bostco.  I paid 75.00 for the bottle of 4 Copas Anjeo at a discount liquor store.  For about 35.00 I tried a 1 liter bottle of Kirkland Anjeo.  Same deep color, same rich aroma, same sipping quality, and you get more too.  Tequila!!!

column9: too fragile unless you are a girlie-man tequila drinker
column10: I like the glass. It definitely is the glass for drinking Tequila. they truly let  the aromas and flavors of fine tequilas be discovered by the drinker.  The problem is that they are so very fragile.  I broke one while gently drying it. The stem separated cleanly from the rest of the glass. I broke another,  again while drying this time I was lucky that I didn't cut my hand with the broken glass. For the price I'm not sure if thy are worth all the trouble.

This is a good price for wild rice.  The packages are individually wrapped, about 2-3 cups of rice in each bag. You get a box of twelve bags.  One bag makes a good sidedish for a family of 4 or five.  The rice cooks fairly quickly so you do need to watch that it doesn't overcook and get mushy.  If it does overcook not to worry, add sauteed mushrooms and onions, and a little half/half or cream and make a really easy and delicious mushroom and wildrice soup.

I tried RevHoney a few weeks ago and have been drinking it ever since.  The drink has a great taste without the crash that the others do (i.e. Monster, Rockstar, Sobe, Redbull, etc...).  I drink a RevHoney usually before working out and get a release of energy that helps me sustain all through my workout...Great Product!

This energy drink does a good job at keeping you alert without giving you the jitters. I like that it uses honey instead of sugar or artificial sweeteners. While the taste is not something I would go for on its own, it is better than many energy drinks and nothing that would discourage me from continuing to drink it.

column9: If you're gonna drink junk.... Drink good junk!
column10: I met the local distributor (Shawn) while he was delivering product to our neighborhood store, and I've been buying it since.  I know that I will never put down the soda or energy drinks, so I figured that I may as well drink one that is good for me.  I've actually lost 10 lbs by substituting soda and monster energy for this drink.  I have no illusion that this is a magical cure all drink, but all the ingredients are natural, all the calories are dietary(from honey), and it contain none of the chemical simulants that the other "energy" drinks do. I actually don't consider this an "energy" drink, but a healthy substitute for them and soda.  Like I stated before, I'm not gonna put down the soda, so if I'm gonna drink junk... I'm gonna drink junk thats better for me!

RevHoney was sponsoring a Homecoming 5k race at my college, and they were giving out all of their products. Looking at the ingredients list, they don't actually list Raw Honey, or Honey, they call it "Rev Honey". In all descriptions of their drink, they say that Rev Honey includes raw honey, not that Rev Honey is raw honey. I feel like it's a little suspicious, but I don't doubt that there is raw honey.Overall, the taste is mediocre on this product, and after our 5k, it's making my stomach hurt. Some may love the taste, but it's not my cup of tea.

column9: An energy drink without caffeine? Excellent concept!
column10: I did not realize that there was an energy drink made without caffeine until I stumbled upon this product in Amazon. What an excellent concept! For those who have a difficult time consuming caffeine because it makes you jittery but still need a little extra boost to get your through the day, then you definitely need to try RevHoney Berry Rain. The concept behind the energy boost is that RevHoney is made from real honey so the honey blend mix in the beverage provides the added energy kick. This is an excellent product that actually tastes really good too. I now drink RevHoney not only for the energy boost but as a substitute for a cola as well because it is a healthy drink so it is better for you than the cola drinks. I would definitely recommend this product!

column9: Ahmad Earl Grey Tea ~ The Most Exquisite Earl Grey I've Ever Tasted
column10: I first came across Ahmad Earl Grey Tea a number of years ago, while I was visiting a friend who lives out in Seaford, Long Island (NY). I was waiting for her to meet me in a mall, there, & I just happened into a Mideastern grocery-deli to browse and look at the great variety of exotic foods & spices they had for sale.By & by, I started getting thirsty & asked the shopkeeper whether he had cups of hot tea for sale. He showed me the varieties of tea they had & I chose Ahmad Earl Grey Tea, since Earl Grey has been my favorite ever since I was introduced to it back in the late '70s by an English friend of mine, who would prepare it with milk or cream & sugar or honey.Well, I had had excellent cups of Earl Grey tea in the past -- Twinings, Bigelow, Island-Rose & others -- but nothing I had previously tasted had fully prepared me for the sublimely fragrant, yet delicate & nuanced bouquet of aroma & flavor that literally "took me by surprise" upon my first sip of Ahmad Earl Grey Tea... aroma & flavor that was not just a simple one-dimensional taste but one that seemed to unfold as you drank it, revealing delightfully unexpected subtleties, layers & shades of enchantingly fragrant aromas & flavors.Surprisingly, the high quality of the tea leaves & the bergamot used to impart the flavor were clearly distinguishable to me in the tea's unmistakably delightful yet delicate aroma, not only when opening the box of 100 tea bags, or the individual envelopes containing the bags of tea... but quite detectable, in the tea bag itself, even after having made a cup of tea or two, making me wonder whether they might have discovered some very effective, secret manner of infusing the bergamot aroma into the tea leaves, or the tea bag, such that the aroma didn't dissipate after having made a cup of tea, or even while standing on the shelf of the grocery, as I've noticed sometimes happens with lesser grades of Earl Grey tea.In any event, after such an incomparable experience with Ahmad Earl Grey Tea, it is the only Earl Grey tea that I choose to drink, unless I happen to be out somewhere where it is, unfortunately, not available.It is at such times that I am so appreciative to have come across Ahmad Earl Grey Tea.Though I've often purchased it at Mideastern food markets, for instance in Astoria, Queens, where it is readily available at rock-bottom prices & fresh from the importers, nevertheless, for those of you who are too far away to do so, the fact that it is available here on Amazon.com is already quite a boon, especially if you order a number of packages of it to lessen the impact of the shipping charges, though, if you already have amazon Prime, that will be a boon as far as shipping charges are concerned.If you do order Ahmad Earl Grey Tea & try it, I'm quite sure that you'll find that it soon becomes for you, as it has for me, "a most exquisite delight, definitely not to be missed!"

column9: Tastes great, but too many 'special effects'
column10: If it were for taste alone, I'd give these cookies 5 stars.  They're pretty much indistinguishable from ordinary high-carb chocolate chip cookies.  Very tasty!However, this product contains inulin, a poly-fructose that is not digestible, at least not by humans.  Turns out, bacteria in the colon love inulin.  They metabolize it like crazy, creating lots of carbon dioxide, hydrogen and methane in the process.  Needless to say, after eating a few of these cookies, you may have to tie the blankets down on your bed to keep them from being blown off.  But if you're the sort who is amused by digestive music, these cookies might become a favored treat.

I can't believe there aren't any other reviews here yet. These are great. Even the raw dough is fantastic. I make some type of low carb dessert whenever we're faced with a holiday or birthday so that we have a legal treat. It helps us to avoid the illegal ones. Don't hesitate to try these if you're a low carber and need a treat.

These won me over. These cookies are soooooo very good. I live a low carb lifestyle and these are some of the best low carb cookies I have tried. I also like the Big Train brand products better than some of the other low carb brands. So good, I will order these cookies again & again!

I didn't like these cookies. I don't know why reviews here on Amazon and on netrition are saying how sweet they are, because they aren't sweet at all. They only taste like almonds and oats. The texture isn't good, and they fell apart before I could even get them off the pan. The directions said not to grease the pan but I think you'd have to, despite having an entire stick of butter in the mix.According to the nutrition facts (when you do the math) the package is supposed to make 34 cookies (a 2" 2-cookie serving, makes 17 servings). It told you to drop tablespoons of dough and I used my tablespoon cookie scoop but it only made 24 cookies.I suppose these cookies were better than any other of the low-carb cookie recipes I've tried from cookbooks, but they still were not good enough to make again and I'll probably end up throwing most of them away. I'm on a low-carb and low-calorie diet and with a whole stick of butter in the dough I don't think it's worth the calories I'd have to sacrifice to eat a mediocre cookie.I suppose when I want to eat a cookie, I just want to eat a darn cookie. I suppose I want to taste sugar (or something like it), not oats or almonds. When you have a sweet tooth, who reaches for oats or almonds? I don't even like oatmeal cookies; maybe that's one reason why I don't like them.

column9: Tasty but a bit too sweet
column10: Maybe it's because these were the first cookies I'd eaten in a couple of months, but I found them too sweet by about 50%.  They are quite tasty, if little cake-like in texture.  They satisfy the urge to have a cookie.  But when one is trying to avoid sugar, having a low-carb treat that has too much of it is kind of disappointing.  I kind of wish they let you add your own sugar to taste.  That would also let you control the carbs more.

These are DELICIOUS! They aren't health food. They are real chocolate chip cookies made with almond flour to cut the carb count. I dont like the price and will probably just buy some almond flour and make some recipes on my own. But these are very good and for not wanting to cook, its worth it.

column9: Pretty good, great on low carb
column10: These are great, they even stay soft after they've cooled. They're not very sweet though and you can really tell it's made primarily with almond flour. Very almondy taste.

column9: Three cheers for tasty low-carb cookies!
column10: My daughter cooked up a package of these over the weekend, and I must say that I was impressed.  They were very tasty, being indiscernable from "normal" cookies.Also, I did not have any of the digestive issues I sometimes have with other low-carb products.  I will definately be purchasing these regularly.Cheers!- Rod

column9: my favorite low carb junk food
column10: I've been eating low carb for years, and these are my favorite of all the low carb baked goods.  They taste the best right out of the oven.  You can definitely taste the almond flour (the base of the chocolate chip cookies) - so if you don't like almond, you may not like these.  Like all low carb desserts, they will mess your stomach up if you eat too much,...but the taste is great.  I highly recommend these.

column9: love the taste very good highly recommend
column10: love the taste very good highly recommend. I did not care for the Big Train Brownie mix but had already ordered this Big Train Cookie mix. I was surprized how great the taste was. If you mix in some pecans or walnuts chunks tastes even better. Highly recommend. Will purchase again soon.
I bought this for my elderly mother who loves flowers. These are very low maintenance and just last week she told me that they had bloomed

My kids used these for their science fair at their elementary school and won second place. My kids especially enjoyed watching the leaves grow. We kept it growing right on our kitchen counter so we could note changes in growth daily. Super fun experiment.

column9: Let me be the first to say...
column10: Our parents were very pleased with what they received. Thanks for sending us such high quality flower bulbs. We are really happy and will order some more around Christmas

I have one cat who is really not into canned food at all - unusual, I know. But, I put down a can of Merrick's 'California Roll' and she totally ignored the dry food that I had mixed with her favorite treat, Kitty Kaviar (fish flakes) and dove into the canned. I think she ate close to the entire can by herself, in fact, purring like crazy the entire time!If you have a picky eater, try this food. I think you'll be pleasantly surprised! Oh, and this really doesn't smell (icky) like your typical canned cat food, either.
After putting our kitties on natural treats and food, we gave the California Roll to our kitties for their Christmas last year - all three loved it.  Will be ordering more.
Yes, my cats loved this product and they run to eat it every time I give it to them.Must be a great combination !

I have 3 very picky eaters, I must say the consistency of this they LOVE! Not to mention how healthy it is for them, you can feel good about giving it to them. They run when the can opens in the morning and evening.. they gobble it all up! Highly recommend this and any other flavors by Merrick..High quality, good tasting (to them) you can't beat it!
My two cats do not like this stuff. And with having to buy 24 cans and then finding out they won't eat it. Don't waste your money.Go to the pet store.

I have a 28lb schnauzer-terrier, who thinks he's 100lbs. He loves big food. Even though this isn't the "large breed" formula, the chunks are pretty good size (marble-size). We recently switched to Iams brand after moving away from a Costco (saddest day of my life). Can't believe Amazon includes this in free 2-day shipping with prime!

column9: My Picky Dog LOVES this food!!
column10: I have a 2 year old German Shepherd that is very picky about her food.  We've tried the expensive brands that you can only buy at the Vet, then we've tried the less expensive, but still good dog food from Petsmart, etc. We just never could find anything she really liked.  WELL, this was on sale at my local Walmart and I decided to give it a try!  OMGOSH, she eats every last morsel.  I'm so happy to finally find a dog food I feel good about that she will actually eat.  And now that i've found it on Amazon, that makes it even better :)

column9: Excellent dog food and excellent value!
column10: I have just recently started ordering my dog's food online through Amazon and I love it!  I use my Prime shipping to have it delivered in two days, and the price is comparable to what I would pay in the store.  The last purchase I made online through Amazon, I was able to use a $1 Amazon electronic coupon.  It was great!  Love Amazon, and I'm really happy with this Iams dog food.  We've been using the regular chunk-size since she turned 1 year.  Before that, we used the Iams mini-chunk.

I remember having some amazing black dragon oolong back in a tea shop in Savannah and I thought this might be the one, it is close but not exactly the same. It makes a satisfying cup and a nice finish with many notes. I would recommend this as a nice mid afternoon tea.

column9: DO NOT buy from this Seller
column10: The product is awesome. I have had super luck with no upset stomachs. I have been feeding Solid Gold dry and canned for 4 months and am very happy with the product.However, Petco is charging a ridicules price for what they are sending. Their ads are very deceiving. Notice they don't bother to tell you they are selling the smallest can possible. I just paid 1.45 a can for the tiny can. You can purchase the large can from Pet Supply Plus for about 128.00. I am so tired of this type of actions going on at Amazon.As far as Solid Gold, I love the product. As far as Petco, never again will I buy from them. Since I am rating the product and NOT the seller, I am giving a 5 star.

column9: I am an adult with GERD
column10: I recently ended up with GERD and a really bad bleeding ulcer, due to stress and grief.  I have problems keeping food down and went on a baby food diet for the sake of thriving.  Some types of baby food stay down,  where as other types cause me indigestion just as bad as adult food.  This specific sweet potato one seemed to ease my acid refluxing and indigestion and sooth my throat.  I'm not at the point where I can eat the whole container yet,  but this is a good start.  This also has a pleasant taste.  Some of the baby food is just bland and boring,  but this one is alright.  Not the best but still alright. Please be weary if you're having gastrointestinal problems.  Babyfood is such a great idea if you're having problems keeping things in,  and need to retrain your stomach and intestines.  Just be careful,  some are more acidic than others.By the way,  this doesn't have all the nutrients you would need to survive.  As a adult you'd need about 12-16 small jars a day and you'd need to make sure you get enough protein.  So be careful,  this is only a temporary fix for people with ulcers and GERD.

My little one liked this and would eat it up without any issues. It does have all the vegetables. I think I could do the same in a blender, but it was just convenient especially when we were travelling. She would not create any fuss and actually showed excitement when I would open up the packet.

column9: He loves sweet potatos, but this one is runny
column10: I don't know if its the corn, but this sweet potato is runny.  The other ones from Gerber with sweet potato's are not.  I prefer the solid food to be thicker.
Can't beat the price and convenience of buying online.  Don't have to waste gas and time going to the grocery store anymore for baby food.

I cant figure out why Gerber 2nd peas are so hard to find in the store...I see something green and its always green beans! We go through peas so much in my house with my child and this is the only way we are going to buy them from now on. The box is very compact and I just remove the top and leave stored them right in the box. It saves a ton of room in the kitchen, rather than having them tipping over in the cupboard.One surprising thing we also discovered is that our cat who has a low appetite loves this simple pea baby food too. It has been healthy for my baby and a real treat for my pet. Good stuff.

This is a great find for our family. First off, mixed vegetables is one of the best flavors of baby food. Its also sometimes hard to find in the stores near me that typically have a very meager selection. This eight pack takes care of our needs for a while, and everything comes neatly shipped in a compact little box that you can tear the top of and keep them all together. Every tub arrived and it had a really long expiration date. You cant go wrong!
I'm a nanny granny and it's very convenient to have my sweet grandbaby's food delivered to the door. Sometimes it can be a bit of a challenge to get to the store.
Convenient. Didn't have to go to the grocery store and haul them. My baby eats a LOT so this really was a good thing.

column9: Instant Potatoes...As Good As They Get!
column10: I have tried lots of different products over the years when it comes to Betty Crocker. Some were really great and I use them everyday in my kitchen, others were a 'one time flung'.I bought these intitally because they were made from Yukon Gold Potatoes that are a family favorite to start with. I had my doubts but the the first time I made them they were GREAT! even the picky eaters at my house asked for seconds. My only thing I think that would improve them was in the labeled servings per box. I needed to make BOTH pouches to feed 2 adults, 2 teen boys and one tween girl.They are a good alternative for quick & easy dinners or for when company is here but no very cost effective for regulars family dinners.

We tried these once after finding them in the local grocery store, then could never find them again.These are some of the best-tasting mashed potatoes that we have tried.  Glad Amazon sells them!They cost a little more, but are worth it.

column9: Betty Crocker mashed potatoes, Yukon Gold
column10: I have never liked powered potatoes, until these.  For one packet in box I add the alotted amount of water, an extra tablespoon of butter, and the alotted amount of milk less 2 ounces. I then put in 2 ounces of half & half and they are delicious. My family really likes them.

We drink soy milk primarily in the summer as my family's stomachs don't handle dairy AND the Texas heat well. We've tried many brands before but I ordered this brand while on sale. This isn't a favorite and I probably wouldn't order it again. It's not very tasty and would probably do better with add-ins... not so good just straight. Yes we have found "chunks and lumps" as my son says. He won't drink this unless it's blended...defeats the purpose of having these small portable packages!It's just OK, isn't one of my favorite soy milk drinks and not one I'd serve to company.

Because of a dairy allergy, we've been a soymilk household for many years. We've bought many types: Silk brand, Trader Joe's, store brand, refrigerator, shelf stable, individual servings, etc. And we've enjoyed all of them.... until we bought this product - Pacific Natural Foods Enriched Vanilla Soymilk, 8 oz. packages. This is by far the WORST soymilk we've ever had. As other reviewers commented, it's chunky. And no matter how much you shake it, it's still chunky. My kids refuse to drink it and send it home in their lunch boxes unopened. I don't recommend this. I do recommend trying another brand!

Taking care of children for a crisis respite nursery can have it's challanges. This wonderful product can be kept on the shelf and won't spoil in a few days so it's on hand when we need it. The children with dairy issues can have milk just like all the other children and they love it. It was shipped in a timely manner. Check this out you may love it too!

I was concerned after buying this due to the negative reviews.  I'm glad that I did buy the soymilk.  I like the taste, I love the individual serving sizes, I appreciate that it is organic, and so far I have had no chunks.  Perfect for lunchboxes and snacks.

It wouldn't be my first choice again in the future, but my son who I buy it for doesn't have complaints after having drunk Silk for a year...I'm not a big cows milk drinker and tend to drink soy along with him, I wanted to try a different brand when money was a little tighter and we ran out of drink boxes for school - this is a better deal as you get more. I'd be interested in trying the chocolate. But I did not care for the taste of this myself and think I'll stick to Silk when I make my next purchase .. but overall do recommend as an option for milk alternatives.
It is a very practical package, however the taste is not the best. I have to mix it with something else like banana or chocolate powder to get rid of the taste.
This is an affordable alternative to the more expensive single serve soy milks... tastes good, too.

This a great product but the note about the mg of caffine is WRONG! The regular Vanilla Chai is 65mg per serving. This one is only 5mg per serving, just in case that was a concern, as it was for me. Otherwise a great product.

column9: Avoderm is my cats favorite food!!
column10: AvoDerm Natural Select Cuts Chicken Chunks Canned Cat Food  My cat has been such a picky eater since he was a kitten, Avoderm is the FIRST food that he just loves (he's tried ALL the premium & organic cat foods).  He loves these little cans especially the broth inside, he slurps it up rather noisily and I love that Avoderm is a healthy ingredient food.  It's made his coat look so shiny & healthy and he has so much energy.
Great tasting soup!  Lots of chicken and vegetables in it.  Very filling.  These containers make it very easy and fast to prepare.

I have eaten Campbell soup for years.  This chunky chicken corn chowder is one of the special ones.  Great flavor and real bite sized meat and vegs.  I think the soup base is the best just the right creammy texture and the spices used really enhance the meat and vegs.  You really can not go wrong to have this one for a warm up any time of year.

This soup is very good.  It has a nice flavor and is a solid comfort food. The container makes it practical for a fast meal, especially at work. The soup contains enough chicken to validate it's name "chunky chicken."  The vegetables are substantial and hearty which makes it a real chowder and a meal in itself.  Quick, easy and tasty -- you can't ask for more than that.  Enjoy.

column9: Reminds me of the "olden days" recipe...
column10: We had a great aunt who used to make this soup every year for our family reunion in Lancaster, PA. Of course she did a marvelous job! But Chunky is giving her a run for her money! The soup is really delicious. It is loaded with corn, potatoes, carrots and of course BIG chunks of WHITE meat chicken! It's the perfect soup to microwave in two minutes when you don't have the energy to cook and you know you'll be getting a nutritious AND filling dinner or lunch or heck, even just as a snack. Very tasty and not too salty tasting at all! Of course being a "canned" soup it is high in sodium but you don't taste it as being high in salt. The flavors are very well balanced. Your family will love this on a snowy day! I eat it all year-round though! Enjoy everyone!
this is the best of the chunky soups that campbells makes- the whole family likes this soup- my husband takes it to work for lunch
i liked this one(corn) much better than the clam chowder...i will buy again, as a matter of fact i'll buy more now..

it's microwavable so basically it's ready-to-eat, and it's delicious. well, but dont take this one flavor for everyday. because that can make you feel sick. but sometimes when you are busy with your work, or even at school lunch, it's convinient. what i like about this product is it's packaging. the soup does not leak from it. plus, i think it's cheaper to buy online rather than offline.

column9: Tasty, satisfying soup, but don't eat too often!
column10: OK, so one can is 2 servings.  So double those nutritional numbers if you eat the whole can (as I, and I expect many, do). That's 400 calories, not too bad, but 180 of those are from fat (oops!).  Also you're getting 70% of your daily sodium, 1680mg. and 50 mg of cholesterol (16%), 40g carbs (14%), 6g fiber, 8g sugar and 20g of fat.  Definitely not health food territory. So, I wouldn't eat this soup too often.  But, occasionally, it's fine (in my opinion).That said, it is very tasty and very satisfying.  The quality seems good, nice texture, good broth, good potatoes, nice corn flavor, OK chicken, and so on.  I enjoyed my first bowl very much.  Definitely a nice treat on a cold day.  An ok value using subscribe and save with free shipping.  Nice to have these on hand for a quick meal. Definitely one of the better tasting Campbell's chunky soups I've tried.  (If they could reduce the cholesterol, sodium and fat, they'd really have something.)Overall, a very tasty and satisfying soup.
I like a soup that is thick with lots of ingredients.  More like a stew in consistency than a soup.  This soup is excellent in that regard and certainly tastes good as well.  Highly recommended.

Very flavorful and gives amazing taste to salads and food in general. Just a pinch make a huge difference in the way your food tastes like.  This is the only type of salt I am using since I discovered it. I put it on meat, fish, veggies, salads, soups,etc. Everything tastes better with this salt. I wish they would offer it in bigger sizes. I usually order 4 at a time so they last for a while since the size is small. You will not be sorry for ordering this salt.
this is a wonderful seasoning which complements any type salad or vegetable and is unique on flavor.  it is extremely hard to get in central florida and i am so glad i am able to find it on amazon.

This sweetener is exactly the same as Splenda, but a whole lot cheaper.  This order was delivered in just a couple days.  I like that the individual packets are not loose in the box.  They are divided in half and in bags with handles that can be tied.  A little thing that means no aggravating spills.  I will buy this product on a regular basis.
It showed up as described, 1500 packets of Kirkland sucralose. This should be about 1 1/2 years supply for one person using it for their coffee. It's just like Splenda, there is no difference.

Costco Warehouse consistently delivers on any product they decide on stamping their 'Kirkland' logo on. Their sweetener is definitely the BEST on the market in terms of price, but most importantly, taste. I am a Costco member and have been using this brand of sweetener for at least 4 years. The 1,500 sachets lasts me almost 2 years. I use it almost every day since I'm a prodigious drinker of hot teas (even in 100 degree weather). I also use the sweetener in baking cookies, drinking coffee on occasion and for anything else that requires a sweet taste. There is no aftertaste. NONE! Even stevia can be exceedingly bitter if too much is used. Not with the Kirkland sweetener; too much just results in it tasting too sweet, that is all. It is just like using white sugar, but without all the debilitating side effects of using such a toxin. It's also much better to buy this product from any of the Costco warehouses dotted around the U.S. It's well worth paying the yearly membership with all the items you can buy there at fantastic prices. The sweetener retails for under $17 at a Costco warehouse.
This is less than half of what you will pay at any grocery store or Sam's Club. Such a great value!
I think Kirkland is better than even Splenda! I can't think of anything else to describe it any better! Thank you!  Carol H, Seattle

There's $7 I can spend on something else. I've been using Splenda since 2003 or so. This is the first I noticed a generic version. Since I trust Kirkland, I tried it. No more Splenda for me. I paid 11.99 at Costco 6-29-2012 for the 1500 pack. I shop Amazon regularly and am a Costco member. I was checking the price of Splenda online and found this. Had costco trip planned for the next day and sure enough, foung it there. Just had it in my ceral and tea. I am very pleased.

This product is getting harder and harder to find at my local grocer and the price was getting ridulous, so when I saw the price from this seller, I simply stockpiled for a year or so.  It works for me. It is my one indulgence and cheaper that running to the Starbucks!!  :)
Seems a bit devious for them to say there is no added sugar, when on an ingredient list I find "evaporated cane syrup."  A rose by any other name would smell as sweet.

My picky eaters love these - I'm so happy to find a snack that they will eat and I feel good about giving them.  Great portion size as well...thanks yo drop makers!!!!Revolution Foods Yo'Drops Strawberry Banana-Rama 1.25 Ounce, 5-count (Pack of 4)

The yogurt drops are so small it will take your child a while to eat them. They are great for outtings (no so great at home can be messy if dropped).  This snack will give you some time to enjoy being out and no fussy toddler to deal with.  The taste is bland but my toddler loves em.

The shipping address transferred over to them incorrectly, so they called me on the phone to obtain the address correctly. They were very friendly and curteous. I will be buying from them from now on!

column9: Great natural coconut water! Taste great!!
column10: This is a great hydrating product, that's 100% natural. You can find it cheaper at Vitacost, with free s/h over $49. Just a FYI.
This tea was not terrible, but lacked the distinctive malt flavor I associate with Scottish Breakfast Tea. I rank it well below, for example, Twinings English Breakfast and Earl Gray tea.

This was exactly what I wanted and had been unable to find in the States.  This beef extract makes a marvelous bouillon which is great and precisely what my system calls for when I am suffering colds or flu.  The product arrived speedily as well and I am gratified to once again have it available on my pantry shelf!
The tea was just what I ordered and the delivery was very fast and easy. The price was reasonable and he taste is great. Will definitely order again.

It is a cut-up piece from a big scoby and it looks unhealthy on arrival.  Its color is dark brown and it is shedding layers.  A label says it is supposed to be good till Jan. 2013, four months away from when I received it.  I tried to make kombucha out of it but no scoby formed after two weeks.  The sweet tea solution smelled musky and unpleasant.  This kit is going back.
It was nice to have all the ingredients to start the kombucha. Fast delivery. Already made a batch and turned out great.

column9: Everything you need to get started and excellent customer service
column10: This kit contained everything I needed (except the container) to get started and the instructions were very thorough and clear.  When my first batch developed mold because I didn't keep it warm enough, I called and received good suggestions on how to easily keep it warm enough to grow faster AND am being sent another culture to try again free of charge.

column9: For the cat with hardwood floors
column10: My cat loves toys.  She wasn't too crazy about Petmate's Cat Crazies toys, but these Looney Loops are her favorites.  I brought these home and she abandoned her previous favorites (which is good since they were stuffed mice which were falling apart) and actually gets upset when she slides one of these toys under the furniture and can't reach them.  She hasn't lost interest in them in over 6 months.  I originally bought them at PetSmart, but they've either been out of stock or no longer carrying them.  I'm very happy to find them on Amazon.These are great because they move quickly across the floor and she can bat them atound.  And they're QUIET, which makes them great for her night-time play sessions.  If you step on them you won't get injured (a rule for any cat toy in my house.)  They're durable.I don't know how they'd do on carpet -- I image they're a hard-floor toy.

My cat loves these so much that I bought ten packs of them just in case they stop making them.  Seriously.  She purrs the minute I pick one up.  She likes to play fetch with these so any time I'm around she brings one to me and meows until I throw it for her.  Then she has a great time chasing it around the room until she catches it.  I have to put them away at night, though, since she'll bring them to my bed and meow for me to throw them.  This is the best cat toy ever.

I bought these after trying several other toys to keep my cat happy while I am at work, and he loves them!  He wraps them around his paws to chew on, loops them on door stops for the 'twang' fun, tosses them in the air and brings them to me to throw for him (the only thing he fetches--self taught by the way).  They are quiet and don't hurt your feet at o'dark hundred when wandering around the house.  My cat even plays with them in bed next to me and I never wake up! Petsmart still carries them for around $2-3 (saw them today) and I have passed them on to other family members with cats.

I think when it comes to cats its hard to tell what they like or do not like.They absolutely love the plastic spring toys so I thought these would be almost the same, just a bit more durable than the thinner spring ones...which have somewhat short life span due to those sharp cat teeth!no luck for my Bengals.so this is not a negative review of the product as much as a heads up ;-)

I just bought my 6 month old kitten these, just to try them out. She loves batting around paper balls and paper-clip type items so I was happy to find something that wasn't expensive and seemed something she would like. SHE LOVES THEM! It's been about 25 minutes and she is still batting it around, carrying it in her mouth and having her crazy kitten moments! It's the perfect cat toy. To big to swollow, quiet and durable, bright colors, cool shape and cheap! She is having a ball. It works on carpet or hardwood floors too!I also recommend the PetMate Crazy Spinners. She really enjoyed those also!

You wouldn't think these simple little plastic curls would make even a mild-mannered cat act like a fool, but they DO.You know how cats go nuts for the plastic pull off the milk/water jug? These are made on the same principle but stronger and more to hold onto.The beauty is in the simplicity. (Like how cats usually like the BOX the fancy gift came in instead of the fancy gift...and would rather sleep on a dictionary than a 100 dollar bed.) Big cats and little cats both liked it. And you can't beat the price. Five paws-up.
items are very cheap..and my cat wasn't at all interested in them..overpriced and overrated in other reviews..disapointing and too cheap to return for refund.
I bought these along with Cat Crazies. Our cats love them both! I bought these knowing the cats love milk tabs. I don't have to worry about them chewing up and choking on plastic bits.

column9: Poor product, do not waste your money on this, possible choking hazard
column10: I gave my cat one of these Looney Loops to test, and in less than 8 hours I discovered that two of the loops had come off.  Smallish plastic pieces, and a choking hazard for sure.  Needless to say that one plus the two remaining in the package went out in the trash.

column9: Not at first...but now she loves them!
column10: Got these for my cat. She's high maintenance and I wanted a toy that would keep her interest. And wouldn't fall apart like her rabbit fur mice toys.At first when I opened these up she was...unenthused. She batted them around a few times and then walked off to play with her other toys. Then, about a week later, I found her going *nuts* around the house. I thought it was another mouse she was chasing and then saw it was one of the Looney-Loops.Now she loves them, and will carry them around the house and chase them for hours. A great, simple cat toy--I just needed to give it time.

Our 15 week old kitten was raised playing with wand toys, before we adopted him.  This is the only toy he will play with that doesn't require me to interact and play with him.  Don't get me wrong, I LOVE playing with him, but I am a student and I do need some time to myself for studying.  He rolls them around on the floor, puts his arms through them (like bracelets) and then flings them across the room, hides and stalks them, and basically acts just plain goofy with them.  I plan on getting a few more of these to have spares on hand as he looses them under the entertainment center every now and then.

My kitten loves this toy.  I have hardwood floors so I watch her run around and play with it all day long.  She can literally spend hours playing with it alone.  I've seen her put it insides shoes, boxes, any type of storage and try to bat them around and out for fun. The cutest part is when she picks it up with her mouth and carries it around with her.  She's carries it around all over the house and I find it laying everywhere, even on my bed. But the funniest was when I actually found it in her litterbox! Guess she liked it so much she took it with her when she had to potty.
This is one of the best cat toys we have ever bought. It keeps your cat entertained and you canjust sit back and watch all the fun they have with this toy.

column9: My cats go crazy for these!
column10: I don't know what it is about these little plastic toys but my kitties go crazy for them.  They get so much joy out of flicking them and chasing them all around.  Sometimes they take them and try to hide them away from each other.  I will say that I do not leave these out.  When they are done playing with them I put them away in case of any choking hazard.  Better safe than sorry.  5 stars though, they love them!
I have yet to find a cat that doesn't love these. I am so upset that I can only find these online now.Sadly my dog loves to destroy them.

My two cats were not impressed with these.  Granted, they are older cats and don't play with much in general, but they are still cats that like to bat things around here n there. Just had no interest in these. Stick with milk jug cap rings. They love those.

Bought these because of all the glowing reviews. My two could care less. I do see them in different places sometimes in the mornings but it's usually only about 1 roll from where I left them. At least I don't have to hunt them down or order more because they lost them. Ordered different kinds of these but they dissed all of them. Cats.......

...my cats just dont like them. i thought they'ld love em since they the love the Ethical Pet Wide Durable Heavy Gauge Plastic Colorful Springs. Go figure. You get 3 lousy Looney Loops for $5 + they barely gave em the time of day. But the pack of 10 Ethical springs for less than $2 a pack they cant get enough of. Theres nothing wrong with the looney Loops, you just cant predict whats going to tickle a cats fancy.

In general, my cat is pretty indifferent when it comes to store-bought toys. She tends to prefer balls of tinfoil, paper bags, cardboard, etc. The first few days, she was not really into these. Then she saw the way they bounced and rolled on the linoleum kitchen floor and is now completely hooked. She goes totally nuts; smacking into cupboards and rolling all over the floor playing with these. The plastic is stiff enough that they roll well but pliable enough that she can pick it up in her mouth, chew it (she's never broken off a piece to eat), stick her paw through the middle; it's hilarious to watch. They are pretty hardy so even when you inevitably step on them in the dark, they bounce back into shape pretty well. My only complaint is that they only come 3 per pack. If I could buy bulk, I would because there is an entire pack under my refrigerator right now! Every time my kitty gets one stuck under something, she goes nuts trying to get it out, so if I can't get it easily I break out another. They used to sell these at one of the chain pet stores but not anymore. I recommend buying 2 packs at a time cuz they will be under your furniture pretty quickly!

column9: OMG My Cat goes gaga for these!
column10: I've tried all kinds of cat toys and wasted a lot of money on toys she's played with a cople of times then never touches again. Then I bought the looney loops and oh boy she absolutely loves them! She chases them all over the apartment, bats at them, and loves digging them out from under the couch. She plays with them so much they no longer resemble their original form and I had to throw them away they were so ratty in shape. I went into panic mode when my local store was out of them and didn't get them back into stock for ages. Then I found them online! I bought a whole bunch so I wouldn't be caught without any of her favorite toy. I don't know why she loves playing with them but she does! I highly recomend them!
my cat only looks at it if i throw it around. he would not play with it at all! would not recommend this product
My kitty absolutely loves these things...I leave them out for her at night and in the morning I have to really hunt to locate then since she bats them around the living room all night..LOL.

second time purchasing these little loops--they are really great, my cats both love them and they take them with them everywhere, under the bed, in the tub, etc. they're a really great toy to play "fetch" with your cat as well as a fun activity for kitty to do on his own. mine like to paw at them and then throw them gleefully into the air and run around the house. only problem i have with these is that sometimes they get stuck under the couch sometimes, but other than that- great toy

One of my cats is extremely fussy when it goes to toys. He likes his mice, but he is always tearing those up. I have tried many others but he just walks away from them. Until I found these. He goes nuts. He is always carrying them around in his mouth. Then will drop it and start batting it around. When that one 'escapes' he goes back to his basket and grabs another. His favorite thing to do is go into an empty bath tub with one of these. He can spend hours in there playing.I highly recommend these. They don't shed, they don't fall apart, they don't break, and they are completely washable!

column9: Great toy! Their new instant favorite!
column10: I recommend these highly instead of the wire, painted springs that Amazon refuses to remove from their inventory: http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B000CMKHDG/ref=oh_o00_s01_i00_details . This toy is safe, and they instantly loved it from the moment it came out of the package.
Very satisfied the cats have a ball playing with them. They arrived in a timely manner no damage to product.

Length:: 1:47 MinsMy 6 month old kitten Dinah absolutely LOVES this toy. She'll play with it until she's so exhausted that she can't anymore and yet she'll continue to try and muster up the energy to go at it some more anyway! It's fun to play with the toy with her as well, so it's not only good for solo play when i'm not around but also for interactive play. It's lightweight so kittens can bat it around and pick it up with their mouths and i'd day its definitely a must have toy for any cat/kitten :]Also, just a side note- apologies for the semi-jumpy video quality... It's hard to play with a kitten and record a video with a steady hand haha.
This should be included in physical therapy for cats; my cats never ran this much in their lives.  Very good for exercising your aimal
My 16 mo. cat loves her springs, so I thought I'd try something different, but similar. She just looks at these and ignores them. I will be getting her the springs from now on.

I was looking for something without catnip, and I took a chance on these odd toys. My cats love them! its something about the lightweight material I guess, but they just pull these out of their little toybox first. One thing, though...they get lost easily. The cats bop them into odd spots and we never see them again..but they just have such a good time.

column9: My foster cats LOVE this toy
column10: I take in foster cats for a local rescue, and these toys are a consistent favorite among our little furry house guests.They're perfect for hardwood floors. When I want to distract a cat, I'll grab one and toss it up on the air so it bounces on the floor - then the cats do the rest. :) They'll also start playing with the loops on their own when they get bored. Very inexpensive, fun toy for them. I'll definitely order more when these wear out.

I got these for my 7 month old kitten, Tabitha (though the old cat sometimes bats them, too). She bats them, throws them, and gets them stuck on her paw until she can throw them off again...watching her is cheap entertainment. They do work best on hard floors, but carpet isn't a deal breaker since they're tossable. If Tabitha isn't playing with these, it's generally because she's sleeping, or because they're all lost under the furniture. Buy extra.

We have been buying these toys since our oldest cat was a kitten in 2004 and they are the favorite of all three of our cats (and many others that we've given them to).  They are safe to be left out but do eventually wear out and break (it takes about a year of our cats heavy use and us stepping on them occasionally).  We had to monitor our cats with them when kittens, though, because the toy would get stuck on paws because the loops are big enough to fit a small cat's paw inside.  Two of our cats fetch with this toy and will carry it around in their mouths to bring it to us.  We have even found one sleeping with the toy at night!

When I opened this, I was very disappointed. These don't look like much at all. In hindsight, they look exactly like the picture, but I was expecting something more... substantial.BUT it's a good thing I wasn't buying it for me to play with, because my cat loves them. I can't imagine what she's thinking but she kicks these things around all day, then picks them up and carries them back to her play spot to do it again.

While I'll admit being outraged at the price they charge for these little plastic squiggles, they are well designed and my cats love them.  They're light enough to bat around easily and they're the right size to pick up in their mouths to carry around.

column9: my kittens growl at each other for these!
column10: my two cats LOVE these!! one will growl at the other when they're playing with the looney loop (and then pick it up and walk away) to keep it for herself! and it's so cute to watch them play with it, especially when it gets wrapped around her paw! (don't worry, it always comes off easily) only bad thing is that they always mysteriously disappear even though they never leave the house!

column9: Something my cats actually play with
column10: My cats love the milk/water jug cap rings but they're harder to come by these days so I picked these up. They're not as light as the cap rings but they're light enough to not whack your cat in the face too hard if you toss it. I can tell my cats would prefer something a little easier to pick up in their mouths (like the rings) but these are a decent alternative.

column9: Better than the milk-ring type toys
column10: Even though these toys will roll under furniture, they are the best toy for our cat - a ragdoll.  because these actually move over tiles/floors (as opposed to the milk-cap types that just sit there after being tossed), this is the cat's favorite toy.i actually would recommend getting two packs, since they get udner furniture so easily.

These actually work very well on a carpet as well. My cat loves them, and he bats them all around and because they are lightweight, they bop and fly everywhere and he chases them! A cheap, durable (you can step on them, and chances are, your cat will still love them!), entertaining cat toy!

I found these at a local pet store but my cat won't play with them at all. She just stares at them like they are aliens from Mars. Some of the best things in life are free (sort of). Here's a tip to save you some money. Pull the ring off your milk container or orange just container and flip it off the counter and watch your cat go wild! My cat loves 'milk rings'. Her all time favorite toy above anything I have purchased that is an actual 'cat toy'. We have them all over the house.  Bottles of vinegar have a nice wide loop to pull off too. My kitty loves them because they fit so well under anything she can bat them under (like the furniture or the refrigerator).

This was my first purchase of Twinings Earl Grey Tea K-Cups for my Keurig. I was hoping it would be at least as good as making a pot of tea. I was not disappointed. In fact, I find them to have a fuller body and stronger flavor than a cup from a tea pot. It is handy and quick as popping one in and pushing the brew button.My biggest concern when making this purchase was that it would pick up the flavor from a previously brewed cup of coffee. It did not. As a precaution I do rinse the inside of the cup holder before I brew a cup of tea, however, even times when I don't I can't tell the difference. So now I can have a great cup of Twinings Earl Grey with better results than a brewed pot of tea, much faster and with less waste. I fully recommend this product.I might also add, I have tried many brands of Earl Grey Tea and Twinings is the only brand that I enjoy. I'm elated that I can now get it in K-Kups! Thanks Twinings!!

This is my favorite gum.  I suffered terribly from aspartame poisoning and it was good to find a gum that I could still chew.  Beware consumers - aspartame is in almost all gum - gum does not need to be sugar free to contain aspartame.  If you want to have good gum and still be healthy - this is a great gum.

Our dentist recommended that we chew this gum 3 times a day after each meal because the xylitol kills the bacteria that causes cavities. It's tasty though it doesn't hold it's flavor for a long time - not a big deal. I would definitely recommend.
My choice of gum these days because it has no sugar and, unlike other sugar-free gums, no carcinogens.

I've tried five flavors of Spry gum: peppermint, spearmint, green tea, fresh fruit, and cinnamon. Spearmint is among my least favorite flavors, beating out only peppermint. It loses its flavor within two minutes. That's not an exaggeration - you get literally two minutes of chewing pleasure. The main reason I prefer it to peppermint is that at least the spearmint goes tasteless, while the peppermint turns bitter.On the bright side, the gum is flavored with xylitol. Unlike some brands that advertise that they contain xylitol, Spry actually uses it as their only sweetener. Most sugarless gums make me sick, as I can't handle sorbitol and maltitol well. At least I can chew this without having intestinal problems, which makes it worth two stars despite the lack of flavor.

column9: Healthy gum, but loses flavor fast!!!
column10: I just recently bought this gum to help my dental grow stronger and healthier.  Now for pros and cons to my point on this product.ProsGum with only Xylitol as sweetener.I do like Spearmint taste.ConsThe flavor is week, sometimes I have to just chew on two pieces or more to help increase flavor.Overall There is some flavor of it, but it isn't strong enough.  I am glad it's not to strong.  So this product gets decent 3 stars for health but lose 2 stars for lack of flavor lasting.  So I well buy different brand of xylitol spearmint gum, but however I will buy the Spry peppermint gum since I do like peppermint gum and people don't seem to have flavor lacking of product.Thank u for reading this review.
tastes great for about 10 seconds, really.Then, it is tasteless. Can't recommend it.

column9: One of the best products, ever
column10: I did not appreciate the damage sugar left on teeth could do until I got cavaties as an adult. I chewed regular gum through high school and had to stop because of the pain. I also had terrible breath, which only spurred my chewing habit.I am so glad I discovered Xylitol,and especially as found in Spry. I am a student and can't afford dentist visits so I've taken my dental care into my own hands. I now brush more often and longer, and floss as well, but these aren't activities practical to perform when eating lunch away from home, so I use Spry for any occasion where a toothbrush isn't convenient.For the past 7 years,I have used this gum to clean my teeth after eating and anytime oral bacteria begins to proliferate. A few years back I stopped using it and I began noticing pain again, and discovered cavaties had cropped back up, so I returned to the regimen. This gum has actually stopped the growth of my cavaties (read up on Xylitol -- it does Not act like regular sugar). So naturally, I am in love with the product. I imagine I will continue to rely on it until I graduate and can afford a decent filling.What's not so fun:No this is not regular gum, so don't expect it to be. If you're looking for long-lasting, flavorful chewiness, then you may be disappointed. And when the gum starts to go soft in your mouth, be ready to spit -- when it starts to break down, it gets down to business. Be ready if you're in public; swallowing it can leave a burn in your stomach. But you get used to what it feels like and just make sure to get rid of it before too long.Anything it lacks as a gum is compensated for more than 1000 fold by the health benefits for your teeth and mouth alone.I pack my bulk purchased Spry in little bags/containers of my own; it feels appropriately more personal considering how personal I find the product to be.At $.05 per piece, you can't go wrong.--AlexisI like all the flavors but the fruit is a little too frooty, like kid's gum.

column10: Traditional Medicinals Echinacea Plus is an herbal remedy in tea form designed to support the immune system. Echinacea Plus has a serene and subtle lemon-mint flavor that is exceptionally comforting for colds, and soothing to scratchy raw throats. Echinacea stimulates activity of cells that fight infection in our bodies and increases the number of these cells such as the white blood cells and lymphocytes. Echinacea has a positive effect on wound  healing, lessens symptoms and speeds recovery from viruses.Echinacea also has anti-inflammatory properites which aids recovery from psoriasis and eczema and may help arthritis.  It also may increase resistance to candida, bronchitis and herpes and other infectious conditions.  Echinacea should not be used continually for any longer than 5-8 weeks.

I'm hoping after it has been used a million times this will improve.- If you try pushing the thing on the counter the little white rubber feet come out. I'm glad I did it before I lifted the machine onto it because I would not have been happy to dump my new coffee toy over.- I feel like it could be a lot sturdier since it is meant to hold a $100+ coffee maker on it.There are a couple pros though, that earned the 3 stars:- It does hold 36 k cups. I read reviews on other products that don't actually hold the number of cups that it claims. At least this one really does.- The black color matches the machine nicely.- It gets those bulky boxes of k cups off of the counter. I still have partial boxes to stow somewhere (since I wanted more than 2 varieties in the drawer) but at least I don't have to keep them handy.All in all I would not buy it again and still might return it. It was cheaper than the other drawers I was finding but I feel like I got what I paid for. Sometimes it's worth a few more dollars to get something a little better.

Wonderful...doesn't take up extra counter space, of which we have very little. Fits under the Keurig easily, leaving plenty of room between the Keurig and the cabinet above.  Also holds more pods that the previous carousel type that I had.
I got this for my husband to use to store his K cups.  He LOVES it!  It doesn't take up counter space because the keurig thing sits on top of it!

column9: Frame is great, rest is flimsy - Thankfully the frame holds the weight

That aside, with my Keurig Platinum it works just fine and it opens without any catching.While putting in the k-cups, I find that alternating upside-down & top-side-up helps fit more into the track.

I bought a new Keurig coffee maker for my wife and was finding those little pods all over the place. The Grandchildren thougth they were building toys! I intended to mount this drawer under cabinet but it's construction is plenty sturdy enough to have the coffee maker sit on top with great stability. Very well built. Put pods in right side up, up side down ect ect you can fit in an extra 6.

My coffee maker fits on the top of it and if water spills on this drawer, its easy enough to wipe off. I bought this in addition to the 3-drawer stack (also sold by Nifty) and it holds all my k-cups. I tend to order in bulk and had a problem storing all those k-cups and of course rotating them with my teas and cocoas in my standing k-cup holder. I highly recommend this product to anyone who wants to keep their k-cups in reach and don't have a lot of counter space.

column9: Does the job but cheaply made
column10: So I read the reviews before and saw ths issue of the hieght of my counter and my Keurig vs adding this drawer. I measured it out and there was going to be enough room to actually allow my Keurig to function. However, once I recieved it, I realized I have to slide it out every time to make a cup of coffe. The drawer is oddly measured because my K-Cups fit inside with about half an inch of slack on each row. So when I do slide my Keurig out, the cups slide. Also, the rubberized "feet" underneath got caught on my granite countertop and I've already lost one. Since it was lopsided and not condusive to holding my $200 coffee pot, I just removed the rest of them. Now I have to try to pick up the thing to move it out or it'll scratch the counters. Honestly I might have to just give up on this and settle for something else!

This was the perfect K-cup storage option for us.  We live in a very small apartment with a galley kitchen and almost no counter space.  I had tried various ways to have the K-cups easily accessible and at the time of this purchase, we had them in bins on top of the refrigerator which wasn't that convenient.We have the Breville Keurig and it fits perfectly on the drawer.I'd say there are only two downsides.  The first is that the drawer has little rubber feet that rest on the counter top.  If the drawer moves at all, the rubber feet tend to pop out and the only way to get them back in is to take the Keurig off of the drawer - not an easy feat.The other is less of a downside for the product, but something to keep in mind.  Our Keurig sat underneath our cabinets.  When we put it on top of the drawer, there was not enough clearance to open the top.  We had to move the entire machine forward so that we were able to actually open the top and put the k-cups in.  Again, not an issue with the product, but if space is a limitation, you should make sure you will still have enough clearance to use the machine.
Love this drawer.  We actually have two of them stacked with the unit sitting on top of them.  Worked out great!

I just got the 36 cup drawer, and it works perfectly.  My full size Keurig fits on top with room to spare.  The drawer works smoothly.However, as others have said, there is not enough room to open the Keurig to put a K Cup inside, when pushed back under the cabinet.  The drawer has 4 non-slip "feet" on the bottom, that grip the counter.  Some have suggested putting a thin cutting mat under it, so it is easy to pull out.I decided to try something else.  I got 3/4 inch self-stick felt pads (the kind used under furniture to protect scratching the floor).  These work really well.  Now the whole thing slides out easily, and then back under counter to save space.Waxman 4718595N 3/4-Inch Self-Stick Round Felt Pads, Oatmeal

It also makes the coffee maker closer to the cabinet so you can't open the coffee maker under the cabinet....  Here is the fix.......  Buy a 18x24 flexable cutting board and stick it under it.  You can slide the entire unit in and out any time you need to make coffee.  You can also use the cutting board for cutting a lime or something else.  I use it all the time in my wet bar in the basement for parties and everyone said oh how ingenous.  You can cut the cutting board to any size and it works perfectly. The cutting boards are available here on Amazon.  I couldn't find them anywhere in the kitchen stores locally. I'm so happy with drawer now that I have this fix.  No more worries about trying to pull the Keurig maker out with the drawer under it and having the little rubber feet falling off the drawer.  Nuff said...  Works like a charm and the wife loves it too!!!  LOL

I bought this product to go with a Keurig coffee maker for my husband for Christmas.  We have limited counter space, so this was the perfect solution for keeping the K-cups close at hand.  It is well made - there is NO issue that this drawer cannot hold the weight of the machine.  The only thing to consider is the space between your counter and cabinets.  Once the machine is placed on top of the drawer, you may not be able to open the machine the whole way.  In my kitchen, it's just enough to put the K-cups in and out although it will not open the full way.  That's something that you should consider when determining if this product will work for you.  We love it.

There are other brands that make this same exact drawer and charge a lot more.A lot of people may say... why spend the extra money when you can just keep the K cups in the boxes they are purchased in. Well, if you only buy a few different types of K cups, that may be true. But if you are like me, and have multiple upon multiple varieties, it is nice to have a bit of each in this drawer and not have a zillion boxes cluttering up my valuable counterspace.I think my only con to this is that the drawers are not smooth sliding drawers. Sometimes you have to shimmy the drawer a bit. But that holds true for those 'other' pricer versions as well.Also... you can actualy fit more than 36 in this drawer. I can fit 42. If you alternate between storing each K cup top side up and bottom side up in each row... you can fit 1 extra cup in each row. However, I don't think all of the rows are exactly the same size. One of the rows is a bit snug.

I really like the convenience this drawer offers. It looks nice and does not raise my coffee brewer too high to still fit on the counter. I would like it if the drawer would slide more easily, but with the weight of the brewer on top it seems to cause the drawer to drag some. Overall I am happy with this purchase.

This product was as advertised . . . very sturdy, drawer slides easily.  However, I'm not going to be able to use the drawer as it elevates my coffee brewer that is located underneath one of my kitchen cabinets a little bit too high and I can't open up the lid to insert the coffee pods.  Bummer.
I got what I paid for. It was exactly what I wanted. I would recommend this product in the future.

The drawer is great for limited counter space. It is sturdy so that the drawer does not bind with a full coffee pot sitting on top. It holds a variety of K-cups with easy access. I prefer the all black finish to other similar products.
I guess I expected more.  It's a wire cage in a wire cage.  Be sure to shop around to make sure you got the best deal.  I didn't.

I bought this at JC Penney several months ago, great space saver and easy to select the coffee you want, doesn't take up any counter space.  It has held up very well under the weight of the large Keurig full of water.

It is a great idea because it doesn't take up more counter space like the spinning rack but it needs to be stronger.

Arrived when I expected it.  I've been looking for one for awhile.  If you have limited counter or pantry space, this is a good addition.  One word of warning - check the space under your kitchen cabinets.  I had to pull my Keurig out about 8" to be able to open it, it adds about 2.5" to the height of the machine.  So I store other pods behind it - no big deal. Came packed in biodegrable pillows!

I ordered the 36 pod drawer with the 3 drawer 54 pod drawer. It makes a nice cozy corner in my kitchen for a Keurig pot and room on top for sugar and creamer. I throughly enjoy the unit! No more shuffling through a basket or refilling a revolving pod holder!

The nifty coffee pod single drawer holds our coffee pods right close to our Keurig coffee makers because our machine sets right on top of it taking up less counter space, and cupboard space. We plan to purchase another one and double stack them. Try it you will like it.

column9: Excellent!!! A Must Have!!! Worth every cent!!!
column10: It saves so much space. It stores my K-cups so beautifully. I no longer need to keep the boxes nearby and I just refill it as needed. It holds the Keurig on top perfectly and does not sag under the weight. The drawer opens and closes easily. A must have for any Keurig owner looking to save space.
Helped to oraganize all those Pods that had to be stored elsewhere. Also, easy to access since they are under coffee maker.Doesn't take up too much space on countertop. Very pleased!

I bought two of these storage pods because I had boxes of coffee pods all over the place and the storage drawers made it very convenient.  It sits right under the coffee maker and I would definately recommend them to anyone looking for a convenient storage drawer for their coffee pods.Dick
