There is enough room left over on the top of the drawer for me to put the sugar canister beside the Keurig.I was really hoping to clear up some counter space with this, by having the k-cups stored beneath the Keurig, instead of in a rack beside it.  In the end, however, I wasn't really able to save any counter space, because there is now a lot of wasted space behind the Keurig/drawer.  In order to be able to open and close the Keurig k-cup compartment on the machine with it sitting on the drawer, I had to pull the drawer and Keurig machine closer to the front edge of my counter, so that the k-cup compartment opens in front of the overhead cabinets, because it was hitting the bottom of the cabinet and wouldn't open enough to get a k-cup in there with the drawer pushed back against the wall!  Unfortunately, I have overhead cabinets over all my counters, so there is no way around this for me.  If your Keurig sits on an island counter, or other surface without a low-hanging overhead cabinet, this probably wouldn't be a problem for you... but to be safe, I'd measure how much clearance you have above your machine (with the k-cup compartment open) and subtract about 3.5 inches from that space for the drawer.

This drawer holds 36 K-CUPS, and you can set the brewer right on top of the drawer. The outside measurements are 13-1/4 WIDE AND 12-1/2 LONG. It is black in color and has screen mesh inside of the drawer. The mesh on the bottom is not to strong,so don't push to hard, or it will bend, and the drawer won't slide.I give this drawer medium stars.  Jim in Ohio

Nifty 36 Coffee Pod Single Drawer This little drawer perfectly organizes my K-Cups. The Keurig Machine sits on top of it, and there is even room on the side to keep my sweeteners handy. The drawer slides open easily and makes choosing a k-cup easy. I'm thinking of getting another one because I have way more than 36 k-cups at any one time.Height is not an issue for me, although if I were to get an additional drawer I might have difficulty opening the cabinet, since the Keurig sits in front of the cabinet, not underneath it. With just the one drawer, there is enough clearance to open that cabinet door.All in all, I recommend this drawer as a space saving way to organize all those k-cups.

HANDY AND UNOBTRUSIVELY ATTRACTIVE.......KEEPS ALL MY COFFEE CHOICES IN ORDER, WITHOUT TAKING UP ANY MORE KITCHEN COUNTER SPACE....I JUST PUT THE COFFEE MAKER ON TOP OF IT!BEST PRODUCT OF THIS TYPE I'VE SEEN

This drawer is very convenient and holds lots of coffee pods.  Doesn't take up additional counter space.  Attractive and unobtrusive.  It does make my coffee maker too tall to open under the upper cabinets, but I pull it forward to use and then push back when finished.

We buy our k-cups in bulk, and it was becoming a pain to run into the pantry every time I just wanted a cup of coffee!  This little number fits under the k-cup machine and cuts down my runs to pantry to just once or twice a week to refill the drawer.  Perfect!One thing (more of a warning than a criticism): when I bought it, I measured the height of the keurig and the height of the drawer to make sure that it would fit under my kitchen cabinets.  I forgot to account for the space the keurig needs to flip open!  Luckily for us, it fits nicely under our traditional coffee machine.  Otherwise, it would be useless to us.The only reason I gave this 4 instead of 5 stars is that it won't be perfect for everyone, depending on the layout of your kitchen, etc.  But, for us, it's one of our favorite purchases.
Its a drawer, its black, it holds 36 k-cups, it slides out. What more could you need.. This item is great, especially if you have limited space between your countertop and cupboards. Fits perfectly.

I don't understand why they couldn't have made this a little taller to allow for the drawer to glide .  It's a nice looking product, holds more k cups if you put every other one upside down, and the coffeemaker fits perfectly on top.  So why doesn't the drawer slide in and out easily? We will use it anyway, but are disappointed.

This 36-pod drawer is the perfect companion for my Keurig coffeemaker.  It keeps several different flavors at my fingertips so I don't have to dig through the box to find the flavor I want and it helps to keep the countertop free of clutter.  I love it and highly recommend it.
The drawer works terrific. Tough to squeeze 36 K-cups into the bottom, but has some room on top to store a few extras. All in all, very happy with the purchase and would definitely recommend!

column9: Works great for CBTL Caffitaly pods
column10: This well made drawer is a good fit for the CBTL Kaldi machine and holds 66 CBTL pods (6 rows of 11 each).It looks really nice and sturdy, I'm expecting it to be very durable. Recommended.
was worried that this wouldn't fit under our knock off keirg coffee maker but it fits great and holds all our k-cups. would totally recommend this to anyone that has a k-cup coffee maker :)
This was bigger than I wanted-- I could fit 4 Keurig mini coffee makers on it-- so I hate that it takes up so much counter space.  But, it looks great and seems sturdy, so I'm keeping it.
I hated having a separate basket for our K-cups, and when I saw this I hoped it would work for us. It's perfect for what we need it for and it really helped open up our counter a bit.

Purchased this K-cup organizer and it works just fine.  No need to pay extra money for a different brand.  Not sure what additional benefits are offered by others that are more expensive.  Does exactly what I bought it to do.  Pretty simple.

If you alternate K-cups instead of put them in like the picture it Holds 42!!!!  Great product, nicely constructed and saves counter space by going under the Kuerig!  I highly recommend this product to anyone needing a place for their K-cups!
A quality product that is a wonderful addition.  It holds the Keurig brewer nicely as well as our assortment of K-Cups.

I received a Keurig coffeemaker for Christmas and needed some way of storing the K-cups.  This drawer is ideal for storing the K-cups without using up too much counter space.  It fits under the coffeemaker and is very handy.  I'm quite happy with my purchase.
Thank you It came in 3 days.. It works great to put the k-cups in. So I don't have the boxs of the k-cups just sitting around.

I got this drawer for my Keurig at work.  The office is just too small to have a carousel taking up space.  I need my cabinet and drawer space for work "stuff" and I had no where to keep my K-cups, so, this has been a lifesaver.  I can have my coffee and maker together without taking up any more space.

column9: I adore the Nifty 36 Coffee Pod Single Drawer
column10: I have a Keurig K-Cup Home Brewer and it fits with space to spare on this 36 pod drawer that I received for Christmas. On one side I leave my K-Cup Reusable Coffee Filter kit out and on the other side I have a small tea cup filled with 5 different flavored liquid creamers and personally I don't feel it's crowded.I do like the little "lip" on the base it is nice for catching little spills like when you are adding water to your machine.I was concerned as well with the metal catching my counter tops, so I placed a drawer liner underneath it and that worked like a charm.With it being metal, I have to say I personally like the durability of it. We have multiple coffee, tea, coco drinkers in our home and we use the drawer daily. During the month of December we could feel the metal on metal, but over time and now in March it's smooth and there was no noticeable loss of color.I adore it, it is space efficient and very "jazzy" looking.

I'm thrilled that I went with this style of display. The coffee is hidden but so conveniently located and doesn't take up additional space on your counter. My only tip, it does raise your coffee pot up, so if you have low cupboards,the combination of this and your pot, won't fit under the cupboard.

This saves my counter and cabinet from getting cluttered with K-cups.  The only thing is that I wish it had feet that would slide.  I have to pull the coffee maker out from under the upper cabinets to open and insert the cups.
We're really happy with this purchase, we received order promptly and product was in perfect shape. Drawer slides out easily and we are able to put Kuerig on top to save counter space! Love it!

column9: These hold K-cups just like they're supposed to
column10: I really love this product. I ordered it because I have very little counter space and I was going to place this under my coffee pot. I have the Mr. Coffee Keurig pot and it's only an 8oz option coffee pot (unless you do a smaller amount of water) so it's not a large pot. It didn't even cover the whole top of this drawer so I had room next to it. I've solved this by placing some coffee enhancers (like powdered creamers and other powdered flavorings) next to the coffee machine. They fit very easily right there.I noticed that someone had said they could fit extra k-cups into their drawer by alternating one up and one down. I found this annoying as I couldn't see what all the flavors of coffee were being stored in the drawer. Saves tons of space on the counter and keeps all our kcups organized in nice need rows. Drawer seems sturdy. So far we are very happy with this product.
Excellent!!!! Now I don't have to sift through all my coffee/ tea to find what I want.  Just open the drawer and look.  Very Handy!

I put this one under my Cuisinart Single Serve and it works great.  It keeps everything organized and at close reach.  I am able to get rid of several boxes of K-cups with this single item.  I think it would be possible to stack multiples together as well.  Very sturdy.

column9: decent product...a little big for the b60
column10: i read some reviews that said their machine barely fit on top of this drawer... that isn't the case if you have a b60; the drawer is almost a little too big compared to the footprint of the machine itself.  other than that, it seems well made enough... i don't notice it being "flimsy" as others have said.  at half the price of others, this drawer is a good option.
Very simple, place the drawer under your coffee maker. Its out of the way and holds your favorite coffee pods.

This drawer is a wonderful way to eliminate storing k-cups in boxes.  I have a mini Keurig brewer, which means that my brewer and my toaster both fit on this drawer; thus, I haven't lost any counter space in the process.  Love it!
This Kcup holder in awesome! You can place your coffee machine, sugar dish, and any other coffee things you use. I would recommend this to anyone with a keurig coffe machine.

I saw this product advertised and found it on Amazon.  It truly is "nifty"!  Coffee pods are kept neatly and easy to select in this handy drawer.  The drawer is covered and makes a handy base for your coffee maker.  Sturdy and simple, looks like it will last a long time.  Love it!!!

I absolutely love this space saving drawer!!!  It looks great and works great.  The drawer opens smoothly and it does not fall out when you pull it all the way open.  The cups fit in it perfectly.  So glad I ordered it!!!!
THE DRAWER HOLDS MORE THAN A CAROUSEL. yOU CAN ALSO ARRANGE THEM BY FLAVORS DOING COLUMN BY COLUMN.  iT WILL HOWEVER INCREASE THE TOTAL HEIGHT OF YOUR MACHINE;

column9: Amazing fresh flowers and lot's of them!

column9: A Matcha A Day Keeps The Doctor Away
column10: So I am mightly impressed with matcha. For a few weeks now, I've been having a cup almost daily, and I have to say I'm seeing benefits. I don't know if it can all be blamed on the matcha, but the matcha is the only real change I've made recently. When a tea company makes claims about the healthiness of their teas and how this tea will make you skinny or that tea will calm your anger, I tend to just laugh it off. Just another marketing ploy, I mean, really, it's just tea. It's delicious and better for you than soda (if you don't weigh it down with tons of sugar and cream like I used to do), but it's still just tea, not some magic potion that's going to solve all of your problems.Well. Since matcha came into my life, I'm more alert (obviously) and my system seems...cleaner. I don't feel bogged down by the terrible foods I sometimes indulge in, and somehow my system seems less responsive to my dairy allergy. Don't get me wrong, it still makes me sick, but it's not the gut-wrenching "I'm gonna die" feeling I'm used to, it's more of a "Oh man, I forgot and ate dairy again". On the whole, I just feel healthier. Which is awesome. Everyone can afford to feel a little bit healthier, am I right?Anyway, this tea smells amazing. Like juicy Granny Smith apples, sweet and tart all at the same time. I want to dip this tea in caramel. The flavor is perfect. It's exactly what I expected this tea to taste like. It's very juicy, my mouth is watering after every sip, and it's tart without being stomach-turning sour. I am having a really hard time not adding some of my Red Leaf Tea Caramel matcha to this. They're just begging to be blended. In college, I was big fan of the Caramel Apple shot, which is basically one part sour apple Pucker to one part butterscotch Schnapps. This seems like a good alternative for me to take to work and not get fired! Though now I'm wondering about matcha cocktails...I love these matchas that are encouraging me to mix and match, play with different blends, bake...I love it! I wish I had the time to just lock myself in my kitchen with my matchas and experiment to my little heart's content.

column9: Taste as good if not better than that "other" brand
column10: Great cherry taste....as good, if not better than that "other" much more expensive brand.  Am using these in glass covered bowls to give as Christmas gifts.  I'm sure the Recipients will love them.  Will definitely buy these again.

column9: Unprepared for the lack of freshness quality...
column10: I gave this item 1 star only as a necessary formality, though I would have left the stars blank if I could.Since I've always been more than satisfied with my Amazon purchases, I was disappointed in the less-than-fresh, (read: stale,) taste of these imported cookies. Granted, this was my first order of a food item, so I can only look to this product distributor for answers to why the quality was sub-par.I had planned to give these cookies as incidental Christmas gifts, but am scrapping that notion as well as the products.

I did not buy these chews from Amazon but didn't have the option of reviewing the product in a way that didn't reflect poorly upon the seller on the site I purchased from. The seller I dealt with was lovely but I definitely don't feel that way about this product or the Flint River Ranch company.I understand that antlers are a natural product and will have some variation but I think the sample image does't represent what you actually receive. I was disappointed when I got these chews in the mail. If you order these they may definitely be smaller than what you see in the image. They all were cut to about the length I expected but the diameter varied pretty greatly from one to the next.  I bought these for my 50 pound, 7 month old lab and can't imagine these holding up to her let alone a larger dog as they seem to be advertised for.One of the chews I got was smaller than a quarter at one end (I think it measured about 3/4 inch in diameter) and clearly came from a tapered tine of an antler rather than a main beam as the picture seems to indicate they will be. I won't give my dog antlers that narrow because she will try to crack them rather than just gnaw and I don't want her to fracture a tooth doing that. The other two antlers were thicker but one was not very dense, and seemed to be older and more weathered than the others. I had concerns about my dog being able to break shards off this one since it already had cracks developing in it. Honestly, the last one would have been fine but at the price I paid for one useable antler, I know I could get a better, larger one for the same price. So, I decided to return them.At this point, I contacted my seller who told me to contact the company to initiate the return since they were shipped directly from there. I did and was told they didn't accept returns on the antler chews. Instead they offered me a discount on a future purchase that I do not anticipate I will be making from Flint River Ranch. I contacted the original seller again and she had not been informed by the company that this was their policy. I went to the official Flint River Ranch site and didn't see this policy anywhere either. I probably wouldn't have ordered them if I had been aware that they are nonrefundable.So the summary is that these  may be fine for large dogs that don't actually chew that much or for smaller dogs than they are advertised for. If you don't like what you get from the company, you are out the $45 or more that you paid for them because they apparently don't take them back.  The distributor I dealt with offered a refund anyway since she had them advertised as returnable but I'm not sure everyone will be that lucky. I won't buy these again for my dog and will return to buying higher priced chews where the jumbo chews are actually big enough to stand up to heavy chewing.

I give the antlers themselves 5 stars.  My dogs love them, they are long(er) lasting, and they don't leave stains, smells or spots.However I give the size of the antlers I received 3 stars.  Definitely smaller than I would expect for "Extra Jumbo."I have two medium sized, power-chewer dogs.  As in they've destroyed black kongs, ripped off slats of 6 foot fencing to chew on, and any stuffed toy gets the stuffing ripped out of it in minutes.  It took them a week to get through each antler.  Granted, for an average dog, I'm sure it would take significantly longer.  But there is a reason I sought out the "extra jumbo" size.  As soon as I opened the box I was disappointed; I do think they were smaller than the antlers pictured.The description only says "packaged by weight," but it would have been nice to know how much weight to expect.  The weight would also be beneficial to know when deciding between the sizes, and in verifying if I received the right size.That being said, these antlers are a fair amount cheaper than similarly sized ones in dog stores.  I'm sure they would be fine for less aggressive chewers, but I've found a different seller who has some real jumbo antlers.

column9: Grit in your teeth and mush in your mouth...
column10: Chex get very soggy very quickly.  Unless you slurp this stuff down then you're going to have a bowl of mush before you're through.  Worse yet, the texture of the `apple cinnamon' coating is very gritty and so you'll have a bowl of sandy mush.  Flavor-wise, the cereal is decent.  It doesn't have a strong apple flavor or even a strong cinnamon flavor.  In fact, once the cereal sits a few and the coating starts to dissipate into the milk you're kind of left with plain old Chex mix in a bowl of sugary milk.  I really expecting something great here, and I was excited to dig in, but after my first bowl I found myself forcing myself to finish the box since no one else in the house would touch it.

Blech. I had high hopes for this cereal but it fell flat due to far too high sugar content and exceeding sweetness. The pieces seem to be double-coated in the flavor powder; they are oddly "fuzzy" and turn your milk into a cesspool of sugar slop. The pieces get mushy right away, too, making breakfast even more unappetizing. This would be much better if they threw in an even number of unflavored pieces to balance out the sweetness and overall flavor. Also, it may be gluten-free but it gave me a bit of a tummy ache. Won't be buying it again.

It is a bit sugar-y, but my family is hooked on this stuff! I don't find it gets mushy faster than any other chex cereals I've had. The apple flavor is subtle, with the cinnamon being a bit more prominent, which I like.

column9: Great tasting time and money saver
column10: I like to use porcini mushrooms in sauces and ragouts.  Using the smaller bits costs less and takes up less storage room over the larger size porcini pieces available from this vendor. While I love the flavor of porcinis I don't think they are very pretty so larger pieces generally do not add visual appeal to dishes.  I sometimes add a few black trumpet mushrooms for visual presentation.  JR has great Black Trumpets too.JR Porcini Kibbles are very high quality and are just the right size.  So to use them just soak them in hot water for about half an hour, no additional chopping needed.  I use a ladle to retrieve the hydrated mushrooms from the water then strain the water through a coffee filter to remove any grit.  I use the resulting 'porcini tea' in my recipes.

I also buy a jar of mixed dried mushrooms regularly, but when I want a major hit of "porcini" flavor, these are great. It takes very little to add flavor to a dish. The flavor is great, and so is the value.
Great to have an hand for stews, soups and rice dishes. The size is just right for many types of dishes and add a lot of flavor with out all the mess. Love this product.

column9: good size, good value, good flavor, but sandy!
column10: these 1/4 inch chunks of dried mushrooms pack a great deal of flavor. the photograph is not really accurate, at least for my batch--mine were more consistently sized and larger than the shreds that are depicted.i have bought many packages of whole porcinis at much higher prices, and the quality of these nuggets is roughly the same. the mushrooms are of good, consistent quality--i've not encountered any dark, crinkly, off-flavored pieces in the package (typical for inexpensive porcini).they've worked well in the recipes i've used them in. one complaint: i cannot seem to get all the grit out, no matter how many times i strain, sieve, soak. that's true of some much more expensive mushrooms, so not a deal killer for me. it's hardly noticeable.

column9: Antique kitty enjoys an ocassional Gourmet feast
column10: I've got an antique kitty (9 Lbs.) who was retirement age when she adopted us in 1994... (looking a little mothy... but still mostly alive with incredibly sharp claws... w/very fast paws (too tough for the coyotes to eat!)).A magnificent fluffy black cat with pure gold eyes... which turn lite green w/lovin'It was years before I had the vet even determine if she was a male or female (at which time her name changed from Satan to Satin (I never had the courage... even with welding gloves)).Very tough customer!Satin really enjoys an ocassional can of this stuff... turkey too...This Fancy Feast looks like real food... and I feel safe giving it to her.(Getting old is tough enough without having to even look at some of the mush they try to pass off as cat food).As long as she's willing to keep us company... we're willing to groom her and provide some interesting/decent food.

Our finicky cat really enjoys this fancy feast grilled tuna cat food (Fancy Feast Gourmet Cat Food, Grilled Tuna Feast in Gravy, 3-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)).  He has a sensitive stomach and this food treats him just fine.  It doesn't smell horrible and lasts for a day in the refrigerator.  Amazon's subscription and save program makes it extremely convenient for me to feed him this food.  Also, *knock on wood* fancy feast is the only cat food that we've bought that hasn't been recalled.

We've had Coco for a year now and zeroed in on her favorite choice. Where I started purchasing it always seemed to be out. I was invited to join Amazon Prime as a family member. Best decision because I click my order in, gets delivered to front door in 2 days,I'm happy, Coco's happy, what more could I ask for?

My cat, Spot, was very sick a couple of years ago, and the only thing I could get him to eat was Fancy Feast. He's much better now, but still a pickier eater than he was before he got sick. He still loves Fancy Feast, however, the quality became unreliable.The meat was often rubbery: I could actually hear it squeak against his teeth, and pieces often shot out of his mouth; the gravy was often very watery, and there was sometimes so much of it that it was more like soup than cat food. Unacceptable, especially for a premium cat food.I was in the process of looking for something else that would appeal to Spot when I received the most recent shipment.  I was pleasantly surprised. The meat is now tender, not rubbery, and the gravy is very thick. Spot can't get enough of it. I still have some of the old food in other flavors, but all he wants now is the new stuff.  My search is over. We're sticking with Fancy Feast.

column9: Grilled Tuna Feast in Gravy Review
column10: This is a good product.I have two cats;a male and a female.The female will eat almost anything that is not nailed down while the male is very, very particular. He likes this product which is a strong recommendation from my point of view. Will I buy it again? Of course!

column9: Review about the actual food, not the service
column10: When you open this can of food for your cat,  you'll notice right away that it's packed with fish.  My cat gobbled this up right away - the protein level is high, the flavor must be right on.  The odor isn't bad as it is with most tuna products - you don't really smell it at all, which I found to be surprising.  Great food but the price here is about $6 more than what I pay for it at the grocery store.  Highly recommend!

column9: Cat loves food, but subscription service is unreliable.
column10: All five of the Fancy Feast subscriptions I signed up for have been unreliable.  Im October, I signed up for delivery every two months and received shipments only in October and December (it's now March 18, but I canceled all of my subscriptions yesterday).  What was supposed to be 48-can cases Amazon turned into 24-can cases, with one flavor being canceled entirely.  I was notified by Amazon that shipments would be sent in mid-February, but they never arrived.

column9: fancy feast grilled tuna feast in gravy
column10: My cat is very particular on foods he likes. The grilled tna in gravy is pieces of tuna in gravy which is one of his favorites. I've tried flaked variety which he didn't prefer. The food is consistent quality on the cans that I've opened.
a woman loved these flowers and commented on how long they lasted. They work. fast delivery also.

column9: best milk chocolate bar out there
column10: It is a shame these are so hard to find, and a good thing Amazon carries them!  This is by far the best milk chocolate bar we've ever tried, and my husband and I have tried many of the gourmet brands.  This is by far the best.  Very flavorful, creamy and rich.

column9: CK Products Clear Artificial Vanilla Baking Flavor
column10: This clear vanilla although artificially flavored is pretty good and I'll probably continue to use it in my baking.  It's a little pricey but cheaper than Wilton's clear vanilla.
It was really tough to find a clear vanilla for use in clear glazes, so I was happy to find this.  My only issue is that the bottle looks nothing like the one in the picture.

Despite the poor reviews I bought this to give it a try. Well, though it had a nice smell, there was a noticable flavor in the Buttercream Frosting I made. Same recipe I use everytime...so I know it was the vanilla. After a few guests asked me what was weird in the frosting, I knew that was a bad decision.  Too bad the price is so tempting...but, trust me, skip this one!

I got this Vanilla flavor to use instead of the Wilton Vanilla, thinking it would be a better quality. I opened the bottle when i received it took a sniff and about vomited. It smelt soooo strong. I can imagine using it for candle making or something but in food, my word NO! Maybe I got a bad bottle but it definitely put me off.

my picky pom loves this brand.  I rotate between 3 flavors (he won't eat same flavor more than 2 days).  I love that they are grain free, organic, and small enough for his tiny mouth. He has rejected several other "natural" dry or dehydrated raw dog foods -- Orijen, Addiction (he liked this for awhile), Canidae, Stella and Chewy's, etc. No digestive problems, no stinky breath (why would I want pizza or even fishy dog breath?).  I have tried all the Acana dry foods --I order the trial size so they stay fresh -- and the price is reasonable for the quality.

I just started my dogs on this food 3 days ago and they love it. No trying to add things to get them to eat, they clean their plates.I have used Orijen in the past and my dogs have always enjoyed that food. It is a bit too expensive for me since I also have to buy very good quality canned for my diabetic dog.My daughter decided to try this since it is made by the same company as Orijen. With all the food recall scares lately, this company has a very good reputation, uses quality ingredients, they have their OWN factory and they have had no recalls.

Caffe Bomrad just hit three home runs in my book.Quality  From the opening of the bag, the aroma drew me closer. Not too oily, but rich and dark. I had to try a cup as soon as my package arrived so I pulled out the grinder and set the grind to course (I will expand on this later).  I put 4 Tbsp in my coffee press and added 16 oz of water. 4 minutes later, my new best friend was there to great me.  The 2mm dark brown foam stayed on top as I poured the coffee for both my wife and myself. She added pure sugar and some frothed milk and I, usually taking my coffee the same as hers, decided to try the coffee uninhibited. We both drew the cups to our noses and took in the new aromas as they were much different than any we have had here in California.  The taste was full, but without any bitterness. We immediately knew that we have found our new staple to our morning wake up.Service  Before sending off $50 to Italy for coffee I had never heard of,  I checked out their great website and even shot off a quick email inquiring of grinding recommendations for this higher quality bean/roast.  Within 6 hours, I had received an extensive email back detailing the desired grinds ( and amounts ) for drip, press and espresso.  To top it off, the emails came from the Bomrad family. This, in my opinion, is a family who takes great pride in their product and their name, not to mention raising the bar extremely high in terms of of customer service.Value,  I was hesitant to spend $50+ on 1kg of coffee until my wife reminded me that I drop that on a bottle of Cab at dinner all the time.  I agreed and then ordered.  For us, the coffee was worth every $$.  If you enjoy great art, wine, or culinary delights; you have spent hundreds of dollars to give yourself the best.  With Caffe Bomrad, you only need to spend an extra 10 cents a cup more to give yourself the best coffee/espresso you can serve yourself.  Enjoy.

column9: The best coffe I have had so far worth the price.
column10: I must say this is the best coffee I have had so far and it is worth the price. I am a coffee aficionado and I have bought many coffees but this one is so far the smoothest and flavorful coffee. Its a must try you wont regret it.

I received Caffe Bomrad Torino as a gift last Christmas.  When I opened the bag, the aroma of the beans made me want to try it immediately.  I went to their website to learn more about the coffee and how best to brew it.  My gift came with a new coffee grinder so I made it using my French Press.  I couldn't believe how good it tasted.  It wasn't oily and it didn't leave a bitter after taste.  After finishing my gift, I purchased my regular brand and couldn't believe how inferior it tasted, so I ordered some more.  It may seem pricey at first, but Kona coffee is a lot more and this is cheaper than buying a cup at the local coffee house.

column9: Favorite coffee on Amazon thus far
column10: I've purchased many types of coffee so far, and this is definitely one of my favorites. I have a fancyish De Longhi Espresso/Cappuccino machine, and I love what it does with this coffee. Nice rich, robust taste, not too heavy/bitter, nice body and aroma..

column9: Cafe Bomrad Torino is Truly Exceptional Coffee
column10: I am a Starbucks loyalist but Cafe Bomrad Torino blows Starbucks away.  Excellent full bodied taste and smell but no bitterness. Great either black or with steamed milk.  A terrific daily treat for coffee enthusiasts.  I highly recommend you give it a try!

column9: A Little Taste of Italy at Home!
column10: The shipment arrived very quickly.  This coffee has a unique flavor and is exceptionally smooth without any bitterness whatsoever.  I don't think there is anything like it being sold in the United States. It really is like having a little bit of Italy in your home coffee maker!  I am really enjoying this excellent Italian coffee!
This coffee is wonderful.  It is rich, bold, and strong-- yet smooth at the same time.  I wake up to it every morning-- this is definitely my new coffee-- I can't imagine using anything else!

column9: Never tasted something like this before...
column10: My wife and I are coffee fans, after tasting Caffe Bomrad decided to sell our Nespresso machine in ebay. This product is absolutely unique, you haven't tried the best coffee ever if you didn't try Bomrad's Torino yet.

I lived in Italy for 3 years and always loved having my morning cappuccino and brioche.  I still drink a lot of coffee, but never found the taste that came close to any of the places I frequented in Milan.  Finally, I think I have something that comes pretty close.  Certainly better than the Starbucks around the corner.

I live for espresso, it flows through my veins. I have tried coffee varieties from all over the world, and I do travel a lot. And while each growing region has certain characteristics, and certain roasters add their certain "je ne sais quoi", the Bomrad label has found an espresso bean that is truly the bomb (sorry, couldn't resist!). It's the morning blast that I now crave. From the whiff you get when you grind it to the first sip, anytime you try it, I expect you will enjoy the results of what Bomrad has discovered in Italy.

What a refreshing change, as compared to many popular coffees. Smooth and delicous, without being too heavy or rich, this coffee is a perfect combination of taste and blend.  I highly recommend Caffe Bomrad Torino!

this was a great surprise and it's really a great coffee. sure it is premium but i think it was well worth the price for its superior quality, especially compared to illy and lavazza. i used a special promotion with which i got two packs for the price of one, which makes the coffee cheaper that lilly's and on par more or less with lavazza. plus i like the fact that it comes from a small company and it is clear that they really care about their product and how it is made.

Tried it and LOVE it. But don't take my word for it. I have a Columbian in-law who is in the coffee business and was very impressed with the Caffe Bomrad Torino he was served at my place - to date he was used to my Nespresso rainbow of flavors, and for a moment was shocked believing this was the usual Nespresso coffee served at my place. The flavor is great without the bitterness I come to experience with many coffees. You will not be disappointed.

Even if you don't know too much about cofee your senses will tell you that  the best coffee in the world has arrived. It' s the only coffee that with every sip takes you to a wonderfull world of enjoyment.

Posting this on behalf of my husband who wrote this and is the coffee drinker in the family...Overall, this is a very quality product and consistently delivers an outstanding experience.Specific observations -·Initial Taste - Drinkable and holds a consistent flavor profile as the temperature cools - for me this is a quality of a very well done and structured bean / roast / coffee·Color - Very good dark color·Nose - Pleasant aroma that does not come across as harsh, but very round and smooth·Food Compatibility - Exceptional in the morning with food (specifically, with my French toast)·Flavor Profile - Well balanced from beginning to end and does not fall off or become bitter.·Acidity - it complements the structure and contributes to the blend, but does not define it.  As a result the finish is extremely refined.I am basing this review on six mornings of 2 to 3 cups - the first cup with food and the remaining cup(s) consumed within an hour or so while working.  Additionally, I experimented with various grinding times and observed that that a finer grind resulted in a consistent and rounder cup.  I have used a drip maker to date and will experiment with a French press over the next few weeks.

No offense to Starbucks, but the only way I can drink its coffee is with loads of milk to eliminate the bitterness.  Caffe Bomrad, on the other hand, has the most delicate taste while offering a rich and smooth flavor.  We simply love it!

column9: Excellent Coffee. Must try and get addicted.
column10: After having tried a few brands with my new coffee machine. I have finally found the one that I prefer. Smell, taste and experience is unique. Cheers.

Being Italian and being cursed with very sensitive taste buds, I have always had a hard time finding good espresso. And it did not get any easier when I moved to the US. When I tried Caffe' Bomrad, I could not believe my luck!It is so good, that I finally switched from Illy Caffe' after thirty year of continuos loyalty and...dependence.Thank you Mr. Bomrad.

column9: Best espresso bean you can have! Totally worth the price!
column10: Length:: 1:20 MinsThis is the best espresso bean I had so far. Compare with Lavazza and illy. This bean is way better then this two well know Italian brand.If you understand espresso, the video is enough to tell you how great this bean is. you guys can check out the written review for farther information.PS: Because I have to manage the camera so I over extracted the bean. but the dark brown crema is what you always get.

I'm embarrassed to admit that I got suckered in by all the 5 star reviews and took a chance on this massively overpriced coffee.  The coffee itself is average at best, nothing really distinguishing about it.  It's fine as a daily drinker but doesn't really work as an espresso and certainly isn't worth the massive premium charged.I have since looked at all the 5 star reviews more carefully and it appears that many reviewers have not reviewed any other products (classic sign that the seller is the one doing the "reviewing").Needless to say I won't be making the same mistake twice, there are many better coffees out there at a fraction of the price.  I hope this helps others from making the same mistake I did.

After reading so many great, five star reviews on amazon about this bean, I had really high hopes for Bomard's Torino coffee.Unfortunately, I think maybe this bean just isn't really all that well suited for making espresso. It is a medium roast, and the beans do smell very nice, but it just didn't seem to be able to produce a really great shot of espresso for me. Crema production was relatively low and even when up dosing to 15 grams on a single shot, the flavors weren't really all that good. At 8 grams (for 1 oz), the shot was flat and thin.I'm not sure if Torino is a blend or a single origin bean, but for espresso it seems to fall a little bit short. With that said, I could see where this coffee might be better when used for pour over or with something like a french press, etc.Some coffees work well for espresso, some don't. At this stage, after dialing in the grind and pulling a few test shots, it seems like this might not be the best bean for espresso enthusiasts. Crema production is almost zero and the flavors are rather unpleasant when compared to other espresso blends.

I wanted to love this coffee.  The service on the Caffe Bombard coffee was fine, but I really expected more Italian 'oomph' in the roast. the write up says "Ambrosial Aroma, Great Body, Delicious Flavor, Long lasting Finish" and honestly it's not quite there. The aroma is great, the body is a bit weak as is the flavor.I know that northern roasts are more subdued than southern Italian, but this is quite mild.  While the beans make a decent cup of espresso especially for an afternoon cup, it doesn't stand up to the milk/foam in a latte or cappuccino. My most demanding customer, my wife, says that she can't find the coffee amongst the milk.  Like I said I do enjoy a straight espresso using the beans, but I also like to enjoy the occasional latte, and this doesn't cut it. Perhaps I should have realized it before purchasing. And now I have a kilo of the beans that will not be fresh by the time I should be finishing them up.  Oh well.  It would be valuable if the beans were offered in a smaller quantity to try out.

I use a Jura super automatic so all shot are consistent. For all the 5 star reviews, I don't think it delivers. Don't get me wrong, it is a very good coffee. Typical Italian with medium roast, but for the money I will go with something similar like Lavazza.

i've tried several other brands of organic dog food.  this is by far the best.  my dogs have lots of controlled energy, (not crazy hyper energy  their coats are shiny, eyes bright, and they tolerate the formula well for digestion.  only thing that would make this item better, is to have a small breed formula also.  i have a 4 lb. chihuahua, and a 10 lb. chihuahua.  i have to moisten and smash the kibble for my little one to be able to eat it.  great food, please make a smaller kibble!!  thanks

Oh!The creamy sweet taste of a perfect white chocolate shell and the wonderful tang of the creamy peanut filling that lies under this toothsome white confection is a memory that lingers on the tastebuds long after this delightful confection has gone down the hatch.Eating a Reeses Peanut Butter White Chocolate Cup is an experience that I GLADLY want to do over and over and over again.

This is absolute heaven in a cup!  I bought it for months at Food Lion and now I'm having trouble finding it. I plan on checking Walmart & Kroger next and hope to find it again. It is SO worth the search! If you see it in your supermarket you have to try it!

*****Stash's Fusion Red & White Tea has a fragrant bouquet, and an unusual taste that comes from the blend of red tea and white tea. The red tea taste is more dominant, the white tea taste subtle. I have to say that I like the red and white blend more than the red alone. I still probably prefer white tea more, but this blend is lovely, and lower in caffeine (the red tea has no caffeine, the white tea a bit). This tea contains only South African rooibos (another word for red tea) and white tea.The package says that it contains a hint of sweetness, and I'd agree, although the taste is very hard to describe (if you've had red tea before then you understand). The package also says that this tea is full of "potent antioxidants", which of course is very healthy.I would highly recommend Stash's Fusion Red & White Tea unless you do not care for rooibos or white tea; otherwise you will enjoy this.Recommended.*****

We serve tea at our coffee bar at church and this tea is all the rage.  I personally am not a fruity tea drinker, but I enjoy this as well.  I just ordered more because, of all the varieties I purchased this one is almost gone already!

This nutmeg is Indonesian.  I'm not sure if that is what the problem is, but the Carribean nutmeg is different.  Indonesian nutmeg is lighter in color and lighter in flavor.  It's okay, but the Carribean nutmeg is richer in color, scent, and flavor.  And it's crispier.  That's important, because the softer Indonesian nutmeg doesn't work in my shaver.  It's probably fine in any grinder, but not in my little shaver.  The gripping spikes slip in the soft nut and you have to constantly fiddle with the nut to get shavings.  If you don't know what a nutmeg shaver is, return your coffee maker for a refund and stick with Starbucks.  I wound up with this product, probably for the same reason as a lot of you; it's the cheapest one.  Well, you get what you pay for.  It works, nothing wrong with it, but there are better quality products out there, and if you use a shaver, you really must pick one of the other options.

We must have received a fruitcake made a year ago - this was so dry, you could not slice it- it just crumbled.  You could tell the ingrediants were of high quality.Last year we purchased a Jane Parker fruitcake and it was great, unfortunately, the large ones are no longer available through amazon.com.  In addition, the tin ( which my wife wanted ) was damaged in 2-3 placed - fedex is rough on things
This fruit cake was just no good. It was even burnt on the top. I had to throw it away. The tTrappist Monk cake was better, and Collins Bakery is still the best.

Since I've been from Europe and lived in Switzerland for a while it was no question about it whether I wanted to order this Swiss Colony Fruit Cake or not. Listen to me my Dears...please forget the American traditional sweets for a few days and enjoy this remarkably precious treasure. Give your taste buds a twist and see you guys in Paradise!! :)

Delicious salad dressing that upgrades any green salad you make at home.  Incredible flavor that explodes in your mouth with every bite.  Have not found any raspberry vinaigrette that compares to Saucy Mama.

The label for a 5 star review says "I love this" when you mouse over the stars.  Technically speaking, I don't love this at all but my cats seem to like it very much.  They especially like the "gravy", licking it off first before eating the food itself.
great taste,not too strong. really healthy for you. i wish it came in a bigger bottle.other brands have been too strong of a unwanted flavor.

I ordered this a little late and the email confirmation said it wouldn't get here until the 20th, which would have been too late for Passover. But, it arrived 3 days before Passover! I was very pleased with the quick shipment and it tasted wonderful. We actually had some that we spread melted Almond Bark on and sprinkled a few pecan pieces and sliced almonds on top. That was really good and different. The bread by itself was very good, also and was not stale like I was afraid it would be. I would highly recommend this for Passover and for diabetics. It is one of the things on the diabetic list of foods that they can eat. I hope everyone had a happy Passover. Shalom

column9: the item says small but they are the giant size which my dogcannot eat.
column10: this was not what I ordered. I am most upset-  I gave the giant size treats to a neighbor with a large dog. the package says small but they are huge. Very disappointed. I will not order from you again.

column9: If I were a plane crash victim, I guess I would eat these
column10: I noticed these treats at the local store and thought the concept sounded delicious - real peanut butter cookie dough covered in chocolate and individually wrapped for a quick treat while on the road or at work.  I thought that the Mrs. Fields name would yield something pretty good for a product such as this. My expectations, unfortunately, were unmet.These cookie dough creations are awful.  Just awful.  When you open the package, there is a faint smell that is chemical peanut butter mixed with cheap chocolate.  Upon the first bite, you realize that the cookie dough is not soft but dry and really doesn't taste like peanut butter.  In a blind tasting, I would never call the flavor peanut butter.  The overall sensation is that this is chemical.  The aftertaste lingers in a very unpleasant way.I award two stars because it is convenient to plop one of these in a purse or lunch bag.  Additionally, if I were in a plane crash (knock on wood), I could eat these but a piece of a passenger seat might easily become more tempting.I purchased a 4.4 oz bag from Meijer for about 2.50.

This product had an unannounced ingredient change. Chicken was added, which caused huge problems for my dog. The representative at Purina wrote back in response to my upset email to advise me they only changed the ingredients to the canned EN. Totally false statement. I had written down the 1st few ingredients in the beginning and I made a comparison when my dog got sick. Totally unacceptable!

column9: Careful, it is smaller than it looks in the picture
column10: I usually do not have much time for shopping grocery, however I really love oyster mushrooms. This dried kind on Amazon is perfect me. It can be stored for a long time, and it taste good. The only thing that I felt a little disappointed is that each bag looks smaller than it is in the picture. But it is okay, as they sent me 12 bags, and each time I only need half bag of them. When you put them in water for an hour, they become surprisingly big though.
These mushrooms store indefinately and the cost is a fraction of what my local supermarket charges.  I'm very satisfied.

I was very pleased to find this dark roast Celebes Kalossi coffee on Amazon, and even more pleased when I received my first shipment.  The beans are a rich glossy dark brown, and the resultant coffee made with my stove top espresso maker is excellent.  Celebes Kalossi is celebrated as the best coffee for espresso, and I've certainly never found anything I liked as well.  African coffees are very good, but don't have the richness of Celebes, and South American coffees don't really compete.  The "Coffee Bean Direct" beans obtained from Amazon are outstanding.
These beans are definitely among the best I've ever had. I've even had many guests over who have remarked as such. Would definitely recommend these to anyone who likes a good, dark brew.

column9: One of the best coffee you will ever have
column10: This is a very smooth, aromatic coffee, with low acidity. It doesn't leave a strong aftertaste, nor kick your stomach when you drink it, just the opposite. This coffe was recommended to us almost 2 years ago, and since then has been our favorite.

I hadn't purchased whole bean coffee from Amazon in the past.  I am reasonably happy with this purchase.  Nice whole bean, dark roasted, with a good oil coating on the beans.  Coffee is dark and delicious.  A word of caution.  Coffee is best consumed shortly after roasting and this is a lot of coffee.  I like the fact that it was packed in separate bags and that helped - but it still was probably too much coffee at one time considering there are only two of us dringking it.
Just thought that I would add a review here. This coffee is great! Rather dark roast, beautiful smell and not that acidic. I'd recommend it.

Good product - have used saccharin for over 20 years and this is the one. I ordered a case of 12 bottles (1/4 grain equals one teaspoon of sugar), however, I only got 10. When I emailed they gave me back the money for the two without even asking if this is what I wanted. I didn't, I wanted 12 bottles. So, now I have to buy 2 more and I can't get just 2 at the price they returned to me. I would have rather returned them and ordered a box of 12 from another seller.  So, product is good  would recommend it but buy from a different seller!!!!!

I drink soymilk on a daily basis, but I usually buy the unsweetened variety.  While this product is both affordable and portable, it is also extremely sweet.  If you're not used to the super sweetness in your cereal, it might come as a surprise.  It isn't un-tasty, but I wouldn't drink it everyday due to concerns of cavities and an upset belly.

column9: Awesome Drink! :) The only soy you should buy! For all ages.
column10: I have been getting soy for my boys 8 & 10 with milk allergies and happened upon Zen Soy on Amazon. I loved the panda and thought let's try it. One of the best buying  decisions I have ever made. My boys and I so love Zen Soy. The smooth creamy taste is awesome.  They say it tastes just like ice cream. Now they request Zen Soy and say not other will do. My 10 year old said to never buy Silk again, he only wants Zen Soy.

Great to have handy in car while on the go.  Requires no refrigeration.  All flavors are very tasty.ZenSoy, Soy On The Go Chocolate, Organic Soy Milk, 8.25-Ounce Aseptic Packages (Pack of 15)ZenSoy, Soy On The Go Cappuccino, USDA Certified Organic Soy Milk, 8.25-Ounce Unit (Pack of 15)

ZenSoy has won me over as the best soy milk available. Ask my 7 kids (some of whom refuse to call it "soymilk" and prefer "soyjuice" as a more adequate name), and they all can agree ZenSoy tastes more like real milk... and even if they don't think it's like real milk, they still want it!

I read 10 reviews that said this was the greatest soy milk product and 1 review that said it had a funny after taste and recommended the Silk Soy. I have to agree with the one review. I'm not sure what it is but it has almost a medicinal taste. I was ordering Silk but the subscription service on Silk Vanilla Soy was cancelled by Amazon. I'm not sure why. I tried this brand but it really is not a good substitute.Who knew?

I read all the reviews about how great the product tasted, so I figured I'd try it out. My son has a dairy allergy so we normally just don't send him to school with anything other than juice. This seemed like a good substitute for those days that he needed a break from juice. I was so excited to try it when it arrived. I let my son have the first taste. He nearly spit it out. I thought he may be overreacting, so I tasted it. I have to say that I'm a big fan of soymilk's flavor. But, this was just gross. I won't waste the money, so I plan on drinking the case up and possibly using it in smoothies. But, I won't re-buy it.

I don't drink soy milk on its own, but I do like the health benefits of it. I use it to make steel cut oats in the crock pot over night.These containers are perfect because they are shelf stable and pre-measured. This pack is enough for 2 months, but I don't have to worry about it going bad in the fridge. I love the slight vanilla flavor it adds too, it makes any fruit I use a little creamier.I will definitely keep buying this. column9: Best Turkey Jerky that I've tried
column10: I've tried some options on amazon.com such as Jack Link's Turkey Jerky and Turkey Nuggets, Snackmasters Range Brown Turkey Jerky, Golden Valley Natural Turkey Jerky, among others from various retail outlets. Totally, I have had ~7 different brands of turkey jerky and ~8 of the beef variety .  Among turkey, Oberto is my favorite by far.Given that jerky is made by a dehydration process, dryness is inherent to jerky as a food.  Also, turkey is a dryer meat than beef (the most common jerky) and I've found turkey jerky to be, on average, dryer than beef jerky.  I prefer my jerky relatively moist.Oberto Turkey Jerky is by far the most moist jerky I've had (aside from the Oberto Pork brand). The package usually has very large strips that hold their water content for greater lengths of time.  The other brands I've tried are broken into small pieces and are very chewy & dry in comparison.  Another key aspect is the flavoring.  This product is well-flavored whereas other products often taste like proteinated cardboard.  For a teriyaki flavor, Oberto doesn't overdo on salt either and the entire product is natural and less processed.Overview:Pros- Moist, Tastey, Natural & Minimally ProcessedCons- Oberto Turkey only comes in TeriyakiBottom Line: If you want Turkey Jerky and don't mind teriyaki, this is probably the best, easily obtainable product out there.

I think the Jack Link's has a better taste due to more flavourings (the secret is in the soy sauce they use, I suspect) where this has a cleaner beef taste which some might like more.I think the beef strips in this brand are a bit too thick, but maybe that's just me.

To me, the flavor was a little overwhelming. There was no turkey flavor. Just the sweetness of the Teriyaki. I think 7 grams of sugar in a 1-ounce serving (1/3 of a package) seems like a lot. And look at the list of ingredients: Brown sugar is the #2 ingredient, sugar is the #4 ingredient, and pineapple juice concentrate is the #7 ingredient. That's quite a bit of sweetness. Too much sweetness for me.

column9: Excellent product with variety of use
column10: This is one product that I keep more on hand than anything else in my house.  I was only introduced to it about a year ago, but it is extremely versatile.  There are a couple of tricks that I've learned to get the most out of it though, and I'll share some of that here.Boiling - the product must be boiled before it can be used.  2 parts water brought to boil with 1 part quinoa.  Bring back to boil and then turn down to simmer for 9 minutes in a covered pot.  Turn off and then let sit for 20 minutes.  It will finish absorbing the rest of the water and do all it's tricks to get the white threat exposed.  It will be soft and fluffy and ready to use.  If you can put it in the fridge overnight and then fluff it up with a fork, this is when quinoa is at it's peak.  I keep some in the fridge for whatever I want later.Dinner - boil in chicken stock and add spices to get something like a healthy rice like product.  It has a nutty taste that is brought out by the salts.  While still hot, add butter, olive oil, garlic, and some goat cheese.  Stir gently till the cheese melts.Breakfast - boil in water as per above, and then mix with a small amount of coconut oil, raisins and craisins, toasted pine nuts, and some honey for an incredible cereal.  Eat it warm or cold right out of the fridge.  It is easy to transport, won't go bad quickly, and that and a yogurt are a great hotel breakfast you can depend on instead of the stale sugar rolls they serve down in the continental breakfast.Quinoa holds a sauce better than just about any rice or pasta product.

column4: Lonnie E. Holder "The Review's the Thing"
column10: I would guess that when Leo Hirshfield first began producing Tootsie Rolls in New York City that he never guessed that more than a century later the chocolate candy would be a favorite of children around the world.  This candy was originally a children's favorite because it was a penny candy, it was one of the first individually wrapped candies, and it was durable under a variety of conditions, like being in a child's pocket.Leo Hirshfield first produced Tootsie Rolls in 1896.  Hirshfield named the candy after his five-year-old daughter, whose nickname was Tootsie.  Tootsie Rolls became even more popular as the United States emerged from the Great Depression.  Tootsie Rolls went to war in World War II as a part of soldiers' rations, and it became a G.I.'s favorite for the same reason it was a children's favorite; it was wrapped and durable under a variety of conditions.  The candy also provided a quick energy boost.Tootsie Rolls are chewy and have a mild chocolate flavor with modest sweetness.  While Tootsie Rolls get harder when cold, they become soft again when warmed, yet they never get so soft in normal circumstances that they actually melt.  However, in a child's pocket they can get very soft.Tootsie Roll Industries is now a candy giant, and yet the original candy retains all its charm and is very much like the original made by Leo Hirshfield.  Tootsie Rolls has now expanded to numerous other countries, and yet in many ways this popular candy is an American institution.For a flavor experience I also recommend assorted Tootsie Rolls, which has included lemon, vanilla and cherry.

So far, Natural Temptations Wild Alaskan Salmon Flavor, Natural Temptations Tuna Flavor and All Natural Temptations Chicken Flavor are proving to be three of the rare exceptions.  Just about all the kitties love these things and will follow me around when I'm handing them out so they can cadge more.  Because they are all natural and only 2 calories per treat, they are a reasonably safe and nutritious treat.  Because they are inexpensive, I can afford to bring enough for everybody at every visit!  And apparently they taste awesome.  I can buy these at my local grocery, Target, Walmart or pet store for around $1.50 to $2.00 a packet and each packet contains enough treats to provide every kitty in the shelter with a generous serving of treats. There is one negative - these treats contain a lot of grains and as a result some kitties will vomit them up after an hour (some kitties tummies will not tolerate food or treats containing grain, or more than very small amounts of grain); over the last few months I've had 3 or 4 kitties through the shelter with this issue.  Once I've identified a kitty who is grain-intolerant, I naturally do not feed it these treats or anything similar.  Note that there are several versions of the Whiskas treats that are not all natural; the kitties like them also but I prefer to feed the all natural version.

This is the best cream of tomato soup you can buy.  Reminds me of the cream of tomato soup I ate in Cyprus 40+ years ago.  I tried to duplicate that soup for a long time and just gave up  Then I found Pacific and without a doubt this is the very best soup.

The flavor is outstanding and we love that there are no preservatives in the bread.  This manufacturer does make other kinds of breads.  I have tried them all and I like them all, however the one with Museli is the best.fourkidmom

column9: How do you say Excellent in German?
column10: I started eating this Mestemacher bread several months ago, buying it in a local store, Meijers, from their international foods aisle.Note- !!!THIS IS NOT YOUR ORDINARY BREAD!! It is real food!!!  It is a dense, heavy bread...You don't just eat it....you savor it,like you might a wine....Seriously...Even our 2 teen sons love it and our 2 daughters who are in their 20's...If you are looking for the best Ham and mustard sandwich, you need to try the rye or pumpernickel version of the Mestemacher bread, toasted or at least warmed a bit.  It's to die for!!  Another note -The other Mestemacher breads have a stronger body to them. This Rye Bread with Muesli has more crumb to it than the others, but its flavor and texture is well worth it...I know I will order it again!! The shelf life is fantastic....my 12 loaves are good till April 2011.(They will be gone long before then - my daughter already took two loaves back to New York with her)  No preservatives are used...It is because of the type of bread it is and is pasteurized in its production.If you need a quick delicious "Pick up breakfast in the morning", cut a slice of this bread, (any variety), toast it and put peanut butter on it (or whatever you prefer). That toast and an apple or banana with water or coffee takes me from 7:30 AM to noon with no problem!!! and I'm a good sized guy at 57 y.o., 6 foot and an undisclosed weight!!...;-)...Give it a try and enjoy!!!

As a German expat, bread is important to me. It took me a while to find a brand in the US that I liked just as much as the bread I used to eat in Germany. This Mestemacher Rye Bread with Muesli is it. In fact, I like it better than the bread I remember from Germany.The 12-pack at Amazon is also about 55 cents cheaper per pack than at my local grocery store.
I REALLY LIKE THIS BREAD, I AM GLUTEN INTOLERANT AND I CAN EAT THIS GREAT BREAD WITH NO PROBLEMS ITS A LITTLE FRAGILE BUT IF YOU USE A KNIFE TO REMOVE FROM PKG NO PROBLEMS

column9: If you enjoy throwing away $ and food buy this product.
column10: NO STARS.  I read it keeps a long time and is very healthy as well as tasty.  So, I took a chance.  This stuff makes anything you put on it taste bad.  I put premium canned crab meat with a little miracle whip on it...yikes, the so-called bread made it taste like garbage...makes anything you put on it taste terrible. I think I got through around two and a half slices before I decided to throw out the whole box of replusive dark loaves.

column9: I love that bread, but it arrived moist
column10: I bought some Maetemacher Bread before without problem. This one is very good, but the bread is a bit moist, and the edges crumble. Very different from the other type I had.Also, the expiration date is too soon for me (7 months). Last time, was longer too.This being said, the bread is good.
Thanks so much for selling these. I'm so happy I had a chance to drink these before their time was up. I really wish they still made them-- they really are the best.
Dublin DP is the best, but any dumbass that pays this much for soda needs his balls cut off so he won't reproduce. For the sake of humanity.
$60 for 1-24 pack,(including s/h) are you kidding? These sodas are my favorite but no soda is worth $2.50 a can. That's $.21 an ounce that's crazy.

I have a couple of dogs, one of which, loves to chew on bones. I gave it to my dog as a Christmas treat and it went to town. But later I found little splinters on the floor. It did not register to me at first since it had lost the meat flavoring color and it was pure white. Still being oblivious at the time, I tried to give the same dog another one, seeing how he loved the first one, and he just walked the other way. Then after my dog threw up, the bone splinter riddle was solved.Later, my daughter, who works at a dog adoption organization, told me that I should have never given my dog pork bones... at least not the dried out variety. Perhaps this won't be a problem for your dog but my dog can really chew thru bone... so maybe that was it. In any case, lesson learned for me with my dogs. And perhaps a heads up for you and your dog if you have any concerns.

My dog almost died from this product. The bone splinters and the company knows it. They have a liability statement on their product because I am sure I am not the first dog owner to have gone through the hell that I went through. I bought a smoked bone from the grocery store because I thought it was big looking, met the size required for my dog and I thought since it was American made it was a quality product. It is far less than quality. Would anyone give arsenic to their dog, absolutely not. So don't spend your money on this killer product. After 3,500 dollars in gastronomy surgery, emergency care,I spent a sad and scared Christmas tending to a poor puppy whining and whelping in pain from their defective junk. Please take this review to heart, I want to spare you what I went through.
While my large dogs loved these, they finished them off in minutes.  The picture really makes the buyer believe these are large size bones, but in fact, they are about 3.5" long.

column9: DO NOT BUY THESE - THEY CAN KILL YOUR PET
column10: Absolutely DO NOT BUY these bones! I bought a 3 pack, gave one to each of my 3 dogs and had to have emergency gastric surgery for all 3. The bones will splinter when they are eaten and can perforate the stomach or intestines.
im always in need more of these...keeps my dog busy and away from chewing stuff he shouldnt,i have couple stocked up

I used to get these bones locally, but the store I got them from no longer carries them.  I have tried the same type of beef bones from other manufacturers, but a large piece always cracks down the middle of the bone.  These bones by Hartz are great.  My 90 pound dog chews on them for months.

column9: Splinters & Dog Just Vomited Undigested Pieces
column10: The aroma of the Hartz Smoked Pork Bone is just downright memorizing-even tempting the taste buds of humans. That's about the extent of the reasons I like this product. This splinters BADLY!! My 75 lb Dalmatian ate one last night @10pm and today @ 5pm he vomited shards of the bone (which was a lot) and everything else he ate that couldn't pass as a result of these bone fragments blocking the passageway of his intestines. Please do not purchase these bones for your dog! If you care enough about them; then find something else!
this is a great product that will keep your dogs busy for a couple of days. mine can eat a large rawhide in 30 minutes, but not these bones. highly recommended, made in USA too!

My dog loves these bones. I only let her have them when I'm watching.She actually can eat them now and get sick. I have purchases these bones at Walmart cheaper, these were a little pricey. I will most likely just get them at Walmart from now on.

column9: GREAT product that encourages HEALTHY chewing!
column10: A co-worker recommended that we get a knuckle bone after my complaints of our lab puppy wanting to chew on EVERYTHING.  We bought the first one at Petco, Petco brand, and she loved it and eventually broke it in two (prob a month or so after having it), and she was needing a new one.  I decided to go with this one on Amazon and she LOVED it!! She spent an entire hour chewing on this just during the first sitting.  She carries it around the house with her and it is FANTASTIC because she doesn't try to chew the wall anymore (or carpet! augh!!).  Highly recommend. :)  Thanks, Amazon.

column9: DON'T DO IT!  MY DOG THREW UP A POOL OF BLOOD!
column10: Gave my Dachshund this Hartz "Premium" bone for "aggressive chewers" on Sunday afternoon.  By dinner Monday she was not eating or drinking.  By Tuesday morning (this day) she was throwing up bright red pools of blood!  I had her to the Vet within an hour and $354.32 later learned that this Hartz "Premium" bone for "aggressive chewers" tore up her intestines.  She is now on 3 medications and a special diet for the next week.  The vet advised me to contact Hartz to let them know what happened.  I plan on doing that AND sending a copy of the bill.  I don't expect them to pay it (they'll likely file it in the circular file) but they need see it and hear about it. I purchased these Hartz "Premium" bones for "aggressive chewers" from Walmart so did not have the advantage of the WARNING reviews on Amazon. You do.  Don't do this to your dog.

I purchased this bone at a local supermarket and gave it to my boxer. I walked in the house to literally make a cup of coffee and my dog devoured the bone. What a surprise, when the packaging clearly says: "...this long last chew satisfies your dog's instintive urge to chew." I didn't think anything about it until 2 hours later when after a walk, my dog regurgitated twice! I checked the vomit and sure enough, there was shards of the bone inside. This stuff was so sharp it actually cut my latex glove! BE CAREFUL. If it could cut my glove, it can damage a dog's stomach, colon, intestines and/or esophogus. THIS PRODUCT SHOULD BE TAKEN OFF THE MARKET AND NOT SOLD! There is a disclaimer on the product packaging, "This is a natural product and may be prone to splintering." Are you kidding me!? I have been monitoring my dog, whom regurgitated two more times since. Still not sure if I need to go to the vet yet. Gave her 1/3 can of pumpkin to coat her stomach and 3-slices of white bread, which I read will gum up and help her pass any shards in her stomach. Why any company would sell such a product is beyond me. This american made item, lacks the quality to sell in america. I am appalled it is even being sold on the shelves. STAY AWAY. Read the other negative reviews. $3500 for stomach surgery and chances of fatalities. Is it worth it to risk the life of a loved family member over a $3.00 bone! Absolutely not. DO NOT PURCHASE, IT IS UNSAFE.
You people arn't going to believe this but.... My dog likes flavored bones, go figure. Why are you reading a review on dog bones?.... A better question:... Why am I writing one?

I bought this product today hoping to amuse my chew-loving dog. But after unwrapping the packaging, I was disappointed. Not only did the bone have a weird, unnatural oil all over it but it also smelled like chemicals. I offered it to my dog, who after being so excited at the sight of the bone, smelled it and walked away! I tried to wash off all the meat and other particles outside but even the inside smelled like chemicals and my dog was not buying it!

column9: My Lab just ate the whole thing!
column10: OMG, I gave this to my 1 year old, 110 lab and he ran outside with it. I got distracted and when I went to check he had already eaten the entire thing. The only thing I could find were two horrible splinter pieces!! Now I'm at this moment terrified!!! I read the other reviews where some dogs have had to have surgery because of these...I'm hoping and praying my dog will be okay. It's only been a hour since it happened and now all we can do is wait and watch. I've given him some bread and he gets pumkin every night anyway. Plus he had already eaten his dinner so I'm hoping his "full" tummy will help the bone to pass. Needless to say my husband is mad at me for not showing it to him before I handed it out. But we've been going through some major life issues the last couple of weeks and I'm not thinking clearly as it is. I soooo wish I could turn back time and have never given it to him!! Please stay away from this bone and please, if you are reading this and have any good thoughts to help while I wait, I'm open to them as I am worried sick!!! I've already lost my 14 year old lab in Sept and this one we got in Oct and he his my Angel!!! I would die if anything happened to him!!!

My dog recived these for christmas this year. and he loves them! he doesnt like any of the fake bones or made treats he loves real bones of course what dog doesnt! Hes been chewing them up for hours and hours since.

This thing is gigantic!  My dog is 35 pounds and I thought this would be a good bone for her to last a while.  She can't even lift this monstrous thing!  She still likes it though.  Been working on it for about 3 months now and it is still the same size as when we bought it.  Recommended for very large dogs only.

column9: I buy them six at a time.
column10: I buy them six at a time, my German Shepherd goes through one a week. I will purchase these again and again.

I was expecting a larger sized bones; The bones in this product are on the small side. My Sheppards where able to shatter the bones into small elongated pieces that I ended sweeping up and discarding. It might be fine for smaller dogs, but I'd pass on these for larger dogs.
OMG this bone was gone in 5 minutes! My lab ate the entire thing. I gave it to him, turned my back....and POOF! It was gone.

They are still edible, but are noticeably dry and stale.  Not bad enough to return, but not fresh enough to try buying them again, either.Note that we got these delivered Prime overnight, so it was not an issue with delays in transit, or anything.  Disappointing.

These cookies in my opinion are way better than fig newtons.And not just because there organic.The taste is truly heavenly if your into fig cookies.For me fig newtons are a thing of the past.And now my present is filled with the gift of fig Newman's.

We've been fans of all the Newman's products that we've tried, beginning with his salad dressing for more than 20 years.Every now and then we go on a little Fig Newtons binge.I stumbled across these low-fat Newman's alternatives in the grocery store today.Same familiar tastes and texture, less fat and some of your purchase price will make its way to charitable causes.What's not to like ?

I love fig cookies, but the big name brand uses partially hydrogenated oil and I won't purchase products that have that as an ingredient so I have been buying Fig Newmans for quite a few years now.These are my favorite, the wheat free and fat free versions just aren't as good.  My local store charges $3.99 per package so Amazon was a better deal, I didn't really need 6 packages of them, but I am sure my kids will eat them.  I left an open package on the kitchen counter and the next time I walked by my kids had eaten them all, they really love them too.

column9: Cookies I Don't Mind My Kids Eating
column10: Unlike the other review, our package of 6 arrived completely fresh. (They're all sealed individually, so unless the 6 packages are opened I don't know how they would be going stale.) My kids have eaten these since they were toddlers--it's a healthy cookie, and very filling. The price on Amazon is much better than at the store, so we're buying them here now.

ARrived in timely manner, as advertised. Chips are very crunchy, good as dippers, especially with hummus, or just by themselves. The chips had a few more broken pieces than the bags you buy in the grocery store, but for the money you save, the on-line purchase is definitely worth it. Will repeat order in future.

column9: Great Chips...Just don't buy them here
column10: I love Stacy's Pita Chips- buy them all the time at grocery store so I know what they should look like and how they should taste. I have used McCormick Spice for over 15 years with confidence my pickles will always be perfect.  I give away several pints and quarts each year.  I highly recommend this product, and the amazon price is much lower than purchasing separately at a grocery store.
