Way better than candy....Here are the ingredients:-Almond butter, coconut nectar, Peruvian cacao powder, chopped almonds, cacao butter, Peruvian cacao nibs-Chia seed, sprouted quinoa flour, brown rice protein powder, Himalayan sea salt-Chocolate Coating: dark chocolate (evaporated can juice, cocoa butter, chocolate liquor, soya lecithin)**UPDATED - 7/21/12SCORE!!!  For some reason, I decided to Google these, and found them on Walgreens.com! WAY BETTER DEAL than ordering on Amazon-- 2 for $5  OR $27.99 for the 12pk. + Free {everyday} shipping $25 or more. Apparently they're sold in-store & online, but none of the stores near my house carried them.

column9: Excellent for Healthy Candy Bar Substitute
column10: This bar is amazingly good, and has a lot going for it in terms of being a healthy treat. The best thing is that is that it doesn't taste "healthy." It tastes like a treat. Compared to a chocolate bar of a similar size it has lower total fat, lower saturated fat, lower sugar conntent, and about the same number of calories. And it has 4 grams of fiber and 6 grams of protein. If only it didn't have evaporated cane sugar in the dark chocolate coating it would be perfect! These bars are expensive, but I think they're worth it!

The Chia bar may just be the best vegan bar I have ever eaten! Firstly, I was thoroughly impressed with the texture: The combination of Almond Butter and Coconut Nectar as the first 2 ingredients, is heavenly.  At 195 Calories per bar, it isn't wimpy.  A healthy dose of good fat, great Carbs and a respectable 6 grams of protein are on offer here.  But nutrition aside, what matters the most is taste.  No matter how healthy or unhealthy a bar is, it must taste good.  This bar is so yummy! It is like a healthy candy bar, but not in a traditional way.  Most 'healthy' bars try to be like candy bars, but fail miserably.  As a solid, good for you bar, this one hits the mark! Now, I need to order more before I run out.  By the way, I don't work for the company, etc...
Keen-Wah Decadence bars are an amazing healthy snack.  If you love chocolate, then this is the healthy snack for you.

This bar is satisfying and tastes better than any other. The ingredients are mostly organic and there are under 200 cals per bar. Of all the selling points, believe me, taste wins hands down. The Himalayan sea salt is really appreciable and makes me slow down and enjoy the snack break.

I've been using xylitol for a few years now.  It has many health benefits and dental uses, do a web search for yourself and see how great this stuff is!  It's an excellent sugar alternative for those of us with diabetes.  We can indulge our sweet tooth without the negative consequences.  Until recently I didn't know that so much of the xylitol on the market was made in China from corn that is likely genetically modified.  Sorry, I'm not about to put those mystery granules in my body.  This product by Health Garden is made in the USA from birch.  Sure, you're going to pay more for this than you will for the other stuff, but at least you know what you're getting.  This sweetener tastes identical to sugar, though the granules are a bit larger (not a problem, just an observation).  You can use it exactly like you would use sugar, but be warned, xylitol is dangerous for pets, so if your furry companions have a sweet tooth, don't give them anything made with xylitol!  Also, too much xylitol will loosen your bowels.  Xylitol is a sugar alcohol and your body does not process it like it does ordinary sugar.  My only question is, why did the price go up $15 in a week?  The 10 lb. bag was $39.99 when I ordered it last week, now it's $54.99.  That's quite a jump.  I'm glad I ordered it when I did.
Excellant quality product. I've ordered this product twice and have been very satisfied with both. They arrived promptly and the products are high quality. I would highly recommend it.

I AM NOW GIVING a 5-FIVE STAR REVIEW to HEALTH GARDEN! Please IGNORE my 1st review as it was MY ERROR in 'reading' wrongly HEALTH GARDEN'S website! Mea Culpa! I hope that HEALTH GARDEN accepts my heartfelt apology for the initial 'bad review.'I went on a 'rant' because of the message I received from the HEALTH GARDEN website concerning an order I placed with Health Garden for their 'Kosher Birch Xylitol' at which time I noticed a "CURRENTLY UNAVAILABLE.WE DON'T KNOW WHEN OR IF THIS ITEM WILL BE BACK IN STOCK" message. (Please see all that ranting below.)I guess I DID NOT check my email closely enough to 'see' that my order of 30 lbs. of Health Garden Kosher Birch Xylitol had already sent me a 'shipping' order that my order was placed and would arrive on Oct 2nd or 3rd which it did! I did not 'notice' until AFTER, I posted this 'rant.' My bad, because that shipment arrived the day after I wrote the following 'bad review' again, please see my initial 'rant', again.Although I have yet to try Health Garden Kosher Birch Xylitol but am excited to get started because after researching a gazillion Xylitol products, Health Garden Kosher Birch Xylitol got the best reviews on every 'review' site I researched. So I am sure it will be a great product.

column9: This tea is really about laxative
column10: I use Super Dieters Tea as a laxative. It must be prepared as to the directions, and it will work as a laxative. It should not be used every day, though. That is extreme.But, it works.
Really fast and a little bit goes a LONG way! I have a three shelf sprouter and a little less then a 1/4 of a cup fills one full tray! Really fresh, great tasting too. Excellent product.

Although bearing only a fairly marginal resemblance to the sweet traditionally known as Turkish delight, these are pretty good. The inside is a semi-reasonable facsimile of traditional Turkish delight (although far softer and less chewey in texture) which is then coated in a very think outer layer of milk chocolate.As chocolate bars go... uh... well, they're low-fat, I suppose! I think the innards are pure gelatin and sugar.Do be aware that these come in a variety of packs containing different numbers of bars. At least as of the time of writing, these do not all work out at the same cost on a per bar basis. So it may well be worth your while doing your homework before deciding which deal is right for you.Enjoy in Moderation!Theo.
I have enjoyed the Fry's brand of turkish delight candy for many decades.  Other brands taste too much like I'm eating perfume.  I highly recommend this candy!

I really like Turkish Delight, I used to eat it all the time in England.  Thing is, I spent about 8 dollars total for these three bars, and these are in fact the tiny little palm size bars.  They actually packed them into a much larger box so I was pretty surprised when I opened them at how small they are.  So yes, the product is good, but I wouldn't buy it from here.
These arrived very quickly and were fresh, which is awesome as I have bought candy from overseas before only to find it a little stale. Nice to find British products at a reasonable price in the USA.

This is the second time I have now ordered from this company (JR Mushrooms) and I am very pleased with their items. All the different peppercorns I have ordered have been nothing but outstanding. For Christmas this year I ordered 6 packages of peppercorns for my husband and mom. The taste of these peppercorns are great for salads and just about anything you want to add great flavor to. I highly recommend these to everyone who wants to spice up their foods. You will definitely not be disappointed. This company has excellent customer service to deal with and the items always arrive ahead of schedule. I will definitely be ordering from you for my future purchases. I am a very satisfied customer.

I really like the fact that the peppercorns arrived in a airtight bag. When I opened the bag the arroma was wonderful. This is the same type of black pepper you can buy at any grocery store but if you compare price per ounce; this definately is the better choice! Great product. I will be a return customer for these peppercorns in the future.

The peppercorns are obviously fresh, having good color and are fragrant even outside the cellophane type of packaging, which, yes, is a little flimsy. Anyway, the peppercorns are just the right size, not big and old.

column9: It was worth the wait at this price...
column10: If you've shopped around for the premium Tellicherry Peppercorns at all you'lll notice one thing about all of the vendors...this ain't no cheap McCormick peppercorns to buy...they all are real expensive, even the ones that look like deals are not when adding in the shipping cost they rip you for on most sites. I have to say that this company is far better priced than any I looked at for the quantity and price...at least this size was. Yes, You will wait longer than you think you should because this comes directly out of India via their slow-ass parcel post. I had forgotten about it when it came, and was pleasantly surprised when I opened it. Packaging kind of sucked, but held together with no leaks of any peppercorns.  And the product is what it says it is...the Premium Tellicherry Peppercorns that is desired by most pepper lovers...so go for it...then forget about it. If you really forget..then you'll eventually be surprised to get the package when it comes.If you don't forget about it you're setting yourself up for a frustrating wait...so just order, have faith, and eventually it'll be on your dinner table when you least expect it. And you'll notice the flavor difference the first time you use it if you've never had this premium pepper before...

column9: Adds a deeper flavor profile than standard black pepper
column10: This is one of the secret ingredients in KFC's original recipe. It will become your secret recipe in the future!

These were packed in a very thin plasic-y bag, with no insulation between inner and outer packaging. The package arrived smashed with peppercorns leaking out. I am using them, but I hope there was no contamination anywhere along the line.

column9: Just Nothing Better Than Fresh Cracked Pepper!
column10: The title of my review really says it all. These are delicious. I blended them with some white, green, pink, and szechuan peppercorns in my grinder for more of a zesty, peppery taste. All the other peppercorns I purchased came from the same company. I'm still enjoying them, I'm sure you will too!Good Luck!

I ordered the 16 oz. Tellicherry peppercorns and received 14 oz of the peppercorns. Not too big a deal, but where are the other two ounces? False advertising, shortchanged - Is this how they make their profit? Will think twice before ordering anything more from this company.

Not a girly boy pepper like what you find in the grocery store. This has a kick in it and you will taste the pepper.  It has been nearly 30 years since I can remember tasting pepper, it all seems so weak now. Not this, brought back memories of what pepper tastes like.

column9: A real Gold - Gold not Yellow!
column10: This Wilton pearlized gold sugar looks like very pretty real gold. I was a little worried that in person this sugar would look like a yellow, mustardy gold.  It doesn't.  I used it to sprinkle on whipped cream so the color was important to me.  I also used it to rim some champagne glasses before adding Champagne, St. Germaine, A touch of ginger-ale and a smidge of fresh lemon juice.  The drink was of course delicious on it's own, but the gold sugar really took it to another level and made it beautiful and a topic of conversation. Surprisingly, a little goes a long way, so while this was a little expensive with the shipping cost, I'll find many uses for it.

Good tasting Italian dressing - I would say one of the best I've had.  The fact that there are zero calories or carbs is great.  It is almost impossible to find salad dressings with no calories.  Convenient packets that don't need refrigeration.  I keep one in my purse always!

column9: a bit small in size but tastey
column10: Tired of not getting the dressing you want? I am!! this works perfect, keep in wallet or office, car, etc. taste good however not enough in one pouch for a normal side salad, let alone a normal size salad

column9: walden farms, this one is a hit!
column10: I like a lot of walden farms products but not all. This is a really good product. I am sorry my local store doesn't carry it so once again amazon comes to the rescue!

column9: Great Gluten Free option, portable and tasty
column10: One of the difficult parts of dealing with Celiac disease is finding foods to safely eat while on the road.  In general salads are safe (except the croutons), but we have to watch the dressings carefully.  By bringing our own dressing my wife has found she can eat on the road and not get sick.  While the no calorie and fat free options are appealing, the Gluten Free aspect is wonderful for those who must eat Gluten Free. When you have Celiac, it's simple to tell if a food it simply labeled as Gluten Free or if it really is!  If it really is GF and free of cross contamination, my wife doesn't get sick.  This dressing meets all her GF needs along with tasting good.This dressing has a nice consistency, tastes good and is about the right size to put on a Subway or Wendy's salad if you prefer your own dressing.  My wife takes this in her lunches too.  If you don't need the packets, you can save some money by buying a larger bottle and filling a small Tupperware type container to take with you.  You can also modify the portion size by pouring your own.In order of preference, our favorite Walden Farms flavors are:Italian Salad DressingRanch Salad DressingChipotle Ranch Salad DressingAs a Calorie Free, Sugar Free, Gluten Free dressing this is the best Italian dressing we have found.  It has the traditional Italian dressing glavor and a good consistency.  If you don't mind calories, and sugar, a great GF Italian Dressing is from Kens Steak House.  I like using the Kens Italian when marinating (since its good tasting and less cost) and then the Walden Farms for salads since it has less calories.It's amazing that these Walden Farms dressings can taste as good as they do with no calories, no sugar, no gluten, and even no fat!  Not all of the dressings taste great, but this flavor is really good.4 stars as one of my wife's favorite dressings.  Not 5 simply because of the much higher price per serving of the packets.________________________________________
The packets of Gluten Free salad dressing arrived in tip top shape and were all that they were touted to be.  I recommend them!

column9: Walden Farms Italian Salad Dressing Packets
column10: I love these Walden Farms Italan dressing! I was using Kraft Italian Free but this brand is much tastier. It's hard to believe something so good can be calorie free with no sugar! I just wish the packets were easier to open, it says tear here near top but had to use scissors to open, not very handy if you're eating out. I will see if store has bottles insread. Shipping was very fast

This ham had a much different taste than the hams yot purchase in the store. It is not curred the way a store ham is cure with aa injection of solution. This ham is aged. The ham was lean. The taste was a bit salter which I liked but the taste was unfamiliar. Our guessed were not sure as to weather it was something they liked althought my son in law ate with gusto. For a new experience this is some thing worth trying. Research Smithfield Hams on the net.  This will explain what makes the so special.

column9: I must have ordered from " Morton salt" by accident...
column10: inedible, so salty no matter how paper thin it was, 40 guests could not eat it. What a terrible experience.

column4: notAyesperson "Always in search of good books"
column10: I tried one stick of this, and two other flavors.  This salmon is so tough that when you break it in half, if forms razor sharp ends.  It is very very salty and not all that great in my opinion.  I am used to King salmon being very juicy and oily.  I understand this is jerky, but it is to tough to chew.

I've used this rub for years on pork ribs and chops. Rub it on before cooking (no need to rub it ahead of time)and grill away. At a recent dinner party my 85 year old aunt said the babyback ribs were the best she'd ever had. My cooking had a little to do with it, but the rub (and the pig I suppose) were the real stars.

I bought this rub from my butcher, thinking, nyah, I'll try it.  Whoa....I used it on pork chops, country ribs and back ribs as a rub.  Really imparts a flavor to the meat.  Add some smoke and maybe some sauce and you have a winner!Oh.....use it sparingly.  This is not a drench rub!

If you like peanut butter m&ms of course. The delivery was actually quite quick considering it was ordered at Christmas time. Package arrived without a scratch and with no unwanted "excess" charges.The price of the m&ms was great,the only downside was the incredible shipping charge, costing around triple the price of the package itself.

column9: Great buy for peanut butter M&M lovers
column10: This is a great buy for peanut butter M&M lovers.  I would buy this over a 1lb bag any day!  This helps with portion control, because any peanut butter M&M lover can tell you that it is easy to over indulge on these!  The packs will keep you under control, plus it is convenient for when you want to bring them into work or share with others!

M&M Peanut butter are my fav!They are very fresh.  Lots of Peanut Butter that just melts in your mouth!Who does not love m&ms??  Well if you love m&ms and Peanut butter these are for you!  A Crunchy shell and smooth peanut butter in the middle.  Not an over powering peanut butter.  So good you cant just eat a few.  Before you know a bag will be gone!  PURE enjoyment!

I love M & M Peanut Butter treats and since I can never really find it in my area I thought I would buy it from Amazon. Great price for a box of 24 the only gripe I have is that the expiration date is right around the corner - meaning I got to eat these NOW!!! Plus shipping costs are outrageous but I knew that going in. Also I like to eat my candy in a casual setting not in a rushed setting - but we live and learn. I took a two stars away for that reason.

I'm hesitant to write this review because then the rest of you will buy this tea, leaving less for me. I'm a tea junkie and have maybe 20 different flavors that I use...that is, until I found this one. Love it, love it, love it. Please don't buy it...I want it all.

Being a big fan of the full line of Demitris Bloody Mary Seasoning, I thought I would give the Bacon Rimshot a chance. I am a bloody mary enthusiast and on several occasions had gourmet bloody mary's served with bacon crumbles, which I have come to like.Prior to purchasing, I negelected to read the ingredients label... had I realized this product contains MSG, disguised as Autolyzed Yeast Extract, I would have never made the purchase.Since I already had it, I went ahead and decided to at least give it a try.... big mistake! It tastes horrible... nothing like bacon, at all. More like meat tenderizer and cajun seasoning.I highly recommend all of the other Demitris products, this one however, you should leave on the shelf.
My brother who makes mean Bloody Mary's uses this product and I have to tell you it is yummy. I am a long time Bloody Mary drinker and this just upgrades any Bloody Mary you can make.I do recommend.

I've tried all three flavors of Crio Bru and this is my favorite.  I brew it for about 15 minutes in a french press, give it just a touch of sweetener and then enjoy the deep rich dark chocolate flavor.  And it's healthy for me too.  What's not to love?!

I've tried several of these. This stuff makes me excited to drink it. Honestly, I add some coconut milk to it and between the smell and the taste it is heaven. And low to no caffeine. But you still perk up. It's awesome!
good corn flavor,but too much salt, i can only eat a couple of corn chips before my tongue begins to burn. lighten up on  the salt..........

I love this tea. I love the way my cup smells when the tea is gone.  I don't add a thing except hot water.  It's so-o-o beautiful and delicate and delicious!I originally purchased the tin with the little sachets (they're too delicate to be called "bags") through a fundraiser and I FELL IN LOVE!!!!  I had to have more.  Those little sachets are refined and make tea drinking even more elegant than it is... even if I'm drinking it from my pink commuter mug (dedicated to tea drinking, so that no coffee oils can taint it).

This tea is the most fabulous Earl Grey, and with white tea all the rage now for health benefits, no need to feel guilty about adding a little sugar, just make it raw cane/demerrara, because this stuff warrants high quality sugar - and add a slivery slice of Meyer lemon, while you're at it!The delicate mesh "sachets" and metal tin packaging I'd gladly sacrifice for more of the tea, but these are impressive if you're making a gift of the tea, which you definately should, if you know someone who adores Earl Grey they should be grateful!

I purchased these for my chinchillas.  Since they are very small animals I was concerned with chemicals being on the rose hips.  Barry's Farm provides organic Rose Hips and they are crushed to just the right size to offer as treats.  Although the shipping was quite a bit, it can be offset by purchasing more of their fantastic items.  The items arrived quickly and carefully packed and I would highly recommend Barry's Farm products for availability and selection.

I love all varieties Dorset Cereals, which are quite simply the best mueslis I have ever eaten. This mix is no exception. What sets this variety apart is the cranberries, which give the cereal a strong tangy overtone. The cherries and cranberries are relatively small in the ingredient mix but are big on the overall flavor.With 50% total fruits, nuts and seeds, this is a dense, high-flavor muesli with no added sugars. It is not my favorite variety among Dorset Cereals, since I generally prefer nutty mueslis to highly fruity ones. I actually prefer the Simply Delicious variety, which has just 30% fruits, nuts and seeds and a more earthy flavor. But all varieties of Dorset Cereals have a spot on my shopping list, and this one makes for a welcome change of pace.Highly recommended! You can't go wrong with a Dorset Cereals products, and if you prefer a strongly fruity muesli, you will absolutely love this one.

column9: Tasty, healthy, crunchy breakfast cereal. A fave
column10: We regularly have different Dorset Cereals for breakfast and can thoroughly recommend the brand. They make really top-quality muesli and cereals which achieve the difficult trick of being tasty and nutritious. The levels of added sugars and salt are kept to a minimum; Dorset Cereals tend to get their flavour by including high proportions of fruit, nuts and seeds.(A word of caution, however! This does mean that they contain a reasonable level of fats and sugars, but in natural forms rather than processed artificial types. So the calorie count can be quite high, if you are watching your weight BUT this is offset by the low glycaemic impact of the food. Dorset Cereals tend to take quite a while to digest, can be very filling, and leave you feeling satisfied for a long time. You just need to watch the portion size...)This variety is a really tasty one; I adore the more fruity flavours and you can really taste the cranberries and cherries even though there's only a small amount of them in the recipe. The flame raisins are in a lot of Dorset Cereals and add to the overall chewyness and the different types of flakes mean that each spoonful is interestingly varied.This cereal is around 7% fiber, 10% protein and 63% carbohydrate overall. It's naturally quite juicy - unlike some mueslis which can be really dry and dusty - and the fruit makes it very tasty, so you don't get bored by the end of the box.One of our favourite flavours.9/10
Buying cereal online as there is so much choice in the stores? Yes, Dorset cereals are just worth it, and until now I did not find any brand that comes close to them, in quality and taste.

Highly recommend any of the Dorset Cereal products.  My wife loves this one while I prefer the 50% fruit (Cherries and Berries) version.  Any and all are a great way to start your day on a positive and healthy note.  Delicious with Almond or Soy milk.If you are a "Prime{ member - you will be purchasing this cereal below natural food store prices!
I enjoy this product and am happy I found it on Amazon at a fantastic price and get automatic shipments

column9: This HAS to be good for you!!
column10: This is about the nicest, healthiest, nommiest cereal I've ever eaten.  It looks and tastes exactly like what's in it.  Grains, dried fruit.  It's totally NOM.  I bought a box at a local discount store, because I had read about where it's made in National Geographic (Poundsbury), and it looked pretty good.... NOM.  Now I'm on subscribe and save for this and I'm always looking forward to my next shipment.  Amazing with milk or yogurt.

column9: Dorset Super Cranberry Cherry & Almond Cereal
column10: I love this cereal, and I can't get it many places. I mix it with plain yogurt and leave it overnight, and it makes a healthy, guilt-free treat for me. It's great to get free shipping, too.

We had this cereal at a friends' house and we fell in love. Now it is the only cereal at our house.  It has a good balanced of quality grain, seeds and fruit. It is perfect and healthy. It is quite filling too.The price on Amazon is much better than wholefoods, and the shipping is fast. Highly recommend!

SinA ginger candy is a strong flavored chewy ginger candy.  If you like the candied ginger you find from time-to-time in your regular grocery, you will probably like SinA.  If you prefer a milder ginger flavor SinA may be too strong for your liking.I find the 2 ounce box to be a convinient size to carry with me.  The pieces are individually wrapped in foil and dusted in tapioca to reduce the stickness.  Each piece weighs about 6 grams with about 3 grams sugar and 3 grams fiber.  Each box holds about 9 pieces.  There are no peanuts in the ingredients, but SinA is produced in an Indonesian facility that uses peanuts.
I was looking for this product and am glad I could get it here - thank you for the great service.

I was first introduced to this product in New Orleans.  When I cam home to Los Angeles, I couldn't find it in the stores and was so happy to find it.  The product was reasonable, came quickly and it totally yummy.  It also does the trick for me with heartburn and alleviates a scratchy throat.

This was the first green tea I tasted.  Like most Japanese greens, it has a flavor that is usually described as "vegetal."  It smells leafy and earthy, in a good way.  I drink sencha to relax and unwind.Don't oversteep!
I discovered this balsamic glaze at a restaurant in LA.  I bought a bottle, and have been using it ever since.  It is sweet and tangy.  It brings life to so many of my dishes.

this is the rice i've eaten since a child, with every dinner, every holiday; unless we were at a restaurant, we at this, and only this, brand of rice.  my parents moved to NW Florida, where this isn't available. it shipped quickly, and my parents (my dad especially) is thrilled to enjoy this style of rice again...sticky like sushi rice, softer than jasmine rice, and goes with everything you'd use mashed potatoes for (Boton rice and gravy is the BEST!!!!). now i'm 31, partnered, and my partner hasn't eaten mashed potatoes in years, and makes rice before even figuring out what to make for dinner. just like i did, growing up. LOL  5 stars!!

I was unsure of this product until I tasted it at a open house.  It was so good, I was glad I had tried it.  Taking some home, I found it great on crackers, but also with tuna/albacore (it's better than just plain onions), it's good with eggs & meat etc.  It also, makes a great house warming gift. This is one item that you'll say "How could I have ever lived without it!"

column9: This soup is great in SOOO many ways!
column10: This soup is absolutely great! It is fat-free and low in calories (only 180 for the whole can) yet fills you up.  Talk about an efficient way to get your vegetables!  I love the taste although I confess to adding bacon bits and dried onions with a little hot ketchup to spice it up.  So efficient as well.  Two 1/2 minutes in the microwave and you've got a nutritous snack.

The soup has animal products (ORGANIC BUTTER [ORGANIC CREAM FROM MILK]) - not listed in the product description.I am a vegetarian, so I didn't try the soup - and so I have no opinion about how it tastes.  Amazon processed a refund for it - great customer service.I checked the manufacturers web site today and it seems to match the label on the can:Ingredients: FILTERED WATER, ORGANIC BARLEY, ORGANIC PEAS, ORGANIC TOMATOES, ORGANIC CARROTS, ORGANIC CELERY, ORGANIC ONIONS, ORGANIC GREAT NORTHERN BEANS, ORGANIC RICE STARCH, ORGANIC BROCCOLI, ORGANIC TOMATO PASTE, ORGANIC MUSHROOM CONCENTRATE (INCLUDES ORGANIC MUSHROOMS, ORGANIC SOY SAUCE [ORGANIC SOYBEANS], ORGANIC MUSHROOM POWDER, ORGANIC BUTTER [ORGANIC CREAM FROM MILK], ORGANIC MOLASSES, YEAST EXTRACT , ORGANIC POTATO FLOUR, ORGANIC FLAVOR, NATURAL FLAVOR), SALT, ORGANIC EVAPORATED CANE JUICE, ORGANIC VEGETABLE CONCENTRATE, ORGANIC ONION POWDER , NATURAL FLAVOR, ORGANIC SPICES, ORGANIC GARLIC POWDER, ORGANIC LEMON JUICE CONCENTRATE.

column9: Nutrition Facts  Are not as what they say they are.
column10: I gave the soup 2 stars instead of 1 becuse I like the soup, But the Nutrition Facts that they have on it is not what they said they are. I would not have order it if I new, I can buy this cheper out in town.
I love licorice.  This was a very nice selection and the product was very fresh too.  I will buy this again for sure.

Does Salt make that much of a difference?  I wouldn't be able to eat this soup without helping it out:  spices, cheese, mixing it with another soup or etc.  This soup doesn't even have a pea taste to it to me.
A good coffee, but not the real Jamaican Blue Mountain Arabica.  The key word in the name is "style."

column4: Doreen B. Bishop "Doreen Bishop cat parent"
column10: These potatoes are full of good flavor and you can easily eat the skin and all. I put one in the micro for 3 mins. and it makes a whole meal for me. They are perfect for a side dish to any meal and quick to fix.They are real big. I've been buying them for awhile and they have always arrived frozen and in great condition. :)

I thought this was a good enough product, but I prefer sugar free podered creamer for my coffee.  What I ended up using it for was in baking recipes that called for milk.  I had some cool results with that.
I love it!! Delivered in just several days. Product is organic, good quality and I will order again!!

I bought a packet of this from my local Thai market today and was very excited to try it. I grilled some beef, cut it into strips, put the seasoning over it and then added shallots and cilantro and a little lime. It just tasted like slightly spicy lime with ground toasted rice. It didn't have that yummy flavor I'm used to when I get nam tok. Please note: This packet contains MSG.

I stocked up with a case of this when I was in Thailand.  No time to be overly picky but I am very happy with the flavors this adds to thai-style dishes.  Adding in some scallions (finely sliced) and strips of sliced tofu is good stuff.  Mixing in some finely chopped cauliflower and stir frying the beef about half-done prior to adding in the seasoning and water gets some powerful results.Wrap in whole lettuce leaves for a nice treat that only has about 350 calories and 7 total carbs.

column4: A. Ward "Audio addict answering to Alexis."
column10: So far, this syrup has been absolutely amazing. We've received several flavors and have enjoyed each one immensely. We have an embarrassingly large collection of their product.There is no way to explain how good this is, it has a depth of flavor that is impressive.Yes, this sounds like a paid advertisement...but it really is that good!We have the holiday collection, dark chocolate, French vanilla, and the Tiramisu syrup.I'll condense this review to cover all their products since they are ALL top notch.Holiday Collection:(Chai, Cinnamon, Eggnog, Nutmeg, Gingerbread, Pumpkin Spice)The cinnamon is so powerful, you can smell it before the packaging is opened! I think it will make an excellent accent to a cup of coffee, but the flavor is so powerful it might not be a good single flavor with strong coffee. We use Sumatra Mandheling coffee we also bought here that is excellent. ** Coffee Bean Direct Sumatra Mandheling, Whole Bean Coffee, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)The Chai is complex, I don't know if we will use it.Eggnog is very yummy, but we haven't used it yet. I will be working on a recipe to use this. Since our use is mainly as coffee flavoring, it might be less useful than some others. My current evil plan is to make a diabetic friendly eggnog for Christmas season using it, I may post a recipe if I succeed.Nutmeg is a strong flavor no matter what form. Again, it may be an ingredient instead of a main flavor.Pumpkin Spice is excellent, I combined it with chocolate syrup before we got the Amoretti dark chocolate syrup. Odd combination, but everyone loved it.Tiramisu is amazing. A single drop tastes like a whole slice of the dessert. I had some and then drank some water to see what the flavor did. It didn't dilute like sugar syrup does, it simply changed subtly into a more complex flavor. My husband tried it in his coffee and it blended beautifully, but didn't stand out as a flavor so he wasn't kicked on it as a coffee additive.When he isn't drinking the flavoring straight from the bottle and making contented noises, it is a real adventure to play with in coffee.We will be back, regardless of conspicuous consumerism, for some other flavors I want to experiment with. My husband and I may find some blood in our caffeine level by the time I'm done...but there will be some new recipes resulting from my painstaking research. As well as four German Shepherds with corn rows and the spice rack alphabetized. Can you end up duplicating bio-luminescence from too much caffeine?

This syrup has a very rich vanilla taste.  I drink dark roast coffee and it sweetened it quite nicely.  Low in sugar.  I received this as a gift and although I like vanilla, I don't drink it that much, so I shared this with my friend.  She really liked the flavor over another brand that she had been using.

So I had a coupon for Torani syrup and ran to the store to get some. I made my own latte and added the Torani vanilla expecting to replicate my usual drink from a local Starbucks. Um..it tasted bland and like I added sugar at best. Luckily I had ordered this syrup and when it came I was happy to give it a try. I was very excited to see it COMES WITH A PUMP and the vanilla FLAVOR IS AUTHENTIC AND RICH and very very tasty. I only use about half a pump and my drink has great, strong vanilla flavor. Highly recommend.

This is OK for a quick lunch.  It is one of those products that you can keep in a desk drawer if you have a microwave in your break room.  It is not my favorite.  It comes with everything premixed, so you cannot adjust the amount of teriyaki sauce.  The plastic film top was a little difficult to peel off which is not good with a hot meal.  It does leave a spicy aftertaste.  It is listed as having 13 grams of protein but is a little low on fiber with only 2 grams.  It is high on sodium with 930 mg.  It is listed as 270 calories.  It has a shelf life (expiration date) shown.
I'm not a real fan of this particular Hormel Compleat meal.It smells "wrong" after opening and doesn't eat really well.It's edible but that's a stretch.

This product isn't that bad. So far its the only dish from this series from Hormel that I have tried and its pretty good. For my taste it is a little sweet and like another reviewer remarked there is more sauce then needed so adding more rice is not a bad idea. Maybe adding some mixed vegies would be good too. As I tried this for office use that wasn't an option for me. Still, this is not a bad product and the flavor was good and since it does not need refrigeration this is a great product for office, on the road or any other situation where a refrigerator is not an option. I can grab this product, throw it in my backpack and go on with my day.Portion size? Well for me its not bad. Sure, I have days where I could certainly use more but that's why packing an apple, crackers or other snack/side item is a good idea.[My office does have a refrigerator but I work in an office where things sometimes disappear but most of the time its full of who knows what.]
The chicken is very tender, and the sauce has a good taste, but there is WAY too much of it in proportion to the meat and rice.  If you mix it with some additional rice, it's pretty good!

For the convenience of long lasting shelf food, this dishcomes out ahead of the other Hormel Compleats I have triedso far. It packs in a nicely proportioned variety of veges,rice, meat, and sauce, and it might only be too sweet for some.
This is a very easy and tasty microwaveable way for me to get my lunch without having to go to a fast food place.This meal is priced right and allows me the flexibility I need for lunch.

column9: Surprised; good teriyaki flavor for this kind of product
column10: Well I was quite surprised by this.  I gave it a try but really expected it to be inedible.  Actually, considering what it is, it's not bad.  What surprised me the most was that the teriyaki sauce wasn't just the typical overly salty soy sauce that so often passes as "teriyaki sauce" anymore.  This product's sauce isn't overly salty and it captures that subtle citrus flavor that real teriyaki is supposed to have.I've only eaten two of these so far, and each one was rather different in what ingredients were in the mix.  The first one contained quite a lot of crispy nice baby corn chunks, and a fair amount of chicken.  The second one was lacking in pretty much everything but rice; it had about four chunks of chicken in it, and one chunk of baby corn.  Each time, I doctored it anyway (first time with extra chicken, second time with pineapple chunks).  The product is saucy, but not too runny.  The chicken  chunks were reasonably bite-sized and the texture wasn't rubbery or mushy.I view this product as an instant teriyaki rice which I can cook in 1 minute in my microwave and add whatever I happen to have or feel like to it.  I think I will buy the product again for this convenience.

The Hormel Compleats Teriyaki Chicken with Rice (10 oz Microwave Bowl) has the best taste and best vaule of the Hormel prepared meals.  It is my favorite!!!  The convenience to have such a tasty, healthy meal in just a minute is awesome for a busy person like myself on the run all the time.  :) Great job Hormel!!!

As an attempt to control how much I spend (and how much I eat) I've been buying packs of the various flavors of Hormel Compleats so that I have all my work lunches covered for a month.  This is the 6th one of I've tried and by far the best, imho.  Much more flavor than any of the others.
A BIT TOO SWEET, BUT WE ADD A COUPLE OF DROPS OF SOY SAUCE, WHICH OVER COMES THAT. GOOD WITH A CUP OF BLACK COFFEE.

Water Chestnuts, Baby Corn and Ginger for a picture-menu-style (shelf-stable) meal with Rice. With Chicken, Carrots, Red & Green Peppers too. Salty and Teriyaki Sauce brown shelf-stable meal. I bought this for lunch for a change from meat & potatoes Hormel meals available locally.

I love Hormel Compleats. They're all very convenient, since I can stash them in a cabinet in my office and not worry about remembering to bring something from home, or about it getting stolen from the communal refrigerator.The Teriyaki Chicken is quite tasty, if a bit salty. The teriyaki is nicely sweet and savory. The chicken does have a slightly odd texture, almost tofu-like, but still tastes good. I particularly like the chunks of baby corn, which somehow manage to retain their crunch.
Great to have on hand... long shelf life and can be reheated by removing from plastic, placing in foil and heating over gas.....

Hormel has came up with another shelf stable product. Of course to make it last over a year on the shelf it has to have lots of preservitive ingredients. I sampled one and found they are very salty and tastless. I bought these thinking they would sell in my little store (I sell mostly to senior citizens) being convienant for Senior Citizens to prepare a quick dinner. I was wrong. They are still on the shelf, and I will probably wind up trying to get rid of them at a loss or give away.

These things are uniformly awful. Not only is the flavor virtually non-existent, but the amount of salt in them is horrifying. It's so high that it actually tastes like eating a bowl of salt-on-rice.Seriously, look elsewhere. Avoid these meals at all costs.
These are wonderful, fresh almond slices.  How often have you wanted or needed almond slices for a recipe and found you were out?  I love having these available all the time!  Great price too!
Good Price, good product. Put in freezer to keep a supply for cooking, baking, munching.
This product was great for the two pups I purchased it for. Lots of variety in chewies, both the shi tzu and the english bull dog loved them!

I use this food color to make my Red Velvet cake and it makes the cake really deep red which I like.  Since this product is so red I only need to use almost half the amount the recipe calls for.  I have other food colors of the same brand for my airbrush and other coloring...great products and I am very happy.
Big 13.5 ounce bottle of red gel color. I have not tasted product, but I've checked the color in a dilute and it is very strong. If I have any taste problems, I'll be back with an update.
A must have fir getting a deep red color in your icing, fondant and food with this gel, works great for getting deep red color, I am really happy with this product!

Americolor Super Red really does live up to the hype. It's excellent for developing a rich red color in my royal icing without diluting it. One warning, though! If you are using this to color royal icing, once the color dries it is several shades darker than it was when first mixed! Don't add too much red or you'll end up with a dark, bloody color when dried. (If that's what you're going for, though, then have at it!) :)

This color came with a short lived expiration date. . could be the nature of the product, not sure, and it had a chemical taste when used in baking goods, again, could be nature of the product.  I wont' be using it in my Red Velvet Cakes, I threw the bottle out.

I do a lot of baking and one of the favorites at work (where all my goodies go...) is Red Velvet Cake.  Buying this large bottle is a great way to save.  I have used it over and over again and  because I am not limited to the small amount that comes in the bottles from the grocery store, I can use as little or as much as I like.  I like my Red Velvet RED ! I will be purchasing more when I run out...but that will not be for some time to come.

These are a wonderful treat... especially if you set them over a cup of tea and let the steam warm and melt the caramel between the buttery, cinnamon laced waffle cookies. Definitely a rich indulgence.

I bought these for my golden retriever to try.  He just loves these treats...he could eat the whole bag if I didn't limit them.  I am hoping with the chicken and rice they are healthy for him.  If your dog likes treats, try these...he'll drop other treats if he sees these coming out.

I purchase these small treat balls as a quick reward for a good girl treat.  They are small and easy to carry in a pocket.  I use them mostly as a reward when out walking with Misty.  I have a small dog so these are just the right size for us.

I have two dogs with digestive problems and they need a treat that can be eaten without causing their systems to get upset.  This is one of only two products available that meets their needs.  No stool problems!  In addition, these 100% real chicken treats are small enough not to have to break apart for dogs on a restricted calorie count.  One treat will do it.  Lastly, since they are round they don't break apart into sharp pieces while the dogs are chewing them.  It is dangerous for a dog to try to swallow a hard, sharp piece of food!  This was a major problem even with my large dog and the flat 100% chicken treats on the market.  This is a great product!

column9: Tasty Treats for my little puppies
column10: My puppies (5 months old) absolutely LOVE these.  They play with them for a little and chew chew chew!!! And being that the ingredients are chicken breast and rice only (no sugar or other fillers) I feel comfortable letting them enjoy it.

column9: My dog knows these by name and RUNS for the treat jar
column10: I've named these "chicken balls" and my Puggle is fully aware of what I mean when I utter those words. She RUNS to her treat jar and pokes at it with her nose with reckless impatience as I hurry along behind her. I love that they're simple with no additives, just dehydrated chicken and rice. They smell just like chicken and rice if you put them right up to your nose. So they're inoffensive for those with sensitive noses. They're bite size and super crunchy. These may be too large or too hard for Shih Tzu and smaller dogs. I say this because when I babysit an adult Shih Tzu, she attempts to eat it but can't. I've broken them into smaller pieces for her and she'll eat them. These do not stain the teeth like those other chewy treats with color additives. They're safe to keep at room temperature and they keep for a very long time since they're dehydrated, although they never last more than a couple of weeks in my house!I highly recommend them.
Jacobsen's Snack Toast is perfect for breakfast or a snack with a little cream cheese or soft spread cheese.  It's crisp, light and only 40 calories per piece!  Delicious!
Excellent product.  We have purchased it before in the supermarket.  But we are unable to locate it again.  We are pleased to know it isnow available on Amazon.com

So happy I stumbled across these awesome, 40 calorie toast snacks.  I've only tried the cinnamon raisin variety, but I'm sure they are all good. I spread some 1/3 fat free Philadelphia strawberry cream cheese on the toast. It makes a delicious low-calorie snack. I bought 6 boxes in Florida to bring home to New Jersey because I can't find them here. So happy I found them on Amazon!!!

I found these nylabone healthy edibles were not up to the standard I am used to when purchasing from other companies.  Many of them were crumbling in the packages when I opened them. They were usable and my dog didn't complain but I don't think I will order more from this company.

I love this product. Finally as a person with a milk allergy I can make all the chicken cream of chicken recipes in magazines. Its good by itself and as a homemade soup base whenever a recipe calls for cream of anything. It is incredibly hard to find and I used to special order it at a health food store which has closed. Am I buying this product. No. Over 40 dollars for shipping! No way.
I have ordered this twice, and I am coming back for more. Simply the BEST!!!
This by all means is the best ham i have ever tasted  and i will never buy any other ham but burgers. All my family and friends are hooked on burgers hams also. Try it I know you will love it to.

I ordered on of these as a sample from a large department store.  It was amazing.  These are moist, full of flavor and very satisfying.  I tried the Banana Walnut - and tried it straight from the package.With a big glass of milk and maybe 10-15 seconds in the microwave, it would have been heavenly.  Have not tried the Cinnamon Roll flavor - but I'm trying.  Our local grocery store never has these in stock - they seem to sell out quickly - so grab some quick!  You won't be sorry.

I sampled these bars at my local Super Target, and they were delicious.  I picked up a couple boxes because I like to have a nutritious snack around the house to tie me over between lunch and dinner.  These bars taste great - better than the Fiber One bars (I still buy the Chocolate Fiber One bars because they are good tasting as well).  These bars are a pleasant surprise - much more substance than a Nutri-Grain bar.  Anyone looking for a good snack bar, or even a quick breakfast bar should check these out (note, when I wrote this the Amazon price through a third-party was $6/box - I bought mine at Target for $2.49/box...might want to look local for a while on these).

These things taste good!  I eat one or two for breakfast almost every day.  Microwave it 10 seconds like the box suggests - It is like having a fresh pastry for breakfast.But these are good for you, too.  I have to monitor my fiber and protein intake to keep them both high enough.  Two bars give me 10 grams of fiber [1/3 the total I need for the day], and 12 grams of protein [18% of the total].  I used to have to eat a lot of AllBran - a good way to get the fiber I need, but the taste gets to be like bland cardboard after awhile.  These bars taste good!  The added protein is a real boost.On the other hand, if you have a Target store nearby, check their shelves.  I have been getting mine for only a little more than half what this outlet charges.

After I'd purchased them once at the grocery store, our 12-year-old son kept asking me to get them again. Unfortunately, I could no longer find them anywhere in town. Thank goodness for Amazon! When the shipment came, my husband and 14-year-old son wanted to try them, too, and they both raved about them. They're not quite my cup of tea (I actually haven't tried them, because I'm afraid I'd be wishing I were eating homemade banana bread instead) - but everyone else loves them. And I hear they're particularly good after 15 seconds in the microwave!

Ajipon citrus flavored soy sauce by Matsukan is by far the best soy sauce I have ever tasted. It goes with everything! Works good as a marinade too.It sure beats regular old boring soy sauce. I'm so glad that I found this stuff again (my local grocery store used to carry it, but discontinued it some years ago)!!
If you like the taste of tart cherries you will love this!  It is absolutely delectable.  It is not the standard taste of juice, but tastes just like tart cherries.

This is my favorite cherry juice. First, I chose it because it's made with cherries picked locally to my home. Next, I discovered there are alleged anti-inflammatory benefits. (Personally, I have experienced this; however, I'm not a doctor and can't say it would work for others). Lastly, I tried others and why I keep coming back to Cheribundi Tru Cherry is two-fold: this brand is made entirely of cherries/not from concentrate AND tastes FANTASTIC. Other brands cannot come close.

column9: it like a Tart Cherry pie in a glass
column10: If you are a cherry or cherry pie love, this is the best juice you can find. It taste like fresh tart cherries off the tree, but in liquid form. I have given bottle to coworkers and they love it! It a little addictive!

Should preface this by saying that I find tart cherry juice fairly revolting in general, but it's a necessary evil for me as it's one of the few things that REALLY helps my gout. I bought this juice to both help my flare ups as well as help me MAINTAIN a healthy diet which will prevent future flare ups. That's the hard part for me because you don't really think about it until you have a flare up, and by then it's too late because there is no immediate relief...at best you start to feel better in a day or two. But that is SO much better than a week or two or more.So, if you suffer from gout, I would highly recommend making tart cherry juice (some people also say black cherry juice works as well but that's even worse than tart for me so...) a part of your regular health regimen. I intend to drink constantly during a flare up, and then a serving every other day or so to maintain. It's a lot of trial and error to find a system that works for you and it varies from person to person. So keep at it.That being said, I've tried many juices and while I don't "like" any of them, Cheribundi is FAR AND AWAY the best I've tried, and the fact that it comes in 8 oz bottles makes grabbing and going much easier, which is going to let me remember to drink it more. It's more convenient to grab the small bottle than pour in a cup, or make your own drink from juice extract (if this isn't a concern for you, I'd recommend purchasing the 3 32 oz bottles as they're slightly cheaper for the same amount, I'm paying the extra bit for convenience). This product is going to be a regular purchase for me and I will recommend it to anyone with similar problems.

This is produced near my home so I've always wanted to try it... but it is pricey. About $2/bottle locally. I bought a four pack and fell in love with it, so I came on here to see if it was cheaper. It is about 20% cheaper... totally worth it to me. I have no idea about the anti inflammatory benefits or anything, but I like the taste, that it contains 50 cherries per bottle (!), and that all the cherries come from NY and MI. Pretty cool.

I am always looking for a good "pick me up" as I am trying to cut down on my caffine intake.  Cheribundi does just that.  I find it most helpful after a workout or my 5 mile run.  The taste combines a little sweetness with a tart aftertaste.  A little pricy, otherwise a great pure juice drink.

column9: love this and it worked for me.
column10: Bought this juice at a store.  Painful arthritis and joint discomfort.  Tried tylenol and my usual arthritis meds for some reason - neither were working that day.  Drank a 8 oz bottle and started feeling the results that afternoon.  Love this stuff!!  Give it a try.

Who knew? I probably didn't read the description well enough or they cleverly deceived me. Either way, this is part apple juice and I didn't realize that when I ordered it. It is still a good product, but a tad expensive for a blend. There are products out there that are "just" cherry.

This pasta has a great texture and doesn't fall apart like so many other non-wheat pastas.  The flavor is so good that it doesn't need to be drowned in sauce to make it edible.  I would highly recommend this pasta to anyone who cannot or doesn't want, to eat wheat products.
Going gluten free, I was looking for pasta I could eat. This pasta is absolutely wonderful! I love that I can purchase it through Amazon.com with free shipping and no taxes.  HOORAY!

After being diagnosed with Celiac, I tried many, many brands of pasta. They were all a disappointment. Grainy, squishy, and if they even got slightly cool they'd harden up. Or they'd just fall apart in the pot if they weren't carefully watched.Then an online friend recommended Tinkyada.I bought a package. Just one. I figured it couldn't hurt to try it. My non GF'ers in the house couldn't even tell the difference from their regular veggie dyed pasta. The taste, texture, and ability to be al dente unlike most other GF pasta's makes this pasta the King of All GF Pasta's in my house. We've tried all the various pasta's that Tinkyada makes by this point and not a single one has disappointed us.The ONLY con to this pasta is if you don't use it all at once, and refrigerate it for later. It tends to get stiff and grainy feeling. However, my 15 yo GF daughter microwaves the pasta for a couple minutes with about a TB of water and then puts them in a microwave safe dish to take to school for lunch. Just those few minutes with some extra water fixes the issue no problems.All in all, I definitely recommend this pasta to anyone struggling with a gluten-free diet. This pasta absolutely replaces all gluten containing pasta's, especially with how very many varieties Tinkyada makes! No more feeling sorry for yourself or your child with yucky pasta.

These veggie spirals make pasta dishes less boring and a little different. At first when I opened the package it smelled strongly of spinach but when the pasta was cooked the other flavors came out and the spinach flavor was toned down. It was very yummy and a healthy alternative. My kids thought the colors were cool and ate it up.

I use Tinkyada spirals the most when making our weekly pasta dinner, they're just so much fun. These work great for pasta dinners or cold pasta salads with lots of veggies and feta.Tinkyada products hold up perfectly to cooking and aren't soggy and mealy like the other gluten free brands out there. This is worth buying and you won't be sorry!

column9: This one really IS like regular pasta
column10: Tinkyada Organic Brown Rice Lasagne, 10-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)They're always telling us that this recipe or that product is just like the wheat flour counterpart.  And it's hardly ever true.But Tinkyada's pasta is almost as good as the best regular pasta.  I prefer the shapes that provide the most surface area, like the spirals, because they are easier to cook "al dente."  Boil it in a big pot of water and stir frequently at the start to keep them from sticking to each other.  (No oil needed in the water.)

My daughter loves escargot, but didn't have the shells to put them in....I went to Amazon & found them for her. She was so happy to receive them...Thanks Amazon again for having what I look for........

Thsi tea is wonderful!! It is my favorite tea of all. It is so fresh and flavorfull tasting!! If I could give it 10 stars, I would! I especially enjoy making this tea and serving it my little girl during her tea parties.

Purchased this tea as a Christmas gift and the recipient enjoys it very much. She said it's very light, which she prefers, since other teas can be too "in your face". She will be purchasing other teas by Octavia in the future.
This is the best tea I have ever tasted in my life!  It is so delicate yet so flavorful.  I have not bothered to drink any other tea in 2 years.
Our three love the meat, and lick the plate if the potatoes & peas are mashed. Otherwise, the vegies stay high & dry.

I have 5 cats and rarely do all 5 love a food. They love this one. Having studied holistic animal nutrition I know what is in pet food and Addiction is a good food. Not all the crap thrown in that others put in food. The Salmon is a favorite amongst all 5 of my cats. Clean bowls are the sign that they all love this one.
What can I say, he's a very finicky eater.  He's stuck on one kind of cat food and it isn't in this line.
Thought this was good for $9.99 price for a door prize at a tea I hosted.. but would not want to pay more than that for item.
My dogs gobble this up every time!  It is a perfect size for feeding with dry food, so none ends up with a cover on it and in the fridge.They like it so much it is on autoship!

Our German Shepherd and Golden Retriever love Mighty Dog.I served it to my other German Shepherd for 13 years andfor several years for the Shepherd before her. I don'tthink you can go wrong with this product, they reallylove the pulled beef and pulled pork too! Would recommend.

Our medium-fussy, senior dog will not eat beef (unless it's off our plates) but our puppy (who is HUGE) seems to enjoy these two flavors, and is never reluctant to eat when we give them to him. We've only started feeding the dogs Mighty Dog within the past six months, and are satisfied with the product, since there are plenty of choices and we have found three varieties that our senior will eat.Our vet always asks what we're feeding the dogs, and when I reported "Mighty Dog and Little Champions," he didn't give the standard lecture about sub-standard dog food. We did, however, get the standard lecture about tooth-brushing...

My dog can be a picky eater and she loves this stuff.  Actually the cats do, too, so if the dog doesn't get to her bowl in a timely manner it is fair game for the cats.  At any rate, I also feed her Harmony Farms dry dog food, and together they are helping my dog to maintain her youthful figure!  Her coat looks glossy and healthy.  She is a happy dog!I am a happy owner, too, because the convenience and savings from ordering from Amazon are wonderful.  These cans are single servings so there is virtually no clean up involved.

I have a little Shih Tzu, and he really likes the Mighty Dog 2-flavor variety.  He won't eat any other flavors or brands, so it is great to be able to purchase this item on Amazon.com, as it is getting more and more difficult to find.

column9: Great packaging, great price, Dog LOVES it!
column10: Great packaging, that is easy to store and doesn't take much shelf room. Small tins that are packed full of food, great supplement or replacement to the kibbles and the dog loves it!

I've had 4 German Shepherds and bought into the expensive dog foods when they werepuppies, however once they were about 12 months switched over to Purina productsand my recipe was Purina dry dog food (Beneful) and one can of mighty dog andBoy Oh Boy !  my dogs thrived on that !  Once in awhile as a treat I'd cut upa plain baked potato and they devoured that !
I run a ranch and we have 2 dogs. They're pretty spoiled. They love the dogfood and I love the convenience of having it delivered.

I am so pleased with my Mighty Dog 24 pack dog food varieties.  It was so easy to find the type and size and variety I wanted for my pets without having to leave the house.  Knowing the selections I wanted were available really made it a pleasurable shopping experience.  I love the shipping options offered too.

column9: Dog loved it for a a while
column10: My terrier loved the food at first but i think she got tired of it so we just buy her dry food now.

column9: JUST LIKE HONEYCUP.. and look at the price difference!!!
column10: Found 6 EIGHT OUNCE JARS of Honeycup online for $42.40....  This tastes just like it... 6 THIRTEEN OUNCE for a little over 14.00??? No Brainer.I love this stuff.  Has been tough to find in our area.  RE: review that said "Maybe the honey had spoiled."  Do some research.  It's the only food that will NEVER spoil. Found in the pyramids and still edible.  Uh, maybe that was the taste of the Mustard?
this product has a weird after taste i wonder if the honey has spoiled. wish i could have brought one bottle
delish!  perfect for our mexican meal nights, my whole family really enjoys the taste.  Very happy with it! Love that it's organic, most importantly!

I purchased this based on it's 5 star review from 1 reviewer.  It is bland in taste, pasty in texture.  Prehaps with some coddling (spices, olive oil) it may improve.  In its current state I would pass.
These beans are really wonderful.  They are not too salty and have just an all around great taste.  And they are organic!

column9: High quality cat food that really looks like food
column10: This looks like real food! The chicken is actual chicken shreds, not some amorphous grey paste. The other TikiCat varieties are similar - the fish looks like fish, you can see pieces of leafy greens, etc.My cats love this. They also love the salmon, chicken+salmon, ahi tuna, and all the "tuna on rice with ___" varieties. I calculated the % calories from protein (vs. from fat/carbs), because I'm looking for the cat food that has the highest %cals from protein. Of the five TikiCat varieties I checked out, Hawaiian grill has the highest %cal from protein, followed by Napili Luau and PukaPuka Luau. The "tuna on rice with __" do have some carbs, since they have rice in them, but I still feed them to my cats every now and then for variety (and because they're less expensive!). My cats love all the TikiCat varieties I've given them, and I feel comfortable feeding this brand of cat food to my cats, since I can see what it's made of, there's no weirdness on the ingredients panel, and everything I've heard about the company (Petropics) makes it sound like they're really environmentally conscious.GreenLittleCat did a review of TikiCat, including a picture of what's inside the can. They also did a "natural cat food showdown" where they compared a bunch of natural cat food companies' environmental practices, and TikiCat won! Google them, since I feel uncomfortable linking to an outside site. (I have no affiliation with GreenLittleCat)

Tiki Cat is the only brand of canned cat food that my cat actually seems to enjoy.  I started with the variety pack and she went crazy for every variety but the ones that have sardines.  Most Tiki Cat flavors are tuna based, and I wanted to add try this salmon and chicken flavor for variety.  It was a bit of a risk ordering a 12 pack of food that my cat has never tried, but she just had her first can today and she LOVES it!  I opened the can and it looks like home cooked chicken and salmon.  Smells great!  Very high quality food and I feel good about the company that makes it, Petropics.  I will definitely continue to buy this flavor.

This stuff is amazing.  my cat goes crazy for it.  Ive been giving her this for 4 months now and she is more playful, energetic, and her coat has gotten dramatically softer.  If you love your cat you need to get this food pronto!

When I unpack the TIKI Wild Salmon and Chicken when it arrives from Amazon, my cats know by the blue lable that it is their favorite food. There are four of the critters. I cannot seem to umpack it when they are asleep or playing. As soon as they hear me open an Amazon box, they run to see what "WE" got. If it is the BLUE TIKI CAN, they start right away with the, PLEASE, MOMMIE, PLEASE....OH, PLEASE...MEOW!I have never seen anything to equal their degree of anticipation when this TIKI arrives...SO...of course they get some RIGHT AWAY.This particular flavor is different from the others in that it is in shreds of, what looks to be, white meat of chicken. Then there are flakes of Salmon throughout these threads of chicken. If you are thinking shreds, as in that awful Friskies stuff, then forget it. More appropriately, these would be described as Threads...like a thin string. And they are not cut into small pieces parts of threads. It looks like Spagetti has looped itself around and around the cat food can. Actually, it looks pretty tasty. The kitties certainly think so!!!!!!!There is NO FISHY ODOR. Honest. Sounds like we are discussing people food. But, truly, no yuccky odor. Looks for all the world like I have opened a can of chicken, but for some reason it has been packed in threads instead of chunks.The kids like the other flavors OK. Sardines better than the rest. But they can take them or leave them. But with this stuff, they are begging to eat. Instead of putting a can in a small bowl as I usually do, I get a larger bowl and fill it with two cans of this TIKI treat. Then all four get some and they line up and behave politely knowing from experience that there is plenty for all.This is a bit pricey, but since there are never any left overs, or turned up noses, it makes up for the cost. I plan to give them a try at the plain Chicken next. They do not have this all the time, but when they do, it is a PLEASE, MOMMIE, PLEASE world. Which is a wonderful thing to a cat owner's ears.I and the kitties really, really are happy with this and suggest you try it too. But do not use it all. Leave some for those who gave you this great news!!!  Happy cat keeping to all of you.

I couldn't believe this food when I opened my first can.  It actually looks like real food!  Shredded chicken and white salmon...unbelievable.  No fillers, only good food.  Expensive, but very good and my cats agree.

column9: Enthusiastic Endorsement from the Cat Family
column10: I did a 3-star review on the mixed Tiki package because the cutlets freaked out the fussy cats (and me), but an enthusiastic 5-stars from one and all on the salmon and chicken mix! Even those dedicated dry food eaters (I'm trying to convert them to wet food) loved this one. Shredded chicken and salmon in an apparently very tasty juice. Looks good. Smells moderately strong but clean and unspoiled. Eaten with great joy by the cat family. Best of all: Dolphin-safe chicken!

This is a very tasty product and was well worth trying.  As with many fresh meat and produce purchases it is pretty expensive compared to buying locally, but at the same time for someone living alone like I do, to have something like a corned beef roast pre-cooked and sliced into 12 ounce trays is a time saver.  This to me tastes as good as cooking a brisket at home, and I don't end up with a large amount of meat that I probably don't end up eating even as left overs.  When I am in the mood for corned beef, either as part of my main meal or since this is sliced for sandwiches, I can just microwave this.  12 ounces is more then enough for one person at a time.

column9: Mexene Chili Powder is the best
column10: Short of making your own chili powder with fresh organic ingredients, Mexene is one of the best chili powders you will find.  If you are used to using the lame mega-corporate chili powders commonly found at the grocery stores, you will be amazed at the difference.You will save a lot of money if you can find Mexene in a store; unfortunately, it is tough to find. Recently found some at Kroger; 3.39 for a 3 ounce jar.
If you're making chili and want to make it a hit, use this powder.Or, better yet, follow Mexine's recipe. Beans are optional.  You can use anything you like in place of beans.It is a great recipe.

column9: TOP RATING FOR THIS CHILI POWDER
column10: Some chili cook-off recipe winners advocate using Mexene Chili Powder, so I bought a supply. This gives a fresh and pungent flavor to all the chili I have since made. Of course it's hard to analyse how much better it is the next day, because there have not been any leftovers. I think it truly is a wonderful "secret" ingredient.
good stuff， good price， good service. i will buy the product again.The whole process is smooth and fast. No extra time to waste. The package is careful.
I love these drinks. Thy really are nice on a hot day. I love to make a smoothie with them just add ice and a blender. Thy are a must in my house.

I too was only familiar with Maynards wine gums before buying these and was a bit wary of trying a potentially inferior wine gum.  These wine gums taste great and come in a bunch of individual boxes that you can open up gradually to keep them fresh.

I enjoyed these wine gums, but I prefer the Maynards brand.  The Norfolk Manor wine gums taste more like fruit-snacks both in their consistency (more soft and less chewy than Maynards) and in terms of their taste (flavor is more fruity and less winey, compared to Maynards).I will stick with Maynards.

column9: Alright, but you can buy better.
column10: The texture of these wine gums is okay, chewy like good wine gums ought to be. Unfortunately, the flavor of these wine gums really fall short. While the box claims "natural and artificial flavors," all I could taste was the artificial flavorings, and weak ones at that! At one point all the flavors seem to taste the same - just sweet but bland.While these are cheap, you do get just what you pay for. I'd say go for the Gustaf's wine gums instead, or just go ahead and splurge on Maynard's or Bassett's.
I USE TO THINK MAYNARDS WINE GUMS WERE THE BEST; BUT I MUST SAY THESE ARE BETTER!!!!!!!!!!!!!

column9: Not as good as Gustafs or Maynards
column10: I would rate these as acceptable but we preferred Maynards over Gustafs and Gustafs over these.  These are gluten free.  I wonder if gluten makes the difference.
The best candy ever!!!!  Share with a friend of mine who's American, & he loves them.  Eats a box in a couple of hours!!!

I was supposed to get 12 boxes of wine gums but only received 1.  I sent an e- mail to Amazon and they said that they would replace the order.  3 days later I received another single box of candy. I called on the phone next and spoke to a customer service representative who assured me that all 12 packs were in the single 8 ounce box.  I finally gave up and ordered my wine gums from E bay. The candy was fine but I never received the full order.  I am happy to say that this the only problem that I have ever had with Amazon.

These chips taste even better than non-gluten free bagel chips.  I couldn't believe I went through a box in no time at all (Scary!).  Unfortunately, Amazon's price of this writing, six bucks a box, is beyond crazy!  The boxes aren't very big to begin with!  I paid about four bucks at my local grocery store, and I've seen them on sale for less than three, so shop around!
I love the chips.....it is refreshing to get tasty gluten free products especially at the high prices GF products demand.

These are the closest thing to "real" food I can find gluten-free so far. They taste just like regular bagel chips and are versitile.  I use them in place of chips and crackers.  Only problem I have is my local grocery does not restock them often, so I'm left ordering in bulk.  Online sites all seems to run close to Amazon's price, though here it's a dollar or so cheaper.  The grocery store is less, but they are tough for me to get.

I'm very disapointed by this product, I thought it would be the same quality as JFC Norimaki Arare, 5-Ounce but it is not. Also some of the crackers are spicy and I cannot eat anything spicy, I would have appreciated if they warned of spiciness in the description or title!

column9: Neighbor, how long has it been?
column10: Let's just get this out of the way right up front.  You don't tug on Superman's cape.  You don't spit into the wind.  You don't pull the mask off the ol' Lone Ranger and you don't mess around with other brands of chili, Jim!Wolf Brand chili is head and shoulders above all other brands of canned chili and that's a fact.  If you do not want to become addicted to it and forget that any other variety exists then don't try it.  You can nitpick the ingredients, the regional availability and/or the price if you want but at the end of the day, you are just not going to find another ready to eat chili from a store shelf that is this delicious.Also, remember that it's just NOT Peggy's world famous Frito Pie without the Wolf Brand! Stock up!

column9: The BEST Canned Chili in the WORLD
column10: We were fortunate enough many years ago to spend a year in Texas which is where we discovered Wolf Brand Chili.  Throughout our many moves over the years, which have been coast to coast literally from Florida to Alaska, we have sought out Wolf Brand Chili and frequently have ordered it when it was not locally available.  I just want to be really clear THIS IS THE BEST CANNED CHILI IN THE ENTIRE WORLD, no I am SERIOUS.  Really no kidding this is not greasy or nasty or made with cheap garbage instead its got a full yummy flavor.  There are flavors for everyone our family eats 3 different flavors, I eat the beanless my husband favors the one with beans although I try to limit that, and our kids like the hot/spicy one, with rice, with cracks its quick its awesome.  We cant get it where we live now so we order it from Amazon.One more time just in case there was maybe a bit of confusion THIS IS THE BEST CANNED CHILI IN THE ENTIRE WORLD!  at least what is sold in the US)

column9: I'll be buying another case of it.
column10: Wolf  Chili with Beans, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)I like this product, and I'll continue to buy it, unless and until I find something better. Having said that, I'm not quite satisfied with it in one respect: its hotness, or lack thereof. I like my chili hot, and this chile fails in that department. Unfortunately, I'm not a cook, and my attempts to "spice it up" have not yet worked, but I'll keep trying. So far I've tried powdered chili, and ground-up fresh jalapeno chile, but I didn't like the results. I know that there must be some percentage of some kind of additional hotness that will make it perfect, but I haven't found it yet. Something to look forward to.One more thought on my personal "hotness" meter. At one point I did read the label to make sure that it contained chile. I really hadn't been sure about that, but it does.

column9: Greasy, OK, but not the stellar chili I expected
column10: The flavor is OK, but this chili is very greasy tasting and Ok at best.  I like the Campbell's Roadhouse and Firehouse line much better.  Taste is very subjective, of course, but I do not see this as the stellar chili others are claiming it to be.  My 2 cents and feel free to disagree.  It does grow on you and I liked it better as I ate it over time, but I would not buy it again.  My kids liked it fine, though.

column9: Damaged deliveries;  chili soup.  UPDATED REVIEW
column10: I've previously had this on Subscribe & Save (last year) but the next time I went to order it had been dropped from S&S.  Recently noticed that it was back on S&S again and decided to order it.  I received the order fairly quickly and as usual some cans were damaged. To the point that at least one of them I will not be able to open.  Amazon MUST do something about the way they package this stuff.  I discovered another disconcerting thing.  What I received in the can I would not call Chili, but maybe Chili Soup.  Unlike all of the Wolf Brand Chili I have ever had in the past this product poured out of the can.  In the past I would have to spoon out the chili and beans to get it out of the can.  Wolf Brand has reduced the meat and beans and is using more water.  WB's quality has diminished.UPDATED:Since unloading the case I have discovered that every single can is dented, some worse than others, a couple likely beyond opening.  I also wonder if the contents would be safe to eat.  The drop in quality of the product is bad enough but the state of the delivery is unacceptable. I'll be contacting Amazon about this.  They shouldn't sell canned goods if they can't deliver them properly.  Buyer beware!
I have loved Wolf Brand Chili since I was little.  I order it on-line because I can't find it in Florida.  I love it and can't eat hotdogs without it.

column9: Best canned chili with spicy flavor!
column10: I love chili, preferably with beans, since that is the way I grew up.  I crumble a half a sleeve of crackers in it, and I can not get enough of it.  I have tried all the manufactured cans of chili, and this manufacture is the king of canned chili, Wolf  brand chili!
Another Tex-Mex item that has no substitute. We bugged our Minnesota Target store about it until they started carrying it. It's great!!

For this Texan living many years in NYC, good canned chili is a necessity when I don't have time to make my own. The national brands have been blanded down too much. Wolf's -- made in Texas bit not available in supermarkets in NYC --  is one of the very few which doesn't need to have additional chili powder to be hot enough.  I'm glad to be able to get it thru Amazon at a reasonable price with free postage.

I bought this Wolf Chili with Beans after reading several of the reviews.  I am so glad that I did.  This is good chili.  My husband and I have slathered it over tamales and spaghetti and corn chips.  The possibilities are endless.  We thought that Hormel Chili was the best.  Turns out that we prefer the Wolf Chili with Beans.  We are keeping this item on our shelves and will continue order this fine chili.
