I have been an addict on Steak n Shake chilli all my life. I even found a clone home made receipe for Steak n Shake chilli on the net.. It was good but just not the same as the real deal. Then I found Wolfbrand in Krogers next to Steak n Shake chilli. It was $1.79 for a 15oz can and the Steak N Shake chilli was $3.59 for a 15oz can. In my brain, someone somewhere told me to try it but havent seen it in my area anywhere.After consuming and comparing both Steak N Shake and Wolfbrand I can say Wolfbrand tastes almost exactly like Steak N Shake chilli. I say almost tastes the same is because Steak N Shake has cumin in it. Otherwise exactly the same. I add some cumin to the Wolfbrand when I prepair it and there you go. Awesume stuff. Now the price at Amazon on Wolfbrand chilli ends up being $2.12 a 15oz can if you get 24 cans @ $50.95. So if you could save  $1.80 a can if you shop around. I give this Wolfbrand product a 5 star.

column9: Way too hot for the average person
column10: i wish someone here in their review would have told me that this is HOT chili.  i'm sure there are plenty who like it that way....but i am not one of them.  not saying its bad chili.....just know that it is HOT!!!
Wolf Chili is the best canned chili you can buy.  It works with hot-dogs, noddles, rice or just in a cup for lunch.  I would recommend this product to anyone...

column9: Best canned chili I have found
column10: I have never rated anything on Amazon before, but I was very impressed by this chili.  I have tried many different canned chilies and have found most of them are like a bland bean soup.  My favorite before trying Wolf's was Amy's vegetarian (and I am NOT a vegetarian) just because it had some flavor.  You can't get any better chili unless you make it yourself.

I bought an entire freaking CASE of this based on my memories and to show my hubby how "totally awesome" it was.... ugh!!!!! big mistake. Don't get me wrong, this is good canned chili. It's basically like most good canned chilies.... good and straight from a can. Don't get wrapped up in memories of the first time you ate it with an ex-boyfriend who told you it was the best ever because it's not AND don't ever brag to the heavens to your hubby that it's the BEST because you will be taken down a few notches like I was.Yes, I admit, what was I thinking or drinking when I decided WOLF was best ever because it's just like the rest.:(It's just like me... wah!

My case of Wolf chili arrived yesterday. Lets start with that. HEY AMAZON, whoever works in your shipping department should be fired. This case of chili was in a box about 8 inches larger than the case itself, no problem there. But only 1 piece of brown packing paper was used, and it was placed on top of the chili. There was no packing around the sides of the case, so this chili was sliding around in this box and tearing the box up. A few of the cans were dented, but no problem there. I worked in shipping and receiving before, and if anything was packed in this manner, it would be totally unacceptable. I am surprised UPS even accepted the package the way the case was sliding around in the box. Ok, enough of that. On to the chili itself.I bought this because I had read so many reviews about how Wolf chili is supposed to be the best. Well, I gotta say that it doesnt even come close to the best. First of all, open the can and pour it into the pot. Thats right, pour. The consistency of this chili is almost like soup. Any other can of chili you would either have to shake vigorously out of the can or spoon it out, but this stuff just pours out. And I think there was beef in it, but it must have been ground up so small that it was hardly noticable, again, adding to that watery consistency.As for the taste, well, it aint bad, but again, nowhere near the best. But the consistency of the chili and the taste combined? Makes you wonder how anyone can rave about this stuff. 4/10 at best, and thats being kind.If you want the best, I would go with Stagg. Many different flavors and a much higher quality, and better consistency.

I was raised and lived in Texas for more than 40 years. Wolf brand chili was by far the most popular canned chili. Tastes so close to home made. It is not available in Nevada where I now live so when I saw it for sale on Amazon, I bought a case. I am so glad to have a source for it now.

Bought a case after seeing the many great reviews of this chili....to me it's average at best. It's very pasty, with no real definition of meat, beans, or tomatoes. Almost pureed, like Hormel's chili....I will say I like it on hot dogs for that reason, but to eat as a stand alone dish...not so much. Doesn't compare to the Firehouse chili I buy in the grocery store.

column9: Greasy, was 5 stars for a canned chili~
column10: It isn't greasy tasting, it's thick and damn good. I was vert surprised it held up to the gtreat reviews.  I added a few dried onions to it while cooking for ten minutes, the slight crisy and sweetness of the onion makes it taste as good as a restaurants.UPDATE...A week later I ate another serving, only I ate the whole can instead of only ten ounces....8 hours later my body was forced to regurgetate it. This has not happened to me since I ate some really greasy spicy chicken wings for lunch at work in 1993. I spit it into a paper towel, it was orange grease, I fear the same orange grease that rises to the top of most other canned chili's that I am able to mostly skim-off  This chili showed very little solid grease at the top, I could not quickly remove it, so I didn't. I suspect it had just as much but was emulsified into the thicker sauce, which I ended up eating and then regurgitating because my body could not digest it. I wish I hadn't eaten it. Now I have 22 cans more which I will be afraid to eat unless I can figure out how to easily get rid of some of the hidden grease.

column9: Please don't feed your cat CORN!
column10: There's almost no meat in this at all. column4: Sandra J. Hovey "I love my life!"
column10: Each Godiva Milk Chocolate Pearl is about the size of a tic tac.  I love the portability of the little tin and the quick easy little pops of chocolate flavor. column10: Although Godiva Chocolate is good stuff,,the price is absolutely stupidly high.35 bucks plus 5 bucks shipping for 9 ounces of chocolate..No way i'd ever pay that.

These Godiva Milk Chocolate Pearls are getting harder to find in stores, which is a shame because they fill a great niche in the chocolate lover's life. They are a perfectly portable, portion-controlled (if you want them to be) indulgence.One drawback is the price tag on these, which I'll admit is hefty (it's usually cheaper in stores, if you can find them!). You're paying, though, not only for the quality chocolate, but also for the design and package. This tin is one of the only candy tins that I have never seen pop open at the bottom of a crowded purse. Never! The box doesn't seem perfectly air-tight, but it keeps the pearls fresh for a good long time regardless.The pearl design is super-smart, particularly given how many people (women especially) are trying to be portion conscious. One or two pearls can satisfy a chocolate craving without "costing" a lot of calories. The milk chocolate is more like Dove than one of the mid-low end brands like Hershey's.  It's sweet but not cloying, and melts smoothly on your tongue.I highly recommend Godiva Milk Chocolate Pearls. Given that they're becoming scarce on stores (and pricier online), I'm a little concerned they might be on the way out - try some while you can!

The rawhide doesn't digest well and the big dummy gets diarrhea. He has to chew sort of sideways on this rounded treat using his back molars.  They must be tasty too because he keeps working on these and they last for days.We will continue to buy this product.  It keeps our pup busy, seems agreeable to his stomach, and compares very favorably to other chewy treats.

not only is this a really good sushi nori, and we use a lot of nori, mostly in salads and soups, but you can't beat the price for the quality.

I purchased per Dr Oz recommending seaweed has good benefits.  Not knowing how to professionally use, I finally decided to spread with light cream cheese, sesame seeds, roll, cut into 1" bites, and eat.  it is delicious.  I do mix up my spreads.

The flavor and especially the aroma of the tea is much too pungent, even burnt. It is oven-roasted, not smoked, as is traditional. And too expensive for what you get. Not enough information is available online to make an accurate choice.

Oatmeal can be classified as a perfect food.  Really.  Quaker Oats offers the best oats, in my opinion.  Oatmeal has many health benefits.  It lowers LDL "bad" cholesterol while not lowering HDL "good" cholesterol levels, is a good source of soluble fiber (which helps suppress appetite), lowers blood pressure, is a good source of vitamins and minerals (especially magnesium, which is good for blood pressure) and contains the amino acid L-arginine (good for lowering blood pressure and cholesterol).With benefits like these, make yourself a nice big bowl right now.
Awesome product, not on the shelves in our grocery store anymore.  Love that I can get this through Amazon.com!

Ok, let me just say that what brought me to this site, was me looking for where they sell this rice because I can't find it in the grocery store anymore & i LOVE it. Frankly-the Mexican rice just doesn't cut it.  That other person must have had a bad bag because this rice is the BEST.  I love it.  And i wish the dang bag wasn't TWO servings because I could easily eat the whole thing myself it is so yummy.  As far as the black stuff-it's called seasonings.  More for me!!!

Old El Paso Heat & Serve Fiesta Rice makes a great side dish. Just warm it up in the microwave. You don't even have to take it out of the package. The rice is not overcooked, letting that final fluffing to take place in the heating process. We use the rice for other things more than the intended serving suggested. We spoon it in burritos as we make them. Add some tomatoes, garlic, onions and a little extra spice and you have a great Spanish rice. This product is great time saver and useful in many dishes.

Perhaps I got a bad bag, it was dated with an expiration of Feb 2011, and it is Nov 2010.  I cooked the rice per the directions and the smell that the rice had was horribly rancid.  I noticed some black particles in the rice which I can only assume was some sort of vegetable which didn't preserve properly and just went bad.Either way, this was the first time I had purchased this product.  I will be steering clear and taking a less convenient approach to fiesta rice next time.

We have tried several brands of so-labeled Chocolate Raspberry Coffee, and this was the worst so far. It has no flavor or aroma of chocolate or raspberry, and has an odd chemical taste as well. Other brands weren't great but at least were tolerable as plain coffee. This one is not.

I will recommed these cheese to everybody, good quality, fresh you can taste the smoked flavor on the cheese. Item arrived sooner than expected plus was in a good packaging and still cold when received Thank you.

All hoisin sauces tend to be very salty, but this LKK one tips the scales with 1120mg of sodium per 2 tablespoons, which comes out to 28% of your recommended daily intake. This sauce gave me that sodium-burn sensation on my tongue. I'm going to look for another brand.

column9: AMAZING...THIS IS MY FAVOURITE HOISIN SAUCE BY FAR!!!

We have been using these on our boat as a substitute for the fresh roasted ones we can get in NM.  They take up much less space than canned and weigh practically nothing.

column9: A "find" for people who need green chili
column10: A family member recently moved to a different country.  Once thing that was sorely missed was green chilies. This is a substitute until they return home.  Also, the lightweight nature of this product makes it easy and inexpensive to mail.

column9: This is okay, but Dandy Blend is far better
column10: I have severe reflux and a corn and gluten intolerance so finding a coffee like beverage was not easy and tea just does not cut it for me.  I tried this product and was thrilled, then the Dandy Blend, which I ordered at the same time arrived.  I got a huge bag of Dandy Blend, compared to the tiny bag of Unforgettable - you can compare the price vs the volume yourself.  In my opinion the Dandy Blend tastes better. I have not touched the whole brown rice drink since I tried the Dandy Blend which tastes like postum, which I do miss since they quit making it.  Pero is good too, but I cannot have it anymore with the gluten intolerance, nor postum for that matter.  I tried Kava for a while but the acid, even though this is an acid reduced product, was too much for my stomach.  The lack of acid is wonderful in both Dandy Blend and Unforgettable. Now I have a good tasting, hot beverage choices that I can sip on throughout the day. I suggest buying both and seeing which you prefer.

column9: Amazing! Smells like hot chocolate, tastes even better
column10: I bought this tea from Whole Foods on my quest to find more loose leaf teas and it looked interesting. The packaging is nice and very much air tight (two lids to keep air out) and the second you open the canister the most amazing smell comes from inside so you just can't wait to make it. Then you open the bag and the smell just gets better. I made the tea exactly as it says and boy did it smell up the kitchen. My mother came into the kitchen and demanded that I make enough for both of us of whatever that amazing smell that was. The smell of the tea and milk together brought up memories of going out to the Christmas tree farm and getting hot chocolate after spending hours trying to find the perfect tree. However, when I tasted it, it was not very chocolatey. The taste was very complex, with cinnamon, a refreshing hit of peppermint and a bit of sweetness. I would go more into detail about the taste except I'm not very good at describing tastes but it tastes very good. You could definitely taste the vanilla and the cinnamon and the peppermint just glided on your tongue. Some teas use too much peppermint and it bombards your mouth and you can't taste anything but peppermint, but this tea uses peppermint perfectly to compliment the other flavors. I will definitely be drinking this on a regular basis, especially as it gets colder.

column9: A Tasty, Less Sugary Granola from Kashi
column10: I actually like Kashi's new commercials about how healthy ingredients need to taste good to be in their cereals, and then they show a somewhat overweight guy as a food researcher going into various third world situations to find them, Indiana Jones-style. I had an opportunity to try Kashi's GoLean Crunch! Cereal in a sample packet as part of a promotional package Amazon sent me of their non-perishable groceries. Full of their Seven Whole Grains and Sesame cereal, it is indeed tasty without the overwhelming clusters of sweeter granola cereals. There is some of the sawdust taste of barley and soybean in there, but the whole oats and brown rice manage to dominate with honey, cinnamon, evaporated cane juice and brown rice syrup adding a dash of sweetness. A cup is 190 calories, which is higher than my favorite, Kashi's Heart to Heart cereal, but it does have only 95 mg of sodium and 8 grams of fiber. It's definitely a worthwhile entry in the granola category.

This is a tasty, relatively healthy cereal which probably goes well with milk.  I don't know as I don't drink milk, but it works for me as a snack.  Better to nibble on this than sugar-laden or fat-laden commercial "snack foods" IMHO.  It does have some rye & wheat so if you are very sensitive to gluten, this might be a downer.  I'm somewhat sensitive, but it didn't seem to have much effect on me.  Fortunately, the main ingredients are oats & rice.  Enjoy!

This is one of my favorite "healthy" cereals.  It's high in protein and fiber, and doesn't contain artificial ingredients or sweeteners that I can't pronounce.  This cereal also fills me up for most of the morning (unlike many high carb, oversweetened cereals). And, most importantly, it actually tastes good!  The flavor sort of reminds me of Cracker Jack - crunchy and slightly caramel-ly.  I like to add blueberries or dried cranberries to it for a little extra sweetness.  It's also great in yogurt.  My only complaint is that some of the clusters in the cereal are really large, so much so that I have to break them up before eating.  A minor complaint, really.  Overall, I highly recommend Go Lean Crunch!
I LIKE MIXING OTHER CEREALS TOGETHER FOR BREAKFAST  THIS IS PRETTY GOOD ALL ALONE. TRY IT !  ANOTHER KASHI GOODY!!!

column9: This stuff is just downright nasty
column10: Tried this stuff for the first time, and to put it bluntly, the taste is just down right nasty.As for the crunch, I will give them that, but say goodbye to your teeth, it is like chewing on rocks.Avoid this stuff, our black lab finished the box.

As someone with blood sugar issues, I had given up on cereal years ago because they just didn't have enough protein to prevent a "crash." The Kashi cereals with 9 or more grams of protein sustain me all morning! I'm thrilled to be able to eat something besides peanut butter toast for a quick breakfast!! The berry crunch is yummy.

column9: Great Meal At Any Time of the Day!
column10: I love Kashi Golean.  It is filling and high fiber and protein.  I have been able to lose weight eating this cereal and sensible low calorie meals.  I buy it in bulk to save money.
This is very filling and good cereal... kind of guiltless as there is so much fiber in it. We eat it daily, and the brand overall seems to have gone down a bit in price.

I am very disappointed in my last shipment of Kashi Go Lean Crunch.  It was very dry in large lumps--not at all the even distribution of cereal I had expected and have always found in Kashi's boxes for the last several years.  I don't know if this was a shipping problem or a product problem.

I love crunchy cereal or anything that does not turn to mush in 60 seconds. However, this cereal is just way to hard. Mid way through my jaw started to ache and I was seriously concerned about one of my teeth since it only has a temporary on at the moment.I hate to rate a cereal with lots of other good attributes only 2 stars, but I just would not buy this again.

I ate the last bowl today of 7 whole grain Kashi and the last shake of the box which had an experation date of October 2008 exposed the insect, not sure what kind of bug it was, but I know its not whole grain anything!

column9: GOLEAN - the name is a lie
column10: There is no way that one gets lean by eating a food that has 13 grams of sugar per serving (a cup). The product name seems to have been clearly chosen to deceive the buyer. Trust the manufacturer?? Get serious! But, America, just keep on eating it and getting fatter.

I recently went on a new diet without any preservatives and chemicals.  So I switched to Kashi cereal.  And this is my absolute favorite.  The price is much better (with Subscribe and Save) than in the stores too.

column10: I bought a case of Kashi GoLEAN cereal from Amazon in December 2007, and opened it only to find an expiration date of March 2008.  According to the manufacturer the cereal has a shelf life of one year and therefore has been sitting on the shelf for the past nine months.  Amazon offered only a partial refund for the stale product.

Delicious cereal but the intense intestinal gas and cramping I will not be buying this one anymore. I am actually in a slight amount of pain. I tried a second box to make sure its not just me, but if you google kashi golean and gas, there are millions of hits.Also, the protein comes from Soy, a no no for certain types of Thyroid conditions.

Tastes great, has lots of fiber, lots of protein, and ....is extremely crunchy, tends to be formed in huge lumps. When I tried to chew it, one of my veneers broke in half. WTF? Seriously I ate  different foods for over a year and 1 stupid cereal  did that!EAT AT YOUR OWN RISK!

They call it "Crunchy". This is much more than crunchy.The taste is actually good, not to sweet. nice honey and nut flavor.BUTThe clusters are big and very hard. Like rockswhen i eat this i have to pour a bowl, add milk and let it sit for at least 10 minutes before i can eat itI much prefer Kashi Heart to Heart Honey Toasted Oat Cereal,

This is a great cereal from Kashi. It has clusters of grains and nuts, and does NOT have high-fructose corn syrup nor sugar, yet it tastes sweet (they use cane syrup, which I assume is not processed like sugar). At times, I have made a meal on it by eating it straight from the box, like a snack. But is very tasty with milk, and doesn't get soggy very fast. My only complaint is that the picture on the box shows it with blueberries, but there are no blueberries in the cereal. This product is one we have bought many times and introduced to others.

Tastes great, has lots of fiber, lots of protein, and stays crunchy all the way through the bowl.  BUT, it stays a bit too crunchy.  This morning, I found a marble-sized, tightly-packed, super-hard piece of "crunch" in my bowl and removed it right away.  Unfortunately, my next spoonful had more of this hard cereal in it.  And, when I tried to chew it, my tooth broke in half.  OUCH!  Sorry, but no cereal should break your tooth, ever!  It's very unfortunate because I ate a bowl of this every day, it's good for me, and I actually liked it.  But, I need my teeth for a few more years.  EAT AT YOUR OWN RISK!

I love Kashi products. I think they taste great and the health stats are sublime. It is with great pain (literal and figurative) that I rate this a 2-star product. I must be in the minority, but about 2 hours after eating any of the Go-Lean cereals I experience pain inducing intestinal gas (farts). Google it if you don't believe me. If this didn't turn my stomach into a pressurized cannon, I would easily rate it 5-stars. It's healthy, tastes great, can be found on sale for the price of regular cereal, and Amazon has it for subscribe and save. Unfortunately, I am one of the seeming minority who will have to stop eating this after making the connection to it's terrible gas inducing powers.

This cereal is extremely crunchy and tends to be formed in huge lumps unsuitable for eating.  "Sweetened cardboard" is what always comes to mind when I try to describe the taste.  It is extremely low in calories compared to other cereals and granolas, but I found it practically inedible.
It does not taste as good as back to nature Granolas, not even Post's pecan cereal. I bought 2 packs, unfortunately, and finished only 1 box in 2 months. I just don't like it.

column9: KASHI GO LEAN JUST NOT CUTTING IT!
column10: I love granola cereal and since I'm watching my weight, I decided to try the Kashi GO LEAN Crunch. Well, needless to say, it is not satisying my granola cereal craving at all. It is totally lacking in flavor and texture. I guess some things you just can't mess with and one of them is granola. IMO, LIGHT granola is just that, "light"-weight. I'm going back to the Quaker Oats 100% Natural Granola Cereal, which by the way, does include raisins and almonds so I don't have to add my own.
Beware, this product is not vitamin fortified. It is probably best utilized for its fiber content.

If you are looking for a healthy, good tasting cereal you should try Kashi's GOLEAN Crunch.  Compared to most healthy (particularly high protein and high fiber) cereals, it has a higher protein and fiber content per serving.  As important, it tastes good.  Its taste obviously cannot compare to some sugar filled normal cereal, but as health cereals go, this one is a keeper.  I eat it 3-4 days a week and have done so for over a year and I still like it!  Just note that you may want to buy one box from your local grocery store before buying a six pack from amazon.com just to make sure you like it.

Kashi GoLean Crunch! is really good. Seriously, truly tasty. It's got a real "crunch!" to it, as the name makes clear -- but after the initial crunch, it's got this understated sweetness about it, a mixture of cinnamon and maybe a little honey. Mmmm. A bowl is very filling, and here's the amazing part: it actually KEEPS me full. For hours. As for the "clumps" that some people are complaining about, those are my favorite part! It's just a characteristic of the cereal -- kind of like how, sometimes, pizza will have a bubble of dough in it. Mmmm. Love the bubble, love the clumps.HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

column9: Great to eat right out of the box
column10: I've been eating GOLEAN Crunch! cereal for over a year now and the exclamation mark after crunch is fitting.  There are huge round clusters at the top of the box perfect as finger food, but after you get half way or so into the contents most of the rest is small and harder to eat right out of the box.  Still tasty and crunchy, however.Despite the great taste without milk, or in concert as a granola topper of sorts, I find that this cereal causes an inordinate amount of gas buildup in my system.  Hence the rating of 4.  It may be just me, or one of the seven grains is the culprit.  And, despite this realization, I'll continue to eat it primarily because of its great taste and good all-around nutrition.

I love this cereal so when I saw a big sale on the 4.3oz boxes of it I bought 48 boxes!  Halfway through our first breakfast my wife realized that the little black seed looking things in the cereal were actually little dead bugs!!!  Once she said that I started looking in my bowl and realized it was full of them!  I'm a big fan of the cereal but will NEVER purchase any from Amazon or probably off the internet for that matter.  Grocery store is fine with me!  Buyer beware!

With so many other glowing reviews, I feel a little ashamed to put my own lukewarm review in.  Kashi GoLean Crunch! has 7 whole grains in it, which means puffed rice is mixed with oats and rye and other grains to make clusters.  It's naturally sweetened, which is a plus, and it definitely stays crunchy in milk.  Really, really crunchy.  It has sort of a sweet, oat-slightly-nutty flavor to it, and it's not bad.However, as I said, I'm not really addicted to it.  I prefer Back to Nature Granolas, and as I wrote this review, I became curious as to their nutrition facts.  So here is the Kashi measured up against the Back to Nature All-Natural Granola, Apple Blueberry, 15-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6) - measured by 1/2 cup servings.  There are definitely more calories in BTN (200 vs. 95), but there's fruit too, which the Kashi GoLean lacks.  BTN has slightly less sugar (6 g to Kashi's 6.5g), less salt (20 mg to 47.5 mg) and there's more protein in it (6 g to Kashi's 4.5g). They are equal in the following categories: dietary fiber (4g) and calcium (2%); there's more fat in BTN (2.5g=4% BTN, 1.5g=2.5% Kashi).  So there is not a lot of difference between the two.But as for the taste and the texture?  I'd readily take granola any day over the Kashi.  I don't like overly crunchy cereals (why buy a cereal specifically named, "Crunch!" right?) and the granola is crisp enough for me.  There are fewer sharp edges to stab me in the gums.

Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal ..  this cereal is a little sweet for my taste.  I will not buy this Kashi again

Good product at a high and increasing price and the size of the container keeps shrinking.  Will soon be single serving container at a very high price.  Need to start looking for other breakfast options.

This cereal is nutritionally fortified gravel. But that's not necessarily a bad thing. It takes a suspiciously long time to get soggy in milk and it isn't too sweet. Think of it, philosophically, as a less extreme Grape-Nuts.  With some freeze-dried strawberry slices on top it's actually even kind of good. If you are especially into eating healthy cereals or small rocks you would probably like it. I'm going to finish what I have but not go out of my way to purchase this again, because I can only consume so much gravel in a given year.
I love Kashi, but this product has been less fresh than what I buy at my local grocery. Maybe I have been eating it less frequently? In any event, I won't be reordering!

column9: Great cereal, maybe a bit TOO crunchy
column10: This serial is awesome. I pretty much exclusively eat cereal as a grad student with very little time, and this has to be among my favorite cereals. The crunch can be a bit too hard sometimes (I didn't think such a thing could happen), so I usually let it soak in the milk for little, making sure I get every cluster.I've had a hard inedible bit here and there, but very rarely. In the whole year+ I've been getting these in the mail from Amazon, I've had maybe two or three boxes that showed the anomalous hard bits.Also, its great with soy milk (are there things that arent?).As always, check the expiration date!! I haven't had a spoiled box yet, but you can never be too careful!
My husband is on a diet and enjoys this cereal mixed with Cheerios every morning.  Kashi is filled with protein goodness.
This week Just finished a box of this cereal. Taste great...more filling ...before you use this product you should be aware of its high test gas production.

We love this cereal and found that the value offered by Amazon's Subscribe and Save deal was great. Only problem is that quality may be hit or miss - one out of the three boxes we received was stale and tasted pretty bad.

This cereal is amazing.  Tasty, filling, nutritionally balanced, and cheaper than a lot of other premium "healthy" cereals.  I love eating this cereal in the morning for breakfast or after work as a snack.  Really, as far as taste and nutrition, this cereal cannot be beat.However,There is some ingredient in this cereal that causes HORRENDOUS gas in some people.  I am one of them.  Forget beans, peppers, whole grain...all the things that usually cause gas.  This is the worst gas imaginable.  In fact, I am still in awe of how much gas one bowl of this cereal causes.  It is not just the fiber.  I eat a high fiber diet anyway and have never had problems like this...there is some specific ingredient that causes this problem.I would recommend trying this cereal from a store before buying a bunch to see how you react to it.

Enjoy twice the crunch: Kashi go-lean crunch is an intestinal wrecking ball. Fun to eat, tastes great and then.... generates the most amount of farts imaginable from a breakfast food. Really, no exaggeration, this cereal should be a registered weapon.

Trying out Golean Crunch for the first time and really like it.But for being a healthy cereal -why does it have more sugar than Kellogs Frosted Flakes!  13g of sugar in Golean Crunch and 11g in Frosted flakes.

column9: Delicious! But not as healthy as expected
column10: I'm a type 1 diabetic and am supposed to avoid "bad" foods. Kashi sort of has a reputation for healthier fare, which initially attracted me to this cereal.What a taste! I enjoy the cereal very much; it's crunchy, sweet, and filling. It doesn't taste as processed as lots of common sweet cereals, and isn't bland at all like typical "healthy" cereals.For those without my specific health issues, I'd highly recommend this cereal as it's pretty darn good and relatively healthy. However, it has a pretty high glycemic index and really gives me sugar spikes, so unfortunately after this case I'm done with the product. Farewell Kashi, you sweet seductress of the cereal isle.

column9: Love it, but should be called Colon Go Clean
column10: Love, love, love this cereal. Great taste, good for you and high in fiber. But my god does it wreck havoc with my intestines.  Wow!

If you are looking for a cereal that is good for you; one that is sweetened with natural ingridents such as honey and cinnamon and has seven whole grains and sesame this is it.  Golean Crunch has twice the protein and fiber of the average cereal, it's crunchy and really quite tasty.It will not go limp in milk and if you are looking for a fiber cereal that works, this little number is certainly it.This cereal makes a great topping on yogurt giving you a double dose of health in every bite. Give it a try...enjoy!

First let me say that I eat a healthy, balanced variety of foods, and am not prone to hardly any bodily disorders.I eat lots of bread and cereal, so this seemed a good choice for supposed good benefits.I noticed after only one bowl, some stomach discomfort and bloating - something I never get save after the massive Thanksgiving dinner.  It lasted 1 full day, and made me wonder...  I ate another bowl 2 days later, and sure enough it happened again.  After checking online I found a vast amount of space already dedicated to the potent side effects of eating Kashi (noxious gas, bloating, diarrhea...)So, a word to the wise - see if any of these symptoms develop coincidentally with the eating of this cereal.  Otherwise it has good flavor - but is overly dry and reminds one of chewing styrophoam...  I guess I'll pass and keep eating my Triscuits and Raisin Bran :)

column9: Very tasty and filling, but save for solitary days.
column10: AS others have said, this cereal is pretty tasty. I like the flavor, although the cereal is pretty crunchy (hard).Despite the good flavor and other positives, BE WARNED!Do not eat this cereal for breakfast if later that day you are:-going on a hot date-having a business meeting-meeting the in-laws for the first time-giving a presentation in front of any number of people-going on a long road trip with other peopleThis cereal is better saved for days when you plan on being a solitary hermit....or are spending the day with someone that doesn't mind (or is highly amused by) explosive flatulence! Holy cow! I bought the 4-pack of these cereal from Amazon several months ago, and I could NOT for the life of me figure out why I've been having such tremendous farts! My long-term boyfriend was initially amused by the frequency and volume of my trumpeting (farts that literally lasted 30 seconds or more), but it's since just become something for him to grimace at. Notably, I ate this for breakfast the morning on the day he proposed to me....Let me just say that our hotel stay that day was less than romantic. Hilariously awful, but not romantic.So, this cereal has its purposes. Despite being a 26 year old woman, fart humor is still a blast (pun!) to me. I might buy it again (I just finished the last box), but I'll just be selective on when to eat it. A Google search for "Kashi gas" reveals that I'm not alone in this.

It's true, most Kashi and Kellogg's products are contaminated with GMOs. If you write Kellogg's to complain, they will try to tell you how great GMOs are. We know better! This is one of the best morning items you can have, Kashi GOlean Crunch cereal is great and the price point beats going to any store.

This is certainly not the worst tasting cereal in the world, not the greatest, but for a health food not bad at all.  The main problem with eating it is that it is a bit too crunchy, and it leaves a very stubborn residue if left in the cereal bowl for an hour.  HOWEVER, the main problem doesn't come when you eat the cereal; it comes about 3 hours after you eat the cereal.  You will be haunted by the most unrelenting gas that you are likely to have ever experienced.  I am positive that GoLEan crunch is responsible because for the last two days that and milk were the only two things I ate and both days I experienced the same tortuous flatulence (I have never had a problem with my milk [Horizon Organic whole]).  The gas isn't particularly smelly but it is frighteningly voluminous.  If you were to consume this product along with a serving of egg curry, you could vanquish your most powerful enemies.

For those with clumping problems: I have encountered this too.  It happens when the cereal soaks up too much moisture from the air!  Seal the bag carefully, and if the air where you live is especially moist, you might even consider transferring the cereal to another container that can be sealed airtight.I've been eating this stuff for YEARS and I still love it just as much as I did when I started.  While I think the Honey Almond Flax variant is somewhat tastier, this one does take significantly longer to develop any rancidity.  This may be due to the omission of the flaxseed which contains polyunsaturated linolenic oils which, though healthy, are highly prone to oxidation (I am extremely sensitive to this; my friends and family can't tell and think I'm crazy).  This may be a consideration for you if you are similarly sensitive and take a while to finish the six boxes in this multipack!I share an apartment with two other college-aged guys.  Kashi is really expensive in the grocery stores nearby, so we get monthly subscribe-and-save deliveries of the following:Kashi GOLEAN Cereal, 14.1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal, Honey Almond Flax, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)Kashi GOLEAN Crisp! Toasted Berry Crumble, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)Kashi Heart To Heart Honey Toasted Oat Cereal, 12.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)We save quite a bit of money this way, and we always have a stock available.  I eat it for breakfast every morning and often for a snack as well - it really is tasty and filling, has lots of healthy protein and fiber, and doesn't leave you feeling sugar-shocked like kid's cereals overloaded with high fructose corn syrup and cane sugar.  I rotate between the five cereals listed above to keep things interesting.

This might be an excellent cereal, but the boxes that I bought had large pieces stuck together that were hard as a rock and dangerous to the fillings in your teeth.  They can be manually broken apart, but that is a lot of extra trouble.  Other than that, the flavor is good.  It does have a significant amount of fiber, and a reasonable amount of protein.  There is a potential problem with sodium deficiency if you eat too many foods low in sodium (that can cause muscle cramps, especially in your legs).
This stuff is the most delicious healthy cereal. It's not too sweet and maintains its "crunch" throughout the entire bowl.

column9: Yummy and super cruncholicious--but needs less "sugar"
column10: I find the crunch and texture of this is very satisfying when you want to get your teeth into a granola-like cereal. The flavor is a melange of grains and of sweetness. It's reminiscent of sugar smacks--but richer and more healthful. :)I do wish they'd dial down the sweetness. Kashi has some very nice granola medleys and cereal products, but on some cereals--like this one and the Cocoa Beach granola--its sooooooooooooooooo sweet. Too sweet. I'm assuming most of the consumers of Kashi cereals are grown-ups, not kids. Well, grown-ups just don't need cereal to have this much SUGAR...er...let's call it "evaporated cane juice". (same diff, really)I'll give it five stars the day they ease up on the sweet stuff.But I'll still buy it. I just dilute with a bit of unsweetened wheat puffs or more milk or Almond Breeze.

i tried golean crunch as part of kashi's free sample gimmick--i'll assume that the quality is the same as the store-bought!... anyway, i rate it highly on taste, as it reminds me a little bit of the honey smacks i used to eat, only not so overly sweet. and its health factor is pretty fantastic too (for me, some things taste better when you know they're good for you, although usually it's the opposite!) but the texture, well, they don't call it crunch for nothing--it was a little too crunchy for me. in some bites, the crystallized honey or whatever was like rock candy, and rock solid. still, it's good stuff, but i'll take one of kashi's crunch bars over this any day.
This cereal is good, but...  make sure you have dental insurance. I am guessing it is a crown breaker.
A great price for this delicious cereal, making my family's stomachs AND my wallet happy :)  I will definitely buy again in the future.

column9: Wonderful cereal if you can tolerate it
column10: The nutritional profile of this cereal is excellent.  It's high in fiber, high in protein, yet has low fat and only moderate sugar.  The clusters are very crunchy if eaten straight, or shortly after put in milk.  In fact, they may be too hard for some people with sensitive teeth or gums.  They do soften after a couple minutes in milk, which is the best time to eat them in my opinion.  The taste is moderately sweet with mild, grainy undertones.For a such a healthy cereal, this is really one you could eat every day and not get tired of for a while.  One thing to note is that due to the chicory root extract in this cereal, some folks will experience very bad indigestion with this cereal.  I would advise trying a box from the store before buying a pack of 6 online.  If it plays nice with your stomach, then it's fantastic.
Great taste and healthy, too. Subscription price brings monthly delivery directly to my door at lowest $/oz. cost, including big box stores. Good value!

column9: Tastes good and keeps you full
column10: I'm a big cereal person. I can spend about ten minutes in the cereal aisle, comparing nutritional information, trying to choose between different flavors and brands (yeah, I'm super indecisive :/). However, I often come back to Kashi GoLean. Good old dependable, trusty Kashi. It tastes good and it keeps me full for much longer than any other cereal (I usually feel hungry again about an hour after eating, but Kashi can hold me off for a couple hours at least).My only complaint about this cereal is its hard texture. I don't like having to bite and chew so hard to eat my breakfast, especially when it's early in the morning and I'm only half awake and incredibly grouchy. But the high fiber and protein make it a good breakfast otherwise.

I bought a few cases of this cereal when I found it on sale. It is normally quite a bit more expensive in the grocery store. It arrived in good condition and I probably worked through 12 boxes in 2 months, which is a lot of cereal. I lost a bit of weight from it. I'm not sure if it makes you lean because it is healthy or because it is so crunchy that it takes twice as long to eat so you probably end up eating less. I like the taste and feel good for hours after I eat it. I'm not sure if this is exactly the same as what is sold in the stores. I felt like there were maybe more defects like the super-hard balls of honey, etc in the boxes I bought. This could just be paranoia on my part. Overall I love how it tastes and was very satisfied. I highly recommend this cereal if you are trying to lose weight.

column9: Best Cereal to beat mid morning hunger!!
column10: I have been eating this cereal for a month now and I must say it is very feeling and satisfying! The crunchy texture is actually the best part! I think because it takes so long to actually eat, that is the reason why it is so satisfying as well: It digests slower!You can't beat the 9 grams of protein and 8 grams of fiber for under 200 calories per cup, astonishing!I would recommend this cereal to anyone who is watching their weight or would like to lose weight! Usually I add a half cup of fruit or half a banana to the cereal and one or two pieces of turkey bacon! With that I'm usually full for 4-5 hours!
Best price for this cereal I've seen in years! And with free shipping it's a no brainer.

column9: Great crunch, not too sweet or "stick-like"
column10: I tend to like cereals that have a lot of crunch and that are lightly sweetened.  Many do well on the crunch part, but are too sweet.  Some go too far on the "sticks & twigs" type crunch without taste.  This one gets it right in my book.  I'll be buying more.

The product came very quickly, and it was in fact 15oz sized boxes (I was worried since the stores seemed to carry 14.1oz boxes and I couldnt imagine there actually being two different sizes for such little difference, and ofcourse I was looking for a better deal than store prices).The cereal itself is great, except I find it a touch too sweet compared to other Kashi brands, so I actually like to mix this cereal with the High Protein and High Fiber cereal half and half. But ofcourse everyone's going to have different preferences when it comes to taste, so I'm still giving 5 stars for the service and the quality of the cereal. Natural ingredients that taste good and are actually quite healthy.If you're looking to beat store prices, you'll end up saving a couple bucks, but you'll save more if you purchase with the automatic renewal enabled, which can always be disabled anytime after or set to 6 months renewal. Not sure how fast one can really eat 6 boxes of cereal. It's taken me 3 or 4 months now I guess.

This  cereal is great to snack on while watching TV or a DVD.  My children even love it.  It is sweet enough that they eat it dry right out of the box.  Yet it is crunchy enough to keep things interesting.  Believe it or not they prefer this to a bowl of greasy popcorn.  Actually, I do too.  :)

column9: Cheaper at your local grocery store
column10: Great product, but you can get it for $2.50-$3.00 per box at your local grocery store on sale!

Most cereal either tastes good or is bad for you.  GoLean Crunch has the best of both worlds - it tastes as great as most full-calorie granola cereals but it has lots of Fiber and Protein, which most people just don't get enough of in their diets.  I even keep a box of this stuff at work for snacking!

column9: And I don't even like cereal
column10: I never have liked cereal-probably because I hate milk, but I wanted to eat healthier and kept seeing the ad for Kashi so I bought it. This is the very best snacky-breakfasty-anytime food I have ever had. I love the flavor, and because I do not drink milk, I eat mine in a bowl with a 1/4-1/2 cup of raisins-mmmmmmm...I swear its so good that you'll want to feel guilty for eating it!! Its is crunchy, but that's a good thing. Instead of reaching for the chips when I want to crunch, I reach for the Kashi. Love Love Love it!!!! I suggest you buy 2 boxes at first if you are married. My husband practically ate an entire box with in 2 days : )

This cereal is a staple in our household. We've consistently used it for breakfast over the past 4 years. It has the perfect blend of sweetness, crunchiness, fiber and protein. And the cereal keeps for a long time without going stale. Very filling and a great way to start the day.

This cereal is delicious.  I eat it dry as a snack.  It is great at work or at home.  I get the satisfaction of the crunchiness as well as the pleasure of the flavor.  The high fiber content and other healthy ingredients make this a wonderful snack any way you look at it.I like to measure the cereal out into portions so I don't over do.  It also allows me to seperate the larger cereal chunks for more convenience at work.
Whole grain, low sugar (well some of their other offerings have less sugar), and it's great with SILK (soy milk).

column9: Bad For Your Health and Bad for Your Teeth
column10: With a whopping 18 grams of sugar, this cereal ought to be banned for anyone with high blood sugar, hyperglycemia or diabetes.  Nobody concerned with being healthy ought to consume more than 4 grams of sugar in a meal.These sugary nuggets are so hard, if you have veneers or crowns, new or old, there is a good chance of them cracking and breaking off.  I've been to the dentist twice -- in order to get repairs done due to consuming this -- let's call it what it is -- breakfast CANDY!  My dentist entirely arned me off of consuming this garbage."Oh, but it's so good for you!  Those whole grains!"  Hogwash.  It's got more sugar than protein.  There are much better foods for the (non-hypocritical) health-conscious person.
Excellent healthy treat. I have lost over 30 pounds and owe my success in part to kashi cereal. I eat cereal most nights - loaded on fibre so I don't go hungry yet lose weight

column9: Yum and yum and apparently good for you
column10: It's a rare day when something is good for you and tastes good.  Every day I have Lean crunch is that day.

column9: Incredible cereal at an incredible price
column10: I've always been a fan of Kashi GoLean Crunch. I find that it's the perfect balance of taste and health. The best part is that my kids actually love this as well. This is significantly healthier than many of the sugar cereals that are marketed to kids. Even my 1 yo enjoys eating this dry. Between this and Honey Nut Cheerios, I don't have to feel guilty about giving my kids "bad" cereal.From a price perspective, you can't beat Amazon's Subscribe & Save. My family of six will work through these four boxes pretty quick. Thanks Amazon!
This cereal is very tasty, has great crunch, great fiber, great protein and little sweet.  KASHI made a delicious and nutritious breakfast treat all in one.  It is a great value, 6 pack.  We love it!
I love this Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! I would say this is the best trade-off between taste and amount of protein for a cereal. It's yummy, crunchy and healthy.
Without a doubt, the best healthy cereal I've ever had. Lots of protein, lots of fiber, and it tastes like old school Sugar Smacks :)

In an attempt to start eating healthier, I switched my morning cereal to Kashi GOLEAN.  This cereal is a treat to eat, even when switching from sugary cereals.  I definitely recommend it as one of Kashi's better cereals.

I ordered my favorite Kashi cereal to eat with yogurt on Sept. 1st and got it the next day on Sept. 2nd with free shipping from Amazon Prime!  I was pleasantly surprised at just how quickly it came.  It's the same standard size box I buy at the grocery store and for slightly less the cost.  I had a cup the day it came and it was in its usual extra crunchy delicious form.
This a very good Cereal At a very good price I am glad I found it at Amazom Becuse this is my favorite Cereal

Crunchy indeed! Careful when chewing,there may be the occasional hard chunk. The taste is sweet with a little taste of cinnamon. High in protein and fiber. I think kids would even like Kashi! I get 6 boxes every 6 months. The boxes were a little damaged but contents were fine.
I was pleased to receive such a great deal on Kashi Go Lean Crunch.  The product arrived quickly and w/ free shipping, prevented me from having to make a trip to Costco for it.
We all like it, kids a bit less than adults.  Fact that it's healthy does not appeal to them as much. I get it as a subscription item.  Otherwise it's cheaper elsewhere.
My wife loves this cereal.  When I saw this for sale on Amazon for the great price it was listed at, we jumped on it - and likely will again too.  Much more expensive to buy in grocery stores!
This cereal is awesome. It stays crunchy in the milk. Well worth the money - both the protein and fiber that are are provided by one serving of this cereal along with great taste.

column9: My Favortie Cereal...Next to Cinnamon Toast Crunch
column10: I've been eating Kashi GoLean for about two years now and I can't live without it. It's just sweet enough to satisfy the kid in me and it's healthy enough to make me feel good about eating it. Though I do tend to eat really-sugary cereals like Cinnamon Toast Crunch, Kashi GoLean is a great substitute. Come to think of it, I haven't eaten Cinnamon Toast Crunch in a while, probably because I've been eating GoLean just about everyday. The only downside is that the fiber can make you go the bathroom quite often. But if you balance your intake of cereal just right, you should be fine. In addition, the cereal tastes really good with Vanilla soy milk. I eat my GoLean with Silk Very Vanilla.
Delicious taste, but it's way too crunchy. It hurts my teeth and gums. I have to let this sit in milk for a while before I can eat it. I really wish this wasn't so crunchy.

Fibre...checkProtein...checkVitamins...checkWhat? You want your cereal to taste great as well? Well here's your answer.Pros:+ Healthy (still has sugars though)+ Delicious+ Crunchy, doesn't get soggy even after prolonged submersionCons:- The size of the granola clusters isn't all uniform. The clumps at the top of the box are quite large, and towards the end you're left with powdery stuff. Not a big minus, but I like my granola to be uniformish.
We love golean crunch: healthy (relatively), crunchy, delicious.  And I love getting it with the subscription plan:  I get 6 boxes at a time, never have to run around looking to find it on sale.
Kashi Go Lean Crunch is the best cold cereal I've even eaten.  Besides, it's actually good for you.

I have always liked the taste of GoLean cereal and now it's even better with the crunchy nuggets.  Kashi is a good source of high fiber and this makes it easy to add to my regular diet.  I also enjoy mixing GoLean Crunch with other Kashi cereals.

column9: Perfect cereal: Tastes good, interesting, high fiber, not too sweet
column10: I'm generally not a big cereal eater. I eat this cereal dry as a snack, which has been great for my waistline. Instead of eating junk, I can eat something healthy, high in fiber, and filling. I don't get hungry for hours. Sometimes there are big clusters and other times a lot of crumbs, depending on settling, but it always tastes good. A slight cinnamon flavor with a satisfying crunch. It's hard to watch TV while eating due to all of the crunching. :-) It's definitely worth a try (I have never commented on a food before, so you know this has got to be good...)

Of all Kashi's products, this is our favorite.  We mix it with plain yogurt and a little fruit-only jelly for a healthy dessert.My only advice is to keep in an air-tight container because it does tend to clump together and get hard if left in the original package too long.
Healthy alternative, high in protein, especially tasty when eaten with soy milk and blueberries! Mix some into your yogurt........goooood.
Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)Great cereal!!!!  My favorite!!!! Healthy and good for you!

column9: Good for your health but hard to chew and digest....
column10: Excellent ingredients and great flavor but difficult to digest and chew. It could be just me... worth to try!!!

column9: Love the flavor and the crunch
column10: This cereal is like rice puff clusters.  Sweet, crunchy and filling.  Love it!

I purchased GOLEAN Crunch with Turtle Rolls and Power Bars using a 20% off coupon on total purchase of $50 or more.  It was a great deal.  The cereal is delicious and was delivered in excellent shape.  No problems with the product being old or having a short expiration date.
Crunchy, just the right amount of sweetness, and doesn't get soggy in milk. Plus it is healthy. The kids prefer this over that nasty sugar coated cardboard. Give this a try!

I found a good deal on this cereal today & thought I'd give it a try, as Kashi seems to be a  high quality, healthy brand.I'm pleasantly surprised by this crunchy, filling cereal. This will be great for breakfast as I have a large gap between breakfast & lunch, and also perfect as a late night snack when I'd normally be tempted by ice cream.The dense, filling nature of this cereal will also make it easier to stick to serving size guidelines. I poured a 'normal' sized bowl and it was way too much, so it looks like I'll be more satisfied with less cereal. This may be my new favorite product here!

I love this product. It is healthy, high in fiber, and tastes delicious! I highly recommend it, especially from Amazon because if you buy $49 worth (at times), you get $25 back. :) So you get a really good deal. This cereal is god for breakfast, lunch, dinner or a snack.
I really like this cereal.  It is great that it stays crunchy and has a nice sweet flavor to it.  It does give you some energy and what can I say the fiber does its job.

I tried a Kashi cereal several years ago and hated it.  But after recently trying one of their frozen dinners and loving it, I thought I'd give the cereal another try.  I was pleasantly surprised.  This one actually reminds me of the taste of Honey Smacks - just not quite as sugary and crunchier.  This cereal still contains some sugar, but at least it's in the form of a natural product instead of corn syrup.

I take a little cup to work with me with Kashi GOLEAN Crunch, walnuts, raisins, bran flakes, etc. I make it a little different every time.When everyone around me is eating cookies or doughnuts, I take out my "survival kit," pour a cup of coffee and my diet is saved for yet another day.

...And that's a good thing, in my book. It has to be said that for cereals with this much nutritional content, it is an uncharacteristically sweet blend. But GoLean Crunch doesn't share the artificial, high-fructose corn-syrup taste of your favorite childhood cereal. The honey and cinnamon deliver a restrained but vibrant flavor that satisfies the sweet tooth and saves you the toothache. In time, you'll wonder why your body kept craving the kid's stuff at all.Kashi cereals are generally very satisfying--after downing a bowl, you feel a rush of energy and a lightness that many competing high-fiber cereals can't deliver. Along with a hot cup of coffee, fresh fruit and maybe some yogurt, this is a highly recommended breakfast item for anyone looking for sustained energy throughout the early hours of the day (and who isn't?).

column9: Finally, good granola with no guilt!
column10: This cereal is great! High fiber, no saturated fat or trans fat, modest sugar, and it tastes really, really good! Plus they admit that the serving size is a full cup of cereal. I highly recommend it.

I love this cereal. It is so healthy and so delicious. The packaging has a picture of blueberries on the cereal, so I thought it came with the blueberries. I was disappointed to find out that I had to buy my own blueberries to go with the cereal. After trying it, I was completely amazed by the taste. Usually something that is so good for you does not taste so good. Well, in this case I don't mind eating the healthy cereal or buying my own blueberries to go with the cereal! It's that good. Very crunchy and just enough sugar to satisfy your taste. It really is the best cereal I've tried in a long while.

To me this is the best cereal ever for breakfast or snacking.  It's delicious-stays crunchy(disagree totally with the person that said it got soggy-try it with just a little bit of almond milk-MMMMM).Since finding this, I'm just not happy with any other cereal, even take it with me when I travel.  And I always buy mine in bulk, so this is great, especially for folks who have a hard time finding it.  I'm lucky,as I can get it for less locally.Even the other Kashis pale by comparison, and it's the most healthy cereal i've found.mld

When I'm dieting I crave crunch food. Kashi GOLEAN is the lowest carb cereal I could find and a portion size larger than 1/4 cup. It's very crunch and stays crunchy even in milk (not forever but longer than most cereal). The flavor is pleasant and it needs NO sugar or sugar substitutes. Very good.

This stuff is great as a snack.  As a breakfast cereal?  Not so much.  For some reason, the taste totally disappears once they come in contact with skim milk and they get soggy (and extremely chewy - like chewing coconut) in less than 3 seconds.  So it's like chewing on wet cardboard with a hint of cinnamon or something.  Maybe it's just me.  Oh well, go figure.  I do love them as a great finger food.  So I recommend these as a light, healthy snack right out of the box, but if you're looking to buy this as a breakfast cereal, I recommend looking elsewhere.
This cereal not only tastes good and is good for you.  It will clean you out pretty good as well!  Tons of fiber and beleive it or not, this cereal has like 9 grams of protien per serving!!!

Billed as good tasting cereal that is also nutritious, the Kashi Golean Crunch  definately delivers the crunch.  Comparing the side nutrition info panel with other cereals shows low fat, low sugar, good fiber and a fair ammount of vitamins.  As with any granola based cereal, adding rasins, bananas, berries, etc. helped vary the taste immensely.  Even so, after 6 boxes I was ready for an extended break.  I expect I will enjoy it again later.  Enjoy!

This is an awesome cereal.  It makes a really good snack too.  That's what I mostly eat it for.  I personally think it has a natural brown sugar taste.  If you are looking for a healthy snack or a healthy cerealm this should be among your top choices.

For decades I have cooked barley the long way - simmering for almost an hour, watching the pot so it doesn't boil over, scouring the sticky, gooey pot afterwards. I recently gave this product a try and am now a convert. No more long vigils at the stove watching a pot simmer.  This is wonderfully flavorful, full of all the healthy stuff we are looking for, and so much easier to cook, in a lot less time. I used to freeze the long-cooking kind and now I cook batches of this and freeze in smaller portions as well.I have even simmered this quick cooking barley along with whole wheat orzo together in the same pot, drained it and frozen it for future use in soups, stews, etc.Never again will I waste an hour of precious time cooking barley the long way. This quick cooking barley will now become a staple in my cupboard.

I could not get the quick barley at Albertson's so turned to the internet.Although 12 boxes is a lot of barley, I was able to sell some of them to friends for cost at $3.17 each, which includes the S & H. Also a local grocer dealing in organic foods took a couple of them.Putting barley in any soup home made or canned adds a flavor I really like, so in two weeks I have used up one 11 ounce box already. It only takes 10 minutes heating the soup with the barley to cook it, either in the microwave or on the stove.Just thinking about it makes my mouth water, mmmmmmmmm.R

column9: The product is great, but there are serious service problems
column10: First, let me say that this product is high quality--once you get it, it is great.  Getting it, however, is a hassle.When I ordered this item, I was sent only a single box of barley, instead of the case (12 boxes) I had ordered and paid for.  Trying to get this problem resolved involved frequent interactions with customer service.  Amazon attempted to fix the problem by resending the order, but made the same mistake again, sending only 5 BOXES instead of the 5 CASES I had requested (and paid for).  Ultimately, I was told that Amazon was unable to fix this glitch, and my order was cancelled.  Until the problem is rectified, it doesn't make sense, in my opinion, to purchase this item.

column9: My very favorite brand of Curry
column10: I've tried other brands of "curry bars"  such as Golden, but Vermont Curry is just plain the best, by far. It's delicious.
I tried this Vermont Hot curry due to the price difference with Golden.  Golden is still the best, in my opinion.

As a curry fan, I like the savory aroma delivered by the finished product. Unless your taste buds are really sensitive, don't be fooled by the "hot" designation; this is at best somewhat spicy, and downright mild compared to restaurant curry. But when prepared and served as directed, it makes for a satisfying cool-weather meal; I recommend using diced chicken meat, carrots, onions, and green peppers.

Not only it's cheaper than buying the ready-to-eat kind, it also taste a lot better. You can put in whatever you want in it and can be cooked in a microwave. Excellent for people who can't cook as my can't-make-ramen boyfriend can make curry now.
this product is the most authentic tasting calamansi drink i've ever tried! taste is clean, crisp and quite addicting! kudos to the makers!

column9: Like English toffee has been turned inside out! Delicious!
column10: Hershey's Symphony milk chocolate candy bars with almond & toffee bits are one of my favorite chocolate bars EVER! I'm not a chocoholic, but when I really, truly want good chocolate, I'm either looking for one of these bars, a Cadbury Fruit & Nut Chocolate Bar 49g England (12 Pack), a good Ghirardelli square (preferrably the solid chocolate mint, not the mint cream filled), Dove milk chocolate, or English toffee for some good crunch & sweet with a chocolate kick. This chocolate bar by Hershey's has been one of my favorites ever since it came out, way back in my college days (if I remember correctly). It really IS like someone turned a big chunk of English Toffee inside out & added extra chocolate. The chocolate itself is smooth and creamy without being too, too sweet, and the crunchy chunks of toffee & toasted almonds inside of it make for a delicious, sweet surprise.If you haven't tried this confection by Hershey's yet, pick one up at your local drugstore or grocery store. I'm sure you won't be disappointed!
For the last few years Hershey Symphony Almond Toffee is my new favorite chocolate bar! My grams prefers the plain since she don't like to be bother with Toffee too much. lol

I purchased these candy bars to give as little gifts to thank people who took a Salvation Army Angel card at our annual "Spirit of Christmas" concert. When I was putting decorations on the bars, I noticed the bars had expired. I am assuming the company sent them at the end of the month of expiration so they were "legal"...but, by the time, I gave them to people on the 11th of the following month, they were expired. It could have caused the orchestra a lot of grief. I will not do business with them again.

column9: Best sauce we've found for cooking!
column10: Our local stores quit carrying this brand -- but we found it online through Amazon.  Thank You!
I love Baronet coffee. It's very rich and convenient in the pods. Baronet pods have more coffee than the senseo pods.

column9: Fusion Italian Porcini Mushroom Sea Salt
column10: I never would have thought these two would become such a fantastic ingredient. I'm so fascinated by the taste and texture of the flavors. I'm primarily using it on meats, veggies right now. yes I will buy it again

I REALLY ENJOY THE MANGO FLAVOR AS WELL AS MY MOM.  I HAVE MENTIONED IN OTHER REVIEWS THAT OTHER INGREDIENTS CAN BE ADDED TO THICKEN OR EXTEND THE PRODUCT VOLUME.  I USE THE MAJIC BULLET AND CREATE WHATEVER. I HAVE ADDED SPLENDA SWEETENED CANNED FRUIT, YOGURT, CINNEMON, GINGER...I HAVE ADDED IT AS A LIQUID TO MY MOMS PANCAKE MIX FOR A FRUIT FLAVOR (SHE IS 97 SO THE SHAPE OR APPEARANCE OF THE FOOD DOESNT MATTER~~~~THE TASTE DOES) I LIKE THE LITE FOR MYSELF BUT IF I DONT HAVE IT, I USE THE REGULAR 4OZ AND ADD LOW FAT COTTAGE CHEESE OR LITE YOGURT AND BLEND FOR A NICE 80Z DRINK THATS FAST AND GOOD FOR ME. THE BOTTLE IS PLASTIC AND I HAVE ACTUALLY REMOVED THE LABEL AND KEEP WITH MY MOMS GLUCOMETER FOR A "SHARPS" CONTAINER ---AND WHEN FULL PUT THE LID ON AND OUT TO THE WASTE RECYCLE CAN WHICH THEY SAID WAS PERMITTED IF I MARK THE BOTTLE WITH MAGIC MARKER.

We ordered the mango and were sent the berry flavor, contacted amazon and told them how much of a pain it is to have to ship back the heavy items and repackage for their mistake.  The box is clearly labeled berry and they swiped their sticker that says mango.  they offered to refund about 20% for us to keep it, and the berry flavor does not taste good at all.  We can use it a little at a time in smoothies to hide it but there is no way we can get through it all a little at a time before it expires.

These pickled eggs are my new favorite . Nice and firm on the outside like you'd expect . They're sweet with a hint of mild vinegar favor . Not overpowering at all . The red coloring is almost purple on the outside and more of a pink on the inside . The best part is the yolk , flavorful and delicious . I only wish that they were available in larger jars because these are going to disappear in a flash .

I was skeptical before I tried it - but this unusual combination of flavors, combined with superb chocolate, absolutely made my day.  The ginger, wasabi, and sesame are so well balanced it's almost like magic.  It's the aroma, the texture, the taste... everything.  I am a fan of chocolate, but I wouldn't have believed that you could make it work with *wasabi* without tasting this masterpiece for myself.  As my friend said when she introduced me; you simply *must* try this.  It will transport you.

This Honey arrived in a timely fashion in two 2.5lb jars. We have consumed one jar and just opened the second and there is absolutely no problem with this delicious honey. It is clean and exactly as advertised.

column9: Seems Processed Too Much for Raw
column10: Good but not great. We've used Wee Bee in the past and have been seeking a cheaper alternative, and that's what brought us here.This honey seems processed too much, due to the lack of the classic light-colored look of raw honey. I suppose this is a factor in not having the "crust" on top, which is a bonus not to have to scrape it aside before enjoying.Also, the taste was not as sweet as the other raw honey we've been using. The texture was a bit "sandy" as I rubbed it between my tongue and the roof of my mouth. I think for the cost and size, this is a great deal overall. I don't think we'll be buying again, simply because we have to use more to get the same result.
Very good product, and man is it sweet!  Delivery was exceptionally fast also.  Will order from this company again.

column9: This honey has proven itself to me!

column9: One of the best stevia based sweeteners
column10: If you're expecting the stevia flavor to be present, you'll be disappointed. This is not a true stevia sweetener, because it only contains reb A and none of the other compounds found in stevia.Truvia is very similar to another brand called PureVia. They are pretty much equal in quality and flavor. Both are very effective at tasting close to sugar without the typical stevia flavor. Truvia differs from PureVia very slightly. PureVia has a slight creamy flavor, and Truvia is a little sweeter per packet (each packet contains more). Both are primarily sweetened with erythritol and purified reb A (another name for rubiana). Erythritol is a natural nearly zero calorie sweetener found in fruit. Reb A is a natural zero calorie sweetener isolated from stevia leaf. Unlike stevia, which is known for a leafy licorice like aftertaste, Reb A has almost no aftertaste and is intensely sweet. Because it's present in Truvia in isolated form without the other stevia compounds, Truvia tastes nothing like stevia.Truvia contains erythritol, reb A, and natural flavors. PureVia differs in that it also contains isomaltulose and a tiny bit of cellulose powder. One big difference between PureVia, and Truvia is that Truvia contains far more erythritol, so erythritol has more of an impact on the flavor than it does in PureVia. Erythritol tastes more like sugar than reb A does, but it has a watery quality to its flavor and a cooling effect. Reb A has a thin sharp sweetness to it. When the two are combined they greatly enrich each other giving a more full bodied sweetness.Truvia, NuStevia, and PureVia are the best stevia based sweeteners you can get when it comes to stevia sweeteners without the stevia flavor.PureVia tastes better in coffee because it has a creamy flavor. Of course most people love cream in their coffee, so PureVia has an upper hand there because of the creamy flavor present. The creamy flavor of PureVia goes well in some things, but not all things. Truvia is not creamy tasting, is sweeter per packet and is better suited for general purpose sweetening where a creamy flavor might not be desired.I did taste tests with my family using PureVia, Truvia, and Sun Crystals, three of the newest stevia based sweeteners. PureVia and Truvia were liked by everyone with PureVia judged slightly better for things requiring a creamy flavor and Truvia scoring better for things that taste better without a creamy flavor. Sun Crystals has the taste of stevia in it, and for that reason it scored lower, because the flavor of the stevia was a negative in some taste tests. Of the three PureVia tasted the most like sugar, Truvia the most like erythritol, and Sun Crystals the most like stevia. One thing that was interesting during the taste test that we found was that when PureVia was tasted plain after Truvia was tasted plain, PureVia tasted better, likewise when Truvia was tasted plain after PureVia was tasted plain it was judged to taste better, but when tasted together the flavor wasn't as good.If you're looking for an effective all natural zero calorie sweetener, this is about as good as it gets. The taste is very similar to sugar, but like all other sweeteners, it has it's own unique flavor. While PureVia tastes a little more like sugar and has a creamy flavor, it's not as sweet as Truvia. Truvia is a better deal because it's sweeter per packet. The difference in flavor is very minor. Also PureVia relies more on reb A for sweetening than Truvia does. Reb A is great in small amounts, but not so good in large amounts, so when more sweetness power is needed Truvia is a better choice. Very large amounts of reb A will taste bitter, but when used in normal amounts, it doesn't taste bitter. Reb A is similar to saccharin in that way. Small amounts taste better than large amounts. There's a sweetness threshold with reb A, and if that threshold is passed, it starts tasting less sweet and starts tasting bitter. That's one thing you need to know when using a reb A based sweetener. Because Truvia relies more on erythritol for it's sweetness than reb A, this is not as much of a problem as it can be with PureVia. You can use far more Truvia packets before you get a flavor "overdose" of reb A than with PureVia.

column9: Yeah Wow, I'm giving it two stars!

I was pretty excited about it, after all the hype, because the grocery store that carried my Sweetleaf  Stevia all of a sudden decided not to carry it any more. Go figure*sarcasm*Anyway, I was pleased until my daughter brought it home, and then I got a look at the ingredients. Have you ever seen the ingredients listed anywhere online, the way they are on the package? I looked around online (this was right before it hit the store shelves) and I even wrote the company an email. I went to the Truvia web site to check it out the same day it was announced. I got an email back saying that the ingredients were Stevia and "natural flavorings'.That didn't answer my question, because I asked them in the email what the "natural flavors" were exactly. I believe I've still got the email saved somewhere on my hard drive.Well, I don't have much of a problem with erythritol, except this product is mostly erythritol and very little stevia. It doesn't taste like stevia or pour like stevia. If I wanted erythritol I can order 100% erythritol. I like the health benefits of stevia. I don't mind a touch of erythritol but this product has too much of it.I'm sorry but as far as I'm concerned this product being marketed as stevia is deceptive marketing at its' best.However it does taste sweet, and if my only choices were table sugar and Truvia, I'd take the Truvia. So it gets two stars for the taste without the health benefits.I was very unhappy with Truvia and the people who make it for not telling me the whole truth when I emailed and asked them directly for a clarification of the ingredients.I will not be buying Truvia again, from any source, online or not.

I don't like the taste of any of them, splenda, equal, sweet'n'low. ick. For that reason I've only used raw sugar or when I'm low on $$, white processed sugar just because it's not a bag of chemicals, and that's a plus in my book.Lately I've been hearing about the stevia based sweeteners, and figured it might be time to give it a try. Stevia has been a bit controversial, as it was banned in 1991 by the FDA(but isn't anymore) and now is ban in Europe and a few other locations. But the reasons for banning are vague and don't seem completely investigated, just that there was "pressure from the market" to stamp them as unsafe.It was important to me that it be natural, because I go as much organic/natural as possible. I knew I wouldn't be using a boat load of it, so I'm not concerned about the controversy. I compared a couple of the stevia based sweeteners in price at the grocery store and this won out as my first to try. To be honest, it's pretty darn good! From a picky taster to you, this is worth giving a try. Dipping my finger in it, it has a cool(as in, cold)super sweet taste. I'm using 1 and 1/2 tablespoons of sugar in my coffee, and this was about 1/2 a packet or less to make it how I like it. I've only put it in my ice coffee so far, but I'm not noticing a huge taste difference between this and my usual sugar, which is great. No after taste to speak of. The price is do-able and I'll definitely buy it again, but I'll also be checking out the other brands.

I've found that the other artificial sweeteners are palatable, but this stuff is pretty dreadful. Go ahead and try it but know that you were warned.

I've used Truvia in three different recipes with cocoa, unsweetened chocolate, and apples, and it improved the flavor dramatically. column9: Not white chocolate, but tasty and lower in fat/calories
column10: Ghirardelli doesn't include "chocolate" in this white sauce's name for a reason:Unlike white chocolate which consists of cocoa butter, condensed milk, and sugar, Ghirardelli "Classic White Flavored Sauce" consists of high fructose corn syrup, sugar, food starch, and carrageenan (which makes the sauce thick and creamy). The sauce contains no cocoa butter, and its unspecified dairy flavors are way down the list of ingredients.in short, this sauce gives my coffee drinks, hot chocolate, and desserts a sweet and creamy consistency with a flavor similar to vanilla or, more accurately, doughnut or pastry frosting.The good news: Unlike real white chocolate, this is fat-free, it's marginally lower in calories, and it pours easily.For a more authentic white-chocolate sauce -- including the saturated fat and additional calories -- try Fontana White Chocolate Mocha Sauce. It contains all the key ingredients of real white chocolate; it's Starbucks' choice for the coffee chain's white-chocolate drinks; and (contrary to the sauce's name) it does NOT contain "mocha" (coffee).If you buy Ghirardelli's sauce in the 64-ounce bottle, be sure to pay less than $20 for it. Some vendors grossly overcharge.
