Perhaps it's because I gave up Starbucks when I gained the ability to make these at home and the comparison isn't there for me anymore? not sure, but really, I found this to be highly comparable with Starbucks.  It's not too sweet either.I've ordered a few of the 64 oz bottles and something I don't like is that when they arrive, the bottoms are bowed out and they don't sit squarely on the table.  I was weary at first because sometimes when products go bad, the packaging becomes misshaped but I went ahead and used it and all 3 containers had perfectly fine/safe contents.
Tried it to try to do a White Mocha like Starbucks and never could get it right and very messy to dispense.
I love this sauce  but unfortunately i did not get too much use out if it because I only used it for myself so it went bad before i could finish it.
Tastes awesome in my iced coffees!!! Only thing I would recommend is including a pump with it at no additional fee. Other than that I love it! Thanks!

Ghirardelli White Chocolate sauce is my favorite!  I used to get Torani White Chocolate sauce but found that I like Ghirardelli much better.  I use it in my version of Tropical Smoothie's Bahama Mamma and for my coffees.  I recommend this to anyone that uses this product in their smoothies and coffees.  I do wish that each of the sauces came with a pump instead of buying it seperate.  Other than that I love this stuff!
Great flavor to add to your coffee.  Not to bland , but not too sweet.  I love it!

Chocolate is great for my morning mochas, but seriously to charge extra for the pump is obsurd, luckily i live near Ghiradelli so go buy it directly from the sorce an everytime they include free pump, i mean seriously how else are you supposed to use it ?  though have washed pump an placed in each new bottle.  An price is cheaper directly from the source so if you live in or are visitng San Francisco go visit Ghiradelli but if not just remember take the pump apart an wash it so you don't have to buy new ones each time you buy the syrup.

I found this sauce to be underwhelming in flavor, all sweetness with a less than lovely aftertaste.  I tried smaller and smaller amounts in my espresso and could never get a comparable result to using the ghiradelli chips.  Also, the companion pump didn't keep it's prime and had to be pumped several times to be reprimed every day and so the amount released was inconsistent which made it difficult to "measure" easily.  (1 pump, 1/2 pump, etc)One ounce in an espresso was VERY strong and not pleasant, and a half ounce is just sweet without a white mocha flavor.
My daughter-in-law loves this White Chocolate Sauce.  The shipment was very prompt, as always.  Thanks.

I am gluten intolerant and make my own granola, so this pack of 4 arrangement is handy and less expensive than buying single packages off the shelf at my health store.  It is good quality, as all Bob's products are.  Honestly, I can't taste any difference from the regular oats.  I think it only amounts to Bob's using a separate mill for this product than he uses for his regular oats.

column9: Excellent old fashion Italian raw food that tastes super
column10: -These kind of cold cured meat products never go over 100 degree in Fahrenheit, yet for 1000's of years this process preserves meat and while retaining all the nutrition and enzymes of raw. It tastes just awesome like a beef prosciutto.-Prosciutto, ham is salted and then air dried for a period of up to two years. After curing, prosciutto is sliced into paper thin pieces which are usually slightly transparent. It is typically eaten uncooked.-I have a Mandolin slicer that I use to shave the Bresaola very thin. Watch out very addictive with cheese and crackers. Maybe some wine too.
The Bresaola Dry Cure Meat is very good but not excellent.You need a restaurant quality slicer to do it justice.

I purchased Daniele Bresaola about a year ago for the first time and was very skeptical. The item arrived very well packaged in a sealed bag and with an ice pack. Since then I have ordered it 4 more times, the quality of the product is excellent. Sometimes the amount of salt added differs, but generally the quality is similar to italian. I first tried bresaola in Italy, so I know what it is supposed to taste like. The only recommendation I have is slicing it with a professional knife very thin. This makes the meat easier to digest and you would fully enjoy each single slice.
This was very delicious.  I loved it.  There was more than we could eat in the time frame we had, but it sure was delicious.

I first bought this in Massachusetts. After moving to FL I found from the company's website that it was sold at a grocery store a mile from my house. Alas, that is no longer the case. I'm very sad, because, after drinking this cocoa, I am now spoiled for all other cocoas. :-(

column9: Ghirardelli Hot Chocolate Mix Hazelnut Flavor, 16 ozI felt
column10: I felt very calm and contented as I sipped this hot chocolate. I love the flavor. I wish it would come in a 2lb can.

We were very disappointed in this extract.  It took way too much extract to get any kind of taste to our root beer and when we did get the taste, it wasn't pleasing.  We emailed Cooks to give them a chance to tell us if this was normal for their product or if we got a bad batch.  They chose not to respond at all.  I certainly would not recommend this company or their products to anyone.
The extract arrived on time for me to make my root beer float cupcakes.  They came out perfect. I would definitely use Cook's brand again.
Used this to make a batch of homemade root beer with the kids.  I force carbonated in the keg since bottle carbonating sounded too dicey.  They loved it and we will do that again!

column9: Mini Lemon Heads in TIny Boxes
column10: There are 24 little boxes contain roughly ten small lemon heads a box, The price was far too high for what you get, and the product was overheated and candy had often been melted together.

column9: The price for one can is outrageous!!
column10: I absolutely LOVE Stokes Green Chile Sauces, but I'm not about to pay $5.14 for one can!  That's outrageous!  Go down to Wal-Mart and buy a can for only $3.00.  Whether you buy the sauce with chicken in it, or my favorite, with pork, it's worth the price.  I mix a can of this sauce with a can of refried beans (my fav is Rosarita) and spoon it over tostadas or Indian fry bread.  Top with lettuce, tomato, and shredded cheddar cheese and wow!  Delicious!!!By the way, WHEN did the Hatch Chile Co. acquire the Stokes brand?  They'd better not change anything...although Hatch DOES make the best red enchilada sauce on the planet.
Product is just as described and arrived fast! Will purchase again soon. Very well packaged and stores perfectly. I always buy spices in bulk to get the most cost effective price.

My wife and I have been using Cornet Bay spices for years.  Very good spice for adding in to make your regular old dishes brand new again.  The Special Seasoning is a family/kid favorite with homemade chicken strips and fried chicken.You can't go wrong with this stuff.  Enjoy!

I purchased the coca leaves before and this tea is not as strong as I had expected. It doesn't even come close to the boost I would get from simply chewing the leaf. It takes about 3 bags (in 1 cup water) for me to actually feel an energy boost. Will not be purchasing this again. Will just go with the straight coca leaf next time.

column9: Erroneous double entry-- see inside for link to "similar" product
column10: This page appears to be an erroneous double entry.  View the product page at Sticky Fingers Carolina Sweet BBQ Sauce (18 oz) and compare the products-- and prices-- for yourself.  Note that this item also (at time of this writing) has a shipping fee-- note the total cost for a single bottle of this product, and compare with the other page.

I am not a kid, but I speak for my kids, that this is a great ceral. I can not find it in the stores here which is frustrating.  It is low fat, high fiber and not too sugary.  Great as a cereal or as a dry snack.

This cereal is so wonderful! It is healthy and delicious...great fiber, too. I started eating this in the early 1980'3, and thought it was no longer made until I just discovered it at a Target superstore recently. I wonder why things that are as good as this are not kept active on shelves??  I also searched online and found you can buy this from Quaker online under their Hard to Find products store section.

I do not eat this cereal in a bowl at breakfast, but bake a box with butter, romano cheese, and onion powder. Sometimes I add pretzels and nut. Guest rave that this is a wonderful alternative to chex mix. I have also used it to mske muffins.

column9: The best cereal you won't find on your grocer's shelf
column10: I absolutely love this cereal. It's really for adults - not too sweet and just right out-of-the box. It stays crunchy in milk, and has five grams of fiber per serving. It's not Captain Crunch and I guess that's why it's so hard to find.

column9: read the title, ignore the product picture
column10: I love Werthers. I thought I was ordering werthers chewy caramels from the picture of the item with the blue ribbon that said chewy caramels and had caramel in the title. It turns out these are the hard candies with soft caramel inside. A bit misleading advertising. werthers are still good but i rated this item a 3 star since it wasn't what i thought i ordered and these items are not returnable if you mess up. so i have quite a few bags of the wrong kind of werthers. that's alright. i know i will find someone who will eat them for me.

column9: Terrible service, terrible taste, not worth the buy.
column10: My experiance with this company has been nothing but bad. Placed the order on the 3rd, arrived on the 16th. Bought this product with aticipation of taste and quality but the smell of the tea and the taste(even when washed) was utterly disgusting, making lipton tea seem desirable. I highly discourage buying this item or from this company if you enjoy quality loose leaf tea. If you are just getting into it loose tea and want to try some thing different or want to use these are decoration, then these may suit you.
This tea is fantastic.  Everyone I gave it to for Christmas also loved the tea.
I have never seen blooming flower tea and was amazed when I tried this.  The little tea ball blooms when you place it into water!  Looks pretty and tastes good
Purchased as a birthday gift for someone that enjoys tea.  She said it was very pretty and the tea tasted great.  She didn't even need to add honey or sugar to the tea.

column9: Not quite what I thought it would be
column10: The blooms in the water were beautiful, but the tea itself hada very gritty, almost "earthy" taste to it which i didnt like. I used them to make interesting centerpieces because when they bloom its gorgeous, but I owuld not suggest actually trying to drink this stuff. Plus some of the "petals" get loose and float to the top which make it have that "gritty" taste.
What a wonderfully delicious tea, mellow to strong in a floral flavor that stays on the palate.  In addition to the wonderful taste, the opened flower is truly beautiful to behold.
My daughter gobbles there up all the time. They taste much better then the "fresh" ones from the grocery store. We eat fresh from our farmers market and then these the rest of the year!
Good product, nice boost without the jitters.Taste way better than 5 hr. saved a bunch by ordering a case
This is a very sweet product. When used in the right amount, it is great for mixing in waffle/corn bread mix. It is also good if you need a little spike before a workout. ;-)

column9: Very fresh but definitely NOT seedless!
column10: The pack of 5 'Panda' brand blocks of Tamarind paste arrived very fresh and tasty but, beware, this definitely has seeds (on average about 10-12 seeds per slab) and also quite a bit of the soft-shell pulp. I carefully pick through the slab for seeds and then put it into a sealed container in the fridge for later use or just to eat sweetened with some honey.All brands of 'seedless' paste in blocks like this that I've tried have seeds. I don't understand why they label it seedless? Someone could break a tooth or wreck their food-processor blades if they didn't know better!

When I got this product in May 2011, it was priced at 8$ for a pack of five which was great with free/prime shipping. The tamarind creates a great concentrate when mixed with water and makes my curries delicious. However, I'm disappointed with the current price point. I wouldn't purchase it at over 5$ a pack.
This is probably the best we have used. Most of the other ones we buy are dry, but this one was still moist and tastes great.
The tamarind was of good quality and for 7 bucks we got a lot. I would buy again. Shipping takes forever though. :)

I dehydrate many types of peppers and then use a coffee grinder to make a powder out of them.  I was expecting to be able to do that with these peppers, but they are not dry enough for that.  They are closer in texture to the dried apricots you buy to eat out of hand.  Sort of leathery and pliant.Not a big problem, as I just plopped them on the dehydrator for a day until they were brittle/rock hard, and then ground them up.  As a precaution, I set the dehydrator outside on the deck to avoid the fumes.  They smell incredible -- a lot like chipotle peppers, actually.  I tasted just a tiny bit of some of the outer skin, and it was quite hot.  I'm sure with the seeds and veins included when ground, it's going to be flaming.There is a fair amount of rope fibers mixed in with the peppers, but I didn't mind this, as it reminded me that these were dried the old fashioned way - by tying and hanging them up.  It just took a little time to pull these threads off as I was placing them on the dehydrator trays.  I probably could have not bothered with that and just ground up the fibers with the peppers.I'll add to this review when I find out exactly how much "one pound" of these peppers actually weighs when properly dried.

Maybe I just got a good batch, but the heaping pound of peppers I received are extremely hot, hottest I've ever tasted, and make amazing chili powder too.There is also a strong smoky, mesquite, jerky, sweet flavor to go along with them.If you are watching the guys on youtube eating bhut jolokia(ghost chile) and expect a similar experience you're sadly mistaken.  These are dried peppers, and while still very spicy, they are unlikely to retain the same bite of a fresh pepper.  Especially since you don't have to chew the pepper very much.  Also those people are acting for dramatic effect, who wants to see a guy take down the hottest pepper in the world without any flair.I'm very satisfied with my order and plan to try growing my own this summer.
This product exceeded my expectations. Very HOT and very flavorful. Merchant is fast and professional. Can't go wrong here.
These are the best quality of ghosts chilis I have ever worked with. So spicy they will make you slap yo momma

column9: Baja South of the Border Contest
column10: Recently my friend took a few samples of the Salsa that I make with Habanero peppers to a Chili contest in Mexico.I also entered a new  salsa made with Bhut Jolokia peppers and a basic traditional recipe and is quite good. To my  surprise the Habanero salsa won First Place and my new found "Fantasma Bhut Jolokia Salsa"  won Third place. I was very excited and also it made me want to experiment more with the new found pepper Bhut Jolokia, My entrees were a Mild Fantasma at about 90,000-150,000 scoville units and a X-tra Hot Fantasma at about 150,000 to 350,000 scoville-units. As you can see I have used just a portion of it's potency but I'll keep you posted on any new developments arising from this new venture in Bhut-Jolokia pepper fever. Thanks to Angelina's Gourmet you've made my day and your pepper selection is great. Yours Truly  AL

I am VERY pleased with this purchase!!! They got here in ONE DAY!! I didn't expect them until Monday. Also I just found out that I got robbed by Hurts Gardens!!! I thought I bought Bhut Jolokia plants and took awesome care of them just to find out they were scotch bonnets!!!!! Hence this purchase. Thanks for the save Angelina Gourmet!!

I want to thank Angelinas Gourmet for these HOTTT Bhut Jolokias and for Angelinas fast shipping. I ordered a pound of dried peppers and was not disappointed. Angelina's Gourmet has the best prices on the internet. For those who are saying these Bhuts are not hot are sadly mistaken. I grow and eat Habaneros, Bhut Jolokias, Tepins, Japones chilis and Jalapenos and know what hot is Here are some ideas for everyone to try. Cook these peppers in soup or anything liquid base and you will notice the heat. You can also break the peppers in half and suck on the side with the stem, seeds and flesh. That is when you will feel the full potential of the heat of these peppers. Plus you can saute these pepppers with some olive oil and peppers and the heat will be noticeable as well. I am satisified with this product and plan on buying more. I went through a 1lb bag already because I have been given them away for people to try. I am a well satisified customer and thank you for these hot Bhut Jolokias.

This is an excellent product that came properly packaged and labeled. The shipping time was very quick and the product quality is what I consider AAA+. There are no bad peppers in the entire bag and believe me, it makes a great beef jerky.  You can find my jerky at [...].I highly recommend the products that this seller is selling.

This is going to read like another ad for the company, but rarely have I been so completely satisfied by a product. I was specifically looking for dried bhoot jalokia (ghost) chilis that I could grind myself for a variety of uses. I had never purchased from this company before and was concerned that the peppers would be leathery and not really dry enough for my grinders to work correctly. No worries! These chilis were exactly what I was looking for. They were perfectly dried and I was able to grind them very easily into the different consistencies that I need for my various uses (jerky, salsas, etc.) The peppers are first rate: the flavor is awesome - the perfect intense flavor and incredible heat. It is obvious that they started out with only the finest fresh chilis and dried them to perfection. Not only that, but the delivery was faster than promised and the packaging was excellent as the peppers arrived in perfect condition. There is no question where I will go when I need to replenish my supply. If you need perfectly dried chilis of the highest possible quality, look no farther. You will NOT be disappointed.
I thought the product was excellent . The peppers where dried. This help in multiple different dishes. I did not weigh the bag but it was way more then I expect. Again a great value
Delivered as promised in a timely manner. And HOT! HOT! HOT! These chilies have great texture and blend well in dishes.

We bought ghost chilies to make a really hot wing sauce for our restaurant.  One of our most loyal customers, for whom we made a sauce with habanero chilies as a base, wanted smoething hotter.  We have finally achieved his dream of a sauce that has both real flavor and heat.  My son wants to call this the GFY sauce but we are looking for a name that is a little more PG in character.

I've always loved hot, spicy food, and after hearing about the Ghost Chili on "Man vs. Food," I decided I had to check them out.  Did some research on the internet, including watching videos of people eating dried Ghost Chilis, and still thought "no way are they that much hotter than a Habenero."  They are.  So hot, in fact, that the huge bag of dried Bhut Jolokai peppers I recieved in the mail is enough to last for years- a half-teaspoon of the dried peppers ground up is enough to make a huge pot of chili very hot, the same amount in a container of home-made salsa renders it un-edible by all but a very few "hot-heads."  Smoky and spicy at the same time, it has a heat that builds a little slower than other hot peppers and lingers longer, with a definite sinus-clearing component and a catch in your throat.  For super spicy food lovers only, be careful when handling them as well.

column9: Dried Bhut Jolokia Chile Peppers (Ghost Peppers)
column10: Outstanding Product at a great price. I recommend this product to anyone who likes Super Hot Peppers,

Since I purchased these primarily for the heat, I too am disappointed: When I said "you gotta try these" to some heat seekers, they were likewise unimpressed for the scoville thrill.However, all of us agreed these really are some very flavorful peppers and a few of those heat seekers will be buying them on that virtue.UPDATE: After cleanup some up and simmering in water for a couple hours, I made a paste from the pulp, reserving the liquid.  Both retained the smokey taste but the heat became quite a bit more impressive. Still, the heat was less than a habanaro though.The crowd now wants to use it in chili for a cook-off. It is great on Pizza.

These peppers are supposed to rate at over 1 million Scoville units; that's almost 3x hotter than a Scotch Bonnet habenero. Maybe it's just me, these peppers seem to be lacking that good old capsaicin. Don't ask me why, but these don't seem to rate anywhere near the orange Havana habaneros I normally cook with.On the bright side, these definitely convey the smokey flavor that the Jolokia is famous for. This stuff is exceedingly good crushed on pizza, on jerky, or pureed into barbecue sauce. Still, true lovers of that caliente feeling will probably wonder where all that legendary fire went to.

I was extremely disappointed with this order.  I really think i got ripped on it. Dont buy this please dont. I got these and made a salsa and batch a chili with these peppers. I used regular dried and i soaked them for a while and still there no hotter then cyan pepper. I ADDED 25 OF THEM TO CHILI AND 14 TO SALSA NO HEAT DO NOT BUY THESE BIG NO NO

I was very excited to try this pepper and make some ghost pepper jelly. I cannot say how dissapointed I was. If not for the flavor it would be a total waste of time and money. There is no heat at all. I have had hotter bell pepper jelly. There is no denying that there is very good flavor but no heat at all.

column9: Did not like this tea at all
column10: I was surprised when I tasted this tea for the first time, I thought I would love this combination but all I tasted was a fake orange taste.  No chocolate, no green tea, just a acid orange taste.  Then I tried another tea bag and I got the same taste.  I did not like the taste and I would not recommend this tea to any one, sorry.

At first this tea may sound like a strange combination, this mostly can be summed into one question: chocolate TEA? I was apprehensive, but all the flavors are appealing separately, so why not put them together? I love Revolution Tea, I always find them to have to freshest, most flavorful tea. I even bought expensive loose leaf tea and it wasn't nearly as good as Revolution Tea. Revolution never seemed to disappoint me, so even though I didn't know what to make of this flavor, I decided to try it anyway.I'm glad I did try it! This tea is absolutely AMAZING! The main flavor is the green tea, with a hint of citrus and the smoothness of chocolate! The aroma's the best part; it smells just like warm chocolate! I took it to work and shared it with my coworkers and they loved it as well! They always ask if I have more with me!If you like green tea and chocolate, TRY THIS TEA! It's my new favorite and I always keep at least 3 boxes at home now!

I started subscribing to this when I tasted once. But, they have changed the ingredients now, no more real chocolate and real stuff. Its all flavors now. Cancelled the subscription and searching for a good tea :-(

The combination of chocolate and orange in a green tea is different and exciting. It is still green tea, but the accents are there. It is good with or without a sweetener added. It is good both cold (iced) or hot. It is also double sealed with a reclosable zip-lock top so it doesn't get stale sitting unopened in the box or opened. The servings are generous. The bags are not the usual fine paper teabags, so it brews better although there will be more "dust" in the teapot because of that.

I found this tea at a Pilot store and fell in love with it.  It has become the only tea I drink.  Chocolate seems like such an unlikely item for tea, but it's perfect.  This tea makes me feel so special, good for anytime I want to have a cup of tea.
This tea is nice. It is different than any other tea that I have ever tried before. It has very mild flavors. But an exceptional green tea taste.

This tea is great!!  Just the right amount of natural sweetness without adding sugar and the chocolate and orange tastes are very natural, not at all artificial.  I was a bit apprehensive when I first tried this tea at a local coffee shop because it sounded so unusual, but once I had a cup I was hooked. If you like green tea you will love this blend!!

column9: Love to use it as an air freshener
column10: I discovered this tea at a Pilot Truck Stop when I was on a trip recently. I fell in love with it. I even used the package that the diffuser came in to freshen my car!

column9: Wonderfully delicious and easy to brew.
column10: This tea has the perfect flavor.  The orange chocolate is a subtle combination and a wonderful treat at the end of a long day.  The sachets make brewing a breeze (though keep in mind that they don't have an attached string to tie over the side).  I do consider this tea a little on the expensive side, but I think it's totally worth it given the taste.

I enjoy Bewely's enormously. I drink a variety of teas from the "fancy fruity" type to the "high mountain picked by monkeys in the mist" teas but I always come back to Bewley's for an excellent sit down and drink to enjoy tea. It's great with food, it's great by it's self. it's good without any additives, or fabulous with a bit of honey and soy milk. It's a steady, reliable daily drinkable tea!
I couldn't do without this in the mornings.  It packs the same punch as  does coffee, but is more gentle on the stomach.  Always quickly delivered.  Thanks for a great product.

I absolutely love this tea and cannot do without at least 2 cups in the morning.  My grocery store sells it so I get it there.  However, it is great to see it here in case they stop carrying it.  It is a strong tea, but is perfect for the mornings.

About seven years ago I quit drinking coffee. I happened to be in Ireland at the time, switched to Dublin Morning Tea and have never looked back. I've tried a lot tea, but this one is perfect-full-bodied and a tiny bit smokey, but no perfume. Thank you Bewley's, thank you Africa, thank you internet for getting each and every day off to a perfect start. Two bags in a giant mug of steaming water, an inch of milk and the world is a better place.

column9: Bewley's (and Barry's too) are my favorites.
column10: This blend was my first experience drinking Bewley's tea.  I found that I liked it very much.  Loved it,that is.  There was one cup of it that I felt was probably the best tea I'd EVER tasted, but I've never been able to duplicate the flavor of that one cup!  --Have found that my tea is best if I make it in a pot instead of a cup and carefully follow basic classic good tea-making instructions, i.e., pour boiling water in the pot to prepare it beforehand, then when tea-water is boiling, pour out the hot water from the teapot, put in tea-bags (1 to each 8 ounces of water), pour in the boiling tea-water, place the lid, let steep 4 or 5 minutes.  It seems that Tea made in a pot comes out mellower, less harsh-tasting than in a cup.  Still, I keep getting different flavor results with each different pot of tea I make.  Very mysterious problem.  Maybe I need to time the process precisely with each cup or batch and note down the results of each different timing, then see if the timing produces a consistent result every time.(I used to flavor my tea with honey, but now I prefer Xylitol sugar substitute which is mild but satisfying, has less calories, and possibly is healthier.)I also love Barry's Tea.  Both Bewley's and Barry's are my super-favorites.  (Not available in my grocery so am happy that I can order both brands through Amazon and can get super-saver no-shipping-fee.)

I will buy this again. Such a convienice to be about to order it right on line instead of running around to different stores trying to find it. Which I have a hard time doing. Awesome tea , try it you will like it , that's if you like a tea that is a little big stronger. I am not a big fan of anything strong but this has such a good flavor.

This is nice tea. It's strong, bold, and crisp. I don't like sissy teas or coffees. They must be BOLD. I drink my teas straight - no milk, sugar, or lemon - so I have to like the tea itself, not additional flavoring. It isn't the best tea I've had, but it's much better than Lipton and similar weak/watery teas.
To sip a cup of this with sugar and cream, makes me long to go back to Ireland for a visit. Bewley's is the best tea on market. Amazon is the place to purchase, fast service at a reasonable price.

Ah, such a delightful tea! Bewley's is our household's staple English Breakfast tea! As avid tea drinkers, that is saying a lot. It beats PG Tips and Yorkshire in flavour by far. With or without adding milk and sugar, its a fabulous tea and you WILL NOT be disappointed.
Bewley's Dublin Morning Tea is a replacement for Dublin Tea Company's Irish Breakfast Tea.I have been looking for a pure Kenyan Breakfast Tea for a while and this appears to be the answer.

I hope Amazon changes the heading from 30 to 80 count; this price for 30 count would be ridiculous.My doctor directed switching from coffee to tea.  He is no longer my physician but I began with Twinnings Irish and English breakfast teas; finally, I found Bewley's.  My breakfast tea style emerged into drinking one batch of 2 bags of Irish breakfast tea, for its strength, followed by using one bag of English breakfast tea an hour later.  Today I use Dublin morning tea-bags, 2 then 1 of course.  It falls in between these two breakfast tea types, slightly milder than Irish but perceptibly stronger than English...and still smooth.The physician made an erroneous assumption about my coffee habit.  I had only been drinking 6 ounces every morning, for years; occasionally decaf cappuccino after dinner.  He probably would have not recommended the switch to tea.  I am happy to have found a strong excellent tea, and have been on Bewley's for a year.  It is smoother and stronger than Twinnings, in my opinion, and about the same price.  A winner all around.If you drink your coffee as espresso, cappuccino, or french press, you will appreciate this strong smooth tea.

column9: Former morning coffee drinker gives 5 stars for new brew.
column10: A while back, I began drinking hot tea instead of coffee in the mornings to cut down on the "jitters" I get from the latter.  Now, I'm the type of person who doesn't take on new habits lightly.  So I began trying many popular brands and blends to try and decide which I like best.  Included were blends from Twinings, PG Tips, Barry's, Bigelow, Taylors of Harrogate, Devonshire Tea, Celestial, and (of course) Bewley's.  Of all the blends I've tried, Bewley's Dublin Morning Tea is by far my favorite.  I don't miss drinking coffee every morning, but actually crave this tea instead.Bewley's Dublin Morning Tea is a very robust tea, somewhat similar to an Irish Breakfast blend in my opinion.  I enjoy it with sugar and milk.
This is a wonderful black tea. A strong, smooth black tea that is perfect with milk and sugar. A great way to wake up in the morning or for a civilized afternoon break.
Lovely aroma and some strong flavour just the cup you need in the morning.highly recomended
Strong, flavorful tea. Not sure if it's the same tea I drank in Ireland, but I like to pretend. It seems a bit pricey, but as a treat, it is worth it.

The Feline Organizational Committee in my house has informed its employee that this is an acceptable product. They previously complained about everything except Natural Value with Albacore and this one. You do not want to be in this house when they are complaining.As for my research, so far as I know there are no additives. This company does not fool around with the product or try to make it pretty for me or stretch it with inedible filler. They provide real fish and real crab (in a small amount of clear fishy jelly). That's fine with me. I don't want additives that make things colorful and eventually kill my cats. I don't want to look at it, they don't see in color, and all they want to do is smell it and eat it. And when they are happy, I am sooo relieved. Keep up the good work!

column9: Our picky cats love this food.
column10: They are not so wild about the pate style flavors but all of the red meat tuna topped with something (crab, mackerel, etc.) are the most successful selections we have ever had in our household.  We used to feed them only dry food, having been advised by a vet long ago this was better for their teeth.  Recently, our vet who is a dental specialist has revised that opinion, saying that cat teeth are not designed for the kind of crushing most dry food requires, and may lead to dental disease and breakage in cats with vulnerable mouths.  So we have switched to wet food, requiring considerable trial and error to find a brand they would accept, and we're happy with Natural Value's healthy ingredients.
My cats would not eat this flavor, I had to give it away to a friend. While Im not saying this product is bad in any way, if your cat is picky, it may not like this flavor.

I give my kitty this every once in a while as a treat but I don't make this his main meal because he's prone to bladder crystal formation and fish tends to make it worse.This is VERY fishy tuna and you need to transfer whatever you don't use into another container because the metal container will make the fish taste like metal if you try to save it in the original can (which is pretty gross).My cat DOES love this stuff but he gets bored of it if I give him too much and then he gives it the ol' "paw-shake flip-off".His favorite feast by this company is the chicken pate which I mix with organic pumpkin and he loves that.Here's to all of our kitties living long and happy lives! AMEN! :)

column9: Great price for a truly healthy product
column10: I love this pineapple.  Right now Amazon's price is pretty comparable to what I pay at Costco for this.  My problem with a lot of fruit snacks is you think you are getting something healthy, but the way they process it makes it not so.  This product is truly healthy!  It is organic and it is not processed with sulphur.  I think it tastes amazing!  It is sweet and juicier than any dried pineapple I've ever had.  Yes, it is not going to drip with juice because it is DRIED pineapple, but it is definitely moist and tasty.  It is a bit brown, but isn't that to be expected?  This is an organic, all natural product that is actually good for you.  If that is what matters to you, get this.  If you care more about looks and cosmetic features of your food, then I'd recommend going the sulphur route where your pineapple will look super pretty but be more unhealthy.

column9: I love that this isn't sugared and actually tastes like pineapple
column10: This isn't some sweet candy like sugared pineapple, so if you want that, look elsewhere, this actually tastes like pineapple, and I love fresh pineapple plain so this really appeals to me.
love this pineapple. taste super good. havent found anything better than this. some of the pineapple in certain bag are softer. But overall they taste awesome

column9: Delicious dried pineapple in a good size package
column10: I really appreciate that this is available in a large size. I hate wasting all the little plastic bags of single-serving size packages. The dried pineapple is really delicious and organic. Some of the chunks get a little brown, but I tend to like those more because they are more moist. I will certainly buy this again.

I have tried a few different brands of dried pineapple and this is definately the best I've ever had. It is not too dry, it is nice and moist, almost juicy. They are also very consistent meaning the entire bag is full of perfect dried pineapple. Most brands are very inconsistent with lots of hard pieces. Made in Nature is the best.

Excellent pineapple.  Small pieces that are the right size.  The pieces are thin, soft and chewy. No added sugar.  Product of Costa Rica, hopefully they follow strick organic practices.  Very easy to eat the whole bag within a day or two.  Will be buying again.  I have found that Made in Nature brand to sell excellent tasty items.

These are the most delicious dried pineapple pieces I've ever eaten. I order them every month. They are super sweet, organic and packed with immense flavor. Because they are not processed with chemicals, some of them have a light brown coating. But don't let that fool you. They are the best! Highly recommend.

AMAZING FLAVOUR - NO OTHER PRODUCT I'VE TRIED COMES CLOSE TO THIS - IT'S TOTALLY WORTH THE PRICE - ONCE RE-CONSTITUTED YOU'D THINK YOU WERE EATING PIECES OF FRESH PINEAPPLE SLICES -GREAT IN MORNING STEEL CUT OATS!

Dried pineapple doesn't resemble the juicy morsels pictured on the package and all are quite unattractive, but wow, these are a real taste treat, much better than others I've tried from Amazon. This is a quality product.

This is by far the best organic dried pineapple I have ever had the pleasure to consume!  And as Aurora said, it's not about how it looks, but the quality and taste for a truly good for you product. Got it at Costco for @ ten dollars a pkg., but maybe they'll make it available through Subscribe and Save (hint, hint, AMAZON)
This dried pineapple is of very good quality. The pineapple pieces are of a good size and moist.My 6 year old daughter loves them,and requests them for her school snack pack.

I love these dried pineapple pieces. I've been trying to move to a healthier diet and reduce or eliminate my use of products that use refined sugar. So many dried pineapple snacks contain sugar, but these don't, they're just natural dried pineapple. I love the taste and the convenience. The only problem I've encountered is that I need to put a handful in a small bowl before I start eating. If I eat them right out of the bag it's too tempting to just finish the whole bag!

column9: Okay, but not nearly as good as whole fruit
column10: I really like whole fruit pineapple and usually eat about two pineapples per month.  This is the first time that I have tried dried pineapple.  Overall, I was unimpressed with this product.  Since this is the first time that I have had dried pineapple, I cannot say if my disappointment is because of this particular brand or not.  I expected a stronger burst of pineapple taste, but this product was relatively bland.  I was also surprised that this dried fruit was less sweet-tasting than I expected, even though it is highly concentrated in sugar (as are all dried fruits).  The individual pieces are relatively soft and small.  They are also sticky, such that there was essentially one large mass of pieces stuck to together when the bag was first opened.  The individual pieces can be separated easily.

In case you con not picture it, 144 bubbles are a lot of bubbles.  We had a wedding with 150 people and it was more than enough.  They are about 3 inches tall by 1 inch wide.  They are cute, did not spill before the reception, and the guests enjoyed them.

Item is exactly what you would expect. Little bottles shaped like wedding cakes with a little pull top out for the wand. Shipped very fast, and packed well, this was exactly what I was hoping to get with the purchase!
Just as I wanted! Perfect for my wedding. Much MUCH cheaper then other sites. The boxes came in sets of 12. All shaped as wedding cakes. SO CUTE!

column9: Easy, Quick, and Tasty BBQ Smoked Ribs
column10: I have ordered this a few times over the past couple years. It is always a crowd pleaser.  Everything is precooked - all you have to do is heat and eat.  The ribs are fantastic.  I have also gotten the BBQ combo - The ribs are very meaty and the smoke is perfect.  Considering shipping is included, these are nicely priced. I have sent Burgers ribs and combos to family members as gifts and all have raved about them.  I have not tried the hams, sausages, bacon etc just the BBQ sampler and the ribs so far.  I would definately buy again.

My husband and I have tried several brands of instant decaf, none to our liking until we found this.  Since we only drink decaf in the evenings we finally gave up wasting our money until my husband came across Mount Hagen in a grocery store.  To our surprise it made the best cup of decaf we ever had (including ground.)  It is a deep, rich smooth and satisfying cup of coffee.  Very flavorful.  If having a supply of great tasting decaf on hand is useful to you, you can't find better.

column9: Best decaf coffee- simply the best brand for instant coffee
column10: There are many claims for best instant coffee, and I have tried many of the top priced brands.  The Mount Hagen brand, both decaf and caffeinated, is excellent.  Sometimes, I do not have the time to grind fresh beans, and I have sent a lot money trying various top end brands.  A little disheartened with The result, so many lack a good solid and smooth coffee taste, I actually bought a box of the 25 sachets rather than a jar.  And boy was I shocked to discover that both the decaf and caffeinated were excellent.  In fact, the decaffeinated had just the right strong and smooth flavor of excellent ground coffee beans: one would have thought you just ground them and it did not taste watery or weak.  I kid you not.  The amazon save and subscribe is a great price!  Thank you.

I really like this decaf. As others have mentioned, it is very smooth. I really love that it is organic. I drink quite a bit of decaf because I love coffee but cannot handle caffeine more than once per day.Here is my only issue with this coffee. It is a *very* light roast. If you like a darker roasted coffee, or even slightly dark roasted coffee, this is not the one for you. This is considered a "city roast", which is very light. Even if it were slightly darker, I would buy it again. As it is, I probably will not buy it again because there are a few other options out there. I thought that I would mention this because it is difficult to tell from the photo.

This is a pretty darn good freeze-dried coffee. As it's the only organic decaffeinated freeze-dried that I'm aware of, there's not much to compare it to aside from good quality drip coffee. My only qualm with it, is the cap. Flimsy plastic that snaps on, instead of twists on, which doesn't seem like it'll keep any air out of the jar. I'm hoping the coffee doesn't end up tasting stale in a few weeks. Another thing to keep in mind is that the serving recommendation for one cup is 1 leveled teaspoon, which definitely isn't enough (leaves the coffee tasting watered-down). I'd recommend 1.5 tsps, which leaves the coffee tasting pretty solid, though the servings per jar then drop from 60 to 40. I'd definitely consider purchasing this product again, and luckily, with this bulk order, that won't have to be for another 6 months!

column9: G R E A T.......C O F F E E....!
column10: Warm, rich, deeply satisfying -- that is what Mount Hagen Organic Freeze-Dried Instant Decaffeinated Coffee tastes like!  A strong brew, but not overly so, with just a hint of sweetness!  Totally superb -- this is COFFEE!  Additional benefits, of course, arethat it is instant coffee, decaffeinated, and organic.  But....mmmm!  That taste!  Totally terriffic!  (I bought only one jar somewhere else -- it went SO fast!  The "six-pack" here on Amazon is a great idea!)P.S.:  For the BEST taste in ANY instant coffee, let the water boil as LONG as possible.  For the best taste in any TEA, let the water boil for as SHORT a time as possible.  (In her books on the British Royal Family, Marion Crawford reports how Queen Mary would stand at the tea kettle, and take it off as SOON as it started to boil.  For tea.  But for a truly "royal treat" in Instant Coffee, my suggestion is to this scrumptious Mount Hagen Decaffeinated Freeze-Dried instant.  I son't think a better decaffeinated instant can be found anywhere!

I don't care much for the "Caffeine Buzz", since I don't really feel it. So, I drink coffee for the taste of it. Naturally, I drink decaf -- it's healthier, and again, why have caffeine if you don't benefit from it anyway? I read about Mount Hagen about 2 months ago -- and that's how long I've been drinking it. The taste is very close to a good brewed coffee and ten times better than a gas-station-grade one. I use more than "one level teaspoon" per cup, as I'm sure most people do -- it's a decaf, isn't it?;)I just bought 6-jar pack for an unbelievable price, with the current Amazon promo + free shipping. But I'd buy it with or without discount -- that's how good it is. The funny thing is, when you just open a jar, it doesn't smell nearly as delicious as any of it's competitors. Than you put a heaping spoon of it in the cup and poor boiling water on top... As a matter of fact, I'm about to do it now!Peace.

As someone who loves high-quality freshly ground coffee, I'm pretty hard to please when it comes to instant. While I can't say this is as good as an expensive, high-quality, freshly ground, brewed coffee, I can certainly say that it is better than any of the store brands of pre-ground brewed coffee! That's pretty hard to find in an instant coffee -- let alone DECAF instant. This is an excellent replacement for brewed coffee when you're in a hurry or you just want to make 1 cup. (And it tastes better than most K-Cups so there's no need to buy an expensive machine that brews single cups.) I use a bit more per serving than it says in order to have a very robust and flavorful cup of coffee.The only thing I don't like about Mount Hagen is the cap on the jar. It snaps on rather than screws on, which doesn't create a tight seal. Because this is freeze-dried, the coffee does stay fresh even without the tight seal, but I usually like to reuse old jars and it's a shame that I have to recycle these otherwise nice, square glass jars.

column9: Really, No One Will Believe You Didn't Brew It
column10: This is a superb instant decaf:  taste and smell are superb.  No bitter notes.  No "chemically" decaf taste or formaldehyde--it's naturally decaffeinated via a carbon dioxide process.  It's organic, and it tastes like it.  Mellow, deeply colored, and delicious.Another great feature is that you can make each cup to just the right intensity for every drinker's preference (I keep a small teaspoon-sized scoop in the container).  My husband jokes that I like nothing but what he calls "Cajun coffee" (brewed black, hot, and strong) while he likes his with a lighter touch.  Nice to both be able to enjoy our coffee together, without ever having to brew a pot just to "water it down."I've secretly served it to some friends who are fellow coffee snobs.  They never noticed the difference & one actually argued that it couldn't possibly be either decaf or instant--he would know.  Without a doubt.  So Wrong!This is a great German import--you've got to taste it to believe it & Amazon's Subscribe & Save price is excellent.  A great find!

column9: Disappointed after all the great reviews
column10: After reading all the glowing reviews, I decided to take the plunge and get a case of the Mount Hagen Instant Decaf. My first cup was a weird experience...wasn't sure if I made it wrong or if it had gone stale. Opened another jar and it was the same; weak, flavorless coffee, almost like drinking tea. The only things I liked about the coffee are that 1) it's organic and 2) it has ZERO aftertaste or bitter finish. I tried doubling and tripling the amounts and then it just tasted like sludge. If you like a weaker coffee or are coming from old-school instant, then this would be a good choice. Even my wife (who is more of a tea drinker) commented on how smooth, but extremely bland this coffee is.I prefer a stronger cup of coffee (not darker; my preference is a french-press medium roast from freshly ground beans). I guess back to VIA it is. I despise most of Starbuck's coffee, but VIA is surprisingly good.

column9: The Finest Coffee For Your Money
column10: I've been drinking this coffee DAILY for a long time and I never get tired of it.  It's got rich, full flavor, but doesn't have the acids and burnt taste that a lot of coffees get because everyone wants to make their coffee like Starbucks.  It's great value and it tastes like freshly brewed coffee every single time.I LOVE this coffee!  I drink the caffeinated version in the AM and the decaf in the PM.  Order and be overjoyed with coffee you can DRINK without the bitter and nasty mouth taste and acid stomach that other coffees bring.100% A+!

column9: Mount Hagen Organic Freeze Dried Instant Decaffeinated Coffee

Mount Hagen Organic Freeze Dried Instant Decaf Coffee (made in Germany) is satisfying both of my needs - excellent taste and quality. this is the best decaf coffee ever. it makes delicious iced drinks as well as hot ones. i signed up for the for automatic delivery deal (they will send it every 6 months) and the price ended up to be only $6.77 a jar -- which is about half of what these jars go for at whole foods. best deal ever! think about it -- a whole jar of mount hagen (which for me makes about 30 "large" drinks, because i use more than the 'serving size' listed on the back of the jar) for the price of TWO starbucks lattes.... yes, quite a deal!

column4: Quilts for Sale - Maria Michaels Designs - Th...
column10: This is wonderfully delicious coffee! I haven't been able to drink coffee at all for the past 40 years. After finding and trying Mount Hagen Organic Decaf I can drink it and enjoy it again. Even the caffeine lovers in my family like this one!

column9: Good Instant Coffee - Organic is a bonus!
column10: This is good coffee.  I use instant, as I have found it saves me considerable money (and calories)over getting a latte or mocha everyday.  I couldn't find this coffee locally, so I thought I would try it through Amazon. It has good flavor.  If you like it stoong, just use more.  I would buy this again.  This seems to be a little bit expensive over other decaf instant brands -- thus the reason for only 4 stars.

Again, great for later in the evening when you don't want all that caffeine before bed....love the fact that it is organic, easy and good tasting to boot.  Great pricing on the 6 pack too at Amazon.com

I love Mount Hagen instant coffee, both the regular and the decaf!  I have been drinking Mount Hagen for several years.  I started with the regular and when I got pregnant, I switched to decaf.  It makes wonderful iced coffee and I love being able to make a fresh glass of iced coffee without having to make a whole pot of coffee.  The decaf is freeze dried, so it doesn't have the chemicals in it that most decaf coffee has.  I highly recommend Mount Hagen and the decaf is perfect for those who are avoiding caffeine. I have been using this for the last three years.  It tastes good is worth the money.  Most decaffeinated coffees have a little caffeine in them.  Even a little caffeine will keep me from sleeping.  This doesn't.

column9: I put away my Mr. Coffee.
column10: I stopped buying expensive (for me) Starbucks coffee and put away my Mr. Coffee after I received this item.  This order has lasted me years and the coffee is fantastic. Gorgeous flavor for an Instant. We continue to buy these at 6 at a pop. Always impressed with Amazon's service and the coffee's taste.
Excelent coffee - it will taste much better if you use destilled water, not tap or bottle water.
price is ok, convenience is great, taste is good for an instant. will continue to buy.
This coffee is great. It tastes great and desolves quickly. I use it everyday to make ice coffee. Great for travel and for a quick cup of joe. Just recently bought more. Love it!!
I love this coffee so much.I bought this at whole foods, over $11 per jar.Amazon's deal is much cheaper than retails. I strongly recommend this item.

column9: a truly outstanding decaf instant coffee
column10: I have searched far and wide  for a decaf instant coffee since i realized my stomach could no longer tolerate acidic coffees.Tried them all including Kava and the barley instants and had bad reactions from them all.Finally,thank God I stumbled on the Mt Hagen organic freeze dried and after a few weeks drinking it once daily (12 oz mug) with very hot boiling distilled water I knew I had found the right one.I have never ordered coffee by the case in my life but 2 weeks ago I ordered a case.You will not belive the taste of this product. Its is as good or better than any coffee brewed by any method including bean grinders.Body,sweetness,& flavor all in one coffee without the acid or caffeine & without having to brew it!Thank you so much Mt Hagen

I have been using this coffee for 2 years. It tastes like fresh brewed, without any bitter after taste. My brother-in-law tried it on vacation and was amazed that it tasted better than his fresh brewed coffee. I love it.
We love this coffee because it makes a perfect glass of iced coffee, just the way we like it!  Have reordered several times and will continue to do so.

Did some comparison taste testing and this came out on top.  Organic and great flavor without the caffeine.  No surprise that Amazon is far cheaper than Whole Paycheck (aka Whole Foods.)  You'd think that making instant coffe is intuitive. There is a another counter intuitive way.  Many decades ago a young Greek gentlemen in Athens showed a way to make instant coffee that is still my preferred method.  Maybe because I grew up in London I prefer to boil my water on a stove top over nuking it.  While the water heats mix the instant coffee, granulated sweetener of choice (Splenda for me) and if using a non dairy creamer powder that as well into a thick paste with a little of the water that is heating.  Then when the water achieves a rolling boil pour into the cup and stir.  This method results in a nice foam (creama) on top that just pouring water on the coffee granules and then adding sweetener and creamer will not achieve.  Enjoy.

I was searching to find an organic, decaf, instant coffee and this is the only one I could find.  I read the reviews and saw how wonderful everyone thought it was so I tried it and am so glad I did.  This is by far the ABSOLUTE BEST coffee I have ever had in my life!  It is so flavorful that you use much less than you would on a generic coffee so don't be scared away by the oz/$ comparison to other coffees, your health is worth the tiny bit more it costs.  Oh, it is so good and me being sensitive to caffeine, I use so very little in my cup but it flavors it so well.  The price is EXCELLENT as I've seen them cost $10-$12 in various health food stores.  I have several cases onhand and will continue to stock up before the end times arrive.  It would make super gifts for others that are trying to watch their health.
It's not easy to find organic decaf instant coffee.  This one is great - tastes much better than the usual brands of instant decaf because it doesn't have that bitter aftertaste.
I have had a problem finding a non-acidic coffee, but this is the one.  Previously purchased at Whole Foods at a higher price.  Great coffee, great price and it is delivered to your door.

We always buy decaf coffee and it tastes like it, when we started to buy Mount Hagen coffee, it was as if it was not decaf, great flavor and it  is a favorite with our friends and family. I buy in a six pack, this way we are are never out of it

Hunts should make this available.  When I questioned Walmart store manager, he said to write to Hunts. haven't opened a can yet. they are still in the cans. i don't know if they are good or bad. i bought them for the future. frequently, i use a crock pot to cook food. i just pour in vegetables and let them slowly cook. keep it simple stupid. vegetables in a pot is delicious. sometimes i add spaghetti sauce. sometimes i add fish , chicken or beef. iv'e come up with some good combinations.

column9: Very Good Bloody Mary Mix - Highly Recommended!
column10: "Mr & Mrs T's Bloody Mary Mix" is our favorite off-the-shelf Bloody Mary mix and these 5.5oz cans are very convenient. We use the less expensive larger bottles if we know our guests will be having Bloody Marys but like these cans for single servings since the larger bottles need to be refrigerated after being opened.We add a little more than 1oz of Vodka (your taste may vary) and find that it really doesn't need anything else for most people. It is just spicy enough for my wife, but I put an extra shot of Tabasco Sauce in mine and my mother cuts hers with a little tomato juice to dilute the heat a little. These are also good straight (without any spirits added) and as substitute for tomato juice in cooking (particularly vegetable stock) to add an extra zing to your dishes.The 24 can case is a good value (especially if you have Prime or qualify for free Super Saver shipping) since we could only find them in smaller packs locally and at a much higher price per can.Highly Recommended!CFH

column9: One of the best Bloody Mary Mixes, though one of the most common
column10: I think you can probably get this at most grocery stores. It really is one of the best mixes for bloody mary's. You hardly have to add anything extra to make a reasonable bloody mary.  I usually add olives and pickle juice, though.

I developed an appreciation for this drink during my days of frequent airline travel. I prefer to drink them straight (without booze). As a result, I started buying bottles of the mix at the grocery store--because finding this by the can in the real world is impossible. IMPOSSIBLE. Unfortunately, when you buy this by the bottle something happens. The first glass tastes exactly as you expected. But  once you open the bottle, if you don't drink the contents within 24-36 hours the taste turns. Keeping a stock of cans in the house, therefore, is essential. I live in a major metropolitan area and I can't find these cans in any store. Not grocery stores (including mom & pop, big chains, high-end small chains, etc), not liquor stores (including corner stores or BevMo). Enter Amazon. I'm very grateful I can buy this by the can here on the interwebs. I personally prefer the smaller-size cans to the 11.5 ounce. Make sure to buy enough to qualify for super saver shipping.

From the amount of this stuff I order, the folks at Amazon must think I'm a serious alcoholic.  Truth is, I drink this because it's an extremely tasty Tomato Juice Cocktail!  No alcohol necessary.  Much tastier than V-8.  Try it!  You could even add alcohol, if it pleases you.

The cans make it portable (I carry them as a snack at work), and although I'm disappointed that Mr. & Mrs. T has apparently discontinued the 11.5 oz size I used to buy, this size works for me, too.

column9: This has hit bottom--used to be great
column10: Until recently (Spring 2012)Mr& MRS T's Original tasted like a tomato juice based scrumptous blody-mary mix. My wife and I enjoyed it. column4: Richard R. Capuozzo "owned by my dog Max"
column9: You'll like this product really well.
column10: This tastes pretty good and is worth the cost. I would prefer a little spicier taste but the convenience is great. I usually add more Vodka than they recommend but that's a personal thing. All in all, a convenient, good tasting product. I will buy again.

I can't tell you how many full sized bottles of bloody mary mix I've thrown away half full before buying a case of these. Ordered the Mr. & Mrs. T Bloody Mary Mix to complete a "FUN" Christmas package for several friends, which consisted of several cans ofthe mix,small container of "spirits" , a small package of Serrano peppers, and two nice sized Holiday Mugs...just a departure from the more common gifts one would select.

column9: A good Bloody Mary mix but you can easily make a Better One
column10: I have a Virgin Mary almost every day and a true Bloody Mary maybe once or twice a week. I've experimented with a lot of different tomato juices, hot sauces, and spices but I've only tried a few Bloody Mary mixes.I recently purchased both the Tabasco Spicy Bloody Mary mix and the Mr & Mrs T Spicy Bloody Mary mix to see what (if anything) I was missing. The Tabasco mix was simply horrid but the Mr & Mrs T was pretty good. It has a nice blend of heat versus sweetness (tomatoes working against hot peppers). However any other flavors (if they exist) seemed lost in the Mr & Mrs Ts mix. A true three star product - good but not great.I'd recommend Mr/Mrs Ts to anyone who MUST purchase a mix. It's a good one. But I don't recommend you purchase any mix!.I'd recommend a simple recipe using just two ingredients - your preferred tomato juice and a great hot sauce but the devil, of course, is in the details..SIMPLE BLOODY MARY RECIPE - Two Ingredients:1.) Tomato Juice or V8 juice - I prefer the low sodium variety of V8 but that is NOT a critical factor. Use whatever juice you like.Actually the lowest priced cans of tomato juice at my local supermarket have proven really excellent! Go figure.2.) A High Quality Hot Sauce. Using a better than average hot sauce is absolutely key. I strongly recommend (if you do not already have a favorite) one of the following (I've taste tasted about 30 different ones and below is my short list of favorites which are also readily available:My LIST of "High Quality" Hot sauces:  a) Huy Fong Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce - This sauce has considerable heat but it is nicely balanced with a bit of sweetness combined with a hint of garlic. It really makes the virgin/bloody mary quite special. Virtually every supermarket carries it - look in the Asian section! b) Cholula Original Hot Sauce - features a fine blend of peppers - medium hot and readily available - look in the Mexican section c) Tapatio Hot Salsa Picanta - another widely distributed and excellent Mexican Hot sauce. Once again you will find this in your Mexican isle. d) Tabasco Chipotle hot sauce - a well know, national brand. The Chipotle pepper is smoked and has a unique flavor. Widely available and worth a try. There are many other brands of Chipotle sauces. e) El Yacateco GreenThat is simple as it gets. A juice and a dash of a really good hot sauce. This is not only far better than the Tabasco mix (which is horrid) but it is also better than the Mr/Mrs Ts Bloody Mary mix!An added bonus of mixing your own ----- you can adjust the heat level to your individual preferences. You can't do that with a mix.Have some fun by adding Worchester sauce, horseraddish, etc to your home mix

Took a bottle along on a camping trip, looking forward to a drink with dinner after being out on a trail all day. YUK. Its generic. The best Bloody Mary mix I have ever had out of bottle came from a Bass Pro Shop in Indiana.
I've been concerned with the quality of dog food lately, and was very happy to find this. No fillers and my dog loves it!

These noodles are for anyone who is working to eat healthfully and loves pasta! They are delicious and make the best and only subsitute for regular pasta, so much so that there's nothing to miss but the extra calories! One whole bag of these noodles only have 40 calories. Give these noodles a try, and you won't be disappointed. I know *I'm* never going back to the real thing!

I found a link to the tofu shirataki in an article on MSN.com talking about foods to stay away from.  Of course they weren't talking about staying away from the tofu shirataki noodles, but to steer clear on pasta, even whole wheat, claiming it to be a glorified junk food that quickly turns to sugar once digested.  Being Italian and an avid pasta fan, I quickly "googled" and found a link to Amazon.com on www.house-foods.com.  I ordered 5 packages of the noodles, because I have been eating health food for awhile and despite the poor reviews, I was ready to give these a shot.  I am so glad that I did.  They are like tough spaghetti.  By tough I do not mean, tire rubber, but more like over cooked.  That doesn't bother me at all.  I cooked them in marinara sauce, put them in broth and made an Asian style soup and served them with teriyaki chicken.  These things are so versatile and fabulous.  I am on weight watchers and an entire bag of these noodles has 0 points and only 40 calories with 4 grams of fiber.  You can't ask for a better alternative to pasta.  The expiration date is about 4 months from when you order, so you don't have to gobble them up immediately. It also makes stocking up more convenient.  I will be stocking up on these indefinitely!  My only complaint is that shipping is kinda high, but I guess they do have to be cold packed to stay fresh.

I am addicted to shirataki noodles. No joke! If you check out lowcarbfriends.com, there is a thread I started in the main lobby. We've had over 20,000 hits, and there are almost 600 posts. The majority of the posts are from people who are now eating shirataki noodles, instead of pasta. It's great for losing weight, adding fiber to your diet and like tofu, they taste like whatever seasoning or sauce you use with them. I have them five out of seven days a week.There are some recipes on the thread on lowcarbfriends, including noodle pudding (kugel), spaghetti pie, among others. These noodles are the BEST!

These noodles taste great, although the texture is a little different than regular spaghetti noodles.  Be warned, if you do eat the whole bag (a serving size is half the bag) they tend to sit like a rock in your stomach.  I've used these in soup as well as with spaghetti sauce.  The nutritional information is what really blows me away - no sugar, very little sodium, and for those of us on weight watchers, the entire bag is 0 points.  I just wish I could find them in a local grocery store.

I lived in Japan for many years & really enjoyed using these "noodles" in soups, stir-fry, Korean-style cooking, etc.  If you are looking for pasta, these may not exactly match your craving, but are nonetheless really versatile!  My advice for those who don't like the smell upon opening the package is to drain them, sprinkle liberally with salt & rub through with clean hands, then rinse in cold water.  This is how they prepare them in Japan - it removes any odor & they are ready to use.

column4: Livin' La Vida Low-Carb Man "Jimmy Moore"
column10: I expect 2006 to be a breakout year for shirataki noodles because people want to eat heathier and better by choosing foods that help them cut down on the carbs without sacrificing the taste and texture they adore. It's a delicate balance, but shirataki noodles are proving it can be done.I've already tried the Konjac brand of shirataki noodles and reviewed them for you last week. Now let me introduce you to another kind of shirataki noodles that are quite different from the Konjac brand. They're from a company called House Foods.House Foods Tofu Shirataki noodles are a unique combination of tofu and polysaccharide glucomannan (yam flour) to provide a genuinely authentic pasta texture that you frankly just don't get from the Konjac brand. I was extremely surprised by the House Foods brand and would definitely choose this brand over Konjac in a side-by-side comparison -- DEFINITELY!What's so different about the House Foods Tofu Shirataki noodles?For starters, each 4-ounce serving (2 servings per bag) has just 20 calories and a neglible 1g net carbs (3g total carbs minus 2g of dietary fiber). While that's not ZERO, it's certainly not bad, especially considering the trade-off you make in the texture of these noodles. These are perfect for every phase of livin' la vida low-carb for a nutritious and delicious pasta alternative.Also, they are sugar-free, gluten-free, cholesterol-free, dairy-free, and even have 10% calcium. What could be better?When I opened my bag of Noodle Shaped House Foods Tofu Shirataki for supper tonight, I immediately smelled the infamous fishy odor from them as I have come to expect from this product. But don't let that deter you away from enjoying the final version of this product, though, because the smell does go away quickly once you have rinsed them off and warmed them up for a few minutes either in boiling water or in the microwave.After draining the noodles in a collander, I transferred them to a bowl, sprinkled some garlic Alsosalt on them, and poured my favorite no sugar added spaghetti sauce on top. Mixing the noodles together with the sauce, I warmed it up in the microwave for about 2 minutes. Then I added some pepperoni slices and mozarella cheese on top and cooked it in the microwave for an additional minute. Mmmmmm. This looks so good!Voila! My low-carb House Foods Tofu Shirataki pasta dish was complete and it was time to eat.Since I had already tried another brand of shirataki noodles previously, I was expecting them to be similar when I put them in my mouth. But imagine my surprise when I started chewing and noticed they were soft like real pasta and weren't as "chewy" as the other brands. WOW! Check it out, this is AWESOME dude! Can you imagine shirataki noodles getting any better than this? My wife said they reminded her of Oodles of Noodles when she looked at them.House Foods has certainly found their niche in the shirataki noodles market and I applaud them for providing consumers with a unique choice. While the other brands of shirataki noodles certainly aren't bad products, the House Foods Tofu Shirataki noodles are the only ones on the market today that provide the actual look and feel of real pasta without the carbs or calories! CONGRATULATIONS to them for doing such an excellent job with their products!And apparently the consumer seems to like House Foods Tofu Shirataki, too, because their Fettuccini Shaped and Noodle Shaped products are currently #1 and #2 respectively on the list of bestselling Gourmet Foods at Amazon.com. How about that?So go ahead, give 'em a try! All you have to lose is excess weight. Eating pasta on a "diet" never tasted so good, baby!We haven't heard the last of shirataki!

The Shirataki Noodles were awesome!!!!  My sister and I purchased 20 bags and they are almost gone, we cook them everyday!!!  Yes, they do have a funny odor when you first open the bag, DUMP THEM IN A STRAINER AND RUN COLD WATER OVER THEM FOR A MINUTE AND THEN BOIL THEM FOR LIKE 5 MINS!!!!  They are totally great!!!  I have made them with spaghetti sauce, stirfried (after being boiled) with veggies and shrimp.  Stirfried with veggies and parm cheese, just some teriyaki sauce and grilled chicken in a skillet!!!! Yes, they are a bit expensive when compared to pasta but i think of it as paying some extra bucks to remove some pounds off! I make sure I rinse them really well in cold water right before I boil them for around 5 minutes which removes all the bad smell! I just add some marinara sauce and it is a done deal! These noodles are a low carb, high protein alternative to regular pasta.  They are decent for stir frys and simple dishes.  I would not recommend them with a heavy sauce as it will not "cling" to the noodles.The noodles need to be rinsed before cooking.  This is very important unless you like fishy smelling food!  You can get these cheap at Trader Joes.

column9: Not that different from regular shirataki noodles, and they are much cheaper elsewheres
column10: These House Foods tofu shirataki noodles have only a small amount of soy flour in them - the konnyaku yam flour is still the main ingredient.I couldn't tell much of a difference between these tofu shirataki noodles and regular shirataki noodles - they may be just a bit softer, but not much.Shirataki noodles are not a hydrated starch paste like wheat noodles - instead they have the structure of a firm gel and are 96% water with only a tiny amount of the konnyaku yam flour (a long chain polysaccharide) holding it all together.The gel structure accounts for the mouth feel and chewing texture of the shirataki noodles.  This is also what makes them so filling without getting you all those calories.  The water soluble fiber of the yam flour is also not digested for the most part, and is very healthy for you.They do go great with a lot of different stuff - udon soup, tomato or pesto based spaghettis, etc.  I give five stars for the shirataki noodles.The main problem with the House Foods noodles listed here is their price, especially the exorbitant shipping charges.  House Foods is actually located in Southern California, and the listed seller is in New York!There are cheaper suppliers elsewhere.

These noodles are a little hard to take in the beginning - "rubbery" would best describe them.  However, seasoning is the key.  Serve them with grated parmesan or imitation parmesan, tomato sauce, olive oil, a little garlic, and you have a delicious meal.  It's a godsend for people who must watch their calories carefully and still crave to eat foods beyond vegetables.  As someone who has always had to watch her weight, I strongly recommend that you give them a chance.  And the fact that it's good for your health is another plus.  Try Whole Foods or Wild By Nature.  Less than $2.00.

We were skeptical, but they LOOKED like spaghetti, and they WERE on sale. Are we glad we took the plunge! If you drain and rinse them well, and dry them thoroughly after cooking and before saucing, the tremendous savings in calories and carbs will be well worth the differences from traditional pasta. And there are recipies at the manufacturer's Web site -- try the Cheesy Noodle Bake with reduced-fat cheese for a guilt-free mac'n'cheese substitute! If your local store doesn't have'em, order'em today. They're NOT exact substitutes for traditional pasta, but they're the best alternative we've found!

column9: I guess I just don't have the taste for them
column10: I had read about these noodles in Your Diet magazine and was intrigued.  I first called my local Whole Foods, but they didn't carry them.  I guess these are super-popular because the guy on the phone said that while they don't currently carry them, they plan to shortly because of the huge number of requests they had received.I placed my order and waited.  I worried that my perishible noodles were sitting somewhere rotting because it took FOREVER (over three weeks) for them to be delivered.  I finally got the box with 4 packets of noodles and a freezer dealy designed to keep them cool.I tried them the way the magazine recommended, heated in the microwave. I poured my beautiful homemade marinara on them, they turned into a watery mess.The heck with that. So when you get your package from UPS don't let them sit too long.)  They do smell when you first open them but if you spend any time rinsing/boiling them it's not an issue. I just ate the entire package, am full, and feel good that what I ate was super healthy!

I just tried the Tofu Shirataki noodles using pasta sauce. Yes, the sauce did slide off the noodles, but for a low carb, low calorie meal, it does not matter. The noodles taste good and they are filling.  No, they are not a substitute for real pasta, but again, that is not that important to me. You can purchase these noodles at Safeway Stores. column9: THE REAL SCOOP ON SHIRATAKI NOODLES!!
column10: Okay, so I heard about the amazing Shirataki noodle and decided to give it a try.  After MUCH research and deliberation I decided to try both the "miracle noodle" (zero calorie, glucomannan, no tofu) and the House Foods (40 calorie per bag, tofu and yam flour) varities.  BOTH arrived today, so I decided to try both and give an unbiased review.#1 - Anyone who says these noodles have a repulsive odor, has never eaten fish before.#2 - anyone who says these noodles have a repulsive texture, has never eaten ramen, or udon noodles before.I put a small pot of boiling water on the stove, brought to a boil.  Opened the bag, put noodles into a strainer, and rinsed 10-15 seconds under cold water.  Then I put the noodles in pot of boiling water.I purposely sniffed the bag.. and yes.. it has a medium to mild "fishy" odor, nothing worse than salmon.  If you don't like this, then don't sniff the bag.  The "miracle noodle" had slightly less of this odor.I purposely sniffed the boiling water after about 1 minute, and yes, it had an odor, not so much fishy anymore, as almost plastic-y.. kind of hard to describe... again, don't sniff the steam if this bothers you.After 3 minutes of boiling (for the House foods brand), and 2 mintues (for the miracle noodle brand), I poured into the strainer again, and rinsed with HOT water for 10 seconds.  I then drained, and put back into the small pot, and added half a flavor packet from a pack of ramen noodles (chicken flavor).IT TASTED JUST LIKE RAMEN!  I was very excited.  The noodles (as other reviews state) have no flavor on their own, but take on asian flavors nicely.  As for being a "spaghetti substitute," these would probably do the same as if you put ramen noodles under some spaghetti sauce.. not quite right.. but not the fault of the noodles, just not the intent of an asian noodle.As for the texture, these noodles actually get FIRMER as you cook them, instead of softer (like regular noodles).  If your're a fan of "al dente" pasta, then this is for you.  YES < they are a bit firm, but not hard like rubber bands (like other reviews have said).  And not slimy in the slightest, I don't get why people have said this (again, felt just like ramen noodles in my mouth).  I love al dente pasta myself, and found the texture preferable to normal ramen noodles.  The "miracle noodle" is slightly firmer, and more transluscent (like more tradition ramen noodles).I ate one bag of each, and loved every bite of both.  This was also about 4 hours ago, and I felt full this whole time (not uncomfortably full, just not hungry).I'm VERY glad I took a chance on this.  Perhaps if you have a picky pallet, this isn't for you.  But if you like Ramen noodles, then I'm telling you give these a try.  One bag (of either) is about the same volume as one packet of Ramen noodles, but at a fraction of the calories (or zero in the case of miracle noodles).  I plan on experimenting with other spices, such as bullion, and asian "flavor packets" found at the grocery store.Hope this helps!!

Be warned:  Shipping is very expensive (at least $18).  This is not indicated anywhere.  You will be much better off trying to find a store that carries them.As to the noodles, they were OK.  I tried them in a dish with a pesto-based sauce and shrimp.  They don't taste too bad, but they didn't hold the sauce like pasta would.  All the sauce slid down to the plate.  They might work better in a different dish.

I bought these at a upscale grocer near my house.  I used them in a dish with diced chicken, plenty of vegetables, and a mixture of asian sauces. column9: THEY'RE GREAT!!! Don't listen to the negative reviews
